'byu shing / 9lo (185)3385 byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi sgyur/bye /shi1nga / rtenadang po/ rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 3gnyis pa/ dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 12gsum pa/ gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 30bzhi pa/ nga las nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 57lnga pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 73drug pa/ ba da ra'i gling du 'gro ba'i yal 'dab/ 84bdun pa/ mu nyig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 110brgyad pa/ dpal sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 123dgu pa/ me skyes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 134bcu pa/ mngal nas 'byung ba bstan pa'i yal 'dab/ 1rga1

bcu gcig pa/ mdzes dga' bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 155bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 177bcu gsum pa/ 'phrog ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 198bcu bzhi pa/ cho 'phrul gye rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 206bco lnga pa/ lha las babs pa'i yal 'dab/ ༷ 216bcu drug pa/ brag nges par 'phangs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/235bcu bdun pa/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i yal 'dab/ 239bco brgyad pa/ me long gi bzhin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 244bcu dgu pa/ shā ri'i bu rab tu byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/251nyi shu pa/ gro bzhin bye ba rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 255nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ a mra skyong ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 273nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rgyal byed kyi tshal yongs su bzung ba'i yal 'dab/ 287nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i (ma/pa/racad/ba/ rten/ / nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ thams cad sgol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 316nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 323nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ bdud bcom pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 3rganyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ shākya byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 360nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i /ra/paparacad/ba/ rten/ tshonanyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ nor skyong gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 371sum cu pa/ kā shi'i mdzes pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 381sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ gser gyi logs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 393sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge byed kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 4002

sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ khyad par lo ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 409sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ dga' bo nye dga'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 417sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ khyim bdag legs sbyin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i (ra/paparatshod/ba/ tsamarten0sum cu rtsa drug pa/ gdangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 424sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 433sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ lkugs pa 'phye bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 444sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ bzod pa la dga' ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i pa //paparacad/ba/ zhengag ru bzhi bcu pa/ ser skya'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 458bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ u dā ya na'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ gre3bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ mkhas pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 501bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 513bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ gser gyi lag pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 517bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i (thapa /paratshod/ba/ ga rten0bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ byas shes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 530bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ sā la'i sdong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 537bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ don kun grub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i par(baparatshodatshob/ ga 'amalamabazhi bcu rtsa dgu pa/ glang po can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 553bsdur mchan/(568)3

'byu shing / a (186)3385 byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing / 619lnga bcu pa/ las bcu spyad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 619lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ gser ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 639lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ bsod nams mi dman pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'ad/ba/ 6grelnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ legs bshad 'tshol ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ ༷ 6ga ma lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ sems can sman zhes bya ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 66zadalnga bcu rtsa lnga pa/ thams cad ster ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 672lnga bcu rtsa drug pa/ klu ba lang skyong btul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ /tsho80lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa/ mchod rten gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 685lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 687lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ ku khā la'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 692drug cu pa/ klu gzhon nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 723drug cu rtsa gcig pa/ zhing pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 727

drug cu rtsa gnyis pa/ grags sbyin kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 731drug cu rtsa gsum pa/ 'od srungs chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i (5laparaḥd/ba/ tsa)tsam(3drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ nor bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 755drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ rwa gcig pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 802drug cu rtsa drug pa/ snyan dngags mkhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i pa /(paparacadathab/ 815drug cu rtsa bdun pa/ dge 'dun srungs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i pa /(baparaḥd/ba/ 829drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ pad+ma ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 841drug cu rtsa dgu pa/ chos kyi rgyal po rab gnas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'ad/ba/ sa ga rten/bdun cu pa/ nyi ma gung pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 862bdun cu rtsa gcig pa/ shā na'i gos can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'aḥd/ba/ 8(tsho3bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa/ nyer sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 866bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/ klu la springs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 876bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa/ sa gzhi phul pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 88༷bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'atshod/ba/ 8zadartenabadun cu rtsa drug pa/ bi du ra'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 884bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ kai ṣ+pe ya ka'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 887bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa/ brgya byin thong ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'atshod/ba/ sa 915

bdun cu rtsa dgu pa/ dbang chen sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 895brgyad cu pa/ rab bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 903brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa/ rgyu'i mchog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 917brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dmyal ba sngon ldan gye rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 921brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 928brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/ sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 933brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa/ phan pa 'tshol ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 941brgyad cu rtsa drug pa/ ba men gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 946brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa/ pad+ma can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 950brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ nag pa glang po'i stan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 956brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa/ chos sred kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 967dgu bcu pa/ nor can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 992dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa/ shi bi'i legs bshad kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 996dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ mdza' bo'i bu mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 1001dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 1011dgu bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ grags pa'i bshes gnyen gye rtogs pa brjod pa'i yala'adab/ 10276

dgu bcu rtsa lnga pa/ stag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1030dgu bcu rtsa drug pa/ glang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1033dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa/ rus sbal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1036dgu bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ dka' thub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1039dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa/ pad+ma can kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1041brgya tham pa/ bsod nams rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i (pa/paparacad/ba/ //nga tsamatsho/brgya rtsa gcig pa/ sngo bsangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1046brgya rtsa gnyis pa/ seng ge'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1052brgya rtsa gsum pa/ dga' ba'i gong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1055brgya rtsa bzhi pa/ ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1059brgya rtsa lnga pa/ ri ba ta'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1063brgya rtsa drug pa/ gser gyi go cha'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1069brgya rtsa bdun pa/ zas gtsang ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1073brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab/ 1077bstan bcos 'di ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul bstan pa/ 1112kya 'a sha dab brgya rtsa basbyo/da spyo) sdocas bstan pa/ 1115snyan dngags mkhan chen po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan dngags mkhan chen po laskyi ka ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong ston gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1135) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1181)7

༄ga /byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khya shing /ṭ+wā༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo bye sa tā ba 2 dā na kalpa la tā rte7 /༄spro/ /bod skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa 4dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing /na maḥsat+tha dzñā 'ang/ mnyam pa'i jit+ta la sa bcu bdun pa dal gyis gnon pa byu1lta 'ab su spa ḍi ka bi ma tshong ṣ+pe ba kṛrje ti thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang thugs dri bral shel la chags mtshon tsho3'dzin pa min pa nyid//rā shaṃ kā ru khyudz+re ma na se ni khi lāḥsho ṣi tā ye na do ṣāḥ/ /a kro dhe na swa ya ma bye ha to yid ni snying rjes brlan la gang gis (kyeskyon rnams ma lus bskams/ /gang gis khro ba med la rang gis ye na saṃ sā ra sha truḥsar+pā zlo sau bha ba tu bha ba tā gre ya se ni: lā ya//bcu dgu pa stag rnam rtsen/sasgo 'khor ba'i dgra mngon bcom/ /kun mkhyen de yis khyed la dge legs g.yo ba med gyur cig /dam pa'i yaḥ sbi ra dharma rū la ba la yaḥ pu rgyu la bā la sbi ti dhī be+e byā ka grib bsel dang ldan brtan pa'i chos kyi rtsa bas bskor cing lce7bsod nams ra bar gnas/ /blo dang rig ru rjam+bha pā di bi la sabyister+ṇa sha khā be+e taḥ/ /sarnyo khodz+dza la pal+la baḥpa snying rje la sogs chu yis rnam mdzes rnam par rgyas pa'i yal ga can/ /chog shes dri med yal 'dab

shu tsi ya sha ཿ pu t+pa ཿ sa dā sa t+pa la ཿ sa d+dhā sha pa ri pū ra ko grags/ snyan dkar ba'i me tog rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /bas/ma kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa bi dza ya te shrī bud+dhā kalpa dru maḥ/ 'dim/na kha sgo phan pa / /dzā ya te dza ga dudhertu saṃ sā ra dpa' ldan sa ngas rgyas/ ljo na pa/ rnam nga/ra rgya' gyur cig /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas la/sa/ /'gro ba ma ka rā ka rāta/ /ma tirma hā nu bhā bā nā ma tā nu shu ya te ya thā/ /gdon pa'i blo gros ni/ /mthu chen rnams 'a sa 1 'byung 'gyur te/ /de yang 'di skad rjes su/ thos / /a ste pra bhā ba tī nā ma he ma harmya kṛ haidṛ tā/ /pu ri pra bhā ba tī ba gser gyi ba gam gzhal yas khang / /khang nga/sa bsko ra ba'i grong khyer ni/ /'od ldan zhes bya bsod nams byebe+e mā ṣ+peḥ pu ju karma rde/ / bi t+yā dha ra ba tī sedhe gan+dharba ga ṇa la sa /'od lda na ma/tho ris lta bu yod/ /legs pa/ rnams kyis legs byas pa'i/ /rig 'dzin dang ldan se bi tā/ /tsā shri tā sha kra na ga rī su kṛ te na sa tā mi ba/ /se bi grub nga/ dang / /dre za'i tshogs/ kyis rab tu bsten/ /brgya byin grong khyer sar gshegs 'dra/ /chos kyi tā sa ta tai sa t+ya pra ta da na da yā ma me+eḥ/ /rā dza dh+wa dī ba dharma gya rgyal ngo/'i pho brang bzhin/ /bso/da nams/ khang nga/ bsnga gas/ 'os/ shing / /bden dang brtul zhugs sbyin pa pu bye bi sa tha shā li dī/ /a bhūdhū ti la kasta sde pra bhā so nā dang / /brtse ba'i rang bzhin gyis rtag bsten/ /gzi brjid la brten lha rnams kyis/ /gang gi grags ma bhū pa tiḥ/ /sa pra bhā sā da rer+ya khru tītī ra bh+yartsa ta su riḥ/ /gu ṇa sau pa mngon mchod pa/ /rab gsal zhes bya'i sa bdag de/ /der ni sa yi thig ler gyur/ /gang gi grags/ ra bha saṃ bhā rāḥsar+pā shā ha ri ṭ+wā dṛ shaṃ/ /yad+ma shaḥput+pa mañdzarlo yā tāḥkar+ṇa pa pa'i me tog gi/ /dog pa yon tan dri bzang tshogs / /phyogs kun ri dwags mig can gyi/ /rna ba yi ni tai sa tī/ /u pā ya dzha gya ya snga dzñā su bar+ṇa ku su modz+dza dze+e/ /mā khā mi pa rgyan du gyur/ /thabs shes ldan pa gang gi bka'/ /sa skyong mgo yi tshogs rnams la / /gser gyi me tog 95—4

tai—/ /lakhro be+e khā sa bha ba ā+oṃ bisma yā di t+ya ṭī ta yata/ /a ho na ba gnas—/ /de ni rnam gzigs sa yi bdag /ya mtshan gyur nas 'di ltar bsams/ /e ma gsar pa na bo ṅka r+ṣa ni rmā rja stsar+ya shā li r+ghaṃ / / ka rma rja ma na ba stson+d+ra saṃ gsar par ni/ /rab gyur ngo mtshar sprul byed pa/ /bsngags 'os las rnams 'khor bar ni/ /spros sā ra sarga san+ta tiḥ/ /a marje na su dh+wasto dhe ra nā yā se na bā su keḥ/ /pa'i rgyun dag ① chad pa med/ /bdud rtsi'i chu gter ma bsrubs shing / /nor rgyas thang yang ma bcad la//a nā kak+ṣe ṇa shi la su ke nā yi dza ni to ga dzaḥ/ /a tha haste ma hā mā tai saṃ ri bo bsgril ba med par ni/ /glang po 'di ni su yis bsgrun/ /de nas glang chen kha lo pa/ /kun tu yā tai nā ma byu ba tiḥ/ /ā di de shā rtsi tā de shaṃ ga dzo yo da mya tā mi ti/ /bgrod ces bka' gnyan khul/ /glang chen 'di ni thul cig ces/ /sa yi bdag pos kun tu bstan/ /ta dā di sh+ya ma tī pā le yā ten+ta pu ram̐ man+di ram̐/ /nā gi dza gā ha saṃ yā taḥde gdams sa skyong nang gi ni/ /grong gi khang par gshegs par gyur/ /bslab pa kun gyi khur bzod pa'i//sarba shi k+ṣu bha ra k+ṣa oṃ/ /sa sastso 6 i ba pādzhaḥmāstsad+mā sgyu sa yadh+ri taḥ/ /glang chen kun tu bgrod kyis sgobazung / /de yi ‘pyaslob ma dam pa bzhin/ /skye ba sngar goms dbang gyur pa/ /dī taste na pra yasne na sarba shik+ṣa bi nī ta hūṃ / /ba hu dā no ni rubye shes rab ldan des 3'bad med du/ /bslab pa kun gyis 67 rnam dul thob/ /sbyin mang gdung ba med pa ga shabyuṣ+ṭha ha yu ta k+ṣa m+bi/ /ri pu pra gha ti su ga tiḥs rā dzña stu l+ya dang / /stobs dang spro ldan bzod par ldan/ /dgra 'joms legs par 'gro ba de/ /rgyal po nyid dang tī ya yo/ /da mya gri yā sa mun+tiṇ+ḍi ta taste kuñdza re shwa ram̐/ /na re shwa mtshungs par gyur/ /de nas (7༄/glang po'i dbang po de/ /gdul/ ba'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ /bya ba byas rā ya saṃ yā taḥkṛ ta kṛ kyo n+ya be+e ta yata/ /dṛṭī ta saṃ ku shā yar+ghaṃ pa'i kun bgrod 5kyis/ /mi dbang la ni sbran par gyur/ /rnam 'gyur med pa'i stobs rgyas pa//95—6

nibe+e kā ra ba lo da yi/ /udh+wa ha shi kha rā rū d+ngha me ṣ+pe rā dzā dza ya lcags kyu'i dbang gyur de mthong nas/ /spro ba yi ni rtser zhugs ① pa/ /rgyal po'i dpal du rgyal pos shri yo/ /sa saṃ dzā ta pra hakhyorja dāk+ṣa shi k+ṣa di dṛk+ṣa yā/ / ta mā ru bsams—/ /de nas rab dga' yang dag skyes/ /mkhas par babe+ebs pa blta phyir de/ /'od stong shar ro ha sot+pa haḥs ha n+d+ra shu ri bo da yo/ /saṃ ya to tha ga dzen+d+ra gya madri ba kyi ri la bzhin/ /de la spro ba chen pos zhon/ /de nas glang po'i dbang po de'i(37/ /dkyil 'khor kun ba sha brti naḥ/ /sarba maṇ+ḍa la saṃ tsā ra tsā tutram̐ sa ma dar+sha yata/ /tu yang dag rgyu/ /mkhas pa blon bzhin dbang sgyur — ba/ /kun tu bgrod kyis yang dag brtan④ //ga dza pre nywa pra saṃ ge na mṛ ga yā ke li lā la saḥ/ /rā dzā ni dzon+d+ra ha mi ba rgyal po rang gi spro ba bzhin/ /glang po blta ba'i zhar la ni/ /rngon la rtse zhing dga' ldan pas/ /che ba'i bya gā ha ta ba rna ma hata/ /sa ya yo raza ke yu ra ki ra ṇi rdu ra sathi bhiḥ/ /shal+la nags su 'khyams par gyur⑤ / /rin cen dpung rgyan 'od zer ni/ /ring du 'phro de spyo shabe+e ka'i/ /lo khri pa l+la ba ba rirdi sna gā nā hwa ya: ba / / bra dzarnyi da dra shāste 'dab mchog gi ⑦phyogs kyi ni/ /glang rnams 'bod pa lta bur song / /nags su de ni 'gro ba dag /ba ṣ+pe ba na de ba tā/ /pra har+ṣa bisma yā shīr+ṇa kar+ṇa pū rī kṛ te k+ṣa shāḥ/ /rab dga' ya mtshan kun rgyas shing / /mig ni rna bar rdzogs byas pa/ /nags kyi lha yis mthong bar gyuraka/sha ba rī ka ba rī pā shi put+pa sau ra bha nir+bha rāḥ/ /bin dh+yā ba sun dh+wa rā pi shaṃ nor 'dzin gyi bdag dbang po ⑨de/ /sha ba ri yi skra tshogs kyis0/ /me tog dri bzang rdzogs pa'i rgyus/ /ma ru taste se ṣe bi re/ /a tha bi sbyo pa kabye 6 swa ts+tshan+da su kha shā 'bigs byed rlung gis bsten par gyur/ /de nas 'bigs byed nye ba ni/ /rang dbang bde ba'i 'dab khi 6/ /smṛ tā bi khā sa bṛṭ+wārnyi ga dza soṅkaste hūṃ ya yo/ /ka ri sgyuḥpre ldan par/ /rtse dga'i bsam skrupa dran gyur te/ /glang po shin tu rgod par gyur/ /dga' bas bcings

ma ba d+dhā yā ga n+dha ma gha ya sa dī paḥ / / bhā ti dṛ pa i bo྾ k+ta sta pa'i glang mo yishe / /dri ma sgom zhing gnyis 'thung de/ /mi bdag g.yer bas lugs bzhin du/ /lcags t+yā dzā ku sha yan+d+ra rde/ /sa be sha jo ba tasta su rā gā kṛṣ+ṭa su darnyi naḥ/ /kyu'i dbang du gyur pa btang / /so ldan 'dod chags kyis bkug pa/ /rjes su chags bcas rgyug pa de//be+e spru bhā gye ba saṃ sā re nā bha bid+ma ra tiḥ ka tsita/ /dṛ ṭī pra bhañdza rmongs pa 'khor ba dag la/ bzhin/ /gang du'ang dga' dang bral ma gyur/ /rlung bzhin mgyogs par na dza ba kuñdza re rā dzā kuñdza raḥ/ /bra dzarnyi dzā ta saṃ de haḥsaṃ yā ta mi da bgrod pa yi/ /glang po rtemathong nas the tshom ni/ /skyes pa'i rgyal po glang po yis kye/ /kun tu bgrod la ma bra bīta/ /a ho ba tā yo bha ba tā be+e na ya grwa hi to ga dzaḥ/ /dṛṣ+ṭaḥpra ya to be+e 'di smras so/ /kye ma ma la glang po 'di/ /khyod kyis 'dul ba 'dzin du btsudarge/ /lcags kyu phyi ba dag mu khye gu ro ra sri ku sha gya yaḥ/ /bh+ra ma tī ba di shaṃ tsakra ma nu yadhī las kyang / /gang zhig phyir phyogs so/nga ba mthong / /'di yi rkang brkod khur gyis ni/ /phyogs kyi 'khor ba pā da pāḥ/ /pā da t+yā sa bha re zla su ṭ+wā be+e shā sbor+ṇa te k+ṣi tiḥ/ /lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /rkang pas 'thung rnams rjes snyog 5bzhin/ /sa rnams kun 'khrul spyos pa bzhin/ /a smin+de ba i bā kā le pra yā te pra ti thi la ṭ+wā/ /sad+dhāḥpu ru ṣa kā ra 'dir ni kha rje dus min par/ /rab tu mi mthun gyur pa bzhin/ /skyes bu'i bya ba thams cad la//mya niphe lā yat+na bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /ba tsa khru te ti saṃ yā taḥpra sgo rā ya ta sā 'bad nga/sa zhugs pa 'bras med gyur/ /de ska da rje yi gsung thos nas/ /'jigs nga/ra gyur pa'i kun tu gha paḥ/ /shi k+ṣu pa da bād be+e la dzñā du bā tsa ra tsi tāñdza liḥ/ /de ba sarba bgrod / /bslab pa sma da pas skyengs gyur cing / /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas smras/ /lha 9gcig bdag kri yā yat+taḥkuñdza ro yi ma yā kṛ taḥ/ /ka ra d+dhā gan+dha mā ghā ya yā taḥki twa r+ya gi glang po 'di/ /bya ba kun gyi dbang du bgyis/ /'on kyang de )ring glang mo yi/ /dri ma mnam zhing ༷8 95—8

bi kri yī/ /no pa de shaṃ na ni ya mi na dāk+ṣi bye na sā dhu tī/ /sma rarnyi dzan+ta baḥrnam 'gyur gyur/ /'dod pa'i dbang du gyur pa yi/ /skye bo rnams ni man ngag min/ /sdom pa ma yin kā oṃ kā ma su ba sha mā ga tā ཿ / / ke na sī ti ra soh+phi gh+ra ṣa yon min zhing / /legs pa nyid min 'dod pa dran/ /yul la rmyemangon par phyogs pa'i blo/ /dga' yā bhe mu khā+e ma tiḥ/ /a da bh+ra shwa bh+ra bi bh+raṣ+ṭa shi la ku bye ba bār+ya te/ /ba'i ro la chags gyur pa/ / gshong gshong mang por kyeri yi chu/ /rnam par lhung khyebazhin su yis ṣebazlog/sha rī ra shra ma shi k+ṣa yī da na kāḥku sha khā ba yo/ /ma no ni ya ma shik+ṣa yī lus ni ngal ba'i bslab pa la/ /'dul bar byed pa kho bo mkhas/ /yid ni sdom pa'i babe+eb pa la//mu na yo pi na paṇ+ḍi tāḥ/ /rā gā da ga ṇi tā yā saḥsnga li tā khi la saṃ ya thub pa rnams kyang mkhas pa yin3/ /chags las ngal bar kyemi rtsi zhing / /bsdams pa ma lus bral gyur maḥ / /e ṣa dh+wa ba t+ya mārge ṇa mūkho kha la i pa dwo baḥ/ /bṛk+ṣa sā khaṃ sam pa mā te—/ /ngan rmongs bzhin du lam min nas/ /gnyis 'thung 'di ni rab tu rgyug /skye bo ngan pa ya ngar la sbya t+ya dze rna thra dī pa teḥ / /bya sa ni pa ti ta sa h+ye pā ta ya lhung kye/ /nges par lhung bar 37bkyid pa nyid/ /sa bdag ljon pa'i lo ma rnams/ /yang dag bzung sheh+ye ba durdza naḥ/ /saṃ yā ta su ba ཿkhru tā taṭ+wā la sa dṛ shaṃ dṛ paḥ/ /te be+e ba la 'di ni thong rngu / /mi bdag gis ni kun tu 'gro'i/ /de dus su 'os tso1tshig thos nas/ /de dang lhan sa hi ta shā khā mā la lo be ma hā ta roḥ/ /a ba tīr+ya ta ro ra shwa mā ru hra dṛ cig shing chen byu/ /lo ma dag la nyu5'phyangs par gyur/ /mi bdag shing las babs gyur te/ /rta la zhon pa to ga te/ /zwa myu li dzi ga ka ri bhā be+e gā khya ga ha ā+oṃ ga dzaḥ/ /ta taḥnas gshegs par gyur/ /glang po kye nags su 'khyams gyur pas/ /glang mo la ni 'khyud pa thob/ /de shān+ta sma ra ha s+t+ri di ṣ+pe ra bye sa p+ta bye ཿ khye / / swa ya mā la na se 'og glang chen 'dod pa zhi/ /nyin zhag bdun gyis 'dod ngapa'i sar/ /rang nyid mngon du 'ongs shing 95—9

ba k+ta sta sgo ka tsa la khā pa ཿ / / shi k+ṣu saṃ ya ma ya dh+ri ta ཿchags—/ /bza' ba mngon par 'dod cing gnas/ / bslab pas bsdams ①pa'i dbang gyur cing //tai dṛṭī swa ya mā ya tai/ /saṃ yā ta kau sha loṅkar+ṣa har+ṣa da rā dze n+ya be+e da yata/ /rang nyid 'ongs pyapa de mthong nas/ /mkhas pa shin 3tu dga' ba yi/ /kun tu bgrod kyis rgyal la smras/ /rā ga ba gu ra yā kṛṣ+ṭaḥbra ya yo yaḥ sma rāt+ta raḥ / /shi k+ṣu yā ma chags pa'i zhags pas drangs gyur cing / /'dod pas gzir nas rab song gang / /babe+eb pa dag dang bi saṃ bā dī so yi pābe+eḥswa yo ga dzaḥ/ /sa saṃ ke ta yadh+ri tai ba sh+ya ra sa mi 'gal bar/ /glang po 'di de rang nyid 'ongs/ /brda ④dang ldan pa'i dbang gyur gzigs/ /sa la dzhaḥsal+la tī bhu r+pā/ /saṃ tap+ta lo ha ka ba lo kṛṇ+ḍa ti bi na ye spri taḥ/ /e ṣa tī sa'i ro shes pa/ /shin tu tsha ba'i be+egs kyi zas/ /'dzin cing dul ba dag tu gnas/ /'di ni kā ma ra sā kṛṣ+ṭaḥ kaṣ+ṭa bi kṛ ti mā ya yo/ /pu naḥpra kṛ ti mā ban+daḥ'adod pa'i ro yis 'udrangs/ /kun tu sdug bsngal ro yis drangs/ /'dod pa'i rims ni rab zhi nas/ /pra shān+ta ma da na dz+wa raḥ/ /shākyā da ma yi hūṃ de ba mo ha byā gh+ra ga dzā da yaḥ/ /phyi nas rnal du gnas pa thob/ /lha gcig seng ge stag dang ni/ /glang po la sogs 'dul 37 bar nus/ /na tu rā gā sa ba spyi bi pi ṣa yā nyi mu khaṃ ma naḥ/ /e ta dā kasbya khyu chags pa'i chang gis myos pa'i yid/ /yul la mngon par phyogs pa min④/ /de dag thos nas sa skyong pā lastat+ta the ti bi tsin+ta yan/ /u bā tsa sa t+ya mu tsi tai saṃ yā ta ka gis—/ /de de bzhin zhes bsams nas smras/ /kun tu bgrod khrod bden pa dang / /rigs snyepa dag thi tai twa yā/ /a pyaste kash+yikhro kesmin ye na tsit+ta ma da dī paḥ/ /m+bi tu brjod pa yin/ /rab zhi 7tshul khrims gang dag gis/ /sems kyi gnyis 'thung myos pa ni/ /sdom taḥ pra sha ma shī le na saṃ ya mā li na hūṃ/ /i h+phuste de ba tā bi ṣ+ṭaḥpa'i thag pas btags gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'di na 'ga' yod dam/ /de skad smras tshe kun tu bgrod/ /95—10

saṃ yā ta sta ma bhā ṣa ta ཿ / / de ba sarnyi dza gasgre sha ni she khon+d+ra lha ni bzhugs 1pas de la smras/ /lha gcig 'go ba'i nyon mongs rnams/ /ma lus 'joms pa la brtson la nod+mā tāḥ/ /bi be ka kā la tā lo ke bai rā gya li tā gra hāḥ/ /sha ma sarnyo ṣa bi zhing / /rnam par rig ldan 'jig rten na/ /'bad pas chags bral skyed pa yod/ /zhi dang chog shes dri ṣa dā budha e ba pra bo bye naḥ/ /i ti bud+dhā bhe d+dhā khru twa sa myakle bo bye ma med/ /rab rtogs sangs rgyas kho na'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas mtshan thos pas/ /skye ba sngar skyes tse ta saḥ/ /rā dzñāḥpāgyud+ma dzā sgyu sāta pra ṇi dh+wa na ma dzā ya ta/ /bi ni madz+dzadz+dza goms pa las/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rgyal po yi ni smon lam skyes/ /'khor ba chu ga di rda saṃ sā re ma ka rā ka re/ /saṃ tā ra ye yo saṃ bo bye muk+taḥsrin 'byung gnas su/ /rnam par byengs pa'i rte7'gro ba 'di/ /dge ba'i lam nas rdzogs pa yi — —//ku la sha la se tu nā/ /sa tho tsurde ba ta byo snaste shud+dhā bā sa kā yi kāḥ/ /byang chub grol bar yang dag bsgral/ /de nas de la nam mkha' las/ /gtsang ma ris kyi lha yis cesmras/ /saṃ myak+shi bo dhi saṃ busgo bha bi 6 se ma tī pa te/ /i ti tad+ma tsa na yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ /sa bdag mngon par 'tshang rgya ye'agyur/ /de skad de yi tshig thos shu tā rā dzā bi ra dza saṃ ra baḥ/ /dzā ti sma ro di bya tsak+ṣuḥpra ya yo bo bye pas—/ /rgyal po rdul bral rnams kyi mchog /skye ba dran zhing lha mig ldan/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid satwa tā/ 'di yan kha sgo phan pa// /a tha sa bi pu la sa twasta twa nik+ṣip+ta tsak+ṣusgo ba dza la du gyur/ /de nas de ni snying stobs yangs sgo7ldan mig ni de nyid dag la gtad/ /srid pa'i chu gter ni dhi madz+dzat+parba bhū tā nu kam+bi/ yi ge bco lnga pa'i nang tshan phreng ldan ma//a bha ba da bhe na bod+mahūṃ bi byings pa'i 3'byung po kun la rjes su brtse ldan zhing / /yang dag rig pa spro ba dang ldan mngon par gsar dun+d+ra ha yo gāta ka li ta ku sha la se tū sa twa saṃ tā ra khyo ya/ /pa bskyed pa las/ /sems can rnams ni yang dag bsgral phyir dge ba'i lam dag bgyis par gyur//95—11

i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 1rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing pra bhā sā ba dā dz+wa pabe+e baḥpra tha maḥs māp+taḥ// //las rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dang po'o// //te dza yarnyi dza ga t+ya smin pu rgya tsan+da na pā da pāḥ/ /ts+tsha da gang zhig bcad bdar trebasregs pas kyang / /gzhan byi don la bslu rmyemed pa/ /'gro 'dir nir+ghar+ṣa dā he pi ye pa rāze 6 nirgya thāḥ/ /ga ṇa m+bi ya gu ṇa ga nai bsod nams tsan+dan gyi/ /rkang 'thung de dag rgya' gyur cig /a riṣ+ṭa zhes bya ba'i gong bya/ /yon tan rasbya ribye nyi dh+wa pu riḥ/ /sbad+dhā yā sha kra na ga rī ya t+yā na sā na ga rī ya sī/ /tshogs kyi zhebagrang bya ba/ /'gran zla brgya byin grong khyer ni/ /gang las brling ba min gyepa yod/ /der ta sde ba bhū ba bhū pā la shrī se na i ti bi khru taḥ/ /sa ma gra gu ṇa raṭ+wā dzā ni sa skyong byung gyur pa/ /dpal gyi sde zhes rnam par grags/ /yon tan rin cen tshogs rnams kyi//rat+na ka ra i bā ka raḥ / /pa ro pa kā ra sak+ta su tsa tur+ya su pra 'byung gnas rin cen 'byung gnas bzhin/ /gzhan la phan pa'i nus pa can/ /gang gi mthu yis phyogs bhā ba taḥ/ /a nu raghā di shaḥsad+dhāḥsur+ya gya ba pra bhā ba taḥ/ /ya sho dīḥsho rnams kun/ /rjes su chags shing mdzes gyur pa/ /nyi ma yi ni 'od kyis bzhin/ /stug por byin mupa'i bhe tai ye na gha na dā na su garnyi byeḥ/ /ga dze+e: byu ti dha ba be+erdza gaṅkalpa dri bzang can/ /'byor pa dkar ba'i grags pa dang / /glang po gang gis 'gro ba dag /mdzes pa dru be+e ri ba / / ka lā la yo pi sha ra la ཿ sha ra lo pi ma dpag bsam ljon pa bzhin/ /skye rgu'i kebasod nams kyis bskrun po gang / /sgyu rtsal gnas kyang drang hā ma nyiḥ/ /ba pu ba pra dzā pu byed+ma ma ti mā na su baṃ tsa kaḥ/ /yā bat+ta pa ti tirja por kye —gyur/ /drang por gyur kyang blo gros che/ /blo ldan gyur kyang slu byed min/ /ji srid tsha zer gyis 95—12

shur+yā bad+ma ha ti ma ru taḥ/ / ta ba dā dzñā tsa tīrti: ya sgyu pra ti ha tā gdungs dang hūṃ / /ji srid rlung ni skyed zubyed pa/ /de srid gang gi bka' dang ni/ /grags pa rab tu bha ba ta/ / sa ma byā yā ma bi du ྾ ṣaḍa gu ṇa dzñā na tsak+ṣu ṣe/ /yo gzhom med gyur/ /mtshungs pa 1ngal zhing mkhas pa dang / /yon tan drug shes mig dang ldan/ /blon dā da sha sa ha sru ṇi ma: rde prarlu pā sa te/ /tasmin+dharma pu re rā rnyi ba po stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis/ /gang zhig yongs su nye bar bsten/ /chos gtsor 'dzin pa'i rgyal po der/ /byu ba su kṛ tī dza naḥ/ /bhadṛ tu spyo bha bakhye ba gu ṇiste ya i ba pra dzāḥ/ /skye bo legs byas ldan par gyur/ /skye rgu jerje dang yon tan kyis/ /mtshungs pa kho na bud med bzhin//ta su pudh+yā pi bā se na dza nāste di ba gā mi naḥ/ /bi mā ṣ+peḥsha kra na ga rī niḥde yi bsod nams dbang gis ni/ /skye bo mtho ris 'gro ba yi5/ /gzhal med khang gi 6brgya byin grong / /saṃ tsā rāḥpra tsa kri re/ /dṛṭ+wā ma nu dza lo ke na su ra lo ka sa mā bṛn+ti/ /lam dang bral bar rab tu byed/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag tu mi'i/ /'jig rten yang dag zhugs mthong nas//dzā ta be+e raḥk+ṣi ti pa to sha ta kra tu ra tsin+t+ra yata/ /se ṣ+pe na lasmyu ba su dhe 6 tsā ra sa bdag la ni khro ba dag /skyes te mchod sbyin brgya pas bsams/ /kye ma sa spyod dpal gyi sdes/ /kye ma sa spyod dpa la gyi sdes sogs kyi 1 ka gcig ngo 'di'i rgya ska da ma dpe tshor chad pa dbang ngo/ rdo rje'i sdeb sbyor du za hor gyi bsdes bsgrigs pa slar sngabyur+ya kārta bya tsa dat+ta ni bye/ /ka l+ya rgya shī len tsa sazla tse ta n+ya pra blu hā sā rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/ /shin tu sbyin par byed pa dang / /dge ba'i khrims kyis skye rgu 3rnams/ /bdag dang ma na asma ka:/ /ta sruḥkhaṇ+ḍi ta tse tā saḥdadh+rid+ma spyo nu bhā pā shā/ /mtshungs par rab tu bkod/ /bdag gis sgyu ma bsgrubs nas ni/ /sbyin pa'i snying stobs mthu ldan zhing / : /tshe sbyin nga 'i snying stobs mthu ldan zhing zhes pa 'i tshig rkang gcig ngo 'di'i ska da dod mi 'dug pa zang nga ga'an rnams dang mthun pa ra kha sgo yangs ma'i sdeb sbyor du 'dar 'o sa bkod pa rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/karta byā byer+ya dzi dzñā sā ma yā mā yā bye dh+wa yi rmā/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya su tsi re swa sems ni nyams pa med pa de'i/ /brtan pa rab tu brtag par bya/ /de ltar yu na ring rnam bsams nas/ /95—13

be+e ra nu ga taḥsu riḥ/ /rū paṃ sha kraḥpa rā thra t+ya mju lo ka ma bā ta rata/ / brgya byin ⑫gzugs ni gzhan bsgyur /thute/ /rjes 'brang lha ni nyung ngu dang / /mi yi 'jig rten dag tu a tra n+ta re pra dzā kā r+ya pa r+yā lo tsa na ta t+pa raḥ / / rā bye zhugs—/ /skabs der blo bzang blon po ni/ /rgyal srid srung ba'i bla ma yis/ /skye rgu'i 7bya ba gtso bor rak+ṣu gu ru madh+ri dṛ pa spru shwe ma hā ma tiḥ/ /rā dzan bi ra dza sā rā bye rā dza mā ni—/ /yongs tog ④mi yi bdag la smras/ /rgyal po rgyal srid mdzes ldan zhing / /rdul bral zol ṣ+pe na nirdzi taḥ/ /nirgyu dza dā ṣ+per+bha ba tā ladz+dza ti tri da she shwa raḥ/ /med sbyin byed pa/ /khyod kyis skabs gsum dbang phyug ni/ /pham par byas pas ngo tshar ltagyur/ /pa ra gya pūr+ṇa gu ṇa tā mād+ma nasta dī tī na hūṃ/ /dṛṭī go nā ma nā yā ti gzhan gyi yon tan rdzogs pa dang / /bdag nyid de las dman pa ni/ /mthong nas phrag dog rnam 'phrul dag/māt+pa r+ya su bi dhī ya tsā/ /idh+yā la paḥpa roṅkadh+ya saṃ ghastso 6 dzu kho dza nāḥ/ /nges pa kho nar cis mi 'byung / /chen po rnams kyi legs byas la'ang / /khyad 'phags gzhan la 'gran pa'i me//pā ye khorbe ga mā yādhi ma hā hūṃ su kṛ te ṣ+ṭa pi/ /sarba swa dā na mar+yā dā dā bsten 6pa'i skye bo phrag dog can/ /phal cher gdung bas nyan rngopar 'gyur/ /sbyin la gcags pa khyod na bya pa ni nostu te/ /pu tra dā rāt+pa dā ni tu saṃ kaspo gya ti sā ha saḥ/ /kyi 8ni/ /nor kun sbyin pa lugs su gyur9 / /bu dang chung ma bdag nyid kyang / /sbyin bsam thub chod dṛ sha rnye dā ru shā ste te swa rtswaḥ sā gha sa te ta ba ཿ / / dza ga ta ཿshin tu ches/ /gang gis 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rmyeni/ /nor bu nyams byed rab brjod pa/ /shin tu drag sru tsu te tī bra yesgo ḍa ma ṇi khaṇ+ḍa nā/ /de ba dzñā rmā pra bā dbya thra ya te cing 'jigs pa'i rgyu/ /mi bzad rmi lam de de mthong / /rnam shes de nyid smra ba rnams/ /sa skyong sku ta twa bā di rna/ /sha rī ra thra thi bī pā lo dā su tī ti su duḥs haḥ/ /sha lus sbyin pa ni/ /bgyid par 'gyur zhes brnag dka'i (: gtam/ /rab tu smra ba dag kyang thos/ /lus 95—14

rī ra dā dz+wa sar+pābe+e sārja naiphe l+ya kā ra rte/ /sarba pra de bha ba t+ya ba tiṣ+ṭha kyi sbyin pa slong ba'i tshogs/ /kun byu 'bras bu med pa'i rgyu/ /dpag bsam sar skyes gnas pa ni//na kalpa ma tī ru haḥ/ /tasmra dasmran ma tī pā la bi ra ma t+yā ga sā ha sāta/ /kun la rab tu byin gyur ①nyid/ /de phyir sa skyong khyod kyi lus/ /'gro ba bsrung ba'i rin cen phyir//rak+ṣu rarja hi dza ga taḥpra dzā yadzhai ba pusta ba/ /i ti madh+ri ba re khok+ta skye rgu'i 5dbang gyur gtong ba yisazu/ /thub chod 'di la dgyes bral mdzod/ /blon po'i mchog gis smras mā ba sbya ba su dh+wa bye pa ཿ / / ta mū tse sa twa dha ba la smi ta pa ni④/ /thos nas nor 'dzin bdag po ni/ /snying stobs dkar 'dzum gyis bkrus pa'i/ /mchu mdzes sgo tā bha rad+ku tiḥ/ /uste hi tai ma hā mā t+ya bha ba tā sa tsi bo tsi tai/ /ki twabe+e ldan pas de la smras/ /blon po chen po khyod kyis ni/ /blon por 'os 3shing phan pa brjod/ /'on kyang dza na bai mu khya saṃ tā paṃ nā ha mun+d+ra he/ /de tī ti bā di 6 gi ro slong skye phyir phyogs pa'i/ /gdung ba bdag gyegis yongs mi bzod/ / slongs shig meces ni brjod pa la//ni ṣe dha ba ru ṣā k+ṣa rāḥ/ /sgu rabye ba tsa ṣ+pe ye ྾ sa dz+re bste ga tā sha baḥ/ /i dgag pa'i yi ge rtsub mo'i tshig /gang gi kha nas rnam par rgyu/ /de dag gson po srog song yin/ /'di da masmra da bāsgyu m+bi t+yā dh+wa ya z-i di yā tsa kaḥ/ /pābe+eḥpra yāste bai mu khye las 'di ni thob 'gyur zhes/ /snying la bzung nas slong ba po/ /'ongs pa gang las phyir phyogs shing //yal+līṅge te na dz+re ba tā / / byestsad+ma purgya tī na gya ta gya niṣ+ka ru shād+ma de yi 'gro ba gson pas 2ci/ /sdug bsngal skye bo gang dag giXḍari/ /gdung ba thos dwa/ pas yid bsil naḥ—/ /ya myurta dza na saṃ tā pa shra ba ṇi shī ta lasma naḥ/ /e ta darja ma zhing / /snying rje med pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bsod nams zhan de'i skye ba smad/ / 'ga' zhig tu hu5ni yi kā yaḥpa pa yo pi sa hūṃ thra yaḥ/ /yaṅka su tsita kwa tsid yā ti ka dā 'ga' zhig tshe/ /gang ⑫zhig 'ga' la phan par 'gyur/ / de don /5 legs pa rnams kyi lus/ /'di ni 95—15

tsi du pa kā ri tsā/ /khru two ti 1 pa ter+pā kya ma mā t+yaḥs twa shā li nāḥ/ /gnod par bcas kyang dga'/ /mi bdag snying stobs ldan pa'i tshig /de skad thos nas blon po ni//no bā tsa kiñtsi da tsa dze+e bi tsi t+ya bha be+e ta bya tī/ /ta taḥka dā tsid bhū bhartu sta g.yo ba med par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bsams nas ci yang mi smra'o/ /de rjes nam zhig sa yi rje/ /rol gya lī khā bi hā ri ṇaḥ/ /dzā yī dza ya pra dzñā nā ma ra ti ra ti pa te ri cing rnam par gnas pa de'i/ /btsun mo rgyal ba'i 'od ces pa/ /dga' ma'i bdag mo'i 1dga' ma baḥ / /dru rād+ma dṛts+tsha yā yā tabyet+ta sā re ga bā gu dzā/ /mu ni ra bzhin—/ /mdzes ma sems kyi ri dwags zhags/ /'chad la mkhas pa'i thub pa ni/ /ring nas rang dh+yā pa kaḥ kārnyi da dar+sha bi ni me ṣa dṛka /pāstsad+mān+ta ra sa sbran+dha sne dgar 'ongs gyur pa/ /mig ni 'dzum bral 'dzin pas mthong / /skye ba snga ma gzhan dag tu/ /'byel hāt+pa ri tsi tā mi ba/ /tai dṛṣ+ṭa sa j-i teḥpā pa dher+ya rā shi ra nī sha hūṃ/ /zhing mdza' bas 'dris pa bzhin/ /de mthong de yi 3'dzin pa dang / /brtan pa'i phung po gtsor ma gyur//ta gya bī ta smṛ ha myu pi pā sa nobe+e ṣi tasma naḥ/ /udṛ bye bha ba bai de yi yid ni chags bral yang / /bag chags kun nas langs gyur cing / /dngos las phyir phyogs btang mu khya ma bya lā ṣa bhu baṃ ya yo/ / i yo nyi sa ta takhru tā san+ta ta gyur te/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i sa la sogs1/ /gang phyir srog chags thams cad kyis nga/ /skye ba spru nyi tai tu bhiḥ/ /na bai ti sarba dzan+d+ra dzā prastsad+mā sgyu sa bā sa nā/ /sngar goms bag chags ni/ /rgyun du dga' ba'i skud pa yis/ /rtag tu btsems 'di med mi 'gyur//ta mā shra ma pa rda pābye sa mābhā dh+ya ya na bra taḥ/ /shi stso mā ṇa ba rka de ni gnas su 'ongs pa la/ /yon ni blang bar mdzod cig ces/ /klog snye pa'i brtul zhugs yongs pā ha dak+ṣi zla kṛ tse tā mi ti/ /sa ta rū tse na me bat+pa ba ṣ+pe bisteḥpra rdzogs pa'i/ /slob ma bram ze'i khye'u 6smras/ /de la des ྅ smras mnyes gshin dag /nags su bdag la 95—16

yo dza rgo/ /ta thā pi ya di nirban+dhaḥshā ya tsā ya da dībe+e tai/ /shrī se na nor mi dgos/ /'on kyang snying nas gus pa na/ /gang zhig mngon par 'dod pa nyon/ /sa bdag gya k+ṣi ti pa ter+ya di de bī dza ya pra bhā/ /la bh+ya te bha ba tā dā tun+ta da sau ma dpal sde'i lha mo ni/ /rgyal ba'i 'od de gal te na/ /khyod kyis sbyin du thob nyupa na/ /'di ni bdag gi ma da k+ṣi rja/ /i trut+ta gu ru rja khru tā shi6ཿkam+bi ta mā na saḥ/ /a shā kya yon du 'gyur/ /de skad bla mas brjod thos nas/ /slob ma'i yid ni rab tu 'dar/ /mi phod bslang 4 pārja lā bhe saṃ sha ya ku li to bha ba ta/ /sa ga tā sa ta ta swe sgo be+e bṛ na rnyed pa la/ /the tshom kun tu 'khrugs par gyur/ /de ni slong rnams rang 'dod bzhin/ /rtag tu ta dā ra mabe+e dzā/ /bi be+e sha swe ra bi shaṃ bha bha ba ram̐ bhu j-i tsā pra sgoḥ/ /gdangs pa'i sgor song nas/ /sa skyong rnams kyi gtso bo yi/ /khang pa/ra yid ches zhan pas zhugs//a la sgyu ṭ+wā rja nā de n+ya tsid+dhā ti mā na saḥ / / na mru na no ti be+e mi 'thob dogs slong zhum pa yi/ /bsams pas yid ni mi g.yo zhing / /shin tu skyengs la/sa gdong btud lak+ṣujok+ṣa mā ṇa i ba k+ṣi ti/ /tai dṛṭībe+e na mā yā tai pra z-iṣ+ṭa byud ma tī pa de—/ /sa la rtog cing lta ba bzhin/ /slong ba 'ong ba de mthong nas/ /sa bdag rab tu dgyes par teḥ / /su dh+wa pra dā na san+dadha sa mud bhū ti i r+pā bu dhiḥ/ /kin+ta bespru ta mi gyur—/ /bdud rtsi rab sbyin chas pa yi/ /chu gter yang dag rgyas gyur 5bzhin/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa ci kyuk+ta pu dzi ta sa ma tī bhu dzā/ /u bā tsā nu tsi tā khyu na be+e la byeji li tā zhig ces/ /brjod nas sa la spyod pas mchod/ /'os pa min brjod ngo tsha zhing / /yi ge 'khrul bar de k+ṣa raḥ/ /a nathi ta pa raḥpūrba mabe+e kalpa ta rosta ba/ /gu rārja yis smras/ /khyod ni slong ba'i dpag bsam shing / /sngon chad gzhan gyis ma babe+engs shing / /shin tu mabe+e hūṃ yā taḥ su durla bha pa de pya haṃ / /ma ma bi byā bra te pūr+ṇa rnyed dka'i gnas de yang / /bla ma'i don du bdag slo/nga gyur/ /bdag gi rig pa'i brtul zhugs sdogs//95—17

dak+ṣi shā bye ma tā gu roḥ/ /rā dzan dza ya pra bhā de bī dī ya tī ya di shā kya slob dpon mngon par 'dod pa'i yon/ /rgyal po lha mo rgyal ba'i 'od/ /gal te phod na gnang ①bar te / /i h+phuste mu ni shi bye ṇa sa ha me+e ba ma tī pa teḥ/ /sgo ha dā mdzod—/ /thub pa'i slob mas de brjod pa'i/ /'phral nyid sa yi bdag po la(snye/ /mdza' dang sbyin na ra sā be+e dhe dī dh+wa bhū ta ma byud+ma naḥ/ / sa dza gā da dī dze+e dan+ta pa'i ror gcags pa 7/ /rnam pa gnyis shig (pyabyung bar gyur/ /so yi 'od zer mdun dkrigs pas//byi ti ṣā gra bi pā ri ṇa/ /kṛ hra tsā da yi ā+oṃ swats+tsha ba sa sā ts+tsha da snying du sdug pa'i btsun mo dag /dkar ba'i gos kyis g.yogs pa bzhin/ /de yis gnyis skyes ‘37dag yin+da ba/ /a bi tsār+ya ma yā de ba ya m+bismi tai ta ba yad gu roḥ/ /bi yo ga la smras/ /'bral bas 'jigs pa'i sems la yang / /nga yis bden par mi rtsi skyezhing / /rnam par mi tsa ki haṃ tse taḥs bye na ga ṇa yā mya haṃ/ /i t+yāgh+ra z-i da ya da yi hūṃ rā dzā dpyad khyod kyi ni/ /bla ma gang bzhed bdag gis sbyin/ /de skad brjod nas rgyal ba tso7yis/ /btsun mo rā dz+re ba lo tsa ram̐/ /sa rā z-i da ya saṃ sas+t+ri dz+re ba thratrī mi bā pa dzā/ /byā bā pad+ma'i spyan ldan ma/ /rtag tu snyeng la yang dag gcags2/ /'tsho srog gzhan pa lta bu bos/ /'bral ri te pi gu ru rja pi yo ga bya pa nābyā nā/ /ni ṣirnyo su ti bṛsne na bas gdung ba'i me dag ni/ /bla mar gyur pas 9 bzlog gyur cing / /mdza' ba shin tu 'phel ba yi/sne he na sma ra ban+tu nā/ /pra da do mu ni shi 6 ya sa ha sā ha ri ṇi mi 'dod pa'i gnyen gyis bkag gyur kyang / /thub pa'i slob la rab tu byin/ /'phral la ri dwags mo bzhin ba / /ki me ta di ti sa yā sa saṃ tā sa ta ra lek+ṣa rde/ /daṭ+wā yāsgyu ga shī li na du—/ /'di ni ci zhes ngal ba dang / /skrag bcas mig ni rig rig gyur/ /sa spyod gtong ba'i ngang can pri yā yāḥthra thi bī bhu dzā/ /tsa kam+bi t+yā ga dī te ba byu mi lo lādhi gyis—/ /dga' ma btang bar gyur pa la/ /gtong bas 'jigs pa bzhin du sa/ /chu gter ske rags 95—18

me kha lā/ /ya1 te durda shī de he sa hi re duḥs hā sā pi/ /in+d+ra g.yo ldan 'dar/ /gang phyir lus la gnas skabs ngan/ /dbang po zla sogs lha rnams kyis/ /bzod tsa n+d+ra da yo de bā stu ཿ thra yā ka gya na pri yā ཿ / / shī lo ke dka' de yang 37bzod byed pa/ /dga' ma de la su mi dga'/ /la la'i tshul khrims la la'i nor/ /la tsita dha 8 ke tsita dharmi ke tsita paḥpa re/ /ladz+dza ke tsita ta nu ke tsita ta t+ya dzurlo la'i dka' thub la la'i chos/ /la la'i ngo tsha la la'i lus/ /bud med ched du btang bar gyur/ /skyes ṣi tī kṛ te/ /ya de ba rā ga sarba sri sum̐ sī dz+re be+e ta dz+re be+e tai/ /ta de ba spyi ta sa tā dzā bu rnams kyi ⑤'tsho ba'i srog /chags pa'i nor kun gang dag nyid/ /de nyid sems dpa' che rnams kyis5snye//dā ṣ+pe tre ṇa la bā ya te/ /ta mā dā ya ga te da smin bi ra hā ku li to sbyin la thurtswa yi gzegs ma bzhin/ /de ni blangs nas song bas de thu/ /bral bas yid 'khrugs mi yi dṛ paḥ/ /bi ra tī naḥsu kha dwo ྾ ma no bha ba i bā bha bta/ /shi bye ṇa mu bdag /dga' ma dang bral bde la sdang / /yid 'byung bzhin du rab tu gyur/ /slob mas sa bdag ni rā m+bi tī dṛṭī bhū pa ti bal+la rja/ /ra hi tī dz+re bi te ṣ+pe ba pa ra chung ma ni/ /'tsho ba dang bral 'jig rten dag /pha rol sar bgrod gyebazhin blangs shing me/ /'ong ba lo ka ju baṃ ga hūṃ/ /gā ṭ+wā nu sha ya saṃ tap+taḥpa re ladz+dza ni m+bi li taḥ/ /thub pas mthong gyur te thu/ /'gyod pa drag pos yang dag gdungs/ /mchog tu ngo tshas shin tu zhum//a tsin+ta ya da no tsi t+ya mād+ma naḥkarma bi bla bāta/ /a ho nu bā la ke ṣ+pe las ni rnam par bslad pa las/ /bdag nyid rigs pa min par bsams/ /kye ma ma rabs byis pa ba ma ya ke ba la tsā pa khāta/ /ni shaṃ ka ma ya shaḥpaṃ ke swa ya māt+na bzhin—/ /bdag gis g.yo ba 'ba' zhig las/ /grags pa min pa'i 'dam du ni/ /dogs med rang ni ni pa ti taḥ/ /a yi pra dzā dzā dza na bhā dharme shā dharma kā ri khyo/ /gis bdag nyid bskyur/ /bdag ni chos min byed pa yis/ /rigs gnas bla ma'i btsun mo ni//95—19

bar+ṇa shra ma gu ro ra dzā yā ma yā duḥkhā na lebe+e tā/ /kin+tu nā ka li tai shī chos kyi skye rgu'i hūṃmar gyur 'di/ /sdug bsngal med ༷rte7la rab tu gtad/ /bdag gis ldutshul khrims ma lo na smṛ taḥ saṃ yā mo mo yā/ / ga ṇi tai ṣ+pe ra bai rā gyi bi be+e ko bsams shing / /yang dag sdom pa ma dran la/ /chags dang bral nyid ma rtsis ④shing / /dben pa rnam nā ba lo ki taḥ/ /a ho tra nibe+e tsā rā rde sad+mārga bi mu khaṃ ma naḥ/ /a par ma bltas ci/ /kye ma rtog dpyod med rnams yid/ /yang dag sdom min chang gis myos/ /legs saṃ ya mā sa ba k+ṣi ba ma ba ṭi ṣe ba dh+wa ba ti/ /i ti saṃ tsin+tu sa mu nidze+e pa'i lam las phyir phyogs te/ /'dir ni g.yang sa kho nar rgyug /de ltar bsams nas thub pa de//la k+ṣa k+ṣa pi ta d+ku ti ཿ / / a bye t+yā rā dza da yi tā mu skyengs pas gzi brjid snyenyams gyur cing gye/ /bzhin ni dman pas ⑦mngon phyogs te/ /rgyal po'i bā tsa bi na tā na naḥ/ /sa mā shwa se nyi te mā tarna sho shaṃ kartu marta se/ /bha btsun mo la smras pa/ /dbugs dbyung mdzod cig ma gcig 8—kye/ /mya ngan babyu bar mi 'os so nges bi ta bya ta yi bā yo gre shaste durna ya: me/ / taghā ā shra ma saṃ tā pa par bdag ni tshul ngan pas/ /khyod kyi sdug bsngal 'di nyid do/ /'jug ngogs shing 'di'i 'og tu ni//ma gya tī ra ta ro ra dhaḥ/ /a dhu ṣ+pe pa ni dze+e dh+wa ma sa hāsmra bherga mi 6 se/ /ngal ba'i gdung ba btang byas nas/ /nga dang lhan cig rang khyim du/ /da lta nyid du khyod 'gro shesna'agyur//i truste mu ni nā de bī seste bā mṛ ta thraṣ+ṭi byeḥ/ /a bābe+e dz+re bi ta thub pas 'di brjod lha mo ni/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis bran pa bzhin/ /'jigs pa'i kun rmongs btang j-i tisgyu dza bha ya saṃ bh+ra oṃ/ /shu two ta ta tro di ba byā pi dā tubya ri gyur cing / /srog ni 'dzin pa rnyed par gyur/ /gtong ba'i spyod pa rmad byung gis/ /mtho ris khyab pa ta mabye tai/ /rā dzhaḥs twa da dze+e dzñā tsu bā sa baḥs mu pā ya yo/ /bhak+ṣi de thos nas/ /rgyal po'i brtse ( ba'i snyeng stobs dag /shes 'dod nor lha'i bu nyer 'ongs/ /mi med 95—20

tā dhaḥsha ri rā rnyo byā sgre ṇa bi dza ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe/ /bu tre: tubhiḥsā kraṣ+pespyo tī to nags su stag gis ni/ /smad kyi lus phyed zos gyur cing / /bu bzhi yis ni du bzhin du/ /bzung bar zwah+ma shā kṛ tiḥ/ /pra sra ba ta bhū ri ru dhi ro ladza mā nān+t+ra maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /gyur pa bram ze'i gzugs/ /khrag ni mang po rab zag cing / /rgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phyang bar 1sgyuldan//kṛsgo su pa ṇi ta pā ṇaḥpā bai ri ba dṛ dhī kṛ taḥ/ /pra t+ya gā mi ṣa gabye na sdig pas 2brtan par byas pa bzhin/ /sdug kyang srog dang ma bral te/ /rab tu gsar pa sha yi dris//kra byu de spyo sha ma nī taḥ / /lubha pābe+e ba tso ro྾ ra na be+e rarja bā sha za'i tshogs rnams rjes 'brang ba/ /brkam shechags rgyal dang rkun pos bskyed/ /nor med rnams kyis ni bān/ /na ga rān+ta ra mā sā r+ya sa ya yo pu ra bā se bhā/ /kā ru nor ldan bzhin④/ /grong khyer dbus su zhugs pa las/ /de ni grong na gnas rnams kyis sgo7/ /snying rje rgya de n+ya duḥkhārta bh+ra ma bisma ya he tu tsā/ /sa sho ka i ba sā kā raḥzhum dang sdug bsngal gzir/ /'jigs dang ya mtshan rgyu ru gyur/ /de yi thubazod dka' mya ngan dang //sa tā sa i ba duḥs haḥ/ /bi da dhe sā r+ya sā yā saṃ sa ha sā po ra yo ṣi skrag pa rnam pa dang bcas bzhin/ /'phral du grong gi bud med rnams/ /'jigs pas sgyid ni lug nga ra tī / /sobe+e saṃ dar+sha nā s+thā nā sbri ta snga tha ma tī pa teḥ/ /pu tra rū bai: byas—/ /de nas sa bdag slong ba rnams/ /blta phyir 'dun sar 'khod pa de'i/ /mdun du bu gzugs tubhi stergya sto gre saṃ tsi kātri taḥ/ / tai dṛ ṭī be+e sha sā/ bai sha bi ṣa ma bzhi po des/ /de ni khri la bzhag ste bkod/ /mi bzad ṣ+pe7nyon mongs rnam sresna'akhrugs shing / /mi sdug cha kle sha bi hwa lo/ /niḥku ṇi tā na na ba no dza no bhūdhī li tek+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /sa lugs spude mthong nas/ /skye bo rke —bzhin gyi tshogs rnams ni/ /sgra med mig ni zum par gyur/ /'dar ka dza bi hwa lo ba k+ṣa mu k+ta mu sde su da k+ṣi rde / / bhu dze+e dza gā da bhū bas 'khrugs shing brkyang ba yis1 skyu/ /dpung pa g.yas pa bslangs 6byas nas/ /gdung bas yi ge bral 95—21

pā lo bya thā shi thi li tā k+ṣa raḥ/ /swaste tu bye ma tī ba te zwa h+ma kho ha mi rmā da shaṃ/ /ba'i tshig /de yis sa skyong dag la smras/ /sa bdag khyod ni dge bar gyur/ /bram ze bdag ①gi gnas tī pra pā pa i ba pā p+ta ཿ pa sh+ya rmā kā ru rja ni dhe ཿ / /skabs 'di/ /bzod dka'i ā+oṃsdig pa bzhin du thob/ /bdag la gzigs shig snying rje'i gter//saṃ sā ra sgo ra ga ha ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe byā sgre ṇa bhak+ṣi taḥ/ /dz+re bā mya ba sh+ya sgo gya twad duḥ'akhor ba lta bur 'jigs pa'i nags/ /zab mo dag tu stag gis zos/ /sdug bsngal rab tu phyi ba 'di//kha myu gya ga rī ya saḥ / / asmin+da pi be+e pa ṭ+wā pe tī bra kle sha sa longs spyod phyir na bdag 'tshor/ /phongs pa'i gdung ba 'di la yang / /drag po'i nyon mongs bzod hiju baḥ/ /bi muñtsarnyi na rmā pā rjaḥsu z-i daḥsadz+dza nā i ba/ /da dā nus pa'i/ /srog 'dis bdag ni mi gtong ste/ /mdza' bshes dam pa'i skye bos bzhin/ /su zhig ti ya di te kabyeta sbyi tā de hād+dhā māt+pa naḥ/ /tarte dz+re ba ta maste ti mā mū bdag nyid lus phyed bcad/ /gal te khyod la ster ba na/ /des khyod 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /nam tse byo ma de ba tā/ /ko da dā ti dza ga t+yasmin+da jo bi tai ka ru zla ni dhe/ /pā mkha'i lha yis bdag la smras/ /'gro ba 'di na skye bo rnams/ /gzhan byi don las phyir phyogs te/ /phal ye ṇa swa su khā dz+wa ṣi pa rārja pi mu kho dza naḥ/ /sarba dā sarba dā tā re cher rang gi bde ba 'tshol1/ /su zhig srog ster snying rje'i gter/ /thams cad tshe na thams cad gtong //dī na bya sa na brnya baṃ/ /de ha dā ṣ+pe su bi mu khaṃ tā masmi sha ra rde dman zhing phongs pa rnams kyi gnyen/ /lus sbyin las kyang phyir ma phyogs/ /khyod la skyabs su bdag ga taḥ/ /e kasta me ba lo ka smen dzā taḥsu kṛ ta pā da paḥ/ /nibyā dza mā da song ngo / /zol med gus shing rgya che ba'i/ /sbyin par gang gi 'bras bu 'khrungs/ /khyod nyid gcig pu ro dā re dā na ya gya pha loṅga tiḥ/ /ki ma mi rba pa dāzla mya tīrti 'jig rten 'dir/ /legs byas rkang 'thung dag tu skyes/ /gtong phod ldan pa gang khyod kyi/ /legs 95—22

stesgob to gu ṇiḥ/ /dā na me bā ha to ya gya lo ka su kṛ ta diṇ+ḍi maḥ/ /byas rnga ni 'jig rten na/ /sbyin pa nyid kyi ①rdung bar bgyid/ /yon tan bsgrags pa gzhan gyis naci//ā pan+d+ra rti pa ri tā ṇa pa bi tra tsa ri tra bra tāḥ/ /pā myarnye puju pa lhung zhing nyen rnams yongs su skyob/ /gtsang mar spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ldan/ /phongs pa'i dus su khyod bye na be+e paṭ+wā le bha chad+ma dh+wa/ /a man+d+ra nan+da su z-i do ha ri tsan+da lta bu/ /bsod nams tshong zong dag gis 'thob/ /mi dman kun tu dga' ba'i gnyen/ /ha ri tsan+dan na shī ta khāḥ/ /ha rarnyi san+taḥsad+dhā paṃ dak+ṣi ṇa pa ba ṇa i ba/ /pūrten+d+ra bzhin du bsel/ /lho yi phyogs kyi rlung gis bzhin/ /dam pa rnams kyis chagadung ba 'phrog /rdzogs sun+da rā da sma du di tā ba da nāt+ta ba/ /byirje ba dzi ba ya h+ye ba ba pa'i zla ba khyod kyi zhal/ /mdzes pa 'di las 'khrungs pa yi/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi'i char rgyun ni/ /zla bhā r+pā yu ṣa babhā bhā/ /i truk+ta te na sa ha sā z-i de saṃ shān+ta tad bya thaḥ/ /'od lta bus 'tsho rgyab nyid/ /de yis de skad brjod pa'i 'phral/ /de yi sdug bsngal snying la 'phos/ /saṃ mo ha mūtshi tai rā dzā ta rūkho bā tsa rā ku lo/ /sa mā shwa se hi muñtsa myur zhing rtabs par rgyal po yis/ /rmongs shing brgyal ba de la smras/ /srog 'bral las skyes 'jigs pa two bha yi pā ṇa bi yo ga dze+e/ / pra yats+tsha mi sha rī rā dzha ma bi tsārle dag /khyod kyis thong la dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /lus phyed rtog dpyod med nyid du/ /gnyis skyes khyod ba te dī dza/ / dha n+ya gya yā h+ye yi kā yaḥpa ro sa kṛ ta ya k+ṣa ti/ /la bdag gis sbyin/ /gang 'di 5skad cig 'dzad pa'i lus/ /'di ni bsrungs kyang mi 'dzad cemin/ /k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa yī hi de ho yo rak+ṣa mā kho pi nā k+ṣa yaḥ/ /i truk+ta bā ti bhu pā dam pa rnams kyi ⑦lus 'di ni/ /gzhan la phan phyir 'dzad par 'gyur/ /sa skyong de skad 2brjod ldan le sa muṅkam+bi ta mā na saḥ/ /badzā ha ta i bo bā tsa ma hā mā tro ma hā ma la—/ /snying ni yang dag 'dar gyur pa/ /rdo rjes bcom bzhin blon po ni/ /chen po blo gros chen pos 95—23

tiḥ / /a ho nu sā ha sā sgyu sā ya sa bya pa bhā pra bhuḥ/ /nyi ta ma na ga ṇa smras—/ /kye ma bab col goms pa las/ /jo bo gdung bas gzir min nam/ /skye rgu ① bsod nams ya h+ye ba pra dzā pu ju pa ri k+ṣa yāta/ /pra dzā ram̐ byu ta ye shak+taḥko n+yastata yongs zad las/ /phan pa nyid la mi rtsi 'o/ /skye rgu a+yo)'byor par byed 3 pa'i mthu/ /khyod mtshungs yon sa dṛ sho gu ju/ /yad bhat+ta mu kha ro j-i t+yaḥsho tā kārta tsa byu ba nyiḥ/ /na ka ro tan ldan pa su/ /gang zhig g.yog 'khor gus /④pas brngod/ /nyan dang byed po sa yi bdag /rje bo glang ti hi tai swā m+bi ga dza lī lā ni m+bi li taḥ/ /ga ṇa bhā yāḥsu dz+dza t+yā nā mi chen rol ba ltar/ /mig zum phan pa mi mdzad na/ /'khor bzang rnams kyi dbang thang dang / /phun ya bh+yo sgo ga saṃ pa daḥ/ /bhā ti te su tsi re karte yiḥkṛ tā ma dhurma ñdza rī/ /tshogs 'di snyed kho nas rtsi 'u/ /'dul ba smra ba rnams kyi tshig /dge ba'i me tog gis bltams khyepa//ka spyo ṇa kaṇi kāḥkir+ṇa bā ṇi bi na ya bā di rmā/ /rāk+ṣu so yo pi shā sbrang rtsi'i dog pa gang dag gis/ /rna bar bgyis te yun ring mdzes/ /'gro rnams bsrung ba'i rin chen tso bāts+tshad+ma nā zwah+ma shā kṛ tīḥ/ /rak+ṣu rat+na gya dza ga tsā sha rī rirlobe+e hūṃ ga taḥ/ /gyedz+wa / /sku lus su zhig slong gyur pa/ /'di ni srin po'am sha za ste/ /slu byed bram ze'i rnam par byas//ya di nā ma na mā ye yo kṛ ta te na ma tī ya sī/ /taṅka dze+e kṛt+ta de ha gya gal te 'di ni che ba'i sgyu/ /'di ni snyenges par ma bgyis she na/ /lus 'di bcad pa skad cig kyang //k+ṣa ṇa ma pyaste dzī bi tai/ /a bī tsā: ba su kṛ tai kri ya te durga he ṇa yata/ /'tsho ba de lta ga la mchis tso— / /gdon ngan dag gis legs byas ni/ /rtog dpyod med pa kyegang byed pa//ta dāt+pa r+pā ḍā pa ru ṣe pa ra lo ge pi niḥsu khaṃ/ /shākya me ba sa dā dar+yāta de dag bdag nyid gdung zhing rtsub —rta/ /'jig rten gzhan du'ang bde ba med/ /rtag tu nus pa kho na a shābye dī ya te ka rja/ /sarba swa de ha dā nā di pra bā dā e ba sho bha nāḥ/ /sbyin—/ /mi nus pa ni ji ltar sbyin/ /bdog kun dang ni lus sbyin sogs/ /rab tu smra ba kho na mdzes//95—24

dzad+mā n+ta re bi da da to de haṃ me na bya thā bha ba ta / / sma rā mya tī yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis1 / /sems kyis 'das pa 2 bdag gis dran/ /skye ba gzhan du'ang ta bṛ t+ta gya sa myak+shi bo bye tse ta sā/ / pu rā dṛsbyo d+ma tsā byā ṭī gru ṭ+wā lus po dag /byin pas bdag ni nad med gyur/ /stag mo ltogs shing nyams/ 4med sngon/ /bu ni rmā po ta bha k+ṣa be+e/ /tad ra k+ṣu ma ma yā datrī sha rī ra ma bi k+ṣa ri rja/ /bza' bar brtson pa mthong 5/ /de bsrung slad du 'u sa/ po ni/ /rnam 'gyur med par bdag gis byin//shi bi dzad+ma ni tsān+t+ra ya datrī ṣ+pe tra yu shaṃ ma yā/ /rak+ṣi tabya swa de he na ka shi bir skyes tshe 'o nga ba la / /mig ni zung dag bdag gis/ byin/ /khra 'a sa skyes/ pa'i 'jigs pa la sa//po ta bye na kād bha yāta/ /tsan+d+ra pra bhā wa tā re tsa ro druk+ṣu yāthi tai shi raḥ/ /phug ron rang gi srog gis 6bsru ngas / /zla ba'i 'od du gyur tshe yang / /drag po'i mig la mgo bo btang //sarba swa pu tra dā rā di dbye tsā bye ṣā dzad+ma su/ /i trut+ta bo bye sa two na skye ba ga'an du bdog kun dang / /bu dang chung ma so/gas/ kyang byin/ /sa/ spyo da byang chub sems dpa' yis //byu bhu rdza mā mā t+ya ba raḥ / /na sa dz+re bo na ni ñdzu ba i bā bhūd bya de ska da smras nga/'i blon ngo/ 7mchog /gson min shi ba ma yin bzhin/ /dbang ngo/ gdung bas nyen thi tedh+ri yaḥ/ /a waṃ bh+ya shā sā ni nā tha rā dzñā kra ka tsa dh+wa ra yā/ /ni yulto pa la gaṇ+ḍa par gyur/ /de nas/ sog le non po yis / /sku 'u sa/ bcad pa'i bya ba dag /bgom 8 par mi nus rgyal khyo sha rī ra ñtsi da karma ṇi / / to tī bra sho ka bi ba sho sha kra mā po'i bkas// /bzo bo dag la bskos par gyur/ /mya ngan drag pos 'bangs/ de dag /brgya byin sgyu /yā bi mo hi to/ /ka dā tsi di ba bhū bharturde hats+tsha de sa mud+ma to/ /dz+ra pa yis rnam rmongs/ te/ /ji zhig ltar stes sa bdag gis/ /lus ni gcod la yang dag zhugs/ /sog kyele te nirngi kā ra su hrū ra kra ka tsa dh+wa ra yā/ /bi dār+ya mā rde de hārte thra thi rno zhing rtsub pa yis / /mi bdag rnam 'gyur mi mnga' ba'i/ /lus phyed rnam par bcad pa'i tshe/ /sa ni 95—26

bī sa ma ka dza ta / / blu sgo lbā ra k+ta ba sa nā ni spyo ta sgro ta tā ra yang dag g.yos par gyur/ /skar mda' ltung ba'i gos/ dmar can/ /rgyu ska ra 'khrugs 1 shing sgra chen kāḥ / / rdzuḥ sa sha sde ru ro de ba tīr+ṇa khru ka ṇa san+ta tiḥ / / be+e sha sgrogs—/ /mchi ma'i zigs 2 pa'i tshogs lhung zhing / /mkha' ni sgra bcas du ba 4bzhin/ /mi rung sā lo ka nod bhū ta tī bra duḥkha sa hisngu nā/ /tūrte ra dzaḥpa ṭi ṣ+pe ba ra gzigs pas drag po yi/ /sdug bsnga la/ shin tu bzod dkar gyur/ /nyi ma rdul byu 5 sgos dag gis///bi nā bi hi tai mu khaṃ/ / ta smin pra dzāḥ pra dzā nā the kra ka tsā krān+ta bi myur du gdong ba bsgribs pa bzhin/ /skye rgu'i 3mgon gyi 'u sa/ la der/ /so ga les/ gathags pas skye rgu 7gra he/ /tsakran+d+raḥpū ri tā krān dā di be+e dhū bheḥpra ti swa ṣ+peḥ/ /a nuts+tsha sa rnams— /ngus shing phyogs kyi bu mo yi / /sgra snyan rnams kyis cho nges bkang / /mi bdag snying twa mā lo kya dṛ paṃ sha kro dī dza kṛ ti ཿ / / bi sma yā nu sha yā krān+ta stobs ma bri ba/ /brgya byin gnyis skyes mdog dbyibs can/ /ya mtshan 'gyod nga/sa non nga/ yi//tsit+ta sh+yi ra ma tsin+ta yan/ /a ho ma hā ma te ra su ka ru zla ko ma lo ma sems kyis mthong nas ring zhig bas mas/ /'di la / blo chen 'di yi yid/ /ga'an gyi don du gdung ba naḥ / /pābye pa rārja r+pā ḍa su badzā da pi ka zo ra hūṃ/ /sā ga rā da pi shaṃ d+dhā ram̐ la / /snying rje bas/ kyang mnyen pa dang / /rdo rje bas kyang sra ba thob/ /kye ma bdag nyid che spyo da tshul //me ro ra pi sa murja tai/ /tri di bā da paṃ sābyar+ya ma ho bṛdzhai ma hāt+pa rmā/ /rgya mtsho bas kyang shin tu zab/ /ri rab bas kyang yang dag mtho/ /mtho ris bas kyang ngo mtshar bcas //a ho pā ṇa pra bā se pi sa two sa two ma ho da dheḥ/ /sā bye ri ba bi sat+yā te kye ma srog ni 'gro na yang / /snying stobs rgya mtsho snying stobs/ ldan/ /dam pa ya ngar lhung na yang //ma hā two nā ba hi ma te/ /i ti tsin+ta ya ti k+ṣi pre sa ha sruk+ṣe k+ṣi ti pra sgoḥ/ /chen po nyid ni mi nyams bzhin/ /mig stong ldan pas de bsams/ tshe/ /sa yi bdag po'i lte 'og nas//95—27

nā bhe ra dhaḥsha rī rār+ghaṃ nisgot+ta ma ba ti k+ṣi to/ /sa di jo bhū ta de ho pi lus phyed nges par bcad nas ni/ /sa la myur du lhung bar gyuratsho / /'u sa ni rnam gnyis gyur kyang de//ha khyon+d+ra ha ma yo bha ba ta/ / sarba bhū ta pa ri tā ṇa sa two na j-i ta dz+re dga' dang spro ba'i rang bzhin gyur/ /'byung po kun yongs bskyab 2 pa yi/ /snying stobs kyis ni srog bi taḥ/ /ta dā dzha yā sha rī rārtesh+laubye saṃ pūr+ṇa bi gra haḥ/ /swa s+tha k+ṣi ti nas bzung / /de yi bka' yis/ 'u sa phyed ni/ /sbyar nas nyams nga/ rna'/ du gnas / /yongs/ rdzogs 'u sa/ sa mujo ya zwah+ma ṇasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a ho bi rā dza se rā dzan pū rdzu bi ra dza sasta ni yang dag nga ngas/ /bram/ ze yis/ ni de la smras / /e ma rgya' po khyod kyi ni/ /zol med 'u/sa kyi sbyin nga/ bī / /ni rgyu dza de ha dā ṣ+pe na bi she ṣa da ya shaḥ/ / twad+ma no ma ṇi yis / /rdu' bral mchod 'os khyad nga ra du/ /dri med grags/ nga/sa/ rnam/ nga/ra mdzes// /khyod yid nor bu bi ma l+ya tu bye kiñtsi da kurba taḥ/ /u pa mā ṣ+pe na dā ri dru ma ho mugha gya be dri med dang / /ma/tshungs nga/ ci yang ma byas nga// /kye ma byed ngo/ rmongs pa dag /dpe yis/ kyang ni shin tu dha saḥ/ /kṛt+ta ཿsu bṛt+ta ཿ sa ra laḥpa rābe+e ma dhu rā sha yaḥ/ / sa ha dbul / /drang zhing rab zlum/ mngar bas khengs / /mtho thing bcad —nga/ra gyur nga/ yis 5 / /bur shing se duḥ sa hā bī ḍā mik+ṣu kāṇ+ḍa mi borja taḥ/ /mi trughā krā h+ma ṇa kā raḥsdong ngo/ lta bu yi / /ga'an don bzod dala'i gdung ba bzod/ /'di smras bram ze'i dbyibs can gyi//sha kraste smṛ ti dzan+ma bheḥ/ /saṃ dzī ba kau ṣa bye dzā taiḥsu ṅgā myan de ra pū ra yata/ /brgya byin dran nga/ 'a sa skyes nga// /yang dag gso byed sma na gyi tshogs / /bdud rtsi'i khu 1 bas/ de sdogs/ byas //ta taḥpra ka ṭi tā kā raḥb ri toṣāta pu ran+da raḥ/ /su sh+lau ṣ+ṭa ni dza de de nas/ byad gzugs gas la/ bar byas// /yongs su tshim nas/ brgya byin gyes/ /rang gi 'u sa/ phyed legs ba de hā r+ghaṃ pra sha shaṃ sa ma tī ba ti/ /a thāsba rām+bi pa ti taḥsi ta ku sbyar ba'i/ /sa yi bdag ngo/ rab tu bsngags / /de nas me tog dkar po'i tshogs/ /mkha' la sa rab 95—28

su ma saṃ tsa yaḥ/ /taṭ+wā lolbā si ta khyo bhā har+ṣa hā sa i bā ba bye/ /a tān+ta re tu lhung gyur pas1 / /de tshe sa gzhi dga' zhing dgod/ /gyen du bskyod pa lta bus mdzes/ /de lta ra gyur mu ni tosmi pri yī dzā yī dza pra yo sgo/ /ā dā yā bye t+ya taj-i t+ta dzā tā :dro pa/sa/ mtshar skyes nga// /thub pas ska bas der de la ni/ /btsun mo dga' ma rgya' ba'i 'od/ /khyer te n+ya be da yata/ /pa ta yā saṃ ga taḥpa ta t+yā swa shībye ba bi shudhe yā/ /mngon du phyogs/ nas/ phul// /rnam dag rang ji grags pa bzhin/ /btsun mo de dang yang dag 'grogs //u bā tsa thraṣ+ṭaḥsha kre ṇa ni kā re nirngi kā ri tā / / ta taḥtsi hā pa she di gnod la rnam 'gyur mi mnga' ba/ /brgya byin gyis dris de yis smra2 / /de nas rab mchog seng she'i khri//bye be+e shwa karma bi nirma te/ /rat+na bar+ṣa sa ma tīrte dzamyu dī pe sa bhū pa tiḥ/ /a bi shwa larmas sprul nga/ dang / /rin chen char byis rab gang ba'i/ /'dzam bu'i gling du sa bdag ni/ /lha bye ṣik+ta ཿ su re dz+re na pra sā r+ya da yi tā sa kha ཿ / / dā na ngu/ rgya pra yi dbang pos bsnga gas/ byas nas// /btsun mo/ra bcas nga/ mngon dbang bsku ra/ /sbyin nga/'i bso da nams/ bhā bodh+wa ku shwa khā/ byā pi ta pra dzaḥ / / sa/ ma be+e sa twa saṃ sā ra saṃ tā ra mthus bskru na nga/'i/ /dke bas skye rgu tshim pa ra byas 4 / /'khor ba'i sems can ma/tha' dag ni/ /yang ṇa kṛ ta pra ta ཿ / / sa mya k+shi bo bye bu bye ma nā ཿ pra mu di to bha dag sgro' ba'i brtul zhugs byas / /ya nga dag rdzogs nga/'i byang chub tu/ /mngon 'tshang rgya yid rab dgar ba ta / /mo tram̐ tse tasta ru ṇa ka ru ṇi satwa si r+ghaṃ bi shud+dhā mā nga/n+darte pra sha gyur / /rgyal ngo/'i thugs ni byams nga/ dang ldan snying rje dar bas 5 snying sto bas grub/ /rnam nga/ra dag cing ma na pha la ste ta māt+pa pra dā ā+oṃ/ yi be bcu bdum nga 'i nang tshan dal kyis sarnom pa / /dṛṭī rā dzhaḥpra ma da sa li phongs/ pa'i gdung ba rab zhi'i 'bras rgyas dag /rab ster rab dga'i chu yis bkrus pa'i mig gis blta sa la k+ṣu li tī sgo bi lak+ṣaḥsha kraḥpā yā da ma ra na ga rī pū ri tī tar+ya sho bheḥ/ /i ti nas skyengs gyur pa'i/ /brgya byen 'chi med grong khyer de yi grags pas khengs pa dag tu song / /de ltar 95—29

sa be+e bu dha j-iṣ+peḥsedhe yasgo ra geje ཿpu la ka ru tsi ra brtse rabyo mā na pra de ni lha yi tshogs dang grub pa gnod sbyin dang / /lto 'phye'i dbang gi she spu ldang mdzes pa'i byug pas mchod bhā baḥ/ phreng ldan ma/ a ba ni ma ba na shak+taḥkalpa yan+da ka kaspra ma bha ba be+e bha ldan mthu/ /sa rnams dag ni mtho ris brtag byar byas shing bsrung nus la/ /srid bral 'byor pa dag ba sho bhā mābe+e bān bo bye sa twaḥ/ /pūṭ+wā ba tā ra saṃ bā derdu no ṅka r+ṣa myugis mdzes/ pa thob ldan byang chub sems// /sngon byung yang dag brjod pa/ yis// /sbyin pa khyad 'phags/ dā ha ran/ ba sgo phan pa / u pa de shā ya bye྾ zla mi t+yā ha bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /gas 'a byed cing / /dke slo nga rnams 'a/ gdams pa'i be+e da/ /bcom lda na rgya' ba de ska da gsu ngas //i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī shrī 'es nga dge ba'i dbang ngo/sa byas pa/'i byang chub se ma/sa dang/'i rtogs nga brjod nga/ dang ga bas/ma kyi 'khri shing se nā ba dā rmā dī tī ya pal+la baḥ// //la sa dang/'a byi sde'i rtogs nga/ brjod nga/'i ya' 'dab ste gnyis nga/'o// //asmin+dabye ta sarge ma ka rā ka ra dzā ya nā/ na ma ṇi brge/ dzā ti bye brag 'phabs ma spyi/ ko 'gro 'dir spros nga/ rmad byung rin chen tshogs / /chu srin 'byung sanas dag la sa skye bar ldan/ /su pi pra ka ṭi ta su ga teḥpu ru ṣa ma ṇidzā ya te dza ga te/ /aste sau bhe pra bhā jig kyang ni rab tu gas 'a ba ru/ /bde bar 'gro ba skyes bu rin chen skyes / / ba gam 'od tshogs ga bur pū ra kaṭ+wā ra pa ri pāṇ+ḍa ram̐/ /shā ke ta nā ma na ga ram̐ sau bhā gyi ti la ka bhū baḥ/ /byis / /yo/ngas su dalar ngo 'i grong khyer ni/ /shā ṅka ta zhes bya ba ste/ /ska 'a bzang sa yi thig le yod//me+e byeḥ pra bhā sa twa ma yishaṃ gā be+e ma la mā na me+eḥ / / tī dze+e ri bāspri 'jug ngogs/ bzhin du bsten 'os gang / /bso/da nams byed gtsang gzi byin dang / /snying stobs/ rang tai ya tra pa bi tre ཿ pu ju ka dṛ bhiḥ / / ya shaḥ ku su mi te ya tra pu bzhin gang 4gā lta ra/ /dri med yid ldan dag tu gnas/ /nam zhig grags pa'i me tog ldan/ /bsod 95—30

rgya sau ra bha nir+bha re/ /ra madhe su kṛ tod+mā ṣ+pe nan+da ṣ+pe pu ra bā se naḥ/ /nams dri bzang rab tu rgyas/ /legs byas skyed tshal dga' ster du/ /grong khyer ba rnams rab tu rtsen//ta tra bhūd byu pa ti bhū ri gu ṇa rat+na ma hod byeḥ/ /bhū tir+ya shaḥsha shaṃ ka su der ni sa bdag chu gter che/ /rab mang yon tan rin chen dang / /grags pa'i ri bong mtshan ma bskyed//he ma tsū ḍa i ti khru taḥ/ / sa dā sa dā shra yārte ṇa ka li kā lā pa hā gser gyi gtsug phud ces grags byung / /rtag tu dam pas bsten 'os shing / /rtsod dus rab tu 'phrog ri ṇa/ /kṛ taḥkṛ ta yu ga ṣ+pe ba ye nadharma dha ro dza naḥ/ /ma tī pa tiḥk+ṣa byed pa/ /rdzogs ldan lta bu gang gis ni/ /skye bo chos/ rnams 'dzin par byas// /sa bdag bzod la kun ma sak+taḥ shrī z-i ta ka ru zla ra taḥ/ /balpa sgo byu ta pra dzā dzā yaḥ pra khya chags shing / /dpal gyis dkris/ gyur snying rje dga'/ /rab grags/ la yang dbang thul/ gang / /skye rgu 1to pi dzi te dz+re yaḥ / / a mā rā sa ba saṃ pū1 ma ho sā sa tra dī k+ṣi rnams kyi dga' byed gyur/ /'tshe med mchog 2 sbyin babe+e/ba ldan nga// /gang bi bso/da nams/ mi 'jigs taḥ / /da do yaḥsarba bhū tā dzā pu rgya ma bha ya dak+ṣi rde/ /nirma do yaḥpra yon / /mi gso da sgra dbyangs yongs rdzogs pa/ /'byung ngo/ kun 'a byin nga/ra gyur/ /mthu dang ldan yang bhā be pi bi bha be pi pri yo ba daḥ / / k+ṣa mā shī laḥ pra bhū two pi yo ba gang ma myos / /rnam par 'byor yang snyan pa/ra smra/ /rje nyid yin yang bzod ldan tshul / /'a nga tsho ldan ni pi dzi tedz+re yaḥ/ /shaṃ dhī re rdorja ti ga tā shu re ṇa sha shī kābye nā/ /sat+pak+ṣe yang dbang po thul/ /mthon por gyur pa'i zab mo dang / /zla ba'i 'od zer dpa' bo dang / /sa/ gzhi ṇa k+ṣi ti j-i tā yenā ta n+ya ta bisma yaḥ/ / rā p+taḥ ta t+yā dī tī ya gya ba 'dzin pa dam pa'i phyogs / /gang gi 4ya mtshan byas par gyur/ /rgyal ngo/ de la 5zla med nga/'i6 / /rgyan byu bā bha ra ṇa dwa yoḥ/ /t+yā ga pūtram̐ tsa kā ru bye tā ru bye su kṛ ta shri yaḥ/ /ni gnyis shig byung gyur te/ /gtong ba rdzogs pa'i snying rje dang / /legs byas dpal ni dar bab pa'o//95—31

pad+mā ka ra su ta sde bhū ta de dī kābye ma tī pri ya/ /pra bhā ta shrī ri ba sa nga/d+ma'i 'byung gnas de yis/ 1 ni/ /lha mo ma dzes ldan dga' mar gyur/ /snga dro'i dpa 'a bzhin rtag tu ni//dā nirdo ṣā ju da yot+pa bā/ /dī tiḥpra bhu gu ṇi ṣ+pe ba t+yā ge na shrī ri bo dz+wa skyo na med dga' ba mngon par 'char/ /'u gas 2 ni rje yi yon tan dang / /dang/la ni 'bar ba gtong ba lā/ / /ra rā dza rā dza tsan+de ṇa sa shī le ṣ+pe ba tsā ru tā / /sa dā nan+da na dang / /mdzes/ nga/ nyid ni khrims kyis/ bzhin/ /de ni rgya' ngo/sa zla bas/ mdzes// /rtag tu dga' byed bi khyu ta ya shaḥ pra sa ra yā ta yā/ / me ru ste di ba la smye ba ba d+ngha snyan nga/ dag /rab bkram — rnam nga/ra grags/ pa des/5 / /sa/ 'dzin mchog tu 6mdzes gyur pa/ /mtho bhū mi bye tsā ba raḥ/ /kā le ka spyo ṇa ni la yo bhartuḥsā gar+bha mā/ da de/ /ris dang/'a gyi chi ci na ngo ba'in/ /rje 'a sa dus su dge ba'i gnas / /ma/nga' ni de yi bzung gyur te//byu h+ye ju ba na nga/d+ma su di bā ka ra mi bā di tiḥ/ /a ra ṇiḥpā ba ke ṣ+pe 'jis rten nga/d+ma 'byor nga/'i sla da/ / i ri ti yi nyin byed bathin/ /bdud rtsi'i zer gyis chu gter ba be le bābye ཿ su/ bye shu nā / / bra d+mā dz+dza nai ba go bi n+da nā bye ga bye ṇa rlabs /tshangs nga/'i nga d+mas khyab 'jug steshā / /dag byed dag jis sru/ba shing bzhin/ /de ni ma/ngal byis sā ba d+ngha / / ta gya ga d+dhā nu bhā be na do ha dra bye ma tai dṛ pa ཿ / /mdzes nga ra gyur/ /de yi mngal gyi mthus srid nga/'i/ /ma/ngon nga/ra 'dod bzhin mi bdag gis///da do sa ṭ+wā rji sābe+e bh+yo bā ñtsi tā bh+ya bye kai ba su / / pu na spyo mi byu mngon nga ra 'dod 'a sa mngon lha ga nor/ /slo nga ba'i don mthun kun la/ byin/ /be+e ra yang sa bdag gis/ ma thra ṣ+ṭa do ha rda shu bha ga bhi bhā / / sa ra swa tī ba sā tsakre swa yo sred dris / /dge ba'i mnga' dang ldan nga/ de / /dbyangs can ma bzhin rang nyid kyis / /dam chos sa dhe rma de sha dzā / / pūr+ṇa pu rgya ma ṇi rja rma ni bye bi bye sa mu da j-i rnam par bshad pa byas// /yo/ngas/ rdzogs bsod nams rin chen ni/ /chos gter bsgrub pa rab 'dzin 95—32

taḥ / /be+e pabyi pu la duḥkhe bh+yaḥs dā rak+ṣa ti rak+ṣi taḥ/ /kād+dhā ra durgo pas—/ /phongs pa'i sdug bsnga la rgyas pa la sa// /rtag tu bsrungs 1 shing rab tu bsrung 2 / /'brog dbon ṣā pa ri sgo tā rmā tā pārtu rā rde pa ra lo ka mārge/ yi be bcu gcig pa 'i nang tshan dbang ngo sdo rje/spruṅgiḥbagrod dkar yongs lhung 'jig rten ni/ /pha ro' 'a ma du gdung bas nyen rnams la// /yid 'ong pra thra dhaḥ pha la pū ri tā shaḥ sgo yā ta rdu rja rma sa moste nā n+ya ཿ / / ā lo rab rgyas 'bras bus 4 rdzogs nga/'i phyogs / /greb shing chos dang mtshungs pa ga'an yod min/ /rab rib ke ti mi re bi padī ṣa ma ṇiḥpā de ka rā lalba rna yādzñā kalpa ta rurdza gadz+dza can la/ snang ba phongs pa'i dug la nor bu lhung la 5'a ga nga/'i mchel nga/ 6 ste/ /slo/nga la dang/ga bas/ma ljo na ya ra tha ཿ pā bye ya ma bye nga/ thi / / du ཿ kha byā bye ma ho ṣa bye bha nga/ 'gro la rgyal ba'i shing rta la ma ga'an dag 'a 'a ma gyi brgyags / /sdug bsnga la nad la sma na chen dang ni ba bha yo da ju d+dhā sha yā shā sa rna tā pe tsa n+da na kā na rgo sbri ra su srid nga/'i 'jigs/ nga/ kun 'khrugs bas ma nga/ dbugs 'byin nga// /gdung ba dag 8 la tsan+dan nags tsha' z-i d+dhā rma ཿ sa tī bā n+dha ba ཿ / / i t+yā di dha rma dha ba lam̐ khru brtan pa'i ma/dza' bshes chos ni dam/ nga/ rnam/sa kyi gnyen/ /de so gas/ mi bdas btsun mo/'i tshis /dalar tā dṛ pa ba dhū ba tsaḥ/ / dharja/ ka sha ra ṇaḥ shrī mā na bhu ba ṣ+pe dza ṣ+pe/ /ba'i chos rgo thos/ gyur nas / /dang/'a lda na 'gro la 'jig rten du/ /dam chos gcig ngu/ skyabs su gyur/ /ta taḥkā le na saṃpūrte bye ri bā mṛ ta dī bye tai/ /a sru ta dra ra kai sa de nas dus ni yongs rdzogs te/ /mkha' 'a bdud rtsi'i 'od zer bzhin/ /'gro ba'i rab rib 'joms hi de bi dza gta ti mi ra dā ra shaṃ/ /a dzā ya tā su sa ha dza: ḍā lo kā ra khaṃ ma ṇiḥ//pa'i bu/ /lha mo 'a ni btsas par gyur/ /de yi gtsug rgyan nor bu ni/ /lhan skyes/ dag tu skyes gyur te//pāstsad+mā n+ta ra saṃ pa sto pi be+e ka i ba nirma laḥ / / sa ba bye bha gasta su skye ba gzhan sngar 'grogs nga/ yi/ /dben pa bzhin du dri ma med/ /de yi gtsug na gang 'od mthus //95—33

mūdh+ri pu rgya ma yo ma ṇiḥ/ /ya su pra bhā pra bhā be+e na yā mi byo di na tai ya yuḥ/ /mtshan mo nyin du bgyid pa yis/ /nor bu bsod nams 'a sa skyes pa/ /rab sdug de yis mdzes par gyur//so: ṣa gye ma be+esta su r+pā yu ṣa susdo be+en+da baḥ/ /na yarja he ma tsā lo gtsug tor dang bcas/ nor bu de'i/ /bdud rtsi 1 khu ba'i thigs pa yis/ /be+e gas/ rnams myur du zhi ba haṃ tu ri tai sha ma yadhi tsa/ /shi shodzā tisma ra snga tha ba tsa sā ta su byu dang / /gser du bsgru ba pa nyid du'ang bgyid/ /de nas/ skye dran byis/ pa de'i/ /tshig gis sa yi bdag pa tiḥ/ /da do he ma sa dābe+e bh+yaḥsarde ma ṇi ra sobye baṃ/ /puju rat+na dh+wa dze+e ts+tsha ngo/ yi / /nor bu'i bcud 'khrungs gser rnams kun/ /slo nga ba rnams la rtag tu byin/ /de skyes tshe na tram̐ pa tā kā bya dza dzā shu kai ཿ / / a pū ra ya rlu ram̐ byo me na ta lha rnam/sa kyis / /mkha' 'a grong khyer me tog dang / /rin chen rgyal mtshan gdugs/ dang ni/ /ba dan gya dzad+ma ni ba tā/ /su pra kā sho di tā she ṣa bi t+yā bi byo ti tād+ma naḥ/ /rlung g.yab sgos kyis b.lang / /shin tu gas/la bar bskyed nga/ yi/ /rig nga/ kun gyis/ rnam mdzes/ bdag/ma ṇi tsū ḍa i ti khyu tai nā ma ta snga ka roj-i paḥ/ / sa tsa kā rā sha yo de ming mi bdag bis mdzes 4pa/ /gtsug na nor bu zhes su grags// /yongs 'du dag gi 5 chu gter ha r+ṣa r+pā yu khots+tsha li tai pi tuḥ/ /a bhe dzā taḥsu to dzā taḥpa ri dzā ta i ba'in /bu skyes mngon nga/ra byes nga/ des / /yab kyi bas ma pa/ dga' ba yi/ /bdud rtsis rab tu rgyas bo da dheḥ/ /po lo m+bi ba dza yadhe na dza na byā pū bye dzad+ma nā/ /ba r+bha te na nga/ra byas// /rgyal bas ngo/ lo ma bzhin dang / /gzhon nus/ ri 6yi sras/ mo/ bzhin/ /ma/chod par 'os par ku mā re ṇa ku mā re ṇi ba pārba tī/ / ta taḥkā le na su kṛ ta so pā ṣ+peḥskyes pa yi/ /gzhon nu de yis/ 7yu ma yang mdzes / /de nas dus kyis sa yi bdag /bsod nams thra thi bī pa to/ /di byan dā ma sa mā ru snye ma ṇi tsū ḍo bha badzñā pa/ /abe+e them/ ska sa/ dag la sa/ 9 ni/ /lha yi gnas su yang dag 'dzegs/ /gtsug na nor bu mi bdag gyur/ /slong 95—34

tsid+dhā ma ṇi sta mya dā ṣ+pe na pa ri pū ri te / / lo ke pu ju su kha lo ba rnams kyi yid bzhin nor/ /de yi sbyin pas yongs khengs 1 pas/ /bsod nams bde snang 'jig rten ke nārto bhū ta na tsa ya tsa kaḥ/ /ta gya bha dru gi rir+ṇa ma ba bhū ba ga dza na / /phongs par gyur med slong ba'ang med/ /rgyal/ ngo/ de yi glang chen ni/ /bzang ngo/'i ri zhes bya bar kuñdza raḥ/ /pra sgo ri bā nu kā re ṇa dā nādre ka rapuṣ+ka raḥ/ / tai ka gyur / /bdag po bzhin du rjes mthun nga/ra/ /sbyin pa'i brlan ldan lag pa'i rdzing / /nam zhig dā tsid+ma hā s+thā na sbi tai bhu pa na nā ya shaṃ/ /bha ba bhū tiḥ sa ma sgyu yāta 'jig rten 'dren byed de/ /chen po'i gnas na 'khod gyur nga/ra/ /j-i gu'i rigs 'khrungs/ thub pa/ ni//j-i gu baṃ sha bha bā mu niḥ / / di bya ka dh+yā sa mā dā ya lā ba rgya la srid 'byor yang dag 'ongs/ gyur te/ /mi dman mtshan mo/'i bdag ngo/ yi4 / /'od kyi dang/'a 'byor li tā na dzñā/ /mūrta mi ba phra bhā la/smro ma khye ṇa su k+ṣa pā pa teḥ / /gzugs/ brnyan 5 bzhin/ /'jo sgeg rol pa 'i bzhin ras can/ /ma/dzes ma mchog cig bzung bar gyur//ku tsa yo ra bi be ke na rā ge na tsa ra shābyā yoḥ/ /ṣ+pe tra yobya pa me ṣ+pe pa nu ma dag ni mi dbe+en zhing / /rkang nga/'i chu skyes dam/ra ba dang / /mig dag g.yo bas 'gro la de/ /shin sā dza ṣ+pe t+ya la dzhai tā / / ta pa ཿ shri ye ba sa nyi tai tai ka t+yā nu ga tu ngo mtshar gyur pa/ bzhin/ /da7'a thub dpa 'a dang 'grogs pa/ bzhin/ /mdzes ma rjes 'brang thub tam+bu kau/ /a pū dza yata pra dzā nā thaḥkṛ tā sa na pa ri gra haṃ/ /ka t+yā pa/ de / /skye rgu'i 6mgon gyis/ mchod byas nas / /stan 7ni yongs su/ bzung bar gyur/ /mdzes/ ma pi dṛ pa mā lo kya dhī ram̐ gi dī ra sun+da ram̐/ /pa ra pi ḍā su kā ru dh+yā ta n+yasta des kyang mi bdag ni/ /brtan ldan zab cing mdzes pa dag /ga'an gyi gdung la snying rje nas/ /gzhu tsā pa mi ba sma raḥ/ /tsū ḍā rat+na su ki ra ṇirdu ra ti k+ṣa ya kā ri byeḥ/ /bzhag 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bzhin/ /gtsug gi rin chen 'od zer ni/ /mi rung 'jig par byed pa yis//95—35

li kharnye rku ku me ṣ+pe ba dik+ṣu ra k+ṣu k+ṣa ra ba bo/ / be+e k+ṣe pa k+ṣi p+ta ma phyogs su/ bsrung ba'i yig 'phreng 1 dag /gur gum gyis ni 'dri ba bzhin/ /rlung be+e g.yabs shing ru tā tsā ma re ṇa be+e rā dzi tai / / so tshwa se ṣ+pe ba sa two na dza ga ta 'phen byed pa/'i/ /rnga yab dag gis rnam mdzes/ pa/ /'gro ba yang dag sgrol min par/ /snying stobs saṃ tā ra khaṃ bi nā/ /rah+pho dā re ṇa hā re ṇa z-i da ya gra ha kā ra zla/ /gyen du 'phyur bcas bajin/ /rin chen yid 'ong na do thal dag /snying gar bzung 4 bar byas pa ni//bā tā nga/ be+e pa dzā shābye she ṣe ṇi ba ni ṣe bi tai / / ba ha r+ghaṃ ma hā tā sa 'og rgud nga/ zhi ba'i sla da/ /lhag ma can gyis bsten nga bathin/ /che ba'i dadu/nga nga/sa sa dang ni//doṣ+ṭa k+ṣa rmā tsibhe na tsak+ṣa rmā/ /pra ya yo sā bhe lā ṣa gya bi sma ya gya bi dhe ya se ma/sa kyis bzod nga thob nga dag /mthong nas ma/ngon nga ra 'dod nga/ dang / /ya ma/tshan dbang du rab tu tī / /kṛ hi tā nu/ ni ruhūṃ ge ku re ga ta ra le k+ṣa rde/ /dz+re ba dīd+dhā ma gyur /ri dwags g.yo ba'i mig can ma// /'u/sa med kyi ni gso/sa/ 5 gyur te/ /thub nga/sa/ pang du bzung rgo ga mya dza gā da dza ga tī pa ti/ /u di te na dza gadz+re tram̐ sha ta pa t+tha nas rmi/ /'gro ba'i bdag 'a rab gru sa nga// /'jig rten 'di na 6 'arga ba'i mig /'dab brgya rnam bi kā shi nā/ /bha ba ta bhā tī lo/ ko yo de be+e na tsa bi ba swa tā/ /a ho nu nga/ra rgyas byed nga// /lha ni khyod dang nyi ma dag /'char bas rab tu mdzes nga/ra gyur/ /'byor 'a sa rnyed — ta ba nāste ba bi byu ti su la sgobye baḥ/ / sā dho ri ba gu ṇa dz+wa ṣaḥ san+d+ra r+ṣa ra 'byung ba yi/ /kun zongs grogs lda na rgyags nga/ dag /dge rnams yon tan 'a sdang bzhin/ /e ha pa tsi bo ma da ཿ / / lo ka nā tha spa terlo ka kā ru rgyu pūr+ṇa tse ta ma ho khyod 'a med nga/ nyid/ /rgya' ngo/ byams ldan 'jig rten mgon/ /'jig rten snying rje kun rdzogs saḥ / /rā dzād+me ṭī dzu ṣa sbya rā tīrtiḥpā ra mi tā pa re/ /a khe da sa ra thugs / /khyod kyi grags/ pa/ sgrol ba / bzhin/ /mchog tu pha rol phyin par gyur/ /khyod ni mi skyo drang 95—36

lo dā tā niṭ+wā dza su kṛ to bha bān/ /a ta e ba bi she ṣe ṇa mā na dī yo po dang / /gtong phod zol med legs/ byas ldan/ /'di nyid phyir na khyad par du/ /blo ldan rnams kyis ma bhā ṣi rde/ /pad+mo dā ra sa mud byu tā ka t+yā ka ma la lo tsa nā/ /ho bsten byar 1 gyur/ /mdzes ma me tog mig can 'di/ /pad+ma'i khongs nas yang dag byung / /sbyin mā ba she ṣa ya sā ba dhi te yayā yā shra rnge / / kṛ hra tā ma gra ma hi sreg lhag ma'i 'o ma yis / /bdag gi 4 gnas/ su legs par gso sa 5 / /btsun mo/ chen cho/ sa/ gzhi yis 6 //྾ pakhye bha ba tā bhu baḥ/ /bi ṣ+ṭaḥshrī ri ba yo gye yo ta be+e ba pu ru ṣet+ta chun mar skyes mchog khrod kyis lo nga / /khyab 'jug nga ni dang/la mo bzhin/ /'di ni khyod bdag nyid la ma / / ya snyo pu rgya pha lo pū tram̐ kā le na ma ma dā su se / / i 'os /dus kyis mchod sbyin bso da nams 'bras / /sdogs/ nga ra bdag 'a sbyin nga/ra ma/dzod/ /'di kyughā bi bye nā rāzlo ka t+yā da tā ya ngo/ mu niḥ/ /pri yī/ pad+mā ba ṭī rā dzā brjod cho gas rgyal ngo/ la / /ma/dzes ma/ byin nas thub nga gshegs// /yid sru ba dasa' ma thob nga/ bzhin//ra ti pā bye ba mad+ma thaḥ/ /a ram̐ sta ru tsi rod+mā ṣ+pe su kṛ te ngu/ rgya bā ni ba/ /rgyal ngo/sa sdug ma nga/d+ma lda na/ /dbe 'a bso da nams/ lda na nga bakhyan/ /ma/dzes mas skyed mo/sa tshal du rtses //ta taḥkā le na sā pu tram̐ baṃ sha bal+lī ba mosti shaṃ/ /a sru ta nga/d+ma tsū ḍā khya de nas dus kyis de yi bu/ /'khri thing spyig ma/'i ru/ tig bzhin/ /bdud rtsi nga/d+ma'i 0 gtsug ces/ nga///gu zla ram̐ dadze+e khaṃ pi tuḥ/ /sha krā di bherlo ka pā le ra nu lo sgya ma ho da yab kyi yon tan me 'o/nga gyur/ /brgya byin 'jig rten skyong so/gas kyis / /bakhyom pa ra mi 'os che bar yaḥ / /saṃ snyu ya mā na tsa ri ta swa yi ka ma la dzad+ma nā/ /ya shaḥsau dar—/ /rang nyid pad+mar skyes so gas/ kyis/ /kun nas bsto da 'os spyod pa/ra ldan/ /grags/ nga/'i dri ra bha saṃ bhā ra saṃ pū ri ta di ga n+ta raḥ / / sa r+pā rja sārja ka spyo ṇa bzang rab rgyas pas// /phyogs kyi khongs/ ni yang dag rdzogs/ /slo/nga ba'i tshogs/ kun dge ba ru//95—37

ka la nā kalpa pā da pa ཿ / / smṛ tā mu ṣ+perba tsaḥ kā le kahūṃ bi pu la bgyid pa'i dpag bsam rkang 'thung ni/ /sa bdag bdag 3 gis thub pa'i tshig /dus su bya bar snyedran dak+ṣi ṇi/ /a ho sā ba su saṃ pūrte mā dza hā ra ma tī pa tiḥ/ /tasmin ya dzhai gyur nas / /mi 'tshe nor ni yongs rdzogs shing / /yon ni yangs pa'i mchod sbyin byas/ /dz+dza jegu'i bu sa mā dzaglu ཿ sa rba kā me+e rbi ra rga le / / mu na yo bhā rga ba mu khā so gas thub nga/ dang / /mi bdag rab tu bzod dka' sogs / /'dod pa kun gyis ma bsdams pa'i//dṛ pā du n+d+ra sa/ hā da yaḥ / / ba rta mā ṣ+pe ma khe ta smin niḥsaṃ khya ba su mchod sbyin der ni yang dag 'ongs / /grangs med nor kyi char 'be+ebs nga 'i/ /sbyin sreg 5mngon du gyur babye ṇi/ /rak+ṣa rū pa sa mut+ta sgo ba sgo ma dh+yāta su re shwa raḥ/ /u pa sre pa/ de'i6 / /me yi dbus/ nas lha yi dbang / /srin po'i gzugs/ su/ yang dag la ngas / /rid cing rnam t+ya sa bhū pā lo kṛ sho bi kṛ ta be+e gra haḥ/ /k+ṣu྾ pā sardi tosmre ti ya yā 'gyur 'u/sa can de/ /sa skyo nga 'a ni nyer btud de/ /bdag ni bkres so cho ma mo zhes// /bza' dang tse pā na sgo dza rgo/ /shā sa nā da tha byu bhartustasmi bi bi dha sgo dza rgo/ /btung ba slo nga bar gyur / /de nas sa yi bdag ngo/'i bkas / /rim gro ba yi 'khor rnams/ kyis///u pa ni rluḥpa ri tsi tāḥpā ā+oṃ tsa pa ri tsā ra kāḥ/ /ta taḥkiñtsid bi ha phye bza' ba rnam pa/ sna tshogs dang / /btung ba dag kyang nye bar bstabs / /de nas srin ngo/sa/ sa bdag la //ba k+ṣi ti baṃ sa ha rāk+ṣa saḥ/ /ṣ+pe da masmata thra yi rā dzan ba yo hi pi shi tā cung zad dgod bzhin rab tu smras// /rgyal po 'di la bdag mi dga'/ /gang phyir bdag ni sha yis sha nāḥ/ /sa dro ha ta su rmā se na ru bye re ṇa tsa byu ya pā/ /dṛste rut+pa r+ya te 'tsho / /'phral la bas/da nga 'i sha dang ni/ /shin tu mang ba'i khrag dag gis/ /bdag cag tshim pa rab s+thā shaṃ dī ya hūṃ ya da dhī smi tai/ / sarba kā ma pra do sī ti tā ma haṃ sa tu skye/ /gang zhig 'dod pa gnang bar mdzod/ /'dod kun rab tu ster ro zhes/ /khyod can bdag ni 95—38

mu pā ga taḥ/ /da dā m+bi ti pra nyi khru t+ya na ni ṣe dhasta bo tsi taḥ/ /i ti yang dag 'ongs/ /sbyin no zhes ni rab bsgrags nas/ /dgag pa khyed kyis 1 'os/ pa min/ /de skad rasgo ba tsa khru tā ka ru ṇa kyu ṇi to dṛ paḥ/ /a ho sā ni ya me nā bhū dbe+e srin ngo/'i tshig thos/ nas/ /snying rjes gzir ba'i mi bdag ni/ /'tshe ba med par nges pas/ na/ /slo nga ba be+e mu khya duḥkhi taḥ/ /a ho so tsin+ta ya de bādz+dza to yo dhan+d+ra saṃ sha yāḥ/ /phyir phyogs sdug bsnga 'a gyur/ /bzod dala'i 'tshe ba mi bzod de/ /slo/nga ba 'bras bu med nga 'ang min//na pa he duḥs/ hūṃ ho shā na tsa ṣ+pe phe l+ya mabe+e naḥ/ /na rmā saṃ sha rī re bh+yo 'a/ kye ma chos 'a the tshom/ 'di/ /byed ngo/sa byas thes de yis bas ma/sa / /bas da nga/ med nga/ra 'u sa la sa ni//bh+ya te be+e ga saṃ bi nā nā/ /haṃ pi dzī la/ kā snga pi kā ya kle sha alpa niḥs he/ /r+sha dag rnyed nga yo/da ma/ yin2 / /bdag bis sngog spu ra dag bi / ya nga / /'u/sa kyi nyon cho/ngas phra mi bzod//da tā haṃ sa rba bhū te bh+ya ཿ pu rgyu ma bha ya da k+ṣe rde / / ka tha ma smi bdag bis/ 'byung ngo/ thams cad la / /'jisas ched bso da nam/sa yo/na byin nas / /sro/ga chasas bas da pra yats+tsha mi rmā/ saṃ s+thā ṇi ba sgo bhe baṃ / / i ti saṃ tsi t+ya dṛ nga/ ti sta mū la sa byung ba'i sgo /'di 'a bdag bis ji lta/ra sbyin/ /nge k+ta ra legs bas ma/sa mi bdag ni/ /snying rjes tse ka ru zla ku la/ཿ/ /swa sha rī ra sa muskṛt+ta ma pri rmā/ saṃ da dā mi te/ /i truste 'khrugs nga sa/ de 'a smra sa// /rang 'u sa/ yang dag bcad nas rgo/ /tha khas khyod la sbyin nga/ra bya/ /sa yi byu mi pa ti na ba bhū bā ku li tai dza gta/ /na tsa de ha bya yod+mā haṃ pa tsi bdag ngo/sa/ de smras nga/sa / /'gro ba rnams ni 'khrugs pa/ra gyur/ /'u sa ni zad nga/ra spro ba yang / /grogs bā sta su se hi re/ / pra ṇa yād bār+ya mā no pi bhū pā leḥmu ni byesta mchog rnams kyis 4bzod ma gyur/ /sa skyong de bzhin thub rnams kyis// /brtse bas rab tu bzlog gyur thā / /da do swa de ha mu t+tha rmya tasmi rmā sa ma sresba saṃ/ /ā kaṇ+ḍi bī ta kyang / /rang sga 'u sa/ la sa 5 bcad nas ni/ /sha khrag zhag rnams de la byen/ /mgrin pa/'i bar du khrag 95—39

raste na rāk+ṣa se na k+ṣi ti pra sgoḥ/ /bhak+ṣu mā ṇi 6 rmā se 6 rak+ṣa rna k+ṣi ti ra kadza 'thungs pa'i/ /srin pos/ sa yi bdag po yi/ /sha rnams rab tu za ba'i tshe/ /skad cig sa ni rab tu ta / /ta taḥpad+ma ba tī de bī pa ti dṛṭī ta thā ga tai/ /bi la padhī ni pa ti 'dar / /de nas/ lha mo pad+ma ldan/ /bdag ngo/ de lta ra gyur mthong nas// /smre sngags 'don cing rab tu tā mo hā mū : ku lā bha ba ta / / ma nu dzen+d+ra gya de be n+d+ra sta tra dṛ ṭī 'gye' /rmongs thing brgya' bas/ dkris par gyur/ /mi yi dbang po'i snying stobs/ ni/ /rab rgyas de sa/twa mūrdzi tai/ /rasgo rū paṃ pa ri t+ya bye ta mu bā tsa kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /a ho mthong lha dbang jis / /sren ngo 'i gzugs ni yongs btang nas / /thal mo/ sbya ra nas de 'a smras / /e ma nu karma ṇa rā dza na duṣ+ka re ṇa ta bā nu/ nā/ /ro rmā/ tsa ka tsu kā tīr+ṇaḥkā ho rgya' ngo/ khyod kyi 1 ni/ /bya ba dala' ba'i la sa 'di yi sa / /ba spu nga ngas nga gtam/sa nga/'i sos / /'u sa yaḥka su na dzā ya te/ /a ho pu rgya ma sā mā n+ya ma ho sa twa ma nu ta ram̐/ /a ho la ci phyir 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgya' ngo rdu' bra' khyed kyi ni/ /e ma/ bso da nams thun mo/nga min/ /e ma/ bye d+ma ma mar+yā rda rā dzan be+e ra dza sa sta ba / / duḥkhi taḥpa ra duḥkhe 6 snying sto bas bla na med/ /e ma brtan nga/ ma/tha' dang bral / /pha ro' sdug 'a sa sdus bsnga 'a zhing / /rnyed nizlo bhā durla bhe 6 tsa/ /bi pak+ṣe 6 k+ṣa mā ban+taḥpan+taḥsu kṛ ta pe ta baḥ/ /dala' 'a yang chags dang bra' / /mi ma/thun phyosas 'a bzod lda na nga// /dam/ nga/ rnams ni legs byas 'a ma///sa ru/ dz+re ṣa ti ko bye ṣa sa two ṣ+ṭha ho ma hā t+pa dzā / / tre lo kyi
