ka ru gang gis 'jis rten sasu ma/ ngo/ la / /rjes su brtser gyur bdag nyid che/ /snying rjes/ brlan pa'i snying rjadre rde yen yā t+ya nu kadz+re hūṃ / /uste ti di bye ṣa bye bheste kṛ tā swasgra stobs/ kyi4 / /spro ba 'di ni yang dag gas la// /'di brjod lha yi sma na rnams kyis/ /de 'u sa rnal du bi gra haṃ/ /pra sā r+ya ladz+dza ba na taḥsha kraḥswa ni la yo ya yo/ /ta taḥs māste gnas/ nga/ra byas / /rab tu dang zhing ngo tshas dman/ /brgya byen rang ji gnas su/ song / /de nas/ mchod 95—40

be+e bye ba ta ya dzhai rā dzñā ma tī pa tiḥ / / tsakre mu ni ba rā rde tsa pū sbyin cho ga bzhin/ /rdzogs te skabs gsum pas mchod pa'i/ /sa/ yi bdag pos rgyal po dang / /thub rdzu tri da sha pū dzi dza nā rmā sha tai tūr+ṇa me brgyar ni mgyogs nga/ ru/ /nyi ma gcig bis 'gro ba gang / /rgyal ngo/'i glang chen mdun na 'don//ke nā d+dhā pra yā ti yaḥ / / ta smi sa ma/thi ti dṛ ṭ+wā rādzñā bha dra gi ri ga tshangs pa'i shing rta jes nga/ra byin4 / /rgya' po/'i glang chen bzang ngo/'i ri/ /de 'a yang dag satad mthong dze+e / /a byud duḥpra sa ho rā dzā tata spri hā kṛṣ+ṭa mā na saḥ/ /pra yā te nas/ / /rgyal po thin tu bzod dala' der/ /chags nga/sa drangs nga/'i yid du gyur/ /de nas sa bdag ṣa tha bhū pe ṣā bi smi te khum kha shrī yā// / sa marngi/ ti yadzha pha le bhārga mchod sbyin gyi/ /dang/'a kyis/ ya mtshan gshegs gyur cing / /sa yi 5 spyo da nga/sa ma/chod sbyin 'bras / /j-i ( bā ya ma tī bhu dzā/ /ta mu bā tsa sa ma bye t+ya swaste bā da pu raḥpa ram̐/ /ma rī gu'i bu la gtad nga/'i tshe/ / ma/ rī tsi 1 sgo ba thub nga ni/ /ma/chod dang sta/na thob bā tī la /yang das tsi shi khyo bā tī kaḥ s+thā p+ta pū dzā sa no mu niḥ / / rā dzan+da dh+ya ya na sngadhe 'ongs nas shis pa'i tshig /ma/ngon du btang nas de 'a smras / /rgya' ngo/ slo ba gnyer gang bi mthar//gu rurme gu ru dak+ṣi rde/ /yī ha te pa ri tsar+yādhī sā mā n+ya dza na durla bhā/ /bdag gi bla ma bla ma'i yon/ /g.yo ga 'khor don du skye bo ni/ /thun mo/nga ba la sa/ 1rnyed da7'a bzhed //e kasta rnge ba bi dhi nā nirmi to durla bha pra daḥ / /ba ha bo dzā tu dzā sgrub byed khyod nyid gcig pu yis/ /rnyed dka' rab tu sbyin pa sprul / /dpag bas ma rkang 'thung 'jig 95—4 1

yadhe na lo ke kalpa pā da pā/ /de be+e pad+mā ba ti pu tra sa hi ta gu ra be rten na/ /nam yang mang po skye mi 'gyur/ /bdag gi bla ma dka' thub kyis/ /nyam chung rgas pa'i g.yog ma ma/ /ta paḥkṛ sha ya bṛdhe ya dī ya tī pa ri hā ri rmā/ /i rkyuste mu ni nā rā 'khor du/ /pad+ma ldan pa'i lha mo ni/ /bu dang bcas pa gnang bar mdzod/ /thub pas de brjod rgyal po dzā da yi tā bi pra yo ga rdzu/ /ru dze+e saṃ sta bh+ya ma na sā ta mū tse byer+ya bhū ni / /brtan pa sa/ 'dzin btsun mo dang / /'bral la sa skyes/ pa'i mya ngan la sa// /yid ni brtan pas de dha raḥ/ / pra yasgo mi mu ṣ+pe tu bye mispru tī gu ru dak+ṣi rde/ /sa hi tsā la smras / /dga' ma srog 'a sa mngon par lhag /rgya' tshab dag dang bcas nga/ ni/ /mngon pa/ra 'dod yu ba rā dze na dz+re bi tā bh+ya dhi rmā pri yī/ /i kyuk+ta sa su tī tasmi da do pad+mā nga/ bla ma'i yon/ /jub pa/ khyed la rab tu sbyin/ /de ska da brjod nas/ mi bdag jis / /pad ldan sras ba ṭī dṛ paḥ / / swa dz+re bi te pi ni ste hasgyu gi sa twa ma yāt+pa rmā/ /bcas/ de la byin1 / /sems dang/'a tshul ldan bdag nyid rnams / /rang srog la yang chags med gtong //ā dā ya rā dza dā yi hūṃ bi ra ha kle sha kā ta dzā/ /sa pu tā mā shra rmā bral ba'i nyon mo/ngas kyis skra ga pa/'i/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo sras dang bcas / /blangs te gnas su/ so nga ga twa pra da do gu ra we mu niḥ/ /a tā n+ta re duḥ pra sa haḥku ru rā nas ni/ /thub nga sa bla ma la rab phul / /na bas der dregs bcas/ ku ru'i rgyal / /shin tu bzod dzaḥk+ṣi tī shwa ram̐/ /dṛsto pa yā tse dru te na bhū h+ye bha dra gi ri ga dze+e/ /pu da7'a na sa dbang 'a / /glang chen bzang po'i ri bo ni/ /'byor phyir pho nyas nye bar blangs 4/ /mdun ro hi tā bye tai rā dza na da do dī ra rda ya dā/ / ta dā bi pu la be+e bye na 'don la byin zin pa'i/ /so gnyis rgya' pos ma byin gang / /de tshe rang nyid mang po'i sdes//na swa yo yoju sa mā ya yo/ /ba li nā ku ru rā dze na ru snye pu ra 6 g.yu la ni rab tu 'gyed du 'ong 5/ /ku ru'i rgyal po'i dpung rnams kyis/ /grong khyer lam rnams bkag 695—42

baṭ+wā su/ /ba bhū ba bhū mi pa khā su me+e t+yā ra ṇa ra soṅgha ṭi/ /sa bī ra kuñdza pa la/ /sa gzhi skyong ba'i dmag gi tshogs/ /g.yul du 'jug pa rab spror gyur/ /dpa' bo glang chen ra ha riḥ sha sto gya ri bi dā ra ṇi / / dza na k+ṣa ya bha yo byi sna ཿ kā seng ge de/ /dgra ni rnam 'joms nus gyur kyang / /skye bo 'dzad 1 pas 'jigs shing 'khrugs/ /snying ru sgyuta sa ma tsin+ta yata/ /a ho3nu kyu la mi tram̐ me rā dzā duḥpra sa haḥpa ram̐/ /rje la sa ni yang dag bsams/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka' ni/ /bdag gi rjes mthun grogs/ kyi mchog/mā tai ga lo bha mo he na sa ha sā sha tru tram̐ ga taḥ/ /ste hād+dhāḥsu dza ṣ+peḥsne glang po dag la chags rmongs pa2 / /kye ma 'phral 'a dgra nyid gyur/ /dam pa'i mdza' ba mdza' ba'i hā ni ste hā khye : ma dh+ya miḥ / / du rdza ṣ+pe sgo rā be+e rā tī bha ba dhi mtha' / /bar ma rnams kyis/ mdza' med mtha'/ /ngan pa rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa/sa / /shin tu pā ṇa hā ri ṇaḥ/ /a ho bi bha ba lo bhe na k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa yi ni dz+re bi te/ /'jigs rung dgra mtha' yin/ /kye ma 'byor pa la chags/ pa/sa/ /bdag ji yang das sbyo ra ba 'di//sa mur+ya mo ya masmra shaṃ pa ra pā ṇa ni pā ta ṣ+pe/ /ho sa yā pa pra sād+dhā srog ni na da cig 'jigs 4ldan zhing / /gzhan kyi srog ni gcod nga/ la 'o/ /'tshe bas ngal 'a rab chags ā+oṃ shaghā dzā ka li karma su/ / ra ṇa raghā ste ṣigh+ra rna bha k+ta tho yo shing / /g.yu 'a gyi khrag gis mngon bkrus pa'i/ /sems can yang dag sbyo ra ba 'di/ /zas don rtsod sa mur+ya maḥ/ / se bā bi yī ta dzī bā dzā tsaṇ+ḍa r+pāṇ+ḍabe+e na ma yi/ / ka pa'i las la 'o/ /g.yog 'khor gtum drag phra ma can/ /srog rnams/ 5 'tshong zhing kha zas/ dag /don la ho daḥs haḥkror+ya pi shu nā rmā shu na mi ba/ /a ho bi bha ba lu pa dhī dzā pa gnyer rnams kyi rtsod pa ni/ /khyi rnams kyi bzhin bzod par dka'/ /kye ma rdzas la chags pa/'i blo/ /pha ra saṭ+wā pa shī ta lāḥ/ /swa su kha ma ba dh+wa brnyi dṛ shaṃ sa tsa ri to bye yaḥ/ /ye rol gdung bas bsel gyur pa/ /rang nyid bde ba kho na'i phyir/ /ma rungs spyod la rab tu rgyug /gang 95—43

yudhi sedhi san+da d+dhā ralnga dhe khyuñdza te shri yo/ / ku taḥhrū ra tā re te ྾ zhig g.yu la grub go bgos shing / /khrag gis sbags pa'i dpal za ba/ /de snying rab tu drag po la//j-i da ya kā ru ṇa ka ṇaḥ/ /e ṣa dun+d+ra sa ho rā dzā lusgo bi bha ba mo hi taḥ/ /snying rje'i cha 1 ni ga la zhig /rgyal ngo shin tu bzod dka' 'di/ /rnam par 'byor la chags shing rmongs//na ba rgyaḥ sā pa rāsgo pi kā ru zla ya ta rna ma ma/ /i ti tsin+ta ya ta bdag gi snying rje'i yu/'a gyur pas / /gnod byed gyur kyang gsad mi 'os// /de ltar bas mas shing snying sta su kā ru rgyuta kā na nai ṣi ṇaḥ/ /pra h+ye ka bud+dhābya twa raḥswa yam̐ byo: sa rje la sa / /nags ni 'tshol byed de yi be+e da/ /rang sa ngas/ rgyas ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rang nyid mkha' la sa/ mā ya yuḥ/ /pāp+ta pū dzā ma nāḥkhru tā sarba dzhasta ta sā m+bi hi tai/ /rā rnyeḥpra yang dag 'ongs / /kun ma/khyen mchod dang stan thob cing / /dang bas/ rab zhi ngang tshul can/ /rgyal po 4sha ma shī la su pra san+d+ra sta twa mū tsi re/ / saṃ mo ha pa ṭa lādhe 6 saṃ yang dag bzhed pa/ de/ /thos nas de nyid rab tu gsu/ngas// /'khor ba kun rmongs/ rab rib kyi/ /lo nga 5sā ri 6 da yā lu tā/ /sho bha te ta ba bhū bī la sa twa lo ka bi be+e ki naḥ/ /bar brtse ba dang ldan pas / /sems nga/ 6snang ba'i rnam rig can/ /sa skyong khyod ni mdzes par gyur//kri ya tā m+bi dhī tai rā dzan bo dhi budhirni dhī ya tsā/ /saṃ pra ti pra ti ro byesmin rgyal ngo/ dgyes pa/ra mdzod cig dang / /byang chub tu ni blo gros/ tshugs / /da lta 7rab tu 'gog nga/'i tshe//ba na me+e ba bi gā khya tī / /smi ra nisgo ra rdzu kā ra tīṇ+ḍi saṃ to ṣa sbo ka nags nyid du ni 'gro bar byas/ / /chu rgyun rab gas la lhung lhung sgrog/ /yang dag sem byed zigs/ pa/ rāḥ / /bi bik+ta kā na nodhe sha sha mi na me ba pabe+e bhāḥ/ /i kyughā nu can / /dben pa'i nags kyi sa phyogs de/ /zhi ba rnams kyi dga' bskyed 7nyid/ /rjes su bzung blos gra ha bye yā bi dha yā su bi yaṅga ti/ / pra bhā pra sā di ta di shaste 'di gsungs nas/ /de la mkha' gshegs bsgrubs byas te/ /'od kyis phyogs rnams rab gsal zhing //95byed44

te na sa nyi tā ya yuḥ / /yā te 6 swa pa rda te 6 nyi ma ba t+ta ṭa kā de dang lhan cig de rnams gshegs/ /de rnams rang rang gnas gshegs te/ /sa skyong gangs can ngos na rna/ /saṃ pā pya thra zi bī pā laḥpra yan+da pra sha mo bha bta/ /bi be ka bi ma la kyi nags / /yang dag thob pas rab dang zhing / /rab tu zhi ba dag tu gyur/ /snying stobs ldan rnams/ nang na ni//sta gya bye yaḥs twa ba tā mi ba/ / : ba bhū pri ya ni buḥpūṇ+ḍi nir+pā bye ba na byu ma yaḥ//wo bar 'der dz+waba' ba'i char gyi 〉 da dob yi sa 'bru sum chad pa ma dpe ma ra 'a sa ma snyed pa pre ya ri rmes pa 'ji 'dar ma sa sasar du bcus pa rgya dpe snyed na ngadrung de blo dbe+en zhing dri ma med/ /dga' ba'i char ni rdzogs pa/'i sa / /nags kyi sa gzhi bzhin du gyur//bhū dha dzā ta ri te ta smin sa ha sā bhū pa bhā swa ti/ /shu shu burmo ha ti sa bdag 'od lda na 'phral la ni/ /sa 'dzin dag 1 gis bsgribs nga/ der/ /gti mug mi ra pābe+e sho ka pra dzāḥpra dzāḥ/ / ta tastata sa tsi bā ga ke ma rī rab rib thob pa/ yis / /mya ngan 'gro tshogs skye rgu na nyal / /de nas thub nga ma rī tse'i/ /dbus 4su tse mu ni mā shra me/ /shashrī rābye gya rak+ṣu yi rā dza pu tram̐ ya yā tsi reḥ/ /mu de yi blon ngo/ so nga / /rgya' srid bsru/nga bar nus gyur nga 'i/ /rgya' ngo/'i sras ni rab tu bar+ṣa ngas / /thub ni nā nirngi kā re ṇa dat+ta mā dā ya madh+ri ṇaḥ/ / rā dza su rnu swa na ga re nga/sa rnam 'gyur med nga/ra 6 byin/ /blon ngo/ yis ni blangs byas te/ /rgyal sras rang si grong khyer du//tsakruḥme+e n+ya sa myur+ya rma/ /ta taḥsri n+ya sa mud+mā ha i ba rā dza ba rāt+pa dzaḥ/ /dmag tshogs yang dag ldan par byas / /de nas/ dmag sde'i spro ba bzhin/ /shin tu dpa/'a ba sngo na 'gro ba//su bha ṭā gre sa raḥpā puḥku ru rā dze+e ra bhā dzi re/ /sa te na ha ta bi dh+wasta bhasna rgyal po mchog gi sras po yis/ /'khrug sar ku ru'i rgyal/ po sleb/ /de yi shing rta glang po che/ bcom san+da na kuñdza raḥ/ /ba khā ya na pa ri tā ṇaḥpra ya yo haste na pu ram̐/ /zhing rnam bshig bcag pas de/ /'bros pas yongs su skyob byed byung / /haste na yi grong du song //95byed45

ba li nā rā dza pu tre ṇa dzi te dun+d+ra sa te yu bye/ /madh+ri bhista rtse dza n+ya stobs ldan rgyal po'i sras po des/ /shin tu bzod dka'i g.yu la bcom la// /blon pos de dpung sa stu bhū mi na she ṣa bye ti ya yo / / rā zlo du dz+ra sa ha snga tha kā le brkod pas/ /lhag ma can bzhin dga' bar gyur—) / /de nas dus kyis sdig bdag nyid/ /rgyal po na ka lu ṣāt+pa naḥ/ /ba bhū ba dṛṣ+ṭi dubhik+ṣa ma ra ko pa bla baḥpu re/ /sa bi shin tu bzod dka' yi/ /grong du char med mu ge dang / /yams/ kyi nye bar 'tshe ba byung / /mi bzad tsin+tu nu tā pārta s+t+ri bye dza na pa dā pa rda/ /na bi be da pa ri tā rde grong rda' 2 rgud pa dag /bsams pa/sa rjes/ su/ gdung bas/ gzir/ /dge ba'i bya ba 'bras med des//bi pha la swaste kaḥkri yaḥ/ /thraṭ+wā bi pata pra tī kā re te nā mā t+yāsta mū tse re/ /yongs su skyob pa na rig ma gyur/ /rgud pa sel byed de yis dris / /blon ngo/ rnams kyis de 'a smras //duḥs ho yasma hā rā dza dza na bya sa nobye baḥ/ /ma ṇi tsū ḍa gya bhū bhartar+ya rgya'/ ngo/ chen ngo/ bzod dka' 'di/ /skye bo gdung ba yang dag bskyed/ /sa/ bdag gtsug na rin chen gyis/4//di tso ḍa ma ṇi pra sgo/ /la bh+ya te sa su ṅgāsudhī te ṣ+pe yo tīr+ya te bi pata/ /jo bo ga' te gtsug gi nor/ /bdud rtsi'i brlan 5ldan rnyed na ni/ /de yis rgud 6pa 'di la/sa/ thar//tsā re bh+yaḥshu ta masmra bhiḥs rā dza hi ma bat+ta ṭi/ /sbi taḥsaṃ sā ra be+e mu gangs can ngos na rgyal po de/ /dben zhing dri bra' bas ma pa/ yis / /'khor ba'i 7la sa/ ni phyir phyogs khyaḥbi be ka bi ma lā sha yaḥ/ /athi taḥ sa da dā h+ye ba bi shwa tsid+dhā gnas / /bdag gis bya ma rta la sa thos// /kun gyi yid bzhin nor bu deḍa / /bsla ngas na nor bu ma ṇirma ṇi/ /pu tra dā ra sha rī rā di na de yo ta su ki tsa na/ /i ti madh+ri ba tsaḥster ba nyid/ /bu dang chung ma 'u sa la so gas/ /de yi 1 sbyin min ci yang med/ /de skad blon po'i tshig shu tā ta the t+ya ra dh+wa r+ya tse ta se/ / sa dī dzād+ma ṇi yadzñā yi bi sa sardza thos nas/ /sems la de bzhin brtan 1 byas te/ /de yis slong phyir bram ze rnams/ /de yi drung du 95—46

ta darnyi shaṃ/ /asmin+da ba sa re rā dzā ma ṇi tsū ḍa : ren pa ṣ+pe/ /ma rī tse rā brdzangs/ pa/ra gyur/ /skabs 'dir rgyal po gtsug na ni/ /nor bu nags su rgyu ba yis/ /thub pa ma rī shra mo pān+ta ma bā pa bi pu lam̐ mu ṣ+peḥ/ /de ste pad+mā ba tī ta tra pha la mū khā tse'i 3 gnas kyi/ /nye 'khor yangs par phyin par gyur/ /der ni lha mo pad+ma ldan/ /rtsa ba 'bras za'i dh+ri ti bra tā/ /pra dzaṭī bi dza ṣ+pe d+dhā tā bi pe ṣ+pe mu ṣ+pe shā sa nāta/ /sa brtul zhugs bzung / /mi med nags/ su/ thub pa yis/2 / /bstan pa la sa ni 'jigs shing song / /rngon ba rimṛ ga yā yā tai j-i ṣ+ṭa ka ṣ+ṭa da shaṃ sh-i tā / /dzi 1 k+ṣu rnyiḥ kadza mā la 'gro ba'i sha ba ris / /sdug bsngal gnas 〉 bas/ bsten nga/ mthong / /'dzin par 'dod pa/sa 'dar nā tsu kro sha ka ru ṇa swa ram̐/ /ā kasbya ka ru zla krasdo ku ra lī kyu dzi to gyur cing / /snying rje rje 〉 da cho nges/ btab/ /kyi hud rgyal ngo/ gtsug na nor/ /zhes dang skyabs shes mi pa oṃ/ /hā rā dzad+ma ṇi tsū ḍi ti tra ya swe ti ra duḥs haṃ/ /sa ha sā bhi bzad nga/4/ /bya ni ku re re sgrogs/ bzhin/ /snying rjer cho nges grags 5pa/ thos / /mi bdag rgyugs/ pa/'i dru ta kādzñā da dar+sha dṛ pa tirni dzā/ /rāhu saṃ tā se ta gyesdorlu tim+bi pa nyi 'phral 6la ni/ /rang gi mdzes ma mthong gyur te/ /zla ba sgra gcan gyis skra ga pa/ /'od ni rnam par tā mi ba / /bī ta rā gī ga ba sa dzñā ni rañdza na pa ri gra haṃ / /nyams nga/ bzhin/ /chags/ bral lus kyi gos 'dzin cing / /mig sma na yongs su 'dzin dang bra' / /ba dadhī mi baṃ saṃ sgo ga saṃ yo gā nā ma m+bi t+ya tī/ /tī rā dza haṃ sa su ga rdzogs pa'i lo ngas spyod kun sbyor rnams/ /mi rtag nyid du smra ba bzhin/ /rgyal po ngang pa bde bar tsā bi hā ra sta na mā ṇ+ḍa dze+e / / a shu kā ṣā ya nā ya dze+e bi lo gshegs—/ /nu ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gnas/ /'dren byed mchi ma'i ngur smrig can/ /snying rje'i kya ka ru zla ba dī/ /saṃ sā ra tsa ri tābyar+ya bi tsa re ṣ+ṭa pi karka shaṃ/ /kṛ sa de rnam gzigs nas/ /'khor ba'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /rnam par spyod la sra gyur kyang / /sa 95—47

pā kṛ pā bhā nidze+e na mi ba khyu pa terma naḥ/ /e kā ki rgo ba ṣ+pe de bī bi bdag yid ni brtse ba yi/ /chu gris nges par bcad pa bzhin/ /lha mo mgon med lta bu yis/ /nags ga tats+tsha tra tsā ma re/ /dṛṭī nā tha ma nā bye ba lo ka nā dze+e ta thā ga tai/ /su mgon po gcig pu nyid/ /'jig rten mgon po de ltar song / /gdugs dang rnga yab bral mthong nas//tabyi yo ga bi ṣā krān+ta tadrwar+sha na ra sā ku lā/ /sho ka har+ṣa sa mā tīr+ṇa ba de bral dug gis non pa dang / /de mthong nyams dga' rgyas pa dag /mya ngan dga' ba yang dag rdzogs//byu ba j-i sha bi two khā/ /sām+bi tāḥs ba rā rā rnye shā pa dī ta pra du dru myur du rnam par 'khrugs par gyur/ /rgyal po ①zhi bgyis sha ba ri/ /dmod pas 'jigs nas rab tu shuḥ / /na nā ma byu da ye bhā no n+d+raṣ+ṭi sa pra ti sgo ta maḥ/ /a tān+ta re sha bros—/ /nyi ma mngon par 'char ba yis/ /mthu ldan mun pa dman gyur mthong / /bar 'dir zhi la ma dwo ྾ sarba bhū tā sha yā sha yaḥ/ /mā raḥpu ru ṣa rū pe ṇa sa me sdang ba'i bdud/ /'byung po kun gyi bsam par gnas/ /skyes bu'i gzugs kyis yang dag 'ongs/ /mi t+ya dṛ pa ma shra bīta/ /rā dzā: dz+re ba na ya rmā thra yī pra ṇa yi bhā mi rmā/ /na t+yathi bdag la ni smras par gyur/ /rgyal po chu skyes spyan ldan dag /mi med nags su dga' ma ni/ /phreng ldan marta gya dza ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe ba na dza lo tsa na/ /i yo hi te ma no thra ti mig can ④mnyes gshin ma/ /'di ni gtang ①bar mi 'os so/ /rgyal srid longs spyod kyis spangs nas//ri ba niḥsu kha hūṃ ga tā/ /brdzi tā rā bye sgo ge na rā dza rā dza na rā dza te/ /nges par bde med gyur pa 'di/ /khyod kyi yid kyi spyod tshul bzhin/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po mi mdzes so//e ta dā kabye dṛ pa tiste bi dzñā ya ma no byu ba/ /an+ta rā yi bi be ka gya de dag thos shing dbe+en pa yi④/ /bar du gcod byed yid byung ⑤du/ /rnam par shes te mi bdag gis//pā t+ya bhā ṣi ta sa smi taḥ/ /dzā nā mi tā ma haṃ kā ma ma kā oṃ sha ma saṃ ya me//'dzum bcas de la lan smras pa/ /dul la zhi ba mi 'dod pa'i/ /'dod pa khyod ni bdag gis shes//95—48

saṃ to ṣa bā saṃ ko nā pa bha ba tā na bi mo hi taḥ/ /i ti bā di ni bhū pā le rab tu sim par 'dod pa rnams/ /su zhig khyod kyis rnam mi rmongs/ /sa skyong de skad brjod pa yis//sa ha sān+ta ri tai sma re/ /ba bhū ba bi kla bā de bī tabhā bi ra ha ba sgo 'phral la 'dod pa mi snang gyur/ /'bral ba'i me yis gdungs pa yisahu)/ /lha mo shin tu rnam par n+da—/ /duḥkhi tād+dhā marta duḥkhā pa ti sgo ga pi yo gi me+e/ /u bā tsā 'khrugs/ /yid byung ①las rgyal rgyal po yi①/ /btsun mo bdag po longs spyod bral/ /sdug bsngal mi shwa sa ya ṭ+wā dzā dzā yī dzi ta ma no bha ba/ /de ba dhah+ma kṛ ya yulnga na sho ka 'os sdug bsngal ldan/ /de la dbugs ni 'byin zhing smras/ /lha mo chos ni bya bar rigs/ /mya ngan bya kartu marta si/ /duḥkhā pa pa ni bi ra saḥsabaṃ yo su kha bi bh+ra maḥ/ /de hi bar mi 'os so/ /bde bas rnam par 'khrul pa yis④/ /ro bral mjug ni sdug bsngal yin/ /lus can dzā da yi tā saṃ gāsta ram̐ ga ta ra lā yu ྾/ /lo la pad+ma pa lā shā gra slu ladz+dza ma tshe ni rgyug chu 'dra/ /g.yo ba rnams kyi snying sdug grogs/ /pad+ma g.yo ba'i 'dab rtse na/ /'breng ⑤ba'i chu la bā ku khāḥ/ /i mā rū snurta nārta kyaḥkāl me gha ta ḍil+la tāḥ/ /saṃ thigs lta bu yin/ /dpal 'di yud tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin glog 'khyug pa dang / /'khor sā ra sadze+e ra sa nā bi lā sa tsa pa lā shri yaḥ/ /sgo ga k+ṣa kho ṣ+pe ba bi yo ga ro gāḥba'i sbrul gyi duro 'dzin ni/ /rnam par rtse bzhin ④rab tu g.yo/ /longs spyod skad cig kho nas 'bral bi khyu ta yaḥswasna bi bā ha tu spyoḥ/ /bā tā ha tā dī pa shi khā su kha shrī ba'i nad/ /'byor pa rmi lam bag ma len dang mtshungs/ /bde ba'i dpal ni rlung bsnun mar me ④rtse//tud+mat+ta dṛtrī bha ba thrat+ta me tata/ /sarbo pa jo byā ka ru ṇa na lasmri sadhen+d+ra srid pa'i spyod tshul 'di dag smyon pa'i gar/ /snying rje kun byis bsten bya dpal 'byor min/ /dam chos pra kā shaḥs tan na dī pāḥ/ /ya shaṃ si ra myu ni na yo ba nā ni sbi rā ṇi rtag tu gsal byed ⑨mar me min/ /grags snyan rnams kyis dga' ldan na chung min/ /bsod nams dag 95byed49

pu rgyu ni na dz+re bi tā ni/ /sa t+ya pra tastu mi ti sā twa yi tā bi mṛ bye ni brtan ldan 'tsho ba min/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ni de la de skad gdams/ /drang srong chen dzā yo ni la yasma hasteḥ/ /tsa tsā ra saṃ sā ra pa rārlu khā ram̐ saṃ to po'i 'dul ba btsun mo rnams btang nas/ /'khor ba las ni phyir phyogs rnams kyi dka' thub nags//ṣa pu bye 6 ta po ba ṣ+pe 6 / / ta thā ga tā ste twa ra yā yang dag bsel ①byed bsod nams ldan par rgyu zhing song / /rgyal po shin tu bzod dkas myur bar bi mṛṣ+ṭhaḥpañtsa dī dzā dun+d+ra sa he na rā dzñā/ /ta mabe+e nā me ka ma kā gnyis skyes lnga/ /rnam par btang zhing de bzhin song bas ①des/ /rnam dag snying stobs slong ba rnams la bahūṃ bi shudha satwa da dṛ shurba nārnyi/ /te swaste bā rda sa na ṣ+perbi dh+wa kyi ni/ /dus med gnyen gcig po de nags mthar mthong / /'jigs nas brtan pa rnam par btang ba ya bi shasta byerlu i ba sa dh+wa se na/ / ta spru tsi re sru tsi ta tī bra bzhin—/ /de dag gis ni sgra bskyungs shis brjod bsgrubs/ /shugs ring ①ring zhing dro ba'i rjorlung dag tā pā dīsgoṣ+ṭa ni shā sa sa m+bi ra ṇi na/ /rā dza na pu re duḥpra sa ha su rā dzñāḥgis—/ /mi bzad gdung ba bsal ⑤byas de la smras/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka'i grong khyer du//ku ro pa sargahai ta shān+ta brgaḥ/ /dza naḥkṛ taḥkṛt+ta sa map+ta kā maḥpra rgyal po drag po'i rjonyer 'tshes dge tshogs bcom/ /skye bo'i 'dod pa mtha' dag chad par byas/ /rab kā ma mārta swa na mā tra she ṣaḥ/ /a she ṣa do ṣa pra sha be+e ka he tuste lo 'dod gzir ④ba'i sgra tsam lhag mar gyur/ /skyon rnams ma lus zhi ba'i rgyu gcig pu/ /'jig rten kya rak+ṣa pra thi ta pra bhā baḥ/ /tsū ḍā ma ṇirde ba bha ba dī dī ṇaḥka ro ti gsum bsrung grags pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /gtsug gi nor bu lha khyod gnang ⑧ba na/ /de yis rjonye bar 'tshe ta spyo pa ni pā ta shārnyi ma/ /da yā dzu ṣabyun+da na pal+la bādroḥswatshwa sha yā byan+d+ra rnams zhi bar bgyid/ /brtse bas bstan ⑩pa tsan+dan yal 'dab brlan pa dang / /dri med bsam pa zla 95—50

ma ṇi pra kā shaḥ/ /saṃ tā pa kā le sha ra rde dza nā dzā bha ba byi dh+wa ba'i nor bu rab gsal ba/ /khyod nyid lta bu yongs su gdung ba'i dus su ni/ /srid par ①skye bo rnams e ba bha be bha brnyi/ /i t+yabe+e taste ra bi lup+ta satāḥsaṃ pūr+ya mā ṇaḥkyi skyabs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de dag gis ni de skad bslangs la snying stobs rnams④/ /rnam par ma bri ka ru shā ra se na/ /u bā tsa saṃ tsin+d+ra dza no pa tā paṃ saṃ krān+ta man+taḥsnying rje'i ro yis yang dag khengs/ /thos pa'i lam nas skye bo'i nye bar gdung ba dag /khong du yang dag shu ti ba t+pa ṣ+pe ba / / a ho sa rā dza sa ha te ka tha n+da de bo zhugs bzhin legs par bsams nas smras/ /kye ma ma la nye bar 'joms pa'i las kyis ni/ /nges par pa ghā te na ni spru ḍi tā rmā/ /nirda ri tān+taḥka ra r+ṇa pra dzā rmā bi yo gzir ba'i skye rgu ④bral ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /rab skyes cho nge'i sgra ni nang gi byed pa dag /nges par ga duḥkhodzha ba mārta nā rda/ /a yi ma ṇis+thāsta ka spru la dzad+mā naskṛ t+ya 'joms pa rgyal po des ni ji ltar bzod/ /bdag gi mgo yi rtsa ba las skyes nor bu 'di/ /myur du nges tūṇ+ḍi pra ti kṛ khya tī me/ / dha sngasmi ya byebe+e dza na gya duḥkha k+ṣa ye par chod la rab tu bzung rjobar gyis/ /gal te skye bo slong ba'i sdug bsngal 'dzad ⑤pa yi/ /rgyu nyid du k+ṣa r+ṇa kā ra ṇa tsā bra dzā mi/ /i kyuk+ta mā tre ba su dh+wa dhi pe na jo ra dha ni skad cig bdag 'gro bdag legs so/ /nor 'dzin bdag pos de skad smras tsam la/ /sa 'dzin chu dzā bo dhi ma tī dha ri ṭī/ / tsi ram̐ tsa kam+bi tsa ki te ba ta su shi rasta ṭot+yā gter dang bcas 'dzin ma ni/ /de yi spyi bo 'gems pa'i sdug bsngal dag /drag pos 'jigs pa bzhin ṭa na tī bra duḥkhāta/ /ta taḥkṛ pā ko ma la tsit+ta thran+tis+t+rikyā shasterba tsa sā 1 du ring zhig 'dar/ /de 'og mi bdag thugs spyod brtse ba yis/ /mnyen pa'i gsung gis rab rno mtshon pa gya/ /su tī kyā sha tra da pi tīkyā tsit+taḥswa yo shi raḥpā ṭa yi rtu pra thraṭ+wāḥ//pas kyang / /rno ba'i sems ldan de rnams mtshon rnon gyis/ /rang nyid spyi bo 'gems la rab tu zhugs//95byed51

ta duḥka ram̐ karma na re shwa ra gya byosna bi mā nairna li nā sa nā r+yaḥ/ /su rig 'dzin grub pa sgrub hubacas lha rnams ni/ /pad+ma'i stan sogs mkha' yi gzhal yas nas/ /mi rāḥs bi byā dha ra sedhe sā rgyaḥs mā ya yudṛju ma lube+e sa two/ /bi pā rgya mā dbang de yi dka' spyad mdzad pa la/ /snying stobs ma zhum blta phyir yang dag 'ongs/ /'phral la spyi bo ṣ+pe shi ra se sra sa hra rat+na pra bhā bi bh+ra ma mā da jo ṣ+peḥ/ /sa rak+ṣa pū ri ra bhe rnam par bkas pa yis/ /rin chen 'od du rnam par 'khrul 'dzin pa'i/ /khrag gi rgyun gyis mngon ṣik+ta kā yaḥse te bya thā mabe+e su khe pra dṛt+ta ཿ/ /bi lo kya tai sa twa gtor lus can de/ /slong ba'i bde la rab zhugs gdung ba bzod/ /sdug bsngal drag po'i shugs kyis ni padha byer+ya tī bra bya tha be+e ga ni m+bi li tā k+ṣ-i/ /ya yurngi rā rmā na dṛ shaṃ pra mig zum zhing / /brtan pa'i ②snying stobs kyis bcings de mthong ste/ /skad cig srin po nyid ni thob pa bṛbyebe+e pāḥk+ṣa rte rāk+ṣa sa tā ma bābhāḥ/ /bi tsār+ya rā dzā swa sha rī ra duḥbazhin—/ /gtum spyod bram ze dga' dang bral ma gyur/ /rgyal pos rang lus sdug bsngal rnam dpyad pas//khaṃ saṃ sā ri rde gre sha mā yo sha rī ram̐/ /e baṃ bi byerduḥkha sa ha sra lak+ṣe 'khor ba pa rnams nyon mongs rang bzhin lus/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i sdug bsngal stong 'bum gyi④/ /zil rā krān+ta mi t+yārta ta ro ba byu ba/ /so tsin+ta ya da de ha ni badha rad+mā gyis mnan ces ④rab tu gdung bar gyur/ /des bsams lus bcings rin chen byin khyepa las//dā ṣ+pe yah+phu 5 pha lasma yāste/ / te no gra duḥ khaṃ ka la yā mi mā bsod nams 'bras bu bdag (7gis gang thob des/ /bsod nams min smin dmyal bar mi rnams kyi⑦//byu pu sgo pā ke na ra ke na rā rde/ /sa murjo te rak+ta bā sā ba siste tasmid+ma ṇi drag po'i sdug bsngal cha yang med par gyur/ /khrag dang zhag gis nges bran nor bu de/ /g.yo med mtshog 2nibya la tā lu mū khāta/ /mūrngo ku lo pi tra ya yo sa har+ṣa saṃ pū ra be+e nābe+e ma'i rtsa ba las bton pa'i/ /brgyal bas 'khrugs kyang slong ba'i re ba dag /yongs su rdzogs pas de ni 95—52

ma no ra the na/ /sa kadza mā ram̐ gu li pabe+e be+e na da tā swa haste na ma ṇi dī rab dgar gyur/ /gnyis skyes rnams la rang gi lag sor byu①/ /yal 'dab 'dar bzhin nor bu byen dze bh+yaḥ/ /ni m+bi la yan san+ta ma se na lo ke pa ta tihūṃ shu ri bā ti rak+taḥ/ /nas de/ /yang dag mun pas 'jig rten 'dzum byed cing / /tsha zer can bzhin shin tu dmar bar lhung ③//a lup+ta sa te pa ti te thra thi dh+yā tasmin su rā rde sa ha puju bar+ṣaḥ/ /ma ṇi sa lha rnams me tog char dang lhan cig tu/ /snying stobs bri ba med pa'i ①sa der lhung / /gnyis skyes de mā dā ya yurdi dzāste rūr+ghaṃ pu ram̐ dudze+e sa ha gya rā dzhaḥ/ /sa te na sar+ya sa rnams nor bu yang dag blangs/ /rgyal po shin tu bzod dka'i grong khyer song / /de yi ④ 'phral la nye bar mi to pa sargaḥsargo tsi tā sā di tasgo ga brgaḥ/ /tasgo bye satwa gya sa 'tshe rnams zhi/ /mtho ris 'os pa'i longs spyod tshogs rnams thob/ /sems can mtha' dag yang dag mabe+e satwa san+t+ra ra rjahaṃ pra shaṃ sa two/ /a tā n+ta re ki tsi da bāp+ta saṃ sgrol 'os pa/ /byang chub sems de'i snying stobs de yis bsngags/ /skabs 'dir mi dbang 'du shes cung snyo na re shwa re bikhru ta rat+na dā rna/ /sa mā ya yuṭ+wārga ba gau ta mā byā zad thob/ /ji gu'i bu dang go'u ⑤ta ma ⑥sogs/ /ma rī tse dze+esogs thub pa nags tshal las/ /rin ma rī tse mu khyu mu na yoḥb ṣ+pe bh+yaḥ/ /ma rī tse me bā nu ga ta tsa de bī pad+mā chen byin ⑧pa thos nas yang dag 'ongs/ /lha mo pad ldan ma rī tsi ⑨nyid kyis/ /rjes bzhin song bas ba tī bīgh+ra pa ri kā tarnyi/ /sasmo ha be+e gā snyi ha tā pa pā ta k+ṣa rde k+ṣi to yongs brlag ⑨de mthong nas/ /kun rmongs shugs kyis mngon bcom sa la ni/ /'khri shing gzhon nu ba la la tai ba phru nā/ /di gan+ta saṃ tsā ri ṇi tsā ra shā rmā na bha swa rā rde dṛ bcad bzhin skad cig 'gyel/ /de nas mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha rnams kyi⑪/ /mi bdag legs brjod phyogs pa sā dhu pā de/ /sa rā dza pu tāḥs ha madh+ri mu khyeḥpra dzā na tha ma tho ba dzagruḥ//mthar rgyu ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po'i sras de blon dang lhan cig tu/ /skye rgu skye rgu'i ⑫mgon can nye bar song //95—53

bīgh+ra k+ṣi tī shaṃ k+ṣa ta dzo k+ṣi hūṃ ga ma k+ṣi ṇa sa two pa ti lta thra thi r+ghaṃ/ /thra thu khrag gis lus bsgos snying stobs ma zad cing / /sa yi dbang po sa la 'gyel mthong nas/ /nyon mongs bya thā kle sha dzu ṣe dza nā nā ma khyu da byu tāza bi kalpa dzalngaḥ/ /ku ṣ+ṭha ri kaiḥgadung ba che ldan skye bo rnams/ /yang dag min ①don rnam rtog brjod par gyur①/ /rang don la chags kaibye da ho da yādz+raḥsaṭ+wāzi pe byaḥs ra laḥsu bṛ taḥ/ /du rād+ma rnyiḥmangon sbyor bdag nyid ngan/ /shing gcod ①'ga' yis snying rjes brlan ldan zhing / /slong kun gyis swārja la bā bhi yuste: yā ta ruḥkaṣ+ṭa ma yo ni kṛt+taḥ/ /a ho pa rā tho spru bsten drang zhing legs spyod pa'i/ /kye ma nyam dungar grib bsil shing 'di bcad/ /kye ma pha rol don du ta dz+re bi to yi pa ram̐ tsa maṭ+wā ra da shaṃ pra yā taḥ/ /sa sau ra bha khyun+da ta nu rgi hūṃ tai srog gtong 'di/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gnas skabs dag tu song / /shin tu dri bzang rang gi lus gcod bha ba t+yā dā ra sa hā kā ra e ba/ /lubha su na swaḥswa dza no pi dzarnyorna kā ma pa—/ /yid 'ong shing ni sa ha ka ra nyid/ /brkam chags srog chags rang gi yin yang rang ma yin kā ma gya dha de nu ro dhaḥ/ /sar+pād+ma nā satwa nyi tod+ma ta su de ho pi 'dod pa'i du'adod pa nor ngor min/ /sems can kun la phan brtson bdag nyid can/ /brtse ldan de na sgo ha pa rda da yā loḥ/ /ye ṣā kṛ ti n+ya ma yi pra yā ti sar+pārba nābhābe+e dza yi lus kyang chags gnas min/ /gang don slong skye 'di ni slong ba'i dngos/ /kun don gnyer la zhum rjonobe+e bhā ram̐/ /ta e ba dī nodha ra ṇa pra tā rmā pā ṇ+ḍaḥpa ri tā ṇ+ḍa pa ṇi tro rja ni/ /par rab 'gro ba/ /zhum pa 'don pa'i brtul zhugs can gyi srog /de nyid yongs su skyob zong rtswa lta yin//i ti pra bā de bi bi dh+wa nu bhā pe bi dz+rem+bha mā ṣ+pe mu ni maṇ+ḍa la gya/ /byu pā la de skad rab brjod rnam mang mthu yis ni/ /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phel ba'i tshe/ /ma rī tse ⑦ma bye t+ya sa bāt+pa tsak+ṣuṣ+ṭha nin+d+ra rī tseḥpra ṇa yā du bā tsa/ /a ho nu nishī ra ṇa thub mchi mar bcas pa'i spyan/ /chags pas sa skyong la ri mngon phyogs smras/ /kye ma ma la rgyal po'i skye 95—54

ban+tu bhā ba mā lo bya rā dzan da ya yā dza na gya/ /pra dzā pa ri tā ṇa ni dh+wa na byu mi rgu ①rnams/ /yongs skyob ⑤gter gyi sa gzhi 'gro ba yis①/ /rgyu med gnyen gyi dngos por bsten byas ta nusta ye yi tro ṇa bad bi tīr+ṇa/ /k+ṣa yo pra thrat+ta ni ra pek+ṣa thrasbyista nas—/ /khyod kyi dubartse bas lus 'di rtswa bzhin byin/ /slong ba'i gnyen khyed ⑤rang nyid srog la yang //bā— brnyoni dzā dz+re bi te pi/ /ya de ṣa kā ma ka ma lā ni kā yaḥkā ltos pa'i spyod tshul zad par nges rab zhugs/ /gang zhig dpal 'byor gnas kyi lus 'di ni/ /khyod yasta yā pā ya pa de ni yuk+taḥ/ /a pyaste rā dzan su kri ta bra te smin pha la kyis gnod pa'i gnas su yang dag sbyar/ /rgyal po legs byas brtul zhugs bsod nams kyi/ /zong 'di smṛ hā pā ṇ+ḍa pa ṇi pi kā tsita/ /a gyabe+e te tosta ba tā lu bhe da khe dāta bi las kyang 'bras 'ga' bzhed las drang rjo/ /slong ba'i rgyus kyang khyod kyi mtshog ⑦ma phye/ /skyo las thugs kā ram̐ bha dza te na tse taḥ/ /i t+yabyu tā bi skṛ ta mā na se na mu —n+d+ra ma bye kyi rnam 'gyur ma bsten nam⑧/ /thub dbang dbus su thub pas de skad du/ /rmad byung ⑨mtshar ba'i mu ni nā sa thraṣ+ṭaḥ/ /u bā tsa saṃ ste bh+ya ru dze+e pra yaṭ+wā da raghā bhi ṣis+ho ba yid kyis dris pa des/ /'bad pas ngal dub bzod byas khrag gis ni/ /mngon par sbags pa'i bzhin da rna pra mṛ bye/ /pha la smṛ ha nā ste mu ṣ+pe ma mā n+ya kirnye ka e ba pra ras ⑩phyis nas smras/ /thub pa bdag la 'bras 'dod gzhan ma mchis/ /'on kyang mngon 'dod gcig tsu ro bhi lā saḥ/ /yad gho ra saṃ sā ra ni masna dzan+tu saṃ ta ra ṇa ma ba bha be nyid rab tu mang / /gang zhig srog chags 'jigs rung 'khor bar bying / /sgol byed nyid du srid par bha be+e yi/ /abe+e pre ye de ha bi dā ra ṇi mirje bāste me ko pi be+e kā ra le bdag gyur cig /slong ba dga' bar lus ni rnam bcom 'dir/ /rnam 'gyur cha shas gang yang med pa shaḥ—/ /ya bye ṣa sa t+ya sa ma yom yogh+rasta dastu swasru ma rda sha rī ram̐//nyid / /gal te ngas brjod dam tshig 'di bden na/ /de yis ⑪lus 'di rnal du gnas gyur cig/95byed55

i kyuk+ta mā tre sa ha dzā nu bha be sa two tsi te sa t+ya dha no na rā dzñā/ /a bhūd+ma rgyal po bden nor ldan 'di brjod tsam la/ /snying stobs la 'os lhan skyes mthu ldan pa/ /bden pa'i pu sa t+ya ba le na ta gya ru zwa bra rde ta1 ṇa dzā ta rasne/ /ta taḥsu riḥstobs kyis de lus rma bsos ①shing / /de tshe skyes pa'i rin chen ldan par gyur/ /de nas brgya byen sha kra be+e ri tsi mu khye dzā ta pra har+ṣarmu ni bhebyu sabyeḥ/ /a sgyube+e to pi tshangs sogs lha rnams dang / /rab dga' skyes pa'i thub pa thams cad kyis/ /sa skyong slad du mngon k+ṣi ti pā la nā ya sgo gā bye khā sī na ba byu ba bhū baḥ/ /a pāp+ta saṃ dzñā mu ni par gsol btab kyang / /sa bdag longs spyod mngon par bzhed ma gyur/ /dran rnyed pad+ma dang ldan nā pra mulnga pad+mā ba tī rā dza su te na rmā shaṃ/ /pa ti ya yā tse bi ra ho thub pa yis/ /rab bskul rgyal po'i sras dang 'grogs nas ni/ /skye rgu'i ②seng ge'i khrir bzhugs bde pa shābye dzi hā sa na kārnyi su khaṃ pra dzā rna/ /ta tasta ma bye t+ya kṛ pā ku lā ste ba la/ /'bral ba zhi slad bdag la gsol ba btab/ /de nas rang rgyal de rnams mngon phyogs te//pra h+ye ka bud+dhā dza ga to hi tā ya/ /de ha pra bhā pū ri ta disbi bhā gā ba 'gro la phan phyir brtsebs 'khrugs gyur te①/ /lus kyi 'od kyis phyogs cha khengs pa ni/ /dgyes pa bhā ṣi te har+ṣa mi boṅgi re taḥ/ /tsi rā da bāste bi ra hā ba sā de pu naḥpā gsal bar mdzad bzhin de la smras/ /bral ba'i mjug ni ring zhig lon nas thob/ /yang ni yongs ri t+yā ga da shā ma sa dhī/ /na rā dza pu traḥs ha te na de bī duḥkhā nu gtong gnas skabs bzod dka' ba/ /gang phyir lan gcig min ltung sdug bsngal bcings/ /bzod pa brjo khya pa kṛn+di pā taḥ/ /swa mabe+e ṣ+pe yaḥpra da dā ti de ha mā pan+da duḥkha pra sha rgyal po'i bus min lha mos min/ /rgud ldan sdug bsngal rab zhi'i rgyu gcig phu/ /rang lus slod la gang mai ka he tuḥ/ /ka rja sa kurlu ta swa dza ṣ+pe pyu pek+ṣ-i dasmo pya yo ya su gis rab sbyin zhing / /gang 'di buchos 'di'ang bugazhan don nyid na de/ /rang gi rjomi la'ang btang 95—56

pa rāza e ba/ /i h+phuste mā kasbya na re shwa rastesta the ti ni— t+ya bye yā ka baṃ tsita//snyoms ji ltar bya/ /de dag gis ni brjod thos ①mi yi dbang / /blo yis de bzhin zhes des ji ltar yang //byo: bi mā ṣ+peḥswa pu rī ma bā su sgo dza ni dze+e rā bye pa rda sa pu tāḥ/ /i ti mkha' yi lam nas rang gi grong khyen phyin/ /sras bcas rang gi rgyal srid gnas rnams bsten/ /de ltar sa bi pu la satwaḥ sat+ya ban bo bye satwaḥ su tsi ra pi nyi ta rā byeḥde ni snying stobs yangs shing bde ldan byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /shin tu yun ring rgyal srid bzung zhing sau ga tā nā ma sgo dze/ /dzi na pu ra ma ṇi tse t+ya ts+tsha tra rat+na bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas bsten nas/ /rgyal ba'i grong khyer rin chen mchod rten gdugs dang rin pra dī pa pra ka ṭi ta bi be+e dha shrīrla k+ṣa rja bh+yasta bo dhiḥ/ /i chen sgon ma ni/ /rab tu gsal ba rnam mang dpal gyis mtshan pa'i byang chub goms par gyur/ /yang t+yā ha bha ga bān bu dhaḥ swa dṛ ṭ+wā n+ta ni dar+sha naiḥ / / dā no dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dge slong rnams la sbyin pa'i gdams ngag tu/ /rang gi pa de sha rnyi khyu rde sa mya kle bo bye si dha ye / / i ti spyod tshul mtha' ni dper mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'di ⑤skad gsungs/ /zhes pa k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa ①brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las/ma ṇi tsū ḍā ba dā rna nā ma tro tī ya pabe+e baḥ// //gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ④ste gsum pa'o// //sho bhadhe byu ba ṣ+pe 6 bha bya ma na saṃ yan+d+ra ka kād+dhā ka ra gang zhig mtho ris mdzes ma'i lag pas mchog tu rab bskyod mdzes pa'i rnga yab dag dang ni//95—57

thra rto da— ta tsā ru tsā ma ra se ta ts+tsha tra smi tāḥsaṃ pa daḥ/ /gdugs dkar 'dzum pa'i phun tshogs dag gis 'jig rten na ni legs ldan thugs ni rnam mdzes dang //yastsot+parba ti tabe+e ta khru nyi ya shaḥ kathu ra pū rodz+dza lo swalpa dā nā ka gang yang grags snyan ga pur rgyun gyis khyedri med thos pa sim byed rab tu 'phro ba dag /sbyin pa'i cha shas de ṇa su tat+pa la ma ho dā ā+oṃ ni dā na shri yaḥ/ /a bhū du po ṣa sgo nā ma 'bras shin tu chung ngu'o e ma sbyin pa dpal gyi dang po'i rgyu/ /'o ma'i mtsho ⑤las bdud rtsi bzhin//bhū j-it+pa su bi bhā ba te/ /bi bu dh+wa bhi ma tā tīrtiḥsu dh+wa dusto da mkhas rnams mngon 'dod grags pa yis/ /gang zhig rnam gsal sa 'dzin ni/ /gso sbyong 'phags zhes ①dhe ri ba/ /ba su ṅgā ma ba to ya mya ba su dh+wa ma ba taḥpu raḥ/ /na nā ma bya ba byung / /nor 'dzin bsrung ba nor dang ni/ /gzi brjid ldan pa gang mdun du/ /mi yi bdag pra ṇa to ka gya na nā ma dṛ pa teḥshi raḥ/ /shud+dhā dhī ri ba dharme ṇa dā ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba po'i spyi bo dag /nges par phyag la sus ma btud/ /chos kyis dag pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /sbyin pas brtse da yā lu tā/ /bi bhū tebe+e na ye ṣ+pe ba bhū ṣi tā ye na bhū ra bhūta/ /gu ba ldan nyid bzhin/ /dul bas rnam par 'byor pa bzhin/ /gang gis sa ni brgyan par gyur/ /yon ṇi naḥpri shu baṃ sha su ba bhū ben+d+ra d+ku teḥsbi taḥ/ /ya su sar+pā ta pa tra mya mūsnyi tan kun ldan rigs su mtho/ /kun gyi gdung skyob zla ba'i 'od/ /gang gi gnas pa'i spyi bor gyur/ /sa saza ma tī dz+dza tai/ /ya phye shwa ra shi raḥs+thā yi shu rja gi gā dza lodz+dza lo//yi bdag po kun gyi'o/ /gang gi ④grags pa 'jig rten rgyan/ /dkar zhing dbang phyug spyi bor gnas//bh+ra me t+yad rja lo ke 6 bhū ba nā bha ra khaṃ ya shaḥ/ /kartuḥkra tu sa ha sru r+ghaṃ sa dri med gang bā'i chu bo ni/ /rab mang 'jig rten rnams su rgyu/ /mchod sbyin stong gi byed pa po/ /mig ha sru 7 bye ka shri yaḥ/ /ya su ṣakhye sa ha sru ṇi ka la tram̐ su dṛ shā ma khyuta/ /ka stong pa las lhag pa'i dpal/ /gang gi btsun mo lha mjos ni/ /stong phrag drug cu byung bar gyur/ /nam 95—58

dā tsi ta mu ni rak+ṣa yi rak+ṣi k+ṣa ya kṛ ta k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /bi tsa tsā rā shwa mā ru zhig drang srong bsrung ba'i phyir/ /srin po gzhom ①par dam bcas nas/ /dka' thub nags kyi ⑤sa la khya sa ta po ba na bhū mi 6/ /ta tra rā dzāk+ṣi bhiḥkai —ta pu treji ka la shaṃ dh+ri de—/ /rta la zhon nas rnam par rgyus/ /rgyal po ①drang srong 'ga' yis der/ /bu yi mchod sbyin bum pa tai—/ /dru rā dh+wa shra ma san+ta p+taḥpa pa yaḥpūr+ṇa mā pa po/ /bi dza na sā di tai bzhag /lam ring gis ngal dub pa des/ /chu yis gang ba 'thungs par gyur/ /skye bo med par rnyed pi tā sa man+t+ra ka la shāt+pa yaḥ/ /rā dza dh+wa dī sa mā sā r+ya gar+ghaṃ le bhe pa'i chu/ /sngags kyi bum pa las 'thungs nas/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'ongs pa na/ /sa yi bdag pos bi khyusgo baḥ/ /swasna mā yen+d+ra dzā lā di ya gyaḥkau tu ka bi pru ṣaḥ/ /dza ya t+yad mngal thob gyur/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig rjo'aphrul sogs/ /gang gi dultad mo'i zer ma ni/ /rmad byung yang bhu ta saṃ bhā ra bhū miḥsā bha bi ta bya tā/ /bi dherbi bi dha bai tsi t+ya tsi dag tshogs pa'i sa/ /brnag par bya ste ⑥rgyal gyur cig /mtshar ba'i las kyis rnam bskrun pa/ /sgrub tra karma bi d+mā yi naḥ/ /a stsar+ya re khā bi t+yā saṃ kaḥpa rits+tshabhu m+bi shwa raḥ//byed sna tshogs rnam par bkra/ /ngo mtshar ri mo bkod pa la/ /gcod par byed pa'i dbang phyug ⑦su//kā le nata gya mūd+dhā oṃ rnyi tā bā lopho shu mā ni ba/ /rū bhā bra ṇa gya sa ha sā di dus kyis de yi spyi bo ni/ /rdol nas byis pa nyi ma bzhin/ /mdzes sdug 'od ldan skyes gyur te/ /'phral bye d+ku ti ra dzā yata/ /tai rā dzā dzā yā dza kṛ hurdza gta sa spra bye lak+ṣa la rma ni rab tu bsos⑧/ /bsod nams gzugs la brten pa bzhin/ /'gro ba'i yang dag rgyal po'i ṇi—/ /bāt+pa l+ya pra stu ta kra bāḥpu bye mūrta mi bā shri tai/ /rmā dh+wa ra yi mtshan—/ /ldan pa de ni mnyes gshin las/ /nu zags rgyal po'i btsun mos blangs/ /byis pa bsngags 6 ti shi shuḥshā bh+yo ya dza na byā pa de/ /i ti tā sī mi tho bā kyes+thād+dhā tā 'os 'di yi ni/ /ma yi gnas su bdag gyur ces/ /de rnams phan tshun tshig gis ni/ /rgyal sras nga 95—59

byu ta dṛ pād+ma dzaḥ/ /ta gya pra badzha mā ṇa su bā la spri ḍā bi khā se naḥ/ /ṣa ḍin+d+raḥlas ①nu zhes gyur/ /dbang po drug ni rab 'das dus/ /bsod nams kyis rtsen ①mi zad tshe/ /de ni pra ya yo kā la pu rgya shrī ḍā k+ṣa yā yu ṣaḥ/ /na ba yo ba na mā rū byeḥrab tu bskyed ldan zhing / /byis pa'i rtse dgas rnam par rol/ /lang tsho gsar par ①rab zhugs te//saza be+ebyā su pā ra gaḥ/ /sa yā te pi ta ri swargo bhe dze rā bye kra mā ga rig gnas kun byi pha rol phyin/ /yab ni mtho ris gshegs la nges/ /rim pas 'ongs pa'i rgyal srid tai—/ /yasgo di bo ka so nā ma su kṛ te dī sa hūṃ ga taḥ/ /a bhi bzung / /legs byas kyis duni 'bangs gyur pa'i/ /gnod sbyin mkha' yi khyim zhes pas/ /de yi ṣe ko pa ka ra khaṃ di bye ta sro pa nī ta bān/ /sa swartezadha mu ku dbang bskur yo byad rnams/ /mchog ni nye bar bsgrubs par gyur/ /gser gyis bcings pa'i cod pan ṭaḥkalpi to: ṣa she ṣa raḥ/ /sa ra da bhā ba tai pa gya me roḥsho bhā ma dang / /gtsug tor zur phud byas pa des/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi rna cha can/ /lhun po'i mdzes pa thob bāp+ta bān/ /sap+ta rat+na ni ta snga tha pā duspyo tā ni ta1 be+e/ /tsakrā shwa ma ṇi haste dang ldan/ /de nas de yi rin chen bdun/ /de tshe byung gyur 'khor lo rta/ /nor bu glang po bud med byā kṛ ha se nā gra gā n+ya pi/ /ba bhū ba tsā su pu r+pā rde tu phya dang / /khyim bdag dmag dpon sngon 'gro ba'o/ /sa bdag 'di yi bu rnams ni/ /gzugs dang byu pa ba lo dza sī/ /sa ha sri bi dzi tā rā tespyo dzā nā mi ba bhū bhu dzaḥ/ /stobs dang gzi brjid mtshungs/ /dpung pa bzhin du dgra 'joms pa/ /stong phrag dag ni byung bar gyur//ba sun+dha dzā sa mabhātri be+e khā kā li ta le kha dze+e/ /ni khi dze+e bi da dhe lhag ma ngal bas bder gnas pa/ /mtha' dag chu gter rlabs kyi ni/ /ske rags ldan pa'i nor 'dzin doṣ+ṭi she ṣa bi shārnyi nidṛ hūṃ/ /bhu ba nā ta pa saṃ nadhaḥpra t+ya gra ka ma / /ma lus dpung pas bzung bar gyur/ /sa ni bsrung bar chas gyur cing / /rab tu gsal ba'i 95—60

ma khā shra yaḥ/ /tsakra brti sa su kṛ taibe+esgo ka ra i bā ba bye/ /tri dpal la gnas/ /'khor los sgyur de legs byas kyis/ /khyab 'jug lag pa bzhin du mdzes/ /grags dza gadz+dza t+na bi tīrteḥpra bhā bā bha ra rja shri yaḥ/ /so yo su kṛ ta bal+lī rmā pa 'gro gsum gang gā dang / /mthu yis rnam par brgyan pa'i dpal/ /'di de bsod nams 'khri shing gi//pra tha maḥku su moṅga maḥ/ /sa ka dā tsid+ma nārnye 6 bi kā si ku su ma shri yaḥ/ /me tog rab 'thon dang po yin/ /de ni nam zhig nags kyi mthar/ /blon po dag dang lhan cig tu//ru tsi dzā sa tsi baiḥsārnyom+bi tsa tsā ra bi lo ka yan/ /da dar+sha ta tra nit+pak+ṣan me tog rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal/ /mdzes pa lta zhing rgyu bar gyur①/ /der ni 'dab ma med pa'i bya//bi ha shān pā da tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /byo ma mārga ga ti smṛ t+yā pra yā tān kṛ sha tā mi rkang pas 'gro rnams mthong gyur te/ /mkha' yi lam bgrod dran pa yi/ /shin tu ring bar ①gyur pa ba—/ /pak+ṣa tī nā na ga ti kān thratrī k+ṣi rja: rasba rān/ /da ri bzhin/ /'dab mas dman zhing bgrod byed min/ /'tsho ba zad cing lus g.yogs med/ /de rnams dru ni ba tān bīk+ṣu thra ba tsa kṛ pa ya dṛ paḥ/ /a ho bā rā kai bi hā giḥki dbul po bzhin mthong nas/ /mi bdag brtse bas rab smras pa/ /kye ma sdug pa'i bya 'di rnams/ /ngan mi taiḥku kṛ tai kṛ tai/ /ya de te pak+ṣa bi ka khāḥkṛts+tshartso ra ṇa tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /i pa'i bya ba ci zhig byas/ /gang las 'di dag sgro dang bral/ /dka' las rkang pas rgyu bar grur/ /snying kyuste bhū mi pa ti nā ka ru ṇ+ḍa ku li tāt+pa nā/ /phu rasbi to ma hā mā t+yaḥrjes 'khrugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /sa bdag gis de brjod pa la/ /blon po chen po bden pa'i sde//sa t+ya se nasgra ma bra bīta/ /khru ta me tad ma yā da ba ka t+ya mā rmā ba ṣ+pe tsā reḥ/ /mdun du 'dug ste de la smras/ /lha gcig 'dab chags rnams kyi 'dab/ /gang las bye bar gyur pa'i rgyu//kā ra khaṃ pak+ṣa pa da ṣ+pe ya da bhūt+pak+ṣi rja mi ha/ /sarnyi pañtsa sha tā n+ya tra nags na spyod rnams gleng gyur pa/ /de dag bdag gis rab tu thos/ /dka' thub kha ton nus ldan pa//95—61

pu ju dh+wasdi ta bo ba ṣ+pe/ /ta paḥswā dh+yā ya shalnga rmā mu smi r+ghaṃ dī p+ta te thub pa gzi brjid 'bar ba ni/ /lnga brgya ①bsod nams gnas gyur pa'i/ /dka' thub nags tshal 'di dza shā/ /te ṣā ma rgya ya na dh+yā na dza pa bi sna bi ṅgā yi naḥ/ /e te ko lā na yod/ /de dag gi klog bsam gtan dang / /zlos rjopa'i bgegs ni sgrub byed pa/ /shing gi nags la ha lo tsa kru kha gasta ru ba ṣ+pe sa dā/ /tame+e be+e ha ga saṃ ghā ya karte kā ya pa bya 'di rnams/ /rtag tu ca co sgrogs par gyur/ /rna bar mchog tu gnod pa dag /shin tu yang dag re khru te/ /a bhi saṃ badhe mā nā ya tsu ko pa mu ni maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /ta dusgru ta rgyas byed pa/ /bya yi 'dus pa de dag la/ /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor khros par gyur/ /des bskrun chen ma hā shā pa tā pa bla ṣa ṇa saza taḥ/ /k+ṣa ṇi na pak+ṣi rja pak+ṣu bya po'i dmod pa ni/ /sreg byed gdung ba thams cad du/ /gnod pa byas pa'i bya rnams kyi/ /'dab sīr+yan+ta kṛ tā sha sī/ /ta e te bi ha gāḥpak+ṣa ra nyi tā kṛsgo brti gshog skad cig gis zags gyur/ /bya ni 'di rnams de ①dag ste/ /sdug bsngal gyis 'tsho 'dab gshog naḥ—/ /swata bi bak+ṣa i ba ba ṣ+pe shān+tabyu ra ṇa tsā ri ṇaḥ/ /ma hā mā bye na bral—/ /khyod kyi mi mthun phyogs bzhin du/ /ngal zhing nags su rkang pas rgyu/ /blon po chen pos ka thi tai ni sha bye tad ma tī ba tiḥ/ /u bā tsa ka ru ṇ+ḍa krān+ta stabe+e shā pe brjod de dag /thos nas sa yi bdag po ni/ /bya rnams dmod pas gdungs pa la/ /snying rjes rab tu na pak+ṣi ṇ+ḍi/ /a ho te dzaḥpa ri ṇa tai shān+ta nā ma pi kā na ṣ+pe/ /saṃ gā rā ṇ+ḍi non pas smras/ /kye ma thub pa sol ④ba rnams/ /zhi bar gyur kyang nags su ni/ /yongs su gyur pa'i mu nī dzā tsa da ha h+ye bā ni bā ri tai/ /mi byā ta pa sri bhiḥki taiḥswa su me dag gis/ /mi zlog sreg par byed pa nyid/ /rang nyid bde phyir gang gi rjoyid/ /khro bas gdung la khā ya na yeḥkṛtaḥ/ /ma na sa ko pa tap+ta su pa ri ṣe kaḥk+ṣa rmā bhu bheḥ/ /pra san+d+ra bhān+d+ra bzod pa yi/ /chu yis rjoyongs su bran ma byas/ /log pa'i dka' thub can des ci/ /rab dang blo dang 95—62

no mi tram̐ da yā dā rna da maḥk+ṣa mā/ /ye ྾ te ྾ ta pa shā khye she byams pa'i yid/ /brtse ba'i sbyin pa dul zhing bzod/ /gang de dka' thub bsngags par 'os/ /lhag ṣa rde kā ya sho ṣa rde/ /ki ta po bhiḥs ko pā dzā bi p+lu tā dzā ba ṣ+pe na ma lus ni ①skoms pa nyid④/ /'jig tshogs 'dzin pa'i dka' thub ci/ /rnam par bslad la nags kyis ki—/ /bi bha be+eḥki sa lo bhā ā+oṃ dudṛṭ+wā rmā shu te na ki/ /e baṃ ka lu ṣa ci—/ /chags dang bcas la 'byor pas ci/ /spyod tshul ngan la thos pas ci/ /de ltar sdig pa'i sems tsit+taste tī bra man+d+ra pa rā ma shāḥ/ /duḥs hā e ba mu na yaḥpra yān+tu bi ldan zhing / /khro ba ①drag pos bskyod pa yi/ /bzod dka' thub pa de dag nyid/ /bdag gi yul nas ṣa yād+ma ma/ /i kyughā pā hi ḍoste bh+yaḥsan+de shaṃ pu ru ṣi sgo pa/ /yā ba tī 'gro gyur cig /'di brjod de la mi bdag gis/ /ji srid bdag ni dbang ba'i sa/ /de srid gtang mad+ma sā byu mistu ba tī t+ya dza tā mi ti/ /bi haṃ ga pak+ṣa pā te na ku bar byos shig ces/ /skyes bus 'phrin ④ni bsrings par gyur/ /bya yi 'dab gshog bye ba yis/ /khros pi ta mya ma tī pa teḥ/ /saṃ de shaṃ mu na yaḥkhru tā bi lak+ṣu sa ma tsin+ta yan//pas dhis yi bdag po de'i/ /'phrin buthos skyengs par gyur pa yi/ /thub pa rnams kyis yang dag bsams//tsa tuḥs mu dra pa ri khā me kha khā yāḥk+ṣi teḥpa tiḥ/ /na rejo yo kwa gatshwa maḥko rgya mtsho bzhi yi 'obs kyi ni/ /sko rags ldan pa sa yi bdag /yul gang mi bdag mi dbang la⑦/ /gang de she gye ba se na yaḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya mu na yaḥpār+sha ka na ka khyu j-i taḥ//zhig bdag cag gang du 'gro/ /de ltar bsams nas thub pa rnams/ /gser gyi sa 'dzin dag gi ngos//su ra sernyi sa mā tīṇ+ḍi dzo byu khaṇ+ḍarnyi ka ya yuḥ/ /a tha ta gya ma tī bhartu lha dang grub pas yongs gang ba/ /dzasru'i phyogs dang nye bar song / /de nas sa yi bdag po de'i//pra bhā be na ma tī ya sa/ /a byu da kṛṣ+ṭa sa tsu byu rarlobya rad+dhāsba ra pra sruḥ/ /mthu ni shin tu che ba yis/ /sa ni ma rmos byun byed cing / /mkha' yang rin chen gos skyed 'gyur①//95—63

pā ka shā sa na bai lak+ṣa ka ra ṇasta gya shā sa nāta/ /sabhā haṃ te ma smin pa gsod byed skyengs par ni/ /bgyid par de yi bstan ①pa las/ /sprin tshogs 'bebs par ba bṛ 6rme ghāḥsaṃ ghā ta bar+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /sa pra bhā be+e na ma hā tā sa ha be+e byerna bgyid rnams kyis/ /zhag bdun gser gyi char pa phab/ /de yi mthu ni chen po yis/ /sde dang lhan cig sgo ga tiḥ/ /tsakra pūrba bi de hā khye dī paṃ di bya dza ā+oṃ ba she/ /ba khyu pu mkha' la phyin/ /shar rmi lus 'phags zhes bya'i gling / /mchog gi skye bo dbang du byas/ /de yi dmag ra gre be+e n+ya sbyi ta saur+ya ba lo dza sī/ /bha ṭā rmā byo ma ga ma ṣ+pe ta dpon mchog dag ni/ /rtul phod stobs dang gzi rgyas pa/ /dpa' bo bye ba phrag bco brgyad/ /mkha' sngaṭ+wā da sha ko ṭa yaḥ/ /go dā nī yo ta to dī pa ma thot+ta ra ku rū na pi/ /pār+sha ni la sngon du 'gro bar gyur/ /de 'og ba glang ④spyod gling dang / /de nas byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /lhun po yi sa su me robya sa shā sā ha ta shā sa naḥ/ /su khaṃ bi ha rasta sta mya ni ngos rnams kyang / /nyams med bstan nas bsrungs par gyur/ /brgya byin mang po 'das gyur dus//me roḥka na ka pā nu 6/ /ba hu sha kro ya yo kā labya tudī pa ma tī pa teḥ/ /sa lhun po gser gyi spyog la ni/ /gling bzhi'i sa yi bdag po de/ /bde ①bas rnam par rab tu rtse/ /nam ka dā tsita su rān dṛṣ+ṭi byosnra gats+tshan su ro pa maḥ/ /tsa kā ra bhā zhig lha rnams blta rjobazhed pas/ /lha bzhin mkha' la gshegs bzhin dude'i/ /sprin sngon gyis bzhin la dza la da byāp+ta i ba ga dzirdi shaḥ/ /a tha te hūṃ ni ras+thā dzā me ru pār+sha glang po yis/ /phyogs rnams rab tu khyab par gyur/ /de nas thub pa bskrad de rnams/ /lhun po'i ngos ta pa su hūṃ/ /mu nī nā ma pata ta rūtri tad ga dzā shwa pa kṛji baḥ/ /ta ta ste la dka' thub kyis/ /gnas pa'i spyi bor mkha' las ni/ /de yi rta glang sbangs rnams lhung / /de las kro dha san+tasnya dṛ shā byo mā ba lo ki naḥ/ /tsakruḥdzi ga pra bhā pal+li de rnams khro bas gdungs/ /mig gis mkha' la lta byed cing / /ser skya'i 'od kyis du'akhri shing gi⑦//95—64

ka lā pa ka pi lnga di shaḥ/ /ki me tasko pa i kyuk+ṇiḥshā pāghi si tshogs kyi ①phyogs rnams ser skyar byas/ /de rnams 'di ci zhes brjod khros/ /dmod pa'i me ni spro srek+ṣa yā/ /a bye t+ya de ba dru tastun pra har+ṣa ku li to ba data/ /e ṣa niḥshe ṣa 'dod der/ /lha yi pho nya mngon phyogs te/ /rab dga' rnam par rgyas pas smras/ /'di ni sa skyong ma bhū pā la mo li bi shān+ta shā sa naḥ/ /pā ka shā sa na tu khya shrīs+thā nān+ta thra lus kyi/ /mgo la bka' ni ngal gso ④zhing / /brgya byen dag dang mtshungs pa'i dpal/ /sa yi bdag thi bī pa tiḥ/ /na bha sā na ra de bo yo sa ha me+e bye pra sarba ti/ /ya sde tīrta na dha po nga las nu/ /mi yi lha ni nam mkha' la/ /sde dang bcas pa rab tu gshegs/ /gang gi drag po'i tshig bye yo bā ṭ+wā pu dh+yā bye mā ni nī/ / na dṛsgo ya gya ni dṛ ṣ+ṭa sadze+e 'di sngags①/ /bsod nams mngon pa'i nga rgyal ldan/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde ba'i dpal/ /sbyin lo ka su kha shri yaḥ/ /mo ha saṃ bid+ma ya sre ba be+e bha bi ma daḥ/ /byed gang la 'byor pa yis/ /rab bskyed rgyags pa ma mthong ste/ /yang dag rig la gti mug bzhin//kau be+e ram̐ dha na da byasgyu kau wā ram̐ shasti mat+ta yā/ /i shā ram̐ thra ṣa bha yo nor 'dzin gsal bas ku be ra/ /stobs dang ldan pas gzhon nu ste/ /khyu mchog ldan pas dbang phyug gāta be+eṣ+ṭa baṃ shrī sa mā ga māta/ /pra tā pa pra sā rā ta sau ra min+da baṃ dza dang / /dpal dang 'grogs pas khyab 'jug dang / /'od rab spro bas nyi ma dang / /skye bo dga' bas na nan+da nāta/ /in+d+ra dṛṣ+ṭa ba lats+tsha dāta di bye rū paṃ bi bhartu yi/ /zla ba dang / /mthong bas stobs gcod dbang po yirjo/ /gzugs mchog 'di yis rnam par 'dzin//ba liḥpra yā tā pā tā lo da dhī tso pyasbi she ṣa tsā/ /a gya t+yā ge na dza ṣ+pe bhiḥstobs ldan sa 'og rab tu zhugs/ /da dhī tsa yang rus lhag nyid/ /chu gter ding yang 'khrug mi 'dor//sgo bha ma byā bi nodzu nyi/ /shu two ti de ba dru ta gya ba tsa ā+oṃ mu ni ma dh+ya gaḥ/ /'di yi gtong bas yin nam snyam/ /de skad lha yi pho nya'i tshig /thos nas thub pa'i dbus son pa'i//95—65

sa sardza dun+d+ra kho nā ma mu niḥshā pa dza lo di ni/ /pra ha san+da tha tai pra ha bzhin ngan zhes bya thub pa yis/ /dmod pa'i chu ni mkha' la gtor/ /de nas sde dpon yongs 'dren se nā m+bi pa ri shā ya kaḥ/ /ma har+ṣa saṃ ha ra ru ṣe mā kṛ thasta pa saḥk+ṣa gyis—/ /rab tu bzhad cing de la smras/ /drang srong chen po khro ba thong / /dka' thub zad par yongs ma yi—/ /bai pha thuphol rdzu shā bo yo yā su t+ya gre ma tī pa teḥ/ /na te ba mdzad—/ /sa bdag mdun du dmod pa 'di/ /'bras med ngo tshar ①'gro bar 'gyur/ /khrod kyis gang yo kha ga ye hūṃ yu yo pak+ṣa ya bya māḥ/ /i kyuste mai n+ya pa ti nā gis ④'dab gshog zad/ /bzod pa'i bya de bdag cag min/ /de skad sde dpon gyis smras tshe//shā pa stad+dhā ma bhā ki s+thā/ /dṛṭ+wā gre bid+ma mā dru tse ki mi ta di ti bhū dmod pas bzung ba'i dpung tshogs la/ /mdun du sa bdag gis bltas nas/ /ya mtshan pas ①'di ci pa tiḥ/ /saṃ rasgo tha sa ma bye t+ya se nā pa ti ru ba tsa lta/ /te hūṃ de zhes gsungs/ /de nas sde dpon khro ldan pas/ /de la yang dag mngon phyogs smras/ /lha gcig drang ba ma hakhyi rde shā pā be+e bye na sarba ti/ /i dañtsa tsakra rahūṃ te srong de dag gisadu/ /dmod pas dpung 'di mi bgrod rjodo/ /khyod kyi 'khor lo rin chen 'di'ang //byom+bi shā pa be+e gyuṇ+ḍi tai/ /dhet+ta dza la da saṃ rudha tigla dī dhi ti mkha' la dmod pas ⑥rnam par 'khyam④/ /sprin gyis yang dag bgags pa yi/ /tsha zer can dang tu thu tsā/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tin+d+ra ṣ+ṭha tsā gre ta dze+e ba tata/ /dṛ mtshungs par bzung / /de dag thos shing mi bdag gis/ /mdun du de ltar mthong nas kyang / /mig shi ba bi da dhe shā paṃ bi pha lots+tshaṇ+ḍa bi bla baṃ/ /de ha k+ṣa yi ma nyid kyis bsgrubs dmod pa dag /'bras med rab gtum bslad par ro/ /snying rje'i tshogs kyis lus hadhī rde pa ri rak+ṣan kṛ pā ku lāḥ/ /dza ṭā n+ya pa nyi ya ta byu mo sa 'jig pas/ /yongs bsrungs de yi kyal ka'i bkas/ /dman pa'i ⑧drang srong che rnams kyi/ /ral 95—66

li lā la sa shā naḥ/ /a dzi ta kro dha mo ha ram̐ bhā ra byu tā bṛ thā ba yo/ /i tī pa sa la lhung ①bar gyur/ /khro dang rmongs pa mi thul na/ /bdag cag don med khur gyur ces/ /de dag ba ladz+dza yā te ྾ lī nā k+shi ti ta le dza ṣ+peḥ/ /a tha me ru shi raḥpā bya n-i paḥsu ral pa ngo tsha nas/ /sa gzhi la ni 'byar ba bzhin/ /de nas mi bdag lhun po'i rtser/ /phyin nas lha ra ni ke ta rna/ /pu ram̐ su der+sha rna nā ma da dar+sha pri ya dar+sha rna/ /nā gāsta rnams gnas pa ①ni/ /grong khyer lta ①na sdug ces pa/ /blta na mdzes pa mthong bar gyur/ /der ni tra kṛ tā rak+ṣuḥpra khyu ta da ka ni shri tāḥ/ /ka ro ṭa pā ṇa yo yak+ṣuḥrol mtsho las 'thon pa'i/ /klu rnams dag la rab brtsams nas/ /gnod sbyin lag na gzhong thogs dang //su ra mā lā dha rā bhi dh+waḥ/ /sa dā maṭ+wāsta thā de bāḥkro dhot+ta bhi ta me+e ni kāḥ/ /'phreng bu'adzin zhes pa'i lha dang ni/ /de bzhin rtag myos zhes pa'i lha/ /khro bas sdom byed sde rnams dang //tsā turma hā rā dza kā yi kā khyu sted shā ba la bat+ta rāḥ/ /ma hā rā dzā : tā raḥrgyal chen bzhi yi ris zhes pa/ /shin tu stobs ldan skabs gsum pa/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams//san+dargyu ka ba tsā yu d+māḥ/ /dzi tā rā dzā pra bhā be+e na ṣ+pe dza se nā go bgos mtshon thogs g.yul zhugs pa/ /rgyal po'i mthu yis pham gyur nas/ /rang sde rnams kyi sngon gra gāḥkṛ tāḥ/ /ta taḥkalpa dru mo dā ra ko bi dā ra ma no ha ram̐/ /da dar+sha pā ri 'gro byas/ /de nas rgya che dpag bsam shing / /yid 'phrog ko be+e rā ra nirjo/ /yongs 'du zhes pa yā tā khya saṃ shra yo tri do bo ka sī/ /me rormyarje ta taḥshu bh+ra pra bye mthong bar gyur/ /lha rnams kyis rjoni yang dag bsten/ /de nas lhun po'i rtser 'od zer/ /'phreng ⑦mā lā mi bā ma dze+e/ /su dhas+thā khyu sa bhā pā pa swa pra bhā bod+dhā ṣi tsā ba dzā/ /ba bzhin du dri ma med/ /mkha' ni rang 'od kyis ⑧gsal ba/ /chos bzang zhes pa'i mdun sar phyin//he ma bi dru ma be+e ḍūr+ya stam+bha saṃ bhā ra bhā swa raḥ/ /pā sā do bai dza yan+d+ra khyaḥgaser dang byu ru be+e ḍūr+ya'i/ /ka ba'i tshogs ni gsal zhing mdzes/ /khang bzang rnam par rgyal zhes pa//95—67

pra khya to ya tra rā dza te/ /ya tāñdzirba da ṣ+pej-i gi ra la kaistu l+ya tsā grags pas gang las ①rnam par mdzes/ /gang du chu skyes bzhin ras dang / /bung ba lan bus mtshungs ga tāḥ/ /pad+me n+yaḥsu ra na rī rde padri nī rmā su ram̐ ga rmā/ /bim+bi toste da shir+ya tra gyur pa/ /lha yi bu mo'i ④pad ljon dang / /pad+ma'i shing gi ①lha mo'o/ /nor bu'i zhal zhal ka ba sa//ma ṇi bhū stam+bha rnyisbyi 6/ /su ra lo ko bi bha bye ko pya ṣ+pe ka su ra lo ka hūṃ/ /gang du lha yi gzugs brnyan byis/ /lha yi 'jig rten gcig nyid kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten du ma 'dzin//rat+na to ra ṇa hathre shu ni ba hair+ya tra tsi tri tāḥ/ /byābhā bi bhārnyi ka ku rin chen rta babs ba gam gyi/ /'od kyi tshogs kyis rnam bkra gang / /phyogs rnams mjos pas khyab gyur bhaḥsha krā yu dha sha tai ri ba/ /ya tra bā lā ni lā lo la kalpa te—/ /brgya phrag brgya byin tshon ④gyis bzhin/ /gang du rlung gzhon gyis bskyod pa'i/ /dpag bsam pa da pa pal+la baiḥ/ /1t+ta dheṭ+wā i bā bhadhi nan+di byo nan+da na shri rkang 'thung 'khri shing gis/ /dga' ba bskyed dude dga' ba'i dpal/ /'gyur zhing rab bsgyur bzhin du yaḥ—/ /ya tra tsi tra ra dze+e nā ma de borlu na ma no ra oṃ/ /dhaste ni rkyot+pa ba pre mi mdzes / /gang na shing rta sna tshogs zhes/ /lha yi skyed tshal yid dga' ba/ /rtag tu spro bas dga' ma kā ma kā ma baṃ sha ta yoḥ/ /sarba kā oṃ sarba su khaṃ sabyurtu ku su dag /'dod dang so ka'i ⑥bzhed pa bzhin/ /'dod pa kun dang bde ba kun/ /dus tshigs kun tu modz+dza lo/ /sar+pā ti shā yi tai dṛṭī de bā ā+oṃ sa da rgo dz+re paḥ/ /rū me tog 'bar/ /lha rnams gnas ni thams cad las/ /khyad 'phags rgyal pos mthong gyur nas/ /yud snurta bisma yā sun+da sā nan+da sdigha lo tsa naḥ/ /a tsidha yata su tsam ya mtshan g.yo med cing / /'dzum pa'i spyan dang kun dgar bcas/ /legs byas rnams kyi bsod kṛ ti nā mi māstuḥpha la byu ma yaḥ/ /e rā ba khaṃ su rā pa terlo lā le ba la nams kyi④/ /'bras bu de ni 'di zhes bsams/ /lha yi bdag po'i sa srung ④ni/ /sred len bung ba'i 95—68

yā ku lo/ /da dar+sha ta tra sā mo rda sā kā ra mi ba nan+da dz+wa/ /pu ran+ta rasta tshogs rgyas pa/ /dga' tshal rnam pa dang bcas bzhin/ /der ni dri bzang ldan pa mthong / /de nas sa to dzñā tā pāsta khyu mi pu ran+da ram̐/ /pra kyur+ya yo pra mu di taḥs ha yi dbang po ni/ /'ongs par shes nas dbang po ni/ /lha yi tshogs dang bcas pa dag /rab dga' sabyen+d+ra ruṅga ṇiḥ/ /pū dzi taḥsu ra rā dze na rat+na rā dza bi rā dzi tsā/ /ldan pas bsu ba byas/ /rin chen 'phreng ①bas rnam mdzes pa'i/ /mdun sa'i sa gzhi rgyal po yikhye //rā dza rā dzaḥs bhā bhū mi bhe dze bi ra dza sādza raḥ/ /tri da she 6 pa biṣ+ṭi 6 rgyal po lha yi rgyal po yis/ /mchod pa rdul bral mchog gis bsten①/ /rin chen stan gyi 'phreng ④ba la//rat+na pa.oṃ ka paṃ t+ta 6/ /u pā bi shra1 paḥshrī mā nā sa nārte sha ta skabs gsum pa rnams nyer bzhugs shing / /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i stan phyed la/ /mi yi bdag po dpal kra toḥ/ /e kā sa na dzu khosta tra su ren+d+ra ma nu dzen+d+ra yoḥ/ /rū pa ldan bzhugs/ /der ni stan gcig dul 'dug pa'i/ /lha dbang mi yi bdag po dgarjo /yon tan gu ṇa ga kho dā ram̐ nibe+e she ṣa ma dṛ sh+ya ta/ /ta taḥsarba su rosmṛṣ+ṭa spaṣ+ṭa tshogs ni rgya che ba'i/ /gzugs ni khyad par med par mthong / /de nas lha kun gyis spyos pa'i/ /rab lo tsa na ṣat+pa deḥ/ /r+pā ya mā na mu khāsto dze+e bha dza hā ra ha ri dṛ paṃ/ /gsal mig ni rkang drug pas/ /bzhin pad 'thung ldan ④mi bdag la/ /'phrog byed kyis ni yang dag smras//a ho pa do yaḥshā gyaste dza sā te dza sī ni dhe/ /bha ba tā bhū ṣi tā kye ma gzi bajid gter gyi gzi/ /gang zhig bsngags 'os mngon par 'char/ /khyed me kyis sa ni brgyan bhū mirdzu bya de ba na bhā swa tī/ /a byun+da ta pra bhā bo yi la sata gyur cing / /'od ldan lha yi stinam mkha' yang / /mthu yis rab mtho grags snyan dag /gsal ba'i si ta yā shaṃ shu ka/ /s+thā dza te te tri bhu ba ṣ+pe sā mā bye bi dza ya dh+wa dzaḥ/ /twata gos can sa gsum du/ /yang dag rgyal po rnam rgyal ba/ /khyod kyi rgyal mtshan 'di mdzes so/ /khyod 95—69

ka thā mṛ ta pā na su twata dar+sha na ra sa su tsa/ /prer+ya te rnge tra ṣ+pe tre ṇa gtam bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang / /khyod ni blta ①ba'i ro la yang / /rna ba mig kyang rab bskul cing //su khā khyu ṣ+pe sa ra swa tī/ /sbi rī kṛ tasta ma bā yi su kṛ tāp+ta bi bhū ti nā/ /bde ba'i sgra la dbyangs can no/ /las rnams 'bras bu rtsod pa yi/ /the tshom chad cing nges pa 'di//karma hūṃ pha la bā da mya nibya yasbyin+da saṃ sha yaḥ/ /a ta e be+edz+re ya 'byor pa legs byas kyis thob pa/ /khyod nyid kho nas brten ④par byas/ /bsod nams 'os pa'i kun gā me tsagru re ba smṛ haspa rda/ /pu byeḥpu stso tsi tā tsā ra dṛ sh+yadhe spyod ldan/ /khyod lta bsod nams kyis mthong gang / /'di nyid phyir na ①dbang po yi/ /tshogs las mi ④yadha babyi dh+wa/ /i kyuste tri da shen+de ṇa mā nā tā ya sha sām+bi dhiḥ/ /nyid dga' ba'i gnas/ /lha yi dbang pos 'di brjod tshe/ /grags pa'i gter ni nga las dunus//twadz+ra sā da pra bhā bo yo bi t+yā bā tsa na tā na naḥ/ /i h+ye baṃ pū bye mā na gya mthu 'di khyod kyi dudrin no zhes/ /smras nas gdong ni dud ④par gyur/ /de ltar de ni lha rnams kyisadze+e//ta sru ni t+yā da riḥsu riḥ/ /ṣa ḍin+d+ra pra ya yo kā lo tri di pe ba sa taḥrtag tu gus pas mchod ldan de'i/ /lha yul bzhugs shing gnas pa las⑨/ /dbang po drug gi ⑩dus sa taḥ/ /ta ta pa rā kra ma bi shwasta sa mabhā su ra maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /ba khyu ba su 'das gyur/ /lha min dkyil 'khor mtha' dag ni/ /de yi pha rol gnon pas nyams/ /lha yi rgyal po ra rā dza su ni ra pā yo da yo dza yaḥ/ /dībe+e dā na ba saṃ gā me te su 'tshe med cing / /dar ba dang ni rgyal bar gyur/ /gzi ldan g.yul du gzhu 'dzin lha'i/ /dpung pa'i saur+ya ma hā ta roḥ/ /bi shātwo bhā dzi re de bā bhu dzāts+tsha yo pa dz+re bi bad/ /ta grib mas nyer 'tsho rnams/ /dpa' bo ljon pa chen po de'i/ /ngal gso ⑪dag ni bsten par byed/ /de su pu 5 pa ṇa kṛ tai bhuṭ+wā na snga k+ṣa oṃ su khaṃ/ /kā la pra bā he ma ha ti pra yi bsod nams tshong zong gis/ /myos ⑫pa mi zad bde spyod pa'i/ /dus kyi rgyun ni che ba la/ /brgya 95—70

ya yuḥṣah+phu ran+da rāḥ/ /saṅkarma pha la sgo ga su dze+e ts+tsha rgo bi ma lasma naḥ/ /kā byen drug ni 'das par gyur/ /dam pa'i las 'bras spyod pa yi/ /rtags ni dri ma med pa'i yid/ /de lu t+yādz+dza ya te ta gya pra t+yā san+da pa ri k+ṣa yaḥ/ /a tha kā le na kā lu 6 ka ni rnyog par gyur pa las/ /rab tu nye bar yongs zad gyur/ /de nas dus kyis khyes bdag ni/ /nyes li ta khya ma no ra thaḥ/ /a bhūkhro bhā bhi bhū ta gya bhū pa te ra nyi mā ni pa'i rnyog pas rab bsgos shing / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal chags pa yis/ /zil mnan snyiyid la 'dod paronaḥ—/ /trid shā nā mi yo la k+ṣa m+bin+d+rabye ju ba la pā li tā/ /ta de gyur—/ /skabs gsum pa yi dpal 'byor ni/ /bdag gi 1dpung pa'i stobs kyis bskyangs/ /de las khumān+da sa he tā ba dad+dhā sa na bi ḍalnga dzā/ /a ha me kaḥsu ra pa tiḥre zhig stan phyad kyis⑤/ /bag 'khums 'di ni yongs mi bzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi lazhwakhur 'dzin pa//pra bhā bā nu bha bā mi ke/ /a yasma ma bhu dzaḥsat+tha dza gadzha ra bha ra k+ṣa maḥ/ /bdag gi dpung pa 'di yis bzod/ /bdag rang gcig pu lha dbang du/ /mthu yis 'gyur ba min pa ci⑦//tsā ba yi tā su rā dhī shaṃ swarga sā mā bye saspa rda/ /e kā ta pa tra ti lha yi dbang po nyams byas nas/ /mtho ris rgyal srid phun sum tshogs/ /gdugs gcig nyid kyi thig la rmā swa yi grwa ho tsi tī bha dze/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tasta gya sha kra dro le ni/ /rang nyid 'dzin par 'os pa bsten/ /de ltar bsams shing khyebargya byen la/ /'khu bar mngon hā rnyi lā ṣi ṇaḥ/ /shu bh+ra pra bhā pra bhā ba s+thārmā le ba smu na tsā ya yo/ /par 'dod pa de'i/ /dkar ba'i 'od ldan mthu yi dpal/ /'phreng 67 ba bzhin du nyams par gyur//gha no da ya sa mut+pa gh+ra sau dza n+ya ta ṭa pā ti m+bi/ /lo lo ka lu ṣa stug pos ⑪rgyas par bsams pa yis/ /skye bo legs pa'i ngogs gcod pa'i/ /g.yo ldan dpal ni sred ya h+ye ba mā na saṃ shrī ram̐ gi bhā/ /pra ma dā bi pa dzā dru tī duḥs ha ma bcas kyis⑪/ /yid kyi rdzing bu dri mar byed/ /bag med rgud pa'i pho nya ni/ /che rnams kyis kyang 95—71

ha tā ma pi / / ku sha lon+d+ra la nā li tsa kilbi ṣā ku li bzod par dka'①/ /rigs ni nyams pa nyid kyi slad/ /sdig pas ④'khrugs pa'i blo gros so/ /sdig pa rnam tā ma tiḥ/ /pā pa saṃ kalpa mā tre ṇa k+ṣi to k+ṣi ti pa ti k+ṣa rjata/ /pā pa ta bi shrī bha pha par brtags tsam gyis/ /sa bdag sa la skad cig gis/ /lhung skeste 'bras bu rnam lhung ④zhing //lasbyin+da mū la i ba dru maḥ/ /hadhi bi byā ma na sgyu saḥshri yo harnyi ma do da rtsa ba bcad pa'i ljon pa bzhin/ /ma goms pa yis rig pa 'joms/ /rgyags pa rgyas pas dpal 'byor yaḥ / /bi dī ṣaḥsā dhu tsā hadhi harnyi lo bha sa muṅgi ti/ /a ho ba 'joms—/ /rnam sdang gis ni legs nyid 'joms/ /chags pas yang dag mtho ba 'joms/ /kye ma kwa te ma hoṅkaste shri gā ro ho ma ho da yaḥ/ /bi bha bodzha ba maṭ+wā rmā pa ye dar rgyas che/ /che zhing mtho ba'i rtser 'dzegs pa/ /'byor pas rgyags pa skyes pa rnams/ /'phral ha be+e ba pa ta t+ya dhaḥ/ /te na sar+pā bi byurwa ma pū dzi taḥpūt+tha dzad+ma ni/ /tat+pa la nyid du ni 'og tu lhung / /de yi ⑤skye ba snga ma la/ /thams cad zil gnon zhes bya mchod/ /lha dbang dāp+ta ba na rā rdzu smṛ ha bhā ma rut+pa teḥ/ /su rā dhi pā dhi baḥko pe pra rgyal srid bsten 'os ni/ /de yis 'bras bu rjothob gyur cing / /gang yang lha dbang las lhag pa/ /mthu bhā bo bisma yā ba haḥ/ /a nalpasta snga bhū ta pā tra dā rmā sha saṃ bha baḥ/ /ban+tu ni ya mtshan ldan pa dag /de yi ⑦snod la sbyin pa'i chas/ /bskyed pa mi nyung skal bar gyur/ /gnyen ①ma t+ya bhi ṅgā nā yī na gar+yā mu tsi taḥshu tsiḥ/ /ba ni guṅka ri ko nā ma so bha ba ldan zhes ni bya ba yi⑨/ /grong khyer 'os shing gtsang ba ru/ /tshong dpon ud ka ri ka zhes/ /de yi sngon h+phut+tha dzad+ma ni/ /bi pa dhī nā ma bhik+ṣa ma samyak+shi budhe hūṃ ga taḥ/ /bi be sha gyi skye bar gyur/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /nyid du gyur cing sems can kun/ /sgrol ba la tasgo haṃ sadze+e satwa saṃ tā ra khod+mā taḥ/ /pā tre ta su sa ni k+ṣe pa brtson rnam gzigs mtshan/ /bsod snyoms slad du de khyim zhugs/ /de yi snod du dang ba'i blos//95—72

muṅga muṣ+ṭispra san+da dhīḥ/ /pha lā ni ta tra tsa tā ri pe tuḥshe ṣā ṇi khyu ta le/ /sran ma chag ①gang de yis 'phangs/ /de las ②lhag ma bzhi dag ni/ /sa yi gzhi la lhung bar gyur④//te na dā na pra bhā be na man+t+ra tā thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /sarba dī pa pa ti byu twa shakrād+dhā de yi sbyin pa'i mthu yis ni/ /sa yi bdag po nga las nu/ /gling rnams kun gyi bdag gyur nas/ /brgya sa na māp+ta bān/ /muṅga she ṣa sgo to yasmrata khyu mo ta myu n+ya tse ta saḥ/ /ta dā byin stan byed thob par gyur/ /de yi sems ni gzhan gang las/ /sran ma lhag ma sa la lhung ④/ /de tshe sau pha la par+yarnye pa ti ste da shā la yā ta/ /lu ṭha ti be+e ka la kaspra 'di ni 'bras bu'i mthar/ /skabs gsum pa las lhung ⑤bar gyur/ /gang zhig rmi lam sgyu ma'i gnas ya tra saṃ ka lpa mā lbo sgu ra ti na tsa ka dā tsita swa sna mā yān+ta skabs su yang nam yang mi 'phro ba'i/ /rnam rtog 'phreng spyob cung zad 'khrugs pas gang la nye bar rab re yā/ / bha ba ti bi bha ba sgo gā sgo gi dī bhā gya bhā dzā ma tu sbyar ba/ /'di ⑦ni sbyin pa'i dpag bsam shing gi 2mtshungs med 'bras bu rab rgyas tshe/ /'byor pa'i la pha la ta nyiḥsā dā na kalpa dru maḥ/ /i t+yā ha bha ga bān budha longs spyod spyod pa nyid du skal ba bsten pa rnam dag grur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dges ⑨pa yis/spru t+ya dā na pha lo shri yo/ /ni dza dzad+mān+ta rā khyu ṣ+pesgokhyu zla ma nu shā sa rang gi skye ba gzhan brjod cing / /dge slong rnams la rjes bstan du/ /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu'i dpal 'di ṣ+pe—/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsiṭ+wā yi bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa gsungs—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam la tā yī mārnya tu ra ba dā rna tsa turbaḥpal+la baḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las/ nga las nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi pa'o// //du d+dhā dhi rbi bu dh+wa za nā ti bi dhu rāḥ gru bha stsa hūṃ pe tsi re lha rnams kyis bslangs bsrubs pas shin tu 'khrugs shing 'o ma'i chu gter ring zhig 'dar/ /rang 95—73

kadzan te tsa ni sarga taḥki la ka lot+parge 6 kalpa dru māḥ/ /e kaḥko pi sa dzā bzhin nyid kyi ①'bras bu rab tu gtong tshe dpag bsam shing yang 'dar ro lo/ /gang zhig lus ni rab tu ya te ta nu sha tai ra bh+yasta dā na sbi tiniṣ+kas+thā pu la koṅka ram̐ ba ha ti yaḥgatong yang spu long tshogs 'dzin 'dar ba mi mnga' ba/ /su zhig gcig pu de ni lus brgyas ④sbyin pa'i kā yo pra dā ṣ+pe ṣ+ṭa bi/ /aste kai lā sha ha si t+yā mut+ta ra snga ma nut+ta rā//lugs ①'di goms par gyur pa yin/ /kai la shas mtshon byang phyogs na④/ /bla na med pa'i grong khyer ni//di shi bha dra shi khā nā ma bhu ba nā bha ra rde pu rī/ /ya sde si ta ya shaḥput+paḥs bzang po'i brag ces bya ba ste/ /sa yi rgyan du gyur pa yod/ /gang du grags snyan me tog dkar/ /phun pha lāḥsar+bha saṃ pa daḥ/ /dā nod+mā na la tāḥdī h+ye ba bhū bu pu ra bā si rmā/ /tshogs kun byi 'bras bu bzang / /sbyin pa'i skyed tshal 'khri shing ni/ /grong khyer pa rnams dga' be+ed gyur//ya tra tri pu ra dzin+de tra shi khi trasto ma no bha baḥ/ /a ba lā bhe tsa la grwa ḍā grong khyer gsum durgyal mig gi mes/ /gang du skrag pas yid 'byung ni/ /stobs med g.yo zhing rtse bub yi//zla lha gi re ba rak+ṣe ta/ /muk+ta dzā lodz+dza lā ya tra bhā ti he ma kṛ ti smin ma 'khyog po nyid kyis bsrungs/ /gang du gser gyi khang pa'i 'phreng ⑦/ /mu tig tshogs rab 'bar ba lī/ /me roḥshi ṣa ra mā le ba bi sgu rata m+bi ta tā ra kāḥ/ /ta sngañtsan+d+raḥpra bhā bas mdzes/ /lhun po rtse yi 'phreng ⑧ba ni/ /rgyas pa'i rgyu skar 'phro ba bzhin/ /der ni dpal ldan zla shrī mā na bhūta bhū mi j-i hūṃ ba raḥ/ /kai khā sa i pa yaḥkādh+yā tsa kā ra di na ba'i 'od/ /sa 'dzin rnams kyi mchog tu gyur/ /nyin mo'i zla 'od mdzes pa yis/ /gang zhig kai la sha tsadh+ri rmā/ /ya su de ha pra bhā pū riḥbyurten+d+ra d+ku ti hā ri rnyiḥ/ /niḥshā su bzhin byas/ /gang gi lus 'od zla nya yi/ /'od ltar rdzogs pa'i 'phrog byed kyis/ /gsal byed can dī pa kā bhā su nā byuta sne ha gu ṇa k+ṣa yaḥ/ /sma ra dz+wa ram̐ bha dzarnye su min snang ba'i mtshan/ /byams pa'i yon tan zad ma gyur/ /'di mthong nyid na ⑨rgyu skar rnams//95—74

dar+sha ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba tā ra kāḥ / /i tits+tsha tra ts+tsha la da myats+tsha di tai kha 'dod pa'i rims ni bsten 'gyur ①zhes/ /mkha' la gdugs kyi zol dag gis/ /'di ni zla bas mi be+en+d+ra nā/ /pra ti sha bye ṣa sa ta tai shri yo masko sha saṃ yī/ /i bsgribs pa bzhin/ /dam pa'i mdzod na gnas pa'i dpal/ /rtag tu 'di yis rab ster zhes/ /gang tī sha dar+sha ṣ+pe gya saṃ ko tsa mā pa padri nī/ /se nā haṃ kā ra mudṛ bye t+yā ga shu zhig mthong la pad+mo can/ /zum par rab tu thob pa bzhin/ /sde yi nga rgyal rab btang nas/ /gtong ba bh+ra shri yā shri yaḥ/ /niji ṭ+wāḥts+tsha tra mu ku ṭa pra ka ṭa ཿpu ra bā dkar ba'i dpal gyis ⑤dpal/ /gdugs dang cod pan rab gsal rnams/ /grong khyer pa rnams dag si rmā/ /shu shu bhe bi bha bsta su pu sgyu lo kṛ ton+da teḥ/ /ā ro ha ti la btang / /de yi 'byor pa dul ba yis/ /dpal gyis brgyan cing mtho ba mdzes/ /gzhu ltar gug pa'i pa dzā ko ṭī na mra gya dha nu kho gu ṇaḥ/ /tsa tā ri shata sa ha sru ṇi bat+pa rā hūṃ yon tan rgyud/ /gzhan dag rtse ru 'dzegs pa nyid/ /stong phrag bzhi bcu dag dang ni/ /brgya phrag dag sha tā ni tsa/ /ba byu ba de hi nā mā yusta su kā le ka li dī ṣaḥ/ /ta mya ṣakhyu gi lo rnams kyang / /lus can rnams kyi cher gyur pa/ /de dus rtsod la sdang ba byung / /'jig rten skyong sa hā sru ṇi pu rī hūṃ pūr+ṇa saspa dzā/ /ba bhū burlo ka pā la gya lo las lhag pa'i dpal/ /'jig rten skyong de'i grong khyer ni/ /phun sum tshogs pas gang ba dag /stong ka pā lā dhi ka shri yaḥ/ /ya rnye naḥtīrti ti la kasta su pu rgya bi khyu ṣa ṇ+ḍaḥ/ /phrag drug cu byung bar gyur/ /mchod sbyin byed po de yi dpal/ /grags pa'i thig le bsod nams brgyan//yarnye dhū ma la tā r+ghaṃ girba bhūdhī lā la kāḥshri yaḥ/ /ta t+yā sadzata ku mu di m+bi mchod sbyin du ba'i 'khri shing dag /'khyog pas ①g.yo ba'i lan bu mdzes/ /de yi blon po zla chen po//bi kā sa na sa do di taḥ/ /a byu ta ma hā tsan+d+ra:n+d+ra lo ka i bodz+dza laḥ/ /rab 'bar zla ba'i snang ba bzhin/ /phun tshogs ku mud ldan pa ni/ /rtag tu rnam par rgyas bgyid gyur//95—75

ya yo/ /in+d+ra dzā la pra yo ga dzhaḥs kṛ tā pra sha mo tsi tai/ /be+e shaṃ ka lu ṣa bar gyur/ /mig 'phrul sbyor ba shes pa de/ /rab tu zhi zhing rigs pa'i chas/ /byas shing sdig pa'i kun saṃ kalpa pu rī shā pa ma tī pa teḥ/ /asmin bha ba ba ṣ+pe ni bye gu ṇa do rtog ldan/ /sa bdag grong khyer sleb par gyur/ /srid pa'i nags 'dir rtag tu ni/ /yon tan skyon ṣa sa mā ku le/ /kalpa dṛk+ṣuḥpra dzā yadhe dzā yadhe tsa bi ṣa dru maḥ/ /a byis yang dag gang / /dpag bsam shing rnams rab skyes te/ /dug gi shing rnams skyes par gyur/ /ma she ṣa nā sha pi shu be+esgo ra sarja sa kā ri bhiḥ/ /durni miste ri ba kha leḥlus nyams pa mtshon byed cing / /'jigs rung skrag par byed pa dag /ltas ngan lta bu'i mi bsrun ①pas//ṣe daḥka gya na dī ya te/ /gu ṇi dz+wa ṣaḥpra kṛ h+ye ba pra kā sha pa ri padz+re su la nyon mongs skyed mi byed/ /yon tan ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /dgrar gyur rab gsal mi mthun naḥ—/ /do ṣā shra ya su ko bhe daḥkha la gya ti mi ra su tsa/ /swats+tshan+da ghā tī phyogs—/ /skyon la brten par mi bsrun ①dang / /rab rib dag la dbye ba ci/ /legs pa rnams kyi sā dhū dzā bi dre ṣa bi ṣa duḥs haḥ/ /dīspyo pak+ṣa kha la byu la yid gcugs ①'joms/ /rnam par sdang ba'i dug bzod dka'/ /logs ring skye bo mi bsrun rjosprul//ka rā laḥke na nirmi taḥ/ /tasmin pra biṣ+ṭi na ga re rū bi bhā su ra de ba tā//'jigs su rung ba su yis sprul/ /grong khyer der ni rab zhugs tshe/ /grong khyer lha ni gzugs can ma//ba tsā bh+ya t+ya bhū pā lo san+t+ra sa ra le k+ṣa ṇa/ /shi ro yā tsa ka e ṣa hūṃ skrag pa'i mig ni g.yo ba yis/ /sa skyong la ni mngon phyogs smras/ /tshangs pa'i gnyen ni mgo slong ba//bra h+ma ban+tu ru pā ga taḥ/ /ba rmyo sau dz+re bi to ts+tsha dī dza ga to dz+re be+e ta su te/ /'di ni khyod can nye bar 'ongs/ /'gro ba'i 'tsho ba khyed kyis ⑤ni/ /'tsho ba gcod byed 'di gzhom 'os//ni rurnyo na ga ra dā ri sa ma yā ma li nā sha yaḥ/ /ma ma ta da drak+ṣe taste bdag gis bsam pa dri ma can/ /de ni grong khyer sgo ru bkagadu /de mthong ba na dubadag gi yid//95—78

j-i ti na la bha te ma naḥ/ /i ti khru bā rde bhū pā la thra bā tsa su ra de ba tsā/ /abe+e skrag cing dga' ba ma thob po/ /'di smra grong khyer lha mo la/ /slong ba bkag hukyepas ngo tsha dag /rab saṃ ro dha saṃ dzā ta lasto tsa na mi tā na naḥ/ /de bi yāsgo bhe yā to sau pra skyes bzhin ras dman gyur pa'isde/ /sa skyong gis ni rab tu smras/ /lha mo slong ba mngon 'ongs pa//bi sha twa ni bā ri taḥ/ /dīsgot+yā saṃ sa te nā hā mā sā be+e pha l+ya 'di ni ma zlog nang du thong / /slong ba'i bsam pa 'bras med pa'i/ /shugs rings ①bdag gis yongs mabe+e naḥ/ /yāsgo pra ṇa yi nā maze pu rgya pāp+tasta nu bya yaḥ/ /yu ga mi bzod/ /slong ba don gnyer rnams don du/ /lus nyams bsod nams rab tu thob/ /gang phyir saṃ khyu ma pi spri tā bi pa r+yarnye ti de hi naḥ/ /e ta de ba su dzā tā rmā lus ni dus bzhi'i grangs/ /gnas kyang rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /slong ba re ba nyams pa dag/sgo rdzu dza ga ti dz+re bi tai/ /ya de ṣā ma gra to yā ti nādhī bhasna ma no ra 'di rnams mdun du mi bgrod gang / /de nyid skye bo legs rnams kyisasde/ /'tsho ba 'gro bar mchod par thaḥ—/ /kri ya tā mā nu ku bye me bha ba t+yā ku sha lo tsi tai/ /ā sā bi ghā te 'os—/ /bdag gi rjes su mthun pa ni/ /dge bar 'os pa khyod kyis ⑤mdzod/ /de yi bsam pa rnam saṃ tā pasta mya tūr+ṇa ni bār+ya hūṃ/ /i ti byu mi z-i taḥkhru tā ba tso nibacom pa'i/ /gdung ba myur du zlog rjopar mdzod/ /de skad sa bdag tshig thos nas/ /g.yo ba med bye la nibya yi/ /dza gā mā dar+sha dz+wa de bi tsir+sā sad+dhā pa mā na sā/ /a thā ya par nges pa yis⑦/ /bsam pas yid ni rab gdung ba/ /lha mo snang ba mun par gyurablu/ /de nas gya yo pa ku ṭi la kha la kra ka tsa tseṣ+ṭi taḥ/ /dā ru ṇaḥs ra la sri ba ts+tsha dā gyu can de 'ongs/ /mi bsrun khya sog le'i spyod tshul can/ /mi bzad drang po'i shing dag ni/ /spyod ⑫la ya swa ya mur+ya taḥ/ /tasmi1 pa kṛ haṃ pāste bi dṛ ta dā ra mabe+e rmā/ /bhūr byu rang nyid sbyor ba bzhin/ /slong la sgo ni rab bye ba/ /mi bdag khang pa der ⑪'ongs la/ /sa bdag 95—79

gya me brah+man+dabe+e nā marba sedha ye/ /nirbi kaspo pa ka ra khaṃ bya yi yā ti legs 'tsho dag /slong ba rnams kyi don grub slad/ /rnam par mi rtog yo byad du/ /zad 'gyur bram ze su dz+re bi tai/ /ka dā pā shāḥpa rābe+e me pra yāṭī ma no ra thaḥ/ /ki me tā bdag legs so/ /bdag srog pha rol don du ni/ /nam zhig 'grur zhing ①re ba yod/ /gal te khyod ni na pu sgyu ni pābyernye te ya di twa yā/ /a ho pa ka ra ṇa se: kyis de bslangs ⑤pa/ /'di ni bsod nams cis ma yin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni slong rnams la//shārgyu me kṛ khya tī shi raḥ/ /tata ta de ba sbi ra lo ke yad ya dbe+e pa mabe+e gang gang byin pa de de brtan/ /grub pa'i yo byad bdag gi mgo/ /bsngags par 'os pa gzung bar tai—/ /i kyuste har+ṣa yuste na bhū bhu dzā sa twa shā li nā/ /ta mū tsa tasma mdzod—/ /sa spyod snying stobs legs ldan pa/ /rab dga' ldan pas 'di brjod tshe/ /blon po chen po hā mā rkyo ma hā tsan+d+ra ma tī dha ro/ /ni dza dz+re bi ta rak+ṣe ba dhan+d+raste pra tha maḥpra zla chen dang / /sa 'dzin dag gis de la smras/ /rje bo khyod kyi chos dang po/ /rang gi srog ni bsrung ba sgo—/ /twa yi dz+re ba ti dz+re brnyi sarbe dza ga te dzan+ta baḥ/ /nā dā tu marta nyid / /'gro bar ①khyod ni 'tsho ba na/ /srog chags thams cad 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir khyed lus si shi raḥsar+pā dh+wa ra nyi te ba suḥ/ /dī ya tai brah+ma shā yāsmi te ma rat+na ma kun gyi gzhi/ /mgo bo sbyin dhipar mi 'os so/ /rin chen gser byi rang bzhin mgo/ /bram ze 'di la yi shi raḥ/ /sar+pādze+e rabe+e sārja dzā pūr+yadhe yin+d+ra no ra thāḥ/ /te ྾ saṃ sbyin par mdzod/ /slong ba'i don mthun re ba dag /gang gi ④don kun gyis rdzogs pa/ /de dag yang rak+ṣa ṇi ṣ+pe ba sabaṃ bha ba ti rak+ṣi tai/ /saṃ kaspo yi dī dza snga su dag bsrungs pa yis/ /thams cad bsrungs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i sems lnga ma sanyis skye sa 'di'i//spyu raḥka lu ṣa tse ta saḥ/ /mū lots+tsha do pa dzī byo hi na kalpa ta ru rabe+e rnam rtog 'di ri 'jigs su rung / /gang phyir slong ba'i dpag bsam shing / /rtsa bcad nye bar 'tsho bya 95—81

dzñā / /he ma rat+na shi raḥpā gya yā two ṣa shi ra sā gya ki/ / tsid+dhā ma ṇibe+e min—/ /rin chen gser gyi mgo thob nas/ /'di ni 'gro 'gyur mgo yis ci/ /bkres pa rnams kyi ①ni t+pa 6 bhu bye te na bu bhu k+ṣi tai ཿ / / i kyu ste ma rnyi mu khyu bye te yid bzhin nor/ /rnam par brtags nas bgam bya min/ /blon po'i gtso bos 'di smras tshe/ /rin ma rat+na la yo shi raḥ/ /sirnyo ṣ+pe bo pa yo gyi tad+ma me ti zwah+ma kho bra bīta/ /chen gser gyi rang bzhin mgo/ /de ni bdag gis 'grub khyepa la/ /nyer mkho med ces bram zes smras//a thozlu mo tsa dṛ pa tirmu ku ṭi moste rmā shu bhiḥ/ /shi ro bi ba ha duḥkhe de nas cod pan mi bdag gis/ /rab bkrol mu tig 'od (kyernams ni/ /mgo dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal na sā khru dh+wa ra mi bā ti ta ཿ / /mu ku ṭā ni k+ṣa ṇi ta smin ni pe gyis—/ /kun nas mchi ma'i rgyun bcas bzhin/ /skad cig de la grong khyer ba'i/ /cod pan rnams ni tuḥpu ra bā si dzā/ /dibyā hokhru ka tu spyo bhi rulbā bhiḥs ha bhū ta lo/ /rā sa gzhi la/ /phyogs ni bsreg (d+nghamatshungs mgal me dang / /skar mda' dag dang lhan cig lhung / /rgyal dzñā bra dā ṣ+pe shi ra saḥsarba thā pa ri kalpi te/ /to tsakra tasta nu t+yā shaṃ madh+ri pos mgo ni rab ster ba/ /rnam pa kun tu yongs brtags ⑤te/ /mthong bar mi bzod blon po ni/ /de ṇi dbyu ma k+ṣa mo/ /rat+na gar+bha mi thod+mā ā+oṃ pra bi sh+ya thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /dag lus ni btang 67ba byas/ /de nas skyed tshal rin chen nang ⑦/ /zhugs te sa yi bdag po yis⑧//uh+phul+la tsadza ka snga dhaḥshi rabyehūṃ sa mur+ya yo/ /ud+mā na de ba tā dṛṭī tai rab rgyas tsam pa ka 'og tu/ /mgo bo gcod du yang dag gshegs/ /skyed mos tshal gye lhas mthong nas//shi rabyebhu mur+ya tram̐ / /mā kṛ thā sā ha saṃ rā dzam+bi kyu bā tsa shu tsa ku mgo bo gcod par brtson de la/ /rgyal po thub chod ma mdzad ces/ /mya ngan dag gis 'khrugs par (khyalā—/ /kadza nāḥpra mā pi n+yasta maṭ+wā li ku la swa ṣ+peḥ/ /n+ya bā ra yin+da smras—/ /'dar ldan 'khri shing rab smras pa⑪ / /bung ba spyos tshogs sgra dang ni/ /yal 'dab rab tu 95—82

ba la tā lo la pa l+la ba pā ṇi bhi ཿ / / so pi byi : la saṃ kalpa ཿg.yo ba yis(1/ /lag pa dag gis bzlog 2 pa bzhin/ /rnam par brtags 1 pa g.yo med des2 //sra sā byod+mā na de ba tī/ /bi ma dze+e bo bye mā lo bya ba bhū ba pra ṇi dh+wa na bān/ /skyed tshal lha yang dang byas nas/ /dri med byang chub la dmigs pa'i/ /smon lam dag dang ldan par gyur//asmin rat+na ma yod+mā ṣ+pe pu sgo rā shi sa mun+da tai/ /stu pa mastu pra ṇa grong dang rin chen rang bzhin tshal/ /'di ni bsod nams phung pos mtho/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ma stu sa twa sa d+dhā ra kho tsi tai / / yaṅgi ñtsa da rji tai bu bye saṃ kaste 'os pa/ /ston pa'i mchod rten 'byung gyur cig /bdag gis brtag pa 'di yis ni/ /bsod nams na ma yā mu nā/ /bha ban+tu te na saṃ sā re niḥsaṃ sā rāḥsha rī ri ṇaḥ/ /cung zad gang bsgrubs pa/ /de yis 'khor bar lus can rnams/ /'khor ba med par 'grur bar shog /dh+yā two ti tsadza ka ta roḥshā khā yī dṛ pa tiḥshi raḥ/ /pa dh+wa ka tsa ka lā se de ltar dmigs nas mi bdag gis/ /tsam pa ka shing lo ma la/ /skra tshogs kyis btags bcad nas mgo//nastso tā pā dād+dhā dzad+ma ṣ+pe/ /a tha na ra pa teḥs twon+d+ra ha sgu ṭa pra ṇi ṅgā na gnyis skyes la ni rab tu byin/ /de nas mi yi ⑤bdag po'i snying stobs spro zhing gsal ba'i smon lam dang //taṅgi ma pi bi ma leḥpu rgyu lo kerdi gan+ta pi sā ri bhiḥ/ /bi ga li ta ma hā gang yang dri med bsod nams snang ba phyogs mthar rnam par 'phro ba yis/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen rnam mo ha ghān+taḥshri taḥpa ri dridṛ ti pra be+e ra ta bha bā sgyu sā yā paḥk+ṣa rja par sel zhing yongs su myang 'das la brten ngh+ru dang / /srid par goms pa'i ngal ba rab sel 'gro la skad da bha badz+dza naḥ/ /i ti pāstsad+ma bṛsgyun+ta ka tha yā bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /bhek+ṣu cig dag gis gyur/ /de ltar sngon skyes spyod pa'i mtha'/ /bshad nas bcom ldan rgyal ba yis/ /sbyin rde bi da dha shudha rā na sadherma de sha dzā/ /i ti k+ṣe men+de na bi ra pa dag pa'i dam chos dag /dge slong rnams la bstan pa bsgrubs/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas 95—83
