tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na ka spra la tā yī tsan+d+ra pra bhā ba dā pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rtogs pa rgo pañtsa maḥpal+la baḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga pa'o// //dā nar+ya tā nā thra thu bīr+yā bhā rdzu shud+dhād+ma rna satwa ma ho da bye dzā/ /sbyin pa la brtson brtson 'grus rgya che'i gnas/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid snying stobs rgya mtsho dang / /a ho ma hots+tsha ha ba ṭ+wā pa raze bha baṃ t+ya tsidh+yā ni sa mā hi tā ni/ /hadze+e ro ha ṇa spro ba che ldan rnams ni gzhan don la/ /kye ma bsam gyis mi khyab bzhed pa yin/ /gang zhig mkhar rnyog he la yā ya da ba lāḥ swa byeḥ sa hā bye li hā yabye got+pa da lī la yā dza ri bo sul bcas dag la rtse dgas pa gam la 'dzegs 3dang / /gang dag chu tshogs 'khrug 27cing gyen la bha ra k+ko sgodha tāḥsin+ta baḥ/ /la bh+yadhe bha ba na s+tha lī ka la na yā 'thor rgya mtsho dag la rol pas ba lang rjes/ /gang yang nags tshal stug po'i khyon ḍasne3la dga' bder khang ye tsā ḍa bī dzā ta ṭa ste bye r+ya gya ma hā d+ma rmā bi la sa ta ཿ sa twordzi pa'i thang bzhin 'god byed pa/ /de ni bdag nyid che rnams snying stobs kyis bsgrubs rgyas pa'i brtson tai sgurdzi tai/ /pu rā hi bha ga bān budhaḥshra bahūṃ pu ra bā si rmā/ /'grus rnam rtsen yin/ /sngon ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /man ngag rab tu gsal ba yis//u pa de sha pra kā sha na dza hā rā dzñā na dze+e ta maḥ/ /dzhagru saṃ s+hoḥpa ri dṛ taḥmanyan yod grong khyer ba rnams kyi/ /mi shes las skyes mun pa bsalasti/ /de ni nam zhig ma ga dhar//pa kā tsid+ma ni gyu naiḥ / / kṛ tā nu yā tro ma ga dh+wa ta swa yo tsa ri dge slong tshogs kyis yongs bskor cing 'a/ /tshong pa'i skye bo'i rjes 'brang bcas/ /rang nyid rgyu zhing ka yā ya yo / / ma hā ṭ+wā nu ga tai pra dze+e tai ba na ba ṭ+wā nā/ /gshegs par gyur/ /nor chen don mthun rjes 'brang zhing / /nags kyi lam nas gshegs pa de//95—84

haṃ dṛṣ+ṭa ta ska ra ga ṇaḥ shā lā ḍa byā ma tsin+ta ya ta/ /e ṣa pra yā chom rkun tshogs kyis mthong gyur nas/ /sā la'i nags su rnam bsams pa/ /sems can phan dges tu bha ga bān su raḥs twa hi te ra taḥ/ /pashāta sādze+e gra tī 6 maḥpūbaṃ dra bi bcom ldan 'das/ /'di ni sngon la gshegs su gzhug /nor gyi phung pos gang ba yi/ /don mthun phyi ṇa rā shi bhiḥ/ /bha ga bā na tha sarba dzhaste ྾ dzñā twa sa mā hi tai/ /nas gzung bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan kun mkhyen kyis/ /de rnams 'dod pa mkhyen gyur nas/ /ki me tā di ti tā nu tse nibe+e kā ra smi tā na naḥ/ /te na mū tsuḥpa ri t+ya rnam 'gyur mi mnga' bzhin 'dzum pas/ /'di dag ci zhes de la gsungs/ /de yis rab dang 'dzum pa bye kaut+pa ma dhu ra yā gi rā/ / ta t+tha sā da smi tā lo kai be+e na ṣ+ṭa yis—/ /snang bas rab rib bcom pa bzhin/ /de dag gdug pa yongs btang zhing / /snyan pa'i tshig mi rā i ba/ /bha ga bān dz+re bi tasmra ka no bye yo karma nirmi tā/ /na bye tirna kṛ gis de la smras/ /bcom ldan bdag cag 'tsho ba 'di/ /smad par 'os pa las kyis sprul/ /gla rngan ma ṣi rtswa n+ya ra k+ṣa ṇi na pra ti gra ha ཿ / / sa hā dze+e kro r+ya ma smra kai yin zhing las min/ / gzhan srung ma yin byen len min/ / rmyebadag cag gdug pa lhan cig skyes//ni sarga ka lu ṣād+ma dzā/ /kri ya te kau swa bhā ba gya de ba tī1 nyi kaṇi kāḥ/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sdig bdag nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyi las kyis thuni/ /sbrul gyi mche rnon ji ltar sel//tasmran+da bṛ nyi lo baṃ na ཿ kartu marta si ga mya hūṃ / /yā te tu twa yi des na bdag cag 'tsho ba ni/ /nyams byar mi 'os gshegs par mdzod/ /khyod ni gshegs na don sārja su ba yo saṭ+wārja hā ri ṇaḥ/ /i ti te bye ba tsāḥshu tā ka ru rja mthun gyi/ /nor rnams thams cad bdag cag 'phrog /de skad de dag tshig thos nas/ /snying rje yongs pū: mā nā saḥ/ /do lā bo lā yi ta ma tiḥb bhū ba bha ga bān k+ṣa rde/ /ta su rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi blo gros ni/ /skad cig khyegs la 'phyang bar gyur/ /de 95—85

ta sārba dha dz+wa sabaṃ pa ri saṃ khyu ya tata sa oṃ/ /sa da do tso ra tsakrā nas don mthun nor rnams kun/ /yangs ①bgrangs de dang mnyam pa ni/ /de tshe thob pa'i gter dag ya k+ṣa rjap+ta ni ṅgā na taḥ/ /tabyi dhe na kra me ṇi ba pu naḥpa thi ga tā ga las—/ /chom rkun tshogs la de yis byin/ /yang gshegs byon pas lam du ni/ /rim pa de lta bu nyid taiḥ / /ṣaṭa kṛ twa pra da do te bh+yaḥsoza sārba gya muk+ta ye/ /su nastso pa ga te kyis—/ /don mthun sgol phyir de yi ⑤nor/ /lan drug de rnams la rab byin/ /yang ni lam de nas tasmin baṭ+wā nā te na sā nu ge/ /ba bhū ba budhistso rā rde tad sgo dza na 'ong ste①/ /rjes su 'brang dang bcas de la/ /de yi zas ni mgron gnyer ba'i/ /blo gros chom rkun ni man+t+ra ṇi/ /j-i shā di shārnyi be+e ma bye shu r+ghaṃ saṃ bhā ṣa ṇi na tsa/ /pra dzarnyi rnams la byung / /dam pa mthong bas dri bral te/ /yang dag bshad pas dge ba yang / /'grogs pa saṃ ga ma sgyu be+eḥ san+taḥ sad+mā rga se tu tsā / / ta tra ti r+yan+d+ra sha sabaṃ goms pas legs pa'i lam/ /zam stegs dag nas 'gro bar gyur④/ /mi dge thams cad yongs zad sarba ku sha la saṃ k+ṣa yāta/ /te ྾ sa mā hi tai shur+ghaṃ bi da dhe bha ga las—/ /de rnams 'dod pa dag pa kun/ /der ni bcom ldan rgyal ba dag /drang por gzigs pas bān dzi naḥ/ /ye ྾ saṃ gra ha batho ni tsa tā ri ni ya tād+ma dzñā/ /arja mkhyen par gyur/ /don spyod pa dang don mthun dang / /bdog pa gtong dang snyan par smra/ /bsdu ba'i tsar+yā sa mā nārja bhā bsgyu gaḥthra yo ba tsaḥ/ /ye hūṃ brah+ma bi hā rābya dngos po bzhi po la/ /nges pa'i bdag nyid gang dag dang / /gang zhig snying stobs ldan rnams kyis⑤//tsa tā raḥs twa shā li r+ghaṃ/ /ka ru rja mu di to pek+ṣa me ṭī tse ti pa ri gra tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi po/ /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms dang / /byams pa zhes bya yongs 'dzin haḥ / /ye ྾ ku sha la mū khā ni shaghā ni ṭī ṇi tse ta si/ /a lo bhasbyo pa ri dwo dang / /ma chags yongs su sdang ba med/ /ma rmongs pa de dge ba'i rtsa/ /gsum ni thugs la zhen pa 95—86

kho pya mo ha byu ma hā d+ma rja / / dā na shrī la k+ṣa ma bī r+ya dh+ya yis①—/ /bdag nyid chen po gang dag dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam na pradzñā dzu ṣe sa dā/ /u pā ya pra ṇi bye dzñā na ba le rā shri ta tse ta gtan shes rab rtag bsten zhing / /thabs dang smon lam ye shes dang / /stobs kyi ①rab tu bsten pa'i sīske/ /pa ri tā ṇi ka bī rā dzñā ya de pā dwa ya ba di dī/ /bi byā thugs—/ /yongs skyobs ①dpa' bo gcig pu dang / /rtag tu gnyis med gsung ④nyid dang / /rig pa tra ya pra dībhā dzā tsa tubye ma l+ya shā li dzā/ /pañtsa skan+t+ra bi mulnga rmā ṣa ḍā gsum gyi gsal ba dang / /dri med bzhi dang legs par ldan/ /phung po lnga las rnam grol zhing / /skye ya ta na bhe di dzā/ / sap+ta bo bye ga yughā nā mārlu bye go pa de mched drug ni 'byed pa dang / /byang chub yan lag bdun dang ldan/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad shi dzā/ /na ba saṃ yo ga tī nā ram̐ te ྾ da sha ba lāt+pa rmā/ /ki bās+t+ya nyer ston/ /kun sbyor dgus dman rgyal ba ni/ /stobs bcu'i bdag nyid ldan dag gis/ /'jig rten bi di tai lo ke dzi nā ghā dza ṣ+pe tseṣ+ṭi tai/ /ta taste ṣa ti ka ru sgyuts+tsha ra rja skye bo'i spyod tshul la/ /mi mkhyen pa ni ci zhig yod/ /de nas shin tu snying rje yis/ /zhabs la mgos lī na mūrja su/ /ta theh+phu bā tsa bha ga r+pā stasgod+mo pa ni man+t+ra ṇi/ /taistahūṃ gtugs de dag la/ /de bzhin no zhes bcom ldan kyis/ /de yi zas la zhal gyis bzhes/ /de mthong dar+sha na khye rja kilbi ṣeḥs ma marngi tai/ /byegru saṃ s+hodṛ tosgo byi bi bye sdig pa zad gyur pa/ /de dag gis ni mnyam du phul/ /dge slong tshogs kyis bskor ba yis/ /zas kun bat+parba mā da de/ /ta tastad pra ṇi jo ṣ+pe na dzñā na lo ka sha khā ka yā/ /te sa mudhī cho ga bzhin du blangs/ /de 'og de yi smon lam ni/ /ye shes snang ba'i thur ma yis/ /de dag mig ni li ta dṛ shaḥpra kā shaṃ da dṛ shuḥpa rda/ /te pa r+yas+t+ri bra be+e rā gya pa ri pa yang dag phye/ /rab tu gsal ba'i gnas mthong gyur/ /de dag 'phral la drag por ni/ /chags bral 95—87

kāḥpra sā di naḥ/ /pra bra dzñā yo ga mā sa bye dzaglurdza ga ti pū bye tā/ /taste yongs smin rab tu dang / /rab tu byung dang ldan thob nas/ /'gro ba'i mchod 'os ①nyid du gyur/ /de ྾ ku sha lo dṛṣ+ṭa sa ha so sa na tai bu raḥ/ /ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān thraṣ+ṭaḥdag 'phral la dge ba de/ /sngon du nye bar gnas mthong nas/ /dge slong rnams kyis 'di ci zhes//ki me ta di ti bhi k+ṣu bhi ཿ / / e te n+d+ra mā yo sa sbra n+ta ཿ sa rja ra k+ṣa dris shing bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /'di dag bdag dang 'byel pa 'di/ /don mthun bsrungs ṇa nirnge yiḥ/ /dī pa yā tā nu ga ta gya sī da n+ya smin+da pi dzad+ma ni/ /a ste bis+t+rir+ṇa shing slu 2ba yis/ /gling du 'gro ba'i skye ba ni/ /gzhan dag la yang grub par gyur/ /rnam rgyas spro ba mārga su sorga ba rga ba byerbi dheḥ/ /pu rī bā rā ṇa sī nā ma kau sha sgrub byed kyis1/ /rab mchog mkhas pa dga' ba'i sa/ / bā rā ṇa sī ④ zhes pa'i grong / /mtho 1 sde loṅkar+ṣa har+ṣa spyo/ /ya snga ma ma la kaphro la bā hi bhā su ra bā hi nī/ /sa dā yis 'tshams ⑤gyur yod/ /gang na dri med chu rlabs ni/ /'dzin pa lha yi rgyun 'dzin dag /rtag tu da ye ba z-i da yo pra sā da ya ti de hi rmā/ /a ho se ba sa tsā se bha lus can rnams kyis 'usnying / /brtse ba bzhin du dang bar bgyid/ /bzod pa bzhin du 'byung po kun//bi bye ba bi du ṣāsma hūṃ/ /k+ṣe me ba sarba bhū tā dzā yā bi shaṃ bha su kha sbi bag phab bde bar gnas pa gang / /'tshe ba med bzhin dam pas bsten/ /rig pa bzhin du mkhas pas tiḥ / /brah+ma la ste dṛ pe ta snga bi ka sata ka ma lā shra ye/ /brah+ma 'dod—/ /de nas ()7mi bdag tshangs par ni/ /brtag bya rnam rgyas pad+mar bstenasnyi/ /tshangs byin ⑨daṭ+wā bhe dhe lo ke tre lo kya mi ba rak+ṣa ti/ /bri ya se nā bhi dha no bhūta zhes byas 'jig rten ni/ /'jig rten gsum po ⑪bzhin du bsrungs/ /der ni ded dpon dga' ba'i sde//ta tra be+e shra ba rto sa maḥ/ /sārba bā horja sārja na s+thā na madhi ri r+pā bha saṃ//zhes pa rnam thos bu lta bu/ /chu rnams dag gi ⑪ chu gter bzhin/ /nor gyi don mthun gnas su gyur//95—88

ta snga bhūta su thra yo nā ma sau dzā n+ya ni la yaḥsu taḥ/ /pra ya yo yo sa mā shri de sras shin tu dga' zhes pa/ /skye bo legs pa'i gnas su gyur/ /gang la brten pa'i yon tan tshogs//t+ya sāza kṛ tā rba tī / /dā rna shrī la k+ṣa mā bīr+ya dh+yā na pradzñā sa ma don byas ①nyid du rab tu gyur/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes nī taḥ/ /ṅgā tā bi lo bhā nā ma ba ya kṛ taḥsu kṛ taḥshri yeḥ/ /tai sat+tha bi byā rab ldan/ /byed po rnam par chags sbad gang / /legs byas dpal du byas pa bzhin/ /de ni dri med bi ṣa dāḥka lāstsa bi pu lā sha yo/ /bi bi shuḥs rā so dā rā ma ho da bye mi rig kun dang / /sgyu rtsal shin tu yangs par yang / /ro ldan yid 'ong chu gter cher/ /chu bo bzhin du bā pa gāḥ/ /gu ṇa lo kṛ ta tsā ri tram̐ lak+ṣa shā lo kṛ tā kṛ 1/ /pu ru zhugs par gyur/ /spyod pa yon tan gyis brgyan cing / /lus ni mtshan gyis brgyan pa gang / /skyes bu sngot+ta ma luste ba yo shā gh+ra shrī rardzi shri yata/ /kā le na su kṛ ta mchog la chags pa bzhin/ /bsngags par 'os pa'i dpal gyis bsten/ /bsod nams kyis myos ④mtho shrī lta se ta ri tri di baṃ ga te/ /tsakre skan+ta ta ṭi ta gya bya ba hā ra bhā ris su/ /yab ni dus kyi ①gshegs pa'i tshe/ /de yi ④tha snyad khur dag ni/ /phrag pa'i ngos la gnas rasbi ti/ /so tsin+ta ya di yo lasmrirbi pu khād+ma kra mā ga tāḥ/ /ta thā pi par byas/ /de khyebasams bdag gi dpal 'byor 'di/ /rim pas 'ong zhing ⑥yangs pa ste/ /de lta ④na ma bye bar+yābhā na sar+pābe+e ma no ra the/ /ki tā yā su ma hā t+yā pi shri yang slong kun gyis⑧/ /re ba yongs su ma ⑨rdzogs snyam/ /sngar 'ongs slong bas zos nyid tshe/ /gang ya san+d+ra ru ṣa sba yā/ /pūr+pā ga tārji bhuste ba yā she ṣābe+e 6 ni spa khā/ /rat+na ka zhig phyis slong 'bras bu med/ /skyes bu dam pa la gnas dpal/ /shin tu che ba des kyang ci/ /rta gdong ⑫ ra gya bai bu sum̐ niphe dze+e be dha sā kṛ tai/ /a byā pi sgo ri to ye na slong ba gcig de yang / /gang gis da dung yongs ⑪ma rdzogs/ /rin chen 'byung gnas byed po yis/ /95—89

ṣ+pe kau pyarba sa bā ḍa baḥ/ /a tha bā thra thu saṃ kalpaḥke nāza pa ri pūr+ya te/ /yangs par byas pa'ang 'bras bu med/ /yang na brnag pa rgya che ba'i/ /slong ba su yis yongs rdzogs te//dza gā marnyi ra gas+t+ya su tsu lu kā ba ma nī ya tai/ /ki ka ro mya ti tā po yo shri a gaskya yi khyor chu yis①/ /hub tu rgya mtsho chen po ④song / /dpal ni gcig la slong ba mang / /slong ba re kā ba ha bobe+e ram̐/ /na ta dā sā r+ya te bir+ghaṃ yat+par+pābe+e bha ra ṇa k+ṣa oṃ/ /kun khengs bzod pa gang / /nor de bdag gis yongs ①mi 'thob/ /ci bya 'di ni shin tu gdung / /pañtsa ṣā pū ri tā e ba dzā bye shrī kaustu bhā di bhiḥ/ /i tī pā r+ya pi taston+ta dpal dang nor bu la sogs kyis/ /lnga drug nyid khengs gzhan min zhes/ /chu gter da dung rta gdong me//dz+wa lo dor+pā ṇa lom+bu byeḥ/ / tasmraṅka ro mi yasne na ni saṃ khya dra bi gdung ba nang du 'bar ba bzhin/ /slong ba phyir phyogs kha yis ④ni/ /sdug bsngal shugs rings yongs rjardza rgo/ /na sa he duḥkha niḥshā saṃ bi mu kha mya mu khebe+e naḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsin+tu mi bzod/ /de slad bdag gis 'bad pa yis/ /grangs med nor ni bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar yun ring sa tsi re sābe+e na ma ha to thra taḥ/ /rat+na dī pa pu re ga tā bi da bsams nas de/ /don mthun chen pos bskor nas ni/ /rin chen gling gi grong khyer du/ /phyin nas dhe rat+na saṃ gra haḥ/ /ta taḥpra tī pa mā sārnyi kṛ tādze+e ba ṣ+pe tsa raḥ/ /sāṭ+wārba ha rin chen bsdu ba byas/ /de 'og don byas sbar log ste/ /'ong ba de ni chom rkun pa/ /don mthun nor ra rton muk+ta da dṛ shurda gya baḥpa thi/ /sāṭ+wārba ha ra be+e dṛṣ+ṭa sa te 'phrog sbyor ba la/ /nags na rgyu bas lam du mthong / /de dag don mthun nor bslang rjophyir/ /bab ྾ sā ha sor+ya oṃ/ /ni dza sarba swa dā no na sri rak+ṣu nu yā yi dzā/ /col du spyor des mthong nas/ /rang gi nor kun byin nas ni/ /rjes su 'brang ba'i nor rnams bsrungs//pu naḥpra me ṇa te ṣ+pe ba rat+na dī pa ga ta ga teḥ/ /sāṭ+wā tā ṇa ya tso rā rde phyi nas rim pa de bzhin nyid/ /rin chen gling gi 'gro 'ong gis/ /don mthun bskyab phyir chom rkun la//95—90

ṣaskṛ tāḥpra da do dha dz+wa/ /ta dze+e ba hūṃ pu sgyu pi pan+d+ra ni saṃ pāp+tasta dze+e ba/ /nor ni lan drug rab tu byen/ /phyis kyang lam ni de nyid nas/ tshe /'ongs pas de bzhin chom rkun pa//ste phyis kyang ma de nyid na zhe pa'i tshig keng gcig po 'di'i kad dad mi 'dug pa keng pa gzhan rna sa dang mazun par kha sgo na pa'i rdob spyor du 'dar los ba ga pa rgya dpe ṣ+ped na dpad/tan da dar+sha tso rān sārbarba ha ra ṇiphodhi kā da ran/ /so tsin+ta ya da ho bitrīrma don mthun nor ni 'phrog pa la/ /lhag par brkam pa de dag mthong / /des bsams kye ma bdag gi nor//had+dhiḥpa ri pū ri tāḥ/ /ma ma ten bi parte te rna pa rārba ha ra rtor+ya māta/ /dza chen po yis ni yongs su sim/ /'di dag pha rol nor 'phrog la/ /brtson pa las ni phyir ma log /nor gta saṃ pū ra yā myadze+e ri h+phughā bi ma yā sa kṛta/ /a ho nu da gya bo ṣ+pe gyis 'gro ba khengs byas shing / /bdag gis yang yang brjod gyur kyang / /kye ma ma la chom rkun ni/ /te ba rā kāḥpa ri pū ri tāḥ/ /u tsi toṭ+wā ha tī na su bya ha tot+ta ra bā di naḥ/ /gdug ①pa 'di dag yongs ma khengs/ /rigs pa'i spro ba zhan gyur cing / /lan smra kun tu bcom pa dang //bi kajo na pra ti snyo su byed+me dzad+ma ku dzad+ma naḥ/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tap+ta gya smad par 'os pa'i dam bca' bzhin/ /ngan pa ④skyes pa bdag skye smad/ / de ltar sems shing 'gyod pa tap+ta snga nu sha yāghi nā/ /bi dza ṣ+pe pra ya yo rā triḥsasbat+pa ra sha to pa maḥ/ /yi—/ /①me yis rab tu gdungs pa de④/ /skye bo med par mtshan mo ni/ /lo brgya lta bur rab tu gyur//tai sho ka paṃ ka saṃ dur+ghaṃ ga dzen+d+ra mi ba ni: lo/ /disgosgo saṃ ma he shā khyu mya ngan 'dam du bying ba yi/ /glang po'i dbang po bzhin mi ⑤g.yo/ /dbugs ring de la rmi lam du//swa sne pro bā tsa de ba tā/ /su ma te ma kṛ thāḥsho ke sha rī rots+tsha ṣa khaṃ dṛ thā/ /sahūṃ lha ni mthu chen ldan pas smras/ /blo bzang mya ngan ma byed cig /don med lus ni rab skem yin/ /rnam ka spra bhi rū zwa su bha be+e 6 nyi ta pe spru tai / / na ta da ste dza ga brtags budam par mngon 'dzegs pa/ /khyed kyi 'dod pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /blo ldan brtson 'grus t+ya smi na swa sna saṃ ka lpa du rla sgo / / ya n+da si dh+ya t+ya ya sne na dhī can rnams kyis④/ /'bad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur ba/ /rmi lam rnam rtog rnyed dka' dang //95—91

rā rde bya ba sā yi ram̐/ /sā kā pya nu pa yā shasti re ka snga bi dī dzad+ma naḥ/ /'jig rten 'di na de yod min/ /gang yang nus pa de dpe med/ /gang zhig gnyis skyes gcig gi yang //ya dā dzñā sun+di te ṣ+pe ba bin+dha smra sa ma tā ya yo/ /bi ṣa oṃ sa ma hūṃ yā ti gsung gi kyal ka kho na yis/ /'bigs byed sa dang mtshungs par gyur①/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bya ba'i dru ra mā yā ti tsārnyi shaṃ/ / sa le lo sba la tā me ti kār+ya kā la dus—/ /mi mnyam pa yang mnyam par 'grur⑤/ /ring ba rnams kyang nye bar 'ong / /chu yang skam sa ma hāt+tha dz+wa/ /ba rātho yo ta bā re bhaḥpha la byu ba na shaṃ sa ya/ /na bha brnyi nyid du gyur①/ /gzhan don khyod kyis ④brtson pa 'di/ /'bras bu nyid du the tshom med/ /snying stobs bi sa bā rda saṃ dispyoḥs twa bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /raṭ+wā ni ba da ra dī pe paṃ ti dri da spyod pa slu ba yisakhye / /the tshom la rjoyang mi 'byung ngo / /lha rnams kyis bsten ba da ra'i/ /gling na rin sha se bi te/ /ye ṣā me ka pra bhā bo pi tri dza gta pū ra ṇa k+ṣu maḥ/ /martu po che dag yod/ /gang zhig gcig gi mthu yis kyang / /'jig rten gsum po khengs par mdzodadze+e/ /gang byu mi ma ti pra mya sā hi byu mi ma tī ya sī/ /ā sā r+ya te pu rgya ma yī nā phyir mi yi sa 'das nas/ /de ni shin tu che ba'i sa/ /bsod nams rang bzhin gyis 'thob ste/ /snying sa tī rtswa kṛ tād+ma bhiḥ / /bi ṣā das+t+ya bye tī pu tra sbri rā budhirbi dh+wa stobs legs byas min pas min/ /bu dag yid ni gdung ba thong / /brtan pa'i blo gros rnam par ya hūṃ/ /ba da ra dī pa yā tā yā mud+mā haḥpa ri kṛ khya tsā/ /shu ya tā me ṣā tata s+thābye bsgrubs—/ /ba da ra yi gling 'gro la/ /rab tu spro ba yongs su zungs⑧/ /khrod ni snying stobs mthu rgyas did+mā tā nu kra maḥkra maḥ/ /sbyi taḥs twa bra bhā bste saṃsā rot+ta ra ṇa k+ṣa shing / /'khor ba rab tu sgrol bar bzod/ /de thob bya phyir phyogs dang ni/ /lam gyi rim pa 'di dag ma / /a ste pabye ma did+dhā ge sa muwaṃ gru ma hā ya sī/ /sha tā ni sabe+e dī pā rmā nyon—/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi cha na yod/ /shin tu che ba'i gling dag ni/ /bdun brgya rab tu 'das gyur 95—92

ta thā sap+ta ma hā tsa lān/ /saju sa gārtswa nu lo ma pra ti lo ma bhi cing / /de bzhin du ni ri ①chen bdun/ /chu klung bdun dang rjes 'gro dang / /bzlog 'gro zhes pa'i sgom+bu byeḥ/ /a nu kyu lā ni ler+yasmin pā ra māsno ti pu ju bān/ /ta tastabhu chu yi gter/ /rjes su mthun pa'i rlung gis der/ /pha rol 'thob bo bsod nams can/ /de nas de l+ya nā mā drir+pā taiste mi ra mo ha kṛ ta/ /ya tā stodi sha ti swāsbya ma mo mtshungs ming can ri①/ /rlung gis ①rab rib rmongs par byed/ /sman chen don yod ces pa yis/ /ghā khyu ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /a thā brtu bhi sgo sgo dhi be+e raster+ya tra ba yu bhi/ /mig gnyis gang du rnal gnas ster/ /de nas kun 'khor zhes chu gter/ /gang du rlung ni be+e rām bhas/ /ma dz+dza nod+ma dz+dza ṣ+pe rdzan+tu ཿ sa p+ta ba rte 6 tā r+ya te / / a ba rta khyasta 'bying zhing 'byung bas srog chags rnams/ /kun 'khor bdun las sgrol bar byed/ /de nas kun 'khor taḥshi laḥshaṃ kha nā sgo ni bā tsa raḥ/ /sgo raḥpā ṇa ha ro ya tra tri de sha tā sa zhes pa'i ri/ /gang na mtshan rgyu dung gi lte/ /'jigs su rung zhing srog 'phrog pa/ /skabs gsum pa kṛta sbi taḥ/ /kṛṣ+ṭa sabyā dṛ tā ta tra shaṃ kha nā dī ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /tā ya te pu yang skrag byed gnas/ /de na sman chen dung gi lte/ /sgrul ni nag pos dkris gyur pa/ /mig dang mgo rgya sadza.oṃ ṣ+pe tre shi ra si tsabe+e tai/ /a tha ni lo da nā mā bye rak+ta sgo la bzhag pa na/ /bsod nams ldan pa yongs su skyob/ /de nas chu sngon zhes pa'i mtsho/ /gang na srin ya tra rāk+ṣa saḥ/ /ma kar+yā dhi bhū tsā budhe bi byā bi dān ba she/ /po mig dmar yod/ /ma gir ④zhes bya'i sman 'dzin dang / /sangs rgyas rig byed rig pa'i dbang / /a tha nī lo dā nā mā dri bhā la shrī baḥk+ṣa pā tsa raḥ/ /pra dīp+ta no tro ya tāste rak+ṣa de nas chu sngon zhes pa'i ri/ /gang na mgrin pa sngon po ni/ /mtshan rgyu mig ni rab 'bar ba/ /srin po sī pañtsa rnyiḥsha taiḥ/ /ta tre ṣa dhi ma mo ghā khye rak+ṣa t+yā shi bi ṣāḥs dā/ /lnga brgya dag dang gnas/ /de na don yod ces pa'i sman/ /mthong dang dbugs dang reg pa dang / /95—93

dṛṣ+ṭi niḥshā sa saṃ spar+sha rdasbyodṛ pa bi ṣā na laḥ/ /u pa ṣa dha bra ta ba tā mche ba ①rab spyos dug gi me/ /rtag tu sbrul byu dug rnams srung (ge/ /gso sbyong brtul zhugs ldan pa dang //mai tre ṇa ka ru shād+ma na/ /la sgyu te sā sa muṣ+ṭhar+ya kṛṣ+ṭa sadze+e ma ho ṣa byams dang snying rje'i bdag nyid kyis/ /sbrul ni nag po rab bskrad nas/ /sman chen de ni thob par dhiḥ / /tai rak+ṣaḥsha ka ṭi shi lam̐ nispa la shra kyā kan+da re/ /tā mañdza ṣ+peshi 'gyur—/ /de yis spyomig sman zur phud ni/ /byas nas rjosrin po'i shing rta ri/ /'bras med bug pa phra khā yo tsa kṛ twa ta ra ti pu rgya bān/ /a tha be+e ram+bha nā mā driḥs re yā srot+ta mo can/ /bsod nams ldan pas sgol bar 'gyur/ /de nas be ram bha zhes ri/ /de rjes ⑤gang gis pha ra ta taḥ/ /gho rā tā s+thā ṭa bi nā ma ma hā shā la ba rmā ta rāḥ/ /ma hā na dza rol gzhan/ /'jigs rung zangs kyi nags zhes pa/ /sā la chen po'i nags kyi nang / /de na sbrul ni ga rasta tra tā māsgo nā ma duḥs haḥ/ /aste ya spyo gra gadhe na bā yu ṣ+pe spram chen dag /zangs mig ces pa bzod dka' ba/ /drag po'i dri ldan gang gi rlung / /nyid kyis 'tshe ⑥ba nā dz+re bya te/ /ṣarja sān swa pa to ya su lā lā byāsno ti yo dza dz+wa/ /k+ṣuta saṃ bar mi byed gnas/ /zla ba drug tu nyal gyur pa'i/ /kha chu yis ni dpag tshad khyab/ /ltogs pas tabe+e su ṣad+mā sā nashrī bha pa ti dzā gra taḥ/ /be+e rku gusme shi khā ba d+dhā gdungs nas zla drug ni/ /gnyis ⑦dang bral bas chung bar gyur/ /'od ma'i rtsa ba rdos bsdams phug /gu hā mut+yā rgya mo di no/ /s+thā pyo ṣa dhīn di bā rā tram̐ dz+wa laṭī oṃ dza no tsi hūṃ/ /rab tu phye bas dri dang ldan/ /nyin dang mtshan du rab 'bar ba/ /mig sman du 'os sman thob 'gyur/ /tasmra da dza ga rā ta sgo rā n+ya to bā ma ho dza saḥ/ /a bai rā khye budha bi bye sdang med ces pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /rig pa bzlas pas sbram chen ni/ /'jigs rung de dang gzi brjid che//dza pa to na bha ber+bha ya/ /ta taḥsap+ta ma hā shi lā be rku kaṇ+ḍa ka saṃ ka ṭaḥ/ /gzhan gyis kyang ni 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /de nas ri ni che ba bdun/ /'od ma'i tsher mas gtams gyur pa//95—94

sarba tāḥ/ /na r+yabya tabe+e dh+wa yā sā ma pā rā bā ri sadza daḥ/ /e ta dud+dhār+ya ni khi tu khengs/ /de lta'i chu klung dag kyang ste/ / chu yi ①phun tshogs pha mtha' med/ /de dag ma lus rab lo pu byeḥpa ra nyi tor+ya taḥ/ /a ro ha ti su dh+wa shi la shri gi rā bo brgal te/ /gzhan phan brtson pa bsod nams kyis/ /rtse mo mkha' la reg gyur pa/ /dkar ba'i ri la gi tāsbra ram̐/ /ta tasta sgyu pa re pabye kalpa dṛkhyo pa sho bhi tai/ /bu ram̐ ro hi ta 'dzeg 0par 'gyur/ /de nas de yi ngos gzhan la/ /ro nyi ta ①ki zhes grong khyer/ /dpag bsam shing shaṃ nā ma dṛ sh+ya te swarga sa: dzha/ /aste ta tra ma gho nā ma ma gis nye bar mdzes/ /mtho ris dang mtshungs mthong bar 'gyur/ /de na ded dpon snying stobs ni//gha pā ni ba bi khru taḥ/ /sarba bā ho ma hā sa twoḥsarba sa twa ti ta re taḥ/ /chen po ma gha zhes pa yod/ /sems can kun la phan par dgyes/ /brgya byin bzhin du rnam par grags//ba da ra dī pa yā tā yā mur+ya ta su nā ba r+ya dhīḥ/ /mārgo pa de shaṃ de sha snyoḥshes bzang blo gros skyon med des/ /ba da ra ④yi gling dag tu/ /'gro bar brtson pa khyod kyis buni/ /sa te sa baṃ ka ri 6 ti / / ih+phu sto ṭ+wā khya ba hu shaḥ su bhā dre ri lam byu gdams ngag kun byed 'gyur/ /'di brjod bdud rtsi'i rlan byus bzhin/ /'os pa'i tshig gis ba su pri yo/ /ba tso ti tu tsi tairde bī sa hā sān+ta ra dhī ya ta/ pra budheḥsu pri yāḥshin tu dga'/ /mang du spro ba bskyed byas nas/ /lha mo 'phral la mi snang gyur/ /shin tu dga' ni rab sabaṃ taṭ+wā ze nyi bi tsin+ta yan/ /pra tasbi sa twa mā rū hra ni dzoṭ+wā ha sad nas/ /thams cad de de bzhin zhes bsams/ /rang gi spro ba sngon btang nas/ /snying stobs la ni pu raḥs raḥ/ /sa bra dzan bi dzi tā yā saste na nirdeṣ+ṭa bzla nā/ /pūrterngu da zhon te chas/ /de yis bstan pa'i lam las ⑥ni/ /ngal ba rnam bcom des bgrod pas/ /lo ni bcu sha bhi rbadze+eḥpā sa ro hi ta shaṃ pu re/ /a drun+ta re karma yo gāt+ta tra gnyis rdzogs pa na/ /ro hi ta ka'i grong khyer sleb/ /skabs 'dir der ni don mthun bdag /ma gha 95—96

sārja pa nyi rma ghaḥ/ /byā bye nā dubye ki྾ na ba bhū bā swas+tha bi gra haḥ/ /a lad+dhān+taḥlas kyi sbyor ba las/ /gso ba dka' ba'i nad kyis ni/ /lus ni rnal du mi ①gnas gyur/ /de nas rgyal pra be shorja kṛ te rā dza kṛ ho pa me/ /ta gya bya lasba ta dā ri su pri yaḥpo'i khab lta'i ②khyim/ /nang du 'jug pa ma thob nas/ /de yi sgo na shin tu dga'/ /bya ba bsgrub slad kār+ya sedhe ye/ /ta to bo dro pa de she na sa pra be+e sha ma bābe+e bān/ /u pa yo ga ka 'dug par gyur④/ /de nas sman pa'i zol gyis ni/ /de ni nang du 'jug pa thob/ /nye bar rigs pa'i thā pra dzñā naka s+thā da ra bhū ma yaḥ/ /ā yurbe da bi dh+wa na dzñāḥs ta snga riṣ+ṭa gtam shes pa/ /su yi gus pa'i sa ma yin/ /tshe yi rig byed sgrub shes shing / /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid lak+ṣaṇiḥ—/ /ṣarja pa she ṣa me bā yudzña tā tsid+dhān+ta ro bha bāta/ /ta gya shes pa des/ /zla drug mjug ④nyid de yi tshor/ /shes nas bsam rjopa 'khrugs par gyur/ /dga' bri ya hi ta zwa po bye ṣa bye pa ri tsar+yā ya/ /a t+yaspe ṣ+pe ba kā le na su zhing phan pa'i sman mang dang / /de yi rim gro ⑥ legs byas pa④/ /dus ni shin tu thung ba yis/ /shin pre yaḥpre ya tī ya yo/ /bye ṣa bye yustista da spru t+yā ta su babe+ebha hūṃ ya yo/ /tu dga' dang mdza' bor gyur/ /de la mdza' bas sman sbyar rnams/ /de yis 'dod pa bya bar gyur/ /pri yo pa nī tai yata kiñtsita tat+parbasma na saḥpri yo/ /pri yo pa tsā rista sngaḥbyu mdza' bos cung zad byen pa gang / /de dag kun la yid dga' 'o④/ /de nas bde ba'i rim gros ⑪de'i//dhirmād+dhā ba mā ya yo/ /ā dhīḥshā l+ya ti sahūṃ gān+ta to byā byerbi shir+ya te/ /nad ni chung ba nyid du gyur/ /dam pa'i grogs las sdug bsngal zhi/ /de las nad dang bral bar gyur/ /ta taḥsaṃ dzā ta bi shaṃ r+ghaṃ su thra ya pra ṇa yād+ma s+ho/ /tsakre bi di ta thraṭ+wārnya de nas ma gha mdza' ba las/ /yid phebs skyes la shin tu dga'/ /slad nas rang gi gtam gyi tshe/ /pabyan+di dza ka thā k+ṣa ṇi/ /ba da ra dī pa yā tā yī ta spyoṣ+ṭha haṃ ma hāt+pa naḥ/ /pa spyod tshul mtha' ni rig par byas/ /ba da ra yi gling bgrod la/ /bdag nyid che de'i spro ba dag /gzhan 95—97

rābe+e nibyu lo dzñā tā ta mū tse be+esma yād+ma ghaḥ/ /a ho ba tā smin saṃ sāre niḥsā re don g.yo med shes gyur nas/ /ma ghas ya mtshan de la smras/ /kye ma snying po med pa yi/ /'khor ba 'di sā ra rū pi ṇaḥ/ /dzā yadhe ma ṇa yaḥkabyeta pa ra tsid+dhā pa ra yā ṇaḥ/ /na na snying po'i gzugs/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa'i dpung gnyen ni/ /nor bu 'ga' zhig yod pa yin/ /na ba ba yaḥpi ya mūrtiḥ pa rārba pra ba khaṃ ma na/ /pu byo tsi ta s+tha tshod gzhon zhing mdzes pa'i gzugs/ /gzhan gyi don la gcags pa'i yid/ /yon tan phun tshogs tse ba yo s+thā ṣ+pe gu ṇa sa mā ga maḥ/ /i ya tsā byu mi mube+e gh+ra pa bsod nams ldan/ /gnas 'di khyod nyid kho na'i yin/ /'di snyed sa 'di rab 'das ①nas/ /khrod rāze twa mu pā ga taḥ/ /ka ro mi ta ba sā hā be+e ki twa haṃ j-i sha mā tu raḥ/ /ni gzhan gye don du 'ongs/ /khyod kyi stong grogs bgyid pa la/ /'on kyang bdag ni mchog tu gzir//ni bad+dhā ba dha yaḥpā shāḥs+thā yā l+ya ba sha rī ri rde/ /te pra rdza tu ma mārnyi pi mtshams ni nges pa lus can gyi/ /srog ni nges par 'gro ba nyid/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /twat+pa mā hi ta he tu tī/ /e ba me ba bya yo yastu bya yaḥs pa ri ga ṇi te/ /bdag gi de mthar gyur kyang sla'i/ /da lta 1nyid du zad pa gang / /de ni zad par yongs su bgrang / /pa rābe+e dzī bi ta snga pi bya yo la bha sha teḥs maḥ/ /na ma yā ba da ra dī paṃ gzhan byi don du srog dag kyang / /zad pa rnyed pa brgya dang mnyam/ /bdag gi ④ba da ra yi gling / /ma j-ibye ki tu khru tasma yā/ /ma hā dhi dika sa mudre shaṃ taisterdza nā mi lak+ṣa ṇiḥ/ /mthong 'on kyang bdag gis thos/ /chu gter chen po phyogs lhung sdeston/ /de dang ⑤de yi mtshan ma shes//i trus+thā bhū pa ti su dz+dzaṅkun+tu bākyo pya nā da raḥ/ /sa oṃ ga la pra ba de skad brjod nas sa bdag gis/ /grogs bzang mnyen pa'i tshig kyang dor/ /de yis bkra shis gru ha khaṃ su thra ye ṇa sa ha da de/ /ta taḥpā ba ha nā rū rnyo to yo dza gzings ni/ /shin tu dga' dang lhan cig bzung / /de nas bsam pa yangs pa ni/ /de dag gzings 95—98

pu naḥpra ba ha ṇa rū hoḥs mud+dhā r+ya bā ri dhi/ /rat+na barba ta pāṅge na yang ni gzings la zhon byas te/ /chu bo'i gter ni yang dag bsgral/ /rin chen ri bo'i ngos nas ni//be+e be+e sha bi ka ṭā ṭa ṭī/ /na be+e yo kairna tsobye giṭ+wā rnyi yo girdi ṣā ma nags tshal stug po'i nang du zhugs/ /bdag nyid chen po'i blo gros ni/ /sman ①pa 'bral bas ma yin pi—/ /na ro geḥkle sha r+bha gir+pā tī ya te ma hā tāsma ti/ /sa ta tā zhing / /gdung dang dgra rnams mngon sbyor dang / /nad dang nyon mongs spyod pas min/ /der ni nam kran+ta ga ga ā+oṃ ni rud+dhā she ṣa dik+ta ṭi / / du rā ro haṃ da dakhye gre mkhar son pa'i ri/ /phyogs ngos ma lus bkag gyur pas⑤/ /mdun du bgegs ni gzugs can bzhin//mūrta m+bisna mi ba tsa lo/ /u pā ya tī rna tai dṛṭī gi ri mūkho mi bodhe bgrod par dka' ba de yis mthong / /rmongs pa bzhin du sbyor ba'i ri/ /de mthong thabs ni dman gyur tai / /a dhaḥpal+la ba sha yā yī sup+ta so tsi ta ya1 ṇi/ /a ho ba ta ki yān cing / /zhabs su yal 'dab mal stan la/ /nyal nas de yi skad cig bsams/ /kye ma bdag ni zhugs kā laḥpra ya taḥprasbi ta su me/ /ba da ra dī pa nā mā pi na nā ma shu ya te kwa tsita/ /gyur nas/ /ji snyed dus ni rab tu 'das/ /gang du'ang ba da ra yi gling / /ming yang nges par ma thos so//bya ba sā ya sa hā yo me yo bhūta pu bye pa byeḥpa ram̐/ /bhasnaḥbe+e ba i bsod nams zong gis bdag gi ni/ /brtson pa'i grogs mchog gyur pa gang / /de yang las kyi rba ①bā kā le so pi karmormi bi sla baiḥ/ /noṣ+ṭa sa ye p+lu sa ye smin bya ba sā rlabs kyis/ /dus min gdos pa chag pa bzhin/ /thabs nyams thabs ni 'di la yang / /shin tu che yān ma hi ya saḥ/ /na nā ma bi ni brte haṃ sirnyirni dh+wa na mastu bā/ /ba'i 'bad rtsol gyis/ /bdag ni nges par rnam mi ldog④/ /grub pa'am yang na shi bar 'gyur⑤//ta de shaṃ dzad+ma yā tā su sru rdzu dzad+ma dza gan+d+ra ye/ /ya smin pa ro pa kā rā ya 'gro ba gsum po 'dir skyes pa/ /gzhan la phan phyir srog dag ni/ /zad par gyur pa de gcig pu/ /95—100

dzā ya te jo bi ta bya yaḥ/ /i ti tsid+dhā ku lo ta tra tai dzñā twa sa twa sā skye 'gro rnams su mchod par 'os/ /der ni de ltar bsam 'khrugs te①/ /snying stobs rgya mtshor shes ga ram̐/ /bhā lo nā ma ga ma bye t+ya yak+ṣa pā hā tsa khā shra yaḥ/ /pūrbe ṇa yo gyur nas/ /ri la gnas pa'i gnod ⑤sbyin ni/ /sngon po zhes pa 'ongs nas smras/ /shar du dpag tshad dza rna ga tā tī ṇi shri gā ni byu j-i taḥ/ /be+e tra so pā na ni gre dh+yā shwa mā tu t+yā phyin gyur nas/ /sa 'dzin rtse mo gsum pa ni/ /sa las byas pa'i them skas la/ /'dzegs la de nas tha ga mya hūṃ/ /i ti yakhyo ba de she na sa bi lo sgya ma hā tsa lo/ /da dar+sha 'gro bar gyis/ /de skad gnod sbyin gdams ngag gis/ /ri ①chen de yi ④rnam brgal bas/ /rtse mo gre sa yuhūṃ ga shri shaṃ sga ṭi ka byu dha ram̐/ /tasmin+de ka shi la shraste durga shin tu mtho ba yi/ /shel gyi sa 'dzin mdun du mthong / /bya rnams kyis kyang bgrod dka' ba/ /'jam me pak+shi ṇa ma pi/ /spyu snurta ma bha bat+ta su nisto pa ro ma no ra thaḥ/ /a byun+da tai shi pa'i brag ni gcig pu der/ /de yi yid la re ba ni/ /yud tsam bya ba med par gyur/ /shin tu mtho zhing rā yam+bi swa saṃ kalpa yi bā tsa lo/ /sa tai bi tsār+ya su tsi ram̐ tsi tra n+yasta rten dang bral/ /rang gi rtog ④bzhin g.yo med par/ /de la rnam dpyad yun ring de/ /ri mo bkod pa i ba bha bta/ /a tha tsan+d+ra pra sgo nā ma yak+ṣaḥshi la gu hā shra yaḥ/ /a bye t+ya satwa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas zla 'od ces pa yi/ /gnod sbyin brag gi phug gnas pa/ /snying stobs phun sadza.oṃ ta ma bhā ṣa ta bi smi taḥ/ /kro sha mā tra mi twa ga tā pūrbe tshogs de la ni/ /mngon phyogs ya mtshan ldan pas smras/ /'di nas shar du rgyang grags tsam/ /song shā pūrba bi bh+ra oṃ/ /dṛ sh+ya te tsan+da na ba rna bā khā ni la tsa la be+e bas tsan+dan nags tshal ni/ /rlung bzhon ⑥gyis bskyod 'khri shing ldan/ /sngon med rnam 'phrul mthong bar tai—/ /ta tra phra sa rā nā ma gu hā lbo nā ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /la bh+ya te de ha rak+ṣu 'gyur—/ /de ⑦ni rab gsal byed ces pa/ /phug na gtams pa'i sman chen po/ /lus can bsrung phyir 95—101

yi sa musto l+ya ma hā shi la/ /tata pra bha ba kṛ ta lo shaṃ so pā ṣ+peḥri ①chen la/ /rab tu btus pas thob ⑤par 'gyur/ /de yi 'od kyis snang byas pa'i/ /skas kyis shel spa ṭi kā tsa lo/ /sa ha me+e ba sa mā ru khya ga mya tā m+bidz+re tāp+ta ye/ /k+ṣa ṇa ta gyi ri la ni/ /'phral nyid du ni yang dag 'dzegs/ /'dod pa thob phyir 'gro ba ①byos/ /sman chen de kṛ ta kārle bā sā pra yā ti ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /na khe dastata 1 te kār+yasta ḍikhro khāḥni don byas bzhin/ /skad cig gis ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa thob pa glog ltar g.yo/ /de phyir mya pri yāp+ta yaḥ/ /i ti yakhyo pa debye na bi dh+wa ṣ+pe na sa khyu dha re/ /sa muta ngan bya ba min/ /de ltar sgrub byed gnod sbyin gyis/ /bstan pas de yis sa 'dzin dag /yang dag kra mya da dad+dhā gre na ga ra te ma man+di ram̐/ /me byu ku ḍi ri bā tīr+ghaṃ 'dzegs pas mdun du ni/ /gser gyi khang ldan grong khyen mthong / /lhun po brtsegs pas rgyas pa bzhin//pra ka shi ri ba nirmi ta/ /sar+pā:྾ ri ba kṛ tai taj-iṭī bismi to bha rab gsal rnams kyi sprul pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar kun gyis byas pa bzhin/ /de mthong ya mtshan ldan par bta—/ /ma hā te ma ka pā ṭā dzñā tudha dā ram̐ bi lo kya tata/ /nirdza ā+oṃ bā ra saṃ gyur—/ /grong khyer lam gyi bumi med cing / /gser gyi sgo glegs chen po yis/ /de yi sgo ni bcad mthong dzā re ba nārnye ni ṣa sā da saḥ/ /a tān+ta re di na s+thārnye byo mā nan+ta nas / /de ni nags kyi mtha' na gnas/ /skabs 'dir nyin mo'i mthar gyur te/ /mtha' med mkha' pa thā dh+wa gaḥ/ /a bā bās+thā tsa lo bārnyi ba ri shān+ta i r+pā shu mān/ /aste yi ༷lam bgrod pas/ /tsha zer can ni yongs dal bzhin/ /nub kyi ri dang nye bar sleb/ /'od stong ga te sa ha shā sho ra dza nī ra ma ṇi sha ṣ+peḥ/ /tā rā pa ti mi bā dz+wahūṃ pra nub par gyur pa'i tshe/ /mngon par 'gro ba mun can ma/ /rgyu skar bdag po 'dod gyur nas/ /dal sa sargya dha sā ri kā/ /a tha pra kā sha bi bha baiḥsarba shā pū ra r+ṇarlu khaḥ/ /bus rab tu 'gro ba bzhin/ /de nas rab gsal 'byor pa yis/ /phyogs kun yongs rdzogs gyen du phyogs//95—102

bo dhi satwa i ba swats+tshaḥsu dh+wa dī dhi ti tur+ya yo/ /sbyi tā ta maḥs mū ha dri med byang chub sems dpa' bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od de shar bar gyur/ /mun pa'i tshogs ni ma lus mya niḥshe ṣa pra pa mo tsi ta/ /mā na sos+thā se be+e byo: satwa bṛtrī ri bā pa—/ /rab tu zhi bar nus shing rgyas/ /yid ni dngas byed zla ba'i 'od/ /snying stobs spyod tshul bzhin ba bye/ /ta mo mo haṃ dza ha ren+d+rardi shī di na bi yo ga dze+e/ /pa ro du mdzes/ /nyin bral las skyes phyogs rnams kyis①/ /mun pa'i rmongs pa zla bas phrogs/ /gang phyir pa kā ro hi du rā ro ho ma hād+ma r+ghaṃ/ /su pri ya :n+d+ra ki ra be+eḥring na bzhugs pa yi/ /bdag nyid che rnams gzhan phan mchog /zla ba'i zer gyis shin tu dga'//dūr+ya mā ṇa ta nuḥk+ṣa rde/ /ni dzā kār+ya sa mū hormi sgo bha mu drwa ma bābe+e bān/ /skad cig lus ni khengs gyur nas/ /bya ba'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs dag /'khrug pa'i rgya ni gnyid thob gyur//k+ṣa mā yī k+ṣi ya mā ṇa yī gu ṇa dīk+ṣa bye sā dā rā/ /dza ga da de ba tā swasde ma mtshan mo zad par gyur pa'i tshe/ /yon tan yon gyis gus bcas pa/ /mthu chen lnga yi ༷rmi lam du/ /de he shā khyu sa me t+ya tai/ /a ho ba ta ma hā satwa sat+ta tā bhe ni be+e shi nā/ /pa la mngon par phyogs nas smras/ /e ma kwa ye snying stobs can/ /de nyid dam pa'i mngon zhen pa/ /legs rābe+e bi pu la gre shaḥkṛ taḥsu kṛ ti nā twa yā/ /alba she ṣe pra yā sesmin byas khrod kyi ①ngal dub ni/ /gzhan gyi don du rgya chen byas/ /nyon mongs lhag ma chung ngu 'dir/ /yid nobye ga kartu marta se/ /a parlu ṣi ta satā r+ghaṃ sa dhī nāḥsarba sidhe yaḥ/ /no 'byung bar mi 'os so/ /snying stobs dman pa med rnams kyis④/ /rang dbang nyid du thams cad grub⑤ //hai oṃ ya de tai na ga ram̐ ṭī ṇi tsā n+ya taḥpa re/ /sadhi rat+na pu ra bye tra gser gyi grong khyer gang 'di dang / /gsum ni pha rol gzhan dang gzhan/ /gong nas gong du rnam par bkra//bi tsi tā rgyut+ta rot+ta ram̐/ /te bh+yo nir+yā ti kin+dar+ya: ta sroṣ+ṭi tsa kho ḍa shaḥ/ /dā 'di na rin chen grong khyer yod/ /khyod kyis sgo ni brdungs pa na/ /de dag las ni mi 'am ci bzhi 95—103

ṭī bya kra me ṇi ba twa yā dā ri bi ghasbyi te/ /dzi teji ya mya bha ba dang brgyad dang bcu drug dang / /so gnyis rim pas phyir 'byung 'gyur/ /khyod kyi ①dbang po thul ba tastat+tha mā da na be+e di naḥ/ /ki ma n+ya da tsi re ṇi ba r+pā sbyi tāster+bha bi yis—/ /de yi bag med rig par bya/ /ring po min par 'dod pa dag / mthong bar gyur snete gzhan 6 ti/ /i kyuk+taḥsā da re de bya pra nyi busgo tha su thra yaḥ/ /tri dza ghā na na ga pa ci/ /lha mos gus bcas 'di brjod la/ /de nas rab sad shin tu dges①/ /grong khyer sgo la mngon ra ṭ+wā ra ma bye t+ya pā ṇi nā/ / ta ta : ta sraḥkirja rlo nir+ya yusta phyogs te/ /lag pa yis ni lan gsum brdungs/ /de nas mi 'am ci mo bzhi/ / g.yo ba'i mig can ra lak+ṣe khyeḥ/ /ābyar+ya ta ru oṃ dza r+ya i ba lbo lā ni khā ku lāḥ/ /mān 'thon gyur te/ /rjogayo ba'i rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ /ngo mtshar ljon pa'i snye ma bzhin/ /yid ni sobe+e sa kā ri byo na ya nā mṛ ta bṛṣ+ṭa yaḥ/ /ba da ṣ+pen+d+ra sa mud+mo tairda rengs ⑤par byed gyur cing / /'dren byed dag gi bdud rtsi'i char/ /bzhin ras zla ba'i 'od zer gyis//bā pi kṛ ta tsaji kā/ /tāḥsaṃ pū bye sma ro dā ram̐ su thra yi pri ya dar+sha nyin mor ⑥zla 'od ldan par byas/ /dga' bas mthong des shin tu dga'/ /'dod pa rgya cher yang dag nāḥ—/ /ta snga bhi la ṣa pra ṇa ma rā ti bya mi ba tsakri re/ /tsan+d+ra kād+dhā mchod—/ /de ni mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /mdza' bas dze+emagron gces bzhin du byas/ /zla ba chu shel sa mā sī dz+wa kṛ tā sa na pa ri gra hāḥ/ /dz+re ba no ṣa dha yo dzā tāḥsma ra sri ba stan 'khod pa/ /de la dran pa 'tsho ba'i sman/ /lus dang bcas par skyes pa bzhin/ /stan ni bzung sa bi gra hāḥ/ /tāsta mū tsuḥs mudhī la dī khā sa ha si ta tī ṣaḥ/ /na byas de dag gis/ /rtse dga' dgod pa'i 'od zer dag /yang dag rgyas par gyur pa ni/ /mdza' r+yan+t+ra i ba kaspru ram̐ pre mo pā ya hūṃ pu raḥ/ /a ho ṅgā t+yā ba yo yā sī ba'i phrad skyes ga pur dag /sngon du ster ba bzhin du smras/ /yon tan dam pas brgyan pa'i dbyebs/ /95—104

saṅga ṇa lo kṛ tā kṛ tiḥ/ /swa ya me bā bhi ga pyo pi bha pā na t+yā ga khyod ①can 'ong bar 'os pa yang / /gang gis ①khyim du rang nyid 'ongs/ /kye ma bdag cag bsod to kṛ haṃ/ /bi dwo ṣa ka su spru yu ṣe tsan da ṣ+pe ka gya tsā ru ཿ/ /isdo man+da da raḥnams can/ /bdud rtsi la ni su zhig sdang / /tsan+dan la ni su mi sred/ /zla ba la ni su gus dman/ /ko bā sā dhu ka gya na sasma taḥ/ /sdi rde ya r+ya pi sau bha gya sgo gā ya pra ṇa yaḥswa yo/ /dam pa rnams la su mi 'dod/ /gang yang bud med rang nyid ni/ /gleng ba skal bzang nyams pa'i rgyu/ /kra mastad dar+sha ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba ta thā bi mu kha ri kṛ tāḥ/ /i dan+da ra pu ram̐ ba yo de lta na yang khyod mthong ba/ /nyid kyis mu cor byas phyir smra/ /mi 'am ci yi grong khyer 'di/ /bdag tsa pra ṇa yābe+e tā ཿ / / rarja tsa sau bhā ṣa ṇi ka sā bho swā dhī na cag dang bcas mdza' bas ster/ /legs par brjod ldan rin chen yang / /dge ba khyod rngukyi rang me ba te/ /i ti tā sī ba tsaḥkhru tā su thra yaḥpra ṇa yo tsi tai/ /u bā tsa sa dbang nyid/ /de skad de dag rnams kyi tshig /mdza' bar 'os thos shin tu dgesarjo/ /so yi zla 'od twa dha ba dze+e di sha na da sha na tsadh+ri rmā/ /ba hu mā nāspa rda ka gya ṣ+pe rda saṃ bhā ṣa snying stobs ltar/ /rab tu dkar ba spro zhing sa / /phebs par smra ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /su yi gus mang ṇa mṛ tai/ /ād+ma no byā da ra s+thā rna bha ba tī bhiḥkṛ tā da rāḥ/ /shā gnas ma yin/ /khyed rnams bdag spyogis gus byas pa/ /bdag gi yang ni gus pa'i gnas/ /'di rgyu dar+sha na me pe rda ta tā bya ya ma nu gra haḥ/ /mughā la tāstu ba ha rā mthong nyid ni bsngags par 'os/ /de yang merjes su 'dzin pa 'di/ /mu tig 'khri shing gdung sel la/ki pu nabyan+da no k+ṣi taḥ/ /e baṃ bi jo r+ghaṃ swasgo nā min+da bī nā mi bā dhī ྾/ /tsan+dan gyis kyang byugs sam ci/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i dri med dag /zla ba'i 'od bzhin gyur pa dang / /ā kṛ tī 8 sa mu tsi tā ru tsi rā lo ka bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /au tsi t+ya tsā ru tsa ri tai rnam pa 'jig rten spyod tshul ni/ /yang dag rigs shing mdzes pa yin/ /rigs shing mdzes pa'i spyod pa 95—105

pra sā dā bi ṣa rda ma naḥ/ /bāt+pa thu pe ṣa lā bā ṇ+ḍi na ka sru da ra khyu ma dang / /rab tu dang zhing ①dri med yid/ /mnyes gshin pa dang 'jam pa'i tshig /su yi gus pa'i sa ma yaḥ—/ /kṛ tī tos+thā rnyi rā tsā rāḥpū dzā pa ri ka ro tsi taḥ/ /āṭ+wā yin—/ /mchod pa'i yo byad 1'os gyur pa'i/ /kun spyod 'di ni bdag gis blangs①/ /bud med rba r+ṇa ru khārde baḥpa rā yaṭ+wā hi yo ṣi taḥ/ /ka t+yā bhā pā da sa krān+ta gzhan dbang yin pa'i slad/ /khyed kyang bdag nyid sbyin mi 'os/ /gzhon nu ma dngos las 'das pas④//yu yo pa ra pa ri gra hāḥ/ /bi shra bhe ṇa bha gi no me dza na n+yaḥsne ha go ra khyod ni gzhan gyis yongs su bzung / /byams shing gus pas ma dang ni/ /phebs pas bdag gi sring mo bā ta/ /pa ra bir+ghaṃ bi ṣi ye ྾ dza na n+ya: n+ya yo ṣi ta/ /pa ra ho sā me ho me+e yin—/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi 'byor pa dug /gzhan gyi bud med ma dang ni/ /gzhan 'tshe bdag nyid ba pak+ṣu ste ྾ ni ra t+ya yaḥ/ /be+e shu t+yā sa t+ya pa ru 6 bhin+da bā 'tshe ba nyid/ /de dag phyogs ni gnod pa med/ /phra ma rdzun dang tshig rtsub dang / /kyal rjopa smra ba dodzhai tai pa tsaḥ/ /sa de ba ba da no ye ྾ te ྾ sar+pā shi ṣā di shaḥ/ /a bhi spangs pa'i tshig /gang gi kha na brtag rjopa nyid/ /de dag phyogs rnams kun tu shis/ /gang zhig dh+yā ra hi tai tse byā pā ra pa ri brdzi tai/ /mi byā dṛṣ+ṭa bi tī rna tsa ye brnab sems bral ba'i sems/ /gnod sems dag ni yongs su spangs/ /log par lta bas dman gyur pa//྾ te sarba dze+e shri tāḥ/ /da shā ku she la mārga bh+yo nirga tā ni ni sarga taḥ/ /de dag legs pa'i lam la brten/ /mi dge bcu yi lam dag las/ /nges par log pa'i rang bzhin can//e te ku sha la brga su mānāḥswarge ni rarga laḥ/ /dhī re ba dha bye dha na mube+e de dag dge ba'i sde rnams kyis/ /bkag pa med pa'i mtho ris lam/ /nor gyes mtho ba rnams kyi nor ni tā rmā bibye ba tsak+ṣurbe dzi teji ya rde/ /da ma ba pu ru sngot+ta mā pu rgyu blo gros nyid/ /dbang po stirnam rgyal rnams kyi mig ni rig pa nyid/ /skyes bu mchog gyur rnams kyi bsod 95—106

na mād+me ba tī dze+e su tsi mā na sā rmā / / e baṃ bi sgo yo nams brtse ba nyid/ /yid ni gtsang ba rnams kyi 'jug ngogs ①bdag nyid do/ /skyes bu rnams kyi rnam gu ṇa sam+bi be+e shaḥshrī le na bai ma lha mu be+e sum̐ sī/ /sad rat+na mugh+ra ni pa de lta'i yon tan dag /legs gnas 'di ni khrims kyi dri ma med par gyur④/ /rin chen mu tig dam ka rā ti ris+ho shī lo sa tā mā bha ra rde ba darnyi / / i kyuk+ta pa'i tshogs las shin tu lhag /tshul khrims dag ni dam pa rnams kyi rgyan du brjod/ /sems can don mā ka sbya gu ḍā nu rū baṃ sa tā be+e nā dzi tedh+ri ye ṇa / / tu ṭ+wā sta gnyer dbang po thul ba de yis ni/ /yon tan rjes mthun de skad brjod pa thos gyur nas/ /tshim par spru tsusgo bi tsan+d+ra lo ka tā kau tu kā me+e ba mu kheḥmṛ dze+e t+yaḥ/ /ma ṇi gyur cing ltad mo'i don bzhin mkha' las ni/ /zla ba dze+e'ajig rten sa la spo ④zhing de yis smras/ /nor bu ri bā nar+gha gu r+ṇadz+dza la su dṛṣ+ṭi ba sā sgo ru tsi tsā ru tsiste/ /ya bzhin du yon tan rab 'bar rin thang med/ /dge ba khyod kyi mdzes pa'i 'od ni mthong gyur pa/ /gang li ba mo lo z-i da ye khru to tsa sadhi sa de bān+da ra bhā kṛ to si/ /zhig mgo dang rna ba snying ga ⑤ nyid la yang / /rtag par dam pa rnams kyi ⑥rgyan du khyod nyid bgyid④//ma ṇi n+d+ra hā rta ཿ pra thi ta bra bhā ba ཿ pra kṛ khya tā māt+tha sa ma sta bdag nyid dang mnyam grags pa'i mthu ldan rin thang che/ /nor bu 'di ni khyod kyis rab tu bzung bar yā yi/ / dh+wa dzābe+e to bste ti yo dza nā rmā sa ha sra me babe+e sa ma mdzod—/ /gang zhig rgyal mtshan la bzhag dpag tshad stong phrag tu/ /slong ba rnams kyi 'dod pa char du hi tai yaḥ/ /uste ti rat+na pra ba ram̐ ta ru 5 stasmi da du ju rta bab ⑧par 'gyur/ /de skad brjod pas ⑫rin chen rab mchog gzhon nu mas/ /rab tu dang ba gzugs mi ba pra sā rda / / ā dā ya ta ts+tsha pra ṇa yo pa tsā ra so can bzhin du de la byin/ /des kyang de ni mdza' ba'i nye bar spyod pas blangs/ /dngul las byas pa'i 95—107

pi dī tī yi pu re mā pa ro bye/ /ta tra da rāt+tad dī gu ḍo rnyi re ba sa sgo dzi taḥgrong khyer dag ni gnyis par phyin/ /der ①ni gus pas de yi nyis 'gyur dag gis ①ni/ /mi 'am ci mo kin+da ra kā mi be+e bhiḥ/ /kra me ṇa te ṣ+pe ba bi shudhe budhirle bhe ma ṇi tad rnams kyis de la mchod pa byas/ /rim pa de dag nyid kyi rnam dag blo gros kyis/ /de yi nyis 'gyur mthu dī gu ṇa pra bhā baṃ / /tri gā ma bai ḍūrja kṛ tai ru tseḥsngo ḍa shek+ṣa ldan nor bu thob par gyur⑦/ /de nas gsum pa'i grong khyer bai ḍūr+ya rang bzhin/ /mdzes pa'i mig can ṭ+wā tatwa tsa pā sh+ya to tata/ : /ta bat+ta dād+mā ṇi ka ta gya byu te bha yā nu bhā byap+ta : sho lo ka gcig gi skad dod sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje yod pa 'di za hor ban des kha bskongs pa mkhas pa rnams kyis daphyad par zhu/bcu drug de dag de yis mthong / /de dag rnams la de bzhin nyid du nor bu ni/ /de yi nyis 'gyur mthu sa da yu saṃ kṛtra/ /prap+tastsa rū rat+na ma yo tsa tudze+e pu ram̐ ta taḥsarba ldan rim gro dam pa ④thob/ /de nas mdun du rin chen bzhi yi rang bzhin gyi/ /grong khyer grong khyer kun pu rā bye ka shri/ /sau bh+yabe+e tastad dī gu zla bhi ra gre gu shā dhi kaḥki las lhag pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /bzhi par phyin de mi 'am ci ni mjos ma de'i/ /nyis 'gyur dag gi buyon na ḍa sun+da rī bhiḥ/ /ta dze+e ba sad+dhārma ka thā pra saṃ gestasto ṣi tāste tan lhag pas de don gnyer/ /legs gdams de yi bude bzhin nyid du dam chos kyi/ /gtam dag zhar na su saṃ ya te na/ /uh+phube+e nī lot+pa la dā ma dīste ka ṭāk+ṣa bi k+ṣip+ta la byung bas tshim gyur de dag ni/ /rab rgyas ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba ltar ring ba'i/ /zur mig gis ka raste rū tsuḥ / / 1 tā ste na ཿ kin+da ra rā dza baṃ sha rat+na ka 'phangs 'od dang ldan pas de la smras/ /rin chen 'byung gnas zla ba ba da ra zhes pa/ /nged kyi ming po ren+d+rarba da rā bhi ṅgā naḥ/ /ta sngaspa rda dī ba mi dasma hāhaṃ swa nā ma mi 'am ci yi rgyal rigs yod/ /rdzu 'phrul yongs kyis rang gi ming gi ⑦mtshan gyur pa/ /rin thang che ba'i tsisdo ba dhi ta ṛdhi/ / rasne tse rda ni ya ma bi dhi nā so ṣa dha gling 'di de yi bzhugs gnas yin/ /'od zer tshogs ni gsal ldan rin chen 'di yang bsod nams 95—108

khya pra te na n+yaste bha swata ki ro ṇa ni ka re pu shā bhā dz+wa dh+wa dzā gre/ /brten ①rnams kyis/ /gso sbyong zhes bya'i brtul zhugs nges pa'i cho gas rjorgyal mtshan la bkod na//dza byu dī pe sha ka la dza na dha bhi be+e ta rja na ba r+ṣa t+ya ba sbi ra dzasru'i ①gling du mtha' dag 'gro tshogs mngon 'dod don rnams char nyid 'bebs/ /gzhan don brtan pa ra hi ta byābe+e ye kṛ khya tsā tata/ /i kyut+yā khya ma ra ta tu pha lo sā par gyur pas khyab par bgyid slad de ni bzung dubar mdzod/ /de ltar mdzes ma rnams kyis 'chi med da re su n+da rī bhi ཿ pra ma byā ma pra ṇa ya su bha gi da t+ta mā sā shing 'bras legs btus gus bcas shing / /lhag par mdza' sdug ldan pas skal bzang nor bu byen pa r+ya rar+ghaṃ/ /bā lā hā khye bi dzi ta pa ba nan+ta pra j-iṣ+ṭi tu ram̐ shaṃ so byā tu khya swa na blangs byas nas/ /mgyogs 'gro rab dga' sprin shugs zhes bya rlung las rgyal ba la zhon te/ /de yi lam ga ra ma ga mabe+ebha mārgo pa de shaḥ/ / tasmin kā le bi pu la ku sha gyi gdams ngag thob pas de yang rang gi grong khyer song / /dus tshod der ni dri med grags ldan sa yi leḥswarga mārge pra yī te bā rā ṇa sde bi ṣa da ya sha si ñtsha pa to brah+ma dat+ta/ /bdag po tshangs pas byin/ /yangs pa'i dge bas mtho ris lam du rab gshegs bā rā ṇa sī duru//shrī mān sarba pra ṇa yi pha la daḥsu pri yaḥpo ra mu khyer lo ka tā d+dhā dpal ldan 'jig rten bskyab blo rnam ⑥bskrun slong ba kun gyi 'bras bu ster/ /shin tu dga' ni grong khyer ta bi nyi ta ma tirjarma rā dzñā bhi ṣik+taḥ/ /ta taḥshi raḥrtswa na bi bye kra me ṇa tat+pañtsa da gtso bos chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur/ /de nas mgo bkru cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /gso sbyong dag la dh+yā dh+wa dza mudh+ri rasna/ /sa po ṣa sgo yo ṣi ta e ba dh+ri tā tsa k+ṣa ra pi shwe pa ri nyer gnas bco lnga la/ /rin po che de rgyal mtshan rtser btags nas/ /sna tshogs 'dod pas yongs su pūr+ṇa kā oṃ/ /kṛ tā yā ṭ+wā pa ra hi ta pha dze+e pat+pa rā rde sha te na sbi tā gang bar byas/ /gzhan la phan pas 'bras bu ldan par gshegs bgrod byas shing lo brgyar ni/ /rgyal 95—109

rā bye ma ha ti ni khi lo pū ra yi tā tsa lo shaṃ/ /pu tram̐ byu twa na ra pa ti srid chen po la gnas 'jig rten mtha' dag khengs byas mi bdag gi /gnas la sras bzhag nye bar zhi ba pa de pā pya sarbo pa shārnyi ta twa zlo sau ki ma bi pa ra oṃ brah+ma bhā baṃ dza gā thams cad thob cing de nyid shes/ /gang yang 'di ni tshangs pa'i dngos po dam pa dag tu gshegs par ma / /du re te da su raḥsarbe pūrba ye pū ri tā ma yā/ /rat+na dī pā sgyi ga gyur—/ /rin chen gling du mngon bgrod pa/ /shin tu dga' yi skye ba der/ /gang sngon bdag gis ma ṣ+pe tasmin su pri ya dzad+ma ni/ /i nyi shāsta swa dṛ tī ta ka tha yā bi da khengs byas pa/ /chom rkun de kun 'di dag go /de skad ston pa gtso bo yis/ /rang gi spyod tshul mtha' dhe ba bhuḥ/ /dān bārlo pa de she na r+bhak+ṣu ṇa ma nu shā sā rna/ /i ti yi gtam/ /sbyin dang brtson 'grus man ngag gis/ /dge slong rnams la rjes bstan bsgrubs/ /zhes pa k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi ta yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ba da dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ra dī pa yā tā ṣaṣ+ṭha pabe+e baḥ// //ba da ra'i gling du 'gro ba'i yal 'dab ste drug pa'o// //ku sha la pra ṇi dh+wa na shudha dh+wasne bi ma lā lo ka bi be ka bo dha kā rmā/ /dge ba'i smon lam dag pa'i gzi brjid dang / /dbe+en pa dri med snang ba'i rtogs byed ldan/ /pa ri tīt+ta na mā tra me ba yo ྾ bha ba mo hā pa harta ran+t+ra e ba dha t+yāḥ/ /pu gang zhig yongs su bsgrags pa tsam nyid na/ /srid pa'i rmongs 'phrog de nyid bsngags par 'os/ /grong rā par+ṣa ta sa ha sru bhā n+ya gro dho pa ba na spri tiḥ/ /ka pi lā khye pu re tsakre bha khyer ser skya zhes par ni/ /n+ya gro dha yi nags tshal gnas/ /sngon tshe 'khor ni stong phrag la/ /bcom ga ban dhan+d+ra de sha rmā/ /a man+da nan+da sasdo ha sun+di tsan+da na shi ta ldan 'das kyis chos bstan mdzad/ /mi dman kun dga' ①tshogs kyi bcud/ /tsan+dan ltar bsil de yi 95—110

lo—/ /ta gya bā ga m+bi tai dha t+yāḥshra tāñdza li pu ṭiḥpa puḥ/ /rā dzā susgo da ni—/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi gsan pa yi/ /snyim stipas bsod nams ldan pas 'thungs/ /chos ni nyan pa'i nasta tra dharma shra ba ṇa saṃ ga me/ /pu byo pa de sha sa li lerlo bhe bai tshogs pa der/ /rgyal po zas ni gtsang ma yis/ /bsod nams nye bar bstan pa'i chus/ /dri ma dang ma khya nidṛ ti/ /a tha ta tra ma hā na ma shākya rā bye ku lodzha baḥ/ /dhasgro bral dga' ba thob/ /de nas rgyal rigs las skyes pa/ /shākya ming chen dag gis der/ /chos kyi pa de sha mā kasbya pāp+taḥswa kṛ ha ma bra bī ta/ /a ho nu bha ga bān busgo dhan+d+raḥgadams ngag thos gyur nas/ /rang gi khyem du phyin te smras/ /kye ma sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'di/ /bdag saṃ gha: sidha yeḥ/ /burnyoṭ+wā do ya masmra shaṃ nir+pā ṇ+ḍa ya ma hā pha laḥ/ /cag gi ②ni don chen la/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun grub dang myang 'da'i ①slad//u pa de sha bi she ṣāp+ta nidṛ testa gya tarbe tsaḥ/ /khru tā sha shi pra bhā yasbyi de yi tshig de thos gyur nas/ /khyim thab zla 'od gdams ngag gi /khyad par thos dhipas dga' ba dang //pra ṇa yāt+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a nu gra t+yā bha ga ba taḥpu ru ṣāḥpu byu don du gnyer las de la smras/ /skyes bu bsod nams skal ldan rnams/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes bhā gi naḥ/ /nibyesta du pa de shā na ma narta yo ṣa to ba yo/ /i ti dzā yā bzung 'os/ /bdag cag bud med smad 'os rnams/ /de yi man ngag 'os ma yin/ /de skad khyim thab ba tsaḥkhru twa sa dza gā da dza gad gu roḥ/ /bha dre bha ga ba to nāste bhe dra tshig thos nas/ /des smras bzang mo bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba'i bla ma ⑤snying rje yis⑥/ /gzigs kā ru bye dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /sa mā sarba tra bhā bhā noḥs mā dṛṣ+ṭiḥpa yo rū tsaḥ/ /sa pa dag la dbye ba med/ /kun la nyi ma'i 'od zer snyoms/ /chu 'dzin dag gis char pa snyoms/ /sems mā bha ga ba to dṛṣ+ṭiḥsarba satā nu kam+bi naḥ/ /ma hā pra dzā pa tī bākyā da can kun la thugs brtse ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs pa snyoms/ /skye rgu'i mebadag mo chen mo yisakhye)/95—111

ba rā t+na k+ṣa khaṃ ta baḥ/ /shusgo da naḥka ro h+ye ba rā dza bha ga ba tornyi ke/ /tshig gis ①phyi dro khrod kyi skabs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du ni/ /rgyal po zas gtsang byed pa nyid/ /i nyi pa h+phuḥpri ya gi rā thra tā shā.ā+oṃ ga nā ga ṇiḥ/ /yā tsa na tad bha ga ba taḥde skad bdag po'i tshig snyan gyis/ /shākya'i bu mo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bsod sa pu byo pa ba rna ya yo / / sā sa twa ku su rma ta tra tai da nams nags/ /gtsang ma der ni de song gyur/ /der ni snying rje'i ⑤dpag bsam shing / /snying stobs dar+sha ma hā pha lo/ /pra sha mā mṛ ta saṃ siste ཿka ru rja kalpa pā da paṃ/ /la te ba me tog 'bras bu che/ /rab tu zhi ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /yang dag bran pa de yis mthong / /rlung gis dud pa ba nā na mā tai dru rā gre na nā ma sā/ /lo he ṣ+pe ba pa ri t+yak+ta tsū ta pa'i 'khri shing bzhin/ /de yis ring nas der phyag 'tshal/ /rna rgyan g.yo ba'i zol gyis ni/ /rmongs pa kar+ṇat+pa lāts+tsha khāta/ /bi lo kya rmā tsa na ru tsi rat+na bhū ṣa ṇa bhū ṣi tsā/ /yongs su gtong ba bzhin/ /gser 'od rin chen rgyan rnams kyis/ /brgyan pa dag ni mthong gyur nas//ā nan+da nā mā bhik+ṣustu ma ba tsa pra hi tor+ya taḥ/ /be+e shaḥpra sha ma shā byo yi dge slong kun dga' bo zhes pas/ /shin tu phan brtson de la smras/ /ma ma khyod kyi cha lugs 'di/ /ma ta rmu ni ta pho ba ṣ+pe / / da rbot+pa sto na yuk+ta ste bi rak+ta nā mi dregs pas rgyags shing ①rab zhis stong / /thub pa'i dka' thub nags su ni/ /mi rigs 'di ni chags rda pa rda/ /gu ṇa saṃ ya ma sik+ta ni mu kha rā bha ra ṇ+ḍa n+ya ho/ /he hāsma bral gnas/ /yon tan gyis gdams ④chags pa yi/ /mu cor rgyan rnams kye ma 'dir/ /bdag cag ta gra ha r+ṇa yuk+ta mi tī bo pa di sharnyi te/ /i h+phugh+ra te na sā ta rtswa bzung ⑤bar mi 'os zhes⑥/ /khyod la nye bar 'dom ④pa bzhin/ /de yis 'di brjod gzugs bzang bai la bye bi na tā na nā / / urlu dzu bha ra r+ṇa sa baṃ pā hi de'i⑧ —/ /skyengs pa'i gdong ni dman pa yis/ /rgyan rnams thams cad bkrol nas ni/ /rang gi khyim 95—112

khom+bi dza man+di ram̐/ /u pa bi ṣe 6 sarbe 6 nirdiṣ+ṭa ku sha lasta taḥ/ /du bskur bar gyur/ /de nas thams cad 'khod pa la/ /dge ba ston mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /a ni t+ya te baṃ bha ga bān u pa de shaṃ pra tsakra me/ /ma hā mo ha pra bha bo yo ye dngos po mi rtag pa nyid du/ /nye bar ston pa'i rtsom pa mdzad/ /gang gi sdertag tu mi rtag nyid/ /rtag na ni t+ya ma ni t+ya tsā/ /ni t+ya tā mi ba ma n+yarnye mū shwe dza ga ti dzan+ta baḥ/ /pa nyid bzhin 'gro bar ni/ /srog chags rmongs pas 'dzin byed pa/ /'di ni rmongs pa'i mthu chen no/ /a sa bye ra ma te lo kaḥs t+ya pra t+ya ya mo hi taḥ/ /ni be+erti sarba bhā bā ram̐ bden par yid ches rmongs pa yis/ /'jig rten mi bden pa la dga'/ /dngos po kun gyi dngos med ma bha bā nu bha r+pā sbi ti/ /ke tsita bya ke ra ṇiḥpa re khru ti pa dze+estarka ni—/ /nyams spyong gnas pa rig pa med/ /skye ba ①thos pa'i lam du yang dag chags ldan kha cig sgra yi pra bā deḥ pa re ke tsin+ta n+t+ra pa ri gra hai rba hu bi bye ra bye ka khā bstan bcos dag dang ni/ /gzhan ni rig byed lam dang rtog ge rtsod pas gzhan de ①kha cig rgyud ni kau sha leḥ/ /saṃ saghāḥsu ṇa ruk+ta dzad+ma sha ra rto yā tāḥs hai bak+ṣa yo ta tā yongs 'dzin dang / /gzhan dag rnam mang sgyu rtsal mkhas dang lhan cig nyid du 'jig par ④skad cig gnas/ /gyak+ṣa ya lī la yā k+ṣa ṇa pa de musneni ba dha j-i tiḥ/ /bi ṣa ya de la yang ni mi 'jigs pa bzhin rol rtsed dag gis ⑤rmongs rnams dga' ba rab tu 'dzin/ /mi bzad be+e ṣa mā pā yaḥkā yaḥpra sa tsa yā sha yā kha ra ta ra ma ru s+thā rā kā raḥpra yul gyi gnod pa'i lus ni nyon mongs phung po dag gi gnas/ /rab rmongs las byung srid pa rab rtsub mya mo ha bha bo bha baḥ/ /hi ta khyu bi ta thā kā: kāṅgi bi be+e ki nī ni ra ba ngam thang gi rnam par gsal/ /mtha' dang bral ba'i srid pa'i nad 'di ji ltar rnam par ldog 'gyur ba//bye ra yo dṛṣ+ṭa byā dhir+ya thā ni ra brta te/ /i t+yā r+ya ni t+ya saṃ s+thā rā saṃ de ltar bya dang bya min phan pa'i sa la rnam dpyod ldan pas dpyad/ /bcom ldan rang nyid 'di la sogs//95—113

yuste yuk+ta mu r+ya te/ / dharmo pa de sha ku sha lo bahūṃ bha ga ba ti swa 'du byed mi rtag yang dag ldan/ /chos kyi gdams ngag dge ba ni/ /rigs par gsung bar brtson pa'i yo / /e ka shākya ba dhusta tra rū pa sau bhā gya garbi tā/ /sbi tā shi sha ba tā ru rgya tshe—/ /der tsho7ni shākya'i bu mo gcig /bu mo gzhon nu ma yi mtshalas/ /bzod dka'i lang tsho la gnas pa//bsgo ba ya se duḥs te/ /muk+ta hā ram̐ sta na ta ḍi lo la dzā girmu hurmu huḥ/ /gzugs dang skal bzang nyid kyis dregs/ /nu ma'i ngos su mu tig gi /do shal dga' ma'i dhibadag po yi//ā lu lo ke ya sha s+thā ra sā ram̐ ra ti pa ti ri ba/ /hā ra ba lo ki bhā dṛṣ+ṭa grags pa'i snying po gsal 'dra la/ /zur mig g.yo bas yang yang ④bltas/ /ming chen chung ma zla 'od kyis//tā ma ṣ+pe kā gra mā na sā/ /ya tsin+ta yad bi raste ba ma hata pasnri sha shi pra rtse gcig min pa'i sems ldan de/ /do shal rnam par blta ba dag /mthong nas chags bral bzhin du bha / /i yo dharmo pa de she pi tsa pa lā hā ra migh+ra te/ /bhā bā dzā na shri ḍo bye bsams—/ /chos ni nye bar ston tshe yang / /g.yo ba'i do shal 'di la lta/ /dngos po rnams kyi skad cig ba mū bhā k+ṣa ṇi ka nā mi rmā/ /sri hā dar+sha yi tā su hā roṣ+ṭha haṃ ha ra mya ma—/ /'di dag rbongs pas mi nyan nyid/ /rang gi do shal bstan nas 'di/ /do shal spro ba bdag gis haṃ—/ /a bye ka lo ka ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba dargyaḥsha mya ti de hi ram̐/ /i ti saṃ tsin+d+ra dbrog /lhag pa mthong ba kho na yis/ /lus can dregs pa zhi bar gyur/ /'di bsams de yis dā sau ro hi tā khya ma bha ṣata/ /ro hi ke gats+tsha me hā re kṛ hā ta sa twa mā ha 'bangs mo ni/ /ro hi ta zhes bya ④la smras/ /ro hi ta song bdag gi ni/ /do shal khyim nas mgyogs su ra / /i truk+ta sā ta ya ta tra pra bṛste dharma saṃ sh-i be+e/ /a kā la ga longasaḍalta—/ /de yis de skad brjod pas de/ /der ni chos nyan (nyal zhugs pa/ /dus min 'gro bas ma no baghā ni shwa gru tai ya ta k+ṣa rte/ /a ho ba tan+ta ro yo yo saṃ yid byung nas/ /shugs dang bcas pas skad cig bsams/ /kye ma bdag gi dge ba 'dir/ /bar 95byed114

dzā taḥku sha le ma ma/ /nāsmin shohūṃ la bhe dharmi yata pa rā yan+ta dzi bi tā/ /chod 'di ni yang dag skyes/ /gang phyir gzhan dbang 'tsho gyur pa/ /bdag gis chos nyan mi 'thob bo//pu sgo sau ra bha saṃ bhā rāta tīr+ṇa kā ru rgya ke sa rāta/ /mu kha pad+mārmya ga ba to bsod nams dri bzang rgyas gyur cing / /snying rje'i ge sar 'khrigs gyur pa/ /bcom ldan zhal gyi pad+mo dha byeḥpāsno ti bād+ma dhu/ / a ho swāts+tshabye bi ts+tsha dasta nu r+ghaṃ gaḥ su las—/ /gsung gi sgrang rtsi mchog gis thob①/ /kye ma rang dbang rnam par gcod/ /lus 'jig bde ba kha k+ṣa yaḥ/ /se bā dza ga ti dzan+tu ram̐ duḥkha duḥkha pa ram̐ pa rā/ /nyams byed pa/ /sdug bsngal 'gro bar srog chags rnams/ /g.yog ni sdug bsngal brgyud ma yin/ /se ba pra yā sa saṃ prabye dha na mā na ka rto da yo/ /tap+ta ma t+yāṇ+ḍa ni shā so g.yog gi 1ngal dub kyis 'thob skepa/ /gla rngan bya dga'i chu yi zigs/ /shugs rings ④ shin tu tsha bas ra ho kṛ sgo ṇa bī ya te / / mā na glu ni rgu ṇa glu ni ro dzaḥbaskol—/ /kye ma dka' slad dag gis 'thungs⑤ / /dpon po mthong na khengs nyams shing / /yon tan pū dza sha maḥshra maḥ/ /shra tha oṃ se ba ka sri tata ku la m+bi shwa ra dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /nyams dang gzi brjid mchod/ /zhi zhing ngal ba 'di dag ni/ /g.yog byed dag gi dang po'i 'bras/ /lo tī ba n+ta na shri kha lā tsa ra ṇa yorte t+yā ba mā nā ba nīḥ swa byā bā g.yog ni rkang pa 'ching ba'i lcags kyi lcags sgrog zhum zhing nga rgyal chags dupa'i sa/ /rtag tu nges par ra ni ṣa dha ni t+ya ni ya tī ni dra su kha dro hi bhā/ /ā sha sā sa bi shā la dzā la rang gi bya ba 'gog cing gnyid dang bde ba 'joms par byed/ /re ba'i chags zhen tshogs kyi lam dang sa ra ṇiḥs྾ ga sgo ga sha nirlud+dhā ram̐ mṛ ga treṣ+ṭi ka ma ru ma tī se ba sha legs 'grogs longs spyod kyi ni rdo rje dang / /rmongs pa rnams ni meri dwags skom bskyed ④mru ngan sa gzhi rī rak+ṣa ya/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya su tsi ram̐ swa dza ga ma ta rā dza yā/ /se bā lus ni zad byed yin/ /de ltar yun ring bsams nas ni/ /de yi bka' yis de song ste/ /lus ni 95—115

bi 1 ta kā yā ā+oṃ swesgo bi ha ra ṇi ku taḥ/ /pra dzaṭī pa ra pre6 kṛ pa g.yog tu btsongs rnams la/ /rang dgar gnas pa ga la yod/ /gzhan gyis bskul bas dman gyur cing //hūṃ ka ru zla ku laḥ/ /n-i dzāgh+ra bha ga bān di byā tsagru ṣā tsin+ta ya ta k+ṣa 'gro ba de ni bcom ldan 'das/ /snying rje rgyas pa'i lha yis ①ni/ /spyan gyis gzigs nas skad cig rde / /asmin dzad+ma ni she ṣe s+thāḥ.ā+oṃ pūrto dz+re bi tā ba byeḥ/ /e yo pa ra bsams—/ /skye ba 'di la 'di yis 1ni/ /'tsho ba'i mtshams lhag yongs su rdzogs/ /sdug ma 'di ni tī saṃ sā ra dudhaṭ+wā byā swa yo ma yā/ /a tha tsā karma yo ge na bra dzir+ghaṃ sa 'khor ba las/ /bdag rang nyid kyis gdon par bya/ /de nas las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lam du 'phral ha sā pa thi/ /bat+pa rāt+pa l+ya ba be+e shāḥshri ga sgyu mā dza ghā na goḥ/ /sā pra da rmyo la bgrod de la/ /be'u la chags rmongs bcas pa'i/ /ba yi ru yis brdungs ①par gyur/ /skye ba gzhan gyi bha ga ba taḥpra sā dāt+ta d+ma yasmṛ tiḥ/ /dzad+mān+ta rā bye bā se na budhe lhag gnas kyis/ /yid ni sangs rgyas la dmigs shing / /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' drin las/ /de la lba na mā na sā/ /a ho karmodri nadhī be+eḥsaṃ sā ra ma ka ra ka yi rang bzhin dran des bsams/ /'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas kyi/ /skye ba'i 'khor mor srog chags re / /dzad+mā brte 6 dzadhū rmā madz+dza nod+madz+dza na kra maḥ/ /sum̐ sī la lā rnams| /las kyi rba rlabs kyis dkrugs pas/ /kye ma 'bying zhing 'byung ba'i rim/ /skyes bu rnams kyi ḍa bi pu lo pa la pa ṣ+ṭa kā su niḥsharma karma gha ḍi ta pra ka ḍi ka ṭi dpral ba yangs pa'i rdo yi glegs bu la/ /bde med las kyi sprul pa bsal khye ba'i rtags can gzong dag kaiḥ / /n+yastu ni dzad+ma ma ra ṇa pra sa rāk+ṣa rā ṇi ṣ+pe tā bhā pā ṇi sa ri mardza gis—/ /skye dang 'chi bar 'u rab spros yi ge dag tu bkod gyur pa/ /'di dag rnams ni lag pas yongs na yā tsa larnyi / /i yi karmā yad+dhā pra tsu ra ru tsi be+e tsi rgya ra tsa su phyis pas bskyod pa min/ /gang gis mngal nas brtsams te rim byis lhung dang rga dang 'jig pa'i dus 95—116

nā na rā shā mā yu rats+tsha da pa ṭa la tu l+ya pa ri ṇa ti/ /ya yā gar+sā rnams dag /gang du yang ni lus kyi rtsis ris gzhan pa nyid du 'gyur ba ma yin pa/ /las kyi dbang gis ram̐ bhe kra ma ni ba ta ṣ+pe dṛdhi sa ma ye k+ṣa ye bā nā bye tsā ba dza ti ta mi rnams dag gi rab mang sred ①pas rnam par bkra ba dag /bkod pa 'di ni rma bya'i sgro yi tshogs dang nu le khāts+tsha bi da se / / saṃ tsiṣ+ṭha te pu raḥ pra dṛ t+ta su da sha ཿmtshungs par yongs su smin par 'gyur/ /de ltar bsams te sngon du nye bar gnas skabs bzang po dang san+da pra san+da sbri tiḥ pā ste nā sa ma dā sa bhā ba ka la nā bai lak+ṣu po'i rnam gzhag rab gnas pa/ /mi bzad 'bangs mo'i dngos po brnag pas skyengs par gyur pa bzhin du ni san+da tsā/ /ā dh+wa ya pra ṇi dh+wa na dh+wam+bi dha ba le sadharma shudhe dhi yo g.yo ba med nyid gyur/ /smon lam khang pa dkar po dam pa'i chos kyis dag pa'i blo ni yongs su bzung misaṃ sā re bi tsi kit+pa e ba ya li rna ta t+yā dza sā dz+re be+e tai/ / ta byas nas/ /'khor ba dag tu rmongs (1 par byed pas dri ma can bzhin de yi srog ni btang bar gyur/ /de taḥsā sau ha la dī pe sa m+bi be+e swarga sadza dzā/ /tsan+d+ra le khe ba dud+dhāsgo di bya byu nas mtho ris phun tshogs nye/ /seng ga la yi gling du der④/ /'o ma'i rgya mtshor zla ba yi/ /ri mo bzhin ti ra dzā ya ta/ /ā dh+wa na dzad+ma nasta su mugh+ra bar+ṣa di babyu te/ /sā byuta du rab gsal skyes/ /de ni mngal zhugs skyes pa'i dus/ /mkha' la ⑤mu tig char pa g.yos/ /seng ga muspyo la tā nā ma sau ha lā bye pa teḥsu tā/ /sā pu rgya yi ba la pa bye pa la bdag bu mo de/ /mu tig 'khri shing zhes par gyur/ /de ni che bar skyes pa yis/ /bsod nams hadh+ri bṛdhi mā ga tā/ /le bhe bi be+e ke ram̐ gā rmā saṃ to ṣa mi ba yo ba rna/ /bzhin du 'jo sgeg 'dzin/ /yan lag rnams kyi rnam 'byed kyis6ste/ /chog shes bzhin du lang tsho thob/ /ta taḥka dā tsiṅga ṇi dzaḥshā bste pu ra bā se nāḥ/ /ma ka rā ka ra mudhī r+ya sau ha de nas nam zhig mnyan yod kyi/ /grong khyer pa yi tshong pa rnams/ /chu srin 'byung gnas rab bsgral nas//95—117

la dī pa mā ya yuḥ/ /te ta dra rā tri par+yarnyi bi shārnyi su khi rā dzā guḥ/ /sing ga la yi gling du song / /de ni de dag mtshan mo'i mthar/ /rab sad ngal bsos dga' ba yis/ /dharmārja gā thā sa na dha pra budhe budha bhā ṣi tai/ / ta dan+taḥ su ra chos don tshigs ①bcad kyis bcings pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs glu ru blangs/ /pho brang ba gam la harmya s+thā shu tī ba shra ba rde mṛ tai/ /ki me ta di ti pa prats+tsha tā nā yā dṛ gnas pa/ /mi bdag bu mo'i ①rna ba yis/ /bdud rtsi de thos de dag rnams/ /bkug ste 'di dag ci pād+ma dzā/ /te tā mu tsuḥpra mu di tā mi rda budhe gya bhā ṣi tai/ /swa bha zhes dris/ /rab dga' ldan mas ⑦de la des/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can bārta bha ga ba taḥsarba sa twa nu ka pi naḥ/ /budhe bhi dh+wa rna khru tī ba kun la thugs brtse bas/ /rang bzhin du 'os gsung ④zhes smras/ /sangs rgyas mngon bajod thos nyid pu la kā lo kṛ tā kṛ tiḥ/ /sā ba bhū ba sa myubyu ta sam+bid bha byā nu kyis—/ /de ni spu long gis brgyan ⑤lus/ /yang dag rig pa legs ldan mthu/ /rab tu bskyed pa'i sa bha ba bhūḥ/ /〈rgyu khi sā la yu rī ba shasde ṣ+pe ba pa yo mu tsaḥ/ /ka e ṣa bha ga bān gzhir gyur/ /sgra ni sprin byu lta bu yis/ /rma bya bzhin du de rangs nas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan zhes budha i ti prats+tsha tā na pu naḥ/ /ha taste ni khi lo ta sum̐ shrad+dhā saṃ brnyi tā da rā/ /pa 'di/ /su zhes yang ni de la smras/ /de nas de la dad pa dag /skyes spyopar gus pa de dag gis/ /n+ya ba de yan pu ju ma yī bha ga brtso ri ta sbi tai/ /a tha sā tata ka tha bāp+ta bsod nams rang bzhin bcom ldan gye/ /spyod pa'i lugs ni ma lus smras/ /de nas de yi gtam gyis de//pāsprud+ma ku sha lo da yā/ /bi snyobhe le khaṃ pra da do te ྾ bha ga ba taḥkṛ te/ /sngar skyes dge ba rgyas pa thob/ /bcom ldan slad du gsol ba yi/ /spring yig de dag rnams la bskur/ /kā le bhādzhai sa mubyā r+ya pāp+ta ste ni rdzu pu ro/ /pra ṇa myu be+e r+ya tasmṛr+ghaṃ dus kyi spyochu gter yang dag bsgral/ /rang gi grong khyer thob nas des/ /bdag nyid che la phyag 'tshal te//95—118

da durle khaṃ ma hād+mā ṣ+pe/ /bha ga bā na pi sarba dzñāḥpūbe+e me ba bi dh+wa bya de yi gtam bshad spring yig phul/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan gyis/ /de ni mngon ①nyid mkhyen tata—/ /mulnga la tā yāḥkṛ pa yā swa yo le kha ma ba tsa ya ta/ /a ho sma ra gyur kyang / /mu tig 'khri shing la brtse bas/ /rang nyid kyis ni spring yig bklags/ /kye ma bsod nams ṇa me ba te ki ma pi pu ju at+pa tai bha ba ti bha ba bye ṣa dze+e tshong zong dag gi ①rnyed par gyur pa khyod ni dran pa nyid/ /rgud dang gdung ba dang ni sred pa 'joms pa'i bya sa na tā pa treṭ+wā pe haṃ/ /bha ga bad+ma ya ka thā kra mo pa na ta sam+bi dā swā da byuḥsrid pa'i sman bzang ci yang yin/ /bcom ldan las byung gtam byi rim pas nyer bsgrun yang dag rig pa sa e ṣa bha ga ba d+ma hā na mṛ ta saṃ bi bhā go ma ma / / i ti myong ba'i sa/ /bcom ldan 'di de bdag gi bdud rtsi yang dag bgo skal chen por gyur pa yin/ /de ltar saṃ k+ṣi be+e le khādze+e bi bhā bya bha ga ban swa yo/ /yī ṣata smi ta tī ṣa sa mdor bsdus spring yig don/ /bcom ldan rang gis rtogs gyur nas/ /cung zad 'dzum pa'i 'od zer twa pra kā sha ma da sha dhi shaṃ/ / ta ta sh+yi tra ka ra sharkyu pra bha pā gyis—/ /phyogs kyi sems can rab gsal mdzad/ /de nas 'od tshogs rjes rgyas shing / /ri mo mkhan tā nu pū ri tai/ /bha ga bān pā hi r+ṇat+ta sri n+ya hūṃ swa pra ti rmā pa ṭi/ /su naḥpra rmis mi nus pa'i/ /rang gi sku gzugs ras la bkod/ /bcom ldan gyis ni de la springs/ /de yi bka' ba ha nā rū ṭ+wā ba ni dza ste ta da dzha yā/ /a bā su sau ha la dī baṃ ta sri pa ḍa yis phyi nas yang / /tshong pa de dag gzings la zhon/ /seng ga la yi gling phyin nas/ /de la thang sku rab ma dar+sha yan/ /he ma dzi hā sa na n+yaste pa ṭi dṛṣ+ṭa ta thā ga tai/ /dza nastad+ma tu bstan/ /gser gyi seng ge'i khri bkod pa'i/ /ras la de bzhin gshegs mthong nas/ /de las byung ya tā dh+yā na de tī bhā ba mi ba ya yo/ /a dhastu ta li khi tan+ta smin ba'i bsam gtan gyis/ /skye bo dgongs pa gabyug bzhin gyur/ /de yi 'og na bris pa ni/ /bsod 95—119

pu dh+yā drwa su ma dṛ sh+ya ta/ /ti sraḥsha ra rgyu ga ta yaḥpañtsa shik+ṣu pa dā ni nams kyis 'thob ①mthong gyur pa/ /skyabs su 'gro ba gsum dag dang / /basbab pa'i gnas ni lnga yang tsa / /pa sra tī t+ya sa mut+pa daḥsā nu lo ma bi par+ya yaḥ/ /ār+yaṣ+ṭi ngo / /lugs las 'byung dang ldog ⑤ bcas pa'i/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung dang bcas/ /de bzhin gasta thā mārgaḥpa ra mā mṛ ta nir+bha raḥ/ /swa yo gha ga ba tā naste 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /mchog gi bdud rtsis rdzogs gyur pa'o/ /de yi steng du legs bshad ni//ta sro pa ri su bhā ṣi tai/ /pā bhāḥse bha ba nā lī nas+thā dziju ka na gser gyi yi ge rab mdzes par/ /dgongs pa mnyam gzhag bcom ldan 'das/ /rang gi bkod pas kā k+ṣa ram̐/ /bi ṣa ma bi ṣa yā lo la byā lā ba lī ba la yā ku khāta ta ru mdzes gyur pa/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i nyon mongs kyis btab gdung ba drag po rab rgyas dag /mi bzad ṇa ti mi rām+bi bye mya s+thāta pra mo hā kṛ hāta/ /dza na na ma ra ṇa gre yul ni g.yo ba'i sbrul gyi 'phreng 1bas dkris shing dkrugs gyur pa/ /rab rib rab rgyas rab rmongs phug shā be shā pra bṛt+ta pra thu bya thā bra dza ta sha ra khaṃ bor+ghaṃ dhadz+re nā tra bha bāta bha yi/ /gi khang pa 'di las phyir thon la/ /sangs rgyas chos la skyabs su song zhig der ni srid la 'jigs pa med//dzin pra kṛ ti kṛ ti pu bye pa shid+dhā pābe+e bād+ma dzā/ /a nā di kā lo pa tsi tsā mu dag byed rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la/ /sa yi bdag po'i bu mos bltas/ /thog med dus nas bsags pa yi//mo tsā dzñā na bā sa rmā/ /bye shuṣ+ka bta kāñtsa na kān+ta kā yo su skarnya mā mi shes bag chags btang bar gyur/ /rab mtho gser zhun lta bur ④mdzes pa'i sku/ /phrag mdzes dpung dzā nu byu dzā snyi rā oṃ/ /dh+yā nā ba dh+wa tārta ni m+bi li tāk+ṣe lnga ba rgya dh+wa rā yi pa pus mo'i bar mngon dga'/ /bsam gtan la chags phyed ni zum pa'i spyan/ /mdzes sdug rgyun bzhin ta rtu ga nā saṃ/ /swa bhā ba gha bya pra bi bhā sa mā ā+oṃ pra lasba nispyo ṣa ṇa kar+ṇa pā rab tu mtho ba'i shangs/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mdzes par rtogs bya ba/ /rgyan med snyan gyi zhags pa ring du 95—120

shaṃ—/ /bā la pra bā lā ru ṇa balka dze+e rka saṃ sak+ta sadh+yā dh+ra mi ba dri/ /'phyang / /thun mtshalas sprin chags lha yi ri bo bzhin/ /lo 'dab gsar pa ltar dmar na bzas mtshan//tri ṣā di shaṃ shi la mi bā di shan+ta mā nan+da dā nor+ya ta bagh+ra tsatram̐/ /k+ṣa 'od kyi ①phyogs la tshul khrims ston pa bzhin/ /zhal gyi zla bas kun dga' sbyin par brtson/ /bzod mā gu rde sgro mi ba shik+ṣa yarnya pu stso tsi tī sā su bha shaṃ bi lo kya/ /pra khyo pa'i yon tan sa la slob pa bzhin/ /bsod nams las skyes skal bzang lan gsum du/ /bskor nas ma par+yan+ta ka po la tsum+bi kasbyot+pa khā driḥpa ri brta ṣ+pe na/ /ni ra gya niḥsā btud pas rna ba'i ut+pal dag /'phyang ba mkhur tshos la reg des mthong nas/ /snying po med pa'i lus ra sha rī ra troṣ+ṭi sa t+yā nu bhā baṃ pa ra oṃ pra pe de/ /sro taḥs mā patrī pha la pra la blta bub spangs/ /bden pa'i mthu ni dam pa skyes par gyur/ /rgyun du yang dag zhugs pa'i 'bras kā sha mā sā r+ya sā ta tra k+ṣa lad+dhā bo byeḥ/ /bi tsit+ta yaṭī su ga ta pra bhā baṃ bu dag /rab tu gsal byas de tshe byang chub thob/ /de yis bde gshegs mthur ni rnam bsams ④shing //sa ma bh+ya dh+wata bisma ya har+ṣa byu miḥ/ /a ho ma hā mo ha ta mo ha re ṇa dru ya mtshan dga' ba'i sa yis mngon par smras/ /kye ma rmongs pa'i mun chen 'phrog byed pa'i/ /de bzhin rasbi te nā bi ta thā ga te na/ /pra sa khya ghā swarbe pu ṣābe+e te yo bi kā sha lasmreḥgashegs pa 'od dang ldan pa'i sku/ /ring du gnas kyang rnam par rgyas pa yi④/ /dpal 'di dge ba'i chu ku sha lam+bu dza su/ /tīrto bha baḥsat+tha ṇi dha na mābye pra ban+ta yan+taḥka ra r+ṇa k+ṣa ṇi na/ /skyes dag la ster/ /skad cig gis ni srid bsgral dam pa yis/ /smon lam thob cing nang gi byid rab dang //a ho nu tro: pa ri tā pa shādh+ri sa muts+tsha larnyi ba sha mā mṛ to ghāḥ/ /i rkyuk+ta sā kye ma sred pa'i yongs gdung zhi ba'i slad/ /zhi ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu bo rab 'phyur bzhin/ /'di brjod de yis bha ga ba te muk+ta rat+na rlu pa ya rna/ /bi tī r+ya saṃ gha pū dzā yi bi sa sardza ba bcom ldan la/ /mu tig rin chen rnams kyi skyes/ /dge 'dun mchod be+ed tshong pa yi/ /skye bo la bskur 95—121

ṇigyu rna/ /te ma ho da bye muṭī bya shābhā bha ga ba tornyi kai/ /tarluk+ta btang bar gyur/ /de dag chu gter che sgrol nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin/ /de yis ①mu rat+na ni ka ra pra ṇa mya smi bya be da yan/ /ba ṇibhiḥka thi hūṃ khru tā taṅka baṃ tig rin chen tshogs/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni de la phul/ /der ni tshong bas de yi gtam/ /bshad pa thos ta tra bhikyu zla/ /ā nan+da nā: thrastso tha ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /yā nas dge slong ni/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya bas dris/ /de nas bcom ldan rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang sau pu rā ro hi tā khyu dā se shākyā kṛ ha bha bta/ /be+e ba mugh+ra la tā dzā tā saṅkan+d+ra 'di shākya'i khyim du sngon/ /ro nyi ta zhes 'bangs mor gyur/ /de nyid mu tig 'khri shing du/ /smon lam dam pra ṇi dh+wa na taḥ/ /a bhūd ma hā dha no nā ma bā rā ṇa sde ba ṇi ka pu rā/ /ta pa'i las kyis skyes/ /nor chen zhes pa'i tshong pa ni/ / bā rā ṇa sīr dusngon byung gyur/ /de yi 1khyim thab su rat+na pa tī nā ma pasbyi pu stso tsi tā bha bta/ /sā pa rkyo pañtsa tā yā te niḥpu tā bsod nams can/ /rin chen ldan zhes bya bar gyur/ /bdag ④po lnga pa nyid gyur tshe/ /bud med de sgru pa she kha re/ /pū rdzu kṛ tā ma hā hā re bhasti yughān+ya be+e da yata/ /te yis mchod rten rtser/ /do shal chen po gus ldan pas/ /mchod pa byas nas phul bar gyur/ /bsod na pu rgya bi pā ke na sau ha lā dhi pa teḥsu tā/ /dzā tā muspyo la tā be+e ba pāsnra nams rnam smin des de nyid/ /sing ga la yi bdag po yidu/ /bu mo mu tig 'khri shing gyur/ /yongs su tsa pa ri nidṛ ti/ /be+e ba dzad+ma ni tsā n+yam+birje shwar+ya ma da mo hi tā/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob/ /de nyid skye ba gzhan la ni/ /phyug pas rgyags shing rmongs gyur nas//pū dzñā bye k+ṣe pa da k+ṣa bhūta dā sbo te nā ti brtso re/ /dzad+ma te dza ṣ+pe nobye yar+yad mchod la smod cing sgrin gyur pa/ /de yis yun ring ⑥'bangs mor gyur/ /dge dang mi dge'i las gang karma shu bhā shu r+ghaṃ/ /ta gya ta gya sa tad rū paṃ bye ste pa ri ṇa ti pha lo/ /gang / /skye ba'i zhing la skye bos btab/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin de/ /yongs su smin pa'i 'bras bu spyod//95—122

ni khi la ku sha la mū khā tīrti put+pa dz+wa la shrī shu bha pha la bha ra sru dge ba mtha' dag rtsa ba grags pa'i me tog dpal rab 'bar/ /legs dbe+ed 'bru yi stitshogs bskyed chos tir+bharma bal+lī na rā rde/ /bha be+e nyi tsa bi ṣa bal+lī kilpi ṣa kle sha mū la bh+ra ma kyi 'khri shing mi rnams kyis①/ /sdig dang nyon mongs rtsa ba 'khrul zhing lhung dang rbongs pa dang / /mtha' ṇi pa ta na mo hā nan+ta saṃ tā ba he tuḥ/ /san+taste smin kha ra ta ra ma ru yas yongs su gdungs ①gyur dug gi 'khri shing dag kyang yin/ /rab rtsub mya ngam ④ du gsal 'khor ba'i swā ra saṃ sā ra mārge pā paṃ bā pa t+ya dza ta dza na tāḥsak+ta tī drwa nu tā saṃ/ /pu lam ni shin tu gdung ba 'dir/ /drag por rjes su gdung ldan sdig pa sdig pa bor cig skye bo dag /rtag bye pu bye ku ru ta sa ta tai pu rgya r+pā yu ṣa pighāḥpu bye sgo yā ta tu tu bsod nams bsod nams mdzod cig bsod nams bsten pa rnam ⑤dag gi/ /bsod nams bdud ta la byu baḥshi ta khāḥpu shā bhā rdzu/ /i ti sat+tha ṇi dh+wa na gya pha rtsis bran pa'i bsod nams grib bsel shing gi sa gzhi bsel/ /de ltar smon lam dam pa'i 'bras/ /lo ka tha ya ta swa yi/ /bhi gru shā myu pa de sha yi bhekhye bha ga bā tā bshad pa yis ni gdams ngag 'di/ /dge slong rnams ni gus pa'i slad/ /bcom ldan rang gis spyomadzad kri taḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā pa yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam yī mughā ya tā ba dā rna sap+ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun pa'o// //kṛ tā pa kā re pi kṛ pā ku khā na spyu re pya la ma pal+la ko ma khā ni/ /dwo sngoṣ+ṭha bsam pa rig ④pa rnams kyi thugs dag ni/ /gnod pa byed pa la yang 'u7snying rje rgyas/ /drag por tabhe bya ti shī ta khā ni bha brnyi tsiṭ+wā ni bi dā sha yā rmā/ /pu rā su ra pu gyur pa la yang 'dab ltar mnyen/ /zhe sdang tsha gdung la yang shin tu bsil/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab 95—123

ro dā re pu re rā dza kṛ hā bhi dhe/ /shrī gubhā khyo kṛ ha pa tirba byu dha na do ces pa/ /lha yi grong ltar rgya cher sngon/ /khyim bdag dpal sbas zhes bya ba/ /nor sbyin lta bu ①byung sa maḥ/ /dṛp+taḥsu dza na bi dī ྾ gu ṇi 6 gi ra tā da raḥ/ /sa dā dha na bar gyur/ /skye bo legs la sdang zhing dregs/ /yon tan rnams la gus pa btang / /rtag tu nor gyis ma dā dhū taḥs dza hā sa ma ti pa tsā/ /ka ṣ+ṭha ṣ+pe ṣ+ṭa ti ba kre 6 shu bye 6 mu rgyags myos te/ /dam pa rnams kyi blo la rgod/ /sra zhing shin tu 'khyog ②pa dang / /stong zhing mu cor kha re 6 tsa/ /shaṃ khi ji ba kha le ṣe lasmre rtak+ṣi rgya mā shri tā/ /ti ka dā tsi sgog pa yi/ /dung nyid la bzhin mi bsrun ①la/ /dpal 'byor yon du sten par byed/ /de la nam zhig ta gu ru dzñā ti pu traḥk+ṣa pa ṇa kaḥkha laḥ/ /mi thaḥsī re ka thā sak+taḥpu zad byed pa/ /bla ma mi bsrun gnyen ④gyi dus/ /dben par dman pa'i gtam la chags/ /bsod sgo dī ṣā da bha ṣa ta/ /ya e ṣa kṛ d+ma kyu ṭā khye gi ro bhi k+ṣu sha tedṛ taḥ/ /nams dag la sdang las smras/ /gang 'di bya rgod spungs zhes pa'i/ /ri la dge slong lnga brgyas bskor/ /sarba dzha tīrkyo su ga ta ste dza ga ta smu bye hūṃ ga taḥ/ /ṣ+pe bā gya pra bde gshegs kun mkhyen zhes grags shing / /'gro gsum mchod bya nyid gyur pa/ /'di yi rdzu 'phrul ti dzñā kāñtsita bha byā mu pa la bhā ma he/ /nī taḥki tūn+da ti rūṇir+bha mchog dag ni/ /ci yang bdag gis ma dmigs te/ /'on kyang blun pos bcom ldan 'das/ /bcom ga bān bha ga bā ni ti/ /a bi tsāme+e ba sa ta tai pa rok+ta ma nu bhā ṣa te/ /ga ldan 'das zhes mtho ba thob/ /rtag tu rnam par ma dpyad nyid/ /pha rol brjod pa'i rjes su brjod/ /skye tā nu ga ti kaḥpra yaḥpra sibye sa ra rdo dza naḥ/ /bra tā di ni ya masta gya rda bo phal cher grags ⑤pa yi/ /lam du song ba'i rjes su 'gro/ /de yi brtul zhugs la sogs kyis/ /nges bha e ba pi bhā bya te/ /artswa ti mo na kṛd+maṣ+ṭha ṣ+pe ka pa da bra to ba kaḥ/ /pa tshul 'chos nyid du rtogs/ /chu skyar mi smra rkang gcig gisadu/ /brtul zhugs bzung nas nya rnams za//95—124

tasmrat+ta spyo pa hā sā ya kṛ ya tai kā pi bañtsa rmā/ /mā yā mo hi tā dhūrta dzā des na nye bar bgam pa'i slad/ /de la slu ①ba 'ga' zhig bgyi/ /g.yo sgyu can rnams sgyu ma yis//pa ro pi tu 6 ti / / i ti te nok+ta mā kasbya shrī gube+eḥ karma rmongs nas gzhan ④yang yongs sam ①'gyur/ /de yis de skad brjod thos nas/ /las kyis ④rmongs mo nyi taḥ/ /pa ti rtu pā ga shwa bye yu byu ta du pa diṣ+ṭa yā/ /pra pa'i dpal sbas ni/ /sdig pa'i g.yang la mchong ba'i slad/ /de yis bstan pa'i rigs pa yis/ /khyim dīp+ta kha di dzā gā rā pūrte gyu rnyi kha dzā kṛ he/ /kṛ tā pa bi ṣa ma luñtsa ya du gsang dong seng ldeng gis0/ /sol ba rab 'bar gyis khengs dang / /dug ldan zas kyang byas nas ni//yo bha ga ba tornyi shaṃ /te na mi byā bi nyi ta ya bhasgyu sgo hūṃ ni madh+ri bcom ldan 'das kyi dudrung du song / /brdzun ④gyis bsgrun pa'i gus pa yis/ /de yi duzas la mgron du taḥ—/ /bi dzñā ya sabaṃ sarba dzñāsta the ti pra ha sa smi ta/ /mi byesni song / /thams cad rnam rig kun mkhyen gyis/ /de bzhin no zhes 'dzum bcas gsungs/ /dug dang yo ga ku pi tī pasna sadharma bā dī bhā/ /kṛ he ba ban+dha shrī gup+taḥshaṃ ki to me sbyor la khros ⑨pa'i/ /khyim thab chos ni smra ba mo/ /gros ni zags su dogs pa yis/ /dpal sbas kyi ⑩man+t+ra bi shra bāta/ /a tha bi dzñā ta dṛ to pi bha ga bān swa ya mā ya yo/ /ni khyim du bcings/ /de nas spyod yul ⑪mkhyen gyur kyang / /'gro bas phyag 'os gdong bzhi sogs//ba bye mā no dza ga ba bye : tu rmu kha mu khi ཿ su riḥ / / shrī gu p+ta lha rnams kyis ⑫ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /bcom ldan rang nyid gshegs par gyur/ /dpal sbas kyis ni gya ta mā re sgo bi be da na ga re dza naḥ/ /dikyu jo ba ti pā pā rmā su gup+ta ma brtsams pa de⑫/ /grong khyer dag tu skye bos rig /sdig can rnams kyi sdig pa ni/ /shin tu sbas kyang pi pā ta ki/ /ta taḥka—ta sa ma bye ta bha ga ban+ta mu pā se kaḥ/ /u phyogs rnams rgyug /de nas dge bsnyen dag cig ⑫ni/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs te/ /me 95—125
