bā tsa tsa ra rja m+bi nabyen+ta yan ga ha na bi ṣe/ /mi byā na mraḥpri yā khā r+pā dang dug la sems byed cing / /zhabs la rab tu gtugs nas smras/ /rdzun gyis phyag 'tshal snyan par gru bhā ba rja bi ṣān+da daḥ/ / ba ri hā khruḥ pra yasne na bha ga ba n+da smrasasti—/ /gsang nas me dang dug zas ster/ /bcom ldan rab tu 'bad pa yis/ /skye bo ngan 'di ṣa durdza naḥ/ /kur+yā da nābye nā shā se kār+yad+ma dhur+ya mā shrī te/ /yongs gtang du'os/ /dogs pas snyan smra la brten nas/ /'phags pa min rnams dbugs 'byen byed//an+t+ra ts+tsha dī pi gīrto hi ma dhu digha mu khaḥkyu raḥ/ /nā n+ya stu ti gu ṇa dz+wa ṣi gang phyir sbrang rtsis kha byugs pa'i/ /spu gri mid na rgyu ma gcod/ /yon tan la sdang mi bsrun ④pas//sa ha te gu ṇi dzā kha laḥ/ /san+tastu 6rnyi ye ba na te na ku pyarnyi durdza yon tan can gzhan bstod mi bzod/ /gang gis ④dam pa dges ⑤'grur nyid/ /de yi ⑥skye bo ngan pa nā / /twa yo lo ka tra ye ṣ+pe tra sha ta pat+tha bi kā shi ni/ /a gya rā hoḥkhro—/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mig dag nidze+e/ /'dab brgya rnam par rgyas byed khyod/ /sgra gcan 'di yi pa rda praste nārnyi bha ba ti ki dza gta/ /tasgo tā bha ga bā byu tse kikhyuta smi ta si gnas thob na/ /'gro ba long ba min pa ci/ /de nas bcom ldan cung zad ni/ /'dzum pa'i zer dkar tsā shu t+taḥ/ /tam+bi kā ro gra ti mi ram̐ dru rāta pa ri ha radz+re ba/ /dag gis de'i/ /gnod pa mi bzad 'u3rab rib dag /ring nas yongs su sel bzhin gsungs/ /na ma rmā gi smṛ sha t+yasniḥpra bha ba t+ya pi bā bi ṣe/ /pa ra dwo ṣa da ri dra rde bdag gi lus la mes reg dang / /dug gis kyang ni tshugs pa min/ /gzhan la sdang bas dbul rnams la//do kho pi ni ru pa dra baḥ/ /a ro ṣa shī ta la tse taḥsilto ya su sha mā mṛ taiḥ/ /skyon byis kyang ni nyer 'tshe med/ /gang gis sems ni mi khro bsil/ /zhi ba'i bdud rtsis bran gyur pa/ /ki ka ro tro na la sta su bi ṣe bā bi ṣa ya dī ṣaḥ/ /bi ṣā ya te tu r+pā yu ṣa ku su de la me yis ci bya ste/ /yul gyi dgra la dug gis kyang / /zhe sdang skyon gyis gzir ba la/ /bdud rtsi 95—126

oṃ ku li sha ya te/ /dwoṣa dwo ṣa tu ra phye ba tsan+da rna da na ya te/ /tirlogla dug nyid bzhin du spyod/ /me tog rdo rje bzhin du spyod/ /tsan+dan sreg byed bzhin du spyod/ /byang chub ni ga ta sgyu pi bo bye sa twa pa da sbi teḥ/ /kā ru bye mi tri muk+ta mya sems dpa'i go 'phang gnas/ /snying rje byams pa dag dang ldan/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas song gyur kyang //nāghirda ha nyi bi gra haṃ/ /pu rā ka lo ga dṛ pa tiḥkhaṇ+ḍa dī pā bhi sgo ba m+bi/ /lus ni me yis mi 'tshig go /ka ling ka yi mi bdag sngon/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams 'joms pa la/ /da dā ha mṛ ga saṃ ghā ā+oṃ saṃ k+ṣe pā sa sa mur+ya taḥ/ /kā na ṣ+pe dz+wa li te yang dag brtson pas dum bu'i gling / /zhes pa'i nags tshal bsregs ①par gyur/ /nags tshal rab tu tasmirje kasten+ti ri sha ba kaḥ/ /mi byu bo dhi sa mā lo bya da ha na pra 'bar ba der/ /byi'u ②ti ti ri gcig pu/ /byams pa'i ①byang chub la dmigs pas/ /sreg byed rab sha oṃ bya pāta/ /tasmra da dro ha ma na saṃ na bha paṃ bi bye te kwa tsita/ /thra tu zhi bar bsgrubs/ /de las du'akhu med yid ldan rnams/ /gang du yang ni 'jigs pa med/ /snying ya tī sa two sa dzaste ri da ma n+yats+tsha kau tu ki/ /a bṛbye bi ṣa me kā le stobs phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /dge mtshan 'di dang gzhan yang nyon/ /char med mi bzad dus su ni//mu naḥka su tsi dā shra me/ /ma nu 6 sa dṛ shā lā paḥsha sha kaḥsu tsi ram̐ sbi taḥ/ /thub pa 'ga' yi bste gnas na/ /mi dang 'dra bar brjod pa yi/ /ri bong zhig ni yun ring gnas/ /gruta k+ṣa mam+bu ni mā lokya pha la mu la pa ri k+ṣa yāta/ /u bā tsa tsa la saṃ kalpastabye 'bras bu rtsa ba yongs zad pas/ /ltogs rid thub pa mthong gyur nas/ /bsam pa de yi gdung bas gzir//thā bya thi tā sha yaḥ/ /bha ga bān ma ma mā se na saṃ pra ti pā ṇa bsto rgo/ /g.yo med kun tu rtag par ⑤smras/ /bcom ldan bdag gi sha dag gis/ /da ni srog gi rten po dag /kri ya hūṃ rak+ṣa bhā yo te sha rī ram̐ dhadz+re sā dha ā+oṃ/ /ikyughā dā ba she ṣā sgo mdzod cig chos ni sgrub ⑥bgyid pa/ /khyod kyi ⑦lus ni bsrung bar 'os/ /'di brjod nags sreg mjug 95—127

bi k+ṣe pa sha sha kasta sum̐/ /bārta mā no pi yasne na pra ṇa yāta mu gi mer/ /thub pas ①byams pas yang yang du/ /'bad pa yis ni bzlog gyur kyang / /ri bong gi ni ni nā mu huḥ/ /ta su sa twa pra bhā be+e na dzā la dzā lā ku lo na laḥ/ /pra lus po 'phangs/ /de yi snying stobs mthu yis ni/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis dkrigs pa'i me 'jam ya yo mañdzu shi dzā na bh+ra ma dzā bye dza khaṇ+ḍa tī/ /so pi di bya ba pu sta tra ka ma pa'i sgra sgrogs bung ba can/ /pad+mo'i rdzing bur rab tu gyur/ /de yang lha yi lus kyis der/ /pad+ma chen po le ma ha ti dz+re taḥ/ /pra ṇa mya mā no mu ni ni bi da dhe dharma de sha rmā/ /i ti bo dhi dag la gnas/ /thub pas ⑤phyag 'tshal ldan pa la/ /chos rnams rab tu bstan pa byas/ /de ltar byang pra dṛṭ+wā dzā na ba snerna be+e ṣāta ba yo/ /bha ga bān ka tha yi two ti chub zhugs pa rnams/ /'jigs pa mes ①min dug gis min/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das//shrī gup+ta bha ba 8 ya yo/ /ta tra te na pra bi bye ba bi ni k+ṣiste dak+ṣi ṇi pa de/ /dpal sbas kyi ni khang par gshegs/ /des ni de ru zhugs nyid na/ /zhabs ni g.yas pa bzhag pa yis//ba bhū bāghi kha dā mañdzu kṛ dzata j-i ga sa ro dza nī/ /dṛsgo ba biṣ+ṭi shrīguste me yi dong ni mtsho skyes can/ /bung ba 'jam sgrogs ldan par gyur/ /mtsho skyes khri la bzhugs pa de/ /sbe sa ro ru ha bste re/ /tad dṛṣ+ṭi naṣ+ṭa kā lu 6ཿsro bā tsa tsa ra ṇa na taḥ/ /dpal sbas kyis ni mthong gyur nas/ /de mthong sdog pa nyams pa yis/ /zhabs la btud de rab tu smras//bha ga bān ma ma pā pa su k+ṣan+ta byo yo bya ti kra maḥ/ /mo hādhe pa ti bcom ldan bdag ni sdig can gyis/ /rim las 'das 'di bzod par bgyi/ /gti mug gis long lhung tai ru tsu kā ru ju ma bye rka sa tī/ /ma mā ka stso ṇa mi tre ṇa yo yo pā chags la/ /dam pa rnams ni thugs rjes ④lhag /bdag ni mi dge'i bshes gnyen dag /rab tu pa pa the kṛ taḥ/ /u pa de shaḥpra mo he ṇa ta tra tā khaṃ bha bta smṛ tiḥ/ /bi ṣa rmongs pas sdig pa yi⑤/ /lam la nye bar gdams pa byas/ /de la khyod nyid dran pa skyabs/ /khyod kyi 95—128

digha ra saṃ sadz+re sgo rdzu te kalpi tasma yā/ /a ho ma mai ba saṃ krārnye zas dang btung ba kun/ /bdag gis ①dug gis bsgos pa byas/ /phyi nas gdung ba'i rang bzhin dug /pashāt+na pa ma yo bi ṣe/ /i ti shu pā hūṃ shrī gubye sā khru ṣ+pe tra kṛ bā ni kye ma bdag nyid rang la 'pho/ /'di brjod dpal sbas mchi ma dang / /bcas pa'i mig la snying rje'i byeḥ —/ /dṛṭī ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān bhikyu saṃ gha gya shri ṇa taḥ/ /gter—/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas gsungs/ /dge slong dge 'dun nyan par byed/ /be+e ṣā dasmra kṛḥtha sā bho na ba yi bi mu khā sta yi/ /gho ra bai ra bi ṣa t+ya gāta legs pa yi mug ma byed cig /bdag cag khyod la phyir ma phyogs/ /'jigs rung khon gyi ①dug spangs na bāsmran tā pa te bi ṣi/ /bā rā ṇa sde bu rā shrī mān bra h+ma dasto bha bta pas—/ /nged la dug gis gnod pa med/ /khrod ni bā rā ṇa sīr ④sngon/ /dpal ldan mi bdag tshangs dṛ paḥ/ /a khyu da nu pa mā nā ma ta sba pra ṇa sa mā shri yā/ /su baṇ+ḍi bhā sa saṃ dzha byin gyur/ /de yi srog dang mnyam pa yi/ /dga' ma dpe med ma zhes pa'o/ /de nas de yi grong khyer gya ta ta pu rān+ta ba na sbi teḥ/ /ra basma yu ra rā dza gya sā ka dā thā sh-i mtha'i / /nags gnas rma bya'i rgyal mo ni/ /gser du snang ba zhes pa'i sgra/ /de yis nam zhig thos kho ta/ /sā ta gya shap+ta mā kasbya bai re bī ṇa sra no pa oṃ/ /ki me ta di ti sa prats+tsha par gyur/ /gling bu pi wang gdangs lta bu/ /de yi sgra ni thos gyur nas/ /dge mtshan ldan pas 'di ci na ra nā zi sa kau tu kā/ / rā dza ba dha nāsta smin+da ste rat+na ts+tsha rda zhes| /mi yi mgon la de yis dris/ /rgyal pos smras pa nags mtha' 'dir/ /rin chen sgra ④ldan rma shi khā+e/ /ma dhu re byu ba na byā pi ya sri tata kaṇ+ḍa kyu dzi tai/ /i ti bya yod/ /gang gis dumagrin nas bsgrags pa 'dis/ /'jig rten rnams ni snyan pas khyab/ /de skad shu bā kho dṛ pa tistat+pan+dar+sha na mabe+e taḥ/ /pre ma pra yasneḥpre ma snga pra smras pa'i mi bdag gis/ /shin tu mdza' sdug rab 'bad pas/ /de mthong don du gnyer ba la/ /rab 95—129

mā nā yā tad be+ethra te ṣ+pe ba sa hi to ya yo/ /sa ta tān+taḥsu re ni bye sa bkug ste de'i ①khyim du/ /de nyid dang ni lhan cig song / /pho brang nang der rtag tu de/ /sa bdag bhābye ṇa me tī byu dzā/ /pū bye mā na pa ri tsa yā u bā sa bi mṛ tā da raḥ/ /btsun mor ⑤bcas pa yis/ /mchod cing yongs su 'dris ①pa las/ /gus pa gyernam par spro zhing gnas//sdir+bha snga rmā bu da te 6 pā lbo la ma ṇi be+edre su/ / tsi tra pa tra ru tsā tsakre mthon mthing nor bu'i khang pa ni/ /'jam ldan chu 'dzin 'od de la⑤/ /'dab ma mdzes bkra dbang saṃ sasten+d+ra yu dha bh+ra oṃ/ /a tha dig dza ya yā tra yo ka dā tsid ba su d+mā bye po'i gzhu/ /chags pa lta bur 'khrul pa byas/ /de nas de yi rim gro la/ /gus dang bcas pas lha mo paḥ / /ya yo ta du pa tsā rā ya de bī mā di sh+ya sā da raḥ/ /ta tartswa nu pa mā de bī bskos—/ /phyogs las rgyal ba'i bgrod pa la/ /nam zhig sa yi bdag po song / /de nas lha mo dpe med ma//pa rkyo yā te bra mā di bhā/ /rū pa yo ba na dar+pān+t+ra nā lu lo ke ku bdag po song bas bag med cing / /gzugs dang lang tsho'i dregs ⑥pas long / /rigs kyi lugs ni la sbi ti/ /ta ru ṇi pre gh+ra rā gi dh+yāsta suḥshaṃ darba bi bla be/ /byu ya mthong ma gyur/ /gzhon nu 'bangs la chags ldan ma/ /'dod pas rnam par bslad ma de'i/ /ngo tsha shin pa lo bha dī te ba laspyo dru ra ta ram̐ ya yo/ /ma li naḥku ḍi las+t+rikyāḥkar+ṇa tu ring song ste/ /yang yang dmigs pas 'jigs ⑦pa bzhin/ /dri ma ldan zhing gya gyu rno/ /rna ba dag saṃ spar+sha no tsi taḥ/ /tsa ba labya pa lāspyi rde su dṛ shī sa dṛ shaḥkra maḥ/ /bi bi la reg par bzod/ /g.yo ba g.yo ba'i mig can dang / /mig ni legs pa rim pa mtshungs/ /'khor ba sgod+ma da kā ri sgoḥsaṃ sā ra ma ka rā ka re/ /tsa radhi pā ṇa hā ri rgyaḥkā la chu srin 'byung gnas su/ /rnam pa mang pos myos byed cing / /srog 'phrog nag po brtsegs pa yi/ /ri kyu ḍa ts+tsha dāḥste yaḥ/ /ku su māta su ku mā ra su kru ra gya kra ka tsā da pi/ /ko mo ⑧bud med rnam pa ⑨rgyu/ /me tog pas kyang shin tu 'jam/ /sog le bas kyang shin ⑩tu rtsub/ /bud 95—131

dzā nā nyi pa rits+tsha rda ste rde tsi tra su tsa ta saḥ/ /ba hu raspyu phri lnga kabyu kṛ med sems ni bkra ba dag /su yis ①yongs su gcod pa shes/ /mang ①chags dga' mas mgu ①byas tā ye yādh+ri nidṛ ti / / shī ta dze+e bi ma dze+e sna — kha ṅga dh+wa dzā nas—/ /gang gi ④dga' bar bgrod byed de/ /bsil zhing dri med 'jam pa yisadu/ /ral gri'i rno rgyun pi be+en+ta te/ /sā tsin+ta yata sbri ti sha l+ya ma yo man+taḥpu re ma ma/ /ma yur 'thung bar byed/ /des bsams bdag gi pho brang na/ /rma bya'i rgyal mo tshul khrims shes/ /skyes bu'i rā dzaḥshī la dzhaḥpu rū ṣā lā pa be+eṣ+ṭi taḥ/ /ka tha yi 6 t+ya ba bye me lugs bzhin kun brjod pa/ /zug rngu 'di ni gnas par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod 'di sa bdag la/ /dṛt+ta me ṣa ma tī ba teḥ/ /ni sri karma kṛ tai tā ba dā dh+wa nā ki ka ro mya haṃ/ /gdon mi za bar 'chad par 'gyur/ /las ni smad 'os re zhig byas/ /da ni bdag gis ci zhig bya/ /āsgo ba re rnyi ta dzha tī marma rnyo sau bi dak+ta dhīḥ/ /dzā tā me kṛ ta pā pā yāḥ'adi ni gnas spyo shes mchog gi blo/ /pha rol zur gyis 'dzin lta zhig⑦ /bdag gis byas pa'i sdig pa shaṃ kā ni bye ta ṣ+pe ṣ+ṭa pe / i ti saṃ tsin+d+ra sā ta su bi ṣe sgo yis(nye—/ /dogs pa sems med rnams la'ang skye/ /de ltar bsams nas de yis ni/ /de la dug ldan dza ā+oṃ da do/ /rā ga maṭ+wāḥkha khā yaṭ+wāḥki ki kubyurnyi na ste yaḥ/ /te yo pā bza' ba byen/ /chags stsos mi bsrun ⑨dbang gyur pa'i/ /bud med ci dang ci mi byed/ /de yis nye tsar+ya mā ṇa su ba bi ṣeḥpā na sgo dza ṣ+pe/ /bi thrad+dhā brti rā dza gya ru ru bar sbyar ba yi⑨/ /bza' dang btung ba dug ldan gyis/ /rma bya'i rgyal mo rnam rgyas shing / /mdangs tse ru tsi rā ru tsiḥ/ /swasgra mā lokya tai di bī ra ha spyosgo da saṃ ka bzang yid 'ong mdzes par gyur/ /lha mos rnal nas ⑪de mthong nas/ /gsang ba rab mched dogs pa tā—/ /sha naiḥsho ka ma ya gra pā trastu ta t+yā dza dzī bi lta/ /e baṃ ta gya bi ṣe yis—/ /dal bu dal bus mya ngan gyi/ /nad kyis bzung nas srog btang gyur/ /de ltar de yi dug gis 95—132

ṇ+ḍa pi ṣ+pe pa glu ni ra dzā ya ta/ /ma hā tsā tsit+ta bai ma bye nirbi ṣi ku ru kyang / /nad dang ldan pa nyid ma gyur/ /chen po rnams kyi ①sems yangs pa/ /dug gis ṭ+wādug med te be+e ṣi/ /rā go bi ṣe bi ṣe mo ho dre ṣastsa bi ṣa oṃ bi ṣi/ /busgo nyid du bgyid/ /'dod chags dug yin gti mug dug /zhe sdang dag kyang mi bzad dug /sangs rgyas dharmasta thā saṃ ghaḥs bye tsa pa ra mā mṛ tai/ /gho re bi ṣe thra dza ti chos dang de bzhin du/ /dge 'dun bden pa bdud rtsi'i mchog /gti mug chu tshogs chen po 'jigs su mo ha ma hām+bu rā shi gho ram̐ bi ṣi sre dza nyi rā ga ma ho rā gabya/ /gho ram̐ rung ba'i dug rnams spyo/ /chags pa'i ltos 'gro chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i dug rnams spro/ /sdang ba'i bi ṣe kṛ dza ti be+e ra ba nā ba ni: dzad+ma kra moste bi ṣa ma gya bi ṣa pe nags kyi phreng ba 'jigs su rung ba'i dug rnams spro/ /mi bzad dug rnams skye ba'i rim pa gzhan ni yod nā byeḥ/ /dhan+d+ra kā ma kṛ ta bā ṣ+pe ba me bā t+yā dzad+ma ni/ /shrī gubhoghi khā dzā saṃ pi ma yin①/ /'di bzhin skye ba gzhan la yang / /dpal sbas kyis ni me yi dong / /chos ni 'dod ma de la ta sgyu bhūta sa ha gyasti nī/ /i kyuk+ta bha ga bān sa myak+ka ru rja lo byas—/ /de yang 'phral la pad ldan gyur/ /de skad brjod nas bcom ldan 'das/ /yang dag snying rjes kā rmā bu r+bhaḥ/ /tsa kā ra bī ta ra dza saṃ shrī gup+ta shā sa norlu khaṃ/ /ka gzigs pa'i chus/ /bstan pa dag la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /dpal sbas rdul dang bral ba byas/ de li ku sha laḥshrī gusto tha prakā sha ba dāp+ta ye sha ra ṇa ga ma nā bye ba nas dpal sbas dge ba shes pas rab tu gsal ba'i gnas thob phyir/ /dri med dran pas skyabs su 'gro ba ṭī ṇi sma ran bi ma la smṛ tiḥ/ /dzi na pa ri tsa yāta pu sgo le bhe pa tsā hi lo gsum nyid dran gyis bugazhan ma yin/ /rgyal dang yongs su 'dris pas bsod nams 'thob (sheste gang phyir ka rgo bha ba ti ma ha te ka s+thā rja ya pra mo da su khā ya tsa/ /shrī gup+ta gya dam pa rnams/ /mthong bar grur pa dge ba che dang rab tu dga' dang bde ba'i slad/ /mi shes rmongs pa 95—133

ni kā ra ki lbi ṣa dzu sngo byā dzñā na mo hā pa ha ཿ kṛ tā ba sh+ya ma bar 'dir 'bad pa'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad pa ma dpe rnams las ma rnyed par a pa bye gyi a shwa dang mtshalas sbyar bye gyi klad skor ma srog med la a nu'i a drangs pa'i dngos bstan pa byu ma'i 'bru gsum po 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/sel ba'i bcom ldan 'das ni snying rje khyabasod nams la brtson pas/ /gnod byed ①sdig pa bsten pa'i nu gra he ṇa bha ga bān kā ru stsor+ya taḥ/ /dīk+ṣu rde bha ba saṃ k+ṣa yā ya dpal sbas kyang ni 'bad pas rjes su bzung ①byas nas/ /'ching ba'i khang par yang srid 'dud stipa 'di bi da dhe nidze+e ra tā shā sa rna ye ṣ+pe ta na bha brnyi brnya bha ba ṣ+pe byu yo bha ba dag rnams su gang gis mi 'gyur ba/ /srid pa yang dag gzhil slad dge slong rnams la khon dang bral ba'i grabye ya/ /i nyi k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kabe+e bstan pa bsgrubs/ /zhes pa 1dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod khyapa la tā yī shrī gubhā ba dā na ma ṣ+ṭa ma pal+la baḥ// //dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dpal sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad pa'o// //dha t+yā nā ma shi baṃ bi bharti shu bha hūṃ bha bya swa bha bortse ba mūkhro hūṃ ku sha lo pra skal ldan rnams la mi shes pa ni legs pa'i rang bzhin las byung dge nyid gyur/ /rmongs pa rnams yā t+ya hi ta tā mi h+ye ṣa lagh+raḥkra maḥ/ /me+e shī gharnyi mi rān+dha mo ṣa dhi la dge ba mi phan nyid 'gyur 'di ni rim pa 'di yis mtshon/ /mtshan phyed smag rum myun pa sman gye nags ba na snga t+yan+ta kārnyi pra da me dastso lu ka ku la dṛṣ+ṭa ha ta ye sarba tra me la mchog tu mdzes pa rab tu ster/ /gang yang nyi ma'i gzi byin 'ug pa'i rigs kyi mig ni kun tu nyams trasma haḥ/ /pu ra rā dza kṛ hā bhi khye bim+bi sā ra su khyu pa teḥ/ /a khyuta par byed/ /sa bdag gzugs can snying po yi/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces pame/ /rab bzang zhes po ra su bha dā khyuḥpa ri pūr+ṇa kṛ ha sbi teḥ/ /mokhyeta mo ha pra pal+la su sarba dar+sha pa'i grong khyer ba/ /yongs rdzogs khyim na gnas pa byung / /lta ba kun la rnam sdang zhing / /gti mug rab 95—134

na bi dwo ṣaḥ/ /ta su k+ṣa pa ṇa ke ṣe ba ba khyu bā sgyu bhi ka da raḥ/ /ta gya tu rgyas pa des/ /rmongs las zad byed pa nyid la/ /mngon par gus pa lhag par gyur/ /de yi chung ma pa t+ya ba tī nā ma dzā yā ti dza na shā li nī/ /gasgo mā dha tu pūrten+d+ra bisbe po rān+da cho rigs can/ /bden ①ldan ma zhes bya ba yis/ /mngal bzung zla ba nya ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor shar gyi ri ba di ka /ka lan+da ka ni bā pā khyu be rku kā na na saṃ shra yaḥ/ /ka phyogs kyi 1bzhin/ /ka lan da ka'i gnas zhes (1pa/ /'od ma'i tshal du yang dag gnas/ /sangs dā tsita bha ga bān budhe pāp+taḥpiṇ+ḍa ya tad kṛ haṃ/ /pū rdzu sa bhār+ya kṛ tāsmi rgyas bcom ldan bsod ④snyoms la/ /nam zhig de yi khang par gshegs/ /de ni chung mar bcas pa yis(khya//pa tai sa prats+tsha sā da raḥ/ /gasgo sbi ta ma pa h+ye lata ki rū paṃ ta bha bi 6 ti/ /de la mchod byas gus bcas pas/ /bu ni mngal na gnas gang de/ /ci yi gzugs 'gyur de la dris/ /sau ba data saṃ pa rda bhu bye pu traste di bya mā nu ṣi/ /bra bra bye yā shā sa ṣ+pe me de yis bka' stsal khyod kyi bu/ /lha mi'i phun sum tshogs spyad nas/ /nga yi bstan la rab byung nas/ /saṃ yusto mut+ta me 6 ti/ /yā ti bha ga ba ti spaṣ+ṭa mi t+yā di sh+ya ni yang dag ldan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /de skad gsal bar bka' ⑥stsal nas/ /bcom ldan rang gi gnas dza shra oṃ/ /a sgyu ya yo kṛ ha pa tespyo ri kaḥk+ṣa pa r+ṇa kṛ haṃ/ /bha ga bta su gshegs/ /khyem bdag khang par zad byed pa/ /bhu ri ka ni mngon par 'ongs/ /bcom ldan 'das byu ṣi tai tatse su bha dre ṇa ni be+e di hūṃ/ /shu tā k+ṣa pa ṇa kaḥk+ṣi pre ma kyis gsungs pa de/ /rab bzang gis ni smras par gyur/ /zad byed pas thos myur bar ni/ /khong khro'i byuta dz+wa ṣā be+e ṣā ku laḥ/ /ga ṇa yi tā sa su tsi re gra ha dzñā na kṛ ta sh+ya yaḥ/ /dug gis 'khrugs par gyur/ /shin tu yun ring des brtsis (gyenas/ /ngal bas gza' ḍakyeni shes byas te//yo de bos+ho bha ga ba tā prashrī pa shan+ta thā bi sgo/ /so tsin+ta ye da ho sa t+ya dris lan bcom ldan gyis gsungs gang / /de lta'i rnam pa kho nar mthong / /des bsams kye ma the tshom 95—135

muk+tarnye na na paṃ sha yaḥ/ / ta ta pra bha bo pa ma dā ya kirlu sa bye dag /med par de yis bden par brjod/ /'on kyang de yis smras pa'i dngos/ /gzhil slad bdag ni ba dā mya haṃ/ /ta su sarba dzha tsā bisti su bha dro ya di mata gi rā/ /ta de ṣa mi bden brjod/ /bdag gi tshig gis rab bzang gis/ /gal te kun mkhyen de rig na/ /de las dge k+ṣa pa ṇa shrazlo t+yabh+ya ti shra ma ṇa da rāta/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya pā mar+shaḥs su sbyong la gus 'dis/ /zad byed la dad gtong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar bsams nas khro ldan pa/ /de yis bha dra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a sa t+ya me tata ka thi tai te na sarba dzha mā ni nā/ /ma nu rab bzang dag la smras/ /kun mkhyen nga rgyal can de yis/ /'di dag mi bden pa nyid brjod/ /lha yi 6ཿka tha māsno ti de bārta di bya baṃ ba rda/ /pra bra dzñā ki tu pa h+ye ba phun tshogs lha la 'os①/ /mi yis ji ltar thob ②par 'gyur/ /'on te rab byung ldan spyonyid na/ /de kartudhe nā snga byurnyi tā/ /spyi ṇaḥgru du pa tasto tsā ya gya nās+t+ya n+ya to ga tiḥ/ /yi sti'adi ni bsam par bya/ /dbul dang ltogs pas gdungs pa 'am/ /gang la 'tsho thabs gzhan med pa//ta su ta su su sgyik+ṣuhaṃ sha ra rde shra ma ṇa bra tai/ /pa shā mya haṃ kṛ ha pa te skya rgyal 'os pa de de yis/ /skyabs ni dge sbyong brtul zhugs yin/ /khyim bdag bdag gis mthong ba ni//bra mā khaṃ ya di mad+ma tsaḥ/ /pra kyu tā yo shi shudzā taḥku lo saṃ tā pa yi6 gal te bdag gi tshig tshad na/ /bzlog par bubyis pa 'di skyes pas/ /rigs ni yongs su gdung bar nyiske/ /i kyu dīr+ya k+ṣa pa ṇa ke pā te kṛ ha pa nyi — ram̐/ /bi tsār+ya bi da 'gyur—/ /'di brjod zad byed pa song tshe/ /khyim bdag gis ⑥ni yun ring du/ /rnam par dpyad nas bye hūṃ tsā yuk+ṣiṃ gar+bha ni pā ta ṣ+pe/ /ya dā dra bya pra yo ge ṣā ṣ+pe ba gasgo mngal lhung slad/ /sbyor ba de dang de dag bsgrubs/ /gang tshe rdzas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mngal ni yongs su pa ri sgo taḥ/ /ta dā sri pasnri ma ba dhī de kādhe ha ṭha marda ṣ+peḥ/ /ta taḥshī ma g.yos nyid/ /de tshe 'di yis bden ⑦par ni/ /chung ma drag pos mnyes te ④bsad/ /de nas sdig 95—136

ta ba rna ta sde thra shā rna te na pā pi na/ /pra pi tā yī k+ṣa ba rja kastabye d+dhā can de yis de/ /bsil ba'i tshal gye dur khrod du/ /rab tu bskyal tshe zad byed pa/ /de yis gtam nan+di ta dza guḥ/ /a ho ba tā bo sarba dzhaḥshi sho sa h+ye ta duk+ta bān/ /me+e yo thos dga' nas smras/ /a ho kye ma kun mkhyen 'dis/ /byes pa la brjod de bden ldan/ /bu ni ma sru no ra dzā te snga dza na m+bi pañtsa hūṃ ma tā/ /i yo sā shrīḥshi sho di byādhe noṭ+wā skyes ma dag ni/ /lnga pa nyid gyur ①'di de yin/ /de yis brjod pa'i byis pa yis④/ /lha mi'i dpal di bya ma nu ṣi/ /i yi tsa sā su pra bra rje yad+kuk+ṣiṃ ni dha rna ga taḥ/ /i te te ṣe mchog de ni 'di/ /'di yi rab byung de yang 'di/ /gang zhig dkur ni shi gyur pa'o/ /de skad de dag pra ba de na so pa hā me na sarba taḥ/ /thra shā na dar+sha nā me+e ba ba byu ba rab smra zhing / /nye bar dgod pas thams cad ni'u/ /dur khrod blta ④ba kho na'i phyir/ /skye bo yang dza na saṃ ga maḥ/ /a tān+ta re di bya dṛ shā bha ga bān khyu ta bhā ba naḥ/ /dag 'dus par gyur/ /skabs der sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'byung po dgongs pas lha yi ni//sadz+re bi dzñā ya tabyedhaḥ pra da rmyo pa smi taḥk+ṣa r+ṇa/ /a ho mo hā nu spyan gyes de skad ⑤kun mkhyen nas/ /'dzum pa dang ldan skad cig bsams/ /kye ma gti mug gis ba dhe na dru ra sbi ra pi de hi rmā/ /ā lo kashā r+ya te spruṇi rme ghi bcings pas/ /rmongs pa ring du gnas pas kyang / /lus can rnams la snang ba sgrib/ /sprin gyi rnam ri ba kā ri bhiḥ/ /shu dzha k+ṣa ya pa ya tā te na k+ṣa pa ṇi na sa muk+ta dhīḥ/ /a ho par 'gyur bas bubazhin/ /kye ma dge ba zad byed pa'i/ /zad byed pa de sdig pa ⑦ las/ /khyim bdag kṛ ha pa ti pā pā da kār+ya ma pi kā ri taḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsin+t+ra bha ga bān dman pa'i blo can las2/ /bya ba min pa khyebyed du bcug /ces tu 7bsams snying rje rab rgyas pa'i//swa yo bhikyu ga ṇibye taḥ/ /ya yo shī ta ba ā+oṃ k+ṣi shaṃ thra shā dz+wa ka ru rja bcom ldan rang nyid dge slong gi /tshogs kyis bskor nas myur bar ni/ /bsil ba'i tshal gye dur khrod 95—137

ku laḥ/ /thra shā na tsā ri rmā dzñā tā rā dzā bha ga ba taḥswa yi/ /dzi bi swa raḥgashegs—/ /bcom ldan rang nyid dur khrod na/ /rgyu ba shes nas rgyal po ni/ /gzugs can snying po sa hā mā h+yestu ṣ+pe ba bhū ba mā ya yo/ /ta taḥs ta tra dzā yā yī rna k+ṣibhā blon dang bcas/ /sa de nyid du 'ongs par gyur/ /de 'og rab bzang chung ma no/ /sreg pa'i me la yo tsi tā na le/ /ku k+ṣiṃ bhi tām+bu dzā r+pā naḥshi shuḥsur+ya i bor+ya yo/ /dzā li tā na bcug pa dang / /chu skyes la gnas byis pa dag /dku brtol nyi ma bzhin du 'thon/ /me 'bar dbus la madh+ya sbe tai kabye gra tīr+ya dā/ /ta da dza na sa mū ha su hā hā kā ro ma hā na gnas pa de/ /gang tshe sus kyang ma blangs pa/ /de tshe skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /hā hā zhes pa chen na byuta/ /ta ta dze+e paṃ tra mā be+ed+dhā ga tiḥsu ga ta sha sa nāta/ /ku por gyur/ /de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bkas/ /'tsho byed ces pa'i gzhon nu bsos①/ /rmongs mā ra j-i tro dza grwa ha dz+re bā khya ku mā ra/ /dzi nā ba lo ka ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba pa lta bu (snyerang 'gro yis/ /gzhon nu 'od ldan de blangs gyur/ /rgyal bas gzigs pa nyid kyis ni//bā la ka gra ha ṇa k+ṣa ṇi/ /a bhūñtsi tā na lan+ta su ha ri tsan+da na shī ta lāḥ/ /dz+re byis pa rab tu len pa'i tshe/ /ro sreg ①me dag de la ni/ /ha ri tsan+dan ltar bsil gyur/ /byis pa 'tsho brnye dz+wa la nārlu ste ru tsi re bīgh+ra dā ra shaṃ/ /bai labye ṇa k+ṣa pa ṇa kāḥk+ṣa rte zhing me las grol/ /rab tu mdzes pa mthong gyur nas/ /skyengs pas zad byed pa rnams ni/ /skad cig tasgru mṛ tā i ba/ /ta taḥsu bha dre bha ga bān sarba byu ta hi te ra taḥ/ /shi ba bzhin du gnas/ /de nas rab bzang ya mtshan rmis/ /rnam par 'khrul la bcom ldan 'das//ba bhā ṣe bisma yota s+thārnyi pu tro yo kṛ khya tā mi ti/ /sa tu do lā ku la ma tiḥ'abyung po kun phan la ④dgyes pas/ /bu 'di blang bar gyis zhes gsungs/ /de yang the tshom dag las blo//ki ka ro m+bi ti saṃ sha yāta/ /k+ṣa pa rja dzā mu khā bye ba shik+ṣu yi k+ṣa ṇa ci bya snyam pa'i khyogs la ⑤'phyang / /zad byed rnams kyis bzhin dag ⑥la/ /bslab pa'i slad du skad 95—138

mi gh+ra ta/ /te ta spru tsu na bā lo yo grwa khyaḥdre shā na balbo dzaḥ/ /ya tā yo tiṣ+ṭha ta cig bltas/ /de la des smras dur khrod kyi/ /me skyes byis pa 'di mi blangs①/ /gsal bar gang du 'di byalte na bha ba h+ye ba tabye nyi/ /i ti te ྾ gi ra rūkhoḥs dza gā ha na tai ya gnas pa/ /de khyim brlag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de skad de dag tshig gis de/ /rmongs pas gang tshe de ma ta / /ta dā k+ṣi ti pa tir+pā la mā da de dzi na shā sa nāta/ /byo tirma byu dā bābe+e blangs—/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i bka' yis ni/ /sa yi bdag pos byis pa blangs/ /me dang mtshungs pa'i gya te ྾ tsā sa dri sha tī ṣa/ /byi nyi dza i ti nā mā su tsa kā ra bha : te ྾ sogs byed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i bod skad mi 'dug pa za hor ban+des bsgyur ba slar ma dpe rnyed na dpyad/'od ldan pa/ / gsal bas de rnams bar khyab pas/ /gyede yi ming ni me skyes zhes/ /bcom ldan nyid ga bān swa yo/ /ta gya bra bar+bha mā na gya byu bā la bha ba ṣ+pe shi shoḥ/ /de shā nā kyis mdzad par gyur/ /sa skyong khang par byes pa ni/ /rab tu bskyed par gyur pa de'i/ /zhang po yul ra ga taḥkā le mā tu laḥs mu pā ya yo/ /sa bi di tā swa su bṛhaṃ ni gzhan song ba dag /dus kyis 1yang dag 'ongs par gyur/ /de yis khrusring mo shi ba dang / /bu skyes dha ṣ+pe pu tra dzasdi/ /ko pāta su bha dra ma bye t+ya ke ba mā naḥs ma bh+ya jota/ /spyod tshul rig gyur nas/ /khro bas 'dar zhing mngon phyogs te/ /rab bzang la ni yang dag smos⑤//rūkho k+ṣa pa ṇa bhaste na tata gi rā ha ta yo ṣi tā/ /twa yā t+yak+ta swa pu tre ṇa rmongs pa zad byed la gus shing / /de yi tshig gis chung ma bsad/ /khyod kyis (⑥ rang gi bu dor naklu//kin+d+ra ma su kṛ ta kṛ tai/ /nibye ta nāḥswa bha be+e na pa ra oṃ tra pa mudz+re legs byas ming ni ci zhig byas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sems med cing / /gzhan gyi sngags kyis kun tu tāḥ—/ /ha sadho pe bi ni gh+rarnyi be+e tā ḍā i ba durdza naḥ/ /a dhu ṣ+pe slad⑧—/ /skye bo ngan pa dgod '-i)na yang / /rnam par 'joms ⑩byed ro langs bzhin/ /gal te rgyal ba na kṛrje pi ya di ra dza kṛ hāta su tai/ /taste ṭ+wā ba bha murgyu 6 kā ra yā po'i khab nas bu/ /da lta nyid du mi len na/ /bud med bsad pa bsgrags nas de/ /khyod nor chad 95—139

myadze+e ni gra hi/ /i kyuk+taste ta ta dī t+yā pa byu pa ti kṛ hāta su tai/ /ā pas gcod du 'jug /de yis ①de skad brjod pa ⑤des/ /'jigs nas sa bdag khab nas bu/ /len ni nā tsi rā ta muk+ta ma kā me na ma tī bhu je/ /ta taḥsu bha dre kā le na du bcug pas sa bdag ni/ /'dod dang ldan pas ring nas ①gtad/ /de nas rab bzang dus kyis ni//kā la gya ba sha mā ga te/ /a byuta ni dhibe+e byu tī ram̐ bye tiṅgārga i ba tī ྾/ /dus kyi dbang du song bar gyur/ /me skyes rnam par 'byor pa'i gter/ /'od kyis ④nyi ma bzhin du gyur//abe+e kalpa dru maḥpā pya sadza rda di bya mā nu ྾/ /sa budha dhan+d+ra saṃ gha slong ba rnams kyi snyedapag bsam shing / /lha mi'i phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 6 shar bye ṣ+ṭa ka ra to ma ti/ /tata bhathi pa na tai di bya rat+na saṃ tsa ya ma da bhu 'dun gye/ /skyabs la de yi (6blo gros byas/ /de la gus pas nyer bsgrun pa/ /rmad byung lha yi rin chen haṃ / /pa da do rnyi k+ṣu saṃ bhe bh+yaḥpu rgya rat+na rdza nor+ya taḥ/ / ta su tshogs—/ /bsod nams rin chen sgrub brtson des/ /dge slong dge 'dun rnams la phul/ /chu gter de ba ni kā ye bh+yaḥsāstsar+yā bi bi dharngu yaḥ/ /swa ya me bā ya yurbethra ma ho da cher ni chu bo bzhin/ /de lta'i khyim du lha'i ris las/ /rnam mang phun tshogs ngo mtshar can/ /rang nyid bye mi bā pa gāḥ/ /tro ṇi rasne tsa pa ma dhīd+ngha ga bā na pi tadṛ he/ /tsakra kho na 'ongs par gyur/ /de yi khyim du bcom ldan 'das/ /rtswa ⑦dang rin chen mtshungs blos kyang / /de ta da nu ro dhe na rat+na sā tra pa ri gra hi/ /sa di bya ban+t+ra yu ga waṃ ya yi ngor ni rin po che'i/ /snod (3ni yongs su bzung bar ⑨ mdzad/ /des ni 4 bye lha yi gos zung dag /sha sā mu pa mā k+ṣa saṃ/ /pā pa pu bye pa na k+shi tai ni dze+e gī la mi bā rang gi khyim 47bzhin dri ma med/ /grags pa rnams kyi dper bzod pa/ /bsod nams zong gis stsos spyom lo/ /ka dā tsi da tha tad bste sta nān+d+ra n+yasta mā ta pe/ /sa m+bi ra nas thob/ /de nas nam zhig de yis ⑫gos/ /bkrus nas brlan pa nyi ④'od bkod/ /yang dag g.yo 95—140

ṇi nā pa z-i tai n+ya pa tata rūdh+ri byu pa teḥ/ /bi lokyā pūdze+e tu tsi ram̐ byo tiṣ+ka bas rab bskyod nas/ /sa yi bdag po'i spyi bor lhung / /me skyes de yi she7gos dag ni/ /sngon med rab gya ta rda shu rka /di bya shrī bi smi to rā dzā tri rde me ṣ+pe ni dza shri yo/ /sgohūṃ mdzes mthong gyur nas/ /lha yi dpal la ya mtshan pa'i/ /rgyal po rang dpal rtsa bzhin sems/ /zas ni madh+ri taḥpā pya ta su rat+na ma yo kṛ haṃ/ /dṛ pa tiḥswarga mā dzñā sī la mgron gnyer mi yi bdag /me skyes khyem na gnas pas de'i/ /rin chen rang bzhin khang pa dag /byo tiṣ+ka bha ba desbi taḥ/ /a tha kā le na bhū pā laḥpu tre ṇa dzā ta sha tū shā/ /mthong nas mtho ris yin par sems/ /de nas dus kyis sa skyong ni/ /chos kyi ngang tshul ma skyes (kyidagra//ts+tshad+ma khā rā bye luste na dharma shi lo ni pā ti taḥ/ /a tī te sad gu ṇi rārnyi bu ni rgyal srid la chags pa'i/ /g.yo yis nges par bkrongs par gyur/ /rgyal po yon tan dam pa can//tasmin kṛ ta yu go pa mo/ /a dharma i ba ba pā pa rā rdzu rā dza ba rāta ma dzaḥ/ /sa rdzogs ldan lta bu de 'das tshe/ /rgyal po mchog gi bu de yis/ /chos min bzhin du rgyal srid thob/ /me khyu j-idrurla dzha dṛṭī byo tiṣ+ka gya kṛ he shri yo/ /ta mu bā tsa se ma bye t+ya skyes dag gi khyim phyi dpal/ /sa bdag la dkon des mthong nas/ /yang dag mngon par song ste smras//ma ta pi tā two bi badhi taḥ/ /blu tā ta bā haṃ dhadz+re ṇa bi bha bāsgo pra yats+tsha me/ /khrod ni pha mas rnam par bsos①/ /khyod dang pha spun chos dag gis/ /'byor pa phyed ni bdag la stsol//na tse bhā ga dha na dro hāta ka li re ba pra dzā ya te/ /i kyusteste na kau ṭi s+thāta bye gal te min na nor skal la/ /'khu las rtsod pa nyid rab skye/ /gya gyus sdang bar byed pa des④/ /de skad tiṣ+kaḥspyu ra kā ri rja/ /rat+na sgoṇi kṛ ha tasmin da tā pra yāta pa ram̐ kṛ haṃ/ /sā brjod pas me skyes ni/ /khang pa rin chen gyis gang ba/ /de la byin nas khyim gzhan song / /lha yi rin di bya rat+na ru tsi ra sbi tā lo ko pa kā ri bhā/ /byi tiṅgā me pā nu ya yo shrīḥchen yid 'phrog rgyas/ /'jig rten phan byed dpal 'byor de/ /me skyes kho na'i rjes su 'brang / /nyin 95—141

pra ti bhe ba di bā ka re/ /pu n+yastagh+ra pi bā saspata sap+ta kṛ twaḥpra bhā ba tī/ /mor byed la 'od zer bzhin/ /yang yang me skyes kyis spangs kyang / /phun tshogs de ni lan bdun du//byo tiṣ+ka ma smṛṣ+ṭa dṛ ba sā dhī ba nyi mi ba ya yo/ /sarba thā ha ra khod+kus+ho da me skyes can song ①mi bdag gis/ /ma reg chung ma khyo can bzhin/ /chom rkun la sogs rigs pa yis//gya tso rā di yut+ta bheḥ/ /byo tiṣ+kaḥku pi ta dzñā tā nirbir+ṇaḥs ma tsin+ta rnam pa kun tu 'phrog brtson cing (she/ /khros par shes nas me ①skyes ni/ /yid byung gyur pas yang dag yata / /a pu ju pa ri pā ke na pra dzā rmā dza na ko pa maḥ/ /sī yā ta smṛ te she bsams—/ /bye rgu'i (gebasod nams ma yin pa/ /yongs su byun pas pha lta bu/ /rgyal po mnyes gshin ⑤ṣa two rā dzā bāt+pa thu pe sha laḥ/ /kau n+yastata sa dṛ shosmi:rgya dza sha ra le yangs pa ni/ /dran pa'i lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /'di na zol med drang po la/ /skye rgu dudabugs phyung pha pra dzāḥ/ /pi ta ri ba kṛ tā shā paḥsu kha rā tri 6 she ra te/ /dha ni naste ṇa ma bzhin/ /mtshan mo bde bar nyal byed pa/ /de dang mtshungs pa gzhan pa su/ /nor ldan rtswa bzhin bta pā byāḥpra pyarnye rat+na bad bu dh+waḥ/ /a mṛ tā da pi duḥpā paḥsau dza n+ya sha ra bsgrub par bya/ /blo gros rin chen bzhin du thob/ /skye bo dam pa drang po ni/ /bdud rtsi bas kyang rnyed lo dza naḥ/ /byārgya dza bai dasbya dzu ṣā ma muk+ta sha ra lāt+pa rmā/ /a pa dka'/ /zol min mkhas pas (rngu bsten pa dang / /rmongs min drang po'i bdag nyid dang / /ma nudha ton+da tā dzñā tsa bi ra lo dzan+ma tā dṛ shī/ /a dhu nā dī ṣa dudṛt+taḥpra brtsigs mthon po nyid dag kyang / /de ltar skyes pa shin tu nyung / /da ni mi bdag zhe sdang gis/ /tshul bṛt+ta ni kṛ ti dṛ paḥ/ /pā pa pā ke na lo kā nā ma kā li ka li rā ga ngan gnod byed la rab zhugs/ /'jig rten rnams kyi sdig byun gnas⑧/ /dus min rtag ⑨tu rtsod ldan taḥ / /mi tre dza ga ti yā teste tasmin bhā swa ti byu ba to/ /do kho da yaḥ'ongs—/ /'gro bar khya7 sa bdag 'od ldan pa/ /bshes gnyen de ni nub pa'i tshe/ /de sras skyon skyed ⑪95—142

pra dṛsgo ya man+ta kā ra ya tah+phu taḥ/ /zla rgo pa tā ma tī tā dzā niṅgā ra mtshan mo ni①/ /mun pa'i slad du rab tu rgyas/ /mi bsrun ①dam pa 'das rnams kyisazhu / /rgyu med ṇa su z-ita kha laḥ/ /yad bṛt+ta pa raḥbhā ge na ya shaste ྾ pra kā sha te/ /snying sdug yin nam snyam/ /gang zhig ④spyod tshul gzhan cha las/ /grags pa de dag rab gsal byed//tasmra di yi pa ri t+ya dzñā dṛ pa t+ya byekhyu tā ma tī/ /kā le ka lo k+ṣi tī she de slad mi bdag ngan pa yis/ /byin brlabs sa 'di yongs gtang ⑤'os/ /rtsod ldan dus kyi sa dbang tsa dza nā dzñā dz+re be+e tai ku taḥ/ /ba ra pa ri tsa yo dā rā dā rāḥs hūṃ la—/ /skye bo rnams ni ga la 'tsho/ /mchog tu yongs 'dris yid 'ong chung ma dam pa rnams kyis ⑪rab gu zla dzā gu rjaḥ ku la ma bi ka lo bha byā byu ti r+ya shaḥ sha shi sam+bi sbyangs yon tan dang / /'chol ba min pa'i rigs dang legs ldan sa bdag ri bong can mtshungs grags lha —/ / sbri ti sa mu tsi tai bṛ trī bi hūṃ ni mit+ta ma nā pa dzā gu ṇa pa dang / /lugs la yang dag 'os pa'i spyod tshul dag dang phongs med rgyu yi ༷)nor rnams te/ /mi pa ti dṛ pe sa baṃ bha ba t+ya bi paṃ ṣ+ṭha lo / / dha rma dru ma bdag yon tan ldan na skyes bu rnams kyis ④thams cad rnam bslad rjomin par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rtsa ba su dha na mū la sa murga ta gya nirdo ṣa kā ma ku su ma pā pa ro dz+wa la sru/ /nor gyi ljon pas yang dag bskyed gyur pa/ /skyon med 'dod pa rnams kyis me tog rgyas shing rab 'bar ba//lo kaḥsu khā ni ki la pu ju pha lā bhuste ha tā na tse ta ku dṛ pa tibe+e bsod nams 'bras bu bde ba nges par 'jig rten longs spyod de/ /rnam par ltung byed ⑪rgyal ngan rlung nir+pā tai bā taḥ/ /ka liḥkā laḥpa tir+pā la stata pra tā pabye tā na la/ /gis gal te ma bcom na'o/ /rtsod ldan dus dang bdag po byis/ /de yis ⑪rab gdung bsreg ⑫pa'i me//a kā la pi bla poṣ+ṭha la kha la be+eṭ+wā la saṃ ku laḥ/ /thra tibe+e ṣaṇ+ḍa khin+d+ra dhīḥdus min rnam bslad rab tu drag /mi bsrun spyoro langs tshogs kyis gang / /dga' ba yid byung blo gros 95—143

su kha shrī ya ta yo ba dzñā/ /a thu nā be+e bha bā sgo ge sgo ga yo ge bskyod—/ /bde ba'i dpal gyi lang tsho song / /da ni 'byor pa longs spyod rnams/ /spyod dang ldan la na me ru ཿ/ /dha ā+oṃ bhū mispyo haṃ dā raḥsu tā z-i t+yā pa rits+tsha dāḥ/ /a ho ni ra bdag mi sred/ /nor dang khyim dang chung ma dang / /bu dang g.yog po yo byad rnams/ /mtha' med nad ba byeḥsum̐ sī mā bye byā di pa ri gra haḥ/ /ya thā ya thā bi brjadhe shrīkhrorja bi dang gdung ba ste/ /kye ma skyes bu'i yongs 'dzin nosti/ /so ga'i tsha ba mi bzad dpal/ /ji lta ji ltar ṣa māḥshri yaḥ/ /ta thā ta thā dz+wa la h+ye ba treṇ+ḍa tā paḥsha rī ri rde/ /pra dṛdhi rnam 'phel ba/ /de lta de ltar lus can rnams/ /sred pa'i yongs su gdung ba 'phel/ /skye ba kun tu ra pi bidho ghi rā dzatho pārdzi taidṛ rde/ /la ba shā: ri ba dza lebe+e dṛbye nyer bsgrubs pas/ /nor gyi tshogs pa rab rgyas kyang / /lan tshu'i mtsho yi chu yis bzhin/ /mi rnams ṣ+pe ba dzā ya te/ /nāste nās+t+ri t+ya saṃ to ṣād ya e ba dha ni ram̐ dza paḥ/ /pu nar+bha be+e sred bral nyid ma yin/ /gang zhig nor ldan tshog khyemi shes/ /med do med do zhes zlos pa/ /gal te de bha be+eta ko ba sa e ba pra sha mār+ya di/ /ṣ+pe biste rduni mirteḥka li ka la ha yis rab zhi na/ /yang srid dag tu su zhig 'gyur/ /rtsod dang 'thab mo zongs dang chags pa chen po rjes mo ha lo bhā nu bṛste ཿki sgo gibe+e pa yo girgya sa na sha ta pa ta nā sgyu pa su 'brang ba'i ltas ngan nor gyis (she/ci/ /rgud pa brgyar lhung yang dag chags pas nad skyed ④ 'bral bar saṃ sak+ta ro giḥ/ /ki bā mi byā bhi mā nairnar pa ti sa da na pābe+e 'gyur ba'i longs spyod dag gis ci/ /yid nyams g.yog la mi bdag khengs khyepa thob pa'i mngon pa'i nga se pā ba mā ṣ+pe rasmin be+e rā gya me ba k+ṣa ya sa ma ya bha ye sgo gya mā ro gya rgyal dag gis ci/ /'dir ni chags bral kho na 'jig dus 'jigs par nad med longs spyod dag tu 'os yo gyi/ /a ti krādhe kā le swa dza na su z-i dā lo ka bi ma le sa pa yin/ /rang gi 'uskye bo snying sdug dri med snang ba'i dus ni 'das gyur cing / /lhag par mi bsrun ⑦95—144

mā pan+de mo ha pra ba la kā lu 6 ma li ṣ+pe/ /su khā shā saḥsum̐ sī pra sha sdeg pas rgyas pa'i rmongs pa yang dag 'ongs pa na/ /ngal dub yongs btang skye bo med pa'i nags kyi ma pa li la s+thā ta ma na sī pa ri t+yak+ta yā se bi dza na ba na bā se pa ri tsa gnas la yongs 'dris pas① / /yid ni rab zhi'i chus bgrus skyes bu rnams kyi bde ba'i dbugs 'byin yaḥ ske/ /i ti saṃ tsin+tu pa tsi re pa re be+e rā gya ma ya yo/ / duḥkhaṃ yin—/ /de ltar yun ring de zhubasams nas/ /mchog tu 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ /sdug bsngal mo hā ya mūkhro rde bi bi kā ya tsa dhī ma tsā/ /sa da tā sathra mabe+e bh+yaḥrmongs pa'i gti mug dang / /blo ldan rnams kyis blurnam 'byed be+ed/ /slong rnams la des kun byin nas//bra ya yo su ga tā shra oṃ/ / shrī shri kha lā nyiḥ kṛ bye na dhi sa t+ya su bde gshegs gnas su rab tu song / /gang phyir bden pa'i bder mngon phyogs/ /dpal gye lcags sgog khozlu khāḥ/ /ya de ba rā dza haṃ se na smar+ya te shu rtsa ma nā saṃ/ /sa de bāsmi ba su ma gis mi khugs/ /gang tshe ngang pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rdzing bu gtsang ma dran pa na/ /de tshe nor gyi blo gros ma//tī sa ra sī bi na ro tsa te/ /yā te duḥs ha mo ha dhū ma ma li ṣ+pe sgo gā nu rā gā ro ldan la yang nga ④ mi sred/ /longs spyod dag la rjes chags me ni bzod dka' rmongs pa'i du ba 'khyems na le sadho ṣā mṛ ta nidzha re ṇa ma na se pāp+ta sha ṣ+peḥbhā ta tsā/ /ṣ+pe tāḥgyur pa/ /chog shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis yid la bsil ba nyid ni dal bus thob gyur name/ /btung bas chu pā na ma do tu re ga bi tsa lasgye dzā ga nā r+bha gu ra byu dzha ga k+ṣa ṇa saṃ ga māḥmyos shing rab rgyug rnam par g.yo rgyun na chung g.yo ba'i byun 'khyog kyecan/ /skad cig 'grogs pa'i dpal sha ma ba hūṃ kurbarnyi bi rgyu shri yaḥ/ / sarba dzha shā sa na bi na ṣ+ṭa bha bā mo 'di dag zhi ldan rnams kyi bgegs ni byed ma yin/ /srid pa'i lam gyi sdug bsngal rnam ④nyams thams dh+wa kaṣ+ṭaḥpra bra bye yā bi ma la me baṃ ba rda pra biṣ+ṭaḥ/ /sā pā bya sarba cad mkhyen pa'i bka'/ /dri med nyid kyi gnas su rab tu byung bas rab tu zhugs/ zhi ba nyid ni thams 95—145

ga dza dh+wa dza ma ṇi ts+tsha tra tsā ma ro dā ra yā shri yā/ /tai dṛṭī pū dzi tai rādzñā glang po rgyal mtshan nor bu gdugs/ /rnga yab rgya che'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /rgyal pos mchod pa de mthong tsiṭ+wā rta byu da ā+oṃ ga na ཿ / / ta gya sa tā ba dā ta su pa k+ṣa nas—/ /ma bsdams bsam pa 'khrugs par gyur/ /snying stobs dkar bar gyur pa de'i/ /rgyal ba pā tī sha ta kra tuḥ/ /tsa kā ra di byā ya lasgyu swa hā khra dzi na pū dza ṣ+pe/ /mchod la 1shestong grogs ni/ /phyogs bdag mchod sbyin brgya pa yis/ /lha yi dpal 'byor rnams kyis byas//sa ta yā di bya yā byu t+yā bha ga ban+ta ma pū dza ya ta/ /ya dā gre tsakra baṭī de yis lha yi 'byor pa des/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mchod gyur pakhru/ /gang mdun 'khor los sgyur ba'i shrī ladz+dza bhā dza na tai ya yo/ /rasneju k+ṣa ta tsan+d+ra srur+ya bhā na bā shaṃ bar 'der 'od zer gyi skad dod yig 'azu bzhi chad pa ma dpe rnams las ma rnyed pa bhā na bā zhes pa 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na dpyad/dpal—/ /ngo tsha yis ⑦/ni snod nyid gyur/ /nyi zla'i 'od zer nyams byed rin chen rnams dang sa srung rgyatī ra ṇi rā ba ṇa ste ra smrasba ra gan+dha mā l+ya sha ba leḥ kalpa dru mā rde 'od ldan glang po dang / /dri med gos dang spos 'phreng ⑤khrus dang dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu rnams ⑥pha leḥ/ /bhat+ta pra hra shā ṭī pi lā sa tsa la nā he lotshwa sadzñā ma ram̐ te dag gis⑦/ /bde sogs gus btud rol pas g.yo zhing dal bus rnga yab dag ni rab bskyod par/ /de nā bh+yartsi ta mā ka la gya su ga tai ladz+dza na to bhūta dz+ra paḥ/ /i ti ba hu yis bde gshegs mngon mchod mthong nas mi yi bdag po ngo tshas dman par gyur/ /de ltar ston pa la ta re bhasgyu shāstuḥpha lo ya da rna ga naḥshu bha pa ri ṇa toḥpu stso dā raḥpu rā sa gus dge ba yongs smin 'bras bu rab mang dag /gang zhig bsod nams rgya chen rdokhyam bsdams pas sngon 'u/ma pap+ta bān/ /bi ma la ma na pasta sri bā sau k+ṣa ṇa pra ṇi d+mā na taḥpa ra yang dag thob gyur cing / /dri med yid ldan de yis ⑩ skad cig smon lam nyid las de nyid ni/ /mchog i pa ra be+esbyo tisko bhūta pa e ba pa da shri taḥ/ /i t+yā ha bi ma la dzñā na pra gi nyi ma bzhin du dpal 'byor gyi gnas me skyes 'dir gyur to/ /'gro gsum dri med ye shes kyis/ /rab 95—147

kā shi ta dza gan+d+ra yaḥ/ /pra ṇi dh+wa no ba de shā ya rnyigru rde bha ga bān tu gsal mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas dge slong rnams la ni/ /smon lam gdams ngag de skad dzi naḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa tā ba da na kalpa la tā gsungs—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam yī bye tiṅgā ba dā rna nā ma na ba ma pal+la baḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las me skyes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu pa'o// //rtsa pho pārnye bi ma la na li bhā tī ra pa r+yan+ta bā sbo shāstu pūrbe 'jig rten mtha' dag nye bar gzung 3snaslad rab zhugs ston pa dag ni sngon/ /grong khyer tsam pa pa ka la byu ba nā nu gra hā ya pra bṛt+taḥ/ /kṛṣ+ṭa spar+sha ba ga ti ru tsi nā dang nye dri med pad+ma'i brdzing ngogs 'gram na bzhugs/ /kun dga' bo zhes bya ba reg na bde ba'i 'od bhek+ṣu shā nan+da nās+thā gar+sā ram̐ bhāta pra j-i ti dza na tā dzad+ma bṛtrī dza ga da/ /ldan dge slong gis/ /dris nas mngal brtsams (1la sogs skye bo'i tshogs kyi skye ba'i ④spyod tshul gsungs//shudze+eḥ kṛste ཿ sha ba la ru tsi bherde ti rmā karma sru tresh+yi tram̐ lo ke ba hu 'jig rten du ni dkar nag 'dren ma'i 'od can las skud kyis bkra ba'i/ /lus can rnams kyi skye ba'i spyota ra shaṃ dṛ sh+ya te dzad+ma bste/ /dzīr+ṇa snga pi bya pa na ma li na sne ha li naḥgos ni rab mang gnas skabs mthong gyur te/ /shin tu 'bad pas gang zhig yun ring yongs sgyur srul 'u pra yasne ya gya t+yarnyi tse ra pa ri ṇa tirne ba nirlu ti rā gaḥ/ /sum̐ saḥshu por gyur mod kyang / /gdung ba'i dri ma snum chags tshon ni med pa nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /skyes pa bud kre pi ga li ta j-i te rārta paṃ yo ṣi tabya spar+sha be+e sha bya nyi ka ra dz+re ṣeḥmed dag kyang 'dzin pa rnam ⑦ nyams reg par zhugs byas shing / /sbyor ba bsten pa'i khu ba zla mtshan yang saṃ ga me saṃ ni pā tāta/ /e tī bhū tai pra dza ti ni ya māta ka mya tsi bī dza bhā baṃ dag 'grogs la ltung gyur pa/ /gcig tu gyur cing nges pa 'ga' las sa bon dag gis dngos por gyur⑧//95—148

podhestasmin bha ba ti sa ha sā paṃ ni kā she ya yāsneḥ/ /rā gojo raḥs+thā ṭi su zhig khong der 'phral la 'jug ste dper na bsrubs pa'i me bzhin no/ /shel dum dag la tshon gyis ① ka sha ka lo me gha masto dhi bā thaḥpube+e mo daste la ka mi bā sha ṣ+peḥkāstsa rna bāsni tā paḥ//rab dbye sprin la chu yi gter gyi chu/ /til la me tog dri bzang gser la me yis gdungs bzhin dal bu yis//so yo gar+ghaṃ bi sha ti ni ya tai ra gya saṃ lagh+ra bṛtrī r+pā yurgame+e ri ba ba dri rnams kyis sdebazhin rnam pa mang po'i las kyis bsgos par gyur pa'i rlung / /spyod tshul byed po yis hu bi byeḥkarma bhir+pā su mā naḥ/ /tasmin sugh+ra kra ma pa ri ṇa tidhī na kyang yang ①dag mi mtshan 'di de nang du 'jug /der ni phra ba'i rim pas yongs su 'gyur zhing rang parluṣ+ṭa ka so nā nā kā ra pra tsu ra ra tsa nā tsi tra rū po su lak+ṣuḥ/ /bzhin kyis btsir 'dir④/ /ji srid dus su rnam par 'gyur ba med pa bzhin du rnam 'gyur 'dzin//shaṃ tsi ta kā lo ba ha ti bi kṛ ti nirbi kā rā ya mā nā mā yuḥrāṇ+ḍi dza la ma ya rnam pa sna tshogs rab mang bkod pa bkra ba'i gzugs ni mi mtshon te/ /rma bya'i sgo nga chu yi ⑤ rang bzhin i ba byak+ta bhat+tarma yu raḥ/ /ta tā dh+wa nāta gha na ka la la tā sha l+ya pa shā rma bya'i rnam par dumi gsal bzhin/ /der ni mer mer nur nur nar (7nar gor gor la sogs gnas r+ya ba s+thā t+ya ghā tā stu dza ṭha ni te noṣ+ṭha ṇa pa tsu mā na ཿ / / pūṇi skabs bzung / /de dang de dag lto yis bskyed dzu pa'i drod kyis smin cing btang phyo7byas nas/ /zla ba mā mairna ba bhi ra tha bā brta karma kra mo po kle shaṃ bhuste ki ma pi bi kha mi rdzogs pa'am yang na dgu yis 'khyel pa'i las kyi rim pa 'di/ /sdug bsngal 'du shes rab ldan ci yang duḥkha saṃ dzñā pra ban+daḥ/ /kā l+ya dṛṭ+wā ta swa ya mi ba pha lo bi rjo tai kah+ma rung ba'i mi bzad nyon mongs spyod/ /dus su yu ba dag las 'bras bu rang nyid be+eng bzhin ⑩mngal smin pā kāta taṭ+wā lobye ra bi ha ta dza be+eḥpre ri taḥbla ti bā teḥ/ /lagh+ra sgyu pas—/ /de dus langs pa'i ma yi rlung ni mi dman mgyogs pas rab bskul nas/ /mtshon cha nyu7goms 95—149

pā ya ta na sa tsi be+e rā tsi taḥkarma ban+denir+ya bye taḥsha ra i ba dha pa'i gnas kyi grogs po 'ching ba'i las kyis ①rdzogs gyur pa/ /gzhu yi 'khrul 'khor bkang nas btang nur+yan+t+ra ṣ+per+yan+t+ra muk+taḥ/ /uṭ+wā na suḥ pa ra la ra sa nabyu bu kā ba'i mda' bzhin nang nas phyir 'thon 'gyur/ /gan rkyal kha gdangs ro 'dzin drag pos nu tog ④rtse la gre li hā no naste mā tuḥbi ba ti ya da sau ṣ+pe ba karte nā nākyā/ /dzad+mā 'dzin byed cing / /ma yi nu zho 'thungs pas ①gang 'di ④rna bas min zhing mig gis min/ /skye bar sgyu sa bya pa na ba ta nā yā sa saṃ bā sa lbo nā sā ta snga gre sa ka la ka la nā goms pa'i gdung bas bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gnas pa'i rol pa des/ /de yi mdun du spros pa mtha' de shi m+bi ba pā ṣ+pe ba / /sru tai ran+ta be+e bi ṣa ya swā da saṃ bā da dag ston byed bag chags kho na'o/ /rnam mang yul gyis ⑤ nyams spyong bskyed pa'i dbye bas grub pa ⑥nang bhe de rgyu staḥsubye rbi ṣa pa i ba byak+ta tai tu pra tā ṣ+peḥ/ /mū bhāḥso khyab pa/ /gsal bar skud pa rab tu rgyas par legs sbyar pad rtse'i cha shas bzhin/ /de nas rang bzhin tha pra kṛ ti pa tsi be+e redz+re yirdat+ta saṃ snyoḥsta t+yā khā pā kṛ ti pa re ma ma spar+sha dbang po'i grogs kyis dze+e'adu shes byen pa'i rmongs pa de/ /nu ma'i don du brjod cing yongs su mnye ba'i ṣ+pebe+en+ti dh+wa trī/ /ha stu kak+ṣeḥsha ya na ba pa nā ghar+ṣa ṇiḥr+pā ḍā mā naḥreg pas ma ma rig /mal stan gos rnams lag pas bskyod pa'i 'dar byed dag gis mnan pa dang //s+thā ṣ+pe sgra ṣ+pe ta ra li ta ta nuḥtī ṭa kair+bha k+ṣu mā ṇaḥ/ /ni t+yā krañdzu ba gnas dang gnas su ya yor 'gyur lus srog chags rnams kyis ④ zos gyur pas/ /rtag tu ngu zhing tshig tsa na bi ra hāta kā ya kau kle shi lo kasgo byu te bi ṣa ma bi pa dā māspa da two pra dang bral bas lus kyi nyon mongs brgyud ⑨ma ni/ /su la smra ste mi bzad rgud pa nyid kyi gnas su rab tu yā taḥ/ /r+pā to dwarnyezi ri ta pa da naḥthrats+tsha lata spyi ra stu ri ruṭ+wā 'gyur—/ /ltung ba tshu/skyugs shing rab 'thob 'o ⑪ma'i tshogs kyis bzhin ni sbags gyur te⑫/ /gan rkyal 95—150

no rasta la ni pa ti tai ruk+ṣi to lak+ṣu te sau/ /mā yā ba ṅgāḥsma ra ṇa ha ra ṇa thra bhā brang gi dbus su lhung bas mtshan pas bran ①par gyur pa 'di/ /sgyu ma'i bud med la 'grogs mchog tu rtse ke lī bi khā se ha pe ṣ+pe balbu ri ta ru tsi nā niṭ+wā ra byāp+ta kā yaḥ/ /so tha dga'i rol pa dran pa las/ /dgod pa'i 'od zer shin tu gsal bas ⑤rab tu khyab pa bzhin/ /de bas 'a pāste li pi pa ri tsa ye he la yā dat+ta hasteḥsaṃ sā resmin+da bi tsa la ta de ni rtse bas yig 'phreng ④yongs 'dris dag la lag gtad thob/ /'khor ba 'dir nyani g.yo med 'ching yā ban+ta le khya kri yā su/ /dzad+mā brte ni dza mi ba la khan dīsgo mo kā ra mā do ba'i rtsibs kyi ⑥ri mo'i las dag las④/ /rang gi skye ba'i 'khor 57mo ring du 'bri bzhin oṃ yig la sogs brge brge bi ra ti ma ti sgo ga sarge ni biṣ+ṭaḥ/ /pāp+taḥprasnyoḥka tha ma pa—/ /sde dang sde la blo gros rab gsal longs spyod spros pa nges par 'jug /ji zhig ltar yang byis pa'i pi ga labye la bhā ba pra mo haḥka mokhru kyāta pu na ra pi pa ri yo ba ṣ+pe dngos po'i rab rmongs bral nas shes rab 'thob⑨/ /slad nas kyang ni lang tsho dar la 'dod pas rab naṣ+ṭa saṃ rnyeḥ/ /nis+thā re 6 bya pa na be+e la sad me gha sau dā mi byā dzā ba dh+wa basbang 'du shes nyams/ /sdug bsngal mdzes pa'i sprin glog blu 7 bud med rnams kyi rtse dga' rol pa dag/t+yahūṃ sbi ra ta ra dhi ya yo ṣi tsā bi bh+ra me 6/ /bā tsi sho tram̐ ba pu ra bi tsa khā snying po med la rab tu brtan pa'i blo yis mngon par 'dod pa bcings/ /bud med rnams kyi tshig la rna ba lo ga de ṣi dza nā dzā ghā rde bak+ṣ-i pa ba pa ri mā le swa da rna tad ra se tsa/ /pā lus ni g.yo med 'khyud pa la/ /kha yi chang gi dri la sna dang de yi ro la myong byed dang / /bzhin la mig tri kuzan dṛ sha ma pi mu ṣe sup+ta sarba kri yo po dhaste ma tram̐ sta nu pa ri ṇa tsā m+bi kyang snod du bgyis nas bya ba thams cad bsnyal ba 'di/ /lus ni yongs su 'gyur ba'i dbang po thams sarben tri yā ṇi/ /dīṣ+ṭi sdir+ghaṃ pa ri tsi ta pa ri dre ṣa shī laḥs kā m+bi cad tshod dag 'dzin pa bzhin/ /sdang la mdza' zhing yongs su 'dris la yongs sdang ngang tshul 'dod ldan de//95—151

baṃ ts+tsha t+ya no na ba na ba ra paḥpa pra yot+na n+ya kā rmā/ /i t+ya byo t+yā gsar pa gsar pa la chags 'bad bcas gzhan gyis sti'adod ma gzhan dag 'dod/ /de ltar phan tshun nu tsi ta tsa ri tā lak+ṣa be+e lagh+ra pāk+ṣu hā t+yā yi ba pra kṛ ti bi ra pash+yi rigs /khumin spyod pa mtshon nas skyengs pa ① mthong gyur pa/ /'di yi 'dod pa rang bzhin ro bral bkra tra tai tro gya kā maḥ/ /a snga dh+wa re bi ṣa ya dza la dhi madz+dza teḥsadz+dza tabya ba'i rgyud 'dis bzhad stislad nyid/ /nyin zhag dag ni nyung zhig gnas pa'i lang tshos long bar byas gyur dh+ra ṣ+ṭa gya pra ti ha te ga teḥ kuñdza ra sre ba kaspe / / ki karta byā cing 'aste/ /'dam la glang po bzhin du yul gyi chu gter dag ni mtha' de spyol/ /bying zhing mtha' la rab ba ga ti ra hi tā dzā ya te mo ha rūstso bhā ta snga: ka ti ba ya di na s+thā yi nā yo lhung 'gro ba dag ni rab tu nyams pa 'di/ /ci zhig bya zhes nges pa'i shes pa dang bral rmongs pas brgyal ④ba ṣ+pe na/ /yā bta kha lo bh+ra ma ti tsa la nyi pri ya tai dzo bha te sau sme bar 'gyur/ /ji srid 'di ni rtse zhing 'khyams ⑧dang g.yo dang dga' dang glal ba dang / /'dod pas ram̐ sme ram̐ ba da ti da nā li ma gi tai ram̐ ga dzha giḥ/ /tā bat+ta spyo pa ri pa ri pa 'khyud pa'i lus ni 'khyog pas 'dzum zhing 'dzum zhing smra byed pa/ /de srid de yis ⑨steng du dus kyis rab ta t+ya bā kā la pra mushaṃ pra le yā lbo dha ba la pa li ta ts+tshad+ma nā ba 'phangs gsod ⑫ rtags me tog 'phreng ⑪/ /kha ba'i 'phreng ⑩ba ltar dkar skra dkar⑫ zol gyis yongs su dh+ya mā nā/ /kā le kā le k+ṣa ṇa ka la na ya mo nyi ni dru ba se na pāste nāsmin 'bab pa nyid/ /gti mug gnyid la chags pas dus dang dus la skad cig ltar shes shing / /lus 'dir ba su ṣi su ṣi su kṛ ta ṣ+pe ba dahaṃ na bhuste/ /idze+e tso ri ri ba sa mu ṣi ta —ste legs byas ma thob byin pa nyid min spyad pa nyid min pa'i④/ /rgyu 'dis de ni rkun pos brkus bzhin snyug yabye ba duḥkhāta saṃ rūṭ+wā nā ma nu sha ya pha laḥpā ba sā daḥ pra mā bsngal dag la stsosems pa nyid/ /kun tu rmongs pa rnams kyis nyams ⑩nyes bag med 'gyod pa'i 'bras bu 95—152

daḥ—/ /tasmin yā te la li ta ba ni tā put+pa bal+lī bā sarnye duṣ+karmāp+ta can—/ /las ngan gyis ①thob nor dang mtshungs pas lang tsho rmi lam du rtag 1pa/ /bud med 'jo dra bi ṇa tu la yā yo ba ṣ+pe swasna kaste/ /naṣ+ṭa she ṣa pra kṛ ti ra khi tha khe di tram̐ sgeg sos ka'i ①me tog 'khri shing song ba de yi tshe/ /yan lag ma lus skyo ④zhing chags dang bral bas rang girbi rak+ṇi rā bye rja pe na thra ba i ba su khaṃ po tha sho tsa t+ya tī tai/ /bzhin mtha' dag nyams/ /rgyal srid las nyams mi bdag bzhin de de nas bde ba 'das pas gdung //ā yudhī tai na tsa pa mu tsi tai yā tsa kā yo pa bhā tai nā glu: tai di shi di bdag gi tshe btang slong ba rnams la yang dag 'os pa'i sbyin ma btang / /phyogs phyogs rab ⑤tu grags shi yā shaḥsat+pa dze+e na pra tī tai/ /spru tai yadzñā bi ṣa ma dhi ma tai sbyi pa'ang ma bskrun legs pa'i lam ni ma rtogs shing / /slong duba'i dug 'thungs tsha dang grang ba yongs su ta saṃ tā pa shī tai dī tsā pā bāta ki ma pi na ma yā yat+ta de ba pra ṭ+wā tai/ /kā rgyas pa lhag par thob/ /sdig las ci yang 'jigs par ma gyur gang zhig de nyid kho na bgyis/ /gser sau he ma dru ma ru tsi ha rā hā ri ṇi yo ba na shrī kā yaḥkā yo kṛ mi ha ta gyi ⑦ljon pa'i 'od 'phrog yid 'phrog lang tsho'i dpal ni sgegang na ste/ /smin zhing mdzes bral srin bus ta ru zwa ya bitshwa yā pā kaḥ/ /dru rā de tāḥpa ri kṛ ta dṛ sha kau na bcos pa'i shing mtshungs lus 'di ga la zhig /na chung 'di dag mig gis ring nas yongs spong zur na lī rna ta ru juḥshusko shi tai tu ra mi ba ba ṣ+pe bā na re rmā ba darnyi/ /zhen gyur pa/ /bdag la nags kyi spre'u bskams ⑨shing 'khyags pas 'khrugs pa bzhin zhes smrasakṛbye //so yo kā yaḥshra ya ti bi la yo ṣ+pe ba mā yā ti kā ya shrastaḥsabe+e da sha na ma ṇa yaste lus 'di rnam par 'jig pa bsten te sgyu ma'i tshogs ni ma yin nyid/ /so yi nor bu kun dang skra de lhung ste tsa ke shā na do ṣāḥ/ /gā troṣ+ṭha he pra ha ra ti ma run ṣ+pe ba mo ha pra ro he ṣ+ṭha ṇa phye skyon ni ma yin nyid/ /lus kyi brtson 'grus rlung ni rab tu stor te gnyi mug myu gu min/ /mal stan la yo sha ya na sha ra ṇa sgyu pi treṣ+ṭha k+ṣa yā me/ /baṃ tsikhye ti pra mṛ ta bi ṣa brkyangs ⑪zad par gyur kyang bdag gi sred pa zad ma yin/ /de ltar bsams nas mi bzad dbugs 95—153

ma shā sa hikrā di te po pa r+ya s+t+ya hūṃ tsi ra pa ri ti tā mur+ya to lo brtsegs hig sogs rab tu rgyas gyur pas/ /'di ni yun ring 'dris pa'i 'jig rten spyod tshul 'phral ①la ka yā tram̐/ /rū tī bhū taḥsā dza na bi ra haṃ dh+yā ya ti dh+wasta hair+yaḥshat+ta ts+tsha tā gtong rtsom ste/ /lkugs gyur rang gi skye bo dang bral sems shing nus pa chad pa las/ /bstan pa nyams dṛ ṇa mi ba ma hata pāp+ta kā lo da ri draḥ/ /byu mo ge haṃ ba su pa ri dza dz+wa bu gyur dus la bab pa dbul ba ①bu lon chen po bzhin/ /re zhig sa dang khang pa nor dang g.yog 'khor bu tra dā rā di tsā n+yad+dhā baṭ+wā baṅka la ya ti bye yā pā ṇa par+yan+ta kā le/ /yā badz+dzad+ma dang chung ma dang / /srog ni mthar thug dus su blo yis de snyed gzhan yang bsams byas pa/ /ji srid skye n+ya pi pu na ra tso sne ha mo hā nu bame+esteste ran+taḥkṛ ta pa ri tsa yastad+ma ba la yang 'di nyid ①slad nas chags rmongs 'ching ba dag /de des nang du yongs su 'dris byas de yi yī bhā pa me ti/ / duḥkhaṃ duḥs ha pā pa kan+d+ra dza ni haṃ kum+bhi sa ha rang bzhin ngo bor 'gro/ /zangs chen stong phrag nang du sdig las kyis bskyed bzod par dka' ba'i sdug pān+ta re bhūk+ta ro ra ba kā la sru tra na ra keṭī brta te yo ni 6/ /yabye bsngal dag /spyad nas ngu 'bod be+eg nag dmyal ba rnams kyi skye gnas dag tu 'khor gyur cing / /gang pu ju ka nārdzi tai su kha pa rda tad saṃ k+ṣa ye duḥkha rda pā nā gā mi yang bsod nams chas bsgrubs bde ba'i gnas de yang dag zad nas sdug bsngal ster④/ /de slad phyir mi pha lap+ta ye bi ma la dhīstasmrata sa mā dhī ya lta/ /i ti dhī ma bha r+pā sgo bye 'ong bcas 'bras thob slad du dri med blo yis ting 'dzin mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi dge thob slad//saṭ+wā ra ṇa kṛ ta pra taḥ/ /sa mā di de sha bha ga bān sa tā rmā ku sha de skad srid pa'i chu gter ni/ /'jigs rung las sgol brtul zhugs mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lngasta ye/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa twa ba dā na yang dag bshad/ /ces ⑤pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa kalpa la tā yī gasgo ba krarnyi da sha ma pal+la waḥ// //dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mngal nas 'byung ba bstan pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu pa'o// //95—154

te kepi sa twa hi ta sarja hi tā nu ka pā bha bya bha badhe bhu ba ṣ+pe gang zhig mnyes gshin byams pa'i blo yis dge ba'i slad du ni/ /srid pa'i 'jig rten skyes bu bha pa tī ti bhā rdzu/ / bāt+pa l+ya be sha la dhi yaḥ ku sha khā ya sum̐ sī rnams kyis stimachog tu rjes 'dzin dag /'bad pas mdzad pa de dag sems can rnams la snying rje dang //kur+bharnyi ye pa ra ma nu gra ha mā gra he ṇa/ /n+ya gro dh+wa rā ma ni ra haṃ drabyu rjes su brtse bas khye nye bar gnas pa'i legs ldan su zhig lags/ /ser skya'i gzhi la n+ya gro dha'i/ /kun ka pi la bāstu ni / /bha ga bārnyi ya yo man+daḥ shākya rā dza su taḥpu dga' rar bzhugs bcom ldan 'das/ /blta phyir shākya'i rgyal po'i ①bu/ /dga' bo song bar gyur te ④ rā —/ /naiṣ+ka mya de sha nā man+t+ra ka thārnye pu raḥsbi tai/ /u bā tsa sngon—/ /nges 'byung gtam dang gros dag gis⑤/ /gtam mthar mdun na gnas pa la/ /rab tu byung bha ga bān bye t+yā pra bra bye gri khya tā mi ti/ /pra sā r+ya bhi ni t+yā gya tai ba mdzod cig ces/ /bcom ldan dgyes pas bka' stsal to/ /de yi drin la mngon dga' nas/ /na n+daḥ pra t+ya bhā ṣa ta / / bha ga ba na pu 5 la bhā pi pra pra dzñā bha dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /bcom ldan bsod nams 'thob mod ⑥kyang / /rab byung bdag ni ma tā na me/ /ta bo pa s+tha ya ko bhū tā bhik+ṣu saṃ r+ghaṃ ya dze+edz+re taiḥ/ /sarbo pa ka ra mngon mi 'dod/ /khyod kyi nye ⑦ /gnas su gyur nas/ /yo byad ci ⑤ltar bzhed kun gyis/ /re zhig dge be+e stu ba ta bhas+thā pa ri tsa rā mya haṃ/ /i truk+ta rat+na mu ku ṭi smṛṣ+ṭa slong dge 'dun la/ /gus pas bdag ni ⑨rim gro bgyi'o/ /'di brjod rin chen cod pan byus/ /de stat+yā da pi ka dzaḥ/ /rā dza pu traḥswa bha ba ā+oṃ ya yo dza yā sa murlu kaḥ/ /sa pun+da yi zhabs pad la reg nas/ /rgyal po'i ⑩bu ni btsun mo la/ /chags pas rang gi khyim du song / /de ni rī sa mā sā r+ya da yi hūṃ ra ti pun+da ri/ /bi dza hā ra ba rod+mā rna mu mdzes ma yid 'ong ma/ /dga' zhing mdzes dang yang dag phrad/ /yud tsam 'bral bar mi bzod pas/ /95—155

snurta bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsita bha ga bān pra kṛ h+ye ba gu ṇi skyed tshal mchog tu rnam par rol/ /de nas nam zhig rang bzhin byis/ /yon tan ldan dgyes ①bcom pri yaḥ/ /swa yo nan+da gya bha ba rna rnyi gru saṃ s+hoḥs hā ya yo/ /sā ldan 'das/ /dge slong tshogs dang bcas pa dag /dga' bo'i khyem du rang nyid gshegs/ /kun nan+da ba da naḥkṛ twa nan+dastat+pa da ban+da rmā/ /ta ma hā dh+wa sa nā si rna dga'i bzhin ldan dga' bo yis/ /de yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / /cher 'os stan la bzhugs de la//pū dza yi tā bya dzi dzhapata/ /ke ྾ pu ju pra ro hā rde pa ri bā ko ya m+bi mchod pa byas nas rim gro bskyed/ /gang zhig bcom ldan rang nyid kyisa'age / /gzigs pas rjes su bzung dri shaḥ/ /kṛ to yi yad bha ga ba tā dar+sha nā nu gra haḥsra yi/ /sga ra byas pa/ /'di 'dra bsod nams myu gu rnams/ /gang zhig yongs su smin pa'i 'bras/ /bdag nyid ṇi shra ba rde bā pi dar+sha dz+wa bā ma hāt+tha ram̐/ /se yo ku sha la bal+lī rmā ma chen po rnams dran nam/ /thos pa dang ni mthong gyur pa/ /'di de dge ba'i 'khri shing gi/ /'bras bu ha tī pha la sarnyiḥ/ /a gya mi tra su ma ha tasta dā lo kā gya dar+sha nāta/ /hri da chen po dag gi rgyunaldu / /khyod kyi snang ba byams pa ni/ /chen por gyur pa 'di mthong nas④/ /snying gi yāstsa bi ka sa shrīḥka gya nā ma na dzā ya te/ /da na da pi thra ya ta re chu skyes rgyas pa'i dpal/ /su zhig gis choni mi bskyed spyo'agyur/ /bdag nyid che rnams mthong ba ni//pu rgyu dā pi ma hā pha lo/ / sa da tsā ra da pi shra rgyu ma ha tsā ki sbyin pa bas kyang shin tu dka'⑦/ /bsod nams pas kyang 'bras bu che/ /spyod dubazang pas kyang la dar+sha dzā/ /i ti ta gya bru bā ṇa mya bhat+ta pra ṇa ya se sha lo/ /a bhe bsngags par 'os/ /de skad brjod de'i gus pa dang / /mdza' zhing byams pa nyid dag dang / /sngon du nan+da pu raḥpū rdzu bha ga bān gan+tu mur+ya yo/ /a nu bā bra dza tai nan+daḥmachod la mngon dgyes nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ni gshegs par brtson/ /dga' bo de yi rjes 'brang ba//95—156

swats+tsha ka na ka bhā dza ṣ+pe/ /ba ro pa tsā ra ma dā ya ma dhu ram̐ swa mi ba sha yo/ /rang gi gser rmi snod du ni/ /mchog gi nyer spyad dngar sti/po dag /rang gi bsam ①pa bzhin du blangs //pabyen+d+ra dza n+ta mā lo kya bhas+thā bha ga ba taḥpa ti/ /na rek+ṣu ta ka ṭāk+ṣe ṇa bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes bzhin du/ /gus pas bdag po bgrod mthong nas/ /'bral ba mi bzod mdzes pun+da ri bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /gu rū khyo ma gre sā sa ra la ta ra lā lo tsa ma yis/ /zur mig gis ni nges par bltas/ /bla ma rnams mdun mig gi 'gros chani drang zhing rab tu g.yo na ga to bi hā ye ba rgya shā tsi ta mu ku li tā spyi pri ya ta oṃ/ /ni rīs+thā ba dag /yangs pa nyid kyis sdezur mig rab mdzes cung zad bye bas mdzes pa'i mchog /blta bya bltas la sgyi ya ta k+ṣa ṇa ma ba na tā byut+ta da bye ka na gan+ta bye nā the t+ya ba da di ba mo nā nas gang zhig skad cig tu spyogyur de phyir lhag par ni/ /'gro bar mi bya mgon po zhes ni thub pa tshig med da ba tsa ā+oṃ/ /nan+daḥpra ṇa yi ni dṛṭ+wā sosgo tsā tsa li tā na nāḥ/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ /mdza' mo shugs rings ⑥ldan pa la/ /dga' bo bzhin ni phyir phyogs nas/ /a yā mā la ta e bā ha mi bi tsā rā di t+ya bhā ṣata/ /ta taḥswa mā shra mo praste bdag ni ring por ⑦mi thogs par/ /'ong ba 'di nyid ces rab smras/ /de nas bcom ldan rang nyid kyi//bha brnya kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /bra dzā mi swa kṛ had+dhā ba da t+yā ha bi ra hā sa haḥ/ /gnas su byon la thal sbyar nas/ /re zhig rang khyim mchi'o zhes/ /'bral ba bzod pa med pas smras/ /ta tasta mā sa nā sī naḥpra ṇa tai bha ga bān pu raḥ/ /u bā tsa sa smi ta ke yo ga de nas khrir bzhugs bcom ldan gyikhye/ /mdun du rab tu btud de la/ /'dzum dang bcas gsungs da ma ṣ+pe saṃ pra ti twa yā/ / bi ṣa yā swā da sau hā rda saṃ mo hā bye lta nyid/ /myur bar 'gro ba 'di ci zhig /yul gyi ro la gcags khyepa yi/ /kun rmongs kyis gzir tse ta saṃ/ /a ho kṛ ha su kha swe ba nirbe da bi mu khā ma tiḥ/ /gu rja bha sems ldan ⑩rnams/ /kye ma khyim gyi bde ⑩/ nyid la/ /yid 'byung las ni phyir phyogs blo/ /tshe yi rgyan ni 95—157

ra ṇa me bā yurbi be+e kā bha ra ṇa gu ṇaḥ/ /pra sha mā bha ra ṇabyu sau bai rā gyu bha ra ṇaḥyon tan te/ /yon tan rgyan ni dben pa'o/ /'di yi rgyan ni rab zhi ste/ /zhi ba'i rgyan ni chags bral sha maḥ/ /tadz+dza hūṃ ta da sa khya sha l+ya sha la shaṃ n+yaste su z-ibye ta si pāzlostaṅga lo—/ /snying sdug sems la bkod pa'i blun po de dang bzod dka'i zug rngu'i dum bu ste①/ /blo ldan ṇi tai bi tsā ra sa ma ye bai pha l+ya me bā yu ṣaḥ/ /yabye rā gya pi be ka shu n+ya rnams kyis de ni rnam par dpyad tshe tshe ni 'bras bral nyid du brtsis/ /gang yid phyugs bzhin chags bral ma na sa me te sa shu rmā ya thā yārgyu yārnyi tsa tsakra ṣ+pe me tsa la nairni dben pa yis stong mtshan nyid med pa rnams dag gis①/ /skad cig 'di dag 'ong dang 'gro ba yang ni lak+ṣa ṇa ā+oṃ k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /pu bye sa twa ba tsā khru tasma ti ma hūṃ shi lo tsa bi 'khor lo'i mu khyud g.yo ba bzhin/ /snying stobs ldan pa'i bsod nams blo ldan gyis thos ①rig byed ldan byā ba tī sa baṃ bhā gya ba hūṃ su khaṃ sha ma ba hūṃ ṣ+pe ba kwa tsi durla pa'i tshul khrims dang / /skal ldan dag gi thams cad zhi ldan rnams kyi bde ba 'gyur ④yang rnyed dka'i ⑤bhi / /du1 dhastu sa map+ta bstu ba sa teḥswawaṃ sha ke byā yu ṣastar+ya gya min—/ /mtha' dag dngos po'i rten gyur tshe ni shin tu chung ba'i cha yang ⑥ rnyed dka' ste/ /'bras med k+ṣa ya me ti nisga la ta yā sho tsā ya tasmi na maḥ/ /bā mā bste bi ṣa ya nyid kyis gang gis zad 'gyur mya ngan 'os pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul gyi chu gter g.yon ma'i klong ⑦dza la sgo pur+ṇa lā ba bye sa re dbyot+pa pyabyi ṣa ma ma ka ram̐ kodha ba khyo ba 'khyel 'jo sgeg chu yis gang gyur pa/ /dregs pa mi bzad chu srin rab langs mtshan ma ske'akhrugs pa ⑨bh+ya mā ṣ+pe/ /ni t+yā san+da pra tsa la bi ra ha brakhro pabye ḍa bldi sum̐ sī se tusta rab bskyed cing / /lhag par 'bral ba'i rta gdong me ni rab 'bar rtag tu gnas pa la/ /skyes bu rnams ra ṇa sa ra ṇi tī bra be+e rā gya me ba/ /tasmata gri hā ṇa pra bra rdzu rā ni sgrol lam chags bral drag po kho na bsdams pa'i stegs/ /de slad rab byung gzung bar mdzod/ /rgyal 95—158

dza pu tra dzi tedh+ri yaḥ/ /e tāḥste ya i ba k+ṣi pre sa mā ga su khāḥshri yaḥ/ /po'i sras ni dbang po thul/ /bud med bde dang dpal 'byor 'di/ /myur du yang dag 'grogs pa bzhin//kṛ ya tsā ku sha lā yi ba brah+ma tsar+ya pa ri gra haḥ/ /t+ya dza tā me ṣa niḥsā ra kṛ dge ba nyid slad tshangs pa yi/ /spyod pa yongs su bzung ①bar mdzod/ /'khor ba snying po med pa'i khyim//ha saṃ sā ra durga haḥ/ /i ti khru twa bha ga ba taḥka ru rja bha ra rde gdon ngan 'di ni gtang bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan gsung ni snying rje yis/ /brgyan pa 'di skad khyothos ba tsaḥ/ /pra t+ya bhā ṣa ta tan+dan+daḥpū bye pra ṇa ya yadh+ri taḥ/ /sa dā gyur nas/ /don gnyer mchod 'os kyis gdams ①pa'i/ /dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /rtag tu bha ba du pā yo ba pra bra bye bha ga bād+ma ma/ /bhi k+ṣu saṃ gho pa kā rārte kṛ khrod nyid bsnyen pa nyid/ /bcom ldan bdag gi rab byung yin/ /dge slong dge 'dun rim gror ni//ha e bā da ra pa re/ /i t+yā ghābha ga ba bākya ma ti krān+tu ma bhā shwa 'os pa'i khyim la mchog tu gus/ /de skad smras nas bcom ldan gsung / /bsgom bya'i dbang phyug min pa raḥ—/ /kri 6 mā ṇaḥpre yā presla so bhūjo lā ku lā sha yaḥ/ /pu na ཿpu nabya dang / /dga' ma la dgas drangs pas 'di'i/ /bsam pa khyogs la phyang mo yug /yang dang yang du kā rā su bha ga bān bra ta de sha rmā/ /u pa kā ror+ya tāḥsaṃ tabyen+ta bcom ldan gyis/ /'di la brtul zhugs nyer bstan mdzad/ /phan par brtson pa'i dam pa rnams/ /mi yahaṃ na yo gya tī/ /ya dā ṣ+pets+tsha ti nan+daspyo pra braṅgā ma dze tidh+ri yaḥ/ /ta dā gya 'os pa nyid mi bsam mo/ /dbang po ma thul dga' bo duni/ /gang tshe rab byung mi 'dod pa/ /de tshe de bha ga babye kya sa pa tata ba pu ṣi swa yo/ /muṇ+ḍaḥkā ṣā ya paṇ+ḍi naḥpā yis ⑤lus la de/ /bcom ldan gsung gis rang nyid lhung / / der ni de tshe spyo ngur sprig gos/ /mgo tra bā ṇaḥta ta k+ṣa ṇa/ /ba r+bha tsa m+bi ka ra ru tsirma hā pu ru ṣa lak+ṣa ṇiḥ/ /klum lag na lhung bzed can/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams kyis/ /gser byu 'od zer lta bur mdzes//95—159

sa sha sa nādzhai na myu byu dā ra rgya biṇ+ḍaḥpā ti kaḥ/ /a bā rā da nā gār+ya tī pra dgon pa pa dang bsod snyoms par/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yis der gyur to/ /khyim las khyem ni med nyid yā taḥr+pā shu ku li kaḥ/ /pri yā mu bā ha sa ta tai shā oṃ pra bra dzi to dang / /phyag dar khrod pa nyid du gyur/ /de ni rab tu byung gyur kyang / /snying la yang dag gcags stipi sa/ /sha shā ka i ba saṃ blte j-i da ye khāñtsha nats+tsha bo/ /ma na saḥspa pa yis/ /sngo bsangs dga' ma rtag tu 'dzin/ /zla ba'i mtshan ma mdzes pa bzhin/ /gang yang sems ḍi ka sri ba na be+ed+maḥke na baṭ+wā nā/ /rā gaḥko pi bi sha t+yan+taṭ+wā pe te kyi chags pa dag /bkrus kyang 'dag pa min pa gang / /lam ni gang nas lam ①du zhugs/ /shel gyi k+ṣa li to bi yaḥ/ /bi ra ha pāṇ+ḍa ra ru ཿsaṃ sagh+ra ru ṇa ṭī ba raḥ/ /sa san+d+ra bzhin du mi shes so/ /bral bas skya bor gyur pa'i 'od/ /chos gos dmar po yang dag chags/ /de ni bh+ra da lo ka gya dza hā ra sha shi niḥshi yo/ /bi tsa ran bi ha ran k+ṣa maḥthun mtshams sprin dum gyis/ /mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dpal 'phrog gyur/ /nags na rgyu zhing rol byed la//sa bi smri ta dh+ri tirba ṣ+pe/ /dzad+ma bi r+ya ma ā+oṃ ga gya na bi sa smra ra sun+da rī/ /rid cing 'dzin pa brjed pa de/ /lus med skye ba'i rig byed kyis(kye/ /mdzes ma dag ni brjed ma gyur//saṃ pūr+ṇa tsan+d+ra ba da nā ba da na dh+yā na nispru laḥ/ /a tsin+ta dhañtsi ram̐ tat+ta rdo ba'i gzhi la bsdad nas ni/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba'i bzhin ras kyi④/ /bzhin la bsam gtan g.yo du pa bi sh+ya shi khā ta le/ /a he bha ga bā tā pre ṣa kṛ to yat+na da med kyi/ /yun ring dag tu de de bsams/ /kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /'bad pas rjes bzung nu gra haḥ/ /nā yā ti ma ma be+e mya bye rā gā byeṣ+ṭha ta tse ta saḥ/ /khru 'di dag kyang / /chags pas byin brlabs bdag gi sems/ /dri ma dang bral nyid mi 'gyur/ /'khor tai saṃ sā ra tsa ri tai niḥsaṃ ga bra ta mā shri tai/ /ta thā pi mṛ ga sha bā ba'i spyod tshul thos gyur cing / /grogs med brtul zhugs bsten mod kyang / /ri dwags gzhon nu'i mig 95—160

k+ṣin+da bisma ra ti me ma naḥ/ /kādh+wa rku ku ma lasna rā ga su bha ge can ma/ /bdag gi yid la brjed pa med/ /mdzes ma'i gur gum gyis reg chags pa'i skal bzang lus gā tre kri tai ṭī ba ram̐ tasmi na sta na maṇ+ḍa la pra ṇa yi nā pā tram̐ dh+ri taspra la snam sbyar legs par bgos/ /de yi nu rgyas dkyil 'khor rab tu nyed pa'i lag pas lhung bzed legs ṇi nā/ /rā ga yo ma ma brta te gya ya di bā t+yā phye ba bridhiḥpa ram̐ yasgo par bzung / /gang zhig byang chub gegs su gyur pa stide la dmigs pa'i nyin mtshan bsam gtan can//bye bya ba dh+wa na byu ta ma ni shaṃ dh+yā ram̐ ta da lo ba rna/ /k+ṣa ṇi na rmā krāp+ta ma bdag gi chags pa dag ni gal te 'phel na mchog tu rigs pa nyid du 'phel/ /mdzes ma skad cig gis ni be+e hi muste tā me ba muk+ta ga ma ṣ+pe pu rastuta/ /a ho ma yā dar+sha na bispyo byu bdag 'ong zhes/ /sngon ni de la de ltar 'ong bar brjod/ /kye ma phrad pa'i bgegs gyur brtul zhugs tai partswata kṛ tasna bra ta me ta dās+ho/ /no gan+ta bya mi ti pra kadza ta 'di—/ /byas pa mi gzo ①bdag gis phyi ①nas blangs/ / gang de'i ④rab tu 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i tshig ra khā bākya ya du tse na sa saṃ t+ya bye bya dza ā+oṃ spru te gu ru dza ṣ+pe dza grwa ha parde gis 'gro bar mi bya zhes smras shing / /bla ma'i skye bo gnas tshe gang zhig rlung yab dor te thu ba nas kyang ⑤tsa lo/ /yat+pa de na li khan+da pi k+ṣi te ta lo mā mok+ṣa tā la k+ṣi tā bzung / /gang zhig rkang pas sa la 'dri duzhing mthong ba min ④yang bdag la zur mig mtshon/ /dgag te nā bye ni ṣe dha muk+ta bi bye na baspyon+ta yā me ma naḥ/ /mabe+e yughān sā nu ā+oṃ pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i rim pa de yis bdag gi ⑤yid ni de yis bsdams/ /bdag bral ri dwags mig she te sho ka pra lā pi byā/ /su li ṣ+pe tsakra bā tī ba habye ha ri ṇa lo tsa can de/ /'jug ngogs ngur pa mo bzhin du/ /ba gam can na mya ngan dag /sgrog cing mi nyal yod dam na spyo/ /hā pri ye t+yak+ta sa bye na ki ta be+e ṣ+pe ba ke ba lo/ /shri tai snyam—/ /kyi ⑨hud dga' ma g.yo can gyis⑫ / /'ba' zhig pa bzhin bden pa btang / /khyod kyi 95—161

twañtsit+ta tso re ṇa bi byā bra ta mi dasma yā/ / ta k+ta bra ta mi dad+dhā ba sems kyi (77chom rkun ngas/ /rdzun gyi krubartul zhugs 'di la brten/ /re zhig brtul zhugs 'di btang ta ga sgo mi dā yi ṭ+wā kai / / a nu rā gā ghi ta bhā rna ta pa stu nas—/ /mdzes ma'i gan kyedu 'gro bar bya/ /gang phyir chags pa'i mes gdungs pa'i④/ /dka' thub po hi duḥs haḥ/ /rā dza pu ṭī tsi rā yā tai 1 shaṃ sa ma ba lokya oṃ/ /gdung ba bzod par dka'/ /sdig can yun ring nas 'ongs pa/ /bdag mthong rgyal po'i bu mo de/ /marlu nā na ba lasne na na dzā ṣ+pe ki ka ri 6 te/ /na sarba tra bi kā rā ya ni gsar du skyes pa'i khro ba yis/ /ci byed par 'gyur yongs spyomi shes/ /mdza' la chags pa'i rdul gyi cha//kā raḥpre ma duḥs haḥ/ / durni pā ro bha ba h+ye ba sde ha li no ra dzaḥganod cing dga' med bzod dka' ba/ /nges par zlog ⑥pa dka' ba nyid/ /kun tu rnam 'gyur ka naḥ/ /yasmin k+ṣa ṇi bha ga ba tā pa sh+ya mi ra hi tai ba rna/ /ma yā nyid kyis bslad1she/ /gang gi dus na bcom ldan gyis/ /nags 'di btang bar mthong gyur pa/ /de tshe ta de ba gan+ta bya kṛ ha ma h+ye ṣa nibya yaḥ/ /asmirje ba shi lā par+bhe ru kho na bdag khyim du/ /'gro bar bya zhes 'di nges so/ /da ni dga' ba'i dmigs rten du/ /rdo yi tsi rigi ri dh+wa tu bhiḥ/ /le kha mi hūṃ sha shi mu khā+e saṃ pra t+yā lasba rgo dh+ri teḥ/ /a tha glegs bu 'di nyid la/ /ri 'ayi khams ni yid 'ong gikhye /zla bzhin ma de bdag gis bris⑫/ /yang na bā ka tha mā le khya bi ṣa yi yā ti sā pri yā/ /son+darlu bin+da bo ya sngaḥsu gang gis mdzes sdug thigs/ /bdud rtsi'i 3skye.ut+pal zla ba 'dra/ /mdzes ma de ni ri mo yi/ /yul du ji dh+wa ku ba len+da baḥ/ /dṛṣ+ṭirmugha ku ram̐ gī tsa la da li byastoh+phe lā brti ni ltar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog ri dwags mig ni bung ba g.yo bas khyab pa'i ut+pal 'khyil ba bzhin//lā ba stso da bye ku la bi dru ma ba rna bis+thā dha ro gra two ṣaḥ/ /nirdo ṣā mṛ ta 'jo sgeg chu gter 'gram du byu ru'i nags ltar mchu ni bim pa'i 'od rab gsal/ /gang yang kha yi 'od de 95byed162

rasmi sārja sha ra ṇiḥsā kā pi bagh+rarlu tiḥpun+dar+ya ka tha me ti tsi tra pā da bī skyon med bdud rtsi'i zer byu don ①mthun dag gi ⑤lam/ /mdzes ma 1lus ni ngo mtshar snying po ri mo'i mashār+ya pā ram̐ ba puḥ/ /i te sa tsiṣ+ṭha pa sha ṣ+pe ra li le kha shi khā ta lam du ji ltar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di bsams de yis ④rdo gzhi la/ /mchi mas bkrus shing 'dar ba le—/ /pun+da rī ma ka tha ma su shu s+thā ta ke r+pā ku dze+e gu liḥ/ /sa saṃ kalpa yis—/ /'khrugs pa'i sor mos ji ltar yang / /mdzes ma dag ni dal bus bris/ /de yis rtog spyopas sa mud gīṇ+ḍi pra ti bisba mi bā shri tsā/ /kṛ twa pu raḥthra ya ta mā ma tsā gsal byas pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu la brten par⑥/ /sngon du byas nas mdzes ma la mchi mas dar+pāt+pa gaṅga daḥ/ /thra yā mā li khya haṃ ni khi la su kha bṛṣ+ṭi na ya na yorna 'dzer 'dzer skad du smras/ /mig gnyis ma lus bde ba'i char rgyun ston ka'i ⑦zla ba'i bzhin ras can//pa sh+ya myubyet+paḥk+ṣa ṇa ma pi sha rastson+d+ra ba da rmā/ /a yon+tu rde ta rtswa mdzes ma bdag gis bris te mig chus rgyas pas skad cig kyang ma mthong / /gzugs can ma dang bral la bi ra ha na pe k+ṣu bra ta ba taḥsgu ran+ta baḥsha paḥki ma bi ma ma pā bā duḥltos ④med brtul zhugs ldan pa bdag la ni/ /sdig las ci yang gdung ba rab bskyad ⑨dmod pa zug pa pa na taḥ/ /phu l+lī sgo dza ba na tī ṣā smṛ ha dwa shā sakyā su tā yo ba pustuṅka lo ma yin nam/ /rgyas pa'i chu skyes nags kyi 'od 'dra dga' ba'i mig gis rjes su chags pa'i lus/ /de yi pa ga tān+ta rā ya dza ni taḥko paḥs mudṛ bye hūṃ/ /haṃ ho bun+da ri de nyi me pra ti dus na nye bar gyur pa'i bar chad kyis ⑩bsgrun khro ba yang dag thong / /kwa ye mdzes ma bdag la tshig lan ba tsata ki mo na mā labe+e se sa bye twan+ma ya rā ga ṭī ba ra mi baṃ tsin+ta byin cig mi smra bar ni ci la 'dug /bden par bdag kyang khyod la chags pa'i chos gos 'di bsam bra tai me bra tai/ /i ti bru ba khaṃ tai dṛṭī dru rā dā le khi tai ma rgo/ / brtul zhugs spyobartul zhugs so/ /de skad smra zhing bud med dag /bris pa ring nas mthong gyur nas//95—163

pā sru yā bhi k+ṣu bo bye t+ya bha ga ban tai ba bhā ṣi te/ /bha ga ban dube+e byā ta khro ldan dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs smras/ /bcom ldan khyed kyis ma gya bād+ma s+thā de ba ke ba lo/ /shu naḥku su ma mā le ba pra bra bye yo twa dul la/ /mnyes gshin 'ba' zhig pa nyid las/ /rab tu byung ba 'di byen te/ /khyi la me tog 'phreng ①yarbi tā/ /ā le khya pun+da rī ma kha nan+da swe re shi lā ta le/ /tan+d+ra khā ba dza pā ba bzhin/ /mdzes ma bris nas dga' bo ni①/ /rdo ba'i gzhi la dal bu yis/ /de brjod bzlas pa la sabyi dh+yā nā lasba na tī ga taḥ/ /e ta dā kabye bha ga bān+dan+da mā chags shing / /bsam gtan la ni dmigs par 'gyur/ /de dag thos nas bcom ldan gyis/ /dga' hā yā kā na nāta/ /ki me ta ri ti sa prats+tsha thra yā bi ra ha mo ti tai/ /so ma bral ba'i ①rmongs gyur pa'i/ /dga' bo nags nas bos nas ni/ /'di dag ci zhes rab tu bris//de ④bra bī ta bha ga ban sa bye kān+tarak+ta gya me pa ram̐/ /sgyigru hūṃ sasma te su smin smras bcom ldan bden par ni/ /mchog tu mdzes ma la chags bdag /dge slong rnams ni 'dod grur ba ṣ+pe na ra ma te ma nyiḥ/ /i di nan+da ba tsaḥshu tā ta rū tse bha ga bān kyang / /nags tshal 'di la blo mi dga'/ /de skad dga' bo'i tshig thos nas/ /zhal gyi zla ba'i 'od dzi naḥ/ /m+bi la yan+de ba bsten+d+ra kāṣ+ṭha rā ga sa ro tu haṃ/ /sā dho zer gyis/ /'dod chags chu skyes 'dzum pa bzhin/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas de la gsungs/ /kun tu bha ba na yuste saṃ rā gā da nu tsi tā ma tiḥ/ /bi sneṭ+wā kṛ 6 te tse taḥka chags las mi rigs blo/ /dam pa khyod kyi rigs ma yin/ /dge la mngon par dga' ⑤rnams kyis//s+thā ṇa bhi ni be+e shi ram̐/ / kā yi yo ga sta nu tre ṇa tu khā t+ya k+ta sems ni bgegs rnams kyis ⑥mi khugs/ /longs spyod rtswa yi gzegs mem dang mtshungs btang la mngon sgo gā bye yo ga ཿ kwa yo ni bye ཿ k+ṣa ṇa su kha la bā swā da saṃ bā sbyor rigs pa 'di ni gang / /skad cig bde ba'i cha yi skero myang tshogs dang 'grogs pa smad 'os 'di ni 95—164

daḥ / /dzā h+ye bā yo ha ra ti ku sha lo dusta ro mā ra mārgaḥpre mād+dhā gang / /chags pas long ba ①rnams ni gang du 'phral la 1nga byed bzod dkar gyur pa yi/ /bsgral nā bha ba ti sa ha sā duḥ sa ho ya tra yā ta ཿ / /i t+ya gya bha ga dka' bdud kyi lam 'di rigs nyid kyis ni dge ba 'phrog par byed pa yin/ /de skad de la chags bral bān kṛ tā tsi ram̐ be+e rā gya de sha rna/ /ta jo ta byā mi te kyuk+ta swa kṛ t+yā dag /yun ring bstan par mdzad nas ni⑤/ /'dug bya zhes brjod bcom ldan rang ⑦/ /rang gi bya ya swā yo ya yo/ /ta me bā ba sa rarjan+daḥsaṃ tsi t+ya ga ma ṣ+pe tsi tai/ /ba'i slad du gshegs/ /mdzes ma lta la chags pa yi④/ /dga' ldan dga' bo'i ⑤ gnas skabs der//pra tasbe swa kṛ haṃ hriṣ+ṭaḥpun+da rī dar+sha nokhru kaḥ/ /bra dzan dā ri pi ṅgā nābyebe+e 'gro bar 'os par ⑥bsams nas ni/ /rang gi khyim du chas par gyur/ /gtsug lag khang ni mang po yime//hā rirba hu bhibya rāta/ /na ga rā bye mu khaṃ mārge ka dze+e tsi da bābe+e sgo rnams bcad pas yun ring na/ /grong khyer mngon phyogs lam dag ni/ /ji zhig ltar stes thob nas bān—/ /a tha be+e dzñā ya sarba dzñaste rā gā ta gan+tu mur+ya tai/ /u ba tsā 'grome—/ /de nas chags las 'gro brtson de/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan byis/ /mkhyen nas bye t+ya bha ga bān nan+da tūṇ+ḍi kwa ga mya te/ /sa dza gā da ba rgo tā badha mngon phyogs bka' stsal pa/ /dga' bo mgyogs par gang du 'gro/ / de nas ⑨bcom ldan re zhig ni/ /ga ban+d+raste me ra tiḥ/ /na khya bi shān+ta tsit+ta rmā kri yā kā tsita pra sī da nyi/ /nags na bdag la dga' ba med/ /sems ni ngal bsos min rnams kyis/ /bya ba gang yang dag pa min//sā shrīstsa ma ra hā se m+bi ma ṇi mā yī sā ra mya ha rmya ba lī sā dpal ni rnga yab bzhad ldan de dang nor bu'i rang bzhin dga' ba'i ba gam 'phreng ⑪ ldan de/ /a phra'i bā khā ni la lo la tsū ta la ti kā kād+dhā na bor+yā na byuḥ/ /sā ta nī ku 'khri shing rlung bzhon gyis bskyod skyed tshal gsar pa'i sa gzhi mdzes pa de dang ni/ /me tog mda' can 95—165

su me 6 kārmu ka la tā k+ṣa mo da rī pun+da rī no dzad+mān+ta ra bā sa nā i ba ma gzhu yi 'khri shing gzugs bzang lto ba phra ba'i mdzes ma de dag la/ /skye ba gzhan gyi bag chags bzhin du na ཿ sa ste pi muñtsarnyi me / / sā rā ge ṇi ba ma na sā bra h+ma tsa dro bdag gi yid ni chags las rnam par mi grol lo/ /yid ni chags bcas kho na yis/ /tshangs par spyod pa tsa rā mya haṃ/ /bra ta pañdza ra badhe na bi haṃ ga i ba yadh+ritaḥ/ /bdag gis spyad/ /brtul zhugs 'ching ba'i gzeb dag gis/ /mkha' la 'gro ba bsdams pa bzhin/ /tak+ta bra dzā mi pra bra bye mastu me na ra ke k+ṣa yaḥ/ /na bī ta rā ga tā me gos ni tshon ①gyis dmar ba yis/ /'dod chags bral ba nyid mi 'gyur/ /rab byung btang nas bdag ti mañdziṣ+ṭha rak+ta saṃ shu kaḥ/ /i ti bru bā ṇa ma sa kṛ ta swa pa rda 'gro'o—/ /bdag gi dmyal ba zad gyur cig /de skad lan gcig ①min smra zhing / /rang gnas 'gro gan+tu mur+ya tai/ /ni bār+yā nu gra ha dhi yā ta rū tse bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /mā bar brtson de la/ /ldog ① cing rjes bzung blo gros kyis/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /shes kṛ thā bi sla baṃ nan+da nin+di tai bi shu ta shu taḥ/ /bibo ta dza no pa tujon ya ldan skye bo nyer sten ④la/ /so so'i skye bor mi 'gyur bzhin/ /dga' ba ⑤thos pas rnam par grags//thā yā ti thra thagyu naḥ/ /bi be+e ka byasta do ṣā hūṃ bi du ྾ shī la shā smad cing bslad pa ma byed cig /rnam par rig pas skyon bshig cing / /tshul khrims ldan pa mkhas li dzā/ /niḥsā ra su kha lo bhe na na kābye dhi pra brta te/ /gā zwa rā ga kṛ tī ta rnams blo/ /snying po med pa'i bde ba la/ /chags pas bya min la mi 'jug /mchog tu smad pa'i khang su dzu gube+e yā ta ṣ+pe pa re/ /dza ga n+ya karma t+yā sastiḥki ladz+dza dza na nī par ni/ /ngan pa'i las la kun tu chags/ /rgya chen 'dod chags 'dzin pa khyod/ /ngo tsha skye ba min pa te / /yo ni dza yo ni saṃ sak+taḥsta na pā sta na mji naḥ/ /a ho ra ta na lasgoste ci—/ /skye gnas las sdeskyes skye gnas chags/ /nu ma 'thungs pa nu ma nyed/ /kye ma ngo tsha mi byed pa//95—166
