dzad+ma bye ba la yo ga taḥ/ /sa dā sadz+dzan brdzi tāḥdza na byā dza gha nā sasti/ /skye ba nyid la brlag par 'gyur①/ /rtag tu dam pa'i skye bo spangs/ /ma yi sgom la chags gyur pa//saṃ mo hā ha ta tsiṭ+wā ā+oṃ pa shu na me ba dṛ byu te/ /rā mā ra ma ṇa mā no sems ni kun rmongs kyis bcom pa'i/ /phyugs rnams nyid la mthong ba yin/ /bud med skyes pa'i nga yi bi ra mya t+ya bye tsā twa yā/ /sgo giḥ sa ha bhu dza gā ram̐ dṛsgo bha rgyal 'di/ /khrod kyis dga' dang bral nas thong / /srid pa'i khung bur lag 'gro rnams/ /longs spyod ba bi le k+ṣa yaḥ/ /dza gha t+yā dza na ya bye ba na ka gya bi ra two ra tiḥ/ /dang bcas 'jig pa mthong ①/ /sgrom las skyes pa'i dga' ba dag /su yi yid 'byung skyed mi bskyed⑪//ya sde bha ba nyi par+yadhe sha pi nā ma pa rādru khaḥ/ /kṛ ha dzā la pi muk+taspyo kin+t+ra gang gi mjug tu khyi rnams kyang / /nges par kha ni phyir phyogs 'gyur/ /khyim gyi rgya las rnam grol khyod//de bā bhi dh+wa ba ta si/ /na hi nirga t+ya ba ram̐ gaḥpu narngi sha ti bā gu dzā/ /i de nyid du mngon rgyug pa ci/ /gang phyir ri dwags thar gyur pa/ /be+er yang rgyar ni 'jug pa min/ /de ti bākyā ta bha ga ba taḥshā sa ṣ+pe na bi yadh+ri taḥ/ /tsin+ta yan pun+da rī nan+daḥskad bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa'i/ /bka' yis nges par gdams ④pa yi/ /dga' bo mdzes ma sems pra bi be shā shra ma pu naḥ/ / ta taḥka dā tsi dā di sh+ya man+da mā shra byed cing / /slar yang gnas su rab tu zhugs/ /de nas nam zhig dga' bo la/ /gnas khang phyag dar ma mārdza ṣ+pe/ /ā sa nā nu gra ha bya graḥpra ya yo bha ga bān pu nāḥ/ /bsgos ⑤nas ni/ /phongs pa'i ⑥rjes 'dzin la brtson pa'i/ /bcom ldan slar yang rab tu gshegs//tasgo sa nāta pra brit+ta gya nan+da snga shra ma sho dha ṣ+pe/ /na bhū ta lā da pa ya yo de yi ④bka' yis gnas khang ⑧dag /spyod la rab zhugs dga' bo yis/ /bsams ⑨pa las ni 'dod ra rdo rā ga i bā sha yata/ / ta snga hahūṃ ga ta sngarja sha li lo pā chags bzhin/ /sa las rdul rnams yongs khya 7ma song / /yongs su spyod pa'i chu dag ni/ /len du song 95—167

ri sgo gi shaṃ /mu huḥpūr+ṇa sa mutrīp+taḥshu bye e ba bha bta gha ṭaḥ/ /te na bisna na bar gyur pa de'i/ /yang yang bkang zhing rab blangs tshe/ /bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ /bgegs ni de ga ma ṣ+pe su ta dzā khin+da mā na saḥ/ / tak+ta tu pra ya yo nan+daḥpun+da yis yid dag ni/ /shin tu skyo nas 'gro ba'i slad/ /mdzes ma blta ①bar 'dod pa 'di④/ /dga' rī dar+sha nodru kaḥ/ /a tha be+e dzha ya sarbaste yar+ghaṃ di bya tsagru ṣā/ /ba bhā bos ①btang nas rab tu song / /de nas re ba brtan pa yis/ /'gro ba de ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /lha yi ṣe sa ha sā bye t+yaste bha mā na ma no ra thaḥ/ /pa tra yo ge na tap+ta gya spyan gyis mkhyen gyur nas/ /'phral la mngon phyogs bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma mdza' ba'i snum gyi dri/ /shā ma rak+ta ru tseḥpa ram̐/ /a ho sne ha ka lo kaste dī pa gya ba na shā mya ti/ /snod du sbyar bas tsha byed cing / /khyod kyi duchags pa mtshan mo'i 'od/ /mar me bzhin du zhi mi 'gyur//a lo bā mā rnyi la ṣe ṇa byā lbo rā ga i bai ṣa te/ /saṃ sak+taḥko pi z-i da g.yon ma mchog tu mngon 'dod pas/ /ci yang khyod snying la chags 'di/ /da dung yang ni ⑤mi 'bral ye yan+da byā bye bi ra bye se/ /arnyi ka ro ti pra ram̐ bhe ra tistata kā la te—/ /gang zhig rams kyi tshon bzhin no/ /chags pa rab tu brtsams pa'i tshe/ /de dus 'jigs shing ka ta re/ /ā liṅga ti dzu gusme ba pra briste mu khye ga saṃ ga me/ /bi ṣa long bar byed/ /yan lag gtsor bgrod rab zhugs tshe/ /smad pa nyid kyis kun tu 'khyud/ /yul gyi ya swā da saṃ ge na pa pā mi tre ri be+edz+re yiḥ/ /duḥs ha bya sa nā brte yā nyams myong dang 'grogs pa/ /sdig pa'i grogs lta'i dbang po yis/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'khyil ba t+ya te na ra ke na raḥ / / a dhi bā sa ya ti spar+sha le she nā yis—/ /dmyal bar mi rnams 'phen par byed/ /'grogs ⑥ngan reg ⑦pa'i cha yis kyang / /lhag par pi ku saṃ ga maḥ/ /pra klin+da mat+pa ku ṇa pā ta pū ti garnya i boṅga taḥ/ /ka s+thā rab tu sgo bar byed/ /nya dang ro ni rul pa yisape/ /dri nga rab tu ldang ba bzhin/ /dge ba'i grogs 95—168

ṇa mi tra saṃ parkaḥsarba thā ku sha la ba haḥ/ /shu bha mo da i ba byap+ta yaḥka ro kyis reg gyur pa/ /rnam pa kun tu dge ba 'dzin/ /dge ba'i dri bzang gis khyab bzhin/ /gang zhig tī ma hārta hūṃ/ /i h+phuste ta su bha ga bā na sā k+ṣu ta sa da sa twaḥ/ /pa thiḥrin ni chen por byed/ /'di brjod de la bcom ldan gyis/ /dam pa dam pa min pa'i lam/ /mngon du spasgo na saṃ dbye tsakre ta྾ ga re sha rmā/ /a tha nan+di sa mā da ya reg pas dri bstan nas/ /grogs ni de dag bstan pa mdzad/ /de nas dga' bo bcom ldan byus//bha ga bān garnya ma da ni/ /ya yo gī ridze+e tsa ma rī bā la bya dza na bī dzi khyer nas ri yi dbang po ni/ /spos ngad ldang ba'i ①ri dwags kyi④/ /rnga ma'i rlung yab g.yob par tai—/ /ta tra dā bā na la p+luṣ+ṭa ma niṣ+ṭa kliṣ+ṭa bi gre haṃ/ /kā rde marka ḍi ka ma gye gshegs—/ /der ni nags mes tshig gyur cing / /mi sdug shin tu rid pa'i lus/ /spra mo zhar ma de la ni//dar+sha yi twa ba dalja naḥ/ /i me ba sh+ya pi ki nan+da mābye nibye ta rā kṛ bstan nas rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /dga' bo 'di ni mthong ngam ci/ /dman ①pas shin tu smad pa'i ti—/ /kasmi tsi du tsi tā tse yo ro tsa ti thra ya dar+sha nā/ /saṭ+wā sa da sa yid④ —/ /'di la'ang su zhig 'os pa yi⑤/ /dga' mar mthong nas sred pa yin/ /legs dang mi to nās+t+ri rā gaḥpa byu ti ra mya tī/ / sa ta su kha li to lo ke yo legs yod nyid min/ /dga' ba nyid du chags pas lta/ /'jig rten na ni skye bo gang / /gang gi ya gya da yi to dza naḥ/ /bak+ṣa pā tai sa muta thra bye sa h+ye nan+da twa yo tsu tī/ /a myusta dga' de de yis dga'/ /'di dang mdzes ma de yi ni/ /mdzes pa'i bar na khye7 ci zhig yod/ /dga' bo myubyu pun+da r+yā lā ba ju gya ki man+ta re/ / a na rmi twa d+ma yo ṣ+pe ba khyod kyi phyogs lhung dag /rab tu thong la bden par smros/ /bdag gis don du ma gnyer slad/ /sau n+da r+yā n+da ra be di na ཿ / / abe+e thra ya twa ma yā ti tsa tsā tu mdzes pa'i khyad nyid rig pa med/ /don du gnyer na dga' bar 'gyur/ /dga' ba nyid na mdzes pa 95—169

tai—/ /pa shā mya haṃ bi she ṣe tu nā su ta subya kri tsa na/ /ra mya two rmā sa tsarmā nyid—/ /'di dang de la khyad par dag /ngas ni cung zad ma mthong ste/ /sha pags ①rus pa'i 'khrul sbi yadhe sa ma yā mā tra rmā/ /i ti thrasgo bha ga ba tā nan+da ste pra t+ya 'khor la/ /dga' bar dam tshig byas tsam nyid/ /de skad bcom ldan gyis dri ba/ /shin tu rigs min bhā ṣa taḥ/ /a t+yan+d+ra nu tsi ta prashāḥko pi go ra ba yadh+ri taḥ/ /ki me dris gyur cing / /gang yang bla mas gdams ④gyur pa'i/ /dga' bos de la lan gsol pa/ /bcom tata bha ga bān bat+ta ke lo sho ke bi ḍadza nāḥ/ /ka pya bā bi shwa gu ra bo bi ni yā pra ldan de skad ci la gsungs/ /gang 'di mya ngan la co 'dri/ /kun gyi bla ma gtso bor ni/ /gyur pa su yis bha baṃṣ+ṭa baḥ/ /ra tiḥsā bye pun+dar+yāḥpa ra bha ge na rā bye te/ /yo dṛṣ+ṭa dza ga rnam par dul/ /mdzes ma yi ni dga' ba de/ /mchog gi cha la ①mdzes pa ste/ /'gro las rgyal ba'i hūṃ dze tā na ra ti sma ra ti sma raḥ/ /byesgo ye ba na taṅkadh+yā mo da te ku dran pa yang / /gang mthong dga' ma mi dran no/ /de yi mdzes pas ku mud tshal/ /dga' bzhin zla mu dā kā raḥ/ /gu rjan+ta ram̐ na dza nā ti pra sirnyi sha ra ḍo dza naḥ/ /ba ba'i 'od kyis khyomin/ /grags pa'i lam 'gro blun po yis/ /yon tan khyad par yongs ⑤mi shes/ /de rtan+ta yā ba da na sau ra bha sā ra tso ra mā lokya put+pa ni tsa yi pri thu ke yis spyome tog tshogs rnams bzhin gyi dri bzang nor la ni/ /brkus ④par mthong nas rab tu rgyas pa'i skra sha pa she/ /ma bye bi lā sa ga ti lo tsa na kārnyi tso rid+dhā bye ba tshogs dag la bcings/ /'jo sgeg 'gros dang mig gis mdzes pa dag la brkus ⑧gyur pa'i/ /ngang pa haṃ sa ha ri ṇirba na me ba yā tai/ /a nadze+e ཿsaṃ kasterba hu bi dha ri dwags 'jigs bzhin nags nyid du ni bros sam snyam/ /ri dwags mig can dpe med ma de yongs be+e kabye ra nu pa mā na sā gā ram̐ gāk+ṣi li khi tu ma pi shākya pa ri tsi taiḥ/ /'dris brtag pa mi nyung zhing / /rnam mang rnam par rtog pas kyang ni dri ⑨bar nus pa nyid ma yin//95—170

tu lnga ro he ya gya ba da na pa ra bhā ge la ghu ta yā sa byu dz+wa tā rā shā ga ga na gang gi bzhin mdzes dag dang srang la gzhal tshe yang ba nyid kyi ①na/ /rgyu skar bdag po de ni mkha' la ma bye rū zwaḥpa ri bṛ snyeḥ/ /pu ju pra bye la li ta pa li ta byu la tā lā mya lbo lhag par 'dzeg ④pa ma yin nam/ /bsod nams kyis 'thob yid 'ong smin ma'i 'khri shing g.yo ldan sgeg lā ra bye ta snga ya di na ba da rna nan+da 8 la bh+ya te tata/ /pra bra bye cing rol/ /de yi bzhin ni yid 'phrog dga' dang ldan te gal te ④mi 'thob na/ /rab byung 'dis yo su kṛ ta ma bye shaṃ ki ka ri 6 to me kasmra de tai bra ta pa ri ka ram̐ bhā bdag legs byas lhag par ci zhig bgyid 'gyur 'di yi sbad/ /brtul zhugs yo byad khur du gyur pa 'di ra khyu ram̐ ba hā mi/ /i ti nan+da ba tsaḥshu tā bha ga bān rā ga nir+bha ram̐/ /dag ci sbad bdag 'khur dulags/ /de skad dga' bo'i tshig thos nas/ /chags pa rab tu rgyas pa de//uspyo su pra bha be na tai ni nā ya su rā la yi/ /a dar+sha pats+tsha ta tra gya lī bcom ldan rang gi mthus blangs nas/ /lha yi gnas su phyin par gyur/ /brgya byin dga' tshal de ru ni//lor+ya ṣ+pe sha ta kra toḥ/ /su d+mā man+d+ra sa mudhū tāḥkān+d+raste da sha yo ṣi taḥ/ /bdud rtsi bsrubs las rab 'khrungs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo mdzes pa dag /de la rab tu bstan par gyur//a ru ṇiḥkārnyi sarja ṣ+peḥbā da pad+ma ba no di taiḥ/ /a nu yā tā i bī sgo bye rkang pa pad tshal las 'khrungs pa/ /mdzes pa'i rgyud ni dmar po yis/ /chu gter ngogs kyi byu ru yisabu//kyu la bi dru ma kān ṣ+peḥ/ /bi shā la khā su sa tsi baiḥpa ṇi bhirbi dzi tsā nags kyi rjes su 'khrid pa bzhin/ /yongs 'du lhan cig skyes pa yis⑥/ /yal 'dab chags pa ltar bu dzāḥ/ /saṃ sak+ṇiḥs ha dza sri ba pā ri dzā ta gya pal+la baiḥ/ /kārnyirma dhur+ya gyur pa/ /rol zhing ⑦sgeg pa'i grogs po yis⑤/ /lag pas chu skyes dag las rgyal/ /mdzes shing yid la li tairma da nā nan+da bārnya be+eḥ/ /he la ni m+bi li tsā sgo dza ba da ṣ+pe 'ong rol pa dang / /'dod pa kun tu dga' ba'i grogs/ /chu skyes bde blag nyid du ni/ /'dzum byed 95—171

byan+d+ra sau da reḥ/ /sasmo ha ṣ+peñdzu ba ṣ+pe: kṛṣ+ṭa sā rirbi lo ka ṣ+peḥ/ /zla ba'i 'gran zla dang / /kṛṇ+ḍa ①sā ri'i ①mig dag dang / /kun rmongs gso bas nag mo ni//ka la ku ḍats+tsha ḍa smṛbye ra mṛ to ghi ri bā bṛ tāḥ/ /pūr+ṇa yo ba na brtsegs pa'i ri mos reg pa yis①/ /bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis dhibaskor ba bzhin/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho lā ba byeḥs ha me+e ba bi lokya tāḥ/ /nan+da sā nan+da ba da naḥswe da rdzogs gyur pa/ /de dag mthong nas 'phral nyid du/ /kun dga'i bzhin ldan dga' bo ⑤ni/ /rdul s+thā ta i bā bhā bta/ /pad+ma na nā su bi pu lot+pa la lo tsa nā su kun+da mi tā pu byis bkrus pa bzhin du gyur/ /pad+mo'i bzhin ras dang ni ut+pal rgyas pa'i mig /kun da'i 'dzum dang me ni be+e ḍa sta ba kasta m+bi 6/ /nan+da gya tā su z-i da yo yu ga pa ta ni pa ta do lā bi tog tshom bu'i nu rgyas can/ /de dag rnams la dga' bo'i snying ni cig car du/ /phyogs lhung bung ba rol khā sa ta ra lā lbo tu lā ma bā pa/ /ta taḥpro bā tsa bha ga bān nan+de taṅga ta mā na saṃ/ /cing g.yo ba dang mtshungs thob/ /de la yid song dga' bo la/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs//a snga saṃ dar+sha ṣ+pe nan+da thra t+ya te ra ma te ma nyiḥ/ /ā sī ta gya: pun+dar+ya dga' bo 'di dag mthong ba dang / /chags pas khrod blo dga' 'am ci/ /'di rnams dag dang mdzes ma khā ba ṇi ki ya dan+ta ram̐/ /uṅkasteḥpa ra bhā ge na sgu ḍa e ba be+e bha de'i—/ /mdzes sdug khyad par ji snyed cig /gzhan gyi cha las rab gyur pa/ /gsal ba kho nar rtogs bye te/ /ni rasta pun+da ri byu paṃ rū ba mabe+e ra r+pā ya di/ /ta de tā e ba kā le na par bya/ /gal te lha mo rnams kyi gzugs/ /mdzes ma'i gzugs pas lhag pa na/ /de phyir de dag kho na ka ri6 mi two da shra yāḥ/ /ā ra ge ṇi ba ma na sā brad+mā tsa bye pra sad+ma nyid—/ /dus kyis khyod la brten par byas/ /re zhig rab tu dang ba'i blo/ /yid ni chags bral kho na byeḥ—/ /tsa ra tā bat+ta taste haṃ dā su myabe+e ra tsā ga ṇi/ /e baṃ bha ga ba yis—/ /tshangs spyod spyod cig de nas ngas/ /lha mo'i tshogs ni khrod la byinarjo/ /de ltar bcom ldan 95—172

to bākyān nan+daḥsaṃ dzā ta nibya yaḥ/ / ta the truk+ta bra te tse tabya kre gsung gi ①ni/ /nges pa skyes pa'i dga' bo yis/ /de bzhin zhes brjod brtul zhugs sems/ /mtho swa.ā+oṃ ga nā shā yā/ /man+da da raḥswa dā re gu swa bhut+tahūṃ ga r+pā ts+tsha yā/ /ris bu mo'i bsam pas byas/ /de dang ②'grogs 'dod gyur pas desal/ /rang gi chung ma la gus dman//gu ṇa pa rgya tu lo bye tertswaste sne ha su sa t+ya tā/ /a ho be+e smṛ ta saṃ ba yon tan zong mtshungs dga' ba yis/ /mdza' ba bden pa nyid ma yin/ /skyes bu'i goms skyes mdza' sa pra ba sa pa ri sho ṣi tā/ /sum̐ sā mā sgyu si tī spru tiḥs ha pā n+ya tra dh+wa ba ni/ /gzhan du yongs su dman pa yis/ /kye ma gnas ni brjed gyur nas/ /'phral la gzhan du rgyug ba ti/ /k+ṣa ṇa yo ba na ra myu ṇi pre ma ṇi pra ṇa ya bya yiḥ/ /na pa dh+wa ni na pa nyid/ /skad cig lang tsho dga' ba yis④/ /mdza' ba gcugs pa nyams pa yis/ /bden pa ma yin ni t+yā ni su khā ni ba sha rī ri rde/ /ta to bha ga ba tā nan+daḥk+ṣa rjam+bi rtag min te/ /lus can rnams kyi bde ba bzhin/ /de nas dga' bo bcom ldan gyis/ /skad cig gis ta swa mā shra saṃ/ /tam+bi: yāt+thah+ma tsaṅgi tsa tsā ra ni ya ta bra taḥ/ /sa ni rang gnas khyer/ /des pa de yis tshangs spyod ni/ /dul ba nyid kyis sdebartul zhugs spyad/ /mdzes bi sa smra ra pun+dar+yāḥkārnyi sa pa da ma n+ya dhīḥ/ /k+ṣa ṇa pra mu ṣi tā spru ti ma ma'i mdzes sdug phun tshogs pa/ /gzhan byi blo des brjed spyopar gyur/ /skad cig rab nyams dga' ba ni//khā ni yā ti gu ṇi ṣa pi/ /ta taḥka da tsibyi tsa ra na nan+daḥkā pi bya lo ka yon tan la 'ang dman par gyur⑦/ /de nas nam zhig dga' bo ni/ /rgyu bas rab 'jigs dmyal ba'i ya ta/ /ka rā la na ra kā sak+ta dī mā kusnyi z-i tā bhu baṃ/ /tai bi tshogs—/ /'jigs rung zangs chen 'dzin pa yang / /'ga' zhig dag tu mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong lo bye ba sā kadzaḥki me ta di ti duḥkhi taḥ/ /sapa prats+tsha ta rā sak+ta na nyid la sgesdug bsngal zhing / /'dar bar gyur pas 'di ci zhes/ /de yis de nas khyatshogs pa yi//95—173

gho ran na ra ka ki ka rān/ /te ta mū tsu ri yi khyu mista pa na kusnyi sha tā tsi 'jigs rung dmyal srung rnams la dris/ /de la des smras tsha ba'i sa①/ /zangs chen rgya ④ni rdzogs pa tā / /kalpi tā rā dza pu tra mya nan+da snga tan+da rā gi ṇaḥ/ /mi byā bra taḥb nā byā 'di—/ /shin tu chags ldan rgyal po'i bu/ /dga' bo la ni byas pa yin/ /chags bral nyid ni da dung bi bha dza te bī ta rā ga hūṃ / / bra h+ma tsazlo tsa ra h+ye ba swarga byā yang / /brtul zhugs log pa de mi sten①/ /mtho ris bud med 'grogs bsam ④pas tshangs par pa ga mā sha yā/ /mi byā pra tā rmā lud+dhā rmā rā ga dwo sha ka ṣā yi spyod ⑤pa spyod pa nyid/ /brkam ⑥chags log pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /chags sdang snyigs ma can rnams dzā / /e to su ni t+ya tabhā su kusnyi ṣe bā k+ṣa yaḥk+ṣa yaḥ/ /i ti nan+daḥs māgh+ra kyi—/ /rtag tu tsha ba'i zangs chen ni/ /'di dag 'jig pa med pa'i gnas/ /de ltar dga' bos yang dzā ta ro rmā tsa rka tsu kaḥ/ / ta tra rjo tā mi ba ta rnu partswaṭ+wā pā da dag thos/ /spu long gos ltar rgyas gyur cing / /der ni rjes su gdung ba yis/ /lus po dum bur gyur ma t+yā ta/ /sa ma bye t+ya t+yak+ta rā ga saṃ bā sa bā sa naḥswa yi/ /ba bzhin sems/ /gnas su mngon song 'dod chags kyis⑦ / /bag chags zhen pa btang byas nas/ /bla byu bā nut+ta ra brah+ma tsar+ya par+yāp+ta saṃ ya maḥ/ /gha na mo hi k+ṣa yāt+ta gya med tshangs par spyod pa ni/ /yongs su rdzogs shing dul bar gyur/ /nang du the tshom rnam grol cing ④ //bi muste saṃ sha man+ta taḥ/ /ma na pra sā da ma pe de sha ra dī ba da dī pa yaḥ/ /stug po'i rgongs pa zad las de'i/ /yid ni rab dang thob gyur te/ /ston ka'i klung gi chu bzhin no//niṅgā maḥpra sha ma pās+t+ya pa re nijo mu pā ga taḥ/ /shudhe dhīḥs ma bye t+ya bha 'dod pa med cing rab zhi thob/ /mchog tu nges par der zhugs pa/ /dag ⑨pa'i blo yis bcom ldan la//ga ban+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /nābe+e ro tirna pun+darlo bhā ga ban kṛ t+ya maste me/ /yang dag mngon du phyogs te smras/ /bcom ldan bdag la bya ba ni/ /lha mos yod min mdzes mas min//95—174

e tāḥpar+yān+ta bisgo yaḥpā pa thā bi ṣa ya shri yaḥ/ /ya thā yā the yo bhā bā dzā gnod pa dang bcas yul byi dpal/ /'di dag mjug ni mdzes dang bral/ /ji lta ji ltar dngos rnams bhā bya te niḥswa bhā bā tā/ /ta thā ta thā pra sbo darnyi ni rā bā ra ṇa brit+ta kyi—/ /ngo bo nyid med 'di bsgoms pa/ /de lta de ltar sgrib pa dang / /bral ba'i spyod tshul rab gsal yaḥ / /i ti nan+da su ba da taḥprap+ta sngartata pa dam sha naiḥ/ /bha ga bān pa gyur①—/ /de skad smras pa'i budaga' bo dag /rim gyis dgra bcom gnas thob pa/ /yongs su mya ngan ri ni r+pā ṇa shu r+ghaṃ sedhi ma ma n+ya ta / / ke ྾ ku sha la phru khā dzā 'das 1pa dag/ /'grub par bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag gi④//nan+de nā sā di tai pha lo/ /i ti bhek+ṣu bhi ra bye t+ya thraṣ+ṭa ta na ba daljo naḥ/ /'bras bu dga' bos thob gyur ces/ /dge slong rnams kyis mngon phyogs dris/ /rgyal bas de la bka' stsal pa/ /dzad+mā n+ta rā rdzi tai ཿ pu bye ཿ su kṛ tā bh+ya sa kā ri rja / / pā be+e ku skye ba gzhan bsgrubs ⑤bsod nams kyis/ /legs byas goms par byas gyur pa⑥ / /dga' bos dge sha la spru lā ram̐ nan+de na pha la sadza taḥ/ /bi pu la bi ma le baṃ she dzad+ma sma ra ba'i rtsa ba yi⑦ / /'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /dri med yangs pa'i rigs su skyes shing dran pa'i pra ti mā ta nu su kha dza na sa khā+e lakhro thratrīḥpri yā sa ta haṃ sa tām/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i lus/ /dpal 'byor skye bo bde ba'i grogs mo spyod tshul dam pa rtag tu dga'//pra sha ma sa li la s+thā tai tse taḥswa bhā ba ga tirga tiḥku sha la ku su ma su sems ni rab tu zhi ba'i chus bgrus rang bzhin lugs kyi 'bros ⑧ldan 'di/ /skyes bu rnams kyi dge ba'i yo sum̐ saṃ bi shā la pha loṅga tiḥ/ /stu be+e be+e pa bye naḥsamyaka sa budha gyarda raḥpu rā/ /me tog dag gi rjo'abras bu cher 'khrungs yin/ /a ru ṇ+ḍa ldan grong khyer du/ /sngon tshe sa bdag a ru ṇ+ḍas//na garlu ma ru rja ba kyā mā ru ṇi na ma hi bhu dzā/ /kri ya mā ṇa ma dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten ni/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin 95—175

ṇi ma ma maitro nā ma dī dzād+ma dzaḥ/ /ma ha taḥpu bye sgo ga su bhā gī kā ra byed pa la/ /byams ldan zhes pa bram ze'i bu/ /bsod nams chen po'i bgo skal gyis①/ /skal ldan ka tai ya yo/ /sa e pa bhigru saṃ gha gya dzed+dhā ka s+thā na pa tra kṛta/ /tata byed po nyid du gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun bsro khang sbyin khrus byas/ /de yi pu ju pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na dzā to kṛ ha pa ti ku le/ /sa pu byu shi laḥpra h+ye ka bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /khyim bdag gi ni rigs su skyes/ /bsod nams ngang tshul de ni sngon//busgo pa s+thā ya kaḥ su rā/ / stu paṃ tsakre sho bha na ste mā khā bhi bha rang sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas gyur/ /mdzes ldan 'phreng dhibs mngon brgyan pa'i/ /rab 'bar mchod ra ḍo dzā lo/ /tata pu rgya pra ṇi dh+wa de na kṛt+taḥkā shi pa tiḥsu taḥ/ /so bha rten dag kyang byas/ /de yi bsod nams smon lam gyes/ /de ni legs skyes zhes bya ba/ /kā ①sha'i ba tarlu ti mān nā ma di bya la k+ṣa ṇa la k+ṣi taḥ/ /kā shā pa khyarta taḥbadag po kṛ tī'i ④ bu/ /gsal ba'i mtshan kyis mtshan par gyur/ /dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs sa myahūṃ bu dha sngan+ta dṛdṛ to/ / sa p+ta rat+na ma ma stu pe kṛ te rgyas—/ /'od srungs mya ngan 'das pa'i mthar/ /mchod rten rin chen bdun rang bzhin/ /kā ⑤shi'i kā shi ma tī bhu dzā/ /tarlu nu rlu ti ma na hi ma ts+tshat+tha mā ro pya bhā swa re/ /sa yi bdag po'i sdebyas/ /de yi bu ni legs skyes kyis/ /'od gsal gser gyi gdugs dag btsugs//dzā tastan+d+ra ṇi jo ṣ+pe na nan+da shākya ku le dhu nā/ /i ti su kṛ ti sa mubye ཿdga' bo de yi smon lam gyis/ /da lta shākya'i rigs su skyes/ /de ltar sngon skye'i rim pas thob pa legs purba dzad+ma kra māp+taḥki ma pi bi pu la pu ju re ba nan+daḥpā pe de/ /ku la byas kyis babe+eng ba'i/ /gang yang yangs pa'i bsod nams kho nas dri med rigs dang ni/ /yid 'ong ma ma la mu da ram̐ rū pa ma gyi tsa sgo shaṃ sha ma pa ri tsi ta madhe sat+pa gzugs dang longs spyod mchog dang zhi ba yongs 'dris mthar/ /dam pa'i gnas su legs par 'gro ba 95—176

da so ga tai/ /ka tha yi twa ti bha ga bān nan+da ka spyo ṇa kā ra r+ṇa/ /dag kyang dga' bos thob/ /dga' bo dge bar mdzad pa la/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan gyis//tsa kā ra bhi gru saṃ gha su tsā tī su kṛ ta de sha dzā/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra dge slong gi ni dge 'dun la/ /legs byas de de bstan par ①mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā pa dā na kalpa la tā yī pun+da rī nan+d+ra ba byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mdzes dga' bo'i du dā na me kā da shaḥpabe+e waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gcig pa'o// //a ro ha ti pa da mun+da ti ma ma la ma tibe+e ma la ku sha la so pā ṣ+peḥ/ /na ra gong na med pa'i gnas su dri med blo/ /dri ma dang bral dge ba'i skas la 'dzegasakhya/ /blo gros dri ka ku ha re 6 ni pa ta ti ma li na ma ti gho ra ti mi re 6/ /shākyā rmā na ga re ma can ni dmyal ba'i khung / /④'jigs rung mun pa 'azibs pa dag tu lhung ⑤/ /shākya rnams kyi grong pūrbam+bi te ka pi la bstu ni/ /ma ha taḥshākya mu kha su su mu khā+e dā pa ka khyer sngon/ /ser skya'i gzhi ni rab rgyas par/ /shākya'i gtso bo chen po yis⑥/ /'bangs kyi bu mo bzhin n+ya kā/ /shāste kṛ ta shra mā sarba ka la kau sha la shā li bhā/ /mkhra kā nā bzang ma/ /bstan bcos dag la ngal ba byas/ /sgyu rtsal kun la mkhas dang ldan/ /yon tan rigs ma kā ma su mā li ke ba gu rte tsi ta/ /pra sgo gi rā ba rod+mā ṣ+pe ku ldan 'phreng ④can ma/ /zhes pa 'dod pa'i 'phreng ⑧ba bzhin/ /skyed tshal mchog na rje bo yi/ /tshig su mā ba tsa yor+ya taḥ/ /bh+ra marnyi sa mā yārnyi da dar+sha su ga tai pu raḥ/ /gis me tog 'thu brtson pa/ /de yi mdun du bde gshegs ni/ /'chag cing yang dag 'ong ba mthong //ta gyarnye mā lo kye ta pra san+da ma bha bad+ma naḥ/ /sha rad kā la i ba swats+tshaḥpra pā de mthong nyid na de yi yid/ /rab tu dang ba dag tu gyur/ /ston ka'i dus ni dri med kyis/ /yid ri 95—177

da ya nyi mā na saṃ/ /so tsit+ta yat+ta dā lo shaṃ pā t+yā z-i di kṛ tā su dā/ /rab tu dang ba bzhin/ /de mthong las stibasgrubs dga' ba dag /gnas par byas pa des bsams pa//su kṛ te piṇ+ḍa pā tai me kṛ sgo yā ta bha ga bān pi/ /bi rnye ya ta suḥsarba rnye bdag gi bsod snyoms legs byas kyis/ /bcom ldan len par 'gyur ④na zhes/ /snying rje rgyas pa'i kun saṃ kadze+e ka ru rja ku laḥ / / pā hūṃ pra mārdzu bha ga ba na bha dre mkhyen rmis/ /de yi brnag pa kun mkhyen nas/ /lhung bzed bstan nas gabacom ldan gyis/ /bzang mo ④de tī t+yā bā tsa tī/ /da tā pra ṇa mya bā ta sri pa ri pūr+ṇa ma no ra thaḥ/ /pra ṇi dh+wa byin zhes de la gsungs/ /re ba yongs su rdzogs pa de⑤/ /de la phyag byas phul nas ni/ /'bangs mo'i ā+oṃ pra bi da dhe dā gya duḥkha ni bṛt+ta ye/ /ta taḥka dā tsi dā ya taḥpi sdug bsngal zlog 67pa'i sbad/ /smon lam dag ni byas par gyur/ /de nas de yi pha yi grogs/ /gnyis tusta suḥs khā dī dzaḥ/ /be+e min+ti ka ste pra de sha dṛṭī bithra to ba da ta/ /skyes nam zhig 'ong ba ⑦yis/ /mtshan ma ldan pa'i phyogs mthong nas/ /ya mtshan gus ④ pas de la smras//a ho kṛ ha pa te ta su pu ṭī two shrī ma taḥsu tā/ /ban+dha tī nā ga ta dā kye ma dpal ldan khyim bdag de'i/ /bu mo gnyen ⑨dang bral gyur cing / /nor dang longs spyod spangs sri dha na sgo ga bi brdzi tā / /a ho mo ha gha nā ram+bha k+ṣa ṇar+ya ta nas ni/ /bu mo khrod ni 'bangs mor gyur/ /kye ma gti mug sprin dag gis/ /brtsams pa'i ⑩skad cig na bid+ku taḥ/ /saṃ sā ra sarba sa ra nā be+e lā sa tsa pa lā shri yaḥ/ /ka stso gsal ba'i glog /'khor ba sbrul gye lce dag gis⑪/ /rol pa bzhin du dpal 'byor g.yo/ /dge ma khaṃ mā kṛ thash+yidzñā dzā ṣ+pe haṃ hasta lak+ṣa ṇiḥ/ /a tsi re ṇi ba byu brturbabe+e dogs pa ma byed cig /ngas shes lag pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /ring po min pa nyid na khrod/ /sa yi bhā two bha bi byā pi/ /i dadza shā mi te pā ṇi lasmre ka ma la ko ma le/ /bdag po'i dga' mar 'gyur⑫/ /khyod kyi lag pa dpal mo yi/ /pad ltar mnyen pa'i 'phreng ba dag⑫/95—178

mā la tsashrī ku sha kā ra mi kyuk+ta pra ya yo dī dzaḥ/ /a tha mad+ma tha saṃ 'khor lo lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'di mthong / /de skad brjod nas gnyis skyes song / /de nas yid srubs sgo ga swa z-id+me dhū pa ba rnya ba ཿ / / la tā lo ga na sau bhā gya bha longs spyod grogs/ /sprang rtsi 'thungs pa ①rnams kyi gnyen/ /skal bzang 'khri shing 'khyud byed pa//byo dṛ sh+ya ta ma dha baḥ/ /ma sgo ki sha ri ṇasta gya kān+ta mā na dī pa legs ldan dpyid ni mthong bar gyur⑤/ /mdzes ma'i nga rgyal gnyis 'thung dgra/ /dpyid ni ral ba ldan dwo ṣaḥ/ /bi ba sgo j-im+bha mā ṇa gya dzi dh+wa bā shwa ka mañdza rī/ /bā la ka po la pa dag /glal bar byed pa'i lce bzhin du/ /mya ngan med pa'i dog pa mdzes/ /gzhon nu'i 'gram pa khā ba rgya tso rabyadza ka saṃ tsa yaḥ/ /su dṛ shaṃ ke sha pā she bhu ya yo mjos pa yis⑦/ /rkun po tsam pa ka yi tshogs/ /mig bzang ④ma yi skra zhags la/ / bcings par ⑤brnya na yo gya hūṃ/ /sa ha kā be+ebe+e ra hi d+dhā ni dha rna bi da dhe ma dhuḥ/ /ni 'os pa nyid du gyur/ /dpyid kyi 0a mra'i me tog gis/ /khyo dang bral rnams pha rol bsgral/ /mthu ra pe k+ṣaḥpa ra ba dhe bi dhu rāḥpra bha biṇ+ḍa baḥ/ /ya yurma dhu la hūṃ tsu ta ldan rnam par ma thul ba/ /gzhan dag 'joms la ltos ⑦ pa med/ /sbrang rtsi 'thungs pas a spo yiske//la tā nir+bha ra sgo gya tī / / sa ha me+e ba be+e dad+dhā nā mi ba mugha bi 'khri shing mchog tu spyad ⑨byar gyur/ /yid 'ong longs spyod mkhas rnams kyis/ /'phral nyid gcad rmye byu ta yaḥ/ /tsū tā yu dhabyu ta la tā tsā pa ṣ+pesta shī li mu khaḥ/ /dza ya tī par bya ba bzhin/ /a mu'i 'khri shing gzhu la mda'/ /bkod pa a phra'i mtshon dang ldan/ /rgyal grur ti dza go ba ban+di kan+dargya gye ba ko ki laḥ/ /asmin+da ba sa re shrī mān cig ces bdag dregs la/ /slong ⑪mo ba bzhin khu byug sgogs/ /skabs 'dir ko sa la yi dbang //ko sa len+d+ra pra se na dzita/ /mṛ gā yā nirga to shwa na ju taste de sha mā ya yo/ /dpal dang ldan pa gsal rgyal ni/ /ri dwags 'ded du song ba dag /rta yis khyer nas yul der 'ongs//95—179

be+en+da ma no bha bā kā raḥso ba tīr+ya tu ram̐ ga māta/ /da dar+sha na n+ya lā ba rgya gzhu ldan yid 'byung rmyernam pa can/ /rta las babs par gyur pa das①/ /mdzes ma dga' ma gzhan pa ra ti mi bā pa re / / ta ju lo ka na bi rgyu rte ma na sta bzhin—/ /mdzes sdug gzhan yod min pa ④mthong / /mig gi lam nas ya mtshan las/ /yid 'byung ④gya ma hāt+tha naḥ/ /pisma diṣ+ṭa mārge ṇa pra bi be+e sha ma no bha baḥ/ /hūṃ lardzu rab tu zhugs gyur te/ /bdag nyid chen po de yi yid/ /de la lta 'dod rnam par rgyas/ /'phral la ba na tsā dṛ ṭī sa ha sod byu ta sā dh+wa rmā/ /a tsin+ta ye ran+da ra 'jigs pa snyerab gyur cing / /ngo tshas gdong btud de mthong nas/ /mdzes ma'i rlabs can gyis pa ti ཿ kādhī ka khro li — z-i ta ཿ / / ke yo na bā sha shī mu khā+e byā phrogs pa'i⑥/ /mi yi bdag pos bsams ⑦ par gyur/ /gang gi mdzes pas nyin mtshan du/ /mig gi mā ta ra khā ta rak+ta/ /yaṭ+wārnyirni shaṃ ṣ+pe tra sha ta pa tra bi kā shi be+e/ /ba 'dab brgya rnam rgyas byed/ /gzhon nu zla bzhin sngo bsangs ma/ /mig 'bras g.yo ldan ma 'di su/ /pā ku khā mo da bi bhān+ta bh+ra ma re pā ṭa khā dha re/ /kārnyi ba sarnyi pa sh+ya mi mu ḍa la mchu ba ⑧ ku la'i/ /dri bzang la ni bung ba bzhin/ /'di yi bzhin la me tog mtshon/ /dpyid khe sngaḥku mu dā yu snye/ /a ho khā ba rgyu ma smra rna tā ru rgyu bha ra r+ṇa ta dang mdzes pa mthong bar gyur/ /kye ma mdzes sdug mi dman zhing / /lang tshos ⑨rnam par brgyan ⑩pa'i noḥ—/ /dhī ra sgyu bi j-i tibye na shaṃ ke shaṃ ka le te ba me/ /a hon+da ma lus—/ /brtan ldan bdag gi'ang brtan pa ni/ /gang gis brkus pa bzhin du dogs/ /kye ma sbrang rtsi'i dhū mañdzarluḥpra raste surtse to gu ṇaḥ/ /ye na gabye na shagho ṣat+pa do bi dog ⑪pa dag /rmad byung yon tan rtsom pas kyang / /rkang drug pas kyang rkang las rkang / /gang gis pa dā ta pa rda/ /i ti saṃ tsin+d+ra bhu pā la ste ma tā ba na de ba tā/ /bṛṣ+ṭa 'gro ba'ang tustem nus so/ /de ltar bsams nas sa skyong gis⑫/ /de mthong nags kyi lha ru shes/ /de 95—180

bi be da tabyer+ghaṃ kra me ṇa ka thi tai ta ya/ /ta tasta tra kṛ tā ti justa yā yis rim gyis bshad pa yis/ /de yi spyod tshul rnam par rig /de rjes der ni gus byas te/ /de yis pal+la ba bi dza ṣ+peḥ/ /shu tsi shī tebya sha li leḥprap+ta bān nidṛ tai dṛ paḥ/ / yal 'dab rlung yab dang / /gtsang zhing bsil ba'i chu yis kyang / /mi bdag bde ba thob par gyur//shān+taḥsaṃ bā te na ta gya ta yā tsa ra ṇa pad+ma yoḥ/ /kṛ te kā rāk+ta saṃ spasgo sa ni de yi zhabs kyi pad+mo ① dag /de yis mnyes shing lag pa yi/ /chu skyes reg pas ngal ba de/ /'phral la d+dhā sa ha sāp+ta bān/ /k+ṣa be+e na pra ti busgo tha pa shān+ta mṛ ga yā shra maḥ/ /gnyid dag thob par gyur/ /de nas skad cig gis rab sad/ /ri dwags bdas pa'i ngal ba bsos//de bya spasgo na tsā me ṣ+pe ra to rū dzā tā rā ga tsā/ /ma hā na pi ta taḥshākya de ni lha yis reg pa yis/ /dga' ma gzugs gzham/ gyur par 1shes/ /de nas shākya chen pos kyang //saṃ pāste ko sha le shwa ram̐/ /khru tā tai de —ga ma bhe t+ya pū dzārta tai ma byu dza ta/ /ko sa la dbang 'ongs pa dag /thos nas de la mngon phyogs te/ /mchod par 'os pa de la mchod//sā da re ṇ+ḍabe+e tārnye na swa su ta mi ba mā li hūṃ/ /rad+dhā dh+wa ya da do tasmi gus bcas blangs pa'i 'phreng ①can ma/ /'dod pa'i bkra shis me tog 'phreng ④/ /de yis rang gi bu mo sma rā rmā ga la ma li rmā/ /tā mā da ya ma no dzad+ma bai dza yarnyi si tā bzhin / /rin chen 'os rjopa de la byin/ /'dzum dkar yid las skyes pa yi/ /ba dan de ni blangs smi tsā/ /ni rdza dza gā ma na ga re ga dza mā ru khya bhu pa tiḥ/ /tarmin nā ga na byas nas/ /sa yi bdag po glang po la/ /zhon nas rang gi grong khyer song / /glang po ri bo'i steng de na//gohūṃ ge pa lo lā la ka ṣat+pa daḥ/ /ba r+bha rā dza ba sen+ta na saṃ ga tā na ba mā lan bu g.yo ba'i bung ba can/ /rgyal po dpyid dang 'grogs pa yispye/ /gsar pa 'phreng mecan ma de li kā/ /rā dzā dh+wa no pa mā sā r+ya pun+dar+yā sa hi tasta yā/ /rat+na harmya ka ro dā ra mdzes—/ /mdzes ma de dang lhan cig tu/ /rgyal po'i pho brang phyin nas de/ /rin chen ba gam 'od zer 95—181

man+di re bi dza hā ra saḥ/ /bar+ṣa kā rā bhi dh+wa de bi rādzhaḥpra tha ma can—/ /yid 'ong khang par rnam par rol/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo sngon ma ni/ /lha mo dbyar gyis rnam pabe+e bhā/ /a bhin na thratrī tā me no rā dza lasmri mi ba k+ṣi two/ /di bya spasgo pa'i ming ①/ /spyod tshul tha dad nyid min sems/ /rgyal po'i dpal mo sa gzhi bzhin/ /de ni de yis ①na sā ta suḥsā tsā snga ru pa saspa dā/ /pa raspa ra gu rtoṅka r+ṣa bisma reg pas dang / /de dang ①de yi gzugs bzang gis/ /phan tshun yon tan phul byung bas/ /mchog tu ya mā ya tuḥ/ /di bya rū pa ba tī byejo di bya spar+sha ba tī pa ra/ /i ya mtshan ldan par gyur/ /sngon ma lha yi gzugs ldan dang / /phyi ④ma lha yi reg ldan zhesarjo/ /ngo ti pra bā daḥpābyabyesta yo lo ke 6 pa pra je/ /a tān+ta re ta yordi bya mtshar ldan pa de dag gtam/ /'jig rten dag tu rab tu grags/ /bar der de dag lha yi ni//rū pa saṃ spar+sha kā ra khaṃ/ /ā shra me bhigru bhiḥpriṣ+ṭaḥpro bā tsa bha ga wā gzugs dang yang dag reg pa'i rgyu/ /gnas su dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas rab na dzi naḥ/ /pu rā khru ta bā rā khya su dī dza su kṛ ha me dhi naḥ/ /kān+d+ra shi rī ṣa tu gsungs/ /sngon tshe thos mchog ces bya ba/ /gnyis skyes khyim par gyur pa yi/ /chung ma mdza' bo bukā tse ti thra ye bhārle ba khyu ba tuḥ/ /sa ka dā tsi da thā kān+ta yā tra pra bra dze+e yā mdzes ma dang / /shi ri ṣa ⑦ka zhes par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig mdzes ma yi/ /ming po rab byung khad sha ṣ+peḥ/ /pra h+ye ka budha hūṃ yā taḥswa sur+bha ba na mā ya yo/ /tre mā bi ko kyis ni/ /nyi che'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur pa/ /sring mo'i khang par 'ongs par gyur/ /bdag po'i bka' pa tsā re ṇa sa ta yā pa t+yā rā dzha yā/ /bhabh+ya ni madh+ri tistaspo tata pa pasngu yis de yi ⑧de/ /zla ba gsum byu rim gro yis/ /gus pas mgron du gnyer te gnas/ /de yi chun ma ba sgo dzi taḥ/ /te tsā ru mṛ du bher sgo gista ma sgya phywa n+ya dzad+ma ni/ /dzā te dhu nā yis kyang mchod/ /mdzes 'jam longs spyod dag gis testi/ /de dag gis mchod skye ba ni/ /da lta lha yi 95—182

tsā tu rū pa de bya saṃ spar+sha saṃ yu te/ /kṛṣ+ṭi 6 pra tha oṃ pra yuk+ta gzugs mdzes dang / /reg pa yang dag ldan par skyes/ /dang po ① 'dul ba dag dang rab ldan phun bi na yā mā dā ya go sadza dā saṅge tre 6 ta paḥpra tabe+e ta nu 6 pāste ṣa sum tshogs pa'i go bzung rmos byas shing / /dka' thub dag gis rab gdungs lus kyi zhing bzang shin tu tī bā du tsā / /yaṭ+wā le shu bha bī dza sup+ta mu tsi tai saṅka n+d+ra sha steḥgashin par gyur pa la/ /gang gi ②dus su dge ba'i ④sa bon rigs btab de ni m+bin cing rab 'bar ba'i//pa ram̐ byu byedhe pha la saṃ pa daḥsu ma ti bhista sri ba pa ko dz+wa khāḥ/ /i ti sarba 'bras bu phun tshogs mchog tu dam pa'i las la chags pa'i blo bzang rnams kyis spyod/ /de skad thams snyo pa tsa dz+wa ta bya mā kakhyu bhek+ṣa baḥ/ /tat+ta je ti bi ni: t+ya ba bhū cad mkhyen pa'i gsung / /bden pa dge slong rnams kyis thos/ /de de bzhin zhes nges byas nas/ /zhi nuḥshān+ta saṃ shra yāḥ/ /a tha kā le na bhū bhartu rmā li kā yā ma byu ta su taḥ/ /ba la ni brten ④par gyur/ /de nas dus kyis sa bdag giphyi/ /sras ni 'phreng ‘kyecan ma la gyur//bi rū bhā kā khya nā m+bi ya tshe khyo bi byā su tsa kṛ ta shra maḥ/ /thra yastu l+ya ba yasta mya pu tshe bar 'dir zhes bya ba'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum ma tshang ba ma dpe rnams la sa ma rnyed pa shā sī ya zhes pa 'di 'dar los gsar du bcug pa rgya dpe dhed na dpyad/'phags skyes po zhes bya ba ste/ /rig dang sgyu rtsal rab sbyangs pa'o/ /de yi mdun na 'don gyi bu/ /ma ro hi ta su pu to bha bta/ /mā turduḥkhe na dzā tra twad bi shu to duḥkha mā tri yis ④sdug bsngal gyis btsas pas/ /ma la gnod ces rnam grags pa/ /na tshod mtshungs pa dāmadza' bor kaḥ—/ /ka dā tsita sa nyi taste na ha yā rū phyo bi rū zwa kaḥ/ /pā pa shākya pu rod+mā rna gyur—/ /nam zhig de dang lhan cig tu/ /'phags skyes po ni rta la zhon/ /rtse zhing sngon la song ba dag /sbo ga yā ke nirga taḥ/ /n+yak+ka rañtsa kri re ta tra shākyasta srod+ma tā yu ṅgāḥ/ /a shākya'i grong gi byed tshal phyin/ /'di ni nged ⑨kyi 'bangs mo yi/ /bu zhes dregs pa rab smra ba'i/ /shākya yo dā r+pā su tāsma ka mi ti darngu pra bā di na/ /ga twa swa su re te bye bai rnams kyis ⑩mtshon bzung nas/ /der ni de la tho 'tshams ⑪/ byas/ /rang gi grong khyer song nas des//95—183

ran+da bya ma tsin+ta ya ta/ /ku la dar+pā pa do nyi sha lca to daḥsha rī ri ṇ+ḍi/ /de ni ①khon lan bsam par gyur/ /rigs kyi dregs pas smad pa ni/ /lus can zug rngu lcags kyu yin//ta gye ni rda khya mā na gya tata pra tī kā ra byun+ta yā/ /rā dzñā pa dzā tā dza na ke dz+re de la lan bya'i bsam pa yis/ /yid ni nges par bsregs pa de/ /yab ni 'tsho duyang rgyal srid la//ba t+ya pi pa raḥspro hā/ /sa tsā rā ya ṇa mu khyu ram̐ marnyi rde sha ta pañtsa ka/ /mchog tu 'dod pa skyes par gyur/ /de yis ①ring spyod la sogs pa'i/ /blon po brgya phrag lnga dag ni//swa ba shaṃ pi tu rā kṛ 6 bi da bye bhe da yut+ta bhiḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsi ta saṃ dzā ta pha las spyad ④nas dbye ba yis/ /rigs pa rnams kyis rang dbang byas/ /de nas nam zhig sa yi bdag /bi be+e kaḥthra thi bī pa tiḥ/ / dharmo pa de sha shra ba ṇi baspyo mā nā da gsal rgyal rnam rig yang dag skyes/ /chos kyi gdams ngag mnyan pa la/ /gus pa mchog 'phel legs raḥpa ram̐/ /tsā rā ya ṇa kṛ tī tā shwa ra tha mā tu khya saṃ ya taḥ/ /drahūṃ dza shā ma bsdams pasaskye/ /ring spyod kyis ni rta bzung ba'i/ /shing rta dag la zhon nas ni/ /thams cad mkhyen sarba dzhai bha ga ban tai pra se na dzi ta/ /pā snga shra me bha ga ba taḥpa bcom ldan 'das/ /blta ba'i be+ed du song bar gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas phyin tedu//kṛ tā bā dā bhi ban+da rna/ /dharma nā yo sa shu shā ba tas+thā sā da pra san+da byeḥ/ /zhabs la mngon par phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi drin byis dang ba'i blos/ /chos kyi rjes 'gro de yis thos//tsā rā yā rto byā shu ga tā ra the na na ga ram̐ dza bāta/ /a ka re dan+ta re tasmin mgyogs pa nyid du ring spyod kyang / /shing rtas grong khyer myur song nas/ /skabs der rgyal po'i bu dag ni//rā dza pu tā bhi ṣe tsa rna/ /bha ga ban+ta ma thā marja dṛ pa nyirgan+tu mud+ma mngon par dbang ni bskur bar byas/ /de nas bcom ldan la zhus nas/ /mi yi bdag po 'go brtson traḥ—/ /da dar+sha nā nu ga na gre na ra dze+e na tsa madh+ri r+ṇa/ /sa babh+yo me pas④—/ /mdun du rjes 'brang mthong ma yin/ /shing rta ma yin blon po'ang min/ /rkang pa nyid kyis 95—184

ba sha na kaiḥpra sbi tai thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /dru rā da pa sh+ya dā yarnya bar+ṣa kā rā sa bdag de/ /dal bus rab tu 'gro ba yis/ /dbyar gyi rnam pa 'phreng ①can mar/ /bcas pa ring sa mā li rmā/ /te thraṣ+ṭa taṅgi rā dzñā tā so bhi ṣik+ta bi rū zwa shaṃ/ /bi sa nas 'ong ba mthong / /'phags skyes po ni dbang bskur ba/ /der ②dris de yi tshig gis shes/ /bu yi sardza su tai shwar+ya pa ri sgo gā ya mā li rmā/ /bar+ṣa kā rā sa mā dā ya sa dpal 'byor yongs spyad slad/ /'phreng ṣ+pecan ma ni de yis btang / /de yis dbyar byi rnam pa bzung //mi tra gya ma tī pa teḥ/ /a dzā ta sha tro na ga re shā pa rā dza kṛ hā nyi snye/ /grogs po sa yi bdag po dag /ma skyes dgra yi grong khyer ④ni/ /rgyal po'i khab ces brjod par phyin//sa tap+tabyu tra bi ra hāta k+ṣuh+phi pā sā shra mā nī taḥ/ /ya yo ba mam+bi ṣatshwa saṃ gdugs dang bral bas de gdung zhing / /bkres skom ngal ba dang ldan pa/ /rnga yab rlung dag ring po yis//dir+bhe: ma ra mā ru taiḥ/ /su kha mam+bha li tai ke na pābe+e ka snga yu rā ya rna/ /shugs ni gtong ⑤ba bzhin du gyur/ /'jigs med bde ba su yis thob/ /tshe ni su yi dbang du gyur//na ka s+thā nu pa de dṛṣ+ṭaḥs pa di sadza daḥ/ /sa dz+rer+ṇa rū la ka bhughā su la duphun sum tshogs pa ni/ /myur bar dze+erjes su nyams ma mthong / /de yis las kyi rtsa ba bzhin//karma mū la mi bā ya tai/ /k+ṣa ram̐ bī tā tsa pā bhā ya pa pā tāp+ta bi su tsi kaḥ/ /ring ba'i la phug rnying pa zos/ /chu yang 'gyur byed 'thungs pa yis/ /gnod pa kun gye tshogs gyur pa//a ni t+ya tā ma bi dzñā ya mo hā ya ba ta te dza naḥ/ /sa tsā pā ya ni kā ya gya kā lus kyi thabs la sred pa yis/ /mi rtag pa nyid mi shes par/ /rmongs pa'i slad du skye bo 'bad/ /ma ya phyo pā ya dṛṣ+ṭa yā/ /a dzā ta shatruḥkhrute ba ko sha le shwa ra mā ga tai//zhu'i nad kyis ⑧thebs nas 'gyel/ /ma skyes dgra yis ko sa la'i/ /dbang po 'ongs pa thos gyur nas//a bye t+ya dzā shu pūr+ṇa sri bi ga tā sum̐ da dar+sha tai/ /ta gya dzā yā nu yā ta gya sa song nas ⑨rdul gyis kha gang zhing ⑩/ /srog dang bral ba de mthong gyur/ /btsun mo rjes su zhugs pa de'i//95—185

kṛ tā de ha sad kri yī/ /bha ga brnyi ya yo drabye su ga tai duḥkha shān+ta ye/ /lus ni legs par bya ba byas/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i be+ed du de/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs lta ru song //sa tai pra ṇa mya pra bā tsa bha ga bān ko sha le shwa raḥ/ /pu radz+re su dṛ daḥpā bya de yis de la btud nas smras/ /bcom ldan ko sa la yi dbang / /grogs po bdag gi grong khyer du//nisgo no ni dha ā+oṃ ga taḥ/ /byed+mā ma sadza rda pā paṃ mo hā da ya sha saḥpa 'ongs nas nor med gum par gyur/ /gang gis grogs la phan pa dag /byas pa min pa'i dpal 'byor rda—/ /bi bha bo ye na nai ba yi mi tro pa ka ra ju kṛ taḥ/ /j-i da ye 'di—/ /bdag dang phun tshogs smad cing sdig /rbongs las grags pa min pa'i sbad①/ /rgud tshe snying bi ni be+e shā shaṃ prap+taḥsu dz+dza da mā ba di/ /su z-irje pha spyo mā yā te yā mya kidhe la re ba dag /rnam par bkod nas grogs thob pa'i/ /grogs po 'bras med nyid gyur te/ /gang zhig na dz+re ba tā/ /mi tro pa ka ra khaṃ lakhyi dī no pa ka ra khaṃ dha ā+oṃ/ /dh+wa to 'tsho ba de yis ci/ /grogs la phan pa'i dpal dang ni/ /phongs la phan pa'i nor dag dang / /'jigs pa ka ra khaṃ pā ṇ+ḍa ye hūṃ te ྾ su dz+re bi tai/ /ku karma ki kṛ tai te na bha ga ban la phan pa'i srog gang yin/ /de dag 'tsho ba legs pa yin/ /bcom ldan skye ba snga ma la/ /de yis las pūrba dzad+ma ni/ /ya su sā ke na par+yarnye pra pe de po pi durda shaṃ/ /a ngan ci zhig bgyis/ /gang zhig sman 1nas mjug tu ni/ /des kyang gnas skabs ngan pa thob/ /sa nyi dṛṣ+ṭaḥk+ṣi ti she na bha ga bān pā khru tsagru ṣā/ /tā mu tse tā pa sha ma 1 bdag mig ni mchi ma dang / /bcas pas 'di dris bcom ldan gyis/ /gdung ba zhi byed tshems kyis ④ni//di shan da sha tsadh+ri ke/ /mā shu tsa dṛ thi bī pā la swa bhā bo yo bha ba sbi teḥ/ /zla 'od spro zhing der bka' stsal/ /sa skyong mya ngan ma byed 'di/ /m+bid par gnas pa'i rang bzhin no//e baṃ bi bye ba bhā bā na ma sa t+yā nā ma ni t+ya tā/ /bi pā ri sa sā ra ba nādhe rnam pa 'di ltar dngos po ni/ /bden pa min rnams mi rtag nyid/ /'khor ba'i nags nang rnam par 95—186

smin ṣ+pe sarga lo laḥtī la kā la j-i gaḥ/ /swa ts+tshan+da yā tī dza na pube+e dz+re ba ki yangs pa 'dir/ /rang bzhin gyes g.yo dus kyi bung ba dag /rang dgar 'bab pas 'gro srog me tog gi//dzalpa sum̐ dzi ka pa li ka ro tu/ / ta ram̐ gā to sgo ga: ki ta ha ge sar tshogs la kham zas ①byed pa nyid/ /longs spyod rba 0rlabs dag dang mtshungs shing ri dwags ri bhā lo tsa na tsa laḥk+ṣa ṇa las+thā lasmrirdza na dza la da bi byo ta nata ḍi 'jigs pa'i mig ltar g.yo/ /dpal 'byor skad cig mtshon bya skye ba'i ①chu gter rnam par gsal ba'i ta—/ /sha rī rādz+dza bā la ta pa tsa pa la rā tsā na ba ba yaḥk+ṣa yi yā glog /lus kyi pad+mar dulang tsho gsar pa'i nyi 'od gzhon nu dmar ba g.yo/ /srog gi zigs pa sred pa'i ti k+ṣi shaṃ bha ba ma ru ta ḍi jo bi ka ṇaḥ/ /ma no mai tri pā tram̐ pa ra hi ta ra ti rnyon+d+ra mya ngam buthang la myur du 'jig par 'gyur/ /yid ni byams pa'i snod gyur gzhan la phan pas dgyes shing dha na tā ma dosgo dostso da k+ṣa ma sa ma bi tsā re pa ri tsa yaḥ/ /chos kyi nor/ /rgyags pa'i tshogs rnams rab bzod gcod cing ⑥rnam par spyod la yongs su 'dris//a yo ta twa nī ṣ+ṭa bi ṣa ya su kha be+e mu khyu su khi nā ma sā re saṃ sa ri pa ri 'di ni yul gyi bde las phyir phyogs bde ldan de nyid tshol rnams kyi/ /snying po med pa'i 'khor bar rnam z-i ta bi kā raḥpa ri ka raḥ/ /dza na sho tsa ti duḥkhe k+ṣi k+shi ha ta i bā bhothra nā/ /'gyur dag dang bral ba'i yo byad min④/ /rdo yis myur du bcom pa bzhin/ /skye bo sdug la mya ngan byed//na ka ro ti pu naskyi bra ta dā pā ta pra ti kri yī/ /pa sh+ya to pi bha bā ya sa phongs pa drag po de zlog pa'i/ /bya ba slar yang mi byed do/ /srid pa'i ngal dub mthong gyur kyang //nirbi be+e ka su sarba thā/ /kṛ ya te ki dzā na snga su mo hā da ku sha la smṛ shaḥ/ /pu rnam kun dben pa med pa yi/ /skye bo 'di dag rmongs pa las/ /mi dge 'dod par byed pa ci/ /bram ra bi praḥsu sharmā khya ku ta— ta pā pya rū la kai/ /bi d+mā ya dza na nī haste ya ze rab bde zhes pas sngon/ /'ba' ⑧ zhig las rnyed la phug dag /ma yi lag tu bzhag nas ni/ /khrus 95—187

yo rtswa tsu na dī pa ṭi / /sā pi pra h+ye ka busgye ya tī pāp+ta ya ta dan+ta la klung ①gi ngogs su song / /skabs der ma dudag 'ongs pa yis①/ /phyag na lhung bzed rang sangs reske/ /pra ṇa tā pā tra hasta ya ta debā bhi ma tai da do/ /a tha bā rtswa rgyas—/ /de nyid mngon par bzhed gyur pa/ /des kyang rab tu btung nas byin/ /de nas de yi bu sa ma yā tadhe na bu tastu ri tai k+ṣu dh+wa/ /dza na m+bi sgo dza nā ram̐ bhe ya yā tse ni bkres nas/ /rings par khrus byas yang dag 'ongs/ /zas ni rtsom par byed pa'i tshe/ /ma la rang gis dza mū la shaṃ/ /pu bye pu tā nu mo da pā tad+ma yā ti tha yephobe+e tai/ /i ti mā turba tsaḥl phug blangs/ /bdag gis mgron la de byin bu/ /dge la rjes su yi rang byos/ /de skad ma yi tshig khru twa so bhu bridhe i be+e 6 ṇa/ /sa spyo bi sru tsa kārta su masgo la ka thos nas/ /de ni mda' yis phug bzhin gyur/ /mgron khyod 'phral la ma zhu bas/ /gzir cing dku ④ma nalpi shaṃ/ /ku k+ṣi bhi tā bi nirlu tu pā ṇiḥs ha tā bā ti theḥ/ /i ti ni phug gyur nasathu/ /mi chung bdag gi la phug dag /srog dang lhan cig phyir 'byung shog /de skad ta sngasta pā pa gya bākrā tu bye ṇi bhu ya sā/ /bi stu tsi kai ba par+yadhe ba bhu bā pa sdig pa thob pa de'i/ /shin tu rtsub pa'i tshig de yis/ /mjug tu ma zhu'i nad nyid ni/ /skye ba gzhan pa ra dzad+ma su/ /pāspu khyun+ta ra pā ke na sa e bā r+ya pra pe na dzita/ /bi pu rnams su gyur/ /de nyid da lta gsal rgyal te/ /snga ma'i bsod nams gzhan byun pas/ /rgyal srid lo rā bye mā pā r+ya ta yi bādhe k+ṣa yi ga taḥ/ /saṃ sā ra pa tha pan+da na me ba yangs pa thob gyur nas/ /mjug tu de nyid kyis zhig gyur/ /'khor ba'i lam byi mgron po la/ /dge karma shu bhā shu sgo/ /sā ze ya me ba hasta sbe sgo gā ma bo ba ba r+ya dang mi dge'i las kho na/ /longs spyod slad du nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /lam brgyags ⑥bzhin du lag na te / /i ti shu tā bha ga ba tasta bye pa byañtsa tad+ma tsaḥ/ /e ba me gnas—/ /de skad bcom ldan de yi gsung ⑦/ /thams cad bden pa skethos nas ni/ /de de bzhin 95—188

ta di ti dh+yā twa tai pra ṇa mya ya yo dṛ paḥ/ /a tān+ta re pāp+ta rā byeḥzhes sems byed cing / /der phyag 'tshal nas mi bdag song / /skabs 'dir rgyal srid thob pa yi//shākya bai ram̐ bi rūbhā kaḥ/ /pu ro nyi ta su te ṣ+pe khya smra ri tasta1 yor+ya taḥ/ /'phags skyes po ni shākya'i khon①/ /mdun na 'don gyi bu song nas/ /sbran dzu pas de dag brlag brtson pa//pra ya yo shākya na ga ram̐ ga dzā shwa ra tha re rku nā/ /me he na de sha kurban glang po shing rta rta rdul ①gyis/ /rmongs pas blo bzhin phyogs rnams ni/ /rnam dbye min spyopa nyid byed dhi yā mi ba nibe+e be kā hūṃ/ /sarba rnyo bha ga bān dzñā tā ta gya tadru ṣ+ṭa cing / /shākya'i grong du rab tu song / /de yi spyod tshul ma rungs dekhye/ /bcom ldan kun mkhyen byus tseṣ+ṭi tai/ /ga tā shākya pu ro pādhe tasgo shuṣ+ka ta ro ra dhaḥ/ /dru rāt+ta tra mkhyen nas/ /shākya'i grong dang nye bar ni/ /gshegs nas shing skam 'og tu bzhugs/ /ring nas de na sbri tai dṛṭī tai mā gats+tshan bi ru bhā kaḥ/ /a ba tīr+ya ra tha da gra ma bye bzhugs pa de/ /'phags skyes po ni 'ongs pas mthong / /shing rta la babs mdun du ni/ /mngon t+ya pra ṇa to ba data/ /sah+phu snagha pa lā she 6 gha natshwa ye 6 shā khe 6/ /phyogs rab tu btud nas smras/ /'dab ma snum pa'i yal ga can/ /grib ma stug rnams yod pa la//bha ga ban+da tra bi shārnyiḥki shuṣ+ka ta ro ra dhaḥ/ /i kyuk+taḥk+ṣi ti pā le na der ni bcom ldan mi bzhugs par/ /shing skam 'og tu ci zhig mdzad/ /sa skyong gis ni 'di brjod tshe//tai pā ha bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /dzñā titshwa yā na ra pa te tsan+da na da pi shi ta lā/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas der bka' stsal/ /mi bdag gnyen byi grib ma ni/ /tsan+dan pas kyang shin tu bsel//nā snyi dzñā ti sa oṃ bi r+ghaṃ nā ste dzñā ti sa mā dh+ri ti ཿ / / nā ste dzñā gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i nor rdzas med/ /gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i dga' ba med/ /gnyen dang ti sa mā tshwa yā nā ste dzñā ti sa ma ཿ pri yaḥ / / ma mi te bhū pa mtshungs pa'i mdzes ma ⑥med/ /gnyen dang mtshungs pa'i mdza' bo med/ /sa bdag shākya 'di dag 95—189

te shākya dzñā ta yastata pu rarnyi kai/ /dzā taḥthra yo yo tata spru t+ya shuṣ+ka sha gnyen—/ /de la dga' bas de dag gis/ /grong 'gram 'dab ma bskams pa yi①/ /rkang 'thung 'di khā be+e pā da paḥ/ /shu tī tabyir tā maste shākyā rmā pak+ṣa pa ti rna/ /bha ga la dga' ba skyes/ /de dag thos nas bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya'i phyogs su lhung bar ni/ /rig nas khro brnye be+e di tī ba n+ya brte na bi byu bye kaḥ/ /bha ga bān pi shākyā dzā dang bral ba yikye / /'phags skyes po ni log par gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /shākyar dzha tā ga mi bha yi ta taḥ/ /shri ya se shudhe sa tā rmā bi da dhe dharma de sha 'jigs pa 'byung mkhyen nas/ /sems pa ①dag pa rnam dudag la/ /dge legs slad du chos bstan rna / /sgo tāste pha lo kaibye ta sa kṛ dā gā mi tsā ba riḥ/ /a nā ga mdzad / /kha cig gis ni rgyun zhugs 'bras/ /gzhan gyis lhan ⑤cig phyir 'ong dang / /phyir mi 'ong mi pha lo tsā byeḥsaṃ pābye ta su shā sa nāta/ /she ṣastu spru zwam ta yaḥshākya 'bras gzhan gyis ni/ /de yi bka' yis yang dag thob/ /lhag ma blo gros blun rjopo yis/ /shākyas pā purna tat+pa rda/ /shārnyi ke pi kha gā ye ྾ bā sa re ti mi robho baḥ/ /rgo dṛt+ta gnas de ma thob ste/ /gang zhig nyin par rab rib dag /'byung ba'i bya ni 'ga' zhig yod/ /de nas snga tha dṛ pa teḥpu ro hi ta su tasta taḥ/ /be+e ra sarba gya sup+ta su bi da dhe mi bdag log pa yis/ /khon gyi sbrul dag nyal ba dag /mdun na 'don gyi bu yis ni/ /rab tu sad pra ti bo dha rna/ /sa te na pre ri ta: kre ma ti shākya ku la k+ṣa ye/ /bai rā pa rnam par bsgrubs/ /de yis bskul bas shākya'i rigs/ /gzhom pa'i blo ④gros de yis byas/ /khon gyi na lo pra tsa la rna ka ro ti pi shu nā ni laḥ/ /sgo ra durdza na madhe ṇa sa ha so me ni rab 'bar bar/ /phra ma yi ni rlung (nyegis byed/ /'jigs rung skye bo ngan pa yis/ /sngags kyis t+tha pi tāḥkha khāḥ/ /be+e tā khāḥk+shi nyi pā lābya na ka gya pā ṇa hā ri ṇa/ /me+e bye 'phral bslad mi bsrun pa'i/ /ro langs dang ni sa skyong dag /su yi srog ni 'phrog byed min/ /de nas 95—190

ga dza ra tho da gre ta tasta pra sarba ti/ /ba bhu ba pu ra saṃ sgo bhaḥde yi dmag dpung ni/ /glang po shing rta'i mchog rab dkrigs/ /lam bkag shākya rnams kyi 4)ni//shākyā rmā rudhe waṭ+wā rmā/ / ta smin bha ga bān bi shākya rna rak+ṣu pā grong khyer yang dag 'khrugs par gyur/ /der ni bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /shākya bsrung slad phyogs te rna/ /sa mud+ma tai ta tra ma hā moṅga l+ya ya na ma bra dī ta/ /shākyā rmā karma do ṣ+ṭa lhung zhing / /yang dag brtson pa mo ⑧ga la/ /chen po dag la bka' su pa pa/ /shākya rnams kyi las kyi yo sarba thā sa mu pa sbi taḥ/ /ta tra rak+ṣa bi dh+wa rna te ga ga ṣ+pe se tu skyon—/ /rnam kun nas 'di nye bar gnas/ /de la bsrung ba sgrub byed pa/ /nam mkha' la ni bgrod ban+dha ā+oṃ/ /sum̐ sā ma tsidh+yā bi bha bā ni shu bhā shu bhā ni yārnyi pra yārnyi tsa mu stegs ①brtsigs/ /skyes bu rnams kyi bsam yas 'byor pa dge dang mi dge dag /'ong dang rab tu 'gro hurni ra pa gra hā ṇi/ /karmā k+ṣa ra ṇi ni dza dzad+ma pa da swa hasta nastu yang yud tsam rang dbang med pa ni/ /las kyi yi ge rang gi skye ba'i gnas la rang lag gis/ /bkod pa ni nā ma na bha brnyi ni rarja kā ni/ /i nyi pā kyāta bha ga ba tastasmin yā te dag ni nges par don med can du 'gyur ba ④min/ /de skad bcom ldan gsung gis ni/ /de la phyag pra ṇa mya tai/ /tsa kri re saṃ bi rda shākyāḥpra t+yā san+derbi rū 6 kai/ /ho 'tshal der phyin te/ /'phags skyes po ni nyer lhags pas/ /shākya rnams kyis bgro ④ba byas/ /srog sā smra rnyirna karta byā pā ṇi ma tra su na su tsita/ /sha rāḥsha rī ra masmra dang ldan tsam su la yang / /yu ⑥ cag 'tshe bar ④mi bya'o/ /dgra yis rab tu 'phangs pa'i mda'//shaṃ bi shadh+wa ri sa m+bi ri tāḥ/ /i ti saṃ bi da mā dh+wa ye te tu pā yaṣ+ṭi pā ṇa yaḥ/ /yu skecag lus la 'dzugs su bas/ /de dag de ltar gros bzung ste/ /khro bas lam ⑨na mdung bzung ste⑩//dhī rāḥpa ror+ya me tasbra ra bā ra yi ta kārmu kāḥ/ /a tān+ta re kārma yo gzhu ni rab tu bdungs ⑪byas nas/ /pha rol 'jug la brten ⑫pas gnas/ /skabs der don gyi sbyor 95—191

gān+di dza de sha na ba spru taḥ/ /a dzñā twa saṃ bi rda shākyaḥshaṃ pā kaḥs mu pa ya yo/ /ba las/ /rang gi yul na mi gnas pa/ /shākya sham pa ①ka yis gros/ /ma shes pa ②ni yang dag 'ongs//sa dṛṣ+ṭa na ga rā brja san+dar+ghaṃ ba su dha dhi paṃ/ /ko pā de ka: kā rā su de yis spyos bdag go bgos pas/ /grong khyer bsdams pa mthong nas ni/ /khros te gcig pus g.yul du ra be+e su bha ḍa saṃ k+ṣa yo/ /yudhe pu ru ṣa dzi he na ha tā ste bī ra phyin—/ /de yi dpal rnams brlag par byas/ /g.yul du skyes bu seng ge yis/ /dpa' bo glang po de kuñdza rāḥ/ /pra ya yuḥspyo ha ṭ+wā ya two ya sho bhirmo t+ta kai ri ba/ /sa ko pi ta dag bsad/ /mu tig gis bzhin grags pa yis/ /dga' bar byas pa ④nyid du gyur/ /gzhan la khros su dza dz+wa la ko pi ta mya pa ri ra si/ /sa ya yo yata pra tā pe na bi pu par gyur pa de'i/ /ral gri de ni ci yang 'bar/ /gang gis khyerab tu gdung bas des⑥/ /dgra yi chu dze+e ri pu bā nyi ṇi/ /bhabhe pra yā te swa pu ri naṣ+ṭidh+wa te bi rū bhā ke/ /pra bo ⑦yangs par song / /'phags skyes po ni spro ba nyams/ /'pham ④nas rang gi grong khyer song / /dgra be shaṃ na da duḥshākya sas+thā ka gya dī hūṃ ba dh+wata/ /swa dza no pi pa ri t+yak+taḥsha tairti ni bsad pas sham pa ⑨ka /shākyas nang du 'jug ma ster/ /sdig las kyis de de dag gis/ /nang mi snga sha karma rja/ /nirdzi te pi bi mu khāḥkru re sā dha bo dharma bān+t+raḥ/ /yin yang yongs su btang / /dam pa chos kyi gnyen ldan rnams/ /rang gi'ang ma rungs la phyir phyogs//dha nā da be+e pa da n+ya two su kṛ tai swa dza nā da pi/ /sa ta mo tsir+ya ni t+yā nā mā dam pa 'os ⑪ nyid rtag pa rnams/ /nor rdzas las ⑪kyang gtong phod dang / /nang mi bas kyang legs yu kho pi ya shaḥpri yo/ /nir+pā saṃ taḥ sa taiḥpāp+taḥsha ṣ+per+bha ga ba byas dang / /tshe srog pas kyang grags pa dga'/ /de dag gis ni bskrad pa de/ /mthar gyis bcom ldan tornyi ka/ /ya yā tse bhū da ya yi ba tai ki tsim+bi dza dze+e ts+tsha rna/ /rirgyu bha drung du phyin/ /de la dge legs slad nyid du/ /rang gi mtshan ma cung zad blangs/ /bcom ldan 'das 95—192

ga ba tā tat+ta ni dza ke sha na khaṃ sha shaṃ/ /sa dza gā mā sa mā mā dā ya bā ku ḍi kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rang gi dbu skra sen cha byen/ /de yis blangs nas ba snu ḍa/ /zhes pa'i dkyil nā ma maṇ+ḍa lo/ /ta tra pra dzñā pra bhā be na sauzlon+d+ra ha gu ṇi na tsa/ /sa pā pa 'khor dag tu song / /der ni shes rab mthu dag dang / /rtul phod spro ba yon tan gyis/ /de yi rgyal rārdzu dhī rā rde sarba tra su khā bhaḥshri yaḥ/ /dak+ṣa rde lak+ṣa rde lasmreḥs ha srid thob ste dpal/ /blo ldan rnams la kun tu mod/ /dpal 'byor grung ①po'i mtshan nyid de/ /grags dze+e bi du ྾ ya shaḥ/ /n+ya ba sā ya sa hā yā hūṃ ka la tram̐ sarba sedha yaḥ/ /ta pa mkhas pa'i lhan skyes yin/ /grub pa thams cad chung ma ni/ /rtag 'grus ldan pa rnams kyi yin/ /de trasbi to bha ga ba taḥso tha ke sha na khaṃ sha ke/ /stu pa pra tiṣ+ṭha ma ka rod nas der ni der gnas te/ /bcom ldan dbu skra sen cha la/ /rin chen mchog gis rab mdzes pa'i//ba ra rat+na bi rā dzi hūṃ / /bi rū bye ki pi shākyā rmā bai ra pā ra mchod rten rab tu gnas par byas/ /'phags skyes po'ang khon gyis ni/ /pha rol bsgral 'dod sbad tīr+ya yā/ /su narlubh+ya pu ram̐ dā ra bhe de na ha sā bi shata/ /ha tā ta tra sa ha pā nas yang / /sgo dbye'i rig ①pas 'phral nyid la/ /shākya rnams kyi grong du zhugs/ /der ni shākya stong phrag ṇi shākyā rmā sap+ta sap+ta tiḥ/ /ba dha ka t+yā ku mā rā rde sa ha sra ma dag /bdun cu rtsa bdun rab tu bsad/ /de nas bu mo gzhon nu rnams/ /stong phrag de yis thā ha rata/ /sha tā ni pañtsa shākya rmā ga dze+erlo tebya marda ṣ+peḥ/ /saṃ pra bcings nas khyer/ /shākya brgya phrag lnga rnams ni/ /lcags dang glang po'i 'joms byed kyis/ /rab tu mṛ dz+re pu rī tsakre kṛ tān+ta na ga rī mi ba/ /bha ga bān pi shākyā dzā bcom nas grong khyer ni/ /mthar byed grong khyer bzhin du byas/ /bcom ldan gyes kyang shākya rnams//sha tū rde bha de rgo kṛ te/ / karmā nu ba r+ghaṃ bi dzñā ya ba byu ba bi dgra rnams kyis ni brlag byas pa/ /las kyis ①rjes su bcings ④mkhyen nas/ /skad cig thugs ni 95—193

ma nā k+ṣa rde/ /pa prasgo sta sa ma bye t+ya bhik+ṣa baḥka ru zla ku lāḥ/ /ki 'byung ra1bar mdzad/ /snying rje rgyas pa'i dge slong rnams/ /de la mngon du phyogs te dris/ /shākya karma bi hi tai shākyesgo ram̐ ya gye dṛ shaṃ pha lo/ /bha ga bā ni te taiḥrnams kyis las ci bsgrubs/ /'jigs rung gang gi ④'bras 'di 'dra/ /de skad des ①dris bcom ldan bṛ ṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dzñastu na bhā ṣā two/ /ni dza karma bi sa ken shākyā rmā me 'das4—/ /thams cad mkhyen pas der bka' stsal/ /rang gi las kyi rnam byun gyis/ /shākya rnams ṣa saṃ k+ṣa yaḥ/ /kṛṣ+ṭi pu ra ma hā mah+pho dhi ba riḥs ri ton+ta rāta/ /sa dā ni ni brlag pa 'di/ /nya pa rnams kyis ⑤chu nang nas/ /sngon tshe nya chen gnyis shig drangs/ /nya ni rtag kṛ to mat+pa gya bhū yastabye tha ya na to/ /kā le na tso ra tsā yā taiste re tu rab bcad pa'i/ /gdung ba chen po dag gis bsad/ /dus kyis ⑥skye ba gzhan la ni/ /de rnams bā pa ra dzad+ma ni/ /ha to gri ha pa tī dad+dhā tā be ba dha na hā rī d+dhāḥ/ /to chom rkun nyid gyur pa/ /nor ni 'phrog pas de dag nyid/ /chos rkun du gyur bsregs nas bsad/ /nya mad+mo to kṛ ha sbo bi rū bhā ka pu ro nyi to/ /dā sā rmā taska rā hūṃ tsa de dag dang khyim bdag de/ /'phags skyes po dang mdun na 'don④/ /nya ba ⑧dang ni chom rkun pa'i//shākyā rmā mṛ h+phu tsā gto/ /i ti shu tā bha ga ba taḥ karma rde pha la shākya rnams kyis bsad par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨'di thos nas/ /dge slong rnams kyis las san+ta ti/ /a bi paṃ bā di ni me ba me ni re sarba rnyik+ṣa ba// /bi rū zwa ko ko tha rnams kyi/ /'bras bu'i rgyu ni bslu ba dag /med pa nyid du nges par gyur/ /de nas rgyal bas ngan swa pu ram̐ drwabe+e bi dza ya durma daḥ/ /dze tā nāsnra su te nok+taḥpra ḍā yajo rgyags pa'i/ /'phags skyes po ni rang grong song / /bu ni rgyal byed ces bya ba'i⑩/ /byis pa rtse bas la lī la yā/ /de ba ki ni hi tāḥshākya ta tesmra kai kṛ tā sha saḥ/ /i ti bru mdza' la smras/ / lha gcig /meshākya ci la gsod/ /des ni su la gnod ⑫ma bgyis/ /de skad brjod 95byed194

bā ṇa ma ba dhī na ni dza sru nu bi ru bye kaḥ/ /ni pā ta ma ti mṛd+mā ti ni nyin+ta pa'i rang gi bu/ /'phags skyes po yis bsad par gyur/ /myos thob gnod pa goms pa las/ /glang bo na ka ro ti ka/ /ma da labha ba dha ya sād+mā tai ga i ba durdza nāḥ/ /sa dza bzhin du skye bo ngan/ /nges par sdang dang nyed ①pa dang / /'joms pa nyid du ci ①mi byed/ /rang gi ⑦gā da sa bhā si naḥswa byu dza ba lo ka yan/ /a ho nu ma hā pāk+ṣiṃ dri dpung pa lta byed cing / /mdun rjosar 'dug nas des ⑤smras pa/ /kye ma bdag gi gzi byin ⑥mer//ṣabyeḥs la bhā yi tai/ /kṛ tān+ta to ra ṇastasto pā khyo ma ma bhū dzā bi dgra rnams phye ma leb ltar bcom④/ /bdag gi dpung sgram 'di gnyis ni/ /mthar byed rta babs ka ba mo—/ /niḥshe ṣa ba dha dīk+ṣa yo shākya rna gu ru tai ga to/ /tsā ta su bi kra ma shārgyu ste—/ /shākya rnams ni ma lus pa/ /gsod ⑤pa gdams byed bla ⑨mar gyur/ /de yi rtsal la bsngags pa z-i tā stuḥshākya ka n+ya kāḥ/ /khru tā ba bhā ṣa re tī bra mubye gā na tā de—/ /shākya'i bu mo bzung ⑩ba des/ /thos nas yid 'byung ⑪drag po yis/ /gdong ba btud nas rab na naḥ/ /karma pā sha ni bad+dhā dzā kha gā nā mi ba de nyi dzā/ /ni jo nowaṃ gha shaste smras pa/ /las kyi zhags pas bcings pa yi⑫/ /lus can rnams la bya bzhin du/ /'chi ba bsgom pa'i nāsnyi pa k+ṣa tsa tā ma pi / / ye na ghi ཿ sha ma me ti ta ṅgi la dza lo nus pa dag /gshog pa ldan yang yod ma yin/ /gang gi ⑫me ni zhi bar byed pa'i rgyu de dag ni rta gdong mārtswa t+ya lo bā ḍa bstergyu sho gra ha r+ṇa ka ro nyi sa ma ye he lā ba le rdzu ta maḥ/ /par+yā gis za lospyo/ /'bad rtsol chung ngus za ba'i mun pa spyodus su tsha zer ldan pa 'dzin par byed/ /yongs su lo tsa na baṭ+wā nā ma bi ṣa yi sābyur+ya tsar+ya pa rda sarba kārmi ka tan+t+ra yadh+ri ta mi blta ba'i lam byi yul min ngo mtshar dang bcas spyod pa dag gi gnas/ /las dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi rda kaḥ ka gya kahūṃ k+ṣa maḥ / /e ta dra kasbya dṛ pa tiḥpa dārnya ra gdams ⑩pa 'di kun ⑩su yi bya bar bzod⑫/ /de dag thos nas mi yi bdag /rkang pas bcom pa'i 95—195

i bo ra gaḥ/ /ka rastso do di de sha su sgo ra mar+ṣa bi sngoṣ+ka ḍaḥ/ /tī re ltos 'gro bzhin/ /'jigs rung khro ba'i dug rgyas nas/ /'di yi lag pa chod ces bskos/ /gang gi ya myuḥkṛ tai tā paṃ pā ṇits+tsha da na bai sha saṃ/ /sā byā pi hasta gar+bhe nyi khyu tā 'gram du de yis ni/ /lag ①pa gcod pa'i sdig las byas/ /rdzing bu lag pa'i snying po zhes/ /da lta puska ri bhā bhū bi/ /la tā swa pi ku kyu khāspyo kra ka tsa na li dī ṣ+ṭa pi/ /ma lā su yang ni sa la grags/ /'khri shing la yang lci snying me②/ /pad ldan la yang sog le'i so/ /'phreng ①ba bi shi lā badze+e pā ta yakhye bā nij-i rjaḥ/ /tābyun+da pā ṇi ka ma khāsta la yang rdo rje'i char/ /brtsa ④med 'bebs su 'jug pa nyid/ /lag pa'i pad+mo bcad de rnams/ /der tra tī bra bya thā tu rā/ /bha ga badhe bye yā dh+ya tā sha ra ṇi sha ra r+ṇa ya yuḥ/ /ni gdung ba drag pos gzir/ /bcom ldan skyabs 'os blo yis ni/ /bsgoms nas skyabs su song bar gyur⑦//tā spru bi dzñā yā sarba dzñā tī bri marmā ha ṭī bya tsā/ /sha ṭī ma tsit+ta yedrwa de dag gnad bsnun gdung ba rjoni/ /drag po kun mkhyen byis mkhyen nas/ /de dag yang dag dbugs 1 ta t+pa mā shā sa no tsi tsā / / ta ta spa r+sha dzā ta ha stusngasteja bya 'byin par/ /'os pa bde sogs lha mor bsams/ /de yis reg pas lag pad ④skyes/ /de yis ④lha ba sa nā bṛ tāḥ/ /ya yubyut+ta pra sā de na tāḥswarge t+yak+ta bi gra hāḥ/ /yi gos kyis g.yogs/ /de dag sems ni rab dang bcas⑨/ /lus btang mtho ris song bar gyur//de ba kaspra tā mā sar+ya di bya pad+mot+pa dze+e ki tāḥ/ /dharma de sha na yā shān+t+rastuḥlha pad ut+pal gyes mtshan lus/ /lha yi bu mo nyid thob nas/ /ston pas chos 'di ⑩bstan pa yis/ /de pā pu bi pu la pa rda/ /t+tak+ṣu bhir+bha ga bān thraṣ+ṭa stad karma pha la ma dag yangs pa'i gnas su song ⑪/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /de dag las 'bras mngon bh+ya dh+wata/ /pā ṇi tsā ba la me ta rnyiḥkṛ tai bhigru pi ḍi ba ṣ+pe/ /karma ṇasta par gsungs/ /'di dag lag pa g.yo bzhin du/ /dge slong dag la tho 'tshalas ⑪byas/ /de yi las kyi 95—196

su pā ke na bi shā se pa ti tāḥpa re/ /ma yi tsit+ta pra sā de na pābhābye tāḥrnam smin gyis/ /mi 'dod par ni ①rab tu thong / /nga la sems ni dad pa yis/ /'di dag dge ba'i khyeshu dzñā ga ti/ /i kyuk+ta bha ga wān karma pha la pā ka bi tsi tra hūṃ/ /bhek+ṣu hūṃ 'gro ba thob/ /las 'bras m+bin pa rnam bkra nyid/ /de skad brjod nas bcom ldan gyis/ /de yi zhar la tan+d+ra saṃ ge na bi da dhe dharma de sha dzñā/ /a tān+ta re gru bye tsa rī rā dge slong dag /rnams la chos ni bstan par ① mdzad/ /skabs 'dir rgyal pos btang ba yisde//dzñā pra ṇi hi tabya raḥ/ / bha ga btsu ri tai dzñā twa bi byu bhā ka mu gsang gnas spyod spyopa'i nyan rna yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyo spyod shes nas/ /'phags skyes po dang pā ya yo/ /so ba dadre ba bhik+ṣu khaṃ te ṣ+pe rda ka thi tai pu ram̐/ /swa nye bar song / /de ⑦smras lha gcig ⑧dge slong rnams/ /mdun du de yis 'di skad gsung ⑨/ /sa karma pha la mā sa.oṃ ta su pa shā mi bhū pa te/ /sabhā te nāsni nā daghaḥbadag de yi rang las kyi/ /'bras bu nye bar bdag gis mthong / /blon po mdun ⑩na 'don bcas te//sa pā mā t+ya pu ro hi taḥ/ /a bī tsi nām+bi na ra ga duḥs te ni pa ti 6 zhag bdun na ni mes tshig nas/ /dmyal ba mnar med ces bya ba tshokye / /bzod dka' dag tu lhung bar ti—/ /i ti tata ba tsa rna khru twa dṛ pa tiḥs pu ro hi taḥ/ /yat+na du 'gyur—/ /de skad de yi ⑫tshig thos nas/ /mi bdag mdun na 'don dang bcas/ /chu yi 'khrul ⑫pa sa sap+ta haṃ dza lo ta tra kṛ hān+ta re/ /k+ṣa shā ba she ṣe sabhā he 'khor khang nang du/ /zhag bdun 'bad pas gnas par byas/ /zhag bdun mjug na skad cig la//tasmin+taḥpu re ga te/ /srur+ya kān+tarka saṃ tā pa yo gāta dza dz+wa la pā ba kaḥ/ /u pho brang 'khor du song ba des/ /me shel nyi ma'i 'od dag gi /sbyor bas me ni rab tu 'bar/ /'jig da j-i te na pra la ya sa ba nā brti ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba be bām+bi dasgo so dha gi pa'i rlung gis gtsubs pa lta bur rab tu 'bar ba rtse mo can/ /rdeg ④ces sgrogs pas de ni myur bas ⑫95—197

ti shi khi nā nā ra kai mā pa ba sna/ /asmin lo ke dz+wa la na dza ḍi lā pā pi rmā pre nges bsregs dmyal ba'i me dag thob/ /sdig ①can rnams la 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du'ang phyogs t+ya rā gā ཿ sa rba tre ba sbi ra su kha rta ba ཿ shī ta lāḥ pu rgya bhā kun 'bar bas khengs/ /bsod nams bsten ①la thams cad kho nar brtan ①zhing gdung ba'i sa gzhi dze+e / /i nyi k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la bsil—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam tā lnga bi rū bhā kā pa dā dzā dā da sha pal+la waḥ// //gye 'khri shing las 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //duḥkhaṃ nu darnyi su kha sadza da ma di sharnyi saṃ dz+re ba yarnyi dza na tsā ti dam pa bdud rtsis brlan ④pa'i zhal dang ri bong can zer dag /sdug bsngal zhi byed bde ba phun mi ram̐ ha rarnyi/ /sad+mā na sa gya ka la yarnyi bi kā sha hā saṃ san+ta su sum tshogs pa sbyin par byed/ /skye bo rnams ni yang dag 'tsho byed rab rib 'phrog par byed/ /dam pa'i dhadre ba da naḥsha shi naḥka ra:/ /bim+bi sā raḥk+ṣi teḥsā re pu re rā dza kṛ yid kyi mtsho ni rnam par rgyas shing dgod par byed/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces pa/ /sa yi snying por duhā bhi dhe/ /sā raḥs map+ta bhū pā nā ma bhū ta bhū mi pu ran+da raḥ/ /k+ṣa mā ṅgā re gzugs can snying / /mtha' dag sa bdag snying po ni/ /sa yi brgya byin byung bar gyur/ /gang gi dpung byu dze ya su k+ṣa ma dh+wa re tsa tse ta si/ /bā khyaḥs mabe+e tsiṭ+wā rmā mā shu n+yastapa sa yi rten/ /sems ni bzod pa'i rten dag la/ /khur ni bkod pa'i skye bo rnams/ /bsam pa mtha' ka ro dza na/ /kurba tasgyu ga saurlu shā mā shā yā pa ri pu ra r+ṇa/ /dag phyi rol gyur/ /gang gis ⑥gtong dang rtul phod kyis/ /re phyogs yongs su rdzogs byed cing //pā ṇi bi myusto rasgo ghi swa bsgo khyu da si gra te/ /ka dā tsi ta bha bat+ta su lag pa rin chen tshogs la yang sti/ /ral gri 'dzin la dam par gyur/ /nam zhig de yi ④grong khyer du//95—198

bi bla bo na ga re gu ru/ /na bā byu da ya saṃ dzā ta darba kā la i bā ku laḥ/ /nye bar 'tshe ba phyi ba byung / /mi bsrun gsar du mngon dar bas/ /kun tu dregs skyes bzhin du 'khrugs//tamā s+thā na sa mā sī rna dza na tsid+dhā kṛ ta k+ṣa khaṃ/ /bya dzi rnyi pa ta sau ra dza na skye bo'i bsam pa'i skabs phye ste/ /mdun stisar yang dag bzhugs ①pa ni/ /skye rgu'i ①pha ltar gyur de la//pra dzā rmā dza na ko pa oṃ/ /de ba de byi pra bhā ba gya ni ya ta shā sa ṣ+pe na te/ /dza naḥgrong khyer pa yi skye bos ④zhus/ /lha gcig ⑤lha yi mthu ldan pa/ /khyod kyi bka' yis dul ba yi/ /skye bo sa dā sa mu dro yo marlu dzā nā ti brta te/ /dza na myu gya pra kṛ ta saṃ thrat+ta rtag tu rgya ldan 'di/ /lugs la ⑥rab tu mi 'da'o/ /dam pa'i lam nas rang bzhin gyis/ /rab su sad+mārge sarga taḥ/ /u pa sargo da ga māḥkasma dasmra da ya mā ga taḥ/ /swa zhugs skye bo 'di dag la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba ⑦rab rgyas 'di/ /glo bur dag tu ga du nas 'ongs/ /rang dhan+d+ra saṃ thraste na karma ṇ+ḍa sharma ṇa dṛ rde/ /su dz+re pe ṇa tsa gu t+yā rmā gi chos la zhugs dga' ba'i/ /las dang rgyal po bzang pos kyang / /sbas par gyur pa'i mi rnams ni//nā pa tarnyi bi parta yaḥ/ /j-i yadhe naḥpra sru tā dzā kṛ nyi d+dhā ā+oṃ kṛ he/ /rgud pa dag tu ltung ba min/ /bdag cag rnams kyi khyim khyim du/ /sbrum ma btsas pa'i bu tsha rnams//a pa t+yā ni pha lā nī ba sa྾ yā ṇa ma saṃ ya mā ta/ /ki tu bhū tai na bid+mastan bya ba legs pa'i 'bras bu dag /ma bsdams pa las bzhin du 'phrog /de ci mi shes 'byung po 'am//mā yo tsā pi ma tī ya r+pā/ /yata pra bhā be+e na bhā yadhe ku khā ni ni ra pa t+ya hūṃ/ /i yang na shin tu che ba'i rgyu/ /gang gi mthu yis rigs dag ni/ / bu brgyud ⑨bral ba nyid du byed/ /de ti te ྾ gi rā byu j-i da bhū ta saṃ krān+ta tabye thaḥ/ /pa re duḥkhaṃ bi sha t+yan+taḥs dag tshig des sa bdag la/ /de yi gdung ba 'phos ⑩par gyur/ /dam pa'i nang du pha rol gyi/ /sdug tī ka dā ra ba re bta/ /sar+pā ga byā pi nā te na dza na duḥkhe na khyu ya sā/ /bsngal zhing la chu bzhin 'jug /yan lag kun la khyab byed pa/ /skye bo'i ⑪sdug bsngal chen po des//95—199

pi ṣa ṇi bā thra ta swa bhū dud+dhān+ta j-i da yaḥk+ṣa r+ṇa/ /so bra bī tā ki ka ro mya dug gi ①bzhin du bsgrubs pas de/ /skad cig snying ni rab 'khyam gyur/ /de ②smras dpung pa'i dbang tra byu dzā dhī ni bi po tu ṣe/ /kan+d+ra nā ma pra brte te durlak+ṣe 6 pra ti kri dang ni/ /skyes bu min pa 'dir ci bya/ /mi mtshon pa de phyir bcos pa/ /ji ltar kho nar ①brtsam par yā—/ /di na me kai bra dze+e twa r+ya bha brnyo ni dza maspa da/ /sa bra ta—n+ta bya—/ /khyod rnams de ring nyi ma gcig /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar byos/ /khrod kyi bu tsha 'jig ④yā bye ba ras+ho baḥpra sa ba k+ṣa ye/ /i ti rā dza ba tsā khru tā z-iṣ+ṭaḥbasrung ba/ /brtul zhugs bcas pas nges par bsam/ /de skad rgyal ba'i gsung ⑤thos nas/ /grong po ra ma hat+ta maḥ/ /dza ga duste sa mā badza pū dza bye dza na oṃ dza bo/ /de pa chen po mgu rnams kyis/ /mchod pa gsal byed thal mo dag /yang dag sbyar nas de la smras/ /lha ba twa da ba dh+wa ṣ+pe na pra ṇa ya karna ṣ+pe na tsa/ /twa yi bi n+yasta tsir+sā gcig khyod kyi ⑥nges 'dzin dang / / khyams dang ⑦rjes su thos ⑤pas kyang / /khyod la bsam pa rnam rmā nāsmra ka ma dhu nā shra maḥ/ /a nudha ta mu dā re tsa twan+d+ra sā bkod pa⑨/ /bdag cag da ni ngal ba med/ /khyod kyi bka' drin mi rtsub cing / /yid du 'ong bas dā bā lo ka rna/ /i da me ba dza na snga gya dzī bi ta byā ba bste ti/ /ki pu rab gzigs pa/ /'di nyid skye bo 'di dag ni⑪ / /'tsho ba nyid kyis ⑪char 'bab bzhin/ /ci yang naḥbri ya me taste r+pā yu ṣa sa dṛ shaṃ ba tsaḥ/ /tā pā pa haṃ mṛ du swā khyod kyi gsung 'di dag /bdud rtsi dag dang mtshungs shing dga'/ /gdung ba 'phrog byed 'jam zhing du ki ki na be+e da dh+wa ti naḥ/ /kṛ tī kri ta snyoḥka ru rgya ni dhiḥsu mnyen—/ / nged kyis ⑫ci dang ci mi sgrub⑫/ /mkhas shing byas shes ⑫snying rje'i gter/ /mthong ba la bha dar+sha naḥ/ /la bh+ya te bhā gya sgo gye na sau dza n+ya sha ra la pra bhuḥ/ /spru yu rnyed sla drang por gyur/ /skye bo legs pa'i rje spyobo ni/ /skal ba spyod pa dag gis thob/ /dam pa'i 95—200

ṣā da ti pe sha laḥ pa ri tsa yaḥ shra bye ba tsaḥ pañtsa mā dā tsaḥ raḥsems la gnas pa'i dam pa rnams kyis ①yongs 'dris bdud rtsi dag pas kyang / /shin tu mnyes gshin sha ri rda du bṛn+da ma hā so snga nan+da sasdo ha daḥ/ /sa:ste ba sa tsā sā tsā tshig ni lnga pa bas kyang mnyan 'os ②ston zla'i 'od tshogs pas/ /spyod pa'i kun dga'i tshogs ster ①gzhan ki ma pa ra puṣ+ṭhad+ma naḥko ma lo sau dza bye ha ri tsan+dan ā da pi pa re san+ta pa pa ci zhig yid ni me tog pas kyang 'jam/ /skye bo legs pa ha ri tsan+dan pas kyang yongs gdung mchog tu nir+pā pa hūṃ/ /i kyuk+ta pra pa ya yuḥpo rātsū pra ṇa mya pra sā di ni/ /ki ran+ta stad zlog dupar byed/ /ces brjod drin dang ldan de la/ /phyag 'tshal de yi yon tan ni/ /yid 'ong bume gu ṇi dā rā mā shā ku su ma mā li tsā/ /rā dzā pi na ga re kṛ twa bhu ta tog phreng ba dag /phyogs su 'grems shing grong pa song / /rgyal po yis kyang grong khyer du/ /'byung po pū dza bi dhi kra me/ /shārnyi swaste ka saṃ bhā re tsakra ra ni ya ta pra taḥ/ /mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim/ /byas nas zhi dang shis pa yidu/ /tshogs kyis ⑦nges pa'i brtul zhugs byas//yak+ṣi hā ri ti kā nā ma bā la kān pu ra bā si bhā/ /ha ra tī ti sa shu shā 'phrog ma zhes pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /grong khyer gnas pa'i byis pa rnams/ /'phrog ces grong khyer lha dag ba pu ra de ba ta yo di tai/ /ta taḥpo ra dzabyeḥsār+ghaṃ sā mā t+yaḥthra thi bī gis—/ /brjod pa de yis thos par gyur/ /de nas sa bdag blon dang bcas/ /grong khyer skye bos lhan pa tiḥ/ /ka lo da ka ni bā pā khye sbri tai be+e rku ba nā shra mai/ /bha ga brnya cig tu/ /ka lan da ④ka'i gnas zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal gyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /sdug bsngal rim ya yo drahūṃ su ga tai do ṣa bān+ta ye/ /sarba duḥkha dz+wa rā yā sa dzu gyis gdung ba dag /bsten pa kun gyi mi tsha'i sman/ /bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /skyon ṣa ma ka ṭu kau ṣa snye/ /tai dṛṭī dzu pa tirdu rāta pra ṇa mya thra ya dar+sha rnams zhi slad blta ⑨ru song / /mthong ba dga' ste ⑩mi bdag gis/ /ring nas mthong nas phyag 'tshal 95—201

rgo—/ /u pa bi shā gra tastasmi bo ra duḥkhaṃ n+ya be+e da yata/ /bha ga wā na bi bi dzñā ya te / /mdun du 'khod nas de la ni/ /grong khyer pa yi sdug bsngal smras/ /grong khyer pa yi brgyud dag ni//po rā hūṃ san+ta tik+ṣa yo/ / tsid+dhā nibya la hūṃ k+ṣi paṃ mu ba hā ka ru ṇa ni nyams pa mkhyen nas snying rje'i gter/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang myur bar ni/ /thugs ni g.yo ba med nyid byeḥ / /sa bi pri bye dza gabosnuḥs dṛ paṃ sau ra maṇ+ḍa lo/ /pā tra 'dzin—/ /'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor mi bdag dang / /bcas pas bskul nas 'gro ba'i gnyen / /①de ni ṭī ba ra ma dā ya ya yo yak+ṣi ṇi ke ta rna/ /ta yā bi ra hi tai shā pya lhung bzed chos gos bzung / /gnod sbyin mo yi khang par gshegs/ /de yis dben pa de yi ni/ /khyim tadz+dza haṃ bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /pri yi ka rā khya tah+phu tram̐ ni nā yi ka ma dar+sha rna/ /du bcom ldan rgyal bas byon/ /dga' byed ces pa de yi bu/ /gcig ni snang ba min par mdzad//yā te bha ga ba te k+ṣ-i pre yak+ṣi swa kṛ ha ma ga tā/ /pra bhū ta pu tā nā pa bcom ldan gshegs nas gnod sbyin mo/ /myur bar rang khyim 'ongs pa yis/ /rab mang bu las dga' sh+ya thra yi pu tram̐ thra yo ka re/ /ta m+bi k+ṣa mā ṇa pā be+e shā kṛ ta bah+phe ba'i bu/ /dga' byed dag ni mthong ma gyur/ /de ni 'tshol snezhing rbongs bcas pas/ /drus ma be+e'u ba dhe nu kā/ /ba bhā ma saṃ blu mot+na r+sā sā dza ṣ+pe 6 pa ṣ+pe 6 tsa/ /hā stor ba bzhin/ /'jig rten dang ni nags rnams kyang / /rings pa ①rab 'khrul de yis bskor/ /kye dupri yi ka ra hā pu tra kwa nu pa shā mi te mu khaṃ/ /i ti pra lā pi nī tā ram̐ niḥhud dga' byed kye ⑤hud bu/ /khyod kyi bzhin ni dugar mthong na/ /zhes pa che bar rab sgogs shing //she ṣaḥsā ya yo di shaḥ/ /sā pi tsidh+yā shu sar+pā sā ni ra shā pu tra dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /de ni ma lus phyogs su song / /de yis ⑦phyogs kun mgyogs btsal nas/ /bu ni mthong re med pa yis//kre shadhī sarba ta dri pa sa mu dra ba la yi ya yo/ /mju bhū mi ma ti kra mya mya ngan byed cing ri dang gling / /rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dag tu song / /mi yi sa las 'das nas ni//95—202

gho re 6 na ga re 6 sa/ /swargodre she ṣa shi k+ṣe 6 bi mā noṅku na shā li 'jigs su rung ba'i grong khyer dang / /mtho ris phyogs ni ma lus pa/ /gzhal yas khang dang skyed tshal 6 —/ / shān+ta kwa tsin+da bi shān+ta ya ti bhā pra ṇi yā ti —/ /pu gnas①—/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i grong khyer du'ang ②/ /ngal zhing gang du'ang ngal mi gso/ /phyogs tra ma nī 6 nā pa sh+ya ta lo ka pā la pu re 6 tsa/ /ku be+e ra snga tha pa tsa sā ga ni 'tshol ①zhing rab song ste/ /btsal yang bu ni rnyed ma gyur/ /de nas lus ngan tshig gis ni/ /bde tā tsa su ga tā shra oṃ/ /bha ga brnye bi yo gat+ta sha ra bye sha ra r+ṇa ya bar gshegs pa'i gnas song ste/ /bcom ldan skyabs su 'os pa la/ /'bral bas gzir ba skyabs su yo—/ /ta yā tad duḥkha thrar+ghaṃ tai sa ni sha mya ni bi di tai/ /tā ma bo song / /der ni de yis rang buspyod mtha'/ /nges par bshad pa des khyegasan nas/ /cung zad 'dzum tsa ta sho tsidzñā ki tsita smi ta si tā dha raḥ/ /hā rī ti ta baḥpu tā hūṃ sarnyi gyi dudakar ba'i mchus/ /mya ngan can ma der bka' stsal/ /'phrog ma khrod la bu dag spyoni/ /kye ma brgya pañtsa sha tā n+ya ho/ /i ya ti ki bi yo gārti re kasmirje ba hā ri ti/ /i ti te phrag lnga dag ⑧yod/ /gcig nyid kho na stor ba la/ /'di snyed bral ⑨ba'i sdug bsngal ci/ /zhes des nok+ta mā kasbya yak+shi duḥkhā k+ṣa tā ba data/ /pu tra lak+ṣa pi bha ga ban bka' stsal sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyams pa gnod sbyin mos thos smras/ /bu 'bum yod kyang bcom ldan sa t+yā ṣ+pe ka pu tra k+ṣatiḥ/ /pu tā ta pi ya ta ram̐ nā n+ya ta ki duḥ'adas| /bu gcig brlag pa yongs ⑩mi bzod/ /bu las mchog dga' gzhan na med/ /bu chags khaṃ ta1 yā ta ba ram̐/ /pu tra bā ṣ+pe ba dzā nā ti pu tra sde ha pi ṣa bya shaṃ/ /sa ha dug gis gdung ba ni/ /de brlag las gzhan ⑪sdug bsngal ci/ /bu dang ldan pa kho nas shes/ /rgyu med dze+e ba su ta dz+re ti ra ka ra ṇa ṇi ban+dha nā/ /ma li no bi ka la spyi ṇaḥka mya ṣ+pen+d+ra nges par gdams pa yi/ /bu yis dga' ⑩ba lhan skyes nyid/ /ma tshang rid dang dri ma can/ /su yi bu ni 95—203

sa maḥsu taḥ/ /i ti yak+ṣa ba dhu bā kyi shu tā bat+pa be+e bi hwa lo/ /zla mi mtshungs/ /de skad gnod sbyin chung mi'i ①tshig /mnyes gshin gyis 'khrugs gsan ①gyur nas//byu tā nu kaspri bha ga bān sa smi tastu ya bhā ṣa ta/ /sho ko yo ba snu tā yā bcom ldan 'byung po la brtse bas/ /'dzum bcas de la bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyi bu ni mang po las//ya bye kā bi ra he ta ba/ /z-i te twa ma ka bat+yā r+ghaṃ pu tra ke kau dṛ shī bya thā/ /gal te gcig bral mya ngan 'di/ /bu gcig rnams kyi bu khyod kyis/ /phrogs pa'i gdung ba ci zhig 'dra//two pra bi sh+ya sa dā ge haṃ ste rmā pu tra nā lak+ṣi tā/ /a sha nā si pu tram̐ mā tā pi byā rtag tu khyim du ma mthong bar/ /khyod zhugs bud med rnams kyi bu/ /bu yi mas kyang stag mo yis/ /ri spyi ba mṛ ga shā ba kān/ /ye na ye na swa de ha su duḥkhaṃ yā kyus sgo ga hūṃ/ /dwags rnams kyi bu bzhin zos/ /rang gi lus la gang gang gi①/ /sdug bsngal nyer spyod nyid 'gyur ba//na tata pa ra gya kurbi ta saṃ mā narjo bha ba shu tsā/ /two bu— dhan+d+ra saṃ ghā rmā ṭī mya ngan nyams myong mtshungs pas na/ /de ni gzhan la bya ba min/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gyirjo//ṇi shi k+ṣu sa dā ni tse ta/ /kṛṭ+wā si ho sā bi mu khyi tas+thā sno se thra yi su bslab pa'i gzhi gsum gal te khyod/ /'dzin cing 'tshe las phyir ldog na/ /dga' ba'i bu de khyod kyis tai—/ /i kyuk+ta sā bha ga ba tā prasbi shik+ṣu pa dā ta taḥ/ /ho sā bi 'thob—/ /de skad bcom ldan byis bka' stsal/ /de yis bslab gzhi bzung de nas/ /'tshe ba spangs ra māt+taṅgañtsa pu tram̐ pā pa pri yo ka ram̐/ /taspru gyud+ma thraṭ+wān+tarnyi ta suḥkarma las dga' byed bu/ /de yis byin nas thob par gyur/ /de yi skye ba snga ma yi/ /spyod mtha' yas ⑤kyi pha khā na yi/ /bhik+ṣu bhir+bha ga bān thraṣ+ṭastabyet+tan+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pu rāsmin+de rjes 'gro de/ /dge slong gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /spyod pa'i mtha' de bka' stsal pa/ /sngon tshe grong ba na ga re po raḥke pyu pa sgo gi na/ /sarba tod+mā na yā tā yī bi dza khyer 'di nyid du/ /grong pa kha cig longs spyod can/ /ri dang skyed mos tshal 'gro zhing / /gar dang 95byed204

h+ma narta bā di teḥ/ /a tha te na pa thā kā pi go pā kān+tagha na sta byā/ /ma thi tai rol mos rnam par rtse/ /de nas lam der ba rdzi yi/ /mdzes ma su zhig nu rgyas shing / /ri dwags mig pa ju mā dā ya ha ri ṇ+ḍaspyi sa mā dā yo/ /gar+bha bha rā la sa ga tiḥpra h+phut+yā ldan dar ba dag /khyer nas 'tshong du yang dag 'ongs/ /rang bzhin gyis ni glang po'i 'gros/ /mngal ga dza ga mi ni/ /pa sha ṣ+pe rū pa sarbaṭī sasmṛ haṃ tā na bya lo ka yata/ /khur le lor bgrod ldan ma①/ /de yi dal bus nyer bgrod cing / /chags bcas de dag rnams la bltas//ta snga ba na mṛ gī mughi rā ba dasterbi lo ka ṣ+peḥ/ /a saṃ bṛṭ+wā lā ṣādz+re nags kyi ri dwags ltar mjos ma/ /yid 'ong ma de'i lta tshul ni/ /mngon 'dod ma bsgribs brlan pa pi soṅka ṇ+ḍa tsā ya yuḥ / / pā tairno madh+ri tā tra ma da na khye ba des/ /de dag rnams kyang sred ldan gyur/ /'dod pas stsos pa nyid gyur cing / /ngang tshul 'phral la tsā ga tā/ /hā ri hūṃ sa hā sā shī lo na bi be+e da pra ma di m+bi/ /ta taste nyams pa dag /ma rig bag med pa de ni/ /de dag rnams kyis der don gnyer/ /de nas de dag 6 pra yā te 6 ta snga ra ti shra ma ta/ /pa pā ta sa ha byeme+e ṇa gar+bha ko rab song tshe/ /chags pas ngal nas de yi mngal/ /khros pas dmar por gyur pa bzhin/ /brtan pa pā di bā ru ṇaḥ/ /a tān+ta re sa mā yā tai tah+phu ñtsiste na bat+pa nā/ /pra dang ni lhan cig lhung / /skabs der de yi bsod nams kyis/ /lam de nas ni rang sangs rgyas/ /lus bye ka bur+ghaṃ sā dāk+ṣi ta kā ya tsit+ta pra sā da rna/ /sāsmi ma zi ta spyu spyop+ta dang sems ni rab dang ba/ /legs par 'ong ba de yis snemathong / /dar ba'i rin gyis thob pa yi//ma mā shā sha ta pañtsa ka/ /dru rāta pra rngo ma bi na tā ma na mai ba n+ya be+e da yata/ /a za lnga brgya de yis ni/ /ring nas phyag 'tshal rnam ④btud nas/ /yid nyid kyis ni de la phul//ta tra pu sgyu ṛdhi ma t+ya smin dzā ta yak+ṣa ku le dhu nā/ /dzā ta mā sprarba ṇi nā pya pu bsod nams de las gnod sbyin rigs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan 'dir da lta skyes/ /a za phul bas 'di la bu//95—205

tā rde sha ta paṃ tsa rka/ /ho sā ba tī pa pa t+yā ga shrī la bi sma ra ṇata pa re/ /lnga brgya dag ni skyes par gyur/ /ngang tshul brjed nas bdag po dag /btang bas 'tshe ba ldan gyur sngon//pra h+yeka budha pra ṇa teḥpābhā shik+ṣu pa dā r+ya sā/ /i ti be+e bi dha bi rang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal bas/ /de yis bslab ①gzhi de ring thob/ /de skad der ni gnod sbyin pā ka kan+d+ra tatram̐ bi tsi tram̐ ki ma pi sa ka tha yi tā ta tra yaspyo ga nā yāḥ/ /ka mo yi las kyi zhurgyud ci yang / /rnam mang rnam smin rnam par ①bkra ba dag ni bka' stsal nas/ /'jig li ta ku sha la se tuḥsaṃ bha bāsgo dza nā nā ma kṛ ta su kri ta tsir+ghaṃ sarba lo ka rten kun gyi legs byas bsams ④byas ston pa de yis ni/ /skye bo rnams kyi srid pa'i mtsho la dge ba'i zam gya shāstu/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī stegs mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag ha rī ta kā da ma nā ba dā rna tra yo da sha pal+la waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las 'phrog ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu gsum pa'o// //yaḥsaṃ kalpa pa thā si nai ba tsa ra ti thra dz+rem+bha mā ṇabyu tai swadze+e r+ya gang zhig rtog ⑤pa'i lam du'ang rgyu ba nyid min rmad ⑥byung rab tu 'phel dang ldan/ /rmi lam byis gya na saṃ ga tiḥpa ri tsa yo yasmin+da pūrba kra maḥ/ /bā ṭ+wā mo na ba tī tsa ya tra nyi kyang gang dang 'grogs min gang la yongs 'dris sngon chad med pa'i rim/ /gang la mi rnams tshig ni mi smra dṛ rde yaḥrnge tra ṣ+pe tā ti thiste nirgyu dza dza na bra bhā ba bi bha baṃ mā ṣ+pe ra me yan+da nyid dang gang zhig rna ba mig gi mgron/ /rgyu med skye bo'i mthu ni 'byor pa tshad kyis gzhal bya min pa de la maḥrka/ /pu re rā dza kṛ hā bhi khye dzi bi sā re ṇa khyu bhu dzā/ /pū bye mā rna dzi bstod—/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab ces par/ /sa bdag gzugs can snying po yis/ /'od ma'i tshal na rgo dṛ ṭī sbi haṃ be rku ba dzā shra me/ /māt+pa r+ya bi ṣa saṃ ta ṭ+wā mūkhroḥbazhugs pa yime/ /rgyal ba mchod pa mthong gyur nas/ /rmongs pa kun mkhyen nga rgyal can/ /phrag dog 95—206
