sarba dzha mā ni naḥ/ /na se hi re ta duṭ+wār+ṣa pra kā sha mi pa kau shi kāḥ/ /dug ①gis rab gdungs ④pas/ /de yi khyad 'phags ma bzod de/ /ko'u ①shi kas snang ba bzhin//ma li ṣ+peḥswa bi ni shā ya pa ra bhā go di taiḥpa dā/ /kri ya te bā sa ra spazlu nub mor gyur pa'i rab rib tshogs/ /dri ma can ni shar cha nas/ /'char bar ④rtag tu nyin par la//sharba riste mi roṅka riḥ/ /maska rī saṃ dza yī be+e rā da dzi taḥka ku dasta thā/ /rang nyams bya slad 'gran par byed/ /gnag lhas bu dang yang dag rgyal/ /mi pham nog can de bzhin du//pū ra ṇa dzha ti pu tra r+ya rūkhro k+ṣa pa ṇa kāḥs re/ /spru tsudṛ pa ti ma bye t+ya rdzogs byed gnyen gyi bu la sogs/ /rmongs pa zad byed gzhan dag kyang / /bdud kyi sgyu mas rmongs byas mā ra mā yā bi mo hi taḥ/ /saṃ ghak+ṣe dz+wa ṣa do ṣe ṇa dhū me ṣ+pe bārnya shing / /'gran 'dod zhe sdang skyon gyis ni/ /du bas bzhin du mun gtibs pas/ /mi bdag la mngon kā ri tāḥ/ /e ṣa sarba dzha tā mā na ba ṣ+pe yaḥshra ma ṇaḥsbi taḥ/ /ṛdhi phyogs nas smras/ /nags na 'dug pa'i dge spyong gang / /'di ni kun mkhyen nga rgyal can/ /khyod kyis pra bhā bo bha ba tā tasmra ke tsa dṛ sh+ya ṭ+wā/ /ṛdhi pra bhā brtso yaṅgi:ta dza na de dang nged rjornams kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu ni blta bar byos/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu las gang cung zad/ /skye bo byā bā dza nordzi tai/ /dbye te ma ha dābyatram̐ pā nyi hātram̐ ta du tsu te/ /shat+taḥmagu bar dhirab spel ba/ /ngo mtshar che ba mthong grur pa/ /de dag cho 'phrul zhes su brjod/ /rgyal po saṃ sa di ya sgyusnyi pā ti hār+ya gya dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /asma rka ta gya bā rā dzan snyu bdag cag gam dang ⑦de/ /mdun sar cho 'phrul ston pa yi/ /nus pa gang la yod gyur de/ /'gro ba bye sastu dza gat+tha ye/ /i ti te hūṃ ba tsa shu tā tajargya bi mu kho dṛ paḥ/ /gsum du mchod 'os 'gyur/ /zhes pa de dag tshig thos nas/ /mi bdag de dregs las phyir phyogs//u bā tsa r+pāsgo ke yi baḥpa shu dzā gi ri lo gha ṣ+pe/ /a pa saṃ dza pa mo bai tata smras pa khyed bsam 'di ci zhig /'phye bo ri la 'dzeg ⑧par 'dod/ /'di ni rigs min phye ma leb//95—207

rdza te dzaḥsadz+dza na brdza rgo bi sgo/ /tīd+dhā bhi dha na ma khi lo pra yā mgu ba yis①/ /rang gi gzi brjid rab gsal mdzod/ /mu stegs zhes pa ma lus pa'i/ /mun pa tu pra la yi ta maḥ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsa khru tā nirbi gā ra ma hā sha yaḥ/ /brlag par rab tu thob du/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /bsams 1pa chen po rnam 'gyur med/ /bha ga bān be+e ra ta mar+ṣa pa ghar+ṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzan+da byo pa 'gran bzhed khro ba dang bral ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis der bka' stsal/ /rgyal po gzhan dag nyer marwa ya bi bā dā ya ma dā ya bā/ /bi be+e kā bha ra ṇardo yi kṛ ya gzhom dang / /rtsod dang rgyags pa'i phyir yang min/ /rnam dben rgyan du 'os pa yang ④/ /yon tan te gu ṇa saṃ gra haḥ/ /māt+par+ya ma li ṣ+peḥki tairbi tsā ra bi gu ṇirgu ṇiḥ/ /'di ni gzung bar bya/ /'gran pa'i rgyu yis rab bsgrubs gang / /pha rol bsngags 'phrog yon tan ni/ /ye ha rarnyi pa roṅkar+ṣa spad+dhā brnya pra sā ri taḥ/ /gu ṇa ts+tsha da na ma n+ya mya phrag dog dag gi dri ma can/ /rnam dpyad yon tan bral des ci/ /gang zhig rang gi yon tan gyis/ /swa gu ṇi na ka ro ti yaḥ/ /dharma ste nā pra shaste na swa ya me ba ni d+ma ti taḥ/ /gzhan gyi yon tan sgrib byed pa/ /bsngags par 'os pa min pa des/ /rang nyid kho nas chos chud gson//sad gu shā rmā pa rī k+ṣe ba pa re bai lak+ṣu kā ri bhā/ /u tsi ta na hi shud+dhā rmā yon tan dam pa yongs brtag nyid/ /mchog tu skyengs par byed pa yin/ /gang phyir dag pa srang la ni/ /tu la ro ha bi ḍi ba nā/ /gu ṇa bā na pi nā yā ti yaḥpa re ṣ+ṭa pra gzhal ba'i tho 'tshams ⑤rigs pa min/ /gang zhig yon tan ldan na yang / /gzhan la rab dngas dusan+da tsā/ /sa dī pa hastastad pā tra sgo ya yā ma li byā kṛ tāḥ/ /lo ke ta e nyid mi 'gyur/ /lag na mar me thogs de de'i/ /snod kyi grib mas mun par byed/ /de nyid 'jig rten ba sarba dzha bid+maḥki ma dhi shaṃ pa ya/ /pa rā bye mā nā bhe bha ba mā gaspyo na kun mkhyen/ /bdag gis lhag pa ⑦ci zhig rig /pha rol mngon khengs zil gnon par/ /rtul ba 95—209

swa pa rā bha baḥ/ /i ti khru tā bha ga ba taḥpra sha ma bhi ma tai ba brtan pas rang zil gnon/ /de skad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /rab zhi mngon par bzhed thos tsaḥ / /j-i sha ma bh+yarja rmā rā dzā tsa kā rābyur+ya dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /ta taḥkṛdz+dzata nas—/ /rgyal pos ngo mtshar bstan pa la/ /mchog tu mngon par zhu ba byas/ /de nas tshogs ①kyi bha ga ba tā kṛ tāh+phu pa ga mo dṛ paḥ/ /rā dza dh+wa no ya yo z-iṣ+ṭaḥsabhā bcom ldan gyis/ /zhal bzhes mdzad pas mi yi bdag /mgu bas zhag bdun dus btab ste/ /rgyal hā ba dhī saṃ bi dā/ /asmin+dab sa ra bhā tā byu mi bhartu ra po da raḥ/ /tsa po'i pho brang song bar gyur/ /skabs der sa yi bdag po yis②/ /ma gcig min pa'i spun zla zhig /pho tsā rān+taḥpu ro pārnye pā sā da ta la baṭ+wā nā/ /sa lbo la bra dza tasta mya brang 'khor dang nye ba yi②/ /khang bzang gzhi yi lam nas rgyus/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /karma bā tai ri be+e ri tā/ /ku su ma sraspa shaṃ tai she rā dza pasnri ka radzñā rgyal po'i btsun mo'i lag nas 'phos/ /rtse dga' dang bcas 'gro ba de'i/ /phrag par me tog 'phreng ba tī / /ta su bi dzñā ta do ṣa su do ṣi saṃ bhā byā pāk+ṣi bhiḥ/ /pi shu nāḥki ba lhung / /skyon ni rig par gyur pa de'i/ /skyon rnams dbang pos bsal ④byas nas/ /phra ma mkhan gyis darnyi hūṃ tsa kri re rā dza gā mi nā/ /sbyi tra malpa ma pi pā pya k+ṣu druḥsar+pā pa gtam de dag /rgyal po yis ni rtogs par byas/ /rje bo'i bsam pa stong par ni/ /chung yang bu ga kā ri ṇaḥ/ /dī dzi hāḥpi shun pra bi shan pra bhū rmā shu n+ya mā sha yi/ /pi shu ṇa pre rnyed par gyur⑤/ /gnod pa kun byed lce gnyis pa/ /phra ma rab tu 'jug pa nyid/ /rgyal po phra mas ri to rā dzā s+thā tu rīdh+ya bi kho lwa ṇaḥ/ /ts+tsha rda pā lā di sha shu pā ṇi pā da su bskul ba yis/ /phrag dog dug rgyas rgyal ⑥gyur pas/ /spun zla'i lag pa rkang pa dag /myur du chod ces mūdh+ri taḥ/ /ni kṛt+ta pā ṇi tsa ra ṇaḥku mā raḥkarma bi bla bāta/ /pa yang dag bsgos/ /lag pa rkang pa rnams ⑦bcad pa'i/ /gzhon nu las kyi ⑧rnam bslad pas/ /gsod 95—210

ba dh+ya ba su dh+wa shā yī bi be sha bi ṣa mā pa rda/ /ti pra bya baṃ pa ri thra tai pa'i nor 'dzin la nyal te/ /mi bzad rgud par zhugs par gyur/ /ma dang gnyen ni mya ngan can/ /sho tsa ṅgha rmā tro ba na dhū bhi ཿ / / da tre shu ste k+ṣa pa ṇa kā ཿgdung ba drag pos yongs bskor te①/ /skad cig mig ni g.yo ba yi du/ /zad byed rnams kyis mthong k+ṣa r+ṇa/ /tān sa ma bye t+ya sho kārta ste rā dza su ta bā na bāḥ/ /dza ga bar gyur/ /de ni yongs bskyabs gal chags shing / /kun la phyag 'tshal mya ngan gyis/ /gzir ba'i dusta ta pa ri tā ṇa lubhāḥsarba pā ṇi naḥ/ /a do ྾ ni kṛ tī to yo rgyal bu gnyen de rnams/ /de dag la mngon phyogs nas smras/ /kā ④la zhes pa mi bdag bu/ /skyon med kā lo nā ma dṛ pād+ma dzaḥ/ /sarba rnye bā di no yu yo pra sā do gya bi dhī ya tsā/ /'di ni chad pas bcad/ /khyed rnams kun mkhyen smra ba po/ /'di la bka' drin bsgrub par mdzod⑤/ /i ti taiḥpra sa rabye྾ rarja mā nāḥpra lā pi rnyiḥ/ /tai mo ni no nin+d+ra ti bhā de skad mchi ma rab zags shing / /rab smras 'ude yis gsol btab pas/ /mthu med de dag mi smra zhing / /be+e lak+ṣu da n+ya to ya yuḥ/ /a tha te na pa thā ya to bhi k+ṣuḥsu ga ta shā skyengs nas gzhan du song bar gyur/ /de nas dge slong kun dga' bo/ /bde gshegs bka' yis lam sa nāta/ /a nasdo bi da dhi gā ni ta su sa kyo pa yā tsa nāta/ /rā dza pū de nas/ /'ongs te bden pa'i byin rlabs ④kyis/ /de yi lus ni rnam par bsgrubs/ /rkang lag yang drastu saṃ dzā ta pā ṇi pā daḥpra san+da dhīḥ/ /dzi na sha ra ṇa ma bye t+ya ta du pa dag skyes pa yis⑤/ /rgyal po'i bu yang dang ba'i blos/ /rgyal la skyabs su mngon song ste/ /de yi nye ji ya ko bha bāta/ /sap+ta rā tre bya tī te tha pā tī hā bye kṛ haṃ ma hata/ /dṛ gnas dag tu gyur/ /de nas zhag bdun bzlas byepa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /cho dhi bha ga ba to drahūṃ ma tī pa ti ra kā ra yata/ /u pa biṣ+ṭi dṛ pe ta tra 'phrul blta 'dod sa bdag gis/ /khang pa chen po byed du bcug /der ni zad byed pa sogs dang / /95—211

sa ha k+ṣa pa ṇa kā di bhiḥ/ /kalpa dṛk+ṣi ki tā byu mi ra bha ba ta su ga lhan cig mi bdag bzhugs pa la/ /bde gshegs bzhed pas sa gzhi dag /dpag bsam shing gis tets+tsha yā/ /ta taḥmāste gu de be+e 6rdahūṃ bha ga ba taḥpra dzñā/ /rat+na brgyan par gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①mthu/ /lta ru lha rnams 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan pra di paṃ bha ga bān bhe dze sau hā sa rna ma hata/ /te dzo dh+wa rtu pra ban+da su ta su 'das kyi 0seng ge'i khri/ /rin chen rab 'bar che ba bsten/ /me yi khams la rab zhugs pa/ /de yi gaṇ+ḍa sa muṅga teḥ/ /byastaḥpā tsa ka saṃ ghā tai ra juta bhu ba na maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /'gram pa las 'khrungs pa'i/ /me yi tshogs kyis 1srid pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag — khyab par gyur/ /sha dhe sha ṣ+pe ཿ kā ma la kā na na sa ni kā she ba rno sa ma p+ta khyu srid par gnas pa mtha' dag 'jig dupa'i 'jigs pas ⑤dal bu yis/ /pad+ma'i tshal dang mtshungs pa'i ba na sbi ta sgo ga bhi t+yā/ /de tīt+ta to bha ga ba taḥka ru ṇ+ḍam+bu ra sheḥpū1 mṛ me ni zhi bar gyur pa la/ /de rjes bcom ldan sku ni snying rje'i chu yi phung po las/ /bdud rtsis 0gang ba'i tormi bi ma khā ru ṇa yaḥpra su sruḥ/ /khā ba khyu sā ra dzi ti tsan+d+ra sa ha sra kārnyi te rba ⑦rlabs dri med 'od zer rab tu 'phros/ /stong phrag zla ba'i mdzes pa las rgyal mdzes pas khengs gyur dza pra tā na bi pha lbo kṛ ta srur+ya tsakre / / tai nā ga nā ya kā cing / /gzi brjid rab tu rgyas pas nyi ma'i 'khor lo 'bras med mdzad/ /'dren pa de ni skye bo'i ⑧ni kā ya bi lo tsa nā ni spru t+yā pa puḥsu kṛ ta labha ma pūdze+e har+ghaṃ/ /tshogs kyi rnam par lta byed kyis/ /legs byas kyis thob sngon ⑨med mgu zhing dga' bas 'thungs par gyur/ /bai ḍūr+ya nā la bi pu lā ru ṇa rat+na pa tra kārnyobe+e saṅka na ka ke sa ra kaṇi chu ba be+e ḍūr+ya ldan rin chen dmar po'i 'dab ma yangs/ /mdzes shing rab tu 'bar ba'i gser gyi ge sar ka ni/ /a byur+ya yuḥk+shi ti ta lā da tha tat+pa m+bi pe pad+mā ni sau ra bha ze 'bru can/ /rkang drug pa rnams dri bzang tshogs kyis 'bod pa'i pad+ma ni/ /de nas de yi drung du sa 95—212

rā hu ta ṣat+pa da ni/ /te 6 pa bi ṣ+ṭa ma tha kāñtsa na tsa rurnyi sdiste gzhi dag las mngon 'khrungs gyur/ /de dag rnams la nye bar bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs 'khor lo ni/ /k+ṣa ṇa su ga ta tsakra ma dṛ sh+ya tā rāta/ /spru yu ṣa pe sha la sha shi gser 'od mdzes shing 'jam pa'i rgyan ①ldan de nas nye bar mthong / /bdud rtsi mnyes gshin ri bong can byu ti shī ta le na ya sro da ye na sa ha pā su khā mā pa lo kaḥ/ /te 'od bsil bar gyur pa dag /gang zhig shar bas 'jig rten dag gis 'phral la bde thob gyur/ /de ྾ pra bhā ba bi bha baṃ bha ga bān ba bhā ra ma bye dhi rka ka na ka shi la i pā dag dbus na bcom ldan 'das ni mthu yi 'byor pa dag /ri rnams dag las gser gyi ri bo bzhin du tsa la rgo/ /su skarnya brnya ra gha na blu ti sam+bi be+e shaḥpre shu su rak+ṣi lhag par 'dzin/ /phrag pa legs mtho sdug ②cing mjos par yang dag gnas pa ni/ /lha yi ser ②skyes ti ru hā mi ba pā ri dzā taḥ/ /swaṅgā ga nā ka ra ku she sha ya tīr+ya ma rnams las yongs 'du bzhin du rab tu mtho/ /mtho ris bu mo'i lag pas me tog rnams ni gtor gyur ṣ+pe ra smra na mā be+e ba la maḥka li tot+ta rmā gāḥ/ /ta s+thā na ram̐ bu pa'i—/ /mi dman 'phreng ba'i tshogs kyis yan lag mchog rnams rgyas gyur cing / /de zhal chu skyes rnam dza bi lo ka na ni rni me ṣa markyo a pi k+ṣa ṇa ma bā pu ra mju bhā paṃ/ /par blta ④la mig ni 'dzum bral bas/ /mi rnams dag kyang skad cig mi yi dngos min thob par 'gyur/ /byo rmā ga ṇi ṣa su ra rdu du rnyi shaṃ kha tū.oṃ gho ṣā thra te ku su ma bar+ṣa ma de nas lha yi rnga chen dung dang rnga sgras khyab gyur cing / /me tog char pa gad rgyangs cher bzhad nam mkha'i hāṣ+ṭa hā sa/ /gan+dhar+bha kin+da ra mu nī shwa ra tsā ra rja rmā spyi tabya tsā ra bha ga do rar ni/ /dri za mi 'am ci dang thub pa'i dbang phyug spyod rnams kyis/ /bcom ldan bstod pa'i tshig gi ban stu ti bā da nā daḥ/ /ta tā ru ṇa dha ra da khā dṛ sha ram̐ shu shu bh+raḥbyā tīr+ṇa sgra ni bsgrags par gyur/ /der ni bcom ldan zhal gyi pad+ma mchu yi 'dab dmar zhing / /'od zer dkar 95—213

ke sha ra ku lā da sha nā ra bin+d+rata/ /sash+lau ra r+ghaṃ bha ga ba taḥswa ra sam+bi bas kun dkris ①so yi ge sar rdzogs pa las/ /bsod nams kyis gtsang shin tu dngar ②ba'i gsung gi bṛ r+ghaṃ dha n+yaḥ sa surma dhu ra bād+ma dhu pu rgya su lta / /pā paṃ bi sum̐ sbrang rtsi ni/ /rang nyams dang mthun dam pa'i dri bzang skal dang ldan pas 'thungs/ /sdig pa'i tha ba tsa ta ni ṣi tsa ta pu ju bī dze+e bai ram̐ pa ri t+ya dza ta shā mya su khaṃ bha dza bye/ /thong la bsod nams dag gis ①sa bon thob/ /khon ni yongs su dor la zhi ba'i bde ba bsten par byos/ /dzñā nā mṛ tai pi ba ta mṛ ta bi ṣā pa hā ri be+e yo ta nuḥ ku sha la 'chi ba'i dug ni nyams byed ye shes bdud rtsi 'thungs shig dang / /dge ba'i grogs por gyur pa'i lus karma sā khā+e tsi ra ya/ /lasmi: khā ta ru ṇa tā tsa dza rā nu yā tā kā yo 'di ring po mi gnas so/ /dpal 'byor g.yo zhing lang tsho nyid kyang rga bar rjes su 'gro/ /lus kyang bya pā ya ni tsa ya su ni kā ya i ba/ /mā rjaḥsha rī ra ka ku ṭī mu byurta gnod pa'i tshogs rnams dag gi gnas nyid gyur pa yin/ /srog ni ngan pa'i lus kyi khyim gyi yud tsam pa n+d+ra ni rkyo da ye ku ru ta dharma ma ye pra yat+na ཿ / / i t+yā di mgron yin pas/ /chos kyi rang bzhin rtag tu skyed la rab tu 'bad par mdzod/ /de la sogs pa'i ⑤bher+bha ga ba ta pra bi bhak+ta dip+ta dzñā nairbi be ka bi ma loḥku sha lo pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis nyer bstan ye shes kyi/ /snang ba dri ma med pas dudaben zhing dge ba'i mthu stobs sheḥ—/ /badz+re ri bā shu da khā shaḥpra ya yo dza na saṭ+wā ya dṛṣ+ṭi ma ma bo sha kyis—/ /skye bo'i ngar 'dzin 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri bo'i rtse mo ni/ /nyi shu rdo rjes bzhin du myur bcom tro sh-iṅga shi laḥ/ /ṛrnyi pra bhā bha ga ba taḥpra bi bhā pya tīd+dhā man+t+ra rab tu pyazhi bar gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul 'od ldan bcom ldan 'das kyi mthu stobs ⑧mu stegs rnams/ /sngags ha tā pi ṣa dha rā i pa bhasna dar+pāḥ/ /di pā e bārka ki ra ṇa pra ti kyis bcom pa'i dug 'dzin bzhin du dregs pa nyams gyur cing / /nyi ma'i 'od kyi mthu yis mar me bzhin 95—214

bhā ti bhu tā bye trarbi tā i ba ya yu— ra ni: la two/ /a tārnya re du zil gyis mnan/ /yun ring g.yo ba med pa ri mo bkod pa bzhin du gyur/ /skabs der gnod sbyin bha ga ba taḥs ta tai bi pa k+ṣa na sar+pād+ma nā k+ṣa pa ṇa ka na ba dh+warma lag na rdo rjes ①zad byed pa rnams ni/ /bdag nyid kun gyis rtag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi 'umi mthun yak+ṣaḥ —/ / k+ṣip+ta shra bāta bri ta ba ste bha ribya kā ra bi dā bya ran+dha phyogs—/ /yin par shes nas 1 drag po'i rlung gis dkris pa'i char dag spros/ /rnam par rmongs nas sa sha ra shā na bhu be+e badz+ra pā ṇiḥ/ /urnyi sh+ya ta na tha kṛ pādz+ra bha yā sha ra rgyaḥyi khung bur bskyabs ④pa dag tu byas/ /de nas de dag la mtshon bcom ldan skyabs 'os snying rje yis/ /sarbo pa de sha bi ṣa yo bha ga bān ba bhā ṣe/ /bhū z-ita ba nā pa ni ma nirbi ba brlan par gyur pas nye bar bstan pa kun gyi yul bka' stsal/ /ri dang nags dang sa dang rlung dang rā di sabaṃ te ṣ+pe tad bha ye 6 sha ra ṇi ki la kā ta rā rde/ /burnyi bra khungs ⑤la sogs/ /'di kun nges par sdar ma rnams kyi 'jigs la skyabs mi 'gyur/ /rab tu sad bo dha ma ma dh+wam+bi ni dh+wa ya burnyi dhadze+e sa saṃ gha ma pi ye sha ra khaṃ pa'i rang bzhin gnas la blo gros bskyed byas nas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas la gang zhig pra pan+d+ra ཿ / / te ྾ dza ga ta k+ṣa ya bha ye ṣ+ṭa pi niste yā rde ṣ+pe bā skyabs song ba/ /de dag 'gro ba 'jigs pas 'jig 'u pa la yang 'jigs pa med/ /dman pa yongs n+ya taḥsha ra ṇa de n+ya pa ri gra hoste/ /dur+pā re pa ra lo ka tī bra ti mi re dharma 'dzin skyabs ni gzhan na yod pa nyid ma yin/ /'jig rten pha rol mi bzad mun pa zlog ⑦dkar chos ni pra bṛrnyo shu mān dā dz+wa duḥ sa ha pā paṃ tā pa bi pa dā ma byuṅga me ba rab rgyas tsha zer can/ /bzod dkar sdig pa'i gdung ba phongs pas mngon par bskyed pa 7sbyin pa chu ri daḥ/ /pradzñā mo ha ma hā pra pā ta bi ṣa ma shwa bye ka rā lalba na de gter yin/ /mi bzad gti mug g.yang sa chen po'i gcong ⑨la shes rab lag pas 'chel ⑩ba ste/ /kun 95—215

t+yā lngan+ta bi tī na me ba sha ra r+ṇa sarba tra pu tram̐ dzu khaṃ/ /i ti ti mi ra tu mi rnams kyis sdeni bsod nams kho na dman dang cho nge bral ba'i skyabs/ /de ltar rab rib kyis dṛ tā k+shi tsa k+ṣu ru dhī la nā rta da sha na ma ṇi ma rī tsa bya bye bsgribs mig can rnams kyi mig ni dbyer 'os shing / /tshems kyi nor bu'i 'od zer dag ni rab gsal mā na pra kā shaṃ / / sa bha pi su ga ta tsan+d+raḥ shudha dharmo pa de shaṃ ldan pas gsal byas nas/ /mdun sar bde gshegs zla bas dag pa'i chos ni nye bar bstan pa dag /spru ra pa da mi ba kṛ tā kā na rna swa dza gā ma/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra brtan par gyur pa'i gnas bzhin mdzad nas rang gi nags busu gshegs par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī pra ti hā t+yā ba dā dbang pos byas pa'i byang zub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las cho 'phrul gyi ā+oṃ nā ma tsa turda shaḥpal+la wa// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //dza ya ta ma hā hūṃ pra bhā baḥpa: da gre tsa brta mā nā yāḥ/ /dza rjes dang mdun dang mngon du gyur par yang / /skye bo'i dge ba'i las kyi lam dag ni/ /gsal na ku sha la karma sha ra ṇiḥpra kā sha rat+na dī pa i baḥ/ /pu rā su ra pu re bar byed pa bdag nyid chen po'i mthu/ /rin chen sgon ma lta bur chargyal gyur cig /sngon tshe lha yi grong pāṇ+ḍa kasbra spyo khye shi lā ta khā/ /sa m+bi pi pa ri dzā ta gya ko bi dā ra gya su pra bhe/ /khyer du/ /yongs 'du ko bi da ra'i drung / /la ba dkar po zhes bya ba/ /'od bzang rdo leb steng du ni/ /kṛ tā tri da sha saṃ ghā dzā bha ga bān dharma de sha rmā/ /a nu gra hā bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs gsum pa'i/ /tshogs la chos ni bstan mdzad nas/ /mi rnams rjes su ya madh+yā r+ghaṃ dze+e rū dī pa ma bā ta ra ta/ /a ma ri ra nu pā ta myu gzung ba'i slad/ /dzamyu'i gling du babs par gyur/ /sa la babs par gyur pa de'i/ /rjes su 'chi 95—216

ta su ba ta ra to bhu baṃ/ /bi mā na kā na nā kāṇi ba bhū ba bhū ba ram̐ ga ṇaḥ/ /med rnams 'brangs ①pas/ /gzhal yas khang gi tshogs kyis ni/ /sa gzhi mnyam pa khengs par gyur/ /ta su rda tai shu saṃ tā ṣ+pe ru pa de sha mi bā tsi tai/ /dza gā ha tsan+d+ra ru tsi re zla ba'i 'od ldan rnga yab ni/ /de yi tshems kyi 'od rgyun gyis/ /rgyas pa'i nye bar bstan pa bzhin/ /tsa ma re tsa tu rā na naḥ/ /ts+tsha tram̐ sha ta sha lā rka ka ma dz+wa ke rna ka gdong bzhi pa yis blangs par gyur/ /thur ma brgya yis mtshan pa'i gdugs/ /mtshan med ri dwags pā rku ram̐/ /pra sā da mi ba sā kā ra mā da de su pu re da raḥ/ /shaṃ mtshan ltar dkar/ /de yi bka' drin rnam ②bcas bzhin/ /brgya byen byis ni blangs par gyur/ /grong ka sh+ya na ga ro pān+ta kā na no dusba dzā ti ke/ /a ba tīrte su kṛ tri naḥsā khyer shang kā ④byu yi 'gram/ /u dum bā ④ra'i nags drung du/ /babs pa de la legs byas ldan/ /kun nan+d+ra ste ba ban+di ri/ /tasmin+d+rat+pa la par+ṇa khya bhikyu tī dza na saṃ ga me/ /dga' ⑤bcas pas phyag 'tshal gyur/ /skye bo'i tshogs der dudage slong ma/ /ut+pal mdog ma zhes pa yis/ /a lad+dhā ba sa rā tibye dṛ pa rū pa mu pa da de/ /pra dīp+ta rat+na mu blta ba'i gnas skabs ma thob nas/ /mi bdag gzugs ni nye bar blangs/ /rin chen cod pan rab ku ṭi ga ṇ+ḍa tā ṇ+ḍa bi ku ṇ+ḍa lo / / z-i dze+e bā su na baṃ rū paṃ dza gsal zhing / /rna rgyan 'gram par rab mdzes pa/ /de yi gzugs gsar mthong gyur nas/ /gtsug hā so: ṣa pabe+e ba/ / sā tsin+ta yadhī bā yo dza ṣ+penirbi ba raḥsu tor yal 'dab dgod pa bzhin/ /de yis bsam pa shin tu yang / /skye bo'i mdun 'di ⑦bar mtshalas raḥ —/ /an+ta ram̐ dṛ pa rū paṃ me troṣ+ṭa dā gya ti sā da ra/ /a med/ /bdag gi ⑧rgyal po'i gzugs mthong nas/ /gus bcas skabs ni ⑨ster bar 'gyur/ /'di to n+ya thā tubha ga bta pra ṇa tirma ma durla bhaḥ/ /na gu ṇ+ḍi go ra ba las gzhan yang bcom ldan la⑩/ /phyag 'tshal bdag ⑪gis rnyed par dka'/ /dbang phyug la dga' skye 95—217

s+thā na m+bi shar+ya pra ṇa yī dza naḥ/ /a ho z-i ṇa tu la lo leniḥpā ra bi ra sed bo yis/ /yon tan zhes pa'i gnas ma yin/ /kye ma rtswa mtshungs g.yo ba'i nor/ /ro bral snying po med dha ṣ+peḥ/ /z-i ya te bā sa nā sgyu sāta nibe+e tsā ra ta yā dza naḥ/ /daṭ+wān+ta rā saṃ sa pa yis/ /bag chags goms par gyur pa las/ /ma dpyad nyid kyis skye bo ①'phrog /'phral la skye bo'i ②hā sa dza ṣ+pe na dṛ pa go ra bāta/ /lo khā hā ram̐ bha ga ba te pra ṇa mi bdag la/ /zhe ④sar byas nas skabs byin ④des/ /do shal g.yo bas bcom ldan la/ /mdun du ma ma ka rota pu raḥ/ /asmin+da ba sa ra bhik+ṣu ru dā yī nā ma saṃ ba di/ /tī phyag kyang byas par gyur/ /gnas skabs der ni mdun sa ru/ /'char ka zhes pa'i dge slong gis/ /de bi lokya ta thā rū pā ma ba data sa smi tā na naḥ/ /i ma mut+pa la bar+ṇa khyu lta'i gzugs de mthong gyur nas/ /bzhin ni 'dzum pa dang bcas smras/ /mi bdag gzugs can dge bhik+ṣu tī dṛ pa byu pi ṇ+ḍi/ /ṛdh+yā bha ga ba taḥpā do ban+da te dza na ban+di slong ma/ /ut+pal mdog ma skye bo yis/ /phyag byas ma 'di rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bcom ldan zhabs la phyag tā —/ /ut+pa khā mo da bar+ṇa dzñā bi dzñā te yo ma yā pu raḥ/ /i kyuk+ta 'tshal byed/ /ut+pal dri dang mdog dag gis/ /bdag gis 'di ⑤ni mdun du shes/ /de skad brjod bi ra te tasmin bha ga bā na pya bhā ṣa ta/ /a yuk+ta me ba r+bhagru kyā dkyā nas 'dug pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan gyis kyang bka' stsal pa/ /dregs las rdzu 'phrul rab ston pa/ /dge dṛdhi pra kā sha ā+oṃ/ /ka ro ti pra sha maglu ni ma bhi mā ṣ+pe na tsu dzu raḥ/ /i slong ma yi rigs min nyid/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rims gsar gyis/ /rab tu zhi ba nad par byed/ /de kyughā bha ga bān kṛ ṭ+wā hūṃ tsā ku sha la de sha ā+oṃ/ /prithra bye de bā na ya yo swa skad brjod nas bcom ldan gyis/ /dge ba de de bstan mdzad nas/ /lha rnams bzlog ste dge slong dang / /pa rda sa ha bhikyu bhiḥ/ / ta tro pa bi ṣ+ṭaḥmṛṣ+ṭasteḥpra ṇa taibhikyu tī lhan cig rang gi gnas su gshegs/ / de ni nyer bzhugs bude dag gis/ /rab tu ④dris shing kun 95—218

ka shaṃ/ /mābyād+ma karma sasbar+ghaṃ sarba dzñāstu ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bā rā mkhyen gyis/ /sngar skyes ①las kyis yang dag bsdams/ /dge slong ②ma de'i gtam gsungs pa/ / bā rā ṇa snga ma bhuta pūbaṃ sāza ba ho ma hā dha naḥ/ /sasbyi dha na ba tī nā ma ta gya pā ṇa ṇa sīr 1sngon byung ba/ /ded dpon nor ni chen po yi/ /chung ma nor ldan ma zhes pa/ /de yi srog dang sa ma bha bta/ /pā ṇi pal+la bi m+bi ta dzñā yo ba nod+mā na mañdza rī/ /mtshungs par gyur/ /gzugs bzang lag pa'i yal 'dab ldan④/ /lang tsho skyed tshal snye ma dang / /pha lo pube+e tī kā le sā ta s+thāta gar+bha ma dā de/ /a tān+ta re dza la ni dhi 'bras bu me tog ldan dus su/ /de yis de la ⑤mngal bzung gyur/ /skabs der chu gter gling la ni/ /dī pā nu ga ma nor+ya tai/ /pra t+yā san+da bi yo gārte sā pal+la bha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ki rjes su 'gro bar brtson pa yi/ /khyo bul rab tu nye ba dag /'bral bas gzir ba de yis smras/ /ji ya tī dha na sasbran+ti thra rnyi ma byā pi nī ya te/ /ya ta kṛ to gho ra gi bhā ram̐ snyed nor ni phun tshogs shing / /da lta yang ni 'phel ba thob/ /gang gi ched du 'jigs rung ba'i/ /tīr+ya te ma ka rā ka raḥ/ /ba hwa pā yi dha nā dā rna ni ra pā yo gu rjardza chu srin 'byung gnas zab mo brgal/ /nor ni 'dzin pa gnod pa mang / /yon tan sgrub ⑦pa gnod pa rgo—/ /swa de shā ta pa ra lo rka hi gats+tsharnyi dra bi rjabe+e naḥ/ /ke tsidruḥkhām+bi med| /nor ni don gnyer rang phul ⑧nas/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ /kha cig ring du song brtan+ta dru re ga twa pi ni spa khāḥ/ /nistsa la dha ni nabya bye karma shā me nas kyang / /sdug bsngal las ni 'bras med ldog /gzhan ni g.yo med nor dang ldan/ /'di yi nges pa ṣā nistsa yaḥ/ /i ti thra yā ba tsaḥshu tā sarba pa ta ra bh+ya dh+wata/ /musnye las rnams so/ /de skad dga' ma'i tshig thos nas/ /don mthun bdag pos ⑨de la smras/ /mdzes ma saṃ bhā ba nā pā tram̐ bha ba bye baṃ dha nor+ya taḥ/ /dha nārdza rna bi hā nā nor dag ⑩bsgrubs pa ni/ /bsngags pa'i snod nyid kho na yin/ /bder gnas nor sgrub ⑪kyis dman 95—219

dzā saṃ gu bta rū la bhak+ṣa ṇata/ /a r+ya shā naḥsu khas+thā rmā r+bha giḥs ha pa ri rnams / /rtsa ba zos pa'i 'bye bo bzhin/ /de ring sang la longs spyod dang / /lhan cig yongs su zad k+ṣa yaḥ/ /swa kṛ te pi da ri dru rde dza naḥkra ka tsa nibye raḥ/ /dha ni ram̐ par gyur①/ /rang khyim du yang dbul rnams la/ /skye bo sog dze+ele bzhin du rtsub/ /'jig rten gzhan pa ra lo ko pi pre ma sdisnya dza rmā bhu baḥ/ /khye ṇa ma srut+pa tai thra: na be+e sum̐ du'ang nor ldan ni/ /skye bo rnams kyi mdza' sdug sa/ /'phel bar rtsom slad zla tshes ni/ /phra mo la yang brnya te dza naḥ/ /na tu sa pūṇ+ḍi ma sudhe pra t+yā san+da pa ri k+ṣa yi/ /rūkho pi skye bo 'dud/ /mthar ni yongs 'dzad rab ④nye bas/ /yongs su rdzogs pa la yang min/ /skye bo mngon bi du ྾ baṃ r+yaḥsdi r+ghaṃ dṛrnyo pi ba khru bhaḥ/ /l+lī bo pi pe byaḥshu rā hūṃ mā par dar la nye/ /rbongs pa'ang mkhas pas phyag byar yod④/ /rgan yang mo yi yid du 'ong / /ma ning sarjo byu da yo dza naḥ/ /ke na n+ya ka ra r+ṇa jughā bī tā kā byā mṛ tā ni bāta/ /yin yang dpa' bstan ⑤'os/ /mkhas kyang bkres dang skom pa la/ /sgra 0yi bstan bcos zos pa 'am/ /k+ṣa khaṃ bi tsak+ṣa ṇi nā pi k+ṣuh+phi pā se bi brdzi te/ /ya sngarbaḥs gu ḍon+da snyan ngag bdud rtsi 'thungs pas ni/ /skad cig su yis rnam par rgyal/ /gang la nor yod de ni yon taiḥ kṛ ta nu ti ཿ ka sbra na dharte gu rte dā ri dh+yā da ya do ṣi du tan gyis mtho ⑦bstod byas yon tan dag kyang cis mi 'dzin/ /dbul las nyams pa'i skyon gyis gzi byin ṣi ta ru tsā nirmā be+e tu spyo gu ṇ+ḍaḥ/ /biste ṣ+pe ba gu rja gu ṇi na ru dha rna sun phyung yon tan me tog snying mtshungs nor gyis ⑧ni/ /yon tan nyid de yon tan la ni nor min nor ⑨dha byo dha nī no gu sh+lau kā yā duḥkṛ ta sa: pā ta sha ma nā dā yurgu ldan bsngags 'os yon tan ldan pa min/ /slong ba'i ngan byas tshogs rnams zhi ba dag las nor ni yon tan ḍā rmā dha rna/ /i ti pā ṇ+ḍa bye kārba su pa kyu rā kasbya sā ba tsaḥ/ /sī dza rnams kyi tshe srog yin/ /de skad srog las nor lhag pa/ /de yis bdag po'i tshig thos nas/ /'khri shing 95—220

nā shu ka rtotrīr+ṇa la te ba bhu ta ṣat+pa dā/ /a tha pra ba ha dz+wa bhe dze rkang drug pas brgyan ①bzhin/ /mig dman dze+edang bcas mchi thigs rgyas/ /de nas de dang lhan cig tu/ /sārja nā thasta yā pa ha/ /tī bra dṛṭ+wā kṛ tī tā rna hasta pā tram̐ ma ho don mthun mgon gyi snegru gzings bsten/ /sred pa drag po 'dzin rnams kyisadu/ /chu gter chen po lag da dhiḥ/ /ta gya dzā yā sa kha snga sau kas+thā bā tā nu baṭī naḥ/ /a bha bye ta pa'i snod/ /las rjokyi rlung gi rjorjes zhugs pa/ /chung ma'i grogs ldan de yi gzings/ /yid la re ba pra ba ha khaṃ sa ma no ra tha dzī bi tai/ /ta taḥpha la kā bāsgyu bha ga she ṣārtso srog dang bcas/ /chu gter du ni zhig par gyur/ /de nas las kyi longs spyod kyi/ /lhag mas shing dum kan+d+ra ṇaḥ/ /ka she ru dī pi mā sā r+ya tat+pasbyi na bya ba r+yata/ /a nā tsā ta tra sho bzung gyur pas/ /ka se ru yi gling phyin nas/ /de yi ⑦chung ma shi ma gyur/ /der ni bsam pa nyams tsarnyi bi haṃ gaḥpu ru ṣā kṛ tiḥ/ /tā mā pa pā da dīr+ṇa shaṃ su par+ṇa gyur cing / /mgon med mya ngan byed de dang / /'dab bzang rigs las skyes pa'i bya/ /skyes bu'i ku la saṃ bha baḥ/ /sa kārnye su mu kho nā ma tā mu ba tsa ru tsā kṛ taḥ/ /dbyibs can phrad par gyur/ /mdzes pas phrogs pa bzhin bzang ming / /de yis mdzes ma ⑧de la smras/ /sa mā shwa se hi lo lā k+ṣi nir+bha yo yo ta pā shra yaḥ/ /de bye yi su bha gā byu mig ni g.yo ma yid brtan mdzod/ /gnas 'dir ⑨spyod la 'jigs pa med/ /'di ni skal bzang mchog mi ba yo twa ta pra ṇa ma ṣi ṇaḥ/ /pu nadzā tā si ka spyo ṇi gho ro gi sa/ /bdag ni khyod kyi 'dod pa 'tshol⑩/ /chu srin 'byung gnas 'di 'jigs rung / /dge ma khyod yi ma ka rā ka raḥ/ /i kyuk+tate na sha na kaidwo tā rat+na la yo kṛ haṃ/ /saṃ ni yang skyes so/ /de yis 'di brjod dal bu yis/ /rin chen rang bzhin khang par phyin/ /mngal ni pūr+ṇa gaṭ+wā ta na yo tsā ru rū pa ma pū ta sā/ /badzha mā na shi sho ta smin sā yongs su rdzogs de la/ /gzugs mdzes bu dag btsas par gyur/ /byis pa de ni cher skyes tshe/ /rim 95—221

sha ṣ+peḥsri ya bā di nā/ /muk+ta te na bi dasnye na saṃ sgo gā bhi mu khā+e kṛ tā/ /gyis snyan par smra byed pa/ /mkhas pa de yis mdzes ma de/ /longs spyod dag la mngon phyogs byas/ /sa ra la tāsmṛ du tārtso sa m+bi pa pra ṇa yī dza naḥ/ /swa ya mā ligh+ra te sdi drang nyid phyir dang 'jam nyid phyir/ /mdza' gcugs nye ba'i skye bo la/ /bud med rang nyid 'khyud gyur bhir+ya tā bhi ra ba pā da paḥ/ /di byod+mā ṣ+pe 6 sā te na ra ma mā ṇ+ḍa gha na sta de① —/ /rkang 'thung dag la 'khri shing bzhin/ /de yis mchog gi dhiskyed tshal du/ /nu rgyas de la rol pa nī—/ /ku mā ra ru tsi rā kā re su 6 be sa tro shaṃ pi tuḥ/ /tasmin pad+ma mu las—/ /gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rnam pa can/ /pha dang mtshungs pa btsas par gyur/ /pad+ma'i bzhin zhes khā bhi khye yo ba nā lam̐ kṛ tā kṛ to/ /su mu khaḥpak+ṣi hūṃ rā dz+wa kā le bya ba de/ /lang tsho'i rgyan byus brgyan pa yis/ /dus su 'dab chags rgyal po ni/ /bzhin bzang 'jig lo kot+ta ram̐ ya yo/ /ta taḥpad+ma mu khaḥshrī mā nā sa sā da pa rda pi tuḥ/ /gu ṇi rten gzhan du song / /de rjes dpal ldan pad+ma'i bzhin/ /pha yi gnas ni thob gyur zhu te/ /yon tan nā ma bi bā de na swa bye nāḥku la sadza daḥ/ /pāste shwabye ta ma ba data bi can la rtsod med du/ /rigs kyi phun tshogs ④rang dbang 'gyur⑤/ /kun tu de yi mthu dag ni/ /gtso dza ṣ+pe dza na nī su tai/ /taza bhā ba su saṃ bhā bya sarba tra pra bha biju tai/ /pu bo'i nus ldan nyid shes nas/ /dbang phyug thob pa'i bu de la/ /skye bo med par 0ma yis smras/ /bu tra pāṭ+wā nā ya la smre ri yo ni dza ku lo tsi tā/ /a yo tu sārja bā hād+me gcig rang rigs la 'os pa'i/ /dpal 'byor 'di ni khyod kyis thob/ /ded dpon las skyes bdag gi bu/ /dzā taḥpu tro ni ram̐ sha kaḥ/ /bā rā ṇa snga ma yo rā dzā swa shas+thā kṛ ya tsā twa yā/ /'di la skal ba yod ma yin/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑦rang stobs kyis/ /khyod kyi ⑧'di ni rgyal por gyis/ /spru ti saṃ bā da sā swā daḥswa de she swe ba sam pa daḥ/ /i ti mā turgi rā pak+ṣi rang yul nyid du phun tshogs pa/ /dga' ba nyams myong ro dang bcas/ /de skad ma yi tshig gis byas⑨/ /95—222

pak+ṣa pā te na bhu ya sā/ /skadhe bhā ta ra mā ro gya byo: bā rā ṇa sī ya yo/ /ta gshog rlabs shin tu che ba yis/ /spun zla phrag pa la khyer nas/ /mkha' las bā rā ṇa sīr ① song / /de tra sau hā sā nā sī ā+oṃ bra h+ma darte ma tī pa to/ /sa dza s+thā ṣ+pe kā de na badzo nas sa bdag tshangs pas byin/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa dag /drag rno rdo rje'i sder mo rnams/ /de gra na kha riḥkha riḥ/ /a bhi ṣi tsā gra dze+e pūrte tam+bin+de ba dṛ pā sa yis lan gcig ①bsnun nas bsad/ /rgyal po'i stan ni de nyid la/ /phu bo rdzogs par dbang bskur ṣ+pe—/ /ā mā t+yā na po ba data bhi tān sa ma grwa na gra bi kra maḥ/ /ya gya rā nas—/ /blon po 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtsal mchog ldan pa des smras pa/ /bdag gis rgyal zlo bhe ṣik+ta gya ma yā yaḥpra tsa li ka raḥ/ /so pya tī ta pra sgo bhabh+ya ta me por dbang bskur 'di/ /gang gis rab tu skyod byed na/ /de yang ②rje la gus pa yis/ / 'das pa ④bā nu ga mi 6 ti/ /i kyughā pra ba rā mā t+yā na sri ri bi haṃ ge puṅga baḥ/ /ya yo de rjes 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rab mchog blon la dal bu yis/ /'di smras bya yi gang zag ni/ /spun la sgyu ta ra mā mabye pu narde sha na saṃ bi dā/ /sa e ba bra h+ma dasto ya mi phyis kyang phrad pa yi⑤/ /'gro ba zhus du nas song bar gyur/ /tshangs byin de nyid 'di'o zhes/ /blon po ti madh+ri ṇa marnyi r+ṇa/ /sa dri pa byu ti mā ye de swa dza ṣ+pe 6 pa re 6 tsa/ /a rnams kyis bgros pa las/ /rang gi skye bo gzhan la yang / /mi bdag de ni grags pa thob/ /skabs tān+ta re sa mā nī tā gaṭ+wā hasnyi ṭī ba nā ta/ /na mu mo tsār+bha nir+ya tai der nags nas blangs pa yi/ /mngal dang bcas pa'i glang mo zhig /mngal ni nang nas bkag pa bzhin/ /gar+bha rudha mi bān+ta re/ /sā dhī ka rā gra saṃ spar+sha di yo gasgo be+e muñtsa ti/ /phyed ni phyir byung grol ma gyur/ /bud med dag pa'i lag rtse yis/ /reg pas mngal ni ④grol bar gyur/ /i ti mū tūrte kā diṣ+ṭi rāzlo madh+ri n+ya be+e da yata/ /shā sā nā da tha byu bhartuḥces pa ⑧rtsis pas bstan pa ni/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal la smras/ /de nas sa yi bdag po'i bkas/ /95—223

spyoṣ+ṭa ha ste na ha ste nī/ /an+taḥpu dzā ga nābyu krusta tra sa rkyo pa yā tsa pho brang 'khor gyi bud med kyis①/ /lag pas glang mo sdel reg nas/ /der ni bden pa'i byin brlabs rna—/ /tā sā sa t+ya gi rā gar+bha nā bh+ya dzata ka ri bhā ya dā/ /ta dā bi lakhyuḥsarbo byu ta byas—/ /gang tshe de dag bden tshig gis/ /glang mo'i mngal — ma grol ba/ /de tshe rgyal po'i pho brang gi①/ /byu yā mān+taḥpu re dza naḥ/ /a tha tsā r+pā ga nā bye t+ya shī la sa rkyo pa yā rtsa rna/ /skye bo thams cad skyengs par gyur/ /de nas ba glang rdzi mo zhig /mngon phyogs ngang tshul bden pa'i tshig /kṛ tā ba spar+sha ka ri khro ye nā sau gar+bha ma bh+ya dza ta/ /ra dzā pi ni dza dzā yā shā smras nas glang mo la reg pa/ /gang gis mngal 'di grol bar gyur/ /rgyal po'ang rang gi btsun mo rnams//dzñā tā shrī la da ri dra tsā/ /me ṣ+pe go r+pā mad+ma me ba hūṃ dza gasti ta yi pi tī/ /tshul khrims kyis dbul nyid shes nas/ /ba glang rdzi mo de nyid ni/ /'gro ba gsum na dag par sems/ /sa sa tī dzā ti lo bhe na so sus+thā nā ma tata su tai/ /pa ri bhā yā nī nā yā gre te dag pa'i rigs la chags pa des/ /de yi bu mo so sum bā/ /zhes pa mdun du yongs blangs pa/ /lha bī shasda gya pā dra hūṃ/ /ta suḥsaṃ tsi t+ya la ba bye tsa pa latwo tsa yo ṣi tsā/ /mo'i sgra yi snod nyid gyur/ /bud med g.yo ba nyid dag dang / /de yi ④mdzes pa bsams rjopa las/ /sa sarba gā mi dī ni dā ma pi ta t+yā dza shaṃ ki taḥ/ /asmin+da ba sa re duṣ+ṭi dogs pa'i kun tu 'gro ba yis/ /gnyid kyang de yis btang bar gyur/ /bar skabs der 0ni spun zla la//bhā ta ram̐ bi haṃ gā dhi paḥ/ /ya yo bha dra mu khaḥste hā da ti sha yorlu kaḥ/ /mdza' las shin tu gcugs pa yi⑦/ /bya yi bdag po pad+mo'i bzhin/ /de la blta ⑧ru 'ongs par gyur/ /khyu pā lo pi ta ma bo gya sī t+yā bi hi ta sadṛ tiḥ/ /bi dza ṣ+pe swa ka thā masmi sa bdag gis kyang de la 'khyud/ /dga' ba yis ni bkur ste bsgrubs/ /skye bo med sar de la ni/ /ni be+e r+ya pu na ra bra bīta/ /shi la sa t+ya tu lā ro hāta dṛṣ+ṭa do ṣe ṇa yo rang gtam bshad nas yang smras pa/ /ngang tshul bden pa'i srang gzhal bas/ /bud med rnams kyi skyon 95—224

ṣi tsā/ /ma mān+taḥpu ra be+e mu khyuta bi bā ho bhi na baḥkṛ taḥ/ /mthong nas/ /bdag ni btsun mo'i tshogs las phyir/ /phyogs te bag ma gzhan gsar blang ①/ /rū pa yo ba na gā mi dzñā ta myu ma pi na me j-i tiḥ/ /e ka tra dṛṣ+ṭa do ṣā rde gzugs dang lang tsho 'gro ldan ma/ /de la'ang bdag ni mi ston te/ /gcig la skyon ni mthong ba rnams/ /sarba tā shaṃ ka te ma naḥ/ /tasmrat+ta ba pu re hūṃ tarnirmā nu bye ni dī ya tram̐/ /shrī kun la yid ni dogs pa skye/ /de slad spun zla khyod kyis ni/ /grong khyer mi med dag tu bzung / /ngang la saṃ kā pa ri t+yā bye bha bā mi bi ga ta dz+ra raḥ/ /tasmra ta pra ti ni shaṃ pakhye tshul la ni dogs btang nas/ /bdag ni rims dang bral bar 'gyur/ /de las de ni mtshan de bzhin⑦/ /shā sa nāṭ+wā ba mad kṛ haṃ/ /pā pa yi 6rnyi tai sī ra mi t+ya yi me ma no khrod kyi bka' las 'dab chags kyis/ /dal bus khyer nas bdag khyim du/ /'ong bar 'gyur ba 'di ra thaḥ/ /i ti bhā turba tsaḥkhru tā ta mu bā tsa bi haṃ ga maḥ/ /irnyuḥshaṃ kā bdag ①'dod/ /de skad phu bo'i tshig thos nas/ /mkha' la 'gro bas de la smras/ /dogs pa'i dri mas ka lo ke na rā dzam+bi bye ba mā kṛ thāḥ/ /na nā ma ra ma ter bye nā swā rda besti phrag dog ni/ /rgyal po rdzun pa nyid ma byed/ /phrag dog dug gis rtag gzir ba/ /dga' bar bya ba sgo dza ṣ+pe/ /na pa sh+ya ti na ni dra ti ni t+ya m+bimyu bi ṣā tu raḥ/ /kli baḥkā des mi dga'/ /bza' ba rnams kyi ro mi rig /blta ④ ba ma yin gnyid ma yin/ /ma ning 'dod m+bi su khā+e bi dān dha nī na mraḥpra byuḥk+ṣa mi/ /adhī mā n+yaḥkha laḥsnaghaḥshā ldan bde ldan mkhas/ /nor ldan dud pa rje bzod ldan/ /slong ba khengs pa mi bsrun ⑤des/ /bud sa tī ti ka dze+e ba kā/ /sa ra la twa pi ku ṭi khāḥs+thā pi byo be+e ti rtsa tsa laḥ/ /ku med dag ces gtam nyid ci/ /drang po la yang gya gyu can/ /gnas pa na yang shin tu g.yo/ /rigs lī nā a pi pār+has+thā mā dzi shaṃ h+ye ba khā la tāḥ/ /dṛjirlo lā dha ro rā ldan yin yang logs gnas pa'i/ /bud med 'khri shing 'khyud par byed/ /mig g.yo mchu ni chags dang 95—225

gi bhūrbagh+ra ka thi nista no/ /dṛ sh+ya te ṣ+pe ba ni rdo ṣaḥrgyu shā ma ba ya be+e bcas—/ /smin ma 'khyog cing nu ma sra/ /bud med rnams kyi cha shas la'ang / /skyon med mthong ba nyid khya pi/ /bhu rdzu te ku sha le'ishā mā bhā ma bha ma ra bi sgyu miḥ/ /mū khā dz+wa ྾ sa yod min/ /mkhas pas g.yo ldan bung ba yi/ /rnam par rol pas bud med spyad/ /mtsho skyes rtsa ba ro dza t+yāḥpaṃ ke ṣ+pe bo pa li pya te/ /ṣ+pe kasmin bisma ya bhu r+pā pa smi btsal ba na/ /'dam gyis nye bar gos pa nyid/ /'dzum bcas ya mtshan dag gis ni/ /gtsang sbra ngang tā dzñā ni yan+t+ra dhe/ shu tsi shī la bi rā ma rde rā mā rde ra ma ṇi ma tiḥ/ /ta thā tshul dag dang bral/ /bud med rnams ni nges bsdams pa'i/ /dga' ba gcig ① la blo ma yin/ /de lta pi ya di nirban+dhaḥkri ya hūṃ dā dhīspru tai/ /pra t+ya haṃ ma ta pu roṭ+wā ṣ+pe na yang gal te 'bad/ /gang zhig mngon par bzhed bupar mdzod/ /nyin re bdag grong skyed mos tshal/ /nirja na sā ni dhī ya tsā/ /i t+yāk+taḥpak+shi rja bhā tā dṛ pa tirngi pa sardza hūṃ/ /tsā tī skye bo med sa de gzhag bya1 / /spun zla 'dab chags kyis de smras/ /ka se ru ka'i gling du ni/ /de dang ka she ru ka dī pa tai tsa saskṛ t+ya sā da raḥ/ /pā pi pra ti ni shaṃ byosna kha mdzes ma mi bdag gis/ /gus bcas bsnyen bkur byas te btang / /de yang gling du skyes pa yi/ /dri gā rū ṭ+wā sa mā ya yo/ /di bya gan+t+ra ma yī mā khā mā dā yā dī pa saṃ bha mchog rang bzhin 'phreng ba blangs④// /bya la zhon nas mtshan re zhing / /nam mkha' las ni 'ongs par ⑤r+pā—/ /pā ri dzā tā nā ya ta ro ṭ+wā ni puṣ+ṭha rgya bā pa sā/ /byu tā ni ti mi rā gyur—/ /yongs 'du'i rjes 'gro ljon pa yi/ /me tog de dag de yis thob/ /bung ba g.yo ba'i mun ṇi bh+ra ma ta dz+re gān+dha ka rā taḥ/ /a tha bā rā ṇa sī bā sī kā dā tsid+mā na gtibs pas/ /grags pa yi ni rab rib bzhin/ /de nas nam zhig mā na ba/ /zhes pa gnyis skyes bā bhi dhaḥ/ /pra ya yo sa mi dha hā rī dī dzad+mā kā na ā+oṃ yu bā/ /ta tra kin+da ra kā gzhon nu ni/ / bā rā ṇa sīr kwa gnas pa cig⑦ /nags nas yam shing len du song / /der ni mi 'am ci 95—226

mi t+yā sa tri ṣ+ṭaḥ spa ṣ+ṭa mad+ma thaḥ / /ya gya saṃ dar+sha ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba sā bha mo yis/ /yid srubs ①gsal ba de mthong gyur/ /gang zhig mthong ba nyid kyis de/ /dran pa rnam par bta bi smṛ ta smṛ tīḥ/ /ta sri ban bā bhi khā ṣi ṇa dza na ke ṣ+pe ba sabe+e tā/ /kān+ta brjed par gyur/ /gsar du mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /phas bzhin de la de gtad nas/ /mdzes kārnyi ma yī nā ma bi dza hā ra gu hā kṛ he/ /ta tā bha ra ṇa rarja shuḥldan zhes pa'i mjos ma dang / /phug gi khang par rnam par rol/ /rin chen rgyan gyi 'od zer gyis/ /r+pā ta ti mi roṅka re/ /ra ma mā rja tsi rarnye na kā le pu tra ma bā pa pā/ /ba la rab rib tshogs ni des bsal te/ /de dang yun ring rtses pa las/ /dus su bu ni de yis thob/ /bu de bān ma ru ta dza baḥs bā byo pi ya dā shi shuḥ/ /ta dā su mā tā saṃ dzñā shī gh+ra ga byes pa nyid la yang / /gang tshe stobs ldan rlung ltar mgyogs/ /de tshe ma yis de yi ming / /myur 'gro i t+ya sā dha bhū ta/ /sā nirbisna saṃ sgo ga su khā j-ibhā gu hān+ta re/ /zhes par bsgrubs par gyur/ /bgegs med longs spyod bde ba yis/ /ngoms med de yang phug gzhan du/ /pri yi j-i tā ba dā yā ti pi dh+wa ya shi la yā kṛ haṃ/ /ka dā tsi da tha bṛṭ+wārnyi mdza' bo bzhag ④nas rdo ba yis/ /phug ni bsgribs shing rtag tu 'gro/ /de nas nam zhig pha yis ni/ /ni dzi pi tā ni bi de tai/ /ā kasbya shī gh+ra gabyen+ta bismra yā ku li to ba da rang gi spyod pa'i mtha' rnams bshad/ /myur 'gro yis thos bsam pa ni/ /ya mtshan dag gis rgyas pas ①ta—/ /shi lā ni badha dā re smin+da tha ka gye ma gre hān+ta re/ /a ho sde ho bye yi smras—/ /khyim gzhan sgo ni rdo ba yis/ /long ba bzhin du bsdams pa 'dir/ /kye ma yab khyod mdzes tā ta ta ba bar+sā na hūṃ ga taḥ/ /e hi bā rā ṇa sī me ba gatshwa bste ni pas kyang / /bcings pa 'di nyid dag tu gyur/ /tshur shog ④khyod kyi rang gi gnas/ / bā rā ṇa sī dudzā spa rda/ /bi su lā ma pya yo me na shi khā muṭ+wā ra yā mya haṃ/ /swa de sha bi nyid du 'dong / /che yang 'bad pa med par ni/ /rdo ba bdag gis bsal bar byas 0/ /rang yul bral 95—227

ra ha gre shaṃ duḥs haṃ sa ha se ka rja/ /taste na shakya te kai— da di ba'i nyon mongs ni/ /bzod par dka' ba ji ltar bzod/ /rang gi lus bzhin yul dag ni/ /sus sho de ha i ba swa kaḥ/ /bhā ram̐ dra bi rde saṃ bhā ram̐ be+eti grabyu gu ṇa gu rde/ /kyang gtang ①bar mi nus so/ /rang yul bral ba'i skye bo rnams/ /nor gyi tshogs ni khur po dang / /sgo ga ni ru pa yo gañtsa swa de sha bi ra tī dza naḥ/ /i kyuk+ta sa gu hā ge longs spyod nye bar longs spyod min/ /yon tan thag ⑤pa'i mdud par rig /ces smras phug gi khang pa hā dut+yā r+ya bi pu khā shi dze+e/ /kṛ tā byu ta ga me nā shu dza na ke na ya yo nas—/ /rdo ba chen po des ①bsal nas/ /khas blangs pa yi pha dang ni/ /lhan cig mgyogs par song sa hā/ /pra yā ta yothorte sa ma bhe t+yā tha kin+da rī/ /shā bye dṛṭī gu ha bar gyur/ /de dag myur du song de nas/ /mi 'am ci mo mngon par 'ongs/ /phug khyim stong pa mthong ge haṃ nirbe dā di t+ya tsin+ta yata/ /a hotre be+e smṛ ta sne haḥs ga taḥkwa pi gyur nas/ /snying mi dga' ste 'di ltar bsams/ /kye ma bdag la gcugs pa brjed/ /skye bo ngan pa de durdza naḥ/ /dī dzi hā rmā bhū j-i gā rna kau ṭi sum̐ bā ki ma da byu tai/ /na ra madhe pa gar song / /lce gnyis pa dang lag 'gro yis④/ /gya gyu nyid la'ang rmad byung ci/ /bde la chags ldan khā yarnye sar+yadhe su kha rā gi ṇaḥ/ / tsi ras+thā a pi niḥsne hāḥshu ka mjug tu ni/ /dga' bar mi byed 'gros ⑤par byed/ /ring du gnas kyang mdza' gcugs med/ /skye i ba dī dza ta yaḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsidh+yā sā pa h+phurni kā rā ta dī ti ma t+ya dzata/ /gnyis ldan pa ṣ+pe tso bzhin/ /de ltar bsams nas de yis ni/ /gnod las khyo la dga' ba btang / /pusgo sa mā ni sre mā ṇi na sa hadhe ka daza rmā/ /bi byā gu ṇi na kai nā sau me tog lta bu du mdza' ba yis/ /gnod pa bzod pa ma yin no/ /bdag gi bu ni ⑦rig byed dang / /pu tro mai bhu bi dzi ba ti/ /a ti dh+yā tā sa khri haste tasmi bī shā di de sha sā/ /yon tan gang gi ⑧sa la 'tsho/ /zhes bsams ⑨grogs mo'i lag tu ni/ /de la de yi ⑩rgyud mang springs/ /95—228

saṃ sgo ga su kha pa bye ba sī tiḥpa ti 6 yo ṣi tsā/ /a parlu ṣa ta bāt+pa longs spyod bde ba'i zong dag gis/ /bud med rnams ni khyo ①la dga'/ /mnyes gshin yongs su ma pyuḥpu tra spru tistu nibyu lāḥ/ /dza be+e na gra dza tostur+ṇa ta yosdordza n+ya ladz+dza nyams pa/ /bu la dga' ba g.yo ba min/ /de dag tshul ngan ngo tsha nas/ /mgyogs pas myur du 'gro ba yā—/ /shī gh+ra gā ya da do bī khaṃ tat+pa khā+e be+e ga ga mi smi/ /ā byā tadh+ri ri yo nā la/ /de yi grogs mo mgyogs 'gro mas/ /myur 'gro la ni rgyud ②mang byin/ /'di yi rgyud ni dang po myuḥspaṣ+ṭa byā bisna kā ra bhā/ /i t+yā bhā 6 ta yā dahūṃ spru hūṃ shā pya dza 'dir—/ /reg par mi bya gegs snebyed yin/ /de skad smras nas de ④byen pas/ /rgyud mang blangs nas gā ma sāḥ/ /ta taḥswa de she dza na kai swa kṛ te bi ni be+e byu saḥ/ /bī ṇ+ḍa pra spru ṇaḥde song gyur/ /de nas rang yul rang khyim du/ /de yi pha ni bzhag byas nas/ /rgyud mang bgrengs pa ⑤pa ṭu sarba tra khā r+ghaṃ pū dza bāp+ta bān/ /ta taḥka dā tsi: ni dzā oṃ bu bye dī pa mkhas pa yis/ /kun tu rnyed dang mchod pa thob/ /de nas nam zhig tshong pa dag /chu gter gling du gā mi nā/ /a ro pi taḥpra ba ha khaṃ di bya bī zla nu ra gi ṇ+ḍa/ /bī ṇa sprusgo 'gro ba rnams/ /lha yi rgyud mang la chags pas/ /de ni gzings la skyon 0par gyur/ /de yis ⑦rgyud na yā ta su sho tra r+pā yu ṣa dh+wa ra yā/ /k+ṣa ṇi k+ṣa ṇi sa mu dro pi nista mang yid 'phrog pa/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi'i ⑧rgyun dag gis/ /skad cig skad cig rgya mtsho yang / /rlabs dzā ga i ba bha bta/ /a thā r+ya ta ṭī saṃ spar+sha dut+parjo pa sla bodz+re te/ /ni med pa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dang po'i rgyud dag la/ /reg pas nyer 'tshe rab bskyed de/ /bhasne bra ba ha ṇi sarba ba ni dzā ma bha ba1 yaḥ/ /ta taḥpha la ha kā bsgyu gzings ni rab tu 'phar zhing chag⑨ /tshong pa thams cad brlag ⑩par gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag ma yis/ /pa ba na sre ri taḥk+ṣa ṇ+ḍa ta/ /ka she ru dī pa mā be de kan+d+ra she ṣe ṇa shī gh+ra gaḥ/ /myur 'gro yis ni shing dum thob/ /rlung gis bskyod nas skad cig gis/ /ka se ru yi gling du phyin/ /95—229

ta tābhi kyu la saṃ lī rna di byod+mā rna pra bi sh+ya saḥ/ /shā rmā da dar+sha so sum̐ bā der ni chu gter ngogs 'gram gyi/ /skyed tshal mchog tu rab zhugs des/ /nu ma me tog chun po dag /musgon+da sta ba kasta nā/ /gā t+na tīrnyi mi rā khyu rmā puṣ+ka nā mudz+dza la shri yo/ /rab rgyas bud med so sum bā/ /me tog dri sar zhes bya ba'i/ /'phreng ba rab 'bar rgyud byed cing / /ni ban+dha rna ta nu gu rdeḥkur+pā ṇa ma pya tsi ta r+pā/ /sā pi tai ru tsi rā sems med rnams kyang lus kyi ni/ /yon tan rmis nges 'ching byed mthong / /des kyang mdzes pa'i rnam kā ram̐ dṛ ṭī bisma ya mā ya yo/ / dhī ram̐ shi sha ba tā ru rgya sarnyi pa can/ /brtan pa byis pa lang tsho yis①/ /mtshams kyi dbus gnas ②nyid gyur pa/ /de mthong ya ma dh+ya s+thā tā ga tai/ /mā ra mā ru ta saṃ pā tsa sa kalpa ka ra pal+la bā/ /mtshan dag tu gyur/ /'dod pa'i rlung gis rab bskyod pas/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab g.yo ldan zhing / /sā shir+ṇa shī la ku su mā la te ba pra ṇa nā ma tai/ /sa ha sā tsi rā rū bye ba sbyi ngang tshul me tog lhung ba des/ /'khri shing bzhin du de rab ①btud/ /'phral la yun ring 'grogs pa tiḥpro bhā ta yo ra bhuta/ /s+thāsngad+masne ha paṃ lī rna na muñtsa ti ma bzhin—/ /de dag mchog tu mdza' bar gyur/ /skye ba snga ma'i mdzar gcags ④pa/ /yid kyis yid ni nasma naḥ/ /ra ma mā ṇa di bā te na ni shā yī tsa ma tī bhu dzā/ /ma ṣ+pe mi mthong ngo / /nyin par de dang dga' byed cing / /mtshan mo yang ni sa bdag dang / /sbas ⑤pa'i tsā ri ta ba ma tāta thra yo gru bhā kā mu ka/ /te ṣ+pe ba bā rā ṇa sbo gan+tu 'dod ldan mdza' bor ni/ /g.yon ma'i spyod pa nyid la bubasams/ /spyod tshul shes pa ⑦des de la/ /dzñā rtu bṛste nā sābe+e tā/ /tam+bi nā ya kha gā rū ṭ+wā taṅgi rā m+bi li te k+ṣa ṇi/ / bā rā ṇa sīr 2 'gro don gnyer/ /de yi tshig gis mig btsums nas/ /bya la zhon nas de yis phyin/ /bā ri to pi byosdi na ya pod+mā la ṣ+pe ta yā/ /so bha bta sa ha si bārnya de yis zlog ⑨par gyur mod kyang / /mkha' la mig ni phye ba yis/ /chu gter g.yo ba'i bsgribs pa'i mig /95—230

tsa pa lābyi thra te k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /sā ta man+taḥbu rod+mā ṣ+pe ni dh+wa ya bha ya kā ta rā/ /de ni 'phral nyid long bar gyur/ /pho brang 'khor gyi skyed tshal du/ /de yis de bzhag 'jig ① pa yis/ /bi be+e sha sho ka san+tabhā shayā beshra ma tī pa teḥ/ /dru ya mā ṣ+pe na ma na skrag cing mya ngan gyis gdungs pas/ /sa bdag gzims pa'i khang par zhugs/ /yid ni shin tu gdung sā ra dza bhā ma ti bā khya tsā/ /pā tarna gabye na s+thā ḍū tsid+dhā krād+dhā ba yis/ /mtshan mo de ni 'das bubyas nas/ /tho rangs bsam ④pas zil non ④des/ /'gro dang sdod sha sha ka sā/ /a tān+ta re sa mudhū ta tsū ta sau ra bha nir+bha raḥ/ /ma dhu par nus ma gyur/ /skabs der tsu ⑤ta dri bzang gi/ /tshogs ni yang dag rgyas gyur cing / /me tog mā bo bi lā sā rmā yo ba rna put+pa dha na naḥ/ /ko ki lā li ku ku leḥgazhu can rtse dga' yi khya/ /lang tsho dpyid kyi zla ba ni/ /khu byug zung ⑦bas gnag gyur cing / /dus kyi ⑤ kā laḥkā laḥkā lo bi yo gi dzā/ /tīr+ṇa sho ka na bā sho ka duḥs haḥpra t+ya dṛ sh+ya te/ /bral ba rnams kyi ⑨dus/ /bzod dka' mya ngan 'grems byed pa⑩/ /mya ngan med gsar rab tu mthong / /rā dza pya bi ra toh+phu kyā dud+mā ṣ+pe gan+tu mud+ma taḥ/ /di na me ke na ta t+yā 'dod pas rmongs pa'i rgyal pos kyang / /sred dang ma bral skyed mos tshal/ /blta ⑪bar brtson pas nyi ma dzā sau shus+thā kā ma mo hi taḥ/ /sa ta yā sa ha rā ga su ma da su ma da na gya gcig /so sum bā ni btang ⑫ma gyur/ /de ni de dang lhan cig tu/ /chags dang rgyags dang 'dod pa tsa—/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba bi shā ti pa da put+pa ba rna ya yo/ /ta tra bā yis⑫/ /'khor ba bzhin du ngal gso'i ⑫gnas/ /me tog gi ni nags su song / /der ni rlung khā ni la lo la la tā bai lak+ṣu ka ri khye/ /pa sh+yan pra mo da mā pe de da gzhon gyis bskyod pa'i⑫/ /'khri shing skyengs par byed pa yi/ /btsun mo mthong nas sa yi bdag /rab yi tā me ba byu pa tiḥ/ /a n+ya rā ga bi ṣā krān+t+ra pā gya bhūd+mā li na smṛ tiḥ/ /tu dga' ba nyid du gyur/ /gzhan chags dug gis zil mnan ⑩pas/ /de yang dran pa zums ⑩par gyur/ /95—231

su kha ma pya su khaṃ ben+ti tsiṣ+ṭha sha spyo ku lasma naḥ/ /an+targa ta bhu rdza ga bsam pa'i zug rngus dkrugs ①pa'i yid/ /bde la'ang bde ba min par rig /lag 'gro nang du song ba rnyiḥ.ā+oṃ rnyi ra t+yan+da rā gi ṇaḥ/ /kabye kṛ tā bhi dṛ t+yarnyi mā khā bhi yis②| /bud med kyi ni 'phreng ba ①bzhin/ /mgrin par byas pas rmongs byas pa'i/ /shin tu chags ri ba mo hi tāḥ/ /ta tre kān+ta la tā kuñdza ni kuṭ+wā na nyi tasbi tiḥ/ /ldan bro gar byed/ /der ni dben par 'khri shing gi/ /tshogs kyis bsgribs ④par gnas byas pa0/ /arnyaḥsau ra bha mā s+thā ya so shus+thā ti mi ra pra dzaḥ/ /sa ha be+e ba bi kā re ṇa rā gā long bas so sum bā yi ni/ /dri sar 'phreng duba'i dri bzang tshor/ /'phral la nyid du chags pa yi/ /rnam ta bi smṛ ta saṃ thra tiḥ/ /a gā yad+ma da na spyi bā ga ṇa yan ti bha yi ku taḥ/ /'gyur las ni sbas pa brjed/ /glu blangs 'dod pas myos pa rnams/ /'jigs pa dag gis ⑦ga la rtsi/ /ta nu pa bta bi lā be+eḥtīr+ya mā ṇa thra yā sāḥs ma da ba da na pad+mā dman pa'i rlung gi rol pas ⑧bskyod par gyur pa'i ⑨dga' ma yis⑫/ /bzhin ni sgos ldan pad+ma'i dri mo da paṃ bā da sā raḥ/ /ti mi ra ku su ma garnyaḥso ya mā yā ti dru rāta khyu bzang tshogs pa'i snying po can/ /dri sar me tog dri de ring nas 'ongs par ⑪gyur pa 'di/ /bung ba'i ma ra ba ra ṇi bī ṇa bi bh+ra mā rā bar myaḥ/ /khru tā z-i da ya saṃ bā da gī tai tat+ta su bhū lam ni rgyud mang du ⑫'khrul sgra yis dga' bar 'os⑫/ /sa bdag gis ni de yi glu/ /snying la 'bab pa de pa tiḥ/ /ud+mān bi tsa yi kṛ tā tai da dar+sha la tān+ta re/ /gā bye ro thos nas/ /skyed mos tshal dag btsal byas pas/ /'khri shing nang du de mthong gyur/ /chags pa drag tsa ma da k+ṣi baṃ sa tai sa prats+tsha shaṃ ki taḥ/ /a pi dzā nā pi so sum̐ r+pā ta su bā lak+ṣa pos myos de la/ /dogs par gyur pa de yis dris/ /so sum bā 'am de yis ⑫ni/ /lus kyi mtshan nyid rde ta noḥ/ /so bra bī ta kin+da dz+wa nā mi so sum̐ bā bisbra pā ṭa le/ /u pa bisgo khyod shes sam/ /de smras so sum bā dag ni/ /ci phyir mi shes gang gi ⑫mchu/ /bim pa dkar dmar 95—232

dha re ya snga rā ga rā bye ma no bha baḥ/ /n+yaste sma re ṇi ba ta dru ru mū le chags pa yis/ /rgyal srid la ni yid 'byung zhugs①/ /'dod pas bkod bzhin de yi brla rtsa na ༷/ /le khā+e ma yo swaste ka maste kār+ghaṃ/ /ā birta sho bhā sta na maṇ+ḍa le bā khā ba ri mo'i 1rang bzhin bkra shis mdzes pa yod/ /'khyil pa sdug gu mdzes pa'i 'khor lo khyo'adra/ /de yi nu rgyu kakhro la ni bhā sbi ta sngaḥ/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tiḥs r+ya sad+dhā pa sho ṣi tai/ /ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la'ang yod/ /de dag thos nas mi bdag ni/ /yongs su gdung ba drag pos nyen/ /mu mo tsa rā ga ku su oṃ nirmā l+ya bi tse ta saḥ/ /so bra bīn+d+ra ste nā rī rde yid kyi chags pa me tog ni/ /rnying ⑤pa bzhin du dor bar gyur/ /de yis smras pa mi mo rnams/ /shi li rak+ṣu sha tai ra pi/ /kha put+pa mā le ba sa tī sarba thā ṣ+pe ba dzā bsrung ba brgyas dukyang tshul khrims minathu/ /nam mkha'i me tog 'phreng ba bzhin/ /dag pa rnam kun nyid ya te/ /i kyukyādhe na sa hi hūṃ dṛ pa.ā+oṃ sa bhū ba hūṃ/ /garda bhā ro du med/ /rgyal pos 'di brjod long ba dang / /lhan cig dur khror nags la de/ /myur du bong bu la pi tsā tūr+ṇa ta t+yā dza na ga rād+ma hiḥ/ /pā te na sa ha nirlasbyo bra dza: di na bskyon nas/ /grong khyer las ni phyir bton gyur/ /ngo tsha med par ④de dang de/ /lhan cig 'gro bas saṃ k+ṣa ye/ /a ṭa bye tso ra pa ti nā pāste sabhi ba saspa dā/ / dza nyin ⑨'das tshe/ /nags su chom rkun bdag po yis/ /phun tshogs dag dang bcas nyid thob/ /'phral ṣ+pe ra dha dru te tasmin sa ha sā tso ra maṇ+ḍa le/ /ni ra ba rā dha e bārnyastso ra la chom rkun dkyil 'khor dag /sngon ⑫bros de tshe skye bo yis/ /long ba nyes pa med pa nyid/ /chom rkun bhādh+yā ni pā ti taḥ/ /tso ro pi hūṃ ni shaṃ bhūghā so sum̐ bā k+ṣa ṇa saṃ ga taḥ/ /dag tu 'phrul ⑩nas bsad/ /so sum bā de rkun pos kyang / /skad cig 'grogs pas mtshan spyad nas/ /kṛ hi tā bha rā rja n+ya snga dza gā modhīr+ya nadz+re hūṃ/ /kā raṇ+ḍa bī yāḥs ri tasta de yi rgyan rnams blangs nas ni/ /chu bo rab tu brgal nas song / /chu klung ka ran da ba de'i/ /'gram 95—233

myu s+t+ri re ni rasba ra/ /shu shotsa sī dza ṣ+pe rā khru dza le sā ma li nasta byā/ /ta du gos dang bral ba des/ /mig sman dang bcas mchi ma'i chus/ /nu ma snog ①cing mya ngan byas/ /de smin k+ṣa ṇi mu khā sha k+shi rmā sa muskṛ bye dze+e bu ke/ /yā te dza lon+d+ra tai mabye ta da yi dus na wa skyes shig kwa /kha yi sha ni rab btang nas/ /chu la 'phar ba'i nya la song / /de ni dumakha' hār+yābyi haṃ ga maḥ/ /maṣ+ṭha ni laghi sa ha sā kha ge na pi se te z-i te/ /sa ba bhu la 'gro bas khyer/ /nya ni 'phral la gting du song / /sha ni bya yis phrogs pa'i tshe/ /gnyis ka ④nyams bo bha ya rja sāstsod+dhā nistsa la lo tsa naḥ/ /ta sngasta bīgh+ra duḥkhe pi mu khe pas de yis ni/ /bsams (dz+wapa mig ni g.yo med gyur/ /de mthong de yis bubazhin la ni/ /sdug kyang smi ta ma dṛ sh+ya ta/ /hā saḥs re 6 snga yi te 6 srurlo ba ra dzā yā te/ /'dzum pa mthong bar gyur/ /gzhan dag gi ⑨ni 'khrul pa la/ /'chir nye rnams kyang dgod pa yin/ /sa tsā bai lak+ṣu ku pi taḥpro ba tsā nu tsi ta sī tai/ /a ho ha sa si rmā lo ke skyengs pas khros pa de yis ⑧ni/ /mi 'os 'dzum pa de la smras/ /kye ma 'jig rten gad mo yi⑩/ /hā myu ya ta na tsā ga tī/ /dṛ pa ti t+yaghā ga sngarnya t+yaghārnya tso ra mā gnas gyur khyod nyid ⑩bdag la dgod/ /mi bdag btang nas long bar phyin/ /long ba btang nas chom shri tā / / ta bā ha mu bha ya bh+raṣ+ṭi tri bh+ra ṭ+wā yāḥsmi tā spa rda/ /ā༈ rkun bsten/ /gsum char nyams pa khyod kyis ⑩ni/ /'dzum pa'i gnas ni gnyis nyam nga / /yongs su bā pa ri hā so yo tai yusgyu ka ro mi te/ /kha khāste be+e ṣa ma s+thā rmā bgad ⑫pa 'di ni chog ⑫ /bdag ni rigs pas khyod phan bsgrub④/ /mi bzad gnas la gang zhig ni/ /ye bi ḍasbra na paṇ+ḍi tāḥ/ /i t+yāghā na ga ri ga tā sa dṛ pā ya n+ya be+e da ya tā/ /co 'dri'i mkhas pa de mi bsrun⑫/ /'di brjod grong khyer song nas ni/ /klung gi ngogs na so sum bā/ /so shus+thā ste na dī tī re ta so yuspri ti sad+ma tiḥ/ /a tha ni nā ya hūṃ dka' thub rigs pas (7gnas so zhes/ /blo gros bzang mos rgyal la smras/ /de nas gos dang rgyan 95—234

rā dzā bi tī t+yā bha ra rja sba dzā/ /do ṣā māsgo da ya h+ye ba rā ga she bskur nas/ /de ni rgyal pos blangs par gyur/ /lus can rnams kyi chags pa yis/ /lhag ma 47skyon ṣaḥsha rī ri rde/ /be+e bā drorba la brte ya mu dā yī shrī gh+ra go pya sau/ /pāstsad+mān+ta ni sgrib pa nyid/ /da lta'i ut+pal mdog 'di de/ / 'char ka 'di yang myur 'gro de/ /nyasngon tshe la1gzhan ra pu bye na bhikhyi bra ta mu pā ga to/ /a bha ba da ti ra sārda mā gyi bsod nams kyis/ /dge slong brtul zhugs nye bar thob/ /'di yi yid ni gang zhig chags pas sbyor na saṃ rā ga yo ge la da ma da na bi dhe yi rā ga yus+ho ya da sngaḥ/ /la nyams kyis rab brlan 0dang / /rgyags pa dang ni 'dod pa'i dbang gyur chags dang ldan pa nyid du gyur/ /bi ra ta sha ma bi tsā ra te na tasmi namu pho rte kṛ ta na ra pa ti rū pā des na de tshe yud tsam zhi ba rnam par dpyod pa dang bral nas/ /mi yi bdag po'i gzugs byas kun dga' nan+di bhā rmā ba ban+de / /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ldan pas bdag la phyag 'tshal gyur/ /zhes (brupa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ba dā na kalpa la tā yī de bā ba tā rā ba dā rna pañtsa da sha pabe+e waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las lha las babs pa'i ༷yal 'dab ste bco lnga pa'o// //ba la ma tu la bye r+ya bī bye sā: tram̐ bha ba ti sa bra bhā bā mthu ldan rnams kyis ⑦ mtshungs med brtan pa dang / /brtson 'grus stobs ni ngo mtshar bcas pa rmā—/ /ma ha tā shra ya yo gāta yasmi sarbo ma hi ma twa mā yā ti/ /yin—/ /chen po nyid la brten 'apa'i sbyor ba las/ /gang phyir thams cad chen po nyid du 'gyur⑨/ /pu rā ku shi pu rī ra rgyu malbā rna ba la shā lī rna/ /swesgo bi hā ri bha ga sngon ni stobs ldan gyad kyi gnas/ /ku sha'i grong khyer dga' ba ru/ /rang dgar rol pa'i bcom ldan bān pra ta ste su ga taḥswa yo/ /te ta dā ga ma rgo shu tā ka spyo khaṃ 'das—/ /bde gshegs rang nyid gshegs par gyur/ /legs par byon pa de thos nas/ /rim gro dag 95—235

ku sha le ṣi ṇaḥ/ /wat+pa saṃ sho dha ā+oṃ tsakru ru pa tsā ra pa dor+ya tāḥ/ /de shaṃ byu la rab brtson pa/ /dge ba 'tshol ①ba de dag gis/ /lam ni legs par sbyang ba byas④/ /rtswa dang tsher ṣa ya hūṃ te ྾ saṃ ses+ho tsan+da no da kaiḥ/ /tre ṇa kalco ka pā ṣā ṇa sarka ma rdo ba dang / /gseg 1ma rdul dag ④bsal byas nas/ /tsan+dan chu yis legs bran te/ /yul ni rā re rku brdzi tai/ /ma bye sa mā ya yo byu mi ni maghā ma ha tī shi lā/ /mdzes pa de dag gis⑤/ /dbus su 'bigs byed rgud ༷gyur pa'i/ /chung ma gting du zhum pa bzhin/ /a ba san+d+ra bi san+da su ba dhu bi bye gi re ri ba/ /tā mut+yā ta ya hūṃ te ྾ gting du bying ba'i rdo chen ni/ /sa las yang dag byung bar gyur/ /'byor dang dpung pa thag pa yis/ /kubyā la byu dza radzu nyiḥ/ /mā so dza gā ma na twa sngaḥs ha n+d+ra she gya byu ta k+ṣa tiḥ/ /a tha de ni sol la de dag rnams/ /zla ba song yang de yis ⑦ni/ /stong phrag cha yang zad ma gyur/ /de nas saṃ sā ra saṃ tā pa pra sha mā mṛ ta dī dhi tiḥ/ /ā ya yo bha ga bān saza 'khor ba'i yongs gdungs khyedag /rab tu zhi byed bdud rtsi'i zer/ /kun gyi yid ni dga' ba'i gnyen//mā na solbā sa ba n+dha baḥ/ /gha nārnya kā ra bi ra ti byak+taḥs pha la bcom ldan 'das ni byon par gyur/ /stug po'i mun pa dag dang bral/ /gsal zhing mthong ba 'bras dar+sha naḥ/ /pra sā da saṃ bi bhaghā shaḥpra kā sha i ba shā ra daḥ/ /sa tān dang bcas/ /rab dang phyogs ni rnam par bye⑨/ /rab tu gsal ba ston nyid ⑫bzhin/ /'bras med dṛṭī pa ri shrad+dhān bi pha la kle sha r+pā ḍi tān/ /khru tā tsa tabye ba si nyon mongs kyis gdungs pa/ /yongs ngal de dag des gzigs shing / /de dag gdungs gyur thos nas tai taza tse pra ṇa tā na nān/ /a ho kle sha pha khā ram̐ bhaḥsra yā sa kyang / /phyag 'tshal bzhin ldan der bka' stsal/ /ngal dub 'bad rtsol ldan pa khyed/ /'khor ba yis ⑪bya ba sā yi ghā/ /saṃ sā ra karma bhā tsasmin byā pā re baḥs mur+ya maḥ/ /pā ra bhe ni las la bzhin/ /bya ba 'di la rab brtson pa/ /kye ma nyon mongs 'bras bu rtsom/ /brtsams na 2/ mi 95—236

bi ṣa ma kle shaṃ kṛ ya mā rde sa saṃ sha yi/ /sidha ma pya nu pa de yo na bzad nyon mongs dang / /byed pa na yang the tshom bcas/ /grub kyang nyer mkho med pa'i las/ /shes pādzñāḥkarma kut+tha te/ /i kyughā tsa ra rde guṣ+ṭha ghaṭi tās+thā ma pā ṇi nā/ /rab ldan rnams yongs mi byed/ /de skad gsungs nas che ba'i rdo/ /zhabs mdzub kyis phyung g.yon pa yi//bi n+ya gya dak+ṣi ṇi pā ṇi bha ga bān bi pu la shi dze+e/ /bi mṛ rdzu bra h+ma lo phyag gis g.yas pa'i phyag tu ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bkod mdzad nas/ /mtha' med pha rol gnon kan+ta ma par+yan+ta pa pa rā kra maḥ/ /tsa kā rābyur+ya tsar+yā yā dū tī mi ba pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthar btang ste/ /'gro ba gsum du ngo mtshar gyi/ /spyod pa pho nya dza gat+tha ye/ /k+ṣibhā yī sa ha pā ta sde te nā t+yad bhū ta kā ri shā/ /ud ju bzhin du mdzad/ /shin tu rmad byung mdzad pa des/ /de ni 'phangs pa'i 'phral nyid la/ /rlung ni rab ta ga ga nod khyu ta i ba byāṭ+wā dza naḥswa naḥ/ /a ni t+yāḥsarba saṃ s+thā ra i t+ya tu langs pa bzhin/ /skye bo khyab pa'i sgra rab byung / /'du byed thams cad mi rtag nyid/ /'di ni bhān+ta bi ṅgā yi naḥ/ /sarba dharma ni rād+ma naḥshān+tad+nghar+pā ṇa me ba pata/ /i 'khrul pa med par byed/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med dang / /zhi ba myang 'das kho na yod/ /de ti sgu ṭo di te shasde shi khā bha ga ba taḥka re/ /gi rīn+d+ra shi ṣa rā kā rā sbi skad gsal ba'i sgra brjod de/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo ba ni/ /ri dbang rtse mo'i rnam pa can/ /slad tā pu na ra dro sh+ya ta/ /k+ṣa ṇi na sā bha ga ba tā k+ṣiste ba da na mā rū taiḥ/ /nas kyang ni gnas par mthong / /skad cig gis de bcom ldan gyi/ /zhal gyi rlung gis gzhig byas te/ /kṛ ta bi sā ri ṇi digru ba ra mā rku pa re pa rā/ /pu na re tī kṛ tā me mchog gi ngo mtshar brgyud ma ni/ /phyogs rnams kun lngotu bkram pa byas/ /slad nas phra rab rdul rnams ba bha ga bān pa ra mā rku bhiḥ/ /shi lā ma n+ya tra bi da dhe bisma yo nidzu —/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gcig nyid byas/ /gzhan du rdo dang 'gro gsum du/ /ma ①mtshan dag 95—237

tsa dza ga n+d+ra ye / / ābyar+ya ni bya la dṛ sha sta to ma lbā ba lom+bi kyang bzhag par mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan brtson 'grus dang / /stobs ni rdzogs pas ①gyad rnams tai—/ /bīr+ya bha ga ba to bīgh+ra pra ṇa tāste ba bhā ṣi re/ /a ho ma hā bhā bo yo dag /ngo mtshar mig ni mi g.yo bas/ /mthong nas phyag 'tshal der gsol pa/ /kye ma khyod kyi mthu chen pa la bītram̐ da yasta ba/ /ni: yā bye ga me ya gya na pra galhaḥsu rā po—/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus rgyas pa 'di/ /gang zhig nges par rtogs dupa yi/ /nus pa lha rnams a pi/ /a nu gra ha pra bṛste na pa le na gu ru shā ta ba/ /a bho ga ti ni la yang med/ /khyed ①kyi stobs dang ④bla ma ni/ /rjes su 'dzin la rab zhugs pas/ /rdo ba bying zhing masne yo dza na te bo rje tā shi lā/ /bīr+ya pra dzñā ba lā dī dzñā pra gting dag tu/ /song 'di skye bo ④bzhin du bton/ /ngo mtshar mchog mdzad khyod kyi ni/ /brtson mā shā ba bye nibya yi/ /a pi dzā nā ti te kabye dābyer+ya ta ra kā ri ṇaḥ/ /'grus shes rab stobs sogs kyi/ /tshad kyi mtshalas ni nges pa dag /su zhig gis kyang cang shes sam/ /i ti bru bā khyo nābyar+ya m+bi : khā ba lo kya tān/ /ta sde shi lā yā mā sī naḥde skad smras khya zhing ngo mtshar ni/ /g.yo med de rnams la gzigs nas/ /rdo ba de ④la rab bzhugs ④te/ /pro bā tsa bha ga bān dzi naḥ/ /ba lo ya te tī bhū tā rmā byu tā rgo bha ba na tra bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /srid gsum 'byung po rnams kyi stobs/ /gcig nyid du ni gyur pa ya / /su ga ta su ta de ka gya lo ke ṣ+pe ba saṃ gi shaṃ pa lo/ /e r+bha pi kuste gang / /bde gshegs gcig gi stobs de dang / /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa min/ /chu gter chu ni rasto dherdza garnyi pa ra mā rku bhiḥ/ /shakyā n+ya lo ga ṇa yi tsu pra bhā bum pa dang / /'gro rnams phra rab rdul dag gis/ /bgrang ⑨ba ru ni shin tu nub⑫/ /bde gshegs bo ra tu sau ga taḥ/ /saṃ khye su me rorlo betrī tu la mā ṣ+pe na ta twa taḥ/ /su ga mthu ni ma yin no/ /gang gi khwa/ srang gi tshad kyis ⑫ni/ /lhun po'i de nyid grangs rig pa/ /des kyang 95—238

tā rmā na dzā nā ti so pi sad gu ṇa go ra baṃ/ /ka tha yi te ti bha ga bān bde gshegs yon tan ni/ /dam pa'i phyi ba nyid mi rtogs/ /de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das①/ /saṃ pāste su ra maṇ+ḍa le/ /sa shakra pad+ma ni la ye tsakre ku sha la de sha rna/ /brgya byin pad+ma'i gnas dang bcas/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor 'ongs pa la/ /dge ba dag ni bstan pa mdzad/ /mal+lasta du pa di she na tat+ta da bo bye sa ma shā yāta/ /sa shā ba kā khye pra t+ya ka de yis de de nyer bstan pas/ /gyad rnams byang chub la brten nas/ /nyan thos zhes bya nyi tsher bcas/ /samyahūṃ budha tsā ya yuḥ/ /sgo taḥpāste pha lo kai— ta sa kṛ dā gā mi yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid gyur/ /'ga' yis rgyun zhugs 'bras bu thob/ /gzhan gyis lan gcig bye tsā pa riḥ/ /a nā gā mi pha lo tsā byeḥpāp+ta martata pa rda ba riḥ/ /i phyir 'ong yang / /phyir mi 'ong 'bras gzhan gyis te/ /gzhan gyis dgra bcom gnas thob gyur/ /de t+yā sha yā nu sha ya dh+wa tu ga ti ni rī k+ṣu dzñā tā ta thā pra kṛ ti ma ltar bsam pa phra rgyas khams dang 'gro ba gzigs gyur cing / /mkhyen nas rang bzhin de ltar mtshungs pa pra ti mo pa de shaṃ/ /te ྾ tsa kā ra bha ga bībya tu rār+ya pa t+ya sa med pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po yang dag rab gsal snyedri med pa/ /de dag myaspra kā sha bi sha rda ku lo da yā ya/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā rnams kyi dge ba spel slad bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang yī bo bye sa tā ba dā sna ka lpa la tā lnga shi la ni k+ṣe pā ba chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las brag nges par 'phangs pa'i rtogs pa dā ni sho ḍa sha pabe+e waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu drug pa'o// //a saṃ ga mo nā ma bi shu rnyi yā ma gre yī se sru te ku sha chags pa med rnams nges par rnam par dag pa'i gnas/ /dge ba mngon 'dod 'khor ba'i g.yon 95—239

khā bhi kā maḥ/ /saṃ sā ra bā maḥsu kṛ tā bhi rā maḥm no ma ledze+e dang legs byas la/ /mngon par dga' zhing yid kyi dri ma rnams ①dag gi/ /khon gyi rdul dang bral ba ra ra dzo bi rā maḥ/ /pu rā gi gā ma nudhīr+ya nā gā ram̐ pha ṇa se tu nā/ /dge legs bskyed pa yin/ /sngon tshe klu rnams gdengs ka yis⑤/ /zam pas gaṅgā legs par bsgral/ /bha ga bā na su ga ta su pā pya bhik+ṣu na bhā ṣa ta/ /e ha rat+na ma bcom ldan bde gshegs pha rol tu/ /byon nas dge slong rnams la gsungs/ /'dir sngon rin chen rang ya pūbaṃ yu po byu dbye tablu tiḥ/ /dar+sha yā mi ta ma tre ba trahūṃ baḥbazhin gyicha/ /mchod sdong rmad byung mdzes pa byung / /gal te dge mtshan khyed blta ④na/ /'di nyid du kau tu rka ya di/ /i byughā bha ga bān bhū mo pā ṇi nā di bya lagla rja/ /de bdag gis bstan/ /zhes gsungs sa la bcom ldan gyi/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa'i phyag dag gis/ /smṛṭī nā ga ga ḍo ta k+ṣibye rat+na yu pra ma dar+sha yata/ /tai dṛṭī snyik+ṣa reg pas klu yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /rin cen ⑤mchod sdong blangs 'unas bstan/ /dge slong thams cad paḥsarbe nad+mā nid+mā me k+ṣa ṇ+ḍabye ram̐/ /ba byu pu— tra li khi ta i ba nistsa de mthong nas/ /yun ring krumig ni mi 'dzum zhing / /lus ni g.yo ba med pa dag /ri mor ⑤bris pa la ni gra haḥ/ /taṅka thā ma thā taiḥthraṣ+ṭaḥbro bā tsa bha ga bān pu naḥ/ /a tī bzhin du gyur/ /de dag gis dris bcom ldan gyis/ /de gtam slar yang rab gsungs te/ /'das tā nā ga ta dzñā rgo dan+ta lo kaiḥki ram+bi pa/ /de ba pu tra pu rā kash+yi ta dang ma 'ongs mkhyen pa ni/ /tshems kyi snang bas 'grems pa bzhin/ /sngon tshe lha yi bu 'ga' zhig /kā le swarga pa ri tsu taḥ/ /ma hā pra ṇa da nā mā byu ta dz+re pa tiḥsha kra shā pa dus kyi mtho ris las yongs 'phos/ /brgya byin bka' las mi yi bdag /mang pos bkur ba zhes par nāta / /dhadz+re bṛṭ+wā nu sa ra zla sma ra ṇa ya ma tī ta le/ /u tsi tai lak+ṣa rde ki— ta gyur—/ /sa yi gzhi la chos kyi ni/ /spyod pa rjes 'jug dran pa'i slad/ /de yis mchod sbyin brgya pa la/ /95—240

pa ya yā tse sha ta kra ḍū/ /ta taḥsu ra pa ter+pākyāji shwa kan+d+ra tadā la ye/ /rig ①pa'i mtshan nyid cung zad blangs/ /de nas lha yi bdag po'i bkas/ /bi sho ② karmas de gnas su/ /bhā shwa re bi da dhe rat+na yu paṃ pu rgya mi bon+da tai/ /ta tastajar+sha na paste 'od ldan rin cen ①mchod sdong ni/ /bsod nams bzhin du mtho ba bsgrubs/ /de nas de ni blta ④ la dza na kau tu ka nibyu le/ / kṛ gro di karma rgyu ts+tshan+da rā snyoḥ ko ṣa chags—/ /skye bo dge mtshan g.yo ba med/ /rmos sogs las rnams rgyun chad pas/ /rgyal po'i bang k+ṣa yo bha bta/ /ta taste na k+ṣi ti bhu dz+wa k+ṣisto yo dzā t+na bī dza le/ /tiṣ+ṭha t+ya byā pi mdzod zad par gyur/ /de nas sa bdag de yis de/ /gang gā ⑤yi ni chu la 'phangs/ /da lta yang ni sa pā tā le rasneḥsrurlo ri bā tsi taḥ/ /bha bi 6 t+ya gya kā le na pa 'og na/ /rin cen gyis brgyan dunyi mas bzhin/ /dus kyis de ni yongs chad ⑦nas/ /yongs su rikhyun+daḥpa ri k+ṣa yaḥ/ /na tadz+dza ga ti nā māste pa ri ṇa me ya da k+ṣa yi/ /'jigs dhipar 'gyur ba khya yin/ /yongs su gyur pas mi 'jig gang / /'gro na nges par de yod min/ /ā gā mi sa ma ye sum̐ sī bar+ṣa shrī ti sa ha sra ke/ /shaṃ kha shu bh+ra ya shaṃ shaṃ kho ma 'ongs dus na skye rgu ⑫lo/ /stong phrag brgyad cu pa yi tshe/ /rgyal po ⑫grags pa dung ltar dkar/ /nā ma rā dzā bha bi 6 ti/ /pu sgyu lap+ta mi yo yu paṃ dṛ paḥkalpa dru mo dung zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi bdag dpag bsam shing rta des/ /mchod sdong bsod nams kyis pa maḥ/ /sa pu ro nyi ta pu tā ya mai tre yā ya pra dā mya ti/ /be+e tre yo 'thob 'di/ /mdun na 'don gyi bur gyur pa/ /byams pa la ni rab sbyin 'gyur/ /slong ba'i ⑫yid pya ya mā dā ya kṛ tā sa pa di khaṇ+ḍa shaḥ/ /atho tsin+ta ma ṇirlo ka ma da ri bzhin nor gyur pa/ /byams pa yis kyang 'di blangs nas/ /'phral la dum bur byas nas ni/ /'jig dre ka ri 6 ti / / yu paṃ da tā tha mi tre yaḥ samyahūṃ budha tsā ga rten dbul po med byed 'gyur/ /byams pas mchod sdong byin de nas/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid 95—241

taḥ—/ /a nut+ta ra dzñā na ni byer+bha bi 6 ti su rartsi taḥ/ /shaṃ kho rā dzā 'thob—/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes gter/ /lha rnams kyis ni mchod par 'gyur/ /btsun mo blon po'i sa ha sru ṇ+ḍa ma shī t+yā pa ri ta ཿ / / sān+ta pu ra mā t+ya ga ḍo tshogs dang bcas/ /stong phrag brgyad cu dag gis ni/ /yongs su bskor nas dung zhes pa'i/ /rgyal rā dzā bi pra bra dzi 6 ti/ /pāstsad+ma pra ṇi d+ma ṣ+pe na shaṃ kha mya ku sha lo da yoḥ/ /po'ang rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skye ba snga ma'i smon lam gyis/ /dung gis stidage ba rgyas pa dag /kṛ ta snga pa shā sgo gya tāta pa ri shā me pha li 6 te/ /ma rgya de she pu rā rā dzā byas pa nges par longs spyod slad/ /'bras bu yongs su byun par gyur du/ /yul dbus su sngon rgyal po ni//bā sa bo bā sa po pa maḥ/ /dha na sasma ta nā mā tsa dṛ po byu dut+ta rā pa the/ /nor lha'i bu lta khyenor lha'i bu/ /byang phyogs su yang mi bdag ni④/ /nor gyis bkur ba zhes pa byung / /ta yorbi bha ba saṃ ghasgo bhū da be+e rāsni ta p+ta yoḥ/ /a khyurlu dha pa 'byor pa 'gran gepa las 'khrugs kwa)pa/ /khon gyi mes ④gdungs de dag gi.a+yo/ /yid ni g.yul dag mā ram̐ bha saṃ bhā ra ra bha masma naḥ/ /na ga re tsa pra pi shā tha ba me rtsom pa la⑨/ /lhag par rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /de nas nor gyis bkur ba 'ongs/ /grong khyer du t+ya dha na pasma taḥ/ /tsakre ga dza ra thā m+bi ṣ+pe shaṃ bā tī re ni ram̐ ta baṃ/ /ta tra yang rab tu zhugs/ /glang po shing rta'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gaṅgā'i 'gram ni bar med byas/ /der ni rat+na shi khā+e nā ma samyak+shi budha ྅ ga taḥ / /dṛṣ+ṭa ste nābyo mā dz+wa rin cen ⑫gtsug ces pa/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid thob/ /brgya byin tshangs sogs lha rnams m+bi bra h+ma sha krā di bhiḥsu riḥ / /so tsin+ta ba dagho rā dzā bā sa baḥkyis—/ /zhabs la mchod ldan de yis mthong / /des (1/bsams rgyal po nor lha'i bu/ /kye ma bsod pri thu pu ṭu bān/ /bi ṣa yārnye ba pa bye ṣa ya gya tri da sha ban+di taḥ/ /ta nams chen por ⑫ldan/ /gang la skabs gsum pas phyag byas/ /'di ni yul byu khong ⑨na gnas/ /de 95—242

tasta snga nu bhā ba na ta tra khyu pā la yo sta yoḥ/ /ya yo bai ra ra dza shī t+yā mi tho mo ha nas de yi mthu yis ni/ /der ni sa skyong de dag gis/ /khon gyi rdul ni zhi ba yis/ /log par rmongs pa pa ri k+ṣa yo/ /kṛ ta sarnyiḥpa re shā tha bā sa baḥpri thi bī pa teḥ/ /bha yongs zad gyur/ /de nas sa bdag nor lha'i bus/ /pha rol dang ni bsdums byas nasarmye/ /bcom ga bahaṃ sa ma bye t+ya sadze+e sgo gi ra pū dza ya ta/ /pra ṇi dh+wa dz+wa tsa bid ldan 'das la mngon phyogs te/ /longs spyod kun gyis mchod pa byas/ /mchod pa'i mjug tu bdag phyag dha sgo dza dhe pra ṇa mya tai/ /a haṃ ku sha la mu le na snga me te na ma hā 'tshal—/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis/ /bdag ni chen por gyur cig ces/ /smon lam dag kyang byas ni ti/ /asmi ṣ+pe na pa sa re bhā paṃ shaṃ kha shan+de sa muṅga te/ /pro bā par gyur/ /skabs 'dir shin tu che ba'i sgra/ /dung las yang dag 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /phyag 'tshal tsa tai rat+na shi khā+e pra ṇa tai su ra ta sbi tai/ /shaṃ kho nā ma ma hi pā labyakra mdun du duganas de la/ /rin cen gtsug gis bka' stsal pa/ /dung zhes bya ba'i sa skyong ni/ /'khor brta bha bi 6 ti/ /par+yarnye bo bye yuk+ta: ku sha la sa ma bāsgu be+e/ /los sgyur bar spyod 'gyur te/ /mjug 3tu byang chub ldan pas kyang / /dge ba yang dag thob par 'gyur④//e baṃ sat+tha ṇi dh+wa na taḥk+ṣ-i ti pa nyiḥpu bye da yā dā sa baḥshaṃ kho nā ma dṛ paḥs de ltar dam pa'i smon lam bsod nams rgyas pa la 'uni sa bdag nor lha'i bu/ /mi yi bdag po dung zhes rat+na shi khi nā diṣ+ṭaḥshri yo srublu ti/ /mo tre yaḥpra ṇa yāta ka ri 6 nyi bya bas blo gros thob 'gyur khye rin cen gtsug gis bstan/ /de bzhin byang chub tu ni rnam dag blo gros ta thā bo sgo bi shudhe dhi ye ka spyo shā bhi ni be sha pu rgya sha ra ṇi rā r+ya hi byams pas byams las mdzad par gyur/ /gang gi 0dam pa'i grogs ni dge la mngon 'jug bsod sahūṃ ga maḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na nams lam gyi sdedang po yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa 95—243

kalpa la tā yī mai tre ya bya ka ra rja pa da dzā nā ma sap+ta da shaḥpabe+e baḥ// //brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las byams pa lung bstan pa'i yal 'dab ste bcu bdun pa'o// //tsit+ta pra pā da pa la la pra ṇa ya dz+wa la snga swalpa su da na ku su ma sems ni rab tu dngas pa'i 7dri med mnyes gshin rab 'bar ba/ /shin tu chung ba'i sbyin pa'i me su pha dze+e sha ke na/ /he mā dri ro ha ṇa na gadhe su dh+wasgo dā na samyut+pa tog 'bras bu'i cha shas ni/ /ri dbang gser ri ro ha na dang bdud rtsi'i gter sbyin 'upa'i/ /'bras bu lo na hi tu khā ka la na mu bai ti/ /pu rā ma no zlo san+d+ra dzhaḥbyu phun tshogs dag dang mtshungs pa nyid du nyer mi 'gro/ /sngon ni kun mkhyen dgongs pa che/ /yid 'ong bahūṃ dze ta kā na ṣ+pe/ /a nā tha paṇ+ḍi dā rā me bi dza hā ra ma hā ya shaḥ/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal/ /mgon med zas sbyin dag gi ni/ /kun dga' ra bar bzhugs par 'gyur2/ /ādro ma hā kā sh+ya pā khyastastso6ཿka ru rja ni byeḥ/ /na ga ro pa ba na gyarnyi de yi slob ma snying rje'i gter/ /'phags pa 'od srungs che zhes bya/ /grong khyer nye ba'i nags kyi mthar/ /dza na tsā ri kā yā ya yo/ /ta tra su durga ti yo ṣi ta na ga rā shra ba lam+bi ljongs ni ④rgyu zhing gshegs par gyur/ /der ni grong khyer mthar brten pa/ /shin tu ngan 'gro'i bud kā—/ /a pa sh+yata kuṣ+ṭha ro gāsbyo kā sh+ya pa ti ya dṛts+tsha yā/ /sā tai dṛṣ+ṭa med dag /mdze yi nad kyis gzir ba yis/ /'od srungs de ni ci 'dod mthong / /de yis de mthong pra sā di t+yā shradhe yā sa ma tsin+ta ya ta / / pā tre su pi ṇ+ḍa pā tā rta rab dang zhing / /dad pa dag gis yang dag bsams/ /'di snod stibasod snyoms su 'os pa/ /bsod ki na dzā nā smi pu sgo taḥ/ /bi dzñā ya ta gyaḥs:r+ya shradha yulte sma no ra dze+e/ /nams las ni cis khyam skyes/ /de yi 'dod pa ngo mtshar can/ /dad pa dang ldan rnam mkhyen nas/ /pra sa r+ya pa tram̐ dza gra ha pi ṇ+ḍa tai kri pā ku laḥ / / nyi bra tsit+ta snying rje rgyas pa'i ④lhung bzed dag /rab tu brkyangs ⑧nas bsod snyoms blangs/ /sems ni dang ba 95—244

pra sā de na bhak+ta sa ra ma marba ṇi/ /kuṣ+ṭi n+ya ni pa phru tā suḥpā tre shiṇ+ḍi ka ram̐ drag po yis/ /'bras chan rab mang phul ba'i tshe/ /mjo mo de yi lag pa yi/ /sor mo brul nas snod du gu liḥ/ /ta taḥpa pā ta ka mi ba t+yaghā ni t+ya ka ḍi ba ram̐/ /de bā ā+oṃ tu ṣi tā khyu lhung / /de 'og de yis sdig pa bzhin/ /mi rtag lus dag dor nas ni/ /dga' ldan zhes bya lha rnarmes dzā ni la ye sa ma dzā ya te/ /shakra sta dbye tai dzñā tā dā na pu byo di di ta kyi—/ /nang du yang dag skyes par gyur/ /rmad byung de shes brgya byin ni/ /sbyin pa'i dge la gus rgyas raḥ—/ /yat+nata kā sh+ya pa sat+pa tram̐ su dha ya sa pa pū ra yata/ /su dhat+tha pas—/ /'bad pa'i ①'od srungs dam pa'i snod/ /bdud rtsi dag gis yongs su bkang / /dge slong ṇi pya sau bhigrurni spri haste ṇa lbo la yā/ /pra sha mā mṛ ta saṃ pūr+ṇa :kre rab zhi'i bdud rtsi yis/ /khengs des bdud rtsi byin la yang / /dga' med rtswa yi rtse mo yis/ /lhung pā tra ma sgo mu khaṃ/ /bha dzadhe pra ṇa ya spru ti kri pa ṇi 6 kri pa ku bzed thur du kha bstan gyur/ /dam pa'i kwa snying rje rgyas pa rnams/ /dman la mdza' gcugs dga' ba khāḥ—/ /saṃ taḥsaspata sa mā d+dhā ta ba da de m+bi li tā da raḥ/ /shu tā hūṃ tu stenasne—/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'bar ba yis④/ /bzhin la gus pa dman par gyur/ /de ni dga' ldan ṣi to de ba ni kā ya ni ra shā dṛ paḥ/ /pra se na dzi ta bha ga ba ta: kre lha tshogs na/ /gnas pa thos nas mi yi bdag /gsal rgyal gyis ⑤ni bcom ldan gyi/ /mchod ston sgo dzñā dhi bā sa rmā/ /rā snyosta phya kṛ he dṛṭī lasmri mā:r+ya ka ri ṇaḥ/ /lhag par gnas par byas/ /rgyal po de yi khang pa ni du/ /dpal 'byor ngo mtshar byed mthong nas/ /āt+yā nan+de na bha ga bān thraṣ+ṭasta ta pu rgya ma bh+ya dha ta/ /pu ru kṛ ha pa teḥ'aphags pa dga' bos bsod nams de/ /dris shing bcom ldan gyis bka' stsal/ /sngon ni khyim bdag sru nu dī rī drubyā sa tī ga taḥ/ /k+ṣe tra kan+d+ra ṇi saṃ sak+taḥk+ṣu ta k+ṣu cig ④gi bu/ /dbul ba las ni 'bang khya nyid gyur/ /zhing las dag la yang dag chags/ /ltogs shing 95—245

maḥklarnyi mā ya yo/ /sa dza t+yā mā nī tī niḥsde ha la ba khaṃ tsi rata/ /kalbā rid pas khyangal bar gyur/ /yun ring zhig na ma yis ni/ /snum dang tsha med gzan chang zhig du /khyer ṣa piṇ+ḍi mā sā r+ya sgohūṃ sā da ra ma ya yo/ /sgo na hasta k+ṣa ṇi tasmin nas 'ongs pa des thob nas/ /gus dang bcas pas za ru song / /lag pa bkrus pa de yi tshe/ /ci saṃ prabhā ya ya dṛts+tsha yā/ /da do pra bye ga budha ya hūṃ pra sadz+re na tse ta sā/ /dgar yang dag 'ongs pa yil / /rang sangs rgyas la de nyid ni/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis byen/ /dzā taḥs a ba kā le na bhu ba lo yo pra pe na dzita/ /ta gya dā na ka ṇa gye yo de nyid dus kyi sa skyong ni/ /gsal rgyal 'di ru skyes par gyur/ /'byor pa 'di ni sbyin pa yi/ /thigs bi bhu tiḥpra tha oṃ pha lo/ /shu tī ti bha ga bad+mā kyi bhi k+ṣurbasma ya ma ya yo/ /pa de yi dang po'i 'bras/ /de skad bcom ldan gsungs ngu thos nas/ /dge slong dag ni ya mtshan gyur/ /rā dzā pi pi pu dze+e bu rdzu bi da dhe bha ga ba taḥpu raḥ/ /rā dzārte ra khi lesgo geḥrgyal po yis ⑤ kyang yangs pa yis dwa/ /mchod pa bcom ldan mdun du byas/ /rgyal pos longs spyod ma kṛ tā bhaspyi ni be da rgo/ /sa ko rgya tai lo kum+bha rmā dī pa mā lnga ma kalpa ya lus pas/ /gus pas zhal zas phul byas nas/ /'bru mar bum pa bye ba yis/ /mar me yi ni 'phreng ba taḥ / /dī pa me shaṃ da do ta tra swalpa kai durga shā ga nā/ /sne yak+ṣa yāta pra ya te byas—/ /der ni dbul mos mar me ni/ /shin tu chung ba dag cig phul/ /thams cad snum ni rab zad 6 sabye 6 ṇa dza gā ma yaḥ/ /tsernyi ༈ bra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na ta yā bi ma la tse nas—/ /rab tu bzlas (rkyetshe gang ma song / /de yi sems ni dri med kyisadā / /smon lam de yis rnam ta pā/ /bhā bi nī shākya mu ni tsā sat+tha zlo sngaḥs ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /rat+na dī pā ba bsams pa/ /shākya thub pa nyid du ni/ /'gyur bar kun mkhyen gyis bka' stsal/ /bcom ldan mdun li da tā rā dzā bha ga ba taḥpu raḥ/ /u pa bi sh+ya pra ṇa myu gre ṇa pra ṇa du rgyal po yis/ /rin cen sgron me'i 'phreng po7 phul nas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mdun bsdad de⑫/ /gus 95—246

yātrī bya dzi snyo pata/ /bha ga bta pra ṇi d+mā ṣ+pe na tat+tah+phu dh+yā nu bhā ba taḥ/ /pa yis ni der gsol pa/ /bsod nams de de'i mthu dag las/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi stismon lam gyis/ /na ga s+thā nut+ta rā sa myak+shi bo dhir+bha ga ba tabe+e tā/ /bha bta pra sā da pra ṇa ya bla med yang dag rdzogs byang chub/ /khyod kyis ( su la ster mi bgyid/ /khyod kyi bka' drin brtse ba las/ /pāp+ta mits+tsha mi tā ma haṃ / /nibe+e kalpa pha lnga bas+ho se byarnye kalpa pā de ni thob par bdag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par mi rtog 1 'bras thob slad/ /dpag bsam rkang 'thung bsten dā paḥ/ /i ti rā dzā pa tsa khru tā bha ga bān swa ya ma bha ṣaṭa/ /durla bhā pa lags/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bla med yang nut+ta rā samyaka saṃ bo byeḥthra thi bī pa two/ /sugrwa mṛ rja la tan+tu bh+yo gi ri bh+yo dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub sa bdag rnyed par dka'/ /pad+ma'i skud pa bas kyang phra/ /ri bo las ④pi ga ri ma r+pā/ /sa mu dre bh+yo pi shaṃ dī rā sā su khe na na labh+ya te/ /na da ṣ+perba kyang shin tu brling / /rgya mtsho bas kyang zab pa ste'7/ /bde blag tu ni 'thob ma yin/ /bdag gis skye hu bhirlabha ma yi bā bye 6 dzad+ma su/ /tsit+ta pra sā da bi ṣa rda dzñā rna taṭ+wā ra r+ṇa ba gzhan rnams su/ /sbyin pa rma nga pos thob ma gyur/ /sems ni rab dang dri med kyi/ /ye shes de yi rgyu dza guḥ/ /tsa turdi pa bye pa h+ye na ma yā man+t+ra j-i dzad+ma ni/ /tsi ram̐ dā na pha lo ru gsungs/ /nga las nu yi skye ba la/ /bdag gi gling bzhi'i bdag po yis/ /yun ring sbyin pa'i 'bras zuste bo byerwa pi ga tā tu pā/ /dā ṣ+pe na tsakra brti shraḥsā su dar+sha dzad+ma bu spyad/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /blta sdug skye bar sbyin pa yis/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal ni / /juk+ta ma yā ma ha tī bo byertswa pi gā tā tu pā/ /pu rā da tā ga dzā byoṣ+ṭi de ni/ /shin tu che ba bdag gis srud/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /gnyis skyes skye ba be+e la 0mar/ /be lā ma dī dza dzad+ma ni/ /ma yā pāp+tasma hah+phu bye bo byeza pi ga tā tu pā/ /glang po brgyad ni sngon byin pas/ /bsod nams chen po bdag gis thob/ /byang chub de ni thob ma gyur/ /95—247
