pu ra dā re ṇa nir+ya yo/ /shi bi kā dā ra mā sā r+ya pa saṃ pā phye ba de ba hūṃ/ /ma dhu sgo nas de ni phyi rol song / /sgo yi lha khang du phyin pas/ /de yi ①lha dang yang dag phrad/ /sbrang rtsi'i skabye na ni diṣ+ṭi gre yaḥsaṃ thā na māp+ta bān/ /bha ga bārnya ta taḥpā gya sa phung pos bstan pa yi1/ /mchog gi lam ni thob par gyur/ /de nas de yis bcom ldan thob/ /skom tre:rta i bā mṛ tai/ /ba bhū bā nu sa mā swārda pra mo dā mo dā nidṛ taḥ/ /pas gdungs pas bdud rtsi bzhin/ /rab dga'i dri bzang bde ba yis/ /nyams su myong ba dpe med gyur//tai dṛ: sā da ra du rātatshwa yā ta ru mi bā dh+wa gaḥ/ /a bā pa ga ta lam mgron ④ skom pas gus bcas par/ /ring nas grib bsil ljon pa bzhin/ /zhi zhing ngal bsos saṃ ta paḥshāk+ṣiṃ bi shrarnyi shī ta dze+e/ /ta gya tad dar+sha de ṣ+pe ba le bhi ga tī bsel ba de/ /thob cing yongs su gdung ba bral/ /de yi yid ni dri ma dang / /bral ba de mthong nyid ma naḥ/ /sha ra ta sa mā ga me ṣ+pe ba gha na dhūdhostotain bhaḥ/ /sa ko kyis thob/ /nam mkha' ston ⑤dang phrad pa yis/ /sprin gyi tshogs dang bral ba bzhin/ /gang yang pi pu rgya shī lā nā ma nu bhā ba pra sā di byā/ /bha brnyi yata pra sā de na bsod nams ngang tshul dang / /bka' drin ldan pa'i mthu de ni/ /rang gi drin gyi sems kyis ⑥ni/ /nirbisnabyet+ta bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /so tsin+ta ya da ho mo ha bi byā naḥko gya la spyod tshul bgegs med 'gyur ba yin/ /de ⑦bsams kye ma bdag gi ni/ / yang dag 6)rmongs pa 'di ma naḥ/ /a nuts+tsha da bi kā ro yo dzā taḥpra sha ma sadza daḥ/ /baṃ tsi to dang bral/ /rnam 'gyur 'di ni rjes su bcad/ /rab tu zhi ba phun tshogs skyes/ /bcom ldan 'das smi na yata pūbaṃ dṛsgo yo bha ga bān ma yā/ /nā dha t+yā nā mi yo yā ti mūn+ti 'di bdag gis sngon/ /gang zhig mthong bar ma grur bslus/ /sku 'di ⑫ skal ldan min pa yis/ /mig lo tsa na go tsa re/ /a mṛ ta ma hu ro dā rā dṛṣ+ṭizlu tiḥ sha shi gi spyod tshul ⑩mi 'gyur ro/ /gzigs pa'i bcud kyi bdud rtsi yid 'ong rgya che'i ⑪ri bong can ltar nyams 95—292

pe sha la ta ru ṇa ka ru ṇa yaṭ+wā bṛsbyiḥpra sā da ma yī ma tiḥ/ /a ya su bde/ /spyod ①tshul snying rje dar la bab pa'i dbang gyur rab tu dang ba'i rang bzhin blo/ /'khor ba ma ti sha yaḥpra t+yā san+daḥka ro ti bi rā ga tsā bi ga ta ra dza sī niḥsaṃ dag ni med par dgyes kyang yongs su 'dzin cing rab tu nye bar gnas/ /phul du byung ba 'di ni rdul bral sā raḥ pri yo pi pa ri gra ha ཿ / / i ti tsit+ta pra sā de na tsit+ta rnams kyi chags pa nyid dang bral bar bgyid/ /ces bsams kun dga' ldan pa des ④/ /nye bar yan+d+ra pa thra t+ya saḥ/ /bi da dhe ta su sā nan+daḥpā da pad+mā bhi ban+da rgo/ /bha btud nas de yi ni/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar phyag 'tshal ba/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bsgrubs/ /der rngug bān pābhi tata pābye pra sā dā nan+da lak+ṣa rde/ /u bā ha ba da nasgo yo ni 'ongs la bcom ldan yang / /rab dang dgyes pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /snying rje rdzogs pa'i pho nya yis//pūṇ+ḍi kā ru 5 dru ti tai/ /dṛṣ+ṭa mā shā sa dza na dī kā me kā ma pi ta bzhin ras mdzes pas bka' stsal pa/ /de yi dbugs 'byin skyed byapa'i sprun/ /skye rdul dag slad bdud su saḥ/ /bi sa sadzā dza dze+e dzad+ma ra dzaḥshu: su bhā na dī/ /a thā surtsi yi/ /chu bo ⑤rab 'bar ci yang ni/ /nges par de la rnam par spros/ /de nas de la bcom ldan gyis//bha ga bān bha dre bi da dhe dharma de sha dzā/ /tsa tur+ṇa mār+ya sa t+yā dzā pra ti ba dhe bhe dha yi 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po rnams/ /rab tu rtogs pa sgrub byed pa/ /legs ldan chos ni ⑥bstan pa dī—/ /sa shā sa na nād byasta sa map+ta kle sha sarnyi tiḥ/ /ni dze+e dza d+ma ni mdzad—/ /ston pa'i bka' las nyon mongs kyi/ /rgyud ni mtha' dag zhig pa des/ /rang gi skye ba bi r+yasmi pra ṇa ta sta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a ti krādho smi bha ga bān bha brjod byas nas/ /de la phyag 'tshal der gsol pa/ /bcom ldan bdag ni shin tu 'das/ /bcom ga badhe sha ra khaṃ ga taḥ/ /bi pal+la bā sa nā sgyu saḥsaṃ sā re na rā me pa ldan 'das la skyabs su song / /goms pa'i bag chags rnam par zhig /'khor bar ⑦ mchog tu bdag mi 95—293

re / /ka ro t+ya ku sha lo dru re shu bha mā shu pra sats+tsha ti/ /sru tsa ya h+phu tsi tā dga'—/ /chen po rnams kyis ①gzigs pa ni/ /mi dge ba dag ring du byed/ /dge ba myur bar rab tsā ram̐ ma ha tā ma ba lo ka rna/ /su khāhaṃ te bi hā rā ya bi hā ra tu ster/ /rigs pa'i spyod pa gsal bar byed/ /khyed ni bzhugs slad gus pa las/ /gtsug lag khang ba ra mā dā rāta/ /rat+na sā ra pu ro dā ram̐ swa pu re kā ra yāmya haṃ/ /mchog bder bye 'os pa/ /yid 'ong rin chen snying po'i gnas/ /rang gi grong du bdag bgyid do/ /ka ro tu ta tra bha ga bān sa ta tai sbi t+ya nu gra haṃ/ /dha bye rā me+e bi to der ni skal ldan bdag cag gisakyi/ /mchod dang d+ngharim gros bsten pa na/ /bcom ldan rtag tu bzhugs sma bhiḥs par+yā pa ri tsar+ya yā/ /i t+yarja dzā tā the t+ya su bha ga bān pa yis/ /rjes su bzung ba dag tu mdzod/ /ces pa'i don gnyer de bzhin zhes/ /bcom ldan 'das pra t+ya pa r+ya ta/ /pra ṇa yi pārja rmā sgo ga pra gastso na nyi sā dha paḥ/ /bha ga kyis de la gnang / /gang phyir dge ba gus pa yis/ /don gnyer 'joms la bstan pa min/ /de nas ban+ta ma thā saṃ rngu shra bas+t+ri sa pu rī ya yo/ /tā dā dīṣ+ṭi na sa hi taḥshā ri pu bcom ldan la zhus nas/ /de yi bka' yis dge slong ni/ /shā ri'i bu dang lhan cig tu/ /de ni mnyan tre ṇa bhigru shā/ /ta tra dze ta ku mā re ṇa hi ra byer+bhe ṇa byu ya sā/ /dar+ghaṃ yod grong khyer song / /der ni rgyal byed gzhon nu yis/ /gser gyi rin ni chen po la/ /nags tshal kā na na mā dā ya bi ha ra ma sru tra ya ta/ /bhabyun+d+ra hā da thā ram+bha byin pa blangs nas des/ /gtsug lag khang gi thig rnams btab/ /de nas mgon med zas sbyin ni⑤//kṛ ta sā hā ya kaḥsu riḥ/ /bi hā re tri di bā kā rā tsa kā rā nā tha piṇ+ḍa lha rnams dag gis grogs byas pas/ /mtho ris rnam pa'i gtsug lag khang / /gus shing spyo bas durab tu daḥ / /ta tra dze taḥku mā ro pi bhabh+ya bha ga bā taḥpa re/ /ya shaḥbartsigs—/ /der ni rgyal byed gzhon nu yang / /mchog tu bcom ldan la gus pas/ /grags ⑦dang 95—294

pu rgya pra ti jo yi bi da bhe dā ka roṣ+ṭha rka /a tha tīrgyu sta ma lo kya bibasod nams bsgrub pa'i slad/ /sgo yi khang pa byas par gyur/ /de nas rmad byung gtsug lag khang / /de hā rā ram̐ bha mabye haṃ / / sā pa bā da bi ba de na tsakre dī ṣā ku brtsams zhe sdang gis 'khrugs pa'i/ /mu stegs kyis mthong smod byas dzoshing / /'gal ba pyabarjod pas laḥka bo/ /raspyok+ṣa pra mu khaste ྾ māt+pa t+yāta gru dra paṇ+ḍi taḥ/ /sa rtsod pa byas/ /de dag gis gtso mig dmar ni/ /sbrul nag 1phyogs dang bcas pa bzhin/ /ngan pa k+ṣa i ba kṛ ṇ+ḍa hi bya ki ta sa daḥ / / rudhe bi hā ra saṃ bhā re mkhas dag gi phrag dog las/ /mdun sa dag ni 'jig par byas/ /de yis rtsod pa rgyal ba'i bar/ /te na bā da dza yā ba byeḥ/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa da gi rā shā ri pu traḥs ma ya gtsug lag khang gi tshogs bkag tshe/ /mgon med zas sbyin tshig dag gis/ /shā ri'i bu ni yang dag yo —/ / ragh+ra khyo tha ta mā tū ya pra bhā boṅka sgo dar+sha de / /in+d+ra 'ongs—/ /de nas mig dmar dag gi 4mthu/ /khyad 'phags bstan phyir de bos nas/ /mig ⑤'phrul dzā la ba loh+phudze+e sa ha kā ra ma dar+sha yata/ /shā ri pu tra bhā bo dz+re be+e stobs kyis rab rgyas pa/ /sa ha ka ra'i ljon pa bstan/ /shā ri'i bu yi mthus babe+engs ༷pa'i/ /rlung pu lestu mu lā ni leḥ/ /udhī la taḥsha ka la hūṃ tithren+d+ra ha i bā pa saḥ/ /stug ④chen po che ba yisakhya/ /mu stegs byed kyi spro ba bzhin/ /rtsa nas 'thon zhing dum bur gyur/ /de rakyāk+ṣa bi hi hūṃ kube+e ka ma dze+e pad+me 1 ta taḥ/ /paṃ ka she ṣā dī pa: kre shā nas mig dmar gyis sprul pa'i/ /me tog rgyas pa'i pad+mo can/ /shā ri'i bu yis rnam sprul pa'i/ /glang ri pu tra bi ni rmi taḥ / / raghā k+ṣa dī k+ṣa ni k+ṣi p+taḥ sa p+ta shīr+ṣa mo ho pos 'dam rdzab lhag mar byas/ /mig dmar stobs kyis bzhag pa yis⑨/ /ltos 'gro du chen po mgo ra gaḥ/ /shā ri pu tre ṇa ni k+ṣip+tastur+ṣa pak+ṣu gra mā ru taiḥ/ /ta dā byu to tha bdun pa/ /shā ri'i bu yis (bya khyung gi/ /gshog pa'i rtse mo'i rlung gis 'phangs/ /de nas des bkug 95—295

be tā laḥ sha ri pu tre ṇa tī li ta ཿ / / pre ri to man+t+ra bīrle ṇa ro langs lalha/ /shā ri'i bu yi ༷phur bus btab/ /sngags kyi 'u brtson 'grus kyis bskul nas/ /mig raghāk+ṣ-i han+tu mud+ma yo/ /be+e tā lā bhi ha tas+thā san na sh+yad+mā na ma da dz+wa raḥ/ /dmar gsod du rab tu song / /ro langs kyis bcom skrag pa las④/ /nga rgyal rgyags pa'i ri zhi ⑤nas//sha ra rte pā da pa ti taḥshā ri pu tram̐ dza gā ma saḥ/ /rak+tak+ṣa te na sgo ge na de ni zhabs la gtugs byas te/ /shā ri'i bu la skyabs su song / /bcom pa de yi kwamig dmar de/ /sha ra bye sha ra rde ga taḥ/ /pra bra rjo yī bī ta rā ga sa shud+dhā bo bye māp+ta skyabs 'os dag la skyabs song nas/ /rab tu byung ba ④'dod chags bral/ /dag pa'i byang chub thob bān / /tīd+dhā sta bye pa ri dwo ṣa kro dha pā ra ti tār+sha baḥ/ /ta tra par gyur/ /mu stegs gzhan rnams yongs sdang dang / /khro ba'i pha rol bsgral 'dod pa④/ /dge slong kan+d+raka ra byā dzā tasbrabhikyu ba sgod+ma tāḥ/ /te tha dharma bru haḥkā le shā dag la gnod brtson zhing / /de na las byed zol gyis ⑨gnas/ /de nas de dag shā ri'i bus/ / dus ri pu tre ṇa lak+ṣ-i tāḥ/ /tadṛṣ+ṭi bā ta mā tre ṇa ba khyu pume+e tra mā na sāḥ/ /su de las 'khu shes nas/ /⑫ de yi spyan zur tsam nyid kyis/ /yid ni byams dang ldan par gyur/ /ā sha yā nu sha ya dh+wa rtu pra kṛ ti tsa bi tsā r+ya saḥ/ /dharma de sha na yā te ྾ di khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /rang bzhin dag kyang spyad nas de.enyu/ /chos ni bstan pas de dag de shā nu t+ta ram̐ da shī / / a tha ta gya be+e hā ra su ni m+bi sna rnams—/ /bla med gnas skabs dag la bkod/ /de nas gtsug lag khang de'i las/ /brtsams pa ram̐ bha karma ṇi/ /a nā tha thraṇ+ḍa rda pā ha shā ri pu traḥsmi tā na naḥ/ /bgegs dang bral ba'i tshe/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan shā ri'i bus/ /mgon med zas sbyin la smras pa/ /bi hā ra sru tra pā ta gya tu la e ba k+ṣa ṇi ma hān/ /he mo bi hā raḥsaṃ dṛt+tastu gtsug lag khang gi thig btab pa'i/ /dus mtshungs nyid du dga' ldan gyi/ /lha yi gnas su gser gyi ni//95—296

ṣi te de ba pad+ma ni/ /e ta dā kasbya sa dzā ta pra sā da dī gu ṇa da gtsug lag khang chen yang dag grub/ /de thos she7gus pa nyis 'gyur gyisasnye7 / /rab tu dang ba yang dag raḥ / /he ma rat+na ba rā gā ram̐ bi hā rā ma kā ra ya ta/ /bi bha be+e ra tha skyes—/ /rin chen gser mchog khang pa yi1/ /gtsug lag khang ni de yis byas/ /de nas bcom ldan rā dzārte pa thi te no pa kalpi taiḥ/ /bi dzñābye s+t+ri de baiḥsārja mā ya yo bha ga rgyal ba la/ /gsol te lha dang lhan cig ni/ /lam du de yis nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /rgyal po la 'os bān dzi naḥ/ /ta dā ga ma nā hak+ṣe ṇa pra sarje bhu ba na tra cha/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa 'byor pas byon/ /de ni byon pa la dga' nas/ /srid gsum rab tu dang ba'i tshe/ /de la mgon med dastasmi bā ri jo rā ma pā ta yata/ /ta smin ya dā na pra de she bā ri khye ra pa pā ta zas sbyin byis/ /chu yi rgyun ni rab tu bgrengs④/ /gang gi tshe na phyogs de ru/ /chu yi rgyun ni ma babs 'usā—/ /ta dā bha ga ba to bākyā da ba tahūṃ ta tā n+ya taḥ/ /tai dṛṭī kau pa—/ /de tshe gzhan du bcom ldan gyi/ /gsung las rgyun dang ldan par babs6/ /de mthong mtshar nas tu kā ta bṛsbyo r+bhak+ṣu bhir+bha ga ban pu raḥ/ /u pā tsa thra ya tā me tad bā dge slong gis/ /zhus shing bcom ldan 'das kyis slar/ /bka' stsal chu 'dir ⑦rengs pa yi / rgyu ri stam+bha gya kā ra rde/ /a ṣ+pe na pārba budhe bh+yophosmin+de be+e da māspa rda/ /ni rab tu mnyan par gyis/ /sngon gye sangs rgyas rnams la 'dis/ /gnas 'di yi ni 'di nyid du/ /pra ti pā di ta mi h+ye ṣa bā ri dh+wa rā n+ya tabyu tā/ /a ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba su rī sa myak+shi rab tu byin par gyur to zhes/ /chu rgyun 'di ni gzhan du lhung( 7/ /sngon gyi yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//budha ya bi pa bye ṣ+pe/ /a ya me ba ba rā rā ma pra de shaḥpra ti pā di taḥ/ /rnam par gzigs la 'di nyid kyis/ /mchog gi kun dga' ra ba yi/ /sa phyogs 'di nyid rab tu byin//bud+dhā ya shi khi de pra dāta pu 6 dzad+ma n+ya yo pu naḥ/ /ta to da do bi shwa bhu be dzi nā rgyal gyi skye ba dag la yang / /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phul/ /de nas ra ghu'i skye ba la/ /rgyal ba 95—297

ya ra gh+ra dzad+ma ni/ /bha ba taṭ+wā bhi sgo bhū tā kra kuts+tshan+d+ra ya dāṭ+wā ya/ /da do thams cad skyob la phul/ /srid pas byin zhes gyur pa na/ /'khor ba 'jig la rab tu phul/ /chen po'i bṛ haspa tisgo twa ka na kā khyu ya tā yi ṣ+pe/ /kā sh+ya pa ya pu nabya yo zwa dā dā ṣa ṭa bdag tu gyur pa'i tshe/ /skyob pa gser zhes bya la phul/ /ā ṣā ḍa yi skye ba la/ /slar yang 'od srungs la dzad+ma ni/ /a de ṣ+pe bā dhu na ma hūṃ de shwa yo pra ti pā di taḥ/ /kā le na su dha nā khro 'di phul/ /da lta nga la 'di nyid kyis/ /yul 'di dag ni rab tu byin/ /dus kyis nor bzang zhes pas ①yo mo tre yā ya pra dā su ti/ /sa twa bān k+ṣurnyi shī la tā— dh+wa nā 'di—/ /byams pa la ni 'bul bar 'gyur/ /snying stobs bzod pa tshul khrims dang / /ldan phyir 'di bye ṣa ba sh+ya ti/ /su ra: yo kṛ ha pa tispyo tā te ma pra dā bhe dhaḥ/ /tsakre yis gter rnams mthong / /sngon yang khyim gyi bdag po 'di/ /gser sbyin zhes par gyur pa na/ /rang pra h+ye ka budzha phya saṃ ska ram̐ pa ri nidṛ to/ /rasne kuste tad sbyi ni ni sangs rgyas ni mya ngan las/ /'das pa'i legs par bya ba byas/ /rin chen bum par de yi gdung / /dh+ri twa tata pra ṇi jo ta/ /a dhu nā rat+na ko shārtaḥsaṃ dza to yi su baṇ+ḍi ghāka /bcug nas smon lam btab pa las/ /da lta rin chen mdzod 'os pa'i/ /gser gyi snod du 'di gyur to//shu two ti shāstu rba tsa nā bhe jo rna te bye k+ṣa ba ཿ sār mi bā mṛ dge slong de dag rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhin/ /ston pa'i gsung gis ①mngon par brjod pa 'di ta su / / ka rtu ཿ pra ti jo rdzi ta pū ṇ+ḍi pu ju pu ṣ+ṭha bye bā se na thos nas/ /byed por ④rab gnas kyis bsgrubs bsod nams rgyas pa yi/ /me tog lhag par gnas pas bye sha na nan+d+raḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba mchog tu dga' bar gyur/ /zhes ⑤pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa bā na kalpa la tā yī dze ta ba na pra ti gra hā ba dā rna nā ma dā bo sha brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las rgyal byed kyi tshal yongs su bzung ba'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa bu95—298

tiḥpal+la waḥ// //gnyis pa'o// //a ho ma harta ma be+e bad+ma ha two bha byā bha dzadhe gu ṇa go ra be+e ṇa/ /kye ma legs ldan rin thang che ba'i chen po nyid/ /nor bu bzhin du yon tan bla ma nyid kyis 'thob//bi nā gu shā yad+ma pu྾ gu ru two sbra lo pa la na mi ba nisga lo tata/ /yon tan med par gang zhig lus kyi ① bla ma nyid/ /rdo las rags pa bzhin du de ni 'bras bu med/ /shrī mān pu rā shākya pu re na ren+d+raḥshurnyo da naḥshudhi su dh+wa ni dh+wa dz+wa/ /be+e ra shākya'i grong gi mi yi dbang po sngon/ /dpal ldan zas gtsang dag pa'i bdud rtsi'i gter/ /chags bral gya yo gāta su ga ta twa māp+ta smṛ twa su tai sokhru ka tā ma bā pa/ /bo tsit+ta ldan las bde gshegs nyid thob pa'i/ /sras ni dran nas 'dod dang bcas par gyur/ /de bsams yata pu rgya gu rja bye pā saṃ sa ra swa tī bā sa sa ro ru ha gre/ /ma bsod nams yon tan lhag buganas shing / /dbyangs can gnas dang mtsho las skyes pa'i dpal/ /yid naḥpra sā da su bi khā sa sau snye tras+thā mi su norba da ram̐ ka dā haṃ/ /e tī ti tajar+sha ni rab tu dang ba'i rtse dga'i gnas/ /bu yi bzhin ras gang tshe bdag gis mthong / /de ni blta rmibar na khā se na ye ye ma yā dze ta ba rna bi mṛṣ+ṭaḥ/ /te te ta dā lo sred pas 'dir byon ces④/ /bdag gis gang gang rgyal byed tshal du btang / /de de mig mi 'dzums ke na nirdi me ṣa ta tre ba tikhye t+ya mṛ tai pi ban+taḥ/ /saṃ pre ṣi tasta gya ma yā pas de blta 3zhing / /de nyid du ni bdud rtsi 'thung zhing 'dug /gang yang mdza' las bdag mtshungs sa mā ya yo pyat+pa tu l+yaḥpra ṇa yā du dā yī/ /sa le kha hastaste di ba bhi rā 'char ka ni/ /de dgug slad du bdag gis yang dag btang / /spring yig lag de lha rnams mngon dga' me ta tre ba le kha twa mi bā bhi ya taḥ/ /saṃ de sha bākyi pra hi tasma yā yata tabyi smṛ taib—/ /de nyid du ni lha nyid bzhin du gyur/ /de yi kha la bdag gi 'phrin ༷gyi tshig /springs pa gang de 95—299

mu dā yi nā sru tsi ta mā ka ma snga dza nata/ /dza gaṅga sum̐ byu mi pa tiḥku mā re kṛ ldan pa/ /'char kas legs par bshad la 17rab shes nas/ /gzhon nu 'gro ba'i bla ma de la ri/ /sa tāñdza liste pra ṇa nā ma dru rāta/ /a thā ba tīr+yār+ya dza nā nu yā taḥsaṃ pū bdag ring nas thal mo sbyar nas ( 7btud/ /de nas babs te 'phags skye'i rjes 'brang bcas/ /rgyal po bye ma nāḥpra ṇa ye na rā dzñā/ /spyita pra bhā bhā se ta disbi bhā tsā t+yā gro dhi no rat+na gus pas yang dag mchod sri gyur pa/ /phyogs cha gzi byin rgyas pas spyomadzes pa yis⑤ / /n+ya gro dha yi rin byu baṃ bi be+e sha /ho mā sa rna shā sa na sad+ngha biṣ+ṭa lo ka tra yaḥsaṃ ga ta pā chen sa gzhir byon/ /'jig rten gsum po bka' la legs gnas de'u/ /der ni rkang stegs ldan pa'i da bī rja/ /sa ta tra ratrī ku ra tsi tra pa tram̐ bhā swabe+e surme ru mi bā ru ro ha/ /gser gye khri/ /rin chen myu gu bkra ba'i 'dab ldan la/ /lhun po la ni 'od ldan lus bzhin 'dzegs/ /tad+mā na sen+d+ra na ya nā mṛ to hūṃ ma no ra tha pārba na yo sa yā tai/ /bi lo ka ya— yid kyi zla ba mig gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /yid la re bas don gnyer 'ongs ⑦pa de/ /dga' bas mig mi dṛ ti nirni e ṣaḥk+ṣa rde k+ṣi tī shaste da sha twa mā pa/ /pa tai dza ga dra shu ni 'dzums rmepar bltas pa las/ /skad cig sa yi dbang pos lha nyid thob/ /dga' ba'i ro las nang du rudha kaste soṅkar+ṣa har+ṣa ku li tai ku mā re/ /hā rā gra raṭ+wā pra tibisba zhugs pa bzhin/ /do shal rin chen mchog la gzugs brnyan chags/ /gzhon nu khyad 'phags dgyes pa sat+ta pra be+e sha yan pra ti ra sā di bān+taḥ/ /sarnyo ṣa shi tā tsa la swa bhā rgyas de la/ /mgrin pa ⑪mchi mas 'gags pa de yis smras/ /yongs tshim g.yo med bsel ⑩ba'i rang bā ta sabaṃ ra madhe ku sha la be+e li 6/ /kṛ tasta yāsmra ka ma yo tu bzhin las/ /thams cad dge ba'i thang la dga' bar byed/ /yongs su gdung byed bral ⑨ba'i nyer kasmrata satru pa ka rī bi ra ho pa de shaḥ/ /sne hāta pra mo dāta gu ṇa go ra bstan 'di/ /bdag cag rnams la khyod kyis ci phyir mdzad/ /mdza' dang rab dga' yon tan la gus 95—302

bārtso dhīd+dhā ba ṭī yo twa yi me pra sa khya/ /ā lo ga nā ya sbi ra saṃ ga mā ya pas—/ /'khyud pa dang ni brtan par 'grogs pa dang / /zhabs la phyag bgyi'i be+ed du mnyam nyid du//pā da pra rja mā ya tsa tu l+ya me ba/ /yabyista ki tsit+ta di da tra ya me sho ta bdag gi blo ni ①'phral la khyod can rgyug /cung zad gang de bdag gis brjod pa 'di/ /bdag la bya me ba pra ṇa yo pa ro jota/ /gu khodzhai tai bā bi ra sa kra rma dā na sne ha byams ngor khyod kyis gsan par bya/ /yon tan spangs pa'i byechags bral rim pa ni/ /mdza' bas rmongs mo ha su bha ba t+ya bā h+ye/ /pra t+yaṇ+ḍi rat+na pra ti bim+bi tārka pro zwa pra bhā pra pas brjod bya min pa nyid/ /nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan (rwaldan pa'i rin chen gyis/ /legs spras lhag ④ pa'i ba ra shā n+ya rū ni/ /two he ma hadh+yā ṇi bi hā ya kasmrata bi gā khya se shu n+ya ba nān+ta 'od zer rab rgyas pa/ /gser gyi khang bzang 'di dag ci yi slad/ /btang nas khrod ni nags na ⑤stong rā ṇi/ /kār+sā ka rā brdzi ta he ma rku bhaḥsata sau ra hūṃ bhaḥpra sa tā rnyi ṣik+taḥ/ /par 'khyam/ /na chung lag pas gser gyi bum btud cing / /dri bzang chu yis mchog tu mngon bkrus pa//e kaḥg the rtswa si bi kā si dzā su yi tap+ta to yā su ma ru sbi lbo 6/ /gaṇ+ḍa be+e mya ngan thang la buyongs su tsha ba'i chu/ /rngul gyis klurgyas pas gcig pu ji ltar 'khru/ /rin chen mdzes la ta kuṇ+ḍa la rat+na kārnyi ki maṇ+ḍa na me ba bo྾ / / kasmra da kasmrat+ta pa'i rna cha 'gram par 'phyang / /rgyan rnams 'dor bar byed pa pya ci zhig rigs/ /ci slad bde med spyod ba niḥsu kha su na tsan+da rna nan+da na min+d+ra shu bye/ /ma hā bi tra ṣ+pe sha ya ṣ+pe dṛ pārte she ni glo bur du/ /tsan+dan zla ltar dkar bas dga' ma yin/ /mi bdag la 'os khri stan bla re che/ /lhag ⑩ṣe ṇa ki she ṣa bi she ṣa shu bye/ /lakhye na bā bo ga na sgo ga yo gya ka rja ltar khyad par dkar la cis mi gzims/ /dpal mos gsar 'khyud longs spyod 'os gyur pa/ /khyod kyi ta nuste sa ha te ku sha l+lī/ /kān+ta smi tom+bi pra ti rmā shu kāhaṃ ki ṭī ba ra lus kyis stan ngan ji ltar bzod/ /mdzes 'dzum rlabs kyis gzugs brnyan gos 'os pa/ /lus 'di la 95—303

sro tsi ta me ta rda ge/ /pā rto tsa lī khā ka ma lā gya de smin pā tram̐ ka rja te thra ya ma r+ya ni chos gos ji ltar 'os/ /khyod kyi phyag ni pad+mo'i rol gnas 'dir/ /da lta stilhung bzed dga' ba ji dzā tai/ /a yo bi hā ra sta ba kaṇ+ḍa r+pā thaḥsoṅkaṇ+ḍa kān+ta ju dza ban+dha nārtaḥ/ /ltar skye/ /khyod kyi mgrin pa rgyab kyi gnas 'di dag /sred ldan mdzes ma'i lag pas bsdams 'os pa/ /saṃ sgo ga lakhyiḥk+ṣa pi ta pra mo daḥka ro t+ya tīṇ+ḍi pra ṇa yā ba sgo gi/ /longs spyod dpal mo'i rab dga' nyams gyur cing / /glo bur nyid du mdza' gcugs nyams par byed/ /rū paṃ bi lasmri kṛ te pube+e tsā paṃ maste bha kustostso ku tsā bi bhu tiḥ/ /ra me tog gzhu ldan skyengs —7par byed pa'i gzugs/ /glang chen myos bum ltar mtho'i nu rgyas 'byor/ /lang terbi khā so pa ba ā+oṃ ba yabyu ke nā sa maste na ka li to bi rā gaḥ/ /khru two ti tsho dga' ba'i rtse sa nye ba'i nags/ /ci slad khyod kyi ④mi bzad chags bral byas/ /zhes gsan tshul tai shī la ni byerba bhā ṣe sha shaṃ ka le khā la li ta smi te na/ /saṃ krān+ta nā nā khrims gter kyis bka' stsal te/ /zla ba'i cha bzhin rol pa'i 'dzum dag gis/ /mi bdag sna tshogs dṛ pa rat+na rā gi kurban+da lak+ṣu mi ba rā dza lasmri ma/ /rā dza na dza rā ro ga ha rin chen 'od 'phros pa'i/ /rgyal po'i dpal ni mi snang 'dzad ④pa bzhin/ /rgyal po chu rgyun ltar g.yo te ba na sru tu re ga lo khā ya di dzī ba dṛdhiḥ/ /taṅka su na snga da ni shaṃ pra har+ṣa 'tsho ba'i srog /gal te rga dang na bas mi 'joms na/ /rab ⑤ dga' bdud rtsi'i char lta'i yul rnams la//r+pā yu ṣa bar+ṣa bi ṣa yā bhi khā ṣaḥ/ /sha mā mṛ tā swā da na su sbi rā zla ma rtag tu su zhig mngon par 'dod mi bgyi2 / /zhi ba'i bdud rtsi nyams stsong brtan rnams kyis⑦/ /nags pa ti ni shu n+ya ba nān+ta bhū miḥ/ /bi byu ti lī khā ma da bi hwa khā rmā harmya nang stong pa'i sa gzhi gnod med yin/ /'byor pas rgyags shing rtse dgas 2'khrugs rnams kyi/ /ba gam ṇi par+yan+ta ni pā ta nā ni/ /sa ku ma ku miḥsturnyi dṛ pāḥs yo bhiḥs rā ga tai maḥldan pa mthar ni rnam par lhung ⑨/ /gang zhig gur kum bidang bcas chus bkrus pa'i/ /mi bdag rtag tu 95—304

sa ta lta pra yārnyi/ /saṃ to ṣa shi lastu ma naḥpra sā da shur+ghaṃ bu sgo tā be+e ma lī bha chags dang ldan par gyur①/ /yid ni rab tu dang ba'i chus bkrus pa'i/ /chog shes ngang tshul dri ma bral brnyi / /sho lta khru te ṣ+pe ba na kuṇ+ḍa le na dā ṣ+pen pā ṇi rna tu rka ka ṇi na/ /bar 'gyur ༷/ /snying rje rgyas pa rnams kyi lus mdzes pa/ /gzhan phan gyis yin tsan+dan byugs 2pas min//bi bhā ti kā yaḥka ru zla ku khā dzā pa ro pa kā re ṇa na tsan+da ṣ+pe na/ /e tā ni mo hā rna ba thos pas yin gyi rna chas khyomin/ /lag pa sbyin pas yin gyi gdub 2bus min/ /sa bdag gis spyad ha ta bal+la bhā ni saṃ sak+ta mutsū shu si ta smi ta ni/ /sa tai na sgo gyu ni lhag mar gyur pa'i rgyan/ /mu tig 'od chags dkar ba'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /rmongs pas dhidaga' ba ma bha brnyi byu j-i dustsoṣ+ṭa shiṭ+wā ni be+e byu ṣa shā ni/ /rā gā tu rā rde ri pu bcom 'di dag ni/ /dam pa rnams kyis ⑦spyad par 'os pa min/ /chags pas gzir dang dgra yis tā pi tā rmā ni dā dha na dh+yā na ba tān+da nā ma/ /sha yā su kha spar+sha ba tī 6 rā gdungs 2gyur pa/ /nor gyi bsam gtan ldan pa'i rgyal po la/ /reg na bde ba'i lam khan gnyid yod dhī san+d+ra tra shān+taḥsu kha me ba she te/ /nirmo ka kādhe na ba dzā shu ke na min—/ /zhi ba rnams ni kun tu bde bar gzims/ /lag 'gro'i spyod tshul sbrul shun mdzes pa yi/ /bhu dze+e ga thratrīrna tu ṭī ba re ṇa/ /pā tra pa bi tā ṇi sa mā p+lu hā ni gos bzang gis min bu chos gos dag gis yin 7/ /lhung bzed kyis ni zas dag gtsang ba dang / /r+pā yu ṣa mi tā rgya sha nā ni sru te/ /ts+tsha tā ṇi bagh+ra dz+dza ṣa ma pra kā shaṃ yongs rdzogs bdud rtsi'i grogs po nyid du bskyed/ /gdugs kyi bzhin ni mchog tu mi gsal zhing / /ma rto bi lo lo bya dza nā ni lo ghāḥ/ /saṃ sak+ta dzā bye dz+dza da yi dṛ pā rde kuzan+ta hā rā rlung yab rlung gis yid ni rnam par g.yo/ /ha ri tsan+dan gyis brlan skedo shal gyis/ /mi bdag snying la ha ri tsan+da nābyeḥ/ /bi yo ga ro gā nu ga tā bi bhu tiḥkān+taḥk+ṣa ṇad+dhā bi ra so bi bsil ba reg par byed/ /'byor pa bral 'u ba'i nad kyi rjes su 'gro/ /rtse dga' ro bral mdzes ma skad 95—305

khā saḥ/ /yasmin+da pā yaḥs ta tā nu shā yī sa ka su sgo gaḥsu bha go pa yo gaḥ/ /cig mtha'/ /gang gi lus la gnod pa rtag gnas te/ /su yi longs spyod skal bzang nye bar rigs/ /dzā hūṃ sa dz+re bha dza na ya t+ya dza sre ta no ti tro: bh+ra ma mo ha spruts+tshaḥ/ /ka 'phral du zil gnon longs spyod nyer spyod ni/ /rgyun du glal bcas blun pa nyid bskyed cing / /sred ro t+ya sa hūṃ sa ra sa twa me ba sgo go pa sgo gaḥpra sa bha pi yo gaḥ/ /ya dā su 'khrul rmongs dang brgyal ba rgyas pa dang / /mi bzad chags dang bcas pa nyid du byed/ /gang tshe bde kha shrirna ba tsan+d+ra le khā pra bhā ta put+pa n+ya pi yo ba nā ni/ /kan+d+ram+bi mā lā gra ha r+ṇa sha rī dpal zla tshes ri mo dang / /lang tsho yang ni snga dro'i me tog ste/ /lus ni las kyi rlabs kyis 'phreng ①ba ram̐ ta dā ma mā yo ga mi to nu rā gaḥ/ /satsā ma rāḥdh+wa dza sum̐ dza paṭ+wā 'dzin—/ /de tshe bdag ni rjes su chags dang bral/ /rnga yab dang bcas dar dang rgyal mtshan thogs⑤//sa bā dzi bā la dri pa kar+ṇa tā lāḥ/ /swa bha ba lo laḥki la rā dza lasmyuḥsabye rta dang bcas pa'i glang zhon rna ba'i stabs/ /rang bzhin gyes g.yo rgyal po'i dpal 'byor gyi①/ /longs bi la sā k+ṣa ṇa dzha ga saṃ gaḥ/ /kuste ti ta ta ta ta ku sha lā yā rā spyod thams cad skad cig 'jig pa'i grogs/ /rgyal po'i thugs ni rab dang mchog bsgrub ④cing / /dge dzñāsh+yit+ta pra sā rda pa ra oṃ be+e dh+wa ya/ /sa shārnyi kaslo la su jo pra bā haṃ ki ran dṛ shā ba'i slad du de de bka' stsal nas/ /zhi ba'i rlabs ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun rgyas shing / /de yi spyan gyes pār+ṣa da mā lu lo ke/ /ma nī ṣi rde shākya ku loṅga tā rna sabhā yu tā ni pra ti pā 'khor la rnam par gzigs/ /shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa ni/ /khri phrag bdun gyis chos ni r+yadhadz+re / /tsakri sa ha su ṇi sap+ta ta tra saṃ pāp+ta sar+yā p+ta bi she ṣa rtogs byas shing / /de la stong phrag bdun yang yongs rdzogs kyi/ /khyad par yang dag 'thob pa'i snod dzñā dzi/ /shuklo da nā ye ku sha lo sa brje ga ṇi tha tabhu l+ya sa ha sra nyid mdzad/ /de nas de dang 'a7 grangs mtshungs stong phrag tshogs/ /zas dkar la sogs rnams kyis dge 95—306

saṃ khyeḥ/ /tro kho da nā bye ra mṛ to da nā bye—t+ta pra sa daḥsu ma hā na bap+taḥ/ /ba thob/ /bre bo zas sogs /ky-i7bdud rtsi zas sogs kyis— 3/ /shin tu che ba'i sems ni dang ba thob/ /ke tsid+ma yuḥshā ba ka bo dhi yuk+ta pra h+ye ka bo sgo ni ra tābya ke tsita/ /samyak+ta thā kha cig nyan thos byang chub ldan par gyur/ /nyi ( che'i byang chub reg dang la la dag /de bzhin yang dag nut+ta ra bo dhi saṭ+wāḥpa re ba byu burga ga na pra san+d+raḥ/ /sho taḥpa ri pāp+ta bla med byang chub zhugs/ /gzhan ni mkha' bzhin rab tu dang bar gyur/ /de nas gzhan gyis rgyun pha lo ta to bye sa sa kṛ dā gā mi pha lo ta tha bye/ /abye gya nā gā mi pha zhugs 'bras bu thob/ /de bzhin gzhan byis lan gcig phyir 'ong dang / /phyir mi 'ong 'bras de yang lo ta dā pu rartat+pa lo kle sha bi mut+ta ra bye/ /e kastu ta tā dzi ta pā pa gzhan gyis te/ /nyon mongs rnam grol gzhan gyis dgra bcom thob/ / mdun sar de ni lha sbyin ④ gcig sha pasta maḥs mu ho pa nyi ta pra mo haḥ/ /mā yo ha mi t+yā ha ha san dza pu zhig /mun pa'i tshogs kyis gtibs shing rab rmongs pasa'7 / /sdig dmod ma thul skye bo rnams kyi na rmā sa t+ya sbi to saṃ sa di de ba dat+taḥ/ /dṛ paṃ tu bāt+pa l+ya ni lbo na me ba lugs—/ /bden pa la bkod 'di ni sgyu zhes smra bu/ /mi yi bdag kyang mnyes gshin gyis chags shing //pu tro da yāta pra byu ta dzā ta dadz+re/ /moṅga l+ya bhik+ṣu dzi na shā sa ṣ+pe na ma hadhi sras ni dar las zlog par dogs ⑦skyes pa/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las dge slong mo gal ru7bus/ /rdzu 'phrul bhis+thā ta ma rda tsa kā ra/ /dṛṭī phi rā dzā bha ga bta pra bhā pi na t+yabyu chen pos rgyags dang bral bar kyebyas/ /bcom ldan mthu ni rgyal pos mthong gyur kyang / /shin tu rmad tai po ru ṣa me ba me ṣ+pe/ /a sgyu sa byā nā ni dza na gya byu rmā soṅkar+ṣa kṛ t+yā ni na bisma byung skyes bu nyid mi sems/ /phul byung mdzad pa goms pas reg pa ni/ /nges par skye bo'i ya mtshan rgyu yā ya/ /a tha pa re d+kur+bha ga bān su ren+d+ra saṃ pa di te he ma ma hā be+e mān/ /ma yin/ /de nas nyi ma gzhan la lha dbang gis/ /rab bsgrubs gser gyi gzhal yas khang chen du/ /95—307

su me ru shī rnyi sa ma kā sha ru tse ཿ sau ha lhun po'i spyog ltar lhun po'i spyog ltar sogs tshig rkang gcig gi skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar dpyad/ gsal zhing sa ṣ+pe rat+na ma yi n+ya ྾ data/ /bra d+men+d+ra mu khe 6 ta taḥsru re mdzes pa yi①/ /rin chen seng ge'i khri la bcom ldan 'das/ /de nas der ni tshangs dang dbang po 6 ta tro pe biṣ+ṭi 6 thra thu pra bhe 6/ /ba bhup+ta duk+ṇi ṣa shi khā+e bi khā sogs—/ /'od zer che ba'i lha rnams nyer gnas tshe/ /de yi gtsug tor rtse las 'phros pa'i duphyogs/ /me+ebyasbyo shu mā lnga dza ṭi khā i bā shāḥ/ /a byo n+ya saṃ ghaṣ+ṭa bi lo pa hā rir+gha nā zla 'od 'phreng ba'i ral pa bzhin du mdzes/ / do shal phan tshun reg cing g.yo ba yis/ /kyelha rnams ba hā riḥtri da sherbi shad+dhiḥ/ /ni radzñātsā bhu ba me ba rā dzā dā re 6 mānā stug por babs shing zhugs pa yis/ /bar mtshams ④ med pa'i sa der rgyal pos ni/ /sgo bzhi rnams su na tsa tukhyo le bhe/ /sa byu blu maste tra ku be+e ra mu khyerni bār+ya mā ṇ+ḍa bhi ma taḥpra lam nyid thob ma gyur/ /ku be ra sogs byun ma g.yo ldan pas/ /der ni mngon par 'jug 'dod zlog ⑤be+e shaḥ/ /bi tshwa ya babh+yaḥslu li tā bhi dh+wayī khyu j-ita pa re nin+d+ra ti sgo ba bhū ba/ /gyur pa/ /bzhin ni mdzes bral brjod pa 'khrul gyur pa'i/ /sa bdag mchog tu gzi byin med par gyur/ /pra bi shi tasterdzi na shā sa ṣ+pe na ka dā tsi dā sha r+ya ta da gra byu mo/ /shurnyo rgyal ba'i bka' yis de dag rnams kyis btang / /ji buzhig ltar stes ⑦de mdun sa gzhi thob/ /zas da naste pra ṇi pa t+ya rūspyo tsit+ta pra sā de na pu re su taspyo/ /shāstu ta tasmi tsa gtsang spyi bos de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi mdun na rab dang sems kyis gnas/ /de nas ston pas de tu rā r+ya sa t+ya pra bo dha k+ṣiṃ dharma ka thān+di de sha /dzñā ṣ+pe na yā dzi sha ti la chos kyi gtam/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi rab tu rtogs byed bstan/ /gang zhig shes pas de yi shri ga ma gya saṅka ya treg bhū dha ra ma su dzñā k+ṣita/ /ta taḥs ga tā kṛ ta kṛ t+ya dzad+mā 'jig tshogs la/ /lta ba'i ri rtse nyi shu dag kyang bcom/ /de nas skye ba'i bya ba byas pa de/ /song nas 95—308

shuklo da rgo pra bha dza swa rā rdzu/ /swa gya bra bītrī bha ga ban+d+ra diṣ+ṭi dasgo sa zas dkar la smras rgyal srid gzung ① / /des smras bdag ni bcom ldan gyis gnang ba/ /bstan pa la ā+oṃ mo da yi tai na rā rdzu/ /tro kho da ṣ+pe rā bye pa rā mu khe pi bai rā gya yo gā da dga' rgyal srid ma yin ༷no/ /bye bo zas kyang rgyal srid las 1phyir phyogs/ /bdud rtsi zas kyang chags mṛ to da na tsa/ /dza gā hā shuzlo da na saṃ pra diṣ+ṭi hūṃ rā bye la smri ma tha bha tri kā bral ldan gyur tshe/ /de nas zas gtsang gis gnang rgyal po yi/ /dpal 'byor de ni bzang ldan zhes pas khyaḥ—/ /rā dzārta sgo gi ra tha pū dza yi tā dzi dz+wa dza ṣ+pe shaḥshu tsi saṃ pra bhā taiḥ/ /bzung / /de nas rgyal pos longs spyod gtsang ma rnams/ /rab phul 'gro ba'i dbang gis rgyal ba mchod/ /n+ya gro dha dh+wa ma pra ti pā r+ya tsā sri shurnyo da naḥshudzha ma no ra tho bhūta/ /trorto da na snga bi su n+ya gro dha yi gnas ni de khyo rab phul/ /zas gtsang yid la re ba dag par gyur/ /de nas bre bo zas kyi bu to yu bā no rā dzā rnye yā pre ra ṇa yā tsa mā tuḥ/ /e kasta yaḥpra dzi to ni gzhon gnyis/ /ma yis bskul bas de las gcig rab byung / /rgyal po'i bka' yis bkag pas gzhan rudhaḥpa ro ma hān+d+ra ma kṛ tī ba bhu ba/ /a thā bha ba: ta se bha tri ka gya rā rnyo ma ni/ /chen po zhes pa khyim na gnas par gyur/ /de nas chags bral rgyal po bzang ldan gyi/ /yid ni bi rak+ta su ba nā bhi khā ṣaḥ/ /bi be+e ga bhā rdzu pra sha ma pra bṛtrī na bā nags tshal mngon par 'dod par gyur/ /rnam rig ldan pas ⑤rab zhir zhugs pa'i yid/ /gsar pa'i pi lakhrorna ma no ru ṇadhi/ /ta taḥs mā hu ya sa de ba darja rarje bhi dpal 'byor gyis kyang khegs pa min/ /de nas de yis rgyal srid dbang bskur ni/ /'thob 'dod sems ṣe ka pra ti pan+da tsir+ghaṃ/ /u bā tsa me pra bra dza na mya ka la kra mā ga tai ki bha ba tā bi ldan lhas byin yang dag bos( — / /smras pa bdag ni rab tu 'byung ba'i dus/ /rim pas long ⑦ la khyod ni ci de yi/ /tai pra sgo bā tsāt+ta bi be ka rda bhaḥsu saṃ bṛ taḥsaṃ sā ri de ba zhig brjod/ /dben pa'i tshul 'chos 'dzin pa'i lhas byin gyis/ /mdun sar legs bsdams de la slar 95—309

rmā—/ /saṃ sru tsi tā nā t+ya yī kā ni tan+t+ra ta thā bi dh+wa bye ba hu lak+ṣa ṇa ni/ /bhū pa—/ /der ni rnam pa de lta'i gegs ①gyur pa/ /ngan pa'i mtshan nyid rnams ni yang dag bshad/ /de pa pra mo dā da tha bha dri ko pi tairde ba dat+ta pra mu kheḥs hai ba/ /pra bra nas rab dga'i ges bdag bzang ldan yang / /lhas byin la sogs de rnams bcas pa nyid/ /rab byung bye yā ṭī ba ra bu tra yo gāstso kā ra be+e rā gya ma yī bi bak+shi/ /rā dzñāsta thā rā dza chos gos lhung bzed ldan gyur pas/ /sa gzhi chags bral rang bzhin byas pa bzhin/ /rgyal po dang ni de ku mā ra kā ṇa muskṛṣ+ṭa hā dzā ga da kuṇ+ḍa lā dzā/ /sā sro bi rā gā da ba tār+ya te bzhin rgyal sras dag /do shal dpung rgyan rna rgyan rab spangs pa/ /de dag rnams kyi skra lhung nye bar ྾ ke shā nu pā lbo ki la kalpa ko bhuta/ /mūkhoḥs byā tso bi dzi nā dzha yi 'khor—/ /'dreg mkhan chags bral mig chu ldan par gyur/ /de ni rmongs shing dman yang rgyal ba'i ba pra bra bye yā pū bye ta ro ba byu ba/ / tsit+ta pra sā da gya ba ra su ma bye bkas—/ /rab tu byung nas mchod 'os mchog tu gyur/ /sems ni mchog tu rab tu dang ba'i rgyu/ /na kā ra khaṃ paṇ+ḍi ta tā na dzā tiḥ/ /sā m+bi tsi kā yā ma tha bha dra go pi mkhas pa nyid min rigs ldan min nam snyam/ /de nas phyag la mi bdag bzang ldan gyis/ /'dreg dzñā tā dṛ paḥpar+sha di rka tai/ /bhā tsa gya pa do ka tha ma gya ban+de ma nyi pa mkhan de yang 'khor der 'khod shes nas/ /sa bdag gyur nas dman pa 'di yi ni/ /rkang la 'dud tiḥsam+bi ti nispru lo juta/ /ta ma bra bī da slu li tā bhi mā dze+e bi kalpa bhi oṃ bha ga bān ces ji ltar ①g.yo med gyur/ /rnam par rtog ldan khengs dang ma bral ba/ /de la bcom ldan 'dzum zhing bi hā gya/ /pa bra bye yā mo hā nu brnyi saṃ t+ya bye te dzā ti ma yo bi bka' stsal pa/ /rmongs pas cher bsdams rigs las byung ba yis④/ /mngon par khengs pa rab tu byung mā naḥ/ /khru two ti rā dzñā sa ha rā dza pu treḥkṛ te pra ṇa me thra thi bī tsa kaspe/ /nas gtong spri / /zhes thos rgyal po'i sras bcas rgyal po yis/ /phyag 'tshal tshe na sa gzhi rab tu g.yos//95—311

na de ba datrī pa ru ṣā bhi jo yī pa do ba ban+de bha ga bān gi rā mya/ /kaspra ta k+ṣi bcom ldan gsung gis de yi rkang pa la/ /lhas byin tshig rtsub brjod cing phyag mi byed/ /de nas sa g.yos tebe+esma ta mā na se na thraṣ+ṭa sta to bhik+ṣu ga ṇi na shāstu/ /u bā tsa rā dzñā ki la kalpa ya mtshan yid can kyi/ /dge slong tshogs kyis dris shing ston pa yis/ /bka' pal rgyal po 07skye ba gzhan ka su dzad+mān+ta re mya gya kṛ ta pra shā maḥ/ /pu ra yu r+pā kā shi pu re bi lo kya la yang / /'dreg mkhan 'di la nges par phyag 'tshal byas/ /kā dushi'i grong du dbul po gzhon nu yis//bha dru bhi dh+wa dzā ga ṇi rka da ri draḥ/ /se r+pā bya dh+wa tā pun+da ra kasta dā sri go smad 'tshong bzang mo zhes pa sngon 1mthong gyur/ /mdzes pas de tshe de yi g.yog rnams byas/ /gang phyir hi sarba bya sa no pa deṭ+wā/ /ta yā bi mṛṣ+ṭaḥku su mostso yā ya pu naḥpu naz-iṅga chags pa d+nghargud kun nye bar ston/ /de yis btang nas me tog btu ba'i slad/ /yang yang lhag par don i bā dhi kār+bhe/ /tahūṃ ga mā rgo ga ma no ra je na shān+taḥs ba bh+ra ma ba nān+ta re 6/ /gnyer bung ba bzhin/ /de dang 'grogs pa'i lus med re ba las/ /nags nang rnams su de yis ngal a tā n+ta re shā n+ta ta ra ཿ k+ṣi tī sha ཿ pā sto ba na rnye mṛ ga yā ra zhing 'khyama'u/ /skabs der rngon (sgo la chags pas rab ngal zhing / /nags nang phyin par gyur pas ⑦sa se na/ /tai brah+ma dat+taḥbra sha m+bi k+ṣa gī tai ta gya sh-i rtota ts+tshan+da ta nurla tā d+dhāḥ/ /yi dbang / /lus ni 'khri shing gis bsgribs tshangs byen 2rmis/ /de ni rab mthong de yi glu dag thos/ /na pa na ba ku su mā sha yā ki me baṃ ma dhu ka ra tā pa ha to si gats+tsha tūrte/ /me tog gsar pa gsar pa 'dod pas sbrang rtsi byed/ /ci ste de ltar gdung bas khrod 'joms myur du song //bi ka se ka ma lā na nañdzi be+e sa bha ba ti hi saṃ ku tsi tā di bā ba sā ṣ+pe/ /bzhin ras me tog rnam rgyas chu skyes ldan pa de/ /gang phyir nyin mo'i mjug tu zum par gyur pa khya yin//te ṣ+pe te gī tai dṛ pa ti ni sha mya smi tasgoṣ+ṭa gha ṭi ta hā ra kārnyiḥ/ /u ba tsa tai tri mi bdag gis ni de yi glu skad thos/ /'dzum zer do shal mdzes pa la reg cing / /der /3smras nyi 'od 95—312

bra ka rārka tā pe ko yo sa khaṃ gī ta rā sa bhi yo gaḥ/ /so gya bra bīta byu pa te na drag pos gdungs pa la/ /grogs po glu yi nyams dga' 'byor pa stici/ /des kyang smras pa sa bdag nges nā ma tasto ra bistabe+e ta rastu kā maḥ/ /swa karma duḥkhā ni bi harnyi lo ke par ni/ /nyi ma mi gdung 'dod pa mchog tu gdung / /'jig rten na ni rang las sdug bsngal 'dzin/ /na shrīṣ+ṭha dak+ta ni ma ru sgra lā ni/ /i t+yarba pabye kya gu rjarba ṣ+pe na sa bhū pa te babe+e so ka'i mya ngam thang ni sreg byed min/ /don ldan tshig 'di'i yon tan phul ba yis/ /de ni sa yi bdag bha tā ma bā pa/ /saṃ pā da saṃ spar+sha su bhā ṣi lta hi ke ྾ tsa saṭ+wā ra pa rda po'i mdza' bor gyur/ /legs bshad yang dag brjod pas reg pa ni/ /su zhig dag gis ④bsnyen bkur na yā ti/ /te nā tha rā dzā bi dza ni shra mā tuḥshī to pa tsā ri ra pa nīta tā paḥ/ /gnas mi 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po ④mi med ngal gyur pa/ /de yi bsel ba'i rim gros gdung ba bral/ /spru t+yā ta mā dā ya ta taḥs hai ba sa rā dza dh+wa nī ma ga maskṛ ta dzhaḥ/ /ta tā gya dz+re ba de nas byas shes de yis dga' bas de/ /blangs nas lhan cig rgyal po'i pho brang song / /de la 'di yis pra da i kyu dat+ta sasgo ṣa saṃ pū ri ta tsit+ta bṛt+taḥ/ /rā dzñār+bhadā nā bhi srog rab byin zhes ④nas/ /lhag par tshim pas sems kyi spyod tshul rdzogs/ /rgyal srid phyed sbyin mngon mu khaḥs ta sgo tsit+ta nu thrat+ta su ka mar+ya de yo/ /rā bye bha dā na bra thra te tha phyogs de gnas te/ /sems rjes zhugs la sbyin min ci zhig yod/ /de ni rgyal srid byed sbyin brtson pa'i ta smin na tsin+ta yadrun+da ra kaḥkṛ pā dze+e/ /bha tram̐ bi nā rā dza su khe na ki me tshe—/ /mdzes pas mtshan mo bsams 3pa bdag la ni/ /bzang mo ( shemed na rgyal srid bde bas ci/ /dha byo hi tata spru ti su d+mā bhi ṣik+taḥ/ /ma hūṃ na rā dzñā da bi ro tsa terta ma der mdza'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur skal ldan yin/ /rgyal srid las kyang byed la bdag mi sred/ /dpal khaṇ+ḍi tāspra pi hi sho bha te shrīḥ/ /e kārba yo ge sa dā bibā dī dwa yod+ngha ni chung yang nyams pa med na mdzes/ /don gcig ldan pas /3rtag tu 'gal bar brjod/ /gnyis ka 95—313

sgo giḥka li re ba muṭ+wāḥ/ /tasmrad dṛ paṃ ku snye ma haṃ ni pā r+ya sa map+ta longs spyod rtsod la ①gzugs can nyid/ /de ཿslad mi bdag nang ②nas bkum pa na/ /rgyal srid mtha' rā bye na bha bā mi pūr+ṇaḥ/ /k+ṣa rde bi tsin+d+ra t+ya nu tā pa tap+tasnyi gre dag gis ni bdag rdzogs 'gyur/ /zhes pa skad cig rnam bsams 'gyod pas gdungs/ /drag po'i ma rnaḥswa gya pu naḥpra da dzñā/ /kitsi ta tri tai no r+ya ta ram̐ ma yi tata ko yo shugs btang ④de yis slar bsams ⑤pa/ /bdag gis ci bsams mchog tu smad 'os 'di/ /nges par pra kā raḥkha lu tīkyā tā yāḥ/ /kṛ ta sna sa kalpa ka lo ka le pā da ho nu ladz+dza ni dza tse ta rno ba'i rab byed 'di lta ci/ /las ngan rtog 0 pa'i dri mas rab bsgos pa/ /kye ma rang sems la yang ngo so pi/ /swas+t+yastu rā dzñā ya na maḥsu khe bh+yaḥsaṃ mo ha mā tā k+ṣa ma hūṃ tsa re tsha/ /rgyal srid shis gyur bde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rmongs ma gcig ⑦dpal 'byor bzod par lasmriḥ—/ /ye ṣā ma nā swā di ta cirnyi tā nā me baṃ bi d+mā dhīḥpra tha maḥswa bhā baḥ/ /mdzod—/ /gang dag nyams su ma myong bsam nyid na/ /dang po'i ⑧blo yi rang bzhin 'di ltar gyur/ /ba oṃ ni dhaste bi da dh+wa tiju1 ni pā ta ya h+ye ba ta masta no ti/ /ā s+thā kye ma dpal dang dug shing bsnams tsam gyis/ /skyes bu rnams ni rnam par nyams par byed/ /'khrul pa ta mā tre ba ka ro ti sum̐ sā ma ho bi nā shaṃ bi ṣa babe+e rī shrīḥ/ /tsi ram̐ bi tsibye skyed byed brgyal ba nyid du byed/ /rnam par lhung ⑨byed mun pa rgyas par byed/ /yun ring 'di bsams ti sa dzā ta tsit+taḥpra byu ka bo bye bi ma laḥpra bhā te/ /a bh+yargya mā no pi na re sho rang nyid byang chub la/ /chags bral de yi sems skyes snga dro ni/ /mi yi dbang ⑩pos mngon par gsol re ṇarā rdzu na grwa ha ni thrat+ta khruṣ+ṭaḥ/ /pra h+ye ka budha twa ma bāp+ta me rna btab kyang / /sred pa dang bral rgyal srid bzung ma gyur/ /dus kyis rang sangs rgyas nyid thob pa de/ /kā le na dṛṣ+ṭa dṛ pa tirma hadhi/ /tat+yā da pad+ma sgo nyi mo le mā lha—t+ta rdzu 'phrul che ldan mi bdag gis mthong nas/ /mgo 'phreng de yi zhabs pad la 'phos pas /sems ni 95—314

pra sā do tsi ta mi t+ya bo tsata/ /sa ko pi saṅkan+d+ra bi pā ka dzad+mā brjo bi dang bar 'os pa de ①dag smras/ /gang yang 1dam pa'i las kyi rnam smin skyes/ /rab zhi'i ④dbang be kaḥpra sha mā bhi ṣe kaḥ/ /ya su pra bhā bābyi ra ta spri ha rde t+ya bye ba raṭ+wā bskur dben de phyag byar 'os/ /gang gi mthu las chags pa bral rnams kyis/ /chu gter ske khyorags ka ra me kha lā bhūḥ/ /khru te ti rā dzñā ka thi haṃ ta darja dzā tai ta da bh+yarja ma ldan pa btang ⑤bar 'os/ /zhes pa de don phyis du bskyed rgyal pos brjod/ /thos nas de don don du yā bi bhā ya/ /taṅkalpa kaḥshārnyi pa rda pra pe de se bān+ta ram̐ gaḥki la shaṃ gā pā gnyer nas bzung / /'dreg mkhan de ni zhi ba'i gnas thob nas/ /de nyid dman ⑦pa gang gā khyeskyong ba laḥ—/ /pābye ta ma pyut+ta ma kan+d+ra yo gāta pra bra bye yā sadz+dza na pū bye bhā baṃ/ /po⑨—/ /mchog gi las kyi sbyor bas rab byung las/ /dam pa'i dngos po mchod 'os thob de hūṃ 7la'ang //rā dzā ba ban+de pra ṇa taḥthra the byaḥkadzasta dā byu da pi ṣaṭa bi kā raḥ/ /so yo rgyal pos rab btud phyag 'tshal de yi tshe/ /rnam 'gyur drug ldan sa yang g.yos par gyur/ /rgyal po rā dzā bi hi ta be+e na ta r+bha dṛ ko bra h+ma dasto pa bye pā lbo sa ki la rnams 'dud bsgrubs ⑫pa de ni bzang sbyin 3dag dang tshangs pas byin/ /gang yang nye bar 0/ 'khor de ku sha lī kalpa ko shaṃ hā pā laḥ/ /i t+yārtswatram̐ bha ga ba du di tai rnyik+ṣa dge ldan 'dreg mkhan gang ④gā skyong ba po⑫/ /zhes pa'i ngo mtshar bcom ldan gyis gsungs dge slong de bste sha mya swa sbyi tsir+ghaṃ su kṛ ta sha ra ṇi me ni re he tu me ba/ /i ti dag rnams kyis thos/ /sems ni rab dang kho na legs pa'i lam la rgyu nyid yin par sems/ /zhes pa k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dze+e dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las yab pi tā pu tra sa mā dā rna tra yo bo sha ti pal+la waḥ// //dang sras mjal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i ⑩yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa ⑫gsum pa'o// //95—315

tsid+dhā ra t+na de dhi ka ru tsa yaḥ sat+tha lo ke ṣ+ṭa kau byā ba byo ste gang zhig sems can don rnams dag gi bu dang chung ma la sogs mchog tu ni/ /phangs pa'ang n+yaḥpu ru ṣa ma ṇa yaḥke khya pūt+tha pra bha baḥ/ /ye ṣārje ba thra ya btang nas dman pa'i pho nya ①bzhin ni log pa ༷gyur pa med pa nyid/ /yid bzhin rin chen las lhag ma pi pa ram̐ pu tra dā rā di da tā sa tā ṭ+wā nā bha ba ti ba da na smra mdzes shing 'jig rten kun gyis smad par mi 'os pa/ /skyes bu'i rin chen gzhan pa sngon med mthu ldan su na tā de n+ya rū tī/ /bha ga bān bhegru byeḥdṛṣ+ṭaḥpu rā shākya pu re dzi naḥ/ /zhig de rnams phyag bgyi 2'os/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag tu sngon/ / lha sbyin chogatam gyi mjug thogs su/ /dza gā da pu za dṛ dzñā tai de ba da t+ta ka thā n+ta re / / pu rī ba dge slong gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal bas sngon byu spyod mtha' gsungs/ /dpal 'byor yid byu ba bi shā khyu bi shā sa ba sa tiḥsre yaḥ/ /bi jo pa kā ra sak+ta mya su gcugs gnas gyur pa/ /sna tshogs zhes pa'i grong khyer byung / /kun la phan pa'i nus pa can/ /legs kṛ ta gye pa dzad+ma bhūḥ/ /saṃ dza yā khro bha bat+ta snga ma mi tra nyi mi dzā shu mān/ /byas skye ba'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /der ni mi bdag spyod tshul bkra/ /grogs min mun pa'i tsha zer can/ /ṣ+pe tā nan+da su ṅgā sru to bi tsi tra tsa ri to dṛ paḥ/ /ta su bi shwarnya ro nā ma mig gi kun dga' bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /kun tu rgyal ba zhes pa byung / /de yi bu ni gtong phod can//ba dā n+yastan yo bha ba ta/ /a pūt+tha t+ya gi nā ye na kṛ tai kalpa ta thams cad sgol zhes bya bar gyur/ /gang gis (chosngon med gtong la ba yis/ /dpag bsam shing gi grags ror+ya shaḥ/ /yīsgo bi ra hi tā tustu lhi bi dasnye na pra sā ta dhi tāḥ/ /sa t+ya na bhā pa phrogs/ /phrag dog spangs nas dus mnyam du/ /mkhas pa yis ni rab brgyan pa/ /bden pa gang gi klu ra nyi ye na dā ṣ+pe na shrīḥkhru te na dhīḥ/ /abyā pi ya su diṅgād+dhā kaṭ+wā bha ra ṇa tshig dang ni/ /sbyin pas dpal dang thos pas blo/ /gang gi grags pa ke ta ka'i/ /nang gi 'dab ltar 95—316

tī ga tai/ /bi bhā ti ke ta tī gasgoḥpa la sha bi sha rda ya shaḥ/ /sa ka dā byuji do dri med pa/ /phyogs kyi na chung rna rgyan du/ /gyur pa da lta'ang rnam par mdzes/ /nam zhig de yis slong di byarat+na lo kā ra mabe+e ṣ+pe/ /ra baṃ bi dza ya sā mra rdzu ma no ra tha ha ram̐ ba la/ /shing rta rgyal srid rnam par rgyal/ /'od kyis yid la re ba 'phrog /rin chen mchog gis brgyan tī ṣā/ /daste ra ze ba ri tasmin bisma ye nā khi lo dza naḥ/ /ba bhū bā krān+ta j-i da pa byin/ /shing rta mchog de byin pa la/ /skye bo mtha' dag ya mtshan gyes/ /snying ni kun tu non gyur yabyen+tat+ta ya ba na re shwa raḥ/ /ma hā mā rtun thā tū ya har+ṣa tī no ma tī cing / /bsam pas kyang ngo mi yi dbang / /de nas sa bdag dga' ba zhan①/ /yid la re ba bsams (te pa tiḥ/ /u bā tso pa tsi tobye ga tsin+ta krān+ta ma no ra thaḥ/ /tasto ra thaḥku pas non/ /mi dga' ba ni nyer bsags pas/ /blon po che rnams bos te smras/ /shing rta chen po'i mā re ṇa sa dze+e traḥsha tru mad+dhā naḥ/ /yat+tha bhā bārdzi tā se yi ma hā ra tha ba bde 'di 1ni/ /gang gi mthu yis rab bsgrubs pa/ /dgra 'joms rgyal bar byed pa yi/ /shing rta de ni rū thi nī/ /lasmraḥsu kha ni ṣaṇ+ḍi me yā tā nibya la hūṃ dwa ye/ /ra gzhon nus byin/ /gnyis la bdag gi dpal 'byor ni/ /g.yo med gyur cing bde bar gnas/ /shing the saur+ya pa the tasmin dza ya kuñdzi ba kuspru re/ /i ti rā dzā ba tsaḥkhru tā ta rta rtul phod lam de dang / /glang po rgyal ba'i ④gter la 'o/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /blon ma bhā ṣan+ta madh+ri ṇaḥ/ /rā dzan+da do ṣasta be+e bā yi bāt+pa bye na pra mā r+ya taḥ/ /dhan+d+raḥpo rnams kyis der smras pa/ /mnyes gshin nas ⑤ni bag med pa/ /'di ni rgyal po khyod kyi skyon/ /chos ka mya na har+ya ya dā rgo ka su na sasma tai/ /kin+tu rū la ha tā thragrum+bi ni su yi dga' ba min/ /sbyin pa su yi bkur bya min/ /'on kyang rtsa ba nyams pa yis )/ /shing las bstodhe pha lābe+e naḥ/ /bi 1 taḥpa ra de she tsa ra thaste na dri dzad+ma nā/ /'bras bu don gnyer ldog /gnyis skyes de yi ⑦shing rta yang / /gzhan gyi yul du btsongs par gyur/ /95—317

i rkyughā madh+ri ṇaḥsabye sha l+ya bad+dhā i pā bha ban/ /a tha kā le na saṃ pāste ces ①smras blon po thams cad ni/ /zug rngus zug pa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dge ba'i rnam smin bzhin//ba sadhe ma da not+pa be/ /bi pā ke su kṛ ta gya ba z-i da yā nan+da dā yi ni/ /snying la kun dga' ster byed pa/ /dus kyis ①myos byed dga' ba yi/ /dpyid ni yang dag byung gyur cing //swa yo gra ho pa jo bya gya ma dhorma dhu ka rābe+e naḥ/ /lo ke put+pa ba ṣ+pe dpyid ni don gnyer bung ba rnams/ /rang nyid kyis bzung bsten 'os pa'i/ /me tog tshal gyi 1'jig yā teḥya sho bhi ri ba shu bh+ra tai/ /a sho ka lo ka sats+tsha ya mu pa kā ro r+ya rten ni/ /grags pa ④bzhin du dkar ba dang / /'gro ba ljon pa mya ngan med/ /'jig rten greb bsil tai dru rma/ /ma sgo bi dh+wa ḍū san+dadhe ka li kā lo kṛ ta dza gta/ /phan par brtson/ /me tog gzhon nus rab brgyan ⑤pa/ /dpyid kyis bsgrub 0par brtsams pa'i tshe/ /rā dzā pu tra sa mā ru khya kuñdza ram̐ rā bye bar+bha dz+wa/ /ya yo phulbā na ba ṣ+pe duṣ+ṭi rgyal sras slong ba'i dpag bsams shing / /rgyal srid 'phel byed glang po la/ /zhon pa ⑦me tog rgyas pa yi⑧//mabe+e kalpa ta rusta run/ /bra dzarnye pra ti sā marnya pra yulngaste dī dzāḥpa ljon pa gzigs su nags su gshegs/ /rgyal phran gzhan gyis btang ba yi/ /bram ze ⑨lam du bgrod de thi / /ba bhā ṣi re sa ma bye t+ya swasnyi bā da pu raḥs rāḥ/ /tsin+ta ma ṇigi la—/ /mngon phyogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig /sngon ⑩du btang nas rab smras pa/ /legs pa khyod ni ya se two shā bh+yo dza ga ti dze+e ga maḥ/ /ya mya san+dar+sha ṣ+pe nādhī gā 'jig rten na/ /g.yo ba'i yid bzhin nor bur ⑪sgogs/ /gang dang phrad pas slong ba rnams/ /dpal bhā mā ligh+ra tre shri yā/ /dā be+e ba bi shu toṅkasgo bi she sngo bha dra dzad+ma ni/ /gyi sha/shemachog tu 'khyud par gyur/ /phul phyin /5khyad par grags pa ni/ /gnyis nyid bzang po'i skye ba la//dā nādz+ra hasta ste lo ke ga dzertswa yo sbi ron+da tiḥ/ /asma bh+ya su kṛ to dā ra sbyin pas lag brlan 'jig rten na/ /khyod dang mtho brtan ⑫glang 'di 'o/ /legs byas rgya che'i glang po 95—318

kuñdza ro da yo pra dī ya tsā / /twa da bye na ba dā bye na dā tu me 'di—/ /bdag cag la no gnang bar mdzod/ /khrod las gzhan kyis ①gtong phod ni②/ /'di ni sbyin me ṣa shākya te/ /i t+yabe+e ta steḥsot+pa hāḥs te bh+yastu da do dī paṃ/ /sa dz+re par mi nus so/ /de yis de blangs ①spro ldan de④/ /srog ldan yang dag rgyal srid bzhin/ /dung dang ba mi ba sā mā bye sa shaṃ kha dh+wa dza tsā ma re/ /da tā bo bye praṅgā ṣ+pe na rgyal mtshan ⑤rnga yab bcas/ /gnyis 'thung de dag rnams la byin/ /byang chub gtso bo ⑦smon lam gyis//pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na shud dha dhīḥ/ /ra tha rarja dī pen+d+rañtsa so bhū dā nan+dir+bha raḥ/ /rin chen mang ldan glang po'i dbang / /byen nas dag pa'i blo ldan de/ /kun tu dga' ba rgyas par gyur//khru tī ba dṛ pa tirdatrī bi khru tai dza ya kuñdza ram̐/ /rak+ṣu pra kā ra ra hi tī rgyal ba'i glang po byin pa yi/ /grags pa mi bdag gis thos nas/ /rgyal po'i dpal 'byor bsrung ba yi//rā dza lal+lī ma ma n+yata/ /sa rā bye bye sa dī te na ku pi te na ma tī byu thabs dang bral ba nyid du bsams/ /de nas sa bdag rgyal srid ni/ /nyams pas 'jigs shing khros pa dzā—/ /niḥkā se taḥku mā ro3tha pra tasbe pra ni pa t+ya tai/ /mā dru da yi ta yā yis—/ /nges par bskrad nas gzhon nu de/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni chas gyur te/ /btsun mo ma dris lha sār+ghaṃ dzā li ni nā ma dā ra shaṃ/ /kṛ: bhi dzñā ta thā ka t+yā mā dā ya sa ya gcig ⑦des/ /gzhon nu dris ④ldan zhes pa dang / /de bzhin kṛṇ+ḍa ⑨zhes pa yi/ /bu mo khyer nas yo ba rna/ /ba ṣ+pe pi she ṣa sa da do bā ha nā di ka mabe+e ṣ+pe/ /sa oṃ hi nags su song / /slong ba rnams la nags su yang / /bzhon pa la sogs lhag ma byin/ /gang phyir chen ma ha tsā sa tī saṃ pakhru tsa bi pakhru tsa/ /ma bye ka dā tsid+mā tā yī put+pa po'i snying stobs ri/ /phun sum tshogs sam rgud kyang snyoms/ /nam zhig ma dris ⑫me tog dang / /rtsa rū la pha khāp+ta ye/ /krāh+ma ṇaḥkash+yi da bye bye rā dza pu tra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ba 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i slad/ /song tshe bram ze su zhig gis/ /rgyal po'i sras la mngon phyogs smras/ /95—319

pa ri dā ra ka tī shā ya tsa tu ro bā la kā bi mo/ /de hi ma hūṃ ma hā sa tā g.yog 'khor med pa bdag la ni/ /bu sring spyang po 'di dag blang / /gang phyir snying stobs chen po khyod//saza do khya saṃ bi khru taḥ/ /shu tī ta ra bi tsārle ba dā ra kau da yi to pa thams cad sbyin par rab tu grags/ /'di thos 'phral la ma dpyad par/ /mchog tu sdug pa'i bu sring ram̐—/ /da tā sa tasta smi sa hā sā se he tabyi ra ha bya dze+e/ /dha na pu tra ka la tā di dag /de yis de la byen nas ni/ /de bral mya ngan bzod par byas/ /nor dang bu dang chung ma sogs//lo ke ka su rna bal+la sgo/ /dā nā da n+yad+ma dā t+yā ā+oṃ da yi tai nā da yā ba 'jig rten pa yi mchog tu phangs/ /brtse ldan gtong phod can rnams la/ /sbyin pa las gzhan phangs pa tai—/ /a tha mā tā sa ma bye t+ya bā ma kau bā la bat+pa lā/ /a pa sh+yaṭī pu raḥmed / /de nas bu la mnyes gshin pa'i/ /ma dris ①'ongs pas bu sring dag /ma mthong shin tu brgyal pa kyuḥpa ti tā t+pan+ta sprudh+ritā/ /sā la bha saṃ dzñā dīste na byāp+ta sho ka kṛ shā nu nā/ /nas ni/ /khyo yi mdun du 'gyel bar gyur/ /mya ngan me ni 'bar ba yis/ /khyab cing cho nge 'don pa de//shi shu pra dā na bṛṭ+wārnyi khru tā ba khyut+tha khā pi nī/ /ta snga shwe ta si duḥ'adu shes rnyed pas bu sring dag /byin par gyur pa'i byung mtha' thos/ /khyo 0la mdza' bas rjes zhugs khāghi ra ba t+ya ste ha duḥs haḥ/ /thra ya pre mā nu dṛ bye ba pra ya yo pu tra pā de②—/ /bu la byams pa'i sdug bsngal me/ /bzod dka' de yi sems la ni/ /khong du rab tu 'bar ka hūṃ/ /a tān+ta re sa ma bye t+ya bi pra rū paḥsu re shwa raḥ/ /z-i t+yābe+e bar gyur/ /skabs der lha yi dbang po ni/ /bram ze'i gzugs su mngon par 'ongs/ /rgyal po'i sras da yi tī pasna rā dza pu tra ma yā tsa ta/ /yā tsi taste na sa ha pā la btsun mo ni/ /sdug ma 'bangs mo'i ④don du bslangs/ /de yis bslangs pa'i 'phral la de/ /shu rtsa dzā yā bi yo ga dzā/ /dhī ya saṃ ste bh+ya satā bhiḥs tasmi bi tā ra hūṃ/ /btsun mo dang bral mya ngan dag /blo yis bzod byas snying stobs kyis⑤/ /chu gter de yis de la byen//95—320

sa r+yaḥpra dā na ta ra dze+e paṃ traspyo ha ri bhā mi ba/ /so ba da si tā man+taḥ'aphral la byen pas rab 'khrugs shing / /ri dwags mo bzhin rnam hu skrag pa'i/ /btsun mo la des byang ka la yasgo bye bā sa nā ā+oṃ/ / sa mā shwa si hi ka spyo ṇi na sho shaṃ chub kyi/ /bag chags nang du 'jog cing smras 'u/ /dge ma yang dag yid rton ①cig /mya ngan bya kartu marta se/ /swasna pra ṇa ya kaspo ya ma sa t+yaḥpre ya saṃ ga maḥ/ /shu thrabar mi 'os so/ /mdza' ba 'di ni rmi lam 'dra/ /snying sdug 'grogs pa bden pa med/ /gnyis skyes ṣa yā dri dza sgyu su dhadz+re te ra ma tsā ma tiḥ/ /bi lo la lo ka ya tā yī dhadz+reḥ'adi la gus pa yis/ /khyod blo chos la dga' bar gyis/ /g.yo ba'i 'jig rten bgrod pa la/ /dam pa'i sbi ra su kṛ ta sa tsā/ /dṛṣ+ṭaḥsabye swa dza na su dza nā ban+dha bā ā+oṃ nu byu chos ni brtan pa'i grogs/ /rang gi skye bo skye bo ④legs pa kun mthong gnyen rnams nyams su stsong bar tā n+ya stuḥ kaṇ+ḍi k+ṣa ṇa pa ri ma la smra yi m+bi mi tra mā lnga/ / dā re gyur/ /skad cig yongs su gyur pas dri ma can 'gyur grogs kyi 'phreng ba mgrin par bkod/ /lang tsho pu tre k+ṣa pi ta mā ni shaṃ yo ba rna dzī bi tañtsa pā sto nā p+ta sbi ra pa ri dang ni srog dag chung ma bu yis rtag tu zad pa nyid gyur cing / /chos las gzhan pa'i thob pa gang yang tsa yaḥko bi dhadz+re tre te n+yaḥ/ /i kyughā bal+la bhālo bha pa ri t+yā ga tu yongs su 'dris pa brtan pa nyid thum thob/ /ces smras btsun mo la chags pa/ /yongs btang de yi bā hā saḥ/ /byu ti ba da na pad+me na byer+ya bṛt+ta ñtsa tse ta sā/ /bi bzhin pad kyis/ /mdzes dang sems kyi brtan pa yi/ /spyod tshul dag ni de yis bzung / /'bral 'u yo ga sho ka bi ka waṃ ma dī dṛṭī kṛ bā ku laḥ/ /ni dze+e rū paṃ sa ma ba'i mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i/ /ma dris lamathong nas snying rjes 'khrugs/ /bde sogs bdag pos rang dh+wa ya sha tsi pa ti ru bā tsa tī/ /bi ṣā rda mā kṛ thāḥpu tri de bo haṃ tri da gi gzugs/ /yang dag bzung nas de la smras/ /bu mo mi dga' ma byed cig /nga ni skabs gsum 95—321

she shwa raḥ/ /abe+e bh+ya stan+da dā bye ṣa tas+thā da se ma yābe+e tā/ /a dhū nā dbang po ①lha/ /'di yis slong ba rnams la khyod/ /ster gyur ②de slad bdag gis bslangs/ /da ni khyo ④sri ba ba kyu hūṃ t+yā sī khyu tā ma yābe+e tā/ /tai da dā h+ye ṣa nā n+yasmi pa 'di nyid la khyod/ /bdag gis gtams par byas te gtad④/ /gzhan la 'di yis khyod mi ster/ /ji ra sī dī ya te ka dze+e/ /ka ri t+yā mi ta bā ba dh+yā dā ra kā rgyu sa mā ga oṃ/ /ltar gzhan byu nor ster gyuradu/ /khyod ni bu sring gnyis po dang / /nges par phrad pa bdag gis bya/ /i t+yā dīr+ya sa ha sruk+ṣaḥs ha sān+ta ra dhī ya ta/ /a tha to dā ra ko bi praḥs zhes smras mig stong ldan pa ni/ /'phral la nyid du mi snang gyur/ /de nas bram ze dubu tsha dag /khyer mā dā yādz+re libla yā/ /bi shā mi tre pu re ga tā lo bha ti kre tu mur+ya to/ /nas nor ni 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad shes ⑦kyi grong song nas/ /chags pa las ni 'tshong bar brtson/ /bi shā mi traḥpa ri dzñā ya rā dza pu tra gya dā ra kau/ /dza gā ma ha tā be+e na rgyal po'i sras kyi bu sring dag /thams cad shes kyis ①yongs shes nas/ /mig ni mchi mas 'gags pa bāt+pa sa rudha lo tsa naḥ/ /kā le na tri di baṃ yā te bi shā mi yis—/ /nor ni chen po dag gis bslus/ /dus kyis sa bdag thams cad shes⑨/ /mtho ris gshegs tri ma tī pa to/ /bhe dze be+e shwan+ta ro rā rdzu yo rā mā t+ya ga shābe+e taḥ/ /tshe grong khyer pa/ /blon po'i tshogs kyis gsol btab nas/ /thams cad sgrol gyis rgyal srid bsten/ /rā bye bi ra dzasta su snga dā na bya sa ni naḥpa re/ /sa two na ban+dha ma nadhin+d+ra mchog tu sbyin pa la zhen pa/ /rdul bral de yi rgyal srid ni/ /phun tshogs snying stobs kyis rgyas pas/ /kabyeṭ+wā tsa ko bha bta/ /tabyi t+ta pūṇ+ḍi bi bha bo zwa h+ma ṇaḥso pidz+dza sgo kaḥ/ /kṛ su yang slong ba por ma gyur/ /nor des 'byor tshogs sdig pa can/ /bram ze dz+dza tshu ka de yang / /bdag tasnaḥswa pra bhā bād+me sadza di t+ya bh+ya jo dz+dza ā+oṃ/ /bi shwan+ta raḥs e bā haṃ gi rang mthus phun tshogs zhes/ /skye bo dag la mngon par smras⑩/ /thams cad sgrol de nga nyid de/ /95—322

de ba dat+taḥs tsa dī dzaḥ/ /uste ti tsa kra bha ga bākhyi khyu rjan+d+ra na de sha gnyis skyes de yang lhas byen no/ /dge slong rnams la bcom ldan gyis/ /'di gsungs sbyin pa bstan pa rmā—/ /ā lo ba na shwa bh+ra sha tā ba sā te gho rān+dha kā re su tsi ra pra kā shaḥ/ /mdzad—/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten pha rol mi rnams gnyen/ /g.yang sa brgyar ①ni kun tu lhungs pa'i ② rten//ā shā sa dz+wa duḥs ha duḥkha kā le dā — na rā bhā pa ra lo ka ban+tuḥ/ /'jigs rung mun par yun ring rab tu gsal/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal dus su dbugs 'byin no/ /i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi rā tsi tā yo bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing yī bi shwan+ta rā ba dā nan+d+ra ma tsa tudz+re shaḥpal+la waḥ// //las thams cad sgol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste nyi shu rtsa ②bzhi pa'o// //ta pa ti sa ka la lo kā lo ka sa nā ya bhā nuḥpa ra ma ma mṛ ta bṛbye mtha' dag 'jig rten snang ba spro slad nyi ma 'od zer ④'gyed/ /bdud rtsi'i char mchog dbab slad pūṇ+ḍi ta me ti tsan+d+raḥ/ /i ya ti dza ga ti pū rdzu dzad+ma kṛ ṭ+wā ti kash+yibyi pu zla ba rdzogs pa nyid du 'gro/ /sems can bsgral ba'i slad du dge ba'i zam stegs chen po ni/ /kha cig la ku sha la se tuḥs twa san+ta ra shā ya/ /pu rā shusgo da naḥshrī mān rā dza shākya 'di snyed 'gro bar bsngags par 'os pa'i skye ba 'dzin/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag tu sngon/ /rgyal po dpal bu re bha bta/ /ya sha sha shāṅka dza na kaḥsu dh+wa si n+t+ra ri bā pa raḥ/ /ldan zas gtsang byung / /grags pa'i ⑤ri bong can bskyed pa/ /bdud rtsi'i chu gter gzhan pa bzhin//kha la saghā swa bhā be na lasmre ru ṇi ga zladz+re tā/ /ābyar+ya kā ri ṇa ye ngo bos mi bsrun dhil chags dpal⑦/ /ngo mtshar byed pa su zhig gis/ /yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs la na kṛ tā sa t+pa k+ṣa pā ti bhā / / a t+yā pya khi la di spyu rja ba na gtad—/ /dam pa'i phyogs su lhung ⑧bar byas/ /da lta'ang ma lus phyogs dang ngogs/ /nags ⑨su 95—323

sastem+bi be+e ke bheḥ/ /ya sho bheḥsho tsi bhār+ya gya mu ni bra ta mi bo bye te/ /chags shing dben ldan pa/ /gang gi grags pa rnam dag pas/ /thub pa'i brtul zhugs blangs pa bzhin//snga ma haṃ budha mā te ti pu rā pra ṇi bye taḥki laḥ/ /bi shwa kadz+re su ta sangs rgyas ma ru bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam sngon btab pas①/ /dri med mdzes par mi yul martu mā dza gā mā ma lad+ku tiḥ/ /tīrtiḥsadru ru ṣa su ba ta s+thā bhūt+pal+la bhā pa re/ /'ongs—/ /bi shwa karma'i bu mo lo/ /skyes bu dam pa'i grags pa bzhin/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul che zhes pa/ /ma hā mā yā bye dha de bī tsan+d+ra phye ba ku mud+ma tī/ /sā pa sh+yan+d+rarnyi ā+oṃ shwe tai swa bhe de yi yid 'ong mchog tu byur/ /zla ba'i ku mud ldan pa bzhin/ /de yi 'urmi lam dku nang na/ /glang po ku k+ṣiṃ be+e hā yā sā/ /ga ti mā ro ha na shi lo pra ṇa tiñtsa ma hā dza nata/ /a dkar dang mkha' la 'gro/ /ri bo 'dzeg dang skye bo ni/ /chen pos rab tu 'dud pa mthong / /skabs tān+ta re bo dhi satwa stu ṣi te tri da shā la yāta/ /gar+ghaṃ ta sngaḥs mā pa de der byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /rang nyid 'jig rten la brtsi bas/ /dga' ldan lha yi gnas dag las/ /swa yo lo kā nu kadza yā/ /ba haṭī bo dhi satwo sā gar+bha byu ba na nan+da rgo/ /de yi lhums su yang dag byon/ /'jig rten dga' byed byang chub sems/ /de yis lhums su bzung ba ni//in+d+ra dud+dhā bi be+e le ba ba byu ba pāṇ+ḍa ra dru tiḥ/ /i1 ku rā dza baṃ bye 'o mtsho'i rlabs kyi 1zla ba bzhin/ /dkar ba'i 'od dang ldan par gyur/ /bu ram shing skyes rgyal po'i na te na ga r+sā sbi te na sā/ /bhurnyi dha na ba tī bā bhūr+bha bya la brgyud④—/ /de ni lhums na gnas pas ṭ+wāde/ /gter dang ldan pa'i sa gzhi bzhin/ /dge ba'i mtshan k+ṣa ṇa lak+ṣi tī/ /ba bhu ba do ha dasta snga dā na pu rgya ma yo da yaḥ/ /e ku re nyid kyis mtshon gyur/ /de yi sred pa byung gyur pa/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams rang bzhin skyes/ /sa ha ka su bi saṃ bā di sa ha kā ra su sau ra sgo/ /a tha kā le na saṃ puṇ+ḍi sā lum+bi ni ra'i dri bzang ni/ /sol ba la yang slu du ba min/ /de nas dus kyis yang dag rdzogs/ /lum+bi ni yi 95—324

ba ṣ+pesbi tā/ /a sru ta ta na yan+de bī di bā ka ra mi bā di tiḥ/ /mā turgar+bha ma nags gnas pa'i/ /lha mo de la sras bltams te/ /a stidi ti las 2 nyin byed bzhin/ /ma yi mngal byi lā smṛṣ+ṭi kuk+ṣiṃ bhi tā sa nirga taḥ/ /tāñtsa kre tha swa bhā be na swa sde dri ma yis/ /ma reg de yi spyodaku brtol byung ④/ /de nas de yi 'urang bzhin gyis/ /gdung 'ubral gi bi ga ta bye tsā/ /nirga ts+tsharje ba rurnyo sau ba la dzi dzñā sa yā k+ṣa khaṃ/ /sha lus ni rnal gnas gyur/ /phyir byung nyid na brgya byin gyis/ /stobs shes 'dod nas skad cig ni/ /rdo kre ṇa badz+ra sā dzā gasta sde shākya twa mā ya yo/ /dzā tā mā traḥshi shurga tā swa yo rje snying po'i sku de bzung / /de ni nus med nyid du gyur/ /bltams pa tsam gyis khye'u de/ /rang gi ⑦sap+ta pa dā ni saḥ/ /di sha bi lo ka yan+d+ra tse su byagh+ra k+ṣa ra yā gi rā/ /gom pa bdun phyin nas/ /yi ge rab gsal tshig gis ni/ /phyogs su rnam par gzigs shing smras/ /i yo me nidṛt+taḥbyud+dhā ma ti lo ke 6 dak+ṣi shāḥ/ /ba— mā dzā ti ra bye 'di ni bdag gi myang 'das shar/ /'jig rten blo gros rjes mthun lho/ /'di yang skye ba'i mtha' dang ṣā saṃ sā rā di ya mut+ta rā/ /e ti ta gya bru bā ṇa gya thra thi bī sa ma kaspa ta/ /nub—/ /'di ni 'khor ba dag las byang / /de skad de yis brjod pa na/ /sa ni kun tu 'dar gyur te//ta ma sa k+ṣa ba lam̐ dh+waskyo ma shaste ba dza gaṅga dṛ/ /ij-i ta su ya shaḥshu rja 'gro ba'i bla ma mi zad ④stobs/ /de ni ⑨gzung bar ma ⑫/nus bzhin/ /mkha' yi chu rgyun gyis bgrus pa/ /satwa sme ram̐ sa tsā ma re/ /byo mās+thā dh+wa ra sgo ta gya dza kṛ hustatra de de yi grags pa dkar /⑪ba'i gdugs/ /snying stobs 'dzum pa'i rnga yab bcas/ /der ni lha rnams dag ba tāḥ/ /a smin+da ba sa re bṛṣ+ṭaḥswaḥgre ye ṇa se tā bhe dhaḥ/ /na ra de na pra dzñā dṛṭī gis bzung / /skabs der nag po zhes pa yi/ /thub pa kiṣ+ṭi de yi rir/ /gnas la tsha bo mi sbyin gyis//kiskon+dha dṛspri to mu niḥ/ /ka s+thā darga sha tā lo ka i bā lo ke pra dṛ sh+ya 'od zer mthong nas rab tu dris/ /phug dang khang par bcas pa'i ri/ /gang gi ⑫mun pas dbul byed 95—325

te—/ /ta mo da ri dru ye ṣ+pe ti gi ra yaḥs gu ha kṛ hāḥ/ /bisma yā di ti te pa—/ /nyi ma brgya yi snang ba bzhin/ /snang ba mthong ba gang las lags/ /ya mtshan las des de skad nok+taḥso ba daji bya lo tsa naḥ/ /dzā ta pu sgyu ba bhā so yo bo dhi satwa gya brjod—/ /lha yi spyan ldan des smras pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skye ba la/ /bsod nams snang ba 'di dzad+ma ni/ /a tsi re ṇi ba tai bat+pa dragh+ra baḥku sha khāp+ta ye/ /i kyughā mu ni rā dag skyes/ /mnyes gshin mi ring nyid na de/ /dge ba'i slad du 'u cag blta/ /zhes brjod thub pa kun nan+da bi shārnyi su khaṃ topho bha ba ta / /pu tra dzad+ma ni sad+dhārja sidhi dga' zhing / /ngal bsos bde ba nyid du gyur①/ /sras bltams don kun mchog tu ni/ /grub pa zas shuzlo da naḥpe dzā/ /dṛṭī sabyerja sesgo ya mi ti nā mā su nin+d+ra me/ /gtsang gis mthong nas/ /'di ni don kun grub pa zhes/ /de yi mtshan yang btags par gyur/ /shākya bar+bha na nā mā byud+mak+ṣaḥshākya pu rā shra yaḥ/ /yat+tha shā me na shākyā rmā shi gnod sbyin shākya 'phel zhes pa/ /shākya'i grong khyer dag na gnas/ /gang la btud pas shākya yi/ /byis sha bo ni ru pa dra bāḥ/ /taje t+yā pra ṣi tai pi tā pra rja mā ya sa gu he kaḥ/ /pa nyer 'tshe med par 'gyur/ /lugs des yab kyis buphyag 'tshal ba'i/ /slad du gtang chatshe gsang ba pa/ /two bo bye satwa mā lo kya ni pā pa tā gya pā da yoḥ/ /a tho྾ ge sa mā da de yis byang chub sems dpa' de/ /mthong nas de yi zhabs la gtugs④/ /de nas sa bdag dgyes pa ya z-iṣ+ṭa ste thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /lak+ṣa rja ni ni mit+ta dzhai sta su de he bya yis—/ /de ni pang ⑤du blangs byas nas/ /de yi lus la mtshan rnams ni/ /mtshan mkhan dag gis lo ka yata/ /lak+ṣa ṇa dzñāsta taḥsabye dṛ pa rū tsaḥs bisma yāḥ/ /de ba rab tu bltas/ /de nas mtshan shes ya mtshan ldan/ /kun gyis mi bdag la smras pa/ /lha gcig ④di bya ku mā rolhayo lak+ṣa ṇi ru pa lak+ṣa te/ /dzā ya te lak+ṣa ṇi re tai gzhon nu mchog 'di ni/ /mtshan rnams dag gis nye bar mtshon/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag rnams kyis ni//95—326

bi shwa bi shān+ta shā sa na ཿ / / sha krā dhi pa byakra ba rte bha ga bān+d+ra 'khor los sgyur ba brgya byin bdag /thams cad ngal gso'i hu7skal ldan nam/ /bcom ldan de bzhin ta thā ga taḥ/ /dīspyoṅga li da lo tsakra dze+e ts+tsha kau su pra tiṣ+ṭha to/ /gshegs par 'gyur④/ /'di yi zhabs ④gnyis rab tu mdzes/ /dmar zhing pad+ma lta bur mnyen/ /a ru rto tsa ra khye ba khya kārnyo ka ma la ko ma lo/ /rā dza haṃ saṃ i sor mo'i 'dab ring 'khor lo yis/ /mtshan zhing ④legs par rab tu gnas/ /mtho ⑤zhing ngang pa'i ba shrī shu sa dzā lāṅga li pal+la baḥ/ /e ṇ+ḍi dz+wa nu yu gaḥshrī mā nā rgyal po bzhin/ /sor mo'i yal 'dab dra bar ldan/ /dpal ldan e ṣ+pe'i ⑥byen pa zung / /pus mo'i nu ju dza bhu ṣi taḥ/ /sa ko sha hasnyi gu khyabya n+ya gro dha pa ri maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /dak+ṣi bar du phyag gis brgyan/ /gsang ba sbubs bcas glang po bzhin/ /n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /g.yas ṇa brta ro maṅkaḥpa ri shā ha sa mon+da tiḥ/ /ra dzo ma la la bā smṛṣ+ṭa su 'khyil ba'i spu yis mtshan/ /rgya khyon dag dang mtshungs par snang ⑦/ /rdul dang dri ma'i chas ma reg /stap+ta rdzu byu na da byu tiḥ/ /hasta pā dzā sha kākhye gra spaṣ+ṭa sap+ta ts+tsha dā 'dzasru chu bo btso ma'i 'od/ /phyag zhabs phrag so mgrin pa'i mchog /rab gsal 'dab ma bdun pa'i kṛ tiḥ/ /sau ha pūrjadhe kā yabya dṛ hat+tha ṭ+wāṅga bi gra haḥ/ /tsa tā rī shat+padabyibs| /sku stod skedag kyang seng ge 'dra/ /lus kyi yan lag che zhing gsal/ /tshems ni bzhi bcu ma gre ta sap+ta dan+ta su nā si kaḥ/ / dīsgo pra ta nu dzi hwa : me mnyam zhing dkar/ /bar mtshams med cing shangs dag mdzes/ /ljags kyang ring zhing srab pa ste/ /gha dun+d+ra bhi ni sra naḥ/ /a bhi bhā lāk+ṣa go pahūṃ sa ha dzoṭī ṣa masta kaḥ/ /si 'brug dang rnga yi sgra lta bu/ /spyan mthing rdzi ma ba yi 'dra/ /gtsug tor lhan cig skyes pa'i dbu/ /dbu to:ṅka su ju bhā gaḥswasnyi ko raḥs+tha lodz+dza la/ /le khā shri bāñdza hasto yo ni gdugs dbyibs byis pa 'di/ /mdzod spu dkar mdzes smin char mtshan/ /thugs kar bkra shis rab 95—327

tsakra baṭīshrīḥpha lo rje ṣām+bi na shwa rāta/ /a gya bo bye pra bhā te na saṃ sgyur ba'i dpal du brjod/ /'bras bu 'di dag bslu ba med/ /'di yis ①/byang chub snga dro yis/ /budhe khya mu khām+bu dze+e/ /dha n+yaḥpad+mā ka ra su ba ṣ+pe tra pā ṭī ka ri 6 rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i chu skyes zhal du / /pad+ma'i 'byung gnas dag gi 1bzhin/ /skal ldan mig gi snod du ti—/ /bi bud+dhāḥshudha satwa su bo bye dusgo ma ho da dheḥ/ /dha t+yā bā ga mṛ ta snga su gyur④—/ /byang chub 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /snying stobs dag pa 'di yi ni/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi mkhas pa bha bi 6 h+phu pa dz+re bi naḥ/ /pu ju bhā dzi dza gad+ma smarja ka e bāsmi dag /skal ldan rnams kyi nyer 'tshor 'gyur/ /gang gi dus ni yongs rdzogs pas/ /'di ni mthong ba pañtsi taḥ/ /e tata saṃ dar+sha ā+oṃ ya gya pūṇ+ḍi kā la gya durla r+bha/ /i tru ghā rnyed dka' ba/ /bdag nyid gcig pu 'gro ba ni/ /bsod nams ldan pa 'di na bslus/ /zhes smras mi dṛ pa mā sgyu ga tā byo : ta po ba rna/ /su pra pan+da ma naḥkṛ tā de bdag la spran nas/ /mkha' las dka' thub nags song ste/ /yid ni rab tu dang byas nas/ /lus ha t+yā ga ma tsin+ta yata/ /sa par+yadho pa de shā ya nā ra de nā bhi tso di taḥ/ /ni rab tu gtang bar bsamadu/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i man ngag ni/ /mi sbyin dag gis mngon par zhus/ /ta mu bā tsā mṛ tai bat+pa ku mā ra ka tha yi 6 ti/ /a bye ga myu mṛ tai tas+thāta de yis de la smras pa bu/ /bdud rtsi gzhon nus ⑥ ston par 'gyur/ /rgyal sras de las bdud rtsi ni/ /dṛ pa sru no ra nā ma yaḥ/ /ta ri 6 se bha r+pā sgo bye mi rkyughā ta nu ma rtogs nas nad dang bral ba khyod/ /'khor ba'i chu gter las sgol 'gyur/ /zhes pa smras te khyelus t+ya byeta/ /sha rī ra saṅgi yī ta su kṛ tā pa pa di nā ra daḥ/ /ya yo bā rā ṇa sī btang gyur/ /mi sbyin gyis ni 'phral la de'i/ /lus kyis rjolegs par bya ba byas/ / ka t+yā skyeya na zhes se: la bha kā t+yā ya nā bhi dhaḥ/ /brta mā naḥku mā ro tha sadze+e bibyā thob nas/ /grub be+ed wa ra ṇa sīr ⑪song / /de nas gzhon nu skyed ⑫bsrings shing / /rig kun legs 95—329

su bā ra gaḥ/ /li bi pra bī rto3bhe na r+pā li pi zwa1 nin+d+ra me/ /nā gā yu ta par pha rol phyin/ /yi ge mkhas pas tshangs pa yi/ /yi ge mngon gsar ①rnam par sprul/ /glang chen khri sa ma pā ṇi ta smin dza ga ti bi khru te/ /bai sha li kaiḥthra yā yā smi pre ṣi yi stobs mtshungs par/ /de ni 'gro la ①grags pa'i tshe/ /yangs pa can pas dga' ba'i sbad/ /de la to man+ta kuñdza raḥ/ /bha bi 6 nyi tsakra badhi tāt+ta gya pāp+ta mu pa yarna/ /glang chen myos pa bsrings/ /'byung 'gyur 'khor los sgyur ba'i phyir/ /de la skyes bu ①'ongs pa yis④/ /de ba dat+taḥpa ri dī ṣār+ghaṃ dza ghā na ma hā ga dze+e/ /sgo lta tsa kar+ṣa dī rda ta glang po che de lha sbyin ⑤gyis/ /yongs su sdang ba dag gis bsad/ /so gnyis rab tu lhung ba de/ /nan+daḥsabe+e ba dā bhā tai/ /ku mā rastu ta duspyo su pā kā rād+ma nyi ra k+ṣi pata/ /dga' bos gom pa bdun du khyer/ /gzhon nu yis kyang de blangs nas/ /ra ba dag las phyi rol 'phangs/ /e ka nā ra tsa ni sgon+da sabe+e tā la ma tī ta laḥ/ /ts+tsha r+ya bhe byā n+t+ra shā ste 6 ta la bdun dang sa yi gzhi/ /mda' gcig gis ni nges par phug /gcod 'bigs mtshon dang bstan sa e bā ti sha yo ya yo/ / ta tastu tī gu rde pasna rā dza sru nur+ya bcos la/ /de nyid phul du phyin par gyur/ /de nas btsun mo yon tan mtshungs/ /grags 'dzin ma ni sho dha rī/ /a bā sa bi shu tai lo ke shudhe shī la i bon+da 1/ /rgyal sras kyidu/ /dag pa'i khrims bzhin 'jig rten na/ /grags pas ④mtho ba blangs par gyur/ /a tān+ta re ma hā bā ta bibyu taḥsap+ta yo dza naḥ/ /sa raza bā ha saṃ ro dhe skabs der ④rlung ni chen po yis/ /shin tu che ba'i ljon pa ni/ /dpag tshad bdun pa rnam par babyel/ /bi dhe bi su la dru maḥ/ /sā s+thā ra ta ru saṃ ru dh+wa ro hi kā nā ma mu ni mṛ gā/ /chu bo'i srol ni 'gags par byas/ /thur bgrod ro nyi ka zhes pa/ /de ni shing chen gyis bkag pas/ /shī la bhaṣ+ṭi pa ba ni tā pra ya yo pra ti lo ma tsā/ /rā dza pu tra sta muspyo pya ngang tshul nyams pa'i bud med bzhin/ /rgyun las rab tu bzlog ste song / /rgyal po'i sras kyis ljon pa de/ /95—330

khā la bā ku leḥ/ /naṭ+wā dṛbye kṛ shaḥkā yaḥshastirlup+ta ha tā shu tiḥ/ /'di ni smad ①par byed/ /lta byed nyams shing lus po rid/ /stobs ni zhum zhing ①thos pa nyams/ /ta thā pi mo hādṛbye ba bṛdhe gya ta ru bhā pri yā/ /dhaste dha ba la hūṃ brid+dhāḥ'on kyang rmongs las rgan po ni①/ /gzhon nu ma yis mdzes par mthong / /dkar po 'di nyid rngusmad pa ki rnge tā ma ti garte tsā/ /lo khā pa ram̐ bi rak+ta pi yar+ya snga ti bri ya nyid—/ /yin yang rgan po ci ste 'dzin/ /mchog tu g.yo zhing chags bral yang / /gang 'di lus la shin ta nuḥ/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tasta su nirbe daḥs ma dzā ya ta/ /ma n+ya mā na tu phangs/ /de ltar bsams shing lus dag ni/ /rgud pa rnams kyi tshogs gyur cing / /gnod pa dang gya sa pā yi kā ya ni tsa ya mā pa dzā/ /pu na: sa ma yephon+yasmi nar+sha bcas dgongs gyur pa/ /de yi thugs yid byung bar gyur/ /slar yang dus gzhan dag na des/ /rnam pa sh+yadh+yā dhi tai na ram̐/ /be+e pa kwa ku ṇa pa pā yo sa pū ya mi ba pāṇ+ḍa re/ /par gyur pa'i ro 'dra ba/ /gnag ⑤dang bcas pa skya ⑥bo bzhin/ /nad kyis thebs pa'i mi zhig mthong / /sa pra dharmyo ta mā lo kya sa mudhi byu ni dzān+ta rnu/ /a ho nu sa ha dze+e de yis de mthong rang nyid kyis⑦ / /lus la dmigs te rab bsams pa/ /kye ma lus 'dir nad kyi bāsmiṅgā ye ro ga ga r+ṇaṅga tiḥ/ /i da me ba ma hañtsi tram̐ḥmi yarja sa ma tshogs—/ /lhan skyes kho nar rab tu 'byung / /sha yi rang bzhin lus po 'di/ /dman pa yin yang skad yī ta nuḥ/ /nā yā ti kle da bai kla k+ṣa ma ṇa ma parlu ṣi te bi yata/ /i ticig gang / /nur zhing 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ba/ /'di nyid ya mtshan shin tu che/ /'di bsams spye ta sobye gaḥsha rī ra bi tsi kit+pa yā/ /ba bhū ba rā bye sasto ga rā ge thugs ni byung ba ste/ /lus la the tshom zhugs pa yis/ /rgyal srid longs spyod chags pa la/ /gus pa be+e ga li tā da raḥ/ /a thā smispyo ṇi mā l+ya baspyo tshwa di ta bi gra haṃ/ /dag dang bral bar gyur/ /de nas dus der phreng ba dang / /gos kyis g.yogs par gyur pa'i lus/ /95—333

da dar+sha deha sad+ku ra bya gra ban dhu dza rna sha baṃ/ /tai dṛṣ+ṭa sa ha sobye ga da lus kyi bya bas gnyen 'dun gyi/ /skye bo 'khrugs pa'i ro zhig mthong / /de mthong 'phral la chags bral yā duḥkhā 1 shā ku laḥ/ / tsi ram̐ niḥ sā ra saṃ sā ra pa ri hā ra zhing / /brtsa ①ba sdug bsngal smod ①pas 'khrugs/ /'khor ba snying po med pa ni/ /yongs su gtang ①ma tsin+ta yata/ /e ṣa pre ta ba rna yā ti saṃ sas+t+ri z-i da ye ba han/ /dīr+ghaṃ bar yun ring bsams/ /las kyi rang bzhin lta bu yidu/ /phreng ba snying la reg par bzung / /ring du pras+thā ṣ+pe yā tā yī mā dze+e kan+d+ra mā yi mi ba/ /a ho nu bi ṣa yā sgyu sa bi 'gro bar chas gyur pa/ /'di ni yi dwags gnas su 'gro/ /kye ma yul la goms par ni/ /rtse dga' lā sa bya pā yi rmā/ /dṛ nā ma n+yak+ṣa ṇi kaṭ+wā kājo sā kha ṇa tu l+ya tā/ /dag la brtson pa yis⑤/ /mi rnams dus mthar 'o brgyal ⑥bas/ /shing dang rdo ba mtshungs pa nyid/ /ubye ga bā ri bha ba sā ga ra bubyu de smiṅgā lā ni lā ku li ta kan+d+ra la skyes bu rnams lus srid mtsho'i sdug bsngal chu yi chu bur dang / /dus rlung gis bskyod las kyi 'khri shing rtse tā gra pu྾/ /mā yā ba dhu na ya na bi bh+ra ma saṃ bi bhā ge sum̐ rmā ka e ṣa ba pu ṣi yi me tog dang / /sgyu ma'i bud med mig ni rnam par g.yo ba dag gi cha/ /'di la brtan pa nyid du mngon dz+re rā bhi mā nāḥ/ /nolte ki tsita pa ra hi ta yu tai na shu tai dhan+d+ra yuk+ṇi be+e par khengs pa 'di ni ci/ /gzhan la phan par ldan pa cung zad ma brjod rigs pa'i chos ma thos/ /dge ba s+thā taḥku sha la ku su oṃ sa t+ya rū pan+da dṛṣ+ṭi/ /ṣ+pe ba spyoṣ+ṭi sha ma pa ba'i me tog bsnams pa nyid min bden pa yi ni tshul ma mthong / /zhi ba'i gnas la reg pa min zhes da mi ti byak+ta mā sak+ta tsin+ta bi shādho yam̐ ba ha ti sa ha sā bai shā la two ga gsal bar bsams ⑦pa la chags shing / /ngal bsos ⑧srog song 'di ni 'phral la g.yo ba med nyid 'dzin tā yuḥ/ /rā dzā sru num+bi dzibye ti sha rī ra bi sa rā ru tai/ /a she ṣa bi ṣa yā saṃ par gyur⑨/ /de ltar rgyal po'i bu yis ni/ /lus ni mi brtan pa nyid bsams/ /ma lus yul la chags 95—334

ge pa re niḥdze+e ha hūṃ ya yo/ /a thā gre nin+d+ra ta de baiḥs shud+dhā bā sa kā pa yi/ /mdza' ba mchog tu med par gyur/ /de nas mdun du gtsang ma yi/ /ris kyi lha rnams kyis yi kaiḥ/ /bya lo ka yan+d+ra bra dzi tai pā tra kā ṣā ya dh+wa ri khaṃ/ /tai dṛbye ba bā bhū ba su sprul pa/ /lhung bzed ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ /rab tu byung ba mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong nyid na de pra bra dzñā bhi mu khā+e ma tiḥ / /idz+re tā lo ka na dī t+yā swa bhā bo yi blo/ /rab tu byung la mngon phyogs ①gyur/ /gang phyir 'dod pa mthong ba ni/ /dga' bas rang hi bi bhā bya te/ /bai rā gya kā ra ṇa ta tra dṛ pa su noḥpa de pa de/ /bzhin rgyas par gyur④/ /gnas dang gnas der rgyal po'i sras/ /'dod chags bral 'gyur rgyu rnams ni/ /bi lo kya sā ra thiḥsabye k+ṣi ti pā ya n+ya be+e da yata/ /ku mā ro tha bi tu bā kyād+mā mthong ba thams cad kha lo pas/ /sa yi bdag po dag la bshad/ /de nas yab kyi tshig gi ①ni/ /mā lo ka na ko tu tī/ /bra dzaza thi ni dh+wa nā ni bi bṛ tā ni bya lo ka gzhon nu grong gzigs dge mtshan la/ /'gro bas lam du gter rnams ni/ /sna tshogs bzhag pa mthong yata—/ /tadhūt+tha pu ru ṣa n+ya steḥ: ka ro྾ to pe tā ni/ /ya dā sa bar gyur/ /skyes bus ④sngon bkod bud med kyi/ /lag pas bton nas nye bar gnas/ /gang tshe de na grwa tīt+ta ni ta dā bi bi shu ram̐ shu dhim/ /ta taḥs kaste kā na r+pā shu byā pū pa ra yis ma blangs pa/ /de tshe chu yi gter du zhugs/ / de nas de yi zhing pa rnams/ /mgor ⑤skyes rdul shi ro tu hān/ /bi dīṇ+ḍi pā ṇi tsa ra rjan gruta pi pā sha shā mā tu rān/ /ha lo kubyā byis gos shing skya/ /lag pa rkang pa rnam par gas/ /bkres dang skom pa ngal bas gzir/ /thong pa mi la bi ṣa mol+le kha pak+ṣa bra ’rdi tān/ /bi lokya gre sha bi ba shan bzad 'jor dag gis/ /rko 'brud phyogs ni rma yis nyen/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur mthong gyur nas/ /ba byu ba ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /bi ṅgā sa da ya yā te ྾ dra be+e ṇi ra da ri dra tsā/ /snying rje rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /brtse bas de dag nor rnams kyis/ /dbul po nyid ni min par bsgrubs/ /95—335

sa bṛ ṣā rde bṛṣa ta bhā ra taḥkle sha mut+ta ma kā ra yata/ /ta taḥpra ti ni bsod nams dgyes des glang bu rnams/ /nyon mongs ①dag las grol bar byas/ /de nas rgyal sras rjes bṛsto tha sā nu gaḥpādz+re bād+ma dzaḥ/ /ma dh+yā t+na pri thu san+d+ra pe ta ra rto ta ra ṇi 'brang bcas/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer rab rgyas pa/ /nyin gung tshad pa chen po'i tshe/ /de nas ②phyir ni log tī ṣaḥ/ /ra tha gho khorlu kha shi khi sh+ya mi kṛ ta di shī ta raḥ/ /swe da pā ri par gyur/ /shing rta'i sgra yis gtsug phud can/ /gyen phyogs phyogs na sngon por byas/ /rngul gyi chu yi ka shā shīṇ+ḍiḥpā bha snak+tab na sba lo/ /so ba ru hra ra thāt+ta tra gaṇ+ḍabe+e zigs rgyas pas/ /nags tshal gzhi ni baṅgal bar sleb/ /der ni shing rta las babs nas/ /snyan par li ta kuṇ+ḍa laḥ/ /be+e shādh+ri bi khru ta ya shā dze+e pūsgo yā ma shi shri yata/ /grags shing rna rgyan ni/ /rnam par 'phyang des ngal gso'i slad/ /'dzam bu'i ①grib ma bsten par gyur/ /sa ba bhā ro ra si byas+t+ri swe dzā bu ka ṇa saṃ ta ti/ /pa ra sā bye kha la li tsā de yi ④rngul gyi chu thigs rgyun/ /gsal ba snying gar ⑤'dzin pa dag /do shal dag gi dhi'abrel pa ni/ /hā ra gya ba ku chem+bi m+bim/ /sgo yā su pa ri dṛt+ta su sha na kaiḥsazla sā chags ldan sbyar bas mdzes pa bzhin/ /rim gyis shing rnams thams cad kyi/ /grib ma yongs su gyur khi dzā/ /ta gya dzam+bu ta rusgo yā na tsa tsā la ta nusta noḥ/ /sā ta su shī ta lasgo yā pa'i tshe/ /de yi ⑦ sku las 'dzam bu 'a3yi/ /grib ma chung ngu g.yos ma gyur/ /de yi grib ma bsil ba des/ /tā pa krān+ta ma bā ra yata/ /saṃ sā ra bi ra ta gye ba tī bra bai rā gya gdung bas nyen pa rab tu bzlog /chags bral drag po'i bag chags kyis/ /'khor bar ⑨dga' bral pa sa nā/ /pu tra dar+sha na soṅkaṇ+ḍa stan+de sha ma tha khyu pa tiḥ/ /ā dza gā dag gi bzhin/ /da tu 3nas sa bdag phyogs de ru/ /sras ni gzigs par bzhed ldan pas/ /glang po che ma ga dzot+par+bha tra bh+ra ma ra gra sta tsā ma raḥ/ /sgo yo sa ni : laspyi ṭī ku mā ra la bung ba ni/ /rab 'dus rnga yab 'khrug cing 'ongs/ /gzhon nu'i mthu las grib ma ni/ /g.yo ba med 95—336

mya pra bhā ba taḥ/ /go ra bābye ta saṃ pābe+eḥpra ṇa tai pra ṇa nā ma nyi/ /pa des ①mthong nas/ /gus pas ①rmad byung yang dag thob/ /rab tu btud nas der phyag 'tshal/ /ta taḥs sa nyi taḥbi tā na ga ra ge tu mud+ma taḥ/ /a pa sh+yah+phu ra par+yarnye de nas yab dang lhan cig de/ /grong khyer 'gro bar brtson pa de④/ /grong khyer mtha' yi dur khrod ni/ /shā ni sha ba saṃ ku lo/ /sa dṛṭī ku ṇa pā tīṇ+ḍi ma shi baṃ shi ba kā na lda/ /ro yis yongs su gang ba mthong / /zhi ba'i nags ni mi shis pa/ /ro yis khengs mthong chags bral can/ /sobye gaḥsā ra thi pā hasba gi ta gyan+da rgo k+ṣa ṇi/ /sā ra the pa sh+ya dze+e tū dzā de yi ④skad cig shing rta ni/ /bzung nas kha lo sgyur la smras/ /kha lo pa ltos srog chags kyis ⑤/ /kā yā pā ya ma yīn+da shaṃ/ /dṛṣ+ṭi da ma pi rā gādz+re ma nā mo ha gnod pa'i rang bzhin lus kyi skabs/ /rmongs pas bag med rnams kyi yidakhye7/ /'di ltar mthong yang pra mā dī rmā/ /pa ra sdi dar+sha nā tre bye ṣ+pe tra mā swā r+ya sā ra ram̐/ /a chags pas brlan/ /gzhan gyi bud med bltas ma ngoms/ /mig ni gus dang bcas par myang ⑦/ /'di gya sat+ya ba tī dzi hā pa sh+ya kā ko na kṛ 6 te/ /a suḥsta na mu kha n+ya sta na yi bden ⑤ldan min pa'i lce/ /bya rog gis ni gcod la ltos/ /'di yi nu ma'i steng du ni/ /sen ⑨ khopre kha su khasbri tiḥ / /khaṇ+ḍa ya t+ya dha ram̐ kṛ dh+raḥkā m+bi ba ma da dmugs dgod spyocing bde bar gnas/ /'dod pas rgyas pa'i bya rgod kyis/ /mchu gcod 'dod ldan ni r+bha raḥ/ /e te dṛṣ+ṭa ni ṣak+ta bā ya sa shra kṛ na nispyu bi naḥdag gis bzhin/ /rkang 'thung 'di dag g.yo ba'i bya rog chags pa'i phyi 4spebs sgyug cing brgyal ba dang / /pā da pā muts+tshaṭī ba pi pā ka pū ya ku na pā s+thā ṇi na niḥkyu ṇi tāḥ/ /dṛṭī kṛ bh+ra rnam par gyur cing rnags pa'i ro yi dri ngas nges par sgra ngan sgogs pa bzhin/ /lan cig ma yin bya rgod bi dār+ya mā ṇa ma sha kṛd+kuṇ+ḍidz+ra tarja sha baṃ bar+ghaṃ bā ta bi lol+la pabe+e ba ka kyis 'joms rlan ⑫ldan rgyu ma gzags /stepa'i ro mthong nas/ /rlung gis rnam par bskyod pa'i yal 'dab 95—337
