n+yaḥka ra bā la la tā i ba/ /dgra rnams yid la re ba yin/ /mu tig gsal bar dgod rjobyed pa/ /rgyal po'i phun tshogs nga rgyal can//t+yaghā na pu na rā yarnyi mā ni byo dṛ pa saspa daḥ/ /i kyusto gya sa kṛta pi tā btang nas ⑥be+er yang mi 'ong ste/ /ral gri dag gis 'khri shing bzhin/ /pha yis lan mang de brngod kyang //nibya yan+da tsa tsā la saḥ/ /badz+ra rat+na shi khā kalpaḥsaṃ kaspo hi ma hāt+pa dzā/ /de ni nges pa las ma ④g.yos/ /bdag nyid chen po'i brtan pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen ⑧rtse mo mtshungs/ /dza na nī bhi ra mā h+ye: ban+tu po ra ma hat+ta moḥ/ /sa pābe+e to gya bhūd+mo m+bi ma dang blon po rnams dang ni/ /gnyen dang grong pa che rnams kyis/ /gsol ba btab kyang nyin gsum de/ /ni rā hā ro di na tra yo/ /rā dza sgo gī ta pa sī bā dz+re ba te ṣani dzats+tsha yā/ /zas dang smra ba med par gyur/ /rgyal por spyod dam dka' thub can/ /'di ni rang gi 'dun pas 'tsho /kā mā nu baṭī lo ko ya mi sgo tsuḥs tsi bā dṛ baṃ/ /sa ka thañtsi da nu dzñā taḥ'ajig rten 'di ni 'dod rjes 'jug /ces pa blon pos rgyal la smras/ /mchi ma dang bcas sa skyong gis/ /sā khru ṣ+pe tre ṇa bhū bhu dzā/ /ya yo po ra dza nā kran+da mo be+e mu ni ta po ba ji zhig ltar stes ⑨gnang nas desalku/ /mi smra grong khyer ba rnams ngu / /thub pa'i dka' thub nags su rgo—/ /be+e rā gya pa ri pā ke na ta tra mi tri pa be+e tra tsā/ /bha dze sa song / /chags bral yongs su byun pa yis/ /der ni sems can thams cad la/ /byams pas ⑪dag sadze+e sa two 6 bi be+e ka da yi hūṃ da yī/ /ba bhū bu stata pra bhā be na ta pra sadze+e byas brtse ba dag /dben pa'i grogs su de yis bsten/ /de yi mthu yis de dag tu/ /nags na gnas 95—386

ba no ka sī/ /dzā ti bai rā nā la t+ya gshī ta khāsh+yit+ta bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /taste pa thams cad kyis①/ /rang bzhin khon gyi me spangs nas/ /sems kyi spyod tshul baṅgal bar gyur/ /ri pā ṇi ba dh+wa pra sa k+ta ha ri bhā thra ṣ+pe ཿ pu li dze+e ཿ pa re sau tai d+dhā dwags tshogs la rab chags rngon pa rnams kyi ④srog chags gsod pa rab btang zhing / /seng ges glang ra ṇa dā ra ṇa blu pa ra me sadrwaṅga sadhī kṛ te/ /mā yu dzā ba ra chen 'joms pa dang bral yan lag kun gyis 'grogs par gyur pa la/ /der ni rngon ①pa'i bud med mu ṇirda ri dra dza gha nā mugh+ra ka lā podzhai tāsta trotshwa sa be+e rā ga shu 6 a da dha tig tshogs rnams spangs pa'i rked duskabs rma bya yi/ /gos kyis dbul zhing shugs rings dang ldan chags ra tā ཿ ki rā tā ṅga nāḥ / / k+ṣa me t+ya ghā bhi ra sa ā+oṃ sat+tha byu ta bral mchu ni rab tu bskams ⑦par gyur/ /chu gter ske burags can sa btang / /'byung k+ṣa ma shi taḥ/ /sophobha ba ta k+ṣurnyi bā dī ti bi khru ta kā shi pun+da raḥ/ /po kun la bzod pa bsten⑦/ /bzod pa smra ba zhes par ni/ /kā shi'i mdzes pa de grags gyur/ /a tān+ta re ma tī har+ghaṃ brah+ma daste di baṃ ga te/ /ubye ga i ba khyu tā skabs der sa gzhi mgu ba yi/ /tshangs pas dhibyin ni mtho ris song ⑨/ /'byung po rnams kyi mya ngan ram̐ byu pā laḥkā li bhū ra byuta/ /a thā da bh+ra bh+ra marjeṅga snru bhaṅga ma mi bzhin—/ /dus kyi sa ni sa skyong gyur/ /de nas rab mang ⑪ bung ba'i tshogs/ /g.yo ba'i smin 'khyog ⑩nā na naḥ/ /mu ni saṃ ya ma bi dī ṣe ba san+taḥbra bye dṛ byu ta/ /ma da bzhin ras log /thub pa'i dul ba la sdang ba'i/ /dpyid ni yang dag byung bar gyur/ /ri dwags nod+mā da bhū ta gya thrasgruta gya mṛ gi dṛ shi/ /mā na bi bye sa dru ta gya tsū ta mig can khengs pa dag /nyams pa'i pho nya tsū ⑫ta ni/ /rab tu rgyas dag ⑫chags pa yis/ /stsos pa'i su ru ru tse ru tsiḥ/ /ragh+ra sho ka su par+shasba la tā ling gan shaṃ ki taḥ/ /rgyu yi ⑫'od kyis mjos/ /mya ngan med pa dmar po la/ /logs gnas 'khri shing gis 'khyud dogs/ /95—387

nābyet+ta dadze+e ṇa mādz+dza rna/ /ta tre ba ni: lasta sbra stabye tā li khi ta i ba/ /de mthong rgyal po'i btsun mo'i tshogs/ /de dag ri mor bris pa bzhin/ /de nyid du ni g.yo med gnas/ /pra burnyophotha dṛ paḥk+ṣi pre nā pa sh+yadrwa yi taḥpu raḥ/ /da dar+sha ba na ma nī 6 de nas mi bdag myur sad pas/ /mdun du btsun mo mthong ma gyur/ /nags su bltas pas thub pa la/ /ba ri ba r+yā sbi tā mu kau/ /bhu dze+e ga sta bi lo bye ba shwa sam+bi dh+ya yongs su bskor nas gnas pa mthong / /de mthong nyid kyi hukyelag 'gro ni/ /dbugs rgod ⑤phrag dog bi ṣā ku laḥ/ /be+e sa sardza ba tso rū pe hā la ha la mi boṅka ṭi/ /kaste mu dug gis 'khrugs/ /ha la ha la bzhin du ni/ /rab grags ①tshig gi tshul gyes spros/ /thub pa'i mtshan ni byañdza na yā tsi tra kṛ tri ma mā tra yā/ /muṭ+wā se muk+ta dṛ da yā nu mar bcos pa yi/ /chas kyis mtshar ba khyod 'dra su/ /blon ④po rnams kyi snying 'phrog ⑤khyod/ /nges rna nā ri pra tā ra kaḥ / /pa ra ste ha ra ṇi dh+ya dz+wa dza pastaju sna par bud med rnams la 'bridaspyo/ /gzhan byi bud med 'phrog bstan nam⑦ / /de yi bgegs zlog ④ba ra ṇi/ /dhūtwo dz+wa pa ra mo pā yaḥpa re lā shwa sa na ta paḥ/ /mu kha bzlas pa dang / /drang po'i yid rton dka' thub ni/ /g.yo sgyu du/can gyi thabs mchog yin/ /kha dngar ⑩mā dhur+ya dhūrta su kṛt+ta r+bhalka li nasta ba/ /a ho nu mo ha dza na byā ba ṣ+pe sgyu ldan shing shun can/ /khyod kyi pags pa nags kyi ni/ /dug gi ljon pa bcad pa bzhin/ /kye ma bi ṣa ta ro ri ba/ /mu ni kaspo sa mā kalpa: ri tai pu na rī dṛ shaṃ/ /rmongs pa skyed ⑪pa yin/ /thub par brtag hu9pa lta bu'i chas/ /spyod ⑫pa slar yang 'di 'dra ⑫ba/ /da m+bha sa sgyu bi ta sbra be+e sbyi ka sta twa mā n+ta ram̐ / / i kyu ste bhū bhu nang gi de nyid tshul 'chos hustekyis/ /bsgrubs ⑫pa'ang su zhig dag gis rig⑩ /sa bdag khro bas 'di dzā kro dh+wa da kro dha ma dhu rāsha yaḥ/ /nirngi kā re ṇa ma na pā k+ṣurnyi bā dī dza brjod tshe/ /khro med phan pa'i bsam pa can/ /bzod pa smra bas rnam 'gyur dang / /bral ba'i yid kyis 95—389

kau—/ /pu dī pra yā te ra dza pā sho ka s+thā ṣ+pe ba bhū ra juta/ /ta ta stadruḥkha ku pi par—/ /grong khyer song tshe rdul gyis tsho)sa/ /mya ngan byed bzhin dri mar gyur/ /de nas de yi bzod pa'i tā rāzlo taṣ+ṭharnyi de ba tā/ /tsa kre na ga: dubhik+ṣa ma ra kā dṛṣ+ṭi bi be+e lha—/ /de sdug bsngal bas rgyal la khros/ /grong khyer du ni mu ge dang / /yams dang char med nyer 'tshe baṃ—/ /ṣ+pe mit+ta ko bh+yo mi dzñā ya rā dzā mu ni ba rā bha bta/ /de ba tā ko pa dze+e do byas—/ /rgyal pos thub la gnod byas las/ /lha rnams khros te bskyed pa'i skyon/ /mtshan ma mkhan las ṣe tai pra sā da yi ḍū ya yo/ /ni pa t+ya pā da yosta gya k+ṣa ma swe t+ya shes nas ni/ /de la dad par byed du song / /de yi zhabs gnyis la btud nas/ /bzod pa mdzod bhi dh+wa ya saḥ/ /pastsat+ta pa bi ṣā de na nibye ta na i ba bha bta/ /ta ma ces brjod nas de/ /phyi nas 'gyod pa'i mya ngan gyis/ /sems dang bral ba bzhin du gyur/ /bzod pa bra bīta k+ṣurnyi bā dī rā dzan marlun+d+ra mephokhyo pi/ /kan+d+ra re kha pa rits+tsha dā dī smra bas der smras pa/ /bdag la khro ba chung ngu'ang med/ /las kyi ri mos yongs bcad pas/ /rgyal po dṛ shi bha bi ta bya tā/ /sabye ṇi m+bi ga ṇa ya ti swats+tshan+da bha bi ta bya tā/ /na bye: 'di 'dra stsong bya nyid / /thams cad za ⑤byed rang dbang du/ /nges par stsong bya rtsi ba ni/ /brtan min na gu r+ṇa nārja na ta po nā pi go ra baṃ/ /an+da dz+re ta pra pa ba bi dza pa radza ra yon tan min don min/ /dka' thub ma yin rje sa min/ /skye ba'i blu gzhi la rtsa ba'i stobs che ldan pa ṇi bhin+da ni kā la ba ri pā ka bi tsi tri tā ni/ / dzad+ma s+tha le bi rang gi lus/ /gsar ④skyes dag gi 'bras bu dus kyis yongs su smin pa ni/ /rnam par bkra zhing tha pu la mū la ba la gya dzabye byeste pa lā ni ni dza kan+d+ra ma hi ru ha gya/ /twa dad gyur pa brgyud mar skyes ⑤ pa yi/ /sa ⑥bon nang na gnas pa skye bo rnams kyis ⑦ spyod pa yin/ /de yi tasman+da me kash+yita bi kā roste ma hi pa te/ /sa h+ye nā ṣ+pe na me pa sh+ya slad sa bdag khyod la bdag /rnam 'gyur ci yang yod ma yin/ /bden pa 'di yis bdag gi khrag /95—391

ba ma na sā myu yan rā dza jo dzā dṛ bo bya gāta/ /k+ṣurnyi bā dī sa e bā haṃ kauṇ+ḍi n+yaḥganas su mi bdag kyang / /de nyid yid ①la sems shing song / /bzod pa smra ba de nyid nga / /dus sa kā la bhu ra yo/ /ā sā r+ya sa myahūṃ bo bye murje to3 yi ma yā dhu nā/ /i nyi su kauṇ+ḍi n+ya 'di/ /da lta yang dag rdzogs byang chub/ /thob nas bdag gis 'di bsgral to/ /zhes pa bde ga ta mu khā ra bin+da nirmata ma dhu ra ma dhu pra ti rma ba tsaḥpra sa.oṃ/ /gshegs zhal gye pad+ma las 'khrungs pa/ /yid 'ong sbrang rtsi'i gzugs brnyan rab tu dang ba'i gsung / /bh+ra ma ra bha ra i bo di ta pra mo daḥki ma pi ba byu ba ni r+pā ya bhekyu bung ba'i tshogs bzhin dge slong tshogs kyis rab 'thungs nas/ /rab tu dga' ba rgyas pa ci yang byung saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la bar gyur/ /zhes dāpa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag tā yī kā shi pun+da rā ba dā rna nā ma tri shaḥpabe+e waḥ// //bsam khyegyi 'khri shing las kā shi'i jemadzes pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu pa'o// //ban+d+raḥko bi sa sa twa pā ra sa ra laḥsau dza n+ya pu rgya lji tim+bi byeḥko pi sems can snying po drang zhing legs spyad 7bsod nams gnas de su yang phyag byar 'os/ /chos lam sa dha n+d+ra mārga ga ma ṣ+pe bi snaḥ kṛ ta snaḥ pa re/ / tsi tram̐ yastso ri tai bgrod pa'i gegs ⑥dang shin tu ngan par spyod de su yang smad par 'os/ /gang gi spyod pa bkra ba rnam bi tsār+ya su tsi ram̐ ro māñtsa tsastsortsi ta stu bye yā ti dza naḥs bāt+pa na ya nastad+madapyad yun ring spu long rgyas pas byugs gyur pa/ /de dag bsngags na skye bo mig chu ldan zhing mi smra nyid ṇ+ḍi na spru ka tī/ /de ba dat+ta pra seṅga na bhekyu bhesgo ga bān pu rā/ /du mtshungs par gyur④/ /dge slong rnams kyis (milhas byin gyi/ /zhar la mngon 6/dris bcom ldan gyis/ /thraṣ+ṭaḥka thā ma ka tha yata pūdze+e dṛt+tarnye saṃ shra yi/ /ma hen+d+ra se nā nā mā bhū sngon gyi ⑪ byung ba'i mtha' dag la/ /brten 6nyepa'i mtha' ni bka' stsal pa/ / bā rā ṇa sīr yortemi yi 95—393

ta bā rā ṇa sde na ra shwa raḥ/ /ya yuḥk+ṣi nyi shwa raḥsabye ya gya lasmyu dbang / /dbang po'i sde chen zhes pa byung / /gang gi dpal byus sa yi dbang / /thams cad skyengs pa bi lak+ṣa tai/ /tsan+d+ra pra bhā bha bat+ta gya di bī tīrnyi ri ba thra yā/ /ya sgyuḥs t+ya pra bhā nyid du gyur/ /de yi lha mo grags pa bzhin/ /yid 'ong zla ba'i 'od ces gyur/ /gang gi bden pa rmobe+e na swa snaḥs t+ya twa mā ya yuḥ/ /ba byu ba sa ma ye tasmin mṛ ga yu tha pa mthu yis ni/ /rmi lam bden pa nyid du gyur/ /dus der nags su ri dwags kyi/ /khyu yi bdag po byung nyirba ṣ+pe/ /su baṇ+ḍi pār+sha i t+yāp+ta nā ma he ma ma yats+tsha biḥ/ /m+bi la rat+na gyur pa/ /gser gyi logs zhes bya ba'i ming / /thob cing gser gyi rang bzhin snang / /mu tig do shal da ra s+thā ra myuk+ta hā ra ni bha pra bhāḥ/ /ba bhūdṛ ṣ+ṭa ts+tsha ṭā ya mya byu ṣa gsal ba'i khongs/ /rin chen mazing gis spras 'dra'i 'od/ /gang gi mig gi rdzi stim ni/ /nags kyi rde kā na na shri yaḥ/ /pra bā la bal+lī shriṅga su tsi tra rat+na tsi ta twa tsaḥ/ /ta dpal gyi rgyan du mdzes/ /byu ru'i 'khri shing rwa co dang / /rin chen bkra ba'i pags pas zhurgyas/ /ngo sngabyar+ya su dzñā sgo dhī la ha rī ru ru tsi ru tsi/ /bo bye satwa ba ta ra su mtshar bdud rtsi'i sdechu gter gyi/ /rba ⑤rlabs de yi 'od zer mdzes/ /byang chub sems dpar zhugs ta su kā n+ta ma bhū t+pa pu ཿ / / pū rde su kṛ ta tsi tra gya la k+ṣa rde gyur pa/ /de yi gzugs ni mdzes par gyur/ /gang phyir legs byas ri mo yi/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid hi su byu pa tā/ /dīr+gha dṛṣ+ṭi rba byu bā gya ba ya sro dṛbye bā ya gya/ /lubha gzugs bzang nyid/ /de yi grogs po bya rog ni/ /rgan po ⑥ring du mthong bar gyur⑦/ /rngon pa kā dz+wa ṣa ṇa tā gye disbi lo ka na tat+pa raḥ/ /to ka thā bhim+bi thaḥpra t+yā 'tshol 'u bas 'jigs pa yis/ /de ni mchog tu phyogs rnams lta6tre/ /de dag phan tshun dga' ba yi⑩/ /bi biste 6 bi dza hra tuḥ/ /pāklu byedzā ya te bā bhā ti rartswa ma pi mā gtam gyis dben par lho1 rnam par rtsen/ /dud 'gro la yang snga ma yi/ /bsod nams rnams kyis ⑫mi 95—394

nu ṣi/ /sa ka dā tsidz+dza lā nī ṣi yu thā nā thaḥs hā nu giḥ/ /ta ṭi t+yāḥskad 'byung / /nam zhig chu ni 'tshol ① byed cing / /khyu yi mgon de rjes 'brang bcas/ /phru ba'i phreng be+e na mā li n+yaḥpu li rgo sa mu pā ya yo/ /ta tā pa sh+yata pra bā ha ṇa rngi ya ldan chu klung gi/ /'jug ngogs dag tu song bar gyur/ /der ni dgra rnams kyis bcings nas/ /chur mā ṇa ma tī ya sā/ /sa sha tru bhirga le badha k+ṣibhā ma kran+di rgo na ram̐/ /'phangs cho nge ④'debs pa'i mi/ /shin tu che ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /khyer nas 'gro ba de yis mthong / /ta gya ta ra ta ram̐ khru tā dīr+ghamā kran+da ni swa rna/ /ha ri ṇ+ḍi du dru buḥsabye shrī de yi cho nge'i sgra dag ni/ /shin tu che zhing ring ba thos/ /ri dwags thams cad mgrin pa ni/ / 'khyog bā ba la na bi bh+ra miḥ/ /su baṇ+ḍi pār+shastu ta dā kṛ pā pā sha ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /pa'i ④ rnam 'phrul ldan pas bros/ /gser gyi logs ni de yi tshe/ /brtse ba'i zhags pas spyodabang du byas//ta tre ba nibye lasta sgo man+d+ra bidha i be 6 shā/ /ta dudhe ra ṇa san+dar+ghaṃ mda' yis gnad du phug pa bzhin/ /de nyid du ni g.yo med gnas/ /de ni gdon par chas pa dag /dīr+gha dṛji bi lo kya tsā/ /kā kaḥpro bā tsa na sa khe yustophoyarnye sa mud+ma maḥ/ /bya rog ring du mtho ba niskye / /mthong nas de la smras pa grogs/ /khyod kyi brtson pa 'di mi rigs/ /pusgo pa mā bi paṭ+wā le kṛ tāṭ+wāḥku li sho pa mā/ /kṛ ta me te na ma n+yadhe swa rgud pa'i dus na me tog mtshungs/ /don byas pa na ⑥rdo rje 'dra/ /mi bsrun ⑦rang gi lus kyi grogs/ /kā ya su z-i daḥkha lāḥ/ /i t+ya sau bārma mā rto pi kā ke na ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /'di dag byas pa mi bsam mo/ /de dag bya rog gis brjod 9snyekyang / /snying rjes rgyas shing drang ba de/ /a ba tirlu shu pa ri tai sa ra lasta ma tā ra yata/ /bi mu tsu ban+dha nā n+ya gya sa chu bo la ni myur ba ru/ /zhugs nas de ni thar par byas/ /dogs med de yi ru dag gis/ /de yi shriṅgā sgyu ma shaṅgi taḥ/ /tai pā da pa ti tai dī na ma ba daṅgabye mud+ma tai/ /bcings pa rnam bkrol nas/ /zhan cing rkang par gtugs byas te/ /'gro bar brtson pa de la smras/ /95—395

be+e sgo mṛ gaḥ/ /abyar+ya ra tsa nā kṛṣ+ṭa lo tsa nartswa ru lo tsa naḥ/ /ri dwags rnyed ma gyur/ /mig ni ngo mtshar bkod pa yis/ /'gugs pa rab tu mdzes pa'i mig /swasna saṃ pan+da rū po sau nyi ra rgya ha ri ṇaḥku taḥ/ /ma no bi no da ni gser gyi ri dwags rmi lam du/ /yongs rdzogs gzugs 'di ga la yod/ /lha gcig ①gal te yid kyis (snyeta smin ya di de ba pra sbo da nyi/ /kurban+d+ra kāñtsa na mṛ ga ku sha lāḥke bi shi lpi ni—/ /dge mtshan de la dgyes pa na/ /bzo bo mkhas pa kha cig dag /gser gyi ri dwags bgyid du naḥ / /i ti khru twa sa dṛ pa tirda dan ba hu ta ram̐ dha rgo/ /mṛ ga nī ṣa ṇa stsol—/ /zhes ①pa thos nas mi bdag de/ /nor ni rab mang ster byed cing / /ri dwags 'tshol ba'i saṃ katse ba bhū bā bhi ni be+e sha bān/ /ta taḥku ṭi la kophobye h+ye dṛ saṃ shu tā brtag spyopa la/ /mngon par zhen pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas nor mang ster thos nas/ /rngon pa bas kyang ba hu pra rda/ /u bā tsa dra bi zla dā ṣ+pe lubha ke bh+yo pi lubha dhīḥ/ /pra sā daḥnor len la/ /brkam chags blo ldan gya gyu can/ /mi bdag la mngon phyogs nas smras/ /lha gcig kṛ ya hūṃ de ba mṛ gi san+dar+sha yā mya haṃ / /dṛṣ+ṭaḥ ka na ka sā raṅgaḥbaka' drin mdzod cig dang / /ri dwags bdag gis bstan par bya/ /gser gyi ri dwags ri dwags de/ /sā raṅgaḥs ma yā ba no/ /i t+yā kakhyu k+ṣi nyi pa tiḥpra hasgoh+phu be+e lo tsa nags su bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /zhes khye pa thos nas sa yi bdag /rab tu dga' ba'i mig rgyas naḥ—/ /bha dra san+dar+sha ya kā sau kā sā bi t+ya ba dadru huḥ/ /ta me bā gre pa ram̐ kṛ tā pas—/ /bzang po ston cig gang ⑥na de/ /gang na de zhes yang yang smras/ /ri dwags lam ni ston byed mṛ ga mār+gha bra dar+sha ka/ /sa me+e n+yaḥs ya yo swats+tsha tra tsadz+dza da yā tsa pa—/ /de nyid ④sngon du 'gro bar byas/ /dpung bcas de ni dri med gdugs/ /zla shar ri bo bzhin du laḥ—/ /dīr+gha dṛṣ+ṭirda dar+sha tha kā kasta ru shi raḥsbri taḥ/ /ga dza bā dzi song / /de nas glang po rta 'gros kyis/ /basbangs pa'i rdul gyis nags khengs pa/ /shing rtser gnas 95—397

bra dzo dīṇ+ḍi re rku pā ba ra khaṃ ba rna/ /su paṇ+ḍi pār+sha sa bye t+ya dza gā pa'i bya rog ni/ /ring du mthong bas mthong bar gyur/ /de yis ri dwags khyu yi bdag /gser gye da mṛ go yu tha paṃ/ /hi ta muk+ṇi ma yā pūdz+re na khru tai na kṛ tai twa yā/ /logs la mngon phyogs smras/ /bdag gis phan pa sngon ①brjod de/ /khyod kyis mnyan min byas pa min//sa e ṣa pu ru ṣaḥpāp+taḥsan+dabye sa ha dha nī bhiḥ/ /ma yā ni bā ri te nā pi ya bdag gis bzlog kyang khyod kyis ni/ /gang la srog ni byin pa ste⑤/ /skyes bu 'di de ①go bgos shing / /gya pā ṇasta yādz+re tāḥ/ /a dhu nā kwa nu gan+ta bye ki kārta bya bha yodha be+e/ /gzhu bzung rnams dang lhan cig 'ongs/ /da ni 'jigs pa byung tshe kwa'i/ /gang du 'gro bya ci zhig bya/ /hi tai ki ma nu parta bye tu bye marta bya me ba bā/ /kṛ ta snaḥkru ra tsa ri taḥphan pa (zhwaci zhig spro bar bya/ /mnyam du 'chi bar bya 'am ci/ /byas pa mi gzo ⑤ma rungs gcod⑥/ /k+ṣu dro yo sak+ta pā ta kaḥ/ /twa yi bāt+pa bi nā shā ya rak+ṣi to bi ṣa pā sdig la chags pa'i ngan pa 'di/ /khyod kyis bdag nyid nyams bya'i slad/ /dug gi rkang 'thung bsrungs da paḥ/ /swa sha rī ra pā da snga pi saṃ hā re ṇa na tro pya te/ /sa sa twa sā par gyur/ /byas pa mi gzo'i ⑦rta gdong me/ /rang gi lus kyi gnas dag kyang / /yongs su spyad pas ga ra grwa saṃ kṛ tosna ba ḍa bā na laḥ/ /u pa kā raḥkṛ tasne 6 bi shā mi ngoms te/ /srog chags bcas pa'i rgya mtsho 'thungs(kye/ /byas mi gzo ⑨la phan pa dang / /gya gyu'i saḥku ṭi lād+ma su/ /u pa de sha: rūkhe 6 kakhyordo ṣā ke ba lo/ /bdag la yid gcugs ⑩dang / /ngan pa rnams la gdams ngag ni/ /byed po'i skyon ni ⑪'ba' zhig yin//i ti kā ke na ka thi te pra t+yā san+de tsa pābe+e be/ /a tsin+ta yata pāp+ta kā lo hi tai zhes pa bya rog gis bshad tshe/ /sa yi bdag po nye bar 'ongs/ /khyu la phan pa'i dus la ni/ /bab ⑫pa yu tha gya yu tha paḥ/ /su bha ṭā hā mi yo se nā bi gā he ga ha rna ma hata/ /khyu yi bdag pos bsams/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi sde 'di yis/ /nags tshal chen po bskor nas ni/ /95—398

ka ro ti mata pra saṅge na mu snutī ṣ+pe ba nimṛ shaṃ/ /ta smrata be+e n+ya pra ṅgā na gya bdag gi zhar la ri dwags rnams/ /yud tsam nyid kyis med par byed/ /de slad dpung gi gtso bo dang / /gasgo mi swa ya man+ta ka/ /e ka sri ba ba bho mistu sazla jo ba twa m+bi mṛ gāḥ/ /nye bar rang nyid 'gro bar bya/ /bdag nyid gcig pu gsod gyur la/ /ri dwags 'di kun 'tsho gyur cig /i nyi byi— t+ya sa ya yo sa m+bi paṃ bhū pa tesmṛ gaḥ/ /pa ra pā ṇa pa ri tā ṇi de ltar des byas ri dwags de/ /sa bdag dang ni nye bar song / /gzhan srog yongs su skyob tshotrepa la/ /tro khaṃ pā zla ma had+ma rgo/ / ta mā yādzha dru lta dṛṣ+ṭaḥ ku ṭi la kaḥpu bdag nyid che rnams srog ni rtswasti/ /mdun du mgyogs par 'ong ba de/ /mthong nas gya gyu can dga' raḥ / /so ya mi t+yā shu pā ṇi rgyu rā dze dru ro da dar+sha yata/ /taṅgha ṇi dro ṇa shā pe bas—/ /rgyal la mgyogs par de 'di zhes/ /lag pa dag gis ring nas bstan/ /de tshe bya rog dmod na badz+ra ṇi ba ṇi pā ti nā/ /ka ro pa ri sgo to ta gya pā pa pā da pa pal+la bo/ /pa ni/ /rdo rje lhung ba lta bu yis/ /de yi lag pa sdig pa yis1/ /rkang 'thung yal 'dab yongs su lhung ④)//tabyetrī bismi taḥshu tā mṛ ge na ka thi tai dṛ paḥ/ /a bhūta kṛ ta sna tsa ri te ri dwags kyis bshad de yi spyod/ /mi bdag ya mtshan ldan pas thos/ /zhal nas byas pa mi gzo (snyeba'i /byeṅgā ra mu kha rā na naḥ/ /ta taḥk+ṣi ti pa ti spru t+ya be+e byu t+ya sa ra yā mṛ gi/ /tai spyod tshul smad ces mu cor gyur/ /de nas sa bdag dgyes pa yis/ /rje sa shin tu che ba dang / /'byor ni nā yā swa na ga rī go ra be na ga rī ya sā/ /rā dza dh+wa m+bi ma thā sa r+ya pa mchog gi spyo ri dwags de/ /rang gi grong khyer dag tu (pekhyer/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho brang phyin/ /de tasmi rat+na sa rgo dṛ paḥ/ /da tā sān+taḥpu rā mā t+yasta snga gre sa mu pā bi shata/ /nas (snye)rin chen khri stan phul/ /de yi mdun du mi yi bdag /btsun mo blon po'i tshogs bcas 'khod/ /sa bo bye sa tā ha ri ṇasta sri paste di di bya dhīḥ/ /dhadz+re di de sha ye nā byang chub sems dpa' ri dwags de'i/ /mchog gi blo yis mdun yo7sa der/ /chos bstan gang gi skye bo 95—399

khyudz+dza naḥshik+ṣu pa dā nī taḥ/ /su baṇ+ḍi par+shaḥ sā raṅgāḥso ha me bā rnams—/ /bslab pa'i gnas dang ldan par gyur/ /nga nyid sngon gyi dus na ni/ /ri dwags gser gyi bha baṃ su rā/ /yophobha bta ku ṭi laḥkru ro de ba dat+taḥs tsā dhū nā/ /i ti su kṛ logs der gyur/ /ma rungs rgya gyu can gyur gang / /de yang da lta lhas byen no/ /de nas bcom ldan ti tsi tai bha ga ba tā bha ba dī ti bhi dā ka thi ta mu dā ra sa twa ru tsi ra gya srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'byed par byed pas snying stobs ni/ /rgya che mdzes pa'i spyod tshul legs spyad la 'os ta tatso ri tai/ /pra sha ma ma yo ni sha mya ku sha lā ya sa bhi gru ga ṇaḥrab zhi'i rang bzhin dag /de skad bshad pa thos nas bsod nams dag ni yongs su smin gyur pa'i/ /ki ma pi ba bhū ba pu sgo pa ri pā ka be+e be+e ka ru tsiḥ/ /i nyi k+ṣe men+d+ra dbe+en pas mdzes pa'i dge slong tshogs de dge ba'i slad du ci yang gyur/ /zhes 47pa dge ba'i dbang pos be+e ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī su baṇ+ḍi pabye ba byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser byi logs kyi rtogs dā na me ka tro shaḥpal+la waḥ// //pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa byegacig pa'o// //pra t+ya k+ṣa la k+ṣa ṇa pa ri k+ṣi ta e ṣa lo ke saṃ la k+ṣu te su dza na 'jig rten dag na yongs su mtshon byed mngon sum mtshan nyid kyis/ /skye bo bzang dang ngan pa'i dudz+dza na yobe+e she ṣaḥ/ / karkaḥpra kā sha bi sha rda bi da jo ti bi shwa khyad par 'di dag legs par mtshon/ /nyi mas thams cad dri med rab tu gsal ba rnam par sgrub①/ /madh+ri ka ro nyi ni khi lo dza ga dan+dha kā raḥ/ /sat+tha snyoḥsgot+tha bṛṭ+wān+ta ma smag rum mun pas 'gro ba ma lus mun nag ldan par byed/ /thams cad mkhyen pas ④ sngon byung mtha'/ /she ṣa ma ba lo ka yan / / a smin+de ba ka thā raste bha ga bān pu ma lus nges par gzigs byed cing / /gtam 'di nyid las ⑤rab brtsams te/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 95—400

na ra bra bīta/ /dṛ paḥpā ṭa li pu tā khye su re byu mi pu ran+da raḥ/ /a byuta ta pu slar gsungs pa/ /grong khyer pa ṭa lngoli yi bu/ /zhes par mi bdag sa yi ni/ /'byer ṛ da ro nā ma man+di ram̐ pu rgya sadza rda/ /ka s+thā ṇa kā ri ta snga bhūta sru 'jig 'byer 'jig ces bya ba/ /bsod nams phun tshogs gnas su gyur/ /de yi sras po 'a3yon tan gyi//nurgu ṇa ga rton+da taḥ/ /a ka spyo shā bhe dh+wa nabya dī tī yo ni rgu ṇaḥsu taḥ/ /ka tshogs kyis mtho ba dge byed dang / /gnyis pa yon tan med pa yang / /mi dge byed ces bya bar gyur/ /dge spyo ṇa kā ri sazlube+e ka ru rja kalpa pā da paḥ/ /ts+tsha tā ba sha ṣā ma ka rota dā byed slong ba thams cad kyi/ /snying rje yi ni dpag bsam shing / /sbyin pa'i tshul gyis yab kyi dpal/ /na shi laḥshri yo pi tuḥ/ /tasmi ma no ra oṃ nā ma pu ju se no ma tī pa tiḥ/ /gdugs kyi lhag ma nyid du byas/ /de la ①sa bdag bsod nams sdes/ /yid dga' ma zhes bya ba yi/ /dru tai bi mṛ bye le khe na swa su tai ba tsa sā da do/ /pra t+yā san+da bi pā hophotha dṛ saṃ rang gi bu mo spring yig dang / /tshig gi ④pho nya btang nas byin/ /de nas len la nye ba'i tshe/ /rgyal la rā dza su to bh+ya dhata/ /pā pāḥpa ri ṇa yasta ta saspra h+ye ṣa na me ma taḥ/ /rgyal sras kyis smras pa/ /yab gcig ⑤bag ma len pa 'di/ /da yolta bdag la thob 'dod med/ /bāt+pa l+ya pe sha la ta yā ma dādhī pra kṛ ta shri yaḥ/ /ma yā dā na bya ba ni mnyes gshin yangs pa nyid kyis ngan⑦ / /bdag ni sbyin la zhen pa yis/ /dga' bas dpal 'byor drag 3snanā ko ṣaste shu ṣi rī kṛ taḥ/ /ta smrata pra ba ha be+e nā haṃ sa muṭī r+ya tu blangs/ /khyod kyi mdzod ni stong shakyepar byas/ /de be+ed chu gter chen po ni/ /gzings kyis yang dag ma ho da sgo/ /rat+na dī saṃ bra dzā bye ba di bya raṭ+wādz+dza nod+ma taḥ/ /di bya bsgral nas bdag /mchog gi rin chen sgrub brtson pas/ /rin chen gling du nges par 'gro/ /mchog gi sadza da mā sā r+ya ka ri ྾ dā ra saṃ gra haṃ/ /ka la tra ma kṛ tārja su tā sa phun tshogs thob nas ni/ /bdag gis chung ma blang bar bgyi/ /nor med dag gi chung ma ni/ /bde ba'i 95—401

ram̐ su kha sadza dzā/ /i kyughā sa pi tu pā gyaḥshā sa rgo tsa ra ṇa na taḥ/ /phun tshogs skrag pa skyed①/ /ces brjod de yis ② yab kyi bka'/ /thob nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /dza ga he dza la dhi lo la kaslo lā liṅgi tālba re/ /s+thā tā tai ma nu ba zwa dza sau rba ①rlabs g.yo bas nam mkha' la/ /'khyud pa chu yi gter du zhugs/ /yon tan med pa yon tan la/ /dza n+ya bya dza nolhanu dzaḥ/ /nirgu ṇaḥs gu ju dwo ṣajo ha man+tam+bi tsin+ta sdang bas nang du 'khu sems shing ④/ /gzhung bzang du ston rjes skyes pa'i/ /spun zla de ni der rjes yan—/ /byeṣ+ṭhaḥtam bra bīd+mat+pa sa mu dre kan+d+ra bi be+e bta/ /sa haṃ gā khya ste 'brang / /thu 'a3bos de la smras pa bu/ /rgya mtshor las kyis rnam bslad pas/ /gzings ni zhig par gyur yāskarnyi dzā te pra ba ha ṇa k+ṣa ye/ /i ti bhā tā kṛ tā shwa sasta je kyu pa na/ /khyod kyi phrag 67par bdag blang bya/ /zhes pas spun zla ④yid brtan byas/ /de bzhin zhes tse sa tai sha ṭhaḥ/ /do ṣa r+ya taḥpra ṇa yi tsā kha laḥs ma ma lasba te/ /ta taḥdes de la smras/ /skyon rtsom g.yo khyacan mi bsrun po7pa/ /rab dud nyid la yang dag brten/ /de nas pra ba ha ṇa ru bhāḥs pa ṣ+pe ra nu ku la hūṃḥ/ /yā taiḥpu bye ri ba pā mya gzings la zhon byas te/ /bsod nams bzhin du rjes mthun par/ /'gro ba'i rlung gis rin chen gling / /rat+na ju paṃ dṛ pāt+pa dzaḥ/ /di bya rat+na ni saṃ pra pya t+yā bṛdhe ta taḥsha mi yi bdag po'i sras kyis ⑫ thob/ /rin chen mchog rnams rab rnyed nas/ /rgyal po'i sras dag dal bu naiḥ—/ /rā dza pu tre pra ba ha ṇi dru ga ba bhañdza pra bhañdza naḥ/ /bhasne pra pa ha ṇi ta smin yis—/ /be+er log tshe na gzings dag ni/ /rlung gi stobs kyis myur du zhig /gzings ni zhig pa de yi bhā ta re pūzla sam+bi dā/ /sa dza grwa ha sha ṭhaḥkabye tai bhu dze+e ga i bā nu tshe—/ /sngon byu gros kyi lhomespun zla de'i/ /mgrin par lag 'gro lta bu yi/ /rjes skyes g.yo ⑫can de yis dzaḥ / /kan+d+ra bā te ri tathor+ghaṃ ku lo s+thā pya dṛ pād+ma dzaḥ/ /a bā pa sa ha sa bzung / /las kyi rlung gis myur bskyod pas/ /rgyal po'i bu yi ⑫ngogs phyin nas/ /long ba'i pho nya dang 95—402

ni dā mārtse bra tha ma dru ti rmā/ / tasu sup+ta su rat+na ni dṛṭī badhe n+ya po nyid/ /'phral la gnyid du song bar gyur⑨/ /nyal ba de yi rin chen ni/ /bcings rnams nu bo ma thā nu dzaḥ/ /pra harba bya sa nakhyu dre spyu raḥs mu pa tsakra me/ /ut+yā rungs des/ /mthong nas gdung ba'i khung bur ni/ /rab tu 'phrog pa'i bya ba brtsams/ /de yis rgya gā bhā badha gya sa ta su na yo rmā bu dze/ /tai tā ra ka bha yī sgo dhi brtan par bcings pa de'i/ /mig gi chu skyes rab phyung nas/ /'jigs pa'i mtsho las sgol byed de'i/ /tsa kā ra ga ta tā ra shaṃ/ /a tu rasne ga te tasmi na rā dzā sru nurga tad+ku tiḥ/ /mig gi 'bras bu med par byas/ /rin chen khyer nas de song tshe/ /rgyal po'i bu ni gzi byin nyams/ /ma tasgon+d+ra li tī sgo dza i bā bhūṅka ma lā ka raḥ/ /sa ba byu ba ni rā lo kaḥglang pos chu skyes dkrugs pa yi/ /pad+ma'i 'byung gnas bzhin du gyur/ /nyi ma zla ba spangs pa yizhu/ /sho ka tī bra ta mo dṛ taḥ/ /kṛṣ+ṭa pak+ṣa k+ṣa pā ram+bha i ba srud+men+d+ra badzhai taḥ/ /nag phyogs mtshan mo rtsom pa bzhin/ /mya ngan mun pa drag pos bsgribs/ /de ni snang ba med par gyur//a tān+ta re sa ma yā taste de shaṃ go ku lā bye paḥ/ /rā dza pu tram̐ be+e lokyān+dha ma de nas ba glang rdzi bo'i ①bdag /gnas der yang dag 'ongs pa yis/ /rgyal sras long ba mthong nas ni/ /byu྾ krān+ta tabye thaḥ/ /sa tai bhā tā swa ni la yo pa ri tsat+yā pa raḥpa raḥ/ /de yi gdung ba 'phos par gyur/ /de ni de yi krurang gnas blangs/ /rim gro mchog gis rab tu bskyangs/ /ta myu sīṅga ṇa so dza n+ya sne hā bi sha ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /ta tra sho ka ru rdzu de yi yon tan legs spyod dang / /mdza' ba 'bebs pas (5dbang byas gyur/ /der ⑪ni mya ngan nad shādh+ri sa dā tse te bi no di dī/ /bī rde swa re pra bī kho sau byud+dhā bh+yasta zhi'i slad/ /rtag tu sems ni dga' byed pa'i/ /pi wang gyesngon du goms gyur pa/ /dbyangs la mkhas ma ba da yata/ /sad+maṅga maḥthra thu be+e be ka ka thā bhi yo gaḥkā byā pa pa de yis blangs/ /dam pa'i grogs dang rgya che ri 7dben pa'i gtam gyi mngon sbyor dang / /snyan ngag 95—403

baḥpri ya su j-ita pra ṇa yo bi hā rāḥ/ /bi rja swa naḥku su ma kān+ta ba nān+ta btung ba snying sdug grogs rnams mdza' bas rtse ba dang / /pi wang ⑫sgra snyan me tog mdzes pa'i nags kyi sa (khye bā saḥsho kāsni tabe+e ma na sā ma mṛ ta ba ga haḥ/ /ta gya go ba pa teḥganas pa/ /yid ni mya ngan me yis gdungs rnams bdud rtsir zhugs pa yin/ /ba glang ①rdzi yi bdag pasbyi gī ta bī rja bi tsak+ṣa shā/ /pa shādhī rā dza ta na yo pra ya yo sā bhi po de'i/ /chung ma pi wang ④glu mkhan mas/ /rgyal po'i bu mthong de ⑤nas ni/ /mngon par 'dod ldan lā ṣa hūṃ/ /kṛ to pa de shā sa ta tai ku ṭi lā bī ṇa ye ba sā/ /muts+tsha nyid du gyur/ /rtag tu spyogya gyu ldan ma de'i/ /pi wang ④gis ni gdams byas bzhin/ /chags pa ṭī na ba rā ge ṇa soṅkas+thā sa ma tsin+ta yata/ /su bha go yi ma mā tī ba dṛ gsar pas brgyal byed cing / /'dod dang ldan pas yang dag bsams/ /skal bzang 'di la bdag gi ni/ /shi tsiste ba brta te/ /ni brta te na me tā paḥprek+ṇi tsen+da pra bsto te/ /mig dang sems kyang shin tu chags/ /gal te mdza' bar ma gyur na/ /bdag gi gdung ba zlog mi 'gyur/ /dha bye yo na kha saṃ pā taiḥkwa ṇa: rā gi bhā mu huḥ/ /yā tā su babe+e tī pu yang yang sen mos khyebatab pa yis/ /sgra byed chags ldan pi wang ⑨'di/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'di yi bye raṅgā ro ha ṇa yo gya tsā / / i ti saṃ tsidh+ri sā sī re ta mu phang / /'dzeg 'os nyid gyur ⑨ skal ba bzang / /zhes bsams de yi ⑪dal bu yis/ /'dar bcas bā tse sa bi bh+ra ma/ /smṛ byurnyi taṅka ram̐ sgo rdza sa kadza ka ra pal+la bā/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab kyis/ /de ⑫lag pad la reg byed ⑫cing / /rnam 'gyur ldan pas de la smras/ /la la nā su la bhā lasbyo ma me rda twaṅga ta ma naḥ/ /a kṛ ta snyo i ba spru ti khyod la song ba'i bdag nyid 6'di/ /mdza' bo byas pa mi shes bzhin/ /bud med rnams la rnyed sla ba'i/ /na saṃ sma ra ti mā na da/ /na shī lo na ku khā tsā re nā bhe mā rna na saṃ sha yi/ /legs ster ngo tsha mi dran no/ /'dod pas 'phangs pa'i bud med ni/ /ngo tsha bral ba'i ltos pa dag /95—404

a pe k+ṣurnye sma rak+ṣibhā bai lagh+ra ha ri tāḥste yaḥ/ /pra ṇa khād+ma ma saṃ kadze+e rigs spyod la med khrims la med/ /the tshom la med khengs la med/ /bdag gi brtag pa mdza' ba yis/ /sa pha lo kartu marta si/ /bha babye mā ni tāḥspru h+ye de ba tā i ba yo ṣi 'bras bu ldan par bkyi bar 'os/ /bud med rnams ni bsten khyepa na/ /lha bzhin gcugs pa nyid du taḥ / /i ti ta gya ba tsaḥkhru twa byen+da swa rā bi sh-iṅga lo/ /tsa pa dze+e rā dza 'gyur—/ /zhes pa dbyangs dang bral gyur zhing phu/ /ma bsdams de yi tshig thos nas/ /g.yon ma de la pu tras+t+ri tra stun+taḥka ra rtophob data/ /ṣ+pe yo mā taḥs mu tsi tā sa taḥrgyal po'i bu/ /nang gi byed pa skrag pas smras/ /yum gcig (snyetshul khrims yongs gtong ba/ /'di ni shī la pa ri tsu tiḥ/ /byek+kilbi ṣa bi ṣa smṛṣ+ṭi naṣ+ṭa shī la su dzī be+e tai/ /dam pa'i rigs ④pa min/ /sdig pa'i dug gis reg gyur pa/ /tshul khrims nyams pa'i skye ba smad/ /pa rāṅga nā pa ri ṣ+ṭaṅga mame+e radhī ka ro ti yaḥ/ /ā liṅga ti pa tai go yo gang zhig gzhan gyi ⑤bud med la/ /lus kyis yongs 'khyud bdag gir byed/ /'di ni dmyal ba'i me lce na ra kāsni shi khaṃ pu naḥ/ /pa ro pa kā ra ṇi ra taḥpa ra dā ra ni rā la—/ /phye ma leb bzhin slar yang 'khyud/ /gzhan la phan pa la chags shing / /gzhan gyi bud med la dā rāḥ/ /ye pya ho sā bya sa ni nap+ta dzī badhe mṛ tāḥpa raḥ/ /i ti te nok+ta mā kardzu gus bral/ /gang yang 'tshe med la chags pa/ /de dag 'tsho la gzhan ni shi/ /de skad de yis brjod sā bhūdzhasna ma no ra thā/ /ni dha nā bh+ya bye kai dī ti pra ti ṣe sgo nyi yo thos nas/ /yid kyi shing rta chag par gyur/ /gang phyir bud med mdza' ba ni/ / bzhag sa ⑥shi ba nyid ṣi tsā/ /ta taḥsri pa ti ma bye t+ya byu dze+e gī bhaṅga mā ga te/ /ma no ra the ma rgyu bi ṣe las lhag /de nas yid la re ba dag /nyams par gyur tshe lag 'gro ma/ /de yi ()7rang bdag la phyogs ba maṭī ba dza gā da sā/ /pa ra bat+pa la tā sāsgo do ṣā ya pa ra la te—/ /khro ba'i dug skyug bzhin smras pa/ /dge ba drang po khyod kyis ldu ni/ /mchog tu mnyes gshin skyon 95—405

su ra su ma tī pa teḥ/ /kā le na s+thā sa dru rā dh+wa kle sha pra sha ma brnya baṃ/ /nams sde yi grong khyer ni/ /lam ring lngonyon mongs rab zhi ba'i/ /grogs po dus kyis thob par gyur/ /a tān+ta re pu tā ta tra ma hi bhaturma no ra lā/ /dā tsā daṭ+wā pu rā ya smi gnas skabs der khyeni de dag tu/ /sa bdag sras mo yid dga' ma/ /gang la tshig gi khyasngon byin pa/ /tam+bin+dabhi tsu te khru te/ /ā tū te 6 na rebye 6 ni biṣ+ṭa 6 ya thā kra oṃ/ /ā de ni chu gter lhung thos tshe/ /mi yi dbang po rnams bos te/ /rim pa ji bzhin 'khod pa la/ /rin ru khya rat+na shi be+e rmā swa yalba ra byu baṃ ya yo/ /bi lo ka yaṭībyu pā lān cen bzhon par ④zhon nas ni/ /rang nyid khyo 'dam sa ru 'ongs(7 / /dal bus mig ni mdzes ma des/ /pā sha ṣ+pertswa tu lo tsa nā/ /ya dṛts+tsha yā ga tan+ta tra rā dza pu tram̐ da dar+sha tai/ /sa skyong rnams la bltas pa na/ /de ⑪ni 'dod dgar song gyur pa/ /rgyal po'i sras de mthong bar gyur/ /astso pi ta suḥs ha sā sa ya yo pri ya tsā dṛ shoḥ/ /gra ha ma bye ku mud+ma t+yā me de ni long yang 'phral la de'i/ /mig gi ⑦snying sdug nyid du gyur/ /sprin gyis long yang gza' nang na/ /ghārnya pi pri yaḥsha shī/ /dṛ pe 6 pra ti yā te 6 be+e la k+ṣe ṣ+ṭa phalā ga māta/ /ku mud ldan la zla ba sdug /long ba gdams pa ⑧ mi bdag rnams/ / 'ong ba ⑨'bras bu med pa las/ /ma tī pa tiḥsu ta man+ta ba ra ṇi na bi nirga tai/ /sā pi hā ram̐ pā ri k+ṣi bya skyengs shing log nas song ba'i tshe/ /bu mo sa bdag gis phyir bskrad/ /mig yangs ma des do shal yang / /kabye ta gya ya tek+ṣa shā/ /sha na kaidz+re dhu rā lnga ba twad+ma shāsmre byu bā tsa de yis ⑩mgrin par yongs 'phangs nas/ /de la dal bus snyan pa'i sgra/ /bdag ni khrod kyi dbang zhes tai—/ /spyi bṛt+ta tsa ki taḥso bi bi dza ṣ+pe tā ma bhā ṣa ta/ /pādzñā da ri smras—/ /de yang bud med spyod tshul gyis/ /'jigs te dben par de la smras/ /bud med shes rab dra yā ṣ+pe rda ṭ+wā yā multo kṛ haṃ twa yā/ /sma ra sau hārja mi tre 6 pad+ma kyis dbul na⑪/ /khyod kyis 'dir spyoni rigs ma byas/ /rgyal po dran pa'i snying sdug grogs/ /pad+ma'i 95—407

ṣ+pe tre 6 rā dza su/ /spru te 6 ban+d+ra dzad+mān+t+ra kasmra da m+bi dṛ tosta yā/ /spyan rnams 'khod pa'i tshe/ /skye ba don med long ba khye7bdag /khyod kyis ②ci yi slad du gdams/ /a n+ya bkyā ba lo ki byo dzā yābyak+ṣuṣ+ṭha tā ba pi/ /ba dhū ki pu na ran+ta mig ldan rnams kyi'ang chung ma ni/ /gzhan gyi bzhin ras rnam par lta/ /long ba'i chung ma nyin mo yang / /su di ṣ+pe bya t+yā bhi sā ri kā/ /la la nā bhen+d+ra me kṛ h+ye pra t+ya yas+thā pu nāste me/ /gzhan la mngon bgrod smos ci dgos/ /bdag la bya med bud med kyis/ /de la bdag ni yid ches med/ /ku la ku la ni pā ti byo ni mā gāḥku ṭi lāḥsdi yaḥ/ /i t+yāghā te na pa bud med thur bgrod gya gyu can/ /rigs dang 'jug (kyengogs rtsang bar byed/ /ces pa'i tshig rtsub des ru ṣe lasbyo lo khā dṛ pad+ma dzā/ / ta mū tse nā tha sat+tha tra na shaṃ rmā smras pas④/ /mi bdag bu mo ngo tsha g.yos/ /des ⑤smras mgon po thams cad du/ /dogs pa bgyi bar kartu marta si/ /dṛṣ+ṭa do ṣaḥkwa tsan+darja ya di twa ma ti shaṃ ki taḥ/ /a duṣ+ṭa mi 'os so/ /gal te bud med 'ga' la skyon/ /mthong bas shin tu dogs pa khyod/ /de yi ⑥khyab pas ṇa mi rda tadh+yā byu kri ya te ka dze+e/ /twa yī ba ya di pri ti ra na n+ya sha skyon med la/ /sun 'byen 'di ni ji ltar byed/ /gal te khyod nyid la dga' zhing / /yid kyi skyabs ni ra ṇi ma naḥ/ /te na sa bye na te ṣ+pe tra me kai bha ba tu nirma lo/ /i t+yāk+ta mā gzhan med na/ /bden pa de yis khyod kyi mig /gcig ni dri ma med gyur cig /mig bzang mas ni ④tre su dṛ shā dak+ṣi ṇan+ta su lo tsa ā+oṃ/ /a nu bhā ba byut+pa t+ya pra bud+dhā ka ma lo brjod tsam las(7/ /de yi lta 67byed g.yas pa ni/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu dag /bden pa'i mthu yis byung pa oṃ/ /rā dza pu traḥpra z-isbyo tha tai pra sā r+ya su lo tsa rgo/ /a bā tsa tam+bu khaṃsgo bar gyur/ /de nas mig bzang ma de la/ /rab tu dad nas de yi bzhin/ /chu skyes mdzes sdug yon dza lā ba rgya gu ṇa bisma taḥ/ / ka spyo ṇa kā rī su bha ge e bā haṃ tan gyis/ /mtshar bskyed rab dga' rgyal bus smras/ /gang la bla ma'i tshig gis sngon/ /khyod ni rab tu 95—408

dṛ pad+ma dzaḥ/ /yasmi pu rā tī gu ru shā ba tsa sā pra ti ya di tā/ /sa e bā haṃ ya byen gyur pa/ /skal ba bzang mo rgyal po'i bu/ /dge byed de ni nga nyid yin/ /de nyid bdag yin mig di pa ram̐ nibye raḥpā ṭa ṣ+pe dṛ shoḥ/ /te na sa h+ye na na ya ā+oṃ swa dze+e bha ba tu phyung la/ /gal te nges par khon med na/ /bden pa de yis bdag gi mig /gzhan pa rnal du gnas mephopa ram̐/ /sa rkyo pa yā tsa ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ti sa ha si bā gya lo tsa rgo/ /dī tī ya ma pi bai gyur cig /ces pa'i bden pa brjod pa las/ /'phral la nyid du de yi mig /gnyis pa'ang sems dang ma l+ya ma pāp+ta sa ha tse ta sā/ / ta to be+e di ta bṛste na pu ju se lhan cig tu/ /①dri ma dag dang bral ba thob/ /de nas spyod tshul rig pa yis(37/ /sa la spyod pa ṣ+pe na byu bhu dzā/ /kṛ ta sā hā ya kaḥpā sa swa rā rdzu sa pri yā sa khaḥ/ /ka bsod nams sdes/ /stong grogs byas te rang gis srini/ /rgyal srid mdzes ma ldan des thob/ /gang spyo ṇa kā rī yaḥso haṃ de ba daṭ+wāḥs tsā nu dzaḥ/ /te na pūdrwa nu bhā be na tabe+e bye a zhig dge byed de ni nga / /nu bo de yang lha sbyin te7/ /sngon gyi mthu des da lta yang / /rnam pa dag ni byā pi brta te/ /i kyu dā ra mu pa kā ra nidz+re lo bo bye sa twa tsa ri tai ni shamya te/ /de ltar gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni/ /dri med rgya cher phan dang mi bsrun 'a7pa'i/ /bhik+ṣa baḥkha la bi tseṣ+ṭa tañtsa tabhu l+ya ma pra ti ma bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /i ti spyod tshul ngan pa thos nas dge slong rnams/ /de la mtshungs par mtshungs med ya mtshan gyur/ /ces pa k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ka l+ya dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dge ṇa kā r+ya ba dā rna dā tri shaḥpabe+e wa// //byed kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //bā māḥ sa dz+dza na bā māḥ drwa ye ṇa bha ba rnyi m+bi tsa rā gi sgo ཿ / / skye bo dam pa'i ⑥g.yon phyogs g.yon pa ⑦ rnams/ /phal cher dman la chags dang ldan par gyur/ /95—409

ti mi rorlu khā+e sa rā gā k+ṣi pa ti ra bo bhū ṅgā rā ta saṃ dh+ya/ /de mtshams ni dmar ldan mun pa mngon phyogs pa'ilha// /sa 'dzin dag las ⑤nyi ma 'phen par byed/ /skye ba dat+ta gya tsa ri ta ba hu dzad+mān+ta rā shra ye/ /ka thi te bi pu naḥs+thā ha bha ba gzhan mang la brten pa/ / lha sbyin zudag gi spyod pa ni/ /bshad kyang bcom ldan ye shes kyi/ /rgya ga bān dzñā na sā ga raḥ/ /pu rā ka ling ka bi ṣa ye dz+ra pa tiḥsha tru bhi ga krita/ /shri mtshos slar yang bka' stsal pa/ /ka ling ka yi yul du sngon/ /mi bdag dgra ni nyams byed pa/ /grangs mā na bhū da sho kā khya pra khya tā saṃ khya bi kra maḥ/ /tai su shā khāḥpra shā khabyu med rnam gnon byegrags pa can/ /dpal ldan mya ngan med ces gyur/ /de yi sras ni mtshungs pa bzhi/ /tā raḥs dṛ sha su tāḥ/ /a nu shā kho bi shā khabye t+ya bha bān bhu pi pi khru hāḥ/ /tā ru lo ma rab tu lo ma dang / /rjes su lo ma khyad par gyi/ /lo ma ⑤ sa la grags par gyur/ /lang tshos ju maṭ+wāsta pi tā sa pasbyi kāḥpa bā se tāḥ/ /sa bi kā ra ni ka re ṇa pu rgyags pa de dag rnams/ /chung mar bcas pa pha mas bskrad/ /rnam 'gyur gnod pa ldan pa yisanya/ /tre ṇa pu tre sne ho pi na sh+ya ti/ /te sha naiḥkhye ṇa pā je yā dud+ngha shā bu yis bu la byams pa'ang 'jigs⑦/ /de rnams rim gyis lam brgyags ⑧zad/ /bzod dka' gnas mi pa duḥs hūṃ/ /bi ka ṭā ma ṭa bo bra pya k+ṣuta k+ṣu māḥs ma tsin+ta yan/ /skabs ngan pa bzhin/ /nags tshal stug por phyin gyur nas/ /bkres pas nyen pas yang dag bsams/ /e tāḥste yo pi bi paṅka le gulpa ban+dha na shri kha khāḥ/ /kṛts+tsha lar+bhe tsa bhā gi n+yaḥrgud ༄kyedus bud med 'di dag kyang / /long bu 'ching 17ba'i lcags sgrog ste/ /bu yis 'bad rnyed lo ma yispeme//sbi tāḥpa sh+lau sha ṣ+pe pi naḥ/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tā mā sīta te ྾ ste ba dha zas la'ang skal ba 'dzin cing ⑫'khod/ /de ltar bsams nas de rnams kyis6rta / /bud med bsad par ni: yaḥ/ /dud+dhā shā dagha bhā gyu dzā gho ra saṃ dzā ya te ma tiḥ/ /te ྾ nges pa byas/ /skal ba gnas skabs ngan pa yis/ /bsregs la blo ni 'jigs rung skye/ /sdig pa'i 95—410

ma dh+yāji shā khartu pā pa saṃ kalpa shaṃ ki taḥ/ /bhār+yā mā dā ya kṛ pa yā pa spyo bya brtag pas 'jigs pa yi/ /khyad par lo ma de nang nas/ /brtse bas chung ma khyer nas ni/ /tha dad pra ya yo thra thaka /sā ka lad+ku da tī nā ma bye shaṃ bai kla bya mā ga ṭ+wā/ /dru rā dag tu bros te song / /skyon ldan ma zhes bya ba de/ /mchog tu rnam par 'khrugs gyur cing / /lam ring ( 1 dh+wa dh+wa ba nā shāṭ+wā mūdh+ri tā n+ya pa tabye be+e/ / ta taḥsā ka ru rjadz+re ṇa brgyugs pa'i ngal dub kyis/ /brgyal nas sa la nges par 'gyel/ /de nas de yi ḍanyasrog 'jig tshe/ /bhaspyo pā ṇa k+ṣa ya k+ṣa ṇi/ /shi rā bya dha sa mudhū ti pā yi tā ni dza sho ṇi tai/ /bdag po snying rjes brlan pa yis/ /spyi bo phug pa las byung ḍa7ba/ /rang gi khrag ni 'thung du bcug /tai rak+ta pā na saṃ prabe+e dz+re bi hūṃ sa twa sā ga raḥ/ /swāṅgadz+reḥkṛ t+ya rmā se khrag 'thungs ④ 'tsho ba thob gyur tekhye/ /snying stobs rgya mtshos rang nyid kyi/ /yan lag nges par bcad na pā ṇa bṛtrī ma kā ra yata / /ni dz+dza yi sgo ra kān+t+ra re sa mudhī r+ya pa yi/ /sha yis srog ni brten par byasakhye/ /chu med 'jigs ⑦rung dgon pa dag /rim gyes bsgral kra me na to/ /pratshwa ya pā da pa shā mo prasto gi ri na dī ta ṭi/ /bi shān+ta nas de dag gis⑧/ /shing gi grib mchog sngo bsangs can/ /ri yi klung gi ngogs su sleb/ /de dag der yosta yosta tra kṛt+ta pā da ka ro na raḥ/ /tī zwa krāṭī na dī be+e ge no bye ni ngal gso ⑨tshe/ /rkang lag bcad pa'i mi zhig ni/ /chu bo mgyogs pas khyer bzhin du/ /cho nge drag mā naḥs mā ya yo/ /dṛbye ba ka ru shā sh+lau ṣ+ṭaḥkaṣ+ṭi be+e sa dmā shi ta/ /pos 'debs shing byung / /'o brgyal 'phangs ⑫pa la brten de/ /mthong ba nyid ni tu7snying rjes 'khyud/ /be+e gā hra sa ri tī dodzñā bi shā khasta ma tā ra yata/ /ta taḥpra t+yā ga ta pā khaṃ khyad par lo ma chur zhugs nas/ /dpung pa dag gis thar par byas/ /de nas chu dang rtsa ba dang / /to ya mū la pha la di bheḥ/ /sa tai tsakre di ṣ+pe re ba saṃ rū shwe ts+tsha da nirgya 'bras bu dag gis srog slar byung / /nyi ma 'ga' yis bcad pa gsos⑫/ /de yis de ni gdungs ⑫med 95—411

baṃ / /swas+thā pi ga ti bai ka spyon be+e ba gabye kwa tsita k+ṣa maḥ/ /sa tosbo byas—/ /gsos ①kyang bgrod pa ma tshang bas/ /gang du yang ni 'gro ma nus/ /der (kyini der gnas ta tra tat+pa tū kā le ka li ta sgo dza naḥ/ /rā dza pu trastu dzā yā yā ma bhūju ra la dus su ni/ /de yi chung ma snyibaza' ba ster/ /rgyal po'i bu ni chung ma la/ /yang dag 'grogs pa nyung saṅga maḥ/ /sau hālpa ra ta yaḥshu rāḥpā ye ṇa bi dze+e gi ṣā baḥ/ /di byo ṣa bye bar grur/ /phal cher rgyal 'dod dpa' bo ni/ /seng ge bzhin du 'khrig pa nyung / /dal byis sman ra sā hā ra ba ri pūṇ+ḍi ta nuḥsha naiḥ/ /tat+pasnri bi ka khā yāsmi tsa kā mchog ro dang ni④/ /zas kyi lus ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /nyams gyur de dang de yi ni/ /chung mas 'khrig ra su ra ta smṛ hūṃ/ /ste he na no pa le pyarnye na ba dh+yadhe gu ṇi na tsa/ /go re la chags par byas/ /mdza' ba'i snum gyis ma byugs shing / /yon tan srad bus ma bcings la/ /rjes ⑤be na tsa sadz+dzarnyi swets+tsha spar+sha su khaḥste yaḥ/ /sa te na ni shi niḥshasde ra ma bla mas ma smad pa/ /bud med rang 'dod med spyopas bde/ /mtshan mo sgra med nu rgyas ma/ /de ni de mā ṇa gha na sta m+bi/ /niḥshaṃ ku su ra tā tre bhā ba two bi sgo ma ma n+ya ta/ /dang rol ba na/ /dogs med 'khrig pas ma tshims ⑦par/ /bdag po gegs ⑧su gyur par bsams/ /sa pa kyuḥswe ri dhī te na bi da dhe ba dha sam+bi rda/ /pā pe 6 shik+ṣu ku sha de nas ⑪bdag po g.yem ma des/ /gsad ⑪ pa'i gros ni byas par 'gyur⑪/ /sdig pa dag la bslab khā ka lu ṣāḥki la yo ṣi taḥ/ /swa shi raḥbyu la ma tu lo ba daṭī swa gya mkhas pa/ /bud med sdog pa can rnams lo/ /rang gi mgo bo mtshungs med ni/ /na bar ston ⑫cing sgra sa swa nā/ /tsa kre li khi ta pā pā gya la lā ṭi paṣ+ṭa brnya ram̐/ /ta gya shi ro ldan des/ /dpral bar sdig pa bris pa bzhin/ /ras kyi 'dab mas bcings pa spyobyas/ /de yi mgo yi ru dzā tī bye byati taḥpābe+e bāt+pa dzaḥ/ /kā ru rgya t+ta t+tha tī kā re tsā tsā nad kyis ni/ /rtag ⑫tu gdungs pas spyos bdag sras/ /snying rjes de slar bcos pa yis/ /rig ⑫pa 95—412

byu na mu pa de shaḥkṛ twa na yā/ /durbi zlo ya pra ta ta ma ti bhiḥswasna saṃ kalpa pa la/ /'di yis gdams ngag byas min nam/ /rab rgyas blo yis rtogs par ①dka' zhing rmi lam kun kaspra rā ga dī ṣa bya sa na bi ṣa mā yā sa bi sde sa salnga ཿ / /rtog dang mtshungs la/ /chags dang sdang ba'i gdung ba mi bzad nyon mongs rnam par 'god ⑤la chags/ /kā māṭ+wā mi sa ka la dza na tā mo ha ā+oṃ saṃ pra bṛṭ+wāḥpā tā ma ba k+ṣa ṇa pa ri tsi nges par 'dod pa las ni skye bo mtha' dag rmongs par rab 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma bud med dag ni skad cig ta snga pi mā yāḥspyo yābyu/ /i ti saṃ tsid+dhā yan+de ba na dī pe ge na khyu ya sā/ /yongs su 'dris pa'ang ltung bar byed/ /de ltar nges par sems byed cing / /shin tu che ba'i chu yi rgyun/ /pā si taḥsu kṛ te ṣ+pe ba sa pu rī puṣ+ka rā ba ṭī/ /tasmin+da ba sa re ta tra niḥpu legs byas lta bu'i ①grong khyer ni/ /pu skar can du de yis phyin/ /gnas skabs de yi tshe na der/ /mi tre dṛ ba to mṛ te/ /ni mit+ta dzhaid+ma hā mā h+ye spyo tī taḥ sa su lak+ṣa bdag sras med nongs gyur pa'i/ /blon po chen po mtshan mkhan gyis/ /mtshan bzang ldan pa de bzung ṇaḥ / /a bhe ṣik+taḥs testa tra bi bye bad+maṅga lo da kaiḥ/ /a byuju bā ha bi gyur—/ /de dag gis de cho ga bzhin/ /bkra shis chu yis de rngu dbang bskur/ /rmad byung bud med spyod dī ṭī dṛṣ+ṭa sdi tsa ri tārtse taḥ/ /ka lo ka ba t+ya pi gi ro bo bye sa twa bi mthong bas/ /bag ma len la sdang bar gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑤spangs pa yis/ /ri la sman ni brdzi te/ /man+da bīrdzu ṣa byeḥkā la dṛt+ta ts+tsha dā ku khā bha bta/ /skan+dhe bhasnaṅga nus pa zhan/ /dus su skyon ldan ma dag kyang / /'tsho ba chad pas 'khrugs par gyur/ /grong dang grong mā ro bya sā gā ma pu ra ba ṭ+wā su/ / dza dz+wa pa ti bra tā smre ti gi khyer lam du des/ /phrag la yan lag nyams pa bkod/ /bdag po'i brtul zhugs ldan tshig gis/ /skye rā t+tak+ṣa ma yā tsa ta/ /pa ti bra ta go ra be+e ṇa sadze+esta sri da do ba hu/ /bo rnams la bsod snyoms bslangs/ /bdag po'i brtul zhugs la gus pas/ /kun byus de la mang du byin/ /95—414

mi byā shi la pra ba do pi pū ti bi pa di sadza rda/ /a ṭas+t+ri sa sha be+eḥpādzñā log pa'i tshul khrims brjod pas kyang / /rgud pa la ni 'byor pa bskyed/ /dag byed kun gyi ①phyag 'tshal na ga rī puṣ+ka ra ba ti/ /sa tī ti be+en+da tā sabye sgo pa dā radhi ke ya yo/ /ma—/ /de yis dal bus bskor zhing phyin/ /grong khyer pu skar can du ni/ /mi bdag sgo dang nye bar song / /rā dzā sdi thrat+ta bi dz+wa ྾ ban+da te tu pa ti pra tai/ /i ti saṃ tsadh+yā tata rgyal po bud med spyod la sdang / /bdag khrims ldan la phyag 'tshal 'gyur/ /zhes bsams de la gus pa yi2//bhasgyu dṛ paṃ pra ha pu ro ti taḥ/ /dru ra de shān+ta rā de ba pābhā kā pi pa mdun na 'don gyis rgyal la smras/ /lha gcig ①yul gzhan ring po nas/ /bdag po'i khrims ldan su ti pra tā/ /ya ye yi tsa ra ṇa t+yā me+esgo ta ṅgā ṭī pa bi tri tā/ /de ba zhig 'ongs/ /gang zhig rkang pa bkod pa yis/ /'byung po'i yum ni ④dag par byed/ /lha gcig pa sh+ya hūṃ sā dhī skan+t+ra ro pi ta bhaj-i rmā/ /pa ti bra ta pra rja me na bdag po phrag bkod pa'i/ /gtsang ma de la gzigs par mdzod/ /bdag khrims ldan la rab btud nas/ /sum̐ sā mā yube+e parta te/ /dṛ paḥpu ro hi te ṣ+pe ti ta྾ dar+sha na mabe+e skyes pa rnams ni ⑤tshe 'phel 'gyur/ /de skad mdun na 'don gyis de/ / blta bar zhus (nyapa'i mi bdag taḥ—/ /ta mu bā tsa na dzā dī ṣe zwah+ma ṇa sa ra lo bha bān/ /sdid+dhāsdi ti pra bā gis—/ /de la smras pa bram ze dag /drang po khyod kyis yongs ⑦mi shes/ /bud med mdza' zhes 'di do yo nirgyu dze ti ma ti bh+ra maḥ/ /sa tī nyi byo ma pun+d+ra bhe pā pā byā ti rab grags/ /zol med ces pa blo gros 'khrul/ /gtsang zhes mkha' yi me tog job/ /bud med sdig nā saṃ sha yaḥ/ /niphe lngabyam+bi ro hi sgoḥs ra khā dza na saṅga me/ /nārlo be ta ces the tshom med/ /'bras bu med cing bcad la skye/ /skye bo 'grogs la drang por 'gyur/ /'byel pa rtsa sa bal+lar+ya i ba nirmu la ban+t+ra naḥ/ /bhe da dro hai ka shī lā bh+yo duḥshī med bud med ni/ /be ta sa yi 'khri shing bzhin/ /'byed 'khu gcig po'i 37tshul khrims can/ /rang 95byed415

khā bh+yaḥ swa bhā ba taḥ/ /na maḥrgyu bh+yo na maḥbyā bh+yo na maḥbyā bh+yo na mo bzhin nyid kyis tshul khrims 'chal/ /bud med la 'dud bud med 'dud/ /bud med la 'dud 'dud do na maḥ/ /dṛṣ+ṭa ṭ+wā z-it+ta do ṣā ya tañtsid+dhā bya thi tāt+pa ṣ+pe/ /a gye 'dud—/ /bud med spyod tshul skyon kye7mthong ba/ /de bsams snyegadung ba'i bdag nyid can/ /bdag ni ṣa thra thi bī mya hūṃ rat+na pūṇ+ḍi na ro tsa te / / na ga mṛ ga ba dhū rin cen gyis gang ba'i/ /sa gzhi 'di la'ang yongs (7mi srid/ /ri yi ri dwags chung ma ltar rmongs pha mud+dhā d+dhā ṣ+ṭhaḥpa ram̐ pa ra pañtsaṣ+pe ta nu bi ta ra ṇi sāgh+raḥsum̐ sī ha rarnyi tsa dz+re bi tai/ /da rol bslu chol mchog tu sgrin/ /lus ni rnam par sbyin la chags shing skyes bu rnams kyi srog kyang 'phrog /me pa ti tsa bha yo pubye yā te bi sharnyi tsa sā ba kai sa ra la ku ṭi lā ṣ+pe ba tog lhung la 'jigs par byed cing ma choyi nang du'ang rnam par 'jug /drang zhing gya gyu bud med rnams dzñā tā bi tsā ra sha tai ste yaḥ/ /ta tha bi ya di nirba n+dasta ba pa shā mi tsā pri yo/ /ni rnam par dpyad pa brgyas spyimi shes/ /de lta na yang gal te khyod/ /'bad na bud med de blta ⑦bya/ /i h+phughā harmya mā ru khya tī da dar+sha na re shwa raḥ/ /tā me ba sa pa ri dzñā ya zhes brjod mi yi dbang po yis/ /yang thog 'dzegs nas de la bltas/ /yan lag bcad pa'i grogs ldan pā r+pā kṛhūṃ ga sasgo dzā/ /sa tsi be+e bh+yaḥk+ṣi ti pa ti staj-it+ta haṃ n+ya be+e da ma—/ /sdig can ma de yongs shes nas/ /blon po rnams la sa bdag des/ /de yi spyod mtha' nges par yata—/ /dṛ paṃ sā bi pa ri dzñā ya pā pā k+ṣa ṇa ma dho mu khā+e/ /ni rastu pra ya yo bshad—/ /des kyang mi bdag yongs shes nas/ /skad cig gdong dud sdig can ma/ /skye bo rna ba bsgribs tūṇ+ḍi bi hi ta shra ba be+erdza naiḥ/ /bi shā kha nā mā na ra nā tha sru nuḥso haṃ ba dhuḥsā gya rnams kyis/ /myur du bskrad de rab tu song / /khyad par lo ma zhes pa'i mi dbang sras/ /de bdag de yi chung tsa de ba dat+taḥ/ /khru two ti thrat+ta ka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na byek+ṣu pra dza stastso ri tai ni nin+da/ /ma de lha sbyin5/ /zhes pa'i byung tshul rgyal bas bshad jos nas/ /dge slong rnams (kyekyis de yi spyod pa smad//95—416

i tik+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī bi ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa hushedapag bsam gyi 'khri shing shā khā ba dā 8 dra ya dhī shaḥpal+la waḥ// //las khyad par lo ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i 5yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //sa ko pi pu rgya pra sha mā nu bhā baḥshud+dhāt+pa nā masgyu mṛ ta swa bhā baḥ/ /ya bsod nams rab zhi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin mthu/ /de ni dag pa'i bdag la ci yang yod/ /gang gya pra bhā be+e nā bha brnyi sa r+yaḥspyu ra i pi kro dha bi ṣa pra mughāḥ/ /pu rā ta thā ga gi mthu yis ma rungs pa rnams kyang / /'phral la khro ba'i dug ni rab tu gtong / /de bzhin gshegs pa te dze ta ba nā rā mā bi hā ri ṇi/ / ta dā dzñā yā bhi 6 ga ṇi gi ri rgyal byed tshal/ /kun dga' ra bar sngon bzhugs sha17shing / /de yi bka' yis dge slong tshogs/ /ri kā na na tsā ri ṇi/ /su me ru pa ri ṣaṇ+ḍa yī sbi tā dh+yā na pa rā ya ṇaḥ/ /ā dang nags la rgyu ba'i tshe/ /ri rab lhun po'i ngos la ni/ /'dug nas bsam gtan skyong byed pa/ /dge ya yustik+ṣa baḥpaṇ+ḍa bi ts+tsha ya ba da nāḥkṛ shāḥ/ /te tha kṛ tā bha ga ba taḥslong nyam chung bzhin ras ni/ /mdzes bral skya d+nghabo rnam dag 'ong snye/ /de nas bcom ldan zhabs pad la/ /pā da pad+mā bhi nan+da rmā/ /spru tsi re bhik+ṣa bhiḥpriṣ+ṭa de ha dorba l+ya kā ra mngon par phyag 'tshal de dag gis/ /lus ni nyams rtsal chung ba'i rgyu/ /dge slong rnams kyis dris nas khaṃ—/ /su me sum̐ tri gu shā dṛ t+yā be+eṣ+ṭa yi tā bya ba sbi to/ /a dṛ stso smras—/ /mkha' lding gis kyang gzhom dka' ba'i/ /klu ni dga' bo nyer ('udaga' dag /lhun po la ni bai na te ya gya nā go nosdo ba nan+da kau/ /to sa dā tri be+e sngodzñā saṃ mṛ lan gsum du/ /bskor cing ḍapebacings nas rnam par gnas/ /de dag rtag tu dug gi dbugs/ /me dza taḥtīṇ+ḍi sā ba shaṃ/ /bha brnyi bhasma spasgo na sa ha so ba shi khā a pi/ /yis rgyas pa lan gsum khro/ /reg pas (nya rdo ba rnams po7dag kyang / /'phral ⑩la nyid du thal bar byed/ /95—417

— — —— byed——— ——byedab yan+ta dz+re ṣa be+e shā me+em+bi da d+dhā dh+yā na yo gi naḥ/ /bi baṇ+ḍi ba da nasgo de yi dug gi dbugs kyis ni/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba bdag cag bsregs/ /bzhin mdzes kha dog bral yāḥkai ba lam̐ kṛ sha hūṃ ga tā ཿ / /i nyi taiḥ ka thi te shastu bhi gru si ba dang / /rid pa 'ba' zhig nyid du gyur/ /ces de ①bshad tshe dge slong gi/ /tshogs kyi mdun ghārji taḥpu raḥ/ /nā ga yorda ma ṣ+pe yo gyi moṅga spyo ya na mā di shata/ /sa su me sum̐ bzhugs rnguston pa yis/ /klu dag ①'dul ba la 'os par/ /mod gal gyi bu la bstan/ /sbyor bas mi sa mā sā r+ya shrime+e rā li ṅga hūṃ sba ram̐/ / su sto da dar+sha nā gi jo yo snang dbyebs can des/ /lhog gis mkha' la 'khyud pa yi/ /ri rab lhun por yang dag phyin/ /klu ge nān+tarti tā 1 tiḥ/ /bo dh+ya ma kau sha ṣ+peste na bu bu dh+wa te ya dā na to/ /ta dā dbang dag ni nyal ba ④mthong / /de yis dal bus bslang ba las/ /gang tshe de dag ma sad pa/ /de tshe ma hā nā ga ba puspyo tā sa sa ma be+e ṣ+ṭa yata/ / pra busgo sī ḍi to te de ni 2klu chen gyi/ /lus su gyur nas yang dag bcings/ /de yis bsdams pas rab sad de/ /na dṛ ṭī d+dhā ṣa shā kri ti/ / bi dru to na ra rū pa ṇi ta s+tha tur+bha 'jigs rung dbyibs de mthong gyur nas/ /'jigs pas rnam par 'khrugs gyur te/ /mi yi gzugs ya bi hwa lo/ /nā ga rū pa pa ri t+ya bye kṛ tā byu paṃ swa ko ta taḥ/ /pa lā ya mā kyis rab tu bros/ /de nas phan tshun 'bros byed pa/ /de la mo gal gyebyi bus/ /klu yi gzugs ni nā ba byo n+ya to moṅga spyo ya kau ba data/ /nā go kwa ga mya te byuṇ+ḍi bha yo yongs btang nas/ /rang gi gzugs su byas te smras/ /klu dag mgyogs par gang du 'gro/ /'jigs saṃ t+ya dza tā mi rda/ /na sa nā gaḥsbi ta sta tra ye na bi dra bi to yu r+pā/ /sasba pa 'di ni yang dag thong / /gang gis khyed cag 'jigs byed pa'i/ /klu de de na mi gnas so/ /de yi thā ya di nāste pa tabye ya ta yu ba yodh+ri tiḥ/ /kṛ ya te ki ka ra ju su 'jigs pas gal te khyod/ /rnam kun brtan pa med nyid na/ /skyabs su 'os pa sangs rgyas la/ /95—418

shri mān pā razla sde na re shwa raḥ/ /kā shā pā khyubye ga ba taḥpāp+ta bān dhadz+re shā sa rna//dpal ldan kṛ ki zhes pa sngon/ /bcom ldan 'od srungs zhes pa las/ /chos kyi bstan pa thob par gyur/ /a mā t+ya yoḥs bi t+yā su rārdzu nasdo pa nan+da yoḥ/ /ba bhū ba bo bye saṃ sak+taḥde yi lho)blon po dga' bo dang / /nye dga' dag la rgyal srid gtad/ /byang chub la ni yang dag chags/ /sa t+ya dar+sha ṣ+pe nidṛ taḥ/ /dharmā dhadz+re ma yi rā rdzu kṛ tā to ta su marnyi bden pa mthong la dga' bar gyur/ /de yi blon khyedes rgyal srid ni/ /chos dang chos min reja bzhin r+ṇa / /sasbo ba ka ra ṇirlus+ho bi hā rja kā sh+ya pā ya tsa/ /kā le na dzā dang / /'od srungs la yang gtsug lag khang / /yo byad kun dang ldan par (kyebyas/ /dus kyis 'di dag to nā gebye be+e to nasdo pa na sdo kau/ / bi hā rādze+e ṇa bye na pa rda dga' bo dang / /nye dga' klu yi dbang por skyes/ /gtsug lag khang phul bsod nams kyithu/ /lhun po me ru byu j-it+ta yo/ /i ti dzi na ni gā di ta pha ṇi ba ra tsa ri tai pa ra ta sa 'dzin de yi gnas/ /de ltar gdengs can mchog gi spyod pa lus gzhan dag /yongs grur legs spyod kezhe(nu pa ri ṇa ti pa ri tsi ta su kṛ tai/ /shu ta ba ti sha ma na ya mu ni pa ri ni ba he yongs 'dris rgyal bas gsungs pa dag /zhi ba'i tshul ldan thub mchog tshogs kyis thos gyur te/ /dug bi ṣa dha ra ni ya ma na gu ṇa nu ti ru di bhūta/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye 'dzin nges par zhi ba ḍūsnayon tan bstod par gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī na sdo pa na n+d+ra ba dā 8 tsa tu sto sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dga' bo nye dga'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal shaḥpal+la waḥ// //'dab ste sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //dat+taḥpa ra hi ta bhā ba na yā ya di ta nu dha na ka ṇa she ṣaḥ/ /a gang zhig nor gyi cha shas chung ngu'i lhag /gzhan la phan par bsgoms pas byin gyur pa⑦/ /yon 95—420

pa ri k+ṣa ya gu ṇa kalpa na ya bha ba ti su pu ju bi she ṣaḥ/ /a thā bya tī te tan brtag pa yongs su mi zad pas/ /bsod nams de ni khyad par gyur pa yin/ /de nas 'ga' zhig kasmirmya ta kā le bha ga ba tophornyi ke/ /nasdo pa nan+da yor+bhan+d+ra de sha nā yī sho tu 'das dus na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du ni/ /chos ston pa la dga' bo dang / /nye dga' nyan dumābe+e yoḥ/ /rā dzā pra se na dzi dz+rabye bha ga ban+ta mu pā ga taḥ/ /ta sgyu ma kṛ 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan la/ /blta ba'i slad du nye bar 'ongs/ /de dag gis ni ta saṭ+wā ra pra ṇa ma ko sa mā ya yo/ /sa pra ṇa mya dzi dz+wa ga tā pra da bsnyen bkur ①dang / /phyag ma byas pas thos thupar gyur/ /rgyal la phyag 'tshal de song nas/ /de dag sgo ni gra haṃ ta yoḥ/ /shan+t+ra dṛṣ+ṭi saṃ mṛ dza taste tsa tasmi bye : ga to/ /chad pas gcad zhupar bsams/ /de dag gis kyang mkhar song ste/ /de la mtshon gyi char pa phab/ /san+d+ra dzha pre ṣi tasgruṇ+ḍi moṅga spyo ya naḥpra t+ya hūṃ/ /shan+t+ra dṛtrī na ra pa te kun mkhyen byis bskul mgyogs par ni/ / mo gal khyogyi bu song nas/ /mi bdag gi ni mtshon char de/ /byakre pad+mot+pa khā pa lo/ /pu nargatā bha ga ba taḥs m+bi baṃ thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /pad+ma ⑤ut+pal phreng bar byas/ /slar yang sa yi bdag po yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin/ /saṃ pāsto k+ṣa mā ya mā sa ta dā de shāta pa bhā shwa ro/ /a thābe+e taḥsābe+e gdengs can dbang po 'ongs pa la/ /de yi bka' yis bzod gsol byas/ /de nas sa bdag gis be+e na bha ga bān rā dzā man+di ram̐/ / bhas+ho pū tai ya yo sgohūṃ bhas+ho gsol te/ /rgyal po'i khang par bcom ldan 'das/ /dge slong tshogs bcas gus pa yis/ /gtsang ma'i bhik+ṣu ga ṇiḥs haḥ/ /bhazlu 6 pa tsu mā ṣ+pe 6 rā tre ta tāsni bi be+e paḥ/ /bshos ni gsol du gshegs/ /kha zas 'tshed par byed tshe der/ /mtshan mo me yi khyanyer 'tshe skyes/ /dzā to dzi na pra bhā be+e na sa ha sā shārnyi mā ya yo/ /byughā ga ti bha ga ba ti k+ṣi 'phral la rgyal ba'i mthu yis ni/ /rab tu zhi ba nyid du gyur/ /bcom ldan gsol nas gshegs pa'i tshe/ /95—421

ti sāḥswa su rephobh+ya dh+wata/ /dz+wa la na dz+wa le na rā tro bā ra khaṃ daṇ+ḍa saṃ bi dā/ /rang gi grong du sa bdag gis/ /mtshan mo me ni ⑨ 'bar ba la/ /chad pa'i gros kyis dgag pa smras/ /a tān+ta re kṛ ha pa tiḥsu dat+ta sngad+ma dzo yu bā/ /mi byā do ṣādh+ri dhi ba lo skabs der khyim bdag legs sbyin gyizhu/ /bu ni rdzu 'phrul stobs zhes rngupa/ /lang tsho ldan pa rdzun skyon nā ma rā dzñā bye ga ti taḥ / /pūdze+e bha ga ba taḥshāstuḥshā sa nā nu gyis—/ /rgyal po yis ni mngon par bsad/ /sngon du bcom ldan ston pa yis④/ /bstan pa rjes su gra he na saḥ/ /la bye dzñā na dh+ri ti pu tra duḥkhe gya r+pā da duḥkhi taḥ/ /a pu tra swa bzung bas de/ /ye shes brtan thob bu yi ni/ /sdug bsngal gyis kyang sdug min gyur/ /bu spyomed rang gi dha rna byu ri dī ṣ+pe bh+yaḥpra ti pā r+ya saḥ/ /tsa kā rā ti ra sā de ka pa ṇa she ṣe nor mang po/ /bkren pa rnams la des rab byin/ /shin tu chags las )dal bus dpal/ /pa na sha ṣ+peḥshri yaḥ/ /pa ṇa lā bha kṛ tā she ṣa dharmaḥswalpa pra do tha saḥ/ /a bhūsgri gcig gi lhag mar byas/ /de nas pa na'i rnyed pas chos/ /ma lus chung ngu byin nas byas/ /de ni khyim ha su daṭ+wā khyo kṛ haṃ hi swalpa mu tsu te/ / ka dā tsidrwar+sha nā yā tai bha legs ster zhes lhigyur/ /khyim na rngushin tu chung ngur brjod/ /nam zhig blta ⑨ba la 'ongs shing / /ga bān pu ra taḥsbi tai/ /tai swalpa dā na nāsne ba lalja tai da ya yāphob data/ /mdun 'khod chung ngu kwa/ sbyin pa yi/ /ming gis ngo tshar rdokhyer+shagyur de la/ /bcom ldan brtse bas bka' stsal pa/ /alpa dā nasgo ha pa te na ladz+dza kartumarta si/ /yā ti shrad+dhābe+e to dā na khyim bdag sbyin 4—pa chung ngu la/ /ngo tsha bgyi bar mi 'os so/ /dad pas sbyin pa byin ⑫pa'i zigs/ /ka ṇaḥka na ka shi la hūṃ/ /pu rā ba hu ta re trī be la me na dri dzad+ma nā/ /gser gyi ri bo mtshungs par gyur/ /sngon tshe gnyis skyes be la mas/ /shin tu mang ba rab tu byin/ /shrasgye bi ra ha sā mā t+yān+da ta thā dṛrnyi ma ya yo/ /yaḥsabaṃ sgo dza ye dad pa dang bral thun mong bas/ /de bzhin du ni 'phel ma ⑫gyur/ /su zhig 'dzam gling gtogs pa yis⑫/ /95—422

bha s+thā dze+e bu dī pa ga tai dza ā+oṃ/ /yabye kai bo dhi saṃ yulte ta gya pu bye ta tolha bye rka/ /'gro kun gus pas gsol byed dang / /su zhig byang chub ldan zhig (tel/ /de yi bsod nams de bas lhag /i ti bā kyi bha ga ba ta sta bye shu tā bi na bye tsa/ / ni dza ge haṃ ces pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /bden pa thos nas mngon dga' zhing / /de la phyag 'tshal kṛ ha pa tiḥpra ya yo pra ṇi pa t+ya tai/ /dī paṃ da tā pa ṭha na rā treta tra khyim bdag ni/ /rang gi khang par rab tu song / /mtshan mo mar me btang nas der/ /bcom ldan rjes bud+dhā nu shā sa dzñā/ /dāṇ+ḍa ya rā dza pu ru ṣeḥs m+bi tophoghi pra brta nāta/ /daṇ+ḍa bstan klog pa na/ /me ni rab bsgrubs chad pa'i slad/ /de ni rgyal po'i skyes bus bzung / /chad pa'i gya sam+bha bāta pasgo brnya nā gā ra batrī ā+oṃ/ / ta dṛngh+ru mā ya yu de bā dngos po med pa 'u na/ /btson khang dag tu bzhag ste (snye bcings/ /mtshan mo brgya byen tshangs pa krusogs/ /rā tre shakra brad+mā da yaḥ/ /sa tair+bha rna kṛ hā be+e ti prabe+e to nā gra hād+ma dā/ /lha rnams de la blta 'uru 'ongs/ /de dag gis gsol nor long zhes/ /gang tshe de yis ma blangs pa/ /ta dā dhasgro pa de shā yo pra thrar+ghaṃ ta gya man+di ye/ /rā dzā pi tat+tha bhā be+e na de tshe de yi khang par ni/ /chos bstan pa las bsags pa 'phel/ /de yi mthu yis rgyal pos kyang / /dṛṭ+wā bra dzā li tai pu ram̐/ /mulnga tai ban+ta nā gā rān+da da dar+sha na lo kwa tsita/ /grong khyer rab tu 'bar mthong nas/ /btson ra nas ni de btang tshe/ /gang du'ang me ni mthong ma gyur/ /sa ga taḥsu ga tai dṛhūṃ ka dā tsit+tah+phu raḥsbi taḥ/ /dṛ baṃ dzi na pra shā mā ya nam zhig bde gshegs blta ⑥ru ni/ /phyin nas de mdun 'khod pa des/ /mi bdag rgyal la phyag 'tshal pāp+ta pa rtswa bye lo ka ya ta / /a gre bha ga ba ta :kre pra ṇa yo na sa slad—/ /phyi ⑦nas 'ongs pa mthong bar gyur/ /de yi 'asngon du bcom ldan la/ /phyag byas sa yi bdag byu teḥ/ /dza gah+phu bye su pu ra taḥpū dza marta ti nā pa raḥ/ /dzi na ma mabye la min/ /'gro bas mchod 'os sngon du ni/ /gzhan la mchod par 'os pa min⑨// /mi bdag rgyal la 95—423

dṛ ba tiḥpra ṇa taḥswa pu raṅga taḥ/ /bi bā pa dze+e kṛ ha pa te rā di de rab btud nas①/ /rang gi grong khyer dag tu song / /khyim bdag rang gi grong khyer las/ /gzhan du sha ni dzāta pu rāta/ /pra sā di ni su dat+ta su de ba tā dṛ ba sto ta taḥ/ /sprugs zhes 37bka' yis bsgos/ /de nas legs sbyin dag la lha/ /rab tu dang bas mi bdag la/ /k+ṣu dra dzan+tu bhi rusmṛṣ+ṭibyakre rda sha be+e ṣā ku lo/ /sa trastastej-i paḥpābe+eḥsrog chags phra mo rab spros tegru/ /so yi dug gis 'khrugs par byas/ /de dag gis btab mi bdag de/ /sā mā t+yan+taḥpu rā nu gaḥ/ /ga tā pra sā da yā mā sa su dar+ghaṃ dzi na shā sa blon po btsun mo'i rjes 'brang mebacas/ /phyin nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa las/ /legs sbyin la ni dad nāta / /i ti sa sa ta ta pra t+yā sadh+yā pa rā mṛ ta nisgo ram̐ bha ga ba du di tai par byas/ /de ltar rtag tu nye bar gnas pas /ltamachog gi bdud rtsi dag gi tshogs/ /khyim gyi bdag po legs shīrnyi ste dze su dat+ta kṛ hā dhi paḥ/ /swa mi ba la bha te bisna yā sa pra yā sbyin de yis bcom ldan gyis gsungs zhi ba bsten/ /dri med yid ldan rnams kyi mtha' ru gnas pas dben sa bi brje tai bi ma la ma na sā marnye bā sbo bi be+e ka ma hā ni bye ma/ /pa'i gter chen ni/ /rang gi bzhin du gegs 67dang nyon mongs ngal dub rnam par spangs pas 'thob/ /i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yo ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing kṛ ha pa ti su daṭ+wā ba dā dz+wa pañtsa tri shaḥpal+la waḥ// //las khyim bdag legs sbyin kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //pha lo sa mā rna la bha ta sa dā tur+yā ti k+ṣa ṇa dā na sa hā ya tai yaḥ/ /sbyin pa'i grogs su skad cig su gyur pa/ /de dag sbyin bdag 'bras bu mtshungs pa 'thob/ /pa ro pa kā ra pra ṇa yor+ya tā rna nā pu bye karmā sa tsi ba twa me ti/ /gzhan la phan par brtson par zhugs rnams kyispyi/ /grogs su bsod nams las med mi 'gyur ro/ /95—424

rā bye pu rā bha ga ba te shra ba hūṃ dze ta kā na ṣ+pe/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa dā rā bcom ldan rgyal ba mnyan yod kyi/ /rgyal byed tshal ni dga' bar sngon/ /mgon med zas sbyin gtsug ma bi hā rā bye ra ti dzi ṣ+pe/ /kau shām bye bat+pa dṛ pa tirba khyu bo da ya lag khang / /kun dga' ra bar mngon 47dgyes tshe/ /rka shām bir /37 bad sa yi/ /mi bdag 'char byed nā bhi dhaḥ/ /gā ya byu t+yā yatrīr+ghaṃ bi byā dha ra ba dhu dza naḥ/ /a bha ces pa byung / /rig 'dzin bu mo'i skye ba rnguyis/ /da lta'ang gang gis (chogrags pa sgrogs/ /de yi babe+eṣa ye ta gya kas+thān+ta ka ra dz+re ba naḥ/ /kṛ ha sāḥsu dha no nā ma yul du khyim pa ni/ /las mtha'i 'byung gnas kyis 'tsho ba/ /nor bzang zhes bya nor dag ni/ /sgrub la dha ā+oṃ dh+wa na bi tsak+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /dṛ paḥka dā tsi dā s+thā ṣ+pe tai kāt+yābe+e na mā ga tai/ /rnam par mkhas par gyur/ /nam zhig bya ba don gnyer zhing / /mdun 'usar 'ongs pa mi bdag gis/ /ba tsa se ba pa ri dzñā ya dza gā da bi hi tā da raḥ/ /dzā nā mya haṃ kṛ ha pa te hūṃ tshig nyid kyis ni yongs shes nas/ /gus pa bskyed de de la smras/ /khyim bdag gser ni yongs bsags hi ra stso pa tsita swa ram̐/ /bi pu laḥpañtsa ya dzha gya su ba ṇ+ḍi ni bye pa—/ /khyod kyi dbyangs ni bdag gis shes/ /gsog ⑥pa shes pa khyod la ni/ /gser gyi gter chen raste te/ /i t+yāk+taḥs smi lta rā dzñā sa ta mū tse kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /sa t+ya maste yangs pa yod/ /rgyal pos 'dzum bcas 'di brjod tshe/ /de la thal sbyar des smras pa/ /rgyal po bdag ba me rā dzan kṛ he kāñtsa na sañtsa yaḥ/ /sabye t+ta tsid+dhā ni ra te de be gi khyim na gser/ /bsags pa bden par yod pa nyid/ /mnyes gshin yangs pa dam pa yi/ /spyod bāt+pa l+ya pe sha le/ /kis+thā nāste dza na snga su pi ta ri twa yi gop+ta ri/ /dha ni no yārmya tshul bsam pa la chags lha/ /yab khyod kyis ni bsrungs pa yi/ /skye bo 'di la ci zhig med/ /gal te mi dha na tī ni dha rna yārnyi tsā dha nāḥ / / byā gh+ra hūṃ yā ti tsebye j-i dā bdag brtse ba med/ /zang zing la snom stag ltar 'gyur⑩/ /nor ldan rnams ni nor med 'gyur/ /95—425

mi ṣā s+thā ṇa nij-i ṇaḥ/ /ni shaṃ kai rardzu te bit+ta mardzi tañtsa bi bha bye te/ /nor med rnams ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mi bdag chos kyi nor ldan na/ /dogs pa med pas ①skye bo rnams/ /bi bha s+ho bhu bye te spa ṣ+ṭi dza ṣ+pe r+bha n+d+ra dha ṣ+pe dṛ bai / / u pa pa rja nor bsgrub (37bsgrubs pa'ang 'god byed cing / /bgos pa gsal bar longs spyod byed/ /blo ldan de yi snyeb tsaḥshu tā dhī ma tasta su bhu pa tiḥ/ /ta mū tse da sha no bye tiḥpra sa tshig dag ni/ /phun tshogs sa bdag gis thos nas/ /so yi 'od kyis ④bka' drin ni/ /gsal bar rda dar+sha yarnyi ba/ /ma ti mān kār+ya sa tsi ba ste me bha bi tu marta si/ /dhī dhū be+e byed bzhin de la smras/ /bdag gi bya ba'i blon por ni/ /blo gros ldan pa khyod 'gyur 'os/ /blo stobs stabe+ebye re ba dh+warlu te dha ra bhā bha raḥ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsaḥshu tā ldan pa khyod lta bus/ /'dzin byed khur ni snye'adzin par byed/ /de skad rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /nor su dha nasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /na ba yo rā dza se bā su sa bhā maṇ+ḍa na paṇ+ḍi tāḥ/ /bzang gis ni de la smras/ /bdag ni rgyal po'i g.yog 'khor la/ /mdun 'usar mdzes pa'i mkhas pa min/ /swāts+tshabh+yod+mā na bi ts+tsha daḥsu ni dra su kha bi kra yaḥ/ /se ba hi thu sī saṃ g.yog ni skyes bu rnams dag gi3/ /rang dbang skyed tshal rnam par gcod/ /bde ba'i gnyid dang bde sā ra duḥ kha de n+ya bha ya kra yaḥ / / yī shwa rirma sta ka n+ya sta tsa ba 'tshong / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bkren 'jigs nyo/ /g.yog po dag ni rkang stegs bzhin/ /rtag ra ṇaḥkṛ ta kṛ t+ya tsā/ /pā da pi ṭha i bā yā ti se ba kophoha dz+re taḥs dā/ /se tu 'og na gnas pa yi/ /mgo la dbang phyug zhabs bkod na/ /bya ba byas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /g.yog bā yā sa pra yā se na pāṭ+wā na ma pi saṃ pa dzā/ /saṃ sgo gaḥpi shu na gi nyon mongs ngal dub kyis/ /phun tshogs thob pa'ang ⑧longs spyod kyang / /phra ma can dang 'grogs pa saṃ gi pra bhu zla bha ṅga bha d+ku ra ཿ / / e tā swa nā ba ti ṣ+ṭha rnye pra yi—/ /rje bo'i ⑨byun ma 'khyog pos g.yo/ /gzung 1 stedaka'i gdon bzhin mi bdag gi /phun 95—426

yasne na j-i tā a pi/ /dbo gra durga ha grwa ha durga hā dṛ pa sadza tshogs drag rtag ①gzung dka' ba/ /'di dag rab tu 'bad pa yis/ /bzung yang nges par mi gnas daḥ—/ /k+ṣa r+ṇa na ba na ba bye ṣa bi bye ṣa pra ṇa yod+ma tāḥ/ /a bā ra bā so—/ /'byor pa gsar pa gsar pa ni/ /'du 'bral mdza' gcugs rtsom pa dag /mi bzlog 27smad ra ra ma bhā ra ma bhā yā bi byu ta yaḥ/ /i truk+ta pra ti ṣe bye pi 'tshong mdzes pa khye bzhin/ /skad cig dga' bar bya ba yin/ /zhes smras rab tu bkag gyur kyang / /sa rā dzñā sa tsi baḥkṛ taḥ/ /a ti krā ma ti ko nā ma pra bha be+ek+ṣiṃḥs m+bi hi tai/ /rgyal pos de ni blon por byas/ /jo bo mchog tu bzhed pa la/ /nges par su zhig 'da' bar byed/ /pāp+ta thra zwa pa rda rā dzñā m+bi tai sad+dhā bye kā ri tī/ /bi dz+wa ṣa du ṣi tāḥsarbe rgyal pos kun gyi gnyer gtad cing / /shin tu che ba'i gnas thob ste(pya/ /rnam par sdang bas sun 'byen marnyi ṇa na ste si hi re/ / dha dz+re dzi dzñā sa yā rā dzñā pi shu na pre pa'i—/ /blon po rnams kyis bzod ma gyur/ /phra ma can gyis bskul ba yi/ /rgyal pos chos ni brtag ri te na saḥ/ /ṣ+pe pā ka ro da saṭ+wār+ya ni yusto pi pu naḥpu naḥ/ /ā ghā haṃ pre k+ṣi 'dod nas/ /dam pa'i bya ba min pa'i las/ /yang yang bskos kyang des ma byas/ /de nas mi bdag khro taḥsophotha mi byā ko ba na byu ju dzā/ /ta thā pya dhan+d+ra saṃ yut+ta na shā sa rdzun gyis/ /de ni gsod (srosnadu bskul bar gyur/ /de lta na yang chos min dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i na ma n+ya tā/ /e ka dzad+ma su khā yi ba ba hu dzad+ma sha tārdi rtu/ /na sā dhu bka' ma mnos/ /skye ba gcig nyid bde ba'i slad/ /skye ba brgya mang nyams 'gyur ba/ /smad pa'i las nin+da tai ka1 ka ro m+bi ti dzā ga da saḥ/ /bha ya dharmo pa dh+wa shudheḥpra nyi ni dge ba bdag /mi bgyid do zhes de yis smras/ /chos kyis 'jigs shing cho 'brang gtsang / /de ni sa muk+taḥs bhū ju dzā/ /dā na sha tri ma be+estsorja ma ka ro da khi labe+e rmā/ /sarba bdag gis rab btang / /slong ba rnams ni ma lus la/ /rgyun chad med pa'i sbyin khang byas/ /grags 95—427

tra bi khru te ta su dā na sha tri ya sha sri naḥ/ /kalpa bṛk+ṣu da raḥsum̐ sī pa snyan ldan pa de yi ni/ /sbyin khang kun tu grags pa'i tshe/ /dpag bsam shing la skyes bu rnams/ /gus ram̐ pra ta nu tī ya yo/ /a tā n+ta re mu ni ga ṇas+t+riṭ+wāṭ+wā dak+ṣi rja pa (3)mchog tu chung bar gyur/ /gnas skabs der ni thub pa'i tshogs/ /'jug ngogs don gnyer lho pa thāta/ /ā ga ta kṛsgo kād+dhā ra ma pi shan ni rdza rna ba ā+oṃ/ /ta tra j-iṣ+ṭhartu phyogs nas/ /'ongs pa 'brog dgon nyam nga ba/ /skye bo med pa'i gnas su zhugs/ /der ni thams rā ཿ sa rbe mū ts+tsha tā ཿ sha ya na shri tā ཿ / / a yā tsin+ta dza lo mo cad skom pas gzir/ /brgyal zhing mal stan la brten pas/ /sems med la yang rgongs pa las/ /hā dru:rnibye ta nā ma pi/ /de ba gan+dhaza nā ge bh+yaḥkash+yid+molhatra da yī bu dhiḥ/ /skad chen (zhe7chu ni rab tu blangs/ /lha dang dri za klu rnams las/ /brtse ba'i chu gter su zhig 'dir/ /sbi ta pra yats+tsha tu dza lo sophosmra ka mi ti te bru ban/ /ta taḥs rat+na ka yu raḥgang gnas de yis bdag cag la/ /chu rab rtsol zhes de yis ①smras/ /de nas rin cen dpung rgyan rjokwa ṇa ka kaṅka ṇa dh+wa niḥ / /bhu dzā sak+ta ho ma z-i ṅgā rasta ru ma can—/ /gser byi dril chung sgra sgrogs shing / /lag pas gser gyi chu snod gzung / /shing gi dbus nas dh+yaji nir+ya yo/ /te tasmra da mṛ tā swa rda pā ṇi pad+mā ba na mi tāta/ /ā kaṇ+ḍi byung bar gyur/ /lag pa'i pad+mas btud de las/ /bdud rtsi myang ④bzhin de dag gis/ /mgrin pa'i sa li lo r+pā tā dza dz+dza 6rlud+dhā dz+re bi tāḥ/ /pra thi taḥpu na ra bye t+ya pa bar du chu 'thungs nas/ /'tsho ba thob cing dga' bar gyur/ /ya mtshan ldan pa de dag rnams/ /chas prasgoste sa bisma yāḥ/ /a dṛ sh+ya bṛk+ṣa ni la yā dusgo tai ko bha ba ni ti/ /te slar yang mngon phyogs te⑥/ /mi mthong shing gi gnas dag las/ /des 'thon khyod ni su zhes dris/ /sophobra bīta bi shu ta ya shāḥshra bsgyu mā shra yaḥshri yaḥ/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa do nā ma de yis smras pa mnyan yod na/ /snyan par grags pa dpal gyi meganas/ /mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya ba/ /95—428

da bye kum+bha pra tsā ra kaḥ/ /tasgo dza nadhe saṃ shāp+ta swalpa she ṣān+da sgo dza zho yi bum pa 'grim byed cing / /de dag gsol ba mthar phyin tshe/ /zas lhag chung ngu za bar ṣ+peḥ—/ /r+bhakhyu ṇi go ra bo dā ram̐ dṛṭī haṃ rā dza sgo dza rna/ /āt+pa nartswan+da pak+ṣu gyur①—/ /dge slong rnams la rgyal po'i zas/ /zhe sa rgya che ldan pa dang / /bdag nyid la ni zas ngan ra ma bha ba khin+da mā na saḥ/ /a nā tha paṇ+ḍi da gi rā sgo dza ṣ+pe go dag /mthong nas bdag yid buskyo bar gyur/ /mgon med zas sbyin tshig gis ni/ /zas la gus pa'i ra bā sha yāḥ/ /ta to ma yābyeg yulte kṛ tī tai po ṣa dzha bra tai/ /a bsam pa yis/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gso sbyong gi/ /brtul zhugs de nas bdag gis blangs/ /de sa mābe+e pra te nā tha bhuste lo l+yad+ma yā ni shi/ /te nā ha ma bha paṃ lo ke nas brtul zhugs ma rdzogs pas/ /sred pas bdag gis spyomatshan mo zos//de yis bdag ni 'jig rten bi dzñā ta khaṇ+ḍa po ṣa dhaḥ/ /khaṇ+ḍi nā pi bra te na haṃ de ba pu tra twa du—/ /gso sbyong nyams par rnam par grags/ /brtul zhugs nyams pa de yis kyang / /bdag ni lha yi mā ga taḥ/ /i ti te tad+ma tsa khru tā mu na yoḥbismi tā ya yuḥ/ /a byudha yan pra bu nyid gyur/ /de yi tshig de thos gyur nas/ /thub pa de dag ya mtshan gyur/ /de dag 'gro zhing rab dzan+ta ste tī bre ṇa ta pa sā ba yo/ /su tsi ram̐ ke ba lo kli ṭ+wā nā bsams pa/ /dka' thub drag pos bdag cag rnams/ /yun ring nyon mongs 'ba' zhig gyur/ /da byā pi ku sha la spri shaḥ/ /ma dhū nā po ṣa sgo pābye bra ta me ba ya tā ma he/ /dung dge la reg pa med/ /da ni gso sbyong brtul zhugs nyid/ /rab tu bsgrub la 'bad par bya/ /ni ra pā ya su kho pā ye swa hi ti ka gya nā da raḥ/ /i ti sa:n+ta yan+ta ste gnod pa med cing bde ba'i thabs/ /rang la phan la su mi gus/ /de ltar bsams shing de dag ni/ /ko shaṃ bī ma bye to ga taḥ/ /su dha na mya kṛ haṃ pā purbi khru tai kṛ ha me ko'u shām bīr gtad nas song thu/ /khyim na gnas pa nor bzang gi④/ /khyem ni grags dang ldan 95—430

bye naḥ/ /ta tra te na kṛ tā ti bya ni bi byāsmi ta dan+d+ra tai/ /a nā tha paṇ+ḍi rda dṛhūṃ par phyin/ /des der mgron gyi bya ba byas/ /de la rmad byung de dag bshad/ /mgon med zas sbyin blta te nai ba sa hi ta ya yuḥ / / shra ba sgyudhe sa mā sā r+ya pū dzi tā ste ba'i slad/ /de dang lhan cig ①nyid du song / /mnyan yod du ni yang dag phyin/ /de rnams de yis na sa da ram̐/ /asmi n+ya be da yan sarde ya thā dṛṣ+ṭi ya thā khru tai/ /sa tā na gus bcas mchod/ /de la ji ltar mthong ba dang / /ji ltar thos pa thams cad bshad/ /brtul zhugs pra tabe+e naḥsar+pān su dṛ rda su dha nañtsa tai/ /ni nā ya dhadz+re sa bi tsaḥdon gnyer de kun dang / /grogs po nor bzang de yang ni/ /chos kyi grogs dang ( 7mdza' ba yis/ /bye ti bha ga ba tornyi ka/ /bha ga bā na pi tabye kyāstsokre ta ṣā ma nu gra haṃ/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du khrid/ /de yi tshig gis de dag rnams/ /bcom ldan kyis kyang rjes su bzung / /sa t+ya dar+sha na saṃ budha ye na te su ga ti ya yuḥ/ /te 6 yā te 6 gang gis de dag bden pa mthong / /yang dag rtogs shing bder bgrod gyur/ /de dag song tshe bcom su dha rna pa k+ṣa pā tā rngu ya dṛ sha /bi lo kya bha ga bān samyaka bi ldan gyis/ /phyogs lhung brlan pa'i spyan gyis ni/ /nor bzang nyid la rnam gzigs nas/ /yang dag da dhe dzñā na bhā dza 8/ /sa t+ya saṃ dar+sha nā bābe+e bi she ṣa ku sha lo da yaḥ/ /ga twa ye shes ldan par mdzad/ /bden pa yang dag mthong ba thob/ /khyad par dge ba rgyas pa de/ /song nas dzi nā ya kau shaṃ sde sa bi hā ra ma kā ra yata/ /yasmrabye ga ba tā diṣ+ṭa rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang / /ko'u rngushām bīr byed du bcug /gang phyir bcom ldan gyes bskos pas/ /ta smin yā taḥs hā ya tī/ /byek+ṣubyun+d+ra bhe dhasta smrata so bhūdzun+da bi hā ra der ni grogs byal 'ongs gyur pa/ /dge slong skul byed de phyin des/ /skul byed (ltagatsug lag khang zhes bhuḥ—/ /rā dh+wa bhi dh+wa da dbyā sī bi hā ra pa ri tsā ra kā/ /da ya yā bha ga gyur—/ /gtsug lag khang skyong 'bangs mo ni/ /mgu byed ces pas phul ba yi(6she/ /gos hrul de la brtse 95—431

dharma dru to yaḥs e bo da ya no dṛ paḥ/ /saṃ dzñā ni de ba ko ya: ku ku raḥsu kyi ①pho nya gang / /de nyid mi bdag 'char byed yin/ /gang zhig brda ni rig (byebyed pa'i/ /khyi de yang ni dha no pi saḥ/ /rā dzñā gho ṣe ṇa bi dzñā to gho ṣi la pa ra nā mā bhū ta/ /tsa ri nor bzang ngo / /rgyal pos zhustegadangs las shes pas na/ /gdangs can zhes pa ming gzhan gyur/ /de ltar ta mi kyu tsi tai bha ba bhe di nā bha ga ba tā ka thi tai ki la bhek+ṣa baḥ/ /yid ni legs pa rnams kyi spyod pa dag /rigs par srid pa 'bigs byed bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /su kṛ ta sau ra bha sā ra su dh+wa ra saṃ su ma na sā shra ba shā ñdza li bheḥlegs byas dri bzang snying por ldan pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsan pa'i snyim pas 'thungs pa puḥ / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra be+e ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa tā ba dā na par grags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa rnyidapag kalpa la tā lnga gho ṣi khā ba dā dzā ṣas+t+ri shaḥpal+la waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las gdangs can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa 57drug pa'o// //bi budhe sa ra si pad+ma sho bha te saṅka dzad+māḥshu tsi pa ri sa ra dzā tsā smṛ lha yi rdzing bu dag tu 'dam las skyes pa'i chu skyes mdzes/ /yongs bskams gtsang 'usar skyes pa'i sh+ya te na s+tha la dz+dza/ /sa ha dza pa ri tsi tā dzā ni t+ya man+targa tā dzā bha ba ti si pad+ma dag la reg mi byed/ /lhan skyes yongs su 'dris shing rtag tu nang na —gnas gyur pa/ /dkar ba'i ḍakyitā gu rja r+ghaṃ ka ra rte nai ba dzā tiḥ/ /shra bahūṃ sadze+e satā r+ghaṃ swa sti yon tan rnams kyi byed po rigs ni min pa nyid6sna/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal na sngon/ /sems can dh+yā na pa ra ya ṇi/ /dzi na kalpa dru ma dze ta ba nā rā masbi ti pu rā/ /kun la shis pa yi/ /bsam gtan rjes su skyong byed cing / /rgyal ba dpag bsam shing bzhugs tshe/ /shur+pā ra kā khye na ga re rat+na pañtsa ya sā ga raḥ/ /bha bo nā mā bha ban+d+rarba grong khyer slob ⑩ma lta bur ni/ /ded dpon blo ldan rnams kyi mchog /rin chen bsags pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /95—433

pa tirma tai ma hūṃ ba raḥ/ /bha bi lo bha ba bha drabya bha ba nadhī tsa bi khru tāḥ/ /ke ta rkyu 'byor pa zhes pa byung bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma ke ta ki/ /zhes pa la ni bu gsum byung / /'byor len ①ta gya dzā yā yī ba zla busta na yan+t+ra yaḥ/ /ro ga yo gā du pa ga taḥ dang ni 'byor bzang dang / /'byor pa dga' zhes grags pa'o/ /nam zhig de ni nad kyis btab/ /sa ka dā tsirlu rūr+ṣa hūṃ/ /pā ru 6j-i sha mube+esne ཿpasbyi pu tre ru be+e k+ṣi 'chi ba 'dod cing nye bar gyur/ /mchog tu rtsub cing chags bral bas/ /chung ma bu rnams dag gis taḥ / /bhasgyu dā se tu ta sri kā pa ri tsat+yā pa ra pa ram̐/ /mal+li kā khya bha baṭ+wā spangs—/ /de yi (②'bangs mo phreng ldan ma/ /zhes pa gcig gis gus pa yis/ /ji srid rnal du gnas bta sa ya bta swāsbya ma yayo/ /sne ho pa kā ra pra ṇa taḥkṛ ta dzhaḥpa ta yā gyur pa/ /de srid rim gro mchog tu byas/ /mdza' zhing phan pas rab btud kyepa/ /byas shes de ni de nī taḥ/ /ṛ to saṃ ga ma bye t+ya ta ta sngaḥpu tra ma dz+re dza na ta/ /ya dā tasgo ni pi tuḥdang ldan/ /zla mtshan dus su 'grogs gyur pas/ /de la bu ni btsas par gyur/ /gang tshe de skyes pha yi sad+dhāṭ+wāḥpur+ṇa tai ya yuḥ/ /sa ta dā puṇ+ḍi nā mā bhūbye laḥpūrten+d+ra pun+da raḥ/ /ni—/ /nor ④kun gang ba nyid du gyur/ /byes pa zla nya ltar mdzes de/ /de tshe gang po zhes par gyur/ /dz+rejon+t+ra yaḥkṛ tobye ha ya yu rabhi rnya nābe+e naḥ/ /pūṇ+ḍistu bhaṇ+ḍa shā lā lnga phu bo gsum gyis chung ma blangs/ /rgya mtshor nor don gnyer du song / /gang pos pha yi tshong khang du/ /pi tubya kre dha nā rja dz+wa/ /ta taḥpra ti ni dṛṭ+wāste pābhāṭ+wāḥsā ga rākhru naḥ/ /'dug nas nor gyi bsgrub pa byas⑤/ /de nas de dag nor thob ste/ /rgya mtsho las kyang grong khyer du/ /ga ṇa r+pā he ma lak+ṣu rde kṛ tā swa mu di re pu re/ /sa mu dra ga ma ṣ+pe te be+er log gser ni 'bum phrag rnams/ /bgrang bar byas te dga' bar gyur/ /de dag rgya mtshor bgrod ṣe yā bā nā sīdzha nā ga maḥ/ /pūṇ+ḍi gya swa kṛ he pa byerba khyu bā bye dhi kasta taḥ/ /pa la/ /nor ni ji snyed byung gyur pa/ /rang gi khyim du gang po la/ /de las lhag pa zong gis byung / /95—434
