tī—/ /so pi pūṇ+ḍi dha naḥkā le shī ta saṃ ku tsi tai pa che/ /da dar+sha kṛṣ+ṭha byas—/ /de yang nor gyis gdung ①dus su/ /lam du so ka'i ①tsha ba la'ang / /grang bas 'khongs kyetā pe pi bi ba shaṃ dā ru bhā re rka /a dā ya dā ru rū phye na sa tasmra ta shing nyen pa yis/ /shing ni khur ba dag gcig ④)mthong / /de yis de las shing gi ni/ /rin gyis shing dā ru bhā ra shaṃ/ /di bya tsan+da na ma dru khye ta da ha na snga pi shī ta rda/ /su kṛ te ṣ+pe gi khur po blangs/ /sreg byed la (sheyang bsil ster ba/ /lha yi tsan+dan dag tu mthong / /legs byas chen ba ma hā ta te na la d+dhā ma hā dha naḥ/ /sa se byaḥsārja bā hā ram̐ pū bye po nyid kyis bzhin/ /de yis nor chen thob pas de/ /ded dpon rnams kyis bsten bya ste/ /sa yi bhudṛ thi bī pa teḥ/ /rat+na ka ra pa ṣaṭa kṛ twaḥpra yā taḥsazla dophobe+e dzā/ /bdag pos mchod byar gyur/ /slong ba rnams la kun ster des/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lan drug bgrod/ /tsa kā ra san+d+ra bā ni rdzu ta ra shulbā r+ya nu gra haṃ/ /shā bste bā si bhiḥsārja tshong pa kun gyi gru btsas dang / /sho gam la sogs rjes bzung byas/ /slar yang mnyan yod na gnas pa'i⑥//ba ṇisgoḥpu na rabe+e taḥ/ /ya yo pra ba ha rja rū bhāḥs mu dra dī pa mā don mthun tshong pas gsol btab nas/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du mgyogs par de(kye/ /gzings la rab tu zhon shu saḥ/ /pra t+yā thraste pra ba ha ṇi so3tha shu shā ba gā ya hūṃ/ /ba ṇi rdzu nas song / /de nas gzings ni slar log tshe/ /tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i phyiradu/ /bde gshegs s+thā ba rī shi la gā thāḥsu ga ta saṃ shra yāḥ/ /ka sri tā i ti te te na thraṣ+ṭha sat+tha la brten tshong pa rnams/ /glu ru len pa de yis thos/ /'di ni su yis zhes des ⑨dris/ /de dag kun ba bhā ṣi re/ /e tā bha ga ba tā gī tā gā thā budhe na dhī ma tā/ /gyis legs smras pa/ /'di dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /blo ldan gyis gsungs tshigs su bcad/ /i ti bud+dhā bhi ṅgā me ba khru tā har+ṣa ma bā pa saḥ/ /sum̐ sī swa bā sa nā rū ces pa sangs rgyas mtshan thos nas/ /de yis dga' ba thob par gyur/ /skyes bu rang la bag chags 95—437

bhā byat+ta mā yā kyu dī ri tai/ /taibe+esta re ṇa ka thi tā mā kakhyu bha ga gnas—/ /brjod pas gsal ba nyid du gyuraṭ+wā/ /de dag gis ni rgyas bshad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das wa ta ka shaṃ/ /sophobha bat+taṅga ta ma nā ta dar+sha na sa musgo kaḥ/ /sa sha ṣ+pespyo kyi gtam dag des/ /thos nas de la yid song ste/ /de ni lta (mibar 'dod par gyur/ /rim byis khyim ha mā ga t+ya t+yaghā sadze+e pa ri ts+tsha rda/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa rda drabye shā ba du 'ongs nas des/ /yo byad thams cad yongs btang ste/ /grogs po mgon med zas sbyin ni/ /lta ru ā+oṃ su j-i rda ya yo/ /a bhi lā ṣe ni be+e r+yasmi pra bra dzñā yī dzi ten+d+ra yaḥ/ /dza mnyan du yod par song / /rab tu byung khrobar mngon 'dod pa/ /de la dbang po thul bas bshad/ /de gā ma sa hi taste na bhas+thā bha ga ba tornyishaṃ/ /dṛbye be ta tra sarba rnyi dag lhan cig gus pa yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song / /gti mug mun pa nyin mor byed/ /mo ha dh+wan+ta di bā ka re/ /tat+yā da baṇ+ḍi ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba me ṣ+pe sa kṛ ta kṛ t+ya hūṃ/ /kun mkhyen der ni des mthong nas/ /de yi zhabs mthong nyid na des④/ /bya ba byas pa nyid du bsams/ /bi p+ta ya ta gya bha ga bān saṃ kalpan+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /de sha na byosgo ya kut+than de yi brtag ⑤pa bcom ldan byis/ /rnam par mkhyen nas de la ni/ /phyogs rnams chems kyi zla 'od kyis/ /bi be+e ka bi ma lā di shaḥ/ /e nyi bhikhyo ni rā rmā k+ṣe nirbi bak+ṣe k+ṣa dri med dben par mdzad cing gsungs/ /dge slong tshur shog dogs med cing / /mi mthun phyogs bral yo zlo te/ / ā khyu te dha n+d+ra be+e na ye bra h+ma tsabye tsa re spru tai / /nyams pa spangs/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul la/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad 'dod pa'o/ /i ti pra sā da shī le na dzi ṣ+pe no dī ri te pu raḥ/ /pra bra bye sa ha me+e bā gya zhes (khye pa rab dang ngang tshul gyis/ /rgyal bas sngon du brjod pa'i tshe/ /de yi lus la 'phral nyid du/ /pa pā tā lak+ṣi tā ta no/ /ta taḥs sha tro mi tre tsa pra sha mā ta sa ma hūṃ shri taḥ/ /mtshon pa med par rab byung lhung / /rab tu zhi las dgra dang ni/ /grogs la mtshungs par bsten pa des⑦//95—438

shastuḥshā sa na mā dā ya pra ṇi pa t+ya dza gā ma tai/ /sho rja pa rān+ta ka mā ma de ston pa'i bka' ni rab bzung nas/ /de la phyag ni btsal ①te song / /sro na'i pha rol 'gram zhes yul/ /shaṃ hrū ra dza nā shra yo/ /swa yo pa rīk+ṣi ḍū k+ṣurnyi dze+e ṣ+pe na sa ha sa mā ya yo/ /ma rungs skye bo'i gnas su ni/ /rang nyid bzod pa yongs rtog cing 7 —sna/ /skye bo dag dang lhan byug song / /ta tā dṛṭ+wā ta ma yān+ti mṛ ga yā yā maṅga lo/ /lubha kabyu sa mā kṛ 6 ri dwags shor ba la mi shis/ /de ni de nas 'ongs (7mthong nas/ /rngon pa rnams kyis ④gzhu bkang ste/ /habye kro dh+wa ta sa mu dra bta/ /nibe+e kā ram̐ ni rubye shaṃ sa tai bi ga ta sā dh+wa saṃ/ /khro bas gsod par yang dag gzas/ /rnam 'gyur med cing mya ngan med/ /'jigs pa dang ni bral ba stertesnye/ /pra ha re ti bru bā ṇañtsa dṛbye ba sha mā mābe+e bān/ /shā mya tasta gya sa ha gya pra snun cig ces kyang brjod mthong nas/ /de dag zhi ba thob par gyur/ /rngon pa 'phral la zhi gyur pa/ /sā dī lubha ka gya saḥ/ /dhadz+ren+di de sha ye nā sau bo dhi pā ba sa hā nu giḥ/ /de la rab tu dang ldan ⑥des/ /gang gis de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /byang chub rtogs byed chos bstan to/ /sa ta tra su ga tāṭ+wā rde sarbo pa ska ra sadza dām/ /sha tā ni pañtsa ra myu rde der ni bde gshegs la 'os pa'i/ /yo byad thams cad phun tshogs kyi⑦/ /gtsug lag khang ni nyams bi hā rā rja ma ka ra yata/ /sgozlo pi dzñā na saṃ pūṇ+ḍi prasta ste da sha dga' ba/ /lnga brgya dag ni de yis 'u7byas/ /gang po'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs/ /skabs gsum pa yis pū bye tām/ /bai rā gya laglu yusto bhūn mu m+bi dzñā smṛ ha rji ya yā/ /a tha mchod bya thob/ /thub pa rnams kyis posna dgyes bya ba/ /chags bral dpal dang ldan par gyur/ /de nas ta snga gra dzā ju tā bha pi laḥspyi ṇa bit+ta hūṃ/ /kā le no pa ga taḥpra ya ta sa de yi ⑪ sngon skyes spun/ /'byor ldan dus kyi nor rnams ni/ /zad pa nyid du rab gyur te/ /nor gyi mu dro dra bi shā sha yā/ /ta taḥpra ba ha shā rū byeḥso3nu kyu r+ṣas m+bi ra ṇiḥ/ /go bsam pas rgya mtshor song / /de nas de ni gzings la zhon/ /rjes mthun yang dag g.yo ba yis go 95—439

shir+ṣa tsan+da na ba rna pra pi ta swalpa bā sa riḥ/ /ku bye ri ka sha testa smin pañtsa shīr+ṣa yi tsan+dan nags1/ /nyi ma nyung ngus sleb par gyur/ /sta re thogs pa lnga brgya yis/ /der ①ni bhibyet+ta mu r+ya te/ /tastson+da na ba dz+wa di bye bhu dza ga ga ṇa saṃ ku lo/ /ta mchog gi tsan+dan nags/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyas gyur pa/ /de la gcod par zhugs pa'i tshe/ /de taḥswā mi yak+ṣa se nā dzā ma he shwa ra i ti shu taḥ/ /ko pā du da sri dza tai gho re kā nas gnod sbyin sde yi rje/ /dbang phyug chen po zhes grags pa/ /khros te 'jigs pa'i rlung chen ni/ /ka li kā khye ma hā ni lo/ /ma ru tā te na ma hā tā pā pi tāḥpā ṇa saṃ sha yo/ /tsa kran+d+rat+tha li ka zhes bya ba spros/ /rlung ni chen por gyur pa des/ /srog la the tshom thob gyur pa/ /tshong pa kun gyis (kyiṇi dzaḥsabye shadze+e sha kra mu khān su rān/ /tā nārtu ra ba mu kha rān bha be+e laḥ0dbang phyug dang / /brgya byin la sogs lha rnams bos/ /mu cor gdung sgogs de dag la/ /don mthun sārja nā ya kaḥ/ /u bā tsa sañtsirgyu tsi ram̐ pa:ṭ+wā pa sa mā ku laḥ/ /'dren pa 'byor len ni/ /rjes su gdung bas 'khrugs pa yis/ /yun ring bsams nas rab smras pa/ /sgoṇ+ḍiḥka byā yān 1 tā so hi tai ྾ rmā pu rā ba data/ /ba hu kle shopholpa su khaḥspun zla gzhon pa gang po des/ /phan 'dod bdag la sngon smras pa/ /nyon mongs mang zhing bde ba nyung / /kwa nu gan+ta byasta dze+e bu byeḥ/ /a kṛ tādhī ma tasta gya ba tsa rna sa t+ya dargo naḥ/ /chu gter du khyod gang (snyel 'gro/ /blo ldan bden pa mthong gyur pa/ /de yi tshig ni ma byas pas/ /tsu tophohaṃ dha na lo bhe na sgo resmin bya sa nāṇ+ḍi be+e/ /shu two tad+ma ṇi dzaḥsarbe 'jigs rung sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir/ /nor la chags pas bdag lhung ngo / /de dag thos nas tshong pa bra bhā baṃ lo ka bi khru tai/ /pūṇ+ḍi gya mā na sā rmya tā ta me ba sha ra khaṃ ya kunaske/ /gang po'i mthu ni 'jig rten du/ /rnam par grags pa yid la bsgoms/ /de nyid la ni skyabs yuḥ / /na mastu bye dza gasgre sha pi ṣa do ṣā sa ha ri ṇi/ /puṭ+wā yo su song / /'gro ba'i nyon mongs dug gi skyon/ /'phrog cing snying rje rgyas pa ⑥yi/ /bdud rtsis yang 95—440

dīṇ+ḍi ka ru rja su ṅgā saṃ pūṇ+ḍi tse ta su/ /i bye ka swa rā ra be+e ṇa te ྾ dag rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /gang po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa de dag rnams kyi sgra/ /dbyangs saṃ pū ri te ྅sbare/ /k+ṣa ṇi na ga tā taj-itrī pūṇ+ḍi pā ha swa de ba tā/ /sgo gcig gis ni mkha' khengs tshe/ /skad cig la phyin de yi spyod①/ /gang po la smras rang gi lhas/ /sro ṇa pa rān+ta ka ga taḥshu tā te ṣe sa be+e sla baṃ/ /byosna sa mā bye san+dadheḥna'i pha rol 'gram gnas pa/ /de yis de dag bslad thos nas/ /ting 'dzin bsgrubs pas nam mkha' la/ /pā pa pra ba ha rde k+ṣa rjata/ /tasmin pa.oṃ ka babye na spru to me ru ri bā tsa laḥ/ /skad cig gis ni gzings can phyin/ /der ni de yis skyil krung bcas/ /lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo bas/ /pra la yoṭ+wā la be+e ga gya ga ti bā yodz+dza hā ra saḥ/ /pūrje na pa ba ṇi rur+ghaṃ dzñā 'jig dus rlung tshub ④lta bu yirngu / /rlung gi shugs kyis 'gro ba phrogs/ /gang pos rlung ni bkag pa dang (snye//tā yak+ṣa ga ṇa gra bhāḥ/ /tai pra sā da ya yo t+yaghā te bh+yastsan+da na kā na oṃ/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyi gtso bos shes/ /de la dang bas tsan+dan nags/ /de dag rnams la btang nas song / /pūṇ+ḍi pra sā dā dā dā ya bha bi la:n+da na dru mān/ /z-iṣ+ṭa ste ṣ+pe ba sa hi gang po'i drin byis tsan+dan shing / /'byor len dag gis blangs nas ni/ /rang gi ⑤grong khyer slob spyom taḥshu pā ram̐ swa pu re ya yo/ /pūrjephotha sasmaste bhā tu sta tra go shiste tsan+da 'drar—/ /dga' bas de dang lhan cig song / /de nas gang pos spun la bgros/ /go shīr+ṣa lkuyi tsan+dan naiḥ—/ /tsakre tsan+da na mā lā khye pra sā rda su ga to tsi tai/ /ta tra pūrje byus—/ /bde gshegs la 'os khang bzang der/ /tsan+dan phreng ba zhes pa byas/ /der ni gang pos na bha ga bān dh+yā tathoṇ+ḍi bi hā ya sā/ /sa mā ya yo dze ta ba nā bsams ④pa na/ /bcom ldan mgyogs par nam mkha' las/ /rgyal byed tshal nas dpag tshad brgya/ /duwaṃ sgya sha ta yo dza bhā/ /ā gats+tsha to bha ga ba taḥpu raḥpra thra ta yā dza 'das nas yang dag byon par gyur/ /bcom ldan byon pa'i sngon du ni/ /sku yi 'od zer rab 'phros ky-ikye95—441

bha ba kle sho sbyi tai shri ta ཿ / / i ti pra ghā baṃ ka thi lta dzi ṣ+pe na rnams—/ /ma lus spangs pa'i dgra bcom bsten/ /de ltar bsod nams bsags pas rab bskrun pa/ /sgoṇ+ḍi gya pu byo pa tsa ya pra bhā tai/ /shu tād ju tai saṃ sa di bhik+ṣu saṃ ghaḥpu gang po'i mthu ni rmad byung rgyal ba yis/ /mdun sar bshad pa thos nas dge 'dun stitshogs/ /bsod sgo pra saṃ shā bhe ra to ba bhu baḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye nams bsngags la mngon par dga' bar gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā lnga pū sh+lau ba dā rgo sa p+ta tri sha ཿdpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam rmi 'khri shing las gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu pal+la waḥ// //rtsa 27bdun pa'o// //ā kiñtsi n+ya su khā ya ni smṛ ha ta yā ba rā gya lakhro dzu ṣaḥ sarde ci yang med pa'i bde be+ed chags pa med pa 1chags bral dpal 'byor sten byed pa/ /thams cad yādhi bi hā ya kā ya sa tsi bāḥsan+taḥpra shā: ba na/ /ta tā si bra ta ḍadza re btang nas lus kyi grogs ldan dam pa rnams kyi ④zhi slad nags su 'gro/ /der yang tshul 'chos brtul pa ri ka rā rartswa ya tsita pañtsa yastata kaḥko sha pa ristso do pa ka ra ṇiṅge zhugs dag la yo byad rtsom pa gal te gsog (snye byed na/ /mdzod kyi yo byad nyer mkho de dag rnams kyis khyim he3pa rā dhaḥkṛ taḥ/ /dzi ṣ+pe dze ta bā nā rā mā bi hā rā bhe ra taḥpu raḥ/ /du gnod pa ci zhig byas/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed gtsug lag khang / /kun dga' ra bar sngon bzhugs pas/ /shākya rā dza ku mā rā rde pra bra dzñā dzu ྾ pu raḥ/ / tsi tra ṭī ba ra sat+yā tra mdun du shākya'i rgyal po 6sternams/ /rab tu byung ba bsten pa yi/ /bkra ba'i gos dang dam pa'i snod/ /yo ga pa ṭ+wā di sañtsa yo/ /pra bhū ta ta ra mā lo kya bha ga bān sa ma pus 'khyud la sogs bsags pa dag /rab tu mang po gzigs gyur nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang 95—444

tsin+ta yata/ /a ho ba te ྾ nā r+ya pi ban+dha he tum+bi babye/ /a bye mā na dag bsams/ /kye ma 'di dag da dung yang / /lus la sdug pa'i 6sheyo byad 'dzin/ /mngon par khengs ma yaḥkā ye pri yaḥpa ri ka ra gra haḥ/ /kā ye kā ya pa ri s+thā rasta spyo pa pa'i rang bzhin gyes/ /'ching ba'i rgyu ni yongs dum zlog /lus la lus kyi chas rnams te/ /de la nye ka ra ṇa ba lbo/ /ta sngaḥpa ri kā rā dā na ma ho nu ban+dha shri kha lā/ /i ti bar mkho ba'i bsred⑦/ /de yi yo byad 'dzin pa ni/ /kye ma 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog yin/ /de ltar saṃ tsirgyu bha ga bān ṣ+pe kān+ta bi hi tasbi taḥ/ /kā ru bye du ba san+d+ra byā bsams nas bcom ldan 'das/ /dben par gnas pa bsgrubs pa yis/ /nyer 'dzin rnams la snying rje ku sha khā ya sa mud+ma taḥ/ /mā pa tra ya mu ba s+thā rgo kasto bye ye na las—/ /dge ba'i slad du yang dag brtson/ /dge slong rnams kyis mi mthong twoslad/ /zla ba gsum du ke na tsita/ /a dar+sha nā ya bhi gru shā ma ka ro di ti saṃ bi rda/ /pra dṛste ni la me bdag la ni/ /sus kyang nye bar gnas mi bya/ /zhes pa'i bgro ba mdzad par gyur/ /nges pa de la rab ta smin bhik+ṣu rā ra rgya ka bra taḥ/ /ā ya yā bu pa se nā byuḥkār+yā zhugs tshe/ /dge slong dgon pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /chos gos dman ldan nye ba'i sde/ /zhes pa dze+e ta nu ṭī ba raḥ/ /pra bā ri taḥs saṃ pā pya dha n+yaḥsu ga ta dar+sha rna/ /dgos pa'i sbad du 'ongs/ /rab zlog ⑤skal ba ldan pa des/ /bde gshegs mthong ba yang dag thob/ /kṛ ta kṛ t+yaḥk+ṣa r+ṇa sbi twa sra ta sbe pa ṇi ba t+ya tai/ /bra dzan+ta me t+ya ba prasgo bya ba byas te skad cig 'dug /de la phyag 'tshal rab tu song / /dge slong rnams kyis bgrod de la/ /byek+ṣa baḥpa ri bār+ya tai/ / ta bār+ya dar+sha na ma ho datrī bha ga ba tā ka yongs bskor sngon rjodu phyin te dris/ /'phags pa khyod la bcom ldan gyis/ /kye ma mthong ba ji ltar rja / /mā sa tra yo dar+sha ṣ+pe gya ni ya maḥshā sa ṣ+pe na yaḥ/ /sa ka dze+e bha ba tā gnang / /'di yi bka' la zla gsum du/ /dge 'dun dag gis mthong med pa'i/ /nges pa gang de lam 95byed445

bhasnaḥsaṃ gha phyod+mārga gā mi nā/ /shu two ti pa tsa rna te ṣā mu pa se naḥmin nas/ /bgrod pa khrod kyis ji ltar bshig /de dag tshig de thos gyur nas/ /lhag par 'dzum zhing smi tot+ta ram̐/ /tā nu tse na ma yā kabyeta kṛ taḥs ma ya bi be+e baḥ/ /a ha musto nye sde yis/ /de dag la smras bdag gis ni/ /nges pa gang yang ①nyams ma byas/ /bdag ni blta ④bha ga ba tā dar+sha nā ba sa re swa yo/ /ā ra rgya ka gya me bhik+korje ba'i gnas skabs na/ /bcom ldan rang gis bka' stsal pa/ /dge slong dgon pa pa rnams ni/ /lta ba ṣe bye nāste dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /pa ri ts+tsha do pa ka ra ṇa t+yā ga nirmuk+ta brnya nāḥ/ /bdag ①gis bkag pa med/ /yo byad nyer mkho yongs btang zhing / /'ching ba dag las nges grol ba/ /a bār+ya dar+sha na bṛk+ṣa rū li kaḥpaṃ shu kyu li kā/ /i da ma r+ya pa ram̐ pā ta ri shing drung phyag dar khrod pa dag /lta ba dag ni bzlog ④pa med/ /lhung bzed chos gos tshogs rnams la/ /ti ye pañtsa ye re tāḥ/ /pā tra ṭī ba ra baṅge 6 te ྾ naste ha dar+sha rna/ /'di deng nang par gzhan no zhes/ /gang zhig bsags pa la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dir ni mthong ba med/ /sā tho dzhaḥ pra sa rabhu ṣā ra shi shi ri skṛ : tu raste pa ram̐ te nirngi gang zhig rab zhi'i brtul zhugs yo byad dag la 'bad pas mngon par khengs 'dis ⑤'ching / /de dag ghā ni dh+wa na dh+wa m+bi bi thra to de t+yā da lo du rga tā / / te ྾ tsan+dan rkang 'thung dag las yang dag gdung byed me ni nye bar bskrun⑥/ /kha bas rab rgyas tsa n+da na pā du pā na ta ཿ sa n+ta pa ka ཿ pā ba ko ye re ṣa pā bsil ba'i chu rnams dag gis de dag mchog tu skom pas gdung / /myang 'das gegs mesha ma bra to pa ka ra ṇi brnyo bhi mā na gra haḥ/ /i kyuk+ta mu pa se ṣ+pe na med gter gyi gnas la de dag bkren zhing phongs pa nyid du gyur/ /nye sdes de skad brjod thos nas/ /shu tā te shākya bhek+ṣa baḥ/ /bai la gh+ra k+ṣa yi ton+d+ra hāḥs ha se ba bya sbub yata/ /shākya'i dge slong de dag rnams/ /skyengs pas spro ba zad gyur pas/ /'phral la nyid du rnam par bsams/95—446

ga tā kā le su 6 be di bya lak+ṣa khaṃ/ /u da kā khyuḥs ba lo3bhūta saṃ dzā taḥs li lta bu'i bu/ /mtshan mchog ldan pa btsas par gyur/ /chu nang du skyes byis pa de/ /chu skyes zhes ni bya khān+ta re/ /bsgo mā ṇaḥpi tustu bye yo ba rā dzu ma no ra dze+eḥ/ /sha tā ni pa.ā+oṃ mā bar gyur/ /yab kyi rgyal tshab bzhed pa dang / /mtshungs pa nyid du che bar skyes/ /de ni skyes pa'i nyin t+yā ram̐ ta gya dzad+ma di rgo sa rma/ /a bā pustu l+ya rū pa hūṃ pu tā rde par la/ /blon po lnga brgyas mtshungs par ni/ /gzugs ni mtshungs pa'i bu rnams dag /lnga brgya rab sha ta pañtsa shaṃ/ /ni dze+e dzā ti sma raḥsmṛ tā pāspruṣ+ṭi shi shuḥsha ṣ+peḥ/ /a tsin+ta tu thob par gyur/ /rang gi skye dran byis pa des(17/ /rim gyes sngon byung dran gyur nas/ /bdag nyid yata pāp+ta kā lo hi tai su kṛ ta māt+pa naḥ/ /ṣaṣ+ṭha bar+ṣa ṇi kṛ tā tu yo ba la phan legs byas kyi rī/ /dus la bab par yang dag bsams/ /lo ni drug cu tham par sngon/ /bdag rā bye ma hā pu rā/ /a bha baṃ kṛsgo saṃ tap+tash+yi ram̐ na ra ka saṃ ka ṭi/ /gis — rgyal tshab byas pa na/ /mi bzad dmyal bar (thuyun ring du/ /nyam nga'i sdug bsngal gdung ba thob/ /dzad+ma n+yasmin+da pi bu narlo ba rā bye mu pa spru tai/ /sat+tha thā zwargya ma kho pi na be+ed nas skye ba 'di la yang / /rgyal tshab dedag ni nye bar gnas/ /rnam pa kun tu gsol btab kyang / /ka ri 6 mi bā ta shaṃ/ /i ti sañtsidh+ya sa tsi ram̐ rā bye sgo ga pa rādru bdag ni sdig pa mi byed do/ /zhes pa de yis yun ring gyebasams/ /rgyal srid longs spyod las phyir khaḥ / /pi tu rubye ga dzan bhā ma gra tī ta paṃ gu rū ka tsā/ /sathra la k+ṣa phyogs—/ /pha ni yid 'byung skyed )snabyed pa'i/ /lkugs pa 'phye bo bzung bar gyur/ /mtshan nyid thams ṇa yusto pi rā dza bṛ ste ra bhā dza rgo/ / sa mū ka paṃ gu nā ma byud cad ldan mod kyang / /rgyal po'i lugs kyi snod ma gyur/ /gnyen rnams sdug bsngal skyed 3byed de/ /ba ju dzñā duḥ kha ba sgo naḥ/ /pā ste 6 madh+ri su te 6 shan+t+ra shān+t+ra ba lo lkugs pa'i 9sna'aphye bo zhes par gyur/ /mtshon dang bstan bcos stobs rgyas pa/ /blon po'i bu rnams kyis 95—448

kiñtsi ta be+e tuḥpu raḥ/ /ta taḥkhyu ta pra ti k+ṣe pe ta myu diṣ+ṭi ma tī byu dzā/ /so pha yi mdun du cang mi smra/ /de nas de la sa bdag gis/ /bshad pas rab smad bstan pa'i tshe/ /de ba da6 bā rā dā ṣ+pen baṅgi pabye pra dzā mi tsa/ /a thā su rā dzñā z-ibye na ba ra yis smras pa mchog ster 3na/ /bdag ni smra zhing rkang pas 'gro/ /de nas rgyal po dgyes pa yis/ /de dā ṣ+pe pra ti khru te/ /sa pargyu swa ya ma bye t+ya spaṣ+ṭi pi ta ra ma bra bīta/ /la mchog ster rjes thos tshe/ /rang gi rkang pas mngon phyogs te/ /gsal bar pha la de yis 3smras/ /nā haṃ saṅgarna mū kolhahaṃ ṣ+pe ba tsā haṃ dza ḍā sha yaḥ/ /kin+tu dzad+mān+ta ra kle bdag ni 'phye min bdag lkugs min/ /bsam pa blun bo'ang bdag min te/ /'on kyang skye ba gzhan shaṃ smṛ tā be+e hwa l+ya mā shri ta ཿ / / yo ba ra bye su khaṃ bhu ghā ṣa ṣ+ṭi nyon mongs/ /dran zhing rnam par 'khrugs la brten snye/ /lo ni drug cu bdag gis sngon/ /rgyal tshab pa /bar+ṣa rgya haṃ pu rā/ /ṣaṣ+ṭi bste sa ha sra ṇi n+ya ba san na ra ko da re/ /rā bde ba longs spyad ‘snyenas/ /lo ni stong phrag drug cu dag /dmyal ba'i nang du gnas par gyur/ /de dza dī t+ya ma yā tas+thāta kṛ te yo mū ka saṅga tā/ /pra bra bye yā brah+ma tsa dro tsa be+ed bdag ni rgyal po yis/ /'jigs nas lkugs 'bye 'di nyid byas/ /rab byung tshangs par spyad pa dag/rā mye ṣa ba ro ma ma/ /i ti te nok+ta mā kasbya ta mu ba tsā tsa ma tī pa tiḥ/ /spyod pa 'di ni bdag gi mchog /ces pa de yis brjod thos nas/ /ma lkugs zhes pas dga' thob cing //a mū ka i t+yā sta dṛ tim+bi rak+ta i ti duḥkhi taḥ/ /dhan+d+ra rū la mi rda rā rdzu chags bral zhes pas sdug bsngal ba'i/ /sa yi bdag pos de la smras/ /chos kyi rtsa ba rgyal srid 'di/ /pu tra na t+yathi marta se/ /ya dzñā dā na pra dzā tra ṇiḥpu bye pūsh+lau dṛ pa shri bu kye btang bar mi 'os so/ /mchod sbyin sbyin pas skye rgu skyob 'u/ /mi bdag dpal ni bsod nams yaḥ / /e ka pu trasta yā pu tra pa ri t+yā ga ra sā da haṃ/ /ni dru rdzogs—/ /bu gcig sa ‘)bdag bu khyod kyis/ /chags pa yongs su btang ba las/ /gnyid kyis kye795—450

da ri dra tsā m+bi taḥsho ka sha spra sa mā shra yaḥ/ /saṃ puṇ+ḍi tsan+d+ra ru tsi ram̐ byak+ta dbul ba thob gyur cing / /mya ngan mal stan dag la brten/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba ltar mdzes shing / /musti ka hā se sh+lau/ / ka rja saṃ pa da mu ta mṛ bye pra bra dzñā bhe ma tā mu tig gsal bar dgod 4 pa can/ /phun sum tshogs/ pa spangs nas khyod/ /rab 'byung ji ltar mngon ta ba/ /ka dze+e sha be+eḥpa ri t+ya bye pā bye rā bye su kha tsi tāḥ/ /ba nān+ta par 'dod/ /rgyal po la 'os bde ba yi/ /mal stan mchog ni yongs btang nas/ /nags mtha'i sde bā sa bya sa byā se ba se dzā shu khā sgra lbo/ /kād+dhā lbo khā mu ku ra ma ṇi mad+man+di gnas la zhen pa yi1tsho/ /rdul khrod sa gzhi ji ltar stan4/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes ma rol/ ba'i me long rī rā dza dh+wa nī me tī t+ya ghā na nu ba na bhu ba ཿ saṃ pa ta bye gh+ra gho nor bu dang ldan khang pa ni/ /'di dag btang nas nags kyi sa gzhi 'jigs rung stag ni yang dag rgyu byed rā ཿ / / se ba pri h+ye dza ra da dza ga rā shā sa bi p+lu ṣ+ṭa sh+lau ṣ+ṭa cing snyetsho/ /brtan pa'i sbrul ni rgan po'i dbugs kyi bsregs 6pa dang ldan grib ma 7dman gyur pa/ /kli ṣ+ṭa tshwa ya pra bi ra la la tā stuḥ ka thadhe bha ba rnyi / / pi tuḥ shu two ti 'khri shing nyung ba de dag rnams kyis mnyes gshin khyod kyi dgyes pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa yab kyi tshig ba tsa dz+wa rā dza pu trasta ma bra bīta/ /dan+ta kād+dhā dha ra ru tsi be+e rā gyi grwa thos nas/ /rgyal po'i bu yis der smras pa/ /mchu mdzes so yi 'od kyis 9 ni/ /chags bral len du hā yan+di bā/ /shī ta la nirma la dza khāḥsarnyo ṣa sha shi shī ta lāḥ/ /ba ṣ+pe be+e rā 'jug pa bzhin/ /chu ni bsel zhing dri ma med/ /chog shes ri bong ldan pa bsel / /chags bral skal ba gya su bha gā bhu baḥka su na bal+la bhāḥ/ /pa ra dā ra i ba k+ṣi pra su khā bam+bi ta bzang po'i sa/ /nags tshal la ni su mi dga'/ /gzhan gyi chung ma dag la bzhin/ /bde myur ngan pas durdza nāḥ/ /na ra ka pra t+ya yā yā me sā pā yā na pri yāḥpri yāḥ/ /dh+yā ma btang ba/ /gang zhig dmyal rkyen gnod bcas kyi/ /dga' ma khornams la bdag mi dga'/ /bsam 95—451

ā+oṃ man+t+raḥpa ri dzñā na min+d+ra yā zlañtsa nirdza yaḥ/ /rā dzñā ho sāphopra yasne na yo gtan sngags dang yongs shes dang / /dbang po rnams ni thul ba dang / /'tshe bas rgyal po'i sbyor ba 'di/ /go yo na ra ka pra rda/ /ha san+d+raḥsaṃ sā ram̐ ku su ma ka li khāḥkā na na bhū baḥ'abad pa med pas (dmyal ba ster/ /nags kyi sa gzhi me tog rab rgyas 'khor ba dag la dgod (dz+wapa 'dra//swa bhā be+e na pyo ti bi da dha ti bu dh+wa ram̐ sha ma ma yī/ /dṛ d+ngha byu1 shāṭ+wā bya dza na pa ba ngo bo nyid kyis mkhas pa rnams la zhi ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba skyed/ /bsam pa yi 1ni mchog tu ngal zhing no sgo sa ba hu khā bi bhu tisgo pā dzā bha ba ti kha lu ṣ+pe yo su kha sa rlung yab rlung gi shugs rings krumang / /sa bdag rnams kyi 'byor pa 'di ni nges par bde ba'i grogs ma khā+e / /a nu dzā byā hi rmā tā ta bra dzā mye ṣa ta po ba ā+oṃ/ /dza m+bi hi yin—/ /yab gcig pasnyebadag la rjes gnang gsol/ /bdag ni dka' thub nags su 'gro/ /mi rtag pa sat+tha bhā bā dzā shi raḥshak+ta ma ni t+ya tī/ /i ti pu tra ba tsa rna khru tā tat+ta the nyid dngos kun gyi/ /rtse mor chags pa mkhyen lags sam/ /zhes pa bu yi tshig thos nas/ /de de bzhin ti tsin+ta yan/ /u pā tso pa tsi tā:r+yaste ma m+bi ྾ ma tī pa tiḥ/ /bi be+e zhes rnam par bsams/ /sa bdag mkhas pa ngo mtshar ni/ /rgyas par gyur pas de la smras/ /dri med ka bi ma lo pu tra twa mits+tsha se sa tserja rna/ /hi tā me saṃ sha yi tā ba ta pabya dben pa'i nags tshal du/ /bu khyod gal te 'gro 'dod na/ /re zhig bdag gi the tshom gsol/ /phyi nas drut+ta ka ri 6 si/ /bra dza tā ba dh+ya ba su bye tir+ya gulte sta yā ba tsaḥ/ /pra tsu rigs par khyod 'gyur ro/ /khyod ni gsod sar 'gro ba yis/ /'khyog po dag tu tshig mang po/ /smras pa re ta da bhi mā yi bathi marta si ta twa taḥ/ /i ti k+ṣi ti bhu dza thraṣ+ṭaḥsophobra de dag dgongs pa ni/ /de bzhin nyid du brjod par 'os/ /sa yi bdag pos dris pa dang / /des bīrtad+ma yo di tai/ /ba sa t+ya tra na kash+yita tā mabo dh+warjo ni brta te/ /smras bdag gis brjod pa des/ /'di na 6su zhig bdag gsod las/ /khyod kyi radz+wa zlog pa mi gnas sam//95—452

su kṛ tī dz+re ba ti sha baḥs pā pastu mṛ tophomṛ taḥ/ /pāklu rgya bhagh+ra te mū lāta sa legs byas dag gi ro yang gson/ /sdig ldan shi ba min yang shi/ /bsod nams snga ma'i rtsa ba spyod/ /dha ṣ+pe rje n+ya rā shi ba ta / / i t+yā sha yād+ma yā ta du s+ho ba tsa ā+oṃ pra nor ldan rnams kyi 'bru phung bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bsam pas k+ṣebadag gis ni/ /tshig ni gsum po de dag yo / /i ti khru tā k+ṣi ti pa tiḥtai pa ri ṣa bye sā da raḥ/ /u tsi tai kre brjod—/ /ces pa thos nas sa yi bdag /de la yongs 'khyud gus bcas pas/ /bu gcig dge ba'i ya tsā pu tra ku sha lā ye t+ya bhā ṣa ta/ /ta taḥs pi tā nu dzñā taḥsā shu ṣ+pe tre slad du ni/ /rigs pa mdzod ces rab tu smras/ /de nas yab ni mig chu dang / /bcas pas rjes ṇa kā na rgo/ /pra ya yo madh+ri pu tā rde sa hi taḥpañtsa bhiḥsha taiḥ/ /ma hastso gnang nags tshal du/ /blon po'i bu ni lnga brgya dang / /lhan cig rab tu song bar gyur/ /der ni drang rarnyi ke ta tra pra bra dzhai pā pya sā nu gaḥ/ /te ྾ kā le na so pa sh+ya srong che drung du/ /rjes 'brang bcas pas/ rab byung thob/ /dus kyis de dag ril/ ba dang / /shing shun kuṇ+ḍa babe+e la sañtsa yo/ /ta taḥs saṃ tsa ya dī ྾ ta da dar+sha na saṃ bi dā/ /e bsags pa de yis mthong / /de nas bsags pa la/ sdang des/ /de dag mi bltar —nges byas nas/ /blo kā tī bi dza ṣ+pe ta sbo kañtsita kā lo ma hā ma tiḥ/ /dar+sha nā bhā ṣa ṇi badha ni gros chen pos ji tsam dus/ /skye bos dbe+en par gcig pur sngubasdad/ /mthong dang smra ba nges pa yis/ /ya mo pi ya dṛts+tsha yā/ / pā ste su ga ta mi tru ghā pa prats+tshaḥ ku sha lo bsdams kyang 'dod dgar 'ongs pa yi5/ /ri dwags la ni dge ba dag /legs par 'ongs zhes smras mṛ shaṃ/ /pu nabya pū dzi tai dṛṭī mu nidhe na spyo ga bra tai/ /a mā t+ya nas dris/ /be+er yang thub pa ri dwags kyi/ /brtul zhugs de yis mchod mthong nas/ /blon po'i bu ta na yāḥsabye bi lak+ṣuḥs ma tsin+ta yan/ /mṛ go mṛ ga bra tabyu yo pū rnams thams cad ni/ /skyengs par gyur pas 7yang dag bsams/ /nags su yongs 'dzin med pa yithu/ /95—453

dzi to ni ཿ pa ri gra ho / / e tai bā nā dzi nā da ṇ+ḍa sa sgyu rā ḍa sba ri dwags ri dwags brtul zhugs 1 'di/ /gos dang dbyug pa'i tshogs dag gi/ /phung po spangs (snyepa rozlo to/ /e ta darba ma ṣ+pe nāsma dadhī na ni ya maḥkṛ taḥ/ /pra to ba 'di dag mchod/ /de yi don du 'di yis ni/ /bdag cag blta la nges pa byas/ /brtul zhugs jeyo ka ra ṇa bya grwa ta nu na ma snga pi bā ra yeta/ /i ti sañtsin+t+ra sarde te bra byad bsags pa na/ /'di dag gis kyang 5bzlog gam snyam/ /zhes pa bsams nas de dag gis/ /to ba s+thā ra sañtsa yo/ /na bye pra k+ṣi pya bā rā yī ya yuḥ shu d+dhā sta darnyi brtul zhugs 5/yo byad bsags pa kun/ /chu yi klung ) du rab spangs nas/ /dag pas de dang nye bar shaṃ / / t+ya k+ta gra ha bhu dzā te ṣā mā sha yā nu sha yo tsi hūṃ / / sa phyin—/ /'dzin pa spangs pa 8 de dag gisapa9sna/ /khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen nas de'i3 / /bsam dh+wa hūṃ pra kṛ ti dzñā tā be+e di dhe dhan+d+ra de sha rmā/ /rā dza pu traḥs e bā haṃ shākya ste pa bag la nyal dag la11/ /'os pa'i chos ni bstan pa mdzad/ /rgyal po'i bu de nga nyid de/ /blon po'i madh+ri sru na baḥ/ /pu nasgyu go pa de sho ya ma byā sre ྾ ma yā kṛ tāḥ/ /i ti bu dag nyu shākya rnams/ /da lta rto1bdag gis de dag la/ /gtong ba nyer bstan 'di slar byas/ /zhes pa shākya ku mā rabṛt+ta me taṅka thi tai bhigru ga ṇaḥ swa ya dzi ṣ+pe na/ /a bi shākya gzhon nu rnams kyi sngon byung ni/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa de dag nges bzung ste/ /rten rngubyed dh+war+ya pa rā ma pū dza ya ta tsā kā ru ṇa mā shri ta ba t+pa l+ya su ta su/ /rnams la mnyes snyegashin ldan par gyur pa de'i/ /thugs rje de ni dge slong tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa ṭ+wā ba dā na ka lpa la ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing tā yī mū kā baṅgā ba dā na maṣ+ṭa trir+shaḥpal+la waḥ// //las lkugs pa 'phye bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa mebargyad pa'o// //95byed454

te dza yarnyi j-i ti shā li naḥb ram̐ nim+bi kā ra ru tsi sru bi tasgo tāḥ/ /brtan pa'i khur kyis mi gdung lhag ma bzhin/ /legs byas bzod pa gang gi skyabazod pa 'dzin/ /she ṣa bta thra thu la bhā ra ṇirgya thā ye ba harnyi su kṛ tak+ṣa maḥk+ṣa rmā/ /pu ra rnam 'gyur med pa'i mdzes pa rmad byung bskyed/ /brtan ldan de dag mchog tu rgyal gyur cig /sngon gye pun+d+ra pu rgya bi sar+ya se na ri suḥpra dzā dzā dza ni ta pra kadza/ /u dus+thā nā mā bsod nams phyin ci lo ga pas sngon/ /gnod sbyin 'dir skyes skye rgu 2rnams kyi dgra/ /u dum pa zhes bya ni bi ḍo pa tā bair+yak+ṣaḥk+ṣa yā me+e ba kṛ ta k+ṣa rtodhu ta/ /a kā la kā lo ta ma nā tha ba drag por ni/ /gdung bas 'jigs la dus byas bzhin du gyur/ /'jig rten la brtse mgon med ba n+tu lo kā nu kam+bi bha ga bā na sa bye/ / shik+ko pa de shaṃ sha ra rde rnams kyi gnyen / /bcom ldan zhi ba 4brjod pas 'phral 'a/ ni/ /dus min dus der babe+eb pa nyer pra parja sha mā bye dh+wa yī bi na ye n+ya yuk+ta/ /tasmin pra shārnye bhu ba no ba tā bstan cing / /skyabs 'gro rab ldan 'du' ba dag la/ brkod/ /srid pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi ba de/ /se dṛṣ+ṭi pra z-iṣ+ṭaḥsu ga tai sa me t+ya/ /sañtsa ri rde nā ka pa tiḥpra ṇa mya bde gshegs de dus 'dzum skyes rgyu ba la/ /rab tu dga' bas lta 5ru 'ongs gyur pa/ /mtho ris bdag taṭ+wā la dzā tasmi ta mi h+phu bā tsa/ /kasmra da kas+thā ta smi ta tsan+d+ra le khā mu khām+bu dze bhā ti pos phyag 'tshal 'di skad smras/ /ci be+e/da glo bur 'dzum pa'i zla ris kyis/ /khrod zhal chu skyes rmad byung ta bābye tā ya/ /a kā ra khaṃ sa twa su dh+wa sa mu dra na lo ka sa mā n+ya ta yā ha slad du mdzes/ /snying stobs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rgyu med du/ /'jig rten thun mong bzhin du bzhad ma sarnyi / /khru two ti bā kyi tri da she shwa ra su tai sazla dadhī bha ga bān lags—/ /skabs gsum dbang phyug tshig de thos gyur nas/ /bcom ldan thams cad gzigs pas der ba bhā ṣe/ /asmin+d+ra de she ni dza pūzla bṛtrī smṛ tā smi tai dzā tai mi rda ma men+d+ra/ /gsungs pa/ /phyogs 'dir rang gi sngon byung dran 6gyur nas/ /dbang po bdag 'a 'dzum pa 'di skyes so/ /95—455

pu ra mu niḥk+ṣurnyir+pā di ba ṣ+pesmin nu bā pa nir+pā se ta ro ṣa do ṣaḥ/ /yo3bhūbye be sngon tshe nags tshal 'dir ni gnas gyur pa/ /khro ba'i skyon spangs thub pa bzod la dga'/ /chags rdul rā ga ra dzaḥswa bhā be+e bi dī ṣa bā nin+d+ra ram̐ bā ra be+en+de/ /a thot+ta rā shā bye pa tizla rang bzhin srid la sdang ba gang sna/ /pad+ma dag la zla ba bzhin du gyur/ /de nas dpyid ka byang phyogs sadhe ba nān+ta rā lo ka na kau tu ke na / / san+ta ཿ pu raḥ ke li su khā bdag po ni/ /chags ldan btsun mo'i tshogs bcas rtse dga'i slad/ /nags kyi nang rnams blta zhing dge ya kā mi ta dā shra yo pān+ta ma tī ma bā pa/ /rā gī kā lirwa ma sa bhū mi pā laḥmatshan gyis/ /de yi bste gnas nye ba'i sa gzhir 'ongs/ /chags ldan sa skyong rtsod ldan zhes pa des/ /pā da pra hā rerba da na sa baibya/ /le bhe bi lā se ṣā ni tam+bi byā nā ma sho ka rtse dga' la ni bud med rnams zhe dag gis/ /rkang pas bsnu na dang kha yi chang gis kyang / /mya ngan med sho hūṃ ba ku la shri yaḥ / / di shasta bo lo pa thra thu pra ko pa byu bhaṅga mdzes ba ku la dpal thob/ /der 1ni phyogs rnams dka' thub pa rnams kyis4/ /dka' thub nyams thraṣ+pe ri ba ta pā sa dzñā/ / ta tra bh+ra mad+dhir+bha rirba bhu puḥkā mabyā dhū mi byed khro chen smin 'khrog gi/ /tshogs kyis bzhin dang 'dod me'i du bas bzhin/ /bung ba 'khor bas ri ba sān+dha kā rāḥ/ /li la pi lo lāḥs ba nā ku lā dzā stan ba na spraḥsta ba mun pa dang bcas gyur5/ /rlung gis bskyod pa rtse dgas g.yo ba dang / /me tog phun bus dud pa nu ka na tā ā+oṃ/ /rak+ta dha rāḥsā ṭa la pal+la bā dzā pra purngi lā saṃ la la nā la tā mas sgu6 / /yal 'dab dmar po dang ldan mchu sgros dmar/ /'khri shing rol rtsed bud med rnams kyis ram̐ / /rā dzāṅga nāḥko tu ka bi blu me ṇa pa ṣ+pe tsa radh+yasta mṛ ṣi bi lokya/ /thob—/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo dge mtshan rnam 'phrul la/ /nags su rgyu bas chags las rnam grol zhing / /a tsañtsa la dh+yā na sa mā dhi salte bi muk+ta rā ge pa ri bār+ya tasbraḥ/ /tad+dhā sha g.yo med bsam gtan ting 'dzin la chags pa/ /drang srong de la yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /de nas 95—456

ma bye t+ya na re shwa ropho tha dṛṭī ba dhū bheḥpa ri bā ri tai tai/ /idh+yā pra mi dbang phyogs der mngon phyogs pas/ /bud med rnams kyis yongs bskor de mthong nas/ /phrag dog ko pā na la durni rīgh+raḥ tsits+tsha da ta snga shu sa pā ṇi pā rda/ /tshin+d+raṅga brgo bi sa nithi khro ba'i me ni blta dka' des/ /de yi lag pa rkang pa myur du bcad/ /brtan par sna rnam 'gyur med des kā rabyu ko pa bhū pā ya nā ma dhī raḥ/ /n+ya bā ra yata krudhe ta rañtsa tasmi yan lag tshogs/ /bcad kyang sa yi bdag la nges ma khros/ /dri za gnod sbyin lto 'phye lha tshogs kyis/ /gan+dhar+bha yakhyo ra ga de pa saṃ ghaḥ/ /ta taḥpra yā te dṛ pa to pu ri swe sa me de la khro ba drag po dag las bzlog /de nas mi bdag sde rang gi grong song tshe/ /nags nas 'ongs pa'i t+ya sabye mu na yo ba ṣ+pe bh+yaḥ/ /tai ta tra kriṭ+wā ba ya baṃ bi lokya k+ṣud+dhā a bi kro dha dhu thub pa thams cad kyis/ /der ni yan lag bcad pa de mthong nas/ /bzod ldan dag kyang khro bas tā ba bhū buḥ/ /shā sa pra dā nā bye mu khān ni bār+ya k+ṣun+tabya mi h+ye ba sa tā 'dar bar 'gyur/ /dmod pa 'debs la mngon phyogs de dag la / /bzlog nas bzod par bya zhes de nu bā tsa/ /k+ṣa mā sa mā liṅgi ta mā na sā rmā ko pa kri yā byeḥya te na saṃ gaḥ/ /yis smras/ /bzod pas yang dag 'khyud pa'i yid ldan rnams/ /khro ba'i las kyis chags par mi byed do/ /bi kā ra be go pi na pā ṇi pā da ts+tsha de ma mā bhūr+ya di bī ta ma byoḥ/ /sa h+ye na te khro bral bdag gi rkang lag bcad gyur kyang / /gal te rnam 'gyur shugs ldan ma gyur na/ /bden pa de nā k+ṣa ta de ha e ba snga mi t+ya ba dī sa su naḥpra sā dī/ /ta taḥk+ṣa shā ta saṅga yis nyams med lus ldan par/ /bdag gyur cig ces rab dang des sbar smras/ /de nas bden tshig ta pā ṇi pā rda rū rte bra r+ṇa ba t+ya sa do da ye na/ /a byu dza yata k+ṣun ti gu brjod pas skad cig la/ /lag pa rkang pa 'byar zhing rma dag gsos thu/ /lha yis bzod pa'i yon tan de 5rja sta be na tai de ba tā sa twa se taibya pu྾ཿ/ /rā dzā pi ta ta kilbi ṣa kā bstod cing / /snying stobs dkar ba'i me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /rgyal po'ang de sdig nag po brtsegs 95—457

la ku ṭa bi spo ṭa saṃ ghaṣ+ṭa bi na ṣ+ṭa tseṣ+ṭaḥ/ /pū yoṅka ṭā brta bi brta mā lta bus/ /chu bur kyis gtams spyod tshul rnam par nyams/ /rab drag rnag gi 'khor mor rnam 'khor na ཿ saṃ ba rta pā kai na ra shaṃ dza gā ma/ / yopho bhūh+phu rā k+ṣu rnyi ra ti dz+re zhing / /'jigs 3byed byun pa'i dmyal bar song 3bar gyur/ /bzod dka' 1drang srong chen por gang hak+ṣiḥsophohaṃ ka lir+yatso sa de ba dat+ta ཿ/ /a tī ta dṛt+ta sma ra ṇi shakra nā sngon byung snye/ /nga nyid rtsod ldan gang de lha sbyin 3no/ /brgya byin 'das pa'i spyod tshul dran pa la/ /kā ra rde dzā ta mi rda smi tai me/ /i tī bha ga ba taḥshu tā bā kyi bismi ya mā na bdag gi 'dzum pa 'di skyes rgyu med min/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gsung khye thos ya mtshan dag dang ldan pa'i saḥpra ma da bi ka tsa byastod+mā hā ba han+da ya nā ma lboḥ/ / ta ra ṇi ki ra yid / /rab dga' rnam rgyas spros pas 7gsal ba'i spyan gyi phreng 'dzin cing / /nyi ma'i 'od zer reg ṇa spasgo ṣ+pe ba sgu ṭaḥka ma khā ka ra ste da sha ba sa ti thra taḥpā yā pa tiste di bo ka pa/sa pad+mo'i 'byung gnas rgyas pa bzhin/ /lha rnams bdag po dga' bas skabs gsum gnas su song bar shā / /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā gyur / /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam byi yī k+ṣu n+t+ra ba dā na mū nā tsa tā ri sha pa l+la wa ཿ / / / /'khri shing las bzod pa la dga' ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste sum cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //a t+yan+ta mun+da ti ma tsā ma ha tī bi na sha do 6 gya durdza nā sa mā ga ma chen po khyad 'phags mtho ba rnams ni nyams par 'gyur ba yire / /skyon gyi rgyu ni skye bo ngan 7 dang e ba he tuḥ / / ku la dru māḥ ki la pha la pra sa bai sa hai ba sa r+yaḥ'agrogs pa kho na yin/ /'jug ngogs shing ni nges par 'bras bu skye bas lhan cig nyid/ /chu dang ba ta rnyi dza la saṅga ti bhin+da mū khāḥ / / ru tsi rā gā ra shā li khye bha 'grogs pas rtsa ba phyung nas 'bral la 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sngon/ /chu 95—458

ga bān pu rā/ /balgu ma t+yā ta ṭi na t+yā bi tsa tsā ra ta thā ga taḥ/ /bo yid 'ong kyeldan pa'i ngogs/ /khang bzang 2mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ /yangs pa can na rnam par rgyu/ /ta sngaḥkai brta saze na gaspyi rertswa se dusta ra/ /ka dā tsid gho ra ma ka raḥnya pa'i tshogs kyis de yi chu/ /bsgral bar dka' zhing zab pa las / /nam zhig rgya ni 'phangs pa na/ /k+ṣi two dzā lo sa mu rje ta ཿ / / a ṭ+wā da sha shi rāḥ sau ha dī pa dī 'jigs rung chu srin yang dag 'thon/ /mgo bo bco brgyad seng ge dang / /gnyis 'thung stag dang bung 4pa kha rā na naḥ/ /dṛ rde sa hā sre rā kṛṣ+ṭaḥsat+tha tā kā ra bi gra haḥ/ /tai dṛṭī ta tra bu'i bzhin/ /lus ni ri yi rnam pa can/ /mi ni stong phrag dag gis drangs/ /der ni de mthong rnam bi tra stuḥsradzñā kasgo ṇa radz+dza baḥ/ /ābyar+ya ni: la dā shā na ta sbyan+d+ra ya par skrag /'dren pa'i thag pa chad gyur cing / /ngo mtshar g.yo med nya pa rnams/ /ska da cig sdod min yu k+ṣa ṇi/ /ga ṇa ni ga ha nā:r+ya bi she ṣa sha ta shā li ram̐/ /saṃ sā re 'gro ba min/ /'khor ba las kyis rnam bkra bar/ /rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar zab mo ni/ /brgya dang ldan kan+d+ra bai tsi bye bi kā rā rde ka ro ti kaḥ/ /a tran+ta re ta mudre shaṃ bha ga bān pa'i khyad par rnams/ /su zhig gis ni rtsi bar byed/ /skabs/ der de yi ched du ni/ /'byung po 5byu ta bhā ba naḥ/ /dzi naḥs mā ya yo sadze+e dza na tā ṇa kṛ ta k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /dgongs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /skye bo thams cad skyob 6pa la / /dus mdzad rgyal ba yang dag byon/ /sa bradhe bā la la la rgo dza rgo kau tu ka saṃ ga tai/ /dṛṭī ta tra ka rodhī re rgan po byis pa bud med bcas/ /ltad mo la 'tshogs skye bo dag /bcom ldan gyis gzigs 'jug ngogs bha ga bā nā sa na gra haṃ / / bhi k+ṣu saṃ bhe ཿ pa ri bṛ tai dṛ stso der / /stan tsu/ ni yongs su bzung ba mdzad/ /dge slong tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /de bzhin ta tra ta thā ga tai/ /dza no bhūstozlu khaḥsazlaḥpra t+yā bṛt+ta i bo da byeḥ/ /gshegs pa der mthong nas/ /chu gter phyir la log pa bzhin/ /skye bo thams cad der phyogs gyur/ /95—459

tai bi lo bye ba bi na tāḥke bad+dhā pra ṇi ban+dha dz+wa/ /bi shā lo dzā lo sa ha sā de mthong nyid kyi rte'aphral la ni/ /nya pa rnam par dud pa yis/ /srog chags 'ching ba yangs pa'i rgya/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba ta t+ya dzuḥ/ /maṣ+ṭha kuspyi ra na krā di saṃ bhā ram̐ taṅgi dzā bha se/ /'khor ba lta bu 2 btang bar gyur/ /de yi gsung gis chu la nya/ /chu srin na kra la sogs tshogs/ /t+yaghā te bi ra ta ko sa ba bhū buḥkilbi ṣa dī ṣaḥ/ /tairtsu ste bha ga bān dṛṭī btang nas de dag khro bra' bas/ /sdig pa yi ni dgra bor gyur/ /de dag gis bkod chu srin che/ /ma hā ma ka ra ma gra taḥ/ /tai dza gā da sre dzadrwan+ta kābye ba ka ru ṇa na do/ /mdun du bcom ldan gyis gzigs nas/ /tshems kyi mdzes pa snyesgyusnying rje yi/ /chu bo spro bzhin de la smras/ /a pi two ka bi laḥpu tra kin+da sma ra se duḥkṛ tai/ /pa tso dubya ri ta snga ya ma bu kye ser skya khrod kyis ni/ /nyes pa 4byas pa mi dran nam/ /'di yang ngag gis 5nyes spyad dag /smin pi bā kophonu bhū ya te/ /sā gya ka spyo ṇa mi tradhe dza na ṣ+pe kā r+ya brta te/ /sazla pa nyams su myong ba yin/ /khyod kyi mi dge'i grogs gyur pa/ /ma de da lta gang 6na gnas/ /thams zlo ṣ+pe t+ya bi hi taḥsmṛ tā dzā ti mu bā tsa saḥ/ /bi sgo bha bā mi ka pi laḥcad mkhyen pas 'di nyabarjod tshe/ /de yis skye ba dran nas smras/ /khyab bdag bdag ni ser skya yin/ /sma rā mi ni dza duḥkṛ tai/ /ba tso du: ri ta snga yo pa ri pā ko nu byu ya te/ /rang gis sā / /sā ga tā na ga ram̐ pa h+phubyo: mūr+bhe ri bairde bī/ /bi bo rgya ni shi gyur—/ /de yis mkha' la zla ba yi/ /gzugs bzhin bdag po'i grong khyer phyin/ /mtshan mo nyal ba sube+e gya tsakre bo bye pra kā sha rgo/ /yā tā ya swa pa rda ta sde pra bhā te ba bslangs 1nas ni/ /byang chub rab tu gsal bar byas/ /de ni tho rangs rang gnas su/ /song ba'i tshe su dh+wa bye paḥ/ /pra bra dzñā bhi mu khaḥpu tra ma rnyi ṣi tsu shi khaṇ+ḍi ā+oṃ/ /na nor 'dzin bdag /rab ⑤ byung mngon par phyogs pas suzhu/ /gtsug phud can ni dbang bskur te/ /pra dzā tā zla ya ni k+ṣi su tai ma hā mā t+ya yosta taḥ/ /dṛ pa terbim+bi sā ra gya su de nas blon po dag las krude/ /skye rgu shebaskyab pa'i phyir gtad nas/ /de ni mi bdag gzugs can snying / /z-i daḥs ya yo pu ram̐/ /bi m+bi sā rasta mā yā tai bi ga tats+tshat+tha tsā ma grogs po'i grong khyer dag tu song / /gdugs dang rnga yab dang bral ba/ /de 'ongs gzugs can snying po ram̐ / /dz+re po pa tsā riḥpra ṇa taḥspru nyi pū tai ra pū dza ya ta/ /bi shān+ta yis—/ /rab btud mi bdag nyer spyad ni/ /mdzes shing gtsang ma rnams ⑥ kyis mchod/ /ngal bsos mā sa nā se dz+wa sa ta mū tse ba bi sma yaḥ/ /j-iṣ+ṭaḥsaṃ dar+sha ṣ+pe nā su shrī be+e khri la 'khod de la/ /de dang phrad pas rab dga' zhing / /dpal dang bral bas sdug bsngal ba'i/ /ya yo ge na duḥkhi taḥ/ /rā dzan+da nan+ta sā man+ta mo li bi shān+ta shā sa naḥ/ /mtshan ldan pa de yis smras/ /mtha' yas kun byi mgo bo la/ /rgyal po'i bka' ④ni ngal gso ④ba/ /pā ka shā sa na tu l+ya ste ka tha me ba mu pā ga taḥ/ /a bhin+da bagh+ra pra kṛ brgya byin dag dang mtshungs pa khrod/ /'di bzhin nye bar ji ltar gyur/ /rang bzhin bzhin ras ma bral tergube+e man+t+ra gya dhī ma taḥ/ /pa re ṇa rā bye ha ra rde bī ra saṃ bhā bya te zhing / /blo ldan don po—ni sbas pa can/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi rgyal srid ni/ /gzhan gyis grogs po ⑩srid na te/ /i ti thraṣ+ṭaḥs su z-i dā sasmi tasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzan dṛd+dhā ma yin/ /zhes pa lho1grogs kyis dris la des/ /'dzum bcas de la rab smras pa/ /rgyal po 'byor pa 95—480

bi bhū tirma na thra yā sadze+e gī mi nī/ /bi ṣa yā swā da be+e mu khyud bi thams cad du/ /'gro zhing rgan la bdag (mi dga'/ /yul nyams myong las phyir phyogs su2/ /sred trosgo na ma yā swa yi/ /sa yi bdag po khyod kyi blo/ /dam pa mang pos bkur yeb yang / /'khor ba las ni mu khā+e ka dze+e dzā tā te ma ti rī dṛ shī/ /sadho ṣa bi bha bā sgo ga su bha phyir phyogs pa/ /skal ldan 'di 'dra ci 6ltar skyes/ /chog shes 'byor pa thob gyur pas/ /skal ba gaḥsho bha se pa ram̐/ /lak+ṣa khaṃ shudha sa tā dze+e bai rā gyu bha ra ṇa ma naḥ/ /bzang po mchog tu mdzes/ /yid ni chags bral gyis brgyan hūṃ dzad+mān+ta ro pārdzi tai be+e rā gyi ku ru te ba rda ya di ma hā mo ha pra ro dka' sgrub byed rnams kyis ci/ /longs spyod skad cig spyod rnams kyis ci sdig ster sdug ldan khye/bde ba hā ba haṃ/ /ye na pā ṇa ya rde pri yā ba su ma tī saṃ t+ya bye te lbo la yā rnams kyis ci/ /gang gis nor mchog srog las phangs pa'i nor ldan ma ni bde blag nyid du gtong / /tre lokyā bhi ma te pi yaḥsma ra su khe bai mu khya dīk+ṣu gu ruḥ/ /saṃ mo ha gang zhig 'jig rten gsum po 'dod kyang 'dod pa'i bde la phyir phyogs 'doms pa'i bla/ /gang gis kun bya sa nā tu ram̐ dza ga di rda ye nā nu kaspraspa rda pu byeḥko pi sa dzā ya te rmongs sdug bsngal gyis gzir 'gro ba 'di ni rjes su brtse ba'i gnas/ /bsod nams dag gis blo ldan ma ti ma tī saṃ sā ra bā maḥ sha maḥ / / itru ghā be+e m+bi sā raste ni rnams kyi zhi ba ci yang 'khor ba'i g.yon der 'gyur/ /zhes brjod gzugs can snying po des snye/ /'od tā be ṇa ba nā shra oṃ/ / sa pra shā saṃ bha ga ba te tabye ṣ+ṭha rnya n+ya be da ma'i tshal gyi gnas khrid nas/ /rab tu btud byas bcom ldan la/ /de yis chabyung ba'i mtha' rnams yata / /u dru ya rto pi su ga tā kā ram̐ su tsi ra tsin+ta tai/ /bi gsol—/ /bde gshegs rnam pa mthong gyur nas/ /dga' bas yun ring ④bsams byas te/ /bdag lo kya hasgo dād+ma sna kṛ ta kṛ t+ya ma ma n+ya ta/ /pra ṇa ma bya gra shi ra sā nyid bya ba byas par gyur 5/ /u dru ya na yis kyang bsams/ /mgo bos 37phyag 'tshal gyis byel ba⑦ / /saṃ sā rastso di nī ta no/ /pa bā ta bha ga ba sprusbyosta gya pra bra bye yā sa de yi lus la/ bcom ldan gyesazhe// /gzigs pa 'khor ba gcod byed ni/ /rab byung nyid dang lhan cig ha / /bhik+ṣu bhā ba ma thā sā r+ya pā tra pā ṇiḥs ṭī ba rī/ /na ga re piṇ+ḍa babs 9 —/ /de nas dge slong dngos po thob/ /lag na chos gos lhung bzed ⑨ ldan/ /grong khyer du ni pā tā dhī tsa kā ra dza na be+e sma yo / / pra dzāḥ shi kha ṇ+ḍi dha m+bi ṇa pā bsod snyoms bslangs/ /skye bo ya mtshan ldan par byas/ /gtsug phud can gyi 1skrerab dang blos/ /95—482

la yi tā pra sa n+da dhīḥ / / yā ta kā le na kā lu 6 ma dha s+thā bhe ra chos kyis skye rgu lho bskyangs byas nas/ /dus kyis chos min mngon 'dod cing / /rnyog pa dag dang ldan tophobha ba ta/ /ka lu ṣe kāñtsa na ru tsa bya t+ta birlube+e lā si dī/ /na ka par grur/ /gser 'od gsal ba'i glog dag ni/ /rnam par ro' pa'i sprin 'phreng nabazhin/ /phun sum gya ku ru de lakhrorme gha mā le ba mā na saṃ/ /a nā yatrī ma hā ma h+yerte ru ko bye tshogs pas su yi yid/ /dri ma can du byed ma yin/ /te ru ka dang bhi ru ka /blon chen dag gis chos ru kabya tai/ /a dhadz+re kan+d+ra ni ra tai krur+ghaṃ ta t+ya dza tuḥpra hūṃ/ /tata pa de be+e hi to min gyi/ /las la dga' zhing dbang ma gyur/ /khro ldan jo bo de btang gyur/ /de nas gnas su/ rgyal po rā dzñā sa tsi bo daṇ+ḍa muṅga ro/ / tsiṭ+wā nu dṛt+ta ku smras/ /skye rgu sngurnams la mdza' bas yang dag chags/ /rgyal po gzhung ngan dag tu smra bar byed/ /swa ya sha ཿ khyu sa nā yi ba dzā ya rnye dhū rta ma dh+ri ṇa ཿ / / na dha n+d+ra g.yon can blon po rnams kyis 5rang nyid kyi/ /grags pa rab tu sgogs par byed pa yin/ /gang zhig rje na su khaṃ nārja na kirta ye na dz+re bi tai/ /ga ṇa yarnyi pra sgo raze te j-i t+yā bha bo'i don du ni/ /chos la mi rtsi bde la min/ /don min grags min 'tsho ba min/ /de dag mchog tu bya bhak+ta yaḥ/ /nā khaṇ+ḍi tā k+ṣa yi tā na tabhā nā su r+pā ḍi tā/ /kuzlan+t+rabe+e gus pa'i g.yog /nges par til mtshungs skye rgu 6rnams/ /rgyal po'i don byed ma bcag pas/ /ma yin kri yā rā dzñāste la tu spyoḥ ki la pā dzāḥ / / i nyi bru bā ṇi to rā ma nyams pas kyang min/ /ma gdungs pas min ma gzir min/ /zhes sma sa 7de dag rgyal srid kyi/ /dzñā ni yuk+ṣiṃ rā bye tsin+ta ṣ+pe/ /lo bhāta pra bṛsto dudṛ to habye niḥsha ra ṇaḥpra bsam pa la ni rgyal pos bskos/ /chags las (she spyod tshul ngan pa yis/ /skyabs med skye rgu 9 gzhom par 95byed483

dzāḥ / /nirngi tsa re du rā tsā re ku ma to thra thi bī pa to/ /lup+ta sa bye ma hā mā zhugs—/ /sa yi bdag po blo gros ngan/ /rnam par mi spyod spyod tshul ngan/ /sna chen bden pa nyams bye pra dzā r+ghaṃ dzī bi te ku taḥ/ /u dā ya rto tha tsi re ṇa ka dā dzibyu ṇi dze+e pa thi/ /pa'i tshe/ /skye rgu lkurnams ni ga la 'tsho/ /de nas nam zhig yun ring 1na/ /lam du u dru ya na yis/ /ni dza de shā ga tai bā: sa prats+tsha dṛ pa rabye yoḥ/ /so ba dadre ba ku sha li rang yul nas 'ongs tshong pa la / /mi bdag yul 'khor gtam dag dris/ /de yis smras pa lha khyod kyi⑦/ /su tasta ba ma tī pa tiḥ/ /kin+tu sad+marnyi ra hi taḥku madh+ri ba sha mā ga taḥ/ /sras pos 3sa yi bdag po dge/ /'on kyang dam pa'i blon chodang bral/ /blon po ngan pa'i dbang du song / /ta tra pra dzā dzā be+e ta to pa tā paḥko pi bra thrat+taḥpra bhu shā sa ṣ+pe na/ /ye nār+ya tad+ku྾ der ni 3jo bo'i bka' yis skye rgu ⑦rnams/ /nye bar gdung ba rab rgyas ci yang gyur/ /gang gis da lta ta de sha dzad+ma di bā ni shaṃ sho tsa ti po ra lo kaḥ/ /ya tra dh+warnyi sri dza de ni yul ngan skyes/ /grang sheba'i 'jig rten nyin dang mtshan mor gdung / /gang na nyi mas mun pa spro ti ta ra ṇir+ya tra tsabyeghi badhī ya tro de ti pra ka ṭa ma mṛ tā duṅka ṭaḥkā la ku ṭaḥ/ /byed gang na zla ba me char 'bebs/ /gang na bdud rtsi las ni rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rab gsal skye/ /ya tra tā tā ha ra ti dṛ pa tiñdzu ba bṛk+ṣiṃ pra dzā rmā ta tā kāsdo pra thra ta bi pu lo pa gang na skyob byed mi yi bdag pos skye rgu rmyernams kyi srog 'tsho 'phrog /nyer 'tshe ⑩ che ba rab rgyas de na cho bla be kaḥsh-i ḍo ti/ /i t+yā sak+ta dṛ pa yā sa khin+da sngar+bhe ma yi ba tsaḥ/ /nge dag ni su zhig nyan/ /mi bdag gis gdungs skyo la gcags skye / /tshong pa'i tshig ni bzod dka' ba/ /duḥs ha ba ṇi dzaḥkhru twa sa ta spru tse 1 pā ni byeḥ/ /maṅgi rā tā mi to ga gdung ba'i rang bzhin de thos nas/ /brtse ba'i gter des de la smras/ /bdag gi tshig gis 'di nas tā tūṇ+ḍi mā shā sa ya pra dzāḥ / / s+thā pa yi byā mya haṃ dhadz+re swa ya me khyod—/ /song la skye rgu 1snyedabugs dbyung mdzod/ /nga ⑫nyid 'ongs nas gtsug phud can/ /chos la rab 95byed484

ṇaḥsha shī sbra bi raḥs rā bye sgothi mits+tsha ti/ /ṭī ba rojisna gā tra su ba brtan ri bong can nyams 1bzhin/ /de ni rgyal srid spyod par 'dod/ /lus ni chos gos kyis skyo zhing / /ra ba s+thā bye lā ṣi ṇaḥ / / dzā tā su mu ṇ+ḍi te mū dh+ri raspyo ka mu ku ṭa gos mchog mngon par 'dod ldan 'di/ /mgo zlum la ni rin chen gyis/ /mtshan pa'i cod pan 'dod smṛ hā / / rat+na ha bye 6 na ba tā sasto ga bi bha bo bye ba / /t+ya ghā par gyur2 / /rin chen khang par /7gas/ra pa yi/ /longs spyod 'byor bas rnam jebaskrun pa'i/ /rtse bi lā saṃ sā yā saṃ pa na bā paṃ sa he ta kaḥ / /mṛ du sha ya na su dga' btang nas/ nags kyi gnas/ /ngal/ dub ldan pa su yis bzod/ /ri dwags rmig pas rtsub cing khārta ye ka rja she ra te te ha ri ṇa khu rakha ror+yat+pa ṇ+ḍa kā su sba lbo 6/ /tsher ma bltams 5pa'i thang kha 6la/ /gang zhig 'jam pa'i mal stan bder 'os pe de dag ji ltar nyal/ /ma dhu bi dhu ka ra shī tai yadz+re r+pā tai ka tharnye ba na dza ga dza ma doṣ+ṭi tik+ta ma gang gis/ zla zer ltar bsil chang 'thungs de dag nags skyes kyi/ /glang po'i chang gis dro zhing kha ba'i chu ni m+bhaḥpi brnyi/ /a dhu ṣ+pe ba ta ba san+da pra ba sa bi ṣa ma sbi taḥ/ /ā r+yasma tai ji ltar 'thung / /khyod la mi bzang bgrod pa ni/ /da lta nyid du nye bar gnas/ /lugs shes rnams na ya bi dā ma rā dza pu tra ni pā ta rna/ /tasmra da nā ga to rā dzā pūthru ba rgyasta kyi dang ngo/'i gros/ /rgyal sras nges par lhung byed pa'o/ /de slad rgyal po ma 'ongs pa'i/ /sngon du jo bo ba pra sgo/ /dī paṃ harnyi pa tai go hi na dastebye ta sa mā ba tan/ /ta yo ri ti khyod kyis gsod/ /phye ma leb ni 'bab pa dag /gal te ma bsregs mar me 'joms/ /zhes pa de dag gi rā k+ṣi pra ma jubyu pa ti rā ku laḥ/ /kha la me s+hoḥka lu ṣa hūṃ bhā tai ka gya na tshig gis ni/ /sa bdag myur du 'khrugs par gyur/ /mi bsrun pa9sprin gyis su yi yid/ /dri ma ldan par mā na saṃ/ /sa to ba bhā ṣe sā shi kaḥkra ka tsa spyu ra hūṃ ga taḥ/ /bā dhaḥbyed mi 'gyur/ /dogs bcas sog le bzhin du ni/ /rtsub mor gyur des der smras pa/ /bdag dang 95—486

sā dh+wa ra e bā yo yu ba yorma ma tsā gra taḥ/ /bha bad+dhā me ba bi na yo khyed gnyis mdun du ni/ /gnod pa 'di ni thun mong nyid/ /khyod kye gnyis nyid kyis khyad par gyis2 / /pā ya bi shān+ta yā dhi yā/ / bi tsār+ya kār+ya tā t+pa bye yarlu shā taji bye yā tshul dang thabs la gnas pa'i blos/ /bya ba'i de nyid rnam dpyod lakasna/ /gang rigs de ni sgrub 4par tī / /i ti rā dzñā kṛ ta sot+pa hā to bi sre rje shu ghā ta kān/ /u dru ya mdzod—/ /ces te rgyal pos spro bar byas/ /de dag gis mgyogs gsod byed btang / /gsad 5phyir u ṇa myu gra pa rja ba dh+wa yi ba ba ban+ta tuḥ/ /so bi bra dzā pa ri tā ṇi ni yohūṃ dru ya na yi byu/ /mdun gye lam ni rab tu bsdams/ /des kyang skye rgu ) yongs bskyab be+ed/ /bu 'a/ bsgo 8pu tra mur+ya taḥ/ /bha ga ba tai sa ma bye t+ya bra dzā m+bi ti bya dzi dzñā pata/ /bar brtson pa yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon phyogs te/ /bdag 'gro 'o zhes zhu bar rmyebyas/ /sarba snye nā dh+ya nu dzñā taḥrba gre tai bhu dz+re tā mi nyi/ / kan+d+ra pā sha sa mā rang gis byas pa spyod mdzod ces/ /thams cad mkhyen pas rjes gnang nas/ /las kyi zhags pas yang kriṣ+ṭaḥ sa ya yo ro ru shaṃ pu ram̐/ / ta maze dzarnyi ni rgyu dza mā tsā ra mi dag drangs/ /de ni sgra sgog 1 grong khyer song / /lam du zol 1byemed 'ong ba de/ /blon po gdug pas ba durdza nāḥ/ /dubye mā t+ya pra yuk+tasta dzasprut+thazla ni ghā ta kāḥ/ / ta gya bskos pa yis 1rta/ /gshed ma de dag rnams kyis bsad/ /skye bo ngan pas kun spyod bzhin/ /bsad pa ṭī ba ra pā tā dī bṛ tī tā ni ha te su te/ /n+ya be da yan kṛ tai dī h+ye rā de yi chos gos dang / /lhung bzed sogs bzung de dag gis/ /blon po dag la mgu ba'i slad/ /rgyal dza kār+ya ma mā t+ya yoḥ/ /ta taḥbā ba bra z-iṭ+wā rgyu dz+ra pas+thā rgyu pra dadhi tai/ /dṛṭ+wā po'i bya ba byas pas 8 smras/ /sdig pas rab dga' de dag gis/ /mi yi bdag la rab tu bstan/ /pha mu mo ha sa ha sā raghālto ṭī ba ram̐ be+e tuḥ/ / sa labye saṃ dzñā sha na kaiḥyi chos gos khrag gis ni/ /sbags mthong 'phral la rmongs par gyur/ /dal gyis ki'adu shes thob pa des/ /95—487

shu sho tsa na ta thā gu sum̐/ /ya thā pa ti ta māza rna gho re na ra ka ga hwa re/ /ji ltar bdag nyid dmyal ba ni/ /'jigs rung gting du lhung ba yis/ /rgya ngan de bzhin bla ma'i min/ /sophob dbo ta saṃ pā bye pha lo kha la dza nād+ma yā/ /e shār+ya ma dhu lubye na des smras dbang phyug sbrang rtsi skyachags/ /sdig par lhung ba ma mthong ba/ /bdag gis skye bo mi bsrun khyepā ba pā ta ma ba sh+ya tā/ /a ho pa ta ni rā lam+bi gho re na ra ka saṃ las—/ /kye ma 'bras bu yang dag thob/ /kye ma kye hud rten sa med/ /'jigs rung dmyal ba'i gting ka ṭi / / un+da tā ro hi rde sa r+yaḥ pa ta shaṃ kha la saṅga tai / /du ni/ /mthon por 'dzegs rnams mi bsrun ldudang / /'grogs pas 'phral la lhung byed 'gyur(5/ /kṛ ta me tata ma hata pā paṃ duṭ+wā mā t+ya bye yā ma yā/ /pa ti ta su ma me dā bhā pā gdug pa blon po'i blo gros kyis/ /bdag gis snyig chen 'di dag byas/ /da ni lhung bar gyur pa ④bdag /ba ko pi na pā ba kaḥ/ /tu l+ya pi tus+thārta tabya ba dhe kā ma ma niḥkṛ tiḥ/ /gtsang byed kyis kyang gtsang mi byeg /menyam du pha dang dgra bcom dag /bsad pa bdag ni su yis sgrol//r+pā tai ya tra ma yi kasmin pā tre sa da ha ā+oṃ bi ṣe/ /thradhe pi ta ri niḥshaṃ gang du bdag gi 'usnod gcig tu/ /dug ni sreg byed ldan pa 'thungasa3 / /dogs med yab ni rgan po ka sha ma pra bra bye lā shri te/ /swa tsibho ni shi tai shaste lo bhābye pa ri tai ma dag /rab byung zhi ba bsten pa la/ /chags las bdag gis rang gi sems/ /mtshon ni rnon po'i bya ba yā / /yahūṃ tsin+ta ta me ba kadza dza na shaṃ sho rtu na tar+sha kya te dṛṣ+ṭi byas / /gang zhig bsams pa nyid na 'dar ba skyed byed de ni thos par yongs 67mi bzod/ /gang zhig yartse ka ro ti sho ka ka la dzā nibye ta nā nā ma pi/ /ya tra kaur+ya ma pi mthong nas sems med rnams kyang mya ngan dag la rab tu bcags la9snapar byed/ /gang la 'gyod pa drag pra yā ti mṛ du tī tī drwa nu tā pāghi nā ta tā pi pra sa rarnyi nispyo ṇa bye po'i me yis ma rungs rnams kyang 'jam po nyid 'gyur ba/ /de la'ang brtse med blo ldan rnams ni ral gri 95—‘ 88

yī niste sha tīṣ+ṭhaḥkri yāḥ/ /i trughā duḥkha san+tabe+eḥpra lā sa mu kha rā na rnon po'i bya ba rab tu sgosasti/ /zhes brjod sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa2/ /bzhin ni cho nge'i sha mu cor naḥ—/ /n+ya pa byas kyang bdag ma khros/ /'di 'dra las kyi 8bgrod pa yin/ /gang tā ba de ba me duḥkhaṃ yan+d+ra bhā su ma tī pa teḥ/ /kha la saṅga ma do ṣe ṇa zhig sa bdag blun po la/ /mi bsrun ḍazhesnadang 'grogs skyon dag gis/ /'jigs pa chen po nye bar gnas/ /bha yo ma hā du pasbi tai/ /pra tha mephotī ma hā bā yuḥpu re gya ni pa nyi 6 ti/ /'di dag kho na bdag sdug bsngal/ /'di yi grong du dang po yi/ /nyin la rlung chen 'bab par 'gyur/ /dī tī ye puju bṛṣ+ṭabya bsnga bṛṣ+ṭa sta taḥpa re/ /rū pya dṛṣ+ṭabya tube+e tsa tem gnyis pa la ni me tog char/ /de nas gzhan la gos kyi char/ /dngul gyi char ni ma dṛṣ+ṭabya pañtsa me/ /rat+na thraṣ+ṭasta taḥdzā shu bṛṣ+ṭabya sap+ta me/ /ta yā sa ban+tu yang gser gyi char/ /de nas rin chen char pa ste/ /rdul gyi char pa bdun pa la/ /de yis sa bdag rāsgo sau gzhag par bya/ /zhes smras thubu tsha gtad nas ni/ /blon po dag ni rang khyim song / /ri mo 3yis ka t+yā mā da ya bra ya yo gho ṣi lā la yo/ /ta taḥkra me ṇa ta da juta ya thoshrī kyang bu mo blangs/ /gdangs can kyi ni gnas su song / /de nas ji ltar dge slong gis/ /brjod de byek+ṣu shā pu re/ /dzñā na dī pa ba ti pra dzñā ya thā ta twa hi pa sh+ya ti/ /ṣakhye bhi rim pas grong du byung / /ye shes sgron ldan shes rab kyis/ /de nyid ji lta bzhin du mthong / /de nas nyi rat+na bstephotha pa ti te rat+na pū ri tī/ /ya ya tun+d+ra ba mā dā ya tā ba mā ma drug pa la/ /rin chen char ni bab pa'i tshe/ /blon po de dag rin chen kyisardothu/ /gang ba'i gru t+yā ba lak+ṣi to/ /to dak+ṣi rde di shaṃ ga tā tsakra tun+d+ra ga ra dwa yo/ /he ru ko bzung ma tshor song / /de dag lho yi phyogs song nas/ /grong khyer gnyis byas te ru kas/ /te ru ka zhes 95byed496

he ru kā khye rnyi ru kats+tsha ta thā pa raḥ/ /pa re sgo r+pā shā pak+ṣe ṇa ma hā tā pa ta de bzhin du/ /gzhan byis bhi ru ka tshal lo/ /nyi ma gzhan la rdul gyi char/ /chen po babs 1nga/sa tā dṛ paḥ/ /sa ban+tu rāt+thaḥpra la yi pra ya yo na ra kā ti thiḥ/ /sa dmyal ba'i mgron/ /mi bdag gnyen dang yul 'khor dang / /bcas pa rab tu nub par gyur/ /rgyal daṇ+ḍi muṅga re rā rnyi yā te kilbi ṣa she ṣa tī/ /te madh+ri pu tra mā dā ya byom po dbyug pa tho bar bcas/ /sdig pa'i lhag mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /kā t+yā ya nas nam mkha' las/ /blon nā kā t+ya ya no ya yo/ /ta me pā nu ga tā pyo t+yā na bha sā pu ra de ba tā/ /po'i bu de khyer nas gshegs/ /grong khyer lha mo nam mkha' la/sa/ /dga' bas/ de yi 2 rjes 'brangs pa/ /ta dā dzha yā kha ra ba ni kar+pā ṭi bi da dhe dz+re ti/ /bhek+ṣu pu dh+yā nu bhā be de yi bka' yis kar pa ṭa'i/ /sha ri'i nags su gnas par byas/ /dge slong bsod nams mthu dang na bhā gyermarnyi su ta su tsa/ /a bye jo ṣ+pe na de byā: shrī mat+ta da bha bah+phu ni—/ /blon po'i bu de'i skal ba dang / /lha mo yi yang byin brlabs kyis/ /grong de dpal dang ldan par ram̐ / /ta tā tha de ba tā tsakre tsi bye kā kyā ya na gya sā/ /su ra ba h+ye ya da gyur—/ /de nas lha mo de yis der/ /kā t+yā ya thuna'i mchod rten byas/ /gang zhig da lta'ang lha ldan la / /t+yā se ban+dabye tsi t+ya ban+da kāḥ/ /madh+ri sru nu ma thā dā ya ladze+e ṭī ba ra kaṇi ke/ /mchod rten phyag byed phyag 'tshal byed/ /de nas chos gos grwa 5zur la / /'chel pa khyon ngo/'i bu khyer nas//ladza rna sa ya yo byo: de shaṃ kā t+yā ya naḥpa re/ /lasba te lalba te ko ya mi 'phyang zhing kā t+yā ya na de/ /yul gzhan dag tu mkha' las so/nga / /skye bo rnams ni ya mtshan las/ /kyugho bisma yādz+dza ṣ+peḥ/ /ba bhū buste dza nāsta tra ladza kā i ti bi khru tāḥ/ /'phyang zhing 'phyang ba su zhes brjod/ /der ni skye bo de dag rnams/ /'phyang ba po zhes grags/ par gyur/ /a tān+ta re di baṃ yā te ta tā pu tre ma hi pa to/ /sa kṛ ta sh+ya ma ko rā skabs der bud med sa yi bdag /mtho ris dag tu song ba'i tshe/ /de yi bka' yis sngo bsangs de/ /95—497

shu muṣ+ṭi ni pā na nāta/ /pra t+yā san+da bi bā hā ha mi ti bhā ta ra māha sā/ /phyag dar rdul par lkugator ba las/ /bdag ni bag mar gyur pa la/ /nye zhu zhes ming po la des smras/ /ta ta sta gya pra bā de na bi k+ṣi burba rā rjabe+e ye/ /spyudhī pra h+ye ka budhe de nas de yis 5gtam dag gis/ /bag mar 'gro 'dod gzhon nu ma/ /rgyags pas rang sangs rgyas su ra rdzu se thra bhā kā n+ya kāḥ/ /gh+ra rja k+ṣa ra pra thraste na pra t+ya phe na be+e rnams kyi/ /mgo bo la ni rdul rnams gtor/ /srin thubus zos rjes yi ge la/ /rab zhugs yid ches mo hi tā ཿ / /nim+bi tsā ra pra ba rtadhe be+e rudhe ṣ+ṭa pi ba stu 6/ / pra kyis rmongs pa/ /rtog dpyod med rnams 'gal ba yis/ /dngos po la yang rab tu 'jug /shesdig dṛ t+ta pā ta kā tsa ra ta smi na bu dhe bu dh+wa bhi bye / /spyod la zhugs de yi tshe/ / 'jigs pa rtogs shing khong chud pas⑥/ / burtse sogs kyi bod skad tshig rkang gcig pu 'di ni ba ra rde kṛ ha pa tī ka rma ṇa sta su tsa kra tu ཿ / / me+e ba chad pa 'dar los bsgyur/7 las de khyem bdag mkhas pa dang / /sad pa zhes pas bzlog pa byas/ /bu mo ka sde na ra pa tiḥshi khaṇ+ḍi pā pa byā ga j-ita/ /pra bā de kaṭ+wā dad+dhā tā bhi khyoḥde nyid gtsug phud can/ /mi bdag sdig pa ldan par gyur5/ /de yi ming po gtam sgogs kyang / /dge kā t+yā ya no gya yo/ /dzā to kṛ ha pa ti rū bye duṣ+ṭa tsa rirni bā ra shāta/ /pu ro pa slong kā t+yā ya na 'di/ /ngan spyod dar ba bzlog pa las/ /khyem bdag de dag skyes pa ni/ /he ru ka tā pa nirmulto he ru bye ru kabya to/ /i ti bha ga ba taḥkhru tā bā kyi dang bhe ru ka /grong khyer nye bar gdungs 97las thar/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gsung thos dge slong rnams bi tsā r+ya tsa dzhak+ṣa baḥ pha la pa ri ṇa ti dzñā tā tsi hūṃ shu bhā shu bha ka n+d+ra ni rnam par dbe+ed nas kyang / /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams 'bras bur yongs gyur bkra ba rab shes rde / / kha la dza na ba tsastu khye sha hūṃ bi tsā ra sa rma gu zu su nas / /mi bsrun snartaskye bo'i tshig mtshungs dgra dang rtog dpyod dang mnyam bla ma dang / /legs byas tso1 95—500

kṛ ta sa dṛ shaṃ ban+tu lo ke na kiñtsa na me ni re/ /e ti k+ṣe men+d+ra be+e ra tsi dang mtshungs gnyen ni 'jig rten dag na ci yang med par sems/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas tā yi bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yā mu dā ya shā ba dā na me pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las u dru ya na'i rtogs pa brjod ka tsa tā ri shaḥpabe+e waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste zhe kyetregacig pa'o// //yabye pā la bi shā la dā na bi bha ba probye ta pu rgyu bye ka dā na gang zhig sa skyong 'byor pas rab bskrun rgya cher sbyin pa'i bsod nams las/ lhag pa/ /dam pa'i snga ti kṛ sha gya sat+pa la bha ra pāsgo t+ya lo du rga taḥ/ /shubye sre ba bi z-ibye dharma 'bru yi grukhur ni dbul ba rirnams kyi sbyin pa shin tu chung bas 'thob4/ /chos dkar rnam par 'phel la dha ba la shra d+dhā sa mṛdh+yām+bi tai niḥsaṃ sā ra bi dz+re bhi te ta du tsi tai tsit+ta dad pa phun tshogs dang ldan 'khor ba med pa ni/ /rnam par 'phel byed de ni sems dang nor dag dag pa su bit+ta gya tsa/ /dzi na dze ta ba nā rā ma be+e hā ri ni ma hā dha naḥ/ /dhī nyid la rigs pa yin/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal/ gyi ni/ /kun dga' ra bar bzhugs tshe sngon/ /mnyan rā bhe jo naḥshra bsgyu ma bhudṛ ha pa ti pu rā/ /ta su paṇ+ḍi ta nā mā dhū ta yod du ni khyim bdag dag /brtan depa zhes bya nor chen byung / /mkhas pa zhes bya de yi bu/ /legs phu traḥsu kṛ ta paṇ+ḍi taḥ/ /a khaṇ+ḍi ta ya shaḥpu bye dā nā waṃ kā ra maṇ+ḍi byas cedag la mkhas pa byung / /nyams pa med pa'i grags pa dang 7/ /bsod nams nor gyi rgyan gyis taḥ / /sa bā la e ba bhek+ṣu rde rā dzāhain+d+ran+t+ra sgo dza naiḥ/ /shā ri pu tra pra dh+wa spras—/ / 'di ni 8byis pa kho na nas/ /shā ri'i bu sogs dge slong rnams/ /rgyal/ po la 'os gos zas nā nā tsa kā rā ti thi sa྾ yo/ / ta taḥ ka dā tsi dakhye ṇa dur+bhek+ṣa k+ṣa kyis—/ /mgron yodu gnyer zhing bsnyen bkur byed/ /de nas nam zhig mi bzad pa'i/ /mu ge skye bo 95—501

yi te dza ṣ+pe/ /yā tsu yā tsa ka tu l+ya twa piṇ+ḍats+tsha dobe+e nā ma bhuta/ /bhek+ṣu rde saṃ zad byed pa/ /babe+e nga bya slong byed mtshungs pa nyid/ /slong ba'i 'tsho ba chad pa byung / /dge slong rnams ka ṭi ta smin kā le ba ra ma dā ru be+e/ /paṇ+ḍi ta su ga tā snu taḥpra tasbe dze ni nyam nga ba/ /mchog tu mi bzad dus der ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas mkhas pa ni/ /bos nas rgyal ta kā na rna/ /tai pra bra dzaste tu re ge na kāñtsa nā dā na sho bhi na/ /ā tsurngi byed tshal du chas/ /gser kyi phreng bas spras pa yi/ /rta yis bgrod par byed de la/ /yon tan rab ṭāḥ sa ma byet+ya gu khot+pa ha sa hiju baḥ/ /arja sarjarba na kalpa thrak+ṣastergyas mi bzod 1 pa'i/ /g.yo can sngon 3 du phyogs nas smras/ /slong ba'i don mthun slong ba yi bye/ /di k+ṣu bi khru ta ཿ / / sha tā ni pa ñtsa saṃ pra bhā sta mu byi shā sha ya dpag bsam shing khyed phyogs su grags/ /bdag cag lnga brgya khyod la ni/ /bsam pa gtad la ④yang ba yo/ /a lo kā dzā shu ka yu ge pra h+ye ka naḥs m+bi hi tai/ /a dhu ṣ+pe bā bi lam+bi dag 'ongs/ /rgyan dang gos ni zung re dag /bdag cag so so yang dag 'dod/ /gal te phod na da lta na dī ya tī ya di shākya te/ /i sgok+tasteḥs dā tsā raḥso ba tīr+ya tu ram̐ nyid—/ /thogs pa med par gnang bar mdzod/ /de yis 'di brjod dam pa yi/ /spyod ldan de ni rta ga man/ /sā dhu pū dza bi dh+wa ye ྾ dhī mār+pā ṇa ma tsi ta ya ta/ /bha ga las babs/ /de rnams legs par mchod byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas skad cig bsams/ /gal te ban+ta ma dṛbye ba gatshwa mi swa kṛ haṃ ya di/ /ā san+d+ra mṛ ta pā na su tai birgyu bcom ldan ma mthong bar/ /rang gi khyem du phyin pa na/ /bdud rtsi 'thung la nye ba yis/ /gegs shede ka tha mud+ma he/ /a da twa thra ya mabe+e snga bra dzā mi ya di nisnga paḥ/ /ka bdag gis ji ltar bzod/ /slong rnams 'dod pa ma byin par/ /gal te khrel med phyin pa na/ /sbyin dze+e ka ro mi dā na gya hūṃ swa yo pra ta khaṇ+ḍa dzā/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tasta su bhi tā bhū pa'i brtul zhugs rang nyid kyis/ /nyams pa 'di yang ji ltar bya/ /de ni de ltar sems pa na/ /klu yi 95—502

mo sa muṅga taḥ/ /nā ga rā dzaḥswa yi she ṣaḥpā dā dārja sa m+bi nyi tai/ /rgyal po lhag ma rang / /sa gzhi brtol nas yang dag 'thon/ /slong 3rnams 'dod pa rab tu byen/ /daja ni nā ga rā dze na bas+thā rgyu bha ra shā ni tsa/ /sa te bh+yaḥpra ti yāt+yā shu ya yo klu yi rgyal pos byen pa yi/ /gos rnams dang ni rgyan rnams kyang / /de dag rnams la byin nas de/ /zug ni ཿ sha l+ya tā mi ba / / te bi dṛ ṭī ta dā byar+ya pu ju su ga ta rngu med bzhin mgyogs par song / /des kyang ngo mtshar de mthong nas/ /bde gshegs bsgoms 27pa'i bhā ba dzā/ /sarjarja sadza ta sispyi dzā dza na dī me ba me ni bya/ /dzā ta bsod nams ni/ /don kun phun sum tshogs pa dag /'grub pa'i ma nyid yin par sems/ /de nas tsit+ta pra sā dā sna ste te ni bas hi tāsta taḥ/ /bha ga brnya ya pradrebye be+e na sems ni rab dang skyes/ /zhe sdang sdig pa rnam par nyams/ /de dag de dang lhan cig nyid1/ /bcom sha dwo ṣa kasma ṣāḥ/ /bha ga ban+ta ma lokyasta tāḥku mā raḥ pra ṇa tā na ldan 'das la blta ④ ru song / /de nas bcom ldan mthong gyur nas/ /gzhon nus bzhin ni rab btud naḥ—/ /ut+yā da pad+ma ra dza sā dha n+yabya sru la la ṭi rmā/ /tā ram̐ pu rabya de—/ /de nas kruzhabs kyi pad rdul gyis/ /skal ldan dpral bar thig le byas/ /ston pa'i zhabs gnyis ra ṇa yoḥshāstuḥsha shi ka ro dz+wa lo/ /bi n+yaste pra ṇa tā na gre sa tā nā smir+ya mdun du ni/ /do shal zla 'od rab 'bar ba/ /bkod nas mdun du rab btud pa/ /de dag de yis be da yata/ /dhan+d+ra de sha na yā te ྾ bha ga bān dzñā na badz+ra byeta/ /bhi tā de la gsol/ /bcom ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /de dag rnams la chos bstan pas/ /'jig 6tshogs sad+ku ya dṛdzñā dṛ sho taḥpābye pha lo bya dh+wata/ /dṛṣ+ṭa pa bye 6 yā te 6 ta lta ba'i ri phug nas/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsgrubs/ /de nas bden mthong de dag rnams/ /taste 6 pra ṇa mya hūṃ/ /ku mā re paṇ+ḍi tai spru t+yā bha ga bān swa ya ma bhā de la phyag 'tshal song ba'i tshe/ /gzhon nu mkhas pa dag la ni/ /bcom ldan dgyes pas mngon gsungs 95—503

ṣata / /pat+pa pu bye ra wasto pi par yābhe su kṛ hūṃ shri yo/ /dubhi k+ṣu ba pa—/ /bsod nams dag gis bu khyod ni/ /legs byas dpal 'byor yongs rdzogs thob/ /mu ge'i bar pi bhik+ṣu rde ku ru sgo dzñā bye bā sa m+bi/ /pa ri gra ho me bhek+ṣu rde sha du dge slong rnams/ /zas la lhag par gnas pa mdzod/ /bdag gis dge slong brgya phrag ni/ /phyed tā n+ya rje tra yo da shaḥ/ /a bye tsadz+re 6 kṛ sgoṭ+wāḥsaṃ bi bhas+thā sta yā dang bcu gsum yongs bzung la sna/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis grong pa27khyer btsal/ /'o brgyal gzer la bgo pu re/ /i ti khrutā bha ga ba taḥpaṇ+ḍi taḥpra mo dā ku laḥ/ /bhasgyu saṃ bshar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di thos nas/ /mkhas pa rab tu dga' bar khyedakrigs/ /ji srid gha gya be+e da dhe yā basbyi baṃ ni man+t+ra rde/ / ta taḥsra kṛ ha ma bye t+ya 'tsho bar gus pa yis/ /dge 'dun mgron du gnyer bar byas/ /de nas rang gi khyem song ste/ /dge rā dzārte sgyik+ṣu sasma teḥ/ /saṃ budhe pra mu khaṃ saṃ r+ghaṃ pa dā r+bha byi ra pū dza yata/ /slong rab bzhed rgyal po la/ /'os pa'i zas kyis rtag tu ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs dge 'dun mchod//da ri dru na da ri dwobya yādh+yā na bi tsa yā tsa kān/ /a tra shaṃ byād+ma bi da dbul dang dbul ba min rnams dang / /bslang bya dang ni slong byed dang ④/ /brtse bas 'os pa rnams la bye dā ṣ+pe nā sdezlu kai pi naḥ/ /she ṣān kṛ pa na saṃ ghā tān sotri 6 des—/ /sbyin pa zas kyis 5brtse ba bsgrubs/ /lhag ma thu'ajungs pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /snying rje'i chu ka ru rjam+bu dhīḥ/ /rat+na rā shi da do te bh+yo dorga r+ya ti mi rā sa haṃ/ /gter des btsal nas/ /de dag rnams la/ rin chen tshogs/ /dbul ba'i rab rib 'phrog pa byin/ /sa rat+na ni ka ra ste ྾ dza gā mā gā ra rā shi tsā/ /dṛ hūṃbyā gyu ni rat+na ni ma rin chen tshogs de de dag la/ /sol ba'i phung po nyid du gyur7/ /gang phyir nor bu rdo rang bzhin/ /ṇa yo he gā ta yaḥ/ /te ta mū tsuḥs ma bye ta swasna dṛṣ+ṭa dha nā i ba/ /rat+na rin chen mi rnams skal pa'o/ /de dag 'ongs nas de la smras/ /rmi lam nor ni mthong ba bzhin/ /rin 95byed504

nās+thā twa yāsmra kai sa dasto gā ra sañtsa yaḥ/ / dha na lā bhe na ma ha tā chen ming gi sol phung de/ /khyod kyis bdag cag rnams la byen/ /skye bo nor chen rnyed pa yis/ /'phral sar+yaḥpābhon+da tisnga naḥ/ /tahūṃ khya yāta k+ṣa be+e ṣ+pe ba pa ri bh+rasbyo na dzi ba ti/ /i nyi la mthon po thob gyur pa/ /skad cig kho nas de zad shelas/ /yongs su nyams pa mi 'tshor/ /zhes pa te ྾ ba tsaḥkhru tā paṇ+ḍi taḥka ru ṇa ni byeḥ/ /tad+ma tse pu rgya tī nā dzā de dag tshig thos nas/ /mkhas pa snying rje'i gter dag gis/ /der smras bsod nams dman rnams la/ /rat+na t+yā lnga t+ya rat+na hūṃ / /yubye bherna kṛ taḥpūrde mo hākhru kṛ ta sañtsa rin chen rin chen min nyid 'gyuraḍa27/ /khyed kyis sngon ni rmongs pa la sa/ /legs byas tshogs ni ma byas ya / /te nā yi rat+na rā shidze+eḥpra yā to gā ra sa ra hūṃ/ /rat+na ni yat+na ni hi pa—/ /des na rin chen phung po 'di/ /khyed la sol ba'i phyung por gyur/ /rin chen rnams ni 'bad ta n+ya pi yārnyi dū re pu sgo k+ṣa yā du ba na yādhi tsa bha gya yo gta/ /nas bzung yang bsod nams zad pa las/ /ring du 'gro zhing skal ba ldan pa las kyang nye bar 'ongs/ /biṭ+wā rdza ā+oṃ pa ti ta sho ka ni mit+ta ma ba bitrī hi tsit+ta mu tsi ti su pra nor rnams sgrub pa dag ni rgya che mya ngan mtshan ma nyid/ /nor ni legs byas dag la rab zhugs rigs pa'i kṛ ta dṛtrī/ /tasmrasgo bidhisgo rje ya byek+ṣu saṃ sgo bye bā gya tī/ /sgo ga saṃ sems nyid do/ /de slad khyed kyis dge slong gi/ /dge 'dun zas la sta gon mdzod/ /longs spyod phun bhā ra sa ma dhī ma haṃ saspa da ya m+bi ba ཿ / /i truk+ta ste na ta dha t+ta sum tshogs pa'i tshogs/ /bdag gis khyed la phun tshogs bgyi/ /zhes brjod de yi 1nor dang zas/ /bit+ta sgo dza na saspa dā/ /te bubye pra mu khaṃ saṃ r+ghaṃ di na me ka ma pū dza phun sum tshogs pa byin pa des/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dge 'dun rnams/ /de dag gis ni nyin gcig 4 yan / /saṃ gha ya thā ba da bh+yabyo pra ṇi d+mā na ma kā ri te/ /mā ka dā mchod—/ /dge 'dun ji lta bzhin mchod nas/ /skad cig smon lam de dag gis/ /bdag cag rnam lta95byed505

tsan dā ri bye snga dasmra ka mi ti k+ṣa r+ṇa/ /ta taste paṇ+ḍi ta gi rā ga tā da dṛ shu yang dbul por ni/ /ma gyur cig ces bya ba byas/ /de nas mkhas pa'i tshig dag gis/ /de dag song ra gra taḥ/ /ta me r+pā gā ra ni ka ram̐ pra yā tai rat+na rā shi tsā/ /bha ba rgo paṇ+ḍi bas mdun du ni/ /sol phung de nyid rin chen byi/ /phung po nyid du gyur pa mthong / /de nas mkhas ta t+yā tha ku mā ra su pra bha ba taḥ/ /bi j-iṭ+wā nā ni dh+wa nā ram̐ nim+bi pa gzhon nu ni/ /mthu dang ldan pa'i khyim nyid du/ /rnam par bzhag pa'i gter dag ni/ /gegs ①med snasha ta mu r+ya yo/ /sa pra se na dzi te rā zlo dharma dzhaḥsbi ti rak+ṣa rjata/ /da brgya dag byung bar gyur/ /chos shes de yi lugs bsrung slad/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal nyid la ni/ /gter do ni dh+wa na ṣad+dhā gi sa tsā sum̐ gā ra tā ma gāta/ /ku mā ra sri ba su kṛ tair+sā gyi drug cha phul de yang / /de la ldusol ba nyid du gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid kyi bsod nams kyis/ /gter gyo ya ni bye sañtsa yaḥ/ /i t+yan+ta rīk+ṣut+pa tsa na ta taḥshu shā ba bhū pa tiḥ/ /gyi tshogs 'di spyad bya yin/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di ldubar snang las/ /de nas sa yi bdag pos thos/ /ku mā ra sri ba sām+bi dh+wa ni ni bye ni dhi tsā/ /bu naḥpās+thā ni sābyur+yaḥgazhon nu nyid kyi tshig gis ni/ /gter rnams dag ni gter nyid du/ /slar gyur ngo mtshar bcas pa yis④//pra hi not+ta kṛ haṃ dz+ra paḥ/ /ta tasta da khi lo bir+ghaṃ bi tīr+ya bi su khā sha yaḥ/ /mi bdag gis ni de khyim springs/ /de nas nor rnams ma lus pa/ /gzhon nu bsam pa yongs ⑤pa yis/ /ku mā raḥsadza dzā tsa kre spru ti durga ta tse me su/ /a tha niḥsā ra saṃ byin nas phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /dbul po'i khyim du gnas par byas/ /de nas 'khor ba snying po yā ra bi tsā ra be+e ra ta spri haḥ/ /a ni t+ya tā sa saṃ tsi t+ya dhī raḥpi ta ra med—/ /rnam par dpyad phyir chags bral ba/ /brtan pa de yis mi rtag nyid/ /yang dag bsams nas ma pra bīta/ /a tra dzā m+bi hi rmā tā bta gabye tā ta ta po ba ā+oṃ/ /i mā pha la smras/ /yab gcig 6dka' thub nags su bdag /'gro ba re zhig gnang bar mdzod/ /skye ba 95—506

dzad+ma sha tosbyi ṣ+ṭha ma ma bi bhu ta yaḥ / / tre lo kya sa spa hūṃ pā byer+ya brgya yi lhag ma yi①/ /'byor pa nyid kyis 2bdag nyon mongs/ /'jig rten gsum gyi phun tshogs thob/ /smin+d+ra dza ti sgo gya hūṃ/ /ta di rda sadze+e bhū tā dzñā mā yuṭ+wā dza na malpa shaṃ/ /shī te gang du spyad bya nyid 'gyur ba/ /'byung po kun gyi tshe yi ni/ /snod 'di shin du chung ba nyid/ /gang zhig ya gya ka ro mi saṃ ta ta mṛ du spabye gu kaihrū ha rde saṃ tā pe ra tsa yā grang la rgyun du bdag gis reg bya 'jam pa'i gos kyis g.yogs khrubya zhing / /gang zhig gdung la bdag gi 2 mi ya gya shi shi ra shri khaṇ+ḍa tsa—rtsa rna/ /ya suze bi ṣa shasnga ba ha ni bhu dza dpal gyi dum bu bsel ba'i byugs ⑤pas byug pa bya/ /gang gi 6don du dug mtshon me dang lag 'gro'i ga zwa tā t+pa ram̐ me bha yo pā p+taḥ so pa ma pā ya taḥ pa ri kṛ to t+yā yā tshogs las mchog tu 'jigs pa 'thob⑦ / /bdag gi lus 'di gnod pa dag las yongs su bsrungs kyang ti kā yaḥk+ṣa rmā/ /sgo gāju rak+ṣa pra bra dzñā mā dā ya da yi tsā ba ṣ+pe/ /'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /longs spyod las ni chags bral bdag /dga' ba'i rab byung blangs nas ni/ /bi ha rā mi ha ram+bitrī tsi tā tabe+e su tse ta saḥ/ /i t+yāghā pa ri t+ya nags su gnas shing bsam pa yis/ /gdungs pa sems kyi gzir ba 'phrog /ces brjod yab kyis khas bye bi ṣa yaste ha brnya rna/ /kṛ tā ju pa ga maḥpi tā shā ri pu tā shra blang phyani/ /byas shes kye yul la chags pa yi/ /'ching ba de yis yongs btang nas/ /shā te ri'i bu yi oṃ ya yo/ /ta tra pra krā dzi taste na pa tra pā ṇiḥs ṭī ba ro/ /ta sri bā nu gnas su song / /der ni de yis rab phyung ste/ /lag na lhung bzed chos gos can/ /de yi rjes 'brang tsa ra byu tā bi tsa tsā ra ma ta bra taḥ / / sa dṛ ṭ+wā ha r+ṣa kai bā ri nyid gyur nas/ /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams rnam par rgyu/ /zhing pa rnams kyis bstan pa yis/ /zhing k+ṣajasnye hūṃ bar+bhe tī/ /nirdibhe ya thā yadhe bi sma yā di t+ya tso ta yata/ /nas zhing la 'jug pa'i chu/ /lam nas bgrod pa de 0/ mthong nas/ /ya mtshan las ni 'di ltar bsams/ /95—507

a ho pi hi ta marge ṇa gastso tā ma gya tse ta saṃ/ /dza khā dzā kan+d+ra saṃ sidhitri kye ma sems med chu rnams kyang / /bsgrubs pa'i lam nas bgrod pa yis/ /las ni yang dag sgrub mthong bye te na tu de hi dzā / / saṃ bi h+ye hi pra dza n+da gre dṛ ṣ+ṭa ste—/ /lus can rnams la ma yin no/ /zhes bsams bgrod pas mdun du ni/ /mda' mkhan dag gis gyasbyi kṛ re/ /sa ta be+e mi 6 ka re ṇa pra da gho rnyi ma tā sba raḥ/ /mda' bsros shing / /drang por byed pa mthong gyur nas/ /blo ldan mchog des ①rab tu bsams/ /tā san+d+ra gu ṇa tā me te yārnyi ni bye ta nāḥ sha raḥ / / na tu saṃ sā mda' ni sems med 'di dag rnams/ / gdung bas khyedrang po nyid 'byur te/ /lus can 'khyog po ra saṃ tap+ta ma pi bas+thāḥsha ri ri ṇaḥ/ /i ti ghā ya na bi lo kyā pre ta rnams dag ni/ /'khor ba'i gdung bas kyang ma yin/ /zhes sems mdun du shing mkhan gyis/ /shing dzñā sha ka ṭa tsakra dzā/ / byā tā ni dṛ zwa rū pā ṇi pu nish+yihūṃ sa mā rta'i 'khor lo nyid byas pa'i/ /brtan pa'i gzugs rnams mthong gyur nas/ /slar yang yang dag sems ya yo/ /a ho nu r+ya shwe nā yo gāta yābye kas+thā rgya tsā k+ṣa ṇata/ /nibye ta nā ni dā par gyur/ /kye ma sems med shing rnams ni/ /bzo yi sbyor bas skad cig las/ /las su rung ba nyid rū ṇi na tsiṭ+wā ni sha rī ri rde/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya saṃ yā taḥsu dha n+d+ra 'gyur te/ /lus can rnams kyi ④/sems ma yin/ /'di dag bsams shing yang dag song / /chos ni ya mā da raḥ/ /bat+pa lo pi ta ra pu tra i bā tsār+ya mu bā tsa sa/ /bzang nges pa la gus pa/ /de yis slob dpon la smras pa/ /mnyes gshin pha la bu yis bzhin/ /ār+ya e ba pri yā twa r+ya pa ṇ+ḍa r+pā tā ye maskṛ te/ /a haṃ ru bha ba 'phags pa nyid ni bsod snyoms la/ /de 5ring bdag gi ched du gshegs/ /khrod kyi ⑥ bstan pa rang tā di ṣ+ṭi tsarnyi yā mi ni dza bra tai/ /i tru pā dh+yā ya bh+yabye bhak+ta kṛ t+yā nyid kyi/ /brtul zhugs bdag gis bsam par bgyi/ /zhes te zas kyi bya ba ni/ /mkhan po la gsol 95—508

na bha saḥs tarnyi/ /byerle ṇa sadze+e bi pa dāḥpra sha oṃ bra dzarnyi dā ṣ+pe rnams mkha' las 'bab par 'gyur/ /brtan pa yis ni rgud pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gro/ /sbyin na sgo ga su bha gāḥ ka ku sgo bha badhi / /bha ga bārlu ga taḥpūt+tha shā pa yis ni phyogs rnams longs spyod skal ba bzang por 'gyur/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon//bahūṃ dze ta kā na ṣ+pe/ /ku sha lā dzā pra ban+d+ra ram̐ bi da dhe dhan+d+ra de sha bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /dge ba rab tu rdzogs rnams la/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa dzā / /pūzla kaspran+ta ra dza de tsa pa nāṣ+ṭa yu tā yu ṣi/ /shrī mārko na ka mdzad—/ /sngon gyi dus ni gzhan dag la/ /skye ba (7tshe lo brgyad khri'i tshe/ /dpal ldan gser mdog baṭ+wā khro ba byu ba thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /ka na ka khya pu rī ta gya sha kra gye bā ma ces bya ba'i/ /sa yi bdag po byung bar gyur/ /de yi grong khyer gser zhes pa/ /brgya byin 'chi med rā ba tī / / san+d+ra lo ke shwa ra snga pi ba sa tidze+ebe+e bhā bha ba ti/ /ldan bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbang yin kyang / /bzhugs gnas yid du 'ong bar gyur//nā ya kahaṃ ya shaḥ shu rja tsā ru bṛ t+ta gu r+ṇa tsi tai/ / j-i da ye yaḥ'adren par 'os shing grags par 37 dkar/ /mdzes par zhugs shing yon tan rigs/ /gang gis mu nyig pra dzā kāṅgi muṣā hā ra mi ba ba hata/ /pra dzā kasmra bi bā ke na pu re pa do shal bzhin/ /skye rgu'i snyebya ba snying la bzung ④/ /skye rgu'i ⑤las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /char med ra ma dā ru shā/ /a dṛṣ+ṭa ra bha bat+ta tra sarba bhū ta bha ya pra dā/ /sābyer+ya mchog tu mi bzad cing / /skye rgu 67rnams la 'jigs ster ba/ /de yi grong khyer dag tu byung / /snying hā ri bhā san+d+ra lo ka saṃ tā pa kā ri d+dhā/ /a bṛṣ+ṭaḥpra ya yo byu j-ita mā stobs ldan )pa 'phrog byed cing / /thams cad yongs su gdung byed pa/ /char med de ni sa 'dzin gyis//na sā ya sa he tu dzñā/ / kuṇ+ḍa sathru pra tī kā raḥ sa tsin+d+ra sba mi tai yid ni yongs gdung rgyu nyid gyur/ /bcos thabs thams cad nyams pa des/ /blon po'i gtso bo'i dkyil 95—514

ta taḥpa pā tā khi la bye bye dṛṣ+ṭi riṭ+wā pra dzā rna byu bi sabe+e rā tram̐/ /dh+wa t+yā di bṛṣ+ṭasta de nas zhag bdun sa la skye rgu rte1rnams/ /'dod pa'i kha zas ma lus char du 'bab/ /de yi snye'og tu da na n+ta ram̐ tsa rat+na di bṛ ṣ+ṭa : ta ta ཿ kra me ṇa / / i ti sa ka na 'bru la sogs pa'i char/ /de nas rim byis garin chen tshogs char yang / /de ltar legs byas phun ka baṇ+ḍi k+ṣa pa nyispyo ba tī rmā mu ku ṭa ma ṇi ri bo rtswad+dhā dzamā naḥpra dzā ā+oṃ/ /tshogs la dga' sa yi bdag po dag /gser mdog de ni sa bdag kun gyi cod pan nor bu bzhin//a kṛ ta su kṛ ta samyut+tha ṇi naḥpā ṇa rak+ṣu pra bha ba nyi hi pa rabe+e sadz+dza na mchog tu mdzes shing skye rgu pyarnams kyi srog ni bsrung bas mdzes/ /gang phyir skye bo dam pa'i mthu ni gzhan rmā pra bha ba/ /bhu pa tiḥka na ka baṇ+ḍi e ṣa yaḥso ha me ba ba pu ṣād+ma nā dhu rmā/ /don rab sgrub byed/ /gang zhig sa yi bdag po gser mdog de/ /da lta nga nyid sku yi bdag nyid 'di//i kyu dīr+ya bha ga bāñdzi naḥs tī dhī ma hūṃ bya bye ta dhan+d+ra de sha r+ghaṃ/ /i ti de skad gsungs nas bcom ldan rgyal ba yi5/ /blo ldan dam pa rnams la chos bstan mdzad/ /ces pa k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī sgo bye sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dze+e ka dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las na kā ba dā r+ghaṃ tri tsa tā ri shaḥpal+la waḥ// //gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //pa ro ba kā ra pra ṇa yi pra bhā baḥsasbo pa dz+re bya ma ha tī be+e bhū tiḥ/ /pu dh+yā gzhan la phan pa 6sgyu'ajibs pa'i mthu dang ni/ /kun kyi nyer 'tsho 'byor ba chen po ste/ /'bras bu ku ro ha gya bhā hūṃ bi shā la pha lārta rnge tat+tha tha oṃ hi put+pam/ /dzi na dze ta cher 'os 'di dag dge rnams kyi/ /bsod nams myu gu'i 'bras bu dang po 7yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gyi ba nā rā ma bi hā rā bye me ta pu rā/ /shā babye de ba se nā khyaḥshrī mā kun rar sngon⑧/ /rgyal ba bzhugs shing sngon 9 7dgyes tshe/ /dpal ldan khyim bdag lha yi sde6/ /zhes 95—517

bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / /de la dam pa'i chos bstan ( 5ram̐ / /ya yā dhadz+re ma yo tsak+ṣu rak+ṣu ṇ+ḍa lo ka mu r+ya yo/ /pāku sgo pa mdzad / /gang gi 6chos kyi rang bzhin can7/ /mi dman snang ba rab tu bsgrun rde7/ /sngon gyi bsod ri rja me na dze ta be+e ra gya bā pa naḥ/ /pra ṇa mya be+e ma la pra dzñāḥsanams yongs smin pas/ /chags bral bag chags sad gyur pa/ /shes rab dri ma med pa des/
