san+d+ra dzha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /sha ra rgya sha ra ṇasta su bha ga bān bha ba ha ri 'tshal kun mkhyen la gsol ba/ /bcom ldan skyabs thob skyabs su 'os/ /nyon mongs ma lus nyams pa'i ṇi / /a she ṣa gre sha nā shā ya pra bra dzñā me bi dhi yā tsā/ /tsa pa lo bra slad—/ /srid pa 'phrog pa'i rab byung ni/ /bdag la rab tu sgrub ①par mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi (2 ṇi nā mā yusta to pi na ba yo ban/ /bi byu da tsa la na bi khāsta to bye tā bi tshe srog g.yo/ /lang tsho gzhon pa de bas kyang / /glog ni 'khyug pa bzhin du g.yo/ /de bas kyang ni bhū ta yaḥ/ /i ti ta gya bra bā ṇa gya su ga tā nu gra ho di hūṃ/ /pa pā ta bī 'byor pa 'di/ /zhes pa smra zhing chags bral ba/rte7/ /de yi lus la bde gshegs kyis/ /rjes su bzung ba ta ra dza saḥpra bra dzñā ba pu ṣi swa yi/ /rak+ta ṭī ba ra su byaste bi s+thā las skyes pa'i/ /rab byung rang nyid lhung bar gyur/ /chos gos dmar pos rab gsal ba'i/ /chags ṇaḥs bi rak+ta dzā/ /pa tra gra he ṇa ta kyā dza pu naḥsaṃ sā ra pā tra rmā/ /bral nyid ni de yis bzung / /lhung bzed bzung bas be+er yang ni/ /'khor ba'i snod nyid rab tu btang //ta gya tā ma da byu tai sed+dhi pra t+yak+ṣ-i bīgh+ra bhi k+ṣa baḥ/ /tadrut+tha bṛ.ā+oṃ pa prasgor+bha dge slong rnams kyis de yis ④ni/ /rmad byung grub de chomangon sum mthong / /de yi sngon byung bcom ldan ga brnya sa tsā bra bīta/ /bā rā ṇa gya pu ra rā dzā kṛ tīrtswa ma ta thā ga la—/ /dris shing des kyang rab gsungs pa/ /rgyal po kṛ tī khuzhes pa sngon/ / wā rā ṇa sīr krude bzhin te—/ /kā sh+ya pā khye bha ga ba ti pra yā ti pa ri nirde ti/ /sha ri ra ma gshegs—/ /bcom ldan 'od srungs zhes bya ba/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das gyur tshe/ /de yi gdung ni gya saskṛ ta stu paṃ rat+na ma yo bya dh+wa ta / / swa nā ba gā ta na thra rte rab sbyangs nas/ /mchod rten rin chen rang bzhin dag /mtho ris snyog kyenus bsod nams ni/ /mūr+bhe pu rgya mi bon+da tai/ / tasmin+d+ra ro bya mā zla yī yabyu pū dza pa ri gra gzugs can bzhin du mtho ba byas/ /de la mchod pa yongs 'dzin cing / /bya ru 'dzugs pa ⑨byed pa'i 95—519

he / /ki ta tsaḥkan+da lo nā ma ni da dhe rū pa ka dwa yo/ / tsit+ta pra sā tshe—/ /bzo bo kan ta la zhes pa'i hūṃ/ /gzugs can ⑤gnyis ni rnam par bkod/ /dang ba'i sems ni debyedhe na te na bu bye na bhu ya sā/ /hi ra ju bā ṇiḥpāsto r+ya ma ha tīsmṛ ha dhī dag pa yis/ ③/ /bsod nams shin tu che ba des/ /da lta gser gyi lag pa ni/ /'dod par bya ba chen ya hūṃ / / bha ba ti bi bha ba sgyu go da yaḥ sa mo gra gu rte bye bi ta ཿpo thob/ /'jig rten du ni rab tu grags pa 5dkar po bdud rtsi'i zer kyis byespun drung dang ༅//pra sha ra ti ya shaḥku kle lo ke sur+ghaṃ shu sa ho da ram/ /pa ri ṇa ti pa de pu gtong ba'i yon tan drag bo dang ldan 'byor pa rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /chung ngu gang zhig yongs bsngo'i bye dhaste ya dalpa ma nalpa hūṃ be+e ma la ma na saḥshrabye shuzlo ta de ba bi dzo bhe gnas la bsod nams chung ngu nyid min gyur/ /de nyid kho na dri med yid kyi dad pa dag pa'i (mekun spyod tai / /i ti pra bhā baṃ ka thi haṃ dzi ṣ+pe na pu dh+yā nu byā ba gya hi ra sgo pā ṇiḥ/ /khru two yin / /bso/da nams mthu ldan gser gyi lag pa yidā/ /mthu ni de ltar rgyal bas bshad pa dag /thos pa ba har+ṣa da ra bisma yā dzā sa r+bhak+ṣu saṃ ghaḥpra ṇa yī ba bhu ba/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra nyid na dge slong she—dge 'dun te1 / /dga' dang gus dang ya mtshan dbang du gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī hi ra bye bā dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod nga/ 11dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser gyi khya bā dā rna tsa tuṣ+ṭa tā ro shaḥpal+la baḥ// //'a ga pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //dudz+dza na duḥs hā bi ṣa dha ra dī ṣa ṇa ta ra ti mi ra ba ti tā rmā/ /srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog rgyal ba dran pa ni/ /skye bo ngan pa nye2bzod dka' dug 'dzin dang //ā lodza rna dza na rgo bha ba bha ya ha ra r+ṇa dzi nasma ra r+ṇa/ /pu re rā shin tu 'jigs rung khron par lhung gyur pa'i/ /skye bo rnams kyi rten sar gyur pa yin/ /grong khyer rgyal 95—520

dzā kṛ hābhi khye bha ga bān+d+ra j-i taḥpu rā/ /ka ṭa ke kṛ dh+ra ku ṭa gya bi dza po'i khab ces par/ /sa 'dzin bya rgod phung po yi/ /ngos la sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin hā ra tathā ga taḥ/ /tasmin+da ba sa re rā dzā be+em+bi sā raḥpu ta pri yaḥ/ /gshegs pa bzhugs par gyur/ /skabs der bu la byams pa yi/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po nyid//a dzā ta sha tru ṇa ta tra pu hre ṇa kru ra kā ri ṇa/ /su hri daḥpā pa ka sre ba de de yi bu ni ma skyes dgra/ /gdug pa byed par gyur pa yis/ /grogs po sdig pa dang ldan pa/ / lha sbyin 3ba dat+ta su sasma tai/ /gho rān+dha ban+dha nā gā ram̐ niḥsaṃ tsā ram̐ pra be shi taḥ/ /sad+dhāḥgyi ni gros bzhin du/ /'jigs rung mun can btson khang ni/ /rgyu ba med par rab tu bcug /bkres pra be+e shi tai ta mya brnya ṣ+pe gru bhā sgo dza rna/ /dzñā tā sa ta ṅgha yā hūṃ khye pas nyen pa de la ni/ /btsun mos zas dag btson khang du/ /gsang nas rab tu 'jug par byas/ /grukhyo ma su n+ya bā ra yata/ /rū k+ṣaḥkṛ sho ni ma li naḥso bha babye thi bī pa tiḥ/ / des gsad ⑤'dod des shes nas bzlog /sa yi bdag de shin tu rid/ /sngo zhing dri ma ldan par gyur//a ka la kā la me ghā rtaḥkṛṣ+ṭa sa k+ṣa i ben+d+ra yaḥ/ / sarko ṇ+ḍa ba sa si dus min sprin nag gis gzir ba'i/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi zla ba bzhin/ /phal cher mnyes gshin sems tā baḥpra yaḥpe sha la tse ta sī/ /ka ro t+yā li gā rna thra ṭ+wā gā bhā pra ṇa ldan lathu/ /mchog tu rgud pa'i mdza' mo ni/ /gdung bcas sred dang ldan rajebazhin du/ /shin tu dam yi nī ba mata/ /sa sa muju sh+ya sho kārtaḥsu ga tā zlu ṣi hūṃ di shaṃ/ /par 'khyud par byed/ /bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i phyogs su ni/ /mya ngan gyis gzir der 57phyogs te//kṛ tā ñdza lirna ta shi rāḥk+ṣu ma swa ra ma bhā ṣa ta/ /na mastu bye bha ga ba thal mo sbyar te spyis btud nas/ /skad gdangs zhan par rab smras pa/ /dman pa 'don pa la brtson te ma hārta ya ma hā rta te/ / dī nod+dhā ra ṇa sa nād+dhā samyak+shi bo bye pa—/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rin chen dgra bcom chen po nyid/ /bcom ldan khyod la 95—521

tsirti se/ /na ma ste gho ra saṃ sā ra ma ka rā ka ra se ta be+e/ /dzi nā ya dza phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba skye tshogs skye ba yi①/ /nyon mongs rab tu zhi ba'i rgyu/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba na tā dzad+ma kle sha pra sha ma he ta be+e/ /na mo ni t+ya pra bud+dhā ya sat+tha rgya mtsho yi/ /zam stegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid rnam par dag /snying rje sa two ka ban+dha be+e/ /bi shudhe dh+wasne budhe ya ka ru shā mṛ ta sen+dha be+e/ /i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ste/ /sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu2/ /rtag tu sad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ti bhasti su dh+wa seskra su ga ta shra ba ḍo tsi hūṃ / / pu ju pu t+pa pra sā pa bsod nams me tog las/ /'khrungs shing gus pa'i bdud rtsis bran/ /bstod pa'i dog pa bde ba dī sa tsakra stu ti oṃ dza rī ma/ /sarba dzha sta gya bi dzha ya kā ya kle sha gshegs kyike —/ /snyan du 'os pa de yis byas/ /de yi nyon mongs ④sdug bsngal gyi/ /rang bzhin skabs ma yī da shaṃ/ /ban+dha nā gā ra bi ba rā lo kai ro snga ya rna bya dh+wata/ /a dzā mkhyen kun mkhyen gyis/ /'ching ba'i khang pa'i bu ga yi/ /snang ba dag gis tshim par byas/ /de ltar ta sha trusta tho trī dzñā tā shaṃ kā ku laḥpi tuḥ/ /a bā ra yad+ma d+dhā kṛ he gyur pa ma skyes dgras/ /shes nas dogs pas 'khrugs gyur te7snye/ /pha yi btson khang dag gi ⑥ni//su srugh+ra bi ba rā rgya pi/ /ta tasta gya ta dā de shāta kru ra ban+ta na rak+ṣiṇaḥ//bug pa shin tu chung ba'ang bkag /de nas gdug pa'i btson srung gis/ /de yi ⑦bka' las spu gri yis//kyu re ṇa gā bye ba n+dha su pā da yostaju karta rna/ / sa ti bra be+e sha sa dam du bcings pa de yi ni/ /rkang pa rnam par bcad par byas/ /drag po 8 sdug bsngal nyon mongs kle sha bya thi ta ཿ sābe+e ba ཿ pa ra / / na mo bu d+dhā ya bu d+dhā ye t+ya n+ti kyis—/ /mchog tu gzir ba'i sa bdag des/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /gdung ba'i sa kran+da bya dha ta/ /bha ga bā na tha sarba dzhaḥpu raḥpra t+ya k+ṣe tai ga taḥ/ /cho nge ldan pas brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /mdun du mngon sum nyid gshegs te//95—522

sha kra dat+yā sa nā sī naḥkā ru rgya t+ta ma bhā ṣi ta/ /rā dzan ki kri ya brgya byin gyis bshams gdan la bzhugs/ /thugs rje nyid kyis der bka' sprul/ /rgyal po ci bya mi te hrū ra kan+d+ra khaṃ ga ti ri dṛ shi/ /shu bhā shu bhā sa mubye tai nā julte bzad pa'i/ /las kyi lugs ni 'di 'dra yin/ /dge dang mi dge nyarab bsgrun 'bras/ /spyad pa k+ṣa ya te pha lo / / rā ga dwo ṣa bi ṣa sa ghā nā nā bya sā na duḥmin pa yongs mi mdzad1/ /chags sdang dug gis dkrigs gyur cing / /sna tshogs gdung ba bzod pa ha/ /e baṃ ba dhe bā niḥsā re saṃ sā re duḥkha sā ra tā/ /saṃ kle she ka li dka' ba/ /snying po med pa'i 'khor ba na/ /sdug bsngal/ 'di lta snying po nyid/ /rgyad pa rgyas pas nyam le kā le bi pa ta saṃ pa ta saṃ ka ṭi/ /byerlu me ba pa ri tā rde be+e rā thag cing / /kun nas nyon mongs rdzogs dus su/ /'khrugs krupa med pa'i chags bral lam/ /brtan rgya ba ni rā ku lo/ /saṃ sā ra gho ra ga ha nān+ta ra j-i bhā mā naḥ duḥkhā pa kho na yongs skyabs ⑤yin/ /'khor ba 'jigs rung nags kyi nang na rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /sdug na la bya ti ka riḥpra thra te ra seghāḥ/ /dhū moṅga me ri ba pu naḥsu kṛ to bsngal me yis ⑥gdung ba 'phro bas 3/rab rgyas du ba bzhin/ /slar yang reg par gyur pa min pa legs tsi tā dzā bābye bu bin+d+ra ka li lā na dṛ sho bha ban+ta/ /bha dza swa dher+ya duḥbyas ldan rnams kyi'u/ /mig ni mchi ma'i chu yi thigs kyis rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po 'o ngas spyod re kha smin sgo gā r+ghaṃ t+ya dza bhū pa tai/ /pa ri zla ma bi ro dha n+yaḥsadze+e saṃ ba thong / /sdug bsngal 'di la brtan 1 pa brten/ /'khor ba'i spyod tshul thams cad ni/ /yongs su sā ra bṛt+ta yaḥ/ /a dhu ṣ+pe ba ta thā san+da de hān+ta ku sha la spru tiḥ/ /i trughā gyur pa 2)'gal ba can/ /lus kyi mjug tu da lta nyid/ /khyod la dge ba nye bar gnas/ /zhes brjod tai sa mā shwa gya bha ga bārlu pa rda ya yo/ /bi m+bi sa ro pi de hodhe de ni dbugs phyung ste/ /bcom ldan rang gi gnas su gshegs/ /gzugs can snying po'ang lus kyi mthar/ /95—523

tasmirje ba k+ṣa ṇi di bi/ /a byudz+dza nar+ṣa sgo nā ma shrī mā྾ shra ba ṇat+pa dzaḥ/ /de dus nyid na mtho ris su/ /dpal ldan rnam thos sras kyi bu/ /rgyal ba'i khyu mchog ces par gyur//a dzā ta sha trurdza na rka dzha tā bi ga ta dz+re be+e tai/ /sha rī ra ma su saskṛ t+ya ni pha ni srog dang bral ba dag /ma skyes dgra yis shes gyur nas/ /de yi lus ni rab sbyangs te/ /rang nin+da ni dza duḥkṛ tai/ /ta snga ti tī bra pā pārte tsit+ta dudṛt+ta du ṣi tsā/ /gis snanyes par byas pa smad/ /de sems drag po'i sdog pas gdungs/ /spyod tshul ngan pas sun phyung ste//pabyut+ta paghi pa ta rna pā yash+yit+ta mi dā ka rota/ /so bad+ma ta sasmo hā de shwar+ya phyi chonas gdung ba'i me la der/ /dag pa'i bya ba byed pa bzhin/ /des bsams kye ma kun rmongs las//ma da lubha dhīḥ / / dubyet+ta pā ta ka shwa bye pa ti to ha ma sgo mu dbang phyug gis rgyags sred ldan blo/ /tshul ngan bdag ni kha sbub dukye/ /sdig pa'i g.yang la lhung bar khaḥ / /shu ta pradzñā da ri dru rde ni dza ni dā su kha mo hā/ / tsid+dhā da ha gyur—/ /thos pa shes rab kyis dbul zhing / /rang nyid bde bas ④rmongs gyur pa/ /mi bsrun sngags thuti gā tā ṇi kha la mad+dhā nu ba r+bhe r+ghaṃ/ / pa ti ta snga tsa san+da gya pā rjes zhugs pa rnams/ /bsam pas lus ni gdung bar byed/ /rten sa med pa'i sdig pa yisakhye //pa saṃ ke bra mā da niḥ/ /a nā lalba rna tā rde dzi na saṃ sma ra ṇa ma ma/ /'dam du lhung zhing nyams gyur pa/ /bag thumed bdag la rgyal ba ni/ /yang dag dran pa skyabs su 'gyur//i ti saṃ tsi t+ya su tsi ram̐ sa ga tā su ga tā rnyi shaṃ/ /dzu gube+e mā naḥku de ltar yu na ring 8 bsams nas der‘9 / /bde bar gshegs pa'i drung song ste/ /ngan pa byas la smod kṛ tā ta pa ra saṃ ko tsa mā ya yo/ /ta tra pa bi tra mād+mā ā+oṃ ma n+ya mā naḥbyad 1 cing / /mchog tu yang dag zhum par gyur/ /der ni bdag nyid mi gtsang bkye/ /khas len khrel sa sa tra paḥ/ /pra ṇa nā ma dzi ā+oṃ du rāta bā pa spar+sha bha yā di ba/ /sā dang bcas pa des/ /sdig la 1rtareg pas 'jigs pa bzhin/ /ring nas rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal/ /ngan 95—524

khru ṣ+pe tra pa ri tā r+ṇa sa sat+tha p+ta bya dza dzñā yata/ /sa kaspaḥkā ya saṃ sat+ta byas lus la yang dag chags/ /gsal bar byed bzhin (ṭ+wā'adar ldan pas/ /mig ni mchi ma dang bcas bi dhu stsom+bi ba du ཿ kṛ tai / / bha ga bān kṛ ta pā bo ha mā sa n+da des—/ /kun mkhyen la ni yongs skyobs kruzhus/ /yongs gdungs 1sdig pa byas pa bdag /dmyal ba'i na ra kā na laḥ/ /san+tap+taḥka ru zla se: tā me ba sha ra khaṃ ga taḥ/ /mā me ni nye ④bar gnas/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod nyid la ni skyabs su song / /grwa mi yo sho ṇa par+yad+dhā dṛṣ+ṭaste puṣ+ka ra pra bhā/ /pu rgya smṛ sha tu gaṅge ba ma la gnyis dmar ba khyod kyi spyan/ /pad+mo'i 'od ldan gang gā bzhin/ /dri ma 'khru bzod dag byed pa/ /'di pra k+ṣu la na k+ṣa mā/ / kha la man+t+ra pra bṛ ste na dudṛste na pra mā di yis bdag la reg pa khrumadzod/ /mi bsrun 6gros kyis rab zhugs shing / /bag mod spyod tshul ngan pa nā / /mā yā bi bhā ba lubye na pā pe na ni ha taḥpi tā/ /i ti pra khā pi nasta su ba can—/ /sdig can 'byor pa la chags pa/ /bdag gis pha ni rnam par bsad/ /ces pa cho nge ldan de yi//tsaḥ khru tā ta thā ga taḥ / / sa sardzastan+d+ra pa ra dzaḥ shurnyo pu ju sa ra tshig thos de bzhin gshegs pa yis/ /de yi sdig rdul dag bya'i slad/ /bsod nams dbyangs can rab swa ṭī/ /rā dzan+da tsi titā pā paḥkha le ṣ+pe ba swa kadz+re ṇa/ /pre ri ta ste pi tu spros/ /rang las kyis bzhin mi bsrun )pa/ /rgyal po gnod pa ma bas mas pa/ /khyod ni pha bsad la dṛ ba dhe pa ti taḥpā pa saṃ ka ṭi/ / duḥkhan+tabye na sgok+ta bye pābhā kilbi bskul te/ /nyam nga'i sdig par lhung bar gyur/ /sdug bsngal de des spyad bya zhing / /khyod kyis kyang ni ṣe twa yā/ /ta ba ta gya sa bhū pā la tu le ṣā bha be+e ta bya tā/ /ni dza kadz+re sa sdig pa thob/ /sa skyong de dang khyod kyi 'di/ /stsong bar bya ba mtshungs pa nyid/ /rang gi las ni rab mudhī d+dhā lā la ṭa ta ṭa btī dzā/ /shi lā sha ka la le khe ba nibya la ni yā tidṛ bkod pa/ /dpral ba'i ngos la gnas pa dag /rdo yi dum bu'i ri mo bzhin/ /mi rnams kyis 7ni g.yo 95—525

ṇam / /kut+tha tā ka lu ṣe kan+d+ra kha la sre ra ṇa ya twa yā/ /pra t+yā san+d+ra mṛ ma yin/ /khyod ni mi bsrun skyapas bskul nas/ /sdig pa'i las ni byas pa yis/ /dge legs bdud rtsi ta gre yaḥ swa ha ste na ti raskṛ tai/ /a t+yā pi ya di te pā paṃ habye nye ba ni/ /rang gi lag pas 'phangs par gyur/ /gal te khyod la da lta yang / /sprug gzhom phun tshogs zwabe+eñtsa sadza rda/ /r+pā.ā+oṃste tabyu rum ti pu khyu bā pa sha mā rād+ma ṣ+pe/ /dī ba thob 'dod pa/ /yod na bsod nams blo gros mdzod/ /de yang zhi las bdag nyid la'o/ /mar me'i thrakhyo su khaṃ sru te dz+re ba ya t+yādz+dza lo ya shaḥ/ /a mṛ ta su pra ka ro yo spyod tshul bde ba skyedañtsha/ /'tsho byed grags pa rab tu 'bar/ /bdud rtsi'i rab tu byed pa 'di//su thra t+ta ཿ sa sa mā ga ma ཿ / / ba byaṭ+wā pā sni pā te na sā dhu ni legs pa dang 'grogs dam pa'i spyod/ /rjes su 'gyod pa'i mes gdungs shedang / /dam pa rnams dang saṅga men tsa/ /sī tīrta ṣ+pe na dā ṣ+pe na pā pi na byu ti de hi ram̐/ /'grogs pa dang / /yang dag bsgrags dang sbyin pa yis/ /lus can rnams kyi thusdig nyams byed//bā tram̐ ba bi tra ya ti ṣ+pe ba gu rjaspyo rto tiste haṃ na saṃ ha ra ti nā pi ma lo snod ni gtsang byed yon tan sdong bu nges par zad mi byed/ /mdza' ba'i snum ni mi 'phrogs ⑤dri ma yang ni pra sru te/ /do ṣa ba sā na ru tsi rabya la hūṃ na dhadhe sahūṃ ga maḥsu skyed mi byed/ /skyon mtshan mjug tu rab mdzes g.yo ba nyid ni 'dzin mi byed/ /dam pa dang 'grogs kṛ ta sad+ma ni ko pi dī paḥ/ / gu ṇi ga ṇa pi padhī k+ṣu k+ṣa ya k+ṣa ṇa legs byas khang par mar me ci yang yin/ /yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs la rgud pa 'doms mkhas mtshan sam+bi bhaḥs ka la na ya na byā pā rā rde dza nā ni ni ro dha keḥ/ /a mo'i skad cig mtshungs/ /skye bo'i 'dren byed rnams kyi bya ba mtha' dag rab tu 'gog par byed/ /shin sa ma bi ṣa mā yā sā bā saḥpra kā shaṃ pa ri k+ṣa yāta su dza ti hi ma hā mo hasgo tu mnyam dang mi mnyam gnas la gnas shing snang ba yongs zad las/ /rmongs pa chen po'i thu'abyung ba 95—526

oṃ ta maḥkha la saṃ ga maḥ/ /pra h+ye ka budhaste rā dzan kā le na khye ṇa bskyed de ① mun pa dang ni mi bsrun grogasakye/ /rgyal po dal bu dal bu yis/ /dus kyis sdig pa zad kilbi ṣaḥ/ /bha bi 6 pi bi be ke na kṛ tā lo kaḥsha ṣ+peḥsha ṣ+peḥ/ /i ti ta gyur nas/ /dben pas snang bar byas pa yi(zu/ /rang sangs rgyas su khyod 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa bcom mya da yā swā saṃñtsa kā ra bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /pa ti te ṣ+ṭa dhi ka san+taḥldan rgyal ba yi④/ /brtse bas de ni dbugs dbyung mdzad/ / lhung las ltalhag par dam pa rnams//ka ru ṇa sdirja lo tsa nāḥ/ /ta taḥpra ṇa mya su ga tai pra yā taḥswā pa rda dṛ snying rje byams pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /de nas bde gshegs la btud de/ /mi bdag rang gi 67gnas su paḥ—/ /ma ha taḥpā pa bhā ra gya bi be de la ghu tā mi ba/ /tasmin+d+ra yā te sat+tha song / /sdig pa'i khur po chen po ni/ /yang ba nyid bzhin rnam par rig /dge slong rnams kyis de song dzhaḥthraṣ+ṭasta gya kan+d+ra kau tu kāta/ /bhik+ṣu bhiḥk+ṣi tai pā la su pūzla bṛt+ta ma tshe—/ /de yi las kyi dge mtshan las/ /sa skyong gi ni sngon byung mtha'/ /dris shing bcom ldan kyegyis bhā ṣa ta/ /bā rā ṇa sde ni rā yā sa bi lā sa bya ba sā yi naḥ/ /tsa twa raḥgrekhye bka' stsal/ / bā rā ṇa sīr klutshong dpon gyi/ /bu bzhi dag ni byung gyur te/ /dpal ldan bsdams pa ta na yāḥb bhu buḥshri bi phru kha laḥ/ /te ka dā tsikhru kha spyi bā ma thiḥka dag bral zhing / /gdung med rtse dga' la brtson pa'o/ /nam zhig bde bas myos gyur cing / /phan tshun li ka thāspru tāḥ/ /pra h+ye ka budha mā yārnyi da dṛ shurlo ba nodhe tāḥ/ /kyal ka'i gtam gyis gnas/ /lang tshos 'phyar ba de dag gis/ /rang sangs rgyas ni byon pa mthong //tai dṛṭī dzā ta bi dī ṣaḥsha ma sa ya ma nin+da kāḥ/ /dz+reṣ+ṭha su pun+da ra ko nā ma s+thā de mthong rnam par sdang ba skyes/ /zhi dul smod byed phu bo ni/ /sun da ra ka zhes pa yis/ /'dzum tren+d+ra bā tsa sa smi taḥ/ /a yo tsi ba ra pā tram̐ kaḥpā ṣ+pe na ga ta dz+re bi bcas spun zla rnams la smras/ /btung bas nyes 67pas dge slong ni/ /chos gos lhung bzed rtags can 95—527

skṛ bhā ཿ pa ram̐ dṛ pa sha ba ཿ sa ma dā bha ba rnye / / bye ṣ+ṭha gre ṣ+ṭha ཿ su ta ཿcing / /mchog tu tshim pas mi yi phyugs rnams rgyags dang bcas par gyur/ /sdig las tshong dpon bu thu pā bā tas e brta dzad+ma ni/ /sha rir+yā nā bhi dhaḥshākyaḥbī tā ma r+ya bi pa r+ya ta/ /bo—/ /de nyid skye ba gzhan la ni/ /shākya shā ri rgya zhes pa/ /chang 'thungs nas ni nyams par gyur//dī tī yo pi ma harja ma shākya sto ye k+ṣa yi ga taḥ/ /tram̐ hūṃ ya: bu tre ṇa byasto rā gnyis pa yang ni shākya dag /ming chen chu la shi bar gyur/ /gsum pa rgyal po gsal rgyal yang / /bu dzā pra se na dzi ta / / bi dza sā ra tso tu rjo sau dṛ ta pu tre ṇa yis sna bskrad nas bsad par gyur/ /bzhi pa gzugs can snying po 'di/ /bu yis btson 2—du bcings ba dha ṣ+pe/ /pra yuk+tan+dha na— baṅka n+d+ra bhu bye te hi sa bṛrnyi shaṃ/ /mo hā ha nas bsad/ /skyed gedang ldan pa'i nor bzhin du/ /las ni rab ldan spyod par byed/ /de ltar rmongs tai re ha ha sa d+dhi ra sa sbo re r+pā ni ཿ sha dz+re ka n+d+ra sa ha me+e ba be+e dzñā pas bcom pa'i dam pa dam min rnams kyis 'dir/ /bde ba med pa'i las ni 'phral nyid rnam par ya te yata/ /bāṣ+kam+bu sgoṇ+ḍi na ya ṣ+pe ra na yo ba bhā ta masto ka sho ka bi bsgrubs pa gang nga// /tshul min nye bar gnas pa de ni mchi ma'i chu dag gis/ /mi 5rdzogs mya ngan mi ba she ra nu byu ya te tra/ /su ga ta ka rja ta me tah+phuzla dzad+ma pra thradzhai chung dbang dang bral bas spyod par byed/ /gzugs can snying po'i skye ba snga mar rab zhugs byung ba'i tshul / /be+e ṣa be+e ṣa ma bi bā shaṃ bo bi sā ra gya dṛdzhai/ /bi bi dha sa da si bhik+ṣuḥmi bzad dug gi rnam smin 'di dag bde gshegs kyis gsungs pa/ /mdun 7sar dge slong rnam mang dag spa ṣ+ṭa mā ka rdzu me ṣ+pe bya sa na sha ta ni mir+ghaṃ dru ṣi ta tsit+ta me ba / /gis gsal bar thos gyur nas/ /gdung ba brgya yi mtshan mas 7sun phyung sems nyid yin par sems/ /i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos shebyas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bas/ma gyi 'khri shing 95—529

ma dzā ta sha tru pi tre dro hā ba dā na pañtsa tsa tā ri shaḥpal+la baḥ// //las ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //arnyi kṛ to pi sa dṛ shā ta ma sā kha le na lasmre bi hā ra bi ra he bi ni mi bsrun rmyemun pas 'phral la long bar byas gyur cing / /dpal 'byor rnam par gnas dang bral pā ti to pi/ /kṛd+dhā da shā mi ba ni shā ma ni bā khya pad+maḥswā me ba saṃ pa da mu bar rab bskrun kyang / /nyam nga'i gnas skabs mtshan mo 'das nas pad+ma bzhin/ /sbar yang yon tan bai ti pu na rgu shā ḍūḥ / / shra bahūṃ su ga te dze ta ba no byā na bi ldan pas rang gi 2snaphun tshogs thobakye/ /bde gshegs mnyan yod rgyal byed kyi/ /skyed mos tshal na hā ri ṇi/ /de ba dat+taḥpa ri dre ṣa bā di byāsto byā tsin+ta yata/ /tu l+yaḥbazhugs pa'i tshe/ / lha sbyin byeyongs su sdang ba yi/ /rtsod pas khyab pas rnam bsams pa/ /shākya'i sa mā no me bh+ra tā ma nu 6 shākya baṃ sha dzaḥ/ /pābe+eḥpu ju pra bhā be rigs las skyes pa'i mi/ /bdag ni spun dang mtshungs shing mnyam/ /bsod nams mthu yis 'gro gsum na tri dza gah+phu rje tī dzi naḥ/ /dz+re bi to z-it+ta ye tasmra ta ta gya yasne ka ro mya haṃ/ /gyis—/ /mchod bya nyid ni rgyal bas thob/ /de slad de yi 'tsho ba ni/ /rab tu gzhom la bdag 'bad bya/ /na byu na ste ga te bhā no pa ra te dzaḥpra kā sha te/ /bi dzñā ṣ+pe nā nu bhā be na gang phyir nyi ma ma nub tshe/ /gzhan gye gzi byin gsal ba med/ /yid ni nga rgyal gyis mtho bas⑤/ /bi r+ya yā ta pa sī shri yā/ /pa ra pra kar+ṣa sa ha te na hi mā non+ta rnam shes dag dang mthu dang ni/ /rigs dang dka' thub dpal dag gis/ /pha rol khyad 'phags bzod tad+ma naḥ/ /bo ṣi ni dza na khā gre 6 dh+ri tā ta su pra shā ma kṛta/ /sa tsā ra yā mi ma yin/ /dug ni rang gi sen rtse la/ /bzung 'unas de la phyag 'tshal te/ /brtan par rkang pa la dha nisgosgo bya ṣ+pe tsi ḍaḥpā da bī ḍa naiḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsin+d+ra ka lu ṣe bi dz+wa ṣaḥbi mnan pas/ /nges par phug la gtang bar bya/ /de ltar sdig pa bsams byas nas/ /sdang ba'i dbang 95—530

ba shaḥkha laḥ/ /sa ti 6 pra mu khā ṣ+pe t+ya bān+dha bā ni da ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /hrū raḥgyur mi bsrun ①pa/ /de yis skar rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /gnyen rnams la ni 'di skad smras/ /de ring kṛ tā pa ka ro haṃ su ga ta snga r+ya pā da yoḥ/ /sa ra la su pra sā dā ya bde gshegs gzu bo yisashe/ /zhabs la rab tu dang ba'i slad/ /gdug pa gnod pa byed pa yigu/ /ba tā mi gu ru pā ta kaḥ/ /i ti bra bā ṇasteḥsabyeḥsu dat+na nu ma taiḥs ta/ /sdog pa lci meldan bdag gtug go/ /zhes smra gdug pa'i blo can de/ /rjes mthun ster byed de dag rnams//dzi rna dze ta ba nā sbo dz+wa dṛṣ+ṭi duṣ+ṭa ma tir+ya yo/ /bha ga bārnyi bi lo kyā kun dang lhan cig rgyal ba ni/ /rgyal byed tshal bzhugs blta kyiru song / /der ni bcom ldan mthong gyur bhut+ta tra yā bat+pa sasba saḥ/ /tā bsdesgo ha mi t+yāsgyu ra ṇajo be+e tsa ra zla ba nas—/ /ji srid ⑥nye bar des phyin pa/ /de srid bdag ni bsregs so zhes/ /rkang pa sprug cing sgra cher data / /ho sā saṃ kalpa pā pe na badz+re ṇi ba sa mā ha taḥ/ /sa shi rī ram̐ k+ṣa ṇi smras—/ /'tshe ba'i rnam rtog sdig pa ni/ /rdo rje lta bus yang dag bcom/ /skad cig de la dmyal ba'i ta smin na ra kasgo pa sā ta saḥ/ /sar+bha dzñā sa ha sā dṛbye tai gho ra na mer—/ /lus dang bcas pa lhung bar gyur/ /'jigs rung dmyal bar lhung ba de/ /'phral la kun ra ke tsū tai / / u bā tsa shu ta ta bye t+ta bi smi hūṃ bhe hūṃ sadza da/ /mkhyen gyis gzigs nas/ /de brjod thos pa'i gyeya mtshan pa'i/ /phun tshogs dge slong la gsungs pa/ /e ṣa kilbi ṣa do ṣe ṇa pa ti taḥgre sha saṃ ka ṭi/ /tī bye sbri tai mi re mṛ te sdig pa dag gi skyon gyis nikye/ /nyon mongs nyam ngar lhung bar gyur/ /gang phyir dri ma ldan pa'i yid/ /sat+tha thā ma li nasma naḥ/ /na gar+yā ba ti sgo ṣa yo ra ti so ma gya ju pa teḥ/ /kun tu rab rib drag po skyed tsu7/ /grong khyer dge ba'i dbyangs su ni/ /sa yi bdag po yid bzang la/ /kṛ ta rnyertswa kṛ ta dzñā: pu rā pu tre ba ju ba tuḥ/ /kṛ ta dzñāḥkṛ pa yābe+e bh+yaḥbyas shes dang ni byas mi shes/ /bu gnyis sngon tshe byung bar gyur/ /byas shes brtse bas slong rnams la/ /95—531

kalpa thra k+ṣa i bā ni shī/ /ni dza bi mu tsa pra da do raṭ+wā bha ra ṇa rtag tu dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /rang gi rin chen rgyan gyi ⑨ tshogs/ /rnam par bkrol khyanas rab sañtsa yo/ /a be+e bhak+ta pi tudz+ra bye sarde sā dh+wa ra ma bye yoḥ/ /ba dadri t+ya kṛ ta tu ster/ /bgos pa min pa pha yi rdzas/ /thams cad 'u cag thun mong yin/ /zhes smras byas mi shes zlo pi te na dat+ta dza hā ra tata/ /ta taḥshā sgyu ya ba tsa sā ma ti gho ṣā bhi kyis kyang / /de yis byin pa de dag phrogs/ /de nas mi bdag blo gros dbyangs/ /zhes pas byas shes bho dṛ paḥ/ /dza na ka s+thā ṇi rmā nā ma kṛ tā dzha ya su tī da do/ /swa ya me bsngags 'os la/ /skye bo dge shem zhes pa yi/ /bu mo ④tshig gis byin par gyur/ /rang nyid kyis bārdzi tai biñtsa dzā ḍū dzā ta ma no ra thaḥ/ /ā ru ro ha pra ba ha khaṃ kṛ ta rja tha bsgrubs byin pa yizhe/ /yid la re ba de la skyes/ /de nas chu gtor khyechen por ni/ /byas shes gzings ma ho da kau/ / rat+na rdza kau ya tai dī ṣa marnyi tā da raḥ / / ta me la zhon par gyur/ /sdang zhing 'gran pas gus 'phel ba/ /ngan pa byas mi shes pa yang / /rin chen bā nu ya yo lo bhā da kṛ ta p+ta bi durdza naḥ/ /saṃ sgoṇ+ḍidza ni dzi sādze+esta sgrub brtson de nyid kyi/ /rjes su chags las song bar gyur/ /de nas tshong pa'i don mthun gyis/ /taḥpra ba ha khaṃ sha naḥ/ /ā nu ku bye na ma ru tā ma bā pa dī pa mismi yongs gang gzings ni dal bu yidz+wa/ /rjes su mthun pa'i rlung dag gis/ /'dod pa'i gling du phyin par tā / /tasmin+da pra nyi ni thrabhe tha swa de shaṃ gabye mu r+ya te/ /rat+na rā shi gyur—/ /tshong pa rnams kyi rdesnakun rtog bzhin/ /rin chen tshogs kyis kun tu khengs/ /de nas de ni bye rā pūṇ+ḍi saṃ kaspe ba ṇi dzā mi ba/ /kṛ ta snyoḥthra thi bī mū bye rat+na ā+oṃ sha ta slar log nas/ /rang gi phyogs su 'gro brtson tshe/ /sa gzhi ri ba'i rin po che/ / brgya phrag po7lnga ni byas pañtsa kai/ /ā dā ya gradz+re par+bhe na ba bad+dhā shu ka pabe+e be+e/ /rat+na bhā shes kyis/ /blangs nas gos kyi yal 'dab la/ /ras ma yis ni mdud par khya3/bcings/ /de nas 95—532

ra pa ri shārnya ta taḥbra ba ha khaṃ ma ha ta/ /a bha dzñā ta ma hā bā tai ri gzings chen rin chen gyi/ /khur gyis yongs su ngal ba de/ /rlung chen dag gis zhig gyur te/ /tshul shwar+ya mi ba duṇ+ḍi yeḥ/ /ta taḥpha la ha kā bās+t+ri kṛ ta dzñāḥpāp+ta dzi bi taḥ/ /ngan rnams kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /de nas shing dum bzung ba yisasnasna/ /byas shes kyis ni 'tsho ba thob/ /a kṛ ta dzñā ni madz+dzarnyi dṛkhye na sa ma ta ra yeta/ /tā ri taḥkṛ pa yā rgyab kyis byas mi shes dag ni/ / byengs par ༷2snagyur pa yang dag bsgral/ /'jigs rung chu srin 'byung bhā tā sa sgo ra ma ka rā ka rāta/ /a sa thra da tsa le ta gya ru tsi re gnas las/ /brtse bas bsgral ba'i spun zla des/ /de yi thu bo (sgodag la ni/ /rin chen yid 'ong rat+na sañtsa yo/ /sa ta mya rat+na lo bhe na dre ṣe tsa ba shī kṛ taḥ/ /sa mu bsags pa mthong / /de yi rin chen la chags dang / /sdang ba'i dbang du gyur pa des/ /rgya mtsho'i dra tī re shran+ta su bhatri dro ha ma tsin+ta yata/ /ta gya ni dru ni lbo na gya shaste 'gram du ngal ba yi/ /spun ya je'akhu ba bsams par gyur/ /de ni gnyid du song ba la/ /mig dag not+yā rgya lo tsa ṣ+pe/ /kṛ tī tā rat+na ni tsa yo kṛ ta bhanaḥs ye yo dza bāta/ /kru mtshon gyis rab phyung nas/ /rin po che yi tshogs bzung ste/ /byas mi gzo de mgyogs par song / sgra re shāñtsi kṛ taste na rā hu ṇi ba di ba ka raḥ/ /lo ko pa kā ra be+e ra hata duḥgacan gyis ni nyin byed gyebazhin/ /gdug pas long bar byas pa des/ /'jig rten phan pa bra' ba las/ /khi taḥso gya tsin+ta yata/ /a dhu nābe+e pra dā ṣ+peze byadhī bhū te ma no ra the/ /sdug bsngal ldan pa des kyang bsams/ /da 6ni slong la sbyin don du/ /yid la re ba don med gyur/ /kisma mān+ta su ba sgo dz+re bi te na pra yo dza rgo/ /a pāp+ta bi dha yaḥpā zla long ba bdag gi 'tsho ba ni/ /'bras med dag gis dgos pa ci/ /gal te dus la ma bab pas/ /srog na pra yārnyi ya dik+ṣa yi/ /ta da saṃ ga ta po yo gaḥkle sha shārnyi k+ṣa ya k+ṣa maḥ/ /ni 'jig par mi 'gyur na/ /de la grogs med dka' thub kyi/ /sbyor ba nyon mongs zhi 'jig bzodarngu/ /95—533

spyi ṇi dha ṣ+pe dza ṣ+pe dī ṣe mā ṣ+pe bai ka l+ya be+e hwa le/ /pū bye sum̐ sī sa me ṣ+pe ba nor zad skye bo sdang gyur cing / /khengs pa dang bral 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /skyes bu rnams ni ①na tshod 'jug /she ṣa mya tsa ya so bya yaḥ/ /i ti sañtsi t+ya sa sha ṣ+perba dzan sābe+e na tā ri zhi bas zad pa mchod par 'os/ /de ltar bsams shing dal bus delngo/ /'gro ba don mthun dag gis taḥ / /a bā pa na ga ro pārnyi ma ti gho ṣa gya bhū pa teḥ/ /go pā la bha ba bsgral—/ /sa bdag blo gros dbyangs kyi ni/ /grong khyer dag dang nye bar phyin/ /ba lang skyong ba'i khang ṣ+pe ta tra sa kiñtsiṭ+wā la mā sbi taḥ/ /u byā na ya tā ga ta yā rā dza pu rngu bi lo pa der/ /cung zad dus ni de yis bsdad/ /rgyal po'i bu mo /1skyed mos tshal/ /rnam par lta zhing 'gro ki taḥ/ /tai dṛṭīn+dha ma pi byak+ta rā dza lak+ṣa ṇa lak+ṣi ta/ /pāstsad+ma pre ba yis/ /long yang rgyal po'i mtshan rnams kyis/ /gsal bar mtshan pa de ④mthong nas/ /skye ba snga ma ba dhe na sa bhi lā ṣā ba bhū ba sā/ / ta ta ཿ swa ya swa ra bi bye ma'i zhemadza' bas bcings/ /de la mngon par dga' bar gyur/ /de nas ⑥yab kyi bka' las ni/ /sā kṛ tā sa sha na྾ tuḥ/ /rā dzñā mā dh+ya mā nā bye brtse bi ga ta lo tsa rang nyid mchog 'dam de yis byas/ /rgyal po rnams kyi (ñdzunang nas ni/ /mig dang bral ba bos te 8 / /byu mi pā lā nu ri t+ya bye bṛ to phon+dha pā pa yā twa yā/ /uste ti pi gdams—/ /sa skyong rnams ni yongs btang nas/ /sdig ma khyod kyis long ba gdams/ /zhes brjod pa tā ko pe na ni ra s+thā ba hi shu bhā sā/ /u t+yā ṣ+pe sā ni dh+wa yār+ghaṃ yasne ni khros pa yis/ /dase/ ma de ni phyi rol bskrad/ /mdza' gcugs — nyer bsags gus pa can/ /de nā kṛ t+ya sgo dza rgo/ /sa dā tasmi da do pre ma pra ṇa yo pa tsi tā da rā/ /yis long ba skyed tshal du/ /bzhag nas 'bad pas kha zas dag /bslangs 9nas ster zhing rtag tu gnas/ /ka dā tsir+ghaṃ tsi rā yā tā mā hā rā ba sa re ga te/ /u bā tsa rā dza ta na yaḥnam zhig zas kyi skabs 'das tshe/ /yun ring lon nas 'ongs de la/ /bkres pas bzhin ni yongs 95—534

pa ris+thā nā na naḥgru jo/ /a sa m+bi k+ṣi ta kā ri sgyu twa yā ke ba la nyams pa'i/ /rgyal po'i bu yis rab smras pa/ /khyod 1ni kun tu ma brtags spupar/ /byed mas g.yo ba tsa pā lāta/ /dṛ te ha man+dhaḥsaṃ t+ya bye dṛ pādz+re pu la lo tsa nān/ /'ba' zhig las/ /mi bdag yangs pa'i ②spyan ldan rnams/ /yongs btang bdag ni long ba 'damasatshoshe/ /pabyat+na pe na byu rna two ma yi parlu ṣi tā da rā/ /a dhu nā tā d+dhā baṃ presnaḥkhyod ni phyi nas 'gyod pa yis/ /bdag la gus pa dman gyur te/ /da ni mdza' ba zhan pa nyid/ /ston pra dar+sha tu mu r+ya tā/ /an+dha san+dar+sha nobyighā su rū pā lo ke no mu khā+e/ /par brtson pa ma yin nam/ /long ba lta bas yid byung ste/ /gzugs bzang blta 57la mngon par phyogs/ /ā hā ra kā le ti krārnyi tsi re shā hā twa mā ga ta/ /i kyugh+ra pa ru ṣe te na de ring zas kyi dus 'das te/ /ring mo zhig na 7cesnakhyod 'ongs so/ /de yis rtsub mo 'di smras te/ /kadza mā nā la te ba pā/ /u bā tsa rgu dzad+ma dhu pa gre d+dhā ma dhu ka ra bā 'dar ba dang ldan 'khri shing ni/ /sgra sgrog 4bung ba'i 'phreng 2ldan bzhin/ /snyan par smras 7she)byed des di m+bi/ /nā tha mi bye ba me shaṃ kā na ko pāṅkan+d+ra marta se/ /bāghā ṇa pā smras pa/ /mgon po khro bas bdag la ni/ /log pa'i dogs pa bgyid she —mi 'os/ /mdza' bas mnyes tai sa ha te na tse taḥspru ti pe sha lo/ /two me ba de ba tī dzā na ya r+ya haṃ gshin sems kyis ni/ /tshig gi mda' lhung mi bzod do/ /khyod ni lha nyid du shes la/ /gal te bdag shudha mā na sa/ /te na ba bye na sā lo ka me shaṃ na ya na mastuta/ /i t+yāste gi yid dag na/ /bden pa de yis khyod kyi mig /gcig /—1ni snang ba ldan gyur cig /ces pa rke5snying sa twa shā li t+yā ta yā ta snga shu lo tsa lda/ /ut+pabe+e ka ma khā kā ra me kai bi ma stobs ldan ma des/ /brjod tshe myur bar de yi rtsenaspyan/ /rab rgyas pad+ma'i rnam pa can/ /gcig ni dri la tsā ya yo/ /ta myuḥb t+ya bra bhā be+e na saṃ dzā ta thra thu bisma yaḥ/ /pa t+ya pra med nyid du gyur/ /de yi bden pa'i mthu yis ni/ /ya mtshan chen po yang dag skyes/ /bden pa'i yid 95—535

t+ya ya son+d+ra haḥkṛ ta dzhasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bhā tā te nā kṛ ta zlo na pā ṭi te lo tsa ches spro ldan pas/ /byas shes kyis ni de la smras/ /spun zla byas mi shes de yis/ /mig gnyis dag ni na dwa ye/ /tasmim+bi kā ro be+e re bā na ni kā ro gya byu ta ma ma/ /swastso te nāstu ba phyung gyur pa'i/ /gnod pa de la bdag la ni/ /khon nam rnam 'gyur ma skyes na/ /bden pa de yis h+ye na dī tī ya ma pi lo tsa nam/ /i sgoste ta 1 ṇi nā gya spaṣ+ṭañtsa kyu gnyis pa yi nyusna/ /mig kyang rnal du gnas gyur cig /ces brjod de yis skad cig la/ /de ni gsal ra lagh+ra ta/ /ta taḥka li ta bṛ tādhe kṛ ta dzha mu tsi tai pa two/ /pra z-iṣ+ṭa dza ba'i mig gis mtshan/ /de nas byung ba'i mtha' bshad pa'i/ /byas shes bdag por 'os pa ni/ /skye bo dge na ka spyo ṇi ga twa pi tre n+ya be+e da yata/ /pū dzitaḥswa shu re rja tha sa rat+na ga dza bā dzi ma rab mgu bas/ /song nas pha la nges par bshad/ /de nas de ni gyos po yis/ /rin chen glang po rta yis bhiḥ / /shri ye ba kān+ta yā sārnyi dza ga ma na ga dzi pi tuḥ/ /sa ta tra pi tā mchod—/ /dpal dang bzhin du mdzes ma dang / /lhan cig yab kyi grong khyer song / /zhabs la cod pan gyis z-iṣ+ṭi na tsa ra zla lbo na she kha raḥ/ /dza nā nu rā ga shu bha ge yo ba rā bye pa de dṛ gtugs te/ /rab tu mgu ba'i pha yis der/ /skal bzang skye bo rjes chags pa/ /rgyal tshab dag gi gnas la taḥ / /a kṛ ta zlo pi nirladz+dzaste pra sā da yi tro sha ṭhaḥ/ /bi tsi t+ya pā da sa ta ṣ+pe ta bkod—/ /ngo tsha med pa byas mi shes/ /de la rab tu dang ba'i g.yos/ /zhabs la gtugs te de la ni/ /su dro hi sa mā ya yo/ /ud+ma nārta tu mā tī ti sa tai ku ṭi la tseṣ+ṭa taḥ/ /'khu ba'i bsam pas yang dag 'ongs/ /sgyu yis de ni gsad thu'adod pa'i/ /gya gyu'i bsam pa ldan pa de//hā hā da sgo smi da sgo l+lī tru ste ba na ra ke pa ta ta / / sa e ba de kyi hud bdag bsregs bdag bsregs zhes/ /brjod pa kho nas dmyal bar lhung / /de nyid lha sbyin 1ba dasto sau kṛ ta dzha bya ha me ba tsa/ /dzad+mān+ta rā nu badhe na dwo kho gya na ni 'di yin te/ /byas shes de yang nga nyid do/ /skye ba gzhan du rjes 'brel bas/ /'di yi sdang ba yongs ④ 9khya —536

brta te/ /sat+tha dzha bhā ṣi ta mi ti pra tsu ro pa kā ram̐ tasde ba dat+ta tsa ri tai mi zlog /de ltar kun mkhyen gyis gsungs lha sbyin ⑨gyi ni spyod pa de/ /yongs su gdung ba byed pa gnod pa ri tā pa kā ri/ /dzad+mān+ta ro pa tsi ta pā ta ka sin+da bar+ghaṃ khru tā ba pa ⑤rab mang dang ldan zhing / /skye ba gzhan du nye bar bsags pa'i sdig pa rjes 'byel ba/ /dge slong bhū ba bi ma khā i pa bhekyu saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye tshogs kyis thos nas yid ni byung ba bzhin du gyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dze+e kṛ ta dzñā ba dā dze+e ṣa ṭa tsa sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las byas shes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab tā ri shaḥpal+la baḥ// //ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //dā ṣ+pe ka tā na ma na saṃ dṛ thu sa tā bhā dzā mun+d+ra ha mā na gu ṇa sgo snying stobs che bsten yid ni sbyin la gcig tu nges rnams kyi/ /spyo dang mchod dang yon tan longs ga bi bhū ti pū taḥ/ /pāklu rgya sañtsa ya ma yaḥku sha lā dī dh+wa na kā spyod 'byor pa skyed byed pa/ /sngon gyi bsod nams bsags pa 'a sa/ byung dge ba mngon brjod pa'i/ /le pha la t+ya bi ka laḥki la kalpa bṛk+ṣaḥ/ /kau sha len+d+ra gya bhu bhaspru shā dpag bsam shing ni nges par dus su ma tshang med 'bras skyed/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba mnyan yod na/ /sa bsgyu bha ga bān pu rā/ /bi dza hā ra ba ro byā dz+re sa ha dzhaik+ṣu ga ṇi re dzi naḥ/ /bdag ko sa la dbang gi/ /skyed tshal mchog na dge slong gi/ /tshogs dang thabs cig mngon 1bzhugs tshe//ā di ma dh+yān+ta ka spyo r+ṇa bha bā rnyi bha ba te pu dze+e/ /sa di de sha sa ran+dhadz+re tre thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /srid pa zil gnon mchog gi chos/ /'jig rten gsum po dge ba la/ /lokya ku sha lo r+ya taḥ/ /a tān+ta re nā ga rā dzaḥpu tāḥsā ga ra bā si naḥ/ /sbyor ba de yis rab tu bstan/ /skabs der klu yi rgyal po'i bu/ /rgya mtsho dag tu gnas pa bzhi/ /95—537

tsa tā raḥ su ga to diṇ+ḍi sa dhah+ma sa ra mā mṛ tai/ /a bhi ra t+ya khyu stobs dang shin tu stobs dang ni/ /dbugs dang dbugs chen zhes bya ba/ /sring mo mngon dga' zhes yā swa pā pre ri tāḥsho tu mā sa byaḥ/ /te ba khā ti ba khā shā sa ma hā shā pa yis/ /bskul nas de dag mnyam du ni/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs dam pa'i chos/ /mchog gi sā bhe dh+waḥs oṃ/ /kra kukhru n+da gya su bye yaḥkā le bha ga ba taḥbu rā/ /bdud rtsi nyan du 'ongs/ /sngon gyi dus na bcom ldan 'das/ /blo bzang 'khor ba 'jig dang ni/ /ka na kā khya su tsa mu ṣ+peḥkā sh+ya pa su tsa yerta taḥ/ /nā dzagluḥs+thā su khā sa kyāḥgaser thub ces ni bya ba dang / /de bzhin dgra bcom 'od srungs ṭ+wāl/ /nyan du sring mos bskul gyur sgo hūṃ ya swā be+e tā a pi / / te pu rgya pa ri rja me na pā be+e ཿkyang / /dpal gyi bder chags 'ongs ma gyur/ /de dag bsod nams yongs smin nas/ /shākya thub shākya mu naḥpu rāḥ/ /te 6 pra ṇa mya shāsnra ram̐ tsa ra shā lbo na mo li 6/ /bi ṅgā ya pa'i sngon 27du 'ongs/ /de dag mi yi lus bsgrubs te/ /ston pa la ni phyag btsal nas/ /zhabs la mgo mā nu ṣe rū paṃ mu sa bi ṣ+ṭi pa r+ṣa di/ / sa dha n+d+ra ma ya yo gro hūṃ kau yis gtugs byas te/ /'khor der nye bar 'dug pa'i tshe/ /gsal rgyal ko sa la yi dbang / /dpal sha len+d+raḥ pra se na dzita/ /lasmre ma dasmi tats+tsha yo ni bārlu ts+tsha tra tsā ma 'byor rgyags 'dzum mdzes pa yi de/ /gdugs dang rnga yab bzlog nas ni/ /dam chos nyan du yang dag ram̐ / /shāstuḥpā da pra zla mā ya bi sha tasta su saṃ sa di/ /a ba kā shaṃ na tābya 'ongs—/ /ston pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal slad/ /tshogs su zhugs pa de la ni/ /mi yi bdag la gus pa kruḥ sasbo dṛ pa ti go ra bāta/ / ta snga bhe rna r+ya mā na su baṇ+ḍi shra ma las—/ /kun gyis ngabatud cing go skabs phye/ /rig snyeganas bla ma mi rnams kyis/ /mngon par dga' gu rodz+ra bhiḥ/ /nā ga rā dza su tābya krurtswa ba kā shaṃ na saskṛ tai/ : /ta ya : de dag dregs pas khengs pa dang zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/'u bar byas de la/ /klu yi rgyal po'i bu rnams kyis/ /go skabs bkur ste ④byas ma grur/ /de dag dregs 95—538

darba na mā bye ba dzi na gya bi na ye na tsa/ /mā ni no dṛ pa ti ran+tan+d+ra rgyuḥpas khengs pa dang / /rgyal ba la ni gus pas kyang / /khengs ldan mi bdag khro ba ni/ /nang du rab tu brats+tshan+da hūṃ ya yo/ /sa saṃ dzha yā mā di sh+ya ni dza pa ri dza rgo pu raḥ/ /ga ma ṣ+pe bsgribs par gyur/ /de yis rang gi 'khor la ni/ /'gro tshe sngon du de dag rnams/ /tshar bcad brda ni gra haṃ te ྾ nim+bi kā ra i ba bha ba ta / /bha ga bā na bi sadze+e yis bskos byas nas/ /rnam 'gyur 2med pa bzhin du gyur/ /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /dzhasta gya nitso yo dzha to/ /r+yasgro pa de sha par+yadhe sngo bā tsa ra tsi tasmi taḥ/ /de yi nges pa mkhyen gyur nas/ / chos ni nye bar bstan pa yi/ /mjug /3snatu 'dzum mdzad rab gsungs pa/ /na bi dī ṣa ra dzaḥpūṇ+ḍi ma no ma li na dadze+e ṇi/ /bha ti dhasgro pa de sha gya pra yid kyi me long dri ma can/ /sdang ba'i rdul gyis gang ba la/ /chos ni nye bar bstan pa yi sna/ /gzugs ti bi sba pra ti gra haḥ/ /a bi ta sa ma tā r+ghaṃ ko sa mo ha ha tā dzā brnyan 'dzin pa mdzes ma yin/ /mnyam pa nyid dang bral zhing khro dang rmongs pas bcom rnams la/ /kṛ sha ma pi ku sha waṃ shaṃ no ba de shaḥka ro ti/ /na hi ba hu ta ra do ṣe shudhi tī nyer bstan gyis ni dge ba'i cha shas chung ngu yongs jimi byed/ /gang phyir blo gros blun po rnams kyi rab mang ṣ+pe sha rī re bra dza pra ma tī rmā bhe ṣa dze+e bhe ṣa dza twam/ /i ti yuthi bha ga ba skyon ldan lus/ /dag pas dman pa dag la sman ni sman nyid mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa bcom ldan rigs pa nā hi ta muk+tasma byā ba tiḥ/ /shu tāpi na tsa ta t+yā dza nā ge 6 bi ma yis—/ /phan pa gsung ba thos gyur kyang / /klu rnams la ni sdang ba'i yid5/ /sa yi bdag pos btang naska tamra/ /bha ga brnyi pra ṇa mā tha pra yā te swa pa rda dṛ paṃ/ /nā gāsta྾ ni kā ma gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan la btud nas/ /mi bdag rang gi gnas song tshe/ /de yi dpung gis lam ba dhe mārga byo ma sa thā yāstaḥ / /te be+e tsiñtsa swa bha ba ṣ+pegh+ra sak+ṣa ya bkag pas/ /klu rnams mkha' yi lam nas song / /khyim du de dag gis bsams te/ /sa bdag gzhom 95—539

shā listas+thāts+tsha dzā ya te/ /di bya sā nān+da sadzabhi ཿ pha la taṅka su kan+d+ra sdong po bur shing sdong por 'gyur①/ /lha yi bza' btung phun sum tshogs/ /de dag las ni gang gi ṇaḥ / /i ti thraṣ+ṭaḥpra ṇa yi nā bhek+ṣu zla bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /u bā tsa 'bras—/ /dge slong gus pas dris pa 'di/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po'i longs khru ya hūṃ rā dzhaḥkā ra rde sgo ga salba dzā/ /kau sha rngesmiñdza na sa da khaṇ+ḍa spyod phun tshogs kyikhru/ /rgyu ni rab tu mnyen par mdzod zu/ /ko sa la yi ljongs 'di ru/ /bur shing khyu gu ḍa kar+ṣa kaḥ/ /da do pra bye ka bud+dhā ya pūt+tha mik+ṣu ra so darna/ /bhuste ṣ+pe k+ṣu zhing pa dum bu zhes/ /bya bas rang sangs rgyas la sngon/ /bur chu dang ni zas dag byin/ /de yi bsod ra sdedz+re na te na bā ta ga dā sdo ta ཿ / pra h+ye ka bu d+dhā sta h+phu bye ཿnams rnams dang ni/ /bur chu gzan 4dag gsol ba des/ /rlung nad kyis nyen chorang sangs rgyas/ /pra san+da swasbya hūṃ ya yo/ /rā dzā pra se na dzi྾ yi pu bye bān gu ḍa kar+ṣa kaḥ/ /rab dang dri med nyid du gyur/ /bur shing zhing pa bsod nams can/ /de ni rgyal po gsal/ rgyal 'di/ /te na pu ju pra bhā be+e na sgo ga bhā gī bi rā dza te/ /u pa kā ra kṛ ta dzha dzā bsod nams de yi mthu yis ni/ /longs spyod skal ldan rnam par mdzes/ /byas/ shes rnams la phan pa dang //ni kā raḥhrū ra tse ta shā/ /su kṛ hūṃ shabya sā dhu nā maspo byā yā t+ya nalpa gdug sems can la gnod pa dang / /dam pa rnams la legs byas ni/ /chung yang chung ngu nyid min hūṃ / / san+d+ra zlo ṣ+pe ti ka thi te pūn+d+ra pu rgya ma tī pa teḥ/ /ba byu 'gyur—/ /sa bdag sngon gyi bsod nams ni sne/ /kun mkhyen gyis ni gsungs pa'i tshe/ /legs byas ba su kṛ toṅkar+ṣa bhik+ṣu rābyar+ya nibya laḥ/ /a tha bhabh+yaḥbha ga ba taḥkṛ twa mchog tu gyur pa las/ /dge slong ngo mtshar g.yo med gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan la gus pas/ /rgyal rā dzā dhi bā sa ram̐/ /u pā ni bye swa yad+dhād+dhā su rār+ghaṃ sgo ga sadza do/ /pos lhag par gnas byas nas/ /longs spyod phun tshogs lha la 'os/ /de de rang gis nye bar bkod/ /95—541

pa ro pa tsā ri ru tsi re radz+re te kāñtsa nā sa ṣ+pe/ /su khā ya biṣ+ṭi sro bā tsa mchog tu mdzes pa'i rim gro yis/ /mchod de gser gyi khri la ni/ /bder bzhugs de bzhin gshegs pa na ra nā thasta thā ga tai/ /bha ga bad+me bha bar+bha t+ta bi bhak+ta su kṛ ta la—/ /mi yi mgon pos rab smras pa/ /bcom ldan khyed rmyel gus pa yis/ /legs byas dpal ni rnam shri maḥ/ /tsa yaḥku sha la spru khā nā ma si mubh+yo bha bi 6 ti/ /bi na yāt+yābe+e rgyas pa/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yis/ /bdag ni grol 'gyur ⑤ srid lags sam/ /bsod nams be+e ṣ+pe ti puṇ+ḍi pu sgyu bhe mā ni nā/ / thra ṣ+ṭa ཿ smi ta se tā lo rka dza rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal 1can/ /sa yi bdag po gus pas 'di/ /dris la bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /gā da su ga taḥthra dzan/ /rā dzā na saṃ sā rā mārga ya ma nā di ni dha na 'dzum dkar snang ba spyo zhing gsungs/ /rgyal po 'khor ba dag gi lam/ /thog mtha' med par 'jug pa baḥ / /he lā lo bh+yaḥka dze+e sum̐ sā ma pāp+ta kle sha saṃ k+ṣa ya/ / tsi ra 'di—/ /nyon mongs kun zad ma thob par/ /skyes bus bde bar ji ltar 'gongs/ /yun ring rngub ri tsi tai: krā bste ra sak+ta ga tā ga tiḥpra kṛ ti ga ha naḥsaṃ sā ro yongs 'dris 'khor lo bskor ⑤bzhin rgyun du 'ong dang 'gro ba yis/ /rang bzhin gyis zab 'khor ba 'di yo su khe na na lo gha te/ /a pa ti hi bi nā yo gyu sgyu saṃ k+ṣa ya ki la karma la bde blag 'gongs ('upar mi nus te/ /sbyor ba goms pa med cing las rnams nges par zad pa min pa ⑦ rde sbu ṭa pha la tai ti dhem+bi su smi— brnya na tsā gtaḥ/ /sarba to bi ni thrat+ta su ni—/ /rgya che 'bras bu gsal ba'i chos kyang 'dir ⑤ ni 'ching ba nyid du gyur/ /sbyin la goms pa chen po dā nā sgyu se na bhu ya sā/ /ma mā pi dhan+d+ra saṃ sā ro ba khyu ba bhu bi dzad+ma yis—/ /kun las rnam par log gyur pa/ /bdag kyang sa la skye ba bzung / /chos kyis 'khor ba nyid du kṛta / /dha ni ko nā ma dha na bān bā rā ṇasnga ma bhūh+phu ra/ /ta po sa ha pha gyur—/ /nor can zhes pa shesnanor dang ldan/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ⑩ sngon byung grur/ /gdung ba 'phrog cing 95—542

la sde tarja yā bṛ k+ṣa i bābe+e rmā/ / dubyek+ṣa k+ṣi pi te lo ke bi ṣa ma 'bras bu rgyas/ /slong ba rnams kyi grib shing bzhin/ /mu ges 'jig rten brlag gyur cing / /mi bzad kle sha bi hwa le/ /sgo bye pra h+ye ka bud+dhā dzñā sobe+e teḥpañtsa byeḥsha taiḥ/ /sa nyon mongs kyis 'khrugs tshe/ /rang sangs rgyas ni lnga brgya yis/ /de la 'tsho ba bslangs par gyur/ /mi tai ྾ pa ra sgo gārti dusgok+ṣu pa bye dza ā+oṃ/ /a kalpa ya da na mya shrīḥchung dpal des bang ba yilku/ /khang bdag la bgros de dag la/ /mchog tu longs spyod 'os pa'i zas/ /koṣ+ṭha gā rī ka sasma te/ /sha ta pañtsa ka saṃ gha tai sgo hūṃ ta gya kṛ haṃ ta taḥ/ /pra mu ge dag gi mthar thug sbyar/ /de yi khyim du gsol/ ba la/ /brgya phrag lnga ni 'tshogs 3gyur te/ /de māt+tha h+ye ka bud+dhā rmā sa ha sra dwa ya mā ya yo/ /ta gya ta ta pu sgo bā se na nas rim gyis rang sangs rgyas/ /stong phrag gnyis ni byung bar gyur/ /skyes tshe 'bras bu'i dpal thob pa/ /dzā tā khāp+ta pha la shri yā/ /dur+bhak+ṣa dā na yi taḥko sha ra na kle sha ā k+ṣa yatu/ tshe /: skyes tshe 'bras bu'i sogs sgo ka gcig gi rkang pa bzhi pa'i skad dod na kle sha sogs tsheg bar drug dang / bde ba brgyud pa sogs sgo ka gcig gi rkang pa dang ngo/ dang / gnyis pa 'i skad dod su khaṃ sogs tsheg bar bcu drug /rkang nga gsum pa 'i zhi ba 'dir yin gsum gyi skad dod shan+d+ra sogs tsheg bar bzhi rnams kyi rgya skad chad nga 'dar los gsar du bcug pa be+er dbe+ed/3/bsod nams btab pa de yis ni/ /mu ge'i sbyin pas de yi mdzod/ /zas kyi nyon mongs zad ma gyur/ /su khaṃ sa nā ta ā+oṃ pu rgya sgo gya two tai badh+wa na btu/ /shad+dhā s+t+ya yo sa re shā haṃ bde ba brgyud /④pa bsod nams kyis/ /spyad nas nor can de nyid ni/ /nga yin zhi ba mchog gis 'dir//samyak+shi bo dhi mā shri taḥ/ /pu bye na pā pe na tsa be+e ṣ+ṭi te yo saṃ sā ri khaṃ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsten/ /'khor ba pa yi las 'bras 2'jug pa 'di/ /'ching byed thag kadz+re pha la pra dṛt+taḥ/ /se tā si tā ban+dha na raspru ṣā ta ta saṃ k+ṣa ye mo pa dkar dang dkar min ni/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag gis rnam par bcings/ /de zad pa la thar k+ṣa pa thadza darnyi/ /i ti k+ṣi tī shaḥka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na mo ha bya pe ye na ni sha mya pa'i gnas zhes brjod/ /de ltar rmongs pa zad pas thar par ni/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa sa dbang gis 95—543

mo k+ṣ-i/ /gre sha k+ṣa yārta sha ma me ba ma tā pu rgyu bhi mā ā+oṃ shi thi lī tsa kā thos nas/ /nyon mongs 'dzad 'os ①zhi ba kho nar nges/ /bsod nams mngon pa'i nga rgyal lhod par ra / / i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yo bo dhi sa tā ba da na kalpa byas / /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi la tā dze+e shā liste bā ba dā na sap+ta tsa tā ri shaḥpal+la baḥ// //'khri shing las sā la'i 7kyesdong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //swārja pra bṛbho be+e ga tasmṛ ha rde pā ro pā kā re sa ta to r+ya tā rmā/ /rang don la 'jug chags pa dang bral zhing / /gzhan la/ phan par rtag tu brtson rnams kyisarte —/ /gre she ṣā d+dhā tā bya sa ṣ+pe ra m+bi tā biste ra spru ḍa ka ma re ti sedhiḥ/ /grub pa nyon mongs rnams la mi 'jigs shing / /gdung dang gegs 4bral gzir byed min par gyur/ /shā babye bha ga bārnyu rde dzi no dze ta ba ṣ+pesbi tāḥ/ /dhas+thā khyu na pra saṃ ge na mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon/ /bzhugs pa bcom ldan rgyal ba yis/ /chos 'chad pa yi zhar la ni/ /bhekyu shaṃ hā ma byā ṣa ta/ /ā sī da khi la byu pa khā mo li lā li ta shā sa naḥ/ /dge slong tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ /sa bdag sa rnams kun gyi bdag /don grub ces pa legs byas ldan//sed+dhāsgo nā ma su kṛ tī sāzla d+ngha mo ma tī pa tiḥ/ /sā ga rā khya gya na ga su su nurdza sa skyong kun gyi mgo bo la/ /bka' ni rnam par rtse bar gyur/ /chu yi gter la gnas gyur pa/ /rgya mtsho la bye bā si naḥ/ /sas+thārja sidzhaḥpu tra hūṃ pra ya yo ta gya bhū pa teḥ/ /sa bhā dra kalpi zhes bya ltasnaklu yi bu/ /don kun grub pa sa bdag ni/ /de yi bu nyid dag tu gyur/ /snying stobs rab tu ko bo bye sa twoḥ sa two dz+wa la pra bhaḥ/ / dzā ta mā traḥk+ṣi ti ta labyakre 'bar ba'i 'od/ /skal bzang byang chub sems dpa' de/ /skyes pa tsam gyis 'u sa gzhi ni/ /rang gi pūṇ+ḍi swa ṛdhi bhi/ /tagya pra bzlu mā na gya dhan+d+ra phye ba sa mu r+ya yo/ /sa map+ta 'od kyis rgyas par byas/ /de ni che bar skyes gyur pa'i/ /grags pa lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ /srid pa 95—544

bhu ba na byā se bi bu dh+wa bh+yargyu tai ya shaḥ/ /sa ka dā tsid+ma ro r+ya ā+oṃ gyan+da ṣ+pe mtha' dag khyab pa ni/ /chos kyi bzhin du yang dag rgyas/ /skyed tshal mchog tu dar ma de/ / nam zhig na yu bā bra dzan/ /da dar+sha dṛdhi pu ru ṣe de ba tā nim+bi ta bu raḥ/ /tai bi shing rtas 'gro ba na/ /⑫)mdun du lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i/ /skyes bu rgan po mthong bar gyur/ /rga bas lo kya dza rā dz+reṇ+ḍi dzā ta be+e rā gya bā sa naḥ/ /saṃ sā ra mi ba ni sā ram̐ sa 'khogs pa de mthong nas/ /chags bral gyi ni bag chags sad/ /'khor ba bzhin du lus dag ni/ /sha rī ra ma ma n+ya ta/ /ur+ya rmā yā tra bi ra saḥsha ṣ+peḥpra ti ni bṛ t+ya snying po med par de yis bsams/ / skyed tshal blta 2ba'i chags bral te/ /dal gyis log nas 'ong ba kaḥ —/ /dā ri dra bi dru tasgo ya na druk+ṣuskṛ pa khyobe+e thi/ /dṛsnye tā ma des 1—/ /lam du dbul ba nyid kyis ni/ /mdzes bral phongs par gyur pa mthong / /snying rjes drangs su kha kliṣ+ṭa nu ka ru ṇa kṛṣ+ṭa mā na saḥ/ /a tsin+ta ya da ho duḥkhaṃ sa pa'i yid can des/ /bde med nyon mongs de mthong nas/ /bsams pa sa la dbul po rnams/ /kye ma hadhe bhu bi durga tāḥ/ /a dā na pra bha ba duḥkhalba dadhe ti bi saṅga tāḥ/ /sdug bsngal bzod par byed/ /rin chen gyis gang sa gzhi na/ /gzhan la bslangs d+nghapas nyer 'tsho zhing //thra thi bye rat+na pūr+ṇa yī pa ra piṇ+ḍi pa dz+re bi naḥ/ /i da me bā bi saṃ bā di phongs gyur 'di dag sdug bsngal ni/ /sbyin pa min la sa skyes par smra/ /skyes bu bkren pa 'di dag rnams//tsidze+e ka lu ṣa karma rde/ /dī nā ya de te ya tsabye pu ru ṣe pu ru ṣāḥpa ram̐/ /skyes bu gzhan la slong ba gang / /'di nyid kho na mi bslu bar/ /sdeg pa'i las rnams dag gi yertags/ /a ho du྾ ta me te ṣā ma ba j-i tā ཿpa de pa de/ /ya de te mārga gnas dang gnas su smad 67gyur cing / /'di dag slong bas yid byung la/ /babe+engs par gyur kyang kho dīghā bhek+ṣi tā pi bu bhu k+ṣi tāḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsin+t+ra pu tsi ra bi sha kle sha bkres pa na/ /kye ma 'di dag nyes byas nyid/ /de ltar yun ring / mebasams byas nas/ /kun gyi nyon 95byed545

k+ṣayo r+ya tāḥ/ /a da ri dra dza gaṅge hūṃ raṭ+wābe+e dza la dhi ya yo/ /mongs gzhom brtson pas/ /'gro ba dbul min bya ba'i slad/ /rin chen don gnyer rgya mtshor song / /ka thañtsi di ba saṃ sak+taḥs pi tā dṛ zwa ni: yaḥ/ /sa ma ru khya pra ba ha pha yis ji (rmyezhig ltar stes krunyid/ /rjes gnang nges pa brtan pa de/ /gzings la yang dag zhon byas khaṃ rat+na dī pa ma bāp+ta bān/ /ta tra pra ba ha rja byu rnyen ba ṇi dziḥs ha nas—/ /rin chen gling du phyin par gyur/ /der ni tshong pa she gzings dag la/ /zhon nas lhan cig yā yi naḥ/ /so bra bī ta kṛ ya tī kā oṃ yud+mā bhih+ma ṇi saṃ gra haḥ/ /e 'ongs rnams la/ /de yis smras pa khyed cag (d+ngharnams/ /rin chen 'dod pa bsdu bar mdzod/ /thun teḥsā mā n+ya rasnestu ma ma nāste bra yo dza 8/ /ka sha ma hārnyi bhā swarnyi mong rin chen 'di dag gis/ /bdag la dgos pa yod ma yin/ /bdag cag mdzod na rin chen mchog /sarnyi rasdot+ta mā ni naḥ/ /kin+tu tsid+dhā ma ṇi pāste bi pu lo yasma mo r+ya maḥ/ /'od khrudang ldan pa mang po yod/ /'on kyang yid bzhin nor thob slad/ /bdag gi rtsom pa chen po 'di/ /te na be+e dru ta rā ri bye kakhyo metshwa mi me di byā/ /shu tasma yā nā ga rā dzaḥsā de yis 'us ni dbul ba nyid/ /nyams pa dag tu bya bar 'dod/ /rgya mtsho zhes bya klu yi rgyal/ /chu ga rā khyu ma ho da dhi/ /ba sa t+yaste kṛ he ta gya tsin+ta tārba bra do ma ṇiḥ/ /bi gter che la rab tu gnas/ /bsam ⑦pa'i don ster nor bu ni/ /de khyim na yod bdag gis thos/ /mi lo gh+ra bi ṣa masmrarga ta mā dā hūṃ bra dzā mya haṃ/ / nāste byer+ya sa hā yā bzad lam ni bgrod byas teldu/ /bdag ni de nyid len du 'gro/ /brtan pa'i grogs ldan 'bad rtsol rmā durga mi bya ba sā yi rmā/ /na tsamaji ra ho ki tsita bya sa rna bo dang / /ldan pa rnams la bgrod she dka' med/ /bdag gi ke/ 7legs byas rtsom pa 'di/ /gal te 'thob bha bi 6 ti/ /sa t+ya me ba pā rārba yo ya di me su kṛ to r+ya maḥ/ /i na bden nyid du/ /bdag dang bral bas khyed cag rnams/ /ci yang gdung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 95byed546

rāk+ṣa sa dī pa muṅka ṭi/ /ta dze+e ba bi ga ta kru ra bi kā ri steḥs pū dzi taḥ/ /nyam nga srin po'i gling du phyin/ /rnam 'gyur gdug bral de dag gis/ /de bzhin nyid du mchod nas de/ /bhusto k+ṣa pe ṇa ni k+ṣip+taḥk+ṣa ṇan+d+ra gen+d+ra sa mu ni/ /sa ta tra dīp+ta be+e bha dpung pas blangs te skad cig gis/ /klu yi dbang po'i khang par 'phangs/ /lha yi dga' bde la 'os be di byot+pa ba su kho tsi taḥ/ /a shri ḍodhīr+gha duḥkhārte ta ta mā ro da na pa'i / /snang ba 'byor ldan der ni des/ /sdug bsngal chen pos gzir byas pa'i/ /cho nge'i sgra ni thos gha ni/ /sa ta mā kabye sobye gaḥpra kṛ h+ye ba da yādre byeḥ/ /ki me ta di par gyur/ /de yis de thos chags bral can/ /rang bzhin brtse bas brlan pa'i blos/ /mdun du klu yi 6ti sa prats+tsha dṛṭī gre nā ga ka n+ya hūṃ/ /sā tai ba bhā ṣe saṃ sak+ta sho koṣ+ṭha pi shu ṣ+permu bu mo dag /mthong nas 'di dag ci zhes dris/ /yang yang mya ngan la chags pa'i/ /dro ba gsal byed hun+d+ra huḥ/ /smra ni na yadzñā ni shā me+em+bi s+thā dha ra da lak+ṣa ti/ /gu ṇa shugs rings kyis/ /bim pa'i mchu 'dab rimadzes pa dag /dri mar byed des de la smras/ /yon tan bān+d+ra ga rā dza su pu traḥka ma la lo tsa naḥ/ /byeṣ+ṭhaḥsazarba sed+dhā khyaḥthra yo pañtsa twa ma ga ldan pa pad+mo'i spyan/ /klu yi rgyal po dag gi bu/ /thu bo don kun grub ces pa/ /gces pa lnga pa nyid du taḥ / /ta twaḥsnga ta bi ga tā na nī pi thrat+ta su khot+pa be/ /gha no nā ro gyur—/ /de yi sdug bsngal dag gis ni/ /kun dga' dang bral bde dga' spangs/ /khang pa 'dir ni da ṣ+pe nāsmin+da babye bha ba ṣ+pesbi tiḥ/ /i ti ta suḥb tsaḥkhru tā son+taḥpa ram̐ tsi cho nge dag /stug po nyid kyis gnas par byas/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /rang yul mthong bas tsā ba han/ /swa de sha dar+sha na pāsto nā ga rā dzādhi shaṃ ya yo/ /nā ga rā dzasta dga' ba des/ /nang du yongs 'dris 'dzin byed cing / /klu yi rgyal po'i drung du phyin/ / klu yi rgyal po namā yārnyi pa ri dzñā ya thra yā sa ha ཿ / /e bye nyi pu tre ti ba dan dga' ma dang / /bcas pas de 'ongs 4yongs shes nas/ /bu gcig ‘sritshur shog tshur shog ces/ /95—548

ma bhū ba nan+da bi hwa laḥ/ /maṭ+wā dzad+ma ka rja te na swalnga ga ma na kā brjod cing kun dga' 'khrugs par gyur/ /mi yi skye ba'i 17 gtam dang ni/ /rang nyid 'ongs pa'i shergyu ra khaṃ/ /shu tā ni be di tai nā ga ba ri ṣ+ṭa bye dza gā da tai/ / tsirnya ma ṇi ra dag kyang / /de yis bshad pa thos gyur nas/ /klu yis yongs 'khyud de la smras/ /bu gcig yid bzhin yo pu tra ma ma mo li be+e bhū ṣa rde/ /kṛ khya hūṃ ta ba saṃ ka dze+en bar+ghaṃ kaspru nor bu 'di/ /bdag gi mgo bo nyid kyi largyan/ /long zhig khyod kyi brtag pa ni/ /'bras med byed par mut+pa he/ /de yaḥkṛ ta dza gaskṛ tro ma me bā yo su nasta yā/ /i h+phuk+tasme da do mi spro'o/ /'gro ba'i bya ba byas nas 'di/ /khyod kyis bdag la sbar sbyin bya/ /zhes brjod gtsug gi rin di bya tsū ḍa rarja be+e mu tsu saḥ/ / tsi d+dhā ma ṇi sa ma dā ya ku mā rasta ra chen mchog /de yis bkrol nas de la byin/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma'i 'od/ /yang dag blangs nas ṇi pra bhe/ /dṛṣ+ṭaḥpra ṇa mya nā gen+d+ra ya yo pra ba ha rjarnyi shaṃ/ /samu dra gzhon nu ni/ /dga' bas klu dbang la btud de/ /gzings dang nye ba dag tu song / /de yi gtam de ba tā ta tra tai dṛṭ+wā shu ta tat+pa thā/ /u bā tsa shī dṛ shaḥsā sgo shāsta byed+dhā thos rgya mtsho yi 4/ /lha yis der ni de mthong nas/ /dge ba khyod kyis thob pa yi5/ /yid bzhin nor ma ṇi sta yā/ tshe /te ṣ+pe yo kā sha bākya me dh+wa mi thu ri dz+re te na tsa/ /pad+ma pā ṇiḥ: de yi sa ga sal ba ra 'di ba rjod tshe sog sa blo ka ga nyi sa kyi rgya skad chad pa za hor gyi bsde sa sdeb sbyor kha sgo ta yang mar ba kod pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus da ga byed/ / sgo bu ci 'dra smros/ /de yis gsal bar 'di brjod tshe/ /zol med bsam pa drang po des/ /lag pa'i pad+ma pā nā su two de sha tsid+dhā to mā ṇi shaṃ/ / t+ya ste n+d+ra ṣ+ṭa ra sgoṭ+wā ma tī bye rab gdengs nas/ /yid bzhin kyi ni nor bu bstan/ /rin chen mchog de des mthong nas/ /phrag gan+t+raḥsaṃ kalpa tsa/ /t+ya yosgo dza sha ye nāñdza spyo sgo hūṃ ta ran+ta pa bye/ /dog dri ma'i bsam pa yis/ /de yi lag pa 7lag pa yis/ /thal mo (khyebasnun nas chu gter dor/ /95—549

sa mu dre pa ti tai dṛ ṭī rarja kṛsgo ta rārdzi lta / / sa dza gā ma dṛ shin tu dka' ṭ+wābs bsgrubs pa yi3/ /rin chen rgya mtshor lhung mthong nas/ /rtsom pa brten 0pa 'bras phyo byo ga bai pha lobye ga ni: laḥ/ /a ho gu r+ṇa tsi tā kā rā pra ṇa yādh+ri du bā med pa'i/ /mya ngan g.yo med des smras pa/ /yon tan la 'os rnam pa can/ /mdza' bas 'jam par smra rda m+bi/ /bi dwo ṣa ka lu ṣa kadz+re kṛ tā hūṃ na bi rā dza se/ /pa roṅkak+ṣe 6 saṃ byed pa/ /kye ma sdang bas sdig pa'i las/ /byas pas khyod ni mdzes ma yin/ /gang zhig pha rol khyad gha r+ṣa sho ka kle sha mu be+e ti yaḥ / / shī ta khā a pi ta sri tā dzā khā 'phags la/ /'gran dang mya ngan nyon mongs gyur/ /de la phyogs ni 'di dag rnams/ /bsel yang ba la yi ta di shaḥ/ /sa ron+d+ra haṃ thra ya ya su ta gya sa twa ma ho da dheḥ/ /'bar bas dkrigs par gyur/ /gang zhig gzhan byi spro bas mgu/ /snying stobs chu gter chen po des bya/ /kas+thā ra dha ba lo dhaste tri lo tī ti la shaṃ ya shaḥ/ /de bi pra yats+tsha me rarja masma grags pa ga bur lta ra dkar ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyi thig le 'dzin/ /lha dag bdag gi rin chen stsol//dri ra ma pā ta kāta/ /a ba sā de tu dze+e kan+d+ra na sā sgo ra bye ro ha sdig pa 'di dang bral bar mdzod/ /dam pa rnams kyi la sa dag ni/ /smad pa dag dang 3mtshungs mi nyi / /lo bhāt+tha mā dābye ṣabye rasne tserja pra yats+tsha pi/ /sho ṣa yā bye ṣa dza 'gyur / /chags sam bag med sdang ba las6/ /gal te rin chen mi stsol na/ /de lta na ni khyod ñdzukyi la dhi ta di me te sa mā gra yi/ /i rkyughā gya sa kṛste na sā rat+na n+da da gnas—/ /chu gter 'di ni bdag gis bskam/ /zhes pa lan mang des smras kyang / /gang tshe rin chen do ya dā/ /sa ta dā swa pra bhā be+e na sho ṣa yābyeḥs mur+ya yo/ /dh+yā ta mā tram̐ des ma byin/ /de tshe rang gi mthu yis de/ /chu gter bskam phyir rab tu zhugs/ /mig stong ldan pa'i sa ha pā k+ṣa ba tsa pā mi shwa kan+d+ra shā/ /nismi tai sa ha sā gya pā tra mā bi ra tshig gis ni/ /bi shwa kamos sprul pa'i snod/ /bsams pa tsam gyis de yi ni/ /lag tu 'phral la byung 95—550

bhūṅka re/ /sa te nā gas+t+ya tsu lu kā kā re rde bhaḥs yo da dheḥ/ /an+ta rī k+ṣe ma muk+ṣi bar gyur/ /bskam par brtson des ri byi yi/ / khyor ba'i rnam pa de yis ni/ /mechu gter dag las chu su bi k+ṣe pak+ṣa ma kho r+ya taḥ/ /kṛ te tre bhā ga she ṣesgo te nā t+ya bye ta kā blangs nas/ /bar snang la ni rab tu gtor/ /shin tu rmad byung byed pa des/ /chu gter sum cha lhag ri ṇa/ /su ba bher+bha྾ tā bhā tā de ba tāsmi ma ṇirda do/ /nisto dza dīp+ta byas te/ /lha rnams kyis ni smad 5pa yis/ /'jigs nas lha yi kyenor bu byin/ /rin chen rnams sa ha saṃ ra t+na nā mi ba ta twa ta ཿ / / pra bhā baṃ be+e ti ma ha hūṃ bzhin bdag nyid che/ /sngags rnams dang ni dka' thub kyang / /zol med gzi byen che rnams kyi④ / /mad+dhā ṇan+ta pa sāñtsa kaḥ/ /s+thā rastu ba da pā ra bā ri bi ra sa byā sā pā mthu yi (khyade nyid su yis 'u rig /rin chen 'byung gnas rang ྅rgyas pha rol med pa de srid chu yis ra he khā ba khāta kakhro khā ba lī yo ghi hūṃ ba ra ta yā rat+na ka raḥkhru ya te/ /dkrigs gyur cing / /byed po'i bde blag stobs las rba rlabs 'phreng blubs mkha' la 'god pa nyid du thos//gasnyi raḥpu na ra pra me ya ma hi mā ko pi pra bhā baḥs hūṃ yasmin bisma ya dh+wam+bi tsin+ta dam pa rnams kyi mthu ni chen po'i bdag nyid gzhal med ci yang zab pa ste/ /ya mtshan gnas gang bsam na bi dh+wa bi ṅgā badhe sla badhe bye yaḥ/ /ta ta1d+dhā ma ṇi labha ni dza sāze na pa'i cho ga dag la blo ni mtha' ru rgyal bar byed/ /de nas yid bzhin nor thob ste/ /rang gi don mthun sa ga taḥ/ /rā dza sru nuḥsru na ga ra pā ba pūṇ+ḍi ma no ra thaḥ/ /kṛ ta kṛ t+ya dang 'grogs nas/ /re ba rdzogs pa rgyal po'i bu/ /rlung gis grong khyer dag tu phyin/ /rab tu mgu ba'i praṣ+ṭadhe na sa pi tā ta tra sgo dzi taḥ/ /dh+wa dzā gre rat+na mā jo ya dza gā da dza pha yis der/ /mchod sbyin kyebya ba byas pa des/ /rgyal mtshan rtse la rin chen btags/ /skye bo'i mdun na saṃ sa di/ /pa rārja e ba yasne yo nād+māthor+ya di rnge kwa tsat+pa/ /sar rab smras pa/ /gal te 'gar yang bdag 'bad 'di/ /gzhan don kho na bdag don min/ /95—551

te na pa bye na lo ke yo sadz+re yā twa da ri dra tram̐/ /i h+phuste sa twa ni bden pa de yis 'jig rten 'di/ /thams cad dbul med nyid gyur cig /dman la brtse ldan snying dha nā te na dī da ya lu nā/ /rat+na dṛ ṣ+ṭa ra pa r+yan tā ni pa pā ta stobs kyishā/ /gter des de skad brjod pa na/ /rin chen char pa mtha' med ni/ /sa gzhi dag la ma tī ta le/ /te na rat+na sa mū te ṣ+pe dikyu sazla su bhā swa tā/ /ya yo babs 2par gyur/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rin chen tshogs/ /'od dang ldan pa de yis ni/ /skye bo dza na su dā ri dh+ya ma yi niḥshe ṣa ṭ+wā ta maḥ/ /ā shā pa sha ba ྅ ba khāh+phu dbul ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /myun pa lhag med nyid du gyur/ /re ba'i zhags ldan stobs kyis dpal ldan be+e sha tā bā dh+yā ga rde shrī ma tsā dāḥs+thā ghā ta ba tī mu hurbi tsa lā tsā dā ro rnams kyi khang mdun phyi rol dag tu 'jug /sgo bas brdegs 1ldan yang yang rnam par g.yo zhing sgo yi da re sī da hūṃ / /dīsgo niḥshwa sa hūṃ shu tsā ni pa ta hūṃ de ha k+ṣa yaḥkhongs su/ nyen gyur la/ /shugs rings dang ldan mya ngan dag gis 'gyel zhing lus ni 'jig pa ④/'dod hūṃ k+ṣa tā dī nā ram̐ ma ṇi rā shi rasmi sha ra laḥshrī saṃ ga maḥko su bhūta/ /tatshwa gyur pa/ /bkren pa rnams la nor bu'i phung po 'od zer drang po'i dpal tshogs ci yang byung / /'jig sa nā du ra ga nā ya ka me ba yā te tsid+dhā ma ṇi bi ga ta de n+ya di rten phongs pa'i thunyin dang bral zhing yid bzhin nor bu yang / /de yi bka' las lto 'phye'i 'dren pa nyid ṣ+pe tsa lo ka /san+d+ra tra dā na ra si ka su dza na gya tse taḥsabyebe+e sābe+e bi ra du gyur pa'i tshe/ /kun tu sbyin pa la zhen skye bo dag gi sems rnams ni/ /slong ba'i don mthun kun dang tā ku li tsā ba bhū ba/ /sad+dhārja sidzhaḥk+ṣi ti pā la su nurlo bhū ta me+e bā ha mi hā bral bas 'khrugs pa nyid du gyur/ /don kun grub pa 6sa skyong sras por ni/ /gang gyur de nyid nga yin n+ya de haḥ/ /khru two ti z-itrī ka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na te bhik+ṣa bstad+ma ya tā ma lus gzhan 'dir/ /zhes pa'i sngon byung rgyal bas gsungs thos nas/ /dge slong de dag de nyid sems 95—552

bā suḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe min+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam la tā dze+e sad+dhārja sid+dhā ba dā na maṣ+ṭha tsa tā ri shaḥpal+la waḥ// //gyi 'khri shing las don kun grub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //maste bha rku sgostso ku tsā bhi ra māḥkaspru ra hā dzā shu bi lā sā hā sāḥ/ /spru nu ma mngon dga' glang chen myos bum mtho/ /ga pur do shal 'od zer ༄1rtse dga' dgod/ /dar nyi pra dāḥpu rgya kṛ hūṃ bha brnyi thra dh+wa yu ba r+ya: bi byu ta ya:/ /ta thā la babs 3 pa'i na chung 'byor pa yang / /bsod nams byas pa rnams la dga' ster yin/ /de bzhin ga te bha ga ba ti shā ba hūṃ ba na tsā ri ṇi/ /a bha bah+phu pra bud+dhā khyuḥgashegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /mnyan yod nags na rgyu ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khyim gyi bdag po sngon//shrī mān kṛ ha pa nyiḥpu rā/ /ba byu ba hasta ko nā ma ta t+yā ti da yi ta su taḥ/ /pūd+dhārdzi legs par rab sad ces pa byung / /shin tu sdug pa de yi bu/ /glang po can zhes bya bar gyur/ /sngon tā dzā pū rgya nā sā kā ra i ba pañtsa yaḥ/ / ta gya dzad+ma di ṣ+pe dzā tabya bsgrubs bsod nams dag gi tshogs/ /rnam pa dag dang bcas pa bzhin/ /de ni skyes pa'i nyin par la//mi ka ra ma yo ma hān/ /e shī bhū da i bātsor+ya pra dzaḥpra ba ra kuñdza rab mchog glang po chen bo nisnye/ /gser gyi rang bzhin skyes gyur te/ /ngo mtshar tshogs ni gcig gyur raḥ / /sa ga dzen+d+raḥku mā rabya tat+pa tubya ma no ra thaḥ/ /lo ka kau tu ka kobya bzhin—/ /glang dbang de dang gzhon nu dang / /de yi pha yis ngare ba dang / /'jig rten ltad mo mdzod shā puṇ+ḍi hūṃ tu l+ya ma ya yuḥ/ /sa sha shī ba shi shu kā lā ka lā ni la ya tā rnams kyang / /mtshungs pa nyid du gang bar gyur/ /ri bong can bzhin byis pa de/ /dus la sgyu rtsal cha se ga taḥ/ /ru tsu tse ru tsi mān sadrwa lo ka lo tsa na bān+dha baḥ/ /sa sha ṣ+peḥpū gnas gyur/ /'jig rten kun byi mig gi gnyen/ /'od zer ldan zhing rab tu mdzes/ /dal gyis de ni 95—553

ri tā sgo ga bhū dzastam+bha bi bhū ṣa khaṃ/ /le bhe ma no bha bā ra bha bha ba rna kho lag rdzogs/ /dpung ba'i ka bas rnam par brgyan/ /yid las byung ba rtsom pa'i gnas/ /lang tsho na ba yo ba dz+wa/ /ka dā tsi da tha bhū bakhyoḥs pra se na dzi taḥsu tī/ /ta nu tsi gsar pa thob par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig de yis ni/ /sa yi bdag po gsal rgyal gyi/ /bu mo lus ba ra tsi sno na sa ha dze na be+e rā dzi tī/ /ka t+yā ṭī ba ra ka t+yā khye lā ba rgya ni 17chos gos kyi/ /rtags dang lhan skyes blurnam mdzes ma/ /chos gos bu mo zhes bya ba/ /mdzes shing la li tā na dzā/ /u byā na dar+sha nā yā tsā da dasgye ya ta lo tsa nā/ /a yid 'ong bzhin ras can/ /mig yangs gzhon nu ma dag ni/ /skyed tshal lta ru 'ong ba mthong / /nyams kliṣ+ṭa rū pa mā lokya tā ma ya parlu ṣita t+yā to/ /bisma yasma ra yostu khye sa pa med pa'i gzugs ldan zhing / /mdzes pa 7mi dman de mthong nas/ /da kruni 'phral la ya mtshan dang //ya yo sa ha sā ba shaṃ/ /so tsin+ta yata a ho kān+ta mi rda na t+yadhū tai 'dod pa'i dbang du mnyam par gyur/ /des ⑤bsams kye ma lus 'di ni/ /shin tu rmad byung mdzes ba pūḥ/ /ya smid+dhā ti mu kha byā dzā da do ṣa bi sha daḥsha shrī/ /lā ba 5 ma prati pa ste/ /skyon bral dri med ri bong can/ /gang du bzhin gyi zol gyis mdzes/ /gzugs can mchu ni brtse ma me ṣa be+e bhar+bhe taṣ+ṭha ba n+tu ka ba n+tu ra dha ro ma dhu ra swa bhā baḥ/ /ka gnyen yid 'ong rang bzhin can/ /'di ni do zla med pa'i mdzes sdug rnam par 'dzin byed cing //dro ho r+ya ta ཿ sa ra sa bi dru ma pabe+e bā rmā bi dza pra bhā pra sa bha bi rlan ldan byu ru'i yal 'dab dag la 'khu bar brtson pa dang / /bim pa'i 'od kyis ༄ 'urnam 'phrul dag ni bh+ra ma ban+d+ra kā raḥ/ /brja na k+ṣa ma te ma rda sha sha z-i taḥklishā ti kārnyiḥsu 'phral la 'bras med byed/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyags pa bzhin gyi skumi bzod mdzes pas bdud rtsi dman dh+wa muh+phu khrot+pa la kā na na su ku ru te dṛṣ+ṭaḥ pra bhā bhaṭ+wā rgo/ /ma bye byed cing / /ut+pal rab tu rgyas pa'i nags tshal 'od ni mig gis rab tu nyams par byed/ /yid srubs 95—554

mad+ma tha saṃ ga mo tse ta ta noḥsā saje dī ti pra dā lbo khā gyaḥs ha sā bi 'grogs 'os lus can 'di yi 'jo sgog 'gran zla dag la 'jigs ster bas(1/ /dga' ma'i 'asnarol rtsed rba ( 1lā sa la ha rī sho ṣe bi dhaste ra teḥ/ /uzlo te ka ṣ+ṭha ṇi sa yo dha ra yu ge na rlabs dag ni 'phral la nyid du skems par byed dam snyam/ /kye ma gang gi 'o ma 'dzin pa zung ni rab tu dzu sh+yadri be ke tsa ram̐ ya snga do ṣa ma ye su ho gu ṇa bā tā hā re ṇa ba sgye sra mkhregs dben pa nyams/ /skyon gyi rang bzhin yin yang yon tan ldan pa'i do shal dag gis gnas spru tiḥ/ /a susmin+da ba la ba te3m+bu dza bye yā ro lalba re khā mu khe lo lā gh+raḥpar byas/ /bzhin 'di la yang bung ba'i 'phring 'arnams chu skyes blo yis nye bar brtan 67pa dang / /g.yo ki ma pi pra shārnyi na ya rna lī rna mu byā nād+ma naḥ/ /i ti tsin+ta ya tasta ldan mig gi 'dren byed thub pa'i yid kyang ci yang chags shing nyams par byed/ /de ltar sems pa de yi gya ba puḥput+pa sha ro pa oṃ/ /bi lokya byu pa nyi su tā ba bhū bābyar+ya nistsa lus—/ /me tog mda' can lta bu dag /mthong nas sa bdag bu mo ni/ /ngo mtshar g.yo ba med par khā / /dṛ te lar+ghaṃ shu ke na suḥsma re ṇa smi takā ri tā/ /pra t+ya gra pu la kā tīrte gyur—/ /dran pa 'dzum par byed pa yis/ /de yi ngo tsha'i gos phrogs te/ /gsar du spu long rgyas pa yis//ba puḥspa ṣ+ṭa na dṛ sh+ya ta / /rud+dhā na bā bye lā ṣe ṇa be+e lagh+ra ṇa ni lus ni gsal bar mthong ma gyur/ /mngon 'dod gsar pas bkag gyur kyang / /skyengs pa yis ni phyir baṭī ta/ /ma nasta tre ba ni k+ṣi pya sā shu bye pa sha ṣ+per+ya yo/ /rā dza dha dī sa mā bzlog ste/ /yid ni de nyid la bzhag nas/ /de ni stong bzhin dal gyis song / /rgyal po'i pho brang phyin sa r+ya ladz+dza bisma ya mad+ma dze+eḥ/ /m+bi li te ba ni lbo ṣ+pe ba pa pra ṣi te ba gyur nas/ /ngo tsha ya mtshan yid srubs kyis/ /zum pa bzhin dang zhum pa bzhin/ /bcom pa bzhin du byu ba sā/ /ku mā ro be+e swa bha ba ṣ+pe sa murtsu ta ma no bha ba/ /tā me ben+d+ra mu khā+e de gyur to/ /gzhon nu yang ni rang khyim du/ /yid las byung ba yang dag rgyas/ /mdun du zla bzhin ma 95—555

ma gre saṃ kadze+e ra li kharlu huḥ/ /sa tā mā na sa bhadz+re sri sma ra be+e t+yā mi de nyid/ /kun tu rtog thu pas yang yang drisari / /de yis yid kyi nor mchog de/ /'dod pa'i rig pa ba sma ran / / pra da rmyo durla sgosma tā ta na yī tsakra ba tī naḥ / /bzhin dran cing 1/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bu mo nirngu / /rnyed par dka' bas ⑤shes nas bsams//dzad+mān+ta re ta nur+ya gya ta paḥpa ri tsi tā tsi ram̐/ /dha n+yaḥs tā ma bā sno skye ba gzhan la gang gi lus/ /yun ring dka' thub yongs 'dris pa/ /skal ldan de yis snesnalegs byas ti la tsā su kṛ ta shā khā+e naḥ/ /ra mya pra dā na pu bye na tardor+sha na ma kyis—/ /shing gi 'khri shing de thob (7'gyur/ /dga' ba rab sbyin bsod nams kyis/ /de mthong ba ni bā su te/ /na dzā ṣ+pe tā ni pu rgyu ni ye ྾ ta྾ ga maḥpha lo/ /tad+magh+ra thob gyur te/ /gang zhig de 'grogs 'bras ldan pa'i/ /bsod nams de dag yongs rmye mi shes/ /de yi shī ta ki ra ṇa sma ra ḍo t+pa be na ta snga byu du rla bha ta yā bzhin ras bsel ba'i zer ldan dran pas dga' ba dang / /de yang rnyed dka' nyid kyis 'bral ba'i bi ra hoṣ+ṭha rja me/ /no be+ed+me ki j-i ti ri yo ki ma yi bi mo hoḥki dzī bi tai gdung ba dag gi bdag /brtan pa 'di ci rmongs 'di ci zhig 'tsho ba nyid phyo ni ci/ /srog dang lhan ki ma su bhiḥs ha bi pra yo gaḥ/ / tad+magh+rastsa dzi taḥpra sa hra bha dza te k+ṣe cig rnam par bral 6lam ci yin yongs mi shes/ /de gdong chu skyes dag gis 'phral la bcom pas mtshan bye k+ṣa pā babe+e bhā gya byu be+e bh+ra ma lalja ti tsa bi na ti paste dha nu smrad+ma mo'i yid 'ong nyams pa bsten/ /de yi /nyasmin ma'i rnam 'phrul dag la ngo tsha yid srubs gzhu ni gug thu par thi / / ta gyaḥ pa be+e ba se sha li byu ti mu ṣā sho shā dha re shādi te gyur—/ /yid 'ong yal 'dab mdangs 'phrog shā1de yi mchu sgros dmar ba dag gis gzir gyur te//nu rna pā pya bi rak+ta tī ba na ma ṭī bim+bi sa mā laspa te/ /i nyi pūrten+d+ra ba da nā chags bral nyid thob bisbra dag ni nags kyi sa la yang dag brten 1stanam snyam/ /de ltar zla nya'i bzhin ras 95—556

ba da na dh+yā na ni : la ཿ / / ni shī n+da nā ya saṃ t+ya k+ta ཿ se dh+ya can—/ /bzhin la bsam gtan g.yo med kyis/ /gnyid kyis phrag dog can gyis bzhin/ /gtang stiye ba na ni dra yā/ /ka t+yā dar+sha na thraṭ+wārnye ta taste na ni be+e di tai/ /khru ba de yis mtshan mo 'das/ /mdzes ma mthong bar gyur pa'i mtha'/ /de ni de yis bshad pa dag /pha tā pi byu gya saṃ krān+ta tsin+t+ra pa ri tsi to3 bha bta/ /sa ta mu tsa ba yo pu tra rā yis thos nas de yis ni/ /bsam pa 'phos shing yongs 'dris gyur/ /de la de smras bdag cag bu//rnyo pya pu ra bā si naḥ/ /sa ka dze+e he du hi ta ram̐ tsakra brti pra dā gya ti/ /rgyal po'i grong khyer gnas pa'ang min/ /'khor los sgyur de bu mo ni/ /khyod la ji ltar ster bar 'gyur//ā shākyi nai ba kut+thadhi sa m+bi hadhe na durlu sgo/ /a saṃ bha bye na bhā ṣasta mā mkhas pa bkur ba 'dod pa rnams/ /mi nus pa nyid byed ma yin/ /rnyed par dka' ba 'dod ma yin//na kā mā ma be+e ṣi ṇaḥ/ /tsū ta tsadza kal+lī 6 swā dhī na pu ni rā da raḥ/ /tsin+ta mi bden pa no smra ma yin/ /'khri shing tsū 5ta tsam pa ka /rang dbang rnams la mi gus par/ /yongs yan+d+ra ri dza ta gya la hūṃ shu 6 ti ṣat+pa daḥ / / ta ba ta s+thābya sadzan+taḥ'adu'i 'khri shing sems pa na/ /rkang drug pa nyid bskam 1par 'gyur/ /gal te khyod dang de gnyis kyang //pāgyud+ma bi nyi to ya di/ /ta da ba bye bha ba h+ye ba niḥpra yat+na pha lo da yaḥ/ /skye ba snga mar 'byel bsgrubs na/ /de yi 'bras bu 'bad med du/ /nges pa kho nar rgyas par 'gyur//ā shā sā shi ra nā kṛṣ+ṭi be+e tsā ri ra ka habe+e tai/ /pra yāt+na bha ri ra shārnya re ba'i zhags pas ma bkug cing / /rtog dpyod dag gis ma gzir la/ /'bad pa'i khur gyis ma ngal bi dhaste bha be+e ta bya tā / / i t+yā ka sbya pi tur+pā kyi ta t+ta the ti bi bar—/ /nges par myong bya grub pa nyid/ /ces ④pa pha yi tshig thos nas/ /de de bzhin zhes rnam tsin+ta yan/ /na tse taḥkān+ta kā nī tai pra t+yāde nyu sha shā ka saḥ/ /sa ga bsams te/ /sems ni mdzes mas bzung (4ba dag /be+er yang zlog pa snedes ma nus/ /de song 95—557

tā dan+ta yu ga lo ya yā tse he ma kuñdza ram̐/ /na ba saṃ dar+sha ṣ+pe rā dzñāḥdī ti yo gser gye glang po la/ /rgyal la gser nyudu phrad pa yis/ /dga' bar 'os phrad skyes su ni/ /gser gye gya mu pā ya ā+oṃ/ /puju babye na ka ri rja dar+ghaṃ dan+ta yu shaṃ ta taḥ/ /mche ba zung dag blangs/ /de nas lag ldan bsod nams kyis/ /mdza' bas byin pa'i mche ba zung //sa he ma ma ya mā dā ya drabye byu mi pa ti ya yo/ /sa rat+na ru tsi re pā gya gser gyi rang bzhin khyer nas de/ /sa yi bdag po lta ru song / /de yis rin chen gyis mdzes pa'i//bha ba ā+oṃ thra thi bī pa te/ /pra bi sh+ya pra ṇa taḥdī h+ye he man+dan+ta dwa yo sa yi bdag po'i khang par phyin/ /nang zhugs rab btud mdza' ba'i slad/ /gser gyi nyamache ba gnyis da do/ /byu bhu dza bi khru ta gu ṇaḥpra sā de nā bhi nan+di taḥ/ /ba ram̐ kṛ hā ṇi po byin/ /rgyal po rab tu dang ba yis/ /yon tan gyis grags dga' bar byas/ /mchog ni long zhes kyuk+ta bya sa na dza grwa ha kiñtsa na/ / ta su de n+ya byubya kre mā na ma bh+ya brjod gyur kyang / /de yis ci yang blangs ma gyur/ /mdzes pa dman min de la ni/ /rgyal pos lhag bye shaṃ dṛ paḥ/ /au tsi t+ya tsā ru tsa ri taḥpri yaḥka su na ni smṛ haḥ/ /sa sa par bkur ba byas/ /rigs shing mdzes pa'i spyod zhupa can/ /chags pa med la su mi dga'/ /rtag tu dā dar+sha ṣ+pe rā dzhaḥkañtsa dzā gā ni darnyi rgo/ /pu nardza ta na r+pā ge na daṭ+wā ni rgyal la phrad tshe des/ /gsar du so ldan la skyes pa/ /gser gyi rang bzhin mche ba rnams/ /dga' ba'i pri ta ye da do/ /ta mu ba tsa ma tī pā laḥse ba pra ṇa ya yadh+ri taḥ/ /dru be+ed du rab tu byinace/ /yid rab dang ba'i pho nya ni/ /bzhin ras mdzes pa 'dzin byed cing / /bsten tī sma naḥ pra sā da gya ba da na byu ti mut+pa ha na/ / pra byu ta he ma pa'i mdza' gcugs (ltekyis bsdams pa'i/ /sa skyong gis ni de la smras/ /rab mang gser tshogs barming /4)saṃ bhā rā gum+bi se bā m+bi mā ma haṃ/ /na sa he po ra brge hi bha ra bhā ba yis/ /bsten 'di bdag gis yongs pemi bzod/ /gang phyir grong khyer ba yi tshogs/ /sa bdag 95—558

yo ma tī bye tsā/ /saṃ be+e bha bye dza nā bhā taiḥkā spru tizla ma kāñtsa ṣ+peḥ/ /te rnams kyi ①rgyas bya nyid/ /skye bos bgos skal phul ba yisakhye/ /gser gyi dga' ba bdag la ci/ /rin ba nar+gha gu rja mūsne ri ya me ba ma ma bri yā/ /lo bhaḥpu ru ṣa rasne 6 chen yon tan khyod kyi ni/ /gzugs 'di nyid la bdag dga'o/ /gser dang rin chen rdo ba'i tshogs//byu ṣa rjarte pra sho bha te/ /rā dhī ko she 6 sī darnyi he ma rat+nathra pañtsa yāḥ/ /mdzod rnams na gnas rgyal po ni/ /rgyan du 'os pa'i skyes bu dag /rin chen rnams la chags na mdzes//sa m+bi hi ta ta oṃ tu bye ki pra yatshwa mi ka bya hūṃ/ /niḥshe ṣa ko ṣa dā ṣ+pe pi na khyod la 'dod pa'i mchog dag ni/ /bdag gis ci sbyin smra bar mdzod/ /ma lus mdzod ni byin gyur kyang //nā mā nu sha yostu me/ /rā dzñā treka pū ta mā tre ṇa pā gyadhe ya di na shri nges par bdag ni 'gyod mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i spyan zur lhung tsam gyis/ /gal te dpal 'byor ma thob yaḥ—/ /ta da nadze+e ga tābe+e t+yā korjaḥpābe+e ba gye ba yā/ /i truk+taḥk+ṣi ti pā na—/ /don gnyer don med nyid gyur pas/ /sa bdag bsten pa'i don ni ci/ /de skad sa skyong gis le na ku mā raḥka li tsā dza liḥ/ /ta ma bhā ṣa ta bhū pa la dā tu marta ti ko pa smras tshe/ /gzhon nus thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /de la smras pa sa skyong dgakhye/ /ster bar 'os pa gzhan pa raḥ—/ /a nabe+e te na rat+na ni bi bu dhe bh+yaḥpra yats+tsha tā/ /ta dun+di dro saṃ mu dra su—/ /mkhas pa rnams la rin chen ni/ /don du ma gnyer stsol mdzad pa/ /khyod kyi rgya mtsho'i grags pa khru mu dri tai bha ba tā ya shaḥ/ /ma hā tā pi pra dā ṣ+pe na srur+ya te na ma hā sha ya//ni—/ /rab rgyas de dag rgya yis btab/ /rab tu sbyin pa chen pos kyang / /re ba chen po khengs ma yin//alpa kā dzā la de shwazlo dā ri bye tad+ma tī ya sī/ /ki tu twata bhu dza gubhā dzā chung ngu rnams kyi ④dbang phyug gang / /de ni chen po'i dbul po nyid/ /'on kyang gang gis nor slong ba//dhadz+re mārge rde dz+re ba tsā/ /dza nā dzā naste dā ri dro dra bi rde ye na mṛ gya te/ /khyod kyi dpung pas bsrungs gyur cing / /chos kyi lam gyis snye 'tsho ba yi/ /skye bo rnams la dbul po med//95byed559

dha nābe+e ṣ+pe na tu ba yo na tsa se bā pi kā ri ṇaḥ/ /dha narnya nan+dha na bye yo mā bdag kyang nor don gnyer ba min/ /sten par byed pa po yang min/ /nor ldan rnams la nor nyid nor//na e ba mā nam+bi dzā/ /mi laṅga ṇi na pa ra me shwa ra se ba ṣ+pe na nin+d+ra khengs ldan rnams la bkur ba nyid/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug bsten pas yon tan dag ni zum gyur pas//l+ya hūṃ su ma na sī sa ha sā ga tā ram̐/ /de n+yah+phu naḥkṛ pa ṇa pa rgya ba dze dam pa'i me tog rnams ni 'phral la rnying pa nyid gyur cing / /slar yang bkren pa'i tshong gi lam du dman sgro tā rmā na spar+sha mā tra ma pi sā dhu dza naḥka ro ti/ /abe+e tāt+pa ra zla pas thong gyur la/ /dam pa'i skye bo rnams ni reg pa tsam yang mi mdzad rmyedo/ /dman zhing smad pa'i ba re ta nu j-i hūṃ de t+yā ba san+d+ra t+pa nā mabe+e sadze+e dza nā ba mā na ba bdag nyid lus 'dzin rnams kyis lathuslong ba nyid pas shi ba mchog /slong ba mchog tu bkur ste 'os pa skye sa tiḥsaṭ+wā ra yo gyaḥsha baḥ/ /rku bhās+thā ba da dhaḥpra yā ti gu ṇa bāṅgha sā ba bo kun gyis smad pa dag gi ṅkuganas/ /ji srid don gnyer nyid thob rmongs pa'i mun par dbang med tā re pa ram̐ yā ba ta mo ha ta maḥ pra be sha bi ba shaḥpāstobe+e tā lasba 'jug cing 'bab byed pa/ /de srid yon tan ldan pa'i /thubum pa khron par 'jug las mchog tu thur du te / /sā mā t+yā dha na sadza daḥgra ya kṛ ṣi pra pyaḥs dā dhī ma hūṃ sarnyo 'gro—/ /phun tshogs thun mong nor ni zhing las tshong la rtag tu blo ldan rnams kyis 'thob/ /gal te chog sngo ya di nāsnyi taṅgim pa rā bhū mirje d+dhā nā thra tā/ /saṃ byu bā ti sha ya pra sā da shes med na gzhan pa ci zhig sa la gter rnams rgyas pa dang / /phul byung rab dang gser dang dngul gyi ti ra sāstu stu ra te ma kṛ yāḥka phyeṣ+ṭa pri ya saṃ ga mā ya ba pu ྾ se bā ma yo bi kra bya ba de dag yod pa nyid/ /dga' dang 'grogs pa'i sbad du lus ni g.yog gi rang bzhin du 'tsho thusu zhig yaḥ / /i t+ya pa ra bye yasta gya ba tsaḥkhru tā matī pa tiḥ/ /kṛ khya tā ma 'dod—/ /ces pa blo gros dzisnagazhan de yis/ /tshig thos nas ni sa yi bdag /gus dang bcas pas 95byed560
