pa ram̐ kiñtsi di t+ya bhā ṣa ta sā da raḥ/ /au tsi t+ya tsa tu rā lā saḥkarka sho pi gzhan pa ni/ /cung zad blang bar mdzod ces smras/ /rigs shing brjod pa mkhas pa yi/ /rtsub mo la dṛ rde thra yaḥ/ /kṛ pa ṇa shaṣ+ṭa ka ro pi kaṇ+ḍi shu lnga ya ko ma laḥ/ /au dār+ya yang mi rnams dga'/ /bkren pa rnams kyis ngo bstod tshoni/ /'jam yang rna ba na ba'i rgyu/ /rgya cher pa ri tuṣ+ṭi na sa rā snyo s+t+yabe+e taḥpa ram̐/ /ta mū tse ya di tusgo si pu tā yongs su tshims ④pa yi/ /rgyal pos mchog tu gsol ba btab 0/ /de la smras pa gal te khyod/ /sim ma hūṃ pra dī ya tām/ /i truste te na dṛ ba tiḥsan+de hāsdo li tā ya shaḥ/ /pra na bu mo bdag la stsol/ /des de brjod tshe mi bdag ni/ /bsam pa the tshom 'phyang mor gyur/ /nang tazlaghā ha mi kyughā k+ṣa r+ṇa smra ta la mo k+ṣu te/ /sa ku mā ra be+e thra dzñā tha pā par bdag smras 5zhes smras nas/ /skad cig sa gzhi dag la bltas/ /de nas gzhon nu btang nas des//dh+wa nā mā t+ya ma pra r+pāt+pa/ /pra sā da ra bha se ṣ+pe ba kṛ hūṃ kāka tsā pa lo ma yā/ /blon po'i gtso bo la smras pa/ /rab dang gzu lums dag 37gis ni/ /bya rog bzhin du g.yo ba byas//tsakra babe+e ku lot+pan+d+ra ka t+yā pu sgo pa rto tsi tā / / ka dze+e sa mā n+ya sau 'khor los ⑫/sgyur ba'i rigs 'khrungs pa'i/ /bu mo bsod nams zod la 'os/ /grong pa thun mong pa la rā ya gu ṇa mā tre ṇa dī ya te/ /da dā m+bi ti pra ti shu t+ya pa: da nu sha ni—/ /yon tan tsam gyis ji ltar sbyin/ /sbyin no zhes ni rab bsgrags nas/ /rjes su 'gyod pas yā ku laḥ/ /ka dze+e sa t+ya dha no bhū tā bha bi byā myabe+e niphe laḥ/ /shaṃ gzir gyur pa'i/ /bden nor ldan par gyur pa bdag /spong ba 'bras med ji ltar 'gyur/ /nong blu dze+e pāp+ta gya ta snga haṃ pā ta j-i ṭī mu ṣa pu raḥ/ /thra yo su thra ya tā par mdun du de 'ongs pa'i/ /bzhin ni bdag gis ji ltar lta/ /bdag la 2rnyed dka' des basbangs yā ta ཿ sā ma du rla bha yās+tha yā/ / byu na gu rto pa sa rjo pi pra kṛ nas—/ /mdza' yang mdza' min nyid du gyur(ge/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis lus can rnams/ /nges par 95—561

h+ye ba sha rī ri rde/ /bat+ta yā ban+da de hi ti tā badzha ba ti bal+la bhaḥ/ /yon tan yongs rdzogs kyang / /ji srid bslang zhes ma brjod par skye/ /de srid snying du sdug pa yin//i ti khyu pa tiḥkhru twa ba tso do la ba lam+bi naḥ/ /ta mu bā tsa ma hā zhes pa khye/sa bdag khyogs la ni/ /nges par bstan chapa'i tshig thos nas/ /blon po chen pos gnas mā t+yaḥsaṃ tsidh+yā ba sa ro tsi tai/ /a nā lo tsi ta par+yan+taḥpra t+ya gra sa ra skabs su/ /'os pa bsams nas de la smras/ /rje bo dag gi blo gros rnams/ /bgros pa min pa'i ④sā da rāḥ/ /swa bhā ba ra bha swa e ba bha badhi pra bhu budha yā/ /a mthar thug cing / /gsar du chags ldan gus pa dang / /rang bzhin gzu lums ldan pa yis⑤/ /sred shakyārja na yā te na lubye ṣ+pe ba gu rdo da yaḥ/ /rā dza se ba pra dṛste na ldan mi nus don gnyer bas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas bzhin du ni/ /rgyal po'i g.yog la rab zhugs des//he ma has+t+ri bi nā shi taḥ/ /bā tsu sau bha ba tā swe ram̐ ka t+yās+thā pu na rā ga taḥ/ /gser gyi glang chen rnam par bcom/ /bu mo slong ba slar 'ongs tshe/ /khyod kyis ⑥dal bus 'di brjod bya//he ma haste na mā ru khya pābe+eḥpāsbya si me su tai/ /te nota kṛt+taḥswa haste na gser glang zhon te 'ongs pa na/ /bdag gi bu mo thob par 'gyur/ /de yi ⑦rang lag gis bsad nas//ku tasta gya sa kuñdza riḥ/ /na tsā sau tabyi ra hi taḥpu na rā yā ti ladz+dza yā/ /i t+ya de la glang po ga la yod/ /de dang bral ba'i ngo tsha yis/ /be+er yang khye'ong bar ⑨mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa mā t+ya gya ba tsa sā dṛ pa tirlut+ta mā shri taḥ/ /pāste ku mā ra ma bye drusta blon po'i tshig gis ni/ /nyin gzhan gzhon nu 'ongs pa la/ /lugs la brten pa'i mi bdag gis//de bā bhi mu kho ba dat+pa/ /ku mā ro bi kṛ ha ga tā bi bā ho tsi ta oṃ ga leḥ/ /mngon du phyogs te de nyid smras/ /gzhon nu yang ni khyim song nas/ /bag ma len 'os lhobye bkra shis kyis//hai ma dri ra da mā ru hra swadza ṣ+pe na sa hā ya yo/ /swaṇ+ḍi bā ra ṇa dru gser gyi so gnyis la zhon te/ /rang gi mi dang lhan cig 'ongs/ /gser byi glang chen la zhon nas//95—562

ṭ+wān+ta mā yan+ti ma tī ba tiḥ/ /bi lokyābyar+ya bi bha ba me ṣ+pe pu rgya ba hūṃ ba 'ong ba de ni sa bdag gis/ /mthong nas ngo mtshar 'byor pa can/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mchog tu ram̐ / /kau tu kā da tha bhū sa laste ga dze+e he ma be+e gra haṃ/ /ā du ro ha ma hod+mā shes—/ /de nas rgyal pos dge mtshan las/ /glang po gser lus can de lashe/ /spro ba chen pos lhun po khyaḥsu me ru mi ba badz+ra bh+rita/ /ā dru bye thra thi bī pā le na tsa tsā la sa kuñdza raḥ/ /la—/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhin du zhon/ /sa skyong gis ni zhon pa'i tshe/ /glang po de ni mi g.yo zhing //pra sa saza ku mā re ṇa pu nartswa lo kṛ tā sa naḥ/ /tasma tā dṛ pa ti re stan 6)ni gzhon nus brgyan pa'i tshe/ /slar yang rab tu g.yo bar gyurage/ /mi bdag gis de ltar shes baṃ tat+tha bhā be+e na be+e smi taḥ/ / dha byosmre ti ba daṅka dh+yā da do tasmi sma shing / /de yi mthu yis ya mtshan pas/ /bdag ni rīskal bzang zhes brjod cing / /bu mo 'dod dpal ra shri yi/ /a bh+yabyo ka t+yā rasne na dṛ pa tiḥpu ru ṣet+ta oṃ/ /hastsot+pa ba sa muju de la byin⑪/ /rin chen bu mos skyes bu mchog /ma nor mchod nas mi yi bdag /spro dga' yang dag taḥsu dh+wa sin dhu ri bā ba sgo/ / ta taḥ ku mā ra da yi tā mā dā ya rgyas gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas gzhon nus mdzes ma ni/ /blangs nas swa kṛ haṃ ga te/ /sa pha lo byu da rgo ga gya kārmu ka kar+ṣa ṇa shra maḥ/ /na be+e rang gi khyim song ste/ /lus med gzhu ni drangs pa yisathu/ /ngal ba 'bras bu yod par gyurarngu/ /lang tsho ba ya saṃ sgo gārte na ba kān+t+ra sa mā ga mo/ / ta sā bhūbe+e bha bo dā raḥgasar pa longs spyod 'os/ /mdzes ma gsar pa shedang 'grogs te/ /'byor pa rgya ches rtag tu des spu//sa dā na ba na bakhro baḥ/ /ta taḥka dā dzibyu bā khāḥkṛ ta kṛ t+yaḥpra se na dzita/ /gsar pa gsar pa dga' bar 'gyur/ /de nas nam zhig sa skyong ni/ /bya ba byas pa gsal rgyal gyis//pu rgya pra bhā baṃ dzā mā tuḥka la yad+ma ma tsin+ta yata/ /a ho di byaḥpra byā bo sau bsod nams mthu ldan mag pa dag /yid la gcags nyu shing rab bsams pa/ /kye ma lha yi mthu 'di ni//95byed563

taḥshā ri pu tro yi taji dze tā ta dā su bhu ta/ /mo gal ḍaltakyi bu nyid gyur/ /bris pa shā ri'i bu 'di ste/ /de las de'i ⑥tshe'ang rgyal bar gyur/ /sasba zlo ṣ+pe ti ka thi te bṛ hūṃ te pāk+ta ṣ+pe ta yoḥ/ /tata kan+d+ra tain+t+ra be+e tsi bye de dag gi ni sngon byung mtha'/ /'di ni kun mkhyen gyis gsungs tshe/ /las kyi rgyud ni bkra ba de/ /sa pran+d+rarmu na yaḥpu naḥ/ /bha ga ban kan+d+ra rde ke ṣā mabye to yo pha loṅga slar yang thub pa rnams kyis dris/ /bcom ldan las ni gang dag gis/ /'bras bu rmad byung 'byung ba maḥ / /ta ba dzñā na ma ya snga pi ye na saṃ smṛ sha te ba suḥ/ /pā dzā guṣ+ṭhaḥ'adi—/ /ye shes rang bzhin khyod kyi yang / /lus la gang gis reg par gyur/ /rdo ba'i ⑦zer mas ke taḥkas+thāta ta ba sā ṣā ṇa dh+wa ra yā/ /bidha kha di ra shu tsā yo sa bra khyod zhabs kyi/ /mthe bong snad pa ci yis 7snad/ /seng ldeng thur mas zhabs phug nas/ /rma dang ṇabyu ra ṇabya ki/ /shu n+ya pā traḥki ma pā su bhik+ṣu ma byā ga to bha bān/ /bcas pa 'di ni ci/ /bsod snyoms ma thob lhung bzed ni/ /stong par ding khyod la smad 67ci/ /mi byā k+ṣisto pi pun+dar+yā ki pra drwa dzi ka yā ta yā/ /bañtsa mā na di kā ki te sā ba mdzes ma rab byung de yis ni/ /rdzun gyis khyod la smad pa ci/ /mi bden smad dang bcas gyur pas/ /95—622

bā dā bha bārje ṣā/ /byuyāḥki ko ṭa ra ya ba be+e rabye 6 twa yā pu rā/ /bar+ṣa rte khyod la slu bar byed pa ci/ /be+e ran t+ya ru khyod kyis sngon/ /ko ṭa ra yi nas gsol ci/ /bcom ldan 'das ṣasgo ga ba taḥki ma byu cheṣ+ka ra kṛ yā/ /pra skarnyi byā bye nā smṛṣ+ṭaḥkasmra bye bha ba to ba kyis lo drug ni/ /dka' ba spyad par gyur pa ci/ /khyod kyi lus la rab gnon byi/ /nad kyis ci yi slad puḥ—/ /shi ron+ti ṛ bha bsko te tasmi na shākya ku la k+ṣa ye/ /bā yu nā thraṣ+ṭha du reg /shākya'i rigs ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyi dbu ni bsnyung gyur ci/ /ci slad khyod kyi tsho7lus khe do bhūt+pa kasmradzñā bya ta nosta/ /i ti tair+bha ga bāj-i ṣ+ṭa stu na bhā ṣa mchog la/ /rlung gis sku rgyab bsnyung bar gyur/ /de dag rnams kyis 'di dris tshe/ /bcom ldan 'dzum ta sa smi taḥ/ /khru ya tā ma na pa sbyin+da be+e tsi bye kan+d+ra san+ta tiḥ/ /bcas der gsungs pa/ /nyon cig rgyun chad med par ni/ /rnam par bkri rngu ba las kyi rgyun/ /gats+tsharnyi ga taḥ pa: ta pu rā tiṣ+ṭarnyi tiṣ+ṭha taḥ/ /sa2 bye t+yā i ba san+dad+dhāḥlus can las kyi ①'ching ba ni/ /chas zhugs g.yog po dam pa bzhin/ /'gro na phyi nas 'gro bar byed/ /kan+d+ra ban+t+raḥsha rī ri rde/ /gā hadhe ga ta nā ni dikyu bi tsa rja t+yā waṃ gha i sdod na sngon du sdod par byed/ /nags rnams dag tu ngu 'jug cing phyogs su rnam par rgyu la chu gter t+ya m+bu dhī nī ro harnyi gi rī shwa rā na bye sa re t+yā kra mya sha krā la yo/ /'god par byed/ /ri yi dbang phyug la 'jog brgya byin gnas ni kun tu mnan nas mngon par 'jug /pā tā lo pra bi shaṃ t+ya lo ka bi ṣa yo kas+thā ṇi kā lom+bi bta nāste ṣā ma ni shaṃ dza sa 'og snang ba min pa'i yul du rab 'jug las rnams dus kyi rba ⑤rlabs bzhin/ /'di dag rtag tu skye nā nu sha ra ṇi mānā ba ro dhaḥkwa tsita/ /dispyo kadz+re la tā na be+e ba sha ta tai bo'i rjes su 'jug pa'i lam ni gang na'ang 'gog pa med/ /las kyi 'khri shing ring po gsar pa nyid la byāstu pu rā ṇiḥpha leḥsābyur+yā sa ha tsā ri bhā ta nu j-i tā ta tā gya lo rtag tu 'bras khu rnying pas khyab/ /ngo mtshar dang bcas lus can lhan cig spyod cing de la'ang nges par 95—623

nistsa lā/ /yā kṛṭ+wā pa ri be+eji tā bi gha ṭi tā sngon+d+ra ṭi tā lo ṭi tā nij-iṣ+ṭa ka na shaḥgayo ba med/ /gang zhig dge ba rnams kyis bkug dang yongs su dkris dang rnam par gsal ba dang / /kṛ tā pi ku sha lenai ba pra yā tik+ṣa yo/ /kān+taḥkā ye ba ha ti ma rab bcad gcus dang nges par brdar dang phye mar byas kyang zad pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig zla ba li rna do ṣa bihūṃ ya i na duḥspyu rā kā raḥki ra ṇa dza ṭi lo yad+ma ṇi mdzes pa'i lus la skyon gyi stithig le nag po dang / /gang zhig ma rungs rnam pa'i sbrul nag nor bu 'od kṛṇ+ḍa sazlaḥ/ /nā nā rū be+eḥsha bal tsa ri tai de nyi rna dar+sha yas+t+ri se yo zer ral can 'dzin/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis bkra ba'i ④spyod pa lus can rnams la ston byed pa/ /tsi tra kra ma pa ri ṇa tā kadz+re nirmā ṇa re khā/ /a byudṛ ha pa tiḥbyuzla 'di ni bkra ba'i rim pas yongs smin las kyi 1sprul pa'i ri mo yin/ /gzhal du med pa'i nor skyed ④karba ṭi khe ba ṭā bhi dhaḥ/ /a pra me yadhe not+parnyirba hu pu tra ka la tra bān/ /cing / /bu mang chung ma dang ldan pa'i/ /khyim bdag kha ba ṭa zhes pa/ /kar pa ṭar ni sngon byung gyur/ /a bi bhak+ta dha na sta gya ju tā dwo mā tī kaḥshi shuḥ/ /mugha nā mā kṛ he ta sbo de yis mdza' bas bskyangs pa yi⑤/ /byes pa mug dha zhes bya ba/ /nor ma bgos pa'i spun zla ni/ /bāt+pa s+thārte na pā li taḥ/ /ka dā tsi— kṛ ha pa ti kā li kā nā ma babe+e bhā/ /ma mi gcig pa de khyim gnas/ /nam zhig khyim bdag de la ni/ /khyim bsam gtam gyi bar skabs su/ /u bā tsa ku ṭi khā swe ra kṛ ha tsin+ta ka thān+ta re/ /mar+ya pu tra twa yī ge he sha ra chung ma nag mo zhes bya ba/ /gya gyu can byus dal bus smras/ / rje yi 'usras po rmongs pa las/ /bag med le nā pra mā di na/ /mo hā da so da ro bhā tā bi ṣa bṛsgo bi brnyi taḥ/ /a ko drang por khyod kyi (7 ni/ /khyem du ma mi gcig pas 2stespun/ /dug gi ljon pa rnam par bskyed/ /'god se pa hu su tra snga bya yi na sta ba nirgya yaḥ/ /a bi bhagha dha nā darja bral gcig pu (khya'adi yis kyang / /'god ldan bu mang khyod kyi ⑫ni/ /bgos pa min pa'i nor dag las/ /95—624

n+ya ye ṣ+pe ṣa ha ri 6 ti/ /a su byā sgo ra be+e dha khya ba dha e bā r+ya mo ṣa khyed ①ni tshul gyis len par 'gyur/ /nad bzhin 'phel ba 'di la ni/ /gsad pa kho na sman gyi khu r+ghaṃ—/ /ben+tu ts+tsha dā dra pi dzu rde dha ṣ+pets+tsha do hi duḥs haḥ/ /ge dī mchog /gnyen ni gcod pa dag las kyang / /mi rnams nor gcod bzod 1par dka'/ /zab mo'i khye rā ya bya yā ram̐ bha saṃ sā ro tsi ta dzad+ma rmā/ /bi sen+da pā to ma ha tsā dī sen+d+ra 'du 'god rtsom pa yisakhye / /'khor bar skye ba 'os gyur pa/ /chen po rgud pa ⑥lhung gyur na/ /gnyis pa ta no pa maḥ/ /i ti ta sngaḥb tsaḥkhru tā hrū ra muṅkam+bi hā sha yaḥ/ /'thung dbang po 'gyel ba bzhin/ /zhes pa de yi gdug pa'i tshig /thos nas bsam pa rab 'dar zhing / /sā ta mu bā tsa pra ṇa yāta ste ha pā sha ba shi kṛ taḥ/ /hi ta myuk+ṇi twa yā mdza' ba'i zhags pas dbang byas de④/ /de la gtsugs ldupas rab smras pa/ /re zhig khyod kyis phan pa tā bta ki tī ta da nyi pā ta kai/ /sa ha dza taḥts+tshan+da bye ga ba hi re ga dha brjod—/ /'on kyang 'di ni shin tu sdig /phyi rol yan lag nor thob slad/ /lhan skyes yan lag su nāp+ta ye/ /na yuk+ta barba sagh+ra nā marjaze pā pa tsin+ta rna/ /k+ṣa be+e nā zhig gcod/ /nor la chags rnams nor don du/ /sdig pa bsam pa rigs ma yin/ /nor rnams yārnyi bi t+ta ni rak+ṣi tā n+ya be+e saṃk+ṣa yi/ /mu huḥ kasgro m+bi saṃ re bha bsrung bar ⑨gyur mod kyang / /skad cig gis ni brlag par 'grur/ /yang yang las rlabs rtsom pa yis/ /saṃ bha batho bha bi bh+ra māḥ/ /gats+tsha juḥke na ba spyernye shi la ku spyo i rab skyed ⑫'khrugs pa'i rnam 'phrul can/ /dpal rnams ri gzar chu bo bzhin/ /bgrod pa dag ni su ba shi yaḥ/ /tasmran+da me su snru ju tro tro he pra brta te ma naḥ/ /bit+ta yis bzlog⑪ /de slad ⑪smin legs bdag gi yid/ /spun zla gsod la yongs ⑫mi 'jug /nor bye she ste me bṛtrīdṛt+ta rja she tu kā ga tiḥ/ /i ti ta su bru bā ṇa gya nyams ⑫bdag ni 'tsho ba yod/ /spyod tshul nyams na 'gro ba gang / /zhes smras ⑫ bdag po de yis ⑩yid/ /95—625

nā nā yut+ta ni dar+sha naiḥ/ /sha ṣ+peḥsā ni de bhe pa kyuḥpā ta kā bhi mu khasma sna tshogs rigs pa nyer bstan nas/ /dal gyis ①sdig pa dag la ni/ de yid ①mngon par phyogs par naḥ / /badhi tābe+e hu bhaḥste haiḥs ha dzan+d+rasgo dzā ni ba/ /stso tā ha rarnyi byas—/ /mdza' snum mang pos bskyed pa yisarju / /lhan skyes spyi bor skyes pa bzhin/ /bud med spu gri'i sa hasā gru ra dha rā kha rāḥste yaḥ/ /ba krā pa ram̐ spyu ra ta rā kri yā so rnon gyis/ /'phral la bcad nas 'dor bar byed/ /rmongs pas bcom pa'i blo dang bud med ni/ /su pra brta nā yi ba dṛṭ+wā bhi yo ga /sā pā ni bā tā ya bha ba t+ya bye mo hā ha tā rgo 'khyog cing gzhan la rab gdug bya min la/ /'jug pa'i slad du brtan pa sngon ④sbyor zhing / /sdig pa ⑤yu ba ti dz+re tibya/ /ba n+dha mi tra bi ragh+ra rgo swa su kha k+ṣi ba tse ta nges par lhung rjobar byed pa nyid/ /gnyen dang grogs la chags bral zhing / /sems ni rab bdes stsos tsā / /shrī yu tā nā ma ba nā taḥsdi dzi nā rmā ma tiḥku taḥ/ /a tha ju tar gyur pa/ /dpal ldan rnams la dud pa bzhin/ /bud med rgyal la blo gros gang / /de nas de yis ⑦mā byu ya dī twa pusgostso yā ya saḥ/ /n+ya ba dhī da khru tā kran+da ma sma nā bi dza ṣ+pe spun zla ni/ /me tog btu slad la spyodrangs nas/ /mi med nags su rdo ba yis/ /cho nge thos pa med par ba ṣ+pe/ /a ha me ba tat+yā paṃ bhuk+ta pūbye 6 dzad+ma su/ /ba hā mya byā pi she ྾ bsad—/ /de nyid nga yin sdog pa de/ /skye ba snga ma rnams ⑨spyad nas/ /mthe bong snad pa'i mtshan nyid sha oṃ guṣ+ṭha k+ṣa ta lak+ṣa khaṃ/ /sārja bā horja dat+ta byuḥpūṇ+ḍi pra ba ha ṇaḥcan—/ /da lta'ang lhag ma'i cha shas 'dzin/ /ded dpon don byin zhes bya ba/ /gzings ni gang bar pu rā/ /sa ba na snga nu ku bye na rat+na dī pān+d+ra mā ya yo/ /dri tī ya gyur pa sngon/ /rjes su mthun pa'i rlung dag gis/ /rin chen gling nas yang dag 'ongs/ /de nas ded sārja ba ho tha naṭ+wārba ste sa mā shrī taḥ/ /dwo ṣān+d+ra ba ha ṇi stso tra prats+tshan+da dpon gnyis pa ni/ /don nyams de la brten gyur pa/ /sdang bas gzings la sbas pa yi/ /'ug ⑩pa 95—626

kakhyo mur+ya yo/ /a tha driṣ+ṭiphorba daste na bār+ya ma naḥpu naḥpu naḥ/ /pā bya bar rab tu brtsams/ /ci ste don byin gyis mthong nas/ /yang dang yang du zlog 37grur kyang / /sdang pa pra yat+nasnye ṣārnyaḥk+ṣa rde na bi ra rā ma saḥ/ /ta taḥsārja pa tiḥko sād+dhā bas long de sdig pa yi/ /'bad las skad cig log ma gyur/ /de nas don mthun bdag khros nas/ /māstsar+ya bi mo nyi taḥ/ /tī bra shasti pra hā re ṇa tsa kā ra ga ta dz+re bi tai/ /khro ldan rnam par rmongs pa de/ /mi bzad shat+ta 'asnarab bsnun nas/ /srog dang bral ba nyid du byas/ /a haṃ sa tat+pa d+mās+thā pa pha lo bhughā n+ya dzad+ma su/ /ba hā mya t+yā pi she ྾ de nyid nga yin de bsad las/ /sdig 'bras skye ba gzhan spyad nas/ /lhag ma'i cha shas da lta yang / /shaṃ tsa ra ṇi kha di ra bra khaṃ/ /pra t+ya ka budheḥpiṇ+ḍa ya pā tra pā ṇi da yādz+ra rkang par seng ldeng rma 'dzin no/ /lag na kyelhung bzed brtse ba yis/ /brlan pa'i blo ldan rab ngu dhīḥ—/ /bi be sha kā shi na ga rī mu pā riṣ+ṭa bhi dhaḥpu rā/ /sa pūṇ+ḍi pā tu sangs rgyas/ /u pa riṣ+ṭa zhes pa sngon/ /ka shi'i grong du bslang slad zhugs/ /de yi 'a7lhung bzed yongs mā lo kya ta gya bi dī ṣa du ṣi taḥ/ /mu dh+wa tsa pa la ko nā ma pā ṇi na pā ta pabyu khengs pa/ /mthong nas sdang bas sun phyung ba/ /'bras med g.yo ldan zhes pa yis/ /lag pa yis ni sa bi / /a haṃ sa pā pan+tabyek+tats+tsha dot+tha ba hu dzad+ma su/ /bhughā pi pha la she ṣe la pho/ /de nga khuzas bcad las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sdig de skye ba mang por ni/ /spyad kyang 'bras bu lhag ṇa pra yā tāḥshu n+ya pa tra hūṃ/ /ba shiṭī khyaḥpu rārta two pābe+e tsit+ta pra sā da ma yis/ /lhung bzed stong pa nyid du gyur/ /ba shiṣ+ṭha zhes bya bar 7‘sngon/ /dgra bcom nyid thob sems bān—/ /u bā pa pra mā rā me bi hā re po ra kalbi te/ /bh+ra tā pra bri dzi rab dang / /rab zhi'i dga' tshal grong pa yis/ /byas pa'i gtsug lag khang na gnas/ /de yi srun zla ta ta gya bha ra dhū dza pa do di taḥ/ /bi lo kya dza na sāṭ+wā ram̐ ya yo bi dī ṣāsni rab byung ni/ /bha ra dh+wa dza skye bo yis/ /bkur ste rtag rgyas de mthong nas/ /sdang ba'i me yis 95—627

tap+ta tsā/ /gu ṇi nāsmra na ma lokya pra yat+na n+tabe+e nā sha ṣ+pe/ /dza naḥgadungs par gyur/ /yon tan can rnams bkur mthong nas/ /de nyams be+ed du skye bo rnams/ /rab tu ka ro te na tāt+pa gu ṇa dh+wa na sa mu r+ya me/ /ma hārta bas+thā yu ga lo ṭ+wā tre 'bad byed bdag nyid ni/ /yon tan gzung phyir brtson ma yin/ /chen po la 'os gos zung zhig /bhat+ta dza nādz+re tai/ /tasmi ba shiṣ+ṭhaḥpra da do dī t+yā sa ra la mā na saḥ/ /ta skye bo gus pas phul ba ni/ /drang po'i sems ldan khyeb shiṣ+ṭha/ /mdza' bas spun zla de la byin/ /de ④dā dā ya gu ṇa dī ྾ na be+e rā bi ra rā ma saḥ/ /no pa kā rerne tsa dī blangs yon tan la sdang de/ /khon dang bral ba nyid ma gyur/ /phan pa rnams dang mdza' bas kyang //t+ya ni dza yā ti durja naḥ/ /a kādhe sa sa mā byu ya bi hā ra pa ri tsā ri rmā/ /ngan pa rang gi (1mi 'gyur ro/ /de yis gtsug lag khang skyong ma/ /dben par yang dag bos nas ni/ /da tā sri ban+t+ra yu ga la dza gā da kṛ ta saskṛ tiḥ/ /i rda twa yā bas+thā yu shaṃ pa ri gos ni zung dag de la byin/ /bkur ste byas nas rab smras pa/ /gos zung 'di ni skyed skyi bzang ma/ /jo ya su ma dh+ya me/ /ba shikhye nādz+re ta mi ti prasne bā tsuḥsha ṣ+perdza naḥ/ /i ti sīkhyod kyis gyon la skye bo dag /'dri ⑤na ba shiṣ+ṭha yis ni/ /byin zhes dal gyis smra bar bya/ /de skad des kṛ t+ya te noghā ba dā diṣ+ṭi tsa kā ra sā/ /ye nā bha babo shiṣ+ṭha su dza no bi be+e ba brjod de yis kyang / /khas blangs de yis bstan pa byas/ /gang gis khyab shiṣ+ṭha la ni/ /skye bo slong bar oṃ ki taḥ/ /shī la bai ka l+ya bā de na so tha po ri ra pū dzi taḥ/ /du ram̐ dgos ⑦par gyur/ /tshul khrims ma tshang brjod pas des/ /de nas grong pas ma mchod de/ /ring du ya yo ma hā to hi saṭ+wā ra bye sha dhī ra baḥ/ /so ha mār+yā sa bā de na song gyur chen po rnams/ /bkur ste nyams pas 'jigs pa nyid/ /bhā dur dh+wa dza de bdag ste/ /bha ra dhū dzo n+ya dzad+ma su/ /bhughā gya pu bye tats+tsha ṣāh+phun+dar+yā r+ya mṛ ṣārdi 'phags la smad pas skye gzhan la/ /bsod nams min spyad de lhag las/ /mdzes mas ding yang rdzun 95—628

taḥ / /brah+ma be+e ṣ+pedh+ya yā pūrde bā rā rja sde ma yā mu ṣ+peḥ/ /duzla de na ha tā gyis smad/ /bdag sngon bram ze'i phrag dog gis/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ① thub pa ni/ /blo ldan mngon shes lnga tīn+tiḥpa.ā+oṃ bhi snyo su dhī ma taḥ/ /bā ra rja snga ma bhun+d+radze+e bha dru nā ma bā pa yis①/ /grags pa phrag dog dag gis bcom/ /me tog gzhu can grags pa yi/ /ba dan ltar mdzes dzā ga na/ /bai shā ya shaḥpa tā ke ba kād+dhā ku su ma dha na naḥ/ /shā ka dā smad 'tshong ma/ /bzang mo zhes bya bud med mchog / bā rā ṇa sīr rngusngon byung gyur/ /g.yo ldan gya tsi1 shā la khyo bi ṭaḥku ṭi la beṣ+ṭi taḥ/ /dṛṭī ta sri da do rā tri sgo gā yo shu ka gyu'i bsam pa can/ /pad rtsa zhes pas nam zhig de/ /mthong nas mtshan mo spyad pa'i slad/ /gos dang byu ṣa rde/ / ta tasta ra la rā gā yāḥ san+dha yaḥsaṃ ga morlu khe/ /rgyan dag de la byin/ /de nas g.yo ba'i chags pa can/ /mtshams la 'grogs par mngon phyogs pa'i/ /ga ga ram̐ ga ṇa bar+yadhe ladza mā ṣ+pe di bā ka re/ /ga twa swa bha ba rgo bha dru nyin mor byed pa nam mkha' yi/ /khyams kyi mthar ni babs pa'i tshe/ /bzang mo rang gi khyim song nas/ /pu྾ shu ka bi khyu ṣa ṇiḥ/ /khā ba rgya bha rā ṇa tsa kre pu na tuste pra sā dha ā+oṃ/ /me tog gos dang rgyan rnams kyis/ /mdzes pa nyid kyi rgyan la ni/ /be+er yang zlos pa'i rgyan dag byas/ /a lak+ta ke pā da ta lā ba saste kakhye ba lam+bi n+ya pi hā ra hā khye/ /smrag rtsi rkang pa'i mazil la rab chags shing / /do shal mchog ni chomagrin par dpyangs (byenas kyang / /kār+yābe+e ni dam ṇa saṃ myu khā+e sā ca kā ra bai shā tsa ri tai ya thārja/ /kaṇ+ḍi n+ya bya ba don gnyer me long la phyogs te/ /smad 'tshong spyod pa'i don bzhin de yis byas/ /mgrin pa la da n+yad+ma da ṣ+pephon+ya dokhye ba bhā ra ta rtswa z-i da ye ta thā n+yat+pa/ /sā bhū ṣa rde gzhan bzhin gzhan mchu la gzhan/ /de bzhin gzugs can ma des snying la gzhan/ /rnam bkra rang gi lo bha na me ba sum̐ sī mur+ghaṃ swa kaste bya mi bā ti tsi tram̐/ /ka li ta ta bya ba gzugs brnyan ⑥bzhin/ /skyes bu chags byed nyid kyis mergyan rnams bzung khya/ /yid skyes ⑨rgyal 95—629

ru ṇa rā gārja ga rā gā ba r+bha pā ti mi ra sha ba la sarmya bobe+e saju pa dhu ba'i grags pa zla ba'i gzugs ni dang po bzhin/ /lan bu thig le'i ri mo sa sti'ajo sgeg ldan par rab spras miḥ / /ma na si dza dza ya kirtswa mur+bhe mā t+yā mi be+esdo ra la ka til ka le khye lī shing / /rab 'phro bdug ①pa'i du bas rab rib thun mtshams bzhin bkra ba/ /chags pa dar byas yan la yā sru tra yaṭī/ /ta taḥpra bi sh+ya twa ri tā dā sī ma kā ri kā bhi dh+wa/ /lag dang bcas chags pa de rab mdzes/ /de nas g.yog mo chu srin ma/ /zhes pa myur bar rab zhugs te/ /ta myu tse k+ṣa ṇa saṃ gādhī ba nyi rāste yu bā na baḥ/ /kār+ṣa pa shā dzā tre ṇa der smras skad cig 'grogs 'dod pa'i/ /gzhon nu gsar pa phyi na sdod/ /kākhyo 1pa ṇi brgya phrag lnga/ /babe+e tīr+ya sha ta pañtsa kai/ /pra bi bye ba bi nirlu te so yan+di dhi ra sa taḥ/ /rtswa ④bzhin du ni ster bar byed/ /'di ni khyod kyi gter zhing khye 'ongs/ /nang zhugs nyid ni phyi rol thong spyo/ /pra bhū ta dra bi ṇa snga gī bya gra tā da tsi rasbi tiḥ/ /ts+tshan+da kā maḥk+ṣa m+bi rab mang nor ldan gtong phod can/ /byel bas yun ring mi sdod pa/ /'dod bsgribs ④'dod ldan kā m+bi su bha ge la bh+ya te ku taḥ/ /i ti ta gyeḥb tsa shu tā bha dru thra bā bzod pa can/ /skal ba bzang mo ga la thob/ /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /yon dang chags pa'itsa sa mi tā/ /k+ṣa rde do lā ya mā ṣ+pe ba ma bye dāk+ṣi ju lo bha yaḥ/ /ka bar du khyeni/ /skad cig 'phyang ⑨mo yug pa bzhin/ /bzang mos 'dzum bcas rab smras pa/ /gzhan dze+e ra bye ga de bā ha ma n+ya smra dā tu be+e ta nā/ /gats+tsha mi prabe+e tā n+ya su las gla ni blang ba kyedag /lam srang dag gi bud med bzhin/ /de dus don gnyer gzhan la ni/ /lag taṇ+ḍa noṭ+wā na pā ṇi tai/ /pra dzā nā mi ba sazla gya swā dhī nā nā ma pi k+ṣa khaṃ/ /bzed nyid du ji ltar 'gyur/ /skye rgu 11rnams bzhin thams cad kyi/ /dbang du gyur kyang skad cig ni/ /pūzla me bā bṛ tā ye na sa swā m+bi be+e sha yo ṣi tsā/ /e kai be yo mṛ shā gang gis sngon nyid 'thams pa de/ /smad 'tshong bud med rnams kyis ⑫bdag /mtshan mo gcig pu 'di 95—630

le na 1 tā rā triḥki mu h+ye te/ /pa raḥpra taḥs mā yā tu na ba re ghāḥs dā nyid ni/ /pad rtsas nyos la ci zhig brjod/ /gzhan kyis ①snga dro 'ong du chug /bdag cag rtag tu ba yo/ /i kyuk+ta bha dā yā k+ṣu dru ma dhu lubye ba sā sa ra/ /saghā gsar pa rtsom/ /bzang mos 'di brjod chung ngu des/ /mtshog tu sbrang rtsi la chags bzhin/ /gsar pa na ba na bā swā de ku pi tā tā ma bha ṣa ta/ /na ga taḥpra ta rā gad+dhā pra taḥgasar pa'i ror chags shing / /khros pas de la rab smras pa/ /gal te 'ong ba (②btang gyur na/ /song saṃ t+ya bye te ya di/ /bhā gyesgo ba ti bai shā rmā ba ni dzā tsa ba hu kra yaḥ/ /ba nang par 'ong mi 'gyur/ /smad 'tshong rnams dang tshong pa la/ /skal bas nyo ba mang bar 'gyur/ /i taḥki tsi di taḥki tsiñtsi na ṭī rmā di bā ni shaṃ/ /be+e shā dzā po du ṣe lā 'di nas cung zad 'di nas dang / /cung zad nyin mtshan du gsog 1pa/ /smad 'tshong rnams kyi skyes bu bhaḥku su mā ba tsa yo pa maḥ/ /na dhan+d+ra ya na kā mā ya dha nā yi na pra yis—/ /rnyed pa'i ④me tog 'thu ⑤ba bzhin/ /smad 'tshong ma la rtag tu mdza'/ /slong ba rnams kyi sā rgya te/ /be+e shā yā tsa ka bi bye ba ba hu pra ṇa yi m+bi sa dā/ /nā yā rig pa bzhin/ /chos kyi slad min 'dod slad min/ /nor nyid be+ed du rgyas par byed/ /mang dang t+ya shu tsi hūṃ bai shā pra ta ma snga na lu bye te/ /bha dza te ba hu saṃ ge na pra 'grogs pas smad 'tshong ma/ /mi gtsang ba nyid mi 'gyur zhing / /'di yi brtul zhugs mi nyams te/ /kyu tā bh+yarba byā ya tsā / / nir+yāt+ya bye bi shakhye bye pra tī gh+radhe ba hi slar la don du gnyer byar 'gyur/ /gzhan dag phyir 'thon gzhan na sh-i'ajug /gzhan dag phyi nas rab ba re/ /ya sgyuḥpa sho bh+ya te be byā sa bhā bhū mi pa te ri ba/ /dod+dhā rgya pa lta ba'i/ /smad 'tshong gang de mdzes pa ste/ /sa yi bdag po'i mdun sa bzhin/ /tshong pa dbul po'i ju kā mi t+yā ki ma n+yan+d+rasbya to bye kai/ /tu le ba k+ṣi ṇa ba ṇi dzaḥshu t+yā sī da ti srang bzhin du/ /stong par khyim na gang 'dug pa/ /smad 'tshong rnams la 'di las ni/ /lhag pa skal 95—631

yasgo he/ /a bhā gye spyo ha kā bhā be+e ga ṇi kā sru t+yā shā yi —/ /mi byā baṇ+ḍi ngan gzhan pa ci/ /skal ngan gyis ni 'dzin byed med/ /'phyon ma stong par nyal ba ni/ /snga dro 'dod ya ti pra taḥkā mu kait+tha bhañdza nā/ /sa byāḥkra ya pa ri kyā gā du ra ldan rnams kyi skra/ /rdzun gyi 'khrug khyepar grub ①par byed/ /'phral la nyo ba yongs btang nas/ /ring batrī pra tī k+ṣa yā/ /mā khā i bā shu shu 6rnyi be+e shāḥpa ju pra sā ra ke/ /na gnas la bsgugs dzu pa na/ /zong 'grems sa ru smad 'tshong ma/ /'phreng ④ba bzhin du myur du bskam⑤/ /e ṣa kau tu kā mā tādhī kār+ya bya gro ba hu pra daḥ/ /pra bi bye ba bi nir+yā ti 'di ni dge mtshan tsam don gnyer/ /bya bas brel zhing mang du ster/ /nang zhugs nyid na phyi rol 'gro/ /kā k+ṣa ta gri khya tān+ta ā+oṃ/ /khru two tan+d+ra hi tai bha dru ta dze+e ti pra t+ya sa r+ya ta/ /ci nyams nor ni blang bar ⑥mdzod/ /phan pa 'di thos bzang mo des/ /de bzhin zhes te kha yis blangs/ /lo bhaḥswa bhā ba bai shā na mo tsi h+ye dza na rañdza rgo/ /k+ṣa mya hūṃ k+ṣa ṇa mā tre smad 'tshong rang bzhin chags pa ste/ /rig ⑦pa skye bo chags byed nyid/ /skad cig nyid ni der bzod ba nā haṃ sadz+dza pra sā dha nā/ /be+e thra k+ṣa nyi mṛ rja lā ya dā sbo san+de mdzod—/ /bdag gis ⑤ chas dang rgyan ma tshar/ /zhes pa'i 'phrin ⑨ni skyel ba la/ /pad rtsa la ni sha bā di dī/ /k+ṣa khaṃ pun+da ra kā khye na ba hu dā ṣ+pe na kā mi nā/ /sā pad+me g.yog mo btang / /'dod ldan mdzes pa zhes bya ba/ /mang po sbyin pas skad cig ni/ /glang pos pad+ma ni ga dze ṣ+pe ba bhuyā byā lo la tsā ya yo/ /ta tastasmin ga te dan+ta ts+tsha dospyoṣ+ṭa can bzhin de/ /spyad pas 'khrugs pa nyid gyur to/ /de nas de ni song ba dang rmye 7 / /mchu ni sos ra dats+tsha dā/ /nirda yā li shaṃ ṣ+pe ste na bhā tā nais+thā l+ya tā k+ṣa rjatu/ /bi sa bcad lhag ma dang / /de yis brtse med 'byung ba yis/ /skad cig gis ni rnying nyid thob/ /be+er yang sam+bi mṛ rja lā ya pu na rat+ta pra sā dha nā/ /sā sa khā+e gyu bye bi dwo ṣe tūṇ+ḍi mā ga rgyan ni rab bzung na0/ / /pad+mo'i rtsa ⑩ la myur bar ni/ /byon zhes sdang ba sbas pa yis⑫ste/ /grogs mo 95—632

mya tā mi nyi/ /dzñā tā mṛ rja lastaj-ir+ghaṃ bai shu t+yāṅka thi tai ta yā/ /i hai bā de ①ni rnam par springs/ /de yis smras pa'i phra ma las/ /de yi spyod tshul pad rtsas shes/ /'di nyid du yā tu bha dre ti gyu zwa ko paḥs ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /ta taḥsā s+thāp+ta san+de shā sau ra bhā ni bzang mo dag /shog ces khro ba sbas pas zhusmras/ /de nas 'phrin zhuthos dri bzang gis/ /rkang drug kṛṣ+ṭa ṣat+pa dā/ /mṛ shā la dzuṣ+ṭa mu byā be+e pra ya yo phul+la pā da paṃ/ /pa ni 'gugs ma der④/ /pad rtsas bsten pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /rkang 'thung me tog rgyas par song / /hūṃ dṛbye ba sa mā yā ta rā ge dre ṣa bi khoṅka ṭa/ /saṃ sā ra i ba pā kā raḥde ni 'ong ba mthong gyur nas/ /chags sdang dug ni mi bzad pa/ /'khor ba rnam pa dang bcas bzhin/ /sa bi kā ro ba bhū ba saḥ/ /so tsin+ta yabye pa la yā ma darja mu pa kalpi de ni rnam 'gyur ldan par gyur/ /de yi bsam khyapa g.yo ba yis/ /bdag thudon gnyer bar btags pa tai—/ /kṛ ta ma byo pa sgo ge na lo bha lubye pra sā dha rgo/ /na khol+le khirba yi—/ /rgyan rnams chags las gzhan dang ni/ /nye bar spyad pas nyams par byas/ /kye ma rang spyod gya kṛḥku ṭi la tsa ri tai han+ta li khi ti ba hadhī pra t+ya gre ni dza mi ba sa ma gre gyu'i tshogs pa bzhin du nu ma'i ngos dag la/ /sen mo 'khyog por rab btab rnams kyis ri mo gsar pa sta na ta ṭi/ /bi ṭostsoṣ+ṭa kliṭ+wā dha ra da la ru tsiḥk+ṣu ma pa da nā bhu dze+e gī saje 'dzin byed cing / /mchu 'dab mdzes pa g.yon can lhag mas nyams shing bzhin ni zad gyur pa/ /lag shaṃ bi ṣa ma bi ṣa me ṣa di sha ti me/ /k+ṣa r+ṇa bi tsibye ti thra thu pra ko pa 'gro ma 'dis bdag gi yan lag kun la mi bzad dug rnams spro/ /skad cig de bsams che bar rab khros kṛ shā nu dhū moṅga ma bi bh+ra me ṇa/ /bhū bobe+e kā re ṇa sa kā la bagh+raḥpa'i—/ /me yis rab bskyed du ba'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /smin ma'i rnam 'gyur dus kyi bzhin ldan des/ /thra bā tsa hūṃ sā gha sa sem+bi ruzlo/ /k+ṣa ṇi na bai shā ba hu saṃ ga tā yā greṭ+wā ti sa pa ra skrag pa rgyas pa de la rab smras pa/ /mang dang skad cig la 'grogs smad 'tshong gang / /de ni dang po 95—633

bit+ta mā da do/ /ma darba me bā hi ta e ṣa be shaḥkṛ tasta mā swe da ka rja ba gzhan nor ci la 'dzin/ /bdag don nyid du byas pa'i chas 'di dag /khrod kyis ①rdul gyi thigs pa'i bushi ṣaḥ/ /i ti bru dzā ṇa su ta noḥpra kaspa bi lo la rmā byā sta ra lasbra lhag mar byas/ /zhes smras gzugs bzang mo ①yi 'og pag ④ni/ /g.yo zhing bskyod pa'i gsal ba'i sgra ṣ+pe na/ /pra sā da bā khā ma bā lā ma bar+ghaṃ rak+ṣe ti de n+ya di ba yā tsu mā dag gis/ /drin mdzod bu mo gzhon nu gsad ⑤pa'i 'os/ /srungs zhes dman pas slong bar byed pa naḥ / /la tā bhi la myu ku la dh+ri ga mā lā bi rā bi shī rnyirda ya yi ba dru bzhin—/ /bung ba'i 'phreng ⑥ ba sgra sgogs gtibs pa yi/ /'khri shing rnams kyang bzhin ni rab btud rata / /nir+pār+ya mā ṇa ta na na bhiḥs man+ta taḥpal+la ba pā ṇi kaspeḥ/ /pas—/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab kun tu g.yob byed cing / /brtse bas ring nas zlog par byed pa bzhin/ /gho dzā ha ti byā s+thā i ba 1 ḍo sau tā pā ba sar+ghaṃ ga la tsā ku radhī/ /ha 'jigs rung bsgrun pa'i stag bzhin brtse med des/ /yan lag 'khri shing skrag nyams ri dwags ni/ /g.yo tā ṇi sha shasta ra khā ya tā stso ragh+rak+ta shas+thāḥpra ya yo dza be na/ /te ṣā yang mig can bsad nas mgyogs pa yis/ /gtum po ⑦mtshon cha khrag sbags rab tu song / /gang zhig ma yo ki mi bāste ye bye kṛ dh+warmya tusgye ni bi lo tsa nā ni/ /da yā da ri dā khro ba'i long bas mig bkag pa/ /de dag rnams la bya min ci zhig yod/ /rtag tu yid ni brtse bas ṇi ma dzñā sa ni h+ye ṣ+pej-i khyu gho rā ṇi tsa beṣ+ṭa tā ṣ+pe/ /pā be+e na bha dru bi dza ṣ+pe dbul ba yis(she/ /spyod tshul brtse med 'jigs rung rnams la yang / /dben par bzang mo sdig can ha te ti ko lā ha le ta tri kṛ te tha dā t+yā/ /dza nā bhi sā re su ru berbi bi sha gyis bsad ⑨ces/ /de nas der ni 'bangs mos sgra bsgrags shing / /skye bo 'dus tshe nyi tshe sangs rgyas kyi/ /pra h+ye ka budha sa kā na nārnyi/ /j-i tā ta da gre ru bye rādz+ra shaste tasmin pra nags mthar de ni rang dga' dag tu zhugs/ /de mdun khrag gis sbags pa'i mtshon bzhag nas/ /skye 95—634

biṣ+ṭa dza na hūṃ ta rā lo/ /po ri ba pā po pi kṛ tī ta tsisgoḥpra bye ka budheḥbo'i tshogs kyi nang du de bros tshe/ /rtag (1'dzin grong pas sdig ( 7pa med mod kyang / /rang sangs rgyas ni sa ha sā kṛ tī taḥ/ /bhā te tha tasmij-i pa shā sa ṣ+pe na spyu rā pa rā sgo tsi ta 'phral la gzung ①bar gyur④/ /ma rungs gnod byed la 'os gsod pa'i sar/ /de nas rgyal po'i bka' ba dh+ya byu mo/ /dzā tā nu tā paḥpra sha sgo mṛ ṇa laḥpā pa ma mi taskṛ ta mi dru bā tsa/ /yis de khyer tshe/ /pad+ma'i rtsa lag 'phral la 'gyod pa skyes/ /sdig pa 'di ni bdag gis (5byas zhes smras/ /muste ta tastarja tsa sā bi tsār+ya pra h+ye ka budhe pra ṇi sa t+ya rā dzñā/ /ra sa de nas de yi tshig gis rang sangs rgyas/ /dpyad nas rgyal pos phyag 'tshal btang ba'i tshe/ /ngan byed p+ta tai duḥs ha shā sa na su m+bi to mṛ shā laḥku kṛ to tsi ta gya/ /a haṃ sa la 'os bzod pa dka' ba'i bka'/ /nyams stsong 'di ni pad+ma'i 'urtsa bas thob/ /de nga ⑦ drag po'i pā paṃ ba hu dzad+ma lak+ṣesgoghā ta du gre na ra kān+ta re 6/ /a r+ya pi taṅkan+d+ra pha lā ba she sdig des skye ba mang / /'bum gyis dmyal ba'i nang du yongs spyad dunas/ /de yi las 'bras lhag ma da ṣām+bi bye ba tīd+dhā ta na yā bhi yuk+taḥ/ /ban+tu ma dh+yā pu ri pu rā bi sa lta yang / /mu stegs bu mo'i rdzun gyis mngon par sbyar/ /grong khyer gnyen ldan dag na sngon/ /bcom dhī bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /sgo gi ra bh+yadz+re taḥpo re ste sbo bik+ṣu ga be+edṛ ldan rgyal ba rnam par gzigs/ /grong pa'i longs spyod kyis mchod cing / /dge slong tshogs kyis bskor taḥ / /pū dzñā mā dz+wa ta mā lo kya drwah+ma rto ma ṭha rā bhi dhaḥ/ /u bā tsa sau rām+bi te gnas/ /bram ze ma tha ra zhes pa/ /mchod dang ldan pa de mthong nas/ /grong pa la smras dge slong ni/ /shi khā sgo ga yo gyu na bhik+ṣa baḥ/ /byu rā ṇiḥko ṭa ra ya be+esgo bye rnge ྾ bi dhī ya hūṃ/ /mgo reg longs spyod 'os pa min/ /ko ṭa ra yi nas rdul gyis/ /'di dag gi ni kha zas bsgrubs thu/ /na muṇ+ḍa kā ghā bi ka ṭi di byā hā rārta mā na rna/ /i ti bā kyāt+pa bi pro haṃ mgo reg 'gyur bag ldan pa'i kha/ /mchog gi kha zas 'os pa min/ /bram ze de dag lho7tshig de las/ /95—635

dza hastesbyi r+ya mā dzā go dṛṭī kai brta dā ra kaḥ/ /so haṃ tat+pa ri tojubye bā lus ni gcod pa mthong gyur nas/ /nya ba'i bu yis dga' bar byas/ /de bdag de la yongs tshim thob/ /paṃ bhughā n+ya dzad+ma bhiḥ/ /tasmim+bi nā she shākyā dzā k+ṣa r+ṇa smṛṣ+ṭaḥshi ro ru dzā/ /pu rā sdig pa skye ba gzhan spyad nas/ /shākya nyams pa de yi tshe/ /skad cig mgo la nad kyis ①reg /sngon tshe dza na pa do mabe+eḥdī ti mawaṃ ba lnga bhe snye/ /ni pā r+ya yudhe byā dze na thraṣ+ṭha ljongs kyi gyad gyur te/ /mdza' bo zhustobs zhes bya ba'i gyad/ /g.yul gyi zol gyis gshags 1byas te/ /ma gya dī dh+wa ka rota/ /so haṃ tat+yā ta kai bhuk+ta be+e pu lo ba hu dza n+ya su/ /a byā pi de yi rgyab ni rnam gnyis byas/ /de nga de yi sdig chen ni/ /skye ba mang por spyad byas nas/ /rlung gi nad bā ta shu le na thra ṣ+ṭha kṛ ta pa da k+ṣa r+ṇa/ /i ti saṃ bhudha bo dherme kyis da lta rwapyayang / /rgyab tu skad cig gnas ⑤ par byas/ /de khyeltar byang chub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nin+d+ra ṣ+ṭa su pi pi gra he/ /kan+d+ra saṃ kā ba she ṣā kā ni se troḥgre sha bi sru nges bstan bdag gi lus la yang / /nyon mongs thigs pa las 'dam byu/ /lhag ma'i cha shas nges par ṣaḥ / /dzad+mot+pa be+e 6 di dha ṣ+pe 6 ba sa: badhe mā le ba kan+d+ra sha ra ṇiḥlhung ⑦/ /skye bar spro dang 'chi ba'i tshe yang skyes bu lus rnams ④la/ /bkra ba'i las kyi lam ni 'phreng ⑨sha ba lā sha rī re/ /sum̐ sā mi yo pra ṇa yi ṇi su kha duḥkha sdem+bi bhustoljab bzhin du rnam btags khya kyepa/ /rab tu chags pa 'di ni bde dang sdug bsngal mtshams dag la/ /spyad tā bi be+e da dha t+ya ba sā na she ṣe/ /i ti khru tā bha ga ba tā ka thi cing btang bar gyur kyang lhag ma'i lhag ma rnam par 'dzin/ /de skad bcom ldan gyis bshad pa/ /tī sazla bhik+ṣa baḥ/ /me ni re kadz+re bad+dhā nā ma na ti kra ma nī yā tā ma/ /dge slong kun gyis thos gyur nas/ /las kyi 'ching ba rnams lhoskyedag ni/ /'da' bar bya min nyid du nges/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī da sha zhes pa dge ba'i ⑫dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing 95—638

hūṃ ga dz+wa/ /yā tu dh+wa m+bi mi ba sash+yata ba khā shaṃ sgothi muh+phu kai/ /tsā shing ltogs pas gzir/ /srin mo bzhin du bu tsha dag /za bar 'dod pa mthong bar gyur①/ /de dṛṭī ka ru ṇa krād+dhā sā k+ṣa khaṃ sa ma tsi ta yatra/ /a ho swa de ha bhe he na ma tiḥmathong snying rje rgyas gyur pa/ /de yis skad cig yang dag bsams/ /kye ma rang lus la chags pas/ /blo pā be+e pra brta te/ /a gya sgo dza na mā hakhyo bra dzā mi swa kṛ haṃ ya di/ /ta di ni sdig la rab tu 'jug /'di yi zas ni len du bdag /gal te rang gi khyim song na/ /bkres pas yi kyut+pa ri k+ṣu ma bha gh+ra ya h+ye ba dā ra kai/ /a tha bā shi shu mā dā ya ya di yongs su nyen pa 'dis/ /bu ni nges par za bar 'gyur/ /yang na bdag gis bu khyer nas/ /gal te gats+tsha mi man+di re/ /ta de ṣā kṛ sha tsā yā tā sa r+yas+t+ya dza ti dz+re bi tai/ /i ti khyim du phyin pa na/ /'di ni bkres pa nyid gyur te/ /'phral la 'tsho ba gtong bar 'gyur/ /de ltar saṃ tsiṣ+ṭha da yā yā tarmin+d+ra bha ya saṃ sha ye/ /dza ga྾ tā ra shā ye bha pra ṇi gnyis ka the tshom dang / /ldan pa de la brtse bas bsams/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i sbad nyid du/ /de yis jo ā+oṃ bi ṅgā ya sā/ /stso tā ta yo pa dī te na shi na shaste ṇa nibya lā/ /ni smon lam btab byas te/ /de yis gtad pa'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /g.yo ba med par bcad nas ni/ /de dze+e sta na yu ge ta gye da do dzi bi ta d+mā ra khaṃ/ /tre lokya spri shi sābyarle ta su la rang gi nu ma zung / /'tsho ba yi ni zung ⑫la byin/ /de nas de grags ngo mtshar can/ /'jig rten ya sha se bi khru te/ /bi pra rū pe ṇa sha kre ṇa ta taḥthraṭ+wā sa me t+ya sā/ /gsum reg grags pa'i tshe/ /brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs kyis ni/ /mngon du phyogs te de la dris/ /a be+e testa na dā ṣ+pe na ma no bi kṛ ti mā ya yo/ /i ti thraṭ+wā pa tī sa t+ya bā di khrod ni ṭ+wānu ma byin pa yis/ /yid la rnam 'gyur ma byung ngam/ /zhes dris de la dag pa dang / /bden nī tai dza gā da sā/ /ya di me nā bha bat+pa byeta bi kā dzā sha sta nārba ṇi/ /te na smras pyaldan pa des smras pa/ /nu ma byin la rnam 'gyur cha/ /gal te bdag la 'ga' ma gyur/ /bden 95—640

na ya ā+oṃ sha ṣ+peḥ/ /ut+yā byot+yā rgya tuṇ+ḍi na thrat+pa sardza pu naḥpu naḥ/ /'gro ba'i mkhar bgrod ①kyis/ /mchu yis phyung zhing rab phyung nas/ /yang dang yang du rab tu btang / /dherle nibya la sabye gaḥs dṛṭī pi smi tai kha shaṃ/ /u bā tsa bhu ghā niḥshaṃ ka brtan zhing yan lag kun mi g.yo/ /de yis ya mtshan bya mthong nas/ /smras pa dogs med nyid du zo/ /nai ba hūṃ dh+wa ra yā mya haṃ/ /niḥsā ra bi ra saḥkā yaḥsā pā yolhayi k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa nga yis khyod ni yongs ⑤mi 'dzin/ /ro bral snying po med pa'i lus/ /gnod bcas skad cig 'jig pa yī—/ /pa ro pa kā ra le she na yā ti saṃ sā ra pā ra tsā/ /gre da gyan+di 'di—/ /gzhan la phan pa'i cha shas kyis/ /'khor ba'i snying po nyid du gyur/ /mi rnams lus ni mi ni nin+di te pra ti pa rda shā sak+ṣaṇa san+di ni sde haḥko3ya ma pā ya jo sdi ma la ṣ+pe mi gtsang zag cing so so'i gnas su smad gyur dri ma can/ /gnod pa'i gnas su gyur cing dbugs dus g.yo byā sha rī re dṛ rdeḥ/ /e kai ba smṛ ha bhā ya tā mya ya di dam pu byeḥkwatsiṅka la log par chags pa 'di ni ci/ /gang zhig bsod nams rnams kyi ④'ga' zhig dag tu 'ga' la 'ga' gya tsita kiñtsa da bī gh+ra ka dā tsi dān+ti sha ma na tā rja ya san+da khya ti/ /tshe 'ga' mthong nas/ /gdung ba zhi byed skyob la zhugs gyur 'di nyid gcig pu 'di yi dga' bya nyid/ /i ti ta gya bru bā ṇa gya grukhye miḥpak+ṣi bhiḥk+ṣa shāta/ /bha gh+ra mā ṇa gya bi k+ṣi su byā taḥces pa smra ba de yi lus/ /bkres pas nyen pa'i bya rnams kyis/ /za zhing 'phangs pa'i spyoskad cig la/ /kā yo da sbi she ṣa hūṃ/ /ma hā shā la su kā le na zwah+ma ṇa ta gya pu tra tsā/ /yā rus pa'i lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /dus kyis de ni bram ze dag /sā ⑤la chen po'i bur skyes te/ /bden taḥs t+ya pra to nā ma ba byu ba dza na sasma ta/ /a bāstu khi la bi r+ya su pa'i brtul zhugs zhes bya ba/ /skye bo dag gis bkur bar gyur/ /rig pa ma lus thob gyur cing / /ka ru shā sak+ta tse ta saḥ/ /ta gya shārnyi ra ta snga bhūji bā ha bi mu khasma naḥ/ /snying rje dag la chags pa'i sems/ /zhi bar dga' ba de yi yid/ /khyim thab las ni phyir phyogs gyur/ /95—642

ku le dzad+ma gu ṇa bāstebe+e be+e kā lo kṛ ta ma tiḥ/ /sat+tha byu ta da yā rigs su skyes shing yon tan thob/ /blo gros dben pas rab brgyan cing / /'byung po kun la brtse zhing mi ṭī lak+ṣa rde bu ju kadz+re bhā/ /bai rā gyu bhi ra tig tā sa yu be+e ba byams—/ /bsod nams las kyi mtshan nyid yin/ /gzhon nu de nyid chags bral gyis/ /dga' zhing ta po ba rna / / da t+ta bra to ma ha r+ṣa rgyu bhe dze be+e shārnyi mā shra dka' thub nags song ste/ /drang srong gnyis kyis brtul zhugs byin/ /bste gnas su ni ngal gso (1rime—/ /ta taḥkā le na si ta p+ta be+e ma la dzñā na lo tsa naḥ/ /ā san+da pra sa r+pā byu bsten—/ /de nas dus kyi ye shes spyan/ /dri med shin tu rno ba yis/ /stag mo btsa' la nye ba dag /spyu sa dṛṭ+wā sa ma tsin+ta yata/ /pra sa bophosngaḥgru dh+warta yā sabhā ha na bha mthong nas de yis yang dag bsams/ /bkres pa yis ni gzir ba 'di/ /zhag bdun dag na btsa' bi 6 ti/ /spri hā tsot+paṣ+ṭha te tī krā ni dza po ta ka bhak+ṣa be+e/ /i nyi saṃ tsi t+ya bar 'gyur bu/ /rang gi bu ni za ba la/ /skom pa drag po'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsams de yis 1ta druḥkhaṃ mu ni dzñā bi be+e r+ya saḥ/ /tsa kā ra tat+tha ti kā re kā ru sdug bsngal ni/ /thub pa dag la bshad nas des/ /snying rje chede ni phyir bcos pa'i/ /yid la re ba bye na ma no ra baṃ/ /ta taḥpra ya te sas+thā he byā spyu gar+bha bha rā la sā/ /ba tū byas par gyur/ /de nas zhag bdun 'das pa'i tshe/ /stag mo mngal gyi khur gyis dub/ /zas chag pa bā sa san+tadzñā kṛsgo ṇa pū ta po ta kān/ /ni dza sho ṇi ta gadhe na dzā ta mang pos gdungs gyur pa/ /dka' las chen pos bu tsha btsas/ /rang gi khrag gi dri yis ni/ /sred pa tī pra ta ra smṛ tī/ /sa t+ya bra tasta mā lo kya da yādz+raḥs ma tsin+ta yatro/ /drag po rab skyes ⑤pa/ /de mthong bden pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ /snying rjes brlan pas yang dag bsams/ /i rda ba rā tī k+ṣudruḥkhā du r+ya tā po ta bha k+ṣa ṇi/ /a ho ba tā sngaḥswāze na sdug ma 'di ni bkres pa yis/ /sdug bsngal dag las bu zar 6brtson/ /kye ma 'di ni rang don gyis/ /95—643

pu tra sne hopho pi bi smṛ ta ཿ / / sa dze+e ཿ swa duḥ kha sa n+ta p+taḥ pa ra bu la chags pa'ang brjed par gyur/ /rang sdug bsngal bas thams cad gdung / /bzhin ①gyi yongs su sadh+wa pa shi laḥ/ /pi she ṣāstoḥpa ra sngasto bi ra lo dzā ya te dza naḥ/ /da tā sha rī gdung bas bsel/ /skye bo 'ga' zhig gzhan gdung la/ /khyad par du ni gdung ba skye/ /bu dang bcas ram̐ ragh+ra mi byā spyi me tsā pa shā ba tī/ /na pa he duḥkha me te ྾ sarlurnye pa'i stag mo 'di/ /lus byin nas ni bdag gis bsrungs dhi/ /srog la the tshol yongs rdzogs pa/ /'di pā ṇa saṃ sha ye/ /pa ra zwa ṇa tā ṇi dṛ ṇa ka pa la yā t+yak+ta ba pu ྾ dag blusdug bsngal yongs mi bzod/ /gzhan srog skyob ④la lus ni rtswa ⑤ bzhin brtags pa spyogatong ba ya sha ཿ kā yaḥ s+thā yī bha ba ti thra thu pu byo da ya ma yaḥ / /rnams ⑦dag gi/ /rgya che bsod nams rgyas pa'i rang bzhin grags pa'i lus ni brtan par 'gyur/ /pra shaspyo pā yophoyo pra sa ra da ni lā lo la na li m+bi da lo྾ ga bye gadz+dza la la ba su gnod pa rab chags srog gi thigs pa 'di ni rab g.yo rlung dag gis/ /g.yo ba'i pad ldan 'dab ma'i z-isnro be+e ta ka ṇaḥ / / dh+yā te ti n+ya sa ta dh+yā sgyu ཿ sa pu raḥ ka ru khong duganas g.yo ba'i chu zigs dag gi grogs/ /'di bsams snying rje'i gter de yis/ /'byed pa'i ṇa ni byeḥ/ /sa la dulte ga le kṛ twa k+ṣa ta be+e dha sha lā ka ya/ /thur mas mgrin pa la/ /khrag zags (perma ni gtod ⑩byas nas/ /stag mo'i mdun du 'gyel bar gyuratse/ /ā san+d+ra tā ṇa sa ra saṃ na hi nā ma ma hāt+pa rmā/ /sa ha te pa ra sar+sā nges par bdag nyid che rnams kyis/ /yid ni snying rjes /rtemanyen pa dag /nye bar bskyabs ⑫la chags pa ka ru ṇa ko ma lo ma na ཿ / / ra ghā bhi lā ṣa ni shi tā ni bcas 4byepas/ /gzhan gyi spyoyongs gdung bzod ma yin/ /de nas g.yo med de yis snying ga ⑩rab tu pa pā ta ta su byā spyo ta taḥpra ta ta bak+ṣa pi ni: la su/ /ā:r+ya rgyas pa la/ /stag mo khrag la mngon par 'dod pa rnon pos rab tu mchongs/ /dga' dang 'dzum skyes 95byed644

mār+ya tsa ri ta mya dza gah+phu dzā ta har+ṣa smi tai ri ba na khaṃ shu bhe rul+li khadzñā/ /sen mo'i 'od zer dag gis 'gro ba la/ /'phags pa'i spyod pa'i ngo mtshar rab tu 'bri bar byed pa bzhin/ /me ṭī ba slu li tī k+ṣa me ṇa ku kṛ hūṃ pra zlo ba tsirnyi tsa yata duḥkhan+d+raḥbyams pas 'khrul bzhin bzod pas nyes byas bzhin dang shes rab kyis ni bsam tshogs bzhin/ /sdug sa ha bi sla ba j-i ti ri ba kle shaṃ ta pa shrī ri ba / / ta bsngal bzod dka'i bslad pa brtan ①pas bzhin dang nyon mongs dka' thub dpal byus bzhin/ /brtse su byā gh+ra ba dhū ni pā ta bi ṣa ma hrū rā bhe ghā tolpa ni se he mūn+ti ra tsañtsa le ba bas de yi ①lus ni snying stobs sa gzhi g.yo ba med pa de nyid kyis/ /stag gi chung mas btab cing mi da ya yā sā sa twa bhū misgo ram̐/ / byā d+mā na khā ba li bi lā sa bi bzad drag por mngon 'joms gsal ba'i khur dag bzod/ /stag mo'i 2sder mo 'phreng lgosnaba'i rol pas lu pya sā nā tsak+ṣeḥdz+re lī k+ṣa ṇa ma lak+ṣa ta bi k+ṣa tā gyaḥ/ /re māñtsa rnam par bcom gyur pa/ /de yi snying ga'i khyegazhi ni rnam par nyams pa skad cig mtshon/ /lus ni spu long tsadz+re ta ta no stu hi rmā shu shu bh+ra sa twa pra kā sha ki ra rde ku ra gis byugs bsil zer can ltar dkar ba yisaspyo/ /snying stobs rab gsal 'od zer myu gus khengs par pū ri te ba/ /ta snga mi ṣa ha ra ṇa sho ṇi ta pā na mad+dhā byā n+d+ra sa har+ṣa gyur pa bzhin/ /sha dag za zhing khrag 'thung stsos par gyur pa'i stag mo ni/ /dga' dang bcas pa mthong ma ba lo kya ya tabya kā ra/ /dispyo pra pā sa sā ma yā ku li tā mu tūrta kakhye nas 'gro ba de yi rang gi srog /'tsho ba dag ni ring du 'gro ba'i dus su bral gyur pa(pe/ /yud tsam zhig ba ladza na dh+ri ti ni dza dz+re ba thratrīḥ/ /treṣ+ṭha pra dak+ṣi ṇa bi lā sa ga tā na ⑧mgrin pa nyid la brten te brtan par byas/ /sred pa'i rjes mthun rtse dga'i 'od dang 'gro ba dag ga te na ladz+dza ba shā di ba z-i shaṃ bi na tā na ṣ+pe ba/ / ta gyaḥka ro gis ni/ /ngo tsha'i dbang las bzhin ni mchog tu rnam par dud yo7 pa bzhin/ /khyim ⑪ thab las ni phyir 95—645

da pi bi bā ha pa rādru kha gya pā ṇi gra ha pra ṇa yi be+e z-i da yot+pa ba phyogs gyur kyang de yi lag pa dang ① / /de yis bzung nas mdza' zhing gcugs ltar snying ni dga' bar sā / /modh+ri ba be+e tra ma bi kā ra mu dā ra sahūṃ sau dza n+ya pu rgya ta ṭi nī byas—/ /byams pas dag cing rnam 'gyur med pa rgya che'i snying stobs dang / /lugs bzang bsod nams bhu ba ṣ+pe 6 tīn+tiḥ/ /bha byāt+pa rmā bha ba ti bhuta hi ta swa bhā ba swa dhī chu bo 'jig rten rnams su grags pa dang / /'byung por phan pa'i rang bzhin dman la snying rjes brgyan na dī na ka ru ṇa bha ra rde tsa tse ta ཿ / / ta t+ta su sa twa pa'i sems/ /rang dbang nyid du gyur pa legs ldan bdag nyid rnams kyi gyeyin/ /stag mo'i sder mo'i ma tu waṃ tsa tu ran+d+ra rā shi bai khā bi khā sa ra sa nā ba su dh+wa pu ra:/ /byā rtse mos bshig pa de yi snying stobs dag /mtshungs pa med pa de mthong 'phral la nor 'dzin bu mo ni/ /rba zhu.ā+oṃ na khā gra da li ta gya be+e lo kya sa r+yaḥpā ṇa k+ṣa ya k+ṣa ṇa bhi ye ba tsi rlabs rol pa dang ldan chu gter bzhi yi ske ④rags can/ /srog ni zhig pa'i dus na 'jigs ⑤pa bzhin ram̐ñtsa kaspe/ /sa t+ya bra taḥs ka ru shā ni ra tophoha me ba smṛ tā swa du ring zhig 'dar/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs snying rje khyerab dga' de ni nga nyid do④ / /da lta 'dir ni bṛt+ta mi ha saṃ pra ti dzā ta hā sa/ /shu two nyi pūt+tha tsa ri tai ka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na sha kraḥrang gi spyod tshul dran nas bzhad gad skyes/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngon gyi spyod pa 'di ni thos gyur nas/ /sa bisma ya ma naḥste mi tā na no bhūt+pa/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra pi ra tsi tā ya mtshan yid ldan brgya byin de ni bzhin ras g.yo med kyur/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang yī bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī rugla ba tā ba dā na me ka pa.ā+oṃ shaḥchub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gser ldan byi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal bal+la waḥ// //'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //95—646

abe+e nāsba na ga tophosi balka lī yaḥka ro t+ya bi ra tai kṛ tārja tsā/ /kairna gang zhig nags song shing shun ldan gyur kyang / /slong rnams rgyun du don byas nyid du byed/ /spyod tsā ru tsa ri ta sa tsabyo te ta su tsin+ta na ta robyu martse tiḥ/ /be+e ha ran+ta ma tshul mdzes ldan de dang tsan dan gyi/ /ngo mtshar dag ni su yis bsam mi bya/ /de ni ①dka' thub nags thā n+yasmin bha ga ban+tan+ta po ba ṣ+pe/ /sa prats+tsha sasmi tai sha kro bismi taḥgazhan na/ /bcom ldan bzhugs shing 'dzum ldan la/ /brgya byen ya mtshan ldan pa yis/ /'dzum pa smi ta kā ra rde/ /thraṣ+ṭaḥpra ṇa yi na te na sabyu snyosta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /asmin+de nyid kyi rgyu mtshan dris/ /de yis gus pas dris pa'i tshe/ /de la kun mkhyen kyis gsungs pa/ /mig stong she sa ha sra k+ṣa pudze+e thrar+ghaṃ smṛ lta ma yā/ /ma dhū da kā khye na ga re pu rā su ldan pa gnas 'dir ni/ /sngon byung ba dag bdag gis dran/ /ma dhū 'a7da ka zhes pa yi/ /grong khyer lha ra pa ro pa me/ /a dī na pu rgya nā ma bhū ta bhū pa tispyo ṣa khaṃ bhu baḥ/ /ka ru grong lta bur sngon/ /bsod nams mi dman zhes bya ba'i/ /sa bdag sa yi rgyun zhu du gyur/ /snying rje ṇa mu di to pe k+ṣa mi ṭī sa sak+ta tse ta saḥ/ /u pā sedh+yā ba tī ba shrīr+ya dga' dang btang snyoms dang / /byams pa sems la yang dag chags/ /phrag dog can bzhin gang gi sngabe+e dza na be+e shā su/ /ka dā tsitsu ri tai ta su khru tā dza ga ti bi gru dpal—/ /slong ba'i skye bo ④khang par gnas/ /nam zhig de yi spyod pa ni/ /'gro la grags pa thos gyur ta—/ /ta mā ya yo bra h+ma dat+tasmra pa tibe+e dzi gī ṣa yā/ /ta taḥka ri nas—/ /sa yi bdag po tshangs pas byin/ /rgyal bar 'dod pa de can 'ongs ye/ /de nas glang po'i gha ṭ+wā ba me+e rārnyi kṛ ta di gan+ta raḥ / / tsa kā ra na ga rā ba d+dhā tshogs gtams pas/ /phyogs mtshalas dag ni mun par byas/ /de ni rjes su bcing ba'i slad/ /de yi khye ma nu ban+t+ra ya ta gya sāḥ/ /sa tā nu kasbyi dṛ pa tirna sha tru k+ṣa ya mits+tsha ti/ /grong khyer bcings par ④byas/ /snying stobs brtse ldan mi yi bdag /dgra ni brlag par mi bzhed do/ /95—647

dh+yā two ta nir+ya yurloju ma nushrī bā su madh+ri ṇaḥ/ /brta mā no ra ṇi tasmin zhes bsams de yi blon po ni/ /ma brjod g.yul la phyi rol 'thon/ /glang po rta dang shing rta rnams/ /ga dza pā dzi ra tha k+ṣa ye/ /a dī na pu rgyaḥka ru rgya pi pisna sa ma tsin+ta rlag byed g.yul ni rgyas pa der/ /bsod nams mi dman snying rje yis/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa ①yang dag ya ta/ /bi ṣa maḥk+ṣa tra dhas+thā ya ma dhan+d+ra sha ta sasmi taḥ/ /yasmin pā bsams—/ /mi zad khurgyal rigs ④chos 'di ni/ /chos min brgya phrag dag dang ldan/ /ma rungs srog ṇi ba dha kror+yabhazla i t+ya rnyi dhī ya te/ /dhighah+ma ru bye rā dibhi k+ṣa tri yā chags gsod /d+nghapa ni/ /gang du chos zhes ma nor ⑤brjod/ /khrag gis bsgos shing dri ma can/ /rgyal rde ma lbo ma yi/ /kṛ te ya gya pra yah+pho ya tasnro bi ta ma shā shwa tai/ /rigs rnams kyi chos 'di smad/ /gang gi ched du rab 'bad pa'i/ /'tsho ba de yang rtag pa min/ /sā pā ya gya bya pa na pa ra ṇi shir+ya mā ṇa sru ni bye duḥkhosgo baiḥpra ti ha ta bde nyung blo ⑥yis bzod bya 'di ni skyes bu rnams kyi nyon mongs smin/ /gnod pa dang bcas gdung ba'i dh+ri teḥsma r+ya mā ṇa gya pabhā ta/ /so yi sa khyaḥsu kha la ba dhi yā gre sha sā lam du rtag tu nyes ⑦pa nyid gyur cing / /phyi nas dran pas sdug bsngal shugs rings dag gis brtan pa ka gya sum̐ sī sgo ga gyaze ba ta ba ta pa ra pā ṇa ho sā pra yat+naḥ/ /tasmra di 'joms byed pa/ /longs spyod don du kyi hud kyi hud gzhan srog 'tshe la rab tu 'bad/ /de slad 'tshe rda pa ri t+ya bye ho sā : pā pa ni ki ta na/ / tshe chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyi skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/ a dharma bā hu rā dz+re yam̐ dang sdig pa'i gnas/ /chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid 'di/ /yongs su btang la bdag nyid ni/ /ta pa sris+tha na ga mya na/ /rā dzñā ma dzñā na mū ṭ+wā nāsba dha ban+ta na sha dka' thub nags su 'gro bar bya/ /rgyal po mi shes rmongs rnams kyis/ /gsod ⑧dang 'ching ba brgyas tārdzi tī/ /kā laḥ ka pa la ya h+ye ba lasmri ma k+ṣi ṇi kilbi ྾/ /a bsgrubs pa'i/ /sdig pa mi bzad dpal 'byor ni/ /dus kyis khams su yo)byed pa nyid/ /'khor bar 95—648

tsin+tuḥsaṃ sā re ba hu la ta ra mo hā ha ta bye yo sbi ri rā shā brnyibi ṣa ya su kha dus min dag tu bsam yas dus ni stobs dang ldan pa 'dis/ /skyes bu so so dag la bskal ①pa'i mtha' dzā lo ka la ya tsā/ /a kā le kasprarnyi pra ti pu ru ṣa me ṣa pra ti di shaza ni so sor ster byed cing / /shin tu che ba'i rmongs pas blo bcom re ba'i 'ching ba brtan po yis/ /yul lī kā laḥsum̐ sbo ki la bi la se tai saṃ ka la ya ti/ /i ti saṃ tsin+t+ra dṛ pa tip+tagyi bde ba'i tshogs la sems byed skyes bu rnams kyi rtse dga' 'joms/ /zhes pa bsams nas mi bdag ni/ /sā sa pa dzā mu khaḥ/ / daṇ+ḍa babe+e la mā dā ya ya yo ni shi ta po 'tshe ba'i nyon mongs las phyir phyogs/ /dbyug pa shing shun bzung nas ni/ /mtshan mo dka' thub nags ba ā+oṃ/ /ta tastaṅga ma ā+oṃ khru tā lo ke pratshwa r+ya madh+ri ṇaḥ/ /yu dh+ya mā na ma su song / /de nas blon po g.yul zhugs pas/ /de ni song ba thos gyur nas/ /'jig rten la bsgribs do da gra ri sum̐ gardzan+ta mū tsi re/ /ga te na mat+ta mā tai ga ma kṛ thā ga la dgra bo ni/ /sgra sgrogs rgyags pas 'char dzul smras/ /nags su glang chen stsos pa dag /drag po'i sgra ni gardzi tai/ /gha na shasda kṛ tā k+ṣurnyi ni ba sa t+ya tra ke sha rī/ /i ti bru bā ma sgrogs shig /'dir ni seng ge sprin gyi sgra/ /bzod pa min pa rnam par gnas/ /zhes smra brtan pa de zlaḥs ma re dhī rā yu yu bye re pa ram̐/ /te gha na swā mi sad+mā na san+d+ra ha ts+tshan+da bi dag gis/ /rje la khye bya dga' stug po dang / /go chas lus ni rab g.yogs te/ /g.yul du g.yul ni gra hāḥ/ /a tādhe ra ko sha le 6 krāh+ma ṇaḥka pi khā bhe dhaḥ/ /hi ra sgo ban+d+ra rja rab tu bskrad④/ /skabs der ko sa la dag tu/ /bram ze ser skya zhes bya ba/ /rgyal po dbyig gi go cha rā dzñā dha na daṇ+ḍi na r+pā ḍi teḥ/ /ban+dha nā gā ra bi nasta sa mabe+e su ta yisa'atsho —/ /nor kyi chad pas gzir bar gyur/ /ma lus nor byin dbul ba las(khye/ /mang po byin (dz+wab n+ta baḥ/ /daṭ+wā she ṣa dha no bhū rī dā ri rgyadī tu ma k+ṣa maḥ/ /par mi bzod pa/ /bu dang gnyen rnams mtha' dag ni/ /btson kye khang nang du
