ga la ni dhiḥku sha lo ta no ti/ /bha ga ban+d+ra྾ lnga nā ma bi bhā yak+ṣa shis gter gyis 'jig rten dag gi dge ba rgyas par byed/ /me tog can ma zhes pa yikye/ /mtshan rgyu ṇa dā tsa rimra / / bi dza hā ra ha ri shā ta ni ཿ shaṃ ka ha ri ṇa btul nas bcom ldan 'das/ /ri dwags 'phrog byed brtul zhugs ni/ /dogs med ldan pa'i tshal na ba ṣ+pe/ /ta tā nu yā yi na thra ṣ+ṭaḥpu naḥshakre ṇa sa smi taḥ/ /sa pūt+tha tsa bzhugs—/ /der ni rjes song brgya byen gyis/ /slar yang 'dzum ldan dag la dris/ /de yi mngon 37spyod ri tai smṛ twa smi ta kā ra ṇa ma bh+ya dh+wat+pa/ /dā sabe+e ti sa ha drwalda dispyo yu ṣi dza dran gyur nas/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu ni rab tu gsungs/ /lo ni stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /skye bo tshe ring ṣ+pe pu rā/ /a byut+pa hen+d+ra ba t+yā khyu dzi ta swargot+pa bā pu rī/ /ma hen+d+ra se gyur tshe sngon/ /grong khyer dbang chen ldan zhes pa/ /mtho ris dga' ba thul bar gyur/ /der ni nor gyi na i t+yā sīt+ta su ba su ma tī pa tiḥ/ /yabya kre tīr+bhe karngu ra ba t+yā bi ti mi ra blo gros bdag /dbang chen sde zhes bya ba byung / /gang gi grags pa ga pur gyi/ /sdong bus phyogs ni di shaḥ/ /ri pu da dze+e dz+wa ra ha raḥkrerngo dz+dzadru ja shā dzu ྾/ /bya mun bral byas/ /gang zhig sman pa dam pa bzhin/ /dgra yi grags (1pa'i rims bcom zhing / /skabs dharje ṣ+ṭha sa ha swas+thā yaḥsabyer+ya i ba pra dzāḥ/ /ta s+thā bhū ta pu ju saṃ bhā ngan bsten pa'i nad phrogs te/ /skye rgu ④ sred bral rnal gnas bsgrubs/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rnam ra i ba sā kā re ga taḥ/ /pu traḥs two ṣa bho nā ma sarba sa twa hi to bcas nyid/ /gyur pa bzhin du de yi bu/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pa/ /sems can sman zhes bya r+ya taḥ/ /sa bha dra kalbi ka bo bye satwaḥs twa bi bhū ṣi taḥ/ /sa ka bar gyur/ /de ni bskal pa bzang po pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpas brgyan/ /snying rje ru khye mu di to be+e k+ṣa mi tri rde babe+e sgo bha bta/ /pu ra grwa ma ba nān+ta bh+yo dga' dang btang snyoms dang / /byams pa rnams kyi grogs su gyur/ /grong dang grong khyer nags mtha' 95byed669

di shrīpe bh+ya: sadz+dza taḥ / /ro gi no pe bye t+ya sa ta ti ta t+tha r+sha t+yā dang / /phyogs dang gling rnams thams cad nas/ /nad pa 'ongs rnams rtag tu ni/ /de yis reg pas s+thā mā ya yuḥ/ /sa ko gye smiñdza na ba ṣ+pe su dza nabyan+da nā ya te/ /pa ro pa kā ra bsos par gyur/ /skye bo'i nags 'dir dam pa de/ /tsan+dan bzhin du ci yang spyod/ /gang gi (pelus kyi ma ta nun+ta nur+ya su ta no t+ya lam̐/ / sa dī r+gha byā dhi dad+dhā rmā bi da gzhan phan 'digre7/ /mi chung rab tu rgyas par byed/ /chen po'i nad kyis gdungs ①pa rnams/ /de dhe sa ha sa su khaṃ / / durdza nā yā sa ta s+thā rmā mi ba sā dhu sa mā yis 'phral la bde bar bsgrubs/ /ngan pa'i nyon mongs gdung ba rnams/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs ga maḥ/ /ro ge spasgo na sha rī re mā na se dra bi ṇi na tsa/ /kṛ te te pas pa༄bzhin/ /don gnyer rnams kyi lus kyi nad/ /reg pa dang ni sems kyi yang / /nor gyi phrogs nābe+e dzā dik+ṣu nāsto bhūn+da tsa yā tsa kaḥ/ / ta taḥ kā la bi khā se na pas phyogs rnams su/ /nad pa med cing slong med gyur/ /de nas dus kyi rtse dga' ni/ /ngo mtshar sazlu byar+yā pa ha ri ṇa/ /sa ya yo ni dha ā+oṃ shrī mān dza na pu rgya pa rik+ṣa thams cad 'phrog byed pasaṅku/ /skye bo'i bsod nams yongs zad las/ /dpal ldan de ni mtho ris yāta / /su d+dhā shurne tā hūṃ ka ti pa ya di nā swā r+ya ma hi mā k+ṣa ṇas+thā yī song 6/ /bdud rtsi'i zer ni nyin 'ga' mig rnams dag gi myang bya'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /yon tan dri brgaḥsu ra bhi gu ṇa sargaḥsu ma na sī/ /a kā le kā le sgo thra ya ta ra bzang spro ba'i me tog rnams ni skad cig gnas pa'i tshogs/ /dus min dus ni 'dod pas mchog tu sa mu ts+tsha da tsa ru rā bi dhaste ka gye ṣā ki ma pi na ma naḥsha l+ya ka la rmā/ /ye ta dga' ba shin tu gcod la mkhas/ /ci yang 'di ni su yi yid la zug rngu lta bur bsgrub ⑦ma yin/ /gang pe sha lo bi pu la pu rgya pa ṇi ra bābye sad+dhātī bye ṣa dza ma yat+na su zhig yid 'ong bsod nams yangs pa'i zong gis rnyed gyur pa/ /gdung ba kun gyi sman dang 'bad med 95—670

kha k+ṣa ṇi na/ /tat+taju lo kya ki la kā la ka lā ba lbo dha sprudh+waḥsmṛ sharnyi na bi bde ba skad cig gis/ /nges par dus kyi cha yis 'joms pa de de mthong gyur nas/ /blun po rnams ni be ka la baṃ ka dā tsi tra/ /a tha tasmin ya shaḥshe ṣe t+yaghā dwo ra hodzha baṃ/ /dben pa'i cha la nam yang mi reg go/ /de nas de grags lhag ma'i tshe/ /dang po de bral las skyes pa'i/ /duḥ khaṃ swa duḥ khaṃ me bā do bhe dze ro ga ma yādz+dza na ཿ / / la k+ṣa ḍo sdug bsngal btang nas nad rang bzhin/ /skye bo rang gi sdug bsngal bsten/ /de nas gzhon nu dag gi 37dzhaiḥku mā ra gya sha rī ram̐ madh+ri byesta taḥ/ /n+yaste nyi tā ya lo kā dzā ba no pān+ta su lus—/ /mtshan nyid shes pa'i blon po yis/ /nags kyi mtha' ru rab bsrungs te/ /skye bo rnams la rak+ṣi ta/ /tasmin+d+rasnyi rā ṇi ra mya de sha phul+la la tā ku le/ /a parlu phan slad bkod/ /me tog 'khri shing gis rgyas pa/ /rdzing bu dga' ba'i gnas der ni/ /bsod nams ṣi ta me bā sīṭ+wā khru pu sgo pa me ba suḥ/ /ā sha ga tā di gabye bh+yaḥsarba bzhin du de yi lus/ /rnying dzupa med pa nyid du gnas/ /re bas phyogs mtha' las 'ong /dāpa/ /nad ro gi ga ṇaḥpu naḥ/ /ta su saṃ spar+sha mā tre ṇa sa ha sā swasgra tsā ya yuḥ/ /taḥpa'i tshogs kun sbar yang ni/ /de yis yang dag reg tsam gyis/ /'phral la bsos pa nyid du gyur/ /de spriṣ+ṭa mā ru ta bī gha sbyi ta pad+ma ṣaṇ+ḍa nyiṇ+ḍa ra maṇ+ḍa na dza lā su sa ro yis reg pa'i rlung gi rgyarnam bskyod pad+ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /chu la rgyu bas brgyan pas mtsho skyes can gye dza m+bi 6/ /rtswa tā be+e muk+ta sa ka lā ma ya nirgya pā pāḥr+pā tā mṛ tā i ba ba chu la ni/ /khrus byas mtha' dag nad las rnam grol skyon dang bral gyur cing / /'phral la nyid du mi bhūḥ sa ha se ba maṭ+wā ཿ / / satwo ṣa dha ku mā ro yaḥso ha me ba ta rnams bdud rtsi 'thungs bzhin rab tu mdzes/ /gang gi ming ni bsgrags nyid kyis/ /nad rnams zad pa dā bha baṃ/ /ya su saṃ tīrta na ṣ+pe ba yā gyarnyi byā dha yak+ṣa ya/ /sma ri 6 tosmṛ ti suzlo nyid 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig gzhon nu sems can sman/ /der ni nga nyid de tshe gyur/ /dran pa'i bdud rtsi dag 95—671

ma mai tī yaḥka thā ma pi/ /a dhi byā bye ma ya duḥkhaṃ ta su shādhi mu pe ྾ gi 7 gtam/ /'di dag su zhig dran na yang / /de yi nad gdung rang bzhin byi/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bar ti / /a sho ko nā ma de shesmin kā le not+paṣ+ṭha te dṛ paḥ/ /rtsa bye hi tā ya 'gyur—/ /dus kyis yul 'dir mi yi bdag /gang zhig (khya'ajig rten la phan be+ed/ /mchod rten rab gnas lo ka gya yaḥpra tijo pa yi6 ti/ /i ti su ga to di ta che ka bye yā khru tī bā ma byed 'gyur ba'i/ /mya ngan med ces bya ba 'byung 3/ /'chi med rgyal po'i blo gcig gis/ /bde gshegs kyis ra rā dzaḥ/ /haste bi lā sa bi kā shi ta ba da na ru tsā bi ra rā dza/ /i ti bshad 'di thos nas/ /dga' ba'i rol pa rnam rgyas pa'i/ /bzhin gyi (47'od kyis rnam par mdzes/ /zhes pa k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī sa two ṣa bye dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las nā mā ba dā dze+e tsa tuḥpalnga shaḥpal+la waḥ// //sems can sman zhes bya ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //tsin+ta ma ṇiḥki la bi tsi ti ta bstu dā tā kalpa dru mabya pa ri kalpi yid bzhin nor bu nges par rnam bsams dngos po ster byed cing / /dpag bsam shing yang yongs ta me ba pū te / / ta gya stu to sa mu tsi tā ni pa dā ni kā ni su brtags se pa kho na byed par byed/ /lus ni rab sbyin dam tshig dag la rang yonyid brtson pa gang / /de ha pra dā na sa ma ye swa ya mu r+ya to yaḥ/ /ghā ṭā pa ghā ṭa ko shastu bi ni yod+ma de dag bstod la yang dag 'os pa'i tshig ni gang zhig yin/ /ghā ṭa klu.a pa ghā ṭa ka /smyo byed gsang ba da gu khya kau/ /ke shi byā kā na nā dan+yad+ma na man+tarti to ya yo/ /pāsmṛt+ta pa btul nas/ /skra can nags las mi snang bar/ /ston pa nags tshal gzhan du gshegs/ /der ni sma ra ṇa sme ra ba da naḥ smi ta kā ra khaṃ/ / sa ta tra thra ṣ+ṭaḥshakre ṇa sngon byung dran gyur nas/ /bzhin 'dzum mdzad la 'dzum pa'i rgyu/ /brgya byen gyis ni gus pas dris/ /95—672

pra ṇa yah+phu na ra bra bīta/ /a khyut+pat+tha ti nā ma ba sa tiḥsadze+e sadza de yis slar yang rab gsungs pa/ /grong khyer thams cad ldan pa zhesanyasna / /nor bu'i ba gam nam mkha' dzā / /na ga rī ga ga nā la ga ma ṇi har+ghaṃ shu ha si byā/ /ā pit+parba da la—/ /reg pa'i 'od zer rgod pa can/ /phun tshogs kun gyi gnas su gyur/ /der ni rgyal po'i zla ba dasta snga rā byen+d+ra ra ma larlu tiḥ/ /ya gya tri byu ba nabyosgo ba r+bha tīr+bheji dag /dri med 'od ldan kun ster ①byung / /gang gi grags pa zla 'od kyis/ /srid gsum nyin dang bī ni shaṃ/ /sho bhā dzu ṣaḥsu kṛ ta sā ra da shaṃ bi she ṣerlabhasbi tirbi na ya mtshan mor mdzes/ /mdzes ldan legs byas snying po'i gnas skabs dag gi khyab 1par gyis/ /'dul ba ṭ+wā ni bha tra rū r+bhe ཿ / / ya gya ya yo bi dza ya ma ṇ+ḍa na di ṇ+ḍi ba'i lam du gnas pa thob cing gzugs bzang ldan gyur pa/ /gang gi legs smra dul ba'i rgyan ldan sgrog (ri ma two dā ṣ+pe na kuñdza ra pa te ri ba sā dhu bā deḥ/ /sa ka dā tsin+d+ra dzā kār+ya pa'i rnga nyid du/ /sbyin pa gyur te glang po'i bdag po dag gi bzhin du'o/ /nam zhig sa yi brgya byen de/ /dar+sha nā nu gra horlu khaḥ/ /bhedze bā dh+yā ga nas+thā na bhu baṃ bhū mi sha ta kra skye rgu'i (snyebya ba lta byed cing / /rjes su gzung zhe7la mngon phyogs pas/ /phyi rol khyams gnas sa gzhi duḥ / /sa ta tā nan+ta sā man+ta mo li rasne 6 bim+bi taḥ/ /shu shā ba dṛ zi bsten—/ /der ni mtha' yas rgyal phran gyi/ /mgo bo'i rin chen la snang des/ /lus ni grangs med bi kār+ya ma saṃ khye ri ba bi gra haiḥ/ /tsan+d+ra kān+ta ma ye ta gya saṃ krād+dhāḥpra ṇa tāḥdag gi bzhin/ /sa yi bya ba thos par gyur/ /de yi rkang stegs zla shel gyi/ /rang bzhin la ni 'phos pu raḥ / /pā dā sī thi pu na byen+ta tā paṃ ta r+ya dzu rabe+e na / /a gyur cing / /mdun du rab btud slong ba rnams/ /slar yang bsam pa'i gdung ba btang / /skabs tān+ta re sa dra sta sa bak+ṣa k+ṣa ya i bā ga tiḥ/ /pā ra ba taḥk+ṣi ti pa te der phug ron rab skrag cing / /'dab gshog zad pa bzhin du ni/ /'gro ba med pas 7sa bdag gisanya/ /95—673

rū ru mū la ma shi shri yata/ /ta kā ta ra ta ro tra bhā ta ṣ+pe tram̐ saṃ ko tsi tsā ga kai/ /byen pa'i rtsa ba 47rab tu bsten/ /rab skrag mig ni 'khrul thu byed cing / /yan lag kun tu 'khums pa de④/ /dṛṭ+wā da yā bhe dhe yo bhū ta sa ha sā thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /sā muh+phul+la ka ma khā lī mthong nas sa yi bdag po ni/ /'phral la brtse ba'i dbang du gyur/ /'di yi 'jigs pa gang las shes/ /ka ma li m+bi i bā ga tiḥ/ /ku to gya bha ya mi t+ya shā —bye shī k+ṣi pre bya lo ka rab rgyas pad+ma'i 'phreng ldan gyisalgo/ /pad+mo can ltar 'od gsal ba'i/ /spyan gyis myur du phyogs rnams yata / /tasmin+da ba sa re satwa dzi dzñā su pā ka shā sa naḥ/ /ma ya yā bltas / /skabs/ der smin pa gsod byed ni/ /snying stobs brtag par 'dod pa yi⑤/ /sgyu mas rngon lud+dhā kā kā raḥs ma bye r+ya bra tī dṛ paṃ/ /de ba muñtsa bi tsā tāp+ta bha spyo ma ma pa'i rnam par ni/ /'ongs nas mi bdag la smras pa/ /lha gcig ⑥ yun ring na rnyed pa'i/ /bdag gi bi haṃ ga oṃ/ /i yo naḥs ha dzā bṛt+ta ra na dṛt+ta ra yā tsa nā/ /ni bza' ba bya de thong / /'di ni ma basbangs mi kruzlog pa'i/ /bdag cag lhan skyes 'tsho ba yin/ /'gro sarga sedha me tad+me sgo dza ṣ+pe dza ga tī pa te/ /t+ya dza to dz+re bi haṃ naste pra rja ba'i bdag po bdag gi zas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni grub pa 'di/ /med na 'tsho ba gtong bar 'gyur/ /t+ya sha na dh+wa ra shāḥ/ /k+ṣa ṇi tasmin+da shats+tsha dād+ma yi sa t+yak+ta dz+re bi te/ /gang phyer sgyu8 zas ni srog gi zungs9sna/ /dus 'dir zas ni chad pa las/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba btang gyur na//bi naṣ+ṭha ti bi lubhā shā sa pu tā me ku j-i bi m+bi/ /a ka saṃ k+ṣa be+e bdag gi khyim thab bu dang bcas/ /re ba chad pas rnams 7nyams 'gyur/ /chos ldan gang gis gcig ṣ+pe ba yaḥka ro ti ba hu rak+ṣa yam̐/ /sa dhasgro ya tra dharmāt+ta ta dharma ste tra tī tre nyid ni/ /bsrungs pas gang du mang po dag /chos las nyams par gyur na bye67/ /de la chos ni ci zhig shaḥ / /ma yi pā rā ba t+yā spru t+yā na dwo ṣa kartu marta se/ /na hi kā ra ṇa rā ge 'dra—/ /phug ron la ni byams pa yis/ /bdag la zhe sdang bya mi 'os/ /gang phyir khyod nyid lta bu ni/ /95—674

ṇa pra brtarnye bha bdwo joḥ/ /ya dze+e bā yo ta dze+e bā haṃ ko bi she khasta bā ba yoḥ/ /sgyu ldan chags pas 'jug pa min/ /ji ltar 'di nyid de bzhin bdag /khyed stil nged gnyis bye brag ci/ /sarba bhū ta sa maḥsan+taḥkṛ sārja ka t+pa kut+tha te/ /i truste te na dṛ pa tidhī dam pa 'byung po kun la snyoms/ /gcig la brtse ba byed pa min/ /des 'di smras tshe mi bdag gi /dz+wa ka ka na rā bī rja/ /ṣ+pe bha ta bya mi tī bā ha kha gi prats+tsha r+ya pā ṇi lag pa gdub ①bu'i sgra ldan pas/ /'jigs par mi bya zhes smra bzhin/ /bya ni phyag gis rab bsgribs (1 nā—/ /sa ta taḥsnagha dzī rū ta sgo ṣa gaspyo ra ya mi ba/ /u bā tsa saza te—/ /de nas sems can gzir ba kun/ /yongs bskyab dus ni byas pa yisti/ /char sprin 'jam pa'i satātrī pa ri tā ṇa kṛ ta k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /ma kṛ thaḥk+ṣa ṇa dṛ s+t+yadhī be+e ṣa rma sgra dbyangs ltar/ /zab pa'i tshig gis rab smras pa/ /skad cig tshim pa don gnyer bas/ /mi bzad pā ṇi bai sha ma/ /tu mya bya thā bi kā ro yo pā ṇa sne haḥsha rī ri r+ghaṃ/ /srog chags gsod ma ⑤byed/ /lus can srog la chags pa yi/ /gdung ba'i rnam 'gyur mtshungs pa nyid/ /pa ra sru shā pa ha re ṇa yā dṛtiḥpa ri kasbya te/ /ni bṛk+ṣiṃḥgre ya sī ma gzhan gyi srog ni phrogs pa yis/ /gang zhig yongs su 'tsho byed pa/ /de yi dge legs ldog 'gyur te/ /nyi pā pa tā paṃ pra yats+tsha te/ /a dhu nai wā pa ristsodz+re ni dzets+tsha sasma tā da re/ /gang phyir sdig pa'i gdung ba ster/ /da lta nyid du ma chad par/ /rang 'dod yang dag bzhed cing gus/ /kṛ khya tā ma sha rna yar+yad+ma daza mu pa kalpi tai/ /khru te nyi rā dza ba tsa dz+wa bdag gi ⑥ don du zas gang gang / /nye bar bsgrubs pa blang bar mdzod/ /ces pa rgyal po'i tshig thos pa ri rla nā na nāḥ shwa pa na / / ba ro ba bye ga bi ma nāḥ pra t+ya nas—/ /yongs su bzhin log shugs rings can/ /longs spyod mchog la yid byung ba'i/ /rngon pas bhā ṣa ta lubha kaḥ/ /na pa yo rā dza sgo gā rmā ra sā dzñā ba na bā se naḥ/ /lan ni rab smras pa/ /bdag cag nags na gnas rnams kyis/ /rgyal po'i longs spyod ro mi shes/ /95—675

na hi sha snga sha na nās+thā sā mo dadhe mo da kai mṛ gāḥ/ /a lad+dhā niju tram̐ ma 'bru zas nyams su ma stsong ba'i/ /ri dwags la dus dga' ma yin/ /tsher ma'i 'khri shing 'dab med mya ru pa ri tsi tsā kaspyo ka la tsā ba ṣ+pe sdisnya shā me ki ma pi ka ra bhaḥshu 6 ti shu ngan dag la yongs 'dris ma thob nas/ /nags tshal ljang zhing snum par khyernga mo mya ngan dag gis ci yang tsā—/ /na kā kaḥsat+yā shaṃ ka ba la ya ti tsū tai bi ṣ+ṭha/ mi ba swa bhā bā dzñā bhe skam—/ /tsū (27ta rab smin dug bzhin bya rog gis ni za bar mi byed de/ /rang bzhin dag gi ①dbye bas dā du tsi ta mi ha sat+tha su su kha rda/ /rā dzārta sgo gi bhughā r+ya zwa tasnyok+ta smi ki pu 'os pa 'dir ni kun la bde ba sterang/ /rgyal la 'os zas ding zos nas/ /nang par slar yang bdag ci naḥ / /tadhaste su kha mā dhadhe ya da n+ya byu na durla r+ghaṃ/ /ra so dā rā za—/ /gang zhig nyin gzhan rnyed dka' min/ /de dag zos na bde ba skyed⑤/ /rgya che ro ldan kha zas ha re na hi pa ri tsi tashā ti bi ra san+da tiṣ+ṭha bye kā tī ba hu pa ri dza nā ram̐ bha yongs 'dris ro dang bral ba zad snyemi byed/ /'khor gye rtsom pa mang por lhung ⑦ rnams gcig pu nyid du ba ti tai/ /ra thā ru bhāḥpabh+yo ma ma na sa ma ye sho tsa ti ta rā ma bābhārba bye gnas mi byed/ /shing rta zhon pa rkang pas 'gro ba'i dus na shin tu mya ngan byed/ /don thob nyams na mi shaḥka ṣa ti bi ṣa ma kle sha pa ru ṣaḥ/ /de ba twadṛ ṭ+wā dṛṭ+wā rmā sa ta tai bzad nyon mongs rtsub mor byeshin tu gdung bar byed/ /lha gadrug rmyergyal po la 'os zas/ /khrod kyi spyan be+e ba durlu dzha/ /rā dzārta sgo dza rna ki tu dzad+ma pūrde na me pri yo/ /gyis gzigs rnams la/ /rtag tu rnyed dka' min mod kyang / /skye bar sngon med bdag mi dga'/ /mṛ ga yā bhi ha tai mād+mā mas+thā kai dzī bi tā ya te/ /tagrwa de ha sa mu྾trī rngon pas mngon par bsad pa'i sha /bdag cag rnams kyi srog ltar spyod/ /des na rang lus rab chod la/ /kha shaṃ dī gu ṇa mar+bha tsā/ / tsit+ta ba ṣaṇ+ḍaḥshu tī tarbe tsa rgo sa ha sā dṛ bya yi nyis ⑫'gyur sbyin par mdzod/ /mi bdag bsam pa 'khrugs pa yis/ /tshig de thos nas 'phral la 95—676

paḥ / /pra har+ṣah+phul+la na ya rmā sgo ru hasta ma bhā ṣa taḥ/ /kha ga gya ta ba tsa pā ni—/ /dga' bas spyan gyi chu skyes dag /rab tu rgyas pas de la smras/ /bya dang khyod kyi srog dag ni/ /zla rak+ṣu ma tu l+ya saṃ sha yi/ /ma mo pa diṭ+wāḥspasgo ya mu pā yaḥsu dhi yā twa bsrung slad mtshungs pa'i the tshom la/ /blo bzang khyod kyi thabs 'di ni/ /gsal bar bdag la nye bar yā—/ /u bha ya pā ṇa san+de ha do lā ro ha ṇa bi hwa lo/ /twa ma ba j-i ti bstan—/ /gnyis ka'i srog la the tshom byisahu/ /khyogs la zhon pas 'khrugs gyur pa/ /bdag gi yid ni mā nī tai ba ya gye ṣ+pe ba me ma naḥ/ /twa dh+riṣ+ṭi pā sha ba sgo yo bi ha grogs kyis bzhin/ /khyod nyid kyis ni brtan par byas/ /khyod kyi 27mig zhags kyis bcings pa'i bya gaḥpra ti mu tsu hūṃ/ /mad+ma me+eḥkṛ ya tsā tā batro saṃ pra ti pā ṇa dh+wa ra rde/ /'di rab tu gtang bar mdzod/ /da lta nyid du bdag gis 1shis/ /re zhig srog gi gzungs thag mdzod/ /rā dzñā sa t+ya pra ti zlo na ka ru rgya di byu dī ri nyiḥ/ /a mā t+yā mu mu hum+bi d+dhā rgyal po dam bcas 'den ④pa yis/ /snying rje las ni 'di brjod tshe/ /dug ldan mda' yis phug pa be+e ṣa dighiḥsha ri ri ba/ /na dā nā ba sa re bā h+ye sa ci baidz+re nyi tā nyi bzhin—/ /blon po rnams ni rmongs par gyur/ /sbyin pa'i skabs su phan mi phan/ /grogs kyis bdag la tā hi tai/ /i t+ya khyut+pa ma yasta gya sha rī ra t+yā ga ni: yaḥ/ /a tha bra bīn+da brjod mi bya/ /zhes pa de yi dam tshig gis/ /lus ni gtong bar nges par gyur/ /de nas mi bdag ra pa ti stasmi pitrī pra yats+tsha taḥ/ /tu l+ya mā ro pa ya nyi me rmā sa muthoṣ+ṭha gis smras pa/ /gang zhig bdag gi lus las sha /bcad nas srang la ⑤'debs byed pa/ /de la nor ni yasta noḥ/ /hi ra sgo babhā ṇa rā dzñā sa mā tū tāsta to dza naḥ/ /ku kah+ma rab tu sbyin⑥/ /de nas rgyal po gser gyi char/ /'bebs klapas bos pa'i skye bo rnams/ /ngan pa'i ku ṇi ta bye yaḥpi dh+wa ya shra ba ṇi ya yuḥ/ /e ka stu dā ru ṇa ma tir na: las kyi blo rmus phyin/ /rna ba bsgribs shing song bar gyur/ /gdug pa'i blo zhes bya ba gcig /ser skya'i 95—677

ka pi la dzi ga laḥ/ /a bhuṅka na ka mā dā ya san+da dheḥkru ra karma ṇiḥ/ /sa mig ni ser po yis/ /gser dag blangs nas gdug pa yi/ /las la chas su zhugs par gyur/ /gdug ra lahrī dā dak+ṣu rde ba krā rde tsa ni sarga taḥ/ /kra kā tsā nā mi ba kroṭ+wā ta pa'i las ni sog le bzhin/ /drang po gcod la mkhas gyur cing / /rang bzhin gyis ni 'khyog ① pa yi/ /ki ma kṛ h+ye du rād+ma dzā/ /na shas+t+ri shashrī yaju da 'a snye ti taṅge li pa tsa sā gdug pa'i bdag nyid ci mi byed/ /gang gi 37mtshon kyis mi nus de dag kyal ka'i tshig gis 'joms par na sha kyi ya d+ma hūṃ ki ma pi ku ru te ta ts+tsha sa ha sā/ / na sha kyi byed—/ /gang zhig brjod par mi nus ci yang de dag 'phral la sgrub ⑦par byed/ /gang zhig bya bar mi kaju yat+ta da pi kā la ya bye ba ma na sā kha laḥsathrubyaṅgi ki ra ti tsa ri tai nus de dag kyang ni yid kyis sems par byed/ /ma bsdams glang (chopo dag gi ⑤spyod pas ngo mtshar thams ra pra ti ha taḥ/ /sa pā rā ba ta mā ro pya tu khā ma tha ma hi pa tiḥ/ /dak+ṣi cad rgyas par byed/ /de nas de yis phug ron ni/ /srang la gzhal nas sa bdag gis⑥/ /byin pa ḍo rka sa muskṛ r+ghaṃ mābe+e tabhu l+ya mā da dhe/ / pra tha me ra tha bhū bhartuḥgayas pa'i sha dag ni/ /rab bcad de dang mtshungs par bkod/ /de nas sa yi bdag po yi⑦/ /khrag smṛṣ+ṭa ru bye ra bin+d+ra bhiḥ/ /bizlaṇ+ḍi mā nā su tsi re bi hwa le bā bha bad+ma tī/ /zigs dang po reg pa yithu/ /'khrugs pa bzhin du sa gzhi ni/ /yun ring rnam par g.yos par gyur/ /pā rā ba te tha gu ru tsā mādz+re tsa la ghu tsā ga te/ /dī ya tā mā n+ya duskṛṣ+ṭha rmā sa de nas phug ron phyi ba dang / /sha ni yang ba nyid gyur tshe/ /sha ni gzhan dag rab chod la/ /byin zhes mi t+yā ha byu pa tiḥ/ /kṛsto ru bhu dza rmā se bi na pāste kha gi tu be+e hūṃ/ /sa yi bdag pos smras/ /brla dang dpung pa'i sha bcad kyang / /bya dang mtshungs pa nyid ma gyur/ /tre lo kya saṃ sha ya tu lā mā ru ro ha tu khādṛ pa taḥ/ /dz+re pa to swa ya 'jig rten gyi ni the tshom dang / /mtshungs pa'i sang (sgo7 der mi bdag bzhugs⑩/ /mi bdag chu rgyus lhag 95—678

ma rū snye rtswa yu she ṣa ta kau tu dze+e/ / ta t+yā gā durga hoji ghā ya yo ma'i lus/ /rang nyid srang la 'dzegs pa'i tshe/ /de yi gtong ba bzung gyodaka' bas/ /yid byung tīrtardi garnya ram̐/ / tasmin k+ṣa ṇi k+ṣi ti pa te ra pa ri k+ṣa te nā bye bye grags pa phyogs mtshams khrusong / /de yi dus na sa yi bdag po dag gi brtan pa 'di sna/ /nyams pa med ṇa bisma ya ma yaste da shaṃ ga nā dzñā/ /masmabe+e mā l+ya pa ri pū ri ta pā ṇi pad+maḥpas ya mtshan gyur pa'i lha yi bu mo rnams/ /gtsug phud 'phreng (d+nghabar 'os pa'i pad+mos yongs gang lag pa pū dzā da raḥki ma pi tats+tsha ri tā ba bhū baḥ/ /nim+bi kā ram̐ sa mā lokya yis—/ /de yi stispyod tshul dag la mchod pa'i gus pa ci yang byung / /rnam 'gyur med par sa yi bdag /tu la rū zwa ma tī pa ti/ /spyu ra kā rī sa pa prats+tsha pu ru ṣa ste sa sā yā saḥ/ /a srang la 'dzegs pa mthong gyur nas/ /skyes bu gdug pa byed pa po/ /skrag bcas 6de yis de la dris/ /lus ṣ+pe na de ha dā ṣ+pe na na dzā ṣ+pe ki ta pebe+e ti/ /sazla khā bha sa ma re bha sha rī rārja kyi sbyin pa 'di yis ni/ /khyod ni ci bzhed yongs 1mi shes/ /gang phyir lus can rnyed pa kun/ /yang dag hi de hi ram̐/ /sa bye bru hi ta nu t+yā ge tsir+ghaṃ ya di na khaṇ+ḍi tai/ /i ti rtsom pa lus kyi don/ /gal te lus ni btang la sems/ /nyams pa med dam bden par smras/ /zhes smras 8snabru bā rde haṃ rā dzā ba bhā ṣe sa smi tā na naḥ/ /na pā pya maste me kiñtsita lo kesmisko de la rgyal po ni/ /bzhin 'dzum ldan pas rab smras pa/ /'jig rten 'di na thob bya ni/ /bdag la ci yang twa nu tat+ta dzā/ /hi tā ya sarba dza ga hūṃ samyahūṃ bo bye marja ye/ /a khaṇ+ḍi ta med mod kyi⑨/ /'gro ba kun la phan pa'i slad/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /gal te bdag gi mi rda tsit+ta ya di sa bye na te na me/ /astu pra kṛ ti mā pa.oṃ sha rī ra ma sems 'di ni/ /nyams pa med ⑫na bden pa des/ /lus ni yongs su ma nyams shing / /rang bzhin rdzogs pa ri k+ṣa tai/ /i sgo dī ri ta mā tre ṇa sa t+ya shī la su khyu pa teḥ/ /al+lī ba pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa brjod pa tsam nyid kyis/ /sa bdag bden pa'i ngang tshul gyisapa/—rta/ /lus kyi rma 95—679

tsan+d+ra ru tsi ram̐ rū bhā bra ṇa ma bhūd+ma suḥ/ /ta taḥpā rā ba te pa te lubha ke ni rab gsos 1 te/ /ma nyams zla ba ltar mdzes gyur/ /de nas phug ron rngon pa dag /song zhing sa ba ma hot+pa baḥ/ /bhū pā la bhā swa du da ye pra kā sha bi bha po bha bta/ /sasban+da daḥskyong 'od ldan ni/ /shar tshe spro ba chen po dang / /rab gsal 'byor pa ldan par gyur/ /gang zhig nges k+ṣi ti pa tiḥki la yo ba byu bā so haṃ bi ṣe ga pu ru ṣaḥs mde ba dat+taḥ/ /taj-it+ta par sa yi bdag po thams cad ster gyur pa/ /de nyid nga yin skyes bu ser skya de yang lha sbyin (ṭ+wāno/ /de yi saṃ sma ra ṇa ta ཿ pra mṛ ta smi to haṃ shu two ti shāstu rā ma rā bye pa sngon byung yang dag dran nas bdag gis 1'dzum pa spyos/ /zhes pa ston pa las thos 'chi med bdag po tin+da nan+dan/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa dga' bar gyur/ /zhes 4pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag la tā yī sat+than+da dā ba dā rna pañtsa pañtsa shaḥpabe+e waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las thams cad ster ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //san+dar+sha ṣ+pe na ye ྾ dz+wa ṣa bi ṣeṣ+ṭha pra shārnyi mu pa yārnyi/ /a mṛ ta gang dag mthong bas zhe sdang dug gi ni/ /tsha ba rab tu zhi ba nyid gyur cing (5/ /bdud rtsi'i ro ra sa shī ta laste ka su na su dza nan+da bo bad+dhā/ /dh+wa rā mu kha sur+ya k+ṣa gya bsel skye bo dam pa yi6/ /zla ba de dag su yi phyag 'os min/ /gnod sbyin kha rnon dag gi gnas/ /de s+thā nā dadhirda tasta taḥ/ /k+ṣa shā da bā pa bha ga ban+da ga ram̐ ho gu marda ā+oṃ/ /bi las snang ba min gyur te/ /grong khyer hing gu ma da 7nar/ /skad cig gis ni bcom ldan byon/ /der na yāsbo dzi tasta dra bra h+ma daste na bhū bhu dzā/ / ta྾ da k+ṣi khaṃ tsakre dha ni sa bdag tshangs byin she gyis/ /dul ba yi she ni mchod pa byas/ /de yis yang dag rjes mthun par/ /t+yā nā ma nu shā sa rna/ / ta tra po rāḥs ma bye t+ya bha ga brnyi bya dz+reṇ+ḍi skal ldan rnams la rjes bstan mdzad/ /der ni grong pa rnams 'ongs te/ /rgud pa kun tu lus can 95—680

6ཿ / /san+d+ra sabe+e ni pa te 6 tā tā ram̐ sarba de hi dzā/ /bha ga ban+daste rnams—/ /rnam par lhung la skyob mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'das la rab gsol pa/ /grong khyer mtha' na ga ra t+yādhe sā ṣā ṇasaza taḥ/ /ta tra go pā la ko nā gaḥhrū ro ba sa na bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo ba yi ni ri zhig yod/ /de na klu ni ba lang skyong / /drag po bzod par 7ti duḥs haḥ/ /sa pa shu ā+oṃ dzi nā nāñtsa sha snga nāñtsa ma hā sha niḥ/ /sadzaspyo dka' ba gnas/ /de ni phyugs dang skye bo dang / /'bru rnams kun gyi rdo rje che/ /phun sum tshogs nā ma bhā bā ya na bid+maḥke na nim+bi taḥ/ /a dān+ta da ma na gyasmin+da shān+ta rnams dngos med slad/ /ca ⑫yis rnam sprul rig ma gyur/ /ma dul 'dul mdzad ma zhi ba/ /zhi mdzad sha ma na su te/ /u pa sarge kṛ pās+thā shaṃ shar ṇa sha ra ṇi ṣi ṇa ma/ /i khyod kyi brtse ba ni/ /nye bar 'tshe ba 'di dag la/ /bdag cag skyabs 'tshol (kyirnams kyi skyabs/ /zhes t+yāghā te 6 dh+wa te 6 bha ga bān ka ru rja ni byeḥ/ /an+tad+ngha ta pra bhā ma dh+yāta ya brjod de dag song ba'i tshe/ /bcom ldan snying rje'i gter dag ni/ /'dus pa'i dbus las mi snang bar/ /yo pā ṣā ṇa khyu dha raḥ/ /ta gre bi saṃ ka ṭi ta su bha ban dī ma sgo gi naḥ/ /rdo ba'i sa 'dzin dag tu gshegs/ /de ngos shin tu snyug po na/ /'jigs rung gdengs can khang pa ni/ /sa da dar+sha bi ṣa shā so ri ba byā m+bi kṛ to da rka/ /tsa larjasko ṣa nisbyi dug gi dbugs rnams dag gis nguchu/ /sngon por byas bzhin de yis mthong / /ral gri shubs med g.yo sha bi ṣa mormi ba nā ku le / / ta byā re bha ga bān+d+ra dheḥ pa rlo ka sa ba yi/ /mi bzad rba ⑪rlabs kyis 'khrugs nags/ /de yi 'gram du bcom ldan gyis/ /skyil krung mu pā bi sha ta / / pra sa n+d+ra lo ka na su jo ba sgo nā sni bha tsak+ṣu bcas te nye bar bzhugs/ /mnyes gyegashin spyan ni bdud rtsi'i gnyen/ /dang bas rab tu gzigs pa ṣa—/ /sa ni nā shu sa bi ṣe bi ṣe nidz+re ṣa tā mi ba/ /dī dze+e bu bim+bi yis—/ /de yis myur bar dug bzhin du/ /dug dang bcas pa dug med thob/ /sku lus gser 'od 95—681

ta ta nu sa ba r+bha ka na kablu tiḥ/ /ra birma ra ka tats+tsha yi gā ha mā na i r+pā ba mthing ga shā/yi/ /chu la snang bas de rab mdzes/ /ma ra ka ta ltar mdzes pa'i/ /mkha' la nyi ma 'gro ba re / /ti mi re nā ga bha ba ṣ+pe tah+phu kā sha bi su tri tai/ /pa lā ya ma bzhin—/ /de yi snang bas rnam bcom pas/ /klu yi khang par rab rib rnams/ /'bros par byed pa n+ya byā lo la byā la dza lā tu dze+e ya yo/ /nā ga rā dzasta 7nā lokya ru bye rā ru ṇa g.yo ba yi/ /sbrul gye tshogs dang mtshungs par gyur/ /klu yi rgyal pos de mthong nas/ /mig ni khrag ltar lo tsa naḥ/ /sa ha sā kā sha mā bi sh+ya tsakre me+e gha ma yo dza gatro/ /kro dh+wasni dhū dmar ba yis/ /'phral la nam mkhar rab zhugs te/ /'gro ba sprin gyi rang bzhin byas/ /de yi khro ba'i ma na ba tai ri ba ta gya gha noṅga be+eḥ/ /bi trulja hai ra kadzan+ta di gaḥpan+t+ra me yis ni/ /du ba'i tshogs bzhin stug po las/ /rab 'thon glog gi lce rnams kyis/ /phyogs rnams se tā i ba/ /gardzi tain+d+rat+ta me ghā dzā pra lā yā ram̐ bha gi si bhaḥ/ /skrag pa bzhin du 'dar/ /stsos pa'i sprin rnams dag gi sgra/ / 'jigs pa rtsom ⑤par sgrogs byed pas/ /gu hā ge hā n+ya bha khyan+ta dṛ da yā m+bi ba bhū z-i hūṃ/ /ta taḥpiṣ+ṭa kra ma sa 'dzin rnams kyi snying bzhin du/ /phug dang khang pa zhom par gyur/ /de nas rdo chen tshogs dkrigs bṛṣ+ṭiḥklibhā dri sa ka lā ba lī/ /sā da pa pā ti ta dh+ri tiḥsnyu lo pa la char / /ri 'phreng mtha' dag nyon mongs shing / /brtan pa thong bye byed ljon shing ni/ /phye mar byed pa ku lā ku lā/ /bā duṣ+ṭa bhu dza godṛ ṣ+ṭa dṛṣ+ṭi n+d+ra ṣ+ṭi ba tā yi naḥ/ /ya bab ‘5snapar gyur/ /lag 'gro gdug pas rab spros pa'i/ /char de skyob khyapas gzigs nyid na/ / rlung yo bā lā ni lo lalbā sa la pa ta ku su ma ba r+ṣa tī / /dṛ ṭī pra kā bzhon g.yo bas bskyed pa yis/ / 7me tog char pa nyid du gyur/ /der phyani rab gsal dri med nags bi ṣa da dā n+ya nu pa bla bā ni byusgo pa gī ta ku su mā ni ba nāni ta tra/ /har+ṣa tshal nye bar bslad pa med/ /bung ba glu dbyangs len pa'i me tog dang ldan mthong byur nas/ /dga' 95—682

smi ta pra sa ra nirdzi ta bhā ra hā rāḥspyu ram̐ pha bhān+d+ra ma ba dasba na de ba'i 'dzum dkrigs do shal khur las nges par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /nags kyi lha yis gdug pa'i gdengs can ba tā sta / / sgoḥ kā la me gha ni kṛ ti pa ri muñtsa kiñtsaniṣ+ka dza e dbang po de la smras/ /kye lags dus kyi sprin dag 1sternam 'gyur dag ni yongs su thobaX / /khyod lta bu ba ka na kā tsa la e ṣa ya gya/ /yuṣ+ṭha dī dh+waḥpra la ya mā ru ta bha rnams 'jigs ② pa'i rlung gis bcom par gyur pa na/ /gang gi rked skabs phug gi rol pas rnyi skyabs su bye mā nā lī lā ni tadza ku ha ram̐ sha ra khaṃ pra yārja/ /ta taḥsar+ya pa ri k+ṣu ṇa ma daḥ'agro byed pa'i/ /gser gyi ri bo 'di la ci yang g.yo ba med pa nyid/ /de nas 'phral la rgyags pas 5snani/ /saṃ t+ya k+ṣa bi kṛ yaḥ/ /nā gaḥshāsta ram bye t+ya pra na nā ma kṛ tā ñdza yongs su zad cing rnam 'gyur btang / /thal mo sbyar nas mngon phyogs te/ /klu yis ston pa la phyag liḥ —/ / ta gya dza ta gya sha ra rde bha ga baṅka ru shā ni byeḥ/ /shik+ṣu 'tshal—/ /bcom ldan 'das ni snying rje'i gter/ /babe+eb pa'i gnas dag rab byin ramupas/ /skyabs su pa da pra dbya kre ku sha khā gra ma nu gra haṃ/ /pra ṇa ya dbe+e taste na tsa ra rja song bar gyur pa de/ /dge ba mchog la rjes bzung mdzad/ /zhabs la mgo yis gtugs pa dedz+wa/ /gus pa dze+e na mo li nā/ /sa ta tai ta gya bha ga bān sa: bye bi da dhe dzi naḥ/ /tasmin+da yis ni gsol btab pa/ /bcom ldan rgyal bas rtag tu ni/ /de la yang dag nye bar mdzad/ /gnas skabs ba sa re ta tra pra saṃ gāp+ta mya shān+ta ye/ /yak+ṣa sre tsakra bha ga bān badz+ra pa ṇi der ni de nyid du/ /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje dag /zhar la 'ongs pa zhi ba'i slad/ /bcom ldan 'das ra nu gra haṃ/ /bo ko pa tā pa ma sa ma bi ni bār+ya shāstu bistu ri tastu ti pa kyis rjes bzung mdzad/ /de nas 'jig rten gdung ba mi bzad rnam 8 zlog ston pa ni/ /rnam rgyas bstod daste da shā tsu mā naḥ/ /bhe dze ba nā ni bi ha ran+da tha pūn+d+ra budhaḥpā pa'i tshig gis skabs gsum pa yis mchod gyur pa/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhabs pad dag dang mdza' 95—683

dām+bu dza pra ṇa ya sru ta shi lā ta lā niḥ/ / ta tra san+dar+sha nāsta ra su ba las/ /dag pa'i rdo ba'i gzhi ldan nags tshal rgyu zhing bsten par mdzad/ / de der tshu'adzum dang ldan pa ra rā dze na mā na sa māsnga ṣ+pe 6 shādheḥpa de 6 dka' thub dag gi nags/ /chos ni lhag gnas sdom brtson rnams kyi yid ni dag byed pa/ /zhi ba'i gnas na ma yi ba kṛ ta bi hā raḥ/ /kra ku ts+tshan+daḥshrī mān ka na ka mu ni ra 'di dag tu nga nyid kho nas rol byas min/ /seng ge'i nu 'og ri dwags phrug (byegu rgyu ba dben pa'i nags tre ba su ga taḥs samyashā budhaḥpa tsa bi ma li dhīḥkā sh+ya pa mu niḥ/ /bi biste tshal 'dir/ /brgya byin dpal ldan 'khor ba 'jig khyedang bde gshegs gser thub de dang ri/ /yang dag smin sau hi sta na ta la tsa labye la ha ri ṇi ba ṣ+pe tsa kruḥshakra sbi ti ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dre med blo ldan thub pa 'od srungs te/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten gdung ba'i sman pa khi la lo kan+tibhe ṣa dzaḥ/ /i ti bru bā ṇaḥs mu pa ga ta mya sa pu ju bā rnams kyis 'di nyid du gnas mdzad/ /de nas de skad smras des gzigs nyid kyi/ /bsod nams smin ka da tha lud+dhā ka gya/ /san+dar+sha ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba sha man+di de shaṃ shik+ṣu pa dāhaṃ sha ra rde ga ta la 6nye bar 'ongs pa yi/ /rngon pa dag ni skyabs su so nga ba la/ / bslab pa'i gnas 'os zhi ba bstan pa su / /bhā gya bān bha ga ba to nu gri ha taḥlubye kaḥku sha la lud+dhā mā na sa/ /mdzad / /skal ldan dge la yid chags rngon pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su bzung ba las/ /tan+d+ra diṣ+ṭa na kha ke sha lāñtsha ā+oṃ ta tra tsi t+ya ma ka rodh+ri gā bye paṃ/ /i ti der ni mchod rten ri dwags bdag po dag / 77des gnas dbu skra sen mos mtshan pa byas/ /zhes pa 95byed684

— byedabyed———— — — ——k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā lnga go pā la dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las klu nā ga da ma rna ṣa ṣat+pañtsa shaḥpal+la waḥ// //ba lang skyong btul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //diklu n+ta shra ba kho tai pa tu lā ro pi ta saṅga shā ཿ / / te dza yarnyi phyogs kyi mdzes pa'i tshu/rna rgyan dang / /mtshungs par yon tan dam pa bkod/ /gang zhig grags dza ga bye ྾ ya shaḥtho bai be+e rā dza te/ /bha ga bān tha sha kre ṇa ta tra pa'i mchod rten gyis/ /'gro mdzes de dag rgyal gyur cig /de nas der ni bcom ldan 'das/ /brgya pra ṇi dhi nābe+e ta ཿ / / pūza bu d+dhā kṛ ta khyu po ni dzastu pa ma kā ra byen gus pas gsol btab pas/ /sangs rgyas snga ma'i mchod rten mdzad/ /rang gi mchod rten byed du yata / /kṛ te rat+na ma ye ta smin de baiḥsrur+ya sha ta tī ṣe/ /dza gā ma dza bcug /lha rnams kyis der rin chen gyisan/ /rang bzhin nyi 'od brgya ldan byas/ /'gro ba'i rmongs pa ga hūṃ kā pi ma hā mo ha pa oṃ ta maḥ/ /ta tra ki na ra gan dharba na ra nā ga di chen po dang / /mtshungs pa'i mun pa ga shed song / /der ni dri za mi 'am ci/ /mi dang klu dang lha bo ka sī/ /dhasgo pa de sha bi na yo sa mā di sh+ya ya yo dzi naḥ/ /pā ṣa ṇa pat+tha rnams la/ /'dul ba'i chos kyi man ngag ni/ /yang dag bstan nas rgyal ba gshegs/ /rdo ba'i ri la lha te de bai bya stastu pa tsa tu ṣ+ṭa ye/ /bha ga bāpreñtsa oṃ stu paṃ pañtsa tho be+e bya rnams kyis/ /mchod rten bzhi ni bkod pa la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sdepelnga pa yi/ /mchod rten mchod be sha yata/ /a tha bā lok+ṣa nā mā rna de shaṃ pā p+tasta thā ga taḥ/ /shriṣ+ṭi dzā rten lnga dag bkod/ /de nas bā lo k+ṣa zhes pa'i/ /yul du de bzhin gshegs pa byon/ /lus ngan rmis su pra budhe na ku be+e re ṇi ba pū dzi ta ཿ / /di de sha dha dz+re bi na yo bzhin tshong dpon ni/ /legs par rab sad ces pas mchod/ /gang zhig de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /95 685

tasmi ye na sa mā nu gaḥ/ /mo ha ni druk+ṣa ye na pābe+eḥsu pra budhaḥpra 'dul ba'i chos ni de la bstan/ /rmongs pa'i gnyid sad legs par ky-i3ni/ /rab sad rab sad nyid budha tai/ /sa shā sa nāsgo ga ba taḥpu ju ni dza mi borja tai/ /ba lo k+ṣu thob gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' las des/ /rang gi bsod nams bzhin mtho ba/ /bā lo spyo zhuyī bye dha snru paṃ rat+na dī paṃ n+ya be da yata/ /ḍadza ྈ krā ma mā sā r+ya sha ya zhes pa yis je/ /mchod rten rin chen 'bar ba byas/ /de nas (snyedal kyis de bzhin gshegs/ /ṣ+pe ra tha ta thā ga taḥ/ /be+e nā ya ḍalba ram̐ nā ma yahūṃ shi k+ṣu pa da pra daḥ/ /ḍam ba ra yi grong du byon/ /gnod sbyin ḍal ba ra zhes pa/ /bslab gnas rab tu byen ⑥pas btul/ /tsaṇ+ḍa la gā ma ma bye t+ya tsaṇ+ḍa lī ma li kā bye jo/ /sa nyi hūṃ sap+ta rnyiḥpu trebe+e gtum po'i 7grong du mngon phyogs te/ /gtum mo ma li ‘nyaka zhes pa/ /bu bdun dag dang lhan cig nyid/ /na yon+da tsā bya dh+wa ta/ /te kadz+re she ṣa saṃ prap+ta mā tai ga ku la dru ṣi 'dul ba yis ni mtho bar mdzad/ /las kyi lhag mas gtum po'i rigs/ /thub pas sun phyung de dag taḥ / /pad+mā ka ra i bā pā pūdze+e ma l+ya dzi na dar+sha — ta/ /an+d+ra pra du ṣi rnams—/ /rgyal ba mthong las pad+ma yipo7/ /'byung gnas bzhin du dri med gyur/ /tha shal skyon gyis ta ta re 6 dzu gu be+e te 6 pā po pa tā pa bi pu la bya sa nārta re sun phyung smad pa dag tu 'os grur cing / /sdig pa'i nye bar gdung ba chen pos gdungs shing nyen ⑪ rnams 6 / /saṃ ta pra dṛt+ta ka ru ṇaḥku bi kalpa tī na dī nā ba lalba na ra la—/ /rnam rtog ngan pa dang bral snying rjes rab zhugs dam pa rnams/ /dman la dmigs pa'i rjes su sā da bye ka bha brnyi/ /a bā su pā ṭa la gā me sā nu gaḥsu ga tasta chags pas lhag par gyur pa yin/ /de nas bde gshegs rjes 'brang bcas/ /pā ṭa 17la yi grong khyer taḥ / / dha sde kṛ ha pa te: kre po ta lā khya gya saṅka tsā/ shik+ṣu byon—/ /dpal ldan khyim bdag gru 'dzin zhes/ /bya la legs pa'i gtam dag mdzad/ /bde bar 95—686

pa dā sta be+e ma spyeḥsu ga tā nu gra he ṇa saḥ/ / taṅge sha na khye ka gya gshegs pas rjes bzung bas/ /bslab pa'i 1gnas thob dri med des/ /de yi dbu skra sen cha yis/ /rat+na tho pa ma kā ra ya ta/ / ta tra san+dar+sha na yā tai bha ga bā nin+d+ra mtshan pa'i rin chen mchod rten byas/ / de ni bltar rngu'ongs dbang po la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bra bīta/ /mi lirjonā ma rā dzāsmin de she sa m+bha paṃ ka ri 6 ti/ /i ti rab gsungs pa/ /rgyal po mi lin du/dra zhes pas/ /yul 'di thumachod rten byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar bha ga ba taḥs+thā de s+thā ṣ+pe da yādro bi lo ke nā da bha ba da khi lo lo kā gnas dang gnas su bcom ldan brtse bas brlan pas gzigs pa yis/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten rnams kyi sho ka pra mo ha bha yesbyi ta ཿ / / a bhi na ba kri ta stu po ts+tsha ga mya ngan rmongs dang 'jigs pa btang bar gyur/ /mchod rten mngon par gsar byas skyibs na nor bu'i twa ṇad+ma ṇi kiṅgi ṭ+wā ku la ka la ka la kṛ ḍā lo lā ba byu ba tsa me di be+e/ /dril chung sgra sgrogs pa/ /dar dir tshogs kyi rtsed 57'jo dag gis sa gzhi'ang sred pa ldan par (67gyur/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa twa ba dā na kalpa la tā yī zhes (7pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing 1 pā ba dā rna sabe+e pañtsa shaḥpabe+e waḥ// //las mchod rten gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// //a nad+dhā babyeste sa ka la ku sha lot+pa t+ta ba su bye su bye sid+dhā man+tarda rgud pa'i gdung ba zhi byed gzigs pa rab tu dang ba'i ro dag gis/ /skyes bu rnams ni nad dang jo ti ki la ye pū r+ṇa ka ru shā / / pra sa rja rā sa n+da bya sa na bral mdzad srid pas zil mnan 'khrugs pa'i sman pa gang / /nges par dge ba mtha' dag bskyed pa'i sa ma nā lo ka ra sa ṣ+peḥkṛ tā ro gya hūṃ sī bha ba pa ri bha ba k+ko bhe bhe ṣa dzaḥ/ /nor 'dzin grub pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /rdzogs pa'i snying rje nang du 'dzin pa de dag mi smad 7phyag byar 'os/ /95—687

na garja puṣ+ka lā ba dh+yā sa smi taḥsmi ta kā ra r+ṇa/ /pu ra rā dze na bha ga bān grong khyer pad+mo ldan pa na/ /bcom ldan 'dzum dang bcas pa la/ /lha yi rgyal pos 'dzum pa'i rgyu/ /dris thraṣ+ṭaḥpu na ra bhā ṣa ta/ /shrī mān pu ju ba lo nā ma pu ra byudṛ thi bī pa tiḥ/ /nas be+er yang rab gsungs pa/ /dpal ldan bsod nams stobs zhes pa'i/ /sa yi bdag po sngon byung ste/ /ya snga shī ti sa ha sru ṇi na ga rā rde pa ri gra haḥ/ /ha gya pu rgya ba ti nā gang zhig grong khyer stong phrag ni/ /brgyad cu yongs su 'dzin par gyur/ /de yi rgyal po'i pho brang ni/ /ma rā dza jo m+bi bya rā dza ta/ /spa ṭi kā kā ra ru tsi rā byosgo ba ra dza bhā pa bsod nams ldan zhes bya ba ste/ /shel kyi rnam par yid 'ong zhing / /mtshan mo'i bdag po'i 'od bzhin te / /sa ka dā tsin+da bo byā na yā tā yī ra tha mā taḥ/ /da dar+sha sa mdzes—/ /skyed tshal gsar par 'gro ba'i be+ed/ /nam zhig shing rta zhon pa des/ /lam du phan pa'i bya bi hā rā ta pa ti sbo dan+ta mā tu re/ /ba haṃ dṛ ṭī pa ri s+thā rgo zas bral bas/ /nad kyis gzir zhing nya 'dug pa mthong / /ring po'i nad kyis mnar ba yis/ /dī r+gha ro ga na durga tai / / be+e bya the ka ru ṇa krād+dhā ཿ kran+ta khi la di yongs su nyams pa de mthong nas/ /phyogs mtshams ma lus gnon pa de/ /snying rjes zil mnan gdung gan+ta raḥ/ /san+ta bye pa ra mā la kya sa r+yaḥsaṃ krārnya dadze+e ṇaḥ/ /san+taḥbar gyur/ /gzhan gyis yongs gdungs —mthong gyur na/ /'phral la 'phos te dam pa yi④ / /me long sad+dhā pa mā yābye srur+ya kān+ta ma yā i ba/ /sa map+ta dā ra ra byā su sabye rnams ni gdung 'gyur te/ /nyi ma me shel rang bzhin bzhin/ /de yis grong khyer thams cad dang / /sgo 6 na ga re ṣā saḥ/ /ro gi rde pa k+ṣu bye ṣa bye shā la sha yā r+ya kā ra yat+pa/ /dang srang rnams mtha' dag tu/ /nad pa rnams la zas dang sman/ /gnas dang mal stan la sogs byas/ /ā di de sha ta taste bh+yaḥku sha khādru ri tsā ra kān/ /pra tha saṃ nyi tsi kedze+e shaṃ de nas de dag rnams kyi slad/ /rim gro pa ni mkhas pa bskos/ /gang phyir dam pa'i rim gro pa/ /nad 95—688

byā dheḥsat+pa ri tsā ra ka ra/ /ka ru shādz+raḥk+ṣa maḥk+ṣun+tash+yi kit+pa kā ma teḥspru gso'i yan lag dang po yin/ /bzod ldan lha snying rjes brlan zhing bzod/ /gso byed 'dod pa dag la taḥ—/ /sde hā da bi tsi kit+pa: durla bhaḥpa ri tsā ra kaḥ/ /rā dzā ta taḥganas—/ /mdza' las khruthe tshom mi byed pa'i/ /rim gro pa ni rnyed pa dka'/ /de nas rgyal pos rim sa mā byu ya ni ya tār+ṣa ri tsa ra kā na/ /a ba daskṛ ya tī ro ge ba ri tsar+yā di gro pa/ /dul ba rnams ni legs bos nas/ /smras pa nyin dang mtshan mor ni/ /nad pa rnams kyi rim ba ni shaṃ/ /rā dzārta shā la su kṛ ta ba ra shwa yā de kalpa nāḥ/ /ro gi gro mdzod/ /rgyal po la 'os gnas rnams su/ /mal stan mchog sogs phun tshogs byas/ /rin chen rde rat+na so pā nāḥpad+me n+yabya la lo da kāḥ/ /bhe ṣadzhai ṣa bye saṃ patrībe+e hi tā skas ldan pad+mo can/ /dri med chu ldan nad pa'i phyir/ /sman pa dang ni sman dag kyang / /phun tshogs tsa ma tī ya r+pā/ /a dhu nā yuṣ+ṭha dā yabho tat+yā sbya mi ti me ma tiḥ/ /sad+dhā shin tu che ba bsgrubs/ /da ni de dag bsos gyur pa/ /khyed kyi gnyer zhes bdag gi blo/ /'jig rten paṃ sha ma ya t+ya tī bra shi shi riḥ shī tai su khe noṣ+ṭha zla tre ṭ+wā shī ta dza 'dir ni rim gro pa dang brtan pa'i sman pa chos kyi 4gzhan du mi rnams kyi/ /yongs su gdung ba shin tu lermu hurmi ta hi tā hā ro ba tsā riḥkla oṃ/ /swasgo sī ti bye ti thra ye na bsil ba yis kyang gang (snye/ba dag ni bde ba'i dro ba yis/ /sred pa bsel ba'i chu yis dang ni ngal ba yang ba tsa pā he li kra me rja ra ti lo ke smidru ri tsā ra kaḥ spri ra bi yang chung ngu phan zas nyer bstabs pas/ /khyod gsos 7'u'agyur zhes bstan pa'i tshig snyan ku re'i rim pas ṣagharmaḥpa ra smi1 rde/ / tasmrabye ba bye stabhā dzā ro ga yo ge na sī da mi dga' ba ④dag zhi bar byed/ /de yi slad du khyed rnams kyisare / /nad kyis gdungs shing 'gyel hūṃ —/ /kār+yā mu hurmu hur+pā kye ri ya ma shwa sa na smṛ tiḥ / /be+e byo rnams la/ /yang dang yang du tshig dag gis/ /dbugs dbyung po 'di ni dran par byasanya— / /sman pa 95—689

na ba r+yaḥsu ga taḥpra sā dī dhaspo pa de shaḥpa ra mo ṣa dhañtsa/ /saṃ sā skyon med bde gshegs bka' drin dang / /chos kyi hūṃraman ngag dam pa'i sman dag kyang / /'khor ba ra dīsgo dz+wa ra sho ṣi tā dzā pā rā ya khaṃ shārnyi ra pā ya nan+ta ta/ /i t+yā ring po'i rims kyis snyebaskams rnams kyi/ /dpung gnyen zhi ba'i bcud len de dag yin/ /mi bdag di ṣ+ṭa dṛ pa ti nā te te na ba su babhā zla/ /ga tā ya tho di tai tsakruḥnor gyi char 'bebs des/ /de dag rnams la de skad bstan/ /nad pa ma lus gsos ①bya'i slad/ /swāsbya yā khi la ro gi rmā/ /ta taḥku sha la ba de na te na taṅga ta mā na sān/ /song nas ji skad brjod bzhin byas/ /de nas nad grol de dag rnams/ /dge ba brjod pas de la yid/ /byā bye muk+tan+da ra pa nyiḥswa yo trahūṃ bi nir+ya yo/ /sha krasta da pa raḥsong ba rnams la blta ba'i slad/ /mi bdag rang nyid phyi rol byung / /brgya byin gyis kyang de la ni/ /sha kra ta gya pu rgya sa mudz+dza lo/ /ra dze+e be+e nin+d+ra me yulte ṣajan+tiḥpāṇ+ḍa gnyis 'thung dkar po mche ba ni / /drug ldan gyis drangs shing rta dag /bsod nams rab 'bar rnam dī peḥ/ /su kha spazla ni khā lo la te ma rat+na sa ro ru hā/ /z-iji ga par sprul/ /rin chen gser gyi mtsho skyes rnams/ /reg na bde ba'i rlung gis g.yos⑤/ /bung ba'i na no pa gī tā tsa di byā ka ma le nī pa thi/ /te 6 rat+na sa ro dza 6 sbi tā mṛ chung glu len pa'i/ /lam du mchog gi pad ldan yang / /rin chen mtsho skyes de dag la/ /gnas sogs ta ka khā ku khāḥ/ /dru ra1 pa ti mā yan+ta su nār+yaḥse ṣe bi re/ /bdud rtsi'i cha rdzogs pa'i/ /lha mo rnams kyis ring po nas/ /mi bdag byon pa bstan ⑥par gyur/ /ta su satwa su dh+wa sesgoḥ sa hūṃ dzñā rtu ma rut+pa tiḥ/ /kṛ tā rnya rū ba snying stobs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de'i/ /snying stobs shes 'dod lha yi bdag /bdag nyid long ba'i mā d+mā na ma bye ta ta ma bhā ṣata / / rā dzan+da ya na tī no haṃ dzad+mā gzugs byas nas/ /de la mngon du phyogs te gnas⑦/ /rgyal po mig gis dman pa bdag /skye bar 95—690

lo ka bi brdzi taḥ/ /sat+tha sa twa pa ri tā khaṃ san+dad+dhi tā mu pā ga taḥ/ /snang ba rnam par spangs/ /sems can thams cad yongs skyob par/ /zhugs pa khyod can nye bar 'ongs/ /e te ta ba pra bhā be na ro gi ṇaḥswāsgyu ma ga ta/ /twaṅgir+bhe ba da mu kha rā: khyod kyi mthu yis nad pa ni/ /'di dag legs par gsos 37gyur nas/ /'od rte7ldan mdzes pas khyod kyi ra dhi ru tsi ra tī ṣa ཿ / / tā tu ma rta se rmā de ba du kha dī ni—/ /grags pa mu cor sgrog cing rgyu/ /sdug bsngal bkren 17dang long ba'i gnyen/ /lha yis rībadag ni nān+ta bān+ta ba/ /dak+ṣ-i r+ṇa na ya ā+oṃ ma hūṃ dī ya hūṃ ya di shakya te/ /i t+yāk+taste bskyab par 'os/ /bdag la mig ni g.yas pa dag /gal te phod na gnang bar 5mdzod/ /des 'di na dṛ pa tiḥ pra san+da ba da na byu ti ཿ / / san+ta ra shā ya dza ga tī brngod tshe mi bdag ni/ /rab dang bzhin ras mdzes pa yi(6sna/ /'gro rnams yang dag bsgral ba'i slad/ /samyak+shi bo dhi sedhi ye/ /bra ṇi dh+wa ā+oṃ sa mā dh+wa ya sha ste rtot+pa 6 lo rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /smon lam rab tu btab byas te/ /mig ni mtshon gyis rab tsa dz+wa/ /da do dhebye ni byestasmi pu྾ rā bu ri taḥsu riḥ/ /ta snga da phyungs ⑦ nas/ /brtan pa'i gter gyis de la byin/ /lha rnams kyis ni me tog gtor/ /de yi rmad (87bhu ta da ṣ+pe na bi sma yā di ba sā tsa lnga/ /be+e tsa tsā la khi la thra dī bi lo byung sbyin pa yis/ /ya mtshan nas bzhin sa gzhi ni/ /chu gter g.yo ba'i ske 97rags can/ /ri dang khāṇ+ḍi ba me kha khā/ /dzā tā lo shaṃ ta mā lo kya ṣ+pe tre ṣ+pe ke na bhū pa tiḥ/ /i ti bcas pa ma lus 'dar/ /mig gcig gis ni snang ba dag /skyes pa de mthong sa yi bdag /sbyin pa'i dā na ra sa spru t+yā dī tī yo dā tu mur+ya yo/ / ta taḥsu ra pa ti sta su ro la rab dgyes pas/ /gnyis pa sbyin par brtson par gyuratsho 7/ /de nas lha yi bdag po ni/ /rang gi sa mā sbra ya ni dze+e ba puḥ/ /swas+tha pi dh+wa ya na ya ram̐ pra shaṃ shaṃ sā ti satwa tsā/ /lus su yang dag gnas/ /de yi mig ni bsos byas te/ /snying stobs mchog nyid rab tu bsngags/ /95—691

dā na k+ṣa ṇi swā ba ya be+e pi ya su na dzā ya te sne ha la baḥka dā tsitra/ /kā nā ma gang zhig sbyin tshe rang gi yan lag la'ang / /nam yang chags pa chung ngu skye min pa/ /nges par snying ta spyodzhai ta sa twa sesgorja nā dī jo ā+oṃ ra dza si swa budhiḥ/ /sa dṛ pa tiḥstobs rgya mtsho rgyas de la/ /nor zhes brjod pa'i rtul skyal rang blo ci/ /de tshe mi bdag bsod nams pu sgo ba lo ha me ba ta dā bha baṃ dā na ra pābe+e bo byeḥ/ āsprur+yaz-it+ta sma ra ṇi na ta stobs grur te/ /nga nyid sbyin pa'i ro yis byang chub thob/ /de yi ngo mtshar spyod tshul dran pas na/ /su dzā na smi tastad+ma ya tā ma bāp+taḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī de yi rang bzhin nyid thob 'dzum pa mdzad/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa lā tā dze+e pu sgo ba lā ba dā dz+wa nā māṣ+ṭaḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal pañtsa shaḥpal+la waḥ// //'dab ste lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //e kaḥpa e ba su kṛ to tsi ta tsakra btīḥsu byak+ta tīn+ti ti la kā gu shin tu rab gsal grags pa'i tshon ris yon tan rin chen rgyan/ /ma nyams sbyin pa'i me tog dang ṇa rat+na bhū ṣā/ /asmra na dā na ku su mā kre ta sa t+ya tsartswa ya snga ba ldan bden pa'i byug pa byas/ /gang gi dpal ni tshul khrims gtsang ma'i hūṃdu gu las mdzes pa/ /de nyid bhā ti shu tsi shī la du ku li bhā shrīḥ/ /su rot+ta me pā ṭa li pu tra nām+bi ma tī gcig pu legs byas la 'os 'khor los sgyur ba yin/ /grong mchog pā ṭa 1li yi bu zhes pa/ /na chung sa yu ba t+yāste la kā ya mā ṣ+pe/ /ya sho ni byeḥsaur+ya ku la ba tai saḥbye mā na sho kaḥk+ṣi gzhi 3thig le ltar gyur par/ /nyi ma'i rigs kyi rgyan gyur grags pa'i gter/ /dpal ldan sa bdag mya ti po ba bhū ba/ /byubye sa kā mo pa ba de na kā m+bi tsaṇ+ḍi pa tsa re ṇa ta ngan med pa byung / /dang por 'u'adod ldan de 'dod nye tshig dang / /de nas rnon po ⑥gtum po'i nyer 95—692
