tā mi pa/ /tai be+e lo kyai ba tat+yā dza saṃ tā paṃ nā ga nan+da naḥ/ /sazlutī bzlog pa bzhin/ /de mthong nyid na klu yi bu/ /yongs su gdung ba btang bar gyura'/ /bdag nyid do ṣa sha ma rna dar+sha ā+oṃ nyi ma hāt+pa ram̐/ / pra ṇa nā ma pa ti tīṇ+ḍi che rnams mthong ba nyid/ /gdung ba'i skyon kun zhi bar byed/ /snyim pa me tog gis gang ba/ /de la saṃ pūṇ+ḍi ku su māñdza liḥ/ /tat+yā da pad+ma spasgo na sa r+yaḥshī tal tī ga taḥ/ /kṛ gtor nas des phyag btsala'asna/ /de yi zhabs pad reg pa yis/ /'phral la bsel ba nyid du gyur/ /de tī bha ga ba taḥpā su ga ta shi k+ṣa pa dā ni saḥ/ /tsakre kṛ hūṃñdza lista su yā nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ni/ /bslab pa'i gnas thob mkhas pa des/ /thal mo sbyar nas de la ni/ /ji babyā bā dhi bā sa rmā/ /tai ba bhā ṣe bha ga bān e ka sri bā bye bā sa nā/ /srid 'tsho bar lhag gnas byas/ /de la bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /thams cad rjes su gzung ①bya la/ /a nu gā bye 6 sarbe 6 yā badz+dza ban+da yu bye te/ /i kyughā pra rja ya thra h+ye gcig nyid ④kho na'i lhag gnas ni/ /ji srid 'tsho ba ji ltar 'os/ /gus la dgyes pas de brjod nas/ /bha ga bād+ma ta tro r+ya taḥ/ /sha ṣ+peḥpra taste saṃ kadze+e sgo gi naḥpa ri pū de la brtson pas bcom ldan dege/ /gdengs can rnam par brtag pa ni/ /yongs rdzogs mdzad cing dal ra yan/ /kra me ṇa gats+tsha tasta su bhigru saṃ ghā gra yā yi naḥ/ /pra bhā bāji da gyis chas/ /dge slong tshogs kyis ⑥ sna drangs nas/ /rim gyis byon pa de la ni/ /klu yi ⑦mthu las ④dhe nā gaḥ swa rga sho hūṃ pa de pa de / / te ma ra trī shu sha ba lān+di gnas dang gnas/ /mtho ris lta bur mdzes pa bsgrubs⑨/ /rin chen gser 'od bkra ba yi/ /mchog byad+mo na ma no ha rān/ /sgo ga pa saṃ gra ha bya gra dā sa dā sbo ga ṇa gi skyed tshal mdzes pa dang / /longs spyod 'dzin pas byel ⑩ba yis/ /'bangs dang 'bangs mo'i tshogs thra tān/ /kaspru ra tsan+da no dā ra hā ra pā lo ba byu ṣi tān/ /s+thā ṣ+pe s+thā de rgyas dang / /ga bur tsan dan rgya che yi/ /do shal 'phyang bas brgyan pa yis(7/ /gnas dang gnas su 95—726

bha ga wa taḥs bi hā rā na kā ra yat+pa/ /ka lan+da ka ni pā sā khye pāp+ta be+e na gtsug lag khang / /bcom ldan 'das la de yis byas/ /de nas ka lan da ka'i gnas/ /zhes pa 'od pa na ta taḥ/ /sa saza sgo ga saṃ bhā rir+bha ga ban+ta ma pū dza yata/ /te ma'i tshal du phyin/ /de yi ① longs spyod tshogs kun gyes/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas/ /der na mā pa tro ya ta tu sa saṃ ghaḥsu ga to ñtsi taḥ/ /u tse bismi ta mā nasdo hā ni de yis zla gsum du/ /dge 'dun dang bcas bde gshegs mchod/ /do shal rin chen 'od kyis bskor/ /ra rat+na shu kaim+bi taḥ/ /e ṣa kalpa sha ta ma tsū taḥpha ṇ+ḍi sarba sgo ga su ya mtshan kun dga' ldan la gsungs/ /gdengs can 'di ni bskal pa brgyar mi g.yo/ /bde ba'i longs kha bhāgha bi 6 te/ /bo bye ma pya pa ra dzad+ma ni sgu ṭī ki ba su pra ṇi nyi taḥka spyod kun gyi snod du gyur2sna/ /'on kyang skye ba gzhan la byang chub kyang / /rab tu 'bad pas gsal bar ri 6 ti/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e byed par gyur3/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag nā ga ku mā rā ba dā rna ṣa ྾ ta maḥpal+la baḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las klu gzhon nu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu pa'o// //rū dha mya hasta pa ta to pi ni byeḥpra yā ti lasmro swa yo bha ba na me ti bi blun po'i lag tu gter dag lhung yang rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rnam dag blo ldan khyim du dpal ni shu d+dhā bu dzhai ཿ / / dā ri dra tī bra nyi mi rā pa ha ra ཿ pra kā rma rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu dam pa ④rnams kyis yid ni (trerab tu dang ba dag /dbul ba'i purja bi byu ṣa ṇa ma ṇirma na saḥpra pā daḥ/ /shā pasbya swaste ko nā ma brah+ma ṇi nir+bha rab rib mi bzad 'phrog pa'i rgyan gyi nor bu yin/ /mnyan yod du sngon bram ze ni/ /nor med bkra shis naḥpu ra/ /a shi shri yaskṛ sha pha lā ma sha t+yā kṛ ṣi dz+re bi rmā/ /sasnye 2 zhes bya ba/ /'tsho ba bral bas 'tsho ba'i thabs/ /'bras bu chung ba'i zhing las 63brten/ /zhing las la 95—727

kan+d+ra ni ra taḥshrī ta bā tā ta pak+ṣa taḥ/ /tsakā ra ha la kubyā la bhā ra bā chags grang ba dang / /rlung dang tsha bas nyen pa des/ /thong ba dang ni tog ①/rtse'i khur/ /khyer zhing tī ga tā gtai/ /sa ka dā tsit+pa mā yādhe shā ba keḥs nyi tai pa thi/ /dzi 'ong dang 'gro ba byas/ /nam zhig chung ma dang bcas de'i2/ /lam du rgyal ba nyan thos dang / /lhan na dzā yā sa kho dṛ ṣ+ṭa pra sā rda sa ha sa ya yo/ /pra pan+da ba da rmā bi rja cig byon pa mthong gyur nas/ /'phral la rab tu dang bar gyur/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams yongs zad las/ /sa dza gā da bi tsin+ta yan/ /dā ri dru duḥkha ma sa rmā dā na pu 5 pa ri dbul ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /sems shing ( )de yis chung ma ni/ /rab dang bzhin ldan la k+ṣa yāta/ /ā bā sgyu me ṣa bha ga ban biṇ+ḍa ke nā pi nartsi taḥ/ /ku ta smras pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni 5yu cag gis/ /rdog gcig gis kyang ma mchod las/ /bsod nams pu ju ṣa rde mā s+thā dha na sadzadhi rā ba yo/ /jo ba h+ye ba mṛ to lo ke naṣ+ṭa zong gis thob 6 pa'i nor/ /phun tshogs yu la ga la 'ong / /shi ba gson nyid 'jig rten na/ /grags tīr+bhebe+e pad+ma de/ /na sa dz+re bo na niñdzu baḥsho bha te nin+dha no dza naḥ/ /rto nasbyo pa nyams pa shi ba nyid/ /nor med skye bo mdzes pa ni/ /gson la ma yin gshin la min/ /nor rigs ti sgo na bi byā dha na n+dhasgo dha rna ya shaḥ/ /kirnya ṣ+pe na bi tī nā dzñā yādzñā nor ni rig 3/pa ste/ /nor chos nor ni grags pa yin/ /nor gyis dman zhing bslangs pa yis 'tsho bheñdzu tairgya ṇiḥ/ /pa ro pā kā rā rji bhū taiḥgin+da ri dra gya saṅga ṇiḥ/ /ba'i yon tan rnams kyis sheci/ /gzhan gyi nye mkhor gegyur pa yis/ /dbul po'i yon tan dam pas ci/ /kle shādze+ezlu ri ka gye ba ma ṇi kāñtsa na byu ṣa ṇiḥ/ /da ri dro dā ri bye pra tha khur dub ba la ① ༄nor bu yis/ /gser rgyan ngal dub don gyis bzhin/ /dbul po sbyin pa dag dang bral sha ti pu na dī na bi ra hā da da ri draḥ pā pād+ma bha ba ti dha na le s+thā bas be+er yang dbul por rab tu 'dzud31/ /dbul po nor la chags pas gzhan dbang sdig pa'i bdag 95 ——728

pa ra ba shaḥ/ /da ri dru satshwa se mṛ ta i ti na tsā draste bi ma tir da ri dra nyid ①dag tu 'gyuradu/ /dbul po gyedabugs dang bcas kyang shi zhes 'di la khyad par blo gros med/ /gye bai tā ni dza dza na thi tī no da sha di shaḥ/ /a bh+yatsu yā baḥsu ga dbul po phyogs bcu 'di dag rang gi khyeskye bo dag gis dman pa bzhin/ /de slad dman la mnyes gshin tai ta smradṛ pa ṇa bat+pa lo/ /a na rā bye ta bud+dhā rmā mud+dhā dzñā ku sha pa'i—/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas mnyes par ma byas pa'i/ /rmongs la dge ba lo ku taḥ/ /e ṣa pad+ma da khā shāk+ṣaḥk+ṣi pa t+yā pan+d+ra bān+dha baḥ/ /ya tro ya tug la yod/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu'i spyan/ /phongs pa'i gnyen 'dis gang gang du/ /spyan ni 'phangs dri shaṃ dzā ṣ+pe ta t+pa ta tā shra ya shri yaḥ/ /i ti pa kyurba caḥshu tā zwah+ma pa de dang der/ /dpal ni gnas pa dag ⑤gis shes/ /de skad bdag po'i tshig thos nas/ /khyim du s+thā pā da ra kṛ he/ /shu tsi pra dhī ta bi da dhe sgo byo bha ga ba taḥkṛ te/ /gus byas (skyobram ze mos/ /zas ni gtsang mar sbyar ba dag /bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du bsgrubs/ /bha ga bān pi sa rba dzhasta yo dzñā tā sa m+bi hi tai / / pra ṇa yā rja bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /de dag bsam pa yongs mkhyan tshinas/ /gus pas ru7gsol ba na yā tsakre ta gya pū dzā pra ti gra haṃ/ /byak+ta dā ri dru duḥ kha su bhū 'debs pa de'i/ /mchod pa dag ni blang bar mdzad/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rab bsal pa/ /bdag yasma bi bha bobye baḥ/ /tsa kā ra dzi na pū dzādhe pra ṇi dh+wa na mi ti dī dzaḥ/ /la 'byor pa 'byung gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam gnyis skyes kyis/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i mjug tu byas/ /a tha ga tā ni dze+e k+ṣe tram̐ bi praḥs pya ya r+pā kurān/ /sar+pā na pa sh+yakau baṭ+wān sa de nas bram ze rang zhing ( padu/ /song bas 'bru nas myu gu ni/ /thams cad gser du mthong gyur nas/ /ha sā t+yak+ta durga tiḥ/ / ta gya pu 5 sa mudhū tai dri ṭī he ma ma tī pa 'phral la nyid du dbul ba btang / /sa yi bdag po gsal rgyal gyis/ /de yi bsod nams las 'khrungs 95—729

ra tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī ka r+ṣa kā ba dā byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las zhing pa'i rtogs pa brjod na me ka ṣakhyu maḥpabe+e waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //uṭ+wā yu sgoṇ+ḍi ja na kā na na sam+bi be she dzā ta: mju ti ma yaḥpu lug gis gang bar gyur pa'i skye bo'i nags tshal gnas dag tu/ /lang tshos long zhing bde ba la 'os ru ṣaḥs e kaḥ/ /ya sngan+dha yo ba na su kho tsi ta tsā ru be sha be+e rā gya mā di mdzes pa'i chas ldan tshe/ /dben pas chags bral zhi zhing dag pa gang la rab byin pa/ /skyes bu de nyid sha ti shārnyi si tai bi be+e kaḥ/ /n+ya gro dha ru tsi rā rā ma bi hā ri ṇi dzi ṣ+pe pu gcig pu ya mtshan rang bzhin rab hūṃtshotu skyes/ /rgyal ba sngon tshe n+ya gro dha'i/ /kun dga' ra ba mdzes par rā / /bā rā ṇasde kṛ ha pa tiḥsu pra busgye bhe bye bha bta/ /t+yā go pa sgo bzhugs—/ / bā rā ṇa sīr snyekhyim bdag ni/ /legs par rab sad ces pa byung / /nor ni rgyas pa ga saṃ bhā ra bi bhū ṣi ta dha no da yaḥ/ /e shwar+ya yaḥku be+e rā su kau gtong ba dang / /longs spyod tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /gang gi —snadabang phyug lus ngan bu4/ /sha lī dz+wa n+ya m+bi la yata/ / sa sat+tha su kha sadzasto nin+d+ra tuḥpu tra tsin+ta mdzod na gnas pa'ang zum par byed/ /bde ba thams cad phun tshogs te/ /bud demed bu yi bsam pa yā—/ /pa re san+ta pa mā ye de niḥsha l+ya ka su sadza daḥ/ /haṃ sho ka shi yis—/ /mchog tu yang dag gdung ba thob/ /phun tshogs su yi zug rngu min/ /de yi 6bsam pa )7khi sa n+ta bye bā rnya bā ba n+tu ba t+pa lo/ / u tsi re be+e sa k+ta n+ta ta ñtsid+dhā 'phos pa yis/ /yun ring yid 'khrugs deganyen rnams kyis/ /gnyen la gnyen ni ( mya ngan gyi ⑩/ /me bat+ta mā na sāḥ/ /l+lī bo tsi tī kṛ ha pa te na tsidzñā kartu marta se/ /yis rab gdungs ⑪de la smras/ /khyem bdag ma ning la 'os pa'i/ /bsam pa bya bar mi rigs so/ /95—731

—————dhī rā rde thra thu sa tā rmā nā ste lo ke 6 durlu sgo/ /ya e ṣa bi shu to brtan ldan snying stobs che rnams la/ /'jig rten na ni rnyed dka' med/ /gang 'di phyogs su grags gyur dik+ṣu de she smisgo ra pū dzi taḥ/ /n+ya gro dha pā da pa ta su pū dza ya sat+tha mā cing / /yul 'dir grong khyer pas mchod pa7 / /n+ya gro dha yi shing de la/ /mchod pas thams cad thob gya te/ /a pu tāḥpu dṛ ṇaḥke tsid+ngha sgo nā dha niḥbare/ /ro gi ṇi pya ru par 'gyur/ /de la zhus pas 'ga' zhig ni/ /bu med bu dang ldan pa dang / /gzhan — nor med nor dzartswa bye dṛṣ+ṭhasta du pa yā tsi taiḥ/ /sa t+ya yā tsa na tsi t+yā khyaḥpo yo n+ya gro dang ldan/ /gzhan yang nad can nad med mthong / /n+ya gro dha yi rkang 'thung ni( kye/ /mchod rten slong ba dha pā da paḥ/ /pha lo pu tā bye dhan+tu sum̐ dā gya tru tsi ta madz+re taḥ/ /i ti te bden zhes bya/ /'os par mchod na khyod la ni/ /bu zhes brjod pa'i 'bras ster 'gyur/ /zhes pa de hūṃ pa tsaḥshu tā tā nu bā tsa sa sasmi taḥ/ /a ho nu mo hā ta ste hā yu dag tshig thos nas/ /'dzum bcas de dag la smras pa/ /kye ma rmongs pa'i lgo)mdza' ba las/ /khyed yo mūrlu twa māg tāḥ/ /swa kadz+re pa ra tan+t+ra smi na lo ke na ni ya te ni: le/ /rnams rmongs pa nyid du gyur/ /rang las gzhan dbang 'jig rten 'di(she// /nges par g.yo ba med pa la/ /spru tai ka ro ti puṇ+ḍa nyi ha ra nyi harnyi ka su kaḥ/ /swa kasgro pa na tai pā pya tu su yis su yi brtan pa dang / /rgyas dang 'phrog dang 'joms par byed/ /rang las nye ba 6 nyid thob nas/ /6 t+ya n+ya gya mugha dhī/ /swa lā lā la ba mā swā r+ya shwe ba shuṣ+ka gya tsan+d+ra ṇaḥ/ /dṛk+ṣaḥblo gros blun po gzhan la tshim/ /rang gi kha chu'i cha myangs nas/ /khye ni pags pa skam la bzhin/ /shing pu tā rba daḥsum̐ sā mi t+ya tasbo r+ṣa bhā ṣi tai/ /dā ḍū shak+taḥs nā kā le pa tra gi 7bu nor skyes bu la/ /ster zhes 'di ni rmongs pa'i gtam/ /'dab ma tsam yang dus min du/ /de mā tu ma bi swa yo/ /ta da byeṣ+ṭha tre de babye ta pū dzā lubhaḥka ro ti tata/ /pūṇ+ḍi nyid rang la sbyin nus med/ /gal te de ni byen rlob lhas/ /mchod pa la chags byed pa na/ /bdag 95 732

sa hā ra pū dzā yī ki swa yi sre dza ti nād+ma naḥ/ /pāp+ta bye s+thā bya ya di bā ghu shā k+ṣa nyid rang gis mchod pa ni/ /yo byad rdzogs pa cis mi spro/ /srin bu'i rjes ni yi ge bzhin/ /gang yang ra pa do pa oṃ/ /kā ka tā li yā sas+thā daste dar+ghaṃ ma n+ya te dza naḥ/ /pāp+ta bye yat+pa la thob bya thob pa na/ /bya rog ta la ltar brjod pas/ /skye bo de yis byin par sems/ /gang zhig thob bya de pa ri ṇa to karma rde pā be+e te ta ta nā nā yat+na pra ṇa ya ya ta ṣ+perla bh+ya ni las rnams 'bras bu yongs su gyur tshe thob①/ /sna tshogs 'bad cing gus pas bsgrubs kyang thob bya te na twa la bye/ /yad+me ṣ+pe ba sra ya mu pa tsi lta sgo ga bha gī sa tasmin+de te min pa 'thob ma yin/ /gang zhig gang gis rang nyid kyis bsags longs spyod skal ldan de la ni/ /'di ṣ+pe taskṛ ta mi ti mu pā ma n+ya te mubha budhiḥ/ /i ti shu ba ṇiḥs sne dag 'di yis byas shes rbongs pa'i blo can 'bras med de dag sems/ /zhes pa smra de mdza' gcugs dang / /hai ra nu badhe na narnya baiḥ/ /pre ri to sa ya yo gru bhā e kā tī pā da pārnyi ldan pa'i gnyen gyis rab 'bad de/ /bskul nas gcig pu gsang ba yis/ /rkang 'thung gi ni drung du ke / /sa ku lbo ra sa mā dā ya n+ya gro dha ta ru ma bh+ya bhāta/ /pū dzā dze+e mū la bha te song / /sta re brdung ②nas de yis ni/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing la smras/ /mchod pa'am rtsa ba gcod pa la/ /bā saljo haṃ tā mu sā ga taḥ/ /pu tu pra dā hūṃ pū dzabye ka ri t+yā mya kṛ tī pa reḥ/ /ngas ①ni chas nas khyod can 'ongs④/ /bu dag sbyin na khyod la bdag /gzhan gyis ma byas mchod pa byed/ /na bye tā ma n+ya thāsbyi tā da d+dhā pe ṣ+ṭa yā mya haṃ / / i ti ta dwa tsa rnam pa gzhan du khyod bdag gis/ /bcad bsregs btags la chu bor 'phangs rngoke/ /zhes pa de yi tshig na shu tā de ba tā thra k+ṣa bā pi dī/ / sa ha se ba bha yodrighā kadza mā thos nas/ /lha ni shing la gnas pa dag /'phral la 'jigs pas 'khrugs gyur te/ /'dar bar byed nā bya tsin+ta yata/ /na ma yā ka bye tsikhru nube+er+ghaṃ bā dat+ta mits+tsha yā/ /dza cing rab bsams pa/ /'dod pa'i bu'am nor dag ni/ /bdag gis su la'ang sbyin spyopa med/ /rang 95 — 733

kwa tsita gats+tsha t+ya bye mu khāḥ/ /te tram̐ ba bye pra lī yadhe ha tha rūrjaḥkha ra 'ga' zhig kha ni 'og phyogs gyur/ /g.yo rmongs mi bsrun ①brtul zhugs kyis/ /gzhan ni de nyid na bra taiḥ/ /ga tā nu ga nyi ka te na pra sedhi sha ra rto dza naḥ/ /sabyesti pa ri rab chags/ /song ba'i rjes su 'gro nyid kyis/ /skye bo grags pa la ston ②rnams/ /gdung ba thams hā rā ya mo dzha s+thā me dh+wa ba nyi / / usgre dzi tā pya haṃ tī bra dza ṣ+pe cad gzhom pa'i slad/ /rmongs pa bdag cag ④nyid du rgyug /skye bo blo gros mi gzo dubs/ /mi bzad nā kyu ta budhi nā/ /ta zu t+yahūṃ na sha kyo mi taṅga ṇa brdzi ta sha yā/ /brnya kle gtses par gyur kyang bdag /bsam pa de yi yon tan la/ /chags pas shing ni gtong mi nus/ /dri la shaṃ bi sha ti ma dhu paḥpaṅga dza garnya lubhaḥpaṃ kā lta ka ga ṇa ya nyi bi sā chags pa'i bung ba 'dam skyes 'ching ⑤ba'i nyon mongs ldan par 'jug /pad rtsa'i ro myang ngang pa nyid ni swā da na ṣ+pe ba haṃ saḥ/ /shī tārtabya t+ya dza ti na dza naḥpā pa rka dhū ma dhū dze+e 'dam gyi 'jigs pa rtsi mi byed/ /grang bas gzir ba'i skye bo du bas 'khrugs pa'i me ni yongs ④mi 'dor/ /tasmisdo ṣe sa ki la sa ha te ya su ye no pa yo gaḥ/ /ta smradṛk+ṣa bi yo gar+ghaṃ tā gang la gang zhig nyer mkho de la de yi ④skyon ni nges par bzod⑧/ /de be+ed shing bral gdung ba las /tu marta si rmā bi sgo/ /sha rī ra t+yā ga sa dṛ shaḥsba na t+yā go hi de khyab bdag bdag ni bskyab par 'os/ /gang phyir lus can rnams kyi gnas/ /gtong ba lus ni gtong hi dzñā/ /abe+e ta pra ṇa ye ṣ+pe ti po lo mā ra masta yā/ /pu tu dang ⑨mtshungs/ /zhes pa de yi ⑩'bad pa yis/ /gsol gdab ⑪po lo mā dga' bas/ /khyim bdag khā sgo kṛ ha pa teḥkas+thā yat+ta ma tsin+ta yata/ /a hūṃ ta re dṛ tu sha tūrde gis ni bu thob ⑫pa'i/ /las kyi dbang ni yang dag bsams/ /skabs der lha min dgra bo yis/ /ba pu tu tri piṣ+ṭa ye/ /su ma tin+d+ra ma saṃ pāp+ta sgo ti kā lam̐ bya lo ka yata/ /mā skabs ⑫gsum pa yi lha yi bu/ /blo bzang zhes pa lhung ba yiske/ /dus la bab pa mthong gyur te/ /mi 95—735

lās+thā na mu pā ya yo kha la na ti kli ṣ+ṭi tī rta na sa ta tshwa yā pā du ra bsrun huṣ+pel btud grags pa nyams pa bzhin du 'phreng (0ba dri ma gecan gyur cing / /dman gyur slong ba bhūt+ta maḥpa ri tsi tā yāsnyo ba de byo da ye/ /swa daḥpu 5 pa ri k+ṣa ye na ba bzhin du mdzes pa mun pa dag dang yongs 'dris byung bar gyur/ /bsod nams yongs su zad las gnod i bā pā ya kra kā rāspa rda ta snga khyu da ra ti sna pā ta pi shu ṇa sa dz+wa pas bzhin du rdul gyis kyang ni gnas dag byas/ /zhe sdang skyon bcas blo bzhin de ni lhung ba gsal byed ṣa do ṣe ba byeḥ/ /gu ṇi naḥsu pra budha mya dṛ shrī bye pra thi ta shri yaḥ/ /su dga' ba min par gyur/ /legs par rab sang yon tan can/ /sa la dpal ldan grags pa yis/ /blo ma teḥpu tu tā me hi ta mit+yā ha su re shwa raḥ/ /so bra bīt+ta tra rmā kā le shāstuḥshākya bzang bu nyid du song zhes/ /de la lha yi (gebadag pos smras/ /des smras ston pa shākya thub/ /bla med rgya mu ṣ+peḥpu raḥ/ /shak+ta snga nut+ta ro dā ra dhan+d+ra tsakra pra brta ṣ+pe/ /pra bra che chos kyi (peni/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor mdzad pa'i/ /mdun du dus der gal te bdag /rab tu dzñā sa da nā ya two ya di saṃ bo dha yi 6 pi/ /ta da haṃ su pra budhe su bra dzā mi bhū byung ba 'dzin pa la/ /khyod kyis yang dag rtogs byed na/ /sa la legs par rab sad kyi/ /bu nyid du bi pu tu hūṃ/ /i rkyuk+ta de ba pu tre ṇa sha kre khosto ta the ti tsa/ /rjotasmṛtasmradā ni bdag gis 'gro/ /lha yi bu yis 'di brjod las/ /brgya byin de bzhin zhes smras tshe/ /rjes gnang de rnyep+ta stat+pa sgyu ཿku k+ṣi mā bi shata/ /de ba tā swa pa da ga tā su pra budzha ni de nas 'phos/ /de yi chung ma'i dku ru zhugs/ /lha ni rang gi gnas song ste/ /legs par rab ma bhā ṣatra/ /pra bra dzñā bhe ra ta sā sgo bha bi 6 ti su tasta ba/ /i ti sad de la 0smras/ /rab tu 'byung bel mngon dga'i bu/ /dge ba khyod la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa shu tā kṛ ha pa tiḥpra hriṣ+ṭaḥpra ya yo kṛ haṃ/ /pra bra dzhai bā ra yi sgyu mi pu tu thos nas khyim bdag ni/ /rab tu mgu nas khyim song ste/ /bu ni rab tu 'byung ba dag /bdag gis 95 736

gye ti bi tsin+ta yata/ /tataḥkā le na tat+pasnri la li tā nā ma bā la kai/ /sabye ga bzlog par bya zhes bsams/ /de nas dus kyis de yi ni/ /chung ma rol pa ma zhes la/ /yan lag lak+ṣa rdo be+e ta ma sru ta ka na ka dha tai/ / sat+tha rat+na ma yo ta su thams cad mtshan nyid ldan/ /byes pa gser 'od can de bcasanya/ /de skyes nyid ni khurin chen ni/ /dzā te sri ba bya dzā ya ta / / sgo tram̐ mu sto mi bābyar+ya sprut+ta oṃ su kṛ kun gyi ⑦rang bzhin gdugs 'khrungs te/ /legs byas dpal ni bla med dang / /ngo mtshar gzugs dang ta shri yaḥ/ /sa ya sho dā bhi dha no bhūr+ya sho bṛdh+yā pi tuḥpa re/ /be+e ldan pa bzhin/ /mchog tu pha yis thugrags 'phel bas/ /rig ⑤pa sgyu rtsal 'byor pa rnams/ /tshogs byā ka khā bhe byu tī dzā sa mā ga ma kṛ ho pa maḥ/ /de ba tā ba tsa ā+oṃ smṛ tā pra bra bye pa'i khang pa lta bu stenya/ /grags sbyin zhes ni bya bar gyur/ /lha yi tshig ni dran gyur nas/ /de ni rab tu shaṃ ki taḥbi tā/ /ta gya tsa kre kṛ ha pu ra dā ra go pu ra rak+ṣa khaṃ/ /a thā bye byung dogs te/ /grong dang khang pa grong khyer gyi⑦ / /sgo rnams pha yis bsrung bar hūṃbyas/ /de nas brgya ta sa sha kre ṇa smra ri dzaḥpūt+tha sam+bi dā/ /ba bhū ba sha masaṃ bik+taḥpra byin mngon phyogs te/ /sngon gyi 'gro ba brtan po7par byas/ /zhi bas dran pa rab byung la/ /mngon bra dzñā bhi mu khā da raḥ/ /sa ka da tshisdo dzorlu rna ra thā rū bhāḥsha nairba dzan/ /par phyogs shing gus par gyur/ /nam zhig rang gi ⑫skyed tshal du/ /dal gyis shing rta zhon 'gro des/ /da dar+sha dzi na mā yā rnye bha ga brnya ya dṛts+tsha yā/ /dz+dza da ya su kha saṃ spar+sha bcom ldan rgyal ba ji zhig ltar/ /byon pa dag ni mthong bar gyur/ /snying la bde bas yang dag reg /bstedhe pra sha mā mṛ tai/ /tai bi lo kye ba sa ha pā ra thā da ba ta tā ra saḥ/ /rab zhi bdud rtsi'i char 'babs 17pa/ /de mthong nyid na 'phral la ni/ /shing rta dag las de yis babs//tai j-i da k+ṣi ṇi kṛ t+ya tat+yā da na li na dwa yo/ /sa ba ban+de pra pā dādz+ra dṛ de la bskor ba gsum byas te/ /de yis ⑫ zhabs pad zung dag la/ /dang bas brlan pa de yis 7ni/ /95—737

sha te nā ba lo ki taḥ/ /bha ga ba rnyi pra ṇa myu tha pra sa.oṃ ta da nu spyan gyis gzigs pa des phyag btsal①/ /de nas rab dang bcom ldan la/ /rab btud de yi rjes rnye ya/ /dza gā ma ni dza mud+mā rna sa ta me ba bi tsadha yata/ /r+bhak+ṣu ma shwa dzi gnang gis/ /de nyid rnam par sems shing ①de/ /rang gi skyed mos tshal du song / /de nas bcom ldan lta shā ha bha ga bān na tha sa smi taḥ/ /e ṣernyi ke me rā tro ku mā raḥpra bra 'dzum ldan pas/ /dge slong rta thul la gsungs pa/ /bdag gi drung du gzhon nu 'di/ /mtshan mo rab dzi 6 ti / / i kyu ghā swa pa rda yā te su ga te sa ha bhi kyu tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs bde gshegs rang gnas su/ /dge slong rnams dang lhan cig bhiḥ / /sha kra nim+bi ta ma dāk+ṣi ta ku mā rāḥsdi ka la ba re/ /pū ya gshegs—/ /brgya byen gyis sprul bud med lus/ /gzhon nu yis ni mthong gyur te/ /brnags ①shing parlu ṣi tai kle da sī daskṛ mi ku lā ku la/ /sa dṛṣ+ṭha sha ba mud+mā ṣ+pe pobye gaḥrdul la mi gtsang ba/ /srin bu'i tshogs kyis 'khrugs shing gnas/ /skyed mos tshal gyi ro mthong nas/ /sa ma tsin+ta ya ta / /bi kā ra e ba tā ru bye ru pa lā ba rgya kān+ta chags bral ldan pa des bsam ④pa/ /dar bab gzugs ni mdzes pa dang / /sdug pa rnam par 'gyur ba yaḥ / /tsan+d+ra mā sa sa mu hā nā mi yi sā pra kṛ tirjo rja/ /lo khā lo tsa nyid / /pags pa sha tshogs mi rnams kyis⑤/ /rang bzhin de ni 'di nyid do/ /mig dag g.yo zhing nu na mum+bi ṣad+ku tsa yu gaḥko ṣe sha shī ka tī ṣā me tat+tan+da ba yo ba no da ya la pas+thā ma zung ni rab rgyas ri bong can gyi 'od kyi mdzod/ /lus de lang tsho gsar pa dar bab mdzes sdug 'phro ba bye ga bye ba buḥ/ /yā haṃ pū ti ba sā ba pe ka pi ka la kla myata kṛ mi bar bgrang ba 'di dag ni/ /rul ba'i brlan gyis nges bran 'khrugs shing dman pa'i srin bu rnams kyis byā ku la kli n+da klo ma ya kṛ be+e tī ṇ+ḍi sa ka la l+lī hā n+t+ra ni r+ya n+t+ra dkrigs—/ /ngan zhing (6༄rab mang bshang bas bsgos shing mtha' dag rgyu mchin (pe'akhrul 'khor med nyid 95 — —738

tai—/ /asmibye ga bi mo ha hā ri ta dṛ shaḥsarde ga saṃ got+pa be+e saṃ lī nāsta gyur—/ /yan lag thams cad 'grogs par spro ba 'di la chags shing rmongs pas mig phrogs shing / /nu na maṇ+ḍa le ha ta dhi yaḥ pra pūḥpa dzā nidṛ tai/ /yasma de ṣa ga ta ma'i dkyil 'khor la chags blo gros nyams pas mchog tu bde ba thob gyur pa/ /gang las wa skyes 'di ni spyo haḥka ba la ṣ+pe bai mu khya ba krā na naḥkle da mo da bi ṣā da kyu ṇi ta ma ti chags bral bza' ba dag las phyir phyogs bzhin 'khyog ①cing / /mi gtsang dri nga dag gis yid byung blo rdu ri ga to rdza bu kaḥ/ /i ti pañtsirgyu saṃ dzā targyu shwe bai rā gya bā gros rmus ⑤phyin ring du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsams ①chags bral bag chags ni/ /sbas pa yang dag sa naḥ/ /dza gā mod+mā na bi mu khaḥs sha ṣ+perti dza man+di re/ /a ṭ+wā ta rgyas gyur te/ /de ni skyed tshal las phyir phyogs/ /rang gi khang par dal gyis song / /skabs der nyin re di na smra ni khirjo bhūn+d+ra sha madru khāḥ/ /bi ra saṃ lo ka bṛhūṃ tram̐ bi byed 'jig rten gyi④/ /spyod tshul ro bral mthong bas bzhin/ /skyo ⑤zhing rab zhir mngon phyogs te/ /lo kye ba di bā ka raḥ/ /a she ṣā yā sha pa ri t+yā ga yo gyi pra sha me nyin par dag ni nyams par gyur⑥/ /ngal dub ma lus yongs gtong bar/ /'os pa rab zhir ⑦ 'gro yu ṣaḥ/ /sastsu ralnga lba ra dzu ṣaḥpra bra bye ba ra be+e ra bhūta/ /lo 'dod cing / /thun mtshams mkha' yi gos dmar bsten/ /nyin mo rab tu byung bzhin gyur/ /nyi ma kot+ta ra pa rda yā te bhā no bhu ba na tsak+ṣu ṣi/ /bā sa ro pi pa ri t+ya bye srid pa'i mig dag ni/ /'jig rten pha rol gnas song tshe/ /'jig rten yongs btang nyin mo yang / /lo ka ta da nu go bha bta/ /ta taḥpra t+ya gra ti mi robye ga yo shaṃ dza gadzu ṣe/ /de yi rjes 'brang nyid du gyur/ /de nas 'gro bsten gsar pa yi'u/ /rab rib mya ngan sbyor ba dag /pra dī pa maṇ+ḍa lā lo kaḥkṛ pa ye ba n+ya bā ra yata/ /a smin na ba sa sgron ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba yis/ /brtse bas ⑨bzhin du rab tu bzlog /skabs der ston pa rang nyid 95—739

ri shāstu ya sho da da ya yā swa yo/ /pu ra na byāḥpa ra pā re pābye sa mu ni—/ /grags sbyin dag la brtse ba yis/ /grong khyer klung 'gram pha rol tu/ /de 'thob ①be+ed du yang pā ya yo/ /ya sho de pi di nā ya sa tu la yā ka la yadru huḥ/ /saṃ sā dag gshegs/ /grags sbyin gyis kyang nyin par gyis/ /nyon mongs mtshungs pa yang yang du/ /'khor ba rā sā ra ta me ba shayā bha ba na mā be+e shata/ /bi ṇa bī ṇa mṛ rda gā di bi no snying po med pa nyid/ /sems shing nyal ba'i khang par zhugs/ /gling bu rgyud mang rdza rnga sogs/ / rtse de n+d+ra da ni za raḥ / / ta tā ba sh+yad+ma la khāḥ shra ma ni dā ni m+bi li dga' la ④zhing gnyid log pa/ /mig zum rgyags pas 'khrugs pa yi/ /bud med rnams der de yis tāḥ—/ /bī rja be+e n+yasta ba da nā sbo rda gādz+re ta dorla tāḥ/ /k+ṣa ṇi ka mthong / /kha ni rgyud mang ①la bkod cing / /lag pa'i 'khri shing rdza rngar ④gtang / /bde ba skad cig tā su kha gye ba duḥkha dh+yā na mu pa ga taḥ/ /bi lo kya shrasta ba da nāstu mṛ tā pa nyid kyis⑤/ /sdug bsngal bsam gtan la zhugs bzhin/ /gos ral shi ba bzhin du ni/ /g.yo med i ba ni: khāḥ/ /saṃ dzā tā bye ka be+e rā gyaḥs tsi ram̐ sa ma tsin+ta yata/ /de dag mthong gyur nas/ /lhag par chags bral yang dag skyes/ /yun ring de yis yang dang bsams/ /a ho ba tā smim+bi ṣa ye pa r+yarnya bi ra pe ba re/ /e baṃ bi dhe ba byu kye ma yul ni 'di dag rnams/ /mjug tu mchog tu ro dang bral/ /bud med ces pa 'di lta la/ /nāsdi mud+dhā rmā ji sha mā da raḥ/ /bi byu dī la ṣi tā t+yā su ma sakhru kha gha no da rmongs pa rnams ni mchog tu gus/ /mchog min bde ba'i sprin rgyas la/ /glog gi rtse dga' 'di dag yeske/ /suṭ+wā rmā tsa mṛ tā rmāñtsa ku྾ dze+e kyu tsa baṃ khyu maḥ/ /shete kā tsi da sgo rnams—/ /gnyid log shi ba dag la yang / /rnam 'phrul gang na 'dzum gang na/ /'ga' zhig 'og tu kha mu khā+e baṃ ba li tā thrakhye sgo tā suḥpa rā yā tā snge pi bi kā shi tā gya bi ba rā sarja ga bltas nyal zhing de yi rgyab ni gzhan du bzlog ste lhung / /gzhan yang gan kyal (7yan lag kun brkyangs ④ 95—740

muṭ+wā na tsā / /saṃ sā sak+ta mi bhak+ta muk+ta ka tsa rī kā kaidṛ te bā pa ra kha yi bu ga rnam par bye bar gyur/ /gzhan dag skra ni grol zhing dral bas phrag pa la chags bya rog babs pa bi bhā d+me bha ba dz+wa ni lbo na na ya naste rde dre shā nā ya te/ /a bzhin—/ /bdag gi khyim ni mig zum bud med tshogs rnams rnam 'dzin dur khrod lta bur spyod/ /deng ①ha ma bye ba niṣ+ka mya bra bra dzñādhī pu dzā ta rāta/ /bha ga badhe bra dzā bye ba nyid rab byung don gnyer bdag /grong khyer nang las (kyephyir 'thon te/ /rmongs pa bzlog slad bcom drabye mo ha ni bṛ t+ta ye/ / bi tsibye ti sa mā dā ya ma hā ste rat+na ldan 'das/ /nges par blta snyeru 'gro bar bya/ /zhes bsams rin gyethang che ba yilngoste/ /rin chen pā du ke/ /sha kra pra bha pāt+pa ya yā ba dzñā ta pu ra rak+ṣi taḥ/ / mchil lham zung khyanas de/ /grong srung rnams kyis ma shes par/ /brgya byin gyi muni mthu yis song / /a bhe niṣ+ka mya na ga ra dā rāt+tha pya pa rirbe dzā/ /saṃ sā ra ma ruhūṃ krārnya tā paṃ grong khyer sgo las mngon par ni/ /byung ste chu klung mchog thob nas/ /'khor ba'i mya ngam ( te'aphos pa yisaldi/t+ya thi mo bor+ya ta ཿ / / ta mā yādhe bi lo kye ba bha ga bān+d+ra ta bha gdung ba gtong bar brtson pa bzhin/ /bcom ldan 'byung po dgongs pa yis/ /de ni 'ong ba gzigs ba taḥ/ /spru t+yā sad+dhā ra rde ta su ya yo poṅkaṇ+ḍi tā mi ba/ sa he ma gyur nas/ /dgyes pas de ni bsgral ba la/ /bzhed dang ldan pa bzhin du gyur/ /de yis rjes mthun baṇ+ḍi mu da mya dak+ṣi rde dak+ṣa rte bhu dze+e/ /de ha pra bhā ba pra kā she na rta maḥpa ri gser gyi mdog /phyag ni g.yas pa brkyangs ⑫mdzad nas/ /sku yi gzi brjid snang ba yis/ /phyogs kyi ha ran di shaṃ/ /e bye hi pāsnu hi pa rda ni ra pā ya ma nā ma yo/ /mun pa yongs phrogs ⑪shing / /tshur shog tshur shog gnod med la/ /nad med gnas ni khrod kyis 'thob/⑩//a bh+ya dh+wa di ti tai du rāta me gha gho ṣa gha na swa raḥ/ /shu tā bha ga ba ces pa 'brug dbyangs ltar sdug sgras/ /ring po nas ni de la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyogasung 95—741

pu tram̐ bu raḥsbi tai/ /ta taḥkṛ ta pra ṇa ma gya ta snga bi bha ga bān pu mdun na ①gnas pa'i bu ma mthong / /de nas slar yang bcom ldan gyis②/ /rab tu btud byas de yi naḥ / /dharmya ya ka tha ya mo haṃ tī ṣa ta ma i bā ha ratu/ /tī bra mo hasta yang / /rmongs pa 1chos gtam rigs pa yas/ /'od kyi mun pa bzhin du phrogs/ /de nas rmongs bral taḥpu tram̐ sa driṭī be+e ma la gyu to/ /shāstu: kā rā nu ma taḥpra ṇa yā da dhi de yis ④bu/ /dri med 'od ldan mthong gyur nas/ /rjes su 'dod cing gus pa yis/ /ston pa lhag par bā sa rmā/ /bha ga ba na tha tadṛ he kṛ tā pū dzā pra ti gra haṃ/ /tai pasnri gnas pa byas/ /de yi khyim du bcom ldan gyis/ /mchod pa rab tu blangs ste)mdzad nas/ /de ni 67chung sa hi lta tsakre shudha shik+ṣu pa do dz+wa lo/ / ta to ya sho da sa cibābya mar bcas pa la/ / dag pa'i bslab kluganas rab 'bar mdzad/ /de nas grags sbyin grogs po ni/ /tā ra shrī madzñā bā rāḥ/ /bi ma khā khyaḥsu bā hubya pūṇ+ḍi ko tha ga r+pā pa tiḥ/ /dpal dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /dri med gang po lag bzang dang / /ba glang bdag ces bya ba bzhis//ya shaḥpra kā shi ta di shaṃ ya sho rda bha ga badru raḥ/ /brah+ma tsar+ya bra tā bcom ldan mdun na grags sbyin 'a7ni/ /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs la chags pa'i/ /grags pa phyogs su sa lte khru tā lta de sha gā ya yu/ / te ྾ ku sha khā pā ke na pā bhā rab gsal ba/ /thos nas gnas der 'ongs par gyur/ /dge ba smin pas thob gyur pa/ /de dag rmā bha ga bārlu naḥ/ /bi da dhe dhan+d+ra bi na ye shā sa rna shud+dhā shā sa naḥ/ /rnams la bcom ldan 'das/ /dag pa'i bka' yis slar yang ni/ /'dul ba'i chos la bstan pa bsgrubs/ /ya sho daste tsa tsa tā ro bhik+ṣa baḥpañtsa tsā pa re/ /artat+pa rda da sha pā pusta bzhi po de dag rmye grags sbyin dang / /dge slong gzhan pa lnga dag sterngu/ /bcu yis ⑩bcom ldan drung du ni/ /da bha ga ba tornyi ke/ / khru tā ya sho da thra d+dhā tai dha t+yāstat+pa tsi bā dgra bcom gnas dag thob par gyuraspyo/ /grags sbyin spyod tshul thos gyur nas/ /de yi grogs po skal 95—743

na ni ya tai kā le na t+yak+ta pi gra haḥ/ /so bha bah+phu ma tirnu ma de pa pu tra de gsungs te/ / dus kyis lus ni btang byas nas/ /①blo bzang zhes pa lha yi bur/ /mtho ris su ni ñtsi ran+di bi/ /sa e ṣa pu stso bā na yaḥya sho daḥshe ya sā ni byeḥ/ /yun ring gyur/ /bsod nams ldan pa de nyid dang / /grags sbyin dge legs gter 5'di ste/ /su dz+dza dā ma pi saṃ pāp+taḥtīdh+yā ku sha la se tu tsā/ /kṛ tīrtswa ma k+ṣi ti pa tiḥgrags pa yis ni grogs rnams kyang / /dge ba'i zam stegs nyid dag thob/ /sa bdag kṛ tī rnguzhes bya ba/ /ka sh+ya pya snga ka roh+phu rā/ /shāstuḥsha rī ra nit+yā ṇi rat+na stu pa mu dā ra dhīḥ/ /rgya chen blo yis ⑦ston pa ni/ /'od srungs / musku dag myang 'das la/ /rin chen mchod rten sngon tshe byas/ /ya sha sī ra me ta na yas+t+ri tī yasta gya bhū pa teḥ/ /bhabyu tasmid+ma ṇitho pe sa yi bdag po de yi bu/ /gsum pa grags ldan dga' ba yis/ /nor bu'i mchod rten de la ni/ /gus rat+na ts+tshahūṃ n+ya be+e sha yata/ /te nā pi pūt+tha pubye na dzad+ma n+yasmid+ma ha ya shāḥ/ /pas rin chen gdugs dag bkod/ /de dang bsod nams snga ma yis/ /skye ba 'di la grags sbyin ni/ /dzā to ya sho dbyutre ṇa rat+na dībhe na byu ṣi taḥ/ /i bye n+ya dzad+ma su kṛ to da grags chen rin chen 'bar ba yi/ /gdugs kyis brgyan pa dag tu skyes/ /de ltar skye ba gzhan la legs ya ba dhe mū la sod+me ṣa e ṣa sha shi shu blu ya sho shu pu be+e ཿ / / dha n+d+ra byas rgyas pas rtsa ba bcings/ /zla ba ltar dkar grags pa'i 'od zer rgyas pa'i me tog can/ /dge ba de dru maḥthra thu ta raḥpa li tā gya sā bhoḥkhru two ti bisma ya ma bā pa sa bhek+ṣu yis 'uchos kyi ljon pa rab rgyas 'bras smin 'di/ /de skad thos nas dge slong tshogs des ya 7mtshan thob saṃ ghaḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e sgo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam tā yo ya sho dā ba dā dz+wa dā ṣakhyu ta ma ཿ pa be+e waḥ / / //gyi 'khri shing las grags sbyin gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste 3snadrug cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //95—745

sha kra bā yu ba ru rja da yaḥsu ra bi kri yārlu ni ba rā: yaskṛ te/ /brgya byin rlung dang chu sogs lha rnams dang / /thub mchog rnams kyang gang slad rnam 'gyur du/ /yārnyi tat+tha ra su khaṃ tri ṇa ya te ya su ka su na sa basmi yaspa rda/ /dī dzad+mā mā ga d+mā 'gyur ba'i dran bde rtswa ltar gcod (1 pa'i gnas/ /ya mtshan can de gang su rung ba'i 2min/ /ma ga jo gra me bi khru ta shri n+d+ra hā s+tha le / / n+ya gro dha ka lpa nā ma byud+ma hā grong thang chen du/ /sā la chen po'i rigs 'khrungs pa/ /n+ya gro dha yi tog ④ces pa/ ) /gnyis skyes shā ya ku lobye baḥ/ /ta su bhār+yā su rū pā khyu kṛ hod+mā na bi ha ri khaṃ/ /a grags pa'i dpal ldan byung / /de yo chung ma gzugs bzang ma/ /zhes pa khang pa'i skyed tshal na/ /rol su ta su ta marmā dzha pispa la su ta ro ro dhaḥ/ /dzā ta mā tri su te tamin+d+rap+ta dzam+bu pas 5ljon shing pispa rdo6la'i/ /'og tu bu ni nyi 'od bskrun/ /gser gyi 'od zer rab 'bar ba'i/ bu na da byu tai/ /di bye shu shaṃ ya sha shu rja tasman+d+ra pur byut+ta roḥ/ /sa pispa khā de skyes pa tsam nyid la/ /grags pa ltar dkar lha yi gos/ /shing de las ni rab tu byung / /pispa skyel ya no nā ma bā laḥka ma la lo tsa naḥ/ /bi byā ka lā ka li ta byergya bzlu ta sa ha skyes zhes bya ba/ /byis pa pad+ma'i mig can de/ /rig dang sgyu rtsal blo sbyangs shing / /dpal dang lhan shri yā/ / sa pi tā pā bye no pi bi bā ha bi mu khaḥ sa da/ / ba bhū cig rnam par rgyas/ /de ni pha yis —7gsol btab kyang / /rtag tu khyim thab las phyir phyogs/ /yul la ba bi ṣa ya dwo ྾ bi be+e ga bi ṣa dā sha yaḥ/ /baṃ shats+tsha ta bha yā྾ tā sa sdang spyo ldan dben pa ni/ /dri med bsam pa ldan par tsho gyur/ /pha ni rigs brgyud chad ⑪pa yis/ /pu naḥpu na rarji taḥ/ /ta mu tse ro tsi te ma hūṃ nā sa ṇi gra ha brnya rmā/ /'jigs nas yang yang gsol btab ste4/ /de la smras pa khyem thab kyi/ /'ching ba la ni bdag mi srid⑫//na tā ta kā ma kā bo haṃ bra h+ma tsa rle ma ti n+d+ra ma / / sha ma swāts+tshabye yab gcig nyuzi'adod pa bdag mi 'dod/ /bdag gi blo gros tshangs spyod la'o/ /rang 'dod zhi ba dor 95—746

mukhru ka ka gyeṣ+ṭi bha ba ban+dha rgo/ /bāt+pa su r+ya sa ta ta sa ṣ+pe ho ma dhū meḥnas ni/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba su zhig 'dod/ /dang por sbyin sreg du bas mchi ma rtag tu 'bab la kye rab pra thratrī ཿ pa t+ya grah+pho rgya pa na sha ra ṇi tu l+ya ha stu dze+e ṇi na / / saṃ tu 'jug /mtshungs par lag pa gtad pas gdung ba'i lam la 3bden par mdud pa mdzad/ /'phreng ( sā rā dzñā sa ma ya tsa la ṣ+pe brnya rna mā le dā: mo hā ro ho pa ha ta ma na sī har+ṣa ba'i thag pas 'khor ba'i bka' yi dam tshig dag la g.yo ba 'chang kru/ /khyim thab yid ni rmongs pa gnas he tube+e bā haḥ/ /yisgo t+ya ni la lo la bā la la la na bal+la bi khā pas nyer bcom rnams kyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ /na chung gzhon nu'i 'khri shing gar gyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i rtse sā nu gā dī rja baṃ sha ra bā bi bā ha sa ma ye pros+thā hi tairna shu taḥ/ /dga'i ⑤ rjes 'brang ba'i/ /rgyud mang spyogling bu'i sgra ni khyim thab dus su spro ldan gang gis ma mnyan pa/ /ha pu tre ti ba pu pra lā pa ka la na l+lī bā na te ྾ shri tā shā yarnyi gu ru bābe+e gaṅga de dag la brten mekyi hud bu zhes chung mas cho nge smra zhing dman gyur pa/ /mchi ma lci bar thigs zigs da ga laṅga ṭa rnyi yo gā gi riḥ/ /i truk+ta ti bra ni sgor+ghaṃ pi ta re dza na 'bab pas mngon par sbyar ba'i sgra grags ⑤thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'bad pa drag po yis/ /pha dang ma sh+lau tsa paḥ/ /ta ma ka bye sa mā dā ya ku sha leḥshidze+e bhiḥkṛ hūṃ/ /saṃ la des smras nas/ /mdzes pas dran rmyepa dge mtshan gyisakhu/ /myu gu /4yang dag skyes pa bzhin/ /bzo dzāhūṃ krarnyi pik+ta su kau tu ka gye ba kan+da s+thā/ /kul bi ts+tsha da tsiṭ+wār+ghaṃ dhī raḥbo mkhas pas byas pa yi⑫/ /gser byi bu mo bzung nas ni/ /rigs chad bsams thupas gzir de la/ /pu na ru bā tsa ti/ /tu l+ya khā bārdzu bar+ṇa su la bh+ya te ya di ka n+ya kā/ /brten ⑫pas slar yang rab smras pa/ /kha dog mdzes sdug 'di mtshungs pa'i/ /bu mo gal te rnyed gyur na//ka ro mi tīṅgi rā tā ta ta da haṃ dā ra saṃ gra haṃ/ /i ti bu tra ba tsaḥyab gcig spyokhyod kyi tshig gis ni/ /bdag gi bud med bzung ⑩bar bgyi/ /zhes pa bu yi ⑩tshig thos 95—747

shu tā tatū l+ya di bi durla dzha/ /krāh+ma ṇaḥka n+ya kāsma ṭ+wā na rā sho bhū da dho mu nas—/ /de mtshungs bu mo mtho ris su/ /rnyed dkar shes nas bram ze ni/ /re thag chad cing bzhin du kha—/ /bi ga ta nan+da ni gyan+da su hrits+tsha ru ra kā bi dhaḥ/ /tai bi praḥshu tā 'gyurahu/—/ /tsartso ka ra zhes pa'i grogs/ /bram zes gtam de thos pa yis/ /kun dga' dang bral g.yo thraṭ+wān+taḥsho ka kludha ma tā pa ta/ /pra yat+na mā tra sā dh+yaze na sho rka kastu marta med pa/ /mya ngan gyis nyen de la smras/ /rab 'bad tsam gyis ②bzod don la/ /khyod ni mya ngan byar serka/ /e ṣa bra dzā mya haṃ drahūṃ ka n+ya kā ka na ka pra sgo/ /i ti snasnya su su mi 'os/ /bu mo gser 'od ldan pa ni/ /blta /1ru nga nyid 'gro bar bya/ /zhes te mdza' ba'i grogs po hri daḥs kṛ tā byer+ya ma gra dzaḥ/ /ā dā ya he ma pra ti rmā ya yo dhī man di ni—/ /dang por skyes pas bstan byas nas/ /gser gyi gzugs brnyan bzung nas ni/ /blo ldan phyogs shaṃ ta ram̐/ / de ba hūṃ ladzi na ts+tsharja sa mā khye khru ka byu ṣi tai/ /rnams dag ④tu song / /'phreng sprib gos dang bcas pas brgyan/ /lha yi mtshan ma'i zol gyis ni/ /kṛ tī twa dik+ṣu ba bh+ra ma kan+ya pū bye mu dā ha ran/ /tah+phudzo pa ga tāḥbazung nas phyogs su 'khyam byed cing / /bu mos mchod par ( bebya zhes smras/ /grong khyer grong dang lam ka sde na ga ra grwa ma baṭ+wā su/ /bi lo ka yad+ma pa ta ti na tabhu be+e ma bāp+ta rnams su/ /de mchod du 'ong (7)bu mo rnams/ /rtag tu rnam par blta ⑧ba des/ /de dang mtshungs pa bān / /ta taḥka dā dzi1 shā bye ka pi la snga gra dzad+ma naḥ/ /ka n+ya mā pa sh+yadha rnyed ma gyur/ /de nas bram ze ser skya yis/ /bu mo gser gyi bu mo bas/ /'od lhag bzang mo zhes pa yi⑨ / /tā khye he ma ka n+ya bye ka pra r+ghaṃ/ /bi bā ha bi mu khā+e kārnyi hūṃ bai rā gya bi be yangs pa can du nam zhig mthong / /mjos ma khyim thab las phyir phyogs/ /chags mabral dben pa dang ki rmā/ /sa tem shulke ka bi lo ya yā tsi ka thi tā nā yaḥ/ /lta ka n+ya ldan zhing / /gser rin ma da 11ser skya la/ /rjes 'gro bshad pa de yis babe+engs/ /bu mo'i pha yis 95 ——748

dza n+ya kaḥshā ha sad+ku lo ku la bi khru tai/ /lo ke n+ya gro dha ka pra sgo go tra dzā ta der ①smras pa/ /'od srungs rigs skyes 'jig rten na/ /n+ya gro dha yi rtog pa yinaphu7/ /rigs mchog su kā sh+ya pya/ /ki tu ka t+yā pra yasne na dha na mam+bi 6 di ya te/ /rigs ni rnam par grags/ /'on kyang mdzes ma 'bad pa yis/ /nor ni brtags snye nas sbyin par bya/ /dā ri drots+tsha pi nā pa ha pi turda ha ti mā na saṃ/ /pasnri ka la haṃ saṃ salto ka n+ya dbul ba'i shugs rings ldan ma des/ /pha yi yid ni gdung bar byed/ /chung ma 'thab mo la chags dang / /kā ni zlu na dri ta/ /bye ba no pa ha taḥsru nustabhā bye ta sa sru tsa bu mo nor med la sbyin ④dang / /bu ni gdung bas nyer bcom rnams/ /sems la khab bsregs khye lta bu yaḥ—/ /da tā shri yo dza la ni dhiḥpu ru khot+ta mā ya dzña tā tha ba ma na ta ram̐ ba li yāsnyo yin—/ /chu gter byi ⑥ni skyes bu mchog la dpal mo byin byas te/ /ci ste de ni stobs ldan la slong mi'u yā tai/ /a r+ya pi sak+ta ba ḍa bā na la ru pa sho kaḥsosgo sa e ba na bi thung shes nas/ /da lta'ang mya ngan la chags rta gdong me yi rang bzhin gyes⑦/ /gdung ba drag po shugs myuñtsa ta tī bra tā paṃ / / ta smraji trī sa ma bhe 6 dzñā tā ha ju bha rings bludang bcas nges par gtong mi byed/ /de slad nor ni btsal byas te67/ /de 'byor mngon mtho bo bon+da to/ /da su maḥsad+ku le ka khye dha nā dhī na hi saṅga ṇaḥ/ /i ti ka t+yā shes gyur nas/ /dam pa'i rigs la bu mo sbyin/ /dam pa'i yon tan nor gyi dbang / /zhes pa bu mo'i pi tuḥkhru tā tah+phu tra ṇ+ḍañtsa bha ṣi tai/ /ta je kyuk+ta dī dzaḥbye yad+ku mā ra dza na pha dang de'i/ /bu rnams kyis kyang brjod thos nas/ /de bzhin zhes smras gnyis skyes ni/ /gzhon nu'i karnyi shaṃ/ /su paṇ+ḍi lā ba rgyu shābhā shu tā ka bye ti tat+pa tsaḥ/ /n+ya gro dha pha yi gan du song / /gser byi mdzes ma las lhag pa'i/ /bu mo thob ces de yi tshig /n+ya gro dha yi rtog kalpaḥshu tī pa ba bhū pā nan+da ni r+bha raḥ/ /brah+ma tsabye ṣi rde shu tā ka n+ya kā pispa lā pa yis⑪/ /thos nas kun dga' rgyas par gyur/ /bu mo tshangs spyod don gnyer ma/ /thos nas pispa la 95—749

yoḥ—/ /ba byu ba bi bha ba glu ni rā dzñā r+bha gān+da no bhu baḥ/ /par+yā ye ṇi pa'i tshe/ /yid la (hūṃbyung ba'i bka' bcag pas/ /'byor pa dman pa nyid du gyur/ /de gnyis reg pa ka ni dru yī dzā gaskyo kaḥs mubyu ta/ /i ti to spar+sha rak+ṣa ye tsakra tuḥsha ya bsrung ba'i slad/ /res kyi gcig ni gnyid log cing / /gcig ni langs nas mel tshe byed/ /ces pa nasbi ti/ / ka dā tsi da tha sha l+lī te kā la byā lam̐ bya lo ka yata/ /nyal ba'i rnam gzhag byas/ /de nas nam zhig mal stan mthar/ /de yi mig ni gnyid kyis rgyas/ /ni dru mu dra ti ṣ+pe tā dze+e pispa khā ya naḥ/ /ta taḥs tar+bha yāt+ta gya dorla tā thebs tshe pispa la skyes kyis/ /sbrul ni nag po mthong bar gyur(glu / /de nas de lag 'khri shing ni/ /logs sār+sha la m+bi bhā / / sa da ya bya ma rā dhe na ra ra sgoblu pya bā sa su 'phyang snye/ba brtse ldan des/ /rnga yab mtha' dang gos dag gis/ /bsdus nas 'jigs pa de las pā—/ /sa ha sā bā ju tsa la na trasnra ha ri ṇa lo tsa nā/ /sā pa kadza bsrungs④—/ /'phral la lag pa bskyod (sripa yis/ /skrag pa'i ri dwags mig can ma/ /nu ma 'dar zhing ku tsā lo la hā ra pa ti ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ār+ya pu tra ka thi nā ma sa ma yaḥpa t+ya bā di do shal ni/ /g.yo ldan ma des khyo la smras/ /jo ⑥ yi sras po ji ltar na/ /nges par dam tshig brjed gyur naḥ—/ /bi smri tasta ba saṃ dzā to ya da yi tsit+ta bi sla baḥ/ /ladz+dza ba hā bi cing / /bden par stismra ba khyod kyi thugs/ /gang 'di (shernam par bslad pa skyes/ /khyod kyi rnam 'gyur kā ra gya ke ya ma t+yat+ta tā ta ba/ /t+ya dzarnyi be+e ti marlu dzā byu dha ra na tu sā ngo tsha'i rgyun/ /shin tu che ldan 'di ni ci/ /sa 'dzin dag kyang brtan po7pa'i lugs/ /gtong gi dam pa dha baḥ/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥkhru tā tā mu bā tsa ba sa smi taḥ/ /bhū dre nāsbya yongs ⑩ ma yin/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /'dzum ldan de yis (1k+ṣede la smras/ /rmi lam na yang ba ma na saḥswasne pi ma ma bi be+e baḥ/ /ki tre ṣa kṛṇ+ḍa sakhro tra dī ṣa ṇaḥpa bdag gi yid/ /bzang mo nges par bslad pa ⑫med/ /'on kyang 'dir ni sgrul nag 'di/ /'jigs 95—751

ri ba t+ta te/ /ba huste sha ya nā lasbyi d+dhā bye saṃ rak+ṣi to ma ya/ /su rung ba yongs su rgyu/ /khyod kyi lag pa mal stan '-itelas/ /'phyang du ba 'jigs nas bdag gis bsrungs/ /e tat+pa kyud+dhā tsaḥkhru twa te shaṃ kā dza ga da sā/ /diṭī t+yab t+yashī la su khyo yi tshig 'di thos gyur nas/ /(snyedogs btang dga' ba des smras pa/ /bden pa'i ngang tshul khyod kyi ④blo/ /na kā ma ma li na ma ti/ /sadze+eḥsā dhun+d+ra rā ko yam̐ bha yo rā go ra gāt+pa 'dod pas dri mar byas pa med/ /gdug pa'i sbrul ni khegs pa ste⑤/ /chags pa'i lto 'phyes mchog tu re / /e ka harnyi ti sum̐ sadze+eḥkā maḥkā ya sha tsā ta kṛ ta/ /rak+ṣa 'jigs / /sbrul gyis (67lus gcig 'joms pa ste/ /'dod pas lus rgo brgya mthar byed/ /de be+ed tasprubo kā ro yo mi trughā bi ra rā ma sā/ /tī bye tsa pra sha shaṃ sā sngaḥsaṃ rnam 'gyur 'di dag bsrungs⑩7/ /zhes smras de ni chags dang bral/ /de yi shin tu dul ba yang pispa ya oṃ pispa khā ya naḥ/ /n+ya gro dha kaspe kā le na sa bhārle tro di baṃ ge te/ /pra la skyes dag gis bsngags/ /dus kyi n+ya gro dha ⑧yi togadwa/ /chung mar bcas pa mtho ris song rab byu ta kṛ ha saṃ bhā ra tsid+dhā bhā ra mu bā hā saḥ/ /ka dā tsit+ta la pā nā ya bṛ ṣā mang khyim gyi tshogs dag gis/ /bsam pa'i khur ni de yis blangs/ /nam zhig til mar btung ba'i slad/ /rde ti la r+pā ḍa ṇi/ / te na bha dā sa mā di ṣ+ṭa n+ya yulte pa ri ba ri khyu mchog rnams kyi til 'tshir la/ /bzang mos yongs su bstan pa yis/ /'khor rnams dag ni yongs kāḥ —/ /tāḥbi ḍi ta ti lāste la rku bhe 6 kṛ mi saṃ tsa yi/ /sgo tai su bskos (/ /til ni 'tshir ba de dag gis/ /til mar bum par ⑪srog chags tshogs/ / lhung zhing ⑫bi lo kya r+pā dan+ta mu tsuḥs ka ru ṇa mi thaḥ/ /a ho nu pā ba masmra ka ba hu nyams pa mthong gyur nas/ /snying rje bcas pas phan tshun smras/ /srog chags mang po yongs brlag pas/ /s+thā ṇi pa ri k+ṣa yata/ /bha dru yāḥsat+tha me tabye pā ta ke yaṅgi rā kṛ tai/ /kye ma bdag kyang sdig pa can/ /yang na gang gi tshig gis byas/ /sdig pa 'di kun bzang mo la'o/ /95—752

tats+tsha tā tad kṛ ha ga tā bha dā bai rā gya mā ya yo/ / tasmitre bak+ṣa ṇi bzang mo khyim nang ①'khod pa yis/ /de thos chags bral nyid du gyur/ /de dus nyid na bdag po ni/ /bhārta pra bi sh+yi ba tsa hūṃ ra haḥ/ /bha dre kṛ ha ma hā bhā ram̐ shrarnyo haṃ na pa te nang zhugs dben par de la smras/ /zhing las nyon mongs kyis gzir par 'u/ /khyu mchog srog chags 'tshe sa dā/ /kṛ ṣa kle shardi ta dṛ ṣa pra ṇa ho sā nu shā sa ā+oṃ/ /i māḥb ston/ /bzang mo bdag gi khyim gyi khyar/ /rtag tu yongs 'dzin yongs (1mi bzod/ /bde ba'i phun parlarnyan+ta bi ra sā niḥsā rāḥsu kha saspa daḥ/ /ā swā r+ya mā nāḥkut+tharnyi na tshogs 'di dag rnams/ /mjug tu ro bral snying po med/ /myangs na 'dam bu'i 'dam ④ma bzhin/ /ḍa shā khā i ba byadhī/ /gre sha shi bā la dzā le 6 pā pa saṃ ke 6 be+em+binaḥ/ /gdung ba dag ni skyed par byed/ /khyim pa rnams ni sdig pa'i 'dam/ /nyon mongs nya phyibs dra ba can/ /a ba san+da kṛ te ṣe ba nisne ṣ+ṭa ba dza raṅgabaḥ/ /tasmrasgo ha sa mā re khyim nyid du ni nyams 'gyur te/ /rlubs su glang ni rgan po bzhin/ /de slad khyem gyi rtsol ba 'di5/ /bha s+t+ya ga yo gyu yarma ba yoḥ/ /i h+phuk+ta nu ma taḥpat+na shārnyoni: ya mā da bye/ /yu cag gis ni gtong khyabar 'os/ /zhes smras chung mas khas blangs pas/ /zhi ba la ni nges par byas/ /sa twa dha na mabe+e bye kṛ haṃ tsa sa pa rits+tsha rda/ /nistsa krā ma sa mudruk+ta sad+dhā khyim dang yo byad bcas pa yinya/ /nor rnams slong la des byin nas/ /re ba'i zhags pas rkawī'aching ba kun//shā pā sha nan+da naḥ/ /so thā kā sh+ya pa go tā twa ta ma hā kā sh+ya pa tsā ga taḥ/ /rnam par grol te nges par byung / /de nas 'od srungs rigs nyid phyir/ /'od srungs chen po nyid gyur te/ /taṭ+wā la samyak+shi budhe kā sh+ya pa sa mu pā ya yo/ /ba hu pu tā khya tsi t+ya su de dus yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od srungs drung du de song gyur/ /mchod rten bu mang zhes pa yi/ /mū lespru ta mu pe t+ya tai/ /tajat+ta dhadz+re bi nā yaḥshur+ghaṃ bo bye ma bābe+e bān/ /rtsa bar gnas pa de can phyin/ /'dul ba'i chos ni des byin pas/ /dag pa'i byang chub thob par gyur/ /95—753

bha dru pi lap+ta bi na yā bai rā gyu diṣ+ṭa bakhyu na/ /zwaklu rgya pa ri rja me na bzang mo yis kyang chags bral kyi/ /bstan pa'i lam gyi 'dul ba thob/ /sngon gyi bsod nams yongs le bye ku sha la mu dz+wa lo/ / ma hā ka byu pa mā lo kya pā bye su ra smin pas/ /dge ba dri ma med pa bsten①/ /'od srungs chen po lha rnams kyis②/ /phyag 'os nyid thob ba bye hūṃ / / ta khru bye bi gru bhiḥdṛ ṣ+ṭa stu nu ba tsa ta thā ga ta ཿ / /mthong nas de'igo/ /bsod nams dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /de bzhin gshegs pas der bka' stsal/ /pra bi rata ni khi lān+da pa su kā le bi ṣa ma ta ra bi ni thrat+ta piṇ+ḍa pā te/ /zas dang 'bru rnams ma lus rab tu nyung ba'i dus/ /bsod snyoms rnam par log cing shin tu mi bzad tshe//kṛ ṣa dha na pu ru ṣe ṇa kā shi pur+ya ta ga ra shi khā+e ma hi taḥswa sgo dza ṣ+pe na/ /kṛ nor chung skyes bu yis ni kā shi ④grong khyer du/ /ta gar shi ṣā durang gi zas kyis legs par mchod/ / mi tī na ra pa ti nā kri te pi tsi bye ba ra ru tsi ra rat+na tsi te ta dāt+pa dza:/ /yi (kyebadag po kṛ tīs dzabyas pa'i mchod rten ni/ /rin chen gyis spras mchog tu mdzes la de yi ⑧bu/ /ma ṇi ka na ka bi tsi tra mā ta pa tram̐ bya dha ti ma hā ta ku sha lā ya pu rgya bsod nams ngang tshul gyis kyang dge ⑨ba chen po'i be+ed/ /nor bu gser gyis ⑩rnam par bkra ba'i shī laḥ/ /dzad+ma dwa yo pa tsi ta pu rgya ma ho da ye na so sasma ho ba pa da kā sh+ya gdugs dag bkod/ /skye ba gnyis su nye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams cher rgyas pas/ /nye ba'i gnas pa tā ma bāp+taḥ/ /la sgon+da tiḥka na ta ka la i ba pra bhā ba martat+pa kyi ⑪'od srungs chen po nyid ni 'di yis thob/ /gser gyi ta la bzhin du mtho ba'i mthu ni thob gyur nas/ /rda ku sha la mū la ka lo bi bha n+ti / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 'bras bu dgra bcom gnas ni rnam par 'dzin/ /zhes spyopa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i tsi tā yi sgo bye sa tā ba da na kalpa la tā yi ma hā kā sh+ya pā ba dā na byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las 'od srungs chen po'i rtogs pa 95—754

ra k+ṣa —/ / ta ta ཿ ka da tsidzha ga bā be+e nā rnye ta sko tu kā dhi kyu ga ldan 'das kyis bsrungs①/ /de nas nam zhig nags kyi ④mthar ni bcom ldan la/ /de yi dge mtshan ṇi na dṛ ṣ+ṭa ཿ / / dza gā da da n+ta byu ti tsa dh+ri ka rnyi d+mā pa ra dag las dge slong tshogs kyis dris/ /tshems kyi 'od zer zla ba'i 'od rnams dag gis ni/ /mchu yi ya rje ga mi bā dha ra su / / ya sho dha rā ma ju ra te ṇa ni h+ye dmar ba 'gebs ①par mdzad pa bzhin du gsungs/ /bdag dang bral bas rtag tu gzir bar gyur pa yi/ /ka ro ti yan+d+ra ha sa ma ha tā n+ti / / ha rarnyi bye oṃ be ta rani mo grags 'dzin ma ni gang zhig gzu lums 'di dag byed/ /brtan pa 'phrog cing rmongs pa rnam par ster ba ha me ṣa swa bhā ba ཿ sma ra bi bh+ra mā rde / / ma mā pi ta snga bi 'di—/ /chags pa'i rnam 'phrul ldan pa rnams kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /sngon gyi skye ba gzhan la de dang bral ra he pūj-i dzarja ta re mā ra bi mo hi te na / / saṃ sa k+ta saṃ tā pa ba yis④/ /'dod pas rnam par rmongs par byas te bdag gis kyang / /rgyun du yongs su gdung ba dag ni mit+ta ju taḥkhe daḥpra bhu ta bya pa no nu byu taḥ/ /pu rā dzi tā ma ra gi ⑤rgyur gyur pa/ /rab mang gdung khyepeba'i nyon mongs dag ni nyams su myong / /grong mchog haste na yi pu re mah+phu re haste na su re/ /rā dza dha nā bi dh+wa no bhūn+de dh+wa rna gu ṇa grong / /'chi med yon tan stithul bar sngon/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i gter/ /rgyal po nor saṃ pa dzā/ /bhu dze nā bo gi tā bhū miḥkṛ tā kabye sa ra swa tī/ /lal+līḥzhes bya ba byung / /lag pa yis geni sa la 'khyud/ /dbyangs can dag ni mgrin par byas/ /ngag '-ikyegi pra sā bye tā ye na tīn+ti re ba pra bā se tā/ /rā mā lnga ta gya dzā yā lnga ta na dpal ni rab tu bstar/ /grags pa kho na rab tu bskrad/ /de yi btsun mo mjos ma la/ /bu ni nor yaḥsu dha nā bhi dhaḥ/ /a bha bat+pa ha saṃ dzā ta ni dh+wa na sha ta bi shu taḥ/ /san+d+ra bzang zhes bya ba/ /gter brgya dang ni grags pa dang / /lhan cig skyes pa byung bar gyur/ /rig gnas 95—756

bi byā ku mu di m+bi bi kā sha ra si kaḥs dā/ /ka khā bām+bin+d+ra la tu tsir+yaḥpūṇ+ḍin+d+ra kun gyi ku mud can/ /rtag tu rnam rgyas byed la chags/ /dri med mdzes pa sgyu rtsal can/ /gang ba'i ①ri bā ba r+bha/ /ba bhū ba ta su bhū baspruspyo pa tispyo mya nan+ta raḥ/ /mā shā zla ba lta bur mdzes/ /sa bdag de dang sa gzhi ni/ /bar med sa bdag byung gyur pa/ /khengs ldan ma hen+d+ra se nā khyuḥpra khyu ta thra thu bi kra maḥ/ /te na duḥs ha daṇ+ḍi na dbang chen sde zhes pa/ /rgya che ldurnam par gnon par grags/ /dus yin chadus su brtag bya zhing / /sadze+e sadze+e swa hā ri rja/ /a kā la kā la kaspe na bī ḍa tāḥshu shu tsuḥkun gyi bdog kun 'phrog byed pa/ /bzod dka'i dpya dang ldan pa des/ /gzir ba'i skye rgus chomya ngan pra dzāḥ/ /ta snga dhan+d+ra pra bṛt+ta gya ni dṛt+ta su kṛ tot+pa be/ /tī bro pa tā paṃ tāste byas—/ /chos min la ni zhugs pa de'i/ /grong ni legs byas spro ba dag /log cing gdung ba drag po 6 su re na ba bṛ 6spyo nāḥ/ /pra nyi ku le ma hā pā le ta tra dubhi k+ṣa pi bla yis—/ /gdung bar sprin gyi char ma phab/ /sa skyong rjes su mi mthun pa/ /der ni mu ge'i nyen (lte'atshe paḥ—/ /ba bhu ba bya sa ṣ+pe ṣe ba bha brnyi bya pa no da yāḥ/ /ta taḥkle sha bi byung / /sdug bsngal can rnams kho na la/ /sdug bsngal rgyas par gyur pa yin/ /de nas nyon mongs kyis she ṣārtaḥsabye pu ra ni bā se naḥ/ /ku pa ti ba sa nobye gā de gī byu tā khyad gzir/ /bdag ngan gyis gdungs yid byung zhing / /grong nang skyeganas pa thams cad ni/ /gcig bya tsin+ta ya na / / rā dzñā do ṣa ka re ṇi yo ja ṇi na dza na tu 'tshogs ྅nas rnam par bsams/ /rgyal blun mtshan mor byed pa ni(87/ /gsar pa'i dpya zer ta pa ram̐/ /pra t+ya gra ka ra pa te na na li m+bi ba ni m+bi li tā/ /e ṣa 'bebs pa yis/ /mchog tu skye bo'i tshogs pa ni/ /pad+mo can ༷/snabazhin zum par gyur/ /rtag tu ngan durgya sa m+bi ni t+ya ma sa t+yā ma t+ya sasma taḥ/ /asmran+da r+pā ḍū pu : ti par zhen pa 'dis/ /bden med blon po'i gros dag gis/ /bdag cag bcir nas g.yo can dang / /95—757

bi ṭa tse ṭa ka gā yā ram̐/ / kabye ta tā su nā thra ṣ+ṭaḥpā pa shā pe na byu bran dang glu mkhan rnams dag bsos0sna/ /de la'ang sa bdag sdog pa yi/ /dmod pas chad rngu med sdug pa teḥ/ /dubhi k+ṣa dza na byā dza tā dza na saṃ k+ṣa ya sā k+ṣi bhā/ /su tīkyāḥsmra bsngal ba/ /skye bo yang dag brlag pa'i dbang / /mu ge skyed par byed pa skyes/ /sa skyong shin tu rno zhing pā lāḥkha ra mu kha ra mūkhoḥpa ri dza naḥka dar+ya shā mā t+yāḥka ṭu ka pa ṭa kau ṭi l+ya pa 'khor gyi skye bo rtsub cing mu cor rdo1)rmongs/ /blon po rnams kyang gdug cing drag (zitshopa g.yo ldan gya gyu dag la ṭa baḥ/ /pa da s+thāḥkā yas+thā be+e ṣa ma mu kha ro gāḥpra ku pi tāḥka baṃ san+taḥmakhas—/ /zhabs drung gnas dang yig mkhan mi bzad kha skyon rab tu khros gyur pa/ /dman pa 'joms so bye kṛ pa ṇa da la no dā ru ṇa ga ṇaḥ/ /dha na shrī mān k+ṣi ti pa tiḥthra ya byed ma rungs tshogs pa 'di dag rnams ni ji ltar bzod/ /dpal ldan sa yi bdag po ni/ /nor gyis thu te rāṣ+ṭa badzha naḥ/ /gats+tsha mastadrur sosmran bat+pa laḥpha la yi 6 ti/ /yul 'khor skyong ba 6thos/ /bdag cag de grong song ba na/ /mnyes gshin de yis ⑦skyong bar 'gyur/ /a pa t+yā mi ba rāhūṃ yaḥpa dā pa sh+ya ti byu pa tiḥ/ /bi ṣa ye dzī bya te ta su dza na sa bdag gang gi yul 'khor la/ /bu bzhin rtag tu lta byed pa/ /de yi yul du pha yis (sheni/ /khyem du ka phye ba be+ethra ni/ /i ti nibya ya mā dh+wa ya ya yusta haste nā bu ra/ /t+yā byeḥbazhin du 'tsho bar bya/ /de ltar nges bsgrubs de dag rnams/ /haste na yi grong khyer song / /lus kyang kā yo pi sā pā yaḥki pu narda sha saṃ shra yaḥ/ /dzñā tā ma hedz+re se no pi swa gnod bcas gtang bya na/ /yul dang gnas ni smos ci dgos/ /mi bdag dbang chen sde yis kyang / /pu re ni dza ā+oṃ dṛ paḥ/ /tī drwa nu tā paḥs mirde ma hā mā t+yā na bhā ṣa ta/ /rang grong skye bo med shes nas/ /'gyod pa drag pos shesnakhro ldan pararme)/ /blon po chen po la smras pa/ /dha na su dha ni no rā dzñāḥpu rasmah+phu ra ba se naḥ/ /pra yā tā i ba nirtswa rgyal po nor gyi grong khyer du/ /bdag gi grong gnas nyunyuskye bo rnams/ /rab tu song zhes nyan sna ⑪ni/ /95—758

reḥka thi tai gru bhā tsā ri bhiḥ/ /dubhik+ṣa khin+d+ra ya di te yā tā ma ma ri poḥpu ram̐/ /gsang nas ① rgyu ba dag gis smras/ /gal te bdag gi dgra grong du/ /de dag mu ges nyen 'gro na/ /tat+paza tra bha baṃ h+ye ba par+yā yerde ba bi sla bīḥ/ /a tha bā rā dza do ṣe ṇa gnam gye nyer 'tshe thams cad du/ /re mos kyis ni 'byung ba nyid/ /yang na rgyal po'i skyon gyes ni/ /ga taste su kha r+pāts+tsha yā/ /beṣ+ṭa daṇ+ḍa ka rodruk+taḥka su rā dzñāḥpu re dza naḥ/ /bde ba 'dod pas de dag song / /rgyal po su yis (gye grong khyer kyi/ /skye bo las dang ‘kyedabe+e las grol/ /pā yaḥpa ri tsi ta dre ṣāt+pa dā na ba na bai ṣi ṇaḥ/ /dru ras+tha e ba sat+tha gya phal cher yongs su 'dris la sdang / /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa 'tshol jisna/ /ring na gnas pa thams cad sadz+dza bha ba ti bal+la bhaḥ/ /asma da bh+ya dhi kaḥko sau ta su bhu mi pa tergu ni—/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong ba khyeyin/ /gang gis gzhan gyi skye rgu rathuni/ /rmongs pa chung ma bzhin du ṇaḥ / /pa re ྾ ha ra te ye na mud+dhā dzā yā i ba pra dzāḥ/ /u pā yabyergyu 'phrog /sa bdag de la yon tan ni/ /bdag las lhag pa ci zhig yod/ /re zhig de yi grags (shaṃpa ni/ /hūṃ tā bat+ta gya dadze+e pra shān+ta ye/ /sa mṛdhi kā ra r+ṇa yats+tsha taji ghā to bi dhī rab gzhil thabs dag bsam par mdzod/ /gang yang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /de dag gzhom pa bsgrub ( ya hūṃ/ /i ti rā dza ba tsaḥkhru tā ma hā mā t+ya ba bhā ṣi re/ /thra ya tān+de ba par mdzod/ /ces pa rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /blon po chen pos rab smras pa/ / lha gcig gang gi phyosnaye nā sau rā dza dha na dza nospru taḥ/ /bi ṣa ye nā ga rā dzoste tsi tro nā ma ba rgyal po ni rmye/ /nor dang skye bo dar ba pho7nyon/ /sa bdag de yi dar ba ni/ /gzugs can bsod nams tū da kaḥ/ /ta suk+ṣi ti pa te sbortaḥpu khyu ba dha i bo da yaḥ/ /a kā le sa mya kyis btags bzhin/ /yul na klu yi rgyal po ni/ /chu mang tsi tra zhes pa yod/ /de yi mthu yis dus min nibe+etrīsten+d+ra bhā be+e ṣ+pe dzā ya te/ /kṛ ṣi saṃ pan+ti mū la: bhū bhū rdzu sathru du—/ /'bru ni phun sum tshogs par 'gyur⑫/ /sa bdag phun sum tshogs kun gyis0/ /rtsa ba zhing ni 95—759

saṃ pa daḥ/ /tasmabe+e r+ya ba khān+d+ra gaḥs hahūṃ ya di shakya te/ /ta dā yārnyi phun sum tshogs1/ /de slad rig pa'i stobs dag gis/ /klu de gal te 'phrog nus na/ /de tshe de yi skye swa yo ta gya pra dzāsta me ba saṃ shra yo/ /dīp+ta man+d+ra ba lo ki:t+tasmra da be+e 6 rgu '-irnams/ /rang nyid khyod la brten par 'gyur/ /de slad sngags stobs 'bar ba yi/ /sgrub pa po sā dha shaṃ/ /nā ga rā dza su ha ra ṇi kṛ ya hūṃ tūṇ+ḍi mu r+ya ma/ /i t+yā 'ga' btsal nas ni/ /klu yi rgyal po 'phrog pa la/ /brtson pa dag ni myur du ①mdzod/ /ces pa blon m+bi t+ya ba tsaḥshu tā ta the t+yā ha ma tī pa tiḥ/ /swa gu zla dha na bhe ka lā ba ra po'i tshig thos nas/ /pha ④bdag gis ni bden zhes smras/ /rang nyid yon tan nor nyams pa'i/ /mi do kho r+ya tāḥkha lāḥ/ /ta taḥpra bhū ta ka na ka pra dā na pa ṇa byo pa hūṃ/ /bsrung (snyepha rol skyon la sbyor/ / der ni ⑥gser ni mang po dag /rngan pa rab tu ster ba'i sgra/ /kṛ tā te man+t+ra ṇiḥpāsgrurtswa ga ban+dha na madh+ri rde/ /sa taim+bi byā dha ro nā ma su bsgrags nas gros pa rnams kyis ni/ /klu dag 'ching ba'i sngags pa thob/ /gser sbyin dam bcas de ba ṇ+ḍi be+e ṇa sa m+bi dā / / pā be+e ta sh+yi tra ma ṣ+pe rtu pra ya yo ha ste dag gis be/ /gsol gdab (sherig 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /de ni tsi tra blang ba'i slad/ /haste na yi grong nā pu re/ /ta tra kā na na bar+yadhe sdik+ta shā ma la pā da pe/ /bha ba rna khyer song / /der ni nags tshal dag gi stematha'/ /snum ljang rkang 'thung ldan pa na/ /gdengs can sgo gi rmā bhaspruḥs da dar+sha na bhaḥpra r+ghaṃ/ /tsa lab ku la mā khā yo bi la bti bdag po'i khang pa ni/ /nam mkha'i 'od can de yis mthong / /ba ku la yi 'phreng spyogayo zhing / /ti ka la ka shri yaḥ/ /ba na lasgra i ba parja maṇ+ḍa nā ma ṇi dadz+dza rde/ /bi lo la /3yi dpal rgyas pa/ /nags kyi dpal mo'i rgyan dag gi/ /nor bu'i me long nye ba bzhin/ /dri med kyā ma la dza saṃ smṛ ha ma li na mā na saḥ/ /man+t+ra nu dh+yā na san+dadha ta se: chu de mthong gyur nas/ /chags pas nyams pa'i yid can gyisa.e/ /sngags kyi bsam gtan chas zhugs te/ /95 ——760

di sba n+dha mā ba da de / / disba dhe bi hi tai te na pra te na tru gra te bsgrub slad phyogs ni bcing ba byas/ /brtul zhugs rab drag gzi ldan des/ /phyogs ni bcings pa dza sā/ /shi ro bya thā nā gā ba te ra byut+ta p+ta pa ṇa ma ṇiḥ/ /a thā dṛ bsgrub pa ni①/ /klu bdag gdengs ka'i nor bu ni/ /gdung zhing mgo bo gzir bar gyur/ /de nas ma shā sa mujo ya tai tre ṭī man+d+ra sā dha shaṃ/ / kasbra mā naḥpha ṇi pa tizan+dha mthong yang dag langs/ /sngags ni bsgrub (kyepa de mthong nas/ /'dar zhing gdengs can bdag po ni/ /tā sa da tsin+ta yata/ /ba sgruzlushra khru sa pa la sta ḍiṅka pi la lo tsa naḥ/ / bcings pas skrag pas 1rab bsams pa/ /khro bo sma ra smin ma ser/ /lta byed ser skya glog lta bu/ /a kā le kā la saṃ kā shāḥku taḥhrū ro pa mā ga taḥ/ /ba ṣ+pe saṃ pra nyi dus min dus dang mtshungs pa yi/ /gdug pa 'di ni ga las 'ongs/ /da ni gdug pa'i bdag nyid disbarnyaḥkṛ to ṣ+pe na du rāt+pa nā/ /ba sgo bye ṣa na yā brja tā babyusti 'dis—/ /nags kyi phyogs ni bcings pa ④byas/ /ji srid 'dis bdag ma bcings pa/ /de srid kra ma ཿ k+ṣa ma ཿ / / ti ro bā dhe ba sa t+ya smid+ma ha bhā r+bha be+e lā ya rigs pa'i rim pa bzod/ /drang srong chen po shin ⑤shun can/ /'jug ngogs nye ba'i mtha' 'dir naḥ / /dzā ṣ+pe so si nā ma sā dhu pa ri tā be+e pra galha te/ /ta t+yā shra ma gnas—/ /bdag yongs bskyab pa dam pa ni/ /des kyang nus pa min par shes/ /gang 'di de yi bste ya de yo sau pa ri tsar+yā sa raḥs dā/ /lubha kaḥpad+ma ko nā ma sa me saṃ rak+ṣa gnas na/ /rtag tu rim gro yongs bsgrub pa/ /rngon pa pad+ma can zhes pasazhwa/ /de yis ༷77bdag ni ṇa k+ṣa maḥ/ /i ti nish+yi t+ya ma na sā ga tā lubha kārnyi kai/ /swa bṛṭ+wārnye bsrung bar bzod/ /ces pa yid kyis da7nges byas nas/ /rngon pa ga la/ ba der song / /rang gi spyod ni biju smi ban+dha rak+ṣu ma yā tsa ta/ /sā dha ka gya ba dh+wa yi ba nā gā rā dze na tshul bshad nas ni/ /de la 'chi ba bsrung 'ubar zhus/ /klu yi rgyal pos sgrub pa po/ /gsad kyepa'i slad 95—761

sobe+e taḥ/ / dha rtswa tai de sha ma bye t+ya man+t+ra bī ram̐ bya lo ka yata/ /du gsol btab ste①/ /gzhu dang ldan pas gnas der phyin/ /sngags pas ④dpa' bo mthong bar byur/ /asmin+da ba sa re man+d+ra sā dha ko pi hu ta na laḥ/ /ā kṛṣ+ṭi nā ga rā dza su gnas skabs der ni sgrub pa po/ /sngags pa yis kyang sbyin sreg mes/ /bcing bar 'dod pas ④klu yi di//bi da dhe ban+ta nokhru kaḥ/ /man+t+ra kṛṣ+ṭi pha ṇi sa to kṛ khaṃ tadha ba no da rka/ /rgyal po rab tu dgug par byas/ /gdengs can bdag po sngags kyis ④ni/ /drangs tshe de yi gnas kyi chu//bi ṣā da la ka ro de ba pro r+yad+kubyu da ga rda/ /saṃ tā sa bi hwa la bhu dze+e chu yi chu bur rab dkrigs pas/ /mya ngan byed par brtson pa bzhin/ /lag 'gro'i chung ma kun tu skrag ga ba dhū bi ṣā da ni shā sa be+e ga bi hi to dz+wa la phe ṇi mā lo/ /pas 'khrugs pa'i mya ngan gyis(she / /shugs rings shugs kyis rab bsgrubs rab 'bar dbu ba'i phreng ba can//rak+ṣutha nā mi ba tsa kā ra ta re ga hasta salngañdza li pra tsa la kadza bi lo la rab tu 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i chu ni rba ⑥rlabs lag pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar byas bsrung ba don du gnyer bar me bhaḥ/ /ā ba r+ghaṃ bi byā ba khāste na nā ge ga ru ḍa te dza sā/ /saṃ byed pa bzhin/ /mkha' lding gzi byin dze+eldan pa des/ /rig pa'i stobs kyis ⑧klu bzung ste/ /'khums ko tse ku ṭi lnga sgoge k+ṣibye ba dza la bhā dza ṣ+pe/ /tai te ma lubha bā ṇi na tā sa saṃ disna shing gya gyu ldan pa'i lus/ /chu yi snod du btsal ba na/ /rngon pa yis ni gzhu bkang ste/ /dug gis lo tsa rna / / bi byā dha dha nu rā kṛ 6 bi ṣa di sne na lubha ka /byugs pa'i mda' dag gis/ /skrag pas mig ni nyams gyur cing / /gser la chags pas ⑨de la bsnun/ /ma sna pā rde tai ma bye t+ya bha ya t+ya k+ta ju dze+e ga ma/ /kā rā la ka ra 'jigs spyopas lag 'gro btang gyur cing / /mda' zug ⑪de la mngon phyogs te/ /de yi ⑫'jigs rung bā le na bi shi raskoñtsa kā ra saḥ/ /sā bi byā ban+d+ra ki ta gya lo bhā da byo pa ral gri yis/ /mgo bo dag dang bral bar byas/ /rmongs pa de yi rig ⑫pa ni/ /g.yem ma chags las 95—762

yo gī nī/ /a bhū྾ d+dhā bi mubha gya swa bi nā shā ya ke ba lo/ /yulngaḥgazhan dag dang / /nye bar sbyor de grub mod ①kyang / /rang nyid brlag don 'ba' zhig gyur/ /blun pa ro pa tā pā ya bi byā bi bha ba shak+ta yaḥ/ /sa ha be+e ba bi rū ṭ+wā dzā bi na po'i rig pa 'byor pa stobs/ /pha rol nye bar gdung ba'i slad/ /sbyor ba rnams ni 'phral la nyid/ /byurnyi sa hā su bhiḥ / / ta ta ཿ pra ha r+ṣa saṃ pūṇ+ḍi ཿ kṛ ta p+taḥ pha ṇi nā srog dang lhan cig nyams par gyur/ /de nas rab dga' yongs rdzogs pa/ /byas shes gdengs can ya kaḥ/ /lta ni nā ya swa bha ba rna lud+dhā rka sne ha lubha dhīḥ/ /ta tra 'dren pa yis/ /rang gi khang par rngon pa de/ /mdza' (migacugs blo dang ldan pas bos/ /nor bu'i rat+na la to byā na bi mā na ma ṇi baishra su/ /a t+yar+gha mā nash+yi tre ṇi ka khang pa gzhal yas khang / /rin chen 'khri shing skyed tshal der/ /tsi tra yis ①ni mchod byed cing / /de tsiṭ+wā la mu bā sa saḥ/ /ka dā tsi da tha nā ge na sgo bye mā na sa bisma yaḥ/ /yi dus ni 'ga' zhig gnas/ /de nas ya mtshan ldan pa des/ /nam zhig glog 'phreng (gelta bu yi/ /bi byubyā mo pa oṃ pā sha ma mo ghā khye da dar+sha saḥ/ /tai driṣ+ṭa tat+pa bhā baṃ tsa zhags pa don yod ces bya ba/ /klu yis ⑤mchod par byed pa mthong / /de mthong de yi ⑥nus mthu dag /shu tā nā ga ni be+e di tai/ /yaṭ+wā t+ta darba rna tsakre lud+dhā ko lud+dhā mā nā klu yis ④bshad pa thos gyur nas/ /rngon pa chags pa'i yid ldan pas/ /de ni 'bad nas ④rab tu saḥ—/ /a dza tshe pa ma rod+mo ge su rā shā ma se ban+dha rna/ /tai jo bi kā dhi bslangasape—/ /g.yul gyi sbyor ba mi pham zhing / /lha rnams kyang ni 'ching byed pa/ /srog las lhag pa de rka tasmi da do spru t+yā pha bhā shwa raḥ/ /ta taste pā sha mā dā ya tsi tra mā mabye lubha de la/ /gdengs can dbang po dga' bas byin/ /de nas zhags pa de blangs nas/ /tsi tra la zhus rngon kaḥ—/ /udhīr+ya nā ga bha ba nāl+labharjaḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /nā ga pra bhā ba saṃ taṭ+wā pa ni/ /klu yi khang pa las 'thon ⑫te/ /don thob rang gi gnas su song / /klu yi mthu yis thob pa yi/ /95—763

tsi ram̐ bhughā sa saṃ pa rda/ /pu tā yot+pa khā khyu ya pā shaṃ da tā bya pa r+ya ta/ /phun tshogs yun ring de spyad she7nas/ /ut+pal can zhes bya ba yi/ /bu la zhags pa byen nas 'das/ /pā la yatri tu rā tsa ram̐ so pi lubha ku mā ra ka /mu ṣ+pesta mya ku la sbi t+yā pa ri rngon pa gzhon nu de yis kyang / /pha yi spyod pa skyong byed cing / /rigs kyi lugs kyis ② thub pa de'i/ /tsar+yā pa ro bha bta/ /ta taḥka dā tsit+pa mu ṣ+pebe+e shān+ta su sbi taḥpu raḥ/ /rim gro byed pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas nam zhig thub pa ni/ /bzhugs pa'i mdun na gnas pa des/ /shu shā ba kā ka li gī tai tīṇ+ḍi kar+ṇa
