/mdzes pa'i nu ma'i 'bras bu 7mtshan/ /chags bcas ⑫yal 'dab byu bye gyaḥ saṃ sgo ga bā da paḥ / / a tā n+ta re da k+ṣi ṇa khyo bi thra ka ldan pa de'i/ /longs spyod rkang 'thung spyad byar byur/ /gnas skabs der ni lho phyogs pa/ /bram ze 95—772

pi la puṣ+ka ro/ /a dzagru tudṛn+ti kā mo dha na gya dṛ pa teḥs bhām/ /to ser skya puṣ+kar ①gnyis/ /rgyal po nor gyi mdun sar ni/ /'tsho ba 'dod pas 'ongs par gyur/ /rig bi byā ti sha yashā spyo po rā nyi t+ya ma bā pa tuḥ/ /ka pi laḥk+ṣi ti pā khā gya pa phul byung bsngags ⑤'os pa/ /de dag mdun na 'don gnyis guthob/ /ser skya dag ni sa skyong gi/ /rā dza pu tra ba tsa sa raḥ/ /ta yorlur+sha tsa badhe na sa dā bi bā da mā na yoḥ/ /rgyal po'i bu yis ④gzhan pa'o/ /de dag reg pas bcings pa yis/ /rtag tu rnam par rtsod byed cing / /e ka dra byā rnyi khā ṣe ṇa bi dwo ṣa sa ma dzā ya ta/ /dz+wa ṣa do ṣe ṇa mā tai ga rdzas gcig mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /rnam par sdang ba khye yang dag skyes/ /glang po la 'os snun byed pa//yo gya nir+gha ta yosta yoḥ/ /bi da dhe ma da le khe ba bi t+yā ma li na tsā mu khe/ /ye de dag gdong gi rig pa ni/ /chang gi ri mo lta bu dag /zhe sdang skyon gyis nyams par bsgrubs/ /gang ྾ bstu bi be+e ki — gu ṇa sa khā+e lo ka pra kā shorlu khā+e bi t+yā dī pa shi gis spyorig pa mar me'i rtse mo dngos po rnam 'byed ⑦yon tan dag gi grogs/ /'jig rten rab tu gsal khā ka ro ti bi ṣa oṃ dī ṣārnya kā raḥpu raḥ/ /te mo ho sa ha tā bi tsā ra la mngon phyogs mdun du zhe sdang mun pa mi bzad byed/ /rmongs pas nyer bcom rtog dpyod dang bral dubi hi tā ཿ sau dza t+yā hi tā dad+dhā byan+dan tsan+d+ra kān+ta ka ma la susdoṅga te gzhung bzang chung ma'i dgra bo de dag rnams/ /tsan dan zla ba chu shel pad+mo khu rngub las 'khrungs me yis nāghi nā/ /shu ti smṛ ti bi bā de 6 puṣ+ka re ṇa pa de ba de/ /ni kṛ sreg par byed/ /thos dang dran dang ⑪rtsod rnams la/ /gnas dang gnas su puṣ+kar 71gyis/ /nges par khya mā ṇaḥ ka pi laḥko pa tā pā da tsin+ta yata/ /man+d+ra t+ya saṃ dṛ ṭ+wā sgyu tshar bcad ser skya yis/ /khro ba'i gdung bas yongs su bsams/ /no zhing brtan par goms gyur pa/ /sas+t+rikyā s+t+ri bra ma dodha taḥ/ /sa dā saṃ sā rda mā me ba na ya h+ye ṣa bi mi bzad rgyags shing 'char ⑫ba 'dis/ /rtag tu goms pas zhan pa bdag skya /mdun sa dag tu skyengs 95—773

lagh+ra hūṃ/ /pradzñā pañtsa ka dṛṭ+wā ya khru tai dadze+e dz+wa ra pa bā/ /dha rna dhasgro ni par byed/ /shes rab slu ①byed tshul dang ni/ /thos pa dregs pa'i rims dag dang / /nor ni chos dag ṣe dh+wa ya bha ba t+ya dha ma tse ta sī/ /dṛp+taḥpa ri bha bya t+ya ṣa rā dza 'gog pa'i slad/ /ma rabs sems ldan rnams la 'gyur/ /dregs ldan 'di yis rgyal sras la/ /brten pu tā shra yi ṇa rmā/ / tasmra dā shra ya e bā mya shrī rū le pra ha rā mya nas bdag ni ②yongs su 'joms/ /de slad 'di yis snerten nyid la0/ /dpal gyi rtsa ba bdag gis haṃ —/ /ni dha ṣ+pe rā dza pu tra gya yukyu pā ye ṇa kai ṇa tsita/ /yuk+taḥgazhom—/ /rigs ⑤pa'i thabs ni 'ba' tshuzhig gis/ /rgyal po'i sras ni dgum pa la/ /bdag ni kahūṃ pra yasgo me mā na gā no ka baṃ paste/ /i tru gra pā pa saṃ kalpa ta 'bad pa bya bar 'os/ /khengs pa nyams pa ji ltar bzod/ /de ltar drag po'i sdig brtags ⑦pa/ /de gya dwo ṣāt+pa mu r+ya yo/ /nāste tat+yā ta shaṃ lo ke yan+da kuzarnyi mat+pa rāḥ/ /la snang ④bas yang dag sbyar/ /phrag dog gis gang mi byed pa'i/ /sdog de 'jig rten na yod min/ /ka dze+e pa sh+ya lta sa baṭ+wā pa pa dā bya thi tā sha yaḥ/ /dat+ta na ya na yorle na tī gang gis mi bzad khro ba yi/ /dug gi mig sman mig tu stibatab/ /rtag tu bsam ⑩pa 'khrugs pa des/ /bra mar+ṣa bi ྾ dza dz+wa/ /rā shaṃ pā paṃ pa ra ma ma dhi kan+dadze+e pā paṃ ta to pi kro dh+wan+d+ra paṃ legs pa'i lam ni ji ltar mthong / /'dod chags mchog tu sdig cing de las kyang ni lhag par dregs pa dza ga ti na pa rā du ཿ sa haṃ lo bha pā paṃ / / yā bā ṣ+pe ṣa bya sdig /khro las sdig gzhan 'gro ba na med bzod dka'i sdig pa chags ⑪pa'o/ /gdung ba dang ldan 'gro pa ni ni dza ṣ+pe ga ju te pā pa brgaḥpā dzā sha gya smṛ sha ti na tu dze+e so pi bi dwo na sdig pa'i tshogs ni ji snyed bgrangs gyur pa/ /des kyang rnam par sdang bas bskrun pa'i sdig pa'i cha la ṣa sru teḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsid+me ghā khye ku rja kat+tha ṭa bā si rna/ /bi mtshungs reg min/ /de nas skenam zhig sprin zhes pa'i/ /gdug cing kar pa ṭar gnas pa/ /gnod 95—774

thraṣ+ṭa me+e n+ya haṃ tā ra sā man+ta ma pa kā ri rde/ /khru tā na ra pa tiḥko pa 'byed pa'i rgyal bran du gyis/ /dpung rnams springs pa gsod (snyepa dag /thos nas mi bdag khros pa bā stso tusgopā ya ni: ye/ /a mā t+yā nā mā nu ma he ku mā ra mi da ma bra yis—/ /thabs ni bzhi par nges byas te/ /blon po rnams kyi 'dod pa yis/ /gzhon nu la ni 'di dag bīta —/ /ku mā ra ga mya tsā tūṇ+ḍi myuts+tshan+tu ta ra sā ri hūṃ/ /kra mo sa smras—/ /gzhon nu stobs kyis ④dgra dag ni/ /myur du gcod du 'gro bar gyis/ /khyod kyis skyerim sasgo sā mra dzhai niḥsha l+ya mi da mastu te/ /a yi te sa ma rā ram̐ bye pra 'ongs rgyal srid che'i'u / /'di ni zug rngu med par 'gyur/ /g.yul gyi rtsom par khyod kyi ྅ni/ /dpung bhā bā bha ra rto byu dzaḥ/ /ā khā na ste bha tī yā tu dza gaju dza ya darnyi niḥ/ /pa mthu yis brgyan pa 'di⑤ / /'gro bar rgyal ba'i glang po dag /'dogs pa'i ka ba nyid du 'gyur/ /me bhe bhū z-id+ku khā krarnyi saṃ ram̐ bhā bh+ya dhi ko da yi/ /ha te ta ba pra ta pa gya sa 'dzin rigs ni non ⑨pa'i sprin/ /sdug cing lhag par rgyas pa dag /bcom na khyod kyi gzi byen gyis⑩//nirbi spyo ba ra shā di shaḥ/ / dudze+e leḥki ha tai ra byeḥ sa man+ti ran+ta phyogs su sgrib ⑪pa'i bgegs med 'gyur/ /stobs med mtha' na gnas pa yi'u/ / /rgyal phran gzhan ni bā pi bhiḥ/ /dṛp+taḥs e ba han+ta byastabo dhe sat+tha sidha yaḥ/ /ki kau bsad pas ci/ /dregs ldan de nyid gzhom par bya/ /de bsad na skyeni thams cad 'grub/ /gang zhig tu shaṃ ya di ha riḥ ka ri tsakra pa lā mā harnyi de ba bi hi tai ni dza me cha yi ④rang zas nyid du rnam par bsgrubs ⑩pa yi/ /glang chen tshogs ni 'phrog byed kyis bcom dge mtshan ba sgo rdzu/ /pañtsa na rna ya di bhi nat+ta na khāṣ+ṭa hā saṃ tat+ta su po ru ṣa ka ci zhig yod/ /gal te sder mo'i gad rgyangs ldan pa'i gdong lnga mngon bcom na/ /de ni de yi skyes bu thā pa tha me ti shorlo/ /i ti pi dru sa ma diṣ+ṭaḥs m+bi nyi ta ra r+ṇat+pa baḥ/ /rtul phod gtam gyi lam du 'gyur/ /zhes pa pha yis bstan pa na⑩/ /g.yul gyi dga' ston 'dod pa dang / /95—775

kin+da rī bi ra hā lo laḥso bhūsdo lā ku lo k+ṣa rde/ /a tsi rā ga ma na khyu mi 'am ci 'bar g.yo bas denya// /skad cig khyogs la/la 'phyang bzhin gyur/ /yun ring 'gro ba min brjod ṣ+pe r+yasne rā shwa gya babe+e dzñā/ /dza na s+thā sī ra ma bye t+ya pra ṇi sa t+ya dza pas—/ /'bad pas chung ma dbugs phyung nas/ /de yi lam la mngon phyogs ste/ /phyag byas dal gyis gā da saḥ/ /du hi tā sha kra kalpa su kin+da ren+d+ra gya mā ni rmā/ /pā spyo bi ra rab smras pa/ /mi 'am ci dbang brgya byin du/ /brtag bya'i bu mo khengs ldan ma/ /khyod kyis bdag la ha sho kātrī mad+mā t+pa l+ya dhi lnga twa yā/ /a sngasgo ḍā ma ṇi ra yo rakhyuḥsretshwa byams pa'i blos/ /'bral ba'i mya ngan gyis gzir skyongs/ /'di yi gtsug gi nor bu ni/ /rang 'dod ga ti pra daḥ/ /da ta byaḥsarba thā mā ta nā n+ya tra mā ṇa saṃ sha yāta/ /i kyughā dza na 'gro ba ster 'di dag /srog la the tshom ma gtogs pa/ /ma ma ④kun tu sbyin mi bya/ /zhes brjod ma yi nī ha ste gār+ghaṃ kādzñā shi khā ma ṇi/ /ni k+ṣi pya sa ya yo tūṇ+ḍi be+e spyotshwa lag tu ni/ /mdzes ma mdzes ma'i gtsug gi nor/ /gtad nas dpung gi rjophyogs kyi sgo/ /sgrib cing de di ti didru khaḥ/ /ta su bā dzi bra dzosgru ta raḥpuñdza sna na do yaḥ/ /pra ya ni myur du song / /de yi ⑥rta tshogs kyis bslang ba/ /rdul tshub ⑦sprin ltar rgyas pa yis/ /ngang pa'i yo rā dza haṃ sā rmā saṃ tā sā yā sa he tu tsā/ /dru ra pra yā te da yi te bi ra he ṇa rgyal po skrag pa dang / /nyon mongs rgyu nyid dag tu gyur⑧/ /khyo ni ring ladu song ba na/ /'bral ba yis ma no ha rā/ /ba bhū ba bā la na li byā pa khā sha sha ya rā sha yā/ /soṅkakhye yā ni yid 'phrog ma/ /pad+ma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma yis/ /mal stan la ni brten par gyur/ /sred ldan nyin di ba pa ga ṇa nā ram̐ bha ni t+yā bhe yo ge saṃ khyu re khā sha ri ṇi ma ba no kadza par bgrang ba'i rtsom ṅkapa dag la rtag tu spyomangon sbyor zhing / /grangs kyi ri mo'i lam ni sa la 'dar zhing lo lo li khaṃ bh+yaḥ/ /ta suḥpā ṇi ni pa ti ta ra ṇaṅge ka ṇi tā na be na k+ṣi pre muṣā g.yo bas 'dri ḍa/ byed pa/ /de yi lag pa phra ba nyid kyis sgra ldan gdu bu lhung ba la/ /mchi ma'i rgyun gyi mu 95 —776

ba la ya ka la nā ma shu dh+wa rā tsa kā ra/ /dwo ṣaḥput+pa sha re su khe ba mu kha tā tig gdub kor ①dag ni myur du gnas par byas(pe/ /me tog mda' ①can la sdang bde la phyir phyogs lus de he yi ni ste ha tā pa khyo dh+yā na pa rā ya ṇa twa ma ni shā tan+d+ra ma masgo la'ang chags pa nyid ma yin/ /bdag po'i bsam gtan skyong zhing nyin mtshan du ni de yi ming gi gsang dza paḥ/ /sha yā byu mi ta lam̐ ta thā pi su ta nostu pa k+ṣa ti rtswa bha ba sngags zlos/ /mal stan sa gzhir byas te de lta na yang gzugs bzang gdung ba nyams ma gyur/ /'dod nu dz+wa nibya la lī na rā ga ma na rmā muspri tsa tī pra bra taiḥ/ /lī nā chags g.yo med chags pa'i yid rnams brtul zhugs drag pos grol ba min nam ci/ /shel gyi ④khri stan la spa ṭi ka ba.oṃ kai ha ri tsan da na pāṇ+ḍa rā/ /tsan+d+ra le khe ba sā ta ā+oṃ byosgo ma rgya ga 'dug cing / /ha ri tsan dan gyis skye ba/ /gzugs can ma de zla 'od kyi⑤/ /dbus song ⑥zla ris tā ba sgo/ /ka dā tsi da tha bhū pā laḥswasna dar+ghaṃ na shi ki haḥ/ /pu ro bzhin du mdzes/ /de nas nam zhig sa skyong ni/ /rmi lam mthong nas dogs gyur pas/ /mdun na hi ti sa mā snu ya pa prats+tsha ka pi li ra haḥ/ /dṛṣ+ṭa ma r+ya ma yā swasne ni 'don ni ser skya dag /yang dag bos nas dben par dris/ /grong khyer dgra rnams kyis bkag cing / /rur+ghaṃ sha tru bhiḥpu ram̐/ /pā ṭi to da ra kṛṣ+ṭi: ma mādhe pa ri beji tai/ /bdag gi lto brdol ⑦rgyu ma ni/ /drangs nas yongs su dkris pa yi⑧/ /rmi lam de ring bdag gis mthong / /swasna snga su bi pā karta pha lo bru hi ma hā ma te/ /bi tsin+ta ya shu sgo da blo gros chen po mi lam 'di'i/ /rnam byun 'bras bur 'os pa gsungs/ /dge bar yongs sgyur 1'os pa kā nu tsi tsā tsa pra ti kṛ lnga/ /i ti thraṣ+ṭaḥk+ṣi tī she na k+ṣa ṇa man+daḥyis / /phyir bcos dag kyang bsam par mdzod/ /ces pa sa yi dbang pos dris/ /mdun na 'don pu ro hi taḥ/ /bhat+ta rda bha bye ta dh+yā naḥs m+bi hi ta ma tsin+ta yata/ /gyis skad cig ni/ /gus pa'i tshul 'chos ⑩bsam gtan bzung / /nang du mngon par 'dod pa bsams /95—777

kin+da rī na durla ghā/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥshu tā spyu ram̐ pā ta ka ku ṇi taḥ/ /yod pas mi 'am ci mi dkon/ /zhes pa de tshig ma rungs pa/ /thos nas sdig pas rmus phyin cing / /dṛ shaṃ pa bṛt+ta saṃ trastastasta ma bhā ṣasgru pa tiḥ/ /ni dza dzi bi ta rak+ṣu yi gtum po'i spyod pas skrag gyur pa/ /sa yi bdag pos 3de la smras/ /rang gi srog ni bsrung slad du 7/ /ka dze+e byā ba dha mupyo he/ /kin+da rī bi ra he ba bye na tsa dz+re ba ti me su taḥ/ /bud med gsod par khyeji ltar spro/ /mi 'am ci mo dang bral na/ /nges par bdag gi 47bu mi 'tsho/ /i nyi byu mi bhu dzā ta gya pra t+yā khyu te sa m+bi hi te/ /tai pā pā r+bha ni be+e she na su zhes te sa la spyod pas de'i/ /'dod pa phyir la bzlog pa na/ /mdun na 'don ni sdig pa la/ /mngon naḥpā ha pu ro hi haḥ/ /a ho rā dzan+da dzā m+bi ṣe dhī mā na bi dza naspru tai/ /tri par zhen pas yang der smras/ /kye ma rgyal po blo gros dang / /ldan yang skye ba'i (3‘lugs mi shes/ /sde brga sā dha rna t+yā rdzu na ra rdzu na tsa dz+re bi tai/ /arja i ba swa dza na gsum sgrub khye7byed rgyal srid dang / /srog kyang gtang rmyabar bya ba min/ /nor bzhin nang mi grogs po mi tra ka la tra pu tānaṣ+ṭaḥsbi ta su pu ru ṣa gya pu nar+bha brnyi/ /utshwa sa mā tra chung ma bu dag chani/ /nyams pa skyes bu gnas na slar yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dbugs tsam bral zhing bi ra te ga ta dzī bi ta gya taṭ+wā la sad+mā hitam su sa de ba sarde/ /t+yā dzasti dzī bi srog ni song bar gyur pa lasakye/ /de dus nye bar gnas kyang thams cad med pa nyid/ /'tsho ba'i don du ta sngabe+e ni dza de sha pri yāt+pa dzaḥ/ /dz+re bi tā da pa ram̐ rā dza na dz+re bi lo rang yul dang / /gces pa'i bu yang gtong bar byed/ /rgyal po 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten na/ /srog las keste na pri yo/ /i ti dz+re bi ta lo bha ya te na nā nā ni dar+sha ṣ+peḥ/ /sha ṣ+peḥgazhan ni gces pa med/ /de ltar de yi 37sna tshogs kyinyurta/ /dpe yis dal gyis brid pa na/ /rgyal po pra tā ri teḥ sā re rā dzā yuk+ta ma ma n+ya ta/ / ta taḥsu saṃ bye tā ram̐ srog la chags pa yi①1 / /sdig la rigs par kha yis blangs/ /de nas phun tshogs rtsom me pa yis/ /95—779

bhe bra thraste ya dzha kan+d+ra ṇi/ /kṛ tā lnga puṣ+ka ri r+ghaṃ tsa push+lau yī pa shu sho ṇi taiḥ/ /mchod sbyin las la 'jug byed cing / /phyugs kyi khrag gis gang ba yi/ /rdzing bu yang ni byas pa'i tshe /rā dzñā ka thi ta dṛṭ+wād+dhā ni dza pasbyi swa yī ra haḥ/ /pu tra pra bā pa sho kād+dhā dben par rang gi btsun mo la/ /rgyal pos rang gi spyod tshul bshad/ /bu ni byes bgrod mya ngan gyis/ /pā pa tra stu bya tsin+ta yata/ /a ho rūkhā+e ta ro rā dzā mo hādhe na pu ro dha sā/ /gzir cing sdig pas skrag pas ①bsams/ /kye ma mna' ma gsod ②pa yi/ /sgrub byed sdig pa rgya che 'dir/ /sgru ṣā ba dha bi dh+wa ṣ+pesmidz+re ri taḥpri thu pā ta ke/ /yasne ra pa ri hāche mdun na 'don ni gti myug gis/ /long bas rgyal po rab rmongs bskul/ /'chi ①ba'i mtshams ni nges pi ni ba ste ni dha nā baṃ sgo / / pa ra pā shā pa hā re ṇa rū ṭ+wā bcad pa/ /'bad pas yongs 'phrog mi nus kyang / /gzhan gyi srog ni phrogs dhipa yis/ /blun po bāsbyi ti dz+re bi tai/ /ya di jo bi ta lubye na mud+dhā mṛ ta ba dhū ri ba/ /rnams ni 'tsho bar 'dod/ /gal te srog la chags pa yis/ /bu mo bzhin bzang bdud rtsi 'dra/ /sgru ṣā pi ha n+ya nyi rā dzñā tiṅgi bagh+ra mya haṃ su tai/ /mā tastu me yo bāt+pa myuta mna' ma yin yang rgyal po yis/ /bsad na bdag gis ⑤ci zhig smra/ /ma gcig khyed kyis mnyes gshin pā l+ya ma ma ma no ha rā/ /i kyughā su dha na sru nurga to ni k+ṣi su las—/ /bdag gi yid 'phrog ma 'di skyongs/ /zhes brjod bu ni nor bzang dag /bdag la chung ma me ba je/ /tasmrasgo ḍā ma ṇi mat+taḥzwa pya byo rja pra yā tu pā/ /bha bi 6 gtad nas song / /de slad bdag las gtsug gi nor/ /thob nas ⑥de ni mkha' la 'gro/ /de ni 'tsho ti ta yā ba h+phu jo baṃ t+yā saṃ ga ma phu naḥ/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya mā ga tā sā na bdag po dang / /slar yang phrad ṣ+ṭapa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bsams mna' ma ga la bar/ /mig chur sru ṣ+pe tā snu ṣārnyi shaṃ/ /rā dzā dṛr+ghaṃ ni be byā sau soṅkaspra pu na ra pra bī ta/ /bāt+pa bcas pa de song nas/ /rgyal po'i tshul ni de la bshad/ /rab 'dar ldan pas slar smras pa/ /mnyes 95—780

kra tuḥsidhiḥsā ha tā te na kin+da rī/ /i ti mi byā ba tsa sta su rā dzā de des gsad/ /khyod kyi gyemachod sbyin bgegs med grub/ /ces pa de yi brdzun gyi tshig /rgyal po yis ② sa t+ya ma ma n+ya ta / / na ju dhe ku ṭi le rmu sgo ya n+t+ra pu t+ta ka lbo ni bden par bsams/ /'khrul 'khor gzugs brnyan rtse ① dga' yis/ /rmongs rnams gya gyus gar la yā/ /pi tur+bha ba ṣ+pe ma bye t+ya khrir+ghaṃ har+ṣa ma no ha rā/ /n+ya be+e da yetwa byed do/ /pha yi khang par mngon phyogs te/ /dga' ba ster byed yid 'phrog mas/ /snying la khyo ni bzung bṛt+ta rnyi ba hadhī pal+la bha z-i di/ /sā pi tuḥshā sa nād+maju saṃ ga po ra bha byas te/ /rang gi spyod pa'i mtha' rnams bshad/ /yab kyi bka' yis ④mi dang ni/ /'grogs pa'i dri shān+ta ye/ /he ma rku bha sha taiḥrtswa rgo pañtsa bhiḥpra t+ya haṃ pya dh+wa ta/ /madh+yā mo daḥpra ta ma zhi ba'i slad/ /gser gyi bum pa lnga brgya yis/ /nyi ma so sor khrus dag byas/ /bkrus pas mi yi dri ma byuk+ṣu li tā yāḥsha ṣ+pe ya yo/ /su dha na sne ha saṃ yo ge na tu rā go mṛ gī ni—/ /rab tu chung ba nyid du gyur/ /nor bzang la ni mdza' gcugs ldan/ /ri dwags mig gi chags dṛ shaḥ/ /di byod+mā no ba sgo ge 6 na pā nahṝ ti mā ya yo/ /a n+ya tra badhe rā gā pa min/ /lha yi skyed tshal longs spyod la/ /de ni dga' bar yongs ma gyur/ /gzhan la chags par gyur rde ra tiṭ+wā n+ya tra de hi rmā/ /sī kān+ta be+e ra hā krād+dhā ka dā tsibye ma gā pa yi/ sde / /lus can gzhan na 67dga' ba med/ /nam zhig mkha' la 'gro ma de/ /sdug pa dang bral nyon mi bhā/ /hūṃ nā ga bha ba no pān+ta ba nān+ta ba su d+dhā ya yo/ /ta tā shra ma mongs shing / /klu yi khang pa'i nye 'khor de/ /nags mtha'i nor 'dzin dag tu song / /drang srong chen s+tha lī pa lte ma ha k+ṣi ba be+e lā ya na / / a ba dh+wa sa ma bye t+ya pra po bste gnas der(dz+wa/ /gnas pa shing shun can de la/ /rab tu btud cing phyag btsal dute/ /dud spu rja ma bi na marlu khā+e/ /lubha ka sro pa di sha tā bha ba tā ma ma brnya rna/ /twa cing mngon du phyogs pas smras/ /bdag ni 'ching ba rngon pa la/ /nye bar bstan pa khrod kyis ni/ /gal 95—782

me ba bru nyi bha ga ban ya di yuk+ta mi rda kṛ tai/ /i ti ta snga ba tsaḥshu tā te rigs pas ①'di byas na/ /bcom ldan khyod nyid bdag gis bye gsungs/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos nas//kiñtsibe+edz+dza na tā na naḥ/ /tā mu bā tsa mu nirmuste ta be+e ṣā bha bi ta bya tā/ /cung zad ngo tshas bzhin btud de/ /thub pas der smras bzhin bzang ma/ /'di ni khrod kyis myong bya nyid//a mo gha pā shasta sngaste t+ya dzñā tā ka thi tasma ya/ /u pa la bh+ya ka dze+e dh+wartahūṃ de la zhags pa don yod ni/ /yod ces bdag gis ma shes bshad/ /g.yon can rngon pas de yi ( 7gtam//pa ban+dha pa lubha kaḥ/ /duṣ+ṭhad+ma rmā na dzā m+bi maḥkau ṭi bye spyu ra tse ta shes nas khyod ni bcings par gyur/ /bden par smra ba'i mu cor can/ /rang bzhin drang ba bdag cag sā—/ /pa t+ya pra bā da mu kha rāḥsata bh+ya ba pa ra khā ba yo/ /i kyughā mu mi nā gis—/ /ma rungs bdag nyid gdug pa yi/ /sems kyi gya gyu yongs mi shes/ /zhes pa thub pas brjod ta rtswa pra ṇi yāt+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bha ga baspyo mya tā me tabye lā ba tsa na de la/ /gzugs can ma yis gus pas ④ smras/ /bu mo'i tshig ni khyagayo ba 'di/ /bcom ldan gyis ni tsā pa lo/ /i dahūṃ bha ba ta ma gre yad+ma yā ki tsi du tsu te/ /la khā bzod par mdzod/ /khyed kyi mdun du bdag gis ni/ /gang 'di cung zad brjod gyur pa/ /dam pa'i su bha gaḥso yo pā dā tsā ra bya ti kra maḥ/ / duḥkhod+dhā ra ṇa san+da d+dhāḥspyod las 'gal ba 'di/ /bud med rnams kyi skal ba bzang / /sdug bsngal 'don la chas gyur cing / /san+tabhā dzā da ya la baḥ/ /kār+yan+ta ra gāḥpā ye ṇa bha baṃ t+ya nu tsi te ṣa pi/ /yongs su gdung la brtse ldan rnams/ /'os pa min pa rnams kyi yang / /phal cher bya ba sgrub mdzad yin/ /pā sha ba n+t+rabe+e mulnga haṃ lubha ke na pra lā se rmā/ / ni ba d+dhā rā dza cho nge dang ni ⑥ldan pa bdag⑦ / /rngon pa'i zhags pas bcings las grol/ /'phrog byed mdza' ba'i pu tre ṇa sne ha pā she na ha ri ṇa/ /su bha gaḥsu dha nā khyo sau mju zhags pa yis/ /rgyal po'i bu yis nges par bcings/ /nor bzang zhes pa skal ba bzang / /bdag 95—783

yo gā na khā ku laḥ/ /a nu nā ya di marge ṇa sa me 6 te ta bārnyi rka/ /ta bral me yi gdung ba 'di①/ /gal te lam ni 'di nyid nas/ /khyod can nye bar 'ongs gyur na/ /snying di rda bha ba tā bātsuḥkā ru 5d+ma tsa sā ma ma/ /spri tā twabe+e ra sā yā pa niḥrje las ni khyod nyid kyis/ /bdag gi 'phrin ④'di smra bar byos/ /khyod bral gdung bas bde med cing / /su khā haṃ kṛ he pi tuḥ/ /uṅkaṇ+ḍa ma nu rka pa rū sa ha dzā byā kṛ ta dzñā tsā/ /bdag ni yab kyi khyim na 'khod/ /'dun ①dang rjes su brtse ba 'am/ /byas shes lhan cig skyes pa yirjo/ /dāk+ṣi bye bā pu raskṛ t+ya tūṇ+ḍi mā ga mya tā mi taḥ/ /durga maḥkin+da ra pu re mārgaḥrjes mthun mdun du bdar byas te/ /'di nas myur du 'byon par mdzod/ /mi 'am ci yi grong khyer lam//kle sha sha tā sha yaḥ / / a bhū mi re ba ma myu rmā malpa bī r+ya ba lo bgrod dka' nyon mongs brgya yi ⑤rten/ /brtson 'grus stobs gzi chung ba yi/ /mi rnams kyis ni sa dza shā/ /dībhā ta po ba nārnye smirlu dh+wa nā ma ma ho ṣa dhiḥ/ /dṛ sh+ya min nyid/ /dka' thub nags mtha' 'dir 'bar ba/ /bdud rtsi zhes pa'i sman chen ni/ /mthong ste te ha bi pā pa hūṃ pā ta byā sā swa yo twa yā/ /tan+d+ra bhā bat+pa muti r+ya kle zhun mar la btsos ⑥pa/ /khyod rang nyid kyis btung bar bya/ /de mthus snying stobs grogs ldan khrod/ /shaṃ sa twa sa hā ya bān/ /kai khā sa hā sa shu bye ṇa pa thā mah+phu ra me bye nyon mongs rab tu sgrol 'gyur te/ /lam ni kai lā sa dgod ⑦ltar/ /dkar bas bdag grong phyin par piske/ /i rda tsa tasmi dā ta bye ma da bhi dzñā gu rī ya shaṃ/ /i trughā bi ṣa gyur(she / /bdag gi rtags mtshan sor gdub ni/ /'di yang de la sbyin par bya/ /zhes brjod de yis oṃ ba ṭ+wā ka tha yi tā kra me ṇa sā/ /bi sna pra ti kri yo pā yāt+pa n+da mi bzad (7pa'i/ /lam ni rim pas bshad byas te/ /ngo mtshar rig ⑩pa dag gis ni/ /bgegs sh+ya sprur+ya yusti bhe ཿ / / ā shā ba n+dha bye ta pā ṇa ya yo da hūṃ gu byā rnams phyir bcos thabs bstan nas/ /re ba'i 'ching bas srog bzung ba/ /sor gdub byen nas song 95—784

ya ke/ /ta yā ka thi ta mā kasbya dru rā dh+wa ta ra zlan+d+ra tai/ /e gu rī ya bar gyur/ /lam ring sgrol byed rmad byung dag /de yis bshad pa thos gyur te/ /sor gdub dag ni ka mā dā ya ta de bā tsin+ta yazlu niḥ/ /a tān+ta re rā dza sru nurdzi tā me gha blangs byas nas/ /thub pa de dag nyid la sems/ /skabs der sa yi ①bdag po sprin/ /pham par byas ma tī pa ti/ /ā ya yo ko sha mā dā ya da yī tā dar+sha nokhru kaḥ/ /sa shing mdzod blangs nas/ /chung ma blta bar 'dod pa yika)/ /rgyal po'i bu ni 'ongs par gyur/ /rgyal bi be+e sha swa na ga re pā man+ta ts+tshan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa be+eḥ / / phube+e phe ṇa smi ta phran gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor byis/ /mkha' ni chu gtor kyilpu ba'i 'dzum/ /rgyas pa dag dang mtshungs sngarnyi ཿkud+dhā ṇaḥs: bhan+da bhaḥ/ /snu ṣā bai sha sha bṛṭ+wā n+ta ka tha na gre byed cing / /de ni rang gi grong khyer zhugs/ /de nas mna' ma'i nyes gyod kyi(two/ /lo rgyus 'chad la sha kem+bi tai/ /a thān+taḥpu ra ma bye t+ya dza na rka thra ṇa nā ma paḥ/ /a bho mu nyon mongs shing / /'dar ba'i pho brang 'khor song ste/ /de yi ⑤ yab la rab tu btud/ /'og tu bzhin khā khi la dza ā+oṃ sho ka sha be+e ha tot+pa baṃ/ /pi tu ran+taḥpu re dṛṭī sa bi pre phyogs skye bo kun/ /mya ngan zug rngus dga' ston bcom/ /yab kyi pho brang 'khor mthong nas/ /de ni ya ma shaṃ ka ta/ /a bi dzī ba ti ma ta rtswa bi ra hāṭ+wā ma no ha rā/ /dga' dang bral bar dogs/ /'bral bas gzir ba'i yid 'phrog ma/ /gzugs bzang ma de 'tsho 'am ci /i ti bru bā khaṃ nā ya dā ta mu tse kabya da thra ya/ /ta dā gā da dza na m+bi pu tra dz+re zhes smra ⑥de la su yis kyang / /gang tshe mi snyan ma brjod pa/ /de tshe ma yis rab smras pa/ /bu gcig ba ti te pri yā/ /ga tā tsū ḍā ma ṇi pā pya ki tu jo be+e ta saṃ sha ye/ /i ti shu khyod kyi dga' ma 'tsho/ /'on kyang srog la the tshom tshe/ /gtsug gi nor bu thob nas song / /zhes pa thos tī ba sa ha sā ba pa pā ta ma tī ta le/ /tīṇ+ḍi hā ra la hūṃ kuzlad+mā sru dh+wa pa nyid na de/ /'phral la sa yi gzhi la 'gyel/ /do shal 'khri shing bkram pa'i lngas/ /mchi ma'i rgyun 'u795—785

rā mi pak+ṣi to/ /tu ṣa ra shrī ka rasma ra ha ri tsan+da na bā bi bheḥ/ /sa lad+dhā ldan byed pa bzhin/ /kha ba'i thigs ①pa ltar dkar ba'i/ /ha ri tsan dan chu dag gis/ /dal byis saṃ snyoḥsha na kaim+bi la khā pā sru gaṅga daḥ/ /a nā ka sha sha shaṃ ka shrī 'du shes rnyed pa des/ /mchi mas 'gar 'gar rnam par smras/ /mkha' ming (nyari bong can gyi dpal/ /ra mabye mṛ ta bā hi ni/ /a yat+na rat+na ba la dī kwa sā ku su ma dha bsrubs min bdud rtsi'i rgyun ①dang ldan/ /'bad med me tog gzhu can byis/ /rin cen (pyaganas de na naḥ/ /gu ru shā sa na yo tri te na dru ram̐ bra dza tā bāt+pa ni rud+dhā lo tsa nā yāḥ/ /gang na yod/ /bla ma'i bkas ༄snyebacings ring du 'gro byed pa/ /bdag gi ④ri dwags mig can mchi ma yis//bi hi tā na dh+ri ti tin+d+ra yā mṛ gā ṣ+ṭha kyu da yo me pa ti taḥsma rā bhi shā baḥ/ /de mig ni 'gags pa'i dga' ba ma bsgrubs pa/ /des na dran pa'i dmod 'di bdag la lhung / /yid hi pra ti ba tsaḥsu ju kwa ga tā pi ma no ha re/ /ma yā pra ma da spyu bye na 'phrog ma ni gang du song / /smin legs tshig gi ⑦lan dag sbyin⑧/ /bag med blun po bdag gis ni/ /ha ri shā k+ṣi na rak+ṣi tā / /tā t+pa mā ga ma sau bhā gya shā gya gya su ra ri dwags mig can khyod ma bsrungs/ /khyod dang 'grogs pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /lha yi mdun sa ⑨saṃ pa di/ /ma me ba ma rtu lo ka gya twa byi yo ga sra kā dru ti/ /i bsngags par 'os/ /khrod dang bral bas mi yis ⑪ni/ /'jig rten bdag bzhin ci zhig mdzes/ /zhes ti bru pā ṇa sha na kaiḥkād+dhā saṃ sgo ga sā k+ṣi 6/ /u byā ṣ+pe 6 pri ya ta rmā pa smra zhing dal bu yis⑪/ /mdzes ma'i longs spyod dbang gyur pa/ /skyed mos tshal du dga' ma mchog /bi tse hūṃ swa ya mur+ya yo/ /bañtsa yi tā pa ri dza rde pa ra dza t+yā ma la k+ṣi taḥ/ /'tshol ⑫du rang nyid song bar gyur/ /'khor gyi skye bo brid byas te/ /mtshan mo dag ni ma tshor bar/ /ga tā ba nār+ghaṃ bi ju ma pa me 6 bi ṣa me 6 tsa/ /tī bra rā ga pi nags mthar song nas mnyam pa dang / /mi mnyam rnams su rnam par 'khyam⑫/ /'dod chags drag po'i 95—786

shā tse na ma ha tā pa bi mo hi taḥ/ /ud+mat+ta i ba pa prats+tsha tse ta nā tse ta sha za ni/ /chen pos rnam par rmongs pa des/ /smyon pa bzhin du sems ldan dang / /sems med la nā na pi/ /byu nyi sa khe shu ka shā ba ka sa khyaḥpā ṇa sa khā+e ni khi yang rnam par dris/ /grogs po de ru'i phru gu grogs kyi grogs mo ni/ /srog mtshungs zla rdzogs bzhin ldan len+d+ra mu kho tī/ /tasde sha nats+tsha da rā ga bi bhā ge bidza pha le stu pa dā ta de ni smra bar byos/ /de yi so yi sgrib byed dmar ba dag gi char17/ /bilnga'i 'bras bu rtag tu khyod kyi (27ba sgo gaḥ/ /haṃ ho haṃ sa mi hūṃ ga saṃ ga na li m+bi lbo khā ba tai pa kyu te dṛṭ+wā longs spyod yin/ /kye lags ngang pa lus dkar dang 'grogs pad+mo can rol rna rgyan ltar mdzes pa mu sau ra bha pad+ma pad+ma ba da ā+oṃ ki kārnyi kakhro li ni/ /ya sngaḥr+pā na pa yo dha rā gra tig tshogs ni rnam par g.yo ba gang gi 'o ma 'dzin pa rgyas pa'i rtser/ /ba spu'i 'khri ⑦shing ngang pa la ni nya bi lu thidrulnga ka lā pa gya sā haṃ sa gye ba bi bhā ti ro ma la ti kā shi bā lcibs 'khri shing lhung bzhin rnam mdzes pa/ /dri bzang khang pa pad+ma'i bzhin ldan mdzes pa'i rba ④rlabs la bal+līdzi tī/ /ta gye ti tī bra bya sa nā nu ban+t+rat+tha khā pi naḥpra s+t+ya la taḥcan de mthong ngam ci/ /de ltar sdug bsngal drag pos bcings pa las⑤ / /rab smre mnyam pa la yang sa mo pi/ /di shan+d+ra kā shaṃ da ya ye ba mārge sha ṣ+perja gā te ga ga rna si tsā 'gred de la/ /brtse bas lam ni rab gsal ster ba bzhin/ /dal gyis ⑥baṅgal zer can ni nam mkhar shuḥ —/ / shā mā pa te dz+red+ma tha bān jo ba su kādhe sa dṛ ṣ+ṭa sba ra 'dzegs④—/ /mtshan mo'i bdag po yid srubs gnyen gyi ni/ /gzugs mdzes mkha' la sbyar ba de tsum+bi bim+bi/ /san+dasgo ta min+d+ra mu khyu me ṣ+pe smi ta mu khaṃ byo mā bi mā na shri mthong nas/ /'dzum ldan zla zhal ma yis nam mkha' yi/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i steng nas bzhin bstan gāta / /mū shaṃ ka lo rmā ka ma bāṣ+ṭa do ṣa ma bi bh+ra oṃ hā sa bi lā sa tī bsamasadu—/ /mi smra dri mas mtshan zhing ⑨skyon dag thob/ /rnam 'phrul med cing dgod dang rtsed ⑩'jos 95—787

bi lo lā la la nā ba ṭ+wādhe la te ba dṛṣ+ṭa sta ba ka bhā pā/ /e na nu ā+oṃ can de 'khri shing bzhin du ni/ /nags mthar nags bdag khyod kyis ①mthong ngam ci/ /de ni sprin dang ba na kuñdza re ṇa sā rā dza re bhā pa ri re bha lo lāt+pa/ /ā kṛ6 nī tā gha na mtshungs pa nags tshal gyi/ /glang po 'di yis khuzla ba'i cha bzhin du/ /gser gyi chu shing yongs 'khyud la sad+ngha bhe na saṃsgo di tā bāsde sha shi naḥka le baḥ/ /i ti kā na na kubye 6 chags nas/ /blangs nas khyer ram bsgribs pa ma yin nam/ /de ltar nags tshal skyibs rnams su/ /ta srod+mā da pra khā pi naḥ/ /sho kā di ba bi brjen+d+ra ba da nā ra dza bhā ya bla bcol rab brjod de yis ①ni/ /mya ngan gyis bzhin mtshan mo ni/ /zla ba'i bzhin ras mdog bral yo / /sa nā ga bha ba nā san+da tī ro pān+ta po ba rna/ /sha ṣ+peḥpra bi song / /de yis ④klu yi gnas dang nye/ /ngogs 'gram dka' thub nags tshal du/ /dal byis zhugs te sh+ya sa prats+tsha ma habhā balka lā ya ā+oṃ/ /i ha bi ra hi bi tsiṭ+wā sho ka drang srong che/ /shing shun can la rab tu dris/ /'dir ni 'bral bas sems dman mya ⑤ngan shugs ni shā rūts+tshad+ma da na da ha na dhū ma sh+ya ma sak+ṇi ka bi bhā/ /i bi sha mi rings kyis spar ba'i⑥/ /'dod pa'i me yi du bas sngo chags lhas ma gcig pa can/ /ri bong can gyi ta sha shī kobyā ma saun+darlu das+thā mu ni ba ra ha ri zla khye kin+da rī kā pi dṛṣ+ṭa/ /mdzes sdug dregs rgyas zhi byed ri dwags mig /mi 'am ci mo su zhig thub pa mchog gis gzigs sam ci/ /i ti kād+dhā bi yu k+ta gya pāp+ta pod+mā ni nin+da shaṃ/ /mu niḥshu tā ba tsa ta gya zhes pa mdzes ma dang bral zhing / /smyon pa'i skabs ni thob gyur pa/ /de yi tshig thos thub pa yis/ /pa ri dzñā ya ta ma bra r+pāt+pa/ /sa mā shwa si hi bi shra mya sarja pasgyu bye tā ma yongs su shes nas de la smras/ /khyod ni ngal gso rdokyedabugs phyung la/ /yongs su gdung ba 'di gtang yi—/ /dṛṭ+wā sā ta ba ka spyo bhā ma yā mān sa tsadh+ri yā/ /yu tha bh+raṣ+ṭi ba mdzod—/ /khyod kyi dge ma yid kyi ni/ /zla ba'i 'od de bdag gis dumathong / /khyu nyams ri dwags mo 95—789

ha ri bhā ni se k+ṣu pi jo bi te/ /pā shā kṛṣ+ṭi ba ka ri bhā dh+war+ya te sā twa dā bzhin du/ /'tsho ba la yang ltos ①pa med/ /glang mo zhags pas drangs pa bzhin/ /de ni khyod kyi bsam sha yā/ /pā r+ṇa she te ba da na ka ma lo pra sta re pal+la bā rmā tā pa klur+sā ta ra pas 'tsho/ /lag pa dag la bzhin gyi pad+ma nyal zhing yal 'dab mal stan la/ /gdung bas nyan ②cing la ba tsa na shaṃ pi nī gā tra le khā/ /ā shā badhe j-i ti ri ba ma ti stabe+e g.yo ba'i tshig ldan ri mo kun du nyams pa'i ④lus/ /re ba bcas la brtan pa bzhin du ④blo gros khyod yo gā ku lā yāsta snga ṣ+pe pa ka tsi da pi ma naḥki tu bi shrī ti me ti/ /dru ma mya bral 'khrugs gyur pa/ /de yi yid ni 'gar yang ci yang ngal gsos ⑤nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /ljon pa mi kin+da ra pa teḥsbi tā haṃ bha ba ṣ+pe pi tuḥ/ /ā gan+ta bye twa yā tūṇ+ḍi mi ti hūṃ san+di 'am ci yi bdag /yab kyi khyim na bdag gnas so/ /khyod ni myur du shog cig ces/ /de yis dukhyod la de sha pā/ /bīr+ya sa twa ba lo pā ya bye rlot+yā ha ba tā ma pi/ /yang dag bstan/ /brtson 'grus snying stobs stobs dang thabs/ /brtan ⑦dang spro ldan rnams kyis kyang //a ga mya kin+da ra pu re kra mābozla sha shaṃ sa ba/ /i rda tsa twa1 te dadzhai bgrod ⑧min mi 'am ci yi ni/ /grong khyer ⑨lam yang rim pas bshad/ /gang gi 'od 'jam reg pa yis//ta mā ratrī gu byā ya ke/ /ya su ldisna pra bhā bye shodi sho yarnyi pi ṣe ga hūṃ/ /phyogs rnams ser po nyid 'gyur ba/ /rin cen ⑩sor gdub 'di yang ni/ /de yis khyod kyi ched du byen//i t+ya nan+da su jo sak+ta musto byer+yā ba lo ba rna/ /i gu rī yo da do zhes brjod kun dga'i bdud rtsi yis/ / dran bzhin brtan ⑪pa dag gi rten/ /sor gdub dag ni de la ta smid+mā rge tsā ka tha yarlu niḥ/ / sa thā ta du pā diṣ+ṭi na so pā ye phyin4)—/ /lam yang thub pas rab tu bshad/ /de yis bstan pa'i lam dag ni/ /thabs dang bcas na dṛ pād+ma dzaḥ/ /dhī raḥpra tsakra me gan+ti dha na dā byu ṣi hūṃ di shaṃ/ /pas mi bdag bu/ /brtan rkyu)pas nor 'dzin gnas pa yi⑫/ /phyogs su 'gro bar rab tu brtsams/ /95—790

saṃ sir+ghaṃ 1 tapā ke na su dzñā be+e tā ma ho ṣa dhi/ /labharnyi ba la ma sman chen bdud rtsi legs grub pa/ /mar gyis smin pa 'thungs nas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag nyid hātūḥs yud+dhāḥpra ya yo sha ṣ+pe/ /rirgyu sam+bi hi tai ta gya sasgo pa ka ra thob—/ /mtshon cha dang bcas dal gyis song / /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni lam du de'i/ /nyer mkho thams cad ṇa pa thi/ /a byut+pa twa sa hā yā dzā swā dhī nāḥsidhi sadza daḥ/ /a nyer gnas gyur/ /snying stobs grogs dang ldan rnams kyi/ /grub pa phun tshogs rang dbang nyid()/ /de tha be+e byā dha ra ba dhū bi lā sa ha si ta byu ti/ /hi ma ban+ta ma ti kra mya nas rig 'dzin bu mo ni/ /rtse dga' dgod ④pa ltar mdzes pa/ /gangs can brgal khyanas de yis ni/ /ku ku khā dh+ri ma bā pa paḥ/ /pha lo pa hā re swo kṛ t+ya ta tra bā na ra yu tha paṃ/ /ba ku ku lā yi rjori la sleb/ /'bras bu'i skyes kyis khas blangs ⑤byas/ /der ni spre'u'i khyu yi bdag /rlung yu be shā khya mā ru khya ga tai shi la ma lo gha yata/ /a thā dza pa thā nā mān ma shugs zhes pa la zhon nas/ /ri bo de ni de yis 'gongs⑩/ /de nas lug gi lam zhes pa'i/ /sa nyi tsakrā ma bhū dha ram̐/ /ni ha t+ya dza ga ram̐ sgo ra bisna saṃ gha mi be 'dzin dag ni rab tu brgal⑦/ /'jigs su rung ba'i sbrul chen ni/ /bgegs kyi tshogs bzhin mda' ṣā ḍā/ /bī rja swā ṣ+perba shī kṛ t+ya rāk+ṣa sī kā ma rū pā sh+lau/ /kā ma yis bsnun/ /'dod pa'i gzugs can srin mo ni/ /rgyud mang ⑧sgra yis dbang byas nas/ /'dod pa'i rū pā dri muwaṃ bh+ya pra ya yo kirja rī thra yaḥ/ /pā la bā na mu hu rā ghā ta ni gzugs kyi ri bo 'dasapo)/ /mi 'am ci mo'i bdag po song / /de nas rgyun gcig ①7ri bo la yang khā taiḥshasnga shaṃ ku bhiḥ/ /e ka dh+wa ram̐ ta taḥshi lo mā ru ro hā ti sā ha paḥ/ /yang mtshon gye rtse mo yis/ /bsnun cing ⑩brkos pa dag gis ni/ /stobs ldan shin du rtul ⑪bas 'dzegs//a tho gra ta ra mā ru khya badz+ra kā khye sa sat+tha tai/ /kṛ dh+ra rū r+pā sa mā lo kya rāk+ṣa de nas rdo rje can zhes pa'i/ /ri bo rab bral /rkyede yis 'dzegs/ /srin mo sha ni 'tshol ⑩byed pa/ /bya 95—791

sī pi pi tai ṣa khro/ /pa ri thrabhe na saṃ ts+tshan+da pa rmā sa mṛ ga tsan+d+ra rgod gzugs can yang dag mthong / /sha ldan ri dwags pags pa ni/ /yongs su bsgyur bas kun du shā—/ /sa pa da mū le ta snga dresta sbo nistsa la bi gra haḥ/ /rmā sa lup+ta ta muk+ṣi g.yogs| /ri bo de yi zhabs kyi rtsar①/ /de yi lus ni g.yo med 'khod/ /mtshan rgyu bya rgod gzugs gya kṛ dh+ra rū pā ni shā tsa rī/ /ni da dhe shi kha ra snga gre sgoste dī can ni/ /sha la chags pas de blangs nas/ /'jigs rung gzugs kyis bza' ba'i phyir/ /ri rtse'i ④ṣa ṇa bi gra hā/ /mṛ ga tsan+d+ra sta muskṛ dzu tsā ni ha t+ya pa bīr+ya bān/ /steng du rnam par bkod/ /brtson 'grus can gyi sneri dwags kyi/ /pags pa btang nas de bsad de/ /nī ran+ta kha di ra tīṇ+ḍi pā pa kha di ra bhū dha re/ /pra bi sh+ya taṅga hūṃ le bhe seng ldeng stug pos dhikhengs pa yi/ /seng ldeng sa 'dzin dag tu phyin/ /de yi phug zhugs rdo bsal bas/ /shi dze+e bya su ma ho ṣa bye/ /shī tā ta pa ta maḥsaza rāk+ṣa sā di bha yā pa haṃ/ /grang dang tsha dang mun pa sprul/ /srin po la sogs 'jigs pa dag /'phrog pa'i sman di chen po thob/ /sa yan+t+ra sat+tha to mā pya paṃ gha byeḥpā ṇa ha ri r+ṇa/ /yan+t+ra tī lo sha rā 'khrul 'khor ri gnyis rab bsdebs rjopas/ /srog ni ⑥'phrog par de yis sleb/ /'khrul 'khor phur pa gre ṇa ts+tsha tā tsakre be+e ni : lo/ / yan+t+ra tī la sa muts+tsha de r+yan+t+ra dā mda' rtse yis/ /bcad nas g.yo ba med par byas/ /'khrul 'khor phur pa bcad rnams kyis/ /'khrul re bi dā rlu pa ཿ / / stso da rgo yan+t+ra tsakra gya ya n+t+ra yuk+ṣiṃ ta thā ya 'khor sgo ni des bcom zhing / /'khrul 'khor 'khor lo ⑦bcad de bzhin/ /lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor sbyar sauske/ /tī bra sra hā ro pu ru kho yan+t+ra ma kho tsa duḥs ho/ /yasgo gra ba'o| /drag ④tu snun byed skyes bu gnyis/ /bzod dka' lug gi 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ /de bzhin chu ⑨darnya ni bye yo ta thā ma ka ra rā k+ṣa sau/ /gho rān+dha kā ra gi bhā gu srin srin po'i so'i/ /'khrul 'khor drag pos 'joms pa gnyis/ /'jigs rung mun pa zab pa'i phug /95—792

hā kyu pa bi lo gha tsa/ /hūṃ hūṃ pa ri ta mudhī rlu ha tā takhru la rāk+ṣa khron pa gnyis kyang rnam par 'gongs/ /chu bo chen po yang dag brgalasti/ /de ngogs srin po rnams sān—/ /ā shī bi ṣa dh+ri ta dza dze+e pa tai gā khyu ba nidza tsā/ /ro di m+bi bsad nas/ /mche ba'i dug ldan gnas pa'i chu/ /pa ta gā ④zhes thur bgrod dang / /gang 'gram mi tsa na dī tī re ya sngaḥkin+da ra tse ṭa kaḥ/ /kuzarnyi ro da na ra baibe+ergyu 'am ci dag gi/ /'bangs rnams ngu ba'i sgra dag gis/ /de 'gro'i sems la bgegs byed pa/ /klung ni taṅga ta tse ta sī/ /taju bye hā pi bhā nā ma hā sā pa kṛ ta tse ta r+sā/ /di ngu ba can dag dang / /de bzhin dgod pa can zhes pa/ /dgod pas sems la gnod byed dang / /mi sharnyi pra li ṣ+pe ya snga bya pha ā+oṃ kin+dadzā ga ṇ+ḍa/ /lo gha yi tā ba gā: n+ya 'am ci mo rnams dag gisadze+e/ /gang gi 'gram du gdung ster ba/ /thur bgrod ④gzhan yang bzlas byas te//be ṭ+wā pā pya na dīn+ta taḥ/ /kyu la be tra lā tā lam+bi ta su ma tha ti tīr+ya ya/ /de 'og spa ldan klung ⑤can phyin/ /de nas de las thar 'dod pas/ /'gam phyi buspa yi 'khri shing bzung ④ //pa ba na bye ri hūṃ pā ra bai tra pakhra la bā pa saḥ/ /ta yā pā bya pa re pā re rlung gis bskul pas ⑧pha rol phyin⑨/ /spa yi 'khri shing de yis thob/ /re ba bzhin du rab ring ba/ /mā sha ye bā ti dīsgo yā/ /da dar+sha kin+da ra pu re sbya ra spa ṭi ka man+di re/ /pra bi de yi pha rol 'gram du phyin/ /mi 'am ci yi grong khyer ni/ /rab gsal shel gyi khang pa mthong / /de yi sh+ya pa sha byeḥpā pya kān+d+ra ka na ka pad+me 1/ /ta byu ra ta ru mā ru khya dal bus nang du zhugs/ /gser gyi pad ldan mdzes par phyin/ /de yi ngogs kyi shing la 'dzegs/ /ta spyo rat+na la tā thra taḥ/ / sa da dakhyem+bu dza ra dzaḥpuñdziḥsu ra bye rin cen ⑩'khri shing gis bsgribs nas⑪/ /der des chu skyes rdul tshogs kyis/ /dri bzang ser por gyur piñdza re/ /te ma rku byerdza lan+ta tra na yaṭīḥkin+da dzā ga rmā/ /kum sgosnye pa'i chu/ /mi 'am ci mo rnams dag gis/ / gser gyi bum par len pa mthong / /nyesteder ni bum 95—793

pe shā māṭī ya sta tre ka sngaḥs ma bye t+ya saḥ/ /has+thā lasbe na ba hā yo kṛ tā 'degs ngal ba yis/ /gzir ba cig rmyecan des mngon phyogs/ /lag pas rten rgyanas grogs byas te/ /sa prats+tsha shā sha ṣ+peḥ/ /mā taḥka su kṛ te to ya mi rda yasne na byā ya te/ /yadzhas+thā dal bu yis ni de la dris/ /ma ma su yi ched du ni/ /chu 'di 'bad nas len par byed/ /gang la gus ga sgo te nā yo bha ba tī bheḥpa ri shra maḥ/ /i ti te na pri ya gi rā pā pas (hūṃ khyed rnams ni/ /yongs su ngal 'di rtsi mi byed/ /de ltar tshig snyan gyis des drisapashe/ /mdzes priṭ+wā ta ma bhāṣa ta/ /mā dhur+ya dhur+ya saun+dar+ya bak+ṣa pā ta pa tī k+ṣa ṇ+ḍata/ /mju mo sdug snyan sgra ldan pa yis cho/ /phyogs su skad cig gis lhung ma/ /de yis de la rab smras pa/ /mi yi dri nga dā sa no dā ya sa dā su ra bhi bā ri byeḥ/ /pi tuḥkin+da ra rā dza sra gi rā rtswa dag bya'i slad/ /rtag tu dri bzang chu rnams kyis/ /mi 'am ci rgyal yab kyi bkas/ /yid 'phrog ma ni ti ma no ha rā/ /ta ye ti ka thi tai khru tā su ṅgā sek+ta i bak+ṣa ḍā ta/ /sa te ma khrus byed do/ /zhes pa de yis brjod thos nas/ /skad cig bdud rtsis bran pa bzhin/ /de yi rtags rku bhe bi k+ṣe ba ta da snyi dhī gu lbo ya shaṃ / / rtswa t+yā sta ta sta da bhi mtshan sor gdub ni/ /gser gyi bum par de yis ⑪'phangs/ /de nas sor gdub mngon par 'phrog hā ri ma no ha rā yāḥrku bhāt+pa pā ta ku tsa rku bha yu go gu lbo yi/ /ya sde shu byed de ni bum pa las/ /khrus byed yid 'phrog ma yi nu ma'i bum pa zung la lhung / /gang gi gzugs ma ta pra ti ma ra t+na ma yu kha le khāḥ k+ṣi sri na kha k+ṣa ta bi lā sa tu brnyan zer ldan rin cen pe'od zer ri mo yis 87/ /myur du sen mo 'debs pa'i rtse dga' dag dang lā ma bsduḥ/ /mūr+ghaṃ ta taḥswa ma nu rā ga mi bā ka la bo rarja gu li mtshungs pa thob/ /de rjes rin cen (snasor gdub lus med gtam dag nang song ba/ /rang gi rjes su ya ka ma rna ga ka thān+ta re shaṃ/ /sā kān+ta mā ga ta ma be+e t+ya ku ta sta ye chags pa gzugs can bzhin du brtags byas nas/ /bdag po 'ongs par shes te 'di ni khyod kyis ⑪gang 95—794

tī tsakran+tasto/ /ta taḥprats+tshan+da dṛṭ+wādhe ladz+dza mā na ma no ha rā/ /bi gnyis dag gis byas/ /de rjes spyod tshul bsgribs pa ni/ /ngo tsha ldan pa'i yid 'phrog mas/ /bshad be+e byā dar+sha ya྾ troḥpa ti byu mi ma no bha baṃ/ /ta taḥkin+da rā rā dzaste ko pa pra sgu ri nas pha ma dag la ni/ /bdag po sa yi yid 'byung bstan/ /de nas mi 'am ci yi rgyal/ /de la khros pas tā dha raḥ/ /u bā tsa dar+sha na pa thi pa riz-i t+yād+ma dzā ba teḥ/ /a ho pra mchu bskyod cing / /bu mo'i bdag ni mthong ba'i lam/ /yongs su btang ①nas rab smras pa/ /kye ma mi mā dā pa ti tā deb dā nu tsi te dza ṣ+pe/ /na bi mulca pi dudṛste k+ṣa lha mā nā 'os skye bo la/ /cha ①yis bag med lhung gyur pa/ /spyod tshul ngan pa bkrus kyang ni/ /chags pa nyid ni pi rak+ta hūṃ/ /yo ba nā ba ni lā ba bye smṛ ha bhā yī di bo ka mā/ /ba ta pra yā ta khyod mi gtong / /khyod kyi mdzes sdug lang tsho la/ /lha rnams kyis ni reg bya 'di/ /kye ma mi dang mdza' ma taste mju sne he na sho tsu hūṃ/ /u da gra go tro pra bha bā gha na yo ba ba yis/ /mya ngan bya 'os nyid du gyur/ /mthon po'i rigs las skyes gyur cing / /stug po'i lang tsho na nisgo rā/ /nisna ge khyo bha bi bh+raṭ+wā yā tā se su ta rā ma dhaḥ/ /birja dubye rab rgyas pa/ /thur 'gro 'khrugs pas rnam nyams pa/ /khyod ni shin tu 'og tu 'gro/ /mkhas pa chags ga dza na bhā ku la bai lagh+ra kā ri bhā/ /ma li na kha la bi bye ba sasma bral skyed byed cing / /rigs ni skyengs par byed pa mo/ /mi bsrun rigs ①bzhin dri ma can/ /khyod tā pi na ka gya tsita/ /byu pa mā tre ṇa tuṣ+ṭa tha ya di mju ba shaṃ ga tā/ /taṅgin+da ni su yang mi 'dod do/ /gzugs tsam gyis ni khyod tshim nas/ /gal te mi yi dbang gyur na/ /gser ra mat+pa he ma ni dz+re ṇa pu ru ṣa tī ṣa/ /pra bhā ba gu ṇa tī nā su las sprul pa ④skyes bu yi⑤/ /gzugs dang rtse dga' cis mi byed/ /mthu dang yon tan gyis dman pa/ /sum̐ sī: tu ta ra kṛ teḥ/ /ā le khyu pu ru ṣa sri ba saun+da.oṃ bhisbyi re dza rna/ /skyes bu rab mdzes dbyebs can gyi/ /mdzes sdug ri mor bris pa yisde/ /skyes bu yi bzhin rtsig pa mdzes//95—796

ba bye me twat+pa tiḥpā pe tī na sasbran+dha ladz+dza yā/ /mu khaṃ dṛṣ+ṭi na shasgo mi 'brel dman ngo tshas sdig can ma/ /khrod khyo bdag gis gsad par bya/ /khyod slong la 'ongs lha rnams kyi//twat+pa dzñāṣ+ṭa di bo ka sī/ / sa t+ya mut+yā hā yuk+ta gya ku la phyon+da ti shā bzhin ni bdag gis ①lta mi phod/ /bden par spro ba dang ldan zhing / /mthon por gyur pa'i rigs ke li naḥ/ /dza re bi ki la kā la ka t+yā saṃ ko tsa kā ri hūṃ/ /i ti bā bhatī dag ni/ /bu mos 'khums par byed pa ste/ /dus ni nges par dga' bas bzhin/ /de skad pha yis (sgotā pi tā ta myu bā tsa na tā na nā/ /a sru tra hā re kud+dhā rde ku tsa yor+pāju smad gyur des/ /mchi ma'i be+egs ④pa nu ma la/ /do shal skud med sgrig byed cing / /bzhin btud de bin+d+ra bhiḥ/ /ko pa da nu tsi tai tā ta ṣ+pe tarja bathi marta si/ /na thra la rab smras pa/ /yab lags khro bar mi 'os ⑪pa/ /de ⑥dag bdag la gsung 'os min/ /mthu yis rte7yarnye pra bhā pe na kin+da rāḥkirja rā dhi kaḥ/ /ga ru ḍa s+thā pi duzlo sgya mi mi 'am ci dag lasacha/ /lhag pa'i mi ⑨ma thos sam ci/ /mkha' lding gis kyang bgrod dka' ba/ /sa mā mudze+e sgya yaḥk+ṣi to/ /pra bhā ba byu mi rā yā ti ma nu 6ཿsa ka tha bha be+eta/ /'di gang gis bgrod gyur nas/ /'ongs pa mthu yi sa gzhi de⑪/ /mi nyid yin par ci 71ltar 'gyur/ /gu ṇa saṃ bā di m+bi mūn+tir+bha ba t+ya ya sha rī rā rde/ /ka ro t+yā nan+da saṃs+thā rda lus can rnams kyi lus dag ni/ /yon tan yang dag rjod byed nyid⑩/ /bsel zer can gyi 'od zer ni/ /byu ti re ba hi ma tī ṣaḥ/ /dzā t+yā ki kṛ ya te tā ta swa bhā bā nu gu rja gu kun dga' skyed par byed pa yin/ /yab gcig rigs kyis ⑪ci zhig bya/ /yon tan rang bzhin rjes su shāḥ—/ /purjen+d+ra ra mṛ ta gyadhī kā la kuṭa su so da raḥ/ /bha baṃ t+yan+targu ṇa 'brang / /zla rgyas bdud rtsi zag ④pa ni/ /nag po brtsegs pa'i spun spyozla nyid/ /kha cig nang na yon ke tsits+tshan+da do ṣā sta thā pa re/ / a pa rī gh+ra na ka rta bya ma dhī tan ldan/ /de bzhin gzhan ni skyon bsgribs pas/ /nor bu rnams kyi rin ⑩dag ni/ /ma brtags 95—797

ma dhu nā sa n+da r+sha yi tu ma rta se/ / a bhin+da ba ṇ+ḍi rū pā shā tu s+thā 'phags dag /khyod kyis ①yang dag bstan par 'os/ /gzugs dang kha dog dbyer med cing / /rgyan bha ra ṇa ba ya pā/ /kin+da rī rde sbi hūṃ ma bye gre hā ṇa ni dza babe+e r+ghaṃ/ /dang na tshod mtshungs gyur pa/ /mi 'am ci mo 'khod pa yi/ /dbus nas ④rang gi dga' ma zungs④/ /i h+phuk+taste na sa pu naḥkin+da rī sha ta pañtsa rka/ /tu lha baṇ+ḍi ba yo be shaṃ da zhes pa brjod nas de yis sbar/ /mi 'am ci mo lnga brgya dag /rdzogs pa kha dog lang tsho dang / /chas dar+sha bya gra ma gra taḥ/ /tā sāsma bye pa ri dzñā ya sa dza gā ha ma no ha mtshungs mdun du de yis dhimathong / /de dag dbus nas yid 'phrog ma/ /de yis ⑤yongs su shes nas dzā—/ /babe+e rī ba na saṃ ts+tshadzñā dz+dza gasgo ta la tā mi ba/ /de bo ya mi bzung / /'khri shing nags kyis bsgribs 0pa yi/ /tsu ta'i 'khri shing bung bas bzhin/ /de nas mi 'am nyi nibye t+ya ta taste kin+da re shwa raḥ/ /tuṣ+ṭastasmi da do ni bya rasneḥs ha ma ci dbang gis/ /'di ni lha zhes nges byas nas/ /tshim pas de la yid 'phrog ma/ /lha yi rin cen dze+eno ha dzā/ /shra bh+yo pa sgo ga bi bha baiḥpū dzi taste na mā da ram̐/ /dzā dang bcas byen/ /mchog gi longs spyod 'byor pa yis/ /gus dang bcas pas sgede yis mchod/ /de yā sa ha sta mā mkhyu ku mā raḥswa pu ri ya yo/ /ma no ha rā gra gi pāp+ta la zhus nas chung mar bcas/ /gzhon nu rang gi grong khyer song / /yid 'phrog ma sngon 'gro ba'i bu/ /pu tra mā lo kya bhū pa tiḥ/ /nā gen+d+ra dar+sha non+d+ra taḥsu dh+wam+bu bhi ri 'ong ba mthong nas sa yi bdag /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos glang po'i dbang / /mthong nas 'phyur ⑨bzhin bā bar+bha/ /pu tram̐ ta ta : ri ta tsan+d+ra se tā ta paste rā bye bhi ṣi tsu rnam par mdzes/ /de nas rgyal srid spyod tshul zla ba'i gdugs ⑩dkar ldan pa la/ /skye rgu'i ⑩gdung ba pa ri tā pa ha re pra dz+wa rmā / / sa rnyo ṣa shī ta la bi be ka su 'phrog pa'i bu ni mngon par dbang bskur nas/ /chog ⑫shes bsil ldan dben pa'i bdud rtsis mngon 95—800

dh+wa nyi ra oṃ ts+tsha yā ma se ba ta dṛ paḥpra sha ma dru ma suḥ/ /shābhā bhi par dga' ba yis①/ /rab tu zhi ba ldan snyepa'i grib bsel mi yi bdag pos bstanaspyo/ /nor bzang dbang ṣe kai su dha rna pra bhū te lta sap+ta raṭ+wā ni thra thu pra tā baṃ/ /na ba pra bhā bskur ④thob pa'i snga dro nyid/ /gzi byin khyergya che de la rin cen (kyebadun/ /gtso bo nyid gyur kye gsar pa'i ba pra bhu tā ba dī t+yā se bā ni pa sārba mi bo pa dza gruḥ/ /sa bo bye mthus 'u 'jigs nas/ /g.yog la gnas pa'i don bzhin nye bar 'ongs/ /nor bzang byang chub sems satwaḥsu dha no ha me ba ya sho dha rā sā pi ma no ha rā bhūta/ /taji pra yo ga de nga nyid de/ /yid kye'aphrog mar gyur de yang grags 'dzin ma/ /de dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal mes bya sa nā na lābyāḥkā mā nu ba n+dha dā ya ti ma yābhā/ / tasmraṭ+wā maḥ ka gdungs pa/ /'di snyed / pe 'dod pas bcings las bdag gis thob/ /de slad 1nye'adod pa pad+mo'i bzhin ma la ba da nā ṣ+pe tra par+yan+ta bā sī brdzaḥsad bheḥsha ma mṛ ga pa dhū brnya ke liḥgyi mig gi mtha' la gnas gyur cing / /rab rgyas me tog las skyes rdul tshogs hā la hā la'i rtse mo can/ /ki rā traḥ/ /sgra dzākhrut+pa pra pa ba dza ra dzaḥpuñdza hā lnga ha khā grirlo kaḥrmongs byed mya ngan gdung ba'i mda' yis ⑫gang gi 'jig rten 'bigs byed pa/ /rngon pa'i rtse dgas zhi sha ka bya pa na bi shi khermo haṣ+per+ya na bibyeḥ/ /i ti bhek+ṣu ga ṇa swa yo ba'i ri dwags 'ching byed dam pa rnams kyis spangs/ /de nas rgyal ba rang gis rang gi gtam/ /bshad dzi ṣ+pe na swa ka tsā tī be+e ni bai di tai ni sha mya/ /sa ra baṃ thra thu mū la me ba me pa de ni ⑫ dge slong tshogs kyis thos/ /'dod pa ro ldan kho na srid pa ni/ /'dab brgya'i rtsa ba spom po ṣ+pe sha ta shā khā su ma no bha baṃ bha gya/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsa tā yi bo bye sa tā nyid du nges/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag ba dā na kalpa la tā yo su dha na kirjar+ya ba dā na tsa tuḥṣaṣ+ṭi ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //bsam gyi 'khri shing las nor bzang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //95—801

pāgyud+mā sgyu sa lī nā da ti sa ra sa sa sabye pa nā rū la she ṣādz+reḥlongs spyod rtse dga' dag gi dri yi tshogs kyis 1dbang po thams cad yongs su drangs gyur pa/ /shaṃ ka su pi dza noḥka ma la ka la na yā dzā ya te mā na se smin/ /rā gaḥchags ldan sbrang rtsi 'thungs (37rnams shin tu dam par ()'di nyid du ni gang gang 0'ching byed pa/ /skye ba paṃ sgo ga lī lnga pa ri ma la pa ṭa la kṛṣ+ṭa sabyedh+ri yā rde ma tre bā a ti mā sngaragoms zhen cing shin tu chags bcas las byung bag chags rtsa ba'i lhag ma las/ /dogs pa med kyang tram̐ pa ra pa ma dhu li haṃ ba n+dha rna yaḥ ka ro ti/ /n+ya gro d+ma rā ma ni skyebo'i yid 'dir pad+mo'i rjes zhesu mthun pa'i 'dod chags 'byung bar 'gyur('u / /shākya'i grong khyer dag ra tai pu ra shākya pu re dzi ni/ /bha ga brnyi sa mu pan+d+raḥpa prats+tshabhik+ṣa baḥtu sngon/ /n+ya gro dha yi kun rar gnas/ /rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das la slar/ /dge slong yang dag tshogs su naḥ/ / pra bṛt+ta shāṅgi pa ri bṛt+ta be+e shi ni bṛt+ta saṃ sā ram̐ bi kā ra pas zhus/ /zhi bar zhugs shing chas ni yongs su bsgyur⑦/ /'khor ba'i rnam 'grur spyod las zlog dupa bṛtrī / /an+taḥpu ram̐ two dṛ pa tebe+e sharnya ya sho dha rā dīgh+ra bi mu khya tī khyod—/ /mi yi bdag po'i pho brang 'khor 'jug pa/ /grags 'dzin mas mthong rnam par rmongs pa bzhin//ba/ /twadrwar+sha ṣ+pe tiṣ+ṭha ti sazla dze+e ba bi bhū ṣi tā kādza ta ram̐ gi tī gī/ /sgo gyu khyod mthong nyid na kun du brgyan byas shing / /'dar zhing g.yo ba'i lus ldan rnam par gnas/ /lag na dhi bā se bha ba taḥka ro ti bi lo bha rna mo da ka pā tra hasta/ /nā byā bi shārnyi mu la du'i snod —/byebazung khyod kyis te snani/ /zas kyi lhag gnas dag la chags par byed/ /de yi yid kyi rnam be+e nyi ta su ma no bi kā raḥs ba hu pra kā raḥ/ /twa dā na rgon+d+ra byu ti bi pra puk+ta 'gyur rnam mang ldan/ /da lta yang ni nye bar zhi mi 'gyur/ /khyod zhal zla 'od bral na shin tu de/ /sī dā t+ya lo sālbo ku murja tī ba/ /i ti bismi ta bhik+ṣu ga be+e na thraṣ+ṭaḥki tsita smi te nyamasade 11nyin par ku mud ldan pa bzhin/ /de skad mtshar las dge slong tshogs kyis dris/ /cung zad 95byed802

nā dha ra pabe+e ba t+yā/ /pra trughā pha la bi dru mā sgo bi be+e sh+ya sho dzñā bha 'dzum pa ①mchu yi yal 'dab la/ /myu nyig 'bras bu khyorab spras byu ru'i 'od/ /mdzes ma 1'god cing ga bān ba bhā ṣe/ /ya sho dha rā bye ba bi kā ri yus+t+ri bi bhar+bhe ṣ+pe ta ma bhi bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /mngon 'dod rtse dga' rnam 'gyur ldan pa 'di/ /grags 'dzin ma ni ding rte7lā ṣa lī dze+e/ /dzad+mān+ta re pi sma ra bi blu mairme sā mo da kairlo bha ban me ba nyid 'dzin pa min/ /skye gzhan la yang 'dod pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /de yi la dus bdag la chags par tsakre / /kā sh+ya paḥpu rā kā shi pu ri na ren+d+rabyuji ba dā ta dru ti tīrte rā sīta/ /a byas—/ /ka shi'i grong du mi dbang kā ⑤sh+ya sngon/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i grags pa can/ /dgra sri ku shaḥsha tru ma da di pā dzā ma tīṣ+ṭha thrat+taḥpa ra la swa bhā baḥ/ /pu trobe+e myos gnyis 'thung lcags kyu yin mod kyang / /spyod tshul mi rno rang bzhin drang por gyur/ /dka' thub na sta gya ta paḥpra yasne re kai ba ka t+yā na li bhā ba bhū ba/ /pā ya pra dzā pā 'bad pas bu don gnyer de la/ /bu mo pad+ma ldan nyid gcig pu byung / /skye rgu ⑥skyong la g.yel ba dang la na sā ba le pāḥswaspra na ya e ba bha brnyi bhū pāḥ/ /an+taḥpu re tsā pa ri war+bha mā bcas pa'i/ /sa bdag phal cher rigs brgyud /⑦nyung bar 'gyur du/ /pho brang 'khor du de ni yongs rmā tsit+ta tsa tsidzñā dṛ pa ti be+e tsā r+ya / / ā ju ya bi bo t+tha mu khā bskyed cing / /sems 'bad bsams du/pa'o mi bdag gis spyad nas/ /mkhas pa la sogs blon po bos na mā t+yān pra dzā ga ra gasta ra nyirdza ga da/ /bi steṇ+ḍi shā khaṃ sbi ra badha mū nas ni/ /gnyid bral dga' ba nyams pas ⑩rab smras pa/ /lo 'dab rgyas shing rtsa ba brtan par zug /la makyun+da tram̐ sat+tha dza no pa dz+re bye/ /a the mi tu l+ya pra sa bā ba tī ā+oṃ gh+ra ṇa k+ṣa tai skye bo kun gyi nyer 'tsho shāmishin tu mtho/ /mtshungs par skye bas dman pa'i rgyal srid ni/ /srin bus zos bṛk+ṣa mi bā dhi ba bye/ /e kai ba ka t+yā na li nī ma māste ba yaḥpra dā no tsi ta pa'i shing bzhin bdag gis ⑫rig /lang tsho / 0rab tu sbyin 'os bsten pa yis⑫/ /bu mo pad ldan gcig 95—803

mā shra yarnyi/ /ta bye pra yasne ṣ+pe ba rā྾ tā yā ma pa t+ya tā tai pra ṇa yo pi dru re/ /pu bdag la yod/ /de ni 'bad pas mag pa la byin tshe/ /bu tsha nyid dang de la byams pa'ang ring ①/ /pā ṇi pra dībe+e mi ba dī brto dhahūṃ na shasgo ti dza na swa ka t+yā/ /n+ya pāza lag par sgon me'i sdong bu rab 'bar bzhin/ /skye bos rang gi bu mo bzung ①mi nus/ /gtams pa'i tu spyo pa rārba bhā yā tsir+sā pha khā e ba ku la su ka t+yā/ /na j-it+ya de yā nor bzhin gzhan la gtad bya ba/ /rigs kyi bu mo bsam pa'i 'bras bu nyid/ /g.yog la sbyin ①min na tsa po ra yo gyu dru ro tsi tā e ba na ren+d+ra ka t+yā/ /a dzñā ta mi t+ya bā tsi ta gya dru grong pa la 'os min/ /mi dbang bu mo ring po nyid la 'os/ /de ltar kun spyad during po mi shes pas/ /ra mṛ ta mya yā ta mya tsa ko ni she ṣaḥ/ /tas+thān+d+ra yasne na ma ma sa kabye mā twa bhā be gu shi dang song ba dag la bye brag ci/ /de slad gang zhig bu dngos bdag nyid can/ /rang yul rab dhispangs ṇi bām+bi yo byeḥ/ /swa de sha muskṛ bye ma be+e ba de she bi bhadhi yaḥpu tra bā bdag gi yul 'dzin pa/ /bdag gi mag pa'i dngos gyur 'ga' zhig de/ /yon tan ldan pa 'bad pas dhi pa tram̐/ /khru tasma yā dzasgo su tā pra bā ha pu sgyu pa dā te pu li no pa kabye/ /btsal dhibar bya/ /bdag gis thos pa gaṅgā dag gi rgyun/ /bsod nams dag pa'i ngogs dang nye ba na/ /sa hādzi byā nāsdi ta po ba nārnyi rā dzabyu rāste ki la kā sh+ya sā khyaḥ/ /ta gya sgo snyim par bcas na dka' thub ⑦nags mthar ni/ /rgyal po'i drang srong ka ⑧sh+ya pa gnas lo/ /de yi sa tai pra shra ba ṇi na bīr+ya de bo da yā dathra ni sarji tā gre/ /to yasmṛ hārta bon byu ⑨bas lhung gyur pa/ /lha yis bskyed las rdo steng ⑫dma' bar chags/ /chu 'dod kyis gzir ⑪ha ri bhā ni bī ya su baṇ+ḍi baṇ+ḍi su pra be ku mā re/ /bai na mṛ gāsta ri dwags mo yis ⑫'thungs/ /gser gyi mdog can gzhon nu btsas par gyur/ /de yi phas bzung ⑫su bi ba rnyi to sau pi tā kṛ hi to pi hi ta bra ta:/ /nā : pra sidhaḥnags su ri dwags de/ /rnam par bskyed cing brtul zhugs dag kyang bsgrubs/ /sor tshad rwa yis yang 95—804

shi shu re ka shiṅgaḥsaṃ lagh+ra mā rmā gu la mā tro shriṅgaḥ/ /yu bā tsa tubye na pa rā dag mtshan gyur pas/ /byis pa rwa gcig pa zhes ming du grags/ /dar bab bsam gtan bzhi po skyong ya ṇabya sa brah+ma tsa rī bi ma la swa bhā ba/ /niḥsaṃ ga bā pa bi ṣa yā byed cing / /tshangs spyod dang bcas dri med rang bzhin can/ /yul ni mngon par mi shes grogs med na bhi dzñāsta tā ka tho rāstso tu tsistsa kāste/ /sā tsan+de li t+yāḥpa te tā mu bai ti ta gnas—/ /der ni drag po'i nyi 'od lta bur mdzes①/ /de ni gal te pad ldan khrod nyid du/ /gyur nas de ṣa baṃ shaḥpra sha oṃ na yā ti/ /te dzo ni dhe rā na ya ṣ+pe tu ta gya bi tsin+d+ra rgyud ni durab tu zhi mi 'gyur/ /gzi brjid gter de rab tu 'gugs pa yisarngu/ /gnod med rigs ④pa hūṃ kā gya na bā ya yut+taḥ/ /shu te ti bā kyi dṛ pa te ra mā t+yā bi tsār+ya sat+tha su tsi rāt+ta ci yang bsam par mdzod/ /ces pa mi bdag tshig thos yun ring du/ /dpyad nas blon po kun gyis ⑤de mū tsūḥ/ /ta dā shra mo pān+ta ba ṣ+pe bi hahūṃ bi sre bye hūṃ saṃ pra nyi dzā dza pu tā/ /tabye la smras/ /da ni de yi bste gnas nye ba yi/ /nags su rgyal po'i bu mo rtse ru thong / /de tshig rjes su kya lad+dhā nu ma te na rā dzñā sā hi tābe+e bi ni bi r+ya sadz+re/ /ya yo bi thraṭ+wā na li 'dod byas rgyal po yis/ /'dod pa'i don kun rnam par bshad nas ni/ /pad+mo can bsrings rab tu nī bi hahūṃ hahūṃ pra gaste ba mu ṣ+peḥku mā raḥ/ /kāṭ+wā ba nārnyi sha na kai ra spobs pa bzhin/ /thub ⑥pa'i gzhon nu dbrog phyir rtse ru song / /mdzes mas nags kyi mthar ni dal bā sri lī khā bhi rā mā bi dza hā ra ta rtswa/ /bā khā ni le nā ka li gyis ④phyin/ /gzugs bzang rtsed 'jos mngon par dga' bas rol/ /mdzes pa'i mig can de ni rlung tā la te ba saṃ tsā ri bhā tsā ru bi lo tsa nā pā/ /bi khā sa pus+thā ba tsa ye na ta su gzhon byus/ /bskyod pa'i 'khri shing bzhin du yang dag rgyu/ /de ni rol cing me tog 'thu chab yis ri shi got+ta re sham+bi tsa lad+ku re shaṃ/ /ba na bi lo kya swa ta po ba nāt+pa dwags rwa rab g.yo zhing rnam bskyod pa'i⑨/ /nags mthong rang gi dka' thub nags tshal nas/ /dge 95—805

mā ya yo kau tu kabād+ku mā raḥ/ /sa san+da hūṃ gi ma ma nu 6 paṃ gasta ram̐ gī mtshan ldan pa'i gzhon nus yang dag 'ongs/ /mi yi grogs med pad+ma ①ltar yangs mig /ya mtshan mig tā yo ba na bi bh+ra me ṇa/ /da dar+sha tsā piṣ+ṭha ya nin+d+ra me baḥpuphrot+pa laspyo ka ma ni 'dzum dang bral ba des/ /lang tsho'i rnam 'phrul gyis g.yo lus btud chacing / /ut+pal rgyas pa'i mig lā ya tā k+ṣaḥ/ /bi lo kya kādzñā mṛ ga lo tsa dzā hūṃ rā mā na bhi zlo pi mu nirdza can de mthong gyur/ /mdzes ma ri dwags mig can de mthong nas/ /dga' ma mngon shes med kyang thub har+ṣa—/ /na bās nā sgyu pa ni lbo na man+ta dza hā ti dze+e tube+e ṣa yā bhi lā ṣe/ /pa dga'/ /bag chags goms pas nang du zhen pa yi/ /yul la mngon 'dod 0skye bos gtong ma yin/ /su sdisna mur+ghaṃ bi ni ba sh+ya dṛṣ+ṭi mṛ gī su ta stad+ma da nā ra bin+de/ /bi t+yā dha ri dwags bu yi rab mdzes yid 'ong mig /de yi bzhin gyi pad+mar rnam bkod nas/ /rig 'dzin nam ④re bā mu ni bu tra kai bā bi dzñā ya hūṃ bye ti ba sārja ban+de/ /ya ti pra ṇa ni thub pa'i bu dag tu/ /shes nas mdza' ba'i dbang gis der phyag 'tshal/ /sdom brtson gyis btud mā ba na tā na nā yāsta sngaḥpra bā la byu ti nā dha re ṇa/ /āsgo r+ya mā no shu ba bzhin ras dud gyur pa/ /de yi mchu ni byu ru'i 'od ldan gyis⑤/ /'od zer tshogs kyis kun bsgribs do ṣ+pe na rā shaṃ dza grwa ha hā ro gya ma la swa bhā baḥ/ /tsā swe da sha sbo dasbyi la kān+ta kād+dhā shal dag /dri med rang bzhin gyis kyang chags pa bzung khye/ /dril chung sgra snyan dag gis grogs kyi bzhin//muṅkam+bi tsā gī ma ba dad+ku mā raḥ/ /sa kho ko byā ma dhu ra swa re ṇa sma 'dod pa'i nye bar spyod pa gdams byas pa/ /rngul zags thig le dag gis mthar ⑦mjos shing / /rab ro pa tsā re 6 kṛ to pa de shaṃ/ /sgo swā ga tai te mu ni pu tra kash+yit+ta po ba 'dar lus can de la gzhon nus smras/ /kwa ye thub pa'i sras khyed legs 'ongs sam/ /dka' thub nārnye ku sha lo sbo gā dzā/ /pa dā twa dā lo ke na nibya waṃ s+tha waṃ 6 ye ྾ bi ra laḥnags mthar ri dwags dge 'am ci/ /rtag tu khyod la lta zhing g.yo med pa/ /gang dag rnams ni thang la 95—806

pra tsā raḥ/ /i di bi lo kyā r+ya ta bā na ba bye di bya pra ta snga mṛ ta babhā dman par rgyu/ /brtul zhugs mchog ldan khyod gzugs bdud rtsi'i char/ /kha na ma tho med pa 'di rū paṃ/ /ba purdza ṭā balka li ram̐ mu m+bi rmā shuṣ+ka dru mā zla mi ba ta ts+tsha yā mi/ /mthong ba'i①/ /ral pa shing shun ldan pa thub rnams kyi/ /lus ni shing skam blubazhin du bdag rtog go/ /a yan+ta bsnagha dza ṭā ka lā baḥkṛ to pa kā raḥku su mirla tā bhiḥ/ /na bā 'khri shing me tog rnams kyis lduspras byas pa/ /khyod kyi ral pa'i tshogs ni mdzes pa 'di/ /sprin gser ④bha saṃ bhā ra bi dzi bha mā ṇa kān+ta ma yu ra pra ti bhā bi bhar+bhe/ /i rda ta tshogs la rnam par gdengs pa ⑤yi/ /rma bya'i mjug ma'i mdzes sdug rnam par 'dzin/ /khyod kyi brang ba shrī pha la yugru sho bhi bsgo bi ni k+ṣibe+e pa tā k+ṣa sru tram̐ / /a sru 'di dpal 'bras zung gis spras/ /bgrang 'phreng ⑥dkar po dag gis ④rnam par bcings/ /ri dwags tra yarjo la ku ram̐ ga ṣ+pe tra bai tsi tā mo tri ma na sa: kāste/ /ho maghi la ga na gzhon nu'i mig ltar bkra ba yis/ /yid la dga' ba skyed byed (shernam par mdzes/ /sbyin sreg me yi me spa ṭa bi spru li gā mo dz+re da dha na na ba pal+la r+pā tsā/ /ku tū ha lo stag gsal chags pa'i/ /ske rags 'dzin cing lus phra khya 'khri shing gzhon/ /yal 'dab gsar pas bā la la te ba ta dzñā ta nusta be+e yo na ta no ti ka gya/ /thra hi pra sarja kwa ta mtshan 'dra khrod kyi lus/ /'di ni su yi dge mtshan rgyas mi byed/ / tha dag ṅku gang du g.yo ldan 'dab skyepo ba nārnye twat+yā da bi bho pa bi kā shi nī bhiḥ/ /ya tra pra bhā bhiḥs ta tai bi bhā ti skyes ni/ /khyod zhabs bkod pas rnam par gsal byas pa/ /'od kyis rtag hu5 tu rnam par mdzes pa yi/ /saṃ tsā ri s+thā paṃ ka dzi be+e s+tha li 6/ /la khā nā na bhi dzha nā na bhi oṃ mṛ ga dka' thub nags mtha' gang yin dang bas smros/ /ri dwags rang bzhin thub pa'i gzhon nu ni/ /bud swa bhā baṃ ta ma bai t+ya bā lā/ /udṛ bye ladz+dza ma bi shaṃ ka mā nā nir+yan+d+ra lī lā med mi shes de rig bu mo yis/ /ngo tsha rab btang spyornam par dogs rngumed pa/ /ma bsdams rtse dga' 95—807

bha ra ṇa ba khyu ba/ /ta tasta mā nan+da ra sān+d+ra tsiste sha ṣ+pe ba bhā ṣi mṛ du bhā dag ni ①rgyan bzhin gyur/ /de nas kun dga'i ros brlan sems ldan der/ /'jam par smra byed de ṣi bhā sa/ /ta bo ba na s+thā sa m+bi pa ban+ti ma mā shra ma swa du pha la pra yis dal gyi ④smras/ /bdag gi bste gnas 'bras zhim me tog can/ /dka' thub nags tshal 'di dang sru naḥ/ /uste te khaṇ+ḍi smi ta mo da kaiḥsā ta snga tha karbu ra sa ra ga nye bar gnas/ /zhes brjod ka ra'i 'dzum dang ga bur gyisakhye/ /nang tshangs ldan zhing yid 'ong ya gabyeḥ / /tsa kā ra mā par+ya tsa maskṛ yārtorngi lo bha ā+oṃ saṣ+ka ṭi sruk+ta tu byeḥ/ /mtshan ngos④/ /la du mkhas pa'i legs bshad mtshungs pa yi/ /de yis de ni rnam par chags par byas/ /ud+mā da keḥsā rā sa nā nu kyu lebyet+ta t+pa dze+eḥpre ma ma yobe+e khā seḥ/ /de yi myos khyabyed ro 'dzin rjes mthun pa/ /sems dga' mdza' ba'i rang bzhin rtse dga' dang / /ba sh+lau mṛ tebya pra ṇa yot+ta ba rnyi stas+thā gu ra bār+ya mṛ ga dza hā raḥ/ /bsngags pa bdud rtsi gus mchod ⑥ 'ching ba yis/ /'phags pa'i ri dwags de ni rgyas bzhin bcings/ /ta po ba nan+dar+sha ya me ma hārta mi h+phul+la yarnyi ju dza bal+la ri rgyu/ /gā zwa pa cher ⑦ 'os dka' thub nags tshal bdag la ston/ /zhes brjod mig zum de la rgyal po yi/ /bu mos lag re gha bye ni m+bi li tā k+ṣa me tī ti tai rā dza su tā dza gā da/ /tai pra sbi tai pa'i 'khri ⑧shing dag gis ni/ /dam du yongs 'khyud tshur shog ces pa smra⑫ / /chas shing cung zad rkang sā ka ti tsit+pa dā ni ga tā pu na staṅga ma nā ya malja/ /ra baṃ sa mā ru khya bi sār+ya pā ṇi gis song de la/ /sbar yang de bgrod ⑫slad du bstar byas pa'i/ /shing rta la zhon lag pa brkyangs ⑪nas mā ro ha zla yi ba gi rā n+ya yuste/ /ra the tu ram̐ gān sa bi lo kya yuk+tad+ma des—/ /bzhon ⑫pa nyid ni tshig gis ⑫rab tu bskos⑩/ /shing rta 'dren pa'i rta dag des mthong nas/ /tā ku ram̐ gām+bi ga laji she ṣaḥ/ /mṛ gī du to haṃ na mṛ gā gra me basmṛ shā mi bye brag ma rtogs ri dwags yin par shes/ /ri dwags bu bdag ri dwags steng du ni/ /rkang pas mi reg 95—808

yāḥ—/ /shu two ti kan+ta j-i ta mā na su san+ta pa tso tā pi shu nāsma hak+ṣiḥ/ /gzir/ /zhes pa mdzes mas yid phrogs bu yis ①ni/ /gdung ba'i bsam pa go byed tshig thos nas/ /pu tra su ba rkyu ta paṣ+ṭhan+ta rā ya ni pā ta dī tāḥsu tsi re pra da rmyo/ /kaṣ+ṭi dka' thub bar chad gyur pas 'jigs pa yisal/ /drang srong chen po geshin tu yun ring bsamang) kye ta pa sī mṛ ga shā ba ko yi tī bre ṇa mughaḥsma ra lubha ke na/ /ba dzā ga nā ma dran pa'i rngon pa mi bzad pas/ /dka' thub can rbongs ri dwags bu 'di ni/ /bud med mchog tu bā gu rā yā ka ṭā k+ṣa ku ṭ+wā ba bā tī sa hā sā ni bad+dhāḥ/ /k+ṣa khaṃ bi tsibye mu nirma gyur pa'i rgya dag gis/ /zur mig gal du lhung bas khru'aphral la bcings/ /skad cig de bsams thub pa nī ྾ ma no pi kā ram̐ ta na ya gya hahūṃ/ /ta ma bra bīṭ+wā ma bhu dze+e ga muk+ṇi bi ṣe mkhas pa yis/ /bu yi yid kyi rnam 'gyur dbrog kyepa'i slad/ /'dod pa'i lag 'gros dug btang yul ba hadhe pi ṣa yā bhi lā ṣe/ /na pu tra sā dhuḥs ma habhā sru nuḥsā sdi la ni/ /mngon 'dod 'dzin pa de la phas ⑦smras pa/ /bu de drang srong che sras legs pa min/ /de ni ma ṣ+pe dzan+d+ra bhu dze+e ga bhū miḥ/ /ta tra sgo taṭī bra ta rā nu rā ga bi ṣa bya thā me bud ⑧med yid skyes lag 'gro'i sa⑨/ /der lhung rbongs pa shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /rjes chags dug gi '-ib bi bhan+ti rū bhāḥ/ /dza nāḥpra sas+t+ri dza na kā la ku ṭidz+re sgyeḥsu tī byāsta ru bhā ka gdung ba rnam par 'dzin/ /mig sman nag po brtsegs chags na chung gi/ /zur mig rnon pos phug pa'i ṭā k+ṣeḥ/ /sho tsarnyi yo ṣin+dhu dza pā sha ba d+dhāḥsaṃ sā ra kā rā pa da ṣ+pe pa do skye bo dag /skyon bcas bud med lag pa'i zhags pas bsdams/ /'khor ba'i btson ra dag tu mya ngan ṣāḥ—/ /gha na su saṃ mo ha ma lī ma sa gya ma bye ku ṭi lāḥsgra re t+ya kut+than+di/ /byed—/ /kun rmongs dri mar ldan pa'i srid pa dag /sprin gyi dbus su gya gyur gsal byed pa/ /skad kād+dhā sta ḍi taḥ k+ṣa ṇa n+d+ra ཿ sum̐ rmā bi yo ge bye sha man+dha kā re/ /e tā cig mtha' can mdzes ma'i glog 6spedag gis/ /bral tshe skyes bu mchog tu mun par byed/ /bud med 95 81 /

bhi ru྾ ka ku sum̐ bi ni bhi rud+mā da rūsgo bi ṣa bal+la rī bhiḥ/ /spyo bhin+d+ra hā mo ha rnams ni mya ngan rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /smyo zhing brgyal byed dug gi 'khri shing ste/ /rbongs pa'i sha za chen mo pi shā tsi kā bhiḥsaṃ smṛ sh+ya mā naḥku sha lī na lo kaḥ/ /swas+thāsta e to ni ba sarnyi 'di dag gis/ /kun tu reg pa'i 'jig rten dge ldan min/ /bud med mig zur gdung byed zug rngu ni//san+taḥsarnyo ṣa kārnyi gu ta po ba ṣ+pe 6/ /sad+dhā pa rna sdi na ya nān+ta sha sum̐ ye ྾ shi tai rnon po gang gis rmyesems la ma zug pa/ /chog shes kyis mdzes dka' thub nags tshal du/ /gnas pa'i tse ta bi nā ba sa.oṃ/ /i ti pra yat+nadz+dza na ke na testerbi be ka bā kyeḥpra ti bo rgya dam pa 'di de rnal du gnas/ /zhes pa 1dben pa'i tshig ni de dang des/ /pha yi 1'bad pas rab tu mā naḥ/ /na bu dh+ya ta so ma da nā nī te na lā ba rgya pā ṣ+pe nā ni gyush+lau rtogs par byas/ /'dod pa dang ldan mdzes sdug btung ba yis/ /rnam par 'phrul pa de 5ni rtogs ma mā na/ /a thā sa re byurbi shwa kṛ t+ya kṛ to mu no pha le n+d+ra ha ra bhā ya yā te/ /lbo lā gyur—/ /de nas nyin gzhan sna tshogs bya ba byas/ /thub pa 'bras bu yam shing len du song / /mi dbang ba ti lo bha yi tsu ku mā re na ren+d+ra ka t+yā pu na rā dza grwa ma/ /dā sī ga ṇi nā nu bu mo 'jo sgeg ldan pa ni/ /gzhon nu chags par byed du be+er yang 'ongs/ /'bangs mo'i tshogs rnams ga tā la tā dzñā pu be+e smi tā dzā shri ya mā shra ya n+ta / / hūṃ shaṃ na rjes 'brang 'khri shing ni/ /me tog 'dzum ldan dag gis snodapal bsten cing / /lus can lus med r+pā ga mi bai ka shri ga mā pā r+ya dz+dzaṣ+ṭha bi bha bo na hūṃ gī/ /di byo tsi tai gsar mtshungs rwa gcig can/ /'byor pas mtho ba'i lus ldan brtan pas phyin/ /bdag gi bste gnas kalpa la tā gra lo bi la hūṃ bhi rā oṃ ru tsi rā shra ma me/ /trahūṃ twa mā he t+ya dpag bsam shing rtse las/ /'phyang ba'i 'khri shing gis dga' lha la 'os/ /lta bar khyod kyis smras ⑥ zhes bhi dh+wa ya sā tai ni nā ya tī ram̐ tri da shā pa gā yāḥ/ /sa ta tra rah+pho dz+wa la pi tsi tra brjod nas des/ /de ni gang gā dag gi ngogs su khrid/ /des der rin cen ⑦rab 'bar 'dab ma bkra//95—812

pa tra su baṇ+ḍi bal+lī pha la puju ra bye/ /no bharnyi tai kṛ tri ma mā ka la yā su khā gser gyi 'khri shing me tog 'bras bu dga'/ /gru yi bzung ①ba'i bcos ma rnams brtags nas/ /dga' shra saṃ haste mi bā ru ro ha/ /saṃ sā ra tu bye na j-i taḥs te na sa rispra ba ba ma zhubazhin bde ba'i gnas la 'dzegs/ /'khor ba dang mtshungs zol gyi bste gnas der/ /chu bo'i te na ka pa ṭā shra me ṇa/ /a dzñā ta ta two pya nu rak+ta j-istir+pā rā ṇa sī spru ti mi bā rgyun la de ni rab tu khyer/ /de nyid shes pa min yang chags tshul gyis1/ /mdza' bo can bzhin bā rā ṇa sa pā da/ /a bā pya kā sh+ya su sa rā dza sh+lau ma hi ma hen+d+ra su ma hārta raṭ+wā/ /sīr ④phyin/ /de yi sa gzhi ⑤dbang chen kā sh+ya yis/ /rin cen 'urin thang che ldan rgyal sar phyin/ /me ṣ+pe mu m+bidz+reḥka thi tai ka thā su swaṅgā ga rna troṣ+ṭi pa dze+e pra yā tsā/ /ta taḥpra thub dbang ⑦rnams kyi gtam la brobashad pa yis⑨/ /mtho ris gnas ni mig lam gyur par sems/ de mo dā ku li taḥk+ṣi tī shastasmi mṛ gā khye bi dhi nā bi bhi dzñāḥ/ /pra dak+ṣi shā brta bi lo nas rab dga' rgyas pa sa yi dbang / /sgrub shes tshogs de la ri dwags mig /g.yas skor bskor ba ⑫do ma hā re da do su tsā pūṇ+ḍi ma no ra tha shrīḥ/ /na ren+d+ra ka t+yā ka ra sak+ta pā shal g.yo ldan ma/ /bu mo re ba rdzogs pa'i dpal gyis ⑪byin/ /mi dbang bu mo ⑫lag par lag bkod ṇibe+e ba ha byā ba nyi tai hu tā sha dz+wa/ /a ma snge tā ma n+ya ma tiḥku mā ra sta cing / /bag ma'i bsreg rdzas me la rnam par bkod/ /der ⑫ni gzhon nu blo gros gzhan pa med/ /sbyin tāsni ho tra su pa ram̐ pra kā ram̐/ /ma hot+pa bon+d+ra ha ra sā ku le na pa pū bye mā naḥsreg ④rnam pa gzhan dag yin par sems/ /dga' ston che dang spro ba'i nyams rgyas pa/ /rgyal pos gus pra ṇa ye na rā dzñā/ /sbi twa ta paḥsaṃ ya ta e ba ta tra dzā yā sa khāḥsre pas rab tu mchod pa des/ /brtul zhugs dul /snyeldan nyid du der 'dug nas/ /chung ma dang 'grogs pra ya yo ba nārnye/ /dzā yā dri tī yam+bi dza ṣ+pe bra dzan+ta treṣ+ṭa mṛ gī tai dza na rang gi nags mthar song / /chung ma'i grogs bcas ⑩ dbe+en par bgrod pa de/ /ma ma ri dwags mos 95—813

byā pra z-iṭ+wā/ /mu ṣ+pe pra pā dap+ta ma nu 6 bā tsā ku tasta be yo la la ṣ+pe kyu bā mthong rab dga' ste/ /thub pa'i drin las mi yi tshig thos pas/ /gang nas khyod kyi bud med 'di zhes tsa / /sa tī pra ṇa mya pra ṇa yāṅga bhā ṣe mā tan+d+ra yā yo byu ti mān ba ya gyaḥ/ /shāp+taḥsmras—/ /de la rab btud de yis gus smras pa/ /ma ma bdag gi ①mdzes ldan grogs mo 'di/ /rab pra yat+na ta smṛ ha bhā ya rū paḥs khye na dīṭ+wā na la pā kṛ ke na/ /i 'bar me yi dbang can grogs med khyekyis/ /'dod par bya ba'i gzugs can 'bad pas thob ces ti khru bā rte ta ma be t+ya mur+ghaṃ mṛ gī bi bā hā di ka thā nā bhe oṃ/ /pa ti bra tā smras ①bag ma la sogs gtam mi shes/ /rmongs pa de rig ri dwags mo de yis/ /khyo yi brtul zhugs nā ma tha tā pa sī rmā ta po ba rna sā sha na ṣ+perni nā ya/ /dhas+thā nu ga te sa ha dka' thub can rnams kyis(pya/ /dka' thub nags tshal dag tu dal rmis khrid/ /chos rjes 'gro 'di khyod tsā ri bhā yo pa te twa ma gyaḥpa ti ri t+ya she ṣi/ /bi bā ha dṛr+ghaṃ ka thi ta sa tā bhiḥkyi rngulhan cig spyod/ /'di yi bdag po khyod ces ma lus pa/ /bag ma'i spyod tshul dag gi bshad pa de⑥/ /khru tā pri ya me bā bi bi da dzā yī/ /pi tā pra har+ṣa da pi kā sh+ya pe na bi bā ha dha1 thos nas chung ma dga' ma nyid du rig /yab ni 'od srungs kyis kyang dga' ba yis/ /bag ma'i chos ni bi hi to pa de shaḥ/ /pra ṇa mya tai tabo tsa sā dza gā ma pu ram̐ sa bhār+yaḥshwa su ra gya nye bar bstan pa bsgrubs/ /der btud de yi tshig gis ⑦chung mar bcas/ /gyos po rgyal po'i ④grong khyer rā dzñāḥ/ /dṛdhe na te na swa pa de sgyi ṣik+taḥs two dz+wa lo shārnyi pa dze+e shri te dag tu song / /snying stobs rab 'bar zhi ba'i ⑨lam bsten pa/ /rgan po de yi rang gnas la dbang na / /sha shā sa sa mān+ta ki rī ṭi bi shān+ta pā daḥs ma tī ma she ྾/ /bskur—/ /rgyal phran cod pan ngal gso'i ⑩gnas de yis/ /ma lus sa gzhi dag ni rab tu bskyangs/ /i shwar+ya mo hā na bhe bhū ta budhidhen+d+ra swa bhā bāt+pa la pa ju be+e keḥ/ /dbang phyug rgongs pas blo gros zil mnan na/ /dben pa'i spyochos kyi rang bzhin las 'khrungs shing / /95—814

dza rā — to bhūṅga hu pu tra po tra pra bra bye yā shārnyi pa thā bhi kā laḥ/ /yo byud+ku mā rgan po bu dang tsha bo mang ldan desde/ /rab tu byung bas zhi ba 'dod par gyur①/ /thub gzhon rwa gcig ro mu ni re ka shri gaḥso haṃ na li bye ba la sho dha rā tsa/ /a byā pi dzad+mān+ta ldan par ①gang gyur de/ /nga nyid pad ldan de yang grags 'dzin ma/ /ding thuyang skye ba gzhan gyi bag ra bā sa na snga bi lo bha nā ma ba mā rnyi yukyā/ /ni dza dzad+mān+ta ra ka tsā dzi chags las/ /bdag la chags pa'i be+ed du mngon par sbyor/ /rang gi skye ba gzhan gyi gtam/ /rgyal ṣ+pe ṣ+pe tru pa baṇ+ḍi tsā/ /ā kaṭ+wā bhik+ṣa baḥsabye ba bhū bu ste sa bismra yāḥ/ /bas rngunye bar bsngags pa 'di/ /thos nas dge slong de dag rnams/ /thams cad ya mtshan ldan par gyur//i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī me ka shrī gā zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing ba dā na pañtsa ṣaṣ+ṭi ta māḥpal+la baḥ// //las rwa gcig pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //nā yā ti kā ya pa ri dṛr+ghaṃ sha taibe+e rā oṃ bi ts+tsha da me ti na dza be+e na pa lā 'jig rten du ni skyes bu'i las lam grib ma bzhin/ /lus la lhan cig spyod 'di nges par mi yi ta su/ /lasmra na nā ma pa pu ṣaḥs ha tsā ri d+dhā yo tshwa ye ba kasgro sha ra mtshon te/ /lus 'di yongs bsgyur brgya yi kyematha' mar mi phyin cing / /mgyogs par 3bros pa dag la ṇiḥpu ru ṣa gya lo ke/ /de ba dat+ta shi lā pā ta pā dzā guṣ+ṭha tā mṛ dzaḥ/ /rnam par 'chad mi 'gyur/ /lhas byin gyis ni rdo 'phangs te/ /zhabs mtheb snad nas khrag byung ba'i/ /kā ra r+ṇa bha ga pān thraṣ+ṭi bhekyu bhesta na bhā ṣa ta/ /khru ya hūṃ ye na rgyu mtshan dge slong rnams kyis dris/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis der bka' sprul/ /mi zlog khon ni dran pa dud+dhā ra bai ra sma ra ṇa dzad+ma nā/ /ma ma kan+d+ra bi pā ke na pā dzā guṣ+ṭhaḥpa las / /skyes pa'i las kyi rnam smin dag /gang gis bdag gi rkang pa yi/ /mthe bong yongs su snad ④95—815

ri k+ṣa taḥ/ /pa.ā+oṃ le 6 ma tī pā laḥrmā pi bye na ga re pu rā/ /a khyut+pa t+ya ra to pa nyon/ /lnga len dag tu grong khyer rgo/ /ka ①bi be+er sngon sa gzhi skyong / /bden dang chos la yang dag nā ma saṃ shra yaḥs t+ya dhan+d+ra yoḥ/ /ba bhū ba lak+ṣa rja nā ma pasnri ta gya su brten—/ /bden par dga' zhes bya ba byung / /skye rgu nāyang dag bsrung 'os pa/ /de yi btsun mo lak+ṣa shā/ /pra dzā saṃ rak+ṣa shārda su ya dza na gye ba dak+ṣi shā/ /dze+e bāt+ta mtshan nyid bzang / /mtshan nyid can zhes bya ba ni/ /mchod sbyin dag gi yon bzhin gyur/ /phywa 1las snga ma pu tā yī pu tā bye pre thi bī pa tiḥ/ /su dhas+thā nā ma bai de ṭī mu pa ye de la bu med tshe/ /de yis ④gsol btab sa yi bdag /bu don gnyer bas lus 'phags ma/ /chos me ta pābe+e taḥ/ /pa rkyo gri ta bi bā he tha lak+ṣa shā sru ta da ra ke/ /bzang zhes pa khab tu blangs/ /khyo yis ‘snye/bag ma blangs pa'i tshe/ /mtshan nyid can la bu btsas te/ /mi byā sa sasbyi lā bhe na partswartswa pa mu pā ha tsa/ /so bhū da non mad+dhā khyaḥdon med chun (khyem thob pa yis/ /rjes su 'gyod pa dag kyang bzung / /de ni ma dud pa zhes bya/ /ku mā raḥbi tu rībe+e taḥ/ /bi byā bi na ya sadzan+daḥka lā shāstan+t+ra pā gzhon nu pha ni rab tu dgyes/ /rig gnas dul ba phun tshogs shing / /sgyu ⑦rtsal bstan bcos mtshon ra gaḥ/ /su dhadz+re dze+e sa gabyu ya ma tha rā dza bya pa r+ya ta/ /sad+dhā re bha mthar phyin/ /de nas chos bzang mngal dag dang / /ldan pa'i tshe na rgyal po 'das/ /rtsom ⑦pa kun la spru rā sha dzñā de hi r+ghaṃ na sbi ra ta nuḥ/ /a mā h+ye ra bhi ṣistoḥta sngarnye lus can gyi/ /bsam pa brtan ⑨gyi lus mi brtananyu7/ /de nas de mthar blon rnams kyis/ /rgyal phran lak+ṣa ṇa su taḥ/ /na pophoku sha i bā byu r+ya s+t+rikyāḥsā man+ta darnyi rmā/ /glang lho1po'i lcags kyu ni/ /gsar pa bzhin du gang gyur pa/ /mtshan nyid can gyi bu dbang bskur/ /go bi ṣā ṇa bhi dha sta su ma hāmā t+yā pri yo bha ba taḥ/ /go shri ga ku ṭi lā ya gya nī gang lugs ba lang rwa co ltar/ /gya gyu gzhan gyis 7mi shes pa/ /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /zhes pa de 95—816

tirna dzñā ya te sa riḥ/ /prat+yā sa dz+re su dhas+thā yaḥkā le na sra sa bā ba sgo/ /gar+ghaṃ yi mdza' bor gyur/ /dus kyis stichos bzang btsa' ba yi/ /mtshams dang nye bar gyur pa na/ /mtshan dṛ pārnya shā ha ni mitrī ka dzñāḥpu ro hi taḥ/ /a tha madh+ri gi rā rā dzā dzad+ma mkhan mdun na 'don dag gis/ /mngal gyi mi bdag mthar byed smras/ /de nas blon po'i phutshig gis ni//k+ṣa ṇa ba dhe shi shoḥ/ /ta dan+taḥpu ra rak+ṣurdo na bi de sho r+ya tā pra dh+wa na/ /tadri byis pa skyes tshe gsod pa la/ /de yi pho brang srung 'os pa/ /mtshon gyi sbyor ldan rgyal pos bskos/ /de dzñā ya su dhas+thā pi se tra stu sha ra rde ya yo/ /ma hā mā h+ye be+e dh+wa tā dag shes nas chos bzang yang / /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /rang 'dod bzhin du byed pa las/ /ra mi ba swa ts+tshan+da kā ri rde/ /pra bhu bhārle ti sā te na nildaṣ+ṭa ta na ya bye yā/ /shin tu skrag nas skyabs su song / /de yi rje bo'i 2chung ma zhes/ /bstan des bu yi 'jigs pa la2 /saṃ dz+wa tai su ta ma t+yāk+ṣiṅge bsto nām+bi ke ta ṣ+pe/ /ta ta e ba sa mā m+bi hūṃ bu ni yang dag skyes pa dag /nya pa rnams kyi khang par bzhag /de nyid nas ni bu mo dag /de yis ta pā ka sdespra dadhi hūṃ/ /dzñā tā ṣ+pe mitrī ka ba tsaḥs t+ya dz+re ṣ+pe na bhū pa tiḥ/ /blangs nas rab bstan pa/ /shes nas sa yi bdag po yis/ /mtshan mkhan tshig ni bden min bzung / /dhī mān ka bi ku mā rā khyuḥs ke brta kṛ he shi shuḥ/ /le bhe ya ta sta tadzñā nya pa'i khyim du byis pa des/ /rig pa bzo 'uganas sgyu rtsal dag /de de thos ྅pa gang des na/ /blo bi byā shismrabe+e tāḥka lāḥ/ /sa ta tra bā la kaiḥsārja shrī ḍā na ga ra kṛ ta pa ldan 3gzhon nu snyan dngags ⑪mkhan/ /byis pa rnams dang lhan cig der/ /lam du rtsed mo'i grong khyer thi / /rā dza ka lī pa ri tsa mabe+e dza hā ra ma hā ju dza/ /ya dṛts+tsha yā ga byas—/ /rgyal po'i rtsed 'jo ⑫yongs 'dris la/ /dpung chen de ni rnam par rtse/ /der ni mtshan mkhan tasta tra ṣ+pe misbyi kā pu ro hi taḥ/ /tai dṛṭ+wā dṛ pa ma bye t+ya ba bhā ṣe mdun na 'don/ /'dod dga' dag tu 'ongs pa yis/ /de mthong mi bdag la phyogs te/ /gus par 95—817

bhak+ṣi sasma taḥ/ /de bai ka brta pa da ṣ+pe ma yā dṛṣ+ṭaḥku mā ra kaḥ/ /ya mngon par 'dod pas smras/ /lha gcig nya pa'i khang par ni/ /gang gis khyod kyi rgyal srid dang / /srog e ba ka thi ta pūrde rā bye pā rja pa ha sta ba/ /shu two ti dṛ pa tiḥkro dag lha'aphrog par sngar brjod pa'i/ /gzhon nu bdag gis mthong bar gyur/ /'di thos mi bdag khros pa pām+bir+bhazlu pa ra mā ta re/ /go bi ṣa ṇi sa mā snu ya ma hā mā t+ya ma bhā ṣa ta/ /yis—/ /gzhan pa'i ma la rab smad de/ /blon po chen po ba glang rwa/ /yang dag bos nas rab smras khyepa/ /a ho ba tā ba tā pe na bha ba tā ma ma saṃ sha ye/ /rā dzñāsgo kaṇ+ḍi dh+wa re ṇa kau ri ba kye ma bdag gi the tshom la/ /rna ba 'dzin pa rab g.yel ba/ /khyod kyi rgyal srid chu gter la/ /gru bzhin shrī ru phe k+ṣi tā/ /tāsma ti n+ya sta tsit+ta gya su khaṃ ni dā bha bad+ma ma/ /dpal la btang snyoms byas/ /khrod kyi blo la sems bkod pa/ /bdag ni ①bde bar gnyid gyur ④te/ /se bā r+ya pā ṇa saṃ de ha dz+wa ra taṭī pa rda shrī hūṃ/ /gru zwa gar+bha pa ri t+ya de ring srog la the tshom gyi/ /rim gyi dbang gi gnas dag bsten/ /bdag gi ⑤mthar byed sbas pa'i bye kai brte 6 ma dan+ta rka/ /pa dz+dzaṣ+ṭa pa ra mā tā me ga ṇa ya tre ba mngal—/ /nya ⑥pa dag la yongs gtad nas/ /rab tu dga' bas gzhan pa'i ma/ /nges par nyi ma bā sa rān/ /a byā pi tarja sgo pā ye twa yā yustirngi bye ya tī/ /nabagrang bar byed/ /da dung de ni gsad ④pa'i thabs/ /rigs dupa khyod kyis (pesgrub par mdzod/ /sen kha ts+tsha ju ku bye ro kā le nā yā ti kuste tī/ /rak+ṣa ti swā mi rāṣ+ṭarja mos chod pa'i dus kyi ⑪ ni/ /sta re yis kyang nus mi 'gyur/ /rje bo yul 'khor nor dang rdzong / /durga mi n+d+ra ba lo da yī/ /a mā t+ya bra kṛ tistasmrat+tha kṛ ti bh+yo ga ri ya grogs dang dpung rgyas srung byed pa/ /de yi slad ⑪du rang bzhin las/ /blon po'i rang bzhin shin tu sī—/ /bya sa na sha ma na dh+yā nā salngaḥ sa dā hi ta pā yi naḥpra ṇa brling / /blon po gdung ba zhi byed bsam gtan la chags rtag tu phan pa blos⑫/ /nyan rna ⑫dul ba'i 95—818

bye ni ya ta byasgyu bhat+ta pra tā ki la madh+ri ṇaḥ/ /a bhi ma ta pha la pās+thā sa byāḥtshul ldan gus pa'i brtul zhugs dag ni nges par 'dzin/ /mngon 'dod 'bras bu thob pas grub pa dag pra dadhi ta sidhe yaḥshu tsi pa ri tsa yo dā rā pu byer+bha brnyi ma tī bhu rdzu/ /ni 'phral la rab tu ston/ /yongs 'dris 1dag cing rgya che sa bdag rnams kyi bsod nams dag gis thob/ /tūṇ+ḍi gu ru ta rā re byerwa kā khye ma hā mā bye brtswatsā ram̐ bi sreṣ+ṭa bā na/ /tsū ḍa ma ṇi pra bhā be+e na saṃ ste bhi de ni btsal ba'i slad/ /pa ta ka zhes nyan rna ①btang / /de nas gtsug gi nor bu yi/ /mthu yis rjochu ta rā dza gya rang nyid lag 'gro'i longs spyod dbang / /gal te 'chad par mi 'dod na/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po mi phan pa/ /rā dza pu tram̐ pa ri khya dza/ /i ti san+tardzi taste na nā ga thoṇ+ḍi k+ṣa yā k+ṣa ṇi/ /rgyal po'i bu ni yongs su thong / /de skad de yis ①bsdigs pa narjo/ /mtshan mo'i ⑫dus su klu yis ni/ /ta t+yā dza rā dza na bha baṃ bha ya sgo gyu hi rdza dza naḥ/ /prats+tshar+ghaṃ rā dza pu tro myur bar rgyal po'i bu btang ste/ /srog chags rnams ni 'jigs dbang gyur⑪/ /de nas rgyal sras rab tha ra dza kā ba pa thāsbi taḥ/ /tsa rā ṇa t+yā sa mu dru bhiḥpa ta ke no bsgribs te/ /'khrud mkhan dag gi khang par gnas/ /rkang pa bkod pa'i rgya dag gis/ /pa ta ka yis ⑫pa lak+ṣi taḥ/ /ta taḥpāste ma hā mā h+ye ra dza ke nā bi tar+bha yāta/ /nye bar mtshon/ /de nas blon chen 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /des 'jigs 'khrud mkhan ⑫dag gis kyang / /95—820

lak+ṣe ṇa shwa khyu bā si nā/ /rak+ṣi taḥk+ṣi ti mā sā r+ya pak+ṣi ban+da bya pa r+ya g.yang sar gnas pas gzhon nu yang / /bsrungs te 'dab chags bzhin du ni/ /sa la phyin cing shi ma ta—/ /su dhas+thā bi pa ti tsā khru tā pu tram̐ swa ni dha ṣ+pe ṣi ṭ+wā/ /su tā te jo ba gyur—/ /bu ni lhung thos chos bzang dag /rang nyid 'chi ba 'tshol ①ba ni/ /lha mo rnams kyis ②khyod tī rkyu ghā rak+ṣi tā di bya yo ṣi tā/ /ku mā ro pi kha la byā gh+ra gru ra k+ṣuṇ+ḍi shi lā kyi bu/ /'tsho zhes brjod nas rab tu bsrungs/ /gzhon nu'ang stag rmig rnon po yis/ /rdo ba'i gzhi ni ta lo/ /ga dzā sred+mat+ta shārdu la
