pu ru ṣe kṛ t+ta rngon pa mig ④ser can/ /zhes pa yis ni rab bshad de/ /lam ni thob pa'i skyes bu dag /lus kun gā tram̐ bya lo ka ya ta/ /bi lo kya dzata ka ru ṇa ste sa pra ts+tsha dṛ pāt+pa dzaḥ/ /ke ṣ+pe bcad pa mthong bar gyur/ /de mthong snyeng rje skyes pa yi/ /mi bdag bu yis ⑤rab tu dris/ /khrod kyi rmā bai sha ba hūṃ nī to pi bi dza ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe/ /so byu bīn+da ti dru re tra sdug bsngal gnas skabs 'di/ /mi med nags su ci yis ⑥thob/ /des 3smras ring po min 'di na/ /tsāṇ+ḍa labyaṇ+ḍa tseṣ+ṭi taḥ/ /ni ba sa t+yan+ta kaḥsum̐ sā su dā so nā ma duḥs haḥ/ /gtum po gtum po'i spyod tshul can/ /bzod dka' su dā sa zhes pa/ /skyes bu rnams kyi mthar byed gnas/ /ta su shaṃ kha mu kho nā ma pā ra me yoste dī ṣa ṇaḥ/ /pan+d+ra sbri sa ka la tīṭ+wā de la dung gi kha zhes pa/ /khyi ni 'jigs su rung ba sod da7/ /lam gnas mtha' dag gang mthong ye ṣ+pe tā bi hi tā di shaḥ/ /tasgo tsa rasgo ta gye ya oṃ gats+tsha da sa mudzha ba —/ /gdon mi za bar rnam 'joms pa/ /de yi spyod tshul lhung gyur pa/ /yud tsam 'tsho ba'i lhag tshig rkang gnyis po 'di bod skad du ma bsgyur 'dug pa za hor ban des bsgyur ba mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/bā / /rū snurta shi ṣa dz+re ba su bya thā me marma shā yi m+bi/ /spyud+dhāḥshaṃ kha ma can/ /bdag gi gnad bsnun zug rngu 'di/ /yan lag bcad las yang dag skyes/ /gtum po nyin 95—822

mu khoskṛr+ghaṃ kakhye nī sārba ga mi dzā/ /ma dh+yā t+na tap+ta byaṇ+ḍa laḥpa dā gung gdung ba'i tshe/ /gdug pa dung gi kha dag gis/ /mgrin pa rab bcad don mthun rmi/ /khrag ni pi ba hi sho ṇi tai/ rnams kyi rigs kyi nang / /phag rnams nyams par byed pa'i rims/ /gtum tai ga pak+ṣa pa te na bi bye nā ba na ba zla ni/ /kror+ya dadze+eḥs si hā po'i phyogs su lhung ba yis⑨/ /byed pos nags kyi lam du tu gtum po rbod pa yi(/nye//tsaṇ+ḍa lak+ṣe ḍa saṃ dzha yā/ /dṛṭī ru ro ha bhū pā la sru nu ra ma la ka dru oṃ/ /tai bī brda yis mngon du 'ong ba de/ /mthong nas sa skyong bu yis ni/ /skyu ru ra yi shing la 'dzegs/ /shing la 95—823

/gzhan du gsar pa'i tshon ris dang / /ku taḥkarnye ya mā kṛ tiḥ/ /bhā bā bha bya ta ra swa bhā ba ra tsa nā bai tsi rgya tsā dbyibs mdzes 'di ni ྅ga la 'ong / /'gyur bag shin tu legs pa'i rang bzhin ba ri ṇa madhī ṇa swa nā mo di sa twa byasti bi bhat+ta kadza ta ra khā tā rorlu 'ong rgyud mang ①sgra yis dga' ldan pa/ /snying stobs gsal bar 'byed ldupas 'dar zhing g.yo ldan 'og khā+e me kha lā/ /ā hār+ya ra tsa ya t+ya ha r+yā tu tsi ram̐ sau rda r+ya re khā pag mdzes sdug ri mo'i grogs/ /gsang por brjod la mngon phyogs mi 'phrogs yid 'ong stabs dang ldan sa khā+e ta bye khā su bi lā sa shi 6 ka ma rmā zla yugla mā se ba te/ /par sgeg par spras/ /gzugs bzang smin ma zung ni sgeg cing rol pa'i bslab pas spras pa kun tu bsten/ /i ti tabo da rmā sgo dza n+yasta ṣ+pe tra su byu pa teḥ/ /ur+ya yo ba da na swe zhes te de gdong chu skyes la/ /mig bkod sa yi ①bdag po yi/ /bzhin kyi rdul gyis rngu bran pa yi/ /da seka to ma da na pā da paḥ/ /di dzñā te rarja saṃ pūṇ+ḍi da tā sri pā ri to ṣi 'dod pa'i rkang 'thung yang dag skyes/ /de la tshim med nyin mo'i mthar/ /rin cen snyeyongs rdzogs byin kai / /an+taḥpu ro da ram̐ ga twa ta me ba tsin+ta yan dṛ paḥ/ /a sa nas ni/ /pho brang 'khor gyi nang song ste/ /mi yi bdag pos bdag 'unyid bsams/ /'khor ba'i rgyus t+ya byu pā ta myun+tarbi shān+ta kyu ṭa kā mi dī/ /tsa kre sa sā ra mā ya ba bzhin bden med gzugs/ /bcos ma'i 'dod ldan ma yis ni/ /sa bdag de yi nang dag tu/ /rnam sā mo haṃ ma tī pa teḥ/ /ā ni nā ya sa hūṃ swe ram̐ pa da ā+oṃ ma da nā tu raḥ/ /par gnas shing rmongs par byas/ /'dod pas gzir ba de yis de⑦/ /dal bu yis ni khyim du bos/ /pa ri ṇ+ḍa ma bi ro dhi n+ya smṛ ha yadhe myu mubye baḥ/ /ya shaḥpube+e pra kā yongs su gyur pa'i 'gal ba la/ /'chi bar 'dod rnams chags par byed/ /grags pa (8me tog rnam rā rde tri brga pha la shā khi dzā/ /pabye dṛ pa bṛk+ṣu shā midh+ri yā ṇa ma bkra zhing / /sde tshan gsum gyi 'bras bu can/ /mi bdag ljon pa rnams dag gis77 / /dbang po ma ni gra haḥ/ /ṣ+pe pā ba ṭi pa ta ti pā nyi ni yu tha nā thaḥsaṃ pūṇ+ḍi dā na pa bsdams sta re yin/ /glang po rjes su chags pa drag po'i dbang du gyur pa la/ /gal te glang mo de yis spyo95—827

ri pū ri ta j-iṅga sāzaḥ/ /sā ban+ta tī ya di ka ro ti na kuñdza ra mya gā ṭ+wā nu rā rmongs pa'i bslab pa ma byin na/ /yongs rdzogs sbyin pas bung ba'i don mthun yongs su dgyes byas pa/ /ga bi ba sha gya bi mo ha dispyo/ / ta taḥswe ra kṛ haṃ tā rā dzhabye ṭa khyu yi mgon po lhung ba'i g.yang la nges par lhung ba min/ /de nas dal gyes rgyal khab tu/ /bran khol kaiḥku ṭa kā mi bhā/ /ts+tshan+d+ra nu bṛsbyi mū byebe+e nā shā ya pra be+e shi tā/ /blun po 'dun pa yi/ /rjes su 'jug pas brlag pa'i slad/ /bcos ma'i bud med rab tu bcug /bi bi ste t+ya k+ta bye r+ya su ta su gru ṭ+wā bi lā ṣi ṇaḥ / / ba byu ba dben par brtan pa btang byas shing / /gsang ba mngon par 'dod de la/ /dus ni mdzes ma'i kād+dhā rū pe ṇa kā laḥkaste gra horlu khaḥ/ /ta tasta dīr+gha ni dā ya sha gzugs dag gis/ /mgul nas 'dzin la mngon phyogs gyur/ /de nas gnyid ni ring po'i be+ed/ /gus yā mā rū bhā mā da rātro/ /bi hā ya narta tī rū paṃ ku mā raḥs ha sā pra bīta/ /pas mal stan 'dzegs de la/ /gzhon nu ①gar mkhan ma yi gzugs/ /spangs nas 'phral la rab smras pa//sgo gā nustso na bha ba tā sgyu j-i ste hā na pe k+ṣi bhā/ /sa ha sgo gya mi rda rā bye khyod kyo longs spyod la chags shing / /spun zla'i mdza' la ltos med pas du/ /lhan cig spyad bya rgyal srid ni①//ka tha me ke na bhu bye te/ /nirdo ṣaḥkle sha dza la sgok+ṣibye haṃ bi ṣa me twa yā/ /gcig pu yis ni ji ltar spyod/ /mi bzad nyon mongs chu gter du/ /skyon med nga ④ni khyod kyis 'phangs//swa kan+d+ra yo gā dudhīṇ+ḍistat+tha tī kā ra tsin+ta kaḥ/ /uste ti ba n+d+ra dṛ pa de yi le lan sems byed bdag /rang gi las ni sti sbyor bas thar/ /zhes brjod de yis ⑥mi bdag 1 bye rdzu rā bye ma ba mya saḥ/ /mubha pra paṃ sha ma baṃ tsakre dza na tā shā pa bcings—/ /rgyal srid rab tu rgyas pa thob/ /skye bo'i tshogs ni dbugs phyung ste/ /sred ldan rab tu zhi ṣ+pe na paḥ/ /sa saṃ pābye pa daste bro tsin+ta yan swa pa rā bha baṃ/ /shi dze+e bar byas/ /gnas thob de yi ⑦rang nyid kyisasnyi/ /gnod pa drag po sems byed cing / /snga dro brtse med 95—828

pra bhā te bik+ṣe pa dṛ pa te1 rgyu ni/ /tsā bhā tri ba dha saṃ sak+ta rak+ta segh+ra mi ba khro ba yis/ /mi yi bdag la rdo ba 'phangs/ /spun zla bsad pas chags pa yi/ /khrag dang sbags bzhin shri yo / / bhu ghā ka bi ku mā ro pi de hā rnye na ra shaṃ ya yo / /dpal 'byor de/ /spyad nas gzhon nu snyan dngags mkhan/ /lus rmyekyi mjug tu dmyal bar song / /so haṃ bar+ṣa sa ha pā ṇi bhustu taṅkan+d+ra pā ta shaṃ/ /pra khye ṇa kilbi kho snga r+ya pā de nyid nga yin stong phrag lor/ /las kyi sdig pa de spyad nas/ /sdig pa zad mod da lta yang / /rkang pa'i dzā gukhye pa ri k+ṣa teḥ/ / dzad+mā ba rta kra ma pa ri tsa yiḥsan+ta taiḥpa tsu mthe bo (khyayongs su snad/sgo/ /skye ba'i 'khor mor rim gyis snguyongs 'dris rgyud dag gis ni smin byas shing //mā rna partswaspyo tai sba la dza la ta ru krā ba gaṭ+wān+ta re pi/ /taisten+d+ra nā ra sa phyi nas skam dang chu dang shing dang rdo yi ḍa3snying po'i dbus skyes kyang / /sna tshogs ro yi 6yo byad lus kyi pa ri ka riḥkā ya pā tre swa bhuk+ṇi kaspra pā ma ra pi na pu ru ṣaḥkan+d+ra she sngo dza hā ti/ /snod ni de dang des kluspyad de/ /skyes bu'i las kyi lhag ma skal ba 8 gnod pa yis kyang gtong mi 'gyur/ /i t+ya n+ya dzad+ma tsa ri tai shu twa bha ga ba to rda tai/ /a lo rgyu me ni re de skad skye ba gzhan gyi spyod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs thos nas/ /dge slong kun gyis las kyi sadze+e ra bhik+ṣa baḥkadz+re san+ta tim/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye rgyud⑨—/ /bgom par bya ba min par nges/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā nā kalpa la tā dze+e ka bi ku mā rā ba dā ā+oṃ ṣaṭa ṣakhyu dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las gzhon nu snyan dngags mkhan gyi rtogs pa brjod ta maḥpabe+e waḥ// //pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa drug pa'o// //dha t+yā te pa ri pūṇ+ḍi pu 5 ni dha yaḥ sad+dhādz+re saṃ po dha na dzñā no 'khor ba yangs pa'i mya ngam lam chen rab mang nyon mongs drag pos gdung byed pa/ /yongs su 95—829

da gra gu rū pa de sha ma hi mā ya dhī pra bhā bo da yāḥ/ /ge ha r+pā ga rdzogs pa'i bsod nams gter gyur dam chos rtogs shing ye shes mchog dang ldan/ /bla mas nyer bstan ṇa lbo la yā ba hu ta ra gre sho gra saṃ tā pa kṛ ta yiḥsaṃ sā ra se pā ri mā rab tu rgyas pa'i mthu thob bdag nyid chen po gang dag gis/ /khyim byi khyams ①su rtse ba lta bus yang dag ra ba ma hā mārgaḥs muwaṃ bh+ya te/ /pu rā bha bsgo ha pa tiḥshā ba bye budhe rak+ṣi rgal byed de dag bsngags dupar 'os/ /mnyan yod dag tu sngon byung ba/ /khyim gyi bdag po ①sangs rgyas taḥ —/ /abe+e sarbo pa ka ra rde gubyo ya gya kṛ ha shri yaḥ/ /yaḥpra srung ⑤/ /gang gi khyem gyi dpal sdug gyeni/ /slong ba'i tshogs kyis nyer mkhor ⑥gyur/ /gang zhig yid san+da ma no bṛtrīḥku sha lā ya pra sā di nā/ /kṛ taḥshik+ṣu pa do1ṣ+ṭaḥshā ri putre spyod rab dang ba/ /dge ba'i be+ed du babe+eb pa'i gnas/ /rab tu dang ba'i dge slong ni/ /shā ri'i bu ṇa bhik+ṣu shā/ /saṃ gha rak+ṣi ta nā mā byuta saṃ pūṇ+ḍi gu ṇa lak+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /pu yis dag par byas/ /de sras dam pa'i kun spyod can/ /rig gnas kun ⑦la rnam par mkhas/ /yon tram̐sta su dā tsā raḥsaza bi byā bi tsak+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /tai ka dā tsisgo ha pa te shā ri tan mtshan nyid yang dag rdzogs/ /dge 'dun srung zhes bya bar gyur/ /nam zhig khyim du shā ri'i bu/ /pu tra pi tā bra bīta/ /twa mu pas+thā ya kaḥpu tra gar+bha sgo gya pa tai khru taḥ/ /tasmrata 'ongs tshe pha yis de la smras/ /bu khyod mngal na gnas pa na/ /'di yi nye gnas su dam bcas/ /de da dhu nā sa bye kangh+ru marta si me ba tsa/ /pu byesgo brnyi sah+phu tāḥpi tu slad da (sheni bdag gi tshig /de ni bden par bya bar 'os/ /pha la bu lon med byed pa'i/ /bu bzang pā dṛ sgo kā ri shāḥ/ /i ti pi tā sa mā diṣ+ṭaḥpra z-iṣ+ṭaḥsaṃ gha rak+ṣi bsod nams dbang gis bye'agyur/ /de skad pha yis phobyeyang dag bstan/ /dge 'dun srung 'di rab taḥ / /a nu gaḥshā ri pu tra su pa ri tsar+ya pa ro bha bta/ /ta taḥpra zwa dga' ste/ /shā ri'i bu yi rjes 'brang zhing / /rim gro yongs su skyong bar gyur/ /de nas de yis ⑪rab 95—830

dzi taste na sa mu dā tsā ra shik+ṣa yā/ /a dh+yā pi taḥpa ni khi lo dhas+thā ga ma tsa tuṣ+ṭa phyung ste/ / kun spyod dang ni bslab pa la/ /①chos kyi lung ni bzhi po dag /ma lus de yis kha ton ②yi—/ /ta taḥka dā tsid+ma ṇi rdzu man+t+ra shā tu l+ya dzad+ma rmā/ /sha taiḥpañtsa bye sbyangs—/ /de nas nam zhig tshong ①pa ni/ /mtshungs par skyes pa'i grogs po dag /brgya phrag lnga yis chu ram̐ sgo /sgrogs tshe chu las tshig drag pa/ /gal te gzings 'di khyed cag rnams/ /grol bar 'dod pa de tā—/ /ta de ṣak+ṣi pya tī k+ṣi pre sa li le saṃ gha ra k+ṣi tāḥ/ /khru tī ta ta pā ṇa san+de lta na/ /dge 'dun srung 'di chu la ni/ /myur ba nyid du 'phang bar mdzod/ /de thos srog la the tshom tshe//te te ṣā me kā bha bad+ma nyiḥ/ /ba re ni dha na me bstu na tu sā dhu su z-id+ma dhaḥ/ /de dag rnams la /brtse ba yis ni bsrung brtson pas/ /chu gter 'khrugs ⑦par dge 'dun k+ṣu d+dhā sgo saṃ gha rak+ṣi ta ཿ / / sa nā ga ni la yo pā p+tasta tra nā gi srung / /rang gis ⑧bdag nyid rab tu 'phangs/ /de nas klu yi gnas su phyin/ /de ⑨ ni klu yis 4 raṭ+wā nī taḥ/ /be+e dh+wa ya pūza saṃ bud+dhā dṛ dha tse t+yā pi ban+da rna/ /gsol btab des/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la/ /mngon par phyag 'tshal mngon ⑪bsgrubs nas//95—831

dṛṣ+ṭa shā sa ra da spar+sha bi ṣā rde tsin+ta ya kṛ shaḥ/ /su tsa ri tā rnyi ma bsam pas phra des mthong dbugs dang / /so reg dug ldan de dag la/ /legs pa'i spyod tshul mngon tārnye ྾ bi da dha dhan+d+ra de sha dzā/ /tī bra ra ti sa mujusnaḥswa de sha ga 'dod pa'i/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa mdzad/ /chags bral drag po'i yid 'byung gis/ /rang yul ma norlu kaḥ/ /sa nā girba ṇi dzā me ba n+yastaḥpra ba ha ṇi k+ṣa zlata/ /'gro bar 'dod pa de/ /klu rnams kyis ①ni tshong pa yi/ /gzings la skad cig nyid kyis bkod/ /te pra j-iṭ+wāḥs mā sā r+ya pa ra lo kā di bā ga tai/ /pra t+yā bṛt+ta pra ba 'jig rten gzhan las 'ongs pa bzhin/ /de dag dga' ba yang dag thob/ /gzings ni duphyir la log ha ṇa s+t+ri ram̐ pā pudz+re ho da dheḥ/ /swa kṛ hoṅkaṇ+ḍa ya te hūṃ bra dza tā ma ti gyur nas/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs su phyin/ /rang gi 'dod pas de dag rnams/ /shin tu rings par satwa ram̐/ /ni dā luzlu lu kā kyu le bi smṛ taḥsaṃ gha rak+ṣi taḥ/ /ga te sāze bgrod pa yis/ /dge 'dun srung ni bye ma yi/ /ngogs su gnyid du song ba brjed/ /de nas don mthun pra burnyo tha pra bhā te bi dza nā di shaḥ/ /pa sh+ya rna su z-iju ra hi taḥpra da dzñā song tshe sad/ /snga dro mi med phyogs rnams su/ /lta zhing grogs dang bral ba yis⑦ / /chags bral blo can sa bi ṣaṇ+ḍa dhīḥ/ /a ho dṛṭ+wābya naṇ+ḍabya gan+dhar+bha na ga ro pa māḥ/ /bi mo ha des krubasams pa/ /kye ma mthong dang nyams pa can/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu yi/ /snying sdug gnyen yarnyi bi ra he su z-izen+tu sa mā ga maḥ/ /ta ru ṇa sa pa rod+mā lā lo dang 'grogs pa dag /bral na rnam par rmongs par byed/ /sa khar ⑤nya gzhon 'phar ba lta bur rab tu khāḥpa ra pri ya saṃ ga mā bi da dha ti dṛ d+dhā mā sgo mi jusbi ra sbi ti brnya g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug grogs/ /mi rnams dag la brdzun 'ugyi yid brtan brtan stipar gnas pa'i 'ching ba bhā / /swa dza na ra hi taḥshe te gasgo ta dze+e ba bi pa r+ya te ba tsa ra ti sgrub(she—/ /rang gi skye bo dang bral mal du nyal zhing de bzhin nges par mchisahuste/ /kun tu chags pa dge 95—832

ste bha ku ḍā pha lā kā rān mārdza nī ratshu pam+bi bhān/ /kha ṭ+wā byube+e kha la rtsig pa 'bras bu'i rnam pa can/ /phyags ma thag par mtshungs pa dang / /khri sogs gtun ni drag ①pa sbu dze+e stan+tu she ṣadhī dh+wa ga tān/ /sa tā d+ma twa ba tā ma gruḥsup+ta tse dang / /rnal ①ma'i lhag dang rnam gnyis gyur/ /nyal zhing sems ldan bde med pa'i/ /sems can t+ya n+ya niḥsu khan/ /sa tādz+reṭī bra dzad+ngha ba pu bye pā pa ta po ba ā+oṃ/ /snying stobs mchog gis mthong / /de mthong 'gro ba de nyid kyis/ /dka' thub drag ldan thub pa ni/ /se ba hūṃ tī bra ta pa sī mu m+bi r+ghaṃ pañtsa bhi sha taiḥ/ /te tai dru rāt+pa mā lo brgya phrag lnga yis ①bsten pa yis/ /bsod nams dka' thub nags tshal thob/ /de dag gis de ring po kya tsakri re nibyu yo mi thaḥ/ /a gya dā ta bya masmra bhirna s+thā ā+oṃ na pri nas—/ /mthong nas phan tshun nges par byas/ /bdag cag rnams kyi 'di la gnas/ /'di dhisbyin snyan yasba tsaḥ/ /shākya shi 6 na saṃ ghā stso ba hu dzalpaḥswa bhā ba taḥ/ /i ti saṃ par smra mi bya/ /shākya'i slob ma rang bzhin gyis/ /mang brjod phebs par smra bye ⑤min/ /zhes pa'i gros bi da mā thā ya te tasbrasmo na ni pu ram̐/ /tai ra daṭ+wā shra yasta tra sa ba s+thā ma ni rab bsgrubs ⑥te/ /thub pa de dag rab tu gnas/ /de dag gis der gnas ma byin/ /de yi nyin di na k+ṣa ye/ /badha kau sherbi naṣ+ṭa sha baṃ ka dze+e ri ba ṣat+pa daḥ/ /mu mo zad tshe 'khyam④/ /'dam skyes mdzod ni bsdams pa yis/ /rkang drug re ba nyams pa bzhin/ /thub ni re kastu bā sā ya ta suḥshu t+yā ku ṭi da do/ /twa yā mo na ba twa rā tre s+thā ta pa gcig gis ⑧de la ni/ /mtshan mo khyed ni mi smra bar/ /gnas par bya zhes rab brjod nas/ /zhag bya mi ti saṃ bi dā/ /ta tra te ra kṛ tā ti bye taik+ṣa pāk+ṣa ya kā ri rde/ /sar bste gnas stong pa byin/ /de dag gis der mgron ma byas/ /mtshan mo 'phen byed nyal gyur pa/ /spru tse sha yā na ma bye t+ya sha ṣ+pe rā shra ma de ba tā/ /utrīṣ+ṭha sā bho sau dza t+yāta de la bste gnas lha mo ni/ /mngon du phyogs te dal gyis smras/ /dam pa legs pa'i tshul gyis bzhengs/ /95—835

ku ru me dhan+d+ra de sha ram̐/ /sadha1 bā di ā+oṃ lo ke pra tha mo byu se me me chos ni rab tu bstan par mdzod/ /'jig rten dam chos smra rnams kyi/ /dang por khyod ni bdag gis taḥ / /i t+yabe+e tasta yā mo bhā sa tsā pā ha la ghu swa naḥ/ /mā tam+biṣ+ka bkur—/ /zhes des gsol btab thub pa des/ / gcom bskyungs ①de la rab smras pa/ /ma ma khyod sa nā thā yi ba tam+bi ke nā pi nin+d+ra tā/ /a smid+me mu ni nā mo rgo sa ma ya dang kho bo yisadzu/ /nges par 'byin pa ci slad sprul④/ /gnas der sdebadag la thub pa yis/ /mi smra ba saṃ shra ye z-i taḥ/ /nishī sa ya ti mā me ṣa tabye ti kra ma kā ri r+ṇa/ /i yi dam tshig byas/ /de las 'das par gyur na bdag /nges par 'di yis ⑤'byin par 'gyur/ /zhes ti bru bā ṇaḥpra ṇa yād+ma hu shaḥs ta yābe+e taḥ/ /drwah+ma ṇa nu ma tan+tan+d+ra smra ⑦de la gus pa yis/ /de yis memang du gsol btab ste/ /bram zes ⑤rjes su gnang ba yis(kye/ /muhūṃ sa mu ba tsakra me/ /ṣ+pe ba bra tā ni ta nu sho ṣa ṇa san+ta tā ni no pā ba nā chos ni smra bar yang dag brtsams/ /rgyun du lus ni gdung bar byed pa nges pa ṅghabartul zhugs min/ /skye ni bi dza nā ni ta po ba nā ni/ /sum̐ sā dza ṭā dzi na pa ri gra ha bo med pa'i dka' thub nags tshal dag par byed pa min/ /bzung ⑪dka'i ral pa pags pa yongs 'dzin du rga hā rde tse ta ཿ smṛ hā pa ri tsi tai pa ri sho ṣa ya rnyi / /skyes bu rnams dag gis⑫/ /chags pas yongs 'dris spyosems ni yongs su gdung bar byed pa yin/ /e te ba ṣ+pe pha la khyu dzaḥ ka pa yo na yulnga bṛk+ṣu ཿ sa balka la pa khā nags su 'bras bu za ba'i spre'u 'di dag rnams dang ni/ /ljon pa 'dab ma shing shun dang bcas ral sa dza ṭā dzha ṭābya/ /an+tardza la pra ṇa yi naste ma yabya tīze mi byā ta tshogs ldan pa dang / /'jug ngogs chu nang du chags nya mid rnams kyang 'gro rmyeb min/ /rab zhi spangs paḥpa ri ka raḥpra sha mordzu tā dzā/ /na bhū ti dha ba le ri bheḥs ba pa rnams kyis spyodaka' thub yo byad brdzun ⑪pa nyid/ /thal bas dkar ba'i glang po dang ni rlung dag 'thung 95—836

na pā yi bheḥsan+da gadze+e na bya sa ni dhimṛ giḥpa la la kaiḥsba lbo shā yi bheḥ/ /ba'i sbrul rnams dang / /nags na zhen pa'i ri dwags rnams dang thang la nyal ba'i gzungs mo dang / /pha la pra ṇa yi bheḥshu ṣ+pe ra pi ni rasbra rirlubha kai ra muk+ta bi ṣa ya sbri he ra bhe 'bras bu za ba'i ṣ+pe tso dang ni gos med rngon pa rnams kyis kyang / /yul la chags pa ma btang rab tu zhi ba ga tā pra shārnyiḥkwa tsita/ /i ti taṅku tsa na khru tā mu na yo pi sa bisma yāḥ/ /ta 'ga' yang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa de yi tshig thos te/ /ya mtshan bcas pa'i thub rnams kyang / /de mā dā rokhru khā sabye pa ri pā yar+yā ba sbi re/ /so tsin+ta ya di yo par+ṣata la gus pas mngon phyogs te/ /kun gyis yongs su bskor nas gnas/ /de yi bsam ①pa 'khor bar ni②//saṃ sā ra pa ri btī nī/ /mi bye ba bra ta sad+dhā pa san+ta ta kle sha yongs su bskor ba'i ①tshogs pa 'di/ /nges par brdzun ④gyi brtul zhugs kyis/ /rgyun du nyon mongs mashu te/ /dṛ rja ma bi byā saṃ s+thā rā bi dzñā rna nā ma rū pa tā/ /ṣa ḍā gdung ba spyod/ /mi rnams ma rig 'du byed dang / /rnam shes ming dang gzugs dang ni/ /skye mched ya ta na saṃ spasgo be+e da nā pa treṇ+ḍa yā/ /u pā dā lda bha bo dzā tidza rā ma drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba sred pa dang bcas dang / /len pa srid pa skye ba dang / /rga shi yis ni ra ṇa durga teḥ/ /e ṣa duḥkha ma yaḥskan+dhaḥsu ma hāza ri badhe te/ /a ngan par 'gro/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin phung po 'di/ /shin tu che bar yongs su 'phel/ /rab zhi pi byā di kra me ṇi ba pra shād+dhā nāsma nī rde/ /e kai ka su ni ro dhe na la mkhas pa rnams kyis ⑤ni/ /ma rig la sogs rim pa yis/ /re re 'gags par gyur pa na/ /gzhan yi yā ti ba raspa raḥ/ /i ti nish+yi t+ya ma na sā pa te ྾ tabe+e sgo pu raḥ/ /dang dhigazhan ni 'gag ④par 'gyur/ /de ltar yid kyis nges bya ④des/ /de dag mdun du de lta yis⑫//sad dhan+d+ra de sha rmā kṛ tā pu nastu ni da ma bra bīta/ /te ṣā ma sho rtsu dam pa'i chos ni bstan byas nas/ /slar yang de dag la 'di smras/ /gang dag yid ni byams pas ⑪ 95—837

dzā tsakre sadhen+d+ra de sha dzā/ /te tat+tha sā dā saṃ dzā ta bi ma la pra sha mo da yā/ /sat+tha dam pa'i chos ni bstan par mdzad/ /dri med rab zhi rgyas pa ni/ /de yi drin las skyes de dag /nyon kle sha bra hā rja rta pū bye twa mā ya yuḥ / / te bra dzā te 6 shāstu mongs thams cad gtong 'os pa'i/ /mchod 'os dgra bcom nyid du gyur/ /de dag song tshe ston pa la/ /ra ma thrats+tshahūṃ gha rak+ṣi taḥ/ /bha ga baṃ ste bha ku ṭ+wā di rū pā put+pa pha dge 'dun srungs kyis ①rab dris pa/ /bcom ldan ka ba rtsig sogs gzugasadu/ /me tog 'bras bu lo pa māḥ/ /rā dzā bhāstan+ta she ṣābya dṛṣ+ṭaḥ sa tā ma yā pa thi/ /mtshungs pa dang / /thag mtshungs snal ma'i lhag ma yang / /sems can bdag gis ①lam du mthong / /taste ྾ kan+d+ra ṇaḥka mya pha lo mo hā nu brnyi rmā/ /i ti ta nā da rābyeṣ+ṭaḥrmongs pas bcings pa de dag ni/ /de dag las ni ci yi 'bras/ /zhes pa de yis ④gus pas dris/ /sat+tha dzhasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ba byu buḥkā byu pā khya su te shāstuḥshā ba kaḥpu rāḥ/ /de la kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa/ /de dag sngon tshe ston ⑤pa ni/ /'od srungs zhes pa'i nyan thos gyur/ /ste bha ku bye 6 taiḥbyeṣ+ṭha pra k+ṣibye saṃ gha man+di re/ /ku ḍā ni saṃ gha z-ik+ṣe dge 'dun khang pa'i ka ba dang / /rtsig pa la des ngar snabs ⑥'phangs/ /gzhan gyis dge 'dun ljon bh+yaḥpha la puṣ+ṭha ṇi ṭī pa reḥ/ /bhigru sgo dza na pā ṣ+pe 6 dre ṣāji rgyu kṛ pa las⑦/ /me tog dang ni 'bras bu blangs/ /dge 'dun zas dang btung ba la/ /gzhan gyi sdang bas twophopa reḥ/ /saṃ gha khā bha pa rā bṛt+tabyekhyu shā ma pa reḥkṛ tā/ /te gegs ⑧dag byas/ /gzhan gyis ⑨dge 'dun rnyed pa ni ⑩/ /dge slong dag la yongs bsgyur byas/ /de taṅkan+d+ra bi pā ke na tat+ta dā kā ra tī ga tāḥ/ /i t+yā khyu tai bha ga ba tā khru tā dag las kyi rnam byun des/ /rnam pa de de nyid du gyur/ /bcom ldan gyis bshad de thos nas/ /de so bhūt+pa bi sma yaḥ / / pā p+ta ma rta t+pa rda dṛ ṣ+ṭa bhek+ṣa ba ཿ saṃ gha rak+ṣi ni ya mtshan ldan par gyur/ /dgra bcom gnas thob dge 'dun srungs⑪/ /dge slong rnams kyis mthong 95—839

tai / /dzi rgo taṅkan+d+ra pa prasgoḥdṛṣ+ṭaḥs tsa dza gā da tān/ /e ka pra bra dzi taḥnas ni/ /las de rgyal ba dag la dris/ /dris pa des kyang de la gsungs/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa shāstuḥkā byu pā khya su shā sa rna/ /pu rā bi hā ra saṃ gha gya tse ya sre t+ya ka ro bha yi—/ /bstan pa la ni rab byung 7 'di/ /dge 'dun gtsug lag khang du sngon/ /zhal ta byed pa nyid du bta / /pañtsa ba gya sha tā t+yā saṃ saṃ ga tā ni bi hā ri rde/ /pra ṇi dh+wa rna sha rī dzā gyur—/ /gtsug lag khang na gnas pa ni/ /lnga brgya de yi grogs por gyur/ /lus kyi mjug tu smon lam te ku sha lā ya tsa kā ra saḥ/ /te nāsmiñdzad+ma ni s+thā pa darta hūṃ saṃ gha rak+ṣi no—/ /dge ba'i slad du de yis (nyabyas/ /skye ba 'di la dge 'dun srungs/ /de yis shedagra bcom nyid taḥ / / ta de tahūṃ ga tai bā gya mu m+bi rmā sha ta pañtsa shaṃ/ /rasteḥshu thob cing / /de dag thub pa lnga brgya po/ /'di dag de dang (d+nghayang dag 'grogs/ /lus can rnams ni kli ra se ta sa bā le rde hi rmā kan+d+ra sru tresh+yi tā kā re bha ba ti ba hu shaḥpā dmar dang dkar dang gnag dang phra ⑤ba'i las skud kyi⑥/ /rnam par bkra ba skye ba'i gos kyis lan ④mang bṛ tai dzad+ma ban+t+ra/ /t+yaste t+yarmiñdza ṭha ra bhu dza ga smra na nisgo ka yusgyu tame+e ba bye dag tu g.yogs par gyur/ /lag 'gro rgan po lkogs dman 'dor ba'i rigs zhikyepa dag gis de btang nas/ /be+e sha ti ku sha lī yan+da shi tai na tsoṣ+ṭi / / i ti ta gya ni sha mya grangs med tsha ba med pa'i 'ba' zhig gang der dge ba ldan pa 'jug /ces pa de bzhin gshegs pa des sā da rāḥka thi tai te na ta thā ga te na/ /pra shaṃ shaṃ su ra na n+ya mā na gsungs pa/ /thos nas dge slong de dag gus bcas pas/ /dam pa'i sems ldan de yi spyod pa dag /pātso ri tai sañtsi ta su bhek+ṣa baḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yo bo dhi sa yid ni gzhan dang bral bas rab tu bsngags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems tā bā dā na kalpa la tā yī saṃ gha ra k+ṣi tā ba dā dz+wa sabe+e ṣakhyu ta maḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dge 'dun srungs kyi 9)rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 95—840

pal+la waḥ// //'dab ste drug cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //ka n+d+ra ṇi pū t+tha bi hi tsā na hi tā ni tā ni kṛ ṭ+wā ni sgo phan dang mi phan las rnams dag ni ⑨sngon du bsgrubs gyur pa/ /longs spyod dus kyis shin tu ga sa ma yir ti bā hi tā ni/ /gats+tshadhi rdza tu ṣa la sad+ku su mo pa mā ni 'das shing nyams par gyur pa dag /rab rgyas me tog mtshungs pas til rnams dag la bsgo ba bzhin/ /lbo 8 ti le ṣ+ṭa na ni dh+wa ya ni dzā pi saṃ/ /badzā sa ni badz+ra sa mā bye srog chags rnams la rang gi bag chags bzhag nas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i gdan la sangs rgyas bdud ban+t+ra da thobye te budha su dh+wa ma yu kheḥ/ /sadzad+ma roḥṣaṭa bhe ra bāp+ta dībe+e rtsi'i zer/ /rdo rje ñtshating 'dzin bcings las bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /rab 'bar ye shes rgyas pa lo drug gis/ /dzñā no da ye byekhyi ga ṇista mū tsuḥ/ /twabyi yo gāldi saṃ ta bhā bha ga bād+ku k+ṣi ko thob pa de la dge slong tshogs kyis zhus/ /khyod bral me yis gdungs gyur pa/ /grags 'dzin ma yi dku da re/ /ni yī ā+oṃ su pra bhe gar+ghaṃ ṣarnyi zladze+er+ya sho dha rā/ / ta smin+d+ra nang du/ /mngal ni chags par lngagyur pa dag /bcom ldan lo drug dag nas btsas/ /khyod mtshungs hu la kā bhi khye dzā te twat+pa dṛ she shi sho/ /dzā tāḥku to ya mi t+yā ha rā dzā shurnyo da byis pa sgra gcan 'dzin/ /zhes pa de ni skyes pa na/ /rgyal po zas gtsang khros pa yis/ /'di ni ga las naḥkru dh+wa/ /sā ba bye ba su d+dhā ni tā shā se ṣ+pe na ma tī pa teḥ/ /sa d+dhā skyes ④zhes smras/ /sa bdag bka' yis de nyid ni/ /gsod pa'i sar ni khrid gyur pa/ /spring yig gis ta bai ba le khe na pra bhā be ṣ+pe ba rak+ṣi ta/ /tādh+yā yā ma shi lorde ge ni bzhin khyod kyi dzumathus/ /dag pa de ni rab tu bsrungs/ /de nas khyod byon rdo nang du/ /de yis byis k+ṣibhe tha ta yā shi sho/ /tat+pa t+ya yā tsa ṣ+pe nā sau sa li le 6 p+lu bi shi kā/ /sā dhī pa nges par bkod/ /de yis ⑥bden pa brjod pa yis/ /rdo ba de ni chu la ldengs⑦/ /mi g.yem dag 95—841

bra ta pa ri tā yāsta suḥshwa su ra ko pa dzaḥ/ /duḥkhā ba mā na san+ta paḥs pā pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de la gyos po khro ba skyes/ /sdug bsngal smad cing gdung ba de/ /las ni ci yi kāṅka gya kan+d+ra rjaḥ/ /i ti bhi gru ba tsaḥshu tā bha ga bān+d+ra ti bhā ṣa ta/ /thra rnam smin lags/ /zhes pa dge slong tshig thos nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsungs pa/ /las ya tī ka1 shā ye na duḥkhaṃ le bhe ya sho dha rā/ /kam+bi bye na ga re rā dzā ni gang gis grags 'dzin ma/ /sdug bsngal thob pa rab tu nyon/ /grong khyer kam+bi ①la dag tu/ /sa yi brah+ma dat+taḥpu rā bha bta/ /khyu ta lā khaṇ+ḍa laḥshrī mād+ku mi nī ku su mā yu dhaḥ/ /brgya byin dpal dang ldan/ /'dod ldan ma yis ②me tog mtshon/ /rgyal po tshangs byin sngon byung gyur/ /khaṅga dh+wa rā dha re ṇa rdo bhu dze na dzi na tiḥpa re/ /pra dza dzā la pra tā g.yul du ral gri'i rgyun 'dzin pa'i/ /dpung pa yis ni rab babyed pas/ /gang gi ①gzi byin me dag ni/ /pāldir+ya snga rā nyi ta maḥpra daḥ/ /sa kā da tsid+ma na dha dzñā mṛ ga ya ke li kau tu tī/ /dgra la mun pa rab ster 'bar/ /nam zhig nags su gzhu 'dzin des/ /sngon gyi rtse dga'i dge mtshan la//bi be+e shā dru rā mi kā tī kṛ to shwe nā ti ram̐ ha sā/ /ta sgyur+gha ki ra ṇi ta rnyi nā shin tu mgyogs 'gro rta yis ni/ /gcig pur byas te ring du zhugs/ /de yi 'gram par rngul gyi thigs/ /ka po le swe da bin+da baḥ/ /tsa kruḥkuṇ+ḍa li mughā rmā pra ti bisba bi ḍasba nyi ma'i zer gyis rab bskyed pas/ /rna rgyan mu tig rnams kyi ④ni/ /gzugs brnyan ⑤dag dang mtshungs ā+oṃ—/ /mānā ga te na sa mu hutshu ga shā pa ke na ra myu ba lo ka na ku tū par byas/ /lam nas 'ong ba'i ri dwags phrug ⑥gu dge mtshan g.yo med kyis/ /yang dang yang du de la ha la ni: le na / / hā rā gra rat+na sha ka la pra ti bi spa te na dka' ④bar kun tu lta byed cing / /do shal rtse yi rin cen ①dum bur gzugs brnyan snang byed pas/ /pā dā1 rde sa dṛ sha rū pa pa rda su d+dhā shoḥ/ /ta myu nu rak+ṣa ha ri bhā skad cig bdud rtsi'i zer gyi gzugs kyi gnas dang mtshungs par gyur⑨/ /rjes su chags ldan ri dwags mo 95—842

ka ri r+ṇa pra sak+ta byā m+bi li tīk+ṣa ṇa mṛ ga dī pa se bya mā na/ /dza dang glang mo la chags pa'i/ /mig zum ri dwags gnyis 'thung rnams kyis ⑨rab tu bsten labya ba/ /ri h+phuḥshra mām+bu sha ba rī ka ba rī ka khā ba put+pa smṛ shaḥsu ra bhi mat+ta ba nān+ta bā khrod ma yi skra tshogs me tog la reg dri bzang can/ /stsos pa'i nags mtha'i rlung gis ⑦de yi ngal ba'i chu tāḥ—/ /am+bi n+da ba sa re ka bye shārnyi l+ya su ma hā mu ṣ+peḥ/ /pra sru ba pā na saṃ dag phrogs/ /skabs der thub pa chen po ni/ /shī ṭi be+e yi gzhon nu ma/ /gci ba 'thungs pas mngal pāp+ta gar+bha mu kha mṛ gī su hūṃ/ /sa li lā ha ra shā yā tī khā ba ju mṛ ta bā hi rde/ /gyi sgo/ /thob pa ri dwags bu ④mo ni/ /mdzes sdug bdud rtsi'i rgyun ldan zhing / /chu ni len du 'ong ba dag/sa da dasgye shra ma sa rirtswa re ta ra la lo tsa rmā/ /ka ma dze+e ka ma khā rā mig rab g.yo ldan bste gnas kyibu/ /chu klung ngogs su de yis ⑥mthong / /dpal mo pad+ma'i dga' tshal la/ /ma spru h+ye ba ka ma khā ka ra/ /thra dzādzñā tsa ra ṇa t+yā sa dzā taiḥka ma la maṇ+ḍa li/ /dga' bas bzhin du pad+mo'i tshal/ /rkang bkod las skyes pad+mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag gis spro byed cing / /a byuza ko tu ka ba tī ṭī dṛṭī ma nu dze shwa raḥ/ /a ma ra twa mi ba pā ba sngon med dge mtshan ldan pa de/ /mthong nas mi yi dbang po ni/ /skad cig mig ni 'dzum bral bas /nim+bi mo ṣe k+ṣa ṇaḥk+ṣa khaṃ/ /so cib ya da ho kā pi kārnye yo mu ni ka n+ya kā/ /ha lha nyid thob pa bzhin du gyur/ /des bsams kye ma mdzes ma 'di/ /thub pa'i bu mo su zhig yin/ /ri ri bhā ba ha ra h+ye ba snisna musnyem+bi lo ki taiḥ/ /se ba sim+bi ni be+e se dwags mo bzhin rab mdzes shing / /yid 'ong lta bas yid 'phrog byed/ /pad+ma can ni rkang pa nyed pa'i tā ka ma li nī sa byā ha ṣ+pe bā da yoḥsgorten+d+rasgo da na su lagla li khi tai g.yog gi mtshams la nges par bskos gyur cing / /zla ba nya ba ⑦bzhin gyi mtshan ma bris pa'i 1'bangs dā sa twa mā pā di taḥ/ /mā rasnye swa ya me ba bi shwa bi dza ye byu bi bh+ra maiḥsu khyu bā nyid rab tu thob par byas/ /byun legs smin ma'i rnam 'phrul rang nyid kun las rgyal bar rab tu rtsom ⑨95—843

kā saṃ nin+d+ra la kārmu kā ni ta la tā ṣ+pe rgu rgya mā lasba te/ /ki ra ti ba pa na/ /nges par 'dod pa'i gzhu yi 'khri shing dri med yon tan med pa nyid la brten/ /'di yi bzhin da na bi sba har+ṣa pe yu ṣa ma snga la li ta si ta ma yu khol+le kha re khā kra gyi dkyil 'khor yid 'ong bsel zer can dag gis/ /bkod pa'i khye ri mo'i rim pas dga' ba'i bdud rtsi me ṇa/ /i ya ma ti sha ya mi ṭī ṣ+pe tra yoḥsho tra spru le na ba ku ba la rgyas par byed/ /mig dag rna ba'i rtsa bar shin tu byams par gyur pa 'di/ /ut+pal gsar pa rol pa'i ya lī lotrī sa kārnyiḥta no ti/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya pa sha ṣ+pe ra ba ru khya tu re ga rgyan gyis trīmadzes pa rab tu 'dzin/ /zhes bsams de yis dal gyis ni/ /rta las yang dag babs byas māta—/ /tā mu bā tsa sa ma bye te kau tu kā lo ka norlu khro/ /as+thā na su te—/ /dge mtshan blta ①la mngon phyogs ma/ /de la btud de rab smras pa/ /legs byas rgya che mi kṛ to dā ra su re kaṇ+ḍa gra ho tsi tā/ /bi dza ye ma ṇi mā le ba kā two ku ba dman pa'i/ /lha yi mgrin par gzung 'os ma/ /rnam rgyal ④ nor bu'i 'phreng ⑤ ba bzhin/ /ut+pal mig la ye k+ṣa ṣ+pe/ /a ya mā nan+da sasdo ha sun+di dī la li tā ta ba/ /na ka su can khyod ni su/ /khyod kyi mdzes sdug dga' ba yi/ /tshogs ni rgyas par byed pa 'dis/ /su yi yid ni ku ru te kārnyiḥkau tu kā kuñtsi tasma naḥ/ /byu nyi ka gya twa yā bye shuḥsha rartson+d+ra dge mtshan la/ /'gugs pa nyid du byed ma yin/ /su yi rigs brgyud 67mu tig gisgo7/ /'khri shing rab ra dā ta yā/ /kā ma muspyo la bhe baṃ shāḥsaṃ bha be na bi byu ṣi taḥ/ /tu 'thob pa na7dag /ston zla ltar dkar she1khyod 'khrungs pas/ /rnam par brgyan pa rab tu smras/ /i ti te nā da rādṛṭ+wā dzñā tā lta mu ni pu tra shaṃ/ /a dzñā ta kā ma bṛṭ+wā pi sā zhes pa de yis ⑫gus pas dris/ /de ni thub pa'i bur shes nas/ /'dod pa'i spyod tshul mi shes kyang / /bye khā ṣā dza gā da pā/ /a ho pad+mā ba tī na ma pā do r+yat+pad+ma mā mngon par 'dod ldan de yis kṛnyasmras/ /rkang pas pad 'phreng spyorab bskyed pas/ /bdag ni pad+ma can 95byed844

li kā/ /mṛ gi gabha sa mubyu ta shāṇ+ḍi l+ya mya su tā mu ṣ+peḥ/ /swā ga tai te mu ni zhes bya/ /ri dwags mngal skyes thub pa ni/ /shaṃ ṭi be+e yi bu mo yin/ /thub pa'i sras khyod legs par su ta thra yo me ta ba dar+sha ā+oṃ/ /ma no ha ra ta re tsi tra babo lo ki mi 'ongs①—/ /bdag ni khyod mthong rab tu dga'/ /shin tu yid 'phrog bkra ba yi/ /shing shun brtul rda bra tai/ /bi bhū ṣi to yasmra yu riḥshi khaṇ+ḍi ri ba pañtsa bhiḥ/ /su zhugs 'di ni ci/ /rma bya'i gtsug phud lnga dag gis/ /brgyan pa bzhin du khyod kyi ni/ /ral ( 7 tshogs rādzñā tīṇ+ḍi ku su maḥsho bha te te dza ṭā bha baḥ/ /i ya mā ma la kabh+yo la 'di dag lha las kyang / /me tog dag gis 1rgyas par mdzes/ /skyu ru ra ni rags pa yi/ /'bras bu kha pā le ya pha la ko dz+wa laḥ/ /dīspyo k+ṣa sru tra mā la bhi kabye ba hu gu khaṃ ta ba/ /ā ba rab 'bar 'dra/ /bgrang 'phring 'phreng ④ba ring po yis/ /khyod kyi mgrin la yon tan mang / /'od sru tra ya ti te pā ṇibye treḥku sha pa bi tra kaiḥ/ /ku ṭi me be+e rku daṇ+ḍi smin ma'i dbyug pa 'khyog po 'dir⑤/ /yal 'dab gsar pa'i 'phreng ‘༅ ba la/ /khyod kyi lag pa ku sha yis⑦/ /bya la pabe+e ba mā li rmā/ /ra ma d+dhā yā bra ta ba taḥka bye tsā kwa ta bā shra maḥ/ /dag byed bkra bas kun tu spras/ /legs pa bdag yid ri dwags nisgo 7/ /gang du ngal ni bses gyur pa⑨/ /ma no mṛ gā dzi na shārnyi me ti me ya tra sā dhu tsa/ /i nyi musna ba tsaḥdaga' bar rma bya'i ⑩ brtul zhugs can/ /khrod gnas gang rke7na yod pa sgos/ /zhes pa bzhin bzang ma swā du su ṅgādz+ra ba su dh+wa dhi paḥ/ /ā sā r+ya da twa pā thre ya mo da ko ta yi tshig /snyan zhing bdud rtsis brlan pa dag /sa bdag gis myang lam brgyags pa/—rtakyi/ /la du byin ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ṣ+pe bāsmin+d+ra tsi tai su zla dar+bha su ṭī ra yā tsi te/ /su ku nas de la smras/ /byun legs khyod lus shin tu gzhon/ /shing dang rtswa ni bskams lku gyur cing / /ku sha'i mā ram̐ ta ba ba puḥ shu 6t+ta ru tri ṇi ba ṣ+pe / / i ta ཿ saṃ sgo ga yo khab kyi tshogs gtams pa'i/ /nags tshal 'dir ni 'os pa min/ /'di nas ha cang mi ring na/ /95—845

gyu shrīṭ+wā ti dru re ma mā shra maḥ/ /e baṃ bi dh+wa bi shī ya rnye yasmi4 la pa ram̐ bdag gnas longs spyod 'os pa'i dpal/ /gang na rnam pa ① 'di lta yis②/ /'bras bu brgyud pa ①rgyas pa rāḥ/ /ni bā saḥkri ya tsā ta tra tsar+ya tī mād+ma baṃ ta paḥ/ /saṃ sgo ga pa yod/ /der ni rnam par gnas par mdzod/ /yid srubs ④dag gi dka' thub mdzod/ /skye bo mchog pa ri tsar+yā su dza no yo ba ni yu bye tsā/ /asgyu྾ ga ba tai ga tai ga ta ni longs spyod kyis⑤/ /rim gro dag la rnam par sbyor/ /mig gsum rab tu khros tshe me yi lam du phye ma ba tas+t+yak+ṣa pra ko pa k+ṣa ṇi dz+re bo sgyu da na me ta de ba bi bye nā ma bye na baṃ nismi tai/ /leb nyid gyur ldan pa/ /srog ni rab tu rdzogs pa ⑥byed pos gsar du sprul pa 'di nyid yin bsam ste⑦/ /kān+tadhe ba su dh+wa su dh+wa ka ra ka lā ko shā nu kā rasba purlu ba sgyu di sa khrod kyi lus mdzes nor 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zer gyi cha yi mdzod kyi rjes mthun pa/ /yid las ⑧skyes pa'i hi i me ba a sa mā nā n+yad+ma no dzad+ma naḥ/ /i ti shu tā tu bik+ta su mdzes sdug mtshungs med dang po de ni 'di nyid gzhan ma yin/ /zhes pa sa bdag mdzangs ④pa'i tshig /mud+dhā bhū mi pa tet+tha tsaḥ/ /tsan+d+ra ba dā ta mā swā r+ya mo da kan+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /bzhin bzang ma yis ⑪ thos nas ni/ /la du zla ba ltar dkar ba/ /myangs nas de la rab smras pa/ /tādh+ra tā nu bṛ tai bā haṃ ni ba pā mi ta ba shra me/ /pra tīk+ṣa swa k+ṣa khaṃ khyod kyi brtul zhugs rjes spyod pa⑩/ /khyod kyi gnas su bdag gnas bgyi/ /ji srid song nas bla ma'i yā baṅga tā dzñā maza ye gu roḥ/ /i ti sam+bi da ā sā dh+wa ya sa mi tā ni dzā bka'—/ /don du gnyer la skad cig sdod/ /ces pa'i gros ni bsgrubs nas de/ /rang gi bste gnas shā oṃ/ /na bā bhi khā ṣa bi ba shā swa padhī mu ni ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /dṛṣ+ṭa dag tu song / /mngon 'dod gsar pas dbang bral bas/ /shugs ni 'byin cing thub la smras/ /yab stuta ba ṣ+pe ko pi ma yā mu ni ku mā ra kaḥ/ /pra san+d+ra sa li la tshwa lags bdag gis ⑫thub pa yi/ /gzhon nu su zhig nags su mthong / /shing shun mtha' ni bkra ba dag /95—846

yā tsi tra par+yan+ta balka laḥ/ /di bya ta dā shra mosgru tai pha la mā swā di tasma rab tu dang ba'i chu ltar mdzes/ /gang gi 'bras bu gzhan gyi tshogs/ /bsdom ①par yongs su rtog rjobyed yā / /ye nā n+ya pha la saṃ bha ro ni ya maḥpa ri kadze+e taḥ/ /gasgo pa—/ /de yi gnas su rab 'khrungs pa'i/ /'bras bu mchog ni bdag gis ①stsong / /de yi dka' thub mi twa da nu dzñā tā kārnya ta gya ta po ba dz+wa/ /tad+mo dza ṣ+pe pra sak+ta me nā n+ya tra ra nags metshal du/ /khyod kyi rjes gnang ⑤bdag mchi'o/ /de yi gzhung bzang la chags pa'i/ /bdag blo ma te ma tiḥ/ /i ti tad+ma tsa dz+wa khru tā bismi taḥsma ra sru tsa rka/ /tā gzhan na ⑥dga' ba med/ /ces pa de tshig 'dod pa ni/ /gsal byed thos nas ya mtshan zhing / /lang mu bā tsa mu nirmud+dhā yo ba nod+mā da shaṃ ki taḥ/ /dṛṣ+ṭa sta yā bhu dza go sau ma n+ya tsho smyon par dogs pa yi/ /thub pas mdzes ma de la smras/ /khyod kyis ④mthong de lag 'gro ni/ /rin rat+na bi byu ṣi taḥ/ /bha brnyi myu na yaḥpu tri na dī dzi hā na sgo gi na/ /chen gyis brgyan yin nam snyam/ /bu mo thub pa rnam dag ⑧ni/ /longs spyod can min lce gnyis min/ /sa sgo hargu ru bhiḥs rā pa ri ṇa to duḥkha pra desgro da kai rā yā to bi kha yo yul bzhin yongs su gyur tshe sdug bsngal rab ster ⑨snum bcas lci ba'i la du ni/ /shin tu dngar ⑩ba dag ra bā ti ma dhu riḥthra ti dṛ thā mā kṛ thaḥ/ /muste kā ma pha lā ni tā ni pa ra sī gis 'ongs pa la ni don med dga' bar yongs ma byed/ /mdzes ma 'dod pa'i 'bras bur ⑪ro ldan nyon t+yā yā sa segh+ra n+ya lo ye ṣā me ba bi sngo pa me na dza na tā swā de na saṃ spru mongs dag gis ⑫bran pa gang de rnams/ /shin tu nges par dug dang mtshungs pa'i nyams su myong ba bskyed ts+tsha ti/ /e hi dar+sha ya me byu rā ṅka stu bat+pa mu ṣ+peḥsu taḥ/ /i pas rgyal bar byed/ /tshur shog re shig thub pa'i sras/ /de su ring nas bdag la ston/ /zhes brjod kyughā ta ṭa bhā tī re ta yā sa ha ya yo mu niḥ/ /sa bi lo kya pa riṭī ra bra klung gi ngogs su ni/ /de dang ⑫lhan cig thub pa song / /de yis ⑫chu klung ngogs su ni/ /sa yi bdag95—847

h+madar+ghaṃ ma hi pa ti/ /yo gyi gu ṇa ga rto dā ram̐ dzā mā ta ra ma ma n+ya ta/ /dṛ po tshangs byin stimathong / /yon tan tshogs ni rgya che stekhye / /mag pa dag tu 'os par bsams mi po pi mu ni mā lo kya bai la gh+ra bi na tā na naḥ/ /dwo gu ṇi na pra zla me bdag gis kyang thub pa ni/ /mthong nas skyengs pas bzhin dud cing / /gnyis la'agyur rab tu btud na ni nā ye ba pra san+da hūṃ/ /ni dzo tsi te na bi bye nā mu ni nā pra ti pā di shā/ /pa yis/ /nges par rab tu dang ba thob/ /thub pas rang la 'os pa yi/ /cho ga yis ni rab tu byin/ /ta ta༈ har+ṣa pe yu ṣa ra ha li ma gra tīdzñā paḥ/ /nā sngaḥka dā tsiṅkarta de nas rab dga' bdud rtsi yi/ / rlabs de ④mi yi bdag pos blangs/ /nam yang khrod kyi ⑤tshig gzhan byo ma rtseḥpa ra gi rā twa yā/ /mud+dhā pā bye ya mi kyughā mu niḥs+thā yādrwa gyis—/ /'di la khro bar mi bya zhing / /mdzes ma 'di ni bskyab ⑥bya zhes/ /brjod nas thub pa dze+erang mā shra oṃ/ /a tha har+ṣa mi bā ru khya ha yo dzā yā sa khaḥk+ṣa shāt+pa/ /rā dza gnas song / /de nas dga' bzhin 'u7 rta la zhon/ /chung ma dang 'grogs skad cig gis/ /rgyal sar dh+wa no sa mā sā bya dṛ pañtsa kre ma hot+pa baṃ/ /sad+dhān+ta pu ra dza na su yang dag phyin nas ni/ /rgyal pos dga' ston chen po byas/ /pho brang 'khor gyi sde kun rmi/ /gtsug tu mūdh+ri n+yasta ma tī bhu dz+re/ /sa ya yo shi 6 tī pa h+phuḥka lā kau sha la ke li 6/ /pā da sa bdag gis bkod de/ /sgyu rtsal mkhas pa'i rtsed 'jo la/ /bdag po'i slob ma nyid du gyur/ /de yi t+yā baiḥka ma la ka li shaṃ bhu mi mā lo kya tasu de bī shasde dṛ pa pa ri dza rkang pa bkod pas sa gzhi pad+mas brgyan pa mthong gyur nas/ /der ni rgyal po'i 'khor gyi lha mo'i sgra dag ji nasta tra me ṣ+pe ya thārbaḥ/ /di byoṅkar+ṣaḥsu kṛ ta pa tsi baḥsru tsu te ke tu bhū taḥbazhin don can bzung 7)/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mchog tu khyad 'phags legs byas grogs ni rtogs sbyi tā byarlo ra ti sha ya ma ma rla k+ṣa ṇi ཿ bu rgya bhā rdzu/ / an+ta ཿgyur pa/ /ngo mtshar rgyas pa phul byung rang bzhin mtshan nyid rnams kyis lngo)gsal bar byed/ /pho brang 95—848

pu ra pu ra: 6 bi mu khe na ma tī bhu dzā/ /le bhe sau bhā gya sho bha pā ra ma 'khor byi bud med las/ /phyi rol phyogs pa'i sa bdag dang / /rtse zhing nu rgyas ldan pa des/ /skal ba mā nā gha na sta m+bi/ /a tha kā le na sā gar+bha mā dhat+ta ba su ṅgā pa teḥ/ /bzang zhing mdzes pa thob/ /de nas dus kyis nor 'dzin gyi/ /bdag las de yis mngal bzung zhing / /tsid+dhā sha bye tsa saṃ sak+ta man+taḥpu ra ba dhū dza naḥ/ /ā san+da pra sa pā pho brang btsun mo'i skye bo yis/ /bsam pas chags pa'i zug rngu yang / /de nas khyim du mdzes ma ni/ /muspyo ta tasta me t+ya man+di re/ /kau ṭi l+ya kru ra māt+par+ya byu tser rdzu ga nā dza btsar nye de la mngon phyogs te/ /gya gyu gdug stipa'i phrag dog las/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams kyis naḥ / /pra sha ba su bi dhi musnye na dzā m+bi ye dṛ po tsi tai/ /dza na bhā hi su ta sru smras—/ /mi bdag la 'os btsa' ba yi/ /cho ga rmongs ma khyod mi shes/ /ma yi mig ni gos dag gis/ /te par+bhe na pi hi te k+ṣa khyo/ /i kyughā sā sa pasnri bhiḥthra bhā gar+bha bha rārdi bsgribs la bu ni btsa' bar bya/ /zhes pa btsun mo gzhan gyis spyesmras/ /mngal rgyas khur gyis zhugazir ba tā / /u tsi haṃ bha ba tī r+bhas+thā kri ya tā mi h+phu bā tsa tā/ /ta tastu bhim+bi des—/ /khyod kyis bdag la 'os pa ni/ /mdzod ces de dag rnams la smras/ /de nas de dag rnams rud+dhā spyi dṛ bhā badhe na bā pa sā/ /sā sru ta bā la yu ga lo pra tap+ta kyis mig /ras kyis ④dam du bcings pas bkab/ /btso ma gser gyi 'od ldan pa'i/ /byis pa zung ka na ka pra sgo/ /j-i tā to bsta bi hi te mañdzu ṣe gru bhā mu dṛ te/ /gi ni de las ⑤btsas/ /gzhon nu de dag sgrom bur bcug /gos kyis dkris shing rgya spyobatab nas/ /bud gā dza le niḥka ru ṇaḥku mā ro bik+ṣip+ta ste yaḥ/ /kṛ tā rak+tak+ta ba da med snying rje med rnams kyis/ /gang klushā'i chu la gsang ste 'phangs/ /pad+ma can gdong khrag gis ni/ /nā rū tsuḥpad+mā ba ṭī tsa tāḥ/ /sha ka la dwa ya ma sudze+e dzā tai te k+ṣibe+e oṃ bha se/ /bsgos te de dag gis smras pa/ /khyod la dum bu g.yo med gnyis/ /btsas pa dag ni chu la 'phangs/ /95byed849

ma tiḥ/ /sgo gārnyaḥpra bha baḥswa bhā ba su la bha shrī pi bh+ra mo྾ kha lāḥbar 'gyur/ /rje bo ①longs spyod kyis long rang bzhin byis smod ⑤dpal gyi rnam 'phrul ldan zhing 'phyar/ /sa t+ya bya t+ya ya bhū ma yo yu ba ta yaḥpu rgyu bhi tsā ra kri yāḥ/ /swa ts+tshan+d+rabyu na chung bden pa nyams pa'i sa gzhi bsod nams mngon par 'joms pa'i bya ba can/ /phra ma ldan pa dang ta bā da nabyu pi shu nāḥkhe tsi tra kasgro r+ya tā ya tre ka tra ba sarnyi ta tra pa ra 'dun ①rmad byung smra byed mkha' la ri mo'i las sbyor rnams/ /gang du nges par rnam par gnas pa der ④laḥsā dhuḥka the dz+re ba ti/ /an+tarti ta ta no di byāḥkhrute ti ba tsa saṃ dṛ paḥ/ /ku ni dam pa drang po ji ltar 'tsho/ /lha mo lus ni ⑤mi snang ba'i⑥ / /tshig de thos nas sa bdag ni/ /khros pi ta ta su z-isnre tai sa pratshwan+taḥpu dzā ga nāḥ/ /kro dh+wa krān+ta gya dṛ pa te ste bra pas de yi byung tshul dag /btsun mo'i tshogs la rab tu dris/ /khro bas non pa ⑦mi bdag gi/ /bka' shā sa na shaṃ ki tāḥ/ /tā ni bi r+ya ya thā bṛr+ghaṃ ba bhū bur+bha ya bi hwa ni drag pos dogs khyegyur pa/ /de dag gis ni byung tshul bzhin/ /bshad nas ⑨'jigs pas 'khrugs lāḥ—/ /nirdoṣe da yi hūṃ dzñā tā pa pasbyi bañtsi tsā dṛ paḥ/ /ba dh+ya byu par gyur/ /chun mas bslus pa'i btsun mo ni/ /gsod sar rab tu btang ba dag /skyon med shes mi sa mudṛ ṣ+ṭha shu sho tsā nu sha yā ku laḥ/ /rā ga kro sgo kṛ pā ladz+dza sho nas mi yi bdag /'gyod pas gzir bas mya ngan byas/ /mtshungs par stobs rgyas chags dang khro/ /kaistu l+ya ba lo da yiḥ/ /sa mu hum+bi ha pa tsi baiṭ+wā gī kṛ ta i bā bha brtse bas ngo tsha mya ngan dang spyo/ /rmongs pa'i grogs kyis ⑪yang yang du/ /de ni bskal par byas bzhin bta—/ /hā thra ye tī na pu 5 su kwa pu naḥsaṃ ga masta yā/ /ma me gyur—/ /kyi hud dga' ma khyod dang ni/ /phyi nas bsod nams dman pa dgaspyo /gang du 'grogs pa kyughā na ra pa tim+bi pa pā ta ma tī ta le/ /a tha shaṃ gā pra bā sāste mdzi ṣe zhes brjod nas/ /mi bdag sa la 'gyel bar gyur/ /de nas gang spyogā'i rgyun thob pa/ /sgom du ④rgyal 95—851

dzā la dz+re ba rnaḥ/ /ā dā ya rā dza mu dzā ka mā ya yur+bhe ba rāḥs dzñā/ /po'i rtags mtshan can/ /nya pa rgya yis 'tsho ①rnams kyis/ /bzung nas mdun sar yang dag 'ongs/ /tairgyuste pu ra tasta smin sa ha sosnyo ṭi ta dzu paḥ/ /da dar+sha bā la yu ga lo de dag gis de mdun bkod cing / /'phral la mi bdag gis bye tshe/ /pad+mo gsar pa'i 'od ldan pa'i/ /pra t+ya ga ka ma la pra sgo/ /tu l+ya rū po dṛ pa gya mo sa ha 4 sho ri bā shi no/ /byis pa zung zhig mthong bar gyur/ /'od stong pa yi tha skar bzhin/ /gzhon nu 'di dag mi bdag gi/ /ku mā ro lak+ṣa ḍo dā do dzā tā bi ti dza na swa naḥ/ /ta taḥs bāt+pa gzugs mtshungs mtshan nyid rgya che bar/ /skyes zhes skye bos rab tu bsgrags②/ /de nas sa bdag mchi ta na yo kṛ tī hūṃ ke ma tī pa tiḥ/ /thra yā bi ra hā sho kārtaḥsad+dhā pa ma ma dang / /btsas pas sras dag pang du blangs/ /dga' ma dang bral mya ngan byus/ /gzir ba'i gdung bye rka ya yo/ /a tha dīr+gha ma tirtswa ma ma hā mā t+yasta ma bra bīta/ /de ba dz+re ba lhag par gyur/ /de nas blo gros ring zhes pa'i①/ /blon po chen pos de la smras/ /lha gcig khyod kyi ba ti pasbyi pa pasbyi dza na bañtsi tā/ /khru tī tat+pa ha sā rā dzā lad+dhā dz+re ba btsun mo ni/ /chun ma'i tshogs kyis bslus pa 'tsho/ /de thos 'phral la rgyal po ni/ /'tsho ba thob pa i bobyu ta/ /dṛṣ+ṭaḥsan+dar+sha ye t+yāghā pra ya yo madh+ri man+di re/ /ta tra bzhin du langs/ /dga' bas ston zhes brjod nas ni/ /blon po'i khang par rab tu song / /der ni tsā duḥkhi hūṃ dṛṣ+ṭha ma rgyu bi smṛ ta saṃ bh+ra rmā/ /a ba pā na sa mujurgyu dza gā da sdug bsngal ldan pa de/ /khro bas gus pa brjed gyur cing / /smad pas kun tu yid byung ma/ /mthong dza ga tī pa tiḥ/ /yi re ṣa bi ṣa maḥbye ṣaḥthra ye ta ba bi nim+bi ta/ /nas 'gro ba'i bdag gis smras/ /gang gis mi bzad lhag ma ni(pya/ /dga' ma khrod la rnam sprul pa/ /e hi pa shā dhu zla te ྾ bi tsitra ba dha be sha saṃ/ /pra sī da t+ya dza saṃ tā tshur shog da ni de dag rnams/ /gsod ⑤pa'i sdug bsngal dka' la ltos/ /gdung ba thong la dang bar 95—852

paṃ mā mo nā bhi mu khi bha ba/ /i kyughā ni pa bā tā sngaḥpā da yoḥthra thi bī mdzod—/ /mi smra mngon ①du phyogs ma byed/ /ces brjod de yi rkang pa la/ /sa yi bdag po rnam par pa tiḥ/ /sā ba dbyet+pa ṅgā ri nyi ṣi tsu mā non+da tasta m+bi/ /na ren+d+ra mā kṛ thāḥko saṃ 'gyel—/ /nu ma rgyas pa mchi ma yi/ /rgyun gyis ④bran byed des smras pa/ /skye bo mi bzad gnod byed la/ /dza ṣ+pe tī zwa pa kā ri ṇi/ /pa h+ye bi thra ya kā ri ṭ+wā 6 dṛ pa te ma rgyurna mi dbang khro ba yongs ①ma mdzad/ /mi bdag bden par dga' dang bral bar byed pa rnams la bdag ni me bi r+ya te bai re hik+ṣa ma yi ba yā tru pa sha oṃ bai re ṇa tabor+bha te/ /khro yod min/ /nges par bzod pas dgra ni nye bar zhi 'gyur ④khon gyi de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sha bye nai ba bi bhuḥpa rā bha ba ba sgo be+e po pa kā re su kṛta sadz+re pāk+ta na kadz+re nim+bi gnod pa bsgrub ⑤la dgra ni khyab bdag ma yin nges par grogs ni phan la min/ /lus can rnams kyi bde ta mi rda duḥkhā hi ka de he rmā/ /kṛ tā pa kā re bi pa rā bha bor+ya dang sdug bsngal 'di dag thams cad sngon gyi las kyis ⑥sprul/ /gnod pa byed pa la yang gnod pa'i sbyor oṃ na nā ma kur+yā da bi tsār+ya budhi mān/ /kru dh+wa pa ram̐ kro dha bi ṣe bi ba dag /ma dbe+ed par ni blo gros ldan pas mi bya ste/ /khros pas mchog tu khro ba'i dug ni 'phel bar bsgo te na shārnyi me ti dz+wa li toghi raldi nā/ /duḥkha saṃ tā pi tā tā 'gyur—/ /me nyid mnan ⑦ pas me ni zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /re zhig sdug bsngal gyis gdungs khyabadag /baṭ+wā ta gye be ta po ba rna/ /gasgo mi tarja tsaḥpūbye kā mi t+yā na kṛ tasma yā/ /yab kyi dka' thub tshal nyid du/ /'gro de de tshig 'dod ldan ma/ /bdag gis sngon tshe yongs po7 ma byas/ /bā ri tā pi pa ratre na ma ma kā mā pha la smṛ hā/ /yo ba nod+mā da do ṣe ṇa bdag ni 'dod 'bras la chags pa/ /de yis ⑩rab tu zlog ⑪gyur kyang / /lang tshos myos pa'i skyon gyis na ni bṛṣ+ṭha ka ro mi ki/ /i kyughā ni shwa sarnyi sā bi li khaṭī pā dā bhu baṃ/ /ni⑫—/ /zlog par ma gyur ci zhig bya/ /zhes brjod de ni shugs 'byin cing / /rkang pa yis ni sa la 'bri//95—853

byedab byu ba na mra bad nā k+ṣa khaṃ mo nā ba lam+bi bhā/ /pra shā me nā pi dṛ pa skad cig bzhin ras dud pa yis1/ /mi smra ba la brten par gyur/ /mi bdag gis ni phyag byas kyang / /terna sā s+thā pa sra pan+da tsā/ /sre: sha l+ya tu dze+e dhaste mi byā do ṣa pa ri gra de ni rab dang nyid ma gyur/ /rdzun gyi skyon ni yongs bzung rtege/ba/ /mdza' ba'i zug rngu mtshungs par haḥ—/ /sā dh+wa tu rak+ta ba sanā dza gā ma pi tu rā shra oṃ/ /bhu dzi ga ko ṭi 'dzin / /de ni dmar ba'i bzhin bzung nas/ /yab kyi bste gnas dag tu song / /khengs ldan rnams lo ma rgyus+thā ni rmā sa hi duḥs haḥ/ /ā lo gya mā ṣ+pe ba la tā sa khri bhidh+ri kyi khro ba ni/ /lag 'gro gya gyu de bzod dka'/ /bung ba'i sgra yis dge legs brjod pa yi/ /'khri shing ga swa ṣ+peḥswā ga ta ba di bhā bheḥ/ /pre: mṛ gī bhiḥpa ri bar+ya mā ṇ+ḍata ta po grogs mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /ri dwags rnams kyi mdza' bas yongs bskor zhing / /pha yi ba rna sā pi tu rā pa sā da/ /yā ti mu no pu rgya ni dho pra san+dan+ta pa bi she ṣārdzi dka' thub nags su de phyin gyur/ /dka' thub khyad par gyis bsgrubs 'jig rten ni/ /dang bar thub ta me ba lo ke/ /dṛṭī shra oṃ shu n+ya ma dh+wa ra bṛt+ta ཿpad+mā ba tī mo ha pa bsod nams gter song tshe/ /bste gnas stong mthong 'tsho ba mi brtan ①pa'i/ /pad+mo can ni rmongs ha tā ba byu ba/ /bāt+pa l+ya mā dzad+ma ni lī na man+taḥswas+tha swa bhā ba mya pi tuḥpas bcom par gyur/ /rang bzhin rnal gnas pha yi mnyes ④gshin dang / /skye ba'i bar ni nang du sma rarnyi/ /shu t+yā ste lo ki mi ba ma n+yamā nā bi ṣārdi te bā nyi ha te ba gcags pa dran/ /'jig rten gsum bzhin stongs ⑤par sems shing ⑥de/ /dug gis gzir bzhin sbrul sā byuta/ /ta de ba ta snga mu ni nā ba tī rna baṃ rna dza gā ma pri yo two gyis ( )bcom bzhin gyur/ /thub pas dman pas 2nags tshal de nyid ni/ /de la dga' ba dga' min kā le na/ /niḥshe ṣa ni spru ta sā ra bha brnyi ra ha swa bhā bā bi ra ha swa bhā nyid du gyur/ /dus kyi snying po ma lus 'thungs gyur pa'i/ /dngos po rnams ni 'bral ba'i rang bzhin 95 854

ba—/ /te ṣe ba de she 6 ma no ha re 6 te ṣi ba puṣ+ka ka ra bā sa re 6/ /e ke yin / /yid 'phrog yul ni de dag kho na dang / /me tog 'byung gnas nyin par de dag nyid/ /su zhig na ke na pi bi nā dza na su saza bi ṣā dā spa da tā mu bai ti/ /be+e shaṃ ta taḥpra gcig dang bral ba'i skye bo la/ /thams cad chags bral gnas nyid dag tu 'gyur/ /de nas sa gzhi dag bra dzi tā nu rū paṃ bi dh+wa ya sā bhū ta la tsan+d+ra re khā/ /su khosgo ta dik+ṣu pa gi zla ris te/ /rab byung rjes su mthun pa'i chas bzung nas/ /bde bas btang ste phyogs su yongs ri bh+ra maṭī bā rā ṇa sī shārnyi mi bā pa pā da/ /ta tā tha rā dzñā kṛ tī nā m+bi 'khyam ①zhing / /zhi bar ①bzhin du bā rā ṇa sīr laphyin/ /de nas rgyal po kṛ tī ④'dod ldan pas/ /gā k+ṣ-i pa prabye mā nā su bhi lā ṣa bhā dzā/ /ta paḥpra dīp+tasdi shi khe ba ta su saṃ der ni ri dwags mig de don gnyer yang / /dka' thub me lce 'bar bzhin de yis ⑤/ni/ /ji zhig ltar spar+sha yo gyu na ka dze+e tsi dā spruta/ /sā rā dza basbyi bhi ra ti pra yat+na da sgyu tsu mā na tri da yang reg 'os nyid ma gyur/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams kyis rab 'bad nas/ /mngon par mchod cing shaṃ ga ṣ+pe ba/ /ta tra su thrat+ta ni tsin ta yaṭī pa ti bra tā kā la mu pā sa lha mo bzhin du de/ /legs spyod sems shing ④bdag po'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /der ni cung zad dus ke tsita/ /tsā brah+ma dasto pi bi shiṣ+ṭa tsā rasta tra sbi tā khyu mi pa tim+bi sha mya/ /shig nye bar gnas/ /'bral ba'i sdug bsngal mo yis sdesreg byed cing / /de ni de na gnas pa sa yi bdag /bi yo ga duḥkhā na la da hra mā naḥs mā ya yo brah+ma ṇa ku ṭa be shaḥ/ /a tshangs byen gyis kyang nyan rna bsrings las thos/ /bram ze'i chas su bcos nas yang dag 'ongs/ /de tha bra tā tshwa di ta tsā ru be shaṃ bi lo kya hūṃ shī la ya shaḥpa tā shaṃ/ /nas brtul zhugs mdzes pa'i chas kyis —)bsgribs/ /tshul khrims grags pa'i ba dan de mthong nas/ /pra sā da nā ya pra ṇa yā bhi pā rī dṛ paḥswa rū paṃ pra ka ṭī tsa kā ra/ /tī dang ba'i slad du mi bdag gus par ni/ /mngon du phyogs pas rang gzugs gsal bar byasaḍasgo/ /sa 95 —855

zwa pa sgo ha mi ti bru bā ṇi na ma tī pa to pā su tsi re ru ro da/ /ma na sri byā nā bdag bdag gi gnod pa mi bzad pa/ /zhes smra tshe na de ni yun ring tu7dus/ /khengs ldan rnams kyis ma ba khā na ma rgyu ru dī ra ṇi nā pi na ba twa me ti/ /gha nā khru dh+wa rā pa ri hā ra kā rī smad pa'i khro ba ni/ /brjod pa na yang gsar pa nyid du 'gyuras7/ /stug po mchi ma'i rgyun ni yongs sel sma ren+d+ra re khaṃ sa pha lbo kṛ tā shaḥ/ /kān+d+ra sha raṭ+wā la i ba pra pā r+ya zhing / /'dod pa'i zla ris phyogs su 'bras ldan byed/ /rgyal po ston dus lta bus mjos ma ni/ /dang ni nā ya rā dzā ni dza rā dza dh+wa dī/ /pā dzā bu dza t+yā pa pa ro dza mā lī bi yo ga bar byas nas rang gi rgyal sar khrid/ /rkang pa'i pad+mo 0bkod pa'i mtsho skyes 'phreng (pya/ /bral ba'i dus su kā le pra sha oṃ pā yā tā/ /pā durba bhu ba pri ya saṃ ga me s+thāḥsaṃ sgo ga lasmro ri ba rab tu zhi grur pa/ /dga' dang 'grogs tshe de la rab 'khrungs te/ /chags pa drag po'i longs spyod dpal gā shwe rā gā/ /dzad+mān+ta re pā ki la ka n+ya ke pa pra t+ya ka bud+dhā ya bi la sa pad+me/ /da 'byor bzhin/ /skye ba gzhan las nges par sribu mo des/ /rang sangs rgyas la rtse dga'i pad+ma dag /phul twa pi lo bhāh+phu na rā da de taji tsār+ya sho dzñā pra da do pu na:/ /pad+ma nas chags pas blangs te de yis 6ni/ /mdzes par spyad penas slar yang de yis ni/ /rab tu ṅku7phul pra dā ṣ+pe na ba byu bu ra sngaḥpā dā ba tā re 6 sa ro ru hā ṇi/ /ā dā no do ṣābyi bas 'di yi rkang pa ni/ /bkod pa rnams la mtsho skyes 'khrungs par gyur/ /blangs pa'i skyon las dus su ra tā ni kā le pu naḥpra dā nātru na ruṅga tā ni/ /te ṣ+pe ba daṭ+wā ha ra ḍodha bral gyur cing / /slar yang phul bas slar yang byung bar gyur/ /byen dang len pa de dag las 'khrungs pa/ /be+e na swa kan+d+ra pā ke na ma lī ma se 6/ /pad+mā ba tī ba dh+ya pa rda bi seṣ+ṭa me+e rang las smin pa yis de skyon rnams la/ /pad+mo can de she7gsod pa'i gnas btang ste/ /dus kyis ⑫da lta bā r+ya kā le na ya sho dha rā tsa/ /shu te ti sabye ka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na tsā tsi tra hūṃ grags 'dzin ma yang ngo / / las kyi 'bras bu rgyas pa'i bkra ba de/ / nyu1de skad rgyal bas gsungs pa thos 95—856

— byed——— —— —— ——— byed—— ———— — ——kadz+re pha lo da ya su/ /ba bhū bu rābyar+ya pa ri gra te ṇa tsi tā bhe lī nā i ba gyur nas/ /dge slong de dag thams cad ngo mtshar ni/ /yongs su 'dzin pas ri mor bkod bzhin gyur/ /bhik+ṣa ba ste/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa khye)dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing la tā lnga pad+mā pa t+yā ba dā na maṣ+ṭi ṣaṣ+ṭi ta maḥpal+la baḥ// //las pad+ma ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //te ṣā ma she ṣa ku sha la pra ṇi dh+wa na dh+wa: shudhaḥsu kha sbi ti ra yi gang gi ②spyod pa'i khyad par mtho ba'i mtshan nyid ldan rnams kyisasnye/ /legs byas dag ni mchod tsa pa ra : lo ka ཿ / / ye ṣā m+bi she ṣa tsa ri to n+da ta la k+ṣa shā rmā rten ldan pa'i nor 'dzin mas smra zhing / /ma lus dge ba'i smon lam gnas su gyur pa de dag ni/ /tsi t+yā nī tā ba su ma tī su kṛ haṃ bra bī ti / / pu re pa ṭa li pu tre 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan yang dag cing bde ba bstan par gyur 0/ /grong khyer pa 5tra li pu trar/ /bhū da sho kaḥthra thi bi pa tiḥ/ /ye nā sho kaḥkṛ to lo kaḥs myashrī la nā gang gis ⑥yang dag bskyangs bsrungs pas/ /'jig rten mya ngan med byed pa/ /sa bdag mya ngan med pā li taḥ/ /bi jo ya bo dhi mu pa rna ye na kāñtsa na ba r+ṣa ṇa/ /tri ṭī pa byung / /byang chub slad du khrus bsgrubs nas/ /gang gis (r+ṣagaser gyi char 'bebs shing / /chos gos ba rāts+tsha da ṣ+pe na bhikyu saṃ sgo bhi pū dzi ta ཿ / /mā n+yaḥ snga dut+ta maḥ shrī gsum ni 'gebs pa yis/ /dge slong dge 'dun rnam 2par mchod/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas sku yi ni/ /mār+ya sha pa s+tha bi ra gya paḥ/ /a tī ta budhe sha rī ra dh+wa tū rmā dīp+ta te ring bsrel gzi bajid 'bar rnams dang / /bla med dpal ldan gnas brtan ni/ /grags pa de yis rtedza tsā/ /a naspyo shā tsa rat+na dzā kṛ tā saṃ gra ha mā da rāta/ /bi da dhe mchod byar gyur/ /rin thang med pa'i rin cen larnams/ /gus pas bsdu ba byas nas ni/ /sa gzhi mu 95 857

mo t+ta ts+tshan+d+ra tsā ru tse dh+yā ki tī ma ṭī/ / nā ga lo rka swa yo ga tā tig gdugs mdzes kyi/ /mchod rten dag gis mtshan pa tsho)bsgrubs/ /rang nyid klu yi 'jig rten du/ /sau ga tai dh+wa tu sañtsa ya/ /sa nā gā kṛ ta mā dā ya rat+na snyu pā ba bī phyin nas bde gshegs ring bsrel tshogs/ /klu yis byin pa blangs nas de/ /rin cen ⑤mchod rten bya dh+wata/ / ta s+thā shī ti sā ha pā ṇi tsa tā ri tsa ma tī ta le/ /dhan+d+ra 'phreng 7ba byas/ /de yi mchod rten chos rgyal gyis④/ /lugs dang ldan pa stong phrag ni/ /brgyad cu rtsa rā dze+e ka yugh+ra rmā snyu pā ā+oṃ ṣ+pem+bi tai ba r+bha/ /e ka k+ṣa ṇa pra ti jo su thra bzhi dus gcig la/ /sprul pa yis 'ani rnam par mdzes/ /dus gcig rab tu gnas pa la/ /de tshe thi dh+yā sba bi ra sta dā/ /kha mu pe t+yatshwa mātshwa r+yasgo ya saṃ dzñā ma kalpa yata/ /gnas brtan mkhar 5song nas/ /nyi ma bsgribs te sa gzhi ni/ /grib ma'i 'du shes dag tu brtags(⑩ / /ni t+ya pra briste ta snga tha bi ta te saṃ gha sgo dza ṣ+pe/ /sha be+eḥpra pra dzi taḥkash+yidz+dza de nas de yi dge 'dun gyi/ /mchod ston rgya che rtag 'dzugs la/ /rab byung rga (pe bas 'khogs gyur pa/ /rā dz+reṇ+ḍiḥs mā ya yo/ /rā dzāhaṃ ma sha nan+ta tra pre ṣi tai sa ma tī bhu dzā/ /'ga' zhig dal gyis 7'ongs par gyur/ /der ni rgyal po la 'os zas/ /sa yi bdag pos rab springs pa//bye dzā naḥpa ra rmā drwa ti mā pa pā da su dh+wa mi ba/ /tī pā hā n+ya ta mo bhik+ṣu ra za zhing mchog tu dga' ba ni/ /bdud rtsi bzhin du de yis ⑩thob/ /dge slong gzhan gyis de la smras/ /pi dzā nā bi bhū bhu dzā/ /ki mdze+e swo tsi tā mi rda tu bye sgo bye mu dā z-i tam/ /rang la 'os pa'i bza' ba 'di/ /khyod la sa bdag gis byen pa/ /ci yi don slad khyod shes sam/ /a ti bṛzlon+ta rā twat+taḥsadhadz+re sho tu myukhru kaḥ/ /twa ma ts+tsha ya ti bhu pā laḥshin tu rgan pa khyod nyid las/ /dam chos nyan dang nyuspe'adod pa yi8/ /sa skyong gis ni bkur ste dag /saṭ+wā re ṇa ma ṭī ya sā/ /i ti smi ta mu khe nolto bhigru shā mokhye ladzhai taḥ/ /shin tu che bas khyod la mchod/ /ces pa bzhin 'dzum dge slong gis/ /brjod tshe rmongs pas ngo tsha zhing / /95—858

————ni dā mu dā k+ṣa ṇa ma pi dṛ sho ri t+ya sasto sa multe she ṣe t+yaghā bra dza ti bi pu mig dag gnyid kyi rgya ri skad cig gis kyang 'di nyid rgyun du ni/ /nyer /gemakho lhag ma btang nas lus can khā ram̐ bha sgo shaṃ sha rī rī/ /i ti de byā sa mā diṭ+wā thradheḥyaṣ+ṭa ta ra swa longs spyod rtsom pa rgya cher 'gyur/ /zhes pa lha mos yang dag bstan/ /rab gsal dbyangs can rgan po raḥ—/ /sho rtu pāsta su bhu bhaskyobe+e da dhe dha1 de sha dzā/ /rā dzā z-i da ya saṃ bā yis—/ /sa bdag nyan du 'ongs pa la/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa mdzad/ /snying la bab ②pa de yi ni/ /di shu tā ta gya su bhā ṣi tai/ /a tsin+ta ya da ho sa t+ya mi da muste mā nī ṣi legs bshad rgyal pos thos gyur nas/ /kye ma mkhas pa ④brjod gyur pa/ /'di ni bden zhes rab tu zla —/ /ma ma bai ta ta sa myurnyi sh+ya hi ta mā ha ma hā ma tiḥ/ /ta twa bsams—/ /blo gros chen pos bdag nyid kyi/ /ched du phan pa 'di dag gsungs/ /de nyid brjod pa ba swā da sā swā dāḥpu 5 pā byāḥs hūṃ gi raḥ/ /yasko she 6 ni dhī ya te dam pa'i tshig /nyams myong bsod nams dag gis thob④/ /gang gi dumadzod rnams su ni me yi bud shing dha na ba rna dṛ ṭī na la srernya rna kṛ bye yartso tsa tuḥs mu dra ba sa rmā byāsno ti bi shaṃ du mthong nor gyi nags dag bsgrubs/ /gang yang bya bas rgya mtsho bzhi yi gos can sna tshogs 'dzin pa khyab bha dzā/ /ā hā ro pi bi tsi tra tā pa ri tsi bī ni dru pi me byu ya sī sarde mo par byas/ /zas kyang rnam par bkra la yongs su 'dris shing bdag gi gnyid kyang shin tu che/ /thams ha su khā ya nān+ta sa ma ye ki tsishwe tsidṛ sh+ya te/ /i ti saṃ tsiṣ+ṭha gru pa cad rmongs pa'i bde be+ed mjug ⑥gi dus su gang du ci yang mthong ma yin/ /zhes bsams mi yi ⑦bdag tista smi kāñtsa na ba stso tai/ /pra ṇa mya pra da do tsā ru ru tsi ma: ba dzā po yis98/ /de la rab tu phyag 'tshal te/ /'od ldan mdzes pa'i chos gos ni/ /gser gyis rab tu spras shu rka/ /pra dzan+ta ma tha tai mārgo rā dza pū dzā bi rā dzi tai/ /dh+yā nā dh+ya ya na pa phul/ /de nas lam du 'gro she byed cing / /rgyal po'i mchod pas mazos pa de/ /bsam gtan kha ton 95 — 860

yo gā ya de ba tā pa ma tso da yata/ /ta tasta du pa de she na ni khi la sbyor ba'i slad/ /lha mo yis 6)ni yang dag bskul/ /de nas de yi man ngag gis/ /de yis labasam kle sha saṃ k+ṣa yāta/ /pā k+ṣabe+e hi ta marta two te na dh+yā nā ba dha ni nā/ /ka gtan bsgrubs pa na/ /nyon mongs ma lus zad pa las/ /dgra bcom nyid ni mngon du bsgrubs/ /de dā tsi da tha bhū bhan+d+ram+bi pu le saṃ gha sgo dza ṣ+pe/ /na baḥs mā ya yo bhik+ṣu rdi nas nam zhig sa bdag gis①/ /dge 'dun mchod ston yangs pa la/ /dge slong chos gos lha yi ni/ /bya sau ra bha ṭī ba raḥ/ /a pūrba gan+dha lud+dhā ni mā lī ba la yi tai dṛ paḥ/ /dri bzang ④ldan pa gsar du 'ongs/ /sngon med dri la chags pa yi/ /bung ba'i 'phreng ⑤bas bskor de la//tai ma thrats+tshad+ku tastu ba da yi te sau ra sgo da bha baḥ/ /po ba da de ba lo ke haṃ mi bdag gis dris khyed kyi dri/ /rgyas ⑥'di re zhig gang las byung / /des smras lha yi 'jig rten gyi/ /pā ri dzā ta ta ro sta le/ /u ṣi to bābhā shaṃ kā lo tah+phu ྾ ra bye ba pi taḥ/ /yangs ⑦'du ljon pa'i 'og tu bdag /dbyar gyi dus su gnas gyur pa/ /de yi me tog dag gis bsgos/ /e ta dā kārdzu dri pa tistata pra bha bā bye kā da raḥ/ /rat+na tra yāts+tsha na pak+taḥde thos mi bdag de yi ni/ /mthu la lhag par gus gyur cing / /dkon cog gagasum mchod la chags pa/ /pu sgyu rā ma ra to bha ba ta/ /dha1 sbri nyi bra ṇa yi rmā ya di mai ba dṛ ta bsod nams kun rar dga' bar gyur/ /gal te gus par chos la gnas 1ṣ+pen de nyid 'tsho ba yin/ /tiḥs tro pa sgo ga su bha go ya di me+e ba bā bhā/ /par+yan ta tsin+ta na ra tā ya di me+e gal te skal bzang bden par spyod na de nyid smra ba yin/ /gal te mthar thug sems par byed na de nyid pa burnyirdu na kri yo pa ka ra rde ya di be+e ba lasmreḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra blo gros yin/ /gal te sbyin pa'i bya ba byed na de nyid dpal 'byor yin/ /zhes pa de hārnye ru tsi rā tsā bi jo yi nā/ /ma yā tabhu l+ya bhā bābye pra ṇi dh+wa na ma nyiḥkṛ tā//pa'i mchod pa bsgrubs byas te/ /de mtshungs nyid ni thob pa'i slad/ /bdag gis smon lam blo gros byas//te nā haṃ pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na tat+pa ma bh+ya dzñā ṣ+pe na tsa/ /sa shā ṇa ban+t+raḥsaṃ dzā taḥshā ṇa smon lam de dang de la ni/ /yang dag mchod pa yis kyang bdag /shā na'i gos dang ldan par skyes/ /shā bā r+pā ti bi khru taḥ/ /i t+yāghā sa sha ṣ+pergats+tshan+da bāt+pa ma thu dzā pu rī/ /na'i gos can zhes su grags/ /zhes brjod bcom brlag grong khyer du/ /phyin cing dal gyis ①'gro ba u ru muṇ+ḍa bhi sgo she la mā ru ro ha ma hor+ya maḥ/ /ta tro pa pi sh+ya parlo des—/ /mgo chen zhes pa'i ri bo la/ /rtsom pa chen po dag gis 'dzeg— /der ni sa gzhi 'dar byed ka babye nā kam+bi ta k+ṣi tiḥ/ /be+e dī ya be+esna pan+dasgo nā go tu mu la pa'i(kye—/ /skyil krung bcas te nye bar 'khod/ /char chen 'bebs pa'i klu dag ni/ /bgegs la chas pa babhā ṇi/ /ma thu rā bā se no grebye su to na ṭa bhaṭ+wā bhilja/ /ā dā ya rnam par btul④/ /bcom brlag la gnas tshong dpon bu/ /na ṭa bha ṭa zhes bya ba/ /grogs kyi sbad du sa khya kṛ t+yā ya sa bi hā re bi nin+d+ra me/ /rah+pho dz+wa la spa ṭi ka kāñtsa na ra mya bzung nas ni/ /de yi ⑤gtsug lag khang par sprul/ /rin cen 'urab 'bar shel dang gser gyi ba gam harmeḥparlo ka r+pā tha ra tsa nā sha ya nā rnyi rā maḥ/ /sargo pa maḥswa bha dag dang ldan/ /khri dang khri'u mal stan dag gis spras shing mngon par dga'/ /mtho ris lta bu skal ga sgo ga ṇi bhebi hā raḥpu ju sbi tirna ṭa bha ṭa bhi dha e ba po byuṭa / /bzang longs spyod gter byi gtsug lag khang / /bsod nams gnas pa de ni na ṭa bha ṭa zhes par gyur/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī shā ṇa bā s+thā ba dā na zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing me ka sap+ta ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //las shā na'i gos can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //95byed865
