la dze+e ku ba la ya gre bya pra de lo tsa ṣ+pe/ /naidz+re mo da yi tai ma no ha ra ta re byed mig ni ut+pal dag la dman pa ster byed pa/ /shin tu yid 'phrog de dag rnams la bdag ni mi dga' ki tu pra yaṭ+wā da haṃ kā mā dzā pra kṛ 1 bi tsā ra be+e ra sī drabye sa ma sgyu ga taḥ/ /'on kyang 'bad pas bdag /rnam par spyad na snasnaro dang bral ba 'dod pa rnams kyi rang bzhin lta ru 'ongs//be+e bhū ṣa khaṃ shu kats+tshadze+e ba ra sau ra bha bā se te/ /sho bhā ta bā bha baṭ+wā ye rgyan dang gos kyis rngozherab bsgribs shing / /dri bzang mchog gis rab bsgos pa/ /khyod kyi lus ni mdzes swa bhā baḥpu na rī dṛ shaḥ/ /ba ta ba ta ni ha tāste tīṇ+ḍi ke shāsbi saṃ sbe pa dag /slar yang rang bzhin 'di 'drar gyur/ /skra dang rus pas gang ba'i dbyibs can rtag tu me pa te ta ma na la tā po t+pa tsu mā nā khi waṃ ge / / ku ṇa pa ba yis ni/ /yan lag ma lus rab 'tshed rnag khrag dang ldan smad pa'i gnas/ /lus kyi ming can dur ti ra maṭ+wā ye dzu gud+mā ni ṅgā ṣ+pe bya sa na ga ṇa ni dh+wa ṣ+pe kā ya nām+bithra shā ṣ+pe/ /khrod sdug bsngal tshogs kyi gter dag la/ /gang gi ④dga' ba de dag kyi hud kyi hud brlag par 'gyur2 //ba ྾n+di ni du rā mo de bi kṛ ta spyo dā saṃ ku le/ /a ho mo hād+ma nu t+yā rde kye ma rmongs las mi 6rnams ni/ /rnam par zag cing dri nga can/ /rnam 'gyur bug pas gang gyur pa'i//kā ye pi pri ya bhā ba nā/ /pā pā yaḥkā ya paspye ya mā yā bi ṣa ma saṃ shra lus po la yang dga' ba bsgom/ /bde gshegs nye bar bsten pa las/ /lus kyi rnam grangs gnod pa yaḥ —/ / duḥkha skan+dhaḥk+ṣa yo yā ti su ga to pā pa nā da yi/ /mo ha can—/ /mi bzad sgyu ma dag gi gnas/ /sdug bsngal phung po 'di zad 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa dhūn+ta di bā ka ra gya sa ka la kle shā ba bā sa sbyi daḥshāstuḥshā sa na saṃ shra ye pra ṇi hi tai dag gi nyin byed nyon mongs gnas skabs mtha' dag gcod byed pa/ /ston pa'i bstan pa'i gnas la gang ka spyo ṇa mi tra su me+eḥ/ /ṣ+pe ba klin+da pu naḥka ram̐ ka ka li le ṭ+wāṭ+wān+t+ra dag gis ni dge ba'i grogs kyi smon lam btab/ /de dag lus zhes brjod pa'i dmyal ba dman pa'i keng 95—870

mu bā tsa kṛ tāñdza liḥ/ /kṛ taḥkṛ tā pa rā dha gya twa yā ta du tsi tasma ma/ /pra sī thal sbyar de la rab smras pa/ /gnod pa byas pa bdag la ni/ /yang dag 'os pa khyod kyis byas/ /da ni da t+ya bye tāsma rgyu ra zlu nā haṃ twa dā shra yaḥ/ /a haṃ kṛ tā pa rā sgo pi su khyod la bdag brten pas/ /khro ba thong la bka' drin mdzod/ /bdag gis gnod pa byas mod kyang / /ga te na ma hād+ma rmā/ / a pi m+bi ta ta raḥ sru nurdza na ke ṣ+pe ba bde gshegs bdag nyid chen po yis/ /bu ni rnam par ma dul 1snab/ /pha yis (dwa bzhin du rab tu rak+ṣi taḥ/ /bo bye rū le ma yā ta gya badzā sa na dzu ṣaḥpu ra/ /kṛ tā ni bsrungs—/ /byang chub snying por rdo rje'i gdan/ /bstan 1pa de la bdag gis ce3spon/ /gnod pa yi ni kā ra ni ka rāḥk+ṣadhi me ba tsa te na me/ /nā nā kā ra bi kā ra ka ri ṇi tshogs dag byas/ /de yis bdag la bzod pa nyid/ /byang chub ting 'dzin grub khyepa'i gnas der skyil ma yi pā kā ra hūṃ bi bh+ra tā tasmisgo bye sa mā bye sidhi bha ba ṣ+pe pa.oṃ ka ban+dha krung dag ni ⑥bcas nas gnas pa'i tshe/ /rnam 'gyur rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa bdag la ra ba nyid ⑦ni sbri to/ /k+ṣurnyi k+ṣu li ta ma rgyu nā bha ga ba tā busnye na shud+dhāt+pa nā ten 'dzin byed cing / /khro ba bzod pas bkrus pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan dag pa nyid kyi bdag nyid can/ /dh+yā na pa rā ya ṇi nā nā ma nā gudhī lo tai lo tsa rna/ /bha ba tā twa r+ya ka ru ṇa bsam gtan mchog tu skyong bar byed pa de yi zu spyan yang cung zad phye ma yin/ /khrod kyis ⑨ snying rje btang mudṛ dzñā haṃ kha lbo kṛ taḥ/ / sā pā rā dhe pi ma ha tī na ma rgyu ma li nas ding / /bdag ni rab tu smad par byas/ /gnod byed la yang chen po yisaḍa/sna/ /yid ni khro ba'i dri nasma naḥ/ /muñtsa me ku ṇa pā bar+ghaṃ sbi to haṃ ta ba shā sa ṣ+pe/ /i ti ldan min/ /bdag la ro dag btags pa thong blu// /khyod kyi bka' la bdag gnas so/ /dul bas de bru bā ṇi bi na yā du pa gup+tasta ma n+ya dh+wata/ /na ka ri byu pi tse de baṃ bhi k+ṣu rde bi skad smra byed pa/ /de la nyer sbas kyis smras pa/ /gal te slar yang nyer 'tshe khyod/ /dge slong rnams la 95—873

sla ba pu naḥ/ /ta de ba ta ba mudzi mi dṛ bye ku ṇa pa ban+dha rgo/ /i rda tsa bha ba tā mi byed na/ /khyod la brtan par bcings pa yi/ /ro 'di dag ni bdag gis dgrol/ /gus ldan bdag kābye pri yo pra ṇa yi no ma ma/ /a tī ta su ga tā kā ram̐ san+dar+sha yi tu la dga' ba ni/ /'di yang khyod kyis rab tu bya/ /'das pa'i bde gshegs rnam pa ni/ /khyod kyis yang ma rta si/ / dṛ ṣ+ṭa ta ba ma yā sha t+ta rwa bye sa d+dhā nu kā ri ṇaḥ / /dag bstan par 'os/ /kun gyi rjes mthun khyod kyis ni/ /zlos gar nus pa bdag gis mthong / /sa n+dar+sha ṣ+pe bha ga ba taḥpa ra muṅkaṇ+ḍi to khya dz+wa/ /dhan+d+ra kā yo ma yā dṛṣ+ṭaḥbacom ldan 'das ni mthong ba dag /bdag ni mchog tu 'dod par gyur/ /bde gshegs kyi ni chos kyi sku//su ga ta sgyu khru tā d+ma nā/ /rū pa kā yastu rgo bā sau na ya nā mṛ tā thos pa'i bdag nyid bdag gis mthong / /nges par mig gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gzugs kyi sku de (lkum nirdzo raḥ/ /i nyi nirmuk+ta ku ṇa saste nok+taḥku su mā yu dhaḥ/ /ta spyu rtse sau yin no/ /zhes brjod de yi ro dag ni/ /bkrol ba me tog mtshon can gyis/ /de la smras pa bde ga ta rū paṃ tu bye karja na shā kya te/ / ta thā pi dar+sha ya bye ṣa twa dā gshegs kyi/ /gzugs dang mtshungs par byed mi nus/ /de lta na yang khyod kyi bka'/ /'dul ba la dzñā bi na ye spri taḥ/ /pra ṇa phye na pra ṇa myo haṃ na twa yā su ga tā kṛ tiḥ/ /gnas bdag gis bstan/ /khyod kyis rjebadag ni bde gshegs dbyibs/ /phyag 'os la yang phyag mi bya/ /i rkyughā su ga tā kā re saza kā ra su kha pra rda/ /sa sa udz+dza ṣ+ṭa ka na zhes brjod bde gshegs rnam pa ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bde ster zhing / /gser gyi snang ba rab tu spro/ /kā lo kai kān+ta ma dar+sha yata/ /dīr+gha dh+yā na ni lī na lo tsa na yu shaṃ niḥmadzes pa dag ni de yis bstan/ /spyan ni zung dag ring zhing bsam gtan la chags smin ma'i 'khri shing saṃ dh+ra ma zla la tai na sā baṃ sha ni sak+ta kān+ta ka na kats+tsha tro pa mā nā li rnam 'gyur bral/ /shangs kyi rgyud ni mdzes par chags shing gser gyi gdugs dang mtshungs pa'i mtshan ma 95—874

ke / /nizlu ṣā ya ta karje pā sha la li tī byā lasba bā hu dru oṃ bo r+ghaṃ can—/ /rgyan med snyan gyi zhags pa ring zhing mdzes la phyag gi ljon pa kun tu 'phyang / /sangs rgyas kyi ni rū pa ma be+egh+ra nidṛ ti ra judz+rebye ta nā nā ma pi/ /u pa gup+ta sta dā lo kya gzugs dag mthong na shebasam pa med pa rnams kyang dga' bar gyur/ /bcom ldan sku ni mdzes pa de/ /kān+ta bha ga ba to ba puḥ/ /sa bāt+pa pu la kā tīṇ+ḍi: kre tat+yā da ban+da ā+oṃ/ /mthong nas nyer sbas mchi ma dang / /bcas shing spu 'o nga rgyas pa yis/ /de yi zhabs la phyag dag byas/ /na nā ma pra ṇa myo haṃ mi ti ba di ni pa mad+ma je/ /u pa gup+tasta ma ba nges par bdag gi naphyag 'os min/ /zhes pa yid srubs smra byed tshe/ /de la/ nyer sbas kyis smras pa/ /dat+tha ṇa myaste dzi nā kṛ tiḥ/ /kṛ tri me ṣa bi bidza 6 bad+dhā bha ga ba tasta rgyal ba'i rnam pa khyod phyag 'os/ /bcom ldan sku ni bcos ma yi/ /gzugs rnams la yang phyag byar nuḥ / /na sa mṛṭ+wāṣ+ṭi dh+wa tū dzñā pra shā maḥkri ya te bu byeḥ/ /i truk+ta 'os—/ /mkhas pa rnams ni sa shing dang / /khams la phyag de byed pa min/ /nyer sbas kyis ni 'di mu pa guste na shu tā mā raḥpra san+da dhīḥ/ /bi hā ya sau ga tai rū paṃ swabe+e buḥpra brjod pa/ /rab dang blo ldan bdud kyis thos/ /bde gshegs gzugs ni yongs btang ste/ /rang gi t+ya ya r+ya ta/ /te ṣ+pe bā tha sa mā tū tā bi m+bi te na hi te ṣi shā/ /u gzugs su rab tu bstan/ /de nas dul zhing phan pa 'tshol4/ /de yis zheyang dag bos pa yi/ /grong ba gubhārnyi rka po rāḥb d+dhādz+re sgo tu ma ya yuḥ/ / ta sro pa de sha ka tha yā khyer ba rnams dam pa'i chos/ /nyan du nyer sbas drung du 'ongs/ /de yi man ngag gtam gyis ni/ /sa t+ya dar+sha na nidṛ taḥ / /lak+ṣu ju ṭ+wā da sha pā bhi rarta hūṃ su ra bā bden pa mthong zhing dga' ba yis5/ /grong khyer na gnas 'bum phrag ni/ /bco brgyad dgra bcom si r+ghaṃ/ /i ti sa sa ka la lo kā lo ka ka s+thā ṇa kā rī bya bye ta ti mi ra hā rī nyid thob 'gyur(pe/ /de ltar 'jig rten mtha' dag dge ba dag gis snang byed cing / /rab rib 'phrog 95—875

dha n+d+ra mā rgo pa de shaṃ / / bi pu la ku sha la mū la pā p+ta pu byo da par byed pas chos kyi lam gyi man ngag bsgrubs/ /rgya che dge ba'i rtsa bas bsod nams rgyas pa thob rnams yā rmā bha ba ti ki la ma harnyir+yaḥb re ྾ hi tā ya/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi kyisashe / /rdzu 'phrul chen po gang de gzhan la phan pa'i don du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā dze+e mu pa gu bhā ba dā ā+oṃ byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las nyer sbas kyi rtogs pa dā sap+ta ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //a khaṇ+ḍi tai shā sa na mā ya tā shrīr+ya shāstu ṣā dzā shu sha tā ba dā tai/ /nyams pa med pa'i bka' 5dang yangs pa'i dpal/ /grags pa bsel zer byed pa brgya ltar dkar//ā byar+ya tsar+yā ru tsi raḥpra bhā baḥpha dze+e sha le shaḥsu ga tābye na su/ /rā ngo mtshar spyod pas mdzes pa'i mthu dag ni/ /bde gshegs mchod pa'i 'bras bu'i cha shas yin/ /grong dzā shrī mā na sho ka bhūh+phu re pā ṭa li pu tra ke/ /dra nārja nā ma bhūr+ya gya saṃ khyu khyer pa ṭa li pu trar/ /rgyal po dpal ldan mya ngan med/ /byung ste gang gis ḍa —sbyin pa don/ /grangs kyi shab da ri dra tā/ /tai ka dā tsit+pa bhā r+pā rgo ba ṇi dzo di pa gā mi naḥ/ /san+d+ra sgra yis dbul bar gyur/ /nam zhig mdun sar 'khod de la/ /tshong pa gling du 'gro ba po/ /bdog nguswa nā khru sho kār+bheḥs niḥshā sā bya jidzha yuḥ/ /de bi dīr+gha bhu dzasgo ya bi kun nyams nga/'i mya ngan gyis/ /gzir cing shugs ring 'a tsholdan pas zhus/ /dpung pa'i grib ma ring po la//shran+ta bhu ba na su te/ / rā dz+re na dṛ sh+ya te ka—ñtsid+dhā pa d+dhā pi tā sha srid pa ngal gso 6 lha khyod kyisa3/ /rgyal srid dag na 'ga' zhig kyang / /re khyab bsam pas gzir ba yaḥ / /a smra ka tu pra ba ha rde r+ghaṃghā rat+na dha rna z-i tai/ /ke ba mthong / / skal ba nyam 'uchung 'ba' zhig las/ /rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu rnams kyis/ /bdag cag 95—876

t+ya pa rāsgor+ya ta ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /u pā yo sa ti byu pā la na dzisgo kaspru marta si/ /nam mkha'i lha mos mngon phyogs smras/ /sa skyong stithabs ni yod pa la/ /bsam pa bya bar mi 'os so/ /ye pū dza yarnyi dzi na mañdza li ram̐ dzi te na mūjo pra zla ma ba ri shā ma ma gang zhig phyag 'tshal yongs su bsngo bas cher 'os bsod nams can/ /spyi bo thal mo khyesbyar bas mtshan harta pu juḥ/ /te ྾ su ra a pi su bstu bi tsi tra sho bhā mā dzñā pra dze+e bi pas rgyal la mchod byed pa/ /rnam par rgyal ldan de dag bka' yi 'phreng ①ba rnam bkra zhing / /dngos po dza yi dzā shi rā sā ba habye/ /e ta dā kasbya dṛ pa tiḥ pra ta s+thā tā mchog gi ngamadzes pa lha rnams kyis kyang spyi bor 'dzin/ /de thos nang par mi bdag ni/ /khrus byas ⑤shu tsi pra ta ཿ / / si bye shu dhe na ma na sā dh+ya tā bu dhe sa ma bh+ya brtul zhugs gtsang ldan pas/ /dag pa'i yid kyis 'u sangs rgyas ni/ /bsams nas grub slad rab smras dh+wata / /sa twa sme ram̐ sa ra sa ka ru rja kau mu dī pū ri tā shaṃ kādzñā shādh+ri pa ka la ta pa—/ /snying stobs kyis 'dzum ro ldan snying rje zla ba'i 'od kyis dz+ware ba skong / /mdzes shing mtha' dag me sī shukla sa k+ṣe ni biste/ /ni t+yā nasdo pa ra ma ma mṛ tai nibe+e kā ram̐ thra mun pa zhi be+ed dkar po'i phyogs la rnam par gnas/ /rtag tu kun dga' rnam 'gyur med cing mchog gi dzadzha be+e sdo tā pa pra sha ma su z-i rda bu dhe pū rte n+d+ra bi m+bi / /bdud rtsi rnam par spro/ /gdung ba rab zhi'i grogs po sangs rgyas zla nya'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsir+ghaṃ sa dā bi ṣa ya do ṣa pa rādru khā dzā ye yā dza she pra tsu ra pā ra mi tā gang zhig rtag tu yul gyi skyon la sa 2phyi rol phyogs gyur cing / /rab mang pha rol phyin la brten pa'i sems shra yā rde/ /te me pa re pa ra hi tī bhi ni be+e sha bhā dzaḥsaṃ kalpa kalpa ni dbang gyur pa/ /gzhan phan dag la mchog tu mngon zhen rten cing kun rtog gi/ /dpag bsam ljon ta ra baḥku sha lan+di shaṃ tu/ /i ti bhat+ta be+e dh+wa ṣ+pe na pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na bhū ba pa de dag bdag la dge bar 97ster grur cig /ces pa sa yi bdag po yi/ /smon lam gus pa sgrub byed 95—878

— — — — — — —tiḥ / /sa ha pā 5 rta hūṃ ṣaṣ+ṭhastuṇ+ḍi dikhyuḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /a thejo bhek+ṣu kyis) —/ /dgra bcom stong phrag drug cu ni/ /phyogs rnams dag las myur bar byon/ /de nas dge slong rā kā ram̐ he oṃ ra mya ma kā ra ya ta / / sa dṛ shaṃ dṛ pa te re ke nā ga dbang po yis/ /gcig 2sgoni mi bdag mtshungs pa dang / /gzhan pa klu yi rgyal po yi/ /rnam pa gser rā dzasu bā ba ram̐/ /ta taḥk+ṣi ti pa ten+d+ran+tini na nā ma sha ṣ+peḥsha ṣ+peḥ/ /urja gyi rang bzhin byas/ /de nas dal bu dal bu yis / / /sa bdag gzugs ni dma' ba dang / /klu yi nā ma tsa nā gen+d+ra mūrnyibi smi ya kā ri rde/ /ya thā ya thā dṛ ba:kre sa dā dbang po'i gzugs dag ni/ /ya mtshan byed pa mtho rngo4bar gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar mi bdag gis/ /rtag tu rat+na tra yā tsa rna/ /ta thā ta thā nā ga mūdhībe+e na nā mo r+ya yo pā rā/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod byas/ /de lta de ltar klu yi gzugs/ /dma' zhing gzhan pa mtho 5 bar gyur/ /a tha rā dzñāḥpu narla khe pra hi ta nā ga sum̐ ga bā/ /skan+t+rabe+e tā khi la ba ṇi de nas rgyal pos spring yig be+er/ /springs tshe klu yi gang zag rnams/ /ma lus tshong pa'i rin chen khur/ /grat+na bhā rāḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /ta da she ṣe na ra pa ti be+e tīr+ya ba ṇi dzān+ta dz+wa/ /phrag la bkod nas 'ongs par gyur/ /ma lus nor de mi bdag gis/ /tshong pa rnams la rab tu byen/ /bi sri bye nā gā na bha brji na shā sa na sā da raḥ/ /su bi dh+warlurta hūṃ pū dzā mu klu rnams btang nas rgyal ba yi/ /bstan la gus dang bcas par gyur/ /mi bdag la 'os nyer spyad kyis//pa tsā ri dṛ po tsi tai ཿ / / ba bhū pā na be+e saṃ kaspe rbu dha sa n+da r+sha nokhru dgra bcom rnams la mchod pa bsgrubs/ /kun tu rtog pa mi chung bas/ /sangs rgyas blta 6 bar 'dod kaḥ —/ / durla bhe pa ri nir+pā ṇa ni lī na dzi na dar+sha ṣ+pe/ /u pa gup+ta par gyur/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das gyur pas/ /rgyal ba mthong ba rnyed dka'i tshe/ /yon tan gyis ni nyer pa shu shā ba su ga ta pra ti me gu ṇiḥ/ /bi dhe yo bhasti yughā dzā dṛ paḥpra ṇa yi sbas dang / /bde gshegs mtshungs par de yis thos// /gus dab ldan nga/'i dbang gyur cing / /ma/dza' kwa/ ()5 ———87 /

bat+pa lo/ /u ru muṇ+ḍa sbi tai dru tai ra ni nā ya ta mā da rā tra/ /tat+pa mnyes gshin 'gro tshe na/ /gnas pa de ni mi bdag gis/ /gus pas pho nya dag gis bos/ /dam chos par+yābe+e gaṭ+wāp+ta sadhan+d+ra ku sha lo da yaḥ/ /pa bhū ba sa ta tai rā dzā rat+na dge ba rgyas pa ni/ /yongs rdzogs de yis mchod pas she thob/ /rtag tu dkon mchog gsum po ni/ /tra ya pa rā ya ṇaḥ/ /i ti dzi na sma ra ṇi na ma tī pa tiḥpra pa ba rgyal po'i dpung gnyen dag tu gyur/ /de ltar rgyal ba dran pas sa yi bdag po dag /rab 5rgyas bsod pu rgya ma ho da ya sadza daḥ/ /bi ṣa dz+dza tā ma pi mo li 6 shā sa dz+wa ku su nams che bar dar ba phun tshogs kyis1/ /bka' ni me tog 'phreng 4bar gyur pa'i rtse dga' dag /dug ma bā ma bi lā sa ma bābe+e ban/ /i nyi k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye satā 'dzin rnams kyi mgo bo la yang thob par gyur/ /zhes 57pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems ba dā na kalpa la tā yī nā ga dru ta pre ṣa shā ba dā rna tri sap+ta ti ta maḥdapa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing la sa klu la khyesprings pa'i rtogs pa bajod pa'i yal 'dab pabe+e waḥ// //ste bdun cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //pu bye pra rja ma pa tha me ti ka than+da te ྾ dā nor+ya tāḥpa ya di gā mi ba lbo gang zhig sbyin la brtson pas 'phral la dga' ba glang chen bzhin/ /yan lag rdzogs shing mdzes la yi ba / / pū ṇ+ḍi ga pū ṭ+wā ru tsi dzā thra thu ma dh+ya de shaṃ ye sdug rgyas la ) rgya che dbus kyi phyogs/ /sa ni rang gi mnyes gshin (8 dang bcas rab tu ster byed pa/ /྾ swa bat+pa sa hi tī pra ti pā da yadhi / /a thā sho kaḥk+ṣi ti pa tirwa de dag bsod nams 9 rab smin lam du ji ltar 'gro ma yin/ /de nas sa bdag mya ngan med/ /sbyin la nā sgyu se na byu ya sā/ /ā pa ga ta pra ṇa yi dzā pra ya yo kalpa bṛk+ṣa tsā/ /shin tu cher goms pas/ /slong ba phyogs nas 'ongs rnams kyi6/ /dpag bsam shing nyid dag tu gyur//95—880

rā dzo tsi tiḥs sa ta tai sgo dza nā bha ra bhādza riḥ/ /bhik+ṣu la k+ṣa tra yi ge he bhaste rtag tu rgyal po la 'os pa'i/ /zas dang gos dang rgyan rnams kyis/ /khyim du dge slong 'bum phrag gsum//pū tai ra snyu dza yata/ /he ma ko ṭi sha tai dā hūṃ sbri to khyur+ya su nish+yi yaḥ/ /gus shing gtsang ba dag gis mchod/ /gser ni 1bye ba brgya ster baX 7/ /gang gi lugs la nges par gyur//sa twa me bāk+ṣa ya ta rāḥko shaḥku sha la shā li rmā/ /sāstsa bye bhū ri be+e bha baḥdage ba ldan pa'i snying stobs nyid/ /shin tu zad pa med pa'i mdzod/ /rgyal srid che la 'byor mang des/ /ṣas+t+ri shad+dhiḥsaṃ bat+pa riḥ/ /hesnaḥṣaṇ+ḍa ba ti ko ṭī rde do saṃ ghā ya sa twadhīḥ/ /ta snying stobs blo yis dge 'dun 'a / /lo ni sum cu drug gi gser/ /bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug phul/ /de taḥkā le na dṛ pa tirgyu bye nā glu ni mā ya yo/ /sbe rā ṇi su kṛ tā bye ba nas dus kyis 2mi bdag ni/ /nad kyis 4thebs pa nyid du gyur/ /lus can rnams kyi legs byas nyid//na sha rī rā bhā de hi ram̐/ /ta nu mā ban+da par+yatai nibye t+ya thra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /brtan ⑤pa yin gyi lus ni min/ /lus ni mtha' la nye ba nyid/ /des 6nas sa yi bdag po yis/ /bya bhik+ṣu bh+yaḥ kuklu ṭ+wā rā me tra bi ṇi dā tu mu r+ya yo/ / ta h+pho traḥ sadza dī gag kun rar 1dge slong la/ /nor ni 'bul bar rtsom par gyur/ /de yi tsha bo phun tshogs can/ /nā ma lo bhārjasta gya shā sa rna/ /dā nā bu rgya pra bṛt+ta gya ko shā dh+ya k+ṣe ra bā zhes pas chags /— slad mdzod srung rkel/ /bskos pas sbyin pa'i bsod nams la/ /zhugs pa de yi bka' ra yata/ /dā ṣ+pe ni ṣidhe po tre ṇa saṃghā ya thra bye bī pa tiḥ/ /bye ṣa dzñā dag bzlog /tsha hūṃ7bos sbyin pa bkag pa'i tshe/ /dge 'dun la ni sa bdag gis/ /rang skal nyid du ma la ka s+thār+ghaṃ da do swa dzñā ga bha ba tai/ /dhī ma taḥsasma ṭ+wā nā tha ra bye gup+ta gya madh+ri gyur pa'i sman/ /skyu ru ra yi tshephye dag phul/ /de nas blon po blo ldan ni/ /mgu byed sbas pa'i gros dag ṇaḥ—/ /da do saṃ ghā yā ni khi dze+e thra thi bī pri thi bī pa tiḥ/ /gi gām+bu hā ra ru tsi dzā tsa gis—/ /dge 'dun la ni sa gzhi dag /ma lus sa yi bdag pos phul / /gang gā'i chu yi do shal mdzes 95—881

tu ram̐m+bu rā shi be lā bi shā la ra pa nāsma la yā ba tai sī/ /dā tā khi dze+e ldan rgya mtsho bzhi yi ni/ /rba rlabs ste rags yangs shing ma la ya yi rna rgyan can/ /nor 'dzin ma nyid ma ba su ma tī pa ba mā sa sā da pu bye pra mā ṇa kal nā ra hi tai hi tā ya/ /lus byin nas phan pa'i slad du ni/ /bsod nams chad kyis snaphodapag dang bral ba de yis (snyeyang dag thob//pra spyo ta ṣaṇ+ḍa ba ti ko ṭi bu baṇ+ḍi dā ṣ+pe yā te di baṃ na ra pa tā ba tha ta gya po traḥ/ /de nas gser ni sgobye ba dgu bcu drug byin gyerab grags pa/ /mi yi bdag po mtho ris song tshe de yi tsha bo she ṣe ṇa madh+ri ba tsa pā k+ṣi ti mā dza hā ra spa ṣ+ṭa kra yī ka na ka kau ṭi yis—/ /sa de gser byi lhag ma bye ba phrag ni bzhi rnams kyis/ /blon po'i tshig gis gsal phyebar rab tu tsa tuṣ+ṭa ye na/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la nyos te blangs par gyur/ /zhes 5pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa tā yī thra thi bī pra dā ā+oṃ tsa tuḥ sa p+ta ti ta maḥ pa l+la waḥ / / / /dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las sa gzhi phul ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //sadze+e ma bi t+yā mū le saṃ sā ra ta ru pra kā ra be+e tsi bye/ /dzñā rtu bahūṃ hahūṃ kaḥm rig pa yi rtsa ba can/ /'khor ba'i ljon pa rnam 7bkra kun/ /shis dang brjod dang gzhom 8 sha sto n+ya tra sa dze+e dzñā ta / / shā ba sgyu swa ste mā na pū rde dzi no dze par ni/ /kun mkhyen ma gtogs rtesu yis nus/ /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal na sngon/ /bzhugs pa'i ta ba na sbi tiḥ/ /a she ṣa dadhi bha ga bān bhik+ṣu saṃ bha ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rgyal ba dge legs can/ /ma lus gzigs pa bcom ldan gyis// /dge slong tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ /shri nu ta gre ya se dzñā nā lo ka nin+d+ra la mā na sāḥ/ /pra tī t+ya sa mut+yā rda baḥye shes snang ba dri med kyi/ /yid can dge legs slad du nyon/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung bdag gis ni/ /ka tha yā mi ya thā kra ma/ /a bi byā bā pa ni be+e yo duḥkha kan+dha su bhū ya saḥ/ /khyed la rim bzhin bshad par bya/ /ma rig pa yi bag chags 'di/ /'khor ba dug gi ljon pa ni/ /95—882

saṃ sā ra bi ṣa bṛk+ṣa su mū la bad+dhā bi dh+wa yi dī/ /tah+phu t+ya yāstu saṃ s+thā raḥsdug bsngal phung po chen po yis snarte/ /rtsa ba 'ching ba sgrub par byed/ /de yi rkyen gyis 'du byed de/ /kā ya pād+mā na pād+ma kāḥ / / saṃ s+thā ro t+tha ñtsa bi dzñā ā+oṃ ma na ཿ ṣakhye dh+ri lus ngag yid kyi bdag nyid can/ /'du byed kyis bsgrun rnam shes yid/ /dbang po drug po'i rte bdag yād+ma kamra/ / ta t+tha t+ya yi nā ma rū paṃ saṃ dzñā san+dar+sha nā bhi sgo/ /ma naḥnyid can/ /de yi rkyen kyis ngaming dang gzugs/ /ming dang mthong ba zhes brjod pa'o/ /'di las ṣaṣ+ṭidh+ri ya s+thā ni ṣa ḍā ya ta na ma su taḥ/ / ṣa ḍā ya ta na saṃ bye ṣaḥdrug pa yid dag kyang / /dbang po la gnas skye mched drug /skye mched drug gis 5 yang dag sbyor/ /spar+sha i t+ya bhi dhī ya te/ /ṣa ṭa spar+sha nu bha bo ya: be+e da nā sā pra tīr+bhe tāḥ/ /reg pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /reg pa drug gi 6nyams myong gang / /de ni tshor ba dag 7tu grags//ta yā bi ṣa ya saṃ kle shābye ga tro: pra dzā ya te/ /kā mā di 6 ta bhū ta ma yul gyi pasnyekun nas nyon 9/mongs las/ /de yis rkachags sred rab tu skyed/ /de las byung ba'i len pa ni//sā dā rna pra ba rta te / / u pā dā no bye ba ཿ kā ma rū bā rū pya ma yo 'dod pa sogs pa /—1'jug par 'gyur/ /len pa las byung srid pa 'dod/ /gzugs dang gzugs med bha baḥ/ /nā nā yo ni pa rā thra t+yā dzā tir+bha ba sa mudhe bā/ /dza rā ma ra ṇa rang bzhin no/ /srid pa la sa byung sna tshogs kyis1na/ /skye gnas su 'jug skye ba'o/ /rga shi mya ngan la sho kā di pan+da tisbyo nyi saṃ shra yā/ /a bi byā di ni ro dhe na te ྾ bhu pa ra ma sogs brgyud4/ /skye ba la ni brten pa yin/ /ma rig la sogs 'gog pa yis/ /de dag rim bzhin zhi kra maḥ/ /pra tī khyo t+yā do yo ba hu ga ti ra bi t+yā dṛ ta pa daḥs tsin+d+ra yuṣ+ṭha bar 'gyur/ /ma rig pas drangs lus mang 7rten cing 'bye'/ par 'byung ba'i gnas 'di ni/ /dben bhibi dza na ba na bi shā ma sha ma bhiḥ / / pa ri dzñā te sa myasbra dza ti pa'i nags su gnas shing nyu1zhi ba khyed rnams dag gis bsam par bya/ /yang dag yongs su/ shes na dus 95—883

ki la kā le na ta nu hūṃ ta nu two saṃ prap+ta su kha ta ra ni bar+yabya bha ba ti/ /kyis khye nges par phra ba nyid du 'gyur/ /phra ba nyid ni yang dag thob nas 75bde blag nyid du zlog par 'gyur//i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra pi ra tsi tā yā bo bye sa tā ba bā na kalpa la tā yī pra tī t+ya sa zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing mu t+yā dā ba dā 8 pa ñtsa sa be+e ti ta ma ཿ pa l+la wa ཿ / / / /las rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //kro dha ཿ sa rja hi ta ཿ pra ta p+ta ma na spru m+bi sne ba shā ṭ+wā mi dzā 'dod ldan rab gdungs 1yid can rnams la phrag dog dbang gis 4khro ba nye bar gnas/ /khro bas kro dh+wan+t+ra ni pa tarnyi tī bra ti mi ra shā bye ma ti bye pi naḥ/ /sa tra spyu ra ta ra long bzhin tsho5 blo gros nyams rnams mi bzad rab rib g.yang sar rnam par lhung / /der ni rab drag rnam pra kā ra na ra ka kle shoṣ+ṭha mūts+tsha dzu ṣā yā kadze+e k+ṣu ra tal+la kalba bi ṣa mang dmyal ba'i 6 nyon mongs tsha bas rmongs pa rten byed cing / /bskal pa'i bar du spu gri ⑦mal stan du ya khyo bhā k+ṣa tā ram̐ k+ṣa ya ཿ / / na dī ma dzi ra ma t+yā khyu shā ba sgyu brtags pa8 yul gyi sa gzhis bcom rnams brlag /bcom ldan rgyal bas she7mnyan yod kyi/ /chu klung bha ga bāñdzi naḥ/ /saṃ pābe+e sa twa ma dru khye ā bṛ tai bi kṛ tai dza be+eḥ/ /khyams ldan zhes par ni/ /byon pas sems can rnam 'gyur can/ / skyo bos ⑫kun tu bskor ba gzigs//ma hā kā ya kṛ mi ku ler+bhagh+ra mā ṇa pra ḍobye be+eḥ/ /sru tsa yahaṃ bya thā rā be+en+d+ra rma las byung ba /shwesrin bu yi/ /tshogs kyis nyan lus chen za byed cing / /gdung ba'i cho nges ⑫dmyal ba na//ra kasbri ti be pa paṃ/ /tai dṛṭ+wā dzā ta ka ru ṇaḥsat+tha dzhasta ṭi byā ta ṭi/ /gnas pa'i sdug bsngal gnas 6byed pa/ /de mthong thugs rje skyes pa yi/ /kun mkhyen chu klung ngogs su u pā bi shah+pho ra dza ṣ+pe rā sa na pa ri kalpi te / / so ba tri kṛ tā ni—/ /grong khyer ba yi skye bo yis/ /yongs su bshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de yi rang bzhin ting 95—884

kā re dzā t+yar+ghaṃ ma nyi kho yi/ /kṛ tā dzā tasma re pa r+yasta dru pe ṇa sa 'dzin gyis/ /'phral la skye ba dran mdzad nas/ /dmus long rnam 'gyur rnam pa can/ /ma te mtshungs mā bye nā/ /a pi to pi du ra spyu ra kan+d+ra rde bhu bye te pha lo/ /a pi la des ①gsungs pa/ /be+e du ra khyod mi bzad pa'i/ /las kyi 'bras bu longs spyod dam/ /tshul ngan dordza n+ya dza na be+e sā ma ti smar+ya te twa yā/ /khru tī takhru ga te noshā sa ma nu skyed par chabyed pa yi/ /blo de khyod kyis 1dran nam ci/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs de thos nas/ /mi 6 gi rā pra bīta/ /tī bra pā pa gya bha ga bān byu bye te bi pu lo pha lo/ /i ti yi tshig gis des smras pa/ /bcom ldan mi bzad sdig pa yi/ /'bras bu rgya che longs spyod do/ /zhes pa ta su bru bā ṇa su dzā ti saṃ sma ra khyot+pa re/ /ki me ta di ti pa prats+tsha bhegru saṃ gha smra ba de yis (pyani/ /mchog tu skye ba dran pa las/ /skye bo mang pos 'di ci zhes/ /dge slong dge 'dun ma hā dza naḥ/ /ā:r+ya dṛtrī bha ga bān ā nan+de nā ba bhik+ṣu shā/ /taṅkan+d+ra ko dag la dris/ /de nas dge slong kun dga' bos/ /de yi las kyi dge mtshan las/ /ngo mtshar sngon byung tu kāsmṛṣ+ṭaḥ san+d+ra dzha sa ma bhā ṣa ta/ /udz+dza ya t+yā ma byun+d+raza bi du ro dris de la/ /bcom ldan kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa/ /sa bdag bi du ra zhes pa/ /mya ngan med bzhin nā ma khyu pa tiḥ/ /a sho ka i ba lo lāk+ṣi tsa ra ṇa ha ti ko tu tī/ /sa mig g.yo mas/ /rkang pas bsnun pa'i dge mtshan can/ /'phags rgyal dag tu sngon byung gyur/ /nam ka dā tsid+ma dhū bṛṣ+pen+d+ra dhi ma dhu pa bān+dha be+e/ /bi la khā sā ni khā lo la zhig sbrang rtsi 'thungs pa'i gnyen⑤/ /dpyid dus rlung gi byugayo ba yis⑦/ /'khri shing yid 'ong nags la tā la li ta kā na ṣ+pe/ /tā byu mi pā li la la nāsta tra pusgots+tsha yā ku lāḥ/ /tshal du/ /de ni bud med tshogs dang rtse/ /sa skyong bud med de dag der/ /me tog 'thu bas pashebyel bi tse ru byu pu rā rā ba ta ram̐ gi ta bi haṃ ga māḥ/ / : e kān+ta gyur pa/ /rkang gdub sgra yi spu'adab chags ni/ /rnam par bskyod cing rab tu 'khyam/ /der ni zhi ba la brten bzhin—/ / : dbe+en par rnam par gnas pa yi zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa 'dar los bcug pa slar rgya dpe rnyed na zhus dag byed/95—885

—— — — — — —— — — ——— ——— — —byedabyedatā bi ti ṣ+ṭhabya kād+dhāḥshādhe ri bā shra oṃ/ /pra h+ye ka budha martabyedrwa ṭ+wā shuḥpa ṛ dben par rnam par gnas pa yi/ /rang sangs rgyas ni dgra bcom gyis/ /yongs bskor mdzes bā ri tai / / sbi tai pa rlo ka ba dhe na dh+yā na ste mi ta lo tsa rna / /ma rnams kyis mthong / /skyil krung bcas nas gnas gyur cing / /bsam gtan spyan ni g.yo med pa/ /tai dṛṭī sa ha mai bā saṃ bra san+da ma bha bad+ma naḥ/ /dh+yā nādhetā de shan+ta tai dhadz+re de mthong 'phral la de dag rnams/ /yid ni rab tu dang bar gyur/ /bsam gtan mthar ni dag pa'i shu dhe mi bā mṛ tai / / pa ri tsā dro pa bi bi shu ཿ kṛ ta pa dā bhe chos—/ /bdud rtsi bzhin du ston de la/ /rkang par phyag byas de dag gis/ /yongs su bskor nas nye ba n+da nāḥ/ /dṛ pa ste de sha ma bye t+ya ste rde dṛ ṭī ta durlu baṃ / /sha bar gnas/ /mi bdag yul der song ba yi1 / /bud med rnams der mngon phyogs mthong / /tshul rī ram̐ shubye shī khā rmā te ṣāṅgi gra ha mā di ta shata/ /te na bā be na bi pu lo kā la khrims dag ldan de dag gi/ /lus ni bcad pa rab tu bskos/ /sdig pa de yis 2 yangs pa yi/ /dus na ra ka saṃ ka re / / pa kyo yo bi kṛ tai ཿ sa tī r+bhagh+ra mā rto du rā kṛ su dmyal ba nyam nga bar/ /rnams da 'gyur sems can gyis za zhing / /ngan pa'i dbyibs can 'di dag tiḥ / /a pā da masta kā ṣ+pe ka bi kā ri bra ṇa saṃ bha baiḥ/ /tīṇ+ḍi kṛ mi ku leḥsmin—/ /mgo nas rkang bar du ma yi/ /rnam 'gyur rma las byung gyur pa'i/ /srin bu'i rigs kyis 5/kā yo pa sh+ya tā su dzu gudz+re tai/ / kaspradhe na ra ke bhughā tsaṇ+ḍa ya twa mu pā khengs gyur pa/ /'di yi lus ni smad pa ltos/ /bskal pa'i mthar ni dmyal ba dag /spyad )nas ga ta ཿ / / pra bye ka bu dhe mṛ ga yā m+bi shī lo yaṅgi ha ni byā ta / /gtum po nyid gyur te/ /rngon pa'i ngang tshul ldan pa 'dis/ /rang sangs rgyas ni gsod par 'gyur8 / /pu narna ra ka saṃ gre sha shīr+ya mā nā ya tā kṛ tiḥ/ /saṃ khyu tī te na kā le slar yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /lus can 9 rnam par nyams byed cing / /grangs las 'das pa'i ()5 88()

na pra yā mya ti ma nu 6 hūṃ/ /shāstu rut+ta ram̐ saṃ dzha gya ta taḥk+ṣa yi ta dus kyis ni/ /mi nyid rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /de nas sdog pa zad gyur te/ /nyon mongs me chen kilpi ṣaḥ/ /dīspyo kle sha na lojighāḥshā sa ṣ+pe pra bra dzi 6 ti/ /u byā de dag gis ni/ /yid byung ston pa ud ta ra/ /zhes pa'i bstan la ①rab 'byung 'gyur/ /de ni ④kā shi'i kā shi rā dza su kād+dhā bhiḥpū dzi tasta taḥ/ /yīdh+yā ko pe na sha rī ra la pāp+lu rgyal po yi/ /skyed mos tshal du mdzes mas mchod/ /phrag dog khro bas lus dag ni/ /chad pa drag pos tru gra ni gra haṃ/ /ta to gya tī pra duḥkhādze+e ba ba pā lda bha bi 6 ti/ /i ti gcod par 'gyur/ /de rjes 'di yi sdug bsngal me/ /mi bzad rab tu nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa shāstudze+e tsaḥkhru tā sazla be+e rā gya ma ya thuḥ/ /ujughā nā ma tha bha ba bha ya ston pa'i gsung thos nas/ /thams cad chags bral ldan par gyur/ /de nas der ni ston pa'i gsung gi kle sha tsid+dhā tu rā rde shā stu ཿ pū rje rā mṛ ta ba sa re d+dhā d+ma ye sta rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgyun rdzogs pas/ /chags bral srid pa'i 'jigs pa'i nyon mongs bsam pas gzir tra te hūṃ/ /salnga ṭ+wā deḥku sha la pa li leḥpra bh+ya mā nā sha yā dzā tā baḥb de dag rnams/ /dga' ba dang ldan dge ba'i chu yis bsam pa rab tu rdzogs gyur cing / /rab zhi me kā pi pra sha maku su nā rā ma bhā dze+e dza gā ma/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye tog dga' tshal ldan pa rnams kyi 1gdung ba ga shed song / /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī bi du rā pa dā rna ṣa ṭa sa p+ta chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las bi du ra'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //'dab ste bdun cu rtsa drug pa'o// //kha loṅkasgo ṇa sat+tha gya gu ṇa laghā niḥpra dzā ya te/ /bha ba t+ya byu mi bsrun ④rab tu rgyas pa yis(sre/ /kun gyi yon tan nyams par byed/ /bdag nyid chen po'i 95—887

da yā yi ba pra bhā bstu ma hād+ma dzñā/ /ā tra mā yī ba no pādhe bha ga bārlu ga taḥmathu yis ni/ /mngon par dar ba nyid du 'gyur/ /ā tra mā yā'i nags kyi mthar/ /'byung po'i khang pu rā / / bhū tā ga ra gu hā ga r+bha ta sbo dh+yā na pā rā ya shā ཿ / /pa'i phug nang na/ /bcom ldan bde bar gshegs pa sngon/ /bsam gtan rab tu skyong zhing gnas/ /ta tra tī zwa sha ni sgo ṭa nijuṣ+ṭa dṛ ṣa kar+ṣa kaḥ/ /te na dh+yā na li ṣ+pe na gha der ni mi bzad lce 'bab pa/ /drag pos khyu mchog zhing pa bcom/ /des khya)ni bsam gtan la chags na shasdo pi na shu ta ཿ / / dh+yā nārnye tha pra ba tsa dz+wa shāstu n+d+ra n+d+ra ki rtswa pas| /sprin gyi sgra yang gsan 'a)ma gyur/ /de nas dal 'bab ge/ngogs su ni/ /bsam gtan mtha' ru ta ṭi/ /tsa tu raḥsgo tu mā dza grubyu hā rā dzā bhi dh+waḥpu ra/ /j-i ta rārgyu ston pa'i gsung / /nyan du rgyal po chen po ni/ /bzhi zhes brjod pa sngon pedu 'ongs/ /yul 'khor srung bi rū ṭ+wā khya bi rū pak+ṣa dha nā dhi pāḥ/ /te shīṇ+ḍi rat+na ku su māsta su pā do dang 'phags skyes po/ /mig mi bzang dang nor bdag go/ /de yi zhabs la de dag gis/ /phyag 'tshal pa ba n+di re/ /te bh+yo hi tsār+ya dzā tī yo j-i ta rābye bi rū bhā kau/ /rin chen me tog gtor/ /de dag las ni 'phags pa'i rigs/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po//dā pa dh+ri ku rā dzā tī yo te ྾ swo tsi ta bhā ṣa yā/ /sadhedz+re de sha ṣ+pe tsakre bha ga gzhan gnyis gdug pa'i rigs can te/ /de dag la ni dam chos dag /bcom ldan 'byung po dgongs pa bā rdzu ta bhā ba na ཿ / / ye na shā sa na dha rme 6 ba bhū pu ste bi shā yis—/ /rang la 'os pa'i skad kyis bstan/ /gang gis de dag bstan pa yi/ /chos la rab tu mkhas ra da ཿ / / shi k+ṣu pa da pra ṇa yi na ste ra t+na tra ya mā bye tā ཿ / /par gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la rab brten cing / /babe+eb pa'i gnas bzung de dag rnams/ /na tā bha ga ba taḥpā do bi ma ṣ+pe ste di baṃ ya yuḥ/ /te 6 yā te 6 bha ga bān bcom ldan zhabs la btud nas ni/ /gzhal med khang nas mtho ris song / /de dag song tshe bcom ldan 95 888

spre spre — — zhe ——— /—— snye —— — sde—— — shernge— — — —byedasde— — —— ——bye k+ṣu bhi sbyo ta bi sma ye ཿ / / pā ku 5 pa ñtsa ya dhe hūṃ thra ṣ+ṭi ཿ thra bā tsa la—/ /dge slong ya mtshan skyes rnams kyis/ /de dag sngon tshe bsod nams tshogs/ /dris pa thams cad saza bi ta/ /alpashā sa ma hā shwa so pu ra nā go ba khyu ba tuḥ/ /ta dre rig pas gsungs/ /klu ni dbugs chung dbugs chen dag /sngon byung de dag dgra bo ni/ /'dab ṣa no su pa zlo tsa tsū ḍi m+biṣ+ṭa swa rasta thā/ / nā go kā sh+ya pā shāstu saṃ pā bzang yo gtsug ldan de bzhin du/ /mi ḍi'i 1chidabyangs zhes bya ba'o/ /klu yis (rte)ston sa sba thā kha lu bai mu khyu ཿ da be+e t+yā be+e 6 ya t+na ta ཿ / / ma ha dhi ཿyang / /nges par rnam kun phyir phyogs pas/ /'bad pa yis ①ni btsal bcal spyonas/ /lhang ba yon saṃ ga mits+tsharnyi gu ṇa lud+dhā i bā ba daḥ/ /a ba tīr+ya swa yo tā bta dze+e bu tan la sred cing / /chen po rnams dang 'grogs par 'dod/ /khyab ①bdag rang nyid 'dzam gling du/ /dī paṃ twa yā bi sgo/ /mṛ gya hūṃ shra ma ṇaḥkash+yibye sa na rak+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa ma/ /re zhig bobs la khyod kyis ni/ /rgud pa bsrung bar bzod pa yi/ /dge sbyong ④'ga' zhig bstsal pebar pra bhā ba bi pu loṅka r+ṣaḥ khru yen+ta shra ma shā ཿ ki la / / yu 6n+ta ku mdzod—/ /gang dag dge bas bgrod spyobyed cing / /dge ba nyid kyis sbyor byed pa/ /dge sbyong mthu ni sha le re ba ye ྾ ku sha la gā mi naḥ/ /i ti thra yā ba tsaḥkhru tā ta the rgya che zhing / /khyad par 'phags pa rngo7 grags pa thos/ /zhes pa dga' ma'i tshig thos nas/ /de bzhin kyughā ma rube+e ti/ /k+ṣi ta ma bye t+ya pa prats+tsha shra ma shā kle sha saṃ k+ṣa yo/ /sha kra zhes smra dulha yi bdag /sa la mngon phyogs nyon mongs ni/ /'jil ba dge slong rnams la dris/ /brgya pra ṇa yi mā tre ṇa te pra bhā bā bhi mā ni niḥ/ /ba bhū bu ruñdza li bya grwastat+tha byin gyis ni dris ⑨/tsam gyis/ /mthu yis mngon khengs de dag gis/ /thal mo sbyar byas de nyid la/ /rja ma na tā na nāḥ / / te kut+tha rnyi ka rja rak+ṣu mā me ba pra ṇa phyag btsal rngu bzhin ras btud par gyur/ /gang zhig bdag nyid la 'dud pa/ /de yi ji ltar srung marnyi ye/ /pa tidh+yā te ti ma ru tā ma bhaghā shaḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /ta taḥbyed 'gyur—/ /zhes bsams ⑪lha yi bdag po ni/ /re ba nyams pas rang gnas song / /de nas de yi sa su ga tai dzñā tā saṃ pāp+ta pa ra mā mṛ tai/ /pra t+yā san+de ni pa ta ṣ+pe ba ri tā ṇa bde gshegs ni/ /mchog gi bdud rtsi thob shes nas/ /ltung ba spyorab tu nye ba ni/ /yongs su skyob pa ma ma t+ya ta/ /in+d+ra mā la gu hā gasgo sbi tai po tha ta thā ga tai/ /te dzo dag tu bsams/ /de nas de ni rjes 'brang bcas/ /dbang po'i phreng ba'i phug nang na/ /de bzhin 95—892

dh+wa tu sa mā par+ghaṃ ya yo trahūṃ sa hā nu geḥ/ /gu hārnyi ka ma thā sā t+yā pa ha gshegs pa me khams la/ /snyoms zhugs gnas lhapa lta ru song / /de nas bde sogs bdag po des/ /sha ṭī pa tiste taḥ/ /spru tse pañtsa shī khaṃ nā ma gan+dhasgo su ta mā da rā ha/ /te dzo 'phral la phug dang nye bar phyin/ /zur phud lnga pa zhes pa yi/ /dri za'i 2bu la gus pas smra①/ /de dh+wa tu sa mā pa.oṃ bha ga badhe ta thā ga tai/ /swa ka khā kau sha le na hūṃ bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /me yi khams la snyoms zhugs pa/ /khyod ni rang gi sgyu rtsal la/ /pra bo dha yi tu marta si/ / u ba rlu rlu t+ya kā le yaḥ pra bhe pa t+ya ni mkhas pas rtogs pa pya bya bar 'os/ /gang zhig dus min nyer bgrod 'a7dang / /ma brjod par ni thunang be di taḥ/ /a nā sha ya dzñāḥs pa tā ma ba mā na su bhā dza rna/ /i t+yāk+taḥsu ra rā dze 'jug dang / /bsam pa shes pa min pa de/ /dam pa rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /zhes brjod lha yi na dhī mārgan+tar+bha dā ra kaḥ/ /bai ḍūr+ya daṇ+ḍa ma ka raḥjo rde su swa ra pār yi dbang nyid thob/ /'byor pa'i chos kyis ⑦bcings bhū ti mu ste ti bā rji ma na ya n+d+ra shādhi / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra pi ra zhes gsungs nas ni/ /bcom ldan gsung ni rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /zhes pa dge n+ta ཿ pu ri gyur pa—/ /dus kyis )rang gi grong khyer song / /de nas khyim 'dod tshogs kyis de/ /song ba grong par+yan+ta kā na ṣ+pe/ /sha rī ra mā tre she kho byubyā sru byermu ṣi to tha saḥ/ /a nasgo mtha'i nags tshal du/ /chom rkun pa yis bcom gyur nas/ /lus tsam lhag ma nyid du gyur/ /bde ba pārdzi to gyarjaḥsā maze na su khabe+e nā/ /ka ro t+ya nits+tsha yā jo tuh+ma ru don gnyer nus pa ma 'bad pa yis/ /bdag gis 2)nor ni bsgrubs gyur kyang //a bhā gya yo gā ya tai me swasna dar+sha na tu l+ya tai/ /shu n+ya pā ṇi dha nābe+e n+yaḥbadag ni skal dang mi ldan pas/ /rmi lam mthong dang pasbyiḥpā byā ha madhi rka/ /rgo dz+re bā sba ba sā no gra bi ṣiḥpa ru ṣa bhā ṣi taiḥ/ /gan du lag stong bdag phyin na/ /smad pa drag po'i dug ldan pa'i/ /tshig rtsub brjod pas bdag mi 'tsho//tas+thā di hai ba me sa r+yaḥpā she nod+man+dha rgo hi tai/ /dā ri dro pa dra ba hrū re byā de slad bdag ni 'di nyid du/ /'phral la zhags pas bcings pa phan/ /dbul ba'i nyer 'tshe drag po shaste na sa te kṛ haṃ / /i ti saṃ tsidh+ya sa la tā pā sha kabye n+ya be+e yis—/ /khyim du bud med mtshon mi bzod/ /ces bsams de yis tshutsho'akhri shing gi/ /zhags pa dag ni sha yata/ /tī pra gre sha bi ṣaṇ+ḍa dzā ni dha rgo ban+tu saṃ ga maḥ/ /a tān+ta mgrin par bkod/ /nyon mongs drag pos nyen rnams kyis/ /gnyen dang phrad pa 'chi ba yin/ /skabs re kṛ pā sen dhu bha ga bān bhū ta bhā ba naḥ/ /duḥkhaṃ dzñā tā gya sat+tha der bcom ldan brtse ba yi/ /rgya mtsho 'byung po la dgongs pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pas de yis ⑤ni/ /snyosta dadze+e ba na mā ya yo/ /da ya yā shā se taste na t+yak+ta pa sha ma tha dwo dzaḥ/ /sdug bsngal shes nas nags su byon/ /de nas de yis khruganyis skyes ni/ /brtse bas dbugs phyung zhags ta sde r+ghaṃ ni dha mā dā ya tai pra ṇa mya ya yo kṛ haṃ / / ta su bhā r+yā pa btang / /de yis su pri ya su kṛ haṃ ya yo/ /sa ta tra pū dzi ta te na ba hu mā ṣ+pe na bhū ya sā/ /rab dga' dag gi khang par phyin/ /de yis rmyeder ni mchod pa dag /shin tu che zhing mang bas mchod/ /āṭ+wā sa nasta ma ba dadre paḥpra ṇa yi bat+pa laḥ/ /e hi su pri ya gats+tsha mdza' gcugs 37mnyes gshin ldan pa'i lha/ /stan dul 'khod des de la smras/ /rab dga' tshur shog sa baḥthra thi bī thra thi bī pa teḥ/ /dzā taḥshurjo da nā khya su pu traḥpu rgya ma la 'dong / /sa yi bdag po bsod nams kyi/ /chu gter chen bo zas gtsang zhes/ /bya ba'i sras su ho da byeḥ/ /pābhā sha mā mṛ tai te na dza ga tsā ku sha khā ya saḥ/ /tata saṃ rab 'khrungs pa/ /de yis rab zhi bdud rtsi thob/ /dge ba'i be+ed du 'gro la des/ /de ni yang dag bi bhā shaṃ ku ru te ka ri 6 t+yā ba yo ra pi/ /ma yā saṃ ti pra bī shā yī yo dzi tā 'god par mdzad/ /yu cag la yang mdzad par 'gyur/ /da lta bdag gis rgyud mang ④la/ /glu gī ti sā ri zla/ /ka tha gats+tsha mi partswaṅge duḥka ri ṣa bha be+e 6 ti/ /dbyangs rgyun ni rab tu sbyar/ /ji ltar bdag 'gro phyin 2 nas ni/ /bdag la bya ba dka' bar 'gyur/ /i kyuk+taste na ma gha bām+bi ma nāḥswa pa rda ya yo/ /bi ṣa yā sak+ta tsiṭ+wā zhes pa des 'ubarjod brgya byin ni/ /yid byung rang gi 3gnas su song / /sems ni yul khrul chags dzā ku sha khā bhe ra tiḥku taḥ/ /a ṭ+wā ta re martu lo ka ku shaṃ puzlo rnams la/ /dge la mngon dga' ga la yod/ /skabs der sdom brtson brtul zhugs can/ /rab bzang sa rasta ṭi/ /u dum ba ra ba na tasbo su bha dru khyo ya ti bri taḥ/ /byaste na mi yi 'jig rten gyi/ /ku sha'i grong khyer mtsho yi 'gram/ /u duswā spura'i nags na gnas/ /de yi u bairmu ku la kaiḥs dṛṣ+ṭi dudza ra dru mān/ /bisma yoh+phul+la na ya naḥsu tsi re dum bā ⑫ra'i shing / /me tog gsar pas khyab pa mthong / /mig ni ya mtshan gyis rgyas pas/ /shin tu sa ma tsin+ta yata/ /dzi na dzad+ma ni dza yadhe tsakra brtur+bha pe bi bā/ /yang dag yun ring bsams/ /u dum bā 1)ra'i nags tshal 'di/ /rgyal ba 'khrungs na me tog dpal/ /95byed90 4

a sman+d+ra dusba ra pa ṣ+pe nā n+ya thā mu ku la bhi yaḥ/ /ma mai ba pu bye 'byung zhing ①'khor los sgyur ba dag /'byung na yang ngo gzhan 1du min/ /yang na bdag gi bsod ra tha bā saṃ dzā ta mi da yasgru tai/ /su bha drash+yin+ta yi te ti ba bhu bā nams kyis/ /rmad byung 'di ni yang dag skyes/ /zhes pa bsams nas ①rab bzang ni/ /kun dga' nan+da nir+bha raḥ/ /a thā mju pa ti ga twa su pri yo pu na ra bra bīta/ /rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /de nas slar yang 'chi med ④bdag /song nas rab dga' dag la smras/ /ni dza kār+yā dhi god+mo gāḥpa ra kābye 6 sa dha baḥ/ /e hi su thra ya gats+tsha baḥdam pa rang gi bya ba bas/ /gzhan gyi bya bar brtson pa lhag /sa gzhi ⑤zla ba bde gshegs kyis/ /sgo ti k+ṣi ti ta len+d+ra nā/ /san+de sha rmā shu byen+d+ra shwa su ga te na pra kā shi lta/ /bstan pa 'od kyis duthams cad ni/ /rab tu gsal ba'i sa gzhi la/ /rab dga' tshur shog 'u cag tai pu thra yo ba dedrwa bi r+pā zla lnga gī ti sā re shā/ /yo dzi to yasma yā 'dong / /de la rab dgas smras pa lha/ /rgyud mang ④la ni glu dbyangs rgyun/ /bdag gis rab tu sbyar pabyukhru ka rā ṇa bha bi bye ti/ /i t+yā ka: ma ra pa tir+ya yo smra na ma no ra thaḥ/ /ba 'di/ /phyi nas bya ba sla mi 'gyur/ /zhes thos 'chi med bdag po ni/ /yid la re ba nyams par gyur//a yo t+na pa na tai tī na pu ju ཿ pi ba rnyi nā mri tai / / uh+phu l+la 'bad med bdud rtsi nyer gnas pa/ /bsod nams dman rnams 'thung ba min/ /dus kyis ①u dum ku su mā mo da saṃ pū ri ta di gan+ta ram̐/ /kā le no drusba ra ba rna su bha dro pi bā ⑨ra'i nags/ /me tog rab rgyas dri bzang gis/ /phyogs mtshams kun tu khengs gyur pa⑪/ /rab bya lo ka yata/ /so tsin+ta yadzha ba bye tabyi kā se ku su saṃ da rna/ /bzang gis kyang mthong bar gyur/ /de yis ⑪bsams pa me tog gi/ /tshal ni rnam par rgyas pa 'di/ /dhadz+re pra bste na shustudz+dza ye nā tsakra btī naḥ/ /mah+phu ju rna pra bha ba tā ni ston pa dam chos ston pa dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i ⑫rgyal la 'gyur/ /yang na bdag gi bsod nams 95—905

swas+thā ya pra da do ta smi ni dza rā dzhai pa tsā nu gaḥ/ /u pa nasdo tha kā le na pu ro bsos pa de la rang gi ni/ /rgyal srid nu bo des kyang byin/ /de nas dus kyis nye dga' dang / /mdun hi ta su ta: saḥ/ /kā dzā pra bye ka bud+dhā ya kṛ tā de hān+ta mā ya tuḥ/ /na 'don gyi bu des kyang / /rang sangs rgyas la mchod byas nas/ /lus kyi mtha' ni rab tu thob/ /shi pispyo mi pa teḥpra pa rā dza pu taḥs pu tra tī/ /pra h+ye ka budha tsā le bhe rgyal po'i 47bu de sa bdag ni/ /shi bi'i grubu nyid thob gyur te/ /mdun na 'don byi bu de yang / /rang pū ro hi ta pu tra: saḥ/ /te na to gru bye pā pe na tu l+ya ro go ba bhū ba tuḥ/ /sangs rgyas nyid rab tu thob/ /de dag sbas pa'i sdig pa des/ /mtshungs par nad kyis thebs gyur cing //byaṅga gya swasbya ka ra shāta yu ga padrwasbya mā ga to/ /i t+ya kardzu tī ta dzad+mā nu yan lag nyams pa gso byed pas/ /de dag gsos 4pa nyid du gyur/ /rgyal ba phongs pas gzir ba ba d+dhā mā san+d+ra r+bhe tā ṇa bsgordzi na gya/ /ni t+yā saste sa twa kā ru bye bṛ: skyob gnyen gyis/ /rtag tu sems can la chags snying rje'i spyod/ /'das pa'i skye bo dang 'byel de thos z-iṭ+wāḥmā pum+bi bṛbye r+bhak+ṣa bste/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye nas—/ /mgu ba'i dge slong de dag bde ba thob/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī hi ta tai bye ba dā na pa lnga shī ti sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gye 'khri shing las phan pa 'tshol seba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i ta maḥpal+la baḥ// //yal 'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //be+en+darnye be+e bi ra kra me ṇa ni ya tai ye dhan+d+ra shik+ṣu be+e daḥpū bye karta chos kyi bslab pa'i 6rig pa gang gis mchod bya rnams la dul bar rgan rim kyis/ /mchod bya'i ga shāḥpra shā ma bi na ma ste pā nu r+pā bye na to/ /dasgon+da bye ta yā bi tshogs la rab 'dud dul pebs phyag byed de dag mtho ba thob par 'gyur⑤/ /dregs pas 'phyar las blo 95byed946

shri kha la bye yo mo hā da dhaḥpā ti dzā byeṣ+ṭha ti kra mi ṇa yo sa tsa pa ro lo gros rnam par ma bsdams rmongs las 'og tu 'gre ①byed cing / /rgan 'das rnams la 'jig rten 'di kaḥ sa sho kaḥ sa dā/ /bye jo pū bye pra saṃ ge na byekyu bhir+bha ga bān+d+ra dang pha rol de yang rtag tu mya ngan bcas/ /rgan po mchod pa'i zhar la slar/ /dge slong rnams kyis dres naḥ—/ /ya thā bṛdha be+e dhi thraṣ+ṭaḥsat+tha dzhaḥpū na ra bra bīta/ /brah+ma daṭ+wā bhi pa dag /rgan po rngo3cho ga ji bzhin sbar/ /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ / bā rā ṇa sīr dhaḥpūrja bā rā ṇa snga ma bhūdzñā paḥ/ /ya su pu rgyu nu bhā be+e na dhan+d+ra rā de dag rngu sngon/ /mi bdag tshangs byin zhes pa byung / /'gro ba gang gi bsod nams mthus/ /chos kyi ma ma bhusgo naḥ/ /ta gya kā le pu ro pān+da ba ṣ+pe pāklu khyu lak+ṣa rjatra/ /kun dga' ra bar grur/ /de dus grong mtha'i nags tshal du/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mtshan nyid las/ /pra bṛt+ta ma nu ṣā khā pābya tā raḥs+thā ṇi nor+bha bān/ /ka be+eñdza lo tha sha sha mi yi smra brjod la zhugs pa/ /srog chags bzhi ni byung bar gyur/ /ba men dang ni ri bong dang / /spre'u ka ka pi rku dza ba rasta thā/ /te ba bhū buḥs dā tsā rāḥsna ha bad+dhāḥpa raspa zhig bde thob de dag gis/ /gtam gyi mjug tu phan tshun smras/ /yu skol rgan rim med pa la/ /ke ka tha pū dzā pra brta hūṃ/ /ya thā bṛsgo ka yā sad+dhiḥsaṭ+wā ro nyi pra bar+bhe taiḥ/ /mchod pa dag ni ji ltar sgrubasnye / /dam pas ji ltar rgan rim gyis/ /bkur ste dag ni rab bsgrub ⑤pa/ /ka la yaṅgi la ka lnga rna ku sha lā ye ba ka n+ya te/ /byeṣ+ṭhaḥka stu ba dasmra nges par dge legs skyed byed spyopa smra ba de dag las/ /glang chen khyu mchog me gis smras pa//95byed947

yo yi dz+reṇ+ḍi ma hā shā khaḥpu ro ṇi dṛ 6 te ba ṭaḥ/ /tu l+ya me oṃ swa kā ya gya 'dab ma che hrul n+ya gro dha/ /gang 'di rnying bar mthong gyur pa/ /'di yi yal 'dab gsar pa dang / /sma rā mi na ba pabe+e baṃ/ /marna ṭo gya tha tāsba tse ba ṣ+pe bi tsa ra tā ma yā/ /swa rang gi lus ni gyomatshungs pa rdudran/ /spre'u yis kyang der smras pa/ /bdag ni nags na rgyu ba yis/ /n+ya kā ya tu thu e bā ya dṛṣ+ṭaḥswalpa ta ro ba ṭaḥ/ /sha sha ko su ba dah+phuzlasma yā pa gro dha 'di rang lus dang / /mtshungs pa shin tu chung ba mthong / /ri bong gis kyang smras pa sngon/ /n+ya gro twa dwa lnga ki
