te sa dā go ra bo tsi hūṃ/ /ste chen n+ya gro dha 'di skyes/ /de nas rgan rim shes gyur nas/ /de dag phan tshun mdza' ba yis/ /rjes ha nu bṛtrī ni ra tāḥtsakruḥpū rdzu pa raspa re/ /pā rja pa ha ra shāñtsir+yā da ga zhugs dga' bas mchod pa ni/ /rtag tu zhe sa la 'os byas/ /de nas pyasrog gcod rku ba dang / /de myu ga ma nāt+ta thā/ /a sa t+yābe+e r+ya tu s+thābe+e pha la saṃ bha k+ṣa shāstso te/ /bzhin bgrod min 'gro ba dang / /mi bden cha laltamatshungs 'bras bu ni/ /skyur ('upo za ba dag las kyang //be+e ra tāḥsu kṛ tā sagh+raḥ swa pa dā tsā ra shi k+ṣa yā/ /tsakruḥpu byā nu chags bral rang gnas kun spyod kyi/ /bslab pas legs byas la chags pa'i/ /bsod nams mthu yis bhā be na tu l+ya thra rgya kau ka saḥ/ /a tha ta ྾ pra bhā be+e na ni t+ya nags tshal na/ /gnas rnams spyod tshul mtshungs par byas/ /de nas de dag rnams kyi mthus/ /rtag pube+e pha la dru māḥ/ /sbyi ta sa snga bha badhū miḥkā la baṣ+ṭha tsa bā ri daḥ/ /tu me tog 'bras ldan zhing / /sprin ni dus su char 'bebs shing / /sa la 'bru rnams rgyas par gyur/ /95byed948

tadṛ ṣ+ṭa ma ha dābyurlo bhu baḥsu kṛ ta lak+ṣa rde/ /me ṣ+pe swa pu bye dze+e sadze+e sa yi legs byas mtshan nyid ni/ /ngo mtshar che ba de mthong nas/ /thams cad sa bdag tshangs byin gyis//brah+ma dasto ma tī pa tiḥ/ /tai mi byā mā be+eḥsaṃ tuṣ+ṭi palnga bhi rnyo mu ni dṛ rang gi bsod nams las skyes bsams/ /log par khengs pas tshim de la/ /thub pa mngon shes lnga pas paṃ / /u bā tsa tāt+tha sā de na nā yo pube+e pha lo da yaḥ/ /kā na ṣ+pe ka pi nā pādhi smras—/ /me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa 'di/ /mi bdag khyod kyi drin gyis min/ /nags na spre'u ri bong dang //sha sha ka piñdza la dī pāḥ/ /sbi tāḥsad+dhām+bi shī lā dzā te ṣā me ṣa gu ḍo da gnyis 'thung ba men ①lhan cig gnas/ /yon tan rgyas 'di dam chos kyi/ /ngang tshul de dag rnams kyi yaḥ / /te bra teḥpañtsa bhiḥshud+dhā ya thā s+tha be+e ra pū dza kāḥ/ /ka piñdza la gi yin—/ /de dag brtul zhugs lnga yis dag /ji ltar rgan pa 3mchod byed cing / /ba men tshig gis rā sabye sadhedz+re sa ma yo shri tāḥ/ /i ti khru tā mu ṣ+pedze+e kyi rā dzā dzā tā thams cad ni/ /dam chos dam tshig dag la brten/ /zhes pa thub pa'i tshig thos nas/ /mchog tu gus da raḥpa ram̐/ /sa sau rān+taḥpu rā mā t+ya stad ste dza bra ta pañtsa rka/ /ka piñdza skyes rgyal po ni/ /grong pa btsun mo blon bcas pas/ /brtul zhugs lnga po de dag bstan1/ /ba men nga lo ha me bā sau shā ri pu traḥsha sho bha bta/ /ka piñtsa muṅga khā pa t+ya ā nasdo ga dza yu tha nyid ri bong ni/ /shā ri'i bu 'di nyid du gyur/ /spre'u mo gal ④gyi bu/ /glang chen khyu bdag kun dga' paḥ / /tepra purjan+d+ra bai ma bye ya thā byeṣ+ṭha kra māts+tsha nā/ /tasmrat+tha zla ma pū dzā su bo—/ /de dag ji ltar rgan pa'i rim/ /mchod las chos ni dri med thob/ /de slad phyag dang mchod pa la//draṣ+ṭa byaḥs+tha bi ra kra māḥ/ /khru two ti shasturbi na yo pa de shaṃ dz+rejots+tsha rna pā rgan pa'i rim pa rab brtag bya/ /ston pa'i 'dul ba nyer bstan de thos nas/ /rgan po mchod pa'i pya ta po be+e she ṣe/ /sa go ra r+pā bar+ṣa di bhe k+ṣa bste pū dzā ya thā bridhi ka yi dka' thub khyad par thobargya/ /ji ltar rgan bzhin dge slong de dag gis/ /zhe sar bcas pa'i mchod pa 95—949

ba tsa kruḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa mdun kye)sar byas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa la tā yī ka piñdza khā ba dā rna ṣa ḍa shī ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //dpag bsam kyi 'khri shing las ba men gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'o// //yan+d+ra bye pa ra sazla dadz+re be+e ṣa oṃ spyu re tsa yad+mā ka re ya stso kyuṅka ṭa kā gang zhig g.yo dang yongs khyab dregs pa mi bzad gang yang gdug pa rnam par bcas/ /gang yang la ku ṭa be+e ka ṭā rnyo pa sbi ram̐ s+thā ba ra/ / yā n+ya t+yā ni tsi tā ni shin tu rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rtsom pa cher gnas brtan trepa dang / /gang dag gzhan yang bzod duḥs ha be+e ṣā bye tī kri tā ni sgu ṭi bā spra rut+ya bi ṣa su taisgo tu la yā nā dka'i dug rnams gsal bar gcig tu byas pa de dag gis/ /tshig rtsub dug gi rno ba nyid la cha dang dper yādhi le sho ba rmā/ /shā ba s+t+yad+mā na sā khya gya pad+ma gar+bha ni bha pra bhaḥ/ /yang mtshungs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyem bdag yid ces bya ba'i bu/ /yon tan ldan pa mnyan yod du/ /a bhūsgo ha pa teḥsru nurgu ṇa bābe+ed+ma kā bhi dhaḥ/ /su shī la gye ba ni ya maḥsā pad+ma'i snyeng po'i 'od mtshungs pa/ /pad+mo can zhes bya ba byung / /tshul khrims can gyi dul ba dang / /blo bho pa ri gu shā da raḥ/ /sorja ta kṛ he ta su bi be ka i ba dhī ma taḥ/ /ldan rnams kyi dben pa dang / /dam pa'i yon tan la gus bzhin/ /de yi mdun du de d+ngharab bskyed/ /sa na be yo ba nā ram̐ bhe rū pa kan+dadze+e hā se rna/ /sgo gyod+mo ga bi rā ge gzugs ni 'dod pa rgyas ‘zheldan zhing / /lang tsho gsar pa rtsom tshe de/ /longs spyod rtsom la chags bral na bai rā gyu bhe mu kho bha batro/ /u pa se nā bhe dh+wa na khya sa bhe k+koḥk+ṣurnyi bas—/ /chags bral nyid la mngon phyogs gyur/ /dge slong bzod pa'i sems ldan pa/ /nye sde zhes ni tse ta saḥ/ /shā sa ṣ+pe pra sha ma shā rgyu pra bra rdzu sa mu pa da de/ /sa pā bya ba yi/ /bstan la ⑪rab zhi bsngags 'os pa/ /rab byung de yis yang dag blangs/ /'khor ba'i 95—950

tra pā ṇiḥsaṃ sak+ta ṭī ba raḥshu shu bhe pa ra/ /saṃ sā re pa k+ṣa be+e rā gyubyi phyogs la chags bral bas/ /chags pa dang bral zla ba bzhin/ /lag na lhung bzed chos gos dang / /rak+ta i bā tsan+d+ra māḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsi de kā tī dza na tsā ri ka yā bra dzan/ /yang dag ldan de mchog tu mdzes/ /de nas nam zhig gcig pu nyid/ /ljongs ni rgyu zhing 'gro ba detsho1/ /bi hā rā rā ma ru tsi dzā ma thu rā ma sa sā da saḥ / / sa ta ta gtsug lag khang dang dga' 27tshal byus/ /mdzes pa'i bcom brlag dag tu kruphyin/ /der ni bsod pi ṇ+ḍa pā tā be+e na ba tā da na bye dzha yā/ / be shā yāḥ sha shi le khā nams kru don gnyer des/ /2gsar bu nyid phyir ma shes nas/ /smad 'tshong zla ba'i ri mo yi/ /khang yāḥdra bi be sha kṛ hūṃ ga r+ṇa/ /sā ta snga sa na saṅka ram̐ kṛ tā ku ba la ma k+ṣa shā/ /pa'i khyams kyi nang du zhugs/ /ut+pal mig can de yis ni/ /de la stan dang bkur ste byas/ /gzugs tai dza gā dā da ra ba tī rū pā lo kam+bi smi tā/ /i yi te ma li tā mūn+ti ni mthong bas ya mtshan zhing / /gus dang ldan pas de la smras/ /lang tsho gsar pa dang ldan pa/ /khyod na ba yo ba na shā li nī/ /ka ro t+ya mṛta saṃ sgo ga dīs+thāṅka su na tsak+ṣu khoḥ/ /a kyi gzugs ni yid 'ong ldan6/ /su yi mig la bdud rtsi yi/ /longs spyod ston par byed ma yin/ /na smibe+e ya pi rū pe smin ke na kā ma bi ro bye nā/ /kaṣ+ṭi sa mu pa diṣ+ṭi tshod 'di dang gzugs 'di la/ /'dod pa 'gal zla su zhig gis/ /rgan po la 'os chags bral gyisatso7/ /te be+e rā gyi sbra bi ro tsi tai/ /la la nā ra sa noṅkaste ku tsaspar+sha su kho tsi sdug bsngal yang dag nye bar bstan/ /chags ldan bud med nu ma ni/ /rab rgyas rig she pas bder 'os te—/ /pā ṇi saṃ sgo ga pā tra su pā tram̐ ta ba na sho bha te/ /a haṃ ku tsa pa—/ /longs spyod snod gyur khyod kyi ni/ /lag na rwartelhung bzed mdzes ma yin/ /nga ni nu ma'i khur gyis bha rā lngan+ta hūṃ tā ra ju ta ram̐ ga taḥ/ /u tsi tai bā ba yoḥbye tiḥsaṃ pā ti non—/ /khyod 4—)ni lang tshos rnam par g.yo/ /yu cag gnyis ni mdza' bar 'os/ /da ni brtul zhugs 95—951

k+ṣa ma hūṃ bra tai/ /udri dzñā ya ta lo tsa nā dha ra da la swā da pra mo dot+pa baṃ bzod par mdzod/ /g.yo sgyus zhi dang dul ba goms pas longs spyod bdud rtsi dag la chags med cing / /saṃ sgo ga mṛ ta niḥsmṛ haḥsha ma da mā sgyu se na shābyā di ba/ /yaḥkād+dhā mig yangs mchu yi sti yal 'dab rab myang khyerab dga'i dga' ston rab tu spangs pa bzhin/ /mdzes ma'i ku tsa rku ku rmā ki ta ru tsidh+waste na rā shaṃ dz+dza di gre sha klin+da pha khā se ṣ+pe dza na nu ma gur gum gyis mtshan mdzes pas snying la chags pa mi 'dzin gang / /skye bo'i nags su nyon mongs ba ṣ+pe dād+dhā ya ta smi na maḥ/ /ya di me spru ti lud+dhā yā ba tsa nā nu dman rngo pa'i 'bras bu za ba'i dul ba de la 'dud/ /gal te mdza' la brkam pyachags can/ /bdag gi kā re 6 se/ /ta de tat+ta ba ba khā krārnyi pa shā mi ba da nām+bu dze+e/ /e tshig 'di mi byed na/ /khyod kyi bzhin ras pad+ma 'di/ /stobs kyis mnan te bdag gis btud/ /de ta dā kasbya saṃ trasta i ba kazlo pi dh+wa ya saḥ/ /tsā ba tse no tsi hūṃ mā tan+d+ra ma jos kun tu skrag pa bzhin/ /rna ba bsgribs nas de la des/ /smras pa ma gcig bdag gis ni/ /bstan shā sa na dru ṣa rde/ /ur+ghaṃ pa tā mu pa ga haṃ su ga ta pra tai su sa twa shri pa sun 'byen 'os pa min/ /bdag nyid kun gyis legs spyad rgyan ⑤ldan skyes bu la/ /bde gshegs yaḥshu tsi ta yā ti la kā ya mā ā+oṃ/ /sad+dhāt+pa nā su tsa ri tā bha ra ṇa gya sum̐ btul 'uzhugs cod pan nyid du rab gyur cing / /snying stobs dpal ni gtsang bas thig le nyid gyur pa/ /saḥshī lo pa oṃ na hi bi byu ṣa ṇa maste kiñtsi ta/ /i kyughā saṃ ya taḥshu n+ya pā tshul khrims mtshungs pa'i rgyan ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes pa brjod nas dul ldan de/ /gnod pa'i tra e ba dza gā ma saḥ/ /a pā ya sha l+ya bi ṣa rmā pū dzā mubye bye pa twa ra/ /a zug rngu mi bzad can/ /mchod pa rab btang myur ba dang / /bcas pa (rngusnod stong nyid du song / /de tha marja ba lān+d+ra ma tsaṇ+ḍa lī bi sha kā li m+bi/ / ba shā kar+ṣa di ni nas sngags stobs zhes pa yi/ /smad 'tshong gtum mo 'dod ldan ma/ /dbang dgug sogs la 'khrul 95—952

yan+t+ra man+t+ra ta n+d+ra di ta t+pa dzā/ / ā byu ya bi ni be t+yāsmi ni dze+e sma 'khor dang / /sngags dang rgyud sogs de sbyor ma/ /bos nas de la rang nyid ni/ /chags pa'i zil gyis ra pa rā bha baṃ/ /ya yā te dha na saṃ tuṣ+ṭi rā gārta thra yī saṃ ga oṃ/ /a mnan pa bshad/ /nor kyis tshim byas chags pa yis/ /gzir mas dga' dang 'grogs pa zhusalku/ /de tha man+t+ra ba khāskṛ ṣ+ṭa sta yā sa ya di pad+ma kaḥ/ /bi ba shas+t+ri sa ma bye nas de yis 'phral la ni/ /sngags stobs kyis drangs pad+ma can/ /dbang med de la mngon phyogs te/ /t+ya ki ka ro m+bi t+ya bhā ṣaṭa/ /sā ta spru tse sha shi mu khā+e bha dza pra ṇa yi dī mi rmā/ /bdag gis ci zhig bya zhes smras/ /de la des smras bsod nams kyis/ /nyer gnas mdzes ma zla bzhin ma//pu bye ru pa na hūṃ kādzñā dībe+e bā bsgo mā be+e shata/ /pad+ma ko bya ba da dṛṣ+ṭa dz+wa mdza' mo 'di ni rab tu bsten/ /yang na 'bar ba'i me la zhugs/ /pad+mo can gyi (47mdun du ni/ /me li tai pā ba ke pu raḥ/ /pā ta sadz+dzaḥs mudh+ri bye bste sa twa si hūṃ 'bar mthong nas gos bzhag ste/ /snying stobs dkar ba'i gos can gyis/ /mchong bar chas nas rab shu kaḥ/ /bi shā mi sā ba ka dī sta rā gāsnin+da twa pā ba kai/ /sum̐ smras pa/ /gtsang byed 1'bar bar bdag 'jug gi/ /mi gtsang chags pa'i mer ma yinargya/ /chags sāsma da na dad+dhā ram̐ dā ho dzad+ma sha tā nu gaḥ/ /i ti ta gya ba tsa pas bsregs pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /skye ba brgya yi rjes 'brang sreg /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /shu tā tsaṇ+ḍa lī khaṇ+ḍi tā sha ya/ /a kār+ya ka ra nobyighā patsoṭ+wā pi sa mā ya yo/ /sa gtum mo re ba nyams gyur cing / /bya min byas pas yid byung ste/ /rjes su gdung ba dag tu gyur/ /de ta yākhyedhi ni la yaḥpra ṇa ye na pra sā di taḥ/ /be+e sh+ya yā tsa bai rā gya yi ⑤bzod pa'i gnas de la/ /gus pa yis ni dang bar byas/ /chags bral zhi zhing bsel ba yis byu blo sha ma shī ta la yā bye yā/ /bi da dhe dhadz+re sa shubye ta yoḥsadhedz+re de sha rmā/ /ldan smad 'tshong ma dag kyang / /chos kyis kun tu dag pa'i slad/ /de dag la ni chos bstan mdzad/ /95—953

te sadze+e kle sha sha ma nār+ya yārta twa ma bā pa tuḥ/ /swa yo tsārta twa mā gang gis nyon mongs kun zhi nas/ /de dag gis ni dgra bcom thob/ /dge legs ldan pa pad+mo can/ /sā r+ya bha ga bahaṃ thā ga tai/ /pad+ma kaḥpra ya yo drahūṃ shā baspyo swaste mā rang nyid dgra bcom rmyenyid thob nas/ /mnyan yod grong du bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa na su dī/ /dzi ā+oṃ dze ta ba nā sī ā+oṃ ta tra dṛṭī pra ṇa mya saḥ/ /kṛ ta lta ru song / /der ni rgyal byed tshal bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba des mthong phyag 'tshal nas/ /bya ba byas kṛ t+yaḥswa dṛṭ+wā n+ti bhek+ṣu rja ma bra bīh+phu raḥ/ /byek+ṣu bhisgo ga bādṛ ṣ+ṭastah+phu pa 2rang nyid kyi/ /spyod mtha' dge slong mdun du bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das la dge slong gis/ /de byo da ya be+esma yāta/ /be shā pad+ma ka tsaṇ+ḍa lī pān+d+rat+ta ma ba dadz+re naḥ/ /yi bsod nams ya mtshan dris/ /smad 'tshong ma dang pad+ma can/ /gtum mo'i sngon byung rgyal bas gsungs//rū ra bha ga ba taḥshāstuḥkā sh+ya pā khya gya shā sa ṣ+pe/ /mi tra nā ma kṛ ha sngon tshe ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs zhes pa'i bstan pa la/ /khyim bdag bshes gnyen zhes pa tiḥpra bra rdzu sa mu pa ga taḥ/ /ta gya nan+d+ra su nan+da tsa bhār+ya pra bra dzi ta pu naḥ/ /pa ni/ /rab tu byung ba nyid du gyur/ /de yi chung ma dga' mo dang / /rab dga' mo yang rab byung ste//bhatri tu spyo nu bhā be tu bi hā re tsakra tuḥsbi to/ /bākrā tu ṣe ṇa ma ha mthu ni bdag po dang mtshungs pa —/ /gtsug lag khang du gnas par byas/ /der ni de dag rtsod pa yi/ /tā ka la he bhek+ṣu tī ga ṇaḥ/ /tā sgyu mubye dzi tasta tra swa bhā baḥki la dus+t+ya tshig rtsub chen pos dge slong ma'i/ /tshogs ni yid dag byung bar byas/ /rang bzhin nges par gtang ④dzaḥ / /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ba tsa ṣ+pe ṣ+pe kā bai shā bā da na tsa pa rā/ /bhik+ṣu bar dka'/ /gcig gis gtum mo'i tshig dang ni/ /gzhan kyis smad 'tshong mar brjod pas/ /dge tī nā ma dhi k+ṣe saṃ da twa pā ba ma bā pa tuḥ / /bāsdoṣā྾ ba tsaṇ+ḍa slong ma rnams smad pa ltadag /byas pa'i sdig pa thob par gyur/ /de nyid gtum mo (zhengag skyon las/ /95—954

lbo dzā tā be+e shā ta thā pa rā/ /pra bra dzñā yāḥbra bhā be naḥpu naḥku sha la mā shri te/ /de bzhin gzhan smad 'tshong mar skyes/ /rab tu byung ba'i mthu yis ni/ /sbar yang dke ba dag la/ brten//sa ta mi tro kṛ ha pa tiḥ pad+ma ko yo ya ta bra taḥ / /bi bhā t+ya rta t+pa khyim bdag bshes gnyen de yang ni/ /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams pad ldan 'di/ /tshul khrims gtsang dā bāphywa shu tsi shī la bi byu ṣa ṇaḥ / / po྾ kaḥ pu t+pa se nā khyaḥ pad+ma bas rnam brgyan ‘she cing / /dgra bcom gnas ni thob pas mdzes/ /pad can skye ba gzhan la yang me ko pya n+ya dzad+ma ni/ /ba bhū ba put+pa ni tsa yeḥpū ri tābe+e dza naḥs dā/ /pra bye tog sde zhes me tog la(zhe7/ /me tog tshogs kyis slong ba yi/ /skye bo rtag tu khengs byed gyur/ /de yis ka pu r+ghaṃ so bh+ya tsu sgo ge na ts+tsha r+ya pā sa sā/ / ka ma lot+pa la ka s+thā rang rgyal longs spyod kyis/ /mchod nas gos kyis g.yogs byas te/ /pad+ma ut+pal ka da ra/ /me tog ra ku su meḥs ma bā ki ra taḥ/ /te na pu bye na dzā to yo pad+ma gar+bha pra bha ni bhaḥ//rnams kyis yang 1dag mchod/ /bsod nams sde jeyis pad+mo can/ /pad+ma'i 5snying po'i 'od mtshungs 'di//pad+ma kaḥ shā sa nārto me su kṛ to dā ra sau ra bhaḥ / / rū paṃ shī la be+e legs byas rgya che'i dri bzang can/ /bdag gi bstan pa la 'os gyur/ /gzugs ni tshul khrims kyis byu ṣa ṇi shu tsi ya shabyabye ba dā tai ku lo tse taḥpā ka be+e be+e ka nin+d+ra la ta ram̐ saṃ sā brgyan grags pa gtsang zhing zla ba lta bur dkar ba'i rigs/ /sems 6dben pa ni yongs smin shin tu dri ra bā maḥ sha maḥ/ /e tah+phu ju ma ho da ya da ya su kṛ ti dzā dṛṣ+ṭi med 'khor ba'i g.yon phyogs zhi gyur pa/ /'di dag mkhas pa rnams kyi bsod nams cher dar mtshan nyid k+ṣa oṃ lak+ṣa khaṃ dzā tirnan+t+ra ta mā ma nabya ma li rna duḥkadz+re tsit+na dṛ rde/ /blta 3bar bzod pa yin/ /shin tu smad 'os rigs dang yid ni dri ma can yang mi rnams las ngan rtags//i ti saza dzha ka thi taiḥ kadz+re pā kā ka thābye taiḥ/ /ba bhū ba ha r+ṣa saṃ zhes pa kun mkhyen gyis bshad pa'i/ /mod byung las smin gtam rngo dag gis/ /dge slong rnams ni dga' 9 95—955

spadhī byek+ṣu rde bisma yo da yaḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye ba yis/ /reg cing ya mtshan rgyas par gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems sa tā ba dā na ka lpa la tā yī pa d+ma kā ba dā na ཿ sa bhā shī ti ta dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las pad+ma can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste maḥpal+la waḥ// //brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //dṛṭī tī bra ta ram̐ ha rarnyi ni ya saṃ ṣ+pe bak+ṣu madhe she oṃ kadz+re k+ṣi pra ma no shin tu drag po'i 'dul/ snab mthong nas 'phrog cing zhi ba nges par bzod mi byed/ /myur bar yid ra oṃ hi ma sa oṃ pa r+yan+ta dā ha k+ṣa oṃ / / e tā be+e bh+ra ti sa dze+e dga' kha ba dang mtshungs mjug tu sreg par bzod pa'i las dag byed/ /bya min dag la 'jigs btang me ba bi ṣa ma ṣa ma swasdo pa oṃ bi bh+ra mi t+yasgyu kār+ya bhi yaḥpra brta na bye maḥsaṃ blo gros rab 'jug 'khor ba'i grogs mo bud med kyir bye/ /rmi lam dag dang mtshungs pa'i rnam 'phrul mtshan sā ra sa khyaḥ ste yaḥ / / bi m+bi sā ra su dṛ pa ti ཿ pu re rā dza kṛ nyid 'di dag thams cad nges par 'dzin/ /mi bdag gzugs can snying po yi/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i he pu rā/ / tsi tā khyo haste sha lbā ti pu tro bhūṅga dza se n+ya paḥ/ /sā rā dza tu khab tu sngon/ /nag pa zhes pa glang sde'i bdag /glang chen stan kyi bu ru gyur/ /rgyal po'i 'byor pa dang bye bi bha be+e kṛ haṃ tsa sa pa rits+tsha rda/ /t+yak+ta yu bai ba pra bra dzñā bai rā gyu rnyi mtshungs khyim/ /yo byad bcas pa rab (4btang nas/ /chags bral la ni mngon phyogs des/ /gzhon nu mu kho gra tīta/ /pasnri ta gya su ru pā khyu pra sru tra bi bha be+e kṛ te/ /bhadṛ nyid la rab byung bzung / /de yi chung ma gzugs mdzes ma 5/ /'byor pa rgyas pa'i khyim du ni/ /bdag sa sgo ga ra ti tā tsi ram̐ tsid+dhā tu rā bha ba ta/ /a tha kā le na par+yan+ta tsā po'i longs spyod dang bral bas/ /yun ring bsam pa 'khrugs par gyur/ /de nas dus kyis yongs 'dris 95—956

ri pa ri tsi tā da ra ta/ /sa tsi tra hasnyi shayā ti pu traḥswa pu ra mā ya yo/ /la—/ /gus pas mtha' ni rgyu byed pa/ /nag pa glang chen stan gyi bu/ /de ni rang gi khyim du song / /a sgyu ga ta gya ta spyo tha pā nu ga gya ni man+t+ra rde/ /pū dzā su raḥs ram̐ tsakre de nas mngon du 'ongs de la/ /chung ma mdza' gcugs ldan ma des/ /rjes su 'brangs nas mchod pa ni//pasbyi pra ṇa ya shā li nī/ / sā tsin+ta yat+ta mā lo kya dru rā dh+wa shra ma ṇiḥsngon du 'gro bas mgron gnyer byas/ /lam ring gis dub bde med desasna / /mthong nas de yis rab su khaṃ/ /a ho ba tā gya lā baṇ+ḍi yo ba ṣ+pe be+e ba dh+war+ya te/ /asmidru ya bsams pa/ /kye ma 'di yi mdzes sdug ni/ /lang tsho nyid kyis nges par bzung zhe(/ /na tshod longs spyod se sgo gārte pa ri t+ya bye kṛ ha shri yi/ /mi bye ba ki ma de nād+mā nidz+re tsā 'os 'di la/ /khyim gyi dpal ni / byeyongs btang nas/ /rnam par ma dpyad (sngu'adi yis ni/ /rdzun gyis re ṇa r+pā ḍi taḥ/ /sne he she sngo su nā t+yā pi dzān shān+tasta pa sri naḥ/ /ge bdag nyid ci la gdung / /gang zhig phyogs lhung bcas pa yi/ /mig gis khyem la lta byed pa/ /dka' haṃ sa pa k+ṣa pā te na tsak+ṣu ṣā yam+bi rīk+ṣu te / /a tha bā bye r+ya me ba thub can ni mdza' ba'i lhagahūṃ7 /da dung zhi ba min par nges/ /yang na dang por brtan patsapa nyid/ /do pa ri k+ṣu byer+ya kā ra rde/ /a su dzā nā mi bai rā rgya tsa la m+bi shān+ta yongs brtags brtan 7pa'i rgyu mtshan kyis/ /'di yi chags bral g.yo ba'am/ /brtan pa bdag gis me ba bā/ / kṛ he sgo ga ga ṇi ste p+taḥ sathruḥ kā na na m+bi ha te / /shes par bya/ /khyim du longs spyod tshogs kyis tshim/ /thams cad nags tshal mngon par 'dod/ /bi dza ṣ+pe tu su kha bhaṣ+ṭa māt+pa na ma nu sho tsa ti/ /i ti saṃ tsi t+ya sā dben par bde ba nyams pa'i tshe(2// /bdag nyid rjes su gdung ba byed97/ /ces pa bsams te 1de yi ta su sgo dza nā ba sa re pu raḥ/ /swa yi ta t+ya dza ha dze+e grwa tra sa shaste ni—/ /mdun du zas kyi gnas skabs su/ /sgra dang bcas par zangs kyi snod/ /ba gam rtse las rang 95—957

tā mra bhā dza rna/ /te na shasde na saṃ trasta i bā lo kya di shaḥk+ṣa khaṃ/ /ki me ta gis dor/ /sgra des kun tu skrag pa bzhin/ /skad cig phyogs su rnam par bltas/ /'di ci zhes pa nag di ti sa prats+tsha tsi tratsū saṃ bh+ra morlu khaḥ/ /ta taḥsmi ta mu khā+e ki tsita pa ti tai pa ni/ /'khrul pas mngon phyogs de la dris/ /de nas dar bab bzhin 'dzum ldan/ /de yis zangs tā mra bhā dza ā+oṃ/ /thra bhā ni be+e r+ya sā tasmi har+ṣah+phu na ra tsin+ta yata/ /a snod cung zad ni/ /lhung bar 1 de la bshad byas nas/ /dga' bas slar yang rab bsams pa re yo tā ba dā saṃ pāp+ta nim+bi kā ra pa daspru tiḥ/ /shi thi la lī la ma ba zhig rnam 'gyur med pa yi/ /gnas la gnas pa 'dis ma thob/ /'di yi yid ni lhod pa dag /rtse gya tūṇ+ḍi mā kṛs+t+ya te ma naḥ/ /yaḥpā tra shasda mā tre ṇa saṃ tā sa ku la tsā ga taḥ/ /dgas myur du khugs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig snod kyi sgra tsam gyis/ /kun tu skrag cing 'khrugs gyur pa//ki ki na kri ya te ta gya be+e ṣa yi ra bi mar+ṣaṇaḥ/ /sazaḥpra ṇa sh+ya ti pa yo dha rnam dpyod bra' ba de la ni/ /yul gyis ci dang ci mi byed/ /ngang pa thams cad chu 'dzin dag gi sgra tsam ra shasda mā tra saṃ tā sa lup+ta j-i ti brnya na e ba haṃ saḥ/ /te sharnyi ke pi las / /skrag cing brtan ṣ+pepa nyams pas bcings nas 'bros par byed/ /gang zhig sprin tshogs ka ma lā sa na rā dza haṃ sā ye pūṣ+ka rā gu ru pa gardzi ta niḥpraspalngaḥ/ /i ti nish+yi bcings par 4sgrogs la g.yo med pa/ /pad stan ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni kha cig yin/ /zhes pa yid kyis t+ya ma na sā sā sha ṣ+pe mṛ du bā di m+bi/ / ta mu bā tsa sa ma bye t+ya bhū la nges byas nas/ /byun ma'i 'khri shing rol rtsed can/ /'jam pa smra ba (shāde yis ni/ /de la mngon tā la su byā la yā/ /tre ṇa basmre pa ri t+ya bye twa yi dru ra ta ra ga te/ /sa phyogs dal gyis smras/ /bdag ni rtswa 6bzhin rab spangs nas/ /khyod ni ring du song ba'i tshe/ /bdag pasbyi bye ri bā krārnyi bi sadhiḥpa sh+ya me kṛ haṃ/ /asmin+da pe ma hā ram̐ bha me gi khyim ni chun 77mas bzhin/ /rgud pas zil gyis mnan la ltos/ /rtsom chen 'byor pa 'di la yang / /95—958

saṃ sgo ga be+e brdzi tā / / twasder+sha nā sha yi bā haṃ dh+ri tā sa khye ba niḥsu longs spyod dag ni rab spangs pa/ /bde med bdag ni grogs kyis bzhin/ /khyod mthong re ba nyid kyis khā / /ya da su nu tsi te ba hūṃ duḥkhāsto di da mu tsu te/ /ba dadhi bzung / / gang yang sna brjod par mi 'os pa/ /'di ni sdug bsngal dag ༷2snagis brjod/ /mi smra 'dod mo na kā me yo dza ṣ+pe dzi hā pa ladz+dza te/ /byu dzha kṛ hā bye pa ti nā pat+naḥshī la kyang brjod pa 'di/ /lce yang rab tu ngo tshar shes/ /khyim bdag gis ni chung ma yi/ /tshul khrims babe+ed gya bi sla baḥ/ /dṛsgo su dzā tai bai rā gye ma kā le ka tha ma n+ya thā/ /i ti bismi mthong de la ni/ /chags bral skyes pa ma yin nam/ /gzhan du dus min ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pa gzhan gyi tamu khaḥsazaḥpa raspa ra be+e lo ka ṣ+peḥ/ /ba dat+ya n+ya gu ṇaglu ni ga rja na yon tan ni/ /nyams pa bgrang ba la mkhas pa'i/ /bzhin 'dzum skye bo thams cad ni/ /phan tshun ni su no dza na ཿ / / bi yo ga ta dzñā rmā lo ka ཿ swa sgra tsiste ti ma rnam par lta zhing smra/ /'bral bas gdungs pa —bdag la ni/ /'jig rten sems sos snguzhes par n+ya te/ /kle she 6 kliṣ+ṭa rū pā haṃ tā ru ju su ka ro mi ki/ /kṛ he 'dzin—/ /dar ma nyon mongs dag la ni57/ /ma nyams gzugs dag dzi ci zhig bya/ /khyim du g.yog pa ri dza na: ye ma molja kha la hūṃ ga taḥ/ /a swā mi kā dzā nā ri ṇa 'khor 'di dag kyang / /bdag la shin tu ma bsdams gyur/ /bud med bdag po med rnams kyi/ /ma gre shā pi pra galha te/ /dā sa sru nudz+re me bā ya mubyeṣ+ṭi na bi batrī taḥ/ /mdun du khyi yang rab tu dgod dza/ /bdag gi lhag ma nyid kyis ni/ /rab tu bsos pa 'bangs phrug 'di//pa byā dzñā dā na ko pād+me ke shā kaste ṇa m+bi ha te / / i t+yā ghā kṛ ta bka' bsgos khros pas bdag gi 8ni/ /skra nas 'dren par 9/'dod la ltos/ /zhes pa brjod nas brda saṃ ke tā ni dza dā sa pa rā bha baṃ/ /bhangh+rubyet+ta bi kā rā ya pā pra t+ya k+ṣa byas te/ /bdag po'i sems ni rnam 'gyur slad/ /rang gi 'bangs kyis zil gnon pa/ /de yis 95—959

ma dar+sha ya tra / / smṛ hā ma kli ṣ+ṭa rū pe ti bai kla bye ni ཿ su khe ti mngon sum nyid du bstan/ /ma nyams gzugs zhes chags pa dang / /bde ba med ces 'khrugs yo3pa tsa / /yīsgri dzā tā pa bā de nyi kru bye dā pārdi te t+ya pi/ /sa hūṃ bi dang / /smad pasnyepar gyur ces phrag dog dang / /'bangs kyis gzir zhes khro ba yang / /thob nas de la lo ka yad+mā su saṃ t+yak+ta bra ta yazlu ṇaḥ/ /tu bye saṃ sā ra do ṣā rde sabye lta byed cing / /brtul zhugs kyis bsdams btang ba de/ /mtshungs par 'khor ba'i skyon rnams ni/ /bye ba sha mā ya yo / / pā tra ṭī ba ra mu bye bye kha dza ā kṛ 6 dī thams cad dag gi dbang du 'gyur(she/ /lhung bzed chos gos rab btang zhing / /'jigs rung ral gri ṣa khaṃ/ /thra yā ni kā ra krorle ṇa sa dā saṃ he tu mur+ya yo/ / pra ṇa phyung nas ni/ /dga' ma'i gnod pa la khros pas/ /de yis 'bangs ni gsod par zhugs/ /'bangs yābye ri taḥsasgyu pa dā sa ba dha bai ga sāta/ /lbo ram̐ pu naspyo ha su khaṃ bhe dze ni gsod pa'i sdig pa las/ /chung mas 'bad nas zlog cepa des/ /dgra las rgyal 'dod khyim gyis khyeni//dza na dzi gīste yā/ / so byu bye ga pa ri gra he ṇa la la nā saṃ sgo bde ba dman pa sgyu6slar yang bsten/ /de ni longs spyod yongs su bzung bas bud med longs spyod meskal ga sau bhā gya byurwa nā kā ra ni kā ra kā ra ṇa ka thā ti h+ye 6 ko pā bzang sa gzhir gyuraḍare / /rnam pa sna tshogs gnod pa'i gtam gyi rgyu las g.yog 'khor rnams la khro bas ku laḥ/ /kā maḥkar+ṣa ti saṃ ya rma k+ṣa pa ya ti kro dhaḥk+ṣa be+e na k+ṣa rmā no mi 'khrugs—/ /'dod pas dul ba nyams byed khro bas skad cig nyid kyis bzod pa rlag par she7byed/ /rdzun byā bra ta sho ṣi te na ma na sā bai rā gya mā sā r+ya te/ /a tha ha ste gyi te brtul zhugs dag gis gdung ba'i yid kyis chags bral nyid ni 'thob 11ma yin/ /de nas rgyal pos ma hā mā tra pa rda rā dzñābe+e ta pu naḥ/ /ā sā r+ya bi bha bo dā raḥso byu glang chen gyi 1rta/ /sna chen gnas ni slar yang byen/ /'byor pa rgya chen ⑫ thob gyur nas/ /de nas lhag 95—960

ta bh+ya bye kodzha baḥ/ /a tān+t+ra re piṇ+ḍa pā ta mā dā ya na ga dzā ta dā ta/ /par rgyas par gyur/ /skabs der grong khyer nang dag las/ /dge slong rnams kyis bsod snyoms blangs//bha ga brnye ba nā sbo ā+oṃ dzi na ma bhe t+ya nyi k+ṣa baḥ/ /be+e ṣaṇ+ḍa ba da nāstasmi bcom ldan rgyal ba nags tshal na/ /gnas pa dag la mngon phyogs te/ /chags bral bzhin byis de la ni//pra ṇi ba t+ya n+ya be da yan/ /tsi tra gya haste shayā nyi pu tra snga nu tsi tai bra tai/ /phyag 'tshal glang chen stan byu bu/ /nag pa dag gi brtul zhugs ni/ /'os pa min pa rnam par bshad/ /bha ga bān tha sa t+tha ཿ sa smi ta stu na bhā ṣa ta / / a sa —ba ku sha de nas bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /'dzum dang ldan pas der gsungs pa/ /de yi dase ba ma rmin le nai ba kṛ taste nabra ta gra haḥ/ /ye nit+pan+da bi be+e ka pā ka ka la pas—/ /brtul zhugs 3 dag ni blang bar byas/ /gang zhig dben pa smin zhing sdogs pa'i brtag pas nā niḥsho ṣi tā shā la twaste nā yārnyi pu naḥpu rā ṇa be+e ṣa yā swā da smṛ tedze+e yid kyi 'khri shing bskams ༄27gyur pa/ /de dag phyi nas yul gyi nyams myong rnying pa dzudran pa'i dbang du sh+ya nywa / /ye twarja pra nyi ṣid+dhā gadze+e shi thi la t+yak+ta pra sak+ta da rāste ṣā 'gyur ma thuyin/ /gang zhig don gyis bkag cing khengs pas lhod la rgyun du gus pa rab btang ba/ /de man+ta ra sbosdi ka ma sha ma yordo lā ya mā rgo ma naḥ/ /dzad+mā sgyu sa ni ṣak+ta dag 'dod dang zhi ba'i bar mtshams dag la/ yid ni 'phyang mo yug par byed/ /gang gis g.yang sar lhung e ṣa bi ṣa ya yaspar+sha bhi lā ṣaḥpa ram̐ bi dzñā so pi pa ri t+ya dzarnyi ni ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyang dul ba dag ni yongs gtong zhing / /chags pa'i dug rgyas rnal 'byor can ya oṃ ye nā pa ṭi pā ti tā/ /rā go da gra bi ṣā bi shadhi bi ṣa ma dzñā hūṃ rnams mi bzad smag 3)rum sa la 'jug par byed/ /skye bar goms pas chags shing yul gyi reg pa mchog bhu oṃ yo gi naḥkā maḥ ka su ka ro ti tīṇ+ḍi bi shi khā sā re bi kā rek+ṣa tu mngon par 'dod gyur pa/ /rnam 'gyur mda' yi char drag dkrigs cha ‘67'dod pa 'di ni su la bzod 95—961

dat+taḥpu ro hi taḥ/ /nit+pan+da be+e na yo bi byā pu tre ta gya ba bhū ba tuḥ/ /'phrog byed kyis byin byung / /de la rig dang 'dul ba dag /rdzogs pa'i bu gnyis byung gyur te/ /ha ri dru ya ṇa i bye kasta thā ha ri shi khophopa raḥ/ / to bi be kāp+ta gcig ni 'phrog byed bu zhes dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa 'phrog byed rtse/ /de dag chags bral dben pa bai rā gya bha ba sgo ga ba rādru kho/ /ta bo ba ṣ+pe pa ri bra bye padzi bye dzñātwa thob—/ /srid pa'i longs spyod las phyir phyogs/ /dka' thub nags tshal yongs rgyu zhing / /mngon shes mā pa tuḥ/ /to byo ma tsā rī zlo rā dzñā pū bye mā kau dza ṣ+pe na tsa/ /lnga ni thob par gyur/ /rgyal dang skye bos mchod byed lkucing / /rab zhi bsngags par 'os pa yisarte)/ /pā ya tuḥpra sha ma shā bh+yo mu m+bi nām pi mā n+ya hūṃ/ /ka dā tsidhū ba bha ba mkha' la rgyu ba de dag ni/ /thub pa rnams kyi'ang mchod byar gyur/ /nam zhig sa bdag khang pa na/ /nasbi ti ha ri shi khe 1 paḥ/ /ka dh+yā lā ba bye ba t+yā khyu mū tsi disbi dza yorlu 'phrog byed rtse gnas mi bdag ni/ /phyogs las rgyal ba ( mngon phyogs pas/ /bu mo mdzes ldan zhes la khaḥ / /be྾ twa yā mu ṣ+pe re su go ra be+e ṇa ga rī ya sā/ /pū rje su pū dza smras—/ /mnyes gshin khrod kyis gus pa ni/ /shin tu che bas thub pa dag /mchod bya 'di la mchod pa rna kārngu saṭ+wā rāho khya yasma ma/ /su tā mi ti sa mā di sh+ya pra yā te thra thi bī pa bya thu—/ /'di ni bdag gis bkur ste sa7'os/ /zhes pa bu mo la bstan nas/ /sa yi bdag po rab song to / /rā dza pu ṭī su de bā bhūtra pū dzā pra ṇa yi m+bi mu ṣ+peḥ/ /he mats+tsha dats+tsha tshe—/ /rgyal po'i bu mo gus ldan mas/ /thub pa rtag tu mchod par gyur/ /gser bcad 'od ltar bi pa ri tsi hūṃ kārnyi oṃ ge da dh+wa dzha tai ba sh+yas+t+ri ka ma la na ya rna mā bhe khā ṣā bha yongs su shes pa'i mdzes pa lus la 'dzin byed cing / /pad+ma'i spyan dang ldan pa de mthong de ni mngon par ba ta sā/ /kā maḥkā oṃ ru tsi ra bi ṣa yā lalba naḥsaṃ ga mā ṇi pra t+yā sred ldan gyur/ /lhan cig 'khod pas nges par mdzes pa'i yul la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa yis/ /95—963

sa t+yā ki ma pi dz+dza da ye ba dhe mū lā ka ro ti/ /sbo naḥ sha sadhisma 'grogs pa'i bsam pa snying la rtsa ba zug pa ci yang byed par 'gyur/ /rlung ky-igazhon dag gis bskyod pa'i ra saṃ bh+ra me ṇa bā khā ni le nā ka li tā ka te ba/ /saṃ ge ra saṃ ga 'khri shing bzhin/ /'dod pa'i rnam 'phrul shugs 'byin lus dag ni/ /dud pas de yi lus kyi kun gya mu ṣ+pe: kā ra ā nan+da mā li ga na mā na tī shā/ /na ba hu ba mu kha lasne dga' dang / /bcas pas 37grogs med thub la 'khyud pa byas/ /de yi nu ma gsar pa'i rtser chags lus dzā ka rā ge ṇa ta sde z-i di ma da na dṛ pā dzñā le khya mu bye da dh+wa naḥ/ /mu ni kyi tshon gyis ni/ /'dod pa rgyal po'i bka' yig rgya ldan snying la 'dzin byed cing / /de dus nyid na glo ra bha ba da kaṇ+ḍi bye ya mā khā ba dzha gā da bhi na ba ma da li nohūṃ kha lastasgru ṇi na/ /bur du ni dul ba'i gdags thag chad/ /thub pa 'dod pa'i rtse dga' gsar pa dag la 'byor ṅku par gyur//bṛ ṣa bya yā yām+bi thu na kṛ yā dze+e sa mu r+ya taḥkarka ta du rusgra he ṇa/ /sā rā khyu mchog nyams las 'khrig pa'i bya ba la/ /rab tu sbyor zhing sdig pas bzung ba bzhin/ /rgyal po seng dza sau ha su gra herna tu l+yasta pā ya ka sde ga ma norlu kho khyuta/ /na madh+ri ge'i khyim du nyi mtshungs desgo/ /gdung slad bu mo 'a ni 'gro 'dod gyur/ /'khyud pa'i sgrub byed dag la rūt+pa: na tsa ru tsi ma maḥshān+t+ra ma ṇi bhin+d+ra yo gin+d+radh+yā ṣ+pen+d+ra tsa sha ma bi she sngo lag 'gro ma rnams dug ni mi bzad pa/ /yang yang rgyal snyermongs 'jig byed rang bzhin lus la nges par ṣa bye ra me+eḥ/ /mu hurmyats+tsha mo ha pra la ya ma ya mā s+thā ga na bi sgo bhu dze+e zhugs pa dag /sngags kyis zhi ba ma yin 'od kyi rang bzhin bstan bcos nor bus min/ /sbyor min gī rmā byu ā+oṃ bi ṣa saṃ ge ni ba pa ti/ /ni pa ti ta spru ta ma yo mṛ gāṣ+ṭha bsam gtan gyes min zhi ba'i khyad par sman kyi ro yis min/ /mdza' ba'i rang bzhin rkun po'i longs sa tsor+ya saṃ sgo ga ma ye ma ma dz+dza/ / ma m+bi ṣi zla ma gya bi be+e ka spyod chur/ /ri dwags mig can gyis 'phangs de lhung ste/ /dban /tsho67pa med las skyes pa'i yid srubs 95—964

taste te ma z-i shā ra bya gra pā ṇi yu tsā mu niḥ/ /e tī nyi bi smṛ ta gser gyi chu snod kyis/ /lag gnyis byel she3ba de la ni/ /thub pa brtan pa brjod chapa yis /dh+ri tiḥpra sār+ya bhu dza ma bra bīta/ /ta mya sma ra bi kā ram̐ tai dṛbye ba ku bi to lag brkyangs rnyitshur shog ces pa smras/ /de yi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur de/ /mthong nas mi bdag rab dṛ paḥ/ /pā pa pra ti kri ya yo ge ni gra he bi da bye ma ti/ /spyu ra ko khros te/ /sdig pa'i phyir bcos sbyor ba la/ /chad pas bcad pa'i blo gros bsgrubs/ /drag po (rnyikhros pa paṃ pi tut+tha khyedṛṭī lā ba rgya ba t+ya pi/ /kaṇ+ḍi lam+bi mu ṣ+per+bhagh+ra mi trughā gya pha yi bzhin/ /mthong nas mdzes ldan ma yis kyang / /thub pa'i mgrin par zas chags zhes/ /brjod da do pa yaḥ/ /pā pā bat+na ba be+e tsi ṭ+wā pra t+yāt+pan+da gi raḥpa ra mā nas de la chu dag byin/ /bud med phur bu'i blo gros can/ /skabs su nyer mkho'i tshig dag ni/ /phyir yā ma yi bi ni ma ye thra haspa ti bye yaḥste yaḥ/ /du nyi tuzla tsa pā te na sa zlog sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sdig pa'i sgrib byed rnam par bkra/ /bu mo yi ni tshig de yis/ /'phral ha me+e ba pra san+da tsā/ /dṛ baḥka ta ka tsūrje na dza la sha ya i bā ya yo/ /a tān+ta la nyid du mi yi bdag /ka ta ka yi bye ma yilta/ /chu yi gnas bzhin dang bar gyur/ /skabs der thub re mu ṣ+pesta gya byesgo bhā tā ba na sbi tiḥ/ /bi nabye di byadhidzñā tā lup+tadherga ga pa rdzu 'phrul bri/ /de yis ⑥mkha' la 'gro nyams pa/ /spun zla thu bo nags na gnas/ /lha yi spyan ldan na ga ti/ /duḥkhi taḥswa ya ma bye t+ya tai dī tāḥni dza mā shra ma/ /pañtsa gyis shes nas/ /sdug bsngal rang nyid mngon phyogs te/ /de ni rang gi gnas khrid nas/ /slar yang bhe r+ghaṃ pu na :kre tsa tu rje na pa rā ya rde/ / na ra pa ti ra pi dzñā bsam gtan bzhi bskyangs te/ /mngon shes lnga dang ldan par byas/ /thub pa chags pa'i chu gter du tā rā go da dho pa ti tai mu no bi ṣa ma bi ṣa ya kle shā baṭ+wāh+phu na: bi nirga tai/ /ba lhung mi bzad yul gyis ⑩ni/ /nyon mongs 'khor lo dag las phyir phyung rab mang dka' thub kyi/ /gzi 95—966

hu ta ra ta paste dzo dagha sma ra smṛ nyi pā ta kai ru ṣa mu pa tsi shā t+yaghā dhī mān+d+ra yi khye'adod pa dran pa'i sdig bsregs shes nas khro ba'i tshogs/ /btang nas mi bdag blo ldan dag khya kyang pā da mu pā ya yo/ /ha ri drwa ya ṇa saṃ zlo sā bra ho me ba ta dā bha baṃ/ /tsi tro ha rab tu dang bar gyur/ /de yi tshe na nga nyid ni/ /'phrog byed bu yi ming can dethu/ /nag pa dag kyang ri shi khabyajut+ta sbyi ba dṛ pād+ma dzā/ / a bi ta shaṃ bra thi hūṃ swa ka thā 'phrog byed rtse/ /chung ma rgyal po'i bu mor gyur/ /de skad der ni mi bden ma yin rab grags pa'i/ /mi rmā ka baṃ ta bā ni nyi ta tra ta thā ga taḥ/ /sa ka la do ṣa ma ye na bha be+e rang gi gtam 'di de bzhin gshegs pas bshad gyur te/ /gang gi 4srid pa mtha' dag skyon gyi rang ma nyiḥki ma pi t+tak+ṣu ga ṇa gya ya yā bha ba ta/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra bzhin las/ /dge slong tshogs kyis 57blo gros ci yang zhugs ma gyur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas tsi tā yī bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī tsi tra haste sha yā tī pu tā ba dā na pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las nag pa glang po'i stan gyi rtogs maṭ+wā shī ti ta ma pabe+e baḥ// //pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //azlu ta bye ra ba gha nā ni la ni dz+re to m+bi saṃ pū ri tā khi la di 'jigs rung stug po'i rlung gis rab bslangs rba gyerlabs rnam sprul pas/ /ma lus phyogs kun ga n+ta ra gho ra gho ṣaḥ / / du s+thā ra bā ri bi kṛ nyi dz+re ka rā ka ro yongs ()'gengs de drag po'i sgra dang rab tu ldan/ /chu srin 'byung gnas bzlog dka' chu yi rnam 'gyur pi so byun+ta me nyi su ga ta sma ra ṇi na sum̐ sī/ /shā bsgyu swaste ye sazla can de yang / /bde gshegs dran pa'i mi rnams dag la mtha' ru gyur pa nyid/ /rgyal ba 'gro kun bde rnye dza ga tsā sa to r+ya te / / dzi na dze ta ba nā rā bi hā ra ni ra legs la/ /rtag tu sbyor zhing mnyan yod kyi/ /rgyal byed tshal gyi kun dga' ra/ /gtsug lag khang na 95—967

te pu rā/ /bi pu la dī pa yā tā yā mun+d+ra he na kṛ ta k+ṣa ṇaḥ/ /rat+nabye ba sngon zhugs lkutshe/ /yangs pa'i gling du 'gro ba la/ /spro ba yis ni dus byas pa/ /rin chen don gnyer ni dzā sārjaste radze+e ba ma ho da dheḥ/ /ta taḥpra ba ha zla rū bye sābe+e gu ru tshong pa yi/ /don mthun chu gter chu 'gram phyin/ /de nas gzings la don mthun ni/ /rab tu zhon tshe ta ram̐ bha ram̐/ /bi tsin+d+ra kaṇ+ḍi dh+wa rastu dru tse madz+dza na saṃ ki taḥ/ /ke yo yuṣ+ṭha phyi ba'i khur/ /dpyad nas bying du dogs pa yi2/ /rna ba 'dzin pas de la smras/ /khyed rnams rab tu ka mokhru kyā dā ro ha ṇa pa ram̐ pa rā/ /two ga tu ram̐ ga lnga go yo na kṛ hūṃ sred pa yis/ /brgyud mar zhon pa 'di ni ci/ /chu gter rba ka7rlabs rtse mo 'u'adi/ /khyim gyi khyams ni ga ṇa oṃ bu byeḥ/ /sa khyastu bah+phu ba ha ṇi bha bad+dhiḥkṛ ya tsā bha raḥ/ /rat+na yongs ma yin/ /re zhig khyod kyis 3gzings la ni/ /'tsham pa'i khur dag rab tu mdzod/ /rin chen rā shi na ka gyeṣ+ṭaḥki twadhi rba hu bi sla baḥ/ /a n+ya trom+bi pra ba n+taḥkha phung po su mi 'dod/ /'on kyang chu gter 'tshe ba mang / /chu gter na ni gzhan na rba ⑥rlabs rab ra ma ka ra ku ka bya ku lo n+ya tra be+e gaḥtīṇ+ḍi n+ya tā n+ta rā drispri ra shi kha 'khrug gzhan na drag po'i chu srin tshogs dkrigs shugs/ /gzhan na nang gi ri bo brtan ⑦pa'i rtse mo stug ra gha noṅgha ta saṃ byā ha to ghaḥ/ /a n+ya tro r+yaskṛ tai ta shwa si ta ta ra pas khyerab bsnun tshogs kyi kyergyun bkag 'thor/ /gzhan na rlung ni mthar byed dag gi dbugs ltar drag ma rut+pani pā tai bh+ra mo nībyaṇ+ḍi n+ya tā sbya kāṇ+ḍa k+ṣa ya ni bi ḍa shi khā maṇ+ḍa pa langs pas kun tu bsnun cing 'khor/ /gzhan na glo bur nyams byed rta gdong me ni rab brtan me lo bā ḍa bāsniḥ/ /khru two ti kaṇ+ḍi dh+wa re ṇa ka thi tai ru pa oṃ bu dheḥ/lce'i dkyil 'khor gtum pa yod/ /ces pa rna ba 'dzin pa yis/ /chu gter rang 7bzhin bshad thos nas//a ba ru khya ya yuḥke tsit+ta sbyaḥke tsid+ma hā sha yāḥ/ /rat+na dī pa ma thā 'ga' zhig babs nas song bar gyur/ /bsam pa che ba 'ga' zhig 'khod/ /de nas rin chen gling phyin 95—968

gho ra su ṣ+pe tra yu.oṃ pra dṛ sh+ya te/ /dā da sharko da ya raste srur+ya dwa ya 'char rtsom tshe/ /nyi ma zung ni shar ba bzhin/ /dus mtha' 'jigs rung 'di yi ni/ /mig ni zung dag mi bo di tai/ /a snga gya shwa bh+ra par+yarnye shu bh+ra pa ri bā ri tā/ /ma hā rab tu mthong / /'di yi kha yi g.yang sa'i mthar/ /sprin dkar dag gis yongs bskor ba'i/ /ri rtse tri shri ga mā le ba lak+ṣu te da sha nā ba lī/ / pra ba te ṇa pra ba ha chen po'i 'phreng /37ba bzhin/ /so yi 'phreng khyab rab tu mtshon/ /'di yi kha ru lhung ba yi/ /rgyun gyis r+ṇa kṛṣ+ṭa ma snga pya dzā ti nā/ /bi ṣa yā bhi mu khaṃ tsit+ta mi ba dhartun+da shākya te/ /gzings ni drangs 1pa dag /yul la mngon par phyogs pa yi/ /sems bzhin gzung bar nus ma yin//smar+ya tsā de ba tai ki tsidz+dzad+mān+ta ra shu bha pra rda/ /pra ti kri yāsmin+d+ra ste ba ni dha 'chi ba las kyis sprul gyur pa/ /'di la phyir bcos yod ma yin/ /skye ba gzhan la dge ster ba'i/ /lha ṣ+pe kadz+re nim+bi te/ /i sgoste kaṇ+ḍi jo re ṇa shu tā sabye ba ṇisba rāḥ/ /ni cung zad dran par mdzod/ /ces pa rna 'dzin gyis brjod pa/ /tshong pa'i tshogs (d+nghakun gyis thos nas//na mo bud+dhā ya bud+dhā ye dre buḥsā kran+da nā di naḥ/ /nā rda te ྾ bha yāṭ+wā dzā sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /cho nge'i sgra dang ldan pas smras/ /'jigs pas gzir ba de bha ga bān bhū ta bhā ba naḥ/ /di bya tho tre ṇa shu shā ba dzi no dze ta ba dag sgra/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal bzhugs 'byung po la dgongs pas/ /lha yi rna ba dag naspru teḥ/ /bud+dhā bye dh+wa dzā shu te ba ta maḥpra sha ma dz+wa nyi tiḥ/ /sha ṣ+pergya m+bi la gis thos/ /mun pa zhi byed sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan thos nyid na sems can gyi/ /nyer 'tshe zhi sbad nya yad+makhye satwo pa sla ba shan+ta ye/ /saṃ thraṭ+wā phye sha be+estasmin+d+ra ti be+e sho gha bi mid kha/ /dal bu yis ni zum par gyur/ /dal gyis de ni kha bsgribs tshe/ /mi mthun phyogs 'gro rgyun sla bāta/ /kā la bas+thāt+tha ba ha khaṃ mut+ta ta ṭa mā ya yo/ /ta taḥku sha li naḥnyams pas/ /dus kyi kha las grol ba yi/ /gzings ni rang gi ngos su phyin/ /de nas mi bzad 'jigs 95—970

san+d+ra ti ṭ+wās+t+ri bra ta rād+dhā yāta/ / shā bste rat+na saṃ pu sh+lau bi shudhibe+e khru las thar/ /grags pa'i dpal ldan rin chen gyis①/ /khengs shing dge 2ba ldan pa kun/ /mnyan yod ta shrī yaḥ/ /te ga tā bhak+ta saṃ yugh+ra bya san tā ṇa kā ri rde/ /dzi rna du ni rnam par zhugs/ /gus ldan de dag song gyur nas/ /gdung ba skyob par mdzad pa po/ /rgyal ba dze ta ba nā se ā+oṃ bha ga bārnye ba ban+di re/ /te ta gya dar+sha ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba stson+da saṃ bcom ldan rgyal byed kyi/ /tshal na bzhugs la phyag dag 'tshal/ /de dag de mthong nyid na ni/ /'khor sā ra ban+dha nāḥ/ /sa r+yaḥpra sā da mā sā r+ya pra bra rjerta twa mā ya yuḥ/ /ba'i 'ching ba chad gyur cing / /'phral la rab tu dang ba thob/ /rab tu byung nas dgra bcom gyur/ /a bha bad+ku sh+ya pā khya gya shāstuḥshā sa na bar+bhe naḥ/ /e te dzad+ma ni pūzadz+ren 'di dag sngon gyi skye ba la/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa yi/ /bstan la zhugs par gyur to zhes/ /thra bā tsa bha ga bā ni ti/ /ti mo gi la gi li stasgo bista raḥs twa saṃ bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu gsungs bye/ /rgya mtshor ④nya mid mid pa yang / /sems can 'joms las dṛ te/ /pā pak+ṣa ṇi na tī:ghiḥk+ṣur+ṣa ta pā ṇa saṃ k+ṣa yo/ /klin+da ka chags bral te/ /bkres pa'i me rdon gyis nyen cing / /skad cig gis ni srog zad thob/ /dri dang snye7 mi le ba re ta gya du rā mo dā sa histu bhiḥ/ /sobye gerba li bhirtswa giḥk+ṣibye dza bzod yid 'byung dang / /bcas pa'i klu ni stobs ldan gyis/ /de yi ro ni mi gtsang ba/ /chu gter la ni dhesta ṭa/ /sa shuṅgāsbi ma yaḥkā yaḥkā le na k+ṣa lo tem+bu byeḥ/ /tu ṣā dag gi ngogs su 'phangs/ /dus kyis lngarus pa skam po yi/ /rang bzhin lus de ༄ d+nghachus bkrus pa/ /ri ra rā shi saṃ ts+tshan+daḥshe la ku ṭa i bā ba bye/ /shā bahūṃ drwah+ma ṇa snga tha su madhoḥbo brtsegs pa kha ba yi/ /phung pos bsgribs pa bzhin du mjes/ /de nas mnyan yod bram ze ni/ /su pu tra hūṃ ga taḥ/ /mā tuḥs tsakre gasgo sbra s+t+ri bye k+ṣudruḥkha be da dzā/ /man tu yi bu nyid gyur/ /ma la bkres pa'i sdug bsngal tshor/ /mi bzad mngal gnas de yis byas/ /95—971

sa dzā tabyā sha tasta byeskṛbe+e nakhyi dhi to ya yo/ /sa sha ṣ+pesbasnya mā nabya saṃ skyes tshe bkres pa bud med ni/ /brgya yi 'o mas tshim ma gyur/ /dal byus skyed ① bsrings tshe na nikhye/ /bhū taispyo ri sgo dza ṣ+peḥ/ /a trepyu pa ra mubyisnaḥs ga tā bhegru saṃ ga oṃ/ /zas tshogs shin tu mang bas kyang / /ma tshim mchog tu yid byung ba/ /de ni dge slong tshogs song nas/ /pra bra rdzu sa mu pā dā ya trobhen+da pra pa piṇ+ḍa kaiḥ/ /ba hu bhusbi khru taḥso tha bi pu rab tu byung ba nye bar blangs/ /bsod stoms dag gis tshil ma gyur/ /de nas cher bkres grags pa de/ /la leḥsaṃ gha sgo dza naiḥ/ /shrad+dhā ni man+t+ra ṇistaspyon+d+ra kwa tsidh+ri p+ta mā ya yo/ /dad pas mgron gnyer dge 'dun gyi/ /rgya che mchod ston de dang des/ /gang du yang ni tshim ma gyur/ /a tā n+ta re kṛ ha pa ti ཿ shrī mān+d+ra na bra tā bhe dhaḥ / / ni man+t+ra zla skabs der khyim bdag dpal dang ldan/ /sbyin pa'i brtul zhugs zhes brjod pas1/ /dad pa yi ④ni ya bhik+ṣu rde shradha yā sa mu pa ya yo/ /saṃ bhe ma ye tam+bin+d+radz+dza ya dhī ma hā gter—/ /'dzam bu'i gling du sngon tre7byung gyur/ /de yi dus na 'phags rgyal du/ /tshong pa tsan+dan byin dha naḥ/ /ba ni stsan+da na daṭ+wā khyaḥpra khyu ta kra ya bi kra yaḥ/ /ta gya kā zhes pa/ /nor chen nyo tshong rngudag gis ni/ /rab tu grags pa byung bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma 'dod ma ba khā khyu yī dzā yī yī ma da na byu tiḥ/ /a shwa daṭ+wā bhi dh+wa no bhūta pu traḥkā pa'i stobs/ /zhes la stsos byed ltar mdzes bu/ /rtas byen zhes ni bya ba dag /lus bzhin du ni dga' ya i ba pri yaḥ/ /aṭ+wās+thā sa dza gā mādhi pasbyi n+yasta kṛ ha sbi ti/ /dha ṣ+pe ba byung / /khyim lugs chung ma la bkod nas/ /nor don gnyer de rgya mtshor song / /lan tshwa yis ④nārja ni rmā tro: la ba de nai ba bar+bha te/ /tat+pasnri pro ṣi te ba khyo yo ba bzhin nor can rnams/ /nor dag gis ni sred pa 'phel/ /de yi chung ma khye song tshe/ /lang tshos myos nod+mā da mo hi tā/ /kṛ ha tsidzñā pa ri t+ya bye kā ma dh+yā na pa rā bha bta/ /ku shing rmongs pa yis①/ /khyim gyi bsam pa yongs btang nas/ /'dod pa'i bsam gtan la chags gyur/ /mā rā ma shwa datrī sā ni dh+wa ya dha na kan+d+ra ṇi/ /sa dā pā sā da harmya de yis nor gyi las la ni/ /gzhon nu rtas byen rnam 67bkod nas/ /rtag tu khang bzang ba gam du/ /s+thā rā dza mārge bya lo ka yata/ /swe rā ra kā sha ra hi tā ba hu dṛ t+ya dzaṣ+pe gnas te ⑦rgyal po'i lam la bltas/ /g.yog 'khor mang po'i khyim du ni/ /rang dbang gnas skabs bral 95—983

kṛ he/ /thrad+dhā dh+wa ṭī sa ma bye t+ya dīsgotshwa sā dza gā da sā/ /bi bha be+e ba hu ba des/ /shugs rings phyung nas ma ma ni/ /rgan mo dag la mngon phyogs smras/ /khyim ni 'byor zhing sgo gesmin+d+ra dzñā dhī na dza no kṛ he/ /swe ra saspyo ra tī nā yā mā taḥs longs spyod mang / /skye bo bka' las khyenyan pa 'dir/ /rang dbang spyod pas dman pa yikhye) ma ma h+ye na me ra ti/ /nā dhi kā rarne saṭ+wā riṭ+wā lo kā rirna sgo dza ṣ+peḥ/ /bi bdag la dga' ba med/ /skyes pa'i longs spyod med pa na/ /bud med dga' ba bsten pa ni/ /dbang nā pu byu ṣa saṃ sgo ge bha dzadhe la ṭa bhāḥsu khaṃ/ /tas+thābye haṃ pa ri t+ya bye gis ma yin bkar stes min/ /rgyan gyis ma yin zas kyis min/ /de slad khyil ni yongs btang nas 2 / /gasgo mits+tshan+da tsā ri bhā/ /bā bye dzā taḥsu te sre ṣa na ste hā ya ta nasma ma/ /bdag ni 'dun pas rgyu zhing 'gro/ /gzhon skyes bu ni 'di la yang / /bdag ni chags pa'i dbang ma gyur//ku la kyu la twa yā ba dhe ba n+tu ba d+dhā na yo tra rde / / na sa ha dhe rigs kyi 'jug ngogs kyis bcings shing / /gnyen byu 'ching bas bsdams pa dag /bud med dga' ta ram̐ gi byo ra ti shī lā hi yo ṣi taḥ/ /i ti bru bā rde tā mū tse ba'i ngang tshul can/ /g.yo ldan dag gis bzod ma yin/ /zhes smra ④ de la ma ma ni/ /shin tu dh+wa ṭī bāt+pa l+ya bi kla bān/ /ba྾ na ga ma na yut+ta t+yak+ta su be+e su mdza' bas 'khrugs pas smras/ /mnyes gshin shin tu yangs pa'i dpal/ /btang nas dze+e shri yo/ /ba hu kṛ h+ye kṛ he twasmin gup+ta tsar+yā na yu bye te/ /k+ṣa ṇi na 'gro ba rigs ma yin/ /bya ba mang pos khyekhyim 'dir ni/ /sbas pas (khyespyod pa mi sbyar te/ /gsang ba'i swe ra tsa ri tai rā dza mārge 6 dha bi ti/ /ka rja rak+ṣa se tsā ri tram̐ saṃ bhā yo ba spyod pa skad cig gis/ /rgyal po yi ni lam du rgyug /lang tsho tsha bas rab gdungs pa/ /khyod kyis spyod pa noṣ+ṭha zla/ /ka tha gra ha ni dh+wa niñtsa pā de non+d+rar+ya gats+tsha se/ /i taḥji ltar bsrung / /khyim gyi gter yang rkang pa yis/ /rab spangs khyod kyis ji ltar 'gro/ /'di nas 95—984

kā ma bi ṣa be+e ṣāḥshwa blu pā taḥka zla di taḥ/ /asmin+d+ra bha ya san+de he na 'dod pa'i dug 'be+ebs shing / /'di nas skad cig g.yang la lhung / /gnyis ka the tshom 'di la ni/ /dza ṣ+pe ki ka ri6 se/ /tā pad+mā ṇa pa be+e nā pi tsa pa laḥs ku byu h+la khāḥ/ /khyod kyis ci bya yongs mi ①shes/ /g.yo zhing dge mtshan ldan pa rnams/ /ji srid gos ni ma dor ①bar/ /pa raste yo pārja yadhen yā bat+pan+t+ra mu dzhati/ /na na ṣ+pe tai sa muṅkam+bi de srid srog gi zong gis kyang / /gzhan gyi bud med don du gnyer/ /'og pag gos nas drangs pa na//ra sa ram̐ shu ka kar+ṣa ṇi/ /gasgo mi muñtsa mubye ti kwa ṇarnyi ka mya ṣ+pespru ma ma ma zhes 'dar byed cing / /bdag 'gro thongs shig thongs shig ①ces/ /sgra sgogs de ni ④su zhig tā / /dṛṭī bi ba sa dzā thrat+ta karta byaḥsan+d+ra thā dza naḥ/ /ju dza pañdza ra 'dod—/ /rnam pa kun tu bya ba byas/ /skye bos gos med mthong nas ni/ /lag pa'i gzeb kyis saṃ rudheḥshu ka thra t+yā pa khā ya te/ /ti mi re ra ti tso re ṇa k+ṣa zlad+dhā bsdams pa yis/ /de tso tshul bzhin 'bros par byed/ /mun par dga' ba'i chom rkun dang / /skad su kha saṃ ga maḥ/ /pu naḥ pra bi rā tā lo ke pa ra lo ke sa mā ga cig byed ni bde bar 'grogs/ /phyin khyenas snang ba rab spangs pa'i/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu maḥ —/ /sā na ṭ+wā nibe+e la klibye ladz+dza ka ṭī da sgo mu khā+e/ /ku mārge 'grogs—/ /bzhin smad ngo tsha'i sdug bsngal can/ /'bras med nyams shing dman pa de/ /tshul khrims hā pi tai yadhī shī la raṭ+wā mi bak+ṣe te/ /sā ro di ti pra mṛ ta dubya ri tā rin chen lam ngan du/ /stor bar gyur pa 'tshol khye)ba bzhin/ /dri med tshul khrims do shal 'dod pa'i ngal pa bā dā snyu lā sru bi n+d+ra bhi ra man+da bi ṣā da kadze+e ཿ / / kā ma shra dub kyis chad cing / /mu tig 'bras bu sa gzhi yongs su khengs par byed pa bzhin/ /mi dman chags ma tru ṭi nin+d+ra la shī la hā ra mukyā pha le ri ba dha ram̐ pa ri pū ra yarnyi/ /bral du brtags mchi ma'i thigs pa rags pa yis/ /nyes spyod smad pa rab tu spros pa de ni ngu bar byed/ /95—985

bā la snga pi tu ṣā ra ran+d+ra ru tsi ram̐ saṃ gru ta yat+yārmitai s+thā yi t+yāḥs ha sā byis pa'i 'dzum bu bsel zer can ltar mdzes pa la yang rab tu sems byed cing / /pad+ma'i stan ltar lus ni m+bi li ta ta noḥpad+mā na nā yāḥpa ram̐/ /ge hān+taḥswa ka baṃ mi thaḥka tha no mchog tu zum zhing 'phral la rab tu nyams gyur te/ /khyem gye nang du phan tshun gtam rnams phyir ni rang ya tā mā kaṇ+ḍi yo t+yā ba hiḥswe rā gyuskṛ ṇa pal+la be+e pi lu li te gats+tsharnyi shaṃ kāsmanaḥ/ /gi gtam du thos gyur pa/ /'phyon ma rnams kyi yid ni rtsa yi 'dab ma bskyod pa la yang dogs par gyur①//rū pa da bye ṇa nir+yādhi ta ru sgo ཿ sa ti ba bye naḥ / / pa rtswat+pa rī gh+ra gzugs kyi dregs pas gzhon nu mas⑤/ /khyo yi khyim las phyi rol 'thon/ /yongs rtog rnams kyi gabasod t+ya byedhe pu sgyu s+thā ṣ+pe pa rī k+ṣa kaiḥ / / ta smrebye ha dz+re tī yā ste ya thā nams kyis(ge/ /gnas la yongs brtags phyi nas dor⑤/ /de be+ed khyem na gnas pa khyod/ /ji ltar pu ru ṣa saṃ ga maḥ/ /lo ke bha ba t+ya bi dzñā tasta thā yuk+ṣiṃ ba dā mya haṃ/ /skyes bu dang 'grogs shing / /'jig rten dag gis mi shes pa/ /de ltar rigs pa bdag ⑥gis brjod/ /a shwa dat+ta ku mā rā sau ki tsi dā san+da yo ba naḥ/ /dza na snga shaṃ ka m+bi ya khyod kyi gzhon nu rtas byin 'di/ /cung zad lang tsho dag la nye(lpi/ /skye bos dogs bya min pa'i slad/ / tāta su kha sgo gyaḥpa ram̐ ta ba/ /e bam+bi dhabya su mu khaḥkārnyi mā na pā pya te ku mchog tu bde ba longs spyod 'os/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i bzhin bzang dang / /mdzes sdug can ni ga las taḥ / /ni ra sā yaḥpra kā ro yo ya di tā bat+tha brta te/ /i ti dh+wa ṭī ba rnyed—/ /gal te re zhig rab bsgrubs na/ /'di ni gnod med rnam pa minaldu/ /zhes pa ma ma'i tshig tsaḥshu twa sā be+e yuk+ta ma ma n+yata/ /tī bra rā ga pra kā rān+dhaḥsā pa pā tan+da thos nas/ /de yis kyang ni rigs par bsams/ /chags pa drag po'i rnam pa yis/ /long bas sdog ltung ⑪pa sh+ya ti/ /dh+wa ṭī ta taḥku mā ra su rgyu sgo ga su khaṃ brta ram̐/ /swe mthong ma yin/ /de nas ma mas dal bu yis/ /bud med longs spyod bde bsngags pa⑩/ /bsgrubs 95—986

ram̐ bi dh+wa ya bi daste bi ṣa yā bhi mu khaṃ ma naḥ/ /ta ma bo tse ta sā ni t+ya shing bsgrubs nas gzhon nu'i yid/ /yul la mngon par phyogs par byas/ /rtag tu 'dod pa rab spros kṛ tā kā ma su tā ra rde/ /asnyi bat+pa twa du tsi tā kā dzisgo ṣi ta bhadṛ k+ṣa/ /nas/ /de la de yis rab smras pa/ /bu khyod la 'os 'ga' zhig ni/ /bdag po yul gzhan song ba yod//shu bye be+ethra ṣ+pe nidwo pe rā tro mo nāb lam+bi nī/ /ladz+dza ba tī sā su ta dzā twa yā khang stong sgon ma med par ni/ /mtshan mo mi smra la brten te/ /shin tu ngo tsha ldan ma de/ /khyod 7dang saṃ ga ma mits+tsha ti/ /i ti ta gya ba tsaḥkhru tā sā bhi lā ṣe ba ṇi ka su taḥ/ /yang dag 'grogs par 'dod/ /ces pa de yi tshig thos nas/ /mngon par 'dod ldan tshong pa'i bus/ /sa dā gup+ta kṛ he bhe dze dza na sde ra ti saṃ ga oṃ/ /sa ta tai se ba mā nā yāḥrtag tu sbas pa'i khyim du ni/ /ma dang dga' mgur 'grogs pa bsten/ /rtag tu rab bsgribs khyim du ni//prats+tshan+da bha ba ṣ+pe ra 1/ /brja mā nāḥs ri ta snga rā gāsniḥpra sha ma ya yo/ /dga' mgur spyod ༷pa sten byed pa/ /de la chags pa'i ma rngudag ni/ /rab tu 'phel zhing zhi ma thugyur//sā tsin+ta ya di rmā ni bye pratshwa da na ka darja dzā/ /na se hai byu pa sgo ga su de yi ⑤bsams pa rtag tu ni/ /rab tu bsgribs pa'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /mi bzod gzugs kyi longs pra k+ṣa shaḥki la dzī bi tai/ /a byo n+ya ba da rmā sgo bi lo ka na ra saṃ be+e nā/ /spyod la/ /snang ba nyid ni 'tsho ba lo⑥ / /phan tshun bzhin gyi chu skyes la/ /rnam par lta ba'i ro bral ba'i//na tsu sbra ṣ+pe na su ra te ka bye da ste su khot+pa pa ཿ / / ta smrah+phu sgo da 'o yi ④dga' mgur spyod pa la/ /bde ba'i dga' ston 'ga' duyod min/ /de bsgribs pa yi nyon nā yā pa ku mā ra gya pa yat+na taḥ/ /dzhaghā pra sa bha sa sgo ge pra di shā mongs ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas bcom ⑨byas te/ /'phral la longs spyod gzhon nu ma/ /gsal bar mi pra gam+bha tī/ /i ti saṃ tsi na sā rā tro pra bhā te byak+ta bi gra ha/ /bdag gis bstan par bya/ /zhes pa mtshan mo rab bsams te/ /rab gsal ⑪ lus des gos dag ni//95—987

ya yo bsnga pa rā dṛt+ta yubh+ya ta gya pra kā sha tsā/ /sa ni dze+e dza na 1 dṛṭī yongs su dze+e ba'i rig pa yi1/ /nang par de la rab gsal gyur/ /de yis rang gis ④ma mthong nas//rits+tshan+da mū la i ba dru maḥ/ /pa pā ta pā ta ka bi ṣā be+e she na bi ba shi kṛ taḥ/ /rtsa ba bcad pa'i ljon pa bzhin/ /sdig pa'i dug ni 'bebs pa yi①/ /dbang dang bral bar byas te lhung //ta yā shī tību nā sik+ta sa ṣ+peḥsaṃ dzha ma bā pa saḥ/ /bi ma khā pa thra thu shwa bh+ra de yis bsil ba'i chus bran te/ /dal gyis 'du shes thob pa des/ /rgya che g.yang sar 'khyam ④pa la//bi bh+ra mā di ba duḥkhi taḥ/ /ta mu bā tsa pa ri khya bye bhu dzā dzñā kā ma mo hi tā/ /sdug bsngal gyur bzhin smre sngags phyung / /dmyal bar lhung ba'i pho nya mo/ /'dod pas rmongs ma de yis ni//zla la hūṃ sā sa mun+d+ra mya na ra kā pā ta dru ti rmā/ /mi byā ki ma ya smin ma'i 'khri shing gzengs bstod cing ⑪/ /lag pas yongs 'khyud de la smras/ /khrod kyi mya ngan bzod mas+thā ṣ+pe bi ṣā da sta ba duḥs ha/ /kin+da dzā nā si nā rī shā ma sa t+yarnya dka' 'di/ /gnas min rdzun pa dag la ci/ /bud med chos kyis bsdams pa rnams/ /mi bden khyod n+d+ra yan+t+ra/ /natwa yot+yā di tai duḥkhaṃ j-i swā ka gya tsidha rna/ /sā dh+wa kyis mi shes sam/ /khyod kyi ⑥sdug bsngal yongs ma skyed⑦/ /su yi yang ni nor ma phrogs/ /thun mong ra su kha sgo gesmin ke yadhe bā pa bā sa nā/ /sa rat+yā d+mā ra zla nār+yāsta ram̐ gi bde ba'i longs spyod 'dir/ /khyod la sdig pa'i bag chags ci/ /g.yo ldan bsdams pa med pa yi/ /chu dhī ni rarga lo/ /ya snga rnge ba pi tās+thā tasta sum̐ kin+d+ra rtswa ti ki su taḥ/ /ya klung bud med thun mong nyid/ /gang la pha yis khrus byas teblu/ /bu ni khrus byed min nam ci/ /lam thā ye na pi tā yāta ste na pu tro pi gats+tsha ti/ /sā mā n+ya ga ma no e ba bat+ta bhā gang nas ni pha song ba/ /de nyid nas ni bu yang 'gro/ /bud med brgya lam dag dang mtshungs/ /thun sam+bi bhāḥ ste yaḥ / /e ka sgo gye ba la la nā na pa rasba ra marta mong ba yis ⑪bgrod bya nyid/ /bud med gcig gis spyod ⑩ bya nyid/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyis 'os min h+pha/ 95—988

ti—/ /yīsgo lu bhiḥkṛ tai kaish+yi de tat+pa ma yamā tra ka/ /ṣ+pe ba kā tsa da pa—/ /'di ni 'ga' zhig phrag dog dang / /ldan pas dam tshig byas pa tsam/ /dam pa'i don du dga' ga myuste ra t+yarjaḥpa ra mārja taḥ/ /e ka pā tro pa sgo gyu hi be+e tuḥpu tra gye mgu'i slad/ /bgrod par mi bya 'ga' yang med/ /pha dang bu yi snod gcig bzhin/ /bud med nye bar bste yaḥ/ /i ti yasne na sa ta yā saṃ sgo gā bye mu khaḥkṛ taḥ/ /sa dzā longs spyod bya/ /zhes te de yi hu7'bad pa yis/ /longs spyod la de mngon phyogs byas/ /'dod chags ta rā gaḥs ta tai shi ṣe bi dza na m+bi pa shuḥ/ /ta taḥkā le na pi ta re pra skyes pas rtag par yang / /phyugs bzhin du ni ma nyid bsten/ /de nas dus kyis 6rtepha dag ni/ /chu t+yā yā tai ma ho da dheḥ/ /sa gru bye pre ri to mā tā bi ṣe na be+e da dhe gter che las slar 'ongs pa①/ /ma yis bskul ba des (byegasang nas/ /dug gis srog dang bral bar byaste / /ta taḥs rā ga thradh+ri ba ni rarga la su khi ṣi bhā/ /swe re ku byas—/ /de nas chags pa 'phel ba yisro)/ /ma bsdams bde ba 'tshol ⑥ba des/ /mdza' bas rmongs mā ram̐ pra ṇa yā du bā tsasne ha mo hi tai/ /sā ra dra bi ṇa nā dā ya nir+yan+t+ra pa'i gzhon nu la/ /mdza' bas dal gyes rab smras pa/ /ma bsdams bde ba thob pa'i slad/ /snying po'i ṇa su khāp+ta ye/ /e hi de shān+ta rad+dhā bta gats+tsha baḥkaspyo kodzhai tai/ /i ti nor dag blangs byas la/ /tsher ma spangs pa'i yul gzhan du/ /'u cag re zhig 'gro bar bya/ /zhes pa tat+pa tsa.ā+oṃ khru tā tsi ra kā la sa m+bi hi tai/ /sā ra dra bi ṇa mā dā ya ya yo sa hi de tshig yun ring gi /dus su 'dod pa thob gyur nas/ /nor gyi snying po blangs byas te/ /de ni de dang tasta gya yā/ /de shān+ta re kṛ ta pa do pa re prats+tshan+da pā ta kau/ /dzā yā 'grogs nas song / /yul gzhan dag tu gnas byas te/ /sdig pas rab bsgribs de dag ni/ /chung ma pa ti hūṃ bi khyu su to nibe+e tai ma bā pa tuḥ/ /ta taḥka dā tsit+taṅge haṃ swa de sha prat+ya khyo bo nyid du grags/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par gyur/ /de nas nam zhig khyim der ni/ /rang gi yul 95—989

bhi snyo yā/ /dzha gruḥpa ri tsi to bye t+ya bāt+pa s+thāt+ta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /par mngon shes pas/ /yongs 'dris hudage slong mngon phyogs te/ /mnyes gshin las ni de la smras//kañtsibye ku sha lasmra tuḥkastsodz+dzad+ma ma ṭī mu huḥ/ /t+yas+t+ri yash+yihūṃ ya tash+yir+ghaṃ khyod kyi ma ni dge ba'am ci/ /skye ba btang las ④yang yang du/ /bsam ①pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems//nā pā t+ya nu sha ya bya tsā/ /i ti bhispyot+tha tsaḥkhru tā shi la ye ba sa tā ḍi taḥ/ /'gyod gdung med par gyur tam ci/ /zhes pa dge slong tshig thos nas/ /rdo ba yis ④ni bsnun pa bzhin//pra t+ya bhi dzñā na tsa ki hūṃ ste hūṃ yuk+ta ma tsit+ta yatu/ /sa mā tra sa ha 'dri shes bdag khyegis 'jigs pa des/ /rigs pa de de rab bsams pa/ /gros byed 'jigs ⑥pas saṃ ma t+ya man+t+ra bhe da bha yā ku laḥ/ /bhi gru man+tan+di r+yan+d+ra ste shan+t+ra ṇa 'khrugs pa des/ /ma dang lhan cig bgros byas nas/ /dge slong de ni mgron gnyer te/ /ma bsdams kṛ he ba dhī ta/ /arta d+dhik+ṣu ba dhe pya gya nā kaspat+pa nād+ma naḥ/ /mtshon gyis khyim du bsad/ /dge slong dgra bcom bsad la yang / /de yid lag kyang bdar ba ④yin/ /dṛ shaṃ sāḥbā ta kair+yārnyi badzā da dhi ka zo ra tsā/ /dhasmra dri sh-i gā gra pa ri tsu tā gtum po rnams ni sdig pa yis/ /rdo rje las lhag sra bar 'gyur⑧/ /ngos med g.yang sar chos kyi ri rtse yi/nām dho mu khā nā ma ta pa ba ṭi 6/ /ba hu blu ma shwa bh+ra shwa tā ha tā ā+oṃ bha ba t+ya steng nas kha ni thur ltas py-ilhung gyur cing / /'khrul mang bya skyibs rgya ⑪ yis bsnun pa rnams/ /nges par lam̐ pā ta pa ram̐ pa ri ba/ /su te na ra ma mā nā pi sā saṃ sgo ga pa rā ya rja/ /rgyun ⑪ma dag tu lhung bar 'gyur/ /bu dang rol par byed mod kyang / /longs spyod dag la chags pa des//pun+da rā khye ba ṇi ka pu tram̐ dṛṭī bhūta ta tra sa smṛ hā/ /ra ti pa ri tsi taisgo gāsgyu mdzes pa zhes bya tshong pa'i bu/ /mthong nas de la chags ldan gyur/ /dga' mgur spyad pa yongs 'dris ⑫ me+eḥs ra pa ri ba rja te ki ma pi bha dza te lo bhaḥthra rnyi pra bṛdha dha no goms pas longs spyod dag ni mchog tu 'phel/ /nor ni rab 'phel dar bas chags pa stug po ci yang 95—990

da yaḥ/ /la ba ṇa sa li khā pā ṣ+peste: pra yā t+ya ti tī pra hūṃ dz+wa la ti bi sten par byed/ /lan tshwa'i chu dag 'thungs pas shin tu mi zad 1sred pa skye bar 'gyur/ /chu ni rgya che me pu la dzā khā lī tairdza lerba ḍa bān ཿ/ /hūṃ gu shwe saṃ ga hūṃ te na te na rā gi bhā lces myangs pas rta gdong me ni rab tu 'bar/ /'dod ldan gsar pa de dang ni/ /chags ldan ma de na ba kā mi nā/ /dṛṭī sho dat+taḥkhaṅge na dza ghā na dza na nī kru dh+wa/ /ā gsang 'grogs pa/ /rtas byin gyis mthong khros pa yis/ /ral gri dag gis ma nyid bsad/ /mtshams narnya:ste bhiḥpā pa bhā riḥs gu ru hūṃ ga taḥ/ /nishī si taḥpu rāta tūr+ṇa de ba tā pre med gsum gye sdig khur gyis/ /de ni phyi ba nyid du gyur/ /skye bo lha yis bskul rnams kyis/ /myur du ri tairdza naiḥ/ /sa dzā tā nu sha ya ste ze ga tā bhik+ṣu ga khyobe+e jun/ /grong khyer dag las byung khye// /'gyod pa drag po skyes pa dezu/ /song nas dge slong tshogs mang la /duḥkhār+ya yā tse pra bra dzhai pa ti tā ya da do ya dā/ /ta dā da dā ha pa dwo ṣāta subye sdug bsngal las ni rab byung zhus/ /gang tshe sdig can la ma byin/ /de tshe de yi zhe sdang gis/ /dge slong bhik+ṣu ga rde ni shi/ /e kastu bo bye sahūṃ shwa bhik+ṣu sta gya da yārtu dhīḥ/ /tshogs nyal mtshan mo bsregs/ /de la brtse bas brlan pa'i blo/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' che/ /ta bā di de sha pra pra dzhai shik+ṣu pa da bi brji hūṃ/ /shik+ṣu pa dā ni nizlan+tar+yā gcig gis de tshe bslab pa'i gnas/ /spangs pa'i rab tu byung ba byin/ /rab tu 'bad cing nan tan tsa mā na pra ya t+na ta ཿ / / bhik+ṣu sta mū tse nārto si shik+ṣu pa da pa gyis—/ /bslab pa'i gnas ni zhu byed pa/ /de la dge slong gis smras khyod/ /bslab gnas 'dzin pa ri gra he/ /na mo bud+dhā ya bud+dhā ye bye ta de ba sa dā ba da/ /dzi yongs ④mi 'os/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa 'di nyid rtag tu brjod/ /rgyal nā bhe jo na shu tī ba kaspradhe mut+ta me 6 si/ /a thā shwa dat+ta de hadhe ba'i mtshan ni thos nyid kyis/ /dus kyi mthar ni khrod grol 'gyur/ /de nas rtas byin lus kyi mthar/ /95—991

gho ran+da ra ka mā bi shata/ /ya snga gre pra ba lot+ta la shī ta khāḥpra la yā na 'jigs su rung ba'i dmyal bar zhugs/ /gang mdun rab tu nyam nga ba'i/ /grang ba 'jig pa'i me ldan laḥ —/ /so yan+dhan+d+raru tsiḥdṛṣ+ṭa tsi ra gye ti tsi rād+ma yā/ /a bhi dh+wa ye nyi pa—/ /de nyid chos sred yun ring gi/ /yun ring las zhes bdag gis dris/ /zhes pa brjod nas bcom bha ga bān bi ra rā ma ta thā ga taḥ/ /bā tā lī dza na byā ta re ga ta ra khā niḥldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bzhugs/ /rba ①rlabs ltar g.yo ma yi rlung 'tshub ②dag la saṃ ka mā lo gi tā pā pya thra rnyi ma dar+sharna sa dza na kaste dzi ni byeḥ/ /dogs pa med par rab tu 'khyud/ /dar ba thob nas pha ni gzi byin gter de snang ba min pa dag tu bkod//arta t+pa twa pa da pra kā sha bi bha ba s+t+ri bra kra me khyo ha to dhū me nā ti dgra bcom sems can 1/gnas ni rab tu gsal ba'i 'byor pa mi zad ngurim pas bcom/ /du ba shin tu ma lbo ma se na na pa ram̐ ki ki kṛ ta duḥkṛ ta maḥ/ /i haṃ k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dri ma can gyis mchog tu nyes byas ci dang ci ma byas/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e dhan+d+ra ru tsu ba dā lda me kān+da ba ti ta maḥsems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam byu 'khri shing las chos sred kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab pabe+e baḥ// //ste brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa'o// //ma naḥshudhi pi dh+wa ṣ+pe na dā ṣ+pe nā ti lasbyi ya sā/ /bha baṃ t+ya lo sgyuḥsaṃ kalpaḥyid ni dge ba'i sgrub byed can/ /sbyin pa shin tu chung ngu yis/ /snying stobs can la phun tshogs ni//saṃ pa da sa twa shā li dzā/ /bu rā thra dzi 6 bai shā spyo marka ṭā khyu dru mārnyi ke/ /brtag pas bgom par 'a7bya mi 'gyur/ /bṛ dzi'i yangs pa can du sngon/ /spre 'u'i rdzing zhes bya ba'i 'gram/ /ku ṭā gā ra kṛ hā bā se dzi ṣ+pe bha ga ba ti spru te/ /ba bhū ba dha ni ko nā khang pa brtsegs pa'i khyim gnas na/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /yon tan mtha' dag ldan 95—992

ma shri yā kṛ ha pa tidṛ taḥ/ /sa ma gra gu ṇa saṃ yo gāh+phu ru sngot+ta ma tsā pa las/ /skyes bu mchog nyid du gyur pa/ /khyim bdag dpal gyis bskor ba ni/ /nor can zhes pa byung ga taḥ/ /pasbyi dhan+d+ra sa khā+e ta su shī la bi t+ya bhi dh+wa bha bta/ /ba da t+yā khyastsa bar gyur/ /de yi chung ma chos kyi grogs/ /ngang tshul can zhes bya bar gyur/ /bu ni gtong phod can zhes ta na yaḥsnu ṣā sa t+ya ba tī ta thā/ /saṃ gha tāḥs ma yo ta tra tsa krudze+e shā dang / /de bzhin mna' ma bden ldan ma'o/ /yangs pa can pa'i bram ze rnams/ /'tshogs stinas li kā dī dzāḥ / / ni ma n+t+ra nī yo bha ga bā d+ma bye ཿ saṃ byu ya nā der ni nges par byas/ /thams cad 'tshogs ②nas bcom ldan 'das/ /mgron du gatrer bya gzhan du n+ya thā/ /e ka tsi ta ku ru te bit+ta ma dālja na ni man+t+ra khaṃ/ /sam+birnirka sa min—/ /nor gyis ④rgyags pas gcig gis ni/ /gal te rgyal ba mgron gnyer byed/ /gzhan gyis ④nī yo yo ba re yān+ta1 bi snan kṛta/ /te ྾ sa ma ya ma dzñā tā pu chos kyi bgegs byed pa/ /de ni kun gyis dbyung bar bya/ /de dag nges pa ma shes na⑤/ /nor can bye bār+sā ni kāḥswa yo/ /di bya sadza da yu ta:kre ga tā dzi na ni man+t+ra khaṃ/ /mchog gi phun tshogs ldan/ /bsod nams ldan pa rang nyid kyis/ /song nas rgyal ba mgron ⑥gnyer byas//sa bhasti mā na bha ga bāsgo hā bhe ga ma ṣ+pe swa yi/ /sa saṃ bhe nā byu pa ga te bcom ldan rang nyid ⑦dge 'dun dang / /lhan cig khyim du gshegs par ni/ /zhal gyis bzhes tshe gus dṛṣ+ṭaḥswa bha ba rde ya yo/ /sa ta tra di bya bi bha baḥsaṃ bhā re ste di bo ldan de/ /dga' bas rang gi khyim du song / /der ni de yis lha la 'os/ /mchog gi 'byor pa'i tshogs tsi taiḥ/ /rat+na sa no pa ka ra rde saṃ dzñā sgo bye byu baṃ bya bhātro/ /a tārnya re rnams kyis/ /rin chen stan dang yo byad dang / /zas kyi sa gzhi bstar ba byas/ /skabs der gnyis dī dzāḥ sa bye ga tā bha ga ba twa rnyi ga / saṃ bhū ya kṛ ta saṃ bhā skyes thams cad ni/ /'dus nas yo byad tshogs bsgrubs pas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi drung song nas/ /95—993

ra tsakrur+bhasgyu ni man+t+ra khaṃ/ /tā nu bā tsā tha bha ga bān+d+ra pā da bi sha dā sha gus pas mgron du gnyer ba byas①/ /de nas de la bcom ldan 'das/ /rab dang dri med bsam pas yaḥ —/ /pūzla me ba sa saṃ sgo haṃ dha ni ke na ni madh+ri taḥ/ /e ta gsungs—/ /sngon du dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ /nor can gyis ni mgron du gnyer/ /de dag thos dā kaṇ+ḍi ya te 6 te 6 swa bha ba rna sha ṣ+peḥ/ /pu re pra tīgh+ra mā ṇi 6 nas bcom ldan 'das/ /mchod pa sngon gyi nyin par la/ /rab tu rtog cing de dag rnams/ /rang gi di rna bha ga ba tor+bha ṣ+pe/ /dha ni kaḥswa kṛ haṃ ga tā bha ga bābe+e ha bhikyu bheḥ/ /khyim du song ba'i tshe/ /nor can khang par bcom ldan 'das/ /dge slong rnams dang bcas byon nas/ /di byābyu tar+bhe saṃ bhā re tsakre sgo bye pra ti gra haṃ/ /e bye dru ra ṣi tat+pa snri lha yi rmad byung phun sum tshogs/ /mchod ston rab tu bzhes pa mdzad/ /de yi chung mas nyin gzhan yang //tabhu l+ya bi pu khā shri yaḥ/ /di byo pa sgo ga saṃ bha ri r+bha ga ban+ta ma pū dza de mtshungs yangs pa'i dpal gyis ni/ /mchog gi longs spyod tshogs rnams kyis/ /bcom ldan 'das la ya2 / /tah+phu tre ṇa dṛ tī yeji tsa tuze snu ṣa yā dzi naḥ/ /ā:r+ya mchod pa byas/ /gsum pa'i nyin la de yi bus/ /bzhi par mna' mas rgyal ba ni/ /ngo mtshar 'byor bi bha bā sgo kai ru pa r+bha gerni madh+ri taḥ/ /a labha bru dzā ba sa raḥpa'i longs spyod kyi/ /nyer spyad rnams kyis mgron du gnyer/ /yangs pa can pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /shāstubye shā le kau ga shāḥ/ /dha ni kā ya pra kruspyo: tsakrunishī sa no r+ya oṃ/ /ston pa mchod pa'i skabs ma thob/ /nor can la ni rab khros te/ /gnas nas dbyung ba'i rtsom pa byas//shā sa nākhru ga ta snga tha dha ni ka na dī dzāsta taḥ/ /na ma yā dza ta de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bkas/ /gnyis skyes de dag rnams la ni/ /bdag gis ma shes zhes i byughā te dha ni ka pra sā di tāḥ/ /sa pasnri ko tha dha ni kaḥs pu tabyusnu brjod nas/ /nor can gyis ni dang bar byas/ /de nas nor can chung mar bcas/ /bu dang bcas shing 95byed994

gats+tsha maḥki bha bi 6 ti/ /i ti te sa ma yo kṛ hūṃ bste ṇa ta ma dh+wa dzan/ /tah+phu du mi 'gro ci 'byung 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i dam tshig de dag gis/ /byas nas gos kyis de la mchod/ /de yi rgya pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na dha ni ko yo sa mā mi kaḥ/ / dzā to di bya pra bhā bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /'phreng ①rgyud mkhan 'di sde nor can 'di/ /chung ma bu dang mna' mar bārjaḥpasnri pu trasnu ṣā nī taḥ/ /sat+tha zlo ni ti ka thi tai khru tā saṃ sa ldan—/ /lha mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ /ces pa tshogs su kun mkhyen byus/ /bshad pa thos nas di rnyik+ṣa baḥ/ /me ni re tsit+ta be+e ma l+ya mū lā dā na pha la shri yo/ /ta taste zwa dge slong rnams/ /sems ni dri med rtsa ba dag /sbyin pa'i 'bras bu'i dpal du sems/ /de nas bram h+ma shāḥ sabye saṃ bhū ya shu tsi sgo dza ṣ+peḥ/ /bha ga parnye sa ma bh+ya tsu ba ze de dag rnams/ /kun 'tshogs —gtsang ba'i zas dag gis/ /bcom ldan 'das ni yang dag mchod/ /bhu buḥku sha lo dz+wa lāḥ/ /te lāspru tai rat+na dha rna tro zla gro shrasgye ba tāṇ+ḍi tre ṇa dge ba rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ /dman byin rin chen nor ni rtswa yi rtse/ /dad pas byin pa'i rtswa yang ma pyanar+ghaṃ/ /a ṣ+pe ka sho bhā nu bha baṃ na biṣ+ṭi tsit+ta ni mitrī shu sgo saṃ bha bā rmā/ /rin thang med/ /mdzes pa du ma'i nyams stsong nor yin ④te/ /dge ba 'byung ba'i rgyu ni sems nyid do/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e dha ni zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing kā ba dā narja ba ti ta maḥpabe+e waḥ// //las nor can rmi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu pa'o// //su bhā ṣi tai sa t+ya pa thā pra kā sha rna ka ro t+ya nā lo ka pa de 6 di snang ba med pa'i gnas rnams dag tu sgon me (zhi7bzhin/ /legs par bshad pa bden pa'i lam ni pa bta/ /sa do pa kā rā da ta e ba bal+la tai bi be+e ka tsa tsā su ma hād+ma gsal bar byed/ /de nyid phyir ni 67 rtag tu nye bar mkho ⑦ba las/ /bdag nyid che rnams dben pa spyod 95—996

nā ma pi/ /ku shi sudzñā bha ga ba tā ya dā mal+la dza nā sba de/ /artat+pa la yid du 'ong / /gang tshe gyad kyi skye ba'i gnas/ /ku sha'i grong du bcom ldan 'das/ /dge ba 'tshol ①rda bhik+ṣu ga ṇaḥpā pi taḥku sha le ṣi shā/ /ta dā ka tha ya tā dhadz+re nyik+ṣu bas dge ba'i 1tshogs/ /dgra bcom gnas la bkod gyur pa/ /de tshe phan tshun snyan par chos smra rde ma dhu rasmi thaḥ/ /swa yi shu shā ba su ga taḥspru nyi yuk+taḥsu bhā ṣi byed dge slong rnams dag gis①/ /legs bshad bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /dgyes pa dang ldan rang gis tai—/ /su bhā ṣi ta bya sa ni hūṃ tī dṛṭī ta su bhik+ṣa baḥ/ /ta mū tsusta ba gsan—/ /de yi legs bshad la gcags ④pa/ /de mthong dge slong rnams kyis ni/ /de la gsol ba sarba rnye ka tha masmraṅga tsaḥthra yi/ /i kyuste bhikhyu saṃ ste na bha ga bā na kun mkhyen nyid/ /nged kyi tshig la ji ltar dgyes/ /dge slong tshogs kyis de brjod tshe/ /bcom ldan rgyal bh+ya dharji naḥ/ /dzad+mān+ta re ṣ+ṭa pi pa ra bal+la bha me su bhā ṣi tai/ /shi ba bas bka' stsal pa/ /bdag ni skye ba gzhan du yang / /legs bshad dag la mchog tu dga'/ /grong khyer ba dh+yā pu rā pu.ā+oṃ shi bin+d+ra ma na re shwa raḥ/ /ba khyu ba saza bhū tā ram̐ da yā da yi ta zhi ldan dag tu sngon/ /mi dbang shi bi zhes bya ba/ /'byung po kun la brtse ba yi/ /yid 'ong gnyen du bān+dha baḥ/ /tah+phu rgya shā sa nā sī ṣ+peḥswaspyo mā pū ri tai dza ṣ+peḥ/ /dṛṭī gyur pa byung / /de yi ⑤bsod nams bkar 'uganas pa'i/ /mi yi kyematho ris kun gang ba/ /mthong sha ta kra tu dzñā hūṃ swa two ta gya sa mā ya yo/ /rat+na pā sā da shi kha ra nas de yi snying stobs ni/ /rtag tu mchod sbyin brgya pa 'ongs/ /de ni rin chen khang bzang rtser/ /krārnyi dṛ pa ti me bh+ya saḥ/ /rak+ṣe rū dzā bi dh+wa yo gre ta da grwa bhe mu 'dzegs pa'i mi bdag can song nas/ /'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs bsgrubs te'u7/ /de yi mdun du kho bra bītro/ /a ni t+yāḥsashā rāsta ra la ta ra bi byubyu ti ni bhaḥs mngon phyogs smras/ /'du byed mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba'i glog rab mdzes pa dag dang mtshungs/ /rab tu 95—997

mut+parjot+pan+da pra la ya pa ri khyo ma pra ṇa yi naḥ/ /su bhā ṣi tār+bha mi t+yāghā tūṭī mā skyes shing skyes shing 'jig pa'i ①yongs su 'gyur ba dag la chags/ /zhes pa'i legs bshad phyed brjod set+pa rā k+ṣa saḥ/ /tai pra ṇa myak+ṣi ti pa tiḥkṛ hūṃ dza li ra pra bhā ṣaṭa/ /nas—/ /srin po de ni mi smra gyur/ /sa yi bdag pos thal sbyar nas/ /phyag 'tshal de la rab smras pa/ /sā sgo su bha ṣi ta sngar+ghaṃ she ṣe sa ma naḥsu khaṃ/ /ba bhā bo dh+yaṅga bhā hūṃ dge ba legs par bshad pa'i phyed/ /yid bde lhag ma gsung bar mdzod/ /byang chub yan lag gyur hūṃ shi khyo byu tā sh-i rto mya haṃ/ /i ti bru ba khaṃ bi na yāta dṛ paṃ pro bā tsa rāk+ṣa skad de/ /slob mar gyur nas bdag nyan no/ /dul bas de smra mi bdag la/ /srin po yis ni rab smras saḥ / /twa yā shi bye ṇa rā dzen+d+ra niphe le na ka ro mi ki/ /pi pā sa pa ri bhū to haṃ pa—/ /rgyal dbang slob ma 'bras bu med/ /khyod kyis bdag la ci zhig bya/ /skom pas bdag ni yongs khyuṇ+ḍa ku k+ṣirbu bhuk+ṣa yā/ /ṣ+pe tat+pa me dz+re tai rā dzaṅge ba lo gu ru go nyen cing / / bkres pas sku 5ni yongs su nyams/ /rgyal po bdag ni bla ma yi/ /zhe sa 'ba' zhig 'di ra baṃ/ /k+ṣutū : byā ku la ta yā yasko tsit+tha la bā mya haṃ/ /she ṣe bahūṃ mi 'dod/ /bkres skom dag gis gzir gyur pas1/ /gang zhig cung zad bdag smra'o/ /lhag ma brjod na shagho mi mā kṛ tā me ka brja dzā/ /mā dhur+ya dhurlu ṇi ra so tsi tā na par yongs pyami nus/ /bdag la sdug bsngal ma mdzad cig /snyan pa'i gdangs ldan ro ni 'os pa can/ /sadzadzha mā nā ni su bhā ṣi tā ni/ /ṣ+pe baṃk+ṣu sgo nak+ṣa pa yarnyi tū: me tā ni j-ibe+e legs par bshad pa rab tu rgyas gyur pa/ /tshim la bde ba ster byed 'di dag ni/ /nges par bkres dang su su kha pra dā ni/ /khru tai gī tai kā bye shra ma pa ri tsa yaḥkau tu ka bi dhi skom pa za byed min/ /thos dang glu dang snyan dngags ngal bas yongs 'dris dge mtshan sgrub byed dang / /ma ṇidzñā rna byu ta gra ha ga da bi khod+mā da sha ma dz+wa/ /dṛ rde bhū j-it+pa bā dza la nor bu shes dang 'byung po gdon nad dug dang skyo snyeb zhi byed dang / /sa 'dzin bsten dang chu gter sgol 95—998

dhe ta ra ṇi he ma ka ra khaṃ ta de tat+pa r+yarnye ga ni ta ma khi lo sgo dza na bar byed dang gser 'gyur dag dang lkurtsis/ /'di dag ma lus mthar thug 'bras bu mi rnams dag gi pa lo/ /sa r+yaḥkṛt+ta su ru bye ram̐ rmā sī tsa ma ma tarba khaṃ/ /a ho bza' ba yin/ /'phral la bcad pa'i sha dang ni/ /khrag dag bdag la khutshim byed pa/ /'tshe ②med sna ban+dha rgo ya mātwat+ta sta da ti durla sgo/ /gatshwa mi yā tsi nyu ki tsita sdom pas bcings gyur pa/ /khyod las shin tu rnyed par (4dka'/ /khyod dang nye bar bdag ci byed/ /twat+pa m+bi pe ka ro mi ki/ /spri ḍāḥka thā: sho bharnye tu spyo hā ra bi hā ra yoḥ/ /'ga' zhig la ni slong du 'gro/ /zas dang gnas ni mtshungs pa yi/ /rtsed mo dang ni gtum ⑤dag mdzes/ /i h+phuk+taste na dṛ pa tista ma bhā ṣa tai mā da raḥ/ /ni dza de ha sa myuskṛtrī zhes des brjod tshe mi bdag ni/ /gus dang bcas pas de la smras/ /rang gi lus ni rab bcad pa'i/ /sna mṛ.oṃ saṃ da dā mi te/ /two pra tī t+ya sa mut+yā da pūn+d+ra dā ra mu dā ha ra/ /nit+tha khrag dang ⑥sha ni khyod la sbyin/ /rgya che blo gros ldan pa khyod/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung dang po'i sgo/ /khyod ṇa na ga ra snga gruḥpadze+esta ba su bha ṣi tai/ /i truste rā dza tsan+de ṇa ta kyi legs bshad myang 'das kyi/ /grong khyer gyi ni lam gyi mchog /rgyal po zla bas 'di brjod tshe/ /myu bā tsa k+ṣa pā tsa raḥ/ /shā ya tī su ma te tuṇ+ḍi dzā ya tī tsa pra ti khru tai/ /mtshan mo rgyu bas de la smras/ /blo gros bzang po myur du nyon/ /dam bcas pa dag sbyin par mdzod/ /a ni t+yāḥsaṃ s+thā rāsta ra la ta ra be+e byuju ti ni bhaḥs mut+parjot+pa n+da pra 'du byed mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba'i glog rab mdzes pa dag dang mtshungs/ /rab tu skyes shing skyes shing dze+el ya pa ri shā ma pra ṇa yi naḥ/ /ta dubye dze+e tu rmā bh+ra ma ṇa pa ri brtaḥshra ma ba tsā ni 'jig pa'i yongs su 'gyur ba dag la chags/ /des bskyed 'khor zhing yongs su sgyur bas srog chags dag ro dh+waji shrirnyi di shi ti bi ba shā nā mu pa sha maḥ / /e ta ni dbang bral zhing / /ngal dub ldan pa rnams la nyer zhi 'gog pas ngal gso ster bar byed/ /de dag 95—999
