saṃ mā pya ta tā pyathra ra saḥpa rāḥ/ /saṃ sgo ga su bha gastad+mar+ya yo dak+ṣi lha mo gzhan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis longs spyod kyisasti / /skal bzang gis ni yang dag thob/ /de bzhin lho ṇa baṭ+wā nā/ /sa dra dzan+da ga ram̐ pā pa durga zwa ya ma yo ma oṃ /yi lam nas song / /de ni song bas mi bsrun zhupa'i/ /grogs bzhin nyon mongs tshogs kyi gnas/ /pa ru ṣe kha la po hārda mi bā yā pa tsa yā shra yo/ /ta gya ta tra pra biṣ+ṭa lcags kyi rang bzhin rtsub po yi/ /grong khyer ngan 'gro mang po shethob/ /der de nang du zhugs pa na/ /gya kra mādī ra ṇi bhū mi 6/ /ke nā pi pi hi tā ni ba ya yudhī sabye ban+dha rim pas sa la sgo rnams ni/ /su zhig dag gis bsgribs pa bzhin/ /mtshams med bsdams pa nyid du dzā—/ /ta dan+ta re ma hā kā yo so pa sh+yah+phu ru ṣe sbi tai/ /sa ka la kle sha do ṣā gyur—/ /de yi nang na skyes bu ni/ /lus chen gnas pa de yis mthong / /mtha' dag nyon mongs skyon rde bis+t+riṇ+ḍi mi ba bhā dza na/ /dzā lnga be+e la yi tai tsakre ta gya mūdh+ri pa ri rnams kyi/ /sgod ni shin tu che ba bzhin/ /bcings shing rgyun du khrag rgyun 'bab/ /de yi spyi bor bh+ra mata/ /tī ā+oṃ da dar+sha badha gya saste rat+ta pra bā hi ṇaḥ/ /swa shi 'khor lo ni/ /skon po 'bar bas dkrigs pa dag /yongs su 'khor ba mthong bar gyur/ /rang gi raḥpra su taiḥpū ya sho ṇi tibe+e hi tā sa dzā/ /tai dṛṭī tī bra ṇirbe dā mgo las zags pa yi/ /rnag khrag gis ni zas bsgrubs gyepa/ /de mthong drag po'i ⑤yid byung nas/ /da ba dad+me tra ka n+ya kaḥ/ /kaste spyu ra bya thā krān+taḥka sre rda kadz+re ṇaḥpha lo/ /mdza' bo'i bu mos rab smras pa/ /gdung ba drag pos non khyod su/ /'di ni las dag ci yi 'bras/ /thraṣ+ṭaste ṣ+pe ti ka ru sgyuta pu ru ṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /mā tuḥkṛ tā pa kā ro haṃ zhes des snying rjes dris pa na/ /skyes bus ⑥de la rab smras pa/ /bdag ni sngam la gnod byed do/ /ta gye rda kadz+re ṇaḥpha lo/ /e ta dā kasbya so pya bīṣ+ṭha pa sas+thād shaṃ ki taḥ/ /'di ni las de nyid kyi 'bras/ /de dag thos nas de yang ni/ /sdig pa dran nas dogs par gyur/ /de 95—1007

su nā mi ba k+ṣi ti mi rmā pa shu rā ga tosmi kabhā t+ya lam̐ ba la tī bha bi 6 ta khyi ①rnams la bzhin sa 'di nyid du phyugs dag 2'ongs par gyur/ /gang na 'di yi las kyi 'khri shing cha bya tai yā/ / kṛ ṣ+ṭa sta yi ba tsa bi sha t+ya ba sho ma nu 6ཿ ya tra su yis yongs bsgrubs pa/ /dus kyis yongs smin spyad bya nyid du gyur pa mdun na gnas/ /nges par spyad tiṣ+ṭha ti pu raḥpa ri sā ka sgo gyu/ /kle sha sgo gā ba bho kā laḥki yād+mā tuḥbya stobs ldan 'di yis mchog tu 'gugs par byed/ / ma la gnod pa byas rnams kyisatshoje/ /nyon mongs kṛ tā ga r+pā/ /a byā ga mi 6 ti na baḥkash+yi dasmabyi bye dza na / /i spyod mtshams ji snyed dus/ /skye bo kha cig bdag lta bu/ /gsar du 'ong ba ye'agyur ram ci/ /zhes pa ti dz+wa la te tsalnga gra dīr+ya mā na gya de hi naḥ/ /tasngasto su ba tsaḥkhru tā pu lus can 'khor lo ni/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i rtses bcom zhing / /gzir ba de yi tshig thos nas/ /skyes ru ṣasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /ṣaṣ+ṭi rbaste sa ha sru ṇi ṣaṣ+ṭha rbaste sha tā ni tsa/ /a gya kle bus de la rab smras pa/ /lo ni stong phrag drug cu dang / /lo ni brgya phrag drug cu dag(gye / /nyon mongs nye sho pa sgo gya su na ya tiḥpā pa kan+d+ra rde/ /i hā pa rā ṇi bhi ṣa ṇa paṃ ti s+thā bar longs spyod 'di/ /sdig pa'i las can rnams la nges/ /ma la gnod pa byas pa yi/ /sdog can nā na pā pi dzā/ /mā tuḥkṛ tā ga sā ma n+ya ye sā me byurnyi tabyi dh+waḥ/ /rnams la 'di na gnas/ /'jigs su rung ba gzhan she7dag yod/ /gzhan yang de ltar (bye'ong bar 'gyur/ /khru tai tadruḥs ha ta ram̐ te nolte mo tra ka n+ya kaḥ/ /su bya thā duḥkha sa des brjod shin tu bzod dka' de/ /mdza' bo'i bu mos thos gyur nas/ /rab gdung sdug bsngal myong swā dāt+pa rār+bhe da ya yā ba datro/ /a dhu nā ye sa me 6rnye na rāḥpā ta ka kā ba las/ /gzhan dag gzir la brtse bas smras/ /da ni sdog pa byed pa'i mi/ /gang zhig khyarab tu 'ong ri ṇaḥ/ /te ṣā mabe+e ma mai be+e rda tsakṛ tiṣ+ṭha tu masta ke/ /ka dze+e me sa 'gyur ba/ /de dag don du 'khor lo 'di/ /bdag gi mgo la gnas gyur cig /'di lta'i gdung ba 95—1009

hadhe tī bra dīr+gha me baṃ bi bye bya tsā/ /e kasri ba bya tha me tu sabye drag cing ring / /de dag rnams kyis ji ltar bzod/ /bdag nyid gcig pu gdung gyur la/ /thams nidṛ tu nirgya thāḥ/ /pa rābe+e dh+wa ra yi byā mi tsakre bhuspyo pha lo ni cad gdung med gnas gyur cig /'khor lo rang gi 'bras bcad nas/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag gis dze+e—/ /pa ra bya tsā bi dzā nā nyi na dza naḥswa bya tsā bi nā/ /i kyu stebazung / /skye bo rang nyid gdung med pas/ /gzhan gyi gdung ba yongs ①mi shes/ /sems can phan ka ru shārte na te na sa twa hi tai ṣi rja/ /sahūṃ kalpa bra bhā be na tartso kra ma ga tshol snying rje yis/ /gzir ba de yis 'di brjod tshe/ /dam pa'i kun rtog mthu yis ni/ /de yi 'khor man+da bhāḥ/ /tā paṃ pabe+e bi tā ni harnyi ta nu te shu bye ya shaḥpu— lo mkha' la song / /yal 'dab dag ni gdung ba 'phrog cing me tog grags snyan dkar po rgyas par byed/ /tā sa r+yaḥsau ra bha bha bya sgo ga su bha shā lakhyem+bi dhaste pu naḥ/ /ka ru rgyudro 'phral la dri bzang legs ldan longs spyod skal bzang phun sum tshogs pa be+er yang 'dzin/ /dam pa'i kun ta yā ya de ba dz+dza da ye sad+dhiḥs mā ro pi tā sa྾ kalpa la tā sa de ba sa ra rtog 'khri shing snying rje'i brlan ldan dam pa rnams kyi snying la ni/ /gang tshe yang dag btab pa de tshe ro ldan saṃ ki ki na su te pha lo/ /kā ru dh+yāh+phu rgya ma hābyut+ta1 rja1 ta kilpi ṣaḥ/ /'bras bu ci dang ci mi 'uskyed/ /snying rje'i bsod nams bdag nyid kyis/ /skad cig de la sdig zad de/ /sa pa bhu ba pa ri t+ya bye de haṃ de baḥsu ra la ye/ /so ha me bā bha baṃ pūbye lus ni yongs su btang nas de/ /lha yi gnas su lhar gyur to/ /nga nyid sngon tshe byams bdag nyid/ /mi rgya1 mai rngu ka n+ya kaḥ/ /pā de non+d+ra ra ṇas+thā tuḥpāp+taspyo duḥkha btī mdza' bo'i bu mo nyid gyur te/ /ma ni rkang pas 1rab 'phangs pa'ingu / /sdug bsngal gnas skabs de 1—/ /kār+ṣa pa shāza tuḥpu dzā krāp+tartswabe+e ra saṃ pa rda/ /i lje tse bha ga bān dag thob/ /kar+ṣa ⑤pa ṇas ma la ni/ /mchod pas lha mo'i gnas kyang thob/ /de skad ma yi srid zhu ni/ /95byed1010

mā tro shu khru ṣe dhabyu myut+ta saṃ/ /mā tā saṃ ga la mā li kā gu ṇa ma ྾ bā se n+ya mo liḥchos kyi mchog tu bcom ldan gsungs①/ /ma ni bkra shis phreng ba yon tan dang ldan pa ni mnyes kye gshin pi tā to ye yī shi ra si thra yā ya ku ru taḥpā dām+bu dzā ro pa ṇa/ /sar+pā cod pan te/ /de dag dgyes slad gang gi spyi bor zhabs kyi pad+mo rab tu 'god byed pa/ /phyogs kun shā pa ri pū ra rtot+pa ta ya shaḥsalbat+tha kā sho da yā ste pu rgyu bha ra zlaḥpra yārnyi yongs su 'gengs par brtson pa'i grags pa phun tshogs rab tu gsal ba rgyas/ /rtag tu dga' ston bsod dza ga hūṃ ni trot+pa baḥpū bye tāmra/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa nams rgyan ldan de dag 'gro ba'i mchod bya nyid du 'grur/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī mai rngu ka n+ya kā ba dā dz+wa dā na ba ti chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las mdza' bo'i bu mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //myu/ shā sgyu dza yarja dzi na bhat+ta be+e she ṣa bhā dze+e shrad+dhā su bye pra pa ra nizlo gang gis mchod 'os mchod par bsgrub rngul me tog la sogs te/ /sems med rnams kyang 'os pa'i ra shī ka rāste/ /nibye ta no byu tsi ta tse ta na tā mra yi ti yiḥsems dang ldan pa nyid du 'gyur(je/ /rgyal la 3gus pa'i khyad par bsten pa rnams la bsngags 'os shing / /pū bye pū dza na bi tho ku su mā di brgaḥ/ /shri bahūṃ bi dza nā m+bi ni dad pa rab rgyas bdud rtsi'i rgyun thigs de dag rgyal gyur cig /mnyan yod rgyal byed tshal du sngon/ /dzi rna dze ta ba na pu rā/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa do bhe t+ya bha ga ban+ta ma bha ṣa dben par bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba de la mngon phyogs te/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis ta —/ / twa sgo t+ta ri ba sadz+dza tra ma hā rta gu ṇa bi shu tā / / bha ga gsol pa/ /bcom ldan khyod kyi gus pa bzhin/ /kun tu khyer ⑪ 'os yon tan grags/ /bdag gi bu mo 95—1011

baspro bye mā yā tā ka n+ya ma ma su mā ga dh+ra/ /shri ma taḥsārja nā tha sa na ga re puṇ+ḍa ma ga dha/ /bzang mo dar la bab par gyur/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel gyi/ /dpal ldan don mthun bar+bha ṣ+pe/ /sru nudṛ ṣa bha daṭ+wā khyastad+mā ṇi gra ha m+bi ha te/ /ka dzñā da dā mgon po'i bu/ /khyu mchog byin zhes bya ba ni/ /de yi lag pa 'dzin par 'dod/ /bcom ldan gal te mi tī tasmi bha ga babe+e di ma n+ya pe/ /twa da dhī na dha na pā ṇasta dā dzñā nu sha ra kho bzod na bdag /bu mo de ni de la ster/ /nor srog khyod kyi dbang gyur bdag /khyod kyi bka' yi rjes khya hūṃ/ /i kyuste te na bha ga bān bāt+pa l+ya bi ma khā sha yaḥ/ /ko do su 'brang / /de 17'di gsol tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /dri med mnyes gshin bsam ldan pas/ /ci skyon ṣasta na yā tasmi di ya tā mi t+ya bhā ṣa ta/ /shāstuḥshā sa na mā dā ya pā da ra bu mo de la ni/ /sbyin par khumadzod ces bka' stsal pa1/ /ston pa'i bka' ni rab bzung nas/ /de la pra ṇi pa t+ya tai/ /a nā tha piṇ+ḍa daḥshrī mān pra ya yo ni dza mān+da ram̐/ /ta gus par ④phyag 'tshal te/ /dpal ldan mgon med zas sbyin ni/ /rang gi khang par rab tu song / /de taḥsu mā ga dhe ka dh+yā bi bha be+en ma tī ya pā/ /arta ya sa da do tame+e bhu ri nas 'byor pa che dang bcas/ /bu mo ma ga dha bzang mo/ /rin chen gos mang rab ster des/ /'os pa rat+nalnga ra pra daḥ/ /daṭ+wā dru ra ta ram̐ de sha ma tha yāju su mā ga dh+wa/ /bha ga de la rab tu byin/ /de nas byin pa'i ma ga dha/ /bzang mo thag ring yul bgrod cing / /bcom ldan bāñdza ra ṇa smṛ t+yā sa bāt+pa na ya nā bha bta/ / tsi ri ṇa sā sa mā pā r+ya na ga 'das kyi zhabs dran nas/ /mig ni mchi ma dang bcas gyur/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du/ /yun ram̐ puṇ+ḍa bar+bha rna/ /shu thra ṣā bhe ratā pak+ṣaḥpa dā bhadṛ kṛ he bha bta/ /ka ring zhig na des sleb nas/ /rtag tu khyo ⑤yi khyem du ni/ /bdag po'i bkur ste la chags gyur/ /de dā tsi da tha hūṃ shwa thra sgo bye saṃ bha ra kā ra bhā/ /u bā tsa dha na ba t+yā khyu nas nam zhig sgyug mo ni/ /grangs las 'das pa 'god brtson zhing / /zas kyi tshogs rnams ster khye byed 95—1012

saṃ khyu tī bya yor+ya tā / /pū byo pa ka ra rde saljo ku ru sadz+re su mā ga pa—/ /nor can zhes pas de la smras/ /ma ga dha bzang mchod pa yi/ /yo byad thams cad chas dag dhe—/ /kṛ haṃ naḥpā ta rā gad+dhā dza gah+phu dzñāḥgu ḍo dza naḥ/ /gu ra bo go mdzod—/ /'gro bas mchod bya yon tan can/ /skye bo nang tso7par bdag khyim 'ong / /bla ma skye bo thams ra ba pa rda pū dzñāḥsadze+e dza na gya te/ /sa me 6dhi k+ṣa pa ṇa kāḥsasmo ha k+ṣa pa cad kyis/ /zhe kyesa'i gnas su mchod bya ba/ /kun rmongs zad sbyor zad byed pa/ /de dag rnams ni kho r+ya tāḥ/ /i kyugh+ra pā ta yā ta tra ba bhu bā ram̐ bha tat+pa rā/ /dzñā tā 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zhes des brjod pa der ni des(kye/ /dge slong tshogs la mchod pa dekru/ /yongs su bhegru ga shā yi ba tsā pū rdzu pa ri kalpa ṭī/ /a thā pa re lbo bi be+e shun+d+raghāḥk+ṣa brtag ⑤par shes gyur nas/ /rtsom pa de la chags par gyur/ /de nas nyin gzhan khyim du ni/ /skra dang ba ṇa kā kṛ haṃ/ /uwaṃ tsi ta ka tsa thra thra saṃ kle sha ni shi ta bra tāḥ/ /sma ra rab 'bar ⑥zhing / /dka' thub drag pos kun nyon mongs/ /gcer bu zad byed pa rnams zhugs/ /tā na lardzo na ba pā nā na b.lokya su mā ga jo/ /mā ṣa shayā sha nā sgyu sā pi ma he sran ma rtswa yi zas/ /goms pas rags par gyur pa bzhin/ /gos med ngo tsha med de dag /ma ga ba rād+ma hi ṣā ni ba/ /lalja tā bā sa sāts+tsha r+ya ba da rna gu ru sarnyi sgo/ /khe da dha bzang gis mthong nas/ /bla ma'i drung du ngo tsha ste/ /bzhin ni gos kyis rab bsgribs nas/ /skyo dang nibye da pi na tā shu thra dza na ma bhā ṣa ta/ /a ho ba tā ya mā tsā raḥchags bral gyis dud pas/ /sgyug mo'i skye bo la smras pa/ /gang 'dir phyogs gos rnams kyi yang / /su tsi rā da ba lo ki taḥ/ /di gasba rā rja ma pya gre ya dī haste ba dhū dza naḥ/ /e mdun du bud med skye bo 'khod/ /kye ma kun tu spyod pa 'di/ /shin tu yun ring lon nas mthong / /mi te bha batho he dān+ta bhuñdza te shri ga brdzi tāḥ/ /a mā nu ṣa tā rja tai min rwa dang bral gyur pa/ /dul ba 'di dag khyod ⑩ 7 kyi ni/ /khyim na — 7gsol byed 'di dag la/ /bud 95—1013

྾ lasgoste byu na oṃ ga nāḥ/ /a s+thā ṣ+pe bha ba tā bhāk+taḥko ya mudṛ kha laḥkra maḥ/ /na med ngo tsha med dam ci/ /gang gis kha zas ma btang ba/ /de yis gos ni ji ltar btong / /ma bsdams t+yak+ta ma sha ni ye na sa ka dze+e bsta mudzha ti/ /ke shorlu la na karma ṇi ba ni rim pa 'di ni ci/ /khyed ni gnas min dag la gus/ /skra ni rab tu 'bal ba'i las dag nyid kyis ①shi tai noste ju mo be di tai kau bī rmā shu ka brdza ṣ+pe na sa dza ṣ+pe shī la su bsne brtse ba med pa drag po bstan/ /skye bor bcas la 'doms khru dkris gos dag spangs pas tshul khrims kyi ni ba kā/ /rda bhā ram̐ bha bha yo ka re tsa pa da ṣ+pe kro dhaḥ swa yi lasba te gtam nyid ci/ /tshul 'chos rtsom pa dang ldan 'jigs byed bzhin la khro ba rang nyid rnam par bsten/ /naghā nā ma sha ṣ+pe ṣi tā ni ya mi nā me ྾ pa shu nā mi ba/ /ya tre te dul ba dang ldan gcer bu 'di dag phyugs rnams bzhin du zas dag 'tshol 2/bar byed/ /gang na phyugs pa sha baḥpū rje ta tron+d+rar+yā bha brnyi ke/ /a tha pā de sho do kho yo ga tā nu ga ti kāsbi 'di mchod byed pa(bye / /de na spang bar bya ba su/ /yang na 'di ni yul gyi skyon/ /song ba'i rjes su 'gro taḥ / /i ti bru bā rde tī shra shube+e ṣaṇ+ḍi pra t+ya bhā ṣa ta/ /pi tuste bha ba ṣ+pe ba'i lugs/ /zhes smra ⑤chags bral dang ldan ma/ /de la sgyug mos lan smras pa/ /bzang mo khyod kyi yab bha tre pu dzñārnye ba de kā dṛ shāḥ/ /sā ba dad+ma྾ turde he pū bye te bha ga bāñdzi kyi ni/ /khang par ci chu'adra mchod pa spros/ /des smras bdag gi pha khyem du/ /snying rjes 'gro ba thams naḥ / /kā ru sgyut+pat+tha dza ga tī ku sha lā nyi sha yo r+ya taḥ/ /dh+yā nā r+pā cad ni/ /khyad 'phags dge ba la sbyor ba'i/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba mchod par byed/ /bsam gtan la naḥsnyi mi ta na ya naḥpūr+ṇa khā ba ju sen+tun+d+ra sā baṃ shaṃ bi pu la sa ra lo pe tu chags g.yo med spyan ldan mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ /shangs kyi rgyud ni yangs shing drang po zam ju tai da d+ma naḥ/ /bhu ṣā shu t+yā pra mṛ ta ru tsi maṅkaṇ+ḍi pā shā bhi rā maḥstegs dag tu gyur pa yin(77/ /rab brkyang mdzes ldan rgyan gyis stong pa'i snyan byi zhags pa mngon dga' ste//95—1014

kā: ba sau ki ma pi pi du ྾ shārnyi man+tasta no ti/ /shi ra pi sa ha dza pā dzñā mdzes pa nyid kyis mkhas rnams nang du zhi ba ci yang rgyas par byed/ /zla zer ltar mdzes de ni lag gnyis lo ka pra se ka ma yo ma ṇi ka ri pa ti karā kā ro bā hu mṛ hūṃ ka ka ru byu nyiḥ/ /glang chen lag pa'i rnam pa dang / /snang ba rab rgyas dbu la lhan skyes rab bkrus rang bzhin nor bu dang / /ka ra ta la ga tsā le khaṃ shaṃ kha dh+wa jo bu dza mā li shaṃ sha ma ma ya ma hā sāstsa lag mthil du son ri mo dung dang rgyal mtshan ste skyes 'phreng ba dang lku/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin rgyal srid chen dzñāhaṃ bi bhan+ti sa lak+ṣa ṇi/ /ta snga dzha lā ṣa dza na ka mya ma hā mu bhā rmā sad+dhā po la 'os mtshan nyid rnam par 'dzin/ /thub chen rnams kyis ṅkumangon par 'dod pa skyed byed de yis (kyeni/ /bye lā ṣa ka pa nā ra hi taḥswa bhā baḥ/ /naḥshe ṣi ta smṛ ti bhu baḥrang bzhin mngon par 'dod pa'i rtag pa kun dang bral ba nyid/ /dran pa'i sa gzhi bag med gnas ni pra ma dā sha ya gya rā gadzha ta gya su ta rā ma dha raḥpa rā gaḥ/ /mustornir+bha lhag ma med par byas/ /chags pa rab tu btang ba'i mchu ni rab 5tu dmar dang bcas/ /grol ba lhag ra saṃ ga ma pra ṇa yi m+bi mi ṭī ma naḥshā yi nī k+ṣudhistad+ma ya kā ri bhā z-i par 'grogs pa'i mdza' gcugs dang ldan byams pa dag ni yid la nyal/ /bzod pa de yi rang bzhin di da yā gā bye sa mā bye ṣi bhā/ /sas+thā shā bha ra ṇa gya bhu ri da yi tā sak+ta byed cing brtse ba snying la dam du mnyam par sbyor/ /yid 'ong mang po la chags kun gyi bsam pa rgyas byed su saṃ lak+ṣu te ta s+thā pūt+tha mu ṣ+pe ra na n+ya ma hi mā bai rā gya gasgoḥsha maḥ/ /sngon med thub pa ni/ /de yi zhi ba sngon med bdag nyid chags bral snying po can ni legs par mtshon/ /smu dzuḥs bha ba nasmra shaṃ ya su pra bra bye yā sa hūṃ/ /dhaste shi la du ku khā rmā tshul khrims du ku la dang ldan/ /dam pa rnams yid sgrib bral nyid/ /gang gi rab tu byung bar 'u'adzin/ /ni rā ba ra ṇa tasma naḥ/ /bi shwa rak+ṣasma ṇir+ya gya smṛ t+yā pi bha ba sgo de dag bdag cag khyim du mchod/ /thams cad bsrungs pa'i zhwanor bu gang / /dran pa yis kyang srid 95—1015

gi nā/ /rā ga dī sngo gra rdaṣ+ṭi ṇa bā dh+ya te na pu nardza naḥ/ /i ti ta su ba tsaḥpa'i sbrul/ /chags sdang drag po'i mche ldan pas/ /slar yang skye bo la gnod med/ /ces pa de tshig rna shwa shā khru tā gro tra ra sā ya rgo/ /sa r+yaḥpra sā da bi ṣa dā tsā dza gā da pra mo di ba yi/ /bcud len thos nas sgyug mo ni/ /'phral la rab dang dri ma med/ /dga' mgu ldan pas de la m+bi / /a pi ta d+mā r+sha no pā yaḥ kash+yi daste ba rā na ṣ+pe / /a pi smras—/ /de ni blta hūṃ7ba'i thabs 'ga' zhig /mchog gi bzhin ldan yod dam ci/ /khrod kyi bsod twah+phu ju sa sba d+dhād+ma ya ma pya mṛ ta spa rda / /i ti sā nu na yo shwa khru nams 'brel pa las/ /nged kyang bdud rtsi'i gnas thob bamatso)/ /zhes pa sgyug mos gus ldan blo(sgo/ /ṣā sa da ra dhi yā nī tā/ /tai baḥsan+dar+sha yā m+bi ti ba bhā ṣe bhat+ta mā ni m+bi/ /tshul dang mthun par de la zhus/ /bdag gis khyed la de bstan zhes/ /gus dang bkur ba ldan mas smras/ /ma hā pra nyi dzha saṃ bhā ra bha ra nir+bha ha nai ṣi ṭī/ /sā pi sha ya tu khā dam bca' chen po'i tshogs kyis rnguni/ /khur dag khyer ba 'u'adod pa yiskye/ /srod la mal stan srang la rū ṭ+wā k+ṣa khaṃ dh+yā na pa rā bha ba ta/ / ta taḥpā pā da mā ru khya bha ga 'dzegs—/ /skad cig bsam gtan bskyangs par gyur/ /de nas khang bzang la 'dzegs te/ /bcom ba྾ ba hūṃ di shaṃ/ /pra ṇi pa t+ya thra dzatru rje pū dzārta ku su māñdza li/ /ldan bstan mepa'i phyogs su ni/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bya mchod 'os pa'i/ /me tog snyim pa rab tu gtor/ /put+pa dhu po da kai ra༈ pā kṛ tāt+ta sa dozlu khā+e/ /ā nan+da bāt+pa baṃ rudha de yi gnas su mngon phyogs des/ /me tog bdug pa chus mchod nas/ /yangs pa'i mig ni kun dga' bi s+t+ri ṇ+ḍi na ya nā ba da ta / / a nu kai bai ba bha ga ba n+d+ra t+na tra yildu—/ /mchi mas 'gags pas rab smras pa/ /bcom ldan thugs rje 'os pa bdag /dkon mchog ya bi brdzi tāḥ/ /ta bā shra ma mṛ gī bā haṃ du ra de sha mi oṃ ga tā/ /gsum po rnam ke9 spangs te/ /khyod kyi gnas kyi ri dwags bzhin/ /shin tu thag ring yul 'dir phyin/ /95—1016

twat+yā da pad+ma yu ga lo sha ra rde pra padzñā du ram̐ sbi tā ma pi dṛ shā smṛ sha rmā da khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma zung gi skyabs ni thob pa bdag /ring du gnas par gyur kyang spyan gyis reg mdzod yā lo/ /bāt+pa l+ya pe sha la bye yī ma hā tai pra bā dru rī kṛ ga te 6 ka ru brtse ba can/ /mnyes gshin gnyen pa'i blo ldan chen po rnams kyi thugs rje ni/ /yul gzhan ring por zla na ta nu twa me ti / / bha ga ba n+da sa su ta yā two ma yā r+ya phyin pa rnams la chung ba nyid mi 'gyur/ /'bangs kyi bu mo dag gis 1deng / /bcom ldan khyod ni ni madh+ri taḥ/ /pā ta rā ga ma ṣ+pe ṣ+pe ba mā dzā bi ta ra me be+e sgo/ /i mgron du gnyer/ /nang par byon pas bdag la ni/ /khyab bdag khengs pa gnang bar mdzod/ /ces kyu dī r+ya ta yodṛ bye bi tsi tra ku su mā ba lbo/ / sa dz+re be+e te ba pra pa brjod nas des 'phangs pa/ /rnam par bkra ba'i me tog 'phreng ldu / /gus pa'i pho nya srog bcas ya yo na bha sā bhat+ta dru ti kā/ /sā shwe ta rak+ta ha ri tā se ta put+pa pā lbo khe bzhin—/ /nam mkha' las ni rab tu song / /dkar dang dmar dang ser dang sngon po dag gi me tog dhū pa dhū ma sha ra khā sha na kaiḥ pra yādhī / / bā lām+bu da pra ṇa yi 'phreng ①/ /bdug pa'i du bas bkra ba dal gyis mkha' la 'gro ba de/ /bde sogs bdag po'i gzhu yi dī su tsi re tsa kā she saṃ tsā ri tsā pa la ti ke ba sha tsā bye pa gya/ /a 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba ni/ /chu 'dzin gzhon nu dag la rab tu chags shing ceyun ring mdzes/ /de nas tha dze ta ba rna pā pya k+ṣa ṇi na ku su mā ba lbo/ /sa bhasti shā li m+bi shāstuḥrgyal byed tshal song nas/ /skad cig gis ni me tog 'phreng khye/ /gus pa dag dang ldan pa de/ /ston pa pā ta tsa ra khyobyā yoḥ/ /bha ga bā na pi sat+tha dzhaḥsadze+e dzñā tā pa m+bi hi tai/ /pa'i zhabs pad dag la lhung / /bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / /ma ga dha ni bzang mo yi /su mā ga jo yāḥ ka ru dh+yā dānan+da ma ba dah+phu raḥ/ /pā targan+ta bya 'dod pa kun mkhyen thugs rje yis/ /kun dga' bo la sngon ltesnadu gsungs/ /grong khyer bu ram shing 95—1017

stso na bha bo hi duḥs haḥ/ /a nā di kā lo pa tsi tāḥkle sha dzad+ma dza rā da dman pa'i dngos po bzod par ①dka'/ /thog stimed dus su bsags pa yi/ /nyon mongs skye dang rga 7snyeyaḥ—/ /tan+tu pa yasneḥshākyarnye pāp+ta mṛdhi pa da ki yata/ /i ti tsin+ta ba sogs/ /'bad pa can gyis gzhom nus na/ /rdzu 'phrul gnas ni thob d+nghal ci/ /chags bral drag ya tasta su tī bra saṃ be+e ga yā dhi yā/ /pā du rā sbo1 ṇi ṣ+pe ba ma hādhiḥshudhe po'i blo gros kyis/ /de ltar sems shing dag pa yisanya / /sems ldan de la skad cig gisasnye / /rdzu 'phrul tse ta saḥ/ /a tha rā spya bya tī tā yī pra bhā te san+d+ra byek+ṣa baḥ/ /nā nā tri chen po rab tu skyes/ /de nas mtshan mo 'das gyur te/ /snga dro dge slong thams cad ni/ /sna tshogs lha da sha be+e she na bi mā ṣ+perna bha pā ya yuḥ/ /a tā n+ta re ma hā ram̐ bha yi chas ldan pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang nas mkha' la gshegs/ /skabs der rtsom pa chen po la(khyaste/ /saṃ bhā ra pa ri pū ra te/ /su mā ga dh+wa bhadṛ gre te bha ga bsder+sha nokhru tshogs kyis yongs su gang gyur pa/ /bdag po'i khyim du (shebacom ldan 'das/ /lta 'dod ma ga dha bzang kā / /sa ha pā pā da mā ru khya shwa shu ra bha dṛ bhiḥ/ /tasbo ku su mo—/ /me tog bdug pa'i mchod pa yi/ /bkod pa 'dzin la mngon phyogs shing / /sgyug mo gyos po khyo ma dhū pa dzñā ra tsa rna saṃ gra horlu khā+e/ /bhik+ṣu rā dzñā ta kauṇ+ḍi n+yasta to rnams dang / /lhan cig khang bzang khye la 'dzegs 'khod/ /de nas rta yi shing rtar lku gnas/ /dge shwa ra ṭha ma sbi taḥ/ /di byarja bi bi bhā:r+ya pra tha ma pra t+ya dṛ sh+yata/ /tai slong kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya/ /rnam mang ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul ni/ /mchog ldan dang po nyuskyerab tu mthong / /nyi dṛ ṭī saṃ kā shaṃ bi smi tā ཿshwa shu rā da yaḥ/ /u tsūḥsu mā ga dh+wa spru ma dang mtshungs de mthong nas/ /ya mtshan gyos sogs dga' ba yis/ /ma ga dha bzang la smras pa/ /t+yā ki me ṣa bha ga bā ni ti/ /sā ba dadzha ga bān+d+ra yo dṛ sh+ya te ta ra ṇi pra bhaḥ/ /bcom ldan zhes pa 'di 'am ci/ /des smras 'di ni bcom ldan min/ /dge slong kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya/ /95—1019

a ya mā dzñā ta kauṇ+ḍa ju rnyik+ṣu rak+ṣaṇ+ḍi dī dhi tiḥ/ /ā ya tarlu kra me shā tha 'od zer dman pa min pa 'di/ /nyi ma dag dang mtshungs par mthong / /de nas rim gyis shing rta yis/ /ra the ṣā shwa shu rā da yaḥ/ /ki ma yi ki ma yo bha dre bha ga bā ni ti tsā dza guḥ/ /byon pa'i tshe na gyos sogs kyis/ /bzang mo bcom ldan 'di 'am hu)ci/ /'di 'am ci zhes rab tu smras/ /sā bra bīsne ba shāstu ya me te tasgo sa no tsi tāḥ/ /bhik+ṣa baḥpra sha ma bla des smras 'di ni ston pa min/ /'di dag de yi bka' la 'os/ /dge slong rab zhi bsngags par 'os /sgyusta po dīp+ta ta ra tī ṣaḥ/ /yaḥkān+ta he ma dru ma ra mya shi la shri gā bi dru bhāḥpu ra dka' thub rab 'bar 'od zer (snyecan/ /gser ljon mdzes pas dga' ba ri yi ni/ /rtse mo la zhon sngon to ju be+e ti/ /ā:r+ya kṛn+d+rasto i ba pra bhā baḥshrī mād+ma hā kā shā pa e ṣa la byon pa gang / /ngo mtshar byed pa mthu ni gzugs can bzhin/ /dpal ldan dge slong 'di ni 'od byekyuḥ—/ /pa.ā+oṃ na na gyan+da na mā sbi to yaḥpa to ya dz+re mū ta shaṃ dhī ra gho ṣaḥ/ /srungs che/ /chu ldan char sprin zab mo'i 'brug sgra ldan1/ /gdong lnga ④shing rta dag la gnas pa gang / /byo: sa ma bye ti gu ṇiḥpra d+dhā taḥs e ṣa bhikyu ju bi shā ri pu traḥ/ /ā ru mkha' la sngon ⑤du byon pa'i dge slong 'di/ /sa la yon tan gyis bsgrags shā ri'i bu/ /gnyis 'thung so hra kai la sha mi bā ti shu bye dī paṃ tsa turdan+ta ma nan+ta kārnyiḥ/ /ā yā ti yaḥpu bzhi kai la sha bzhin du/ /rab dkar la zhon mtha' yas mjos pa gang / /byon pa'i dge slong de ⑥ni ju ba hūṃ dza gah+phu moṅga l+ya nā mā pa ra e ṣa bhigruḥ/ /bai ḍūr+ya nā lo ka na kā ra bin+da 'gro rnams na/ /bsod nams ldan mchog mo gal ⑦bu zhes bya/ /gser pad bai ḍū r+ya yi yu ba can/ /mā ru hra raspyo ku ra ke sha dzā shaṃ/ /u pe ti yaḥsau ra bhā pū ri tā shaḥs e ṣa bhik+ṣuḥrin chen myu gu ge sar gyis mtshan zhon/ /phyogs ni dri bzang gis 'gengs byon pa gang / /dge slong de pra thi to ni ru d+dhāḥ/ /pan+d+ra ma rā gre ga ru ḍā dhi ru zwaḥpak+ṣu ni lot+pa ri nyid ma 'gags pa zhes grags/ /gang zhig 'a3mkha' lding la zhon gshog rlung gis/ /chu 'dzin rab tu 95—1020

da sha dā ra pa tha pu ra tat+pabhu be+e ma ṣ+ṭha de sha mūr+bhe bai ba/ /pra bi sh+ya sgo lam bco brgyad ldan pa der/ /mtshungs pa'i sgu ni bco brgyad hūṃ7dang bcas pas/ /rab zhugs ma ga tsa kre sha shi kārnya rat+na shi la ma yo be+edre su ma ga dh+wa yāḥ/ /a bh+yañtsi tai ta tra ba hu pra dha ni bzang mo'i khyim/ /zla shel rin chen rdo yi rang bzhin byas/ /der ni yo byad rdzogs pa rnam mang gis/ /kā riḥpūṇ+ḍi pa tsā riḥpra ṇi pa t+ya sabyeḥ/ /ā pū dza yah+pho ra dzaḥs mān+ta dz+re hi: mngon par mchod cing kun byus phyag 'tshal te/ /grong pa'i skye bo dag gis kun nas mchod/ /rtsig par bhisti pra ti thim+bi bhān+ta/ /su mā ga dh+wa yā da ya yā da yā luḥpū dzi kṛ tī tā gzugs brnyan snang de phyi nas kyang / /bcom ldan brtse ldan dge 'dun dang bcas pas brtse bas bha ga bād+ma saṃ ghaḥ / / a nu gra hā lo ka na sa m+bi bhā giḥ sa bān+dha mchod pa blangs nas rjes bzung ⑤ ni/ /gzigs pa'i cha yis ma ga dha bzang mo/ /gnyen dang bcas pa bā yā bi da dhe pra sā rda/ /su mā ga dh+wa sa shwa shu rā di brga sa hā pa riḥbo ra dza rnams la bka' drin bsgrubs/ /ma ga dha bzang gyos sogs sde dang bcas/ /grong pa'i skye bo kun dang na: sazaḥ/ /shāstusta dā de sha na yā ba byu baḥshud+dhā sha yīsta1 ṇa dṛṣ+ṭa sat+yāḥ/ /bcas pa yang / /de tshe ston pa'i bstan pa dag gis ni/ /de dus bden mthong bsam pa dag par gyur/ /su mā ga dh+wa yāḥku sha khā nu badhe pu ju pra bhā baṃ bi pu lo bi lokya/ /te nyik+ṣu dge ba ①rjes 'brel ma ga dha bzang gi/ /bsod nams mthu ni yangs pa mthong gyur nas/ /dge slong de bsta tra ku tū ha le na pa prasgo ra snga dzi na mā di bṛtrī/ /thraṣ+ṭaḥs taiḥsaṃ sa di dag gis der dge mtshan las/ /de yi sngon byung rgyal ba dag la dris/ /ma ga dha bzang dge ba'i rgyu dag saza daṅgi su mā ga dh+wa yāḥku sha la su te rtu/ /dan+ta pra bhā bhiḥka ku bhā mu khe 6 ni—/ /tshogs su de dag gis dris bcom ldan 'das/ /kun gzigs de yi (gyechems kyi 'od rnams kyis/ /di shan+d+ra kā sha bha ga bādru bhā ṣe/ /bā rā ṇa snga ma jun+d+rarde kri kriḥkān+ta su byu ba phyogs sgor snang ba byin cing cho rab gsungs pa/ / bā rā ṇa sī yidag tu sngon/ /sa bdag mdzes pa kri kri ( shaṃ95—1023

sa mo ho pa ha tāḥpa ram̐/ /bo bye ga muspyo prasba gya sathi praste na bi kra yo/ /bcom pa de dag byang chub kyi①/ /yan lag mu tig bye gang ②ni/ /phye bye gang ①la 'tshong bar 'gyur/ /nyispyo bā kya ku dā rū ṇi budha bhā ṣi ta tsan+da ṣ+peḥ/ /sā mā n+ya mā pā mu stegs tshig ni shing ngan dang / /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs tsan dan dag /rmongs las khyad par mi da yi 6rnyi mokhye da bi she ṣi ṇaḥ/ /kwa tsidha dro sa mā sā r+ya bi nī tai bhikhyi shes pa/ /de dag gis ni mtshungs byed 'gyur/ /dul ba'i dge slong glang po che/ /bzang po thob nas kuñdza re/ /duḥshi la ka la sgo bhigruḥsparja yā dhi ka ka ri 6 ti/ /tsā 'ga' zhig tu/ /dge slong khrims 'chal glang phrug gis/ /'gran zhing smod par byed par 'gyur/ /g.yo pa khā shu tsi li dzñā gaḥ su shī la d+dhi gru ma rga ṭa ཿ / / a nu lispa na ba'i bumi gtsang gis byugs lus/ /dge slong spre 'us khrims ⑤bzang rnams/ /rang gi skyon gyis sgo byed swa do ṣe ṇa ka ri 6 t+yād+me saṃ ni bhān/ /paṇ+ḍa ka myu bhi ṣe kastsa bha bi byu ti cing / /bdag nyid mtshungs pa spyobyed par 'gyur/ /spre'u bzhin du rigs 'khyal ba/ /mngon par ka pe ri ba/ /saṃ budhe shā sa na pa ṭi kṛ 6 mā rna na rde k+ṣa ti/ /dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yi/ /ras yug drangs pas nyams mi 'gyur/ /saṃ gha dra bya pha lā rā me ṣ+ṭa pi yā sudhi tso ra tsā / /mi thaḥ ka la dge 'dun rdzas dang ⑦'bras bu yi/ /dga' tshal dag kyang rku bar 'gyur/ /phan tshun skyon nas brjod ⑧ha shī la: bha bi 6ṣ+ṭha pa pā dī naḥ/ /ta ba swasna bi pā kādhe pha lā bye tā byed cing / /'thab ⑨mo'i ngang tshul dag tu 'gyur/ /khyod kyi rmi lam rnam byun mthar/ /'bras bu 'di ni bhū ta le/ /i ti shāstuza tsaḥkhru tā bismi to byud+ma tī pa tiḥ/ /sā nu ga dag sa las byung ⑩/ /zhes pa ston pa'i tshig thos nas/ /sa yi bdag po ya mtshan gyur/ /de nas ston myu tha dṛ pa teḥs shāstu dharma de sha dzā/ /kṛ tā kāñtsa na mā khā dze+e des mi bdag ni/ /rjes 'brang bcas la chos bstan pa/ /mdzad nas gser 'phreng khyanyucan ma la/ /95—1026

di de sha ku sha lārta tsā/ /dzad+mān+ta re tsa kā rā ༈stu pe nā ram̐ ga mā la yā/ /dge ba 'os pa nyid dag bstan/ /skye ba gzhan du mchod rten la/ /nā rang ga yi 'phreng ①bas mchod/ /sā te na su kṛ te ṣ+pe ba dzā ta he ma sra rdzu ki tā/ /se yo su mā ga dh+wa legs byas de yis de nyid ni/ /gser 'phreng khyadag gis mtshan par skyes/ /ma ga dha ni bzang mo 'di/ /pu sgo pra bhā be+e na ma tī ya sā/ /pābhā r+ya dza na kā ya gya saṃ myaklu sha la gya tu de nyid bsod nams mthu chen gyis/ /yang dag dge ba'i zam stegs nyid/ /de ring skye bo'i tshogs kyis hūṃ / /a bhi dh+wa ya ti bha ga bān+da bha sā bhik+ṣu bhiḥs haḥ/ /ru tsā thob—/ /ces gsungs bcom ldan rgyal ba ni/ /dge slong rnams dang bcas pa dag /mdzes pas saṃ pu ra yan+d+ra shā ya yo dze ta ba sna dzi na ཿ / / sum̐ sā sa d+ku la phyogs rnams yongs 'gengs shing / /mkha' las rgyal byed tshul du gshegs/ /skyes bu rnams kyi rigs bhū ta ye ba la ba tī mi bye ba su tra smṛ hā sru nubye da bu ṇa sta de ba bi ka lo mchog 'phel slad stobs ldan bu la chags pas brdzun 7pa nyid/ /gal te bu la yon tan med na de tshe taṅgin+da sarde ku lo/ /sā ka t+yā ki la dzā ya te gu ṇa ba tī pu rgya pra bhā bā rigs kun nyams pa min nam ci/ /gang gi bsod nams mthu yis 'khor ba'i chu klung (byebadag po che la gru r+ya yā saṃ sā ro ru pa rit+pa to ku la yu shaṃ nā be+e bā sad+dhār+ya te/ /i ti bzhin du/ /rigs zung yang dag sgrol byed yon tan ldan pa'i bu mo de dag nges par 'byung / /zhes pa k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī su ma ga dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ma ga dh+wa ba dā rgo tri na ba ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// //ta ra la ta ra ta ram̐ god+dhā ra shaṃ dī ra to ye da dha ti dza ga nyi ke tsit+tap+ta hūṃ skal ba nyams pa kha cig rab g.yo rba thu rlabs skyed pa yi/ /zab mo'i chu ldan 'gro ba dag tu gdung 95—1027

bhasna bhā gyuḥ/ /kha ra ma ru pa ri tā pe ke tsi dut+pak+ta pu rgyaḥs ha dza ba nyid 'dzin cing / /bsod nams rgyas pa kha cig mya ngam drag pos ①yongs gdung la/ /lhan skyes chu sa li la sā ris+t+ri bra z-iṣ+ṭi t+ya dzarnyi/ /shra bahūṃ pu khyu mi tra su sru nuspyo ha ba te yi tshogs kyi ①mi bzad sred pa gtong bar byed/ /mnyan yod du ni khyim gyi bdag /bsod nams bshes ra khyu tra/ /ya sho mi tra i ti khyu ta pra ti mā ā+oṃ ya sha sri rgo/ /ta su gnyen dag gi bu/ /grags pa'i bshes gnyen zhes ①bya ba/ /grags pa can byi tshad gyur byung / /bdud dzan+ma k+ṣa ṇi pu byeḥbe+e yu ṣa ki ra ṇa tī ṣaḥ/ /a bṛji pra bha bā bā rnyiḥsha rtsi'i zer gyi ④'od zer can/ /de skyes tshe na bsod nams kyi/ /chu yi ⑤char med las skyes pa/ /mi shā ma bi ṣa mā bi bta/ /pra sa be+e ba ba shī ga tā bha ba sgo ga pa rādru khaḥ/ /bzad rgud pa zhi bar gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid la dbang gyur cing / /srid pa'i longs spyod las phyir phyogs/ /dzi rna dze na ba nā sī rna se ṣe be ku sha lo r+ya taḥ/ /dhan+d+ra de sha na yā shastuḥdage la brtson pa de song nas/ /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal bzhugs bsten/ /ston pas chos ni bstan pa yis/ /pra bra byerta t+pa do shri taḥ/ /tu l+ya kāñtsa na bā ṣā ṇaḥso khyuṣ+ṭhak+ta thra rab byung dgra bcom gnas la brten/ /de ni gser dang rdo mtshungs shing / /dga' dang mi dga' yā bri yaḥ/ /rdaṭī rgyu sa ra saṃ ta gya dru ta spa ṭi ka nin+d+ra lo/ /shu shā ba tsā ri ye btang bar gyur/ /de yi mche ba dag las chu/ /ro ldan dri med shel gyi ni/ /khu ba zags pa gang zhig nā sau bī tasngaṣ+ṭaḥs dā bha bta/ /ka dā tsibyek+ṣa paḥsat+tha bha ga brnye ku gis—/ /de ni rtag tu sred bral gyur/ /nam zhig dge slong thams cad kyis/ /dge mtshan las ni tū ha khāta/ /dṛṇ+ḍa byu pa ra me ta su ba pradz+raḥpu rgya kā ra rde/ /so bra bīṭ+wā bcom ldan la/ /de yi sred ⑪/pa bral ba yi/ /bsod nams rgyu ni rab tu dris/ /des gsungs kā shi'i sh+ya pā khya gya shāstuḥkā shi pu re pu rā/ /a bhūn+d+ra dzi taḥgreṣ+ṭha su taḥsu na da ra kā grong du sngon/ /mdzes pa zhes bya tshong dpon bu/ /ston pa 'od srungs zhes pa yi/ /rab tu byung ba nyid 95—1028

bhi dhaḥ/ /sa ka dā tsidh+ri ṣā krān+taḥsad+dhā pa klan+ta bi gra haḥ/ /ni dā bhe tsā du gyur/ /nam zhig skom pas gzir gyur cing / /gdung bas nyen pas ①lus can des/ /so ga'i tsā ①ta ka i ba na kwa tsidz+dza la māp+ta bān/ /shu n+ya hūṃ to ya pā tā ṇi ku pa nirdza ta ka bzhin du/ /'gar yang chu ni thob ma gyur/ /de yi bsod nams ma yin pas/ /chu snod stong pa la ta ma pi/ /sgo hūṃ si sa ha pā sho ṣe ta snga pu byeḥs mā ya yuḥ/ /de ha nyid dang 1ni/ /khron pa yang ni chu med dang / /'jug ngogs 'phral la bskams ④par gyur/ /de nas t+yā go r+ya ta snga tha ta gya dṛṭ+wā pra khā pi naḥ/ /u pā sgye ye na pa li lo dadzhai s+thā yā da skom pas cho nge smras/ /lus ni gtong bar brtson de la/ /mkhan pos chu ni byin pa dag /mthong ba dṛ sh+ya tram̐/ /shā sa nāṭ+wā sh+ya pa snga tha pa shāsturdza la bhā dza rgo/ /ak+ṣa ya min pa nyid du gyur/ /de nas de yis ston pa ni/ /'od srungs bka' yis chu yi snod/ /mi zad pa nyid twa mi bā yā tai saṃ bhe tsi ra ma tsā ra yā tai/ /kā ru jut+ta gya bha ga bānad+ku sh+ya paḥbazhin gyur pa/ /dge 'dun dag la yun ring ⑪brims/ /de yi chu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'od srungs gre ya sam+bi dhiḥ/ /pra san+da pā ṇi pad+me na tsa kre bā ri pra ti gra haṃ/ /dṛṭī dge legs dag gi gter/ /rab tu dang bas thugs rje nas/ /phyag gi pad+mos rab bzhes mdzad/ /der sa bisma yasta tra dza na saṃ gha sa mā ga maḥ/ /to ya ma k+ṣa ya hūṃ ya tai ni skye bo'i tshogs 'ongs pas/ /chu ni zad pa med gyur pa/ /mthong nas ya mtshan dag dang bcas/ /sa t+ya dar+sha na māp+ta bān/ /tatru ju pra ṇi dh+wa ṣ+pe na so yi ku sha la mū la bden pa mthong ba thob par gyur/ /de yi bsod nams smon lam gyis/ /grags pa'i bshes gnyen dge bān—/ /ya sho mi traḥshri taḥshārnyi rdat+thabye ta pa yo bha raḥ/ /i ti dzad+mān+ta rtsa ldan/ /zhi ba bsten 'di mche ba las/ /chu yi tshogs ni 'khrungs par gyur⑥ / /de ltar grags pa'i ra dar+ghaṃ ya sho mi tra su sā da rāḥ/ /dzi ṣ+pe na ka thi tai shu tā bhek+ṣa bo bshes gnyen gyis/ /skye ba gzhan la byin pa ni/ /rgyal bas gsung thos gus pa yis④/ /dge slong 95—1029

bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /saṃ sā ra ma ru pa ri bh+ra ma troṭ+wā tā paṃ t+ya dzasti dzi na se baṃ/ /rnams ni ya mtshan gyur/ /bde ba dri med chu ① gang zhi ba ni/ /kha ba'i rlabs ldan rgyal ba bsten pa dag /su kha bi ma la sa li la ka li lo sha ma nyi ma kakhro lin+di pā su/ /i thob nas 'khor ba mya ngam sdethang la ni/ / yangs 'khyam srid pa'i ①gdung ba gtong bar byed/ /ces ④ ti k+ṣe men+d+ra be+e ra tsi tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e ya sho mi tā pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ba dā rna tsa tun+d+ra ba ti ta maḥpabe+e waḥ// //grags pa'i bshes khyaganyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //un+d+rar+ya pā pa bi byu lo nyi mi rā ba tā ram̐ sa r+yaḥpra tīṇ+ḍi ka ru rja ki ra rgya che sdig pa'i mun par 'jug pa dag ni rab spangs nas/ /'phral la snying rje'i 'od zer snang ba ṇa pra kā shaḥ/ /do ṣā pa ha: pa ri tā pa ha rabyu ko pi sad+marga mā rab tu rgyas pa yis/ /skyon sel ci yang yongs su gdung ba dag kyang 'phrog byed pa/ /sangs rgyas 'od di sha ti bubye sa ha sra raṭīḥ/ /pu ri pu rā rā dza kṛ he bha ga bādre khu kā stong ldan pas dam pa'i lam ni ston par byed/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab na sngon/ /ka lan da ka'i gnas na ṣ+pe/ /ka lan+da ka ni bā sā khye bi dza hā ra ta thā ga taḥ/ /tasmizlu zhes pa/ /'od ma'i tshal na bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par bzhugs/ /grong der ⑥re sārja pa te rat+na dat+ta su dā ra kau/ /a byu tsā ni shi tā khyu yī dzā yā yī ded dpon don byin gyi/ /chung ma rdon ྅mo zhes pa la/ /bu gnyis /8snadag ni dus gcig tu/ /mtshe ma yu ga par+ya yo/ /to shaṃ ku sharnyi daṭ+wā khyo yā te bi ta ri pañtsa tsā/ /k+ṣ-i nyid du byung bar gyur/ /pha ni lnga pa nyid gyur cing / /nor dang 'khor ni zad pa'i tshe/ /shang ku ṇi dha ṣ+pe pa ri dza ṣ+pe mā tā kṛsgo ṇa brja to/ /to mā tudze+e tsa sā bā lo sha na mtshams byin zhes bya ba/ /de dag ma yi ⑨tshegs kyis bskyed/ /ma yi tshig gis chom rkun la/ /rab 95—1030

kaiḥpra ti be+ethra ram̐/ /tsor+ya pra bṛk+ṣiṃ swasprarja bhāṇ+ḍa dzā tsakra tuḥk+ṣa yo/ /zhugs byes pa de dag gis/ /khyim zla dag gi nor chung dang / /snod rnams dal gyis brlag par byas/ /mā tuḥpi tu: ni ya me na bha brnyi yo gyuḥshwa bye ba tai t+ya bi na ye ta du nge ma dang pha yi dul ba yi ①ni rung ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /de yi btang snyoms nyid kyis 'dul ba min pa'i k+ṣa ma ba/ /pūsbo di ta swa dza na bā sa na yi ba bsgye bā khāste khā i ba g.yang la lhung / /rang gi skye ba sngon bskyed bag chags dag dang 'byel ba las/ /byis pa rnams di til pa ra pra kṛ ti bha dzadhe/ /kra rnge na brja mā no to sro bhā tso ra twa mā ga bzhin gzhan gyi rang bzhin sten par byed/ /rim gyis de dag cher skyes te/ /chom rkun dar bab nyid du to / /ul+ladza sarnyi ts+tsha dā byeḥpo rā r+ghaṃ dza snu tur+bha dz+wa/ /a dzā gyur—/ /'dzeg dang mtshams 'bigs la sogs kyis/ /grong khyer ba yi nor rnams blangs/ /de dag bya ta sha tru shā rā dzñā tsā rim+bi dzñā ya taskṛ yī/ /be+e kṛṣ+ṭi ba dh+ya ba su dh+wa to mā tā sa hi ba nyan rna yis/ /shes nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras/ /de dag ma dang bcas pa ni/ /skad cig nyid kyis to k+ṣa ṇ+ḍatu/ /yabyu bye te pa ra dha ṣ+pe na ni sni ya te yash+lau byu sha yā bi ṣa ya gsod par springs/ /gzhan gyi nor gyis ⑤/gang zhig za byed gang zhig 'thung bar byed/ /bde ba'i bsam baṭ+wā bi gā khya te yata/ /ta snga bi tsā ra ra ma ṇ+ḍi ya su khā da ra gya pas yul gyi lam ni gang zhig nyams myong byed/ /ma dpyad dga' bar byed pa'i dubade la gus pa de nyid ni/ /pra shā ba shā na pa ṇa dā ru ṇa e ba pā gāḥ/ /saṃ dzā ya te bi ṣa ya pā na smin par gyur pa srog ni nyams byed mi zad buzong dag yin/ /yul byi btung bas rgyags shing 'khrugs pa ma dā ku khā dzā yastsor+ya dā ha ba dha labha bha ṣ+pe na rā gaḥ/ /nir+yā t+ya rnams kyi chags pa gang / /rku dang sreg dang gsod pas thob pa'i nor gyis rab bskyed pa/ /de ni yongs sau pa ri ṇa taḥka ra pā da bhe da shu khā dhi ro ha ṇa pa ri shu ta rak+ta smin rkang lag bcad dang gsal shing la zhon pas/ /yongs zags khrag gi rgyun gyis phyi rol dag tu 'byung 95—1031

byu reḥ/ / ta tasto ba rgya mā waṃ kau bhā la ragh+ra sbra ra thra to/ /pre bar 'gyur/ /de nas gsod pa'i 'phreng ①bas mtshan/ /sngon dmar gos kyis g.yogs de dag /lta ru k+ṣa ga ta dza nā tīzlo ba dh+ya s+thā na mu pā ga to/ /dzñā tā da yā bād+mabyu rnyeḥ'ongs pa'i skye bos bskor2/ /gsod pa'i gnas su nye bar song / /brtse ldan kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen nas//swa ya ma bye t+ya hūṃ bhu baṃ/ /pra sā dā nu gra te ṇi ba tsakre bi ga ta rang nyid sa der mngon phyogs te/ /rjes su bzung gaba'i bka' drin gyis/ /bcings pa dag dang bral brnya no/ /sazla dzñā dzha yā rā dzñā to t+yak+ṣiṃ muk+ta pā pa ta kau/ /pra bra bar mdzad/ /kun mkhyen bka' yis de dag ni/ /rgyal pos btang zhing sdeg pa grol/ /bcom ldan bye yā bha ga ba taḥshā sa ṣ+perta twa mā pa tuḥ/ /dza na nā si hi to dṛṭī to dzñā na 'das kyi bstan pa la/ /rab tu byung nas dgra bcom ④thob/ /ye shes 'byor 'bar de dag ni/ /ma bi bha bo dz+wa lo/ / ta ṅka tsā kau tu kādṛ ṣ+ṭi bhegru rnyiḥ su ga to bh+ya dang bcas pa mthong byur nas/ /dge slong gis dris dge mtshan las/ /de gtam bde bar gshegs pas jota—/ /ma ye ba rak+ṣ-i tā be to pūzasmi: pi dzad+ma ni/ /e ta yordza gsungs—/ /sngon gyi skye ba dag la yang / /'di dag bdag gis rab tu bsrungs/ /de tshe 'di dag nyid na nī byā spyo gho ra rū pā ta dā bha bat+pa/ /tasmid+ku yo kṛ pā ban+tusgo bye sa twa kyi ma/ /stag mo 'jigs rung gzugs ldan grur/ /de dus byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /brtse bas lus sha rī ri rde/ /a haṃ ka ru ṇa re ṭā khyaḥk+ṣi ti pā la su to bha baṃ/ /ka dā tsi can rnams kyi gnyen/ /snying rje'i rdul zhes bya ba yi/ /sa skyong bur ni nga nyid gyur/ /nam zhig bkres de tok+ṣu1 mā po ta kau sgothi mu r+ya tā/ /swa sha rī rasma yā da tā byā gi sā tu ni pas nyen pa yis/ /phrug gu 'di dag za rtsom pa'i/ /stag mo de ni rang gi lus/ /byin nas bdag gis bā ri tā/ /a r+ya tā be+e ba tso ra two kah+ma she ṣā du sā ga to/ /ma yā saṃ rnam par bzlog /las kyi lhag mas lad lta yang / /'di dag chom rkun nyid du gyur/ /stag mo de ni ma 95—1032

rak+ṣi to byu 1 mā tā so be ya me ta yoḥ/ /i kyughā ka ru zla sen+tur+bha ga bān+dhu 'di ste/ /'di dag bdag gis rab tu bsrungs/ /zhes gsungs bcom ldan thugs rje yi ①/ /rgya mtsho ta bhā ba naḥ/ /rnyik+ṣu saṃ ghi na sa hi taḥpra ya yo dze ta kā na dz+wa/ /'byung po la dgongs pa/ /dge slong tshogs dang bcas pa dag /rgyal byed tshal du rab tu gshegs/ /a mṛ ta ra sa thraṣ+ṭa riṣ+ṭa dṛṣ+ṭa ra ni ṣ+ṭa pa hā pa tā dza ye ti/ /pa ti bdud rtsi ro yi char bzhin mi 'dod sel/ /'dod pa dam pa'i gzigs pa gang lhung bas/ /lhung ba tai ba pa ti ta ma bi yā ku ru te pu byon+d+ra ta shā sgyamra/ /i ti k+ṣe rnams kyang bsod nams kyis mtho ba'i/ /bsngags par 'os par mdzad pa rgyal gyur cig /ces pa dge men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī byā sgya ba dā ram̐ pañtsa ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las stag mo'i 5 na ba ti ta maḥpal+la waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// //d+mā daḥsha shāṅka su ra beḥpra kā shastu paḥkṛ shā noḥpa ba na su be gaḥ/ /pa ro pa zla ba'i 1kun dga' nyi ma'i rab gsal dang / /me yi tsha ba rlung gi mgyogs pa dang / /snying rje la kā raḥkā ru ṇa ra tā dzā ma hā dza nā dzā sa ha dzaḥswa bhā baḥ/ /ud+mā ṣ+pe ke dga' skye bo che rnams kyis④/ /gzhan la phan pa lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ /'phags rgyal skyed mos li ra si kaḥshrī mā nu da ya naḥpu rā/ /a baṭī bi dza yo rā dzā bi dza hā ra tshal du sngon⑤/ /rgyal po dpal ldan 'char byed ni/ /rtse dga'i ro dang ldan pa dag /btsun mor ba dhū pa khaḥ/ /ta gya pusgostso yā sagh+raḥkān+taḥku ba la ye k+ṣa shāḥ/ /ya dṛbyu bcas pa rnam par gnas/ /de yi mdzes ma ut+pal mig /me tog 'thu (blul chags pa rnams/ /thub pa yā ga tedṛ ṣ+ṭa mu nī r+ghaṃ pañtsa bhiḥsha taiḥ / /tā spri yā n+yastu na ya nā brgya phrag lnga rnams ni/ /'dod dgar 'ong ba lngodag gis mthong / /phrag dog khro ba skyong ba des/ /95—1033

sgyut+pa bya tho bha bta/ /dru rāt+pa le la mā da ya sa haste na ma tī ya sā/ /tā na bī ta ba dang bcas gyur/ /chu dang rtsa ba 'bras ster des/ /ring po ring po dag nas chu/ /lag pa shin tu che tre: na bi da dhe pa yo mū la pha la pra daḥ/ /te ṣ+pe ba sa ta haṃ pri t+yā nirdaṣ+ṭa pā ṇa dha bas blangs/ /de dag skom pa dang bral byas/ /de yis dga' ba ①rtag tu ni/ /srog gi zungs 2dag ra ṇaḥ/ /bi shārnyi ta tra te pā puḥpra shān+ta bi pu la shra māḥ/ /kā le na t+yak+ta nges par bsten①/ /rgya che ngal ba rab zhi ba/ /de dag der ni ngal bsos thob/ /de nas dus kyis so de ha su ta taste ta mya darnyi naḥ/ /kṛ twa sha rī ra saṅgā ram̐ pū dzā tsagruḥsu ro ldan pa/ /lus ni btang ba de nyid kyis④/ /lus dag sbyangs nas de dag gis/ /lha la 'os pa'i mchod tsi hūṃ/ /kuñdza re ṇa ma yā ra ju ta e te madh+riṇaḥpu rā/ /kṛdzñā྾ tā ri pa byas/ /dgon par bdag ni glang po yis/ /snyug bsngal de las blon po ni/ /sngon bsgral de dag da sri tā stasmrarlu na yartswa bya be+e sha sāta/ /i kyughā bha ga bābe+ezla satwa saṃ tā lta yang / /thub pa de dag ⑥mi 'dod las/ /zhes pa gsungs nas bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can ra ṇa bra ta ཿ / / pūbye mā no mu ni ga ṇi rdza gā ma swa ta po ba kun sgol brtul zhugs can/ /thub pa'i tshogs kyis mchod byed cing / /rang gi dka' thub nags su rna—/ /a khaṃ la su kha ku sha la dru tī bha ba ma ru sad+dhā pasgo ya/ /dza ya gshegs—/ /ston pa'i thugs rje bdud rtsi'i chu bo ni/ /ma lus bde dang dge ba'i pho nya ste/ /srid pa'i nyi dza na ni ba dza na dī kā ru shā mṛ ta bā hil+lī shāstuḥ/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra mya ngam dze+egadung bsel grib ma dang / /ma bzhin skyed par byed pa rgyal gyur cig /ces pa dge ba'i bi ra tsi tā lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ha s+t+ya ba dā rna dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las glang po'i ṣaṇ+ḍa ba ti ta maḥpabe+e waḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu bcu rtsa drug pa'o// //95—1035

bi dre ṣa do ṣa bi ṣa dru ṣi ta mā na sā ram̐ yaḥsā dhu bā dha na bi sgo ni rnam sdang skyon gyi dug gis yid ni sun phyung ①gyur rnams kyisarjo/ /dam pa dag la gnod pa bsgrub ④shi taḥpra yat+naḥ/ /sngañtsit+ta du dz+wa la gu shā nu kṛ to sa e ba tasko bha be+edṛ la 'bad pa rab rno gang / /de nyid gal te de yi yon tan rab 'bar rjes byed par/ /gyur nas sdesrid thu pa rā bha ba bār+pā be+esmin/ /dzi ṣ+pe rā dza kṛ ho pān+ta be+e rku kā na na tsā 'dir su zhig rgya cher gnod dang ldan par gyur⑤/ /rgyal ba rgyal po'i khab dang nye/ /'od ma'i tshal na rgyu ri ṇi/ /bi dre ṣād+dhā ba dat+ta na pre ri tā stu pa sāḥpu rāḥ/ /zla r+ghaṃ ga ba na/ /lhas sbyin 'ugyis ni sdang bas sngon/ /rab tu bskul ba'i dka' thub pa/ /de yis byin pa'i dī ma ba da nāstajat+ta bi bi dh+wa yu dh+waḥ/ /a sgyu dra brlu saṃ rad+dhā kro dha bi mtshon cha can/ /smin 'khyog 'jigs su rung ba'i bzhin/ /khro bas dul ba nyams gyur pa'i/ /rtsom pa khyasta saṃ ya māḥ/ /pañtsa bhistu pa sa sha taiḥte ྾ k+ṣip+tastedṛṣ+ṭa yaḥ/ /chen pos mngon par gtses/ /brgya phrag lnga yi dka' thub can/ /de dag gis 'phangs mtshon gyi char/ /ya yur+bha ga btaḥkā ya kā ya ka ma lot+pa dzā lashā/ /ni shi tā n+ya bi shas+thā ṇi shra bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la ni/ /pad+ma ut+pal tshogs nyid gyur/ /dam pa rnams la rnon po yi/ /mtshon yadhi sakhru mārda baṃ/ /bi dī ṣa bi ṣa did+dhā ni na tu tsiṭ+wā ni pā pi ā+oṃ/ /pā yang 'jam pa sten byed de/ /sdang ba'i dug gis byugs gyur pa/ /sdig pa can gyi sems ni min/ /ston du rā sīd+ma ṇi ma yo ku ṭā gā ra na bhaḥpra sgo/ /sha rī ra sgo da oṃ shāsturna pa'i sku ni sgrib byed pa/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin khang pa brtsegs/ /nam mkha'i 'di ④ni rab 'khrungs te/ /tu dṛṣ+ṭa ni bā ra khaṃ/ /ta taste ta pa sā shād+dhā ladz+dza ba na mi tā na nāḥ/ /lta ba dag ni bzlog ma gyur/ /de nas dka' thub can de dag /ngal zhing ngo tsha bzhin dud pas/ /ni pe tuḥpā da yoḥshāstuḥk+ṣa mā sirjoḥpra sā di naḥ/ /bha ga bān pi pu bzod pa'i rgya mtsho rab dang bas1/ /ston pa yi ni zhabs la gtugs/ /bcom ldan gyis kyang bu la 95—1036

tā shā mi ba te ྾ pra sā di byā/ /ni kā re khyo pi nin+d+ra rtsebe+e da dhe dhadz+re de sha bzhin—/ /rab tu dang ldan de dag la/ /gnod byed la yang khro med pas/ /chos ni rab tu bstan pa rmā—/ /a khyo bha be+e bh+ra ma su khaṃ sha ma mā shri tā ni pu rgya k+ṣa mā sa mi mdzad—/ /chen po'i ①yid ni 'khrugs ①pa'i rnam 'phrul med pa yis1/ /bde dang zhi ba la brten la nin+d+ra la shī ta lā ni/ /na mā na sā ni ma hā tā hi ta hi pra bṛt+tan+tat+tha bsod nams bzod pa dag gi chu/ /dri med bsel ba dag dang ldan pa phan min 'jug pa min d+ngha/ /de gya ma rgyu ra dza pā ka lu ྾ bha ba rnyi / / dha n+d+ra de sha na yā shās+thāḥthob khro ba'i rdul gyis rnyog pa dag tu yongs ⑤mi 'gyur/ /ston ⑥pas chos bstan rab byung gis/ /bra bra byod+mārdzi tā sha yāḥ/ /te sadrwa shra ba nirmuk+ta marta hūṃ pra ti pe di re/ /bsam pa rab phyis de dag gis/ /zag pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /dgra bcom nyid ni rab tu thob/ /a tān+ta re sa mā yā taibhik+ṣu snyiḥshu ta taṅka dze+eḥ/ /ki me ta di ti sābya:ཿskabs der 'ongs pa'i dge slong ni/ /gtam de thos shing ngo mtshar dang / /bcas pas 'di ci zhes pa thraṣ+ṭastu na ba dalja naḥ/ /kṛ tā pa kā rāḥsu ta dzā pudze+esmin+da pi dzad+ma ni/ /dris—/ /rgyal bas de dag la gsungs pa/ /sngon gyi skye ba dag la yang / /shin tu gnod byas 'di dag la//ma li te nidz+re kā re ṇa pra sā dā da ba lo ki tā/ /i te sa mu dra ya dra yī rnam 'gyur med pa bdag gis ni/ /rab tu dang bas nges par bltas/ /rgya mtsho dag tu 'gro ba la/ /ba ṇi dzaḥkā shi de sha dzāḥ/ /bhasne pra ba ha ṇi pā puḥpu rā dz+re bi ta saṃ da sha yo/ /gzings ni chag par gyur tshe sngon/ /'di dag kā shi'i yul skyes pa'i/ /tshong pas srog la the tshom thob /kats+tsha pe na ma yā ta tra thraṣ+ṭha mā ro su tā ri tāḥ/ /pā ra mā sā r+ya bi shārnyi de la bdag ni rus sbal gyi④/ /rgyab tu bkod nas rab tu bsgral/ /'tsho ba thob cing pha rol tu/ /ste dzi re labha dz+re bi tāḥ/ /uja ra ṇa pa ri shārnye ma yi ni dru z-i te phyin nas ngal gso ⑧rnam par bsten/ /rab tu bsgral bas yongs ngal te/ /bdag ni skad cig gnyid 95—1037

di 6 zla mṛ pa'i sngo bsangs can/ /ri dwags don gnyer rgyal pos ring po nas/ /rna ba'i bar du drangs pa'i mda' gābe+en—/ /a shan+d+ra kasgo pa na te na te na shi te na bidhaḥkha la nadz+re ṇi ba/ /yis bsnun/ /mi bsrun spyotshig gis bzhin du mda' rnon ni/ /bde med las kyis nye bar gnas pa de/ /mas+thā ba san+de na sha re ṇa tī bye bi gyuṇ+ḍi mā naḥpa sha ṣ+pedza gā da/ /a ho ba gnad du zug pas rtag ⑤tu phug pa des/ /rnam par g.yo zhing dal gyis rab smras pa/ /kye ma shin tu tā nār+ya ta re ṇa ke na niḥkā ra khaṃ niṣ+ka rur+ṇa sha ye ṇa/ /a kārlo saṃ gā da bi tsār+ya 'phags pa min pa su/ /snying rje'i bsam pa med pas rgyu med du/ /sdig pa ma spyad bya min la chags nas//pā paṃ pra ṇa ba hā rī pra hi ta sha ro yo/ /pi trospru ṣ+pe de ha dh+ri to na biṣ+ṭi dṛṣ+ṭi pra srog ni 'phrog par byed pa'i mda' 'di 'phangs/ /nags na pha ma'i lus 'dzin du gnas pa/ /mig lo pāt+pa yi yaṣ+ṭi bhu te/ /kaṣ+ṭi ha te to ni ha to ni rā sho ka sgyu ya mu paste rab nyams pa'i dbyig par gyur pa bdag /kyi hud bsad tshe re med de dag bsad/ /gsum gsod drag 95—1048

ba dhe pra yat+naḥ/ /e ti bya thā bisnga li ta pra lnga paṃ bi shaṃ na bathra khru ni lbo po'i bsad ①'di su zhig gisakhru/ /zhes pa gdung bas 'khrul smra bram ze de/ /sma ra'i ri mo gsar chags na le khaṃ/ /dṛ paḥs phru ga na ba tsū ta ma gra tai kāṣ+ṭi kabyen+da mi bān+ta lo mi bdag gis/ /bung ba dang bcas tsū ta gsar pa dag /shing mkhan dag gis bcad bzhin mdun du ke—/ /sha ram̐ gu ru kle she bi she ṣa tsid+dhā saṭ+wā sa dī ṭ+wāsni shi khā ya mā mthong / /bla ma'i nyon mongs khyad par bsams ①pas gdung / /'bar ba'i me lce celta bur spyod pa'i oṃ—/ /pahūṃ ki tai pā ṇa bi pak+ṣa bhū tai su baṇ+ḍi sum̐ khaṃ j-i da ye ba harnye/ /mda'—/ /sgos mtshan srog gi mi mthun phyogs gyur pasaspyo/ /gser gyi ltong can snying la 'dzin byed cing //bi tseṣ+ṭa mā rna ta ṭi byā ta parnye dṛṭī ta mā kṛṣ+ṭa dh+ri tirna ren+d+raḥ/ /pra tā bo pa chu klung ngogs na 'gre ldog byed pa de/ /mthong nas mi dbang brtan pa rab tu nyams/ /gzi byen bral ba ga te na ta na swa sā pa ge ha ṣ+pe ba thra thu bya tho bhūta/ /sa tai ba bhāṣe na mu ni rang gi mda' de yis/ /bsdun pa bzhin du rgya cher ⑥ gdung bar gyur/ /de la des smras thub pa ri dwags ma yā two mṛ gā dzi nātshwa di ta pūn+d+ra kā yaḥ/ /ha taḥpra mo hā bye ga te na kyi—/ /pags pas lus stod g.yogs pa khyod ni bdag /rab tu rmongs pas bcom mo dam pa kye/ /sā sgo shā pāldi nā nārta si ma bhā haṃ ḍū/ /khru two ti bā kyi bya thi tagya rā rnye s+t+ri bra bya shaṃ bdag nyid dmod ⑦ pa'i me yis gzhom mi 'os/ /zhes pa rgyal po gzir ba'i tshig thos nas/ /ral pa'i sa twa ni byerni ya mya/ /tam pra bīdhī ṇ+ḍi dza ṭā ka khā paḥswa bhā ba nidz+re tshogs bkram 2gzhon nu rang bzhin gyis/ /khro med yid ldan snying stobs gter gyis ni/ /drag por rtse ma naḥku mā raḥ/ /a lo ta pa shā paṃ bha ye na dā dza n+da haṃ bi ma rgyuḥgadung ba bzod byas de la smras/ /rgyal po dka' thub dmod pya/ pas 'jigs don med/ /khro bral bdag pi ta ro ma mārnyo/ /asmin+da pi pra ṇa ha rā pa kā re shā po pa paṃ ga na ka ri 6 dang bdag gi pha ma dag /long ba srog 'phrog gnod pa 'di la yang / /khyod la dmod pa dag ni 'dor 95byed1049

si pu tra ke ti gā d+ngha sa ram̐ ṣ+ṭa bye ta mū tsa tusto/ /ā rā bye to bhat+ta sa par+ya yi ba ris khyod 'gro zhes/ /de dag gis ni de la dam 'khyud smras/ /bu khyod me yi sbyin sreg la dga' zhing / /bla nirgyu dza mā baṃ gu ru de ba te na/ /twa yāsni ho tā bhi ra te pu tra sa h+ye na te nāstu ma'i lha dang ldan pas bdag cag ni/ /zol med gus pa'i mchod pas mnyes byas pa'i/ /bden pa des bha bādz+re sha lhaḥ/ /i truk+ta mā tre ka ru shārti sat+ya satwo pa sarje ba tsa na khyod zug rngu med gyur cig /ces pa bla ma dag gi snying stobs rdzogs/ /snying rjes gzir ba'i bden tshig gu ru rgyu/ /sha kraḥs ma bye t+ya su dh+wa pra se kai ra dz+re ba yarjarbi pa ram̐ ku brjod tsam la①/ /brgya byin mngon phyogs bdud rtsis bran pa yis/ /gzhon nu rma dang bral zhing bsos mā re/ /shā mā ka nā mā sa muṣ+peḥku mā rasta dā bha baṃ tabyi na ya bra to haṃ/ /par byas/ /bdag ni de tshe der gus brtul zhugs can/ /thub pa'i gzhon nu sngo bsangs can der gyur//tā be+e ba me shākya ku lodzha be+e pi pū bye su pū byi pi ta ro pra yāṭ+wāta/ /i ti shākya'i rigs 'khrungs mchod bya bdag gis kyang kye/ /'bad nas mchod bya pha ma de dag go/ /de ltar bi bi dha dhan+d+ra mū lo ga di tai su ga te na bhi k+ṣa baḥshu tā/ /gu ru se rnam mang chos kyi rtsa ba ni/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs dge slong gis thos nas/ /bla ma bstan lkupa'i bā bra ta sa dṛ shaṃ nā mya ma n+ya n+ta sa bye trī / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra brtul zhugs dang mtshungs pa/ /dam pa'i spyod pa gzhan dag med par sems/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang bi ra tsi tā lnga bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī byā ma kā ba dā na pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las sngo bsangs can gyi me kā bye ka sha ta ta maḥpabe+e baḥ// //rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa gcig pa'o// //dā ṣ+pe na dī na dza na tā bya sa rna ni hadhi shī le na to ṣa ya ti sadz+dza dman ④pa'i sbyin pas skye bo dman pa rnams kyi gdung ba sel/ /tshul khrims kyis ni skye bo dam pa'i 95byed1052

na mā na pā ni/ / pradzñā ba le na tsa ha ra t+ya bi be ka mo haṃ bīrle yid dag tshim par byed/ /shes rab stobs kyis kyang ni dben pa dang bral gti mug 'phrog /brtson ṇa bā ra ya ti dī ru bha yā ni dhī raḥ / / shā ba hūṃ sa twa ku sha lo 'grus kyis ni 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa zlog ①par byed/ /chos kyi bka' yis mnyan yod na/ /di shaṃ tai dhadz+re shā sa ṣ+peḥ/ /dzi rna dze ta ba nā sī rna pa prasgor+bhek+ṣa paḥpu rā/ /dge ba sems can la ston cing / /rgyal ba rgyal byed tshal bzhugs la/ /dge slong rnams kyis sngon dris pa//bha ga bān bha ba tā sha kro bim+bi shā rabya bhū pa tiḥ/ /rnyik+ṣurtswa dzñā ta kauṇ+ḍi n+yaḥbacom ldan khrod kyis brgya byin dang / /sa bdag gzugs can snying po dang / /dge slong kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya//pra pi tāḥs t+ya dar+sha ā+oṃ/ /lagh+ra dā yo de ba tā dzā ta thā yu ta tsa tuṣ+ṭa yo/ /bden pa mthong ba dag la bkod/ /de yi zhar la lha rnams ni/ /'bum phrag gnyis dang de bzhin du/ /tat+tha saṃ ge na saṃ pāste sat+ya dar+sha na bā tra hūṃ/ /swa bhā baḥs ha dzo bā yi khri phrag bzhi yis bden pa ni/ /mthong ba'i snod nyid rab tu thob/ /kun la phan mdzad khyod kyi 'di/ /gu ṇaḥpu rgyu na yo pi bā/ /dzad+mā bh+yasta pra sā do bā ta ba be+e sho pa kā lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin nam/ /yon tan bsod nams rjes 'gro'am/ /skya (dā bar goms pa'i ri ṇaḥ / / i kyu lte bhik+ṣu bhiḥ shu tā bha ga bān+d+ra t+ya bha ṣa ta / /rab dang yin/ /dge slong rnams kyis 'di brjod gsan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis be+er gsungs pa/ /sa hā dza ba ga mā sgyu sat+pa re pa kṛ ta me ma tiḥ/ /asprurjad+ma ni ki tsi tram̐ bdag gi blo gros gzhan phan la/ /goms pas lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /skye ba 'dir bdag sems can la//ma ma satwa hi te ra tiḥ/ /a su bhū ta pa dā sgyu satrī ha hasgyu di dzad+ma su/ /phan par dga' ba ci zhig mtshar/ /rtag tu goms pas seng ge dang / /glang sogs skye ba (cho 'di la gyur⑤//da k+ṣi zla t+yāḥ pu rā sārja bā hā gā bye gra hā ste yaḥ / / dzagludza la sngon tshe ded dpon lho phyogs pa/ /drag por skye'abrangs pa'i bud med dang / /don mthun 'bum phrag 95—1053

ni dhis+t+ri ram̐ sārja lak+ṣa dwa yā nu gāḥ/ /tasmid+ku le dza gabye sa bya graḥkā la gnyis rjes 'brang / /chu gter dag gi ngogs su phyin/ /de dus dus ni gzhan pa bzhin/ /'gro ba za i bā sa raḥ/ /a bhū ta dza ga rodha raḥphe pā khyaḥs+thā ra bi gra haḥ/ /te lta ba la chags pa/ /'jigs rung lus rgyas sbrul chen ni/ /pham pa zhes pa byung bar gyur/ /skye bo ①kun san+d+ra dza na yā saṃ paṃ tā sa mi ba duḥs haṃ/ /bi naṣ+ṭa dher+ya dṛṣ+ṭha ba ba bhū bur+gha gyi nyon mongs kyi/ /skrag pa bzhin du bzod dka' de/ /mthong nas brtan pa rnam par nyams/ /de ṭi tā i pa/ /sgo ge na sgo gi nā te na sa maṭ+wā byeṣ+ṭi ta pa thi/ /dag dkrugs pa bzhin du gyur/ /gdengs can de yi lus kyis ni/ /lam dag kun nas bskor ba'i tshe/ /nisteṣ+ṭaḥkā la bagh+ra gra ban+ti naste pra bra kru khruḥ/ /te ྾ ma she ṣa tri da sha bsam bral dus kyi kha sgor gnas/ /de dag rnams kyis cho nge bton/ /ma lus lha rnams bstod pa yis//sta baiḥsha ra ṇa rā bi shā/ /ā kran+daḥsat+tha disgyu r+pā pror+ya yo ka ru ṇa swa naḥ/ /skyabs pa'i sgra ldan de dag gis2/ /cho nge phyogs kun khyab byed pa/ /snying rje'i sgra ni rgyas par gyur/ /ya shaḥke sha ra saṃ je tha dzi haḥshe la gu hā shra yaḥ/ /tai shasde man+da raḥde nas seng ge khyeri phug gnas/ /grags pa'i ral can zhes pa dang / /de yi grogs po glang po che/ /khru tā tad+ma ya pabyakuñdza raḥ/ /ā san+da tā ṇa san+darnyo ka ru rja kṛṣ+ṭa mā na sau/ /dhī man dha ra yis sgra de thos/ /rgud ④pa skyob pa la chas ⑤shing / /yid ni snying rjes drangs gyur pa/ /don rā bā dzagla tuḥsārja saṃ rak+ṣa ṇa kṛ tra k+ṣa mo rte/ /ta taḥmo haḥs mā tu khya ga dzerja mthun skyob la dus byas pa'i/ /brtan ⑥pa de dag 'ongs par gyur/ /de nas glang chen ri bo yi/ /lus gi ri bi ga haṃ/ /be+e gārje pa t+yā dza ga re tsa kā ra ga ta dzī be+e tai/ /can dag la seng ges stizhon/ /shugs kyis bsnun nas sbrul chen ni/ /srog dang bral ba dag tu byas/ /pā ṇa pra bā sa sa ma yata su ni shā sa ma ru taḥ/ /tsa ka ra da ha no bhā rī de yi srog ni 'gro dus su/ /dbugs kyi rlung ni sreg byed dag /rab tu 'bar bas seng ge dang / /95—1054

bhāsma sāta sau ha kuñdza ro/ /ta yoḥsha rī ra pū dzā yi ta taste sārja nā ya kāḥ/ /glang po dag ni thal bar byas/ /de nas ded dpon de rnams kyis/ /de dag lus la mchod pa'i slad/ /tho paṃ bi dh+wa ya pra ya yurdi shastad+ma sha pā pa ha/ /a ha me ba ta dā sau mchod rten byas nas de dag gis①/ /grags pa dang 'grogs phyogs su song / /nga nyid de tshe don mthun haḥsārba pā ṇa pra do bha baṃ/ /ma hā hirde ba dasto sau shā ri pu trabya kudzi raḥ/ /la—/ /srog ster seng ge dag tu gyur/ /lhas byin dag ni sbrul chen te/ /shā ①ri'i bu ni glang po che/ /tat+ta su sa twa sha shi naḥsu kṛ ta pra kā shaṃ bi sho ba kā ra tsa tu re tsa ri tai ma snying stobs zla ba de yi spyod pa legs byas rab tu gsal/ /kun la phan par byed mkhas grags shing chen po hāhaṃ —/ /shu tā dzi ṣ+pe na ka thi tai pra tha mā har+ṣasta rnyik+ṣa baḥpra ti pa dag tu 'os/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa de dag thos nas dga' ba thob gyur pa'i/ /dge slong de dag rnams de pra sha shaṃ su re ba / / i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye kyis tshig gis ①so sor rab tu bsngags/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī dzi hā ba dā rna bye bye ka sha ta ta maḥrtogs ④ pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las seng ge'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste pal+la baḥ// //brgya rtsa gnyis pa'o// //tā ra hā ra ba ra ban+t+ra she kha ra ts+tshan+d+ra tsā ma ra pi ta smi tāḥshri yaḥ/ /do shal rab gsal gos mchog cod pan dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab dkar pos 'dzum pa'i dpal/ /di bya sgo ga su bha gāḥsu khot+pa be+eḥsru tsa yarnyi su kṛ tai ma hāt+na rmā/ /mchog gi longs spyod skal bzang dga' ston gyis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i legs byas gsal bar byed/ /pra thradha dhan+d+ra bi bha ba pra bhā bodzha ba dar+sha nāta/ /bismi tai bhi grusaṃ gha tai ba chos kyi 'byor pa rab rgyas pa'i/ /mthu ni rgyas pa ⑤ mthong ba las/ /ya mtshan dge slong tshogs la ni/ /95—1055

bha ṣe bha ga bān pu ra/ /a pābhā nut+ta ra dzñā na ma hā so gya n+ya dzad+ma ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sdon gsungs pa/ /skye ba gzhan la bla med kyi/ /ye shes gzi byin ma thob kyang / /ba byu bun+d+ra ma sābyar+yāḥsu kṛ ta bye dza nāḥshri yaḥ/ /badz+ra ba t+ya bhi bdag la ngo mtshar bcas pa'i dpal/ /legs byas gsal bar byed pa byung / /byang gi phyogs kyi grong dh+wa nā yī na gar+yā mut+ta rā pa thi/ /badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa bhi dho rā dzā badz+ra pā ṇi ri bā bha bta/ /khyer dag /rdo rje can zhes bya bar ni/ /rgyal po phyag na rdo rje bzhin/ /rdo rje gtum po zhes par gyur//gaṅgā bye pa bye na ga re me sum̐ dzi tā ma tī pa ṭī/ /tatru tsā ro hi bhā nā grong khyer gang gā'i bdag po ⑫ ni/ /sa bdag lhun po btul nas de'i/ /bu mo snar ma zhes bya ba/ /ma swa su bye shu ri bābe+e bān/ /ta snga ma dz+re dza nah+phutram̐ sa mi tra sa dṛ shaṃpra dzha/ /des khyethob bdud rtsi'i zer gyis bzhin/ /de yis de la bu dag ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs pa bskyed//tsi tra ya gya ma ṇits+tsha tram̐ sa ha dzā lta bya rā dza ta/ /ta su pu ju pra bhā be+e na sa gang la nor bu'i gdugs dag ni/ /bkra ba lhan cig skyes pas mdzes/ /de yi bsod nams mthu yis ni//kalpo pa na taḥs dā/ /di byā bha ra ṇa sgo gā nu sgo ge byuh+phu ra bā se dz+wa/ /rtag tu bsams pas nyer gnas pa/ /lha yi rgyan dang longs spyod dag /grong khyer ba yis nyams myong gyur//sgo ga piṇ+ḍi ཿthra yiste na yasma྾ pū ri tai pu re/ /tasmraspri ya piṇ+ḍa khyaḥlongs spyod dga' ba'i gong bu des/ /gang phyir grong khyer yongs btang ba/ /de phyir sa bdag sras de ni//smra pa te rabha bah+phu taḥ/ /pi tu ram̐dhe sa saṃ pāp+ta rā dzñāḥpā bye ya sha di dga' ba'i gong bu zhes par gyur/ /pha yi mjug tu rgyal srid thob/ /grags pa rgyas des ① phyogs rnams shaṃ / /di de sha sasba bhū tā dzā swestso yo sgo ga sadza rda/ /dun+d+ra ti dudz+re su—/ /'byung po kun la rang 'dod kyi/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa bstan/ /blon po blo ngan blo tī nā mā madhī ta su bi rak+ṣa tī/ /pra ya yo gu ṇi bibye ṣaḥswa bhā be hi du ngan zhes/ /bya ba de la chags bral grur/ /yon tan can la sdang ba ni/ /bdag nyid ngan pa'i rang 95—1056

rāt+pa rmā/ /me zu mā tā ma haṃ ta gya gyu bhā le khiḥs bhu pa ti/ /pūṣ+ṭha sa kā bzhin yin/ /de yi ma mes sa bdag ni/ /lhun po'i spring khyeyig rnams kyis des/ /sngon gyi gnod pa rasmi h+ye pa tsa kā ra rasma rodru khaṃ/ /sa dru taiḥs ha sobyebyeta ma rtse pra dz+wa li dran pa yis/ /g.yul la mngon par phyogs par byas/ /khro ba mchog tu rab 'bar ba/ /'phral la rgyas taḥs ram̐/ /pan+di de sha ba lot+pa kāsgo hi tram̐ ni dhano r+ya taḥ/ /do hi shing gsod brtson desakhye/ /stobs rab rgyas pas pho nya springs/ /bu mo'i bu la rab bstan pa/ /bu mo'i traḥsha tru pu traste twata pi tā du rāt+pa nā/ /maṇ+ḍa lo khaṇ+ḍa tsā nī tā dṛ tā khrirti bu khyod dgra yi bu/ /bdag nyid ngan pa khyod kyi phas/ /dkyil 'khor nyams pa khyod byas nas/ /grags ri bāt+pa dza/ /ākhyun+d+ra mut+tha rā me tsā pa prats+tsha swets+tsha yā na tseta/ /swa pa bzhin du bu mo phrogs/ /ma nyams sa 'di rang 'dod kyis/ /stsol cig gal te ma yin na/ /rang ya ma bye t+ya ka ro mi pra t+yan+ta sha ra rja ti tho/ /mā tā ma he na pan+deṣ+ṭa nyid 'ongs khyod mtha' 'khob tu/ /skyabs pa'i mgron du bdag gis bya/ /ma mes kyis ni rab bstan pa//me ta dā kardzu khyu pa ti/ /dza na saṃ k+ṣa ya kā ru sgyur+ghaṃ pra sā da yi rtu ya yo/ /sarnyi de dag thos nas sa yi bdag /skye bo rlag la snying rje bas/ /de la dang bar byed du song / /dmag pi gra ha san+dadhaḥs no dzhartsu ra se ni kaḥ/ /ma tā ma haṃ pu ra pā sa dpung ring zhing g.yul gyi ni/ /sdums la chas des gru dag gisarmye/ / /gang gā'i 'gram na gnas pa yi//shaṃ gā bu li na saṃ shra yo/ /sā mā t+ya bye t+ya brga gya ta gya saṃ kalpa lbo la yā/ /udhū ma mes grong khyer dag tu phyin/ /blon po g.yog sde dang bcas pa/ /de yi kun rtog rtse dga' yis/ /lha tai di byā mā hā re dṛṭī me ru ma tī pa tiḥ/ /de bo ya mi ti tā ma tā ta darnyi yi zas ni rab 'khrungs pa/ /sa bdag lhun pos mthong gyur nas/ /'di ni lha zhes nges byas te/ /rang ka swa yo ga tā/ /kaste gra hots+tsha byet+paḥsaza rasne ra pū dza ya ta/ /nyid de yi drung song nas/ /mchi ma zag cing mgren par bzung / /rin chen kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /95—1057

pra ṇa yārja ṇi taste na ga twa swa na ga rī ni rdzu/ /di bya sgo godzha po da gre dze+e byu dī de yi ①gus pas mchod pa des/ /rang gi grong khyer phyin nas ni/ /'dzam gling skye bo lha yi ni/ /longs pa dza rgo bya bhāta/ /tastso tai dzi na thrasgo bhekyu rnyiḥsadza daspra ti/ /spyod rab rgyas stilhag par bsgrubs/ /de spyod phun tshogs la mtshon te/ /dge slong gis dris rgyal ba ni//sazla zlo pya ba daste 6 ta su sadzati kā ra khaṃ/ /bā rā ṇa sde sa be+e pro kun mkhyen gyis kyang de dag la/ /de yi phun tshogs rgyu mtshan gsungs/ / bā rā ṇa sīr ①skye gzhan de//bhūn+d+ra li kā khyo n+ya dzad+ma ni/ /te na pra h+ye ka budhe ro ga glu na su dzhai ṣa dza/ /bram ze rtsa ba can zhes gyur/ /de yi ④ nad kyis gzir ba yis/ /rang sangs rgyas la sman dag ni//swās+thā ba dhī kṛ tai ya tra ts+tshahūṃ tsā dh+ri ta mā ta pe/ / tah+phu sgyu ts+tshan+d+ra bsos pa'i mtshalas la thug par byas/ /gdung ba gang la gdugs kyang bzung / /bsod nams des rgyal bān+d+ra dza so bhūdhi byo pa sgo ga bhāka /pre ya thraṇ+ḍi ha me bā sau de ba dat+tabya gdugs can de/ /lha yi longs spyod snod du gyur/ /nga ni ⑤dga' ba'i gong bu de/ /blo ngan de yang dun+d+ra tiḥ/ /shu te kyuste bha ga ba tā bhik+ṣa bo bisma yo ya yuḥ/ /yabyisma lhas byin no/ /zhes pa bcom ldan gyis gsungs pa/ /thos nas dge slong ya mtshan gyur/ /kye ma gang yā ba ha ma ho bi bha ba pra bhā ba di byo ba sgo ga su bha gi byu ba nā dhi zhig yon tan 'dzin dang 'byor pa'i mthu dang ni/ /lha yi nye bar longs spyod skal bzang srid pa'i bdag pa h+ye/ /dīr+gha sa mā bra ya gha na bya sa nā ba san+da sasru ha nodha ra ṇa pu 5 po dang / /yid ⑥du gnas shing sdug par gyur pa'i gdung bar lhung ba dag /skyob cing yongs su 'don bi j-i bhi tai ta ta / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī pa de dag bsod nams rnam 'phrul yin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bo dhi satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī thra ya piṇ+ḍa ba dā rna rgya dhi ka sha ta ta maḥrtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las dga' ba'i gong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste 95—1058

pabe+e baḥ// //brgya rtsa gsum pa'o// //sad+mārga saṃ j-i ta ma no ra tha sidhi su taḥshā gh+raḥs tai su kṛ ta nidz+re legs pa'i lam la yid la re ba rab rgyas grub gyur cig① /dam pa'i legs byas dri med 'jug la tī bye p+lu ta ཿ / / saṃ sā ra gho ra ma ka rā ka rā se tu byu ta ཿngogs gtsang ma bsngags par 'os/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i chu srin 'byung gnas dag gi zam stegs gyur//sata saṃ ga e ba shu bha sarga ni sarga dru taḥ/ /shā bahūṃ ka ma khā khya gya pu tram̐ kṛ ha pa dam pa'i grogs nyid dge ba spro ba'i rang bzhin pho nya yin/ /mnyan du yod pa dag tu sngon/ /khyim bdag teḥpu rā/ /haṃ sā bhi sgo bha ga ba tā yasne nārta ta pa de j-i tai/ /dṛṭī pad+ma zhes pa'i bu/ /ngang pa zhes bya bcom ldan gyisakhya/ /'bad pas dgra bcom gnas la ni/ /rab pra pā da bi ṣa deḥka ru shā lo ka nā mṛ taiḥ/ /a nu gra hā gra ha bya dang dri med snying rje yi/ /gzigs pa bdud rtsis bzung mthong nas/ /rjes 'dzin brtson pas byel 'di gre ta ma bhā ṣan+ta bhi k+ṣa baḥ/ /bha ga bād+ku la pu tro yi pra bra rje pi kṛ la—/ /dge ①slong rnams kyis rab gsol pa/ /bcom ldan rigs kyi bu 'di ni/ /bag chags lhag ma horlu khaḥ/ /ba bhū ba bā sa nā she ṣā da shān+ta bi ṣa ya smṛ tiḥ/ /sa pra dag gis ④yul/ /dran pa ma zhi rab byung yang / /khyim la mngon par phyogs par 'gyur3/ /de ni rab yasne na bha ga ba tā bi ṣ+pe ya bi na yo dzi taḥ/ /a ho ma hā nu gra he ṇa sasmo ha 'bad bcom ldan gyis/ /'dul ba dag la rnam par sbyar/ /kye ma rjes khya/bzung chen po yis/ /kun ra hi taḥ kṛ ta ཿ / / usto ha r+ṣa mṛ ta seste m+bi smi te ri ti bhigru rmongs dag dang bral bar mdzad⑦/ /de skad dge slong ya mtshan zhing / /dga' ba'i bdud rtsis ④bran bhiḥ —/ /tā na bhā ṣa ta sazi rja bha ga bāsgok+ta bat+pa laḥ/ /pūdze+e pas zhus/ /gus la mnyes gshin bcom ldan 'das/ /thams cad mkhyen pas der gsungs pa/ /sngon 95—1059

ma gye ṣa ku sha la ma yā yaṭ+wām+bi bi shi taḥ/ /ta po ba ṣ+pe mu ṣ+pe ra sau su yang bdag gis dge ba la/ /'di ni 'bad nas rnam par bkod/ /sngon 'di ①dka' thub nags su ni①//bra tā khyaḥpu rā bha bta/ /tasmiṅgā le sgu ṭa lā paḥsha sha ko haṃ ta dā shra me//thub pa brtul zhugs bzang zhes gyur/ /de dus de yi gnas su bdag /ri bong gsal bar smra byed pa//taṅka thā a tā ba shra bhaḥbye ti mā na ba si sa dā/ /a thā dṛṣ+ṭi ha te de yi gtam la yid gcugs skyes/ /mdza' ba dang ldan rtag gnas gyur/ /de nas char med kyis bcom kā la shuṣ+ka mū la pha lo da ke/ /sa bhūrlu nizla nobye gāṅgā mān+ta ga ma ste—/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu chu bskams ①tshe/ /nags su yid byung thub (ṭ+wā pa de/ /grong mthar 'gro bar nokhru kaḥ/ /sa ma yā pra ṇa ye nok+taḥsā bho ta ba be+e pabye taḥ/ /ta bo 'dod par gyur/ /bdag gis gus pas sharkyede la smras/ /dam pa khyod ni rnam par mkhas/ /dka' thub ba na pa ri t+yā gaḥka baṃ yuk+ta sta bo dha na/ /bi yo ga be+e bhobye ga ni nor can dka' thub kyi/ /nags ni yongs btang ji ltar rigs/ /rnam mang bral ⑥ ba'i mya ngan du//masna dza na shaṃ ku khāḥ/ /gra ha mo ha kṛ hā yā sa saṃ gra hā gā ma byu ma yaḥ/ /bying ba'i skye bos gang ba'i khyem/ /rmongs pa'i gdon gyi nyon mongs kyis/ /bzung bar gyur pa grong gi sa//byā shri kha lā mu kha ra duḥs ha pu tra pā sha j-i t+yā ku lā ni bi ḍi bārgyu ba bud med lcags sgrog mu cor bzod dka' bu yi zhags pa dang / /g.yog 'khor gyis dkrigs brtan pa'i ban+tu pā lo/ /t+yar+ghaṃ pu naḥ smṛ sha ti kaḥkha la saṃ gha ro shaṃ dhī māsgo gnyen gyi dra ba dang / /mi bsrun ⑦tshogs pa'i nad dang blo ngan gyis bcings mun chen can/ /btang haṃ ku ma ti ban+ta ma hān+dha kā ram̐/ /bi da dha ti mu husmo haṃ nā nā bi ba'i khyem la blo ldan su zhig slar yang reg par byed/ /sna tshogs 'bral ba'i mya ngan stug pos duyang yang yo ga gha nāḥshu tso dra ba ṇa la ba shā hā riskṛ: pa re ba ri pasgo te/ /bi rmongs pa skyed par byed/ /nor ni lan tshwa'i zas rnams dag gis sred pa mchog tu yongs su spel/ /mi 95—1060

ṣa ma bi ṣa ya ste hā sgyu sordza ḍi kṛ ta tse ta sī bra dza ti ku sha lo gre sha k+ṣe tra k+ṣa bzad yul la chags pa goms pas sems ni blun par byas gyur pa/ /nyon mongs zhing gi khyim na gnas pa yi ba sa tī k+ṣa yo/ /na dhīdz+re da bi byuṇ+ḍi tā bi ṣa ya sgo ga rā gā sa rnams kyi dge ①ba zad par 'gyur/ /skye bo med pa'i nags su zhi ba'i khyad par dag gis tshim pa rnams//be+en+d+ra bāt+pa ka li la dṛ shaḥthra ya bi yo ga dhū moṅga mi/ /na dā ha ni ba ha yul gyi ⑦longs spyod la chags chang gis blo gros myos shing g.yo mi 'gyur/ /mdza' bo dang bral du ba rgyas bya thāḥka la ha ko ba tā por+pā bair+bha parnyi bi dza ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe sha ma bi she ṣa pas mig ni mchi mas 'khrugs ① mi 'gyur/ /gzir dang 'thab mo khro dang gdung ba'i tshogs rnams dag saṃ to ṣi rde/ /gā ma smṛ hā ba nobe+e ga gā mobye gābo na smṛ tiḥ/ /gis sreg mi 'gyur/ /nags las yid phyung ngugrong la chags/ /grong las yid phyung ⑤nags tshal dran//sum̐ sī pra sa ma bai mu byut+tha saṃ ge ṣ+pe ba dzā ya te/ /grwa me ni ya bā me skyes bu rnams ni rab zhi las/ /phyir phyogs zhar las ⑥'byung ba yin/ /grong dze+egi dul ba'i g.yon la tī mā kā ye ma ti par+ya kṛ thāḥ/ /pā ge ba bi ṣa yaldi gha nasnro ti gā ma saṃ khyod / /dus min blo gros yongs ②ma byed/ /grong dang 'grogs pas yul la ni/ /chags rnams thog ma ga ti/ /i hai ba ta ba kā le na pha la lā sgo bha bi 6 ti/ /shudzhaiḥnyid du 'ching / /dus kyis 'di nyid du ni khyod/ /'bras bu thob pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi sha saṃ pra ti mad+mā me+eḥkri ya hūṃ pā khyo bhā ra ṇi/ /i kyughā haṃ sa mā ban+de bsgo ni ba ti ni dag pa yis/ /da ni srog gi zungs pyadag mdzod/ /ces pa brjod nas bdag gis ni/ /nye ba'i me taḥswa yi/ /sa tsa tūṇ+ḍi sa murnyi pya pa ri ṣ+ṭa bye dza gā da rmā/ /ki la rang nyid mchongs/ /des kyang myur du rab blangs nas/ /yongs su 'khyud de bdag la smras/ /gzu me tat+pa ha saṃ tī ze bi rur+ghaṃ bha ba tā kṛ tai/ /na gasgo mi ba nā dasmaṭ+wātrī lums drag sti/ po'i 'gal ba 'di/ /khyod ni ci yi slad du byed/ /nags 'di las ni bdag mi 'gro//95—1061

tirla bh+ya te ku taḥ/ /pra ṇa yā di tai te noste byosni tsā lo ki te ma khyod mtshungs mdza' bo ga las rnyed/ /de yi gus pas ①de brjod cing / /bdag gis mkha' la bltas yā—/ /pa pā ta thraṣ+ṭiḥs ha sā sa pha lā khyu ra bhūd+ma yā/ /pa.ā+oṃ bhi dzñā pa'i tshe/ /'phral la char ni rab babs pa/ /gang gis sa gzhi 'bras bcas gyur/ /de nas gus bcas twa mā sā r+yaḥs ta ta ཿsā da ro mu niḥ/ /mā mu tse shudha sa two na ki ma ṣ+pe na twa ma tī thub pa des/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob nas/ /bdag la smras pa dag pa yi/ /snying stobs 'di yis ya se/ /pra ṇa yā di tra tai nā haṃ thraṣ+ṭasta tasta ma ba da na/ /a ṣ+pe na khyod ci bzhed/ /ces pa de yis gus pas dris/ /de nas bdag gis de la smras/ /bdag ni spyod pa tsa ri te nā haṃ samyak+shi bo bye marja ye/ /sad+dhā ra shā ya dza ga tī dzi naḥsnga 'di dag gis/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /skye ba gzhan la 'gro ba rnams/ /bsgral slad ma n+ya dzad+ma ni/ /ma ye kyus+ho sa ma mā ha bha bo 6 si ta thā ga taḥ/ /rgyal bar bdag gyur cig /ces brjod de yis bdag la smras/ /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs par 'gyurage//ya dā tu sa mya k+shi bu d+dhā sa t+tha p+ta ste bha bi 6 se / / ta dā ma mā gang tshe yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mkhyen par khyod gyur pa/ /de tshe bdag gi 1lus n+ya de ha gya karta byo nu gra hasta yā/ /e tat+ta gya ba rtsa sā dhoḥsgo ha rda gī kṛ gzhan ni/ /khyod kyis ④rjes su bzung dzubar bya/ /dam pa de yi tshig 'di ni/ /mdza' bas bdag gis kha tasma yā/ /saṃ pābe+eḥsha sha kaḥso ha masmiñdzad+ma ni budha tī/ /su bra tā khyo mu yis blangs/ /ri bong de nga skye ba 'dir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag thob/ /khyim bdag bu ni dad niḥsā yo haṃ so kṛ ha pa tiḥsu taḥ/ /pūdze+e smṛ h+ye pra yasne na pā bi taḥku sha pa 'di/ /thub pa brtul zhugs bzang zhes pa/ /de yin sngon gye rab 'bad ni/ /dran nas ༷bdag lasma yā/ /pra pan+da bat+pa le ṣ+pe ti ka thi tai sat+tha dargo rmā/ /dzi rgo gis dge la bkod/ /de ltar gus la mnyes gshin pa/ /thams cad gzigs pa rgyal ba yis/ /rang gi 95byed1062

na ni dza thrad+dhāhaṃ khru tā te bisma yi ya yuḥ/ /a bi ka la ku khā la pha la sngon byung gsungs pa dag /thos nas de dag ya mtshan gyur/ /rdza mkhan ①bzhin du ma tshang med pa'i pra sa ba shu bha tsa ri teḥs ha bā saḥ/ /di na pa ti pa ri tsa ya ni tsi ta ru 'bras—/ /skyed byed dge ba'i spyod pas 'di na duganas/ /nyin mo'i bdag dang yongs 'dris btang tse ཿ shrī ra sa mā hi ma bha sa ཿ / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra bi ra tsi gyur pa/ /bsil zer mdzes pa'i dpal ni mtshungs med bzhin/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i tā yī bo bye satā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī sha sha kā ba dā 8 tsa tu ra bye ka sha ta ta byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs ldupa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod ④pa'i maḥpabe+e baḥ// //yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa bzhi pa'o// //krobye ṇa ya dī ra sa nāḥshu tsi tseṣ+ṭa tā rmā mi byā pa ba da bi ṣa oṃ bi ṣa lce gnyis gang zhig khros pas kun spyod gtsang ma rnams la ni/ /rdzun gyi skyon brjod mi bzad dug ni muskṛ dzarnyi/ /te pā pa shā pa pa ri tā pa pa re pa rāṭ+wās+t+ri bra bya lī rab tu spro byed pa/ /sdig dmod ⑤yongs su gdung ba rgyud 4)mas gzir ba de dag ni/ /mi bzad 'dod ka ti mi re bi pa ram̐ bi sharnyi/ /pu rā ri ba ti ko nā ma kashrī ri 6 shu tsi bra taḥ/ /bya min pa'i rab rib khung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /kha cher ri yi gnas su ni/ /ri ba ta ka zhes pa sngon//bhigruḥ shi la bi hā re bhūt+pa t+tha byu ta da yā shra yaḥ / / ta ru twa tsaḥ'abyung po kun la brtse ba'i gnas/ /dge slong brtul zhugs gtsang ④ba byung / /nam zhig de yi bum nang ka ṣā ye ṇa sa ka dāñtsi gha ṭan+ta re/ /thi bik+ta kā na nodre sha tsakre ṭī ba ra du—/ /shing shun ngur smrig dag gis ni/ /nags tshal dben pa'i phyogs ⑧su ni/ /chos gos kha ni rañdza rna/ /a tān+ta re dhe nu bat+pa n+daṭ+wā nasbraju mā ya yo/ /zwah+ma ṇaḥpi bsgyur ba byas/ /skabs der drus ma'i be'u nyams/ /bram ze phra ma can zhes pa/ /skye bo ba glang ⑨za 95—1063

shu ṣ+pe nā ma go bhak+ṣa dza na shaṃ ki taḥ/ /sa dru rāsgyu ba rasgo tha pā ke balbo bar ni/ /dogs khya pa dang ldan 'tshol ①du 'ongs/ /de yi ri las khyaring po nas/ /chos gos tshos khu sa muṅga tai/ /sadze+e te dhū ma mā lo kya baṣ+ṭha pa ka ma ma n+yata/ /ta taḥ'atshed ④pa yi/ /me las skyes pa'i du ba dag /mthong nas be'u btsos par bsams/ /de nas mtshon shi lo sa mā ru hra sa hi taḥshan+t+ra pā ṇi bheḥ/ /a bye t+ya ri ba tai bhekhye pa prats+tsha be+e cha lag rnams dang / /lhan cig gnyis skyes ri la 'dzegs/ /dge slong ri ba ta la ni/ /mngon phyogs na yā dhī dzaḥ/ /ki me ta dār+ya kṛ ya te thraṣ+ṭaste ṣ+pe ti go ra bāta/ /dul bas rab dris pa/ /'phags pa 'di dag ci zhig mdzad/ /ces pa de yis ④gus pas dris//bha dra ṭī ba ra rā go ya mi ti tai re ba to bra bīta/ /asmin+da ba sa re ta snga pūt+tha kadz+re bzang po 'di ni gos 'tshed ces/ /ri ba ta yis de la smras/ /gnas skabs der ni sngo spyomed kyi/ /de bi pā ka taḥ/ /go rmā saṃ rak+ta sa li la sa pā kaḥs ma ba r+ya taḥ/ /su kha yi las kyi rnam smin byis⑦/ /'tshed pa de ni ba lang gi/ /sha khrag chu dang bcas par gyur/ /sgrub byed duḥkha twa mā yā ti shukla ma gye tikā la hūṃ/ /bi sgo bi dhu ra tsā yā te 'khrugs ④par gyur pa na/ /bde ba sdug bsngal nyid 'gyur zhing / /dkar po dag kyang nag por 'gyur//dharmo byā yā t+ya dhan+d+ra tsā/ /mi byā bā ba pra ka ṭa rna dza na ko paḥpa da sgo tiḥ/ /chos kyang chos min nyid du 'gyur/ /rdzun gyi ⑨sdig pa gsal byed dang / /skye bo khro dang gnas ⑩nas lhung //a pū rgya pa ri pā kā nā me tat+tha t+ya k+ṣa la k+ṣa rde/ /do ṣaḥs mum+bi 'di dag bsod nams ma yin pa/ /yongs smin mtshan nyid mngon sum yin/ /skyes bu rnams kyi ⑩nyes ṣa ti yā ti gu ṇaḥpra shā shaṃ kārlo pi par+ya ya mu be+e ti bi shīr+ya te dhīḥ/ /byas sngon bsgrubs ⑫smin pa'i dus su ni/ /skyon rnams rab tu rgyas shing yon tan dag ni nyams par sum̐ sī pū rā bi hi ta duḥkṛ ta pā ka kā le ke ke na nā ma ni pa tarnyi ma hā 'gyur⑫/ —/ /bya ba phyin ci log 'gyur blo gros rnam par bslad par 'gyur/ /mngon par 'joms pa chen 95—1064

bhi ghā tāḥ/ /be+e rud+dhā mi ṣa gadhe na ru dhe re ṇa tsa shaṃ ki taḥ/ /so pa byepos nges par su dang su mi ltung / /'gal ba'i sha yi dri dang ni/ /khrag gis kyang ni bsgos ①pa yi/ /bram ze byeh+ma ṇaḥkuste ṭī ba ram̐ rmā sa tai ga ta/ /pra t+yaspyo do ṣa mā lo kya sa kro dha bi de yi bum par ni/ /chos gos sha nyid gyur par 1 bltas/ /skyon ni mngon sum mthong gyur nas/ /khro ba'i kṛ tā kṛ tiḥ/ /ta ma bhā ṣa ta nir+bhaṣ+ṭha tī bra bai sha sha shaṃ pi taḥ/ /a rnam 'gyur dbyebs ldan zhing / /mi bzad sdig pas 'dar ba des/ /smod cing de la rab smras pa/ /kye ho ba ta pā dā tsā raḥsbi to yi bi dza ṣ+pe ba ṣ+pe/ /ya gye dṛ shā ni kan+d+ra ṇi na kabya ma dam pa'i kun spyod ldan/ /mi med nags su gnas pa 'di/ /gang gi las ni 'di 'dra ba/ /'dir di ha pa sh+ya ti/ /pra bra dzñā ram̐ dzi taḥkā yaḥkṛ yāslets+tsha dza no tsi tā/ /dzā nā ni su yang mthong ba med/ /rab tu byung bas lus bsgyur 1 cing / /bya ba kla klo'i skye bor 'os/ /sdig pa ④tisgon+da pā pā rmā kaḥku ṭa bra ta shārnya tai/ /i kyusto te na sā k+ṣe pa bsgribs pa'i rdzun gyis ni/ /brtul zhugs zhi nyid su yis shes/ /zhes des smod ⑤bcas brjod pa'i tshe//ri ba taḥs ma tsin+ta yata/ /do ṣe pra t+yak+ṣa lak+ṣesmiṅgi bra bī mi ni rut+ta raḥ/ /ri ba ta yis rab bsams pa/ /skyon ni mngon sum mtshon 'di la/ /lan med bdag ni ci zhig smra/ /ma ma de bo pa ghā to ya mi kyuk+ta go nu ma n+ya te/ /hā snga ya ta na bdag gi 'di ni lhas bcom zhes/ /brjod kyang su zhig bden par 'dzin/ /mngon sum gsang ba'i skye tā me ti pra t+yak+ṣu pat+na bī dza naḥ/ /u pa sbi tai sa he saj-i mo na mā la bya ke bo buni/ /bzhad gad dag gi gnas su gyur⑦/ /mi smra 'ba' zhig la brten te/ /nye bar gnas pa kun ba lo/ /a yi me niḥpra tī kā raḥs li lā dasni rurji taḥ/ /do ṣe gu rja ti bzod bya/ /bdag la bcos su med pa 'di/ /chu las me ni rab tu 'khrungs/ /skyon la yon tan phul sha ya mā shu gu ṇi bi do ṣi be+e yu ṣa jom+bi be+e ṣa ma bya mṛ haṃ bi ṣeb/ /san+dar+sha byung myur du yon tan dag la skyon/ /bdud rtsi'i gnas la dug dang dug la yang ni bdud rtsi ste/ /nges 95—1065
