ṛrnyi pra dbye pra ya yo ri ba taḥs ha bhigru bhiḥ/ /a sa t+ya do ṣe rdzu 'phrul bstan nas ①ri ba ta/ /dge slong rnams dang lhan cig ④song / /bden med skyon byis ④bye ṇa bi ṣa yusgyu pra t+yak+ṣu k+ṣa ta la k+ṣa ṇi na / /a lo ki taḥ sā dhū dza brag rig rjopa ni/ /mngon sum du mtshon mi nyams mtshan nyid kyis/ /brlang pos zil mnan skye bo dam naḥkha le na ki bsti bi spri ta i baṃ t+ya de sha/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā pa ni/ /yul gzhan dag tu btsongs bzhin ci zhig brjod/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang lnga bo dhi sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ri ba tā ba dā ā+oṃ paspyot+ta ra sha ta ta chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las ri ba ta'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal maḥpal+la baḥ// //'dab ste brgya rtsa lnga pa'o// //bi dzi gī ṣa ba la i ba ta ra sā duḥs haḥsaṃ sā ra sha bye ba lo ha rgyal bar 'dod rnams bzhin du stobs kyis ni/ /bzod dka' 'khor ba'i dgra yi stobs bcom tā —/ / ri pu ā sā da yarnyi dhī rāḥ pā dzhai sa dha dz+re sāp+ta rdzu/ /nas / /dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid chen po ni/ /rgyas pa brtan 2pa rnams kyis thob par 'gyur/ /ya dā sru tram̐ bha ga ba tā byā byu tai na ga ro pa oṃ/ /ta dā sa kau tu kādṛsgo gang tshe grong khyer lta bu'i mdo/ /bcom ldan gyis gsungs de yi tshe/ /dge slong rnams kyis ⑥dge mtshan bhigru bhistu na bha ṣa ta/ /a khyu ta ka na ka ba t+yā khyu dza na swarga pra bhā las| /dris pa de yis dze+erab gsungs pa/ /grong khyer gser can zhes pa ni/ /skye bo mtho ris 'od pu rī/ /ta snga mā sīn+da ra ba tirgyu ti māṅka na kābhi dhaḥ/ /ta su pra ldan byung / /der ni mi bdag 'od dang ldan/ /gser zhes bya ba byung bar gyur/ /de yi dga' ba brje mā nā yāḥspru te rā ya ta rna pa re/ /pu traḥka na ka basmra bhūrlu tā ba ka na ka pra mchog tu ni/ /rab tu rgyas pa dag gi gnas/ /bu ni gser gyi go cha dang / /bu mo gser 'od dag tu 95byed1069

bhā / /kā le na yo ba nā rū ṭ+wā stan sta pa ka sho bhe byā/ /la te ba sā gyur—/ /dus kyis lang tsho la 'dzegs ①shing / /nu ma'i me tog phun bus mjos/ /mdzes pa de mdzes ba r+bha kān+ta ba san+ta la li tā kṛ tiḥ/ /bā la spru t+yā pa ri tsi ta s+t+ri madh+ri dpyid kyi ni/ /yid 'ong dbyibs can 'khri shing bzhin/ /gzhon la mdza' bas yongs 'dris pa/ /blon ta na yo yu bā/ /kā ma sā rā bhi dheḥsī ra ma kā ma yata kā mu kaḥ/ /po'i bu gzhon 'od ldan 37 ni/ /'dod pa'i snying po zhes pa yis/ /de la dal gyis 'dod pa bsten//pra dṛste put+pa sa ma ye byer+ya hā ri ṇi yo ba ṣ+pe/ /j-i gaḥpra saṃ ga pañtsa me tog dus su rab zhugs shing / /lang tsho can gyi brtan 'phrog tshe/ /snye ma dang 'grogs bung ba ni/ /rī mañdzar+yāḥke na bār+ya te/ /ta na yī naṣ+ṭa tsa ri tai dzñā tā mā byā ma tī pa tiḥ/ /tu yang dag rgyu ba su yis zlogs/ /bu mo spyod tshul nyams pa dag /shes nas sa bdag khengs ldan ni/ /mi sum̐ bi be+e sha bi ṣa ma sho ka kro ṅgā na la dwa yo/ /ka t+yā bi tī nā ni su bzang mya ngan khro ba yi/ /me gnyis dag la mtshungs par zhugs/ /khengs pa bsten pa rnams la bsod lā ni pu byer+bha brnyi mā t+yā n+ya nyi mā na bhā rdzu/ /a yā tsu yastso ba mu khaṃ nams kyis/ /mchod 'os rigs ni bu mos dman par gyur⑦/ /bslang bya min par ④slong ba'i gdong k+ṣa ṇi na ku lo hi ga t+yā ma li be+e ka ro ti/ /shā sa nā da tha byu bhakhyoḥka t+yā madh+ri bzhin du/ /skad cig gis ni bu mos rigs nyams byed/ /de nas sa yi bdag po'i bkas/ /bu mo blon su ta: paḥ/ /ā kṛ 6 ba dh+ya ba su dh+wa m+bi to shā sa na kā ri bheḥ/ /ya tsa po'i bu de yang / /bka' ni byed pa rnam 37dag gis/ /blangs nas gsod pa'i gnas su khyen/ /de nas mā no pa ri tā rde ta tasto ka ru rja ku laḥ/ /rā dza pu traḥswa na ga rān+di nā ya na ga skyabs ni zhu byed pa/ /de dag snying rje rgyas pa yi/ /rgyal sras kyis ni rang grol las/ /grong khyer gzhan pa ram̐ pa ra/ /ta taḥkru dhaḥk+ṣi ti ba tiḥpu tram̐ sha tru mi boṅka ṭi/ /niṣ+ka su dag tu khrid/ /de nas sa bdag brtse med cing / /khros pas dgra ni drag po bzhin/ /bu ni nges par 95—1070

niḥ kṛ pa bya kre pra t+ya n+ta ma ha nā ti tho/ / pi tā ni rastaḥ satā rab bskrad de/ /mtha' 'khob nags kyi mgron ①du byas/ /snying stobs chu gter phas bskrad detso3/ /sgo r+sā tā tī rba ba nā ba no/ / ra myod+mā nā ñdzi kārnye pu re pā pa sa 'jug ngogs nags tshal sar 'khyams nas/ /dga' ba'i skyed tshal pad+ma (ṭ+wācan/ /mi med grong khyer nirdza rna/ /da dar+sha kā ki bhā ta tra bha gi byā ka na ka pra dzñā/ /khidzñā dza na be+e mdzes pa thob/ /der ni sring mo gser gyi 'od/ /skye bo dang bral skyo ba ni/ /grong khyer dag gi lha mo yo ge na na ga ra pa sri ba de ba tsā/ /swa s+thā ta ram̐ pa ri dzñā ya thra t+yā bāṣ+ṭham+bu bzhin—/ /gcig pu nyid ni mthong bar gyur/ /de yis stong pa'i rgyu thu dag dris/ /de yis ming por pabhā dhī/ /shu n+yata kār hūṃ te na bṛṣ+ṭa tai pra t+ya bhā ṣata/ /bhā tarjerdza yongs shes nas/ /mdza' bas mchi ma'i char 'bebs shing / /de la lan ni rab smras pa/ /ming po n+ya gro na hūṃ m+bi haṃ bu ra me tat+tha hā ri bheḥ/ /ṣakhye saṃ khyeh+ma hā nasne r+ya k+ṣertsu gro dha brten pa'i/ /gnod sbyin stobs chen snun byed pa/ /drug cu'i grangs kyi ⑤grong khyer 'di/ /skye bo dha so shra yiḥ/ /saṃ pra t+ya smin k+ṣa ye she ṣa ba haṃ madh+ri su ta: saḥ/ /a dhū nā med pa dag tu byas/ /'di brlag lhag ma da lta ni/ /bdag dang blon po'i bu de ste/ /da ni khyed kyi twabye hu ba la bra bhā baṭ+wā ṇa me ba no/ /i ti swa sun+d+ra tsaḥkhru tā rā dza pu dpung pa yi/ /stobs mthus bdag cag skyob rmyepa nyid/ /ces pa sring mo'i tshig thos nas/ /rgyal po'i tra ཿ sa mā ga tī / / e ka ya k+ṣu ba she ྾ tsa kre ya k+ṣa ba lo sha bu yis mda' rnams kyis/ /gnod sbyin 'phreng ④)ba 'ongs pa dag /gnod sbyin gcig gi 7lhag mar riḥ / /sa yak+ṣaḥko ṭa ro nā ma ta me ba sha ra khaṃ ga taiḥ/ /pra san+da dā sa bhā bā byas—/ /gnod sbyin ko ṭa ra zhes pa/ /de nyid la ni skyabs song zhing / /'bangs kyi dngos po thob pa su bi da dhe dza ya gho ṣa rde/ /pu naḥpo riḥs mā tīrte pu re tasmin bi p+lu des—/ /de yi rgyal ba bsgrags pa byas/ /be+er yang gang ⑨de grong khyer bas/ /khengs shing 'tshe ba med 95—1071

be+e / /dṛ paṃ rā dza su tabya kre madh+ri sru rnu swa saḥpa ti/ /pu tra bhā r+pā pa na/ /sring mo'i bdag po blon po'i bu/ /rgyal sras kyis ni rgyal por byas/ /ngo mtshar dang bcas bu sābyaṅgi khru tā tsā rirni be+e di tai/ /ka na kaḥgrwa pa tirle kha pra ṇa ye na ni yi mthu/ /nyan rna dag gis bshad thos nas/ /sa yi bdag po gser gyis ni/ /spring yig dag gis ①nā yā tai/ /sa ba dhe mu ku ṭa ཿpi tāh+phu ba rā dzaḥpra tā pa bān/ /'bad pas bos/ /yab kyis cod pan bcings gyur cing / /rgyal tshab gzi brjid ldan gyur pa/ /ba she ba byen+d+ra yabyakre tsa tudī pa ba tīsma ṭī/ /shrī mān+d+ra dza ku mā ro sā dbang po dbang gyur de yis sa / /gling bzhi ldan pa dbang du byas/ /'khor ba bzhin du dgra yi sde/ /ba ha me ba ta dā bha baṃ/ /saṃ sā ra sri ba ya: kre sha tru brga su saṃ k+ṣa yo/ /gang gis kun tu brlag byas pa/ /dpal ldan rgyal po'i gzhon nu der/ /nga nyid de yi dus na gyur/ /un+d+ra hā du pa bi sh+ya sa twa ru tsi re sa dha n+d+ra sau hā sa ṣ+pe shī la : snying stobs mdzes ldan dam chos seng ge'i khri la spro ba zhuyis ni nyer bzhugs ⑦shing / /tshul khrims gtsug ṣa ba tā bi pe ka sa li la pābhā bhi ṣe ka shri yā/ /ha tā sha tru pa tor dang ldan dben pa'i chu yis mngon par dbang bskur dpal thob pas/ /mi bzad ⑤rgya che srid pa'i ram̐ pa dzā thra thu bha ba kle shā ba lī ma k+ṣa yī sā labha pra sha me na bi shwa dza yi nyon mongs 'phreng ba brgyud khyamar gyur pa'i dgra bcom nas/ /rab zhi thob cing kun las rgyal ba dag gis nā nidrwa ṇa bhūzlu bye te/ /na ga ro pa ma ma ma la ta re nidzā ṇa yak+ṣa sam+bi myang 'das sa de spyod par byed/ /gnod sbyin dang mtshungs nyon mongs brlag byas nas/ /shin tu dri med bhād+me shān / / k+ṣa pa yi tā bye kaish+yibye ga ba nuste ti bi ra rā ma grong khyer lta bu yi/ /mya ngan 'da' ba 'ga' zhig dag gis thob/ /ces pa gsungs nas bcom ldan rnam par saḥ —/ /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo bye satwa ba dā na kalpa la tā gnas—/ /zhes pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 95—1072

dze+e ka na ka bas+thā ba dā na ṣa ḍa dhi ka sha ta ta maḥpabe+e baḥ// //'khri shing las gser byu go cha'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa drug pa'o// //gu ṇ+ḍi smṛ hā na dra pi ṇi ka dā tsid+mo ge bhi yo gaḥpra sa r+ghaṃ na sgo ge/ /bsod nams rab 'bar bsam pa dri med rnams/ /yon tan la chags nam yang nor la min/ /pu byo dz+wa lā rna bi sha dā sha yā ṣ+pe ra dzo bi rā gā rnyi ra tirna kā me/ /pu rnal 'byor la sbyor longs spyod dag la min/ /rdul gyi chags bral la dga' 'dod la min/ /bsod sgo pra bhā baṃ bha ga bārlu rgya shi lasta thā ga taḥ/ /ba bhā ṣe dīk+ṣu bhiḥnams ri bo bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsho7bsod nams mthu/ /de yi bsod nams la gus thraṣ+ṭastah+phu sgyu da ra bismi teḥ/ /bā rā ṇa sri ma ṭī rā rnyi brah+ma dbye pra shā pas—/ /ya mtshan dge slong gis dris gsungs/ /bā rā ṇa sīr khyergyal po ni/ /tshangs byin dag gis sa sa ti/ /shurnyo da ṣ+pe kṛ ha pa toza byu ba dh+wa na do pa maḥ/ /ta myu bsrungs kyetshe/ /khyim bdag zas ni gtsang ma dag /nor sbyin dang ni mtshungs pa byung / /rgya mtshor be+e kalpa dṛk+ṣa gya sa mu dra ga ma nārdzi teḥ/ /ma ṇi mosti ka saṃ bhā riḥ'agro bas rab bsgrubs pa/ /nor bu mu tig tshogs rnams kyis/ /slong ba dag gi dpag bsam shing / /pa ri pūṇ+ḍi ma byubye haṃ/ /rat+na dī pān+ta rā yā taḥs ka dā tsid+ma tī pa ho/ /de yi khyim ni yongs gang gyur/ /nam zhig rin chen gling gzhan nas/ / 'ongs pa de ni sa bdag la/ /④drabye ya yo sa mā dā ya mughāhā ra mu pā la rna/ /pra kyuṅga te na pra ṇa yād+ma ni taḥskyes su mu tig do shal dag /khyer nas blta ru song bar gyur/ /sa bdag sngon du langs byas nas//sa ma tī bhu dzā/ /tā ram̐ hā re da do tasmi lī khā hā sa mi ba shri yaḥ/ /gus pas mchod pa de yis ⑤ ni/ /dpal gyi rtse dga' dgod pa bzhin/ /gsal ba'i do shal de la phul//sa ra smi sru tra saṃ sak+ta tā ra kā ni ka ro pa maḥ/ /bhu mi bhakhyorgu bhā hā 'od ldan skud par yang dag chags/ /rgyu skar gyi ni tshogs lta bu/ /yon tan ldan pa'i do shal gyis/ /95—1073

rabya kā ra z-i da ya gra haṃ/ /asmin+da ba sa re rā dzhaḥsu ta bā la sa ra swatī/ /sa bdag snying ni bzung ba ①byas/ /gnas skabs der ni rgyal po yi②/ /bu mo gzhon nu dbyangs can ma//su bhā ṣi tai bha bya shaṃ rā ha smo saṃ ga tā dza go/ / srushā kṛ ha pa ba gam can byi nang song bas/ /legs ldan tshig gis legs bshad blangs/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'dod pa tiḥshu tā shra ba rja mṛ ta m+bispru tai/ /pra la hūṃ ku ri tā kā rastasmad+ma yaḥswa kṛ yi1—/ /legs bshad khyim bdag gis thos nas/ /sru long myu gu'i rnam pa can/ /de yi rang bzhin haṃ ya yo/ /t+yak+ta hā ra bi hā ro tha su bhā ṣi ta z-i tā sha yaḥ/ /rang khyim song / /de nas zas dang rtse dga' btang ④/ /legs bshad kyis ni bsam pa phrogs/ /ni dā da ri draḥswa kṛ he ba tsi re ma tsin+ta yata/ /a ho nu rā dza pu gnyid kyis dbul ba de yis ni/ /rang gi khyim du yun ring bsams/ /kye ma rgyal po'i bu mo des/ /byut+ta gī tai sā dhu su bhā ṣi tai/ /a par+yā lo tsi te nā pi ye nā mṛ ta mi bādz+re legs pa'i legs bshad glur blangs pa/ /gang de 31yongs su ma spyad kyang / /bdud rtsi dag ni byin pa tai —/ /ma yā dā da sha bhirbakhyorbi pu lo rat+na sañtsa yaḥ/ /saṃ pāp+taḥbazhin—/ /bdag gis lo ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rin chen tshogs ni yangs pa dag /thob de legs sruk+ta radze+e tu na ku ta— du pārdzi tai/ /rasneḥki mathra gu ru bhiḥ pra bshad rin chen ni/ /'ga' zhig las kyang nyer ma bsgrubs/ /'bad pa brgya yis bsags pa yi/ /rdo yat+na gu ru saṃ tsi taiḥ/ /sad+mārga lo ka ṣ+pe rarja tabyi dhan+tu su bhā ṣi tai/ /lci rin chen rnams kyis ci⑥/ /dam pa'i lam ni gsal byed pa'i/ /legs bshad de ltar rin chen yin//i ti saṃ tsi t+ya pu ru ṣe bi thra bye dṛ pa man+di ram̐/ /sa tsakre rā dza du zhes pa ④tebasams nas mi bdag gi'u3/ /khang par skyes bu rab btang ste/ /legs bshad rgyal po'i bu mo hiḥtu sruk+ta yadzñā ma yā tsa kaḥ/ /sā ba bhā ṣesmi ta mu khā+e sus+ho mu le las—/ /slong ba po min de yis basbangs⑪/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan des smras pa/ /legs bshad rin 95—1074

na la bh+ya te/ /ta myur+gha tu lhi dra bi khaṃ dī ya tsā ya di shākya te/ /yā bdī gyis thob par 'gyur/ /de yi rin dang mtshungs pa'i nor/ /gal te nus na sbyin par mdzod/ /ji srid dasha bhezasgoste na sad rat+na saṃñtsa yaḥ/ /ni hi taḥsat+ya shī le na pa rgyuho lo ni bcu gnyis su/ /bden pa'i ngang tshul de yis ni/ /rin chen dam pa'i tshogs bsgrubs pa/ /rin sau sa madz+re hūṃ/ /e tadhū pā la du hi tuḥsan+de shaṃ rū ta bhā ṣi tai/ /shu tā du 'os pa de sbyin mdzod/ /sa skyong bu mo dag gi 'phrin/ /'di dag pho nyas bshad pa ni/ /thos pas khye kṛ ha pa tiḥsat+tha raṭ+wā t+yā dā ya sā dā raḥ/ /swa yo rā dza kṛ ha ga tā khyim bdag gus bcas pas/ /rin chen thams cad blangs byas nas/ /rang nyid rgyal po'i khyim song ste//da tā sau tri ṇa lbo la yā/ /sruk+ta rarja ta dā dā ya pa pā joṅkaṇ+ḍa to mu huḥ/ /de la rtswa yis 1rtse dga' byen/ /de tshe legs bshad rin chen thob/ /dga' bas yang dang yang du brjod//yad+maṅgi tsikhru kha ma nu pa oṃ bā khya mā bh+yan+ta ram̐ bā yo yaḥsatwa pra sa pa bi la gang gang phyi 'am nang gi bde ba dpe med chung lduzad dag dang ni/ /gang gang snying stobs kyis bskrun ④ ya sabyisma yaḥsernyi yo gaḥ/ /ye ye j-i: pra sha ma bi ma khā san+ta tā nan+da lā bhāḥmatshan rgyas pa grub ⑤ pa'i sbyor ba dang / /gang gang sred pa rab zhi dri med rgyun du dga' ba thob pa dag /pā ko྾k+ta sa sa pha la bha raḥpu ju kalpa dru ma khru/ /oṃ dār+ya ni dhi nā de des bsod nams dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu smin cing rgyas pa'i khur/ /rgya cher gyur pa'i gter de te na sadze+e rat+na su bhā ṣi tai/ /kṛ tī tai dṛ pa ti khru tā tai pa prats+tsha sa yis—/ /rin chen kun gyis legs bshad ni/ /blangs pa thos ⑥nas mi yi bdag /ya mtshan bcas pisma yaḥ/ /raṭ+wā ni kasmra duskṛ bye sruk+ta mā tra mi rda twa yā/ /kṛ pas dze+ede la dris/ /ci be+ed rin chen rab btang nas/ /legs bshad tsam ni khyod kyis rbobazung / /bu tī tai bā li kā bā kya sa ra laḥpra t+ya yībyen/ /pūdzā su bhā ṣi tespyo mirja ā+oṃ mo 'di ⑨yi tshig dag la/ /drang po khyod ni yid ches ldan/ /legs bshad kyi ⑪ ni sa gzhi gang / /nor 95—1075

kṛsgo ṇa la bh+ya te/ /na bhak+ta bi ra te bhulte sruste na ke na tsita/ /ni tshogs chen dag gis 'thob/ /zas dang bral na su zhig gis/ /legs bshad dag ni bza' ①bar nus//i ti shu tā kṛ ha pa tiḥsgo ha duk+tasma tī bhu dzā/ /sruk+ta lā bhe na ma zhes pa 1sa bdag mdza' ba yis/ /brjod pa khyim bdag gis thos nas/ /legs bshad rnyed pa chen po ha ta su tuṣ+ṭasta ma bhā ṣa ta/ /rā dzasko kri ya te rasner+yat+na rak+ṣu bi nā shi yis—/ /tshim pas de la rab smras pa/ /gang gis ①sbrul bzhin skyes bu la/ /chags sdang dug ni skyed bhiḥ—/ /sas+thā khyo mi ba maḥsum̐ shā rā ga dī ṣa bi kho da yaḥ/ /bai ma spyo byed pa/ /rgyal po 'bad bsrungs spyonyams pa yi/ /rin chen dag gis ci zhig bya/ /legs bshad nor ba tsi tī ru tsi ra tsa ya taḥsad+mārga dī po pa rmā bha byā ā+oṃ dz+dza da ye su bhā ṣi ta bu dhilegs ldan rnams kyi snying gar ⑥brtan pa'i yon tan gyis brtags shing / /dam pa'i lam gyi sgron ④ma ṇi ṭ+wā dhe gu ṇa la m+bi na ཿ / / pā ko dhī ṇ+ḍi su ba ṇ+ḍi su n+da ma dang mtshungs dri med rgyas pa'i 'od zer spro byed pa/ /'tshed pa las thar gser bzang mdzes pa'i ra pa da shāp+ta pra brtsesbri taiju bye sā ga ra me kha khā ba su ma tī pā dzā sha ko gnas la rab sbyar gnas pa thob pa yi/ /rin de ⑧nor gye blo gros rgya mtsho'i ske rags dang ldan rkang pa'i pya bya ka/ /i ti shrī masgo ha pa tiḥm+bi ga t+ya ku sha lo r+ya taḥ/ /su baṇ+ḍi cha la'ang chung / /zhes te dpal ldan khyim bdag ni/ /dge la brtson ldan phyir thos rjonas/ /gser gyi pa tra li khi tai srulti dik+ṣu n+ya be+e sha yata/ /shusgo da no kṛ ha pa tiḥso ha me glegs bu la bris te/ /legs bshad phyogs rnams dag tu springs/ /de yi tshe na nga nyid ni/ /khyim bdag ba ta dā bha ba / /srusteḥpu byo pa de shābe+e sabye na nā bi pā da zas gtsang der gyur te/ /legs bshad bsod nams nyer ston pa'i/ /don la bdog kun btang bas raḥ—/ /shā ri pu tro pya yo dzhaigruḥsā bhū pa ti su tā bha pata/ /i kyu bā tsā khi la gus—/ /dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di yang / /sa bdag bu mo der gyur to/ /zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa 95—1076

dza gad+ku sha lā ya ta thā ga taḥ/ /ār+yaḥkan+daḥku sha la na li byā rū la yis—/ /'gro kun dge ba'i slad du gsungs/ /dge ba'i pad+mo can ni rtsa ba btsugs nas rab skyed ①dang ban+dha pra sru teṭ+wā nā sadzan+da ba na ba la tā saṃ bha bo t+yā na khyu miḥ/ /tro: po'i rgyu/ /sna tshogs phun tshogs gsar pa gsar pa'i 'khri ñtshashing rab skyed kyeskyed tshal sa/ /sred pa'i tā pa pra sha ma na hi ma sme ra shaṃ gā pra bā haḥsad+mānā gra pra ka ṭa na pa ṭuḥpu gdung ba rab tu zhi byed kha ba'i 'dzum ldan gang gā'i rgyun/ /dam pa'i lam mchog gsal bar byed mkhas rgya me ba pra kā shaḥ / /i ti k+ṣe men+d+ra bi ra tsi tā yī bo dhi satā snang ba dag ni bsod nams nyid/ /ces pa dge ba'i dbang pos byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs ba dā na kalpa la tā dze+e shurnyo da nā ba dā rna sastot+ta ra sha ta ta maḥpa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing las zas gtsang ma'i byartogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste pal+la baḥ// //brgya rtsa bdun pa'o// //e ṣā dzi ṣ+pen+d+ra bi hi to ru bi hā ra tsa ye tsi dh+yā ga ṇi ka na ka rgyal ba'i dbang pos bsgrubs pa gtsug lag khang chen dag gi tshogs/ /mchod rten khyams ⑪su tsi tra gu hā kṛ he 6/ /ṣ+pe tra mṛ ta pra tsi ta le pya ma yī ba bhū ba bud+dhā gser gyi ri mo'i phug gi khang par ni/ /sangs rgyas rtogs brjod rnam mang rmad byung dpag bsam 'khri ba dā na bi bi dh+wa bye ta ka lpa ba l+li / / be+e be+e yo ku shing 'di/ /mig gi bdud rtsi rab skyed ⑥yi ge'i rang bzhin dag tu 'khrungs/ /legs byas kyis gang sha khā ya pūṇ+ḍi su kṛ te tsi tre bi hā re sa tram̐ k+ṣe men+de ṇa bi she ṣa tsi tra ra bkra ba'i gtsug lag khang du dam pa rnams ni dge ba'i slad/ /khyad par byis ni bkra bar bkod cing tsa nā ra myu ba dā nā ba lī / / ā ka dze+e pra ti mā sa ha dga' ba'i rtogs brjod 'phreng ⑦ ba gzugs can 'a7/dag /stong phrag rnam gsal bsod nams rab sbyar 95—1077

sra bi ka sah+phu sgo pra bsgo dz+wa la mā bhūt+ta byi ra hā ku lo dza ga di ti byashā pra 'bar ba de nyid dge ba'i dbang po yis/ /bskal pa'i bar du 'gro ba de bral 'khrugs par ma gyur cig tijo pi tā/ /sastot+ta ra sha ta me taste na kṛ lta bo dhi satwa tsa ri tā rmā/ /ces gsal bar bkod/ /de yis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod/ /brgya rtsa bdun po 'di dag byas/ /maṅga la sa khyu pū ra ṇa me kai kārja pra yasne na/ /so men+d+ra nā mā ta na yo tha ta bkra shis grangs ni rdzogs pa la/ /gcig ni rab tu 'bad pas bya① / /de nas zla ②dbang zhes pa de yi bu//gya ka bits+tshan+daṅgā ba rā nā ma dhe yaḥ/ /asmidz+dza no dā re ka thā pra badhe saṃ pū ra ming gzhan nā ko ḍa1zhes brjod snyan dngags mkhan/ /rgyal ba'i gtam rgyud rgya che sbyar ba 'dir/ /rtogs yi 6 t+ya ba dān —she ṣe/ /ban+dhaḥke ra la kā mi m+bi ka tsa bha rā kā raḥpa ram̐ pa brjod pa lhag ma skong byed gyur④/ /mtshams sbyor ke ra la yi bu mo'i skra tshogs rnam pa mchog tu yang saṃ ha taḥhūṃ rī kān+ta ka po la ko ma la ta raḥko pi pra sā do da yaḥ/ /kādzā dag 'byel/ /ci yang rab tu dang ba rgyas pa ke ri'i mdzes ma'i 'gram pa shin tu mnyen/ /ro yi gter ṭī na ya nats+tsha ṭā pa ri tsi tā kar+ṇan+ta rā saṃ gi m+bi sgo gir+ya gya ta re gi d+dhā ra sa ni gyur gang gis rkye'akhyog tshig g.yo ldan kar+ṇa ṭa ma'i mig gis 'uzer/ /yongs 'dris rna ba'i bar du 'grogs dhet+tha byeḥs srusto da dhiḥ/ /oṃ kā rad+ku ṭi la twa me ba pa ra oṃ maḥshik+shi tai ldan legs bshad chu gter de ni phyag byar 'os/ /gang gis oṃ yig dag las gya gyu kho na mchog tu bslabs nā pa ram̐ ye hūṃ swasnyi ba rda ka dā tsi da pi na smṛṣ+ṭi mu khām+birga hūṃ/ /kro kyis gzhan pa ⑦yin/ /gang gi kha nas swaste'i tshig ni gsal ba nam yang nges par mi 'byung zhing / /khro dh+wa sgyu ta ta yā thi baṇ+ḍi ba da nā tī drwa pa rā bye pa yo te bi byā ni dha maḥb 'bar bas bzhin ni mdog bral mi srun rig khyabyed gter gyur de dag gis/ /drag po'i gnod pa ka dze+e thra thu ka baṃ kā bye k+ṣa madhe kha khāḥ / / kṛ te mā ma ba dā na bzhin du rgya che gtam gyi snyan dngags dag ni ji ltar bzod/ /dge dbang zhes pa'i snyan dngags mkhan 95—1078

kalpa la ti hūṃ k+ṣe men+d+ra nā mā ka biḥsadhadz+re pra ṇi dh+wa na me ta da dhu nā dhaste gyi rtogs brjod ①dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di byas nas/ /da ni dam pa'i chos kyi smon lam 'di dag blo bye yādhī dha naḥ/ /pu bye yat+pa mu pārdzi tai dzi na gu zla khyu ṇa pra ban+dhad+ma gros nor ldan blo yis 'dzin/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan sgogs byed bsdebs las bdag gis bsod nams gang yā bhū yaste na sa map+ta satwa ku sha le ni rkyo r+ya to yo dza naḥ / /zhig nyer bsgrubs pa/ /de yis spye skye bo 'di ni sems can mtha' dag dge la rtag tu brtson gyur cig /saṃ sā ro ru pa ri shra ma gya da dha taḥkā mā pa ba k+ṣi ba two mo hasmra ha ta mo ni 'khor bas che bar yongs su ngal zhing 'dod pa'i chang gis stsos pa nyid 'dzin la/ /gti mug rgyas pa'i sbo li ta dṛ shaḥsup+ta gya lube+e smṛ teḥ/ /san+dadhe dza ga taḥpra bo dha na mun pa dag gis mig zum nyal zhing dran pa nyams pa yipya/ /'gro ba rab tu rtogs par bsgrub ④la chas bi sgo niḥshe ṣa do ṣā pa haṃ bhā swarnyi bha ga ban+ta me ba sa ta tai bur+ghaṃ pra shing skyon rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /'od dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan sangs rgyas rab tu sad pa nyid budhan+da maḥ/ /ā nan+da ban+tu ma sa kṛsmṛ thu mā na sā dzā srulte shu bhin+d+ra la rtag tu bstod/ /kun dga'i gnyen gyur lan cig min par rgya che yid can la/ /legs bshad 'od kyi ⑤hi ta sabye su kho pa de shaṃ / /k+ṣe men+d+ra mu dz+wa la ni dzā dzhai dza bde ba kun gyi nye bar bstan pa sgrub/ /dri med rang rig khye)chu gter dag gi zla ba dge ba'i ⑦dbang / /nādhi tsaj-i tīrnyipra kā sha dza na kai dza na shaṃ na mā mi/ /bākrā ka pū ba na ni dh+wa na grags pa gsal ba skyed byed yab la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa dag byed tshig dzi nā ba dā na nis+thā ṇa bu rgya ka la nā ku sha lā bhi yo ge/ /asmri1 ni smin pa'i gter/ /sprul byed bsod nams rtag du pa dge ba'i mngon par sbyor ba 'di/ /bla ma legs taḥsu kṛ ta nā di sha tā ni yo shaṃ saṃ pū ra shā ya gu ru rja ma ma saṃ bi bhā byas ldan pa bka' ni rab tu sbyin mdzad pas/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i be+ed du bdag la skal ba'i cha shas 95—1079

gaḥ—/ /ye ྾ su bar+ṇa pra ti ma pra tā nā dzi nā ba dā nā n+ya bha brlu hā mdzad—/ /gang zhig phug tu rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dang / /gser gyi gzugs brnyan rab tu rgyas par su / /saṃ sak+ta ṣ+pe tā mṛ ta tsi tra tsi tāḥkā le na te te pi ga tā bi hā rāḥ/ /gyur—/ /mig gi ①bdud rtsi bkra ba'i ri mo chags/ /de ni gtsug lag khang ni dus kyis 'da'②//sa ra tī tū li ka yā bi tsi tra baṇ+ḍi kra mai rul+li khi tā ba dā naḥ/ /tā te dbyangs can pir gyis rnam par bkra ba yi/ /rtogs pa brjod pa ①yi ge'i rim pas bris/ /gang 'di na yo yo bi hi to ma hāzeḥsan+dan+da na pu rgya ma yo bi hā raḥ/ /na ta bsod nams rang bzhin gtsug lag khang / /don chen dam pa dga' byed yab kyis bsgrubs/ /phyogs su su nā shoste yu ga k+ṣa ye bi dza khā na lol+la se pa ri bla be+e na/ /dik+ṣu po ti'i 'phreng ④ba rab bkod pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan tshogs ni brtan pa ⑤ rab chags pa/ /de ni chu pra tijo bye ta pusta kā lī sbyi ra pra sak+ta pra ti mā ga ṇa mya/ /tasmid+ma yā gya dang mes bskyed nyer 'tshe yi/ /dus bzhi 'jig kyang nyams pa yod ma yin/ /de la rtogs brjod gcig k+ṣa ya pu5 lo bhā de kā ba dā na pra ti mām+bi te yo/ /ma hād+ma rmā gi gzugs brnyan 'di/ /mi zad bsod nams la chags bdag kyang 'god/ /bdag nyid chen po der pro snya pa dā nu sā rī swaspo bya yasne na ma ha twa me ti/ /mā dhur+ya dhur+ya ma gnas ⑥rjes 'brang ba/ /shin tu chung yang 'bad med chen por gyur⑦/ /thos pa'i skyogs kyis btung mra ta khru ti shut+ta pe ya mā mo da pad+ma mu kha pad+ma pa de dh+wa naṭī/ /j-iṅgāṅga bya'i bdud rtsi snyan pa dag gi rgyun/ /dri bzang khang pa bzhin gyi pad+mo'i gnas su sgrogs byed pa/ /bung nā mi ba pi tuḥpra ṇi pa t+ya bā sh+lau saṃ pū ra yā mi thra thu kā bya bi shi ṣa ba'i na chung dang mtshungs yab kyi skad la btud nas ni/ /snyan ngag ④rgya che'i khyad par lhag ma bdag gis she ṣa ma/ /kādzñā byu ta na saṃ ga mot+pa ba ba tī di bya pra bhā bi shri yo tā rdzogs par byas/ /mdzes ma gsar du 'grogs (7pa'i dga' ston can dang lha yi mthu ldan dpal dang ni//95—1080

ru sgyu bha ra rto pa sgo ga la ha ri t+yak+ta tro ṇa gī ḍa yā/ /pā shā tā ṇa dar bab rgyan kyi nye bar longs spyod rba ①rlabs rtswa yi rtse dga' btang byas nas/ /gus bcas gang dag bi sgo pa ra su kṛ pa yā kun+d+rarnyi ma sā da rā nisto dzā ni dza de ha dā na ma tsa khāstu brtse bas gzhan gyi srog ni bskyab par bsgrub la rang gi lus/ /zol med sbyin par byed (kyel g.yo ba med pa ṣ+pe ba ban+d+ra ma hai / /ba bhū ba kañtsa na pu re shrī mabyu r+ya dha re shwa de la bdag cag phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang / /sprin gyi tog ①ni sprin bzhin ra—/ /dzī mū ta ke tuñdzu mū ta i ba tā pa ha robe+e dzā/ /ya gya kalpa du—/ /slong ba'i gdung ba 'phrog pa dag /grong khyer gser du byung bar gyur/ /gang gi dpag bsam dru modhū tāḥpa dā na ba na bāḥshri yaḥ/ /tsa kā shi re ye shaḥpubyeḥpuju shing las 'khrungs/ /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal/ /grags pa'i me tog bsod nams kyi/ /dri sau ra bhā nir+bha rāḥ/ /dzī mū ta bā ha nasta gya pu trabyan+d+ra i bo da dheḥ/ /a bzang rgyas pa rnam par mdzes/ /chu gter la ④ni zla ba bzhin/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa de yi sras/ /shin bhū da kyu gra pu sgyu bhā pra t+ya gra i ba sañtsa yaḥ/ /gu ṇa bādz+re na ye ṣ+pe ba tu lhag pa'i bsod nams rnams/ /gsar du tshogs pa bzhin du gyur/ /dam pa'i skye bo legs byas dang / /t+yā ge ṣ+pe ba bi bhū ti mān/ /sa ba sgo te na pu tre ṇa su kṛ ta ṣ+pe ya sadz+dza naḥ/ /yon tan ldan pa dul bas ⑪dang / /'byor pa ldan pa gtong bas bzhin/ /de ni sras po de yis mdzes/ /kalpa dru mo sa sā ma rā bye pu tā ya pra ti pā r+ya saḥ/ /ta pa se shārnyi ni de yis bu la dpag bsam shing / /rgyal srid che dang bcas btang ⑥nas/ /dka' thub sbad du zhi ba'i la yi bi be+e kā ma la yo ya yo/ /dzā yā sa khe shri yo t+yaghā yā te tā te ta gnas—/ /ma la yar ni dben pas song / /yab ni btsun mo dang 'grogs te/ /dpal btang dka' po ba ā+oṃ/ /dz+re mū ta bā ha naḥpāp+ta bi bha baḥs ma tsin ta yata/ /gu ru se thub nags song tshe/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa 'byor pa dag /thob pa yis ni rab bsams pa/ /bla ma bstan 95—1081

bya bi yuk+ta khru ma ma niḥsu kha tsā ga tā/ /i yo shrīrne tra tī na gya tsi trag le ba pa dang bral ba/ /bdag la dpal ni ⑨bde med gyur/ /mig gis dman pa dag la ni/ /ri mo'i gnas niḥpha khā/ /tā ta gya pā da pa ta ṣ+pe na kha radre mā khā bi bh+ra dza mān dag 'bras ④med bzhin/ /yab kyi zhabs la gtugs tshe sen mo'i 'od kyi 'phreng ①ba yis/ /rnam par mu ku ṭa gya ya thā pu rā byuta/ / tatshwa sa na shra pa ṇa kuṇ+ḍa la maṇ+ḍi mdzes pa'i cod pan dang ldan de yi ④bka' nyan pa'i/ /rna rgyan gyis brgyan dpal ni ji ltar bdag la ta su no tsa kra brnyi bi bha be r+ya ta thā ma ma shrīḥ/ /i t+ya saṃ tsi t+ya sa sngon gyur pa/ /da lta 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'byor pa dag la de lta med/ /ces bsams de yi ⑤'jig rten rgo rdza kṛ tā ka na ka bak+ṣi r+ṇa/ /sabyu lo ko pa bā rā ya san+dar+ghaṃ kalpa ni—/ /kun la phan slad rang nyid kyisakhye/ /dpag bsam rkang 'thung gser gyi char/ /'bebs pa dag pā da paṃ/ /pā rdzu sāṭ+wā bye musmṛ bye pra ya yo pi tu rā shra ma/ /tram̐ lokya tu bstar byas nas/ /rgyal srid chen po rab btang ste/ /yab kyi bste gnas dag tu song / /'jig rten sā ra mi shwar+ya tre rde bi pu la tse ta sī/ /tasmid+māsdu bye mudṛ dzu pra yā te gsum gyi snying po yi/ /dbang phyug sems yangs rnams la rtsa④/ /rgyal srid chen po btang nas de/ /ma ma la yā tsa lo/ /tesnra kalpa dru maḥthra bhā pa ri pūr+ya di baṃ ya yo/ /la ya yi rir song tshe/ /dpag bsam ljon pas sa gzhi ni/ /gser gyis yongs bkang mkha' la song / /gi re dzi spru ta bā ha naḥpā su shrī khaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa dz+wa/ /bi yo ga tā pa ta tā dzi bi sprin gyi bzhon pas ri bo ni/ /dpal byi dum bus brgyan par phyin/ /pha ma'i zhabs pad bsten pa yis/ /troḥpā dābyā se ba yā/ /a tān+ta re tsan+da na babe+e rī hūṃ di de sha bā 'bral ba'i gdung ba rab tu btang / /skabs der tsan+dan 'khri shing rlung gzhon ⑤gyis/ /bskyod cing lā ni la lo la tī rmā/ /utshwa bi ni nā ma bhi khā ṣa thra.ā+oṃ dzo bhā dzu shugs ring ⑨glal ba bsten rnams la/ /'dod pa'i grogs por gyur pa dpyid kyis no/ /mngon par 95—1082

ṣe kā ma su j-id+ma san+taḥ/ /a dak+ṣi ṇa pro ṣi ta kā mi — rmā ba po mu hurdak+ṣi ṇa 'dod pa'i spyod tshul rab tu bstan/ /khyo bral 'dod ldan ma yi mi mthun phyogs/ /lho phyogs rlung ni yang mā ta ri shaṃ/ /dza gadz+dza yā ye ba dzha ṣa dh+wa dze na bā ya bya maste sa ha sru pra yang rab tu ldang / /'gro la ①rgyal slad nya yi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rlung gi mtshon ni 'phral la rab sbyar yuste / /a sru tra ṇiḥṣarja da maṇ+ḍa khā rna gha na pra sru ṣ+pergu ru tī pra yā tāḥ/ /tsū bzhin / /rkang drug dkyil 'khor dag gis ma spras pa/ /stug pos khyergyas pas lci ba nyid gyur pa'i/ /tsū ta dru māstsakru ra bhin+da mu drwa badhe na yu nā ma bhi lā ṣa dīṣ+ṭha/ /ba san+ta ta'i shing gis mi phyed phyag rgya bcings/ /lang tsho can la mngon 'dod babe+eb pa byas/ /dpyid kyi dpal lakhro shra ba ḍā ba tai pābya kā shi ri la ta ṭī khya sho kāḥ/ /pā da pra hā ri ri ba nā ga rī mo dag gi rna ba'i rgyan/ /ri bo'i ngos la mya ngan med pa mdzes/ /grong khyer ma yi rkang pas rab bsnun hūṃ saṃ krān+ta rā gā na ba pal+la be bhu/ /dha n+ya su kāṭ+wā ba da nā ba be+e na pas—/ /yal 'dab gsar pa dag la tshon 'phos bzhin/ /mdzes ma'i kha yi chang gi ⑦dga' ldan pa/ /ma mo ba ra myaḥsma ra do ha de yo/ /i tī ba dzā tā ba ku la dru ma su har+ṣasmi ta shrīḥ'adod pa'i thabs ni ④ skal ldan bdag nyid la/ /zhes te ba ku la shing me tog gi/ /zol gyis dga' zhing ku su ma hwa la na/ /mā dz+wa sa mudz+dzabye be+e hā ya mo 8 pā da pra shā me na 'dzum pa'i dpal skyes bzhin/ /khengs ldan ma rnams khengs pa rab btang zhing / /mi smra spangs nas ma na sī nī bhiḥ/ /pra sā r+ya mā nān+da yi tām+bi lokya dza hā sa pu྾ ri ba sin+d+ra bā rkang pa ⑤rab btud de/ /mdza' bo dag la dang bar byed mthong nas/ /ṅgan+d+ra bā ra me tog gis dgod ⑥raḥ / /ba san+ta dzi ha gya pa lā sha pā lī ba byesgu raṅge sha ra bhā ra bhā dzaḥ/ /bzhin| /ge sar rgyas pa'i khur bsten pa lā sha'i/ /'phreng ⑦ ba mdzes pa dpyid kyi seng ge yis//ma na sri nī mā na ga dzā dzñā ghā ta raghā ba sighā na kha rā ba byā ba/ /karje khengs ldan ma yi khengs pa glang po la/ /bsnun pa'i khrag bsgos sder mo'i 'greng ①ba bzhin/ /rna bar 95—1083

kwa ṇasko ki la kā mi m+bi bhiḥspasgo shi rī kho dṛ shi kaṇi kā riḥ/ /gh+ra ṇi pa ra ta ke snyan sgogs khu byug bu mo yis/ /reg las ①shi ri ṣas mig kaṇi kar/ /sna la ge sar rdul tshogs rgyas pa sha re rku pū rirba bar+ṣa har+ṣa ku su mā ka ra shrīḥ/ /tam+bid+ma dhu khye ba bi gyuṇ+ḍi yisti—/ /me tog 'byung gnas dpal byi 1dga' char phab/ /bung ba'i na chung rnam 'phrul longs spyod mā na dz+dzadzñā ga na bh+ra ma sgo ga kā le/ /uh+phul+la babe+e 6 pa nas+tha le ldan—/ /sbrang rtsis myos shing rnam par 'khyam dus der/ /me tog rab rgyas 'khri shing tshal gyi gzhir/ /6 tsa tsā ra bi byā dha ra rā dza sru nuḥ/ /sa ta tra he ma pra ti badhe josdi sernye pra rig 'dzin rgyal po'i sras ni rnam par rgyu/ /des der gser las bsgrubs pa'i khang par ni/ /grub pas tijo pa ti rat+na mūṭī/ /a bh+ya tsu go rī mu pa bī ṇa yaṭī da dar+sha ka dzñā ka li rab tu gnas byas rin chen gzugs/ /go rī ④mchod nas rgyud mang ⑤glu len pa'i/ /zla ba gsar pa lta kā me besdoḥ/ /gorluḥs mā ra dha na sam+bi mā na badha sbi tai mad+ma tha dz+re ba nā ya/ /bu'i ⑥bu mo mthong / /yid srubs 'tsho slad go ri mnyes pa yi/ /sgrub byed la ni rab tu gnas byas pa/ /bi lo kya tsākā ma ba dhū mi bā bye dz+re rū ta bā haḥthra thu bisma yo byuta/ /sha ṣ+pe ra 'dod pa'i chung ma gzhan bzhin de mthong nas/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa ya mtshan rgya cher gyur/ /de nas ri tsā kā da ba tārba bī rde gī tā ba sā ṣ+pe ha ri zla ya tā k+ṣi/ /lardzo na tā dwags mig yangs ngo tsha yis/ /dud pas glu mthar rgyud mang ④phang ba nas/ /dal gyis phab pas rig t+yak+ta sa ra sma rā sgo da dar+sha bi byā dha ra rā dza pu tram̐/ /pa raspa rā lo 'dzin rgyal po'i bu/ /mda' bzhag 'dod pa dag dang mtshungs pa mthong / /mig zer mdzes pa'i rgyan ka na bi bh+ra me ṇa ṣ+pe ṭ+wā shu sho bhā bha ra rto bhi lā ṣaḥ/ /ga tā ga tā bhā ba ldan mngon 'dod des/ /phan tshun lta bar byed pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /yid ni nye bar ⑧mtshams sbyor ta yobya kā ra ma bye ma naḥsarnyi ni badha du taḥ/ /sā kā ma pad+mā ka ra rā dza haṃ sī pho nya bzhin/ /de dag bar du 'gro dang 'ong ba ⑨byas/ /gsar mthong la yang phyogs su lhung bcas ⑩pa//95—1084

sa pak+ṣa pā tā na ba dar+sha ṣ+pe pi/ /dzad+mān+ta rā sgyu sa ra sā di bā gya swats+tsha ma had+mā 'dod pa pad mtsho'i ngang pa'i rgyal mo des/ /skye ba gzhan du goms pa'i ro las bzhin/ /de yi yid mtsho na sa mā bi be+e sha/ /sha shaṃ ka rarja bi ma la sha shī ba ka t+yā ku lo lagh+ra mi che zhing dngas par ①zhugs/ /rin chen zla bas dzudri med ri bong dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis (1 'ben la basma re 6ཿ/ /ta sngaḥs rā shaṃ sa bi be+e sha tsit+ta min+din+di raḥphul+la mi bā ra bisdo/ /dran pa'i mda'/ /rab rgyas pad+mo dag tu bung ba bzhin/ /chags ldan de yi ④sems la'ang de zhugs gyur//a bye t+ya tsā bā la sa khye dī tī yī lardzo ni madz+dzan+da ba kā ma dze+e sgo/ /bi t+yā grogs mo bu mo'i gnyis pa dang bcas der/ /'dod pa gsar skyes ngo tshas snun byed cing / /brtan yang dha ren+d+rarngi dza ṣ+pe dza gā da dhī ro pi rū pārtse ta kṛ6 mā ṇaḥ/ /saṃ rmad byung gzugs kyis drangs gyur pa/ /rig ⑤'dzin zla bas dben par mngon phyogs smras/ /smin bhā ṣa ṇin kri ya te na kasmrakhru zla twa yā sgyug ta saṃ bi bhā gaḥ/ /bi bhar+bhe legs ci sbad sngon du 'ong ba spyol/ /phebs smras bkur ba'i cha ni khyod mi byed/ /dam pa'i kun spyod bha byā bhi dza nā nu rū paṃ byu paṃ sa dā tsā ra gu ṇi na sho dzñā/ /i rda na pā yon tan gyis mdzes gzugs/ /legs ldan rigs kyi rjes mthun rnam par 'dzin/ /kha na ma tho med lo ka ra ṇi sma ra gya ta bā na ba bye gi sha shaṃ ka kārnyi/ /di bye ba puḥka gya sa mun+da lus khyod lus mchog /dran pa'i rgyan ni gsar pa zla ba ltar/ /mdzes pa mu tig nor bu nyid 'di ni/ /ta su baṃ sha su mugh+ra ma ṇi tā ma bāste/ /ta bā tha bā sun+da ri dar+sha ṣ+pe na ba yo su dh+wadz+re rab tu mtho ba'i rigs min megang las thos⑪/ /yang na mdzes ma khyod ni mthong gyur pa/ /bdud rtsis ṇa kṛ to pa tsā rāḥ/ /ka ro ti khā ba rgya bi tīṇ+ḍi har+ṣa saṃ bhā ṣa rde ka su sha brlan pas ⑨nged la rim gro byas/ /mdzes sdug dga' ster ri bong gis mtshan pa'i/ /ri mo su la phebs shī ka le khā/ /i rda tu naḥkau tu ka mā tra me ba bri t+yā be+e ṣ+pe hūṃ bha ba tī pra par smra bar byed/ /'on kyang dga' bas nged kyi dge mtshan tsam/ /gsal ba'i slad du spyod kyis 'dir ⑩95—1085

bītaske/ /sat+pak+ṣa pā tā bhi mu khe na dh+wa tra ka gya nā ya snga bha ra bhā kṛ tā smros shig /dam pa'i phyogs lhung mngon phyogs byed pa yi①/ /su yi rigs ni khyod kyis brgyan ①par pi—/ /khru te nyi bi t+yā dha ra she kha ra mya ba tsasta dokhru kya bi bhā ba gar+ghaṃ/ /kri byas—/ /zhes pa rig 'dzin cod pan dag gi ①tshig /'dod dgongs snying po can de thos gyur nas/ /ngo yā bha bāta mo na ba tī ya dā sau ta dā sa khi ma ta li kā dza gā da/ /ku mā ra bi byā dha tshas de ni mi smra ldan gyur gang / /de tshe grogs mo ma ta li kas smras/ /gzhon nu rig bu'adzin rgyal rigs ra rā dza baṃ sha su dh+wadhi tsan+d+ra sta mi ha pra sedheḥ/ /asmah+phu re sedha bi lā si nī bdud rtsi yi/ /chu gter rmi ni zla ba khyod 'dir grags/ /nged kyi grong na grub pa'i rtse dga' mas/ /nyir+yadhī ya se bi gra ha bā na dz+wa gaḥ/ /pra khyu ta kalpa dru ma dā na li lo gu ṇa pra bhā lus med lus ldan khyod ni glu len byed/ /dpag bsam shing sbyin rtse dgas rab grags pa/ /khyod kyi bā bha ra rde ya sha ste/ /a snga: mi tā ba su nā nu dze na kadzā pa tai tsā ki ta grags pa yon tan mthu yis brgyan⑤/ /zla ltar dkar ba 'di yi rna rgyan du/ /ming po nor gyi bshes min+d+ra shu bye/ /sa twasma hā satwa ka dze+e ka thārtaḥthra phyo pa tsā ra kri ya ⑪ ba gnyen dag gis byas/ /sems dpa' chen po de khyod grogs mos gtamaspyo / /dar ma'i nyer ⑦spyod bya bas sa khyuḥ/ /bha brnyi madz+dza bi dzi ta swa bhā bā bi she ṣa to gre ma ha tsā nyi ka n+ya kāḥ/ /ji ltar 'os/ /khyad par tshe rnams mdun ①du bu mo ni/ /ngo tshas rnam par thul ba'i rang bzhin 'gyur//sid+dhā nā yī sgo dhi su d+mā ka ra gya bi shā ba soḥsidha pa teḥsu te yi/ /urba na ke li bu mo 'di ni grub rigs chu gter gyi/ /zla ba grub bdag sna tshogs nor gyi ste/ /gang gi ⑨mdzes pa skyed 6 ka ro ti ya sngaḥs de ba kārnyiḥku mu dā ba bo bye/ /na ba ma la ya dza bal+la rī ba tshal du rtse tshe/ /rtag pa nyid du ku mud rgyas par byed/ /ma la yar skyes 'khri shing gsar bzhin phra/ /ta rtswa pra tha ma sa muṅga ta pabe+e bā tu rtodhī/ /i ya ma mṛ ta ma yi su rā su rā shā dang por 'khrungs gyur yal 'dab ltar dmar mchu/ /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ma la ya can 'di⑩/ /rtag 95—1086

ma la ya ba tī sa ta tā bhi khā ṣa bhū miḥ/ /i ti ta sde khru bā shā yī spru bi ro bye tu lha dang lha min mngon 'dod pa①/ /zhes des smras par gyur pa na/ /nyug ⑤rum rgan po mngon phyogs t+ya shaṃ bu tī/ /satwa rā ga ma nodzñā saḥs+thā ha sesgye bye pād+ma rdzu/ /ka spyo ṇi te—/ /myur bar 'ong ba'i ①shugs bcas pas/ /grub bdag bu ma ④la smras pa/ /dge ma nor gyi mi tā ba su nā sa hi ton+taḥpu rasbi taḥ/ /twabyi bā ha ka thā sak+taḥsi tā hūṃ bshes gnyen dang / /lhan cig pho brang 'khor na 'khod/ /khyod kyi bag ma'i gtam la chags/ /yab ni drangh+ru mits+tsha ti/ /i h+phulnga sa ha sā te na sa ha sa khyu lo tsā nā/ /khyod la lta bar 'tshal/ /zhes pa de yis brjod pa'i 'phral/ /grogs mo dang bcas mig bzang ma/ /dz+re mū ta ba ha na n+yasta mā na sā sā shaṣ+per+ya yo/ /ta sde pabya sbyi ta sa khā+e yid ni sprin gyi bzhon pa la/ /rnam par bkod nas dal gyis song / /grogs mo phyi na 'khod de la⑤/ /ka thā byā dze+eḥpu naḥpu naḥ/ /kārnyi ni rīk+ṣu mā nā yī bra rdza t+yā ma la be+eḥpa de/ /gtam gyi zol gyis yang dang yang / /mjos pa rjornam par lta byed cing / /le lo'i gom ⑦pas 'gro ba'i tshe//tat+pa the dat+ta na ya naḥ ku mā raḥ sa ma tsin+ta ya ta / /na boṅka ṇ+ḍa mngon 'dod gsar pa la brten cing ske/ /phrag dog gis bzhin brtan pa ⑨ btang / /lam der mig ni shra yo j-i t+yā t+ya bye mā na i be+edh+ya yā/ /a ho nu mṛ ga sha bas+thā bra rdza t+yāḥpi tu gtad pa yi/ /gzhon nu yis ni rab bsams pa/ /kye ma ri dwags phrug gu'i mig /pha yi drung du 'gro rarnyi ke/ /sa rā gi tadha ye ṣ+pe ba ma yi t+yā se kṛ tasma naḥ/ /shā sā byed ma/ /de yis 'jigs bzhin chags bcas kyi/ /yid ni bdag la gtams par byas/ /dbugs kyi yā sa ni ro dha yat+na ni ra tā niḥsha sda sas+thā di bhā soṅka s+thā bi dza ṣ+pe ngal dub 'bad pas 'gog la chags shing sgra med dag tu rnam par gnas/ /mthong ba'i 'jigs las shin ya dar+sha na bha yā da h+ye ta shaṃ kā ku lā/ / ta nī mad+ma tha mārga tu dogs pas 'khrugs shing dben pa ru ⑫yang rab 'dar bcas⑪/ /yid srubs dag gi mda' yis rab 95—1087

zla ti ba ta ṣ+pe bai lak+ṣu lī nasbi tirto dzā no ka ta me na sā ma ma pa thā tso rī tu bsnun tshe skyengs pa yi ①ni chags shing gnas/ /lus phra chom rkun ma de bdag yid la zhugs lam gang pra biṭ+wā ma naḥ/ /tsi ram̐ bi tsi h+ye ti shi khā ta las+thaḥs mad+ma thā dzñā bi ṣa yo mā nas ni yongs mi shes/ /zhes pa yun ring bsams nasnyenas rdo la 'khod/ /yid srubs bka' yi yul du yā taḥ/ /saṃ kalpa bamyu pu ra to bhi li khya mu hu mṛ gā stso ste mi te k+ṣa r+ṇa bhūta/ /gyur pa des/ /kun rtog pir gyes mdun du ri dwags mig /yang yang mngon bris mig ni g.yo med gyur//a thā ya yo put+pa rā ga re ṇa nā pūrje ba ṣ+pe pā da pa ro dza mu dāḥ/ /tsakra dh+wa de nas me tog rdul dang rdul byis gang / /nags tshal dben par rkang pa'i mtsho skyes rgya/ /'khor lo rgyal dzā ka bi dza ṣ+pe nu thra t+ya ta s+thārnyi shaṃ nan+d+ra su z-irlu ban+tuḥ/ /sa tai bi mtshan gyis mtshan rjes 'brangs zhunas/ /de yi drung du rtsed grogs gnyen bzang 'ongs/ /mngon 'dod lo kyā bhi na bā bhi lā ṣa bi she ṣa tsin+ta pra ti bad+dhā tsisto/ /bi shrī ta gsar pa'i khyad par bsams ④pa yis/ /sems ni rab tu bkag de des mthong nas/ /dran pa'i bka' bye.oṃ sma ra shā sa ṣ+pe na pa prats+tsha sābyar+ya bi kā ra te rtu/ /ko yo sa yis brtan pa btsongs pa la/ /ngo mtshar bcas pa'i rnam 'gyur rgyu dag dris/ /grogs po brtan pa'i khye byer+ya ni dhesta bā be+e ni tarnyi san+ta pa pa do pa deṣ+ṭa/ / tsin+ta shra yan+dibya gter gyur khyod la yang / /shin tu gdung ba'i gnas ni ⑤nyer bstan cing / /bsam pa la brten mig ni la lo tsa na gya bi bhā byā te ko pya dh+ri ti pra kā raḥ/ /i ti pra yat+na pra ṇa ye na thrasgo bi g.yo med pa/ /brtan med rnam pa ci zhig nyams su myong / /zhes pa yid gcugs gnas ni grogs po dag /shri bha dh+wazwa su z-i dā ku mā raḥ/ /ta ma bra r+pā: shā se tā nu me ya sa pak+ṣa bā rab tu 'bad cing gus pas dris pa ni/ /shugs rings mthun phyogs rlung gis rjes dpag bya/ /dran ta sma ra bā ṇa nā taḥ/ /sa khe sa khe da su pu rā ṇa sarga brge bi dhabyu ta na rū pa'i mda' lhung gzhon nus de la smras/ /grogs po sngon spros sde la skyo ldan pa'i/ /byed po yis ni gzugs 95—1088

pa re khā/ /dṛṭ+wā ma yā kārnyi ma yī ba ka t+yā sid+dhā na yī sgo dhi su d+dhā shu gsar ri mo dag /grub rigs rgya mtsho'i zla ba'i ①ri mo bzhin/ /mdzes pa'i rang bzhin bu mo bdag re khā/ /isdostad+ma da nā ra bin+da bi la sas+thā pa ju lup+ta byu teḥsā ram̐ ga gis mthong / /de yi bzhin gyi pad+mo mdzes sdug rgyas pas gzi byen nyams pa'i zla ba dang / /de yi mig gya tsa tabyi lo tsa na ru tsi pra t+yasta ṣ+pe tra shri yaḥ/ /ma bye haṃ sa ma duḥdag mdzes pas mig gi dpal ni rab tu nyams pa'i ri dwags dag /grags pa zhi zhing sdug bsngal mtshungs kha yoḥpra ti ni shaṃ be+e la gh+ra lī nāt+pa nobyed+dhā nibya la e ṣa shān+ta ya sha soḥsaṃ dṛ pas mtshan mo so sor skyengs te zhum pa yi/ /bdag nyid dag ni bsam pa g.yo med 'grogs pa 'di nyid sh+ya te saṃ ga maḥ/ /kaṭ+wā ba tai sī kṛ ta ṣ+pe tra kādhirna be pi san+dar+sha na bi mthong bar bdag rtog go/ /mthong ba'i rnam 'phrul gsar pa yin mod kyang / /mig gi mdzes pa rna ba'i bh+ra me sā/ /bi bhā bya mā nā bhi na bā dzha lā ṣe ma yi swa bhā baṃ pra ka ṭī tsa kā rgyan byas des/ /mngon 'dod gsar pa nyams su stsong byed pa'i/ /rang gi ngo bo bdag la gsal bar ra—/ / ta smisko pa ta ram̐ gi ṇi bya ti ka re byā hā ri bhā me kha dze+e byas—/ /der ni glo bur 'dar zhing g.yo ldan sgra dag sgrogs par byed pa'i 'og pag la/ /'jigs pas mū tī kṛ t+ya su sārnyi tā mi ba bha yād+man+t+ra pra dā ṣ+permu huḥ/ /ladz+dza mo na ba tī rab tu zhi bar byed bzhin yang yang gos dag byen nas lkugs 3—par byas/ /ngo tshas mi smra dang ldan bi na mra ba da nā sā srasta kazlot+pa lo rda tsabyek+ṣu ra oṃ tsa rī ka bi ru tai:kre ma bzhin dud de yi 1rna ba'i ut+pal lhung ba la/ /'khor zhing rgyu ba'i bung ba rnams kyi sgra yis bdag la legs ma swā ga tai/ /bste tsan+d+ra sha tā ni lo tsa na yu ge m+bi lot+pa lārmā ba dz+wa bā par 'ongs sam byas/ /bzhin la zla ba brgya phrag dang ni mig gnyis dag la ut+pal sngon po'i nags/ /hos+thā la mṛ zla li kābya ra ṇa yo ruh+phul+la pad+mā ka rāḥ/ /nis+thā ṇi pa ra mā rku lag pa dag la pad rtsa gzhon nu rkang par pad+mo'i 'byung gnas rab rgyas pa/ /lus mchog sprul la ④phra rab 95—1089

tai pa ra ta noḥkā me na tse ta pā tāstaṅgi bablu ma yī ba sā da ha ti me ste hā nu rdul dag gal te 'dod pas rab tu bkod pa na/ /me yi rang bzhin bzhin du de yis bdag yid mdza' bidhe ma naḥ/ /sā kā pi kā ma ku mu dā ka ra tsan+d+ra le khā dṛṭ+wā ma yā na ya na bas phug pa ci be+e da sreg /'dod pa'i ku mud tshal gyis ①zla ba'i ri mo su zhig de/ /mig gi pad+mo rnam pad+ma bi kā sha he tuḥ / / yaṭ+wārnyi bi bh+ra ma su dh+wa ta ṭi nī ni par rgyas pa'i rgyur ni bdag gis mthong / /gang gis ④mdzes pa'i rnam 'phrul bdud rtsi'i chu bo 'thungs r+pā tā mūsdi bi sngoṣ+ṭha pi shu shā ma ni shaṃ ta no ti/ /bi shā ba sorbi ma pa ①yis/ /tsha ba'i dug tu gsal byed rmongs pa rtag tu rgyas par 'gyurarjo/ /ma la ya can zhes pa'i bu la se dha ku lnga mṛ tāsdo tā rā bye pa su ta na ye ti ma yā khru tā sā/ /bā lā bi lā mo ri dwags mig can de/ /rtse dga'i bla ma me tog mtshon gyi rol rtsed skyed byed ma/ /dri med grub rigs dhisha dza na dī ku su mā yu dha gya lī la gu ron+d+ra la ya ba t+ya bhi dh+wa mṛ gā khye//bdud rtsi'i chu gter dag gi rgyu skar bdag /sna tshogs nor bdag dugi ni bu mo yin zhes bdag gis thos//khru two ti bi byā dha ra rā dza sru nor+pā kyi na bodhū ta ma no bha ba su/ /u bā tsa zhes pa rig ④'dzin rgyal po dag gi bu/ /yid byung skegasar pa rgyas pa'i tshig thos nas/ /dri za'i gzhon gan+dhar+bha ku mā ra kaste bi shān+ta bhū miḥpra ṇa yī su ban+tuḥ/ /disgyu sa khe tu lca nu yid gcugs dag gi sa/ /gus ldan gnyen bzang gis ni de la smras/ /grogs po dga' bas khyod kyi gu rja nu bhā bāt+tha no ta bā yo pra sre to bhi lā ṣaḥ/ /bha ba t+ya ba sh+ya su kṛ to mngon 'dod 'di/ /yon tan mthu dag mtshungs pa'i gnas la spros/ /legs byas ldan pa rnams kyi re tsi tā dz+wa ma no ra thaḥsat+pa tha pān+d+ra e ba/ /dha bye ba lo ka tra ya lak+ṣata khyu tā sā ba ni/ /nges par dam pa'i lam du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lha yi bu mo bltas pas mi g.yo ba/ /khyod kyi bai dza yadhī ra ti bal+la bha gya/ /su dzā ga nā lo ka na nistsa la gya ya yā j-i tiste ta brtan pa gang gis g.yo bzhin byed/ /dga' ma'i bdag po dag gi ru mtshon de/ /skal ldan 'jig rten 95—1090

ra lī kṛ te ba/ /pa ram̐ rā dza bye kā dza ga ti dza yi m+bi pūr+ṇa ra dza bhā ba rā gsum gyi mtshon bya nyid/ /'gro la nya yi mtshan mo rgyal ba dang ldan gcig pu mchog tu mdzes/ /sngo shā rmā brge ba ha ti bi bha baṃ mai ba su bha gā/ /ya yā tī naḥkhye ṇarlu bsangs sde la mchog gi 'byor pa 'dzin pa de nyid skal ba bzang / /gang dang bral bas mtshan mo ①so sor ti ra mṛ ta ra1ཿpra ti ni shaṃ sha ṣ+pernyeste ta dzñā na ba na kha mu khoste kha ta nu tsā/ /bdud rtsi'i zer ni gzi byin nyams/ /dal gyis sen mo'i kha ris gsar pa phra ba nyid 'dzin lus dang ldan//bha dza swa byer+ya ta ba baspyo tai yat+ta da pra yasgo ba na tai ka ra gre/ /bi shā ba brtan pa sten cig khyod kyi 'dod pa gang / /de ni 'bad med lag pa'i rtse na gnas/ /grub bdag sna poḥsedha pa testa dbe+e ka sngebe+e tā twadz+dza na ke na sā hi/ /dha byosmi ya su ta tshogs nor las bu mo de/ /khyod kyi yab kyis ②khyod kyi don du bslangs/ /'dod ①ldan zla bas mtshan mo na yā tri dza gaspri ye ṇa saṃ yu bye te byu ti ma tā sha shi nā ni she ba/ /u la bzhin gang gi bu mo la/ /'gro gsum dga' bas yang dag spyor ba bdag ni ④skal ba bzang / /zhes k+tati sidha pa ti rā da ra har+sha pūṇ+ḍi ka t+yā bi bā ha ma ha tata pa ra tā ma pa brjod nas grub pa'i bdag po gus dang dga' bas gang / /bu mo yis ⑤ni bag ma'i dga' ston de nyid bstaḥ—/ /pā taḥs khe sa bha bi tā bi pu lot+pa bste kān+ta sa mā ga ma skyong bar gyur/ /grogs po nang par khrod kyi rtse dga'i dga' ston yangs pa dag /mjos ma dang 'grogs su dh+wa sa pha lo bi hā raḥ/ /yasmin sa mā na gu ṇa saṃ ga ma dar+sha ṣ+pe na dh+wa tuḥbadud rtsi'i 'bras bu ldan pa de byung buste/ /gang la yon tan mtshungs pa 'grogs pa dag ni mthong bas na//ka ri 6 ta dza naḥsu tsi rāt+tha shaṃ saṃ/ /i ti su j-id+ma tsa rna sa ha me+e bots+tsha skye bo shin tu yun ring byed po bsngags pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pa grogs po'i tshig de thos gyur nas/ /labyi pu la har+ṣa ma ya sa ni sha mya tata/ /ni dza pa rda pra ya yo ka la yarnyi yā di dga' ba'i rang bzhin yangs pa 'phral rgyas te/ /nyin mo'i lhag ma du ma'i dus mtshungs par/ /blo yis 95—1091

ba sha she ṣa ma ṣ+pe ka yu go pa oṃ/ /a tha saṃ dh+yā ba dhū saṃ gā di ba saṃ krān+ta rku ku rtog cing rang gi gnas su song / /de nas thun mtshams bu mo dang / /'grogs pas gur gum 'phos pa maḥ—/ /dza gā ma ga ga no t+yā ṣ+pe tirja shu rā ṭa rā ga hūṃ/ /di nādhe padri bzhin—/ /nam mkha' yi ni skyed tshal du/ /nyi ma chags rtag ldan par gyur/ /pad+ma ①can dga' nyin nī kārnyi bi shrarnyesta ta ṭī ta ra/ /bā da saṃ bā ha nā salnga sartsu ta sngarnyi ke mo'i mthar/ /nub ri'i ngos la 'khod pa na/ /de yi mjug tu thun mtshams ni/ /rkang pa bsten pa la ba bye/ /ta tabya pabye rmā sgo dhi pra biṣ+ṭi bā sa re shwa re/ /kha ma chags mdzes/ /de nas nub phyogs chu gter du/ /nyin mo'i dbang phyug rab lhung tshe/ /de las pūr+ya ta na k+ṣa tre sta dubye ri ba shi ka reḥ / / sha ṣ+pe sto ka ta 'thor bas thigs pas ⑤bzhin/ /skar ma rnams kyis nam mkha' gang / /dal gyis mun pa chung ngu maḥbyā mā ni sha bhu ba na bhā dza nāta/ /sastsu rā gā sa baṃ r+pā tā spyi re gnag /mtshan mos srid pa'i snod 1dag las/ /thun mtshams dmar ba'i chang 'thungs nas/ /stsos bā gyuṇ+ḍi te k+ṣa r+ṇa/ /ta taḥpra ṭī sha ṭī kān+ta bi khā se ba sa tiḥka ku pa/ /pa bzhin du skad cig 'khyams/ /de nas bde sogs mdzes pa yi/ /rtse dga' gnas pa shar gyi phyogs/ /ā san+desgo da yā lo ka tsan+ta ṣ+pe ram̐ ki tā ba r+bha/ /a thor+ya yo su dh+wa sru 1 zla 'char snang ba nye ba na/ /tsan+dan dag gis mtshan bzhin mdzes/ /de nas bdud rtsi skyed pa ni/ /byā mā mu kha bi she ṣa kaḥ/ /sgo gi rmā sgo ga saṃ bhā gya lī khā mu kha bi she ṣa longs spyod can gyi longs spyod kyi/ /skal bzang rtse dga' khyad par can/ /sngo bsangs gdong gi khyad kaḥ —/ /bi lā sa hā sā bhe mu khā+e mo dos+thāk+ṣu ku mut+pa tī/ /ma rgyu can shar/ /zla ba'i rtse dgar mngon phyogs pa'i/ /ku mud ldan pa mthong gyur nas/ /khro bas zhum lbo ṣ+pe ba na li nī ni mi m+bi la ga labyu tiḥ/ /pra t+ya gra tsan+d+ra ti la kā tā rā ni bzhin pad+ma can/ /gzi byin nyams shing zum par gyur/ /zla ba'i thig le gsar pa dang / /skar ma'i 95—1092

ka ra hā ri bhā/ /kā oṃ dza gā ma sā shā mā mu ni sum̐ ya ma sum̐ ya ma bā ma tī/ /ta snga tshogs kyi do shal can/ /sngo bsangs ma de thub pa ni/ /dul ba'i mi mthun phyogs nyid gyur/ /de nas ni sha yo soṅkar+sā habye ma la ya ba t+ya tha/ /dz+re mū ta bā ha na dh+yā na nirni dru sa mtshan de khang bzang du/ /srid ldan ma la ya can ma/ /gnyid med sprin gyi bzhon pa yi/ /bsam gtan ma tsin+ta yata/ /i yo ma ma sa mā pan+da bi bā hān+ta ra babyā nī/ /ldan pas rab bsams pa/ /bdag ni bag mar nye ba yi/ /bar na gnas pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /na pa ri k+ṣu ya te bā mā sha ta yā mi ba yā mi dī/ /a ho nu ga ga norlu rna mtshan mo 'di ni thun brgya dang / /ldan pa bzhin du yongs mi 'dzad①/ /kye ma nam mkha'i skyed mos tshal//sha shi saṃ ga ma grudṛ tā/ /tā ra kā ku su ma smi re ra dza m+bi na bi muñtsa tai/ /rgyu skar me tog 'dzum ldan pa/ /ri bong can 'grogs dga' ba yi/ /mtshan mo yis ni gtong mi byed/ /ā yā mi nī ya mi bhā yo yā tā me pri ya bi sna hūṃ/ /swa yi su kha rā sā shin tu ring ba'i mtshan mo 'di/ /bdag gi dga' ba'i gegs ⑤su gyur/ /rang nyid bde ba'i ror sak+taḥko dzā nā ti pa ra bya tsā/ /i ti tsid+dhā nu badhe na ta sngaḥsad+dhā pa kā ri chags pa/ /su yis gzhan gyi gdung ba shes/ /zhes pa de yi bsam pa ni/ /gdung byed rjes su 'byel shā—/ /sā nu ro dhe ba ra dza nī dza gā mā dar+sha rde sha ṣ+pe/ /a thā ru rde ba yi/ /dor ①bzhin du ni mtshan mo de/ /dal gyis mthong ba min par gyur/ /de nas skya rengs rjogos shu ka ba tī twa rā grasten+d+ra dadze+e shā/ /ā sarjot+pa ba sadz+dza ba pra bhā pā bhā ti tī dang ldan/ /brel bas zla ba'i me long zags/ /dga' ston nye ba la chas bzhin/ /snang ba ldan pa tho ba bye/ /u di te pad+me bhā kādhe shārnye ta ma se sāt+tha re/ /ba bhū ba sat+tha rengs rjomadzes/ /pad+mo can gyi dga' ba shar/ /mtshan mo spyomun pa zhi ba na/ /'byung po thams cad byu tā rmā su khā ya na ya not+pa baḥ/ /ta taḥpra dṛste pad+me t+yā di pā ka ra ka ra bde ba'i slad/ /mig gi dga' ston dag tu gyur/ /de nas pad+ma ldan pa yis/ /nyin byed zer 'dzin la 95—1093

kṛ he/ /ud+ma yudh+ri ga la la nā saṃ ga oṃ ga ga gī ta yaḥ/ /ta taḥsid+dhā zhugs tshe/ /bung ba'i na chung 'grogs pa yis/ /bkra shis glu dag rab tu bsgrun/ /de nas grub pa'i dhi na tha su bha ba ṣ+pe khyu ri saṃ pa daḥ/ /su tā pa ri ṇa yā re bha saṃ bhā raḥs bdag po ni/ /phun tshogs mang ba'i khyim dag tu/ /bu mo ①bag ma'i dga' ston dag /rtsom pa'i chas ma brtata/ /a tha se dha pu ra: rnyi rdi r+ghaṃ shu ka bi khyu ṣa ṇiḥ/ /dṛṭī pra ni rab tu bstar/ /ci ste grub pa'i na chung gis①/ /lha yi gos dar ①rgyan rnams kyis/ /bu mo brgyan sā bye hūṃ ka t+yā mū tsu ra be+e ra so mi thaḥ/ /hā ro sngaḥku tsa yoṭ+wā raḥpa ri hā rāḥpa mthong gyur nas/ /lha mo rnams kyis phan tshun smras/ /'di ni ④nu ma rab mjos pa/ /do shal khur pa ra ru tsaḥ/ /lā ba rgya bya ba dh+wa ṣ+pe na khyu ya sā bhū ṣa ṇi na ki/ /ta two gyis rab tu bsgribs/ /mdzes sdug sgrib par byed pa yi/ /shin tu mang ba'i rgyan gyis ci/ /grogs mo shāḥs khi ki kri ta sta na ta ṭi rat+na ba lī bhir+bha rash+yi tram̐ maṇ+ḍa na paṇ+ḍi tā si su lus phra nu ma'i ngos la rin chen 'phreng ⑤ba'i khur gyis ci zhig byed/ /khyod ni bkra bar rgyan la mkhas te dṛ shaḥ ki bāñdza ṣ+pe nā mu nā/ / ra myu rañdza na dusgra te ṇa be+e hi mig bzang dag la mig sman 'dis kyang ci/ /bzhin ras zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la khyod kyis 'bad tā bsten+d+ra be+esbe twa yā pa bye yo ku ru te ka lo ka ka la hūṃ ka sgru ri kā mañdza nas dga' bar bsgrubs pa'i mtshon⑥/ /gla rtsi dag gi dog pa rnams ni dri ma chags par byed pa 'di la rī—/ /sa khā+e bhi ri ti saṃ kalpa dza spe rā ka lpa bi bh+ra maḥ/ /kalpi to ltos / /de ltar kun rtog brjod pa yis/ /grogs mos rgyan byu ④rnam 'phrul ni/ /bkra shis slad du oṃ ga lā yi ba swabe+e pya myu bya rā dza ta/ /a thā ya yo bi mā ṣ+pe na brtags rbogyur pa/ /shin tu chung ba dag kyang mdzes/ /de nas nam mkha' ⑨ gzhal yas khang //ma be+e mā dze+e shu mā li nā/ /hā ra hasmyu ya ma ni na byo: dz+re mū ta bā ha naḥ/ /nor la 'phreng ⑩ba'i zer 'phreng ⑪can/ /do shal ba gam can lta bus/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa rab tu 'ongs//95—1094

dza gat+tha yī pū bye gu ḍā da re ṇa sid+dhā dhi nā the na su pū bye mā naḥ/ /be+e yon tan la gus 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod/ /grub pa'i mgon pos mchod par gyur pa des/ /rig byā dha ra she ṇi sha tā nu yā taḥsadzi kṛ hūṃ oṃ ga la bhū mi mā ya/ /a thā ya 'dzin 'phreng ①ba brgya phrag rjes 'brang zhing / /bstar byas bkra shis sa gzhi dag tu phyin/ /de nas rin yo rat+na bi mā na sakyā ka t+yā ma no dzad+ma bi khā sa bal+lī/ /bi bā ha har+ṣa dru chen gzhal yas khang gnas pa/ /yid skyes rtse dga'i 'khri shing bu mo ni/ /bag ma la dga' mdzes pa'i cha nyi saṃ pi bhā gam+bi bhū ṣa shā nī ba di shaṃ di sharnyi/ /sa khi ka rāsdo li ta tsa ma rā gra bi dag gis/ /phyogs la rgyan dag ster ba bzhin du 'ongs/ /grogs mo'i lag pas bskyod pa'i rnga yab rtses//srasta kazlot+pa la pal+la yan/ /ka po la labhe na ba d+nghak+ṣa rde sā bya s+t+ri ka tsan+d+ra rna ba'i ut+pal yal 'dab lhung gyur pa/ /'gram par reg pas skad cig de rab mdzes/ /rtags yon zla bha ra ṇ+ḍa ni she pa/ /ta taḥpra bṛste bi bye babyi bā ha ma hot+pa be sedha 1 pād+ma bas brgyan pa'i mtshan mo bzhin/ /de nas bag ma'i dga' ston chen po la/ /cho ga bzhin zhugs grub dzā yāḥ/ /pā be+e gra ha spar+sha na bā mṛ te na na nan+da be+e t+yā dha ra rā dza sru bdag bu mo yi/ /lag bzung reg pa gsar pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /rig 1'dzin rgyal po'i bu ni dga' nuḥ—/ /to daspa tī hā ra ma hārta rat+na saṃ krān+ta de ho ba bhā turbi bā te/ /dī bar gyur/ /khyo shug de dag lus ni bag ma'i tshe/ /do shal che du'os rin chen la 'phos mdzes mdza' h+ye ba laspyo j-i da ye ba kā shaṃ pa raspa ram̐ swats+tsha ta yā pra biṣ+ṭi/ /nirbar+bhe bas snying la go skabs thob gyur nas/ /phan tshun rab tu dang bas zhugs pa bzhin/ /bag ma'i cho gas ④tojo ha bi dhi pra bkau gī ta dṛ sto tsi ta nā ka kārnye/ /bi n+ya sta raṭ+wā sa rab tu sbyar byas pa/ /mchod yon bsten pa de dag rgyal po'i khyams/ /glu dang gar ldan mtho ris ltar na ma rgya bhā dzo rā rdzu ga rde dzagla tu rut+pa bārte/ /a thot+pa boṭ+wā haṃ bi she ṣa dṛt+ta mdzes pa/ /rin chen stan bkod dga' ston 'os par song / /de nas dga' ston spro ba'i khyad par gyis⑤//95byed1095

ma hot+pa be+e mi tra sa mā ga me na/ /bā lā ta baiḥsedha pu re ba byu ba sizla ra pū ri ri yongs su rgyas tshe grogs dang phrad pa yis/ /nyi 'od gzhon nus li khri'i tshogs kyis bzhin/ /grub pa'i ba po ra ke liḥ/ /sha ṣ+peḥpra yā te 6 di ṣ+pe 6 ṣazlu ma hot+pa ba sngabyuta har+ṣa grong du grong ba'i rtse dga' byung / /dga' ston chen po rmad byung dga' ba'i sa/ /nyi ma drug ni dal gyis byu meḥ/ /gi resta ṭi sap+ta ma bā sa rā kre tsa tsā ra bi t+yā dha ra rā dza sru nuḥ/ /da rab 'das te/ /nyi ma bdun gyi ①dang po ri ngos la/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po'i bu ni rnam par rgyu/ /der dar+sha ta tra spru ṭa ra1 dzā la pha ṇ+ḍa ma ṇi sbyi ta kṛ ta pra kā shaṃ/ /mā tā nu ni gdengs ka'i nor bu'i 'od zer dag /rab gsal dra ba'i khu snang ba rgyas byed pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil yā tai pa ri pūṇ+ḍi tsan+d+ra be+es+thā na rgo nā ga ku mā ra ma gre/ / ta sngaḥ'akhor yongs rdzogs bzhin ras can/ /klu gzhon ma dang bcas pa mdun du mthong / /mchi ma stug por pra sargyadha na bāt+pa pin+d+ra mā khā ba tīṇ+ḍista na maṇ+ḍa lā yāḥ/ /a byu gra sho kā rab 'bab thigs pa yi② / /phreng bas nu ma'i dkyil 'khor dkrigs grur cing / /rab drag mya ngan byus ha ti kam+bi tā yāḥshu shā ba tā re ka ru ṇa pra lā paṃ/ /hā bat+pa pā tā la ma ṇi bcom 'dar ba de'i④/ /snying rje'i cho nge rab tu gsang ba ⑤thos/ /kyi hud mnyes gshin sa 'og nor pra dī pa sa m+bi sa māste si ka dze+e k+ṣa ya su/ /dragh+ra mi kārnye kwa pu nasta be+e da bu'i sgron/ /ji ltar khyod ni brlag la nye ba thob/ /khyod gdong chu skyes kun dga'i tshogs bzhin mdzes/ /mā nan+da sasdo ha mi bā na nā dz+dza/ /a smidh+ri yā pyo ti la tā ba sadhe ki yo 'di ni bdag gis phyi nas gang du mthong / /kyi hud dga' ma'i dga' ba'i 'khri shing ⑪dpyid/ /yid ba ṣ+pe mad+ma tha sarnyi dru te/ /hā bagh+ra se bān+dha ba dz+re ba bhū ta kā la dī pā srubs mtshams sbyor pho nya lang tsho 'dir/ /ji ga gnyen gyi srog gyur khyod za 'gruraskye / /dus kyi gnyis kran+ta i bā si tsū taḥ/ /shu te ti ta sngaḥka ru ṇa pra khā pa man+taḥs mudhīṇ+ḍi bi ṣā da sha 'thung gis bcom tsū ⑧ta bzhin/ /zhes pa de yi snying rje'i sgra thos nas/ /mya ngan zug rngu nang du rab 95byed1097

l+yaḥ—/ /sa prats+tsha nywa duḥs ha duḥkha ha tu ma bye t+ya bi byā dha ra rā dza pu tra/ /zug pa/ /rig ①'dzin rgyal po'i bu yi rngu mngon phyogs te/ /de la bzod dka'i sdug bsngal rgyu dag dris//ka smat+ta bā saṃ r+ya na duḥkha paṃ shī mā taḥpra dzā taḥpra sa dzha pra khā paḥ/ /ki tī pra ma ma ma khyod kyi cho nge drag po 'di/ /sdug bsngal drag po'i khyegasal byed ci las skyes/ /dge ba'i gzugs kadza ka ma su sā sgoḥka spyo ṇa rūbye ra ti shaṃ ka se tī/ /ba hūṃ ṣi kā oṃ ku sha can dam pa 'di la khyod/ /drag po ④kun tu 'dar byed ci zhig dogs/ /nges par dge ba dag la 'os lo tsi tā ni sau dza n+ya sas+thā da su kha pra dā ni/ /a baṃ bi dh+wa ni pra ti ghā ti nī dzā nai pa'i lus/ /skye bo bzang po dang 'grogs bde ba ster/ /rnam pa 'di lta bu ni rab 'joms pa'i/ /rgud ba gya da two bi pa dzā pra yā ti/ /saṃ krān+ta tadruḥkha bi ṣā ku le na thraṣ+ṭi ti sā pa'i gnas nyid rab khyatu mi 'gyur rospyo/ /zhes pa de yis ⑦sdug bsngal dug 'phos 'khrugs/ /brtse ba'i te na da yā ma ye na/ /tam bra bīdhī li ta lo tsa ṣ+pe ba bi yo ga dī t+yā ba da rang bzhin de yis dris la des/ /'bral bas 'jigs nas bu yi bzhin la mig /phur pa btsugs bzhin ṣ+pe su ta su/ /ki ni spra tī kā ra sa nuṅga me na shu te na te3smabye sa nā na le de la rab smras pa/ /bcos thabs med par gyur pa nged kyi ni/ /sdug bsngal med kyedag thos pas khyod la na—/ /a kā la pā tī ma ma duḥs ho yo duḥkan+d+ra phru ko pa na taḥpra kā raḥ/ /nikye—/ /las ngan byun pa 1 7nyer gnas bzod dka' yi/ /rnam pa 'di ni bdag la dus min lhung //bi shā la tīṭ+wādz+dza la shaṃ kha pā la ku dze+e ku re bat+pa ta re ma māsmin/ /rū khā bhi ghā rgya che grags 'bar dung skyong rigs nyid kyi/ /myu gu bdag gi 1cebu gzhon 'di la ni/ /byed po gdug pas tī bi dhu re ṇa ṅgā tā salja kṛ to ya ka thi naḥku ṣ+ṭha raḥ/ /e kaḥs dā bhak+ṣu ṇa dīk+ṣi rtsa ba 'joms pa yi/ /sta gri rnon po 'di ni chas su byas/ /rtag tu za bar ston byed mkha' lding la/ /tasma tākhye su sadze+e k+ṣa ya rak+ṣu shā ya/ /bā re ṇa nā gaḥpha ṇi nā ya ke na bi mṛ bye te thams cad brlag pa bsrung be+ed re mos kyi⑫/ /gdengs can 'dren pa dag gis klu de (⑫ni/ /gos dang ⑩ 95—1098

pā ṭa la paṣ+ṭa tsi t+naḥ/ /yo yi tu ṣā rā tsa la saṃ ni be+e shaḥsaṃ dṛ sh+ya te rā shi ra dṛ rtags kyis mtshan pa spring bar byed/ /gang 'di kha ba'i ri ni bkod pa yi/ /phung po pha rol mthong min sh+ya paraḥ/ /sa e ṣa bhultodzhai ta sgo gi kā ya kai kā la mā 'a/ ka li tosbi ṭa/ mthong gyur pa/ /'di ni gdengs can lus zos dor ba yi/ /keng rus phreng bas bsgrubs pa'i rus phung ṭaḥ / /bā ra kra me rja r+ya ma mā su sru noḥkṛ tān+ta dad+dhādhi ka mā ga ta su/ /yin—/ /mthar byed so yi drung du song gyur zhing (/ /gos dmar bka' ni rab tu bzung byas pa/ /pāsto ya masmad+ku la spru la ghā tī kṛ tī ta sho hūṃ shu ka shā sa na su/ /i ti bdag gi bu 'dis de ring rim kyis ni/ /nged ‘snyerigs rtsa ba 'joms pa'i res 'di thob/ /ces pa bru ba shā ta bha ye na tūṭ+wā mā shā gya mā na ta na ye na te na/ /sā tai bi dh+wa 'jigs pas myur du smra byed cing / /bu de yi 37ni dbugs dag 'byin byed ma/ /de yis de ni gos lnga shu ka pal+la be na tsu kro sha tā ram̐ ka ru ṇa sru te na/ /hā shaṃ kha tsū ḍa twa ra se 'dab kyis bsgribs nas/ /snying rje'i nga ro gsang por cho nge bton/ /kyi hud dung gi gtsug phud 'gro ki me baṃ gan+tu dza gad+maṇ+ḍa na ba dh+ya bhū mo/ /uste ti kaṇ+ḍa kṛ hi tā du tā ta ta ba'i rgyan/ /gsar ④par 'gro la 'di ltar khyod ring ci/ /zhes brjod bu yi mgrin bzung de yi ni//skan+ta bi n+ya sta mu khā+e sa mu mo ha/ /dṛṭīp+ta saṃ dzñā sha na ṣ+peḥku mā ra.ā+oṃ k+ṣa phrag par bzhin bkod ma de rmongs par gyur/ /dal gyis 'du shes thob cing skrag ma de/ /be'u gcig ta dzā bye nu mi bai ka brja/ /a tsin+ta yajuḥkha da bā na la snga ni ba ra kho pā ya ldan pa bzhin gzhon nus mthong / /de yi sdug bsngal nags me zlog sre7pa'i thabs/ /brtse bas brlan bye yā da yādz+raḥ/ /a ho ba tā yo ba ta ge shwa ra su kror+yā nu badh+ri ma li naḥpa'i blo yis rab bsams pa/ /snying rjes dman pa gang gis rtag tu ni/ /gzhan dag bcom nas lus pra yat+naḥ/ /pu: ti ni h+ye ka ru ṇa bi tī nāḥpa ro pa ghā te na sha rī ra ke ngan gso byed pa/ /kye ma 'dab chags dbang gis 'bad pa ni/ /gdug pas rjes su 'brel 'di rab tu 95byed1099

yaḥ—/ /bi yu bye mā nā ta na ye na ṣ+pe yi dz+re ba t+ya ba bye dzi na bhā bi ban+d+ra/ /a dman/ /bu dang bral bar gyur pa stibu med kyi/ /ma 'di nges pa nyid du 'tsho ma yin/ /gzhon nu shin yo ku mā raḥsu ku mā ra rūn+tin+d+ra ye ba rak+ṣuḥswa ta nu pra de na/ /k+ṣa ṇi bi gru h+ye tu gzhon pa'i lus can 'di/ /rang gi lus byin bdag gis bsrung bar bya/ /skad cig 'di spye bsams ti sa tā mu bā tsa mā tarba dza two sa su tā swa byu mo/ /gasgo mya haṃ san+da ga ba de yis der smras pa/ /ma gcig khyod ni bu bcas rang sar song / /klu dag gsod pa'i gnas su bdag dh+ya dh+wa ma pra yats+tsha sho rde shu ka tsit+na me tata/ /i kyuk+ta mā tre pa da ye na te na mchi ⑦ yis/ /gos dmar mtshan ma 'di ni bdag la sprul/ /zhes pa brtse ldan de yis brjod tsam la//sā kaspa mā rmā ga la tā ta mū tse/ /na bā tsu me tadzha ba tā bi ru sgo two shaṃ kha yan lag 'khri shing 'dar des de la smras/ /'gal ba 'di ni khrod kyis brjod mi bya/ /khyod ni dung gtsug tsu ḍā da dhi kaḥsu to me/ /a haṃ tu mo hom+bi ma gā dha sen+tu ma shan+d+ra kam+bi pa na las lhag bdag gi bu/ /bde med las kyi nyer gnas gting med mtsho/ /rmongs pa'i rba ④rlabs ldan ta bi shā mi/ /a kā la yasgo pa la duḥs hā ni duḥkhā n+ya lo duḥkṛ ti nā pa par bdag 'jug go/ /nyes pa byed pa rnams la sdug bsngal ni/ /dus min phyogs ⑤kyi rdo ba bzod tarnyi—/ /sā dho su ṅgā sam+bi bye rā shri tā dzā sa two da dheḥswaste mas+t+ri ta nu ste/ /dka' lhung /
