rnams kyi tshe 'di mgyogs pa'i bal+lī da lot+pata sa li la la ba bi lo lo de hi nā me ta dā yuḥ/ /sbi ra rlung gi rtse dga' yis/ /bskyod pa'i 'khri shing 'dab ma la gnas chu thigs rnam par g.yo/ /rgyun du 95—1108

pa da ma mṛ tā s+thā saṃ ta tā sto pa kā ri kṛ ta pa ri ka ra ba r+ghaṃ pu bye gzir ba la phan bsod nams gnas la yo byad ni/ /bsgrubs byas bdud rtsi thob pas nyabartan pa'i gnas dh+wam+bi pra yā ti/ /i sgok+ta dza na kau sā sro pu raḥpraste kha ge shwa ram̐/ /pabya su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /pha ma mchi ma can la ni bu/ /brjod nas mdun du 'dab chags dbang / /'gyod hūṃ pe na ma ha tā nildan+t+ra ni dza duḥkṛ tai/ /bai rā gya gu ru rja satwa pa chen pos rang gis ni/ /nyes byas smod cing gnas pa dag /de yi ke snying stobs 'bad pa ni/ /pra ṇa ye na pra mṛ khya saḥ/ /tsa kā ra sbi ra saṃ kadze+e nā gā sha na ni bṛt+ta ye/ /ta chags bral bla mas dag byas nas/ /klu ni za ba las zlog ④la/ /kun tu rtog 3pa brtan po byas/ /de taḥpar+yan+ta bi ṣa ma shā sa prar+ṣa li tā k+ṣa raḥ/ /satwa pra kā sha she kho byut+pa ni nas mi bzad mtha' yi dbugs/ /yi ge rab tu 'khrul pa can/ /mig ni rab tu zum pa de/ /snyeng m+bi li ta lo tsa naḥ/ /a tho tsi tsā su ra tsi tī pud+dhā shu ko tsi hūṃ tsi hūṃ/ /stebs ⑥gsal ba'i lhag mar gyur/ /de nas sreg khang rab spras pa/ /'os shing me tog gos kyis spras/ /pra be+ebyu taspri ya ba sno ra gra me bh+ya sa ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /bhas+thā ma yā bha ga ma ⑦yi mdun du mngon phyogs te/ /'jug 'dod de yi dga' mas smras/ /bdag gis 2snagus pas mnyes ba tī to ṣi tā bha ba ba be+e bhā / / ā di shan+de ba re sadz+re bi t+yā byas pa/ /'byung po'i ⑨dga' ma bcom ldan mas/ /rig lnga'adzin kun gyi 'khor los kasgyur/ /mchog dha ra tsakra ban+ti rna/ /ta di rda pi ta dze+e kasmradz+dza tai ma ma pa tī ba tsaḥ/ /ni bdag la rab tu byin⑫/ /gang zhig zhag bdun nyid kyis bdag /bu mo yugs sa'i skal ldan gyur/ /ya da haṃ sap+ta rā tri ṇa bā la bai bha bya bhā gi dī/ /dzad+mān+ta re bi me bhū yā dag pa'i tshig 'di bdag la ni/ /ci slad bden pa min par gyur/ /bdag gi skye ba gzhan du yang / /da ya me bo tsi tāḥpa tiḥ/ /uste ti sāsgo bi k+ṣe pa mān+d+ra ra ku su māñdza liḥ/ /ta 'os pa 'di nyid bdag gyur cig /ces brjod de yis man+da ⑫ra'i/ /me tog snyim pa me la gtor/ /de 95—1109

taḥpe yu ṣa ka la sha bya gra pā ṇi sa ro ru hā/ /swa ya ma bye t+ya gi ri dzā nas bdud rtsi'i bum pa yis/ /lag pa'i mtsho skyes byel ba yis4sna/ /ri skyes rang nyid mngon phyogs te/ /spru t+yā dz+re rū ta bā ha rna/ /a yo dzīb ti te pu tro pa ti ri t+ya dzhai jo yi dī/ /dga' bas bu mo khyod kyi bdag /de ni 'tsho zhes rjod ༷ byed cing / /bzhin kyi 'od kyis phyogs bkang ste//ā dz+re ba ya ta su dh+wa sā riḥpū ri tā shā mu khaṃ shu bhaḥ/ /an+tabha tā yī san+d+ra dh+yā swa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dag gis ni/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa rab tu bsos/ /ri sras mi snang gyur pa na/ /sgo dz+re mū ta bā ha naḥ/ /tāhūṃ ya yā tse nā gā dzā ha tā dzā dz+re bi tai pu sprin gyi bzhon pa rab bsos nas/ /bsad pa'i klu rnams bsos pa ni/ /mkha' lding dag la slar yang naḥ / / ta taḥsazla sa mut+ta sbra stasmṛ ṣ+ṭa bṛ ta bṛṣ+ṭa bhiḥ/ /sā lo kā zhus—/ /de nas de yis bdud rtsi'i char/ /spros pas gdengs can thams cad ni/ /gdengs ka'i nga pha ṇi naḥsbyi ta pha shā ma ṇi ma rī tsi bhiḥ/ /ta taḥpra har+ṣabye ta mad+ma thā nor bu'i 'od rgyas pa'i/ /snang ba dang ldan rab tu langs/ /de nas dga' dang rmad byung yid srubs rmā tu spyo bhi yo gi na bi sbo ṭ+wā mā naḥ/ / sa mā ya yo sedhe su tā sa rnams—/ /mtshungs par mngon par sbyar dbas 'dar byed cing / /dpag bsam 'khri shing yang dag rgyu m+bi paṃ saṃ tsā ri bhā kalpa la te ba pa t+yāḥ/ /yā te sa ma bh+yatsu ta taḥku mā ram̐ ba bzhin/ /grub pa'i bu mo bdag po'i drung du song / /de nas lhun po gshog pa ldan pa bzhin/ /kha ge shwa re pa k+ṣa ba tī ba sa me ro/ /dz+re mū ta bā hā bhe mu kha gya dṛṣ+ṭirna 'dab chags dbang pos gzhon nu mngon mchod song / /sprin gyi bzhon pa dag la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /shaṃ kha tsū ḍa gya dza gā ma trobye/ /a tha su ra pa ti kād+dhā pā ṇi pad+ma pra muk+ta bi dung gi gtsug ni blta tsibs ngoms ma gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyi bor lha yi bdag po yis/ /ka tsa ku su ma thraṣ+ṭisgo bye satwa su spru dz+dza / /n+ya pa ta da ma ra mo dā mdzes pa'i lag pa'i pad+mas (3rab gtor me tog rgyas pa'i char/ /bung ba'i tshogs kyi 'usgra yis yon tan 95—1110

sā ra saṃ pū ri tā shā kṛ ta gu ṇa nu ti shasde bā ku lā ni swa ṣ+pe na/ /bstod 7byas sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /'chi med dga' ba'i tshogs kyis phyogs ni yongs su gang ba babs/ /ban+di tā pi ta ro ta rda gh+ri ka ma la byā sak+ta tsū ḍā ma ṇi har+ṣa sru sru ti bhe sta yoḥsu be+e pha ma dag la phyag 'tshal de dag zhabs kyi pad+mar gtsug gi nor bu chags/ /de dag dga' ba'i mchi ma hi ta pre mā bhi ṣe ko t+pa ba ཿ / / sa twa dzhai ཿ pa ri pūṇ+ḍi pu bye ni zags pas dbang bskur rngo 7dga' ston legs par bsgrubs/ /snying stobs chu gter bsod nams tshogs ni pa he dz+re mū ta bā ha ཿ k+ṣa ṇa draṭ+wā ni sgu ṭa tsa kra ba r+bhe ka ma khā tsi yongs rdzogs sprin gye bzhon pas skad cig las/ /gsal bar 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal kyi mtshan ma rin ṭ+wā ni saṃ pā p+ta bān/ /a tha su ra pa ti nā sa me bh+ya hadh+yat+tha ṇa ya pa tā swa chen rnams ni yang dag thob/ /de nas lha yi bdag po —gus pa dang ldan pa/ /dga' bas mngon phyogs ya mā sa no bhi ṣik+ta ཿ / / shri ya ma bha dza ta ba bye mā na kir+bhe ste rang gi stan 4la mngon dbang bskur/ /skabs gsum tshogs kyis phyag byar 'os pa'i grags pa can/ /da sha ga ṇiḥs tsi rā yā tsakra batri/ /i ti swa dzad+mān+ta ra dṛt+ta me tah+phu 'khor los sgyur ba de yis yun ring dpal dag bsten/ /de ltar rang gi skye ba gzhan gyi tshul 'di dag /bye pa de she ka thi tai dzi ṣ+pe na / / kṛ tā ma yā sum̐ ku sha lo ya bsod nams nyer bstan dag la rgyal bas gsungs pa ni/ /bdag gis bsdebs las dge ba'i mchog ni dā bye ta t+pa n+d+ra sa tā byu da yā ya bhū yā ta / / i ti k+ṣe me n+d+ra gang thob des/ /sems can thams cad mngon par 'byung ba nyid gyur cig / ces pa snyebyang chub bi ra tsi tā dze+e bo bye sa tā ba dā na kalpa la tā yī ta dāt+pa dza so sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa las/ de nyid kyi men+d+ra kṛ tai dzī spru ta bā ha nā ba dā na masbyot+ta ra sha ta ta māḥ pa l+la sras zla ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i ltesnasprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgya rtsa brgyad 95—1111

dpal ldan rgyal ba'i rngo cod pan blon/ /blo bzang mi dbang zhes rigs la/ /gdengs can ba bhū ba sgo gīrjo bye gīn+d+ra i ba sgo ga bān/ /ta su satwa ni dheḥshrī mān dbang bzhin longs spyod can/ /longs spyod ldan pa'i dbang po byung / /snying stobs gter gyur de yi bu//gu ṇa rat+na gā ṇa shra yaḥ/ /sru nud+dhā ṇi su dh+wa yu ti sin+tuḥsen+tu ri bā yon tan rin chen tshogs kyi gnas/ /dpal ldan tshig gi ༷ bdud rtsi bskyed/ /rgya mtsho dang mtshungs rgya dha bta/ /ta gya pu traḥpra kā shen+d+raḥpra kā shen+d+ra ni sgo bhu shaṃ/ /ba khyu ba mtsho byung / /de yi bu ni rab gsal dbang / /sbyin pa'i bsod nams dag gis ni/ /byang chub sems dā na pu bye na po bye satwa gu ḍo tsi taḥ/ /k+ṣe men+d+rastu ta yasta su ka dpa'i yon tan 'os/ /sa la rab gsal dbang mtshungs byung / /de yi bu ni dge ba'i dbang / /snyan bīn+d+ra kirta tsadh+ri kā/ /tsan+d+ra gye ba di tā ya snga mā na sobe+e si bhā sa hūṃ/ /ngag 2mkhan dbang zla shar bzhin/ /gang gi grags pa zla ba'i 'od/ /dam pa'i yid ni rangs par byed//ya su rā ma ya shāḥsarba pra ban+dha pre ra ko dī dzaḥ/ /pra yā taḥsadz+dza nā gnyis skyes dam pa'i zhe skye bo dga'/ /rtsom pa thams cad skul byed pa/ /dga' ba'i grags pa gang gi ( nan+daḥpu ju pra tha ma dru ta tsā/ /tai ka dā tsikhru khā sī rna su z-iṅga ṇa ba ni—/ /bsod nams dang po'i pho nyar gyur/ /nam zhig bde bar 'khod de la/ /grogs po yon tan tai sa raḥ/ /sau ga taḥkhyu ta su kṛ ta nak+ka nā ma sa ma bh+ya dh+wata/ /ā tsar+ya go ldan pa'i mchog /legs byas grags ldan bde gshegs pa/ /na ka zhes pas rab smras pa/ /blon po sa sa ta ṭ+wā : ra ba dā na kra mo lja tā ཿ / / uñtsi tro ñtsi t+yā ba nyi tā 'tshos byin sogs kyis/ / rtogs brjod ⑦ rim pa rab spangs te/ /btus shing btus pa khyarab bsdebs pa//95—1112

ga r+ya pa r+ya bi shri khā lāḥ/ /e ka mānā nu sā ri ②ཿba re tsā bhir+ya tshigs bcad rkyang par bsdams pa dag /lam gcig nyid kyi rjes 'brang ①ba/ /mchog tu zab cing rab karka shāḥ/ /bis+t+risgyu baṇ+ḍi naḥsarnyi dzi na dzā ta ka mā li kāḥ/ /a ba dā na tu dka'/ /rgya cher bsngags pa rgyal ba yi/ /skyes rabs ④dag gi phreng ba yod/ /khyod kyi ①rtogs pa kra me ṇi ba two tu saṃ k+ṣe ba bi sta riḥ / / ra byesta thā ga ta ka thāḥbarjod pa yi/ /rim pa ④mdor bsdus rab rgyas pa/ /dga' bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtam//ko ma khā kartu marta si/ /i kyuk+taste na bi na yād+dhā ka shaṃ k+ta khyo muzla taḥ//mnyen ⑤pa dag ni bya bar 'os/ /de yis dul bas 'di brjod tshe/ /gtam de bya bar rab tu brtsams//a ba dā na tra yo kṛ tā bi ra rā mā ti dergya taḥ/ /ta taḥswasne bha ga ba rtogs pa brjod pa gsum byas nas/ /shin tu ring bas dor bar gyuradhi/ /de nas rgyal ba bcom ldan tā dzi ṣ+pe na pre ri taḥswa yo/ /sa gra ṭīh+phu na rud+mo ga ma ba dā nārba saṃ 'das/ / rang gi ⑦rmi lam du bskul te/ /rtogs pa brjod pa'i don bsdu ba'i/ /rtsom pa de yis slar gra heḥ/ /a thā bye ta swa yi na su kṛ haṃ pradzñā pra kā sha bān/ /ā tsarlo yang blangs/ /de nas shes rab snang ba can/ /slob dpon brtson 'grus bzang zhes pa/ /legs byas bīr+ya bha dā khyuḥpra khyu ta su kṛ to dz+wa laḥ/ /dz+re na shā sa na shāste ṣ+ṭa rab tu 'bar bar grags/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yis ⑧bstan bcos la/ /yid ni yongs su rab gnas pa//ba ri niṣ+ṭha ta mā na saḥ/ /ge bhi rā ga ma mārgesmir+ya yo rat+na pra dī pa hūṃ//rang nyid de khyem mngon phyogs te/ /zab mo'i ⑨lung gi lam 'dir ni/ /rin chen sgon me ⑫nyid du gyur//asmabe+e tā ba dā nā dzā kṛ te sastot+ta ra sha te/ /so men+d+ra ṇa ma yā gye bdag gi yab kyis rtogs pa brjod/ /brgya rtsa bdun ni byas pa las⑪/ /zla ba'i dbang po bdag gis ke kṛ tai maṅga la saṃ pūrte / /ya gya ha sta ga tai sarde shāsta mā yā gcig /bkra shis rdzogs pa'i slad du byas/ /gang gi lag son bstan bcos ni/ /thams cad dag pa 95—1113

shudha hūṃ/ /ā tsār+yaḥso tra srur+ya shri lī kha t+yā sarja mthi taḥ/ /sasbrat+pa re sap+ta nyid 'gyur ba/ /slob dpon nyi ma'i dpal de 'dir/ /yi ge 'god pa'i don du zhus/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa bo she bai shā khya gya si to da ye/ / kṛ te yo kalpa la ti kā dzi na bdun gyi/ /sa ga'i dkar phyogs shar ba na/ /rgyal ba skyes pa'i (dga' ston tshe/ /dpag bsam 'khri dzam+bi ma hot+pa be/ /khrirtastu rā z-i ku ṭi ru di tā pā pa sha tru pra mā the dik+ṣuṭ+wā haḥshing 'di byas so/ /'jig rten mgon po gang gi dusdig pa'i dgra bcom tshe na grags pa ni/ /sgol ma khro ki ma pi su ga to lo ka nā tha gya ya gya/ /tam+bin k+ṣiṃ bhā pa ti pa ri dṛ snye gnyer can 'khrungs phyogs su spro ba ci yang legs par song / /sa yi bdag po yongs su bstan ②pa mtha 'a shā sa naṣ+ṭha ma nan+ta saṃ to ṣā ya pra sha ma su khi rmā nim+bi to yo pra ban+dhaḥ/ /a yas da shweni sa skyong tshe/ /ra bzhi bde ba can rnams tshim pa'i sbad du gzhung 'di rnam ⑤sprul lo/ /khyed pā ram̐ dud+dhā ram̐ pra sha ma pa ri hā ram̐ ha ta bye dze+e ma hā mo hā shā ram̐ bya sa na ga kyi 'khor ba mtha' med bzlog dka' blo nyams rnams kyi rab zhi 'phrog /rmongs pa chen po'i khang pa rgya che ṇa bhā re thra thu ba the/ /ma da dre ṣā dh+wa ro bi ṣa ya bi ṣa sā re dzi na ru lam du gdung ba'i tshogs kyi khur/ /rgyags dang sdang ba'i gzhi ma yul gyi dug gi snying po rnam 'gyur can//tsikri kā ram̐ saṃ sā ram̐ ti mi ra pa ri bā ram̐ ha ra tu paḥ/ /sadho ṣa kā ri pa rab rib dag gis yongs su bsgribs pa rgyal ba'i 'od kyis 'phrog 4gyur cig /bsam pa dri ma med pa ra saṃ bi ma lā sha yā dzā kārnyi pra sā da su bha gi su kṛ ta pra yarja //rnams ni mchog tu tshim byed cing / /mdzes shing rab dang skal bzang legs byas dag dang rab tu ldan//bhū yāspri yā ya dza ga hūṃ ta di rda bi kā shi kā bye ba sur+bha ga ba tabya de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang snyan ngag zudag /rnam par khyargyas pa 'di ni 'gro rnams ta thā ga ta suḥ// //dga' ba'i slad gyur cig / ///she795—1 114

stsa/ bo bye sa twa da shā yo yaḥpra bhā saḥthra thi bī pa tiḥ/ /shārnyi li bh+ya myu/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs su/ /gang zhig sa bdag rab gsal gyis/ /glang chen mthong ga dze+e dṛṭī sa ba ཿ pā yāt+ta thā ga taḥ / /yaḥ shrī ṣe ṇasta sum̐ pā dā ta nas zhi ba thob/ /de bzhin gshegs des khyod la bsrungs1/ 1 /gang zhig dpal sdes lus byin dang/2/ma ṇi tsū ḍa: ta thā ma ṇi mra/ /mad+dhā tā su dza yaslo kā na da do tsan+d+ra pra bhaḥshi raḥ/ /de bzhin nor bu gtsug nor gyis/3/nga las nu yang 'jig rten rgyal/gozla ba'i 'od kyis mgo bo byin /5/yatso kre ba da ra dī pa yā two su pri ya dzad+mā na/ /yash+yi tā pra ti bim+bi na mut+ta shin tu dga' yi laskye bar gang / /ba da ra yi gling bgrod byas/ 6/gang zhig ri mo'i gzugs brnyan gyis//bā nu gra haṃ bya dh+wa t+pa / / sha shā sa ya : shrī gu dze+e dha n+ya bye ti ṣ+ka mu tig can ni rjes bzung ④mdzad/ 7 /gang zhig dpal sbas la bstan dang / 8 /me skyes skal ldan du sa ma bh+ya bhā tra / / na n+da su n+da rī rā shaṃ pra ya sne na dza hā ra ya ཿ / /gsungs dang / 9 /mngal nas 'byung ba bstan pa dang / 10 /gang zhig dga' bo mdzes ma la//bi rū bye ka su na ra shaṃ pā hā yaḥshākya saṃ k+ṣa yāta/ /hā rī ti kā yā da chags pa dag ni 'bad pas bsal7/ 11 /gang zhig shākya brlag byas pas/ /'phags skyes po ni dmyal ma nā ya bya kre ya k+ṣa yo ṣa te ཿ / / a da r+sha ya spru ti hā r+ya de r+pā bar gsungs/ 12 /gang zhig nor sbyin bud med ni/ /'phrog ma dul bar mdzad pa dang / 13 /cho ba tā ra rde tsa yaḥ/ /yaḥshi mā ma k+ṣi pabyem+bi mi tre yo byā ka ra ṇa tsaḥ/ /'phrul rab tu bstan pa dang /1gogang zhig lha las babs pa dang /15/gang zhig mkha' la rdo ba 'phangs/16/pā hā da r+sha mu kha snga hūṃ shā ri sru nobya yaḥ ka shaṃ / / yaḥ rnge ṇa ko byams pa dag ni lung bstan dang / 17 /gang zhig me long bzhin dang ni/ 18 /shā ri'i bu yi gtam ṭi kakyā bhū ta pu bye la k+ṣa ṇa kaṇ+ḍi kaḥ/ /yartswa mra pā lī tsa ri lta su mchog gsungs/ 19 /bsod nams mtshan nyid rna rgyan 9 can/ /gro bzhin bye rnar gang gyur dang / 20 /95byed1115

kṛ to tsi ta ma bh+ya sgye ta / / ya rtswa kṛ hā ljo ta ba gang zhig a mra skyong ma'i spyod/ /legs byas la 'os lha gsungs pa dang / 21 /gang zhig rgyal byed tshal rna tsa kro pi tā pa saṃ ga me / / pra da de pu tra dā rā di yo bzung dang / 22 /yab dang mjal ba mdzad pa dang /23/thams cad sgrol gyi skye bar gang / /bu dang bi shwan+ta ra dzad+ma ni/ /a bye niṣ+ka ma khaṃ ya: dzā taḥshākya ku le bh+ya dh+wata/ /chung ma la sogs byin/24 /shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs gyur pa/ /gang gis mngon par 'byung ba mdzad/25/mā ra bi dru ba rde kṛ tā shā kyot+patrī mu bā tsa yaḥ/ /yaḥsgo ṇa bdud ni rnam par btul mdzad nas/26 /shākya 'byung bar d+ngha gang gsungs dang / 27/skye ba gzhan la ko ṭī dzi shā khyaḥshrī māñdzad+mān+ta re bha bta/ /dha na sā lā bhe dh+wa rna yaḥsha shā sa dpal ldan gang / /gro bzhin bye ba nyi shur gyur/ 28 /gang zhig nor skyong zhes pa yi/ /glang chen dag ma da kuñdza ram/ /yaḥkā shi pun+da raḥshādh+ri k+ṣurnyi me ba bya tsin+ta yata/ /ni stsos pa btul/ 29 /gang zhig kā dushi'i mdzes pa yis/ /zhi slad bzod pa rnam par bsams/ 30 /su baṇ+ḍi pār+sha nā mā si r+yaḥsatwa hi ta kṛ ta mṛ gaḥ/ /ka s+thā ṇa kā ri sems can phan byed ri dwags gang / /gser gyi logs zhes bya bar gyur/ 31 /gnod byed la yang rnam ya: byu da pa kā re pya bi kri yaḥ/ /yo bi shā khaḥswa dzā yā yāḥpā pā tsā 'gyur med/ /dge byed dag tu gang gyur dang / 32 /rang gi chung ma'i sdig spyod las/ /khyad par lo ma rābye ra byeta/ /di de sha nā ga yoḥshārnyi yabya nasdo ba nan+da yoḥ/ /tsakra phru gang chags bral/ 33 /dga' bo nyer dga'i klu dag la/ /gang gis zhi ba bstan pa dang / 34/brtse ba'i ha su dat+ta suḥ yāḥ pra sā rda da yā ni dhiḥ / / yo bha ba sgo ṣi laḥgater ni krugang zhig gis/ /khyem legs sbyin la rab dang mdzad/ 35 /gang zhig dpal ldan gdengs 6 shrī mān puṇ+ḍi ཿ pūṇ+ḍi gu ṇa sta thā/ / be+e ra gyu ta rū ka paṃ gu two can gyur/ 36 /de bzhin gang po yon tan gang / 37 /chags bral dpal las phyir phyogs pas/ /gang 95—1116

sa d+dhā tu ra byā dhi hā ri yo bhūt+pa two ṣa dh+wa bhi dhaḥ / / sat+tha da do nad kyis gzir ba kun 'phrog gang / /sems can sman lngazhes brjod gyur dang / 54 /'dab chags bskyab bha bar+yabya kha ga tā na swa de ha daḥ/ /tsa kri go pā la nā ga gya shārnyi la rang lus ster —/ /thams cad ster bar gang gyur dang /55/gang gis klu ni ba glang snye skyong / /gzigs pa ka ra dṛ shi ba yaḥ/ /yat+tha bhā be+e na ba su dh+wa rat+na tsi dh+yā ki tā bha bta/ /nyid kyis zhi bar mdzad/56/gang gis mthu yis nor 'dzin ni/ /rin chen mchod rten gyis mtshan ā sītru bye ba lo ya bya ro gārte tā ṇa ba rnya ba ཿ / / ku rja laḥ shī gyur—/ 57/nad kyis gzir ba skyob pa'i gnyen/ /bsod nams stobs su gang gyur dang /58/tshul ldan ku 2 la bārmyo byuta nā ga shadhi bya dh+wa stso yaḥ/ /kar+ṣa kaḥshrī pa do yo byuta ya la lar gang gyur/ 57 /gang gis klu ni zhi bar mdzad/ 60 /gang zhig zhing pa bkra shis gyur/ 61 /zhi 6sho dā khya: shas+t+ri mān / / yaḥ kā sh+ya pā nu gra ha 1 ta pā p+ta bār+ya bya ldan grags sbyin zhes pa 7dang / 62 /gang gis 'od srungs rjes bzung dwa mdzad/ 63 /gang gis mi 'am kin+da rī/ /mu nir+yabye ka shri gi byu ta ka bibya k+ṣi ti pāt+pa dzaḥ/ /ci mo thob/ 64/ rwa gcig thub — par gang gyur dang / 65/sa skyong bu ni snyan dngags mkhan/ 66 /yaḥ saṃ gha ra k+ṣi ta bhi hūṃ tsa kā rārta ta pa do di tai/ /pā ha pa d+mā gang zhig rkadage slong dge 'dun srungs/ 67 /dgra bcom gnas su bskyed ḍa 1mdzad dang / /pad+ma can gyi ba tī bṛ j-i dha dz+re rā dzasbri tai tsa yaḥ / / kashrī re 6 bi hā rārgyu yasmi tshul rab gsungs/68/gang zhig chos rgyal rab tu gnas/69/gang phyir nyi ma zhe rta gud pa yis/ /kha cher mā dh+yarnyi kau bya jo ta / /shā ṇa pā sbo be+e hā ram̐ yo ma thu rā yī bi ni dz+re gtsug lag khang mchod bsgrubs/ 70 /shā na'i gos kyis bcom brlag tu/ /gang zhig gtsug lag khang sprul me / /u pa gup+tabya ya sngarnye ba bhū bā lak+ṣa rto dzi naḥ/ /yasmṛ t+yā sho ka dang / 71 /gang gi 5mjug tu nyer sbas ni/ /bdud las rgyal bar gyur pa dang / 72 /mi bdag mya ngan 95—11 18

kā rād+mābhār+bherlo bha bad+me tra ka t+yā kaḥ/ /shā rgyu su mā ga sgo tsakra swa ya mā ga mdza' bo'i bu mo yis/ /ma yi gnod las gzir thob gyur/92/gang zhig rang nyid byon pa yis/ /ma ga dha me na na yaḥ / / ya sho mi tra gya yaste : ma ha rat+tha sha rmā bu bzang bsngags 'os mdzad/ 93 /gang zhig rab zhi'i chu sbyin gyis/ /grags pa'i bshes gnyen skom pa daḥ / /tso ro dzad+mān+ta re byā gh+ra shā ba kau tsa ra rak+ṣa yaḥ/ /madh+ri brga ga bsal—/ 94 /skye ba gzhan la stag phrug dang / /rkun po dag ni gang gis bsrungs/ 95 /glang dbang dag dzerjo paḥ kats+tsha pa: ba ṇistsa rna/ /tsa kā ra ku sha la pe tād+ma gi ①blon po'i sde/96/tshong pa'i skye bo rus sbal gyis/97/gang gi 'usngon byi dka' thub can/ 98 /gyad lbāk+ṣiṃt+tha tā pa sān/ /yabya ro hi ta madzñā byurbo ra swās+thā ya pad+ma kaḥ/ /yaḥpra rnams dge ba ldan par mdzad/ /grong ba gso slad pad+ma can/ 99 /ro nyi ta yi nyar gyur gang / /gang zhig bhā sa ཿ sha n+d+ra bhe dze shā mā ka bya gu ru pri yaḥ / / sau ho ra k+ṣa yaḥrab gsal bde ba bsten/100/sngo bsangs bla ma dag la gus/101/gang zhig don mthun seng ges sārja thra ya bi ṇ+ḍa : yo bha ba ta / / ta sum̐ yaḥ sha sha ka spra dā ta bsrungs—/ 102 /gang zhig dga' ba'i gong bur gyur/ 103 /ri bong can gyi 1lus byin gang /10gari ba ti tsodz+dza hā ra yaḥ/ /pu ro pa mā rmā yaḥpā ha ka tsā ka na ka gang ④gis ri ba 3ta dag bton/ 105 /gser gyi go cha dag gi gtam/ /grong khyer lta bu gang ba n+d+ra ṇaḥ / / rasne dṛ pa su tā sruste yabyu shusbyo da no gra tī ta / /gsungs dang / 106 /zas gtsang gang gis rin chen gyis/ /mi bdag bu mo'i legs bshad blangs//de ha dā tā pha ṇi tā ṇi yo khyuspyo rū ta bā ha na ཿ / / sasgon+ta tā gdengs can skyabs la lus byen pa/ 107 /sprin gyi bzhon bupar gang gyur pa'o/ 108 /kun las mtho ya su gtā ya gu ṇa nī tā ya bha drwa ya bhū ri ta ra bīr+ya ba lak+ṣa mā ya/ /zhing bde gshegs yon tan dag dang ldan/ /bzang zhing rab mang brtson 'grus stobs dang bzod pa can//95—1120

un+d+ra li tā ku sha la rū la bha ba dru mā ya tasmi na mo bha ga ba te ma da bā ra ṇa ya/ /mi dge ① rtsa ba srid pa'i ljon pa rab 'joms pa/ /rgyags pa zlog ge/mdzad bcom ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo//yā baṭ+wā rā ta ru ṇa ka ru shā lo ki m+bi bhat+ta bhā dze+e ka spyo rja dzā ku la ma 'jig rten du ni ji srid sgol ma snying rje dar bab kyis gzigs shing / /grub slad gus ldan dge ba rnams bi ka lo sedhe ye san+di dhabye/ /lo ke yā babyi ma la ku sha la dh+yā na dhīzlo ka nā la ma tshang med pa'i 'bras bu sgrub/ /ji srid 'jig rten mgon po dri med dge ba'i bsam gtan blo ldan pa//thastu bod+maspyi bi bu dha ba da rmā mo di rmā yi ka thās+t+ri/ /yā babyeḥs ka la de srid mkhas pa'i zhal gyi dga' skyed sangs rgyas gtam 'di gnas gyur cig /ji srid sangs rgyas srid pa khyu ba noṭ+wā ra khyo ya pra busgo yā ba dha dz+reḥ su kṛ ta sa ra ṇi swe ra mtha' dag bsgral slad rab tu rgyas gyur cing du / /ji srid chos ni legs byas lam dag rab gsal rin rat+na pra dī paḥ/ /yā bahūṃ ghaḥs rā sa ma na sī dat+ta ka spyo ṇa saṃ ghaḥsbe chen sgon mar gyur/ /ji srid dge 'dun chags ldan yid la dge ba'i tshogs sbyin de srid du/ /dpag yārtswa balja na gu ṇa ka thā kalpa bal+li na be+e yo/ /yā badhūsgori bhū z-ih+phu ta bsam 'khri shing gsar pa rgyal ba'i yon tan gtam 'di gnas gyur cig /ji srid sa gzhi rab mang sa sa li la tsa lad+mā li kā she ṣa shīste mā yu rats+tshat+tha sho bhā ma nu bha ba 'dzin las 'bab g.yo ba'i chu yi phreng ldan lhag ma yi④/ /mgo la gdengs ka rin chen 'od zer rgyas pas ti pha ṇa rat+na raṭī pra tā ṣ+peḥ/ /dhatrī yā bah+phu me ruḥk+ṣi ti ta la ka ma le rma bya'i gdugs kyis sprimadzes pa'i rjes su spyod/ /ji srid sa gzhi pad+ma 'u dag la lhun po ze 'bru'i rnam pa'i kaṇi kā kā ra kārnyi shāstu stu baṅka the yo ka la ya tu dza ga hūṃ kaṇ+ḍi pū ra pra mdzes pa 'dzin byed pa/ /de srid ston pa'i gtam 'di 'gro ba'i rna rgyan dag tu rab tu gnas pa bsten ge ti jom—/ /sa mābe+e bo bye saṭ+wā ba dā na kalpa la tā kṛ ti ra yo ma hā gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing snyan dngags mkhan chen 095—1121

ka beḥshrī k+ṣe men+d+ra gya// //po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //yon tan phul du byung ba dpag tu med pas spras pa'i bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po dang / mi'i dbang po dbon chen shākya bzang po'i bka' lung gis/ rgya gar byi mkhan po snyan dngags mkhan chen po lal+lī ka ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ra17ba dge slong shong ston gyis mang yul 'phags pa'i drung dge 'dun bzhi sde'i 'ugatsug lag khang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du rgya dpe dang gtugs nas zhus 1dag tshar bar byas so / /(ngu skad gnyis ka la zhu chen zhib pa cig grub pas gzhan las khyad du 'phags so// //rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod snyan ngag chen po dpag bsam 'khri shing zhes bya'i bstan bcos skad gnyis zung du sbyar ba 'dir/ /yi ge pa dang dag byed pa yi skyon las yig 'bru lhag chad brda nor 'khrul pa ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'di yi skad gnyis zung sbyar thog mar byed po 'jig rten mig gyur chos skyong bzang po zhes bya'i dge slong gis/ /legs sbyar gzhung dang sdeb sbyor bstan bcos bod skad brda yi bstan bcos dang bstun blo gros zhib mos dag par babyus// //sdeb sbyor rgyun chags gnyis pa'i chu rgyun/pernga ni mi ta ud ha rim re khāblu haṃ sāg rak+ṣe tra ta ཿ ānu radzñāñtsasaṃ khyeṇamatshan dpe'i ri mo ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing gi rdul snyed grangs kyis mthong na mi mthun med pā shā pra tī ku la ru pa ma dha su ṣ+ṭa sha ri swa ram̐ pā da a be+e ka bi shā ra ta ཿ swa swa bhā ṣāpa'i sku/ /snyan 'jibs sgra dbyangs tshig don gcig gis sna tshogs 'gro ba'i rang rang skad dang dbang por sgo be sbra d+me bā kra / / ya tha ya thi bi da ta ཿ sbi te ta t+pa ro pho k+ṣu lpa ba sgo bi sa rba'ajug pa tshangs pa'i gsung / /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la sgog gyur ma de cung zad mi mnga' rnam pa dzha ta byet+ta shā kyagya ut+ta mya po ru ṣam dhu ya sha nām shornyo da na shwe ta tsātā gra bhā ba bluthams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /shākya'i skyes mchog zas gtsang sras zhes grags snyan gdugs dkar srid oṃtena.adhīshur+ghaṃbhar+ṣapaḥ / /rtser 'khor des dus kun dge legs char du bsnyil/ /95—1122

yid 'phrog rin chen gdu bus legs spras 'jam mnyen phyag sor rtse mos bskul ba'i rgyud mangs sgrar//srid zhi'i chos kun nyams dang 'grur ba'i rgyan gyi glur len dri za'i na chung dbyangs can la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i snying gi ze 'brur thugs rje'i 'jo sgeg gar gyis rtag tu legs bzhugs nas/ /smra ba lce yi bang mdzod 'bum sder 'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i shis pa 10/ /mkhyen rab rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsrings mang thos sdong bu dar babs las/ /rgyal ba'i rnam thar yal 'dab brgya rtsa yongs 'du'i 'khri shing g.yur za'i rtser/ /bsod nams phung po smin pa'i 'bras bzang dpyod ldan 'chi med dga' ston che/ /spel mdzad dge ba'i dbang po yab sras 'phags yul mkhas mang gtsug gi rgyan/ /ye shes nyi ma 'og min mkha' dkyil nas/ /shar ba'i rnam 'phrul 'od zer ches 'bar gzis/ /gdul dka'i gdung mun sel la snying stobs khur/ /bla nas blar 'degs dwa/don kun grub pa'i dpal/ /gang de'i sngon dang da lta'i mdzad bzang chab/ /rnam mkhyen mes po'i ral klung sbubs 'khyil las/ /rmad byung gtam gyi zigs gcig gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /log rtog dri ma 'khrud pa'i zhabs bsil mchog /daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /sgra don rgyan gyi bzhin ras rab shar ba/ /legs bshad dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' yis/ /shes ldan kun byu brtan pa cig car phrogs/ /bod rgan drang srong mang pos blun dad kyis/ /smod mtshon rtogs brjod mgrin sngon la phab mthar/ /grong tshig mtshan ma tsam la lhar bzung nas/ /dam pa'i gsung zhes 'dud rnams skal ba phra/ /gti mug mun 'thibs log sgom khung bu ru/ /rlom pas rab 'khyil nyon mongs dug gi lces/ /thar 'dod srog la rgol ba phyag rgya'i khyu/ /tha snyad rtsi la phrag dog dbang gis bshung / /byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen rmi cha shas gang / /lci yang sdeb sbyor ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes—/ /snyan 'gyur ga pur gzegs ma 'bum 'dzag pa/ /bstan bcos kun+da'i gnyen la 'khu sems can—/ /rnam dpyod mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor bag la zha/ /res 'ga' gdol gtam du ba'i mjug ma rkyong / /brtsams chos rgyu skar khrod na gnong ba'i gzas/ /'gran de cher rlom mang po'i ngag sgros rgyan/ /rlung gis rtser g.yengs sbur ma stes dbang gis/ /mthon por chags min gong ma'i lung las kyis/ /sa gsum rnam 'dren 'phags pa'i bdag rkyen las/ /rtogs brjod che 'di kha ba'i sman ljongs dar/ /phra mo'i 'grur bcos tsam la lo chen du/ /zlas sems mgron bus mig dbang phyid min par/ /gtsug lag gangs ri'i spo na brda sprod kyi/ /rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i zhu chen shong ston rje/ /blo gros dzamyu'i snye mas nyer btungs pa/ /chos phung rgya mtsho'i snying po legs bshad gser/ /'dren byed gangs can bstan pa'i shing 95—1123

rta che/ /don gyi gnas lnga rig pa lo chen dpang / /gna' bo'i lugs srol sgon mes khol bo'i mun/ /bsal tshe gcam bus bsngags dang mtshungs min par/ /chos kun mkhyen pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /rgyal bstan yongs kyi mkhar shar chos skyong bzang / /tshul 'di'i 'chad nyan ma snyigs ut+pa la/ /rna gong mdzes rgyan gsar pa'i spel legs su/ /skal bar thob 'di bstan la gces 'dzin pa/ /bshes gnyen rim byon bka' drin pha mtha' yas/ /khyad par lnga rig lang tsho na dar blos/ /drang srong phur bu'i khengs pa 'phrog nus can/ /sā la'i ljongs kyi lha dbang smon 'gro ba/ /nges par thams cad mkhyen de'i rnam dpyod mthu/ /dge dbang zhal lung dpyid kyi bser bu yis/ /mkhas mang 'dod ldan pa spu nyer bslang nas—/ /tshig don mchu sgos ches dmar ro bda' bar/ /yid kyi shing rta lan brgyar rgyug pa byel/ /de tsam sngon byung gtam gyi skyor zlos las/ /da lta 'khri shing chu gter lta zhog gi/ /mkhas dbang dpa' bo'i gsung rab pagru yang / /sgol ba'i blo gros gru gzings nyin skar bzhin/ /kṛ tī'i mtshan ltas drang srong tshig gi mdas/ /chos brgyad lcags kyi gtun bu bdun skyes pa/ /bstan 'dzin khyab 'jug gya gyu'i gar mkhan phal/ /drang po'i glegs bu gcan gzan mdun gyi rtswa/ /'on te rgyal bstan lnga phrag drug pa'i dus/ /gnam bskos sa spyod las shugs dar la drag /skye rgu'i legs byas mtsho mjing zab rgya ches/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i spun zla 'byung srid snyam/ /de phyir slob lam dus nas 'gro kun la/ /brtse bas bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnam thar dri/ /lo rgyus ma la ya rlung gis drangs pas/ /yid kyi tsha gdung sel ba'i mdza' gcugs ma/ /bla med byang chub ched du bya dka'i tshogs/ /grangs med bskal gsum bsags pa'i bden dpang du/ /sa yi lha mo kun bzod las 'phags phyir/ /brdzun phreng gzhan 'drid gleng mo'i rjes 'gro min//gdul dka'i zhing 'dir pad mtshor ngang pa ltar/ /dgyes dgur 'jug pa'i lhag bsam snying stobs la/ /sras bcas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus pas/ ches cher bsngags pa'i gtam snyan snying la sdem/ /dpyad bzod rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa'i zla/ /kun rtog 'bum phrag rdzing bur shar ba'i gzugs/ /gzhan rkyen rlung gis bskyod min rdo ba'i ngos/ /bris pa'i ri mo g.yo med dngos po'i gshis/ /blo gsal rgya mtshor rtag 'bab glegs bam klung / /'dzad med par gye ma dros chu gter che/ /'phel 'grib med gang byed po gaṅga'i yab/ /rab dkar sems kyi rtse mo mkha' la bsnyeg /dri bral 'byor pa'i 'o mtsho legs 'khyil bar/ /sgo gsum brtson pa'i ljon pa bsgril ba las/ /snying po tshogs gnyis cher spungs rtsi bcud mar/ /byang chub mchog gi zungs su 'gyur bar shog /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs de snyed lus 95—1124

can kun/ /bsod nams sa bon grangs med skye srid cing / /btab smin g.yur du za ba'i snye ma la/ /spyod pa'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod gyur cig /ltar snang sna tshogs grub mtha'i mtshan mun klong / /sgra tshad bzo gso nang rig rta bdun can/ /gung shar thos bsam sgom pa thub pa'i bstan/ /lung rtogs snang ba dam pa'i dpal 'bar shog /'jam dpal mi yi zlos gar btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i sde/ /'dzam gling skye dgu'i bsod nams mchod sdong du/ /nyi zlas mun sel de srid brtan gyur cig /tshangs pas ka ba med pa gnam gye sgo/ /phye nas mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal srid du/ /nyer bskos sa yi brgya byen mchod yon zung / /dbang thang dpal mgrin can dang skal mnyam shog /spyi dang khyad par rgya hor gangs can 'dir/ /ring por 'cho ①ba'i nya phyibs khog yangs par/ /sdig 'bras dri bral bde skyid mubhi ka /cher srungs thar pa'i srad bur brgyu bar shog /yongs 'du'i 'bras bzang gtong bar lag rkyong ba'i/ /byed por gtogs kun 'dir bstan rnam par thar/ /'dzin las ldog byed sdig dang rang gi rgyud/ /cung zad tsam yang lhan cig gnas min shog /nye ring med par kun la rab 'jug rgyal ba'i thugs rje nyin byed dbang / /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun stug rab bcil phan bde'i pad dkar dga' tshal du/ /mchog gsum dam par bstod bsngags dar dir blo gros bung ba gzhon nu'i glus/ /dus mkhyen rgyal po'i bsod nams de snyed 'gro kun gyis thob bkra shis shog /de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i dbang po de nyid kyi zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa ni ②sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin la/ 'on kyang gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par mdo dang lung las gsungs pa rnams tshad ma'i dpang por byas te 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po slob dpon dpa' bos 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa/slob dpon seng ge zhabs 'bring pas skyes rabs sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mis 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ dpal dga' ba'i lhas klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ chos rgyal dge dbang yab sras kyis rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsal 'khri shing sogs mdor na mkhas pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi rigs gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba ji snyed cig yod pa'i nang nas rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid brjod bya don dang 'byel pas rtogs sla/ rjod byed rgyan dang 'byel pas rna bar snyan/ tshig rkang sdeb sbyor dang 'brel pas gcod mtshams byed/ ming mngon brjod dang 'brel bas ngo mtshar ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin pas phun sum tshogs la/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu'i chos 'byung du 'di nyid la slob dpon gsung ba ni slob dpon dang rgyal po mi 'gal ba'i dbang du mdzad pa 95—1125

ste—/ don du 'di nyid sa spyod chen po yin pa'i khungs ni/ dpal ldan rgyal ba'i cod pan blon/ /blo bzang mi dbang zhes rigs la/ /gdengs can dbang bzhin longs spyod can/ /longs spyod ldan pa'i dbang po byung / /zhes dpal ldan shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po'i mdun na 'don du gyur pa'i mi'i dbang po'i rigs brgyud las byung ba yin la/ de yang mes po rgyal po rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i sras sa spyod rab gsal du grags pa lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa de nyid kyi sras su bltams pa'i chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang pos bstan bcos 'di mdzad pa'i rkyen yang / gnyis skyes dam pa'i skye bo dga'/ /rtsom pa thams cad skul byed pa/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ de nas rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rang gi rmi lam du bskul te/ /zhes pa'i bar byis bstan pa ltar bstan bcos 'di rtsoms shig par dang por bram zes bskul ba—/ bar du grogs kyis bskul ba/ tha mar bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis bskul ba la brten nas rab gsal nas bzung / zas gtsang ma'i rtogs brjod kyi bar brgya rtsa bdun po rnams rgyal po rang nyid kyis mdzad nas/ sprin la zhon gyi rtogs brjod bkra shis kyi grangs tshang ba'i slad du dge ba'i dbang po nyid kyis rang gi sras zla ba'i dbang po la rtsoms shig par bskul bas na/ de yis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod/ /brgya rtsa bdun po 'di dag byas/ /bkra shis grangs ni rdzogs pa la/ /gcig ni rab tu 'bad pas bya/ /zhes gsal bar bstan pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di nyid snyan dngags kyi tshig sbyor la ldog pa shar ba'i lugs kyis tshig rna bar mi 'jibs shing don go dka' ba ma yin par dngos lho pa'i lugs kyi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa kho na'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ tshigs bcad rkyang par bsdams pa dag /lam gcig nyid kyi rjes 'brangs pa/ /mchog tu zab cing rab tu dka'/ /rgya cher bsngags pa rgyal ba yi//skyes rabs dag gi phreng ba yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i lam gcig nyid kyi rjes 'brangs pa zhes pa'i tshig gcig pu 'dis lho phyogs pa'i lam kho na dang mthun par dngos su bstan to zhes mkhas pa'i dbang po grangs chen lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rjes ngoms bshad du mdzad pa ni bla na med pa'i legs par bshad pa'o/ /de yang bod 'dir rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' 'dzin pa'i bla chen mang pos rtogs brjod 'di ni rgyal pos brtsams pas byin rlabs mi 'byung zhes smra ba ni chargyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti dang / bod kyi chos rgyal mes dbon sogs dam pa mang po la'ang smod par 'gyur ba'i ngag gi las ngan gsog par zad cing / mkhas zlas la la dag dge dbang yab sras gzigs rgya chung bas bstan bcos 'dir sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ma yin pa'i gang zag gzhan gyi rtogs brjod mang du yod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam thar kho na min no 95—1126

zhes smra ba ni smra ba po rang nyid rtogs brjod 'di la blo gros kyi 'jug pa zhib mor ma byas shing / mdo lung rnams dang ma 'dris pa'i rang gi nang cha phyir ston pa kho na ste/ dam pa'i grib bsel dang ldan brtan pa'i chos kyi rtsa bas bskor zhing bsod nams ra bar gnas/ /blo dang rig pa snying rje la sogs chu yis rnam mdzes rnam par rgyas pa'i yal ga can/ /chog shes dri med yal 'dab grags snyan dkar ba'i me tog rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /bsam kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dpal ldan sangs rgyas ljon pa rnam par rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'dis rtogs brjod rin po che'i tshig don mdor bstan pa yin la/ bstan tshul khyad chos dang po ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms byed pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang por byang chub tu thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags—/ mthar bdud bzhi bcom nas sangs rgyas pa ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam par thar pa'i rtsa ba yin pas/ dam pa'i grib bsel sogs kyi don tshul 'di dang mthun par 'chad tshul ji ltar zhe na/dang por theg pa chen por rigs nges pa'i dam bca' mi 'gyur bar brtan pa'i chos smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed kyi rtsa bas rab tu bskor zhing 'phel ba ni rgyas bshad yal 'dab dang po rab gsal gye rtogs brngod dang / brgya pa bsod nams rab gsal rmi rtogs brjod gnyis kyis bstan/ bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi ra bar gnas pa la byang chub kyi blo dang rig pa shes rab dang brtse ba snying rje chen po gsum dngos su bstan la/ sogs khongs nas sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan lnga shugs kyis bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i chu yis rnam par mdzes par byas nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis kyi sdong bu ches cher rgyas pa yin pas/ de'i don rtogs brjod 'dir rgyas par phye ba'i skabs yal 'dab gnyis pa dpal sde/ gsum pa gtsug nor/ bzhi pa nga las nu/ lnga pa zla 'od/ nyer bzhi pa thams cad sgrol/ zhe gsum pa gser mdog /nga gcig pa gser ldan/ nga gnyis pa bsod nams mi dman/nga lnga pa thams cad ster/ nga brgyad pa bsod nams stobs/ re bzhi pa nor bzang / don dgu pa dbang chen sde/ gya lnga pa phan pa tshol/ go lnga pa stag mo lus byin/ go drug pa glang po/ /go bdun pa rus sbal/ go dgu pa pad+ma can/ brgya dang gsum dga' ba'i gong bu/ brgya dang bzhi ri bong / brgya dang brgyad sprin zhon rnams sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sbyar/ so gsum pa khyad par lo ma/ so brgyad pa lkugs pa 'bye bo/ /gya drug pa ba men gsum tshul khrims la sbyar/ sum cu pa kā shi mdzes dga'/ so 95—1127

gnyis pa dge byed/ so dgu pa bzod pa la dga' ba/ zhe drug pa byas shes/ go gnyis pa mdza' bo'i bu mo rnams bzod pa la sbyar/ drug pa ba da ra bgrod/ zhe brgyad pa don grub/ brgya dang drug pa gser gyi go cha rnams brtson 'grus la sbyar/ nga bzhi pa sems can sman/ re lnga pa rwa gcig pa/ gya brgyad pa nag pa glang po bstan/ go brgyad pa dka' thub pa/ brgya dang gcig pa sngo bsangs can rnams bsam gtan la sbyar/ bco brgyad pa me long bzhin/ so gcig pa gser logs/ nga gsum pa legs bshad tshol/ re drug pa snyan ngag mkhan/ go gcig pa shi bi legs bshad/ brgya dang gnyis pa seng ge/brgya dang bdun pa zas gtsang ma rnams shes rab la sbyar/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi rang rang gi re ba dang mthun par bsam pa kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin la/ de nyid rtogs brjod du rgyas par bye ba ni/bdun pa mu tig 'khri shing / brgyad pa dpal sbas/ dgu pa me skyes/ bcu pa mngal byung / bcu gcig pa mdzes dga'/ bcu gnyis pa 'phags skyes po/ bcu gsum pa 'phrog ma/ bcu bzhi pa cho 'phrul bstan pa/ bco lnga pa lha babs/ bcu drug pa brag 'phangs pa/ bcu bdun pa byams pa lung bstan—/ bcu dgu pa shā ri'i bu/ nyi shu pa gro bzhin bye ba rna/ nyer gcig pa a mra skyong / nyer gnyis pa rgyal byed tshal yongs su bzung ba/ nyer gsum pa yab sras mjal ba/ nyer lnga pa mngon par byung ba/ nyer drug pa bdud bcom pa/ nyer bdun pa shākya 'byung ba/ nyer brgyad pa gro bzhin bye ba nyi shu pa/ nyer dgu pa nor skyong / so bzhi pa dga' bo nyer dga' btul ba/ so lnga pa legs byen/so drug pa gdangs can/ so bdun pa gang po/ bzhi bcu pa ser skya/ zhe gcig pa u ṭa ya/ zhe gnyis pa mkhas pa/ zhe bzhi pa gser lag /zhe lnga pa ma skyes dgra/ zhe bdun pa sā la'i sdong bu/ zhe dgu pa glang po can/ lnga bcu pa las bcu spyad pa/ nga drug pa ba lang skyong btul ba/ nga bdun pa mchod rten/ nga dgu pa ku lā la/ drug cu pa klu gzhon/ re gcig pa zhing pa/ re gnyis pa grags byin—/ re gsum pa 'od srungs/ re bdun pa dge 'dun srungs/ re brgyad pa pad+ma ldan/ re dgu pa chos rgyal rab gnas/ bdun cu pa nyi ma gung pa/ don gcig pa sha na'i gos can/ don gnyis pa nyer sbas/ don gsum pa klu la springs pa/ don bzhi pa sa gzhi phul ba/ don lnga pa rten 'byel bcu gnyis—/ don drug pa bi du ra/ don bdun pa ke na ya ka /don brgyad pa brgya byin lhung ba/ brgyad cu pa rab bzang / gya gcig pa rgyu'i mchog /gya gnyis pa dmyal ba mngon ldan/ gya gsum pa sgra 95—1128

gcan zin/ gya bzhi pa sbrang rtsi dbyangs/ gya bdun pa pad can/ gya dgu pa chos sred/ dgu bcu pa nor can/ go gsum pa ma ga dha/ go bzhi pa grags pa'i bshes gnyen/ brgya dang lnga pa ri ba ti'i yal 'dab rnams mngon par sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu'i mdzad pa la sbyar nas bshad ma thag pa'i mdzad pa de dag thams cad khyad chos gnyis pa rjod byed kyi tshig rgyan nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gis ngo mtshar bas 'di las lhag pa gzhan du tshol mi dgos pa'i chog shes shing rgyan sbyor tshul log pa sogs rtsom pa'i skyon gyi dri ma cung zad tsam yang sbags pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa ngo mtshar ba'i rgyan gyis blo ldan rnams kyi yid rang dbang du 'phrog cing / khyad chos gsum pa rnam par rgyas pa'i sdeb sbyor gye yal ga mtha' klas pa can rin chen 'byung gnas sogs nas bshad pa'i lci yang 'khrul pa med pas gcod mtshalas byed—/ khyad chos bzhi pa phul du byung ba'i grags pa'i snyan pa ming gi mngon brjod mjos pas dkar ba me tog gi lachung g.yur du za ba la brten nas/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rtogs brjod kyi ljon pa chen po skyes bu dam pa'i thugs rje'i grib bsil dang ldan pa la lus can kun bde bar ngal gso ba 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi legs bshad nyi ma chen po 'di nyid mngon sum du lta ba'i skal bar gyur na log rtog gi mun pa thams cad bsangs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rje sa paṇa gyi gsung chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs la nye bar bzhag ste bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dang dpon chen shākya bzang po gnyis kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'phags yul gyi snyan dngags mkhan chen po lakhyi ka ra la brten nas mang yul 'phags pa'i drung du bod kyi skad du legs par bsgyur/ de nas bzung ste zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po dngos kyi slob mar bcas pa'i bar du gtsug lag 'di nyid la dpyis phyin par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur gyur cing / de nas dus kyi dpang gis legs par sbyangs pa'i dpyod ldan ches cher dkon na'ang rgyun cung zad ma nyams tsam gnas pa las rtogs brjod rin po che 'di'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams kyis zhib mor bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shong ston nas rim pa bzhin gcung lo chen blo gros brtan pa/ lo mchog pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dbang lo chen po/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen nam mkha' bzang po/ lo chen shes rab dpal/ lo chen thugs rje dpal/ mtshungs med budha'i mtshan can/ gnas brtan legs pa rgyal mtshan—/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ de'i dbon pad dkar chos skyong / grangs chen lo tsā ba 95—1129

'jam dpal rdo rje/ smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang don grub/ rigs chos kyi sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung du skad gnyis smra ba za hor byi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos thos so/ /lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po/ sras zla ba'i dbang po/paṇ+ḍi ta laskyi ka ra/ shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gcung blo gros brtan pa/ dpon chos skyong dpal/dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ kun spangs rnam rgyal grags pa/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde/ mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/rje tshe dbang kun mkhyen/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag ①dbang rnam rgyal/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ yang na dpal khang lo tsā nas/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/'jam dbyangs kun mkhyen tshe dbang nas/ rje chos dbyings rang grol gyi bar gong bzhin te/ de las bdag gis nos shing / bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun la bsams nas thos bsam gyi ched 0du 'chad nyan sgo gsum 'bad pas bsgrubs pa las bzang rdzu 'ug pa sbos pa'i 'gying tshul lhur len pa rnams dang 'dra ba ni ma yin no/ /de yang srid pa mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i klong ltar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du shes nas 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i gang zag ches dkon na'ang / dus kyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i longs spyod la sred pa ches cher 'phel kyang mang du thos pa'i tshul la blo sna bstungs te/ nges 'byung sru sud kyi rnam pas gsol 'debs thang thung dang bzlas bsgom sems khrid sad sud kyi yig cha la sha rul la sbrang ma 'thibs pa ltar 'du zhing / gzhung chen po rnams yal bar 'dor ba'i dbang gis gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo'i yig cha la mkhas rlom gzhan gyi brtsam chos gang gis kyang bsgrun du med pa grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas grub chen po nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sngon med kyi legs bshad dri med 'od rgyan par du 'khod na'ang don du gnyer ba ches dkon pas/ rtogs brjod rin po che 'di nyid kyang par du brkos pa par mkhan rnams kyi yan lag ngal ba'i dka' thub lhur len pa tsam du zad mod/ 'on te rgya gar gyi paṇa chen kha spu can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa gsar du brtsams pa dang / skad gnyis smra ba'i 95—1130

lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur zhing rjes 'jug gi bstan 'dzin mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa ni rang nyid mkhas par bsgrub pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang gya tshom rmis tshul der zhugs pa ma yin par de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa med pa'i 'gro ba rnams dad pa gsar du spel ba dang / dad pa dang ldan pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur bas rang gzhan kyi bsod nams dpag tu med pa gsog pa'i phyir dkon mchog tā la las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pas bde 'gro'i grong khyer mtshon pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis dga' ba nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun zhing / lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i bka' drin las sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/dbon pad dkar chos skyong / skyogs ston smon grub lo tsā ba/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can snyems pa'i sde sogs skad gnyis smra ba'i lo chen mang du byon zhing / de dag las brgyud pa'i yang slob dang nying slob rgya cher gyur pa'i nang tshan sgang rgan 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang grangs chen lo tsā ba'i drin las smon 'gro ba yab sras sogs tshad thub kyi mkhas pa kha yar byung yang deng song ni zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i gsung las| tshul de lta na yang pur rgyal 'dir/ /gzhan kun la phyogs med gtong ba dang / /rang legs bshad tshol bar rlom na yang / /don byen len gnyis ka gser las dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar glegs bam 'di nyid la gzigs pa lhur len pa dkon pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas par bshad pa'i da lta lnga phrag drug pa'i nang du yod pas gzhung lugs 'di dag 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig 'ong srid snyam rang gis rang la blo bag nye bar bsros te skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi ma dpe 'di bzhin rgya dpe dang bstun nas thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen chos skyong bzang pos zhus dag mdzad pa'i dpe rgyun yin pas 'khrul pa ga la srid kyang / bu dpe gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par yi ge nor ba'i skyon 'dra yod 'dug pa nas rin spungs sa spyod dbang po'i phyag dpe khungs dag tu byed pa dang bstun 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis 'bru zhus dang / dogs gnas kyi sar sgra'i dpyad pas gtan la 'bebs pa dang / rgya bod kyi tshig rkang re gnyis chad pa snon pa dang bsgyur du bcug /khyad par yal 'dab gnyis pa'i/ bdag gis sgyu ma bsgrubs nas ni/ /zhes 95—1131

sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa'i skad dod rkang pa gzhan rnams ltar kha sgo yang ma'i sdeb sbyor / yal 'dab gsum pa'i/ snying stobs ldan rnams nang na ni/ /zhes sogs khro ka gcig gi byed phyi ma'i rkang pa dang por dga' ba'i char gyi skad dod 'bru gsum chad par thra ya ni zhes pa bcug /yal 'dab drug pa'i/ phyis kyang lam ni de nyid nas/ /zhes sogs sgo ka gcig gi phyed snga ma'i rkang pa dang po'i skad dod chad pa rkang pa phyi ma gsum dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/ yal 'dab brgyad par| mi shes rmongs pa sel ba'i bcom ldan 'das ni snying rje bsod nams la brtson pas/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa gnyis pa nas 'bad pa'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad par a gong du mtshams sbyar/ ma srog med la a nu'i a bcug pa'i dngos bstan pa sh+ya ma zhes pa bcug /yal 'dab dgu pa'i/ nyi zla'i 'od zer nyams byed rin chen rnams dang sa srungs 'od ldan glang po dang /zhes sogs sgo ka gcig gi byed snga ma'i rkang pa dang por 'od zer gyi skad dod yig 'bru bzhi chad par bha na wā rka zhes pa bcug /yal 'dab bcu gnyis par/ de nas dus kyi sa bdag gi/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi phyed phyi ma'i rkang pa dang po'i zhes bya ba'i skad dod yig 'bru gsum chad par nā m+bi ya zhes pa bcugayal 'dab bcu bzhi pa'i/ zad byed rnams kyis mthong bar gyur/ /zhes pa'i mthong bar gyur gyi skad dod chad pa dar+sha sogs yig 'bru drug bcug /yal 'dab sum cu rtsa drug pa'i rgya skad tsa tu ra sogs rkang pa gcig bod skad du ma bsgyur 'dug pa/ yongs su spyod pa bzhi yi ni/ /zhes par bsgyur/ yal 'dab zhe gcig pa'i burtse sogs kyi bod skad rkang pa gcig chad pa/ 'jigs pa rtogs shing khong chud pas/ /zhes par bsgyur/ yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'i/ de dag dregs pas khengs pa dang / /zhes pa'i skad dod chad pa rkang pa gzhan rnams dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/ yal 'dab lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i/ chos min mang ba'i rgyal srid ces sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi skad dod chad pa rkang pa gzhan gnyis dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/ yal 'dab drug cu rtsa drug pa'i/ mkha' dang ral gri 'grogs pa yi/ /zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig chad pa rkang pa gzhan gsum dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/ yal 'dab bdun cu rtsa drug pa'i/ dbe+en par rnam par gnas pa yi/ /zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig chad pa rkang pa gzhan gsum dang mthun par kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/ yal 'dab bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'i/ rang gi gnas su sa bdag de/ /zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig dang / yal 'dab brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'i/ gter ni brgya yis bskor ba de/ /zhes pa'i skad dod rkang pa gcig chad 95—1132

pa rnams 'dar pa ①lo tsā ba'i rnam dpyod las legs par 'thon zhing / yang yal 'dab gnyis pa'i/kye ma sa spyod dpal gyi sdes/ /zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi rgya skad/ yal 'dab drug pa'i nang gi/ de nas gsum pa'i grong khyer bai ḍūr+ya rang bzhin/ /zhes sogs sgo ka gcig dang / yal 'dab zhe brgyad pa'i nang gi/ de yis gsal bar 'di brjod tshe/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis/ yal 'dab re gnyis pa'i nang gi/ sa yi bdag po tshangs pas byin/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis la skad shan sbyar yod pa'i glegs bam rnams sgo mthun par rgya skad mi 'dug pas/ yal 'dab gnyis pa'i sgo ka gcig pu sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/ yal 'dab drug pa'i sgo ka gcig pu sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje/ yal 'dab zhe brgyad pa'i sh+lau ka gnyis po sdeb sbyor kha sgo ta yang ma/ yal 'dab re gnyis pa'i sh+lau ka gnyis po sdeb sbyor rkang bkra'i sgo nas nged rang gis rgya skad du bsgyur/ yal 'dab dgu pa'i nang gi/ me dang mtshungs pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /zhes pa'i rjes su rgya dper te ྾ sogs tshig rkang gcig gi rgya skad ma gtogs bod skad mi 'dug par/gsal bas de rnams bar khyab pas/ /zhes bod skad du bsgyur/ yal 'dab re drug pa'i nang gi/ de la dung gi kha zhes pa/ /khyi ni 'jigs su rung ba yod/ /ces pa 'di rdzogs mtshams su rgya dper pan+d+rasbi sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyi skad dod 'dug pa skad shan sbyar yod pa'i glegs bam tshor bod skad du ma bsgyur bar sa stong bzhag 'dug cing / thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha ba chen po'i phyag dpe skad shan sbyar med pa der yang tshig rkang gnyis po de mi 'dug pas/ lam gnas mtha' dag gang mthong ba/ /gdon mi za bar rnam 'joms pa/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis po 'di rgya dpe las bod skad du bsgyur yod pa slar yang rgya bod kyi yi ge khungs btsun pa'i rigs rnyed na mkhas pa rnams kyis le tshan 'di rnams la dag mi dag gi dbe+ed pa mdzad dgos yod cing / rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams la skad shan sbyar yod pa 'di blo bskyed shin tu che ba 'ong 'dug pas/ par du brkos shing mchan bu rnams brkos tshe glegs bam rdzog por song dogs pas/ rdul khrod du g.yo 'gul med par 'jog pa rnams la mchan kyis dgos pa med cing /blo gros dang brtson par ldan pa rnams kyis mchan bu rnams slar bris chog pa'i dbang du byas te par gyi ma dpe'i sta gon byas pa bzhin/ sa skyong phyag mdzod phrin las rgya mtshos bkod pas khyab par byas nas zhus dag pa rab 'byams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel/ lo tsā ba kun dga' dbang ldan/ par yig pa byams gling pa legs ldan slob mar bcas pa bzhi dang / par mkhan mkhas pa yon bdag tshe ring sogs par mkhan rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pas bsgrims te/ khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug lo'i zla ba lnga 95—1133
